Souma đã nhờ Chika nếm thử đồ ngọt mình làm và đổi lại cậu phải trông chừng cô bạn cùng lớp này.

"Tớ muốn làm thử rất nhiều thứ đấy."

"Ichinose-kun, khi xấu hổ mặt cậu đáng yêu lắm luôn."

Không biết vì sao một Chika đáng yêu, rụt rè lại trêu chọc Souma không thương tiếc. Thanh xuân của họ dần trở nên ngọt ngào hơn!?

Câu chuyện hài hước nhưng không kém phần lãng mạng giữa 'cô nàng thiên sứ tinh nghịch' và 'chàng trai mang ước mơ cháy bỏng' bắt đầu...

title: Na neun Amy reul Saranghae
description:
"Is this how it feels to have a friend?" 

Bibi is obsessed with Peter, the prince of the school. When she spots Amy next to him, she starts to feel jealous. She invites Amy to her house to warn her, but instead takes a liking to the girl. They agree to be friends on the condition that Amy has to help Bibi confess.

**Links:**
- Alternate Official Raw - [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/A001), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/i_love_amy), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/2901012070), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12533803)
- Defunct Official Raw - [Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/ko/comic/detail/6317)

---
Alt. Official English: [Yen Press (vol.)](https://yenpress.com/series/i-love-amy)

title: Ookii Kouhai wa Suki Desu ka?
description: A big junior is set on pampering her senior!? An uneven love comedy!

title: Akuyaku Reijou, Cecilia Sylvie wa Shinitakunai no de Dansou suru koto ni shita
description: I reincarnated as the villainess in an otome game. If it proceeds like the game, what awaits me is either a 'death in anguish' or an 'instant death'. I'll die on any route. At this rate, I'm going to die. If that's the case, I will change my fate! Therefore, I will become a man. But the story takes an unexpected turn when I made a mistake during an event…!! If revealed as a woman = instant death!! I will aim for a peaceful life!!

title: Maydare Tensei Monogatari - Kono Sekai de Ichiban Warui Majo
description: Makia is a noble lady descended from an infamous witch. Thor, a boy who was raised with her and came from another world, is chosen to be the knight of the "savior." The two are forced apart, and to see Thor once again, Makia aims to be the top student at Magic School!

title: Kimi wa Yakamashi Tojite yo Kuchi wo!
description: Hiiragi Tsukino là một cô bạn bị khiếm thính bẩm sinh. Khi cậu ấy chuyển đến trường mới, cậu ấy gặp được một cậu bạn lắm mồm tên Enomoto Taiyo. Tại đây, Tsukino luôn bị xoay tròn bởi những câu chuyện xàm xí của Taiyo bất chấp việc cô không thể nghe được cậu ta nói gì.

title: Tonari no Kuderella wo Amayakashitara, Uchi no Aikagi wo Watasu Koto ni Natta
description:
Katagiri Naomi, a high school student who lived alone for two years, meets a beautiful girl with black hair and blue eyes, who moves into the apartment next door. The girl's name is Yui. It seemed that she really was a noblewoman, and her nickname was "Quderella" because of her nonchalant attitude at school. Naomi knows that Yui doesn't want to depend on others, but she's actually quite naive, so Naomi decides to help her.

"Today what are we having at night... Karaage chicken, huh?"
"That's right because the price of chicken is discounted today"
"I love your fried chicken so I'm really looking forward to it"

title: Izuki-kun wa Tadasaretai
description:
Itsuki-kun has someone he’s interested in — a senior, Ririko-senpai, the president of the disciplinary committee! In his efforts to talk to her, he purposely messes up his uniform, but Ririko is always one step ahead—?! 

A heartwarming, dedicated youth romantic comedy begins!

title: Koko Jidai ni Gomandatta Jou sama to no Dousei Seikatsu wa Igaito Igokochi ga Warukunai
description:
"Này, muốn làm không?"

Một bộ rom-com (hài lãng mạn) kể về cuộc sống chung với một "Nữ hoàng" mang đầy tổn thương — mối quan hệ không hẳn là bạn, nhưng cũng chưa hẳn là người yêu!!

Vào một đêm khuya, Yamamoto — sinh viên đại học kiêm nhân viên bán thời gian tại một cửa hàng tiện lợi — tình cờ gặp lại Hayashi Megumi, bạn cùng lớp cấp ba và cũng là cô gái xinh đẹp nhất lớp ngày ấy.
Hayashi từng được mệnh danh là "Nữ hoàng" nhờ tính cách mạnh mẽ và kiêu ngạo, khiến Yamamoto lúc nào cũng cảm thấy khó gần. Thế nhưng, trong một lần trò chuyện bình thường, anh bất chợt nhìn thấy những vết bầm tím đau đớn trên cổ tay cô.
Sau khi biết được bạn trai cô đang ngược đãi cô, Yamamoto quyết định để Hayashi tạm thời ở lại chỗ mình...!?

title: Jitsu wa Watashi wa
description:
Meet Kuromine Asahi, "the man who can't lie".  On his way home, he just learned an important secret: his crush, Shiragami Youko, is actually a vampire!  Can Asahi actually keep her secret?  
  
It's a fun, clumsy, one of a kind vampire romantic comedy!

title: Uchi no Maid ga Class no Suki na Ko ni Niteiru
description: Eiga, the next head of the prestigious Kujo family, is in a serious predicament. That is, love. He wants to approach Himeka, a girl in his class whom he secretly has feelings for, but because it is his first love, he can't think of a good way to do it... At that moment, he decides to ask for advice from Maria, a maid of the same age who serves the Kujo family...!?

title: Rokudou no Onna-tachi
description:
Tousuke Rokudou is a loser, and everyone knows it. He gets picked on at school, gets snide looks from passersbys, and can only muster up the courage to complain in secret with his equally hapless friends. Looking to turn his life around, he desperately uses an ancestral artifact passed down in his family for generations: a scroll that is capable of subduing all demons. However, in the modern age, it has a different effect: it makes all bad girls fall in love with him.  
  
…And then, things go **ballistic** when he meets the delinquent beast-on-a-girl's-body Ranna Himawari, who hopelessly falls deep for him.  
  
See Rokudou traverse through a school life filled with delinquents, turf wars, backstabbing, and as the song goes, *"Everybody Was Kung Fu Fighting!!!"*

title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
description: These student council members are all over the place! Each one of them is eccentric in their own way—one’s an airhead, one’s just plain frightening, one’s a closet pervert, but all in all, they’re really just weird! And yet it’s everyone’s oddities that makes them endearing and what allows them to create their new normal. Get ready for a slice-of-life manga that’s irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

title: Akebi-chan no Sailor Fuku
description: The setting is Roubai Private Academy, a prestigious girls' middle school in the country. For Akebi Komichi, donning this school's sailor uniform is a dream come true. Her middle school dream life is finally beginning! Verdant open countryside vistas. The slowly flowing time of youth. With a gentle touch, the genius artist Hiro brings you this simple school tale... now enrolling!

title: Osananajimi-tachi ga Ninki Idol ni Natta: Amaama na Kanojo-tachi wa Ore ni Mitsuide Kureteiru
description: Kazuma Kuzuhara, a high school student who doesn't want to work, spent his days having huge amounts of money contributed to him by his childhood friend idols, Yukina and Arisa. However, the excessive love of the two gradually began to harbor madness...? A youth dark love-comedy about living off the contributions of others!

title: Zenbu Kowashite Jigoku de Aishite
description: Kurumi Yoshizawa, the student council president, has excellent grades and an inviting, friendly personality... on the surface at least. In reality, her days are spent struggling against her domineering mother and agonizing over her teachers' expectations. One day, Kurumi reluctantly goes to meet Naoi, her truant classmate, at her homeroom teacher's request to look after her. The situation sours quickly as Naoi sees through Kurumi's facade and makes her animosity clear. On the verge of a meltdown, Kurumi is barely able to stop herself from shoplifting, unaware that she's being recorded by Naoi…

title: Kimi no "Gizaba" ga Mitemitai.
description: One day, Yamato Satsuki saw the jagged teeth behind Aisu Kisaragi's mask. As he approached her, those teeth marked the beginning of a sharp and prickly romantic comedy.

title: Ojousama no Shimobe
description: The story centers around a main character who was raised as a butler from his family's trade, and who one day meets a rich young lady who cannot even change her own clothes, let alone know what to do in the outside world.

title: Kurai Anoko to Shitai Koto
description: Starting his second year of high school, Ren Tabata was determined to get over his loner past and make some new friends. The first person he approached was the girl next to him, Toruko Sasaki, who seemed gloomy and a little intimidating at first, but he couldn't seem to take his eyes off her.

title: Iinchou Desu ga Furyou ni Naru Hodo Koi Shitemasu!
description:
Ryoko Masaki is a serious class president, yet she has decided to become a delinquent to catch the attention of her childhood friend, Masato Todoroki. The reason is that as a discipline committee president, Masato always goes out of his way to remind delinquents about their attire, yet he doesn't pay any mind to the serious Ryoko. That's why Ryoko decided to dye her hair and shorten her skirt, and when Masato saw her, he was devastated and concerned. Is this what Ryoko had hoped for...?

A ridiculous rom-com between a serious class president and a dense discipline committee member!

title: ReLIFE
description:
Kaizaki Arata is a 27-year-old unemployed man who, after quitting his last job after three months, has failed every interview since. Enter Yoake Ryou; representative of the ReLIFE Organization. He offers Kaizaki a pill that changes his appearance to that of his 17-year-old self; thus, Kaizaki becomes the subject of a one-year experiment in which he begins his life as a third year high school student once again.

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Eaststar Adhi Citra (2016)

title: Naze ka S-kyuu Bijotachi no Wadai ni Ore ga Agaru Ken
description: High school girls Sara Himekawa, Rin Kohinata, and Yuna Takamori are called "S-class beauties," admired by everyone for their unparalleled beauty. While the school is abuzz with questions about the mysterious guy that the girls are talking about, Haruya Akasaki, a quiet boy in the class, is feeling anxious. In fact, the subject of the girls' talk is Haruya! He definitely does not want to draw that much attention at school, so he tries to make the girls lose interest in him, but it all backfires and...

title: Yakumo-san wa Ezuke ga Shitai.
description:
When her husband passed away, Yakumo Shuko lost her appetite for life, and with it, her love of cooking. But her neighbor Yamato Shohei brings an end to Shuko's solitary existence.

A high school baseball player living on his own, Shohei has a seemingly bottomless stomach... and this presents a challenge that Shuko is only too happy to accept!

As her days begin to revolve around her secret hobby of feeding Shohei, will Shuko rediscover the happiness life has to offer?
___
**Official English Volumes:** [SQUARE ENIX Manga & Books](https://squareenixmangaandbooks.square-enix-games.com/en-us/series/beauty-and-the-feast)

title: Classroom of the Elite
description: Kodo Ikusei Senior High School, a leading prestigious school with state-of-the-art facilities where nearly 100% of students go on to university or find employment. The students there have the freedom to wear any hairstyle and bring any personal effects they desire. Kodo Ikusei is a paradise-like school, but the truth is that only the most superior of students receive favorable treatment. The protagonist Kiyotaka Ayanokoji is a student of D-class, which is where the school dumps its "inferior" students in order to ridicule them. For a certain reason, Kiyotaka was careless on his entrance examination, and was put in D-class. After meeting Suzune Horikita and Kikyo Kushida, two other students in his class, Kiyotaka's situation begins to change. Based on the popular light novel series of the same name.

title: Kanojo wo Dere saseru Houhou wo, Shourai Kekkon suru Ore dake ga Shitteiru
description:
Q: Why did you choose this high school?
A: Because my future wife is enrolling here.

When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past. Standing before me was Yuki, my future wife, wearing a school uniform. In the original timeline, we wouldn't meet until we became adults and eventually got married, so we're still strangers for now. But I know that she distrusts people, has no friends, and spends her school days alone. I also know she'll deeply regret that time in the future. So this time, I'm going to rewrite her youth. "How do you know my secret!?" "Because we're husband and wife... in the future."

title: Kawaikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Nattekuremasu ka?
description:
After cleaning the Calligraphy Club room one afternoon, Kiryuu Keiki found a love letter addressed to him on the club's desk. Eager at the possibility of finally getting a girlfriend, he opens the envelope only to find the words, "I like you" along with a pair of the sender's panties.   
  
With only these panties as evidence, Keiki narrows down the identity to the four girls who helped him clean the club room that day: Tokihara Sayuki, the lazy third-year president of Calligraphy Club; Koga Yuika, a library committee member of foreign descent; Nanjou Mao, Keiki's slightly tsundere fellow classmate; and most awkwardly, Kiryuu Mizuha, Keiki's clean freak of a younger sister. Among at least three of these girls, Keiki believes is the one who left him the letter and their panties so with determination in his heart, he sets out to uncover which of these seemingly unorthodox ladies will become his girlfriend!

title: Senryuu Shoujo
description:
Yukishiro Nanako is a cute, cheerful high school girl with one peculiar trait: instead of verbal communication, she writes senryu (a type of haiku) poems to relay her thoughts. Together with ex-delinquent Busujima Eiji, they are budding freshmen of the school's Literature Club.  
  
Even though Nanako doesn't talk, with the power of senryu, the adorable pair has no problem enjoying their fun school-life through the tune of 5-7-5 syllables.  


---

title: Kishuku Gakkou no Juliet
description: Inuzuka Romio và Juliet Persia đang hẹn hò, song vì xuất thân từ hai đất nước đối địch nên họ không thể công khai mối quan hệ dù học chung một trường. Nhưng tình hình đã có sự thay đổi nhờ Hasuki - người bạn thơ ấu đem lòng thương Inuzuka!

title: Anemone wa Netsu o Obiru
description: Nagisa Ootsuki shed her former self out of shame from failing her highschool entrance exams. On her first day in her new highschool, who does she meet but the girl who made her fail the exam! How does Nagisa deal with these complicated emotions?

title: Gyakkou Shita Akuyaku Reijou wa, Naze ka Maryoku o Ushinattanode Shinsou no Reijou ni Narimasu
description:
She was once known for her powerful magic — the very reason she was chosen to be the crown prince's fiancée. But when a "saintess" appeared, fear of losing everything drove her to make desperate, reckless decisions. Accused of committing evil acts against the saintess, her engagement was broken off and she was exiled to a monastery. On her way into exile, she was ambushed by bandits... and killed.

But death wasn't the end. When she opened her eyes, she had gone back three years into the past! Yet her body was now frail, and her magical power had all but vanished. This time, she resolves to choose a different path — to pursue happiness, even if it means breaking off the engagement herself. The twist? The crown prince refuses to let her go! And even more shocking... a mysterious dark spirit, one never before seen in this world, chooses her as its master!

title: Otaku Datte Gal to Koi Shitai
description: Affection Level of each Gyarus for a single Otaku. Who will our otaku-kun chose as his girl?

title: Kibishii Onna Joushi ga Koukousei ni Modottara Ore ni Deredere Suru Riyuu: Ryou Kataomoi no Yarinaoshi Koukousei Seikatsu
description: Average company worker Shimono spends his days constantly being helped and scolded by his superior and section chief Kamijou Touka. One day, he finds himself having traveled back in time to his high school years. He sees this as a chance to aggressively approach the section chief a second time around, only to find out that very woman had turned into a girl constantly acting lovey-dovey towards him!

title: Ore wa Shiranai Uchi ni Gakkouichi no Bishoujo wo Kudoiteita Rashii: Baito-saki no Soudan Aite ni Ore no Omoibito no Hanashi wo Suru to Kanojo wa Nazeka Terehajimeru
description: The protagonist begins to get involved with the most beautiful girl in school, who is famous for her cold attitude, and slowly becomes attracted to her. That protagonist finds himself in a consulting relationship with a plain girl in glasses at his part-time job. He doesn't realize that the girl he is consulting is the same girl he is in love with, and just keeps telling her about his growing feelings while continuing to fall in love with her. The heroine realizes that the person he is in love with is herself, and although she is embarrassed by the protagonist’ feelings, she gradually becomes attracted to him.

title: Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki
description:
Yoi is a girl who is called "prince" by those around her and treated like a hero in a girls' manga.
Then she meets Ichimura, who is also called "prince." He calls her "beautiful" and saves her from getting tangled up with a drunk at a convenience store, and the two quickly get close!
Is this encounter fate? Or is it bad luck?!
The story of a man and a woman, both called "princes," begins now!

title: Houkago no Goumon Shoujo
description: Sau nhiều năm đen đủi với các cô gái, Ishimaru Daito chỉ mong được tận hưởng cuộc sống cao trung của mình bên một cô bạn gái bình thường và dễ thương. Tuy nhiên, sau khi thua một trò chơi trước hai tiền bối mới của mình là Sasahara Kiyoka và Tomochika Asami, cậu buộc phải tham gia câu lạc bộ <Nghiên Cứu Chủ Nghĩa Nhân Văn> thực chất lại là một câu lạc bộ Nghiên Cứu Tra Tấn. Liệu Ishimaru có được cuộc sống cao trung bình thường mà cậu hằng mong muốn?

title: Chika Idol wo Kage de Sasaeru Ore
description: Kageyama, an unremarkable boy, secretly receives a message from gal classmate Natsukawa, saying, "Meet me at the usual karaoke place after school." He goes to karaoke with her alone. There, Kageyama reveals something he had been asked by Natsukawa to show her.

title: Ryuusa no Ori
description:
The Solminati Academy is a prestigious school that harbors the dreams and hopes of ambitious students.

A young man named Nozomu Bountis entered the school for his lover's dream. As time went on, his powers deadlocked and could no longer advance, and his grades fell. Eventually, his lover was stolen by his at-the-time best friend. Heartbroken and lost on what to do next, he focused even harder on his training. 

Eventually, he meets an old woman, who triggers the catalyst to his growth. The future is uncertain but gradually, his world changes.  
  
---
  
[Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n7408y/)

title: Daikenja no Manadeshi ~Bougyo Mahou no Susume~
description:
Two childhood friends born in a remote village.

One of the boys, Alfi, was good at everything, and grew up as a handsome genius  with four attributes of magic, and entered the elite magic school as a scholarship student. On the other hand, the other boy, Reese, was a seemingly mediocre and naughty boy who could only use defensive magic for beginners, but in fact he was discovered by a rare Sage and had been educated as a gifted child since he was a child!

And Reese enrolls in the elite magic school with one extremely defensive magic, brilliantly destroying the common sense of childhood friends, teachers and students! An uncaring and selfish commoner pushes the aristocrats away and runs up the school caste at explosive speed!

title: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shite shimatta... Zettai Zetsumei! Hametsu Sunzen Hen
description:
As she was busy bullying the honour student with the power of light magic, Maria Campbell, along with her friends, the fifteen year old daughter of a Duke Katarina Claes suddenly hit her head and remembered her previous life.   
  
Thanks to those memories, Katarina realized that she was actually the villainess of an otome game that she had played in her previous life, with a struggle to avoid the destruction flags that would lead to her doom awaiting her…  
  
Except, there's not even a year left before her destruction end!? The story of Katarina, who is on the verge of her demise, begins now…!  


* **Note:** This is a "What-If" story to the original *[Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shite shimatta...](https://mangadex.org/title/22637/otome-game-no-hametsu-flag-shika-nai-akuyaku-reijou-ni-tensei-shite-shimatta)* where Katarina receives memories of the real world from the moment the otome game starts when she's 15, and not from her childhood like in the o

title: Taoreta Fujin wo Sukutta Gohoubi wa, Musume no Bijin Futago to no Otsukiai deshita.
description:
Kirishima Ao encounters a collapsed woman on the street. Having learned CPR from his father, Ao rushes to her aid and does everything he can to help. Thanks to his actions, the woman survives—and her daughters turn out to be the strikingly beautiful twin sisters in his class, Kotobuki Yuzuki and Kotobuki Hikari. To express their gratitude, Yuzuki and Hikari begin searching for Ao.

"I'll definitely make you fall for me."
"I'll make sure you come to like me."

title: Hana ni Arashi
description: Unbeknownst to their friends and classmates, Nanoha and Chidori are dating. Watch as they try to keep their relationship secret!

title: Isekai-gaeri no Yuusha wa, Dungeon ga Shutsugen Shita Genjitsu Sekai de, Influencer ni Natte Kane o Kasegimasu!
description: One day, an ordinary high school student is transferred to another world. He raises his level in the other world, successfully defeats the Demon King, and saves the world! With his strongest status, he decided to return to his own world; however, in the world to which he returns, a new "dungeon" has appeared.

title: My Stepsister Who Tells Me to Die Every Day Tries to Hypnotize Me So I would Fall for Her...!
description:
"Oh, you'll love me! And kiss me."
 
My step-sister who is the same age as me treats me like garbage. This beauty, admired by everyone around her, shows her true ugly nature only in front of me. But upon learning that she loves me so much that she'd even use hypnosis to make me fall for her, what exactly am I supposed to do!? Shizuku asks for one embarrassing demand after the other while moving a 5-yen coin like a pendulum. As her brother, and as a man, which path should I take...!?

title: Yuumei VTuber no Ani Dakedo, Nazeka Ore ga Yuumei ni Natteita
description:
Tôi có đứa em kế tên là Shiojiri Isuzu, nhỏ là  hikikomori và là một brocon thứ thiệt. Lúc ở nhà, nhỏ là một cô em gái rất dễ thương và thường hay bám tôi và nói “Em hổng thể sống nếu thiếu anh được đâu!” Isuzu thực ra là một Vtuber nổi tiếng với 1.9 triệu người theo dõi  tên là ‘Isuzu Wine’. Nhỏ đó là một người mới nổi và có tương lai đầy triển vọng, và rồi đã vươn lên vị trí này sau khi gia nhập một công ti Vtuber lớn chỉ trong vòng 6 tháng thôi đấy. 
Mặt khác, tôi chỉ là một gã u ám, bị cô bạn cùng lớp là Kisogawa Kusumi chế giễu và xem tôi như “một thằng đần độn xấu trai”. Nhưng rồi một ngày nọ, Isuzu quên tắt stream và cuộc trò chuyện giữa tôi và em ấy đã bị ghi hình lại. Isuzu, là một nhân vật tiểu quỷ gian xảo trên stream, được tiết lộ thực chất là một cô gái tốt bụng và là một brocon, đang cố gắng stream vì nhà nghèo. Tôi đây sẽ cho mọi người biết mình  là một người anh hiền lành của Isuza, và cũng sẽ ra mắt với tư cách là một nam Vtuber! Trong khi đó, cô ả Kusumi đã bỏ rơi tôi

title: Irozuku Monochrome
description:
Isshiki falls in love with a maiden who is pure and innocent, but he has been possessed by Asmodeus, the demon of lust. The demon tries to arouse Isshiki by stimulating the sexual desires of the girls around him in every possible way. However, in order to exorcise the demon and avoid the girls' suspicions, Isshiki must never get excited, no matter how lewd they may act!

"How can I stand this...!"

title: Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Moto Kanodatta
description:
A certain boy and girl in middle school became lovers, flirted with each other, disagreed on trivial things, became more frequently irritated with each other rather than excited... and ended up breaking up on graduation. And so, the two of them, Irido Mizuto and Ayai Yume, wound up meeting each other in the most unexpected fashion.

"Isn't it obvious that I'm the elder brother."
"Isn't it obvious that I'm the elder sister."

The children of the partner of their parent's remarriage was their ex-lover!? The former couple, mindful of their parent's feelings, decided on a 'sibling rule' where the one takes conscious of the other as the opposite sex loses, but— When they encounter each other in the bathroom, commute to and from school together... along with the memories of the past and living under the same roof, just how do they disregard each other!?
___
- [Official Twitter](https://twitter.com/tsurekano)
- [Light Novel](https://j-novel.club/series/my-stepmom-s-daughter-is-my-ex) - Englis

title: Tookago ni Menhera ni Naru Gyaru
description: This is a work that depicts the 10 days until the heroine "Kurusu" who has never fallen in love before, falls in love and becomes Menhera.

title: Akuyaku Reijou Route ga Nai Nante, Dare ga Itta no?
description:
I reincarnated into the world of an otome game as the villainess, "Ophelia". I thought I'd be able to enjoy a peaceful school life, but to my dismay, I found myself subjected to constant harassment at the hands of the wicked, vindictive heroine; and to top it all off, I'm plunging headlong into the dreaded Bad Ending — hold up, as if I'd meekly submit to such a fate! If that's how it’s going to be, I'll tap into the top secret "cheats" known only to those who've played the game and carve out the "Villainess Route" of my fantasies!! But for some unfathomable reason, the capture targets seem to be doting on me far more aggressively than in the original story...?  

---
- [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0411fu/)

title: Kimi no Risou no Maid ni Naru!
description:
Để đáp lại lòng tốt của chủ nhân, mục tiêu của cô là trở thành một maid lý tưởng!

Một bộ romcom với nội dung khá cổ điển nhưng hứa hẹn chứa một cả tấn đường bắt đầu!

Mặc dù đã nhập học cấp 3 được vài tháng, Renya Nijou vẫn chưa hề có bạn bè hay bạn gái mà chỉ dành cả ngày cô đơn một mình. Nhưng một ngày, anh chứng kiến cô bạn xinh đẹp nhất lớp Maya bị bắt cóc bởi những người mặc đồ đen (không phải Conan:))) ) hay nói đúng hơn là cô bị bán bởi cha mẹ của mình để trả khoản nợ khổng lồ, vậy nên Renya quyết định giúp cô ấy. Như để trả ơn. Maya quyết định sẽ làm Maid của Renya...?

title: Sekimen Shinaide Sekime-san
description: I'm the only one who knows the true face of the popular girl, Sekime-san! Thus begins the romantic comedy between my overly shy girlfriend and me!

title: Itoko no Ko
description:
His more-than-friends, less-than-lovers cousin is so cute that he could die!!!!? 

Nozomu is a boy staying at his uncle's house over summer vacation. In the countryside, where there are no convenience stores, or any busses even, the boy has a problem. That problem is his younger cousin, Sou! He's being led around by this tanned, energetic girl day after day and can't show her the dignity befitting his older age! On top of that, whether intentional or not, he’s getting flustered by Sou's inviting demeanor. Eventually, Nozomu couldn't take his eyes off Sou and is falling more and more under her spell...!!? With a "cousin" like this, his reason is having a hard time hanging on!
___
**Additional Links:**
- **Alt Official Raw:** [KADOCOMI](https://comic-walker.com/detail/KC_004640_S?episodeType=latest)
- [Official X](https://x.com/itokonoko0804)

title: Yumemiru Danshi wa Genjitsushugisha
description:
Wataru Sajou, who is deeply in love with his beautiful classmate Aika Natsukawa, is continuing to approach her without getting discouraged while having dreams about their mutual love. However one day he woke up thinking, “I am not really fit to be together with someone as good as her, huh…” Upon realizing this, Wataru started keeping an appropriate distance towards her, much to Aika’s surprise. “Could it be that he hates me now…? ”Did his intentions slip by her because she was getting impatient after arriving at the wrong conclusion!? This is the start of a romcom revolving around two people who just cant get their feelings across and both think their love is unrequited!

[Official English Light Novel](https://monogatari-novels.com/collections/the-dreaming-boy-is-a-realist)

title: Ano Oni Kyoushi ga Boku no Ane ni Narundesuka?
description: A boy is initially overjoyed at the news of him having an older sister, due to his father remarrying to a woman who has a daughter. That is, until he finds out that his new sister is actually his school's strict PE teacher, Shina. With his father going off to live with his new wife, the boy will live alone with his new sister. In their new life together, the boy finds out that Shina at home is completely different from Shina at work: clumsy, scared of insects, and kind.

title: The Golden-Haired Summoner
description:
I thought I was dead, but when I woke up, I was reincarnated as a nobleman's daughter?! The only thing I did in the seventeen years of my first life was studying. Now that I'm alive again, I won't live just to study! The second life of an ordinary middle school girl with a slightly strange personality, Jeanie Crowell, begins an unstoppable journey on this continent!  
  


---

title: Watashi no Koto Suki ja Nakatta no ka yo!?
description: Okabe quyết tâm sẽ tập trung vào việc học ở trường, nhưng không hiểu vì sao, các cô gái xung quanh cậu lại liên tục đưa ra những tín hiệu khó hiểu…

title: Choppiri Ecchi na Sanshimai Demo, Oyomesan ni Shitekuremasuka?
description: Our young protagonist faces the greatest challenge of his time... babysitting and rehabilitating three massive pervert sisters. Their rich father has given him the arduous task of turning them into three young, refined ladies.

title: Kakkoii Onnanoko to 12-centi no Yakusoku
description:
Tomoaki Kanba admired his boyish childhood friend, Ibuki Tachibana, and promised to become "more cool" than her. However, four years have passed, and Ibuki has grown up to be an even more handsome girl! Their relationship is as unchanged as a 12cm height difference that cannot be filled...?

The curtain rises on a pure love story about a cool girl who is sorely in love with a boy who wants to be cool!-

---

Serialization of the Twitter webcomic *[A Story About Becoming Cooler Than the Cool Girl](https://mangadex.org/title/d0407445-b80d-4854-9f12-c8227f94cba6/)*.

title: Yuujin Character wa Taihen desu ka?
description: My first impression of Ryuuga was “This is the kind of protagonist you’d see in something like an anime.” Then, that thought soon changed into conviction. First of all, this guy almost never talks about his past. Also, he frequently slips out of class. As soon as he comes back, he gets extremely tired, blood comes out from his lips, the sleeves and cuffs of his uniform get torn, and so forth. Furthermore, there’s always beauties that are surrounding Ryuuga. The one who’s like an idol within the school, Yukimiya Shiori. The cool expert of the sword, Aogasaki Rei. The mysterious transfer student, Elmira McCartney. It’s very tiring for me when these people appear in front of Ryuuga. I have to frantically make a fuss by saying things like “H, hey Ryuga! How did you get acquainted with Yukimiya!”, “W, why did the beautiful swordswoman Aogasaki come to the classroom to specifically meet Ryuga?!”, or “E, E, Elmira! What is it that you see in Ryuga!” …So why am I doing this? That’s because I,

title: Momogusa-san ga Monogusa Sugiru!!
description: Chuyện tình chàng giúp việc và nàng lười!

title: Saotome Senshu, Hitakakusu
description:
Strong girls need some loving too!  
  
Satoru Tsukishima has just been confessed to by fellow high school boxing club member Yae Saotome, who is currently the Kanto region's Female Featherweight Champion, and her efforts singlehandedly put the town of Umesaki on the map. Overjoyed at first, Satoru isn't able to accept her feelings as he believes that she should be focusing on boxing instead. Yae's championship will soon be on the line, the entire school is counting on her to someday represent Tokyo in the Olympics. It also doesn't help that he's nowhere near as skilled as she is, conflicted by the thought of a rising star being in a relationship with someone as average as him.  
  
But when their coach finds out about the confession, Satoru is assigned as Yae's trainer so the two can secretly date and spend more time together while also engaging in club activities. However, if anyone finds out about the two, it will mean the end of their relationship. With this in mind, their pure and

title: D-Frag!
description: Kazama Kenji likes to believe he is something of a delinquent. Moreover, others seem to like to agree that he is. Of course, Kenji's gang finds their way to a group of four not-so-normal girls - Chitose, Sakura, Minami and Roka - and all at once, whatever reputation he may have, is nothing compared to the outrageous behavior of the girls. Shanghaied into joining their club, what will happen to his everyday life from that point on?

title: Jishou Kanojo no Kouhai ga Iiyottekuru Hanashi
description:
A 5-part one-shot about a beautiful girl flirting with her self-proclaimed boyfriend.

---
**Links:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Pocket Magazine](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/episode/4855956445050908077)

title: Seton Academy: Join the Pack!
description: Seton Academy, a school full of animals where, thanks to population decline, there are fewer humans than any other creature. Mazama Jin, an animal hater and the only human male in his class, falls in love with Hino Hitomi, the only female human, the moment he lays eyes on her. However he soon finds himself entangled with various other creatures after he reluctantly joins the 'pack' of Lanka the wolf, the only other member of her pack.

title: Wàn Zhā Cháo Huáng
description:
Why torment scumbags for just a moment when you can do so forever? Join Su LuXia as she transmigrates into countless worlds with her ‘Supporting Female Character’s Counterattack System’ to unleash vengeance upon the deplorable male and female leads using a variety of tactics! 

Su LuXia: "The only thing that brings me comfort is the tears of remorse from scumbag men and the agonizing groans of despicable women who can't get what they want." 

System: "Has My Esteemed Host learnt to reel back her vengeful spirit? Nope, I guess not."

title: Tsukkomi-machi no Machino-san
description:
"Machino-san from the swim team always drops by the Domino Club's room, where I'm the only member, before her practice starts. She constantly fires off jokes in a sketch-style conversation, and I can't help but fire back. Back-and-forth banter, teasing words. Conversations full of nonsense... and maybe something more. Every day passed in a flash, yet those summer days felt like they could last forever in that clubroom. But when this summer ends, the dominoes between us will all begin to fall, at once."

"Why did you suddenly start narrating a light-novel-style summary, Machino-san?"

title: Ota-kun ni dake Yasashisugiru Ayame-san
description:
In a “shitty rural” school where simply being an otaku makes you a target of bullying, Ota, a boy who loves idols, is inexplicably doted on by Ayame-senpai, a girl renowned for her beauty. 
Ota, who is routinely subjected to violence from his classmates and insulted by his parents as a disgrace to the family, and lives a miserable life. Understandably, he is confused by Ayame-senpai's sudden advances.
What exactly is she thinking? A “terrifying romantic comedy” unfolds, with a mixture of sweetness and horror!

title: Hanashi ga Susumu Goto ni Me no Kuma ga Kieteiku Onnanoko
description: This is a story about the rescue of a girl who has not slept for many years and who has dark circles under her eyes.

title: Jishou F-Rank no Oniisama ga Game de Hyouka sareru Gakuen no Chouten ni Kunrin suru Sou desu yo?
description: Shishio Academy is a prestigious, the best school in Japan, in which only the elite of such fields as study, sports, pedigree can study. But in reality it is a school of principles of “devouring the weak by the strong”, where everything is measured by the results of the games. This is a massacre in which only a definite winner can survive. Guren is a legend of the shadow world, conquering and invincible, and at the same time he wants to start a normal, carefree life. He fails the entrance exams to the academy on purpose, therefore, following his results, he qualifies as the lowest grade F. However, after reuniting with his younger sister Karen, the situation changes dramatically. And when his sister is in danger, he shows his true abilities!

title: Trinity Seven - 7-Nin no Masho Tsukai
description: Everyday is a normal day in the small town where Kasuga Arata lives. However, everything changed on the day of the Black Sun, and following it, a magician appears before him. The Black Sun caused the Breakdown Phenomenon which destroyed the town where he lives. Because of this, his normal life was artificially reconstructed by a Grimoire that his childhood friend had left. Just what is the purpose of the magician coming to the town? What will he do with the Grimoire's keepsake?

title: Yane no Shita no Artemis
description:
A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!?

Poor university student Sanosuke Saraki unexpectedly reunites with his admired genius classmate, Koharu Kobachi, at his part-time job back at his old school. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who has repeated her second year in a row...! Saraki's mission is to "make Koharu graduate by the end of the year."

title: Himeno-chan ni Koi wa Mada Hayai
description:
Though 4th year elementary school student Aikawa Himeno has feelings for her classmate Ouji-kun, then why can't she properly express her feelings? Is she going too fast? Is he unable to pick up her cues? The story of a slightly precocious love comedy. ♪  


---

title: Choppiri Toshiue demo Kanojo ni Shite Kuremasu ka?
description:
One day, the high school student, Kaoru Momota, saved the baby-face, big-boobed JK, Orihara Hime, who was being harassed on the train. It was love at first sight. However, this JK had a secret; she actually was a 27-year-old OL.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Gangan ONLINE](https://www.ganganonline.com/title/63)

title: Chiisakute Kawaii Bungeibu no Chiteki na Senpai o, Hiza no Ue ni Nosetara Mainichi Suwattekuru you ni natta
description:
One day, the chairs in the Literature Club were lent out to other clubs, leaving only a single chair behind.
Kakeru and Yuzu began a lighthearted argument, each trying to yield the remaining seat to the other.
Each wanted the other to sit more than themselves. Because of their mutual kindness, neither would back down, resulting in a stalemate—until finally, Yuzu’s opinion won out, and Kakeru ended up sitting in the chair alone.
Kakeru felt guilty being the only one sitting, but right then, he had a flash of inspiration.

“Since I'm the one sitting in the chair, if I become the chair and let Yuzu-senpai sit on my lap… wouldn't that work?”

…Or so he thought.

title: Maji de Tsukiau 15-fun Mae
description: Growing up in the same apartment complex, Yuuki and Natsuha have known each other forever. They’ve been friends for so long that everyone just assumes they’re a couple! But as they both approach the final stretch of high school, they get a silly, totally-not-serious idea— what if they actually started dating? What a ridiculous thing to say! Unless…?

title: Danshi Kinsei Game Sekai de Ore ga Yaru Beki Yuiitsu no Koto - Yuri no Aida ni Hasamaru Otoko Toshite Tensei Shite Shimaimashita
description:
"Everything for the score"—biệt danh "Esco"—là một kiệt tác nổi tiếng trong giới game bách hợp. Một chàng trai sau khi tái sinh vào thế giới này đã thấy mình vào vai Sanjo Hiro, một cái tên nổi tiếng với biệt danh "Kẻ ngáng đường yuri".

Hiro là một nhân vật phiền toái với một kết cục là bị trừ khử bất kể là trong tuyến truyện nào của game. Để tránh gặp phải tình huống tương tự, cậu trai của ta bắt đầu luyện tập và tìm kiếm một con đường thoát thân—nhưng vì lý do nào đó, các nữ chính cứ bu lấy anh ấy như thể anh là nhân vật chính...!?

"Tôi không muốn một câu chuyện hài lãng mạn harem đâu! Tôi muốn bách hợp cơ! Làm ơn chỉ bách hợp thôi!"

title: Tsukushitagari na Uchi no Yome ni Tsuite Derete mo Ii ka
description: There's the flower of Takamine High, Hanae Riko, whom every boy admires. Then, there's the plain boy, Niiyama Minato, who got proposed to by that most beautiful girl in school. Without knowing what's happening, the curtain on their newlywed life rises! For some reason, my bride, who's too cute and happily follows me around everywhere, refuses to leave my side...

title: Multiverse no Watashi, Koishite Ii desu ka? (Pre-Serialization)
description:
If things had gone differently, we might never have met, you and I.

Would you have any regrets if you never said "I love you"?

Exploring endless possibilities in this multiverse rom-com one-shot!

title: Takane no Hana wa Midaresaki
description: Anh chàng trung bình main nam romcom cảm nắng chị hoa khôi xinh đẹp, thông minh, các thứ các thứvà chỉ biết ngắm nhìn từ phía xa... Nhưng rồi một hôm, anh main đã bắt gặp một cảnh tượng của chị main khiến anh ấy nghi ngờ nhân sinh quan?! Chị main sẽ phản ứng ra sao? Hai người đã va vào đời nhau như thế đấy. Vậy kết quả sẽ là dư lào đây?!

title: Osananajimi BIGLOVE
description:
I once had a childhood friend who was an angel. However, when we met again, several years later, she had become a gyaru. 

A yuri story between two childhood friends.

title: Chiyo Kuno the Psychic
description: The story of Kuno Chiyo, a tsundere with the power to see the future, and her friend Kishida who likes her.

title: Otome Kaijuu Caraméliser
description: Afflicted by a "mysterious illness," high school first year Kuroe has spent her entire life avoiding socializing with others. However, after coming into contact with Minami Arata, the most popular boy in school, something changes— and Kuroe's true powers are unleashed…

title: Koutsugou Semi-Friend
description: Kuruma Suuna, a gloomy and socially awkward girl, begins her high school dorm life only to discover her new roommate, Hamanasu Ruka, flirting with another girl!

title: Undead-san no Bukiyou na Seishun
description: One day after summer break, the perfect young lady, Sana Tsukuyomi, showed up at school as an undead. As a school health committee member, I, Hiyoshi, ended up helping her navigate her daily life, despite her movements being as stiff as a corpse’s… A school romantic comedy featuring a heroine who’s both scary and cute!

title: #Gyaru to Gyaru no Yuri
description: When flashy high school gals Yua and Reina casually decide—on a whim—to date each other for a year, their spontaneous choice kicks off a wild and heart-thumping ride of laughs, love, and gyaru energy!

title: Ochikobore Datta Ani ga Jitsuha Saikyou ~Shijou Saikyou no Yuusha wa Tensei-shi, Gakuen de Mujikaku ni Musou Suru~
description:
Eugene, a hero, is forcibly reincarnated by the demon king Venomzard. In a world far in the future, he becomes a noble boy named Julius. Freed from his "hero" mission, Julius decides to enjoy his second life and his school life. However, his brother, Gaias, mocks him, and his parents and teachers consider him a failure. Having been reincarnated with the immense power of his previous life, Julius unknowingly becomes a warrior...!
___
[Original webnovel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8910gh/)

title: It Shows on Your Face, Ichijou-San
description:
Mahiro seems to admire Ichijou-san from afar. She's the most popular student in the class and belongs to a very prestigious family. Despite all this, Ichijou-san treats everybody nicely and is equally kind to everyone. But she harbors a secret that Mahiro unexpectedly discovered— she's a vampire! She claims she's not interested in human blood, though there appear to be moments when she's barely able to conceal her innermost desires...
A bloodsucking, heart-throbbing love-comedy about a young lady vampire!

title: Assassin's Pride
description: In the world where only the aristocrats have the power to fight the monster – mana. A youth named Kufa is dispatched as a tutor to find Mareida's talent, a nuisance girl born in a duke's family. If she is not talented, assassinate her. That, is the dark side of his task.

title: Uso Kareshi demo Ii kara Tonikaku Shitai Mashiro-chan
description:
Mashiro Naomoto wants to have a taste of romance and even get to try lewd things, now that she has become a high school student.

However, she has low self-esteem and as a result of lacking confidence in herself, she began to think that it's probably impossible for her. Right at that moment, to her surprise a handsome male classmate named Oosagi-kun confesses to her. Mashiro starts to suspect that his confession must be some sort of punishment game, but her own desire to do lewd stuff wins over it and as a result, she does the opposite and makes a move on him... it's a case of sexual desire winning over suspicion!?

*Source: Comic-Meteor*
___
* [Twitter](https://twitter.com/nekomattaaaaan/status/1851462156996551019) (Preview) *Posted with the caption: Doushitemo Sukebe Shitai JK no Manga Kakimashita (どうしてもスケベしたいJKの漫画描きました) "I drew a manga about a high school girl who wants to do perverted stuff no matter what"*

title: Kasane-gasane no Hatsukoi desu ga
description: Hassaku Tamao came back to his hometown to teach and fulfill a promise he made when he was younger. However, he's not the only one who remembers a promise he made...

title: Mia-ga dorawatda
description:
Five years ago, my first love, Cha Mia, disappeared. Now, she has reappeared before me, completely changed.
An unexpected reunion at the police station… and she turns out to be a freshman at the same university?

The story of two people who thought it was over begins again on campus... or so I thought, but she still insists on letting the past go.

title: Demi-chan wa Kataritai
description:
Succubus, Dullahan and Vampire. They are known as demi-humans, or "demi"s and are slightly different than the average human. They have lived alongside humans for ages under persecution. However, in recent years, they have become accepted as members of society. This manga follows a high school biology teacher who has a great interest in demis and his interaction with the various demis in his school, each with their own cute problems.

[INKR Comics](https://comics.inkr.com/title/307-interviews-with-monster-girls?utm_source=mgd)

title: Tomodachi-nchi no Nee-chan ga Kowakute Ii Hito
description:
Satomi Yuuki (Trai thẳng lớp 10) có một nỗi khổ tâm thầm kín. Đó là bà chị gái của thằng bạn thân - gặp nhau khi sang nhà thằng bạn chơi - lại đáng sợ một cách kinh khủng khiếp!!
Tóc tai thì nhuộm màu "cháy phố", khuyên tai đeo chi chít, đã thế hễ cứ chạm mắt là bả lại lườm cháy cả mặt. Dù ngày nào cũng sống trong lo sợ, nhưng cậu nhận ra hình như bà chị này còn có một "nhân cách bí ẩn" khác thì phải...?

title: Chigau Miyahara Omae Janai!
description: Câu chuyện diễn biến xung quanh Arima - một cậu bạn sơ trung phải lòng một bạn nữ cùng lớp tên Yukihira. Nhưng mỗi khi cậu ấy chuẩn bị tiến gần hơn với Yukihara thì cô bạn thuở nhỏ Miyahara lại bất chợt xuất hiện lúc nào chẳng hay làm cho mọi người lầm tưởng rằng Arima đang nhắm đến cô bạn đó hơn là Yukihara.

title: Ore no Ichizu o Jama Suru Aitsu
description:
Osanai Wakaba, a fifth-grade boy, is in love with his homeroom teacher! To become a man worthy of his teacher, he pretends to be more mature than he really is! But his childhood friend, Wakanouchi Kai, begins teasing him after he reveals his feelings for his teacher. Kai has feelings for him too... and she's trying to catch is attention by flirting!

Thus begins a "double unrequited love" romcom, featuring a boy struggling against the seductive antics of his childhood friend!

title: Onanie Master Kurosawa
description:
Onani means masturbation. And that's what this guy is good at. Every day after school, he sneaks into the mostly unused girls bathroom on the 3rd floor, and masturbates. Until one day, when he's caught by a bullied girl with a hidden agenda.  
This is a story of mistakes, redemption, and the choices made in between. It contains the worst and best of the human condition.

title: Sanpakugan-chan no Ohanashi
description:
**Trivia Notes:**
Sanpaku (三白) is a Japanese term meaning "three whites". It is generally referred to in English as "sanpaku eyes" and refers to eyes in which the white space above or below the iris is visible.

**Link:** 
Alternate Official Raw - [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/2071786/series/34490)
Alternate [Denpa Official Release](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08845NW9B)

title: Jijyou wo Shiranai Tenkousei ga Guigui Kuru
description:
Akane Nishimura is a shy and gloomy elementary school girl with an unfounded dire reputation in her class due to her appearance. Taiyou Takada is a transfer student in her class who came from a small countryside school, and who is fascinated by the aspects of Nishimura that her classmates use to pick on her, finding her "darkness" cool beyond compare. Through the unbridled and fundamental joy Takada finds in being her friend, Nishimura starts realizing that being herself is not as bad as she thinks.
___
* [Alt English: Comikey](https://comikey.com/comics/my-clueless-first-friend-manga/289/)

title: Doushitara Osananajimi no Kanojo ni Naremasu ka!?
description: High schoolers Minami Ikoma and Yuzu Makita have been childhood friends since grade school. Since their parents are friends, they have always been together. However, as Minami sees her friend get confessed to, feelings in her own heart start to sprout.

title: Owari no Seraph
description: One day, a mysterious virus appeared on Earth which killed every infected human over the age of 13. At the same time, vampires emerged from the world's dark recesses and enslaved mankind. Enter Hyakuya Yuuichirou, a young boy, who along with the rest of the children from his orphanage, are treated as livestock by the vampires. Even in captivity, Yuuichirou dreams big. He dreams of killing vampires. He dreams of killing them all.

title: Okorippoi Gal wo Date ni Sasotte Mita
description: I asked an angry gal out on a date.

title: I'm in Love with the Older Girl Next Door
description: There's this beautiful, bubbly, film-loving girl who's three years older than me: her name's Shia, and she lives right next door! I'm madly in love with her, and I needed some way to see her! I settled on asking her for movie recommendations, and now I get to meet her every Wednesday! I want to know more about her, and tell her how I feel... but I just can't get the message across! Enjoy this lopsided rom-com brought to you by the author of "The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses" and "Paper Braver", Koume Fujichika!

title: TS Tensei Bishoujo Netora Reiko wa Netoraretai
description:
A man who drove countless couples to ruin in his past life is reborn as the angelic beauty Netora Reiko! But this girl has only one desire and it's "to experience the ultimate NTR!?"
The most despicable yet glorious romantic(?) comedy where an NTR-obsessed TS beauty sets out to deceive everyone around her and mentally destroy her childhood friend in the process!

title: Confession Series
description: Cute Short Stories of Confession of Lovee!!

title: R15+ ja Dame desu ka?
description:
"Mình sẽ làm gì để trở thành người lớn?"
Akane Amo, lớn lên trong sự bảo bọc nghiêm khắc của cha mẹ mà không tiếp xúc với phương tiện giải trí, bước qua tuổi 15, trước những thứ "tình cảm", thậm chí là một nụ hôn cũng không thể xem được.
Giờ đã vào trường cấp ba, cùng với cậu bạn Fuyumine, Amo sẽ bước qua những rào cản ấy. Liệu cô bé có thể xem được một phim nhán mác "cấm trẻ em"?

title: Hanazono-san Chi no Futago-chan
description: Tatara Tani is an average high school first year, both in terms of grades and athleticism. He has two childhood friends that attend his school, and they're twins! The elder sister Ranko is a flashy gal, while the younger sister Yuriko is a popular idol. They had slowly become distant from Tatara, but even so he always secretly held a crush for Yuriko. One day, Yuriko suddenly asked him out on a date. This date was the beginning of a secret relationship between the twins and him!

title: Oshi no Bishoujo ni Kokuhaku sareru Hanashi
description: A yuri romcom manga where an otaku is confessed to by the pretty girl she declares as her oshi and they start dating.

title: Hino-san no Baka
description: Class president and overall good girl Koguma is concerned that her classmate Hino often skips classes by spending her time behind one of the school buildings. Koguma feels it's her duty to guide Hino down a better path, even if it means going along with Hino's unusual requests.

title: Amamori Junna wa Shitsudo ga Takai
description: Shigure Kurimoto meets Junna Amamori by chance. As they get excited talking about books and Japanese rock music, Shigure begins to glimpse a more intense and clingy side to the otherwise aloof Junna.

title: Uchuujin no Kakushigoto
description:
The girl I fell in love with is… an alien!? I, the class president, happened to fall in love with my classmate, the eccentric Haru. I confessed my feelings, but her true identity was an alien who came to Earth to survey it.

“I still like you!”

I started going out with Haru, but now I have a further “secret” to keep…

title: Konyakusha ga Akuyaku de Komattemasu
description:
Lizzia is reincarnated into an otome game world as a mob character.  
  
She decides to live with two lives worth of filial piety, however, she has been betrothed to Bernhardt, the last villain in the prince' Route. This is the struggle of Lizzia as she tries for a peaceful life.

title: Kanojo no Real ga Kirinukenai!
description:
Vào mùa xuân năm nhất đại học, Mikami Riku bàng hoàng khi hay tin VTuber mà cậu theo dõi bấy lâu bất ngờ tuyên bố tạm ngừng hoạt động. Đang buồn bã vì cú sốc tinh thần này, Riku lại được Saionji Rui – cô bạn cùng lớp vừa dễ thương vừa thân thiện –  an ủi và động viên.

Thế nhưng, đằng sau nụ cười rạng rỡ ấy, Rui cũng đang mang một nỗi trăn trở: cô muốn tìm ra điều gì đó để thật sự đam mê và theo đuổi hết mình. Biết được điều đó, Riku đã đưa ra một lời đề nghị bất ngờ… mở đầu cho câu chuyện ngọt ngào giữa hai người!

title: The Male Lead's Girl Friend
description:
I was poor and with no one looking out for me, I was struggling financially. Because of this, I had trouble adjusting to school as well.  
  
My only hobby was reading a fantasy web novel <The Fake Lovers of the Academy> and imagining that I could become the main character of it. One day, after falling asleep and imagining this as usual… I woke up but instead of becoming the heroine, I'd become the villainess, Louise Sweeney, who meets a terrible ending.  
  
"Since I know the original novel, if I just avoid falling in love at first sight with the male lead, I definitely won't have a tragic ending!" Thinking this, Louise avoids the male lead.  
  
But what's this…? Unlike the original novel, the male lead passionately confesses his love to Louise, and the heroine, who she believed to be kind, has it in for her…?!  
  
How did this happen? Wasn't it supposed to all work out if I just avoided the male lead?!

---
Waking up inside your favorite novel sounds like a dream come true. Unless

title: Mietemasu yo! Aizawa-san
description:
Michi, plagued forever by her ability to see ghosts, pretends like she can't in order to avoid them at all costs. But recently she found a ghost she just can't ignore: Aizawa Honami, ex-classmate and ex-member of the famous idol group De:LPhinus, hanging around school from some lingering attachment.

Still, no matter what ghost it is, Michi's not getting involved. Though while she steels her heart, her eyes keep coming back to Honami's bizarre antics and passionate fanservice...(?)

title: Hagure Seirei Ino Shinsatsu Kiroku ~ Seijo Kishi-dan to Iyashi no Kamiwaza ~
description:
Grass loses his path in life when he pulls a "flop" during his spirit summoning ceremony. However, he is given another chance when he receives a royal order to fight in the front lines, along with the Princess's knights, as a war doctor. With his "flop" capable of curing anything, the curtains unfold upon a new fantasy war chronicle!  
  


---

title: Renai Daikou
description: Tác phẩm của Akasaka Aka (tác giả của Oshi no Ko và Kaguya-sama) và Nishizawa 5mm. Một cô gái mang trong mình dòng máu Thụy Điển và Nhật Bản cực kỳ ưu tú nhưng cô ấy lại không có kinh nghiệm với đàn ông. Cô ấy quyết định sử dụng một ứng dụng dịch vụ tình yêu để chinh phục chàng trai ấy. Tuy nhiên, anh chàng mà cô ấy nhắm đến cũng đang sử dụng ứng dụng đó để chinh phục cô!

title: Dekisokonai no Himegimi-tachi
description: Fujishiro Nanaki is super cute, super popular, and super annoyed with anyone as plain as her classmate Kurokawa Kanade. When Nanaki finds out her boyfriend’s cheating on her, however, her life makes a complete 180—as does her relationship with Kanade. This all-new yuri manga series explores the budding romance between the cool girl in school and the “plain” girl she once brushed off!

title: Koibami Shoujo
description: High school student Ooishi Kyou is afraid of women. Suddenly, five girls confessed to him. Among them, four are creatures called Koibami - beings that devour human romantic feelings. If he has his romantic feelings eaten by these girls, he will never be able to love again. However, he cannot abandon the feelings of the one who confessed to him for real - Kyou decides to find the one he truly loves among the five!

title: Katabutsu-kei Joshi ni Kokuhaku shitemita
description: Although she's pretty, she's widely rumoured to be the school's number one straight-laced girl. So when I gathered up my courage to confess to her…‽

title: Geist x Revenant: Kusozako Mob na Ore wa, Aibou no Seirei o Bishoujo ni Shinka Sasete Saikyou ni!
description:
"I'll turn the tables on the main character!"

Yohei Mochizuki, a new student at a [geist] user school, was bullied by his classmates because his geist partner, a [Goblin] by the name of Gobubi, was weak and ugly. However, one day he discovered a "wiki" and realized that he was living inside a game world, and his situation changed for the better! "No more tears. Let's take revenge on the main character together."

Yohei took full advantage of knowledge about the game to evolve Gobubi into the strongest natural beauty! With this, he can look back at his classmates and stand next to the senpai of his dreams! But just as he was finally able to obtain happiness, but then I was suddenly challenged to subjugate a domain boss by a beautiful foreign exchange student...are these problems that happen as you get stronger?

This is the fairy tale story of a boy who resists fate as the game's loser character and the weakest [Goblin], who together, aim to become the strongest!

[Original Webnovel](h

title: Class no Ko ni Saimin wo Kakerareta?
description: I was walking normally until a girl appeared in front of me and tried to hypnotize me, as I didn't want to embarrass her I pretended... And now she thinks I'm really hypnotized...!

title: Ayakashi Triangle
description:
Ever since he was a boy, Matsuri Kazamaki has worked as an exorcist. Because his childhood friend Suzu Kanade attracts malicious spirits called ayakashi like moths to a flame, Matsuri is tasked with slaying any with ill intentions.

One day, an ayakashi named Shirogane notices the budding romance between these two childhood friends. Eager to both devour Suzu and foil Matsuri’s chance at love, he performs a forbidden spell…
___
**Official English Volumes:** [Seven Seas Entertainment](https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/ayakashi-triangle/)

title: Yuri no Hajimari wa Dorei Kara
description:
Chiyoko Hanamura, một gyaru tự xưng đã thất bại trong màn ra mắt ở trường cấp ba, lại trốn học như thường lệ trên sân thượng thì bất ngờ bị đàn em Sakine tiếp cận. Có vẻ như Sakine có một việc muốn nhờ vả, cô đưa cho Chiyoko một bức thư tình và nói:

"Chị có thể từ chối lời tỏ tình này giúp em không?"

Tuy nhiên, người gửi thư lại không rõ danh tính.

Vì cô đàn em đáng yêu và để giữ vững khí chất gyaru, Chiyoko quyết tâm nhận nhiệm vụ này và đi từ chối lời tỏ tình...

title: Kuma to Usagi wa Tomodachi de wa Irarenai
description:
Sinh viên năm hai đại học Tozawa Kiyoka bỗng nhiên được Kumasaka Takeru — một chàng trai ăn chơi, nổi tiếng trong trường với những tin đồn xấu về NTR (cướp người yêu) — bắt chuyện.
Mọi người xung quanh đều nghĩ đầy thương hại: “Chắc là chỉ nhắm vào thân xác thôi chứ gì?”
Nhưng không — Kumasaka thực ra chỉ đơn giản là muốn kết bạn một cách trong sáng!!
Trái lại, chính cô nàng Tozawa trông thanh lịch, đoan trang kia lại… không ngờ là người nhắm vào thân thể!?
Một rom-com không hề có NTR, xoay quanh hai con người hoàn toàn trái ngược

title: Cupid no Hatsukoi
description: My childhood friend in the archery club is my rival, an angel, and a cupid.

title: Chikasugiru Futari
description:
Từ lúc mới sinh ra, họ đã ở bên nhau trong mọi chuyện - từ lúc thức, lúc ngủ, thậm chí cả lúc tắm. Đến lúc này, gọi họ là "bạn thuở nhỏ" nghe có vẻ chưa đúng lắm.

Trên tình bạn, dưới người yêu. Vậy câu chuyện này sẽ đi đến đâu?

title: Kamiyama-san no Kamibukuro no Naka ni wa
description:
On his very first day of starting high school, Namito Kominato's homeroom teacher has him sit behind a strange girl who wears a paper bag over her head and is always soaking wet with sweat. Her name is Samidare Kamiyama, a extremely shy girl with severe social anxiety. Ultimately, she meets Hinata Arai (the student council president who's kind and helpful, but alarmingly obsessed with her uniform) and Harusame Amano (a girl who only speaks to a cardboard cutout of a magical girl). These three unfortunate, but beautiful girls form a "conversation club", opening the curtain on this somewhat pitiful and comedic tale of adolescent romance!

[Alt official source](https://mangaplanet.com/comic/63800f8c032ad)

title: Asahina Wakaba to ○○ na Kareshi
description: Asahina Wakaba là một cô gái luôn vui vẻ năng động khi ở nhà nhưng thực tế cô lại rất nhút nhát và hơi vụng về khi ở trường, chính điều đó khiến cô luôn bị phỉ báng và bắt nạt. Cô bị các bạn cùng lớp ép buộc thực hiện một trò chơi trừng phạt đó là tỏ tình với kẻ bị ghét nhất trường Iruma Haruto. Điều gì sẽ xảy đến với hai con người này...

title: Seihantai na Kimi to Boku
description:
Suzuki, a girl who goes along with the flow, is attracted to Tani, a quiet guy who can speak his mind.
How can such a pair date each other!?
___
**Additional Links:**
- **Official English Volumes:** [VIZ](https://www.viz.com/shonenjump/chapters/you-and--are-polar-opposites)
- [Official X](https://x.com/seihantai_x)

title: 7-Kakan Gentei Kanojo
description: The story begins when Manatsu, a gal who is on the verge of repeating a grade, starts receiving tutoring from Sumie, an honor student. Manatsu loves shoujo manga and romantic gossip but has the vague feeling that having a boyfriend somehow doesn't fit her. When she casually brings this up, Sumie suggests, "Why not try starting with just the form?" and offers "How about dating me for just 7 days?"

title: Kamibukuro-kun wa Koishiteru
description:
A stalker? A pervert?   
No, no. I'm just a college boy who is single-mindedly in love with someone.  
It's just. I live my life wearing a paper bag on my head.   
People look at me strangely on campus.  
  
Even though he's extremely timid, he abruptly confessed his love and pushing forward!  
The girl he confessed to, Umi-chan, took it by surprise! And soon an unexpected turn of events is about to happen…?!  
A series of weird but lovely, super cute romantic comedy

title: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken: after the rain
description: A spin-off of the series *[The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten](https://mangadex.org/title/2fec6641-beb1-4ae9-a32f-204dd06688ac/the-angel-next-door-spoils-me-rotten)* which comicalizes the stories from Volume 5.5 of the Light Novel and its special edition booklet, which contains additional short stories.

title: Uchi no Kuro Madoushi ga Kawaisugiru!
description:
Aria, an honor student at the magic academy, is a supervisory student who teaches and guides the younger students, but she is troubled by a problem child, Jade. He is a member of a family of black mages and is feared by those around him, but just as Aria comes into contact with him, she hears a strange voice. Aria is afraid of him, but when she comes into contact with him, she hears a strange voice: *"Bitch (isn't she too cute?)"* 

This is the voice of his heart! Aria is a young girl who is in love with a man who is a little too cute for her own good!

title: [Rouhou] Ore no Iinazuke ni Natta Jimiko, Ie de wa Kawaii Shika nai.
description:
“Onii-san, congratulations on your marriage. This person is your bride.”

“M-my name is Watanae Yuuka… I’m in the same class as you…”

My name is Sakata Yuuichi. I’m in my 2nd year of high school. Due to my parents’ circumstances, I’m suddenly getting married..? Furthermore, my partner is a plain girl, Watanae-san. During my 3rd year of middle school, I went through a bad experience. Ever since then, I’ve only been interested in 2D heroines. There’s absolutely no way I’d ever be interested in a 3D girl. That was what I thought, but…

“…Well then, who’s your favorite heroine right now?”

Turns out, she was actually an otaku and she becomes very talkative when you get to know her. She’d always happily engage in our conversations. She showed me things I’d never have expected from a girl in my class.

“Err, since we’re going to be living together… Is it okay if I call you Yuu-kun?”

And, the moment I let my guard down, she’d instantly try to shorten the distance between us. Wha

title: Sousei no Onmyouji
description:
Rokuro Enmado is from a family of exorcists who remove evil Kegare, but his real dream is to be a singer, a soccer player, or anything other than an exorcist. When another exorcist, a girl named Benio Adashino arrives, Rokura is suddenly inflamed with competitive spirit and decides to put his natural knack to good use. Their rivalry gets more complicated when they both learn they are the destined "Twin Star Exorcists," two ultimate fighters fated to marry and create the prophesied child who will eliminate all the Kegare in the world.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Twin Star Exorcists** (2019)

title: XX Shinaide! Tsukimine-san
description: Hidaka Akira is a high school student who loves solitude. He avoids the crowds in his class and decides to eat alone, but there is someone who disturbs his peace. It is Tsukimine Chiyo, the girl at the highest level in the school hierarchy, a girl who is absolutely beautiful. Tsukimine called Akira and asked him to do his "usual thing". What kind of "normal" did they mean, and why were her clothes off...?

title: Ittsumo Shiotaiou na Osananajimi dakedo, Ore ni Kataomoi shite iru no ga Barebare de Kawaii.
description:
"Today, I'll confess to Ko-chan!"

A voice suddenly heard by Kouta Nitake, a high school boy who is not particularly popular. It was the voice of Ayano Yumemigasaki, a childhood friend who always has an attitude that doesn't look like him! Kouta didn't know that Ayano fell in love with him.

"I really wanted Kou-chan to talk to me..."

Kouta begins to be aware of Ayano's unrequited love. However, an unexpected side effect of "voice of the heart"...!?

title: I Guess My Roommate Is Pretty?
Inkya ga Netoge Tomodachi ni Ren'ai Soudan sareta Hanashi
description:
**Link:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [X (Formerly Twitter)](https://x.com/R4_119/status/1590977523680436225)

title: Shouwaru Tensai Osananajimi to no Shoubu ni Makete Hatsutaiken o Zenbu Ubawareru Hanashi
description:
Wakaba Yoshizawa has a childhood friend named Komaki Umezono.

This girl wore the mask of an honor student with good morals who's blessed with both beauty and brains, but in reality she's an evil genius who looked down on people. For the sake of regaining the dignity she lost to Komaki, Wakaba challenges her to a match, but Komaki tells her "Each time I win, I will take one precious thing from you." as a condition!? Every time she loses to the girl she "hates", her true feelings get exposed.

(Source: Young Ace Up)

title: Mukasete! Ryuugasaki-san
description:
Ryugasaki-san in my class is a lizard-woman, and as such she will shed several times a year.  
It appears that such a time came, and sooner than I expected.

title: Wakaba-san'chi no Aoi Koi
description:
Dưới mái nhà kia, có đến bốn trái tim đang loạn nhịp!

Nhà Wakaba có bốn chị em, ai nấy đều đang tuổi xuân căng mọng, xinh đẹp vô bờ.
Và tất nhiên rồi, cái tuổi học sinh sinh viên mới nhú mà, dĩ nhiên phải có gia vị tình yêu quyện vào nó mới trọn vẹn được. Chị cả thì phải lòng tiền bối ở chỗ làm thêm, chị hai, ba và cô em út thì đang phải lòng bạn cùng trường. Và rồi cứ mỗi đêm, cả nhà lại ngồi quây quần với nhau, tâm sự chuyện yêu đương đàn đúm đủ kiểu. Liệu cặp nào sẽ bùng nổ trước đây ta?

Còn nội dung sâu xa thể nào ấy hả? Vào đọc đi rồi biết, hứa không uổng thì giờ hảo ngọt của bạn đâu!

title: Koushinchou no Kouhai ♀ to Teishinchou no Senpai ♂ ga Ren'ai ni Hatten Suru made
description: A younger, tall, conceited female kouhai doing as she pleases towards her short senpai! A senpai who is teased about his height and treated as a kid... but unexpectedly shows a manly side of him! Will their relationship develop into romance...?

title: Hayaku Shitai Futari
description:
Hasegawa Yuuri, một học sinh cao trung bình thường luôn có ước mơ được “chim chuột” với người yêu. Cô đang hẹn hò với Katsuragi Keiichirou – tương lai sẽ trở thành người đứng đầu đất nước?! Và đặc biệt, trong gia đình của Keiichirou lại có truyền thống kì lạ về chuyện “ấy”? Làm thế nào Yuuri có thể chấp nhận được chuyện này?? Hãy cùng đón xem câu chuyện siêu đáng yêu của cặp đôi chênh lệnh nhất mọi thời đại này nào!!  
  
**Links:**  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/aki_kusaka)

title: Bokutachi no Remake
description:
Hashiba Kyouya is a 28 year old game developer. With his company going bankrupt, and him losing his job, he returns to his hometown. Looking at the success of creators of his age, he finds himself regretting his life decisions as he lay distressed on his bed. But when he opens his eyes, he finds that he has travelled 10 years back to the time before he entered college.  
  
Will he finally make things right? This is a story about a failed person who is given a second opportunity to follow his dreams.

[Official Site](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/episode/10834108156679858281)

title: Tonari no Seki no Inkya Joshi ga Oshi Utaite Datta ~Ore no Kyoku o Uttatekure!~
description:
"Tại sao bài hát của mình, lại được ca sĩ mình yêu thích hát vậy chứ!?"

Tsunagu Kurose, nam sinh cấp ba với niềm đam mê sáng tác nhạc cùng giọng hát dở tệ, thường nhận phải gạch đá khi đăng tải chúng lên mạng. Một ngày nọ, trong lúc đang gánh vác công việc chụp những bức hình kỉ niệm ngày hội văn hóa bất đắc dĩ cùng cô bạn trầm tính bàn bên Otoha Hinomori, cậu bạn thưở nhỏ Tetsu Tamura đã rơi vào tình cảnh tiến thoái lưỡng nan vì một vài sự cố bất khả kháng diễn ra ngay trên sân khấu do CLB cậu điều hành. Không do dự, Tsunagu đã đưa cho cậu dùng bản demo không lời của bài nhạc sáng tác ra để cứu vãn tình hình, nhưng trớ trêu thay Tetsu lại mở nhầm file nhạc có lời hát tệ hại của Tsunagu khiến cho cậu như muốn chui tọt xuống đất vì thảm họa oái oăm đấy. Ngay lúc tuyệt vọng nhất, Otoha gỡ bỏ chiếc kính dày cộm của mình, nắm chặt chiếc micro ngân nga khúc ca ấy!

Và rằng "Giọng hát ấy chẳng phải giống với ca sĩ mà mình vẫn luôn mến mộ - icy hay sao...!?

title: Osananajimi no Watashi wa Mobu de Itai noni, Nazeka Heroine no Ren'ai Taishou ni Natteiru.
description:
Yukitsuki Mashiro has been reincarnated into the world of a dating game. She decides to live an inconspicuous life as one of the heroines, "Amatsuki Suzuna," but after she helps "Hinase Riri" who is being harassed by a man in the downtown area, she becomes the target of love. What will become of Suzuna, who is surrounded by more and more heroines as everything she does goes wrong...?!
___
* Original Web Novel: [link](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n1873ib/?p=1) (Japanese)
* English Translation of Web Novel: [link](https://dobytranslations.com/series/im-a-childhood-friend-and-i-want-to-remain-a-supporting-character-but-for-some-reason-i-became-the-heroines-love-interest/)

This series is being continued as a doujinshi called "Ame nochi Yuki." 
English translation is available on Pixiv: [link](https://www.pixiv.net/user/122109038/series/315614)

title: New Normal
description:
In the near future a pandemic spreads around the world, so people hiding their mouth with a mask has become the norm. Natsuki, a girl who is secretly reminiscent of the world before the pandemic, and Hata, her classmate, suddenly become friends and share a small secret. This is the story of the “new abnormal” of two people living in the world of the “new normal”!
___
