title: Read to Level Up
description: The main character, Jong-Seok Lee used to be your average, run of the mill person. The only thing remotely interesting about him is the fact that he’s always at local book stores. All of that changes when he suddenly encounters a completely blank book and foolishly accepts what’s asked of him…

title: There’s No Way a Side Character Like Me Could Be Popular, Right?
description:
“I just love you sooooooo much, Senpai!”
My name is Tomoki Yuuki, a second-year student in high school. I'd say I'm a fairly normal student, save for the fact that everyone avoids me like the plague because I apparently look like I'm out for blood. Ike Haruma is the only one that doesn't steer clear of me. He's your typical ‘perfect guy’ in every sense; the protagonist with no real flaws that you see in any given story. 

Life at school was going on as usual… until one day Haruma's super popular little sister confesses to me out of the blue?! Though she later clarifies that her feelings toward me are anything but romantic and that she has an ulterior motive, I end up accepting my new role as ‘fake boyfriend’ as a favor to Haruma. 

Believe it or not, the moment I start going out with her, Haruma's idol-tier childhood friend and my super hot teacher get involved with me too! 

Wait a minute, this can't be a dream rom-com scenario setting itself up for me, can it?! I mean, there's no way

title: Kagakubu Girl
description:
*A drug that makes you invisible… A clock that stops time…*

A slapstick, cackling, and… slightly thrilling?... story of the daily life of “Doctor”, a girl who belongs to the Science Department and works day and night on such mysterious, dreamlike inventions, and “Assistant Hara-kun”, who is constantly at her mercy!

title: Gotou-san wa Furimukasetai!
description: Gotou-san, the prettiest girl in school, tries to get the attention of Maeda-kun, who sits in front of her. She secretly harbors a crush on him, but Maeda, who lacks self-confidence, doesn't notice her feelings. What is the future of Gotou-san's unwavering love?

title: Kimi no Love o Misetekure!
description: Komichi Shijou, the most famous person at her school, was troubled. Despite being a romantic comedy manga artist, she had no understanding of "the feeling of love" was stuck in a creative slump. One day, a certain boy and girl appear before her.

title: Gakuen Babysitters
description: After their parents are killed in a plane crash, Ryuuichi and his younger brother Kotarou are taken in by the chairman, who they never met before, of an elite academy. Ryuuichi becomes the school daycare's new babysitter.

title: Koushin Koinu ni Koibumi wo
description:
The stage is a modern school that fosters female officers, "Girl's Only Army School".  
A girl, Indou Shinobu, who came out from the countryside, meets Kagami a high-class senior student.  
Contrary to her high-handed attitude, Kagami occasionally shows kindness to Indou.

title: Otome no Teikoku
description: A peek into the "everyday nudity" of high school girls. Virgins’ Empire is a look into the lives of seven high school girls attending an all girls school. We follow them as they grow relationships with one another. Some more intimate than others.

title: Ningen da kedo Maou-gun Shitennou ni Sodaterareta Ore wa, Maou no Musume ni Aisare Shihaizokusei no Kennou o Ataeraremashita.: The Guardian of Princess
description:
The main character, Leon, was abandoned to the world of demons right after he was born because of his lack of magical power. However, his fate changes completely when the Four Heavenly Kings of the Demon King’s Army pick him up. The Four Heavenly Kings were the strongest and most powerful figures in the world had trained him personally and took good care of him. As time passed, the boy became a magnificent soldier of the Demon King’s army with the power to “rule” every kind of magic. Leon has been given a new mission to protect Alicia, who will enroll in a magic academy on the island called “Paradise Island.”
___
**Alt. Raw:** [EarthStar](https://www.comic-earthstar.jp/sp/detail/sitennou/), [Seiga](https://sp.seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/47252)
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8396fg/)

title: Ikemen ni Tensei Shita kedo Cheat wa Dekimasen deshita.
description:
After Koganei was rejected by a girl he had confessed to, he angrily ran off and was hit by a car.   
  
When he woke up, he found that he was reincarnated in another world as Theodore Goldberg, the eldest son of a marquis. And of course, as Koganei is no stranger to isekai series, he knows that he will have some sort of cheat skill to become overpowered and live a slow life.   
  
And so he tries to open up his status screen… only to find that this world doesn’t have video game stats. He then tries to use his OP magic skills… only to find out he is too young to even learn magic. So then he tries swordsmanship… but turns out to be weak with the blade. And so he decides to just invent modern technology to get ahead… only to find out that this world has magical devices which are identical to modern technology.   
  
Theodore is at an impasse. He’s not strong, he’s not smart, and he’s not handsome. So what exactly is his cheat skill? For what purpose was he reincarnated in the first place

title: “Toutosugite Yomenaaaaaaai!!” 4P Short Stories
description: Bộ sưu tập các truyện ngắn của nhiều tác giả khác nhau. Các chap không liên quan đến nhau.

title: A Tan Childhood Friend with Absolutely No NTR!
description:
Yuu-kun and Nacchan from the countryside are childhood friends who've always been together.  Now reaching puberty, they seem to be getting interested in each other...
She's a tan childhood friend, but there's absolutely no NTR.  Their friends around them only want to support them.  A heartwarming love comedy that's sure to make you happy.

---
**Links:**
- [Chapter 1 on Fanbox](https://asitoteto.fanbox.cc/posts/5311130)

title: Tsuyokute New Game na Love Comedy
description:
Komine is an ordinary grade-school kid who is at the top of his class. And for good reason - after dying, this is actually his second run at life. Knowing everything from upcoming class subjects to future events, Komine naturally excels at whatever he does. 

…and then there’s Sarara Miyano, Komine’s classmate. The last time he was in school, he was despised by her because of some foolish actions he took in the past. But now that he’s mentally older and wiser, maybe he can turn things around?

---
**Notes:**
-  Some chapters on Pixiv are incomplete previews. Full chapters are available for free in the Amazon volumes.

**Links:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/1032496/series/122597) (Incomplete Chapter Previews)

title: Starting out as Friends With a Yankee Girl
description: A guy fell in love at the first sight with the school #1 delinquent. He steeled himself and asked her out, but…

title: Ikiru no Hetana Takou no Joshi
description: A boy meets girl story about Mita, a fierce-looking but clumsy high school girl, and Hitoyoshi, a timid high school boy. One morning on the train, Hitoyoshi is suddenly approached by the intimidating-looking Mita. It turns out she's feeling unwell. Despite his fear, he helps take care of her. Through the encounter, he catches a glimpse of Mita's clumsy and awkward side, one that is completely at odds with her intimidating appearance.

title: Itsumo Kaerimichi ga Isshona Ano Ko
Kumakura-san to Boku
description: Vào ngày đầu nhập học, Hachiya - một người gần như vô hình trong mắt người khác đã vô tình được xếp ngồi kế với Kumakura - một người nổi tiếng và hoạt ngôn nhưng đội chiếc mũ gấu to tướng trên đầu, và cô bằng một cách nào đó lại biết đến và bắt chuyện với Hachiya.

title: Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Akashic Records
description:
*The manga of the popular Light Novel series of the same name*

Sisti attends a magical academy to hone her skills in the magical arts, and hopes to solve the mystery of the enigmatic Sky Castle. After the retirement of her favorite teacher, the replacement, Glen, turns out to be a tardy, lazy, seemingly incompetent bastard of an instructor. How was it that Glen was hand-picked by the best magician in the academy!?

title: Zense Coupling
description: Even if my age and position have changed, my feelings for you will never change! A romantic comedy featuring four couples who've been reincarnated, having been given a second chance at love after being driven apart the first time around.

title: Hodoite, Musunde
description:
Ms. Nohara is next to me when we change seats. Her hair is very beautiful, but she is clumsy and can't seem to do it herself…?

Haruki, who sets his sister's hair every morning, suddenly finds himself setting hers. As they tie her precious hair, they gradually become more and more aware of each other and grow closer. Untying and tying, their hearts are spun by their hair.

"A high school romance about a boy who is growing closer to a clumsy girl while fixing her hair."

title: Here U Are
description: Receptioning the newcomers is a task for YuYang, and he ends up helping the unsociable and towering LiHuan, the kind of person that does everything to be disliked. But after better knowing each other, he discovers that the giant isn't that bad of a person at all…

title: One Room, Hiatari Futsuu, Tenshi-tsuki.
description: Thanh niên Tokumitsu Shintaro, sống một cuộc đời bình dị nhưng yên bình, bất ngờ đón một thiên thần tên Towa từ thiên giới ghé thăm. Towa được Chúa trời yêu cầu học hỏi về con người. Lo lắng cho Towa, người quá thiện lương và không biết nghi ngờ người khác, Shintaro tiếp nhận cô và dạy cô về thế giới con người. Xung quanh họ, những cô gái không phải con người dần tụ họp, khiến cuộc sống thường nhật của Shintaro trở nên náo nhiệt hơn.

title: Uli an Sagwieo!!
description:
“Why do you keep asking if we’re dating? We’re just holding hands, we’re not dating!!”
It’s a slice-of-life romantic comedy about couples who aren’t really couples!

title: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume o Minai
description:
"Forget what you saw today."  
  
There's something odd about Sakuta Azusagawa, an acerbic, standoffish high schooler who doesn't even own a cell phone in this day and age. And perhaps strange things happen to strange people, which is why on the last day of the Golden Week holiday, in a tranquil library, he meets a wild bunny girl. With that unforgettable encounter, their bizarre and mysterious love story begins.  


---

title: Kuzu Rouninsei, Jinsei ga Tsurai no de Yoru no Onee-san wo Yondemita
description: Makino failed her college entrance exam. Her only comfort is in her 2D game characters... until she found an ad for a call-girl who looked exactly like her favorite in-game waifu! The yuri love comedy between a gullible young woman and a street-wise call-girl begins now!

title: Kanojo to Kare no Kankei ~Heibon na Hayakawa-san to Heibon na Miura-kun no Hibon na Kankei~
description:
"I wish I had a girlfriend, I don't even care who—"
"Really? Anybody? Even me?"

Kaho, who has never had a boyfriend before, wanted to have a male-female relationship.
Takumi, who wanted a girlfriend, just happened to be talking about it in front of her.

---
Alternate Raws: [Pixiv Comic](https://comic.pixiv.net/works/8556)

title: Kitazawa-kun wa A Class
description:
Masashi Kitazawa, high school 2nd-year, has a trauma: he was fat when he was a kid!

Kitazawa, who diligently dieted and worked hard in middle school, grew up to be a handsome man and was supposed to lead a peaceful school life, but... In the new semester of high school, handsome men and beautiful girls have gathered in Kitazawa's 2nd year class A for some reason. What's more, he received a secret invitation from Ayame Yagyu, the most beautiful girl in her grade...!?

title: Ijime kara Tasuketa Osananajimi ga Yandere ni naru made
Hanazono-kun to Kazoe-san no Fukakai na Houkago
description: Kazoe, a girl sheltered from perverse content, and Hanazono, a boy brought up in a family that lives off of the perverse. As Kazoe is finally unable to restrain her curiosity, she turns to Hanazono for help.

title: Gakuen no Madonna no Watanabe san ga, Naze ka Maishu Yotei wo Kitekuru
description: Ryoichi Aikawa is a high schooler who prefers spending his youth fishing in solitude rather than chasing romance. For him, the tranquility of the harbor is everything—until one day he saves a girl from being harassed by some troublemakers. To his surprise, that girl is Watanabe-san, the incredibly popular school "Madonna". Ever since that unexpected encounter, the school idol has somehow taken an interest in Ryoichi's fishing hobby and started asking about his weekend plans every single week.

title: Ponkotsu-chan Kenshouchuu
description:
Mito is a boy with a big heart and the frightening face of a thug. He wants people to rely on him, but he scares people off at first sight. That is, until his schoolmate Yumesaki asks him to help her.  
  
Yumesaki has a problem. Every day she is given a new, random supernatural ability by an mysterious being called God, as she has to test them in order to stop a giant meteorite that will destroy the planet in a year.  
  
Sure, the goal is to save the planet, but when a boy and a girl spend time together, there are more tender things to discover too!

title: Love at Fourteen
description:
The second year of junior high, when most students are in the throes of puberty and feeling the pangs of first love.
It’s no different for Kanata Tanaka and Kazuki Yoshikawa, a girl and a boy who have been friends since elementary school. But even though Kanata and Kazuki are at the same point in life as their classmates, an air of adulthood sets the two apart. Kanata is taller and more attractive than the other girls, but the boys stay away because she seems too mature for them. Kazuki too stands out from the other boys, but the girls are wary of him because he seems like a player.
And so, Kanata and Kazuki are thrown together in a charming, bittersweet tale of two seemingly mature students falling in love like the teenagers they are.

title: Kanojo-tachi wa Ana wo Umetai
description: "Whom will you go out with?" Those were the words Doumoto Genki was confronted with on his first day of high school. Now he has to figure out which one of the "out of this world" beauties he wants to date!

title: Uchi no Musuko wa Tabun Gay
description:
A sweet, open-minded mother starts suspecting one of her sons might be gay.
___
**Alt Official Raws:**
- [Defunct Twitter Moment](https://twitter.com/i/moments/1079348817449766913)
- [pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/2585182/series/58591)

**Official English Volumes:** [SQUARE ENIX](https://squareenixmangaandbooks.square-enix-games.com/en-us/series/i-think-our-son-is-gay/)

title: Kenja ga nakama ni natta!
description: High-school student Suou Amadera has gone big brain and quit real life! Why waste time and money on real friends when you can browse the internet all day, every day? But suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, and with her saintly patience she shows Suou that maybe, friends in real life aren't so bad after all... Join us for the new "friendship comedy" by the author of the acclaimed "Tejina-senpai"!

title: Akabane Honeko no Bodyguard
description: Honeko Akabane is an ordinary high school girl. The daughter of a lawyer, she seeks to just live a regular life - even if that means chiding her childhood friend, the ever-violent Ibuki Arakuni, whenever he gets into fights with random people. However, Ibuki holds a secret only he knows - Honeko was adopted by her current parents, and is actually the illegitimate daughter of a yakuza bigwig. As it turns out, the boss is retiring, and many people in his gang are looking to take his place; since Honeko is his heir, they want to kill her to clean up any loose ends. And so Ibuki must protect Honeko from a variety of criminals, without letting her know about her true lineage. Can he act as her bodyguard while simultaneously keeping her unaware of her situation?

title: JK Shachiku wo Kau
description: The third year of joining a black company, Atsushi Inubosaki is 24 years old, single, savings balance is 89,000 yen, and… It is a company stock! As such he is forced to live a double life of a "company slave" and "pet of a high school girl" in the wake of encounter with the beautiful girl JK (high school girl) and Kurume owner Nia…?!

title: The World God Only Knows
description: Katsuragi Keima là một cậu học sinh có khả năng chinh phục mọi cô gái ở trong game. Một lần khi đang trả lời email của các bạn say mê dating game, Katsuragi Keima thấy 1 bức email lạ trong hòm thư của mình. Theo nội dung bức email thì có một người nhờ Katsuragi Keima làm cho các cô gái phải "Fall in love". Với tính cách "không có cô gái trong dating game nào ko thể chinh phục", Katsuragi Keima đã ko ngần ngại ấn Reply và sau đó một con quỷ đáng yêu tên Erushi xuất hiện và cuộc chơi bắt đầu. Katsuragi Keima phải tìm cách cho những cô gái mà Erushi chỉ định phải lòng với cậu. Nếu Katsuragi Keima từ chối thì đồng nghĩa cậu sẽ bị "mất đầu" do bản giao ước, liệu cậu có thể làm được điều này giống như với những cô gái ở trong game không...

title: Mutou and Satou
description: Satou Yutaka is the representative for her class at school. She's reliable, cool, and pretty, but tomboyish to a fault. One day, Mutou Chihiro, a straightforward yet motherly boy who admires her, asks her to teach him how to be cool like her. Overwhelmed and embarrassed by his persistence, she says 'yes'…

title: "Osananajimi ga Hoshii" to Tsubuyaitara Yoku Issho ni Asobu Onna Tomodachi no Yousu ga Hen ni Natta ndaga
description: "I want a cute girl as a childhood friend..." ― It was a casual remark made by Akito while having lunch with his usual friend group of four. However, he didn't know that the person sitting right in front of him, Natsumi, was actually his childhood friend who had moved away when they were small! Since then, Natsumi has been trying to express her feelings to Akito, but because they had always been friends, it hasn't been easy for her to convey them...

title: Henshin Ganbou!
description:
Sunaki is a back-up player on the baseball team and he finally gets the courage to give a love letter to the idol of the school. Where will his actions take him?

Published in *Weekly Shounen Jump 2014 No. 37·38*.

title: Witch Watch
description: Morihito, a boy with the strength of an ogre, is about to start living together with his childhood friend Niko, who is training to be a witch. Niko's magic leads to all sorts of unpredictable trouble, and with two teens under one roof...

title: Busu ni Hanataba o.
description: Tabata Hana is a lonely, negative and unpopular high school girl. Her class's most handsome guy, Yousuke, accidentally witnessed her happily pretending to be a heroine in the classroom one early morning...!?

title: Asobinin na Shoujo-tachi wa Kyou mo Houkago Yatteiru
description:
Kyosuke entered high school dreaming of a sparkling, youthful life. However, after reuniting with his older, introverted childhood friend, Kyoko, he is lured into joining the "Imitation Games Club."

The club's activities revolve around sophisticated versions of "make-believe" games like "House" or "Hide-and-Seek"—reimagined as intellectual pursuits for high schoolers. But for some reason, "accidents" keep happening, leading to some very steamy and unexpected developments!

While these boys and girls initially intended to play wholesome games, their childhood pastimes are fast-tracking them into a deeply immoral relationship...?! Playing children's games at this age is naughty, fun, and totally scandalous! An immoral youth comedy begins!

title: Netoge no Yome wa Onnanoko ja Nai to Omotta?
description: Nishimura Hideki is a young man who once confessed to a person he thought was a girl online, only to find out that this person was actually a boy. He keeps this story secret and swears he'll never trust a girl online again. However, one day a girl online confesses to him, and it turns out she is actually a beautiful girl named Tamaki Ako. But Ako unfortunately cannot tell the difference between the online world and reality, and she is also a loner who has trouble communicating with others. Hideki and his friends from the guild then decide to work together in order to help her understand the difference between real life and online gaming.

title: Tereru to Seitenkansuru Hitotachi no Renai Jijou
description: Hai anh chị yêu nhau, nhưng mỗi khi xấu hổ thì lại bị đổi giới tính, nên cũng ta có thể coi đây là Yaoi, Yuri, Romcom trong một cặp đôi ấy XD

title: Uchi no Seiso-kei Iinchou ga Katsute Chuunibyou Idol datta Koto wo Ore Dake ga Shitteiru.
description: The once-famous chuunibyou idol "Nightmare of Calamity"—nicknamed Mea—had taken the world by storm. Reo, who used to take photos with her and post them online to make them go viral, unexpectedly reunites with her at his new high school. However, she has already graduated from her chuunibyou phase and now goes by Kanagi Nagi, the socially awkward, introverted class representative! On top of that, due to certain circumstances, Nagi is aiming to become student council president and asks Reo for help, pulling him back into producing her once again...!?

title: Darashinai desu, Hotta-sensei!
description: Một học sinh trung học bình thường bỗng trở thành "osin" cho giáo viên được yêu thích nhất trường, nhưng lại là một con người khác hẳn khi ở nhà.

title: Jiken Jaken!
description: A beautiful, talented and mystery-loving high school girl and a younger school boy solve mysteries in their day-to-day lives at school.

title: Koi to Uso
description:
Lies are forbidden and love is doubly forbidden. In the near future, when young people in Japan turn sixteen, they are assigned a marriage partner by the government. People don't have to go through the trouble of looking for someone, and everyone accepts that the country will find a compatible partner to make them happy. Yukari Nejima is fifteen years old. He lives in a small corner of the country, and just can't seem to get ahead in life. Both academically and athletically he's below average. But within him, he hides a heart burning with passion! In this world in which love is forbidden, what will happen to him when he falls in love?

---
**Links:**
- Alternative Official English - [Kodansha](https://kodansha.us/series/love-and-lies/), [Manga Planet](https://mangaplanet.com/comic/6172658aa11d3)

title: Renai Boukun
description: Một ngày nọ, Gris – một nữ thần chết bí cùng với một quyển Kiss Note ẩn xuất hiện tại nhà của Aino Seiji, và yêu cầu cậu ta phải hôn ai đó để duy trì mạng sống của mình . Mọi chuyện bắt đầu rắc rối hơn khi Hiyama Akane – một Yandere chính hiệu bắt gặp Aino Seiji đi cùng cô bé thần chết. Aino Seiji phải làm gì để có thể sống sót, và quyển Kiss Note là gì, thì.... đọc đi sẽ rõ

title: Replica datte, Koi o Suru.
description:
Vào những ngày mà cô ấy bị cảm, vào những ngày mà cô ấy có một công việc tẻ nhạt, vào những ngày mà cô ấy có bài kiểm tra thường xuyên.

Vào những ngày mà cô ấy quá lười để đi học, tôi được gọi ra.
Tôi là vật thay thế cho cơ thể của một cô gái tên là Sunao Aikawa, và đó chính là tôi.
Tôi có lẽ trông giống hệt họ, nhưng mà tính cách của tôi thì có hơi khác một chút.
Tôi không thể tự do ra ngoài được, tôi cũng chẳng thể nào lên kế hoạch cho ngày mai.
Tôi chỉ được coi là một bản sao thôi, nhưng tôi đã biết yêu.

Một "chuyện tình" rất trong sáng và có chút bí ẩn diễn ra tại một thị trấn ven biển.

title: Koitsu, Ore no Koto Suki Nanoka?!
description:
The creature known as man is quick to misunderstand. The same applies to the pure middle-schooler Yokoyama-kun: A diligent fellow who does his infirmary duty properly.   
"You're so nice. Thank you." The one to say that to him was his classmate Nishino-san, so Yokoyama-kun ended up thinking: ("Isn't she only nice to me?!")   
He couldn't help but be hopeful. ("Does she like me?!")  
  
This is the start of the misleading life between the fantasizing Yokoyama-kun and the ambiguous Nishino-san.  
  


---

  
**Links:**  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Mangaka's Twitter](https://twitter.com/arata_momose)

title: Ano Koro no Aoi Hoshi
description: Koumoto Umi, a normal high school girl, falls in love with the pretty girl from the class next door, Segawa Shou. Even though she feels overwhelmed by her feelings, she can't help but want to get closer to the mysterious Shou.

title: Kouga-san no Kamiguse
description:
Kouga is a flawless high school girl. She is sweet, gentle, and beautiful. Mochida, her classmate, likens her to a Disney princess. The only oddity she displays is that she rarely takes off her mask. 

However, one day, Mochida sees her without it, and discovers that the Disney princess actually has a secret…

title: The Breaker
description:
The new English teacher, Chun-Woo, is not your ordinary teacher. Shioon, a victim of constant bullying, unexpectedly witnesses Chun-Woo's fighting prowess, and begs him to make him his disciple. Chun-Woo claims he can teach Shioon only if he is truly determined, and Shioon must put his life on the line to prove it. It turns out, however, that Chun-Woo and his powers are more than meets the eye. Shioon makes a grand entrance into the Murim (the hidden world of martial arts), and he is about to be taught by the best there is!

Official Release:
- Indonesian release by m&c! Comics as **The Breaker**

title: At First Glance, Shinoda-san Seems Cool but Is Actually Adorable!
description:
A story about a girl named Shinoda-san who is not what she seems, and the only guy in school who seems to get her!  
  
Pixiv Raws - See raw link below.  
[Twitter Raws](https://twitter.com/i/events/1182226041038786560)  
  
Buy the book here: [Melonbooks](https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=597572).

title: Kininaru Kurumi-san!
description: A plain, quiet guy named Fujimori admires a girl who's too beautiful — Kurumi. Because of his shy personality, he freezes up and can't speak when he gets attention, so he's never once talked to her and they shouldn't have any connection… or so he thought? A wild, emotionally intense beauty and a gloomy, oblivious boy — their clumsy, mismatched love comedy begins!

title: Classmate no Tanaka-san wa Sugoku Kowai (Webcomic)
description:
My classmate, Tanaka-san is super scary… or is she?  
  
Creator-approved translations by [TheElusiveTaco.](https://twitter.com/elusive_taco)

title: 2 Saisa no Osananajimi
description:
Feelings that have remain unchanged from back then...

Please be aware of me soon!

When did he become so cool……! No, no, there's no way!

I thought he was just a normal cute "little brother"-like childhood friend, but
6 years later he……

title: Oversized Sextet
description: Meet the adventuring school's highest honour student, Touru. Once he got to study abroad, he had a reunion with his childhood friend Nikka. However, what he thought was a girl as human as he was, she was actually a giant of the ogre lineage! Everything is mega-sized in this city of giants. His childhood friend is 100cm taller than him. Somehow his classmates are only girls. Even though he doesn't mean to, miniskirts flutter all around him. Brandish your sword and sorcery in this school-life harem story!!

title: Isekai-gaeri no Arafoo Riiman, 17-sai no Koro ni Modotte Musou Suru
description: A black company employee in his 40s, Namba Kazu, died of overwork and was reincarnated to another world. After saving the world, he returns to find himself regressed to his 17-year-old self. Kazu realizes that he can use the abilities he acquired from another world and is excited to restart his life over again. However, through the help of his childhood friend, Yui, he learns of the existence of human-eating abomination called Variant in the world he was born in. Kazu knows from his past memories that Yui will die in the near future. In order to save Yui, who is on a mission to fight against variants, Kazu decided to throw himself into battle in this world as well.

title: Iris Zero
description:
In a world where every boy and girl has a special power called Iris, Tooru who, as a result of not having any kind of special power from a young age, lives by his motto, "low exposure"—to live without standing out.  
  
But his peaceful school life changes when he receives a certain "confession" from the school's most popular girl, Koyuki. His motto begins to shake!!  
  
The school fantasy that shakes the heart begins with their meeting.

title: Eromanga Sensei
description: Writing light novels isn't all that easy, especially when you're in high school and you have to do the cooking and the chores for your shut-in stepsister who's hardly come out of her room the past year! In the light novel business, it's crucial to have the right person illustrating your books to help them sell–and maybe get made into manga and anime! But in a world of online pen names, the author and the illustrator may still not even know each other . . . until one day they realize they've been living in the same house all along! Now the home life of confident writer Masamune Izumi and his reclusive sister Sagiri–aka the artist ''Eromanga Sensei''–will be a drama to compare with their rising careers, their restive fan base, and their rivals in the industry!

title: Yamada-kun to 7-nin no Majo
description:
Ryu Yamada is a second year student at Suzaku High. Ryu is always late for school, naps in class and gets abysmal grades. His life is a dead bore. The beautiful Urara Shiraishi, on the other hand, is Suzaku High's brightest student. One day, without explanation, their bodies are swapped! Ryu ends up in Urara's body, and Urara in Ryu's.

---
Alt. Official English: [Kodansha](https://kodansha.us/series/yamada-kun-and-the-seven-witches/)

title: Observing Elena Evoy
description:
Everyone had no doubt that Johann would be the top student at the Academy. After all, he possessed a face blessed by God, a friendly personality, and was talented in both sports and academics. However, the position was taken by someone else.

"Miss Elena. Congratulations on your accomplishment."

"Thank you."

Elena, who didn't even seem to know his name, was different. She didn't say anything to him, even though most people would've taken the opportunity to talk to him.

"Do you have something more to say?”

Johann's self-esteem was shattered when he realized she had no clue who he was.

From that moment on, Johann started to observe Elena.

---
"If you're not my rival, why do I feel this way?"

Blessed with both beauty and brains, it was only natural for Johann to be the top student at the Academy — that is, until Elena Evoy appears. To make things worse, she seems completely unfazed by his charms, shattering his self-esteem. So why can't he stop thinking about her?

title: Rin-chan wa Suezen Shitai
description: Kobayashi is a thirty-something high school art teacher, and Rin-chan is the beautiful and popular girl at the school. These two people shouldn't have anything to do with each other, but actually they share a common secret.

title: Shēnwéi Èyì Nǚpèi de Wǒ Yǎngchéng Bìngjiāo Nǚzhǔ Hěn Zhèngcháng ba?!
description:
Jiang Yang was a lead designer for a popular game company until she fell to her death while gathering inspiration for a new game. After waking up in a world of cultivation, she trained tirelessly to return to her original world, when a thread of fate pulled her into the world of an otome game.

Jiang Yang quickly realizes she is in the world of the very first game she had worked on. The thread of fate connected her to Stardew, the heroine of the game who is being bullied during her first year at the Royal Academy of Magic.

As the game progresses, Jiang Yang remembers the ridiculous story the game follows, and she decides that she can’t stand by while the game makes Stardew suffer. She helps Stardew deal with the flirtatious love interest of the original game, Crown Prince Miller, and even imparts her with some of her cultivation power. To protect Stardew from the game’s story, she even puts herself in danger. However, as Jiang Yang and Stardew’s relationship becomes closer, Jiang Yang

title: Yandere ka to Omottara Motto Yabe Onna Datta (Fan Colored)
description: A man who no longer can turn a blind eye saves a girl who's being bullied by the other classmate, but little did he know.

title: Josou Danshi wa Skirt o Nugitai!
description: Uichiro, a junior high school boy, harbors a secret he cannot share with his childhood friend, Tama-chan. He has been cross-dressing for her because she has a phobia of men. This is a thrilling yet agonizing comedy about a boy who cross-dresses for the girl he loves!

title: Yarikonda Renai Game no Akuyaku ni Tensei shita node, Gensaku Chishiki de Heroine wo Kouryaku shimasu
description:
Yuto Hatano has replayed his favorite dating sim, After School Flare Star, more times than he can count. Surely, his real school life would be way more fun if it were more like that game…but after the thought casually enters his mind one night, he wakes up inside Flare Star’s world—not as the protagonist Shun Ogasawara, but as the villain, Kanji Aku! With every heroine’s affection starting at rock bottom, his dream of romancing them all is already in shambles. Worse yet, one wrong choice means instant death. Armed with his expert game knowledge but hindered by his low stats and the heroines’ lower affection scores, Kanji must survive the game’s deadly routes to win over the girls and return to the real world!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*

title: Bandai Kaname wa Asobitai
description:
Presented by Sakusaku Tei a.k.a Hikawa Shou who wrote [Shinozaki-san Ki wo Ota Shika ni!](https://mangadex.org/title/9177/)  
  
Takara Taiyou is a studious high school student who joins the Cultural Research Society due to the fact that there are no active club members and he'd be able to concentrate on his studying.  
However, his arch enemy, the beautiful and academically gifted Bandai Kaname, also joins for the same reason. Together, they become interested in the old toys in this club room…  
Girl X Boy X nostalgic toys comedy !!  
  


---

title: Moteharune, Ashiya-kun
description:
Con người và yêu quái đã chọn con đường chung sống, khiến cho những loài quỷ quái, yêu tà cũng tràn lan khắp Kyoto. Tại một ngôi trường nằm ở vùng đất đã hóa thành ma giới ấy, có một succubus tên là Saki, nhờ vào nhan sắc và năng lực của mình mà đã trở thành “công chúa” của học viện!

Tuy vậy, ngay cả cô nàng kiêu ngạo, ngang tàng như Saki cũng có một kẻ địch không đội trời chung. Đó chính là Ashiya Yuu! Một gã trai mặt lạnh, thế mà lại không hề bị Saki quyến rũ, thậm chí còn được các á nhân khác cực kỳ yêu mến!!

Cảnh tượng đó làm cho Saki – người tự xưng là nữ hoàng – không thể nào chịu đựng nổi. Quyết không để thua những á nhân khác, Saki liên tục dùng mọi chiêu trò quyến rũ, tìm đủ mọi cách để chinh phục Ashiya trước bọn họ… Thế nhưng—!!?

title: A Story About a Creepy Girl's Smile
description: "That creepy expression is just the best!"

title: Kakushigoto
description:
An only slightly particular ability hidden from others, a power of no benefit to anyone, yet recently because of it I can't help but be interested in you.

Highlighting the secrets of 5 people and their slow-going feelings towards another…

title: Osananajimi ga Mamasugite Tsurai
description: Hina has one-sided feelings for her childhood friend, Yakumo. However, Yakumo is actually like a helicopter parent, an overprotective mama…! "I'm happy about being doted on by the person I like, but being treated like a daughter is the worst!" Wanting to become lovers with Yakumo, Hina tries her hardest to make him look at her as a woman, but…?! The romcom between a determined maiden in love and an overly-protective boy starts now!

title: Dame Inu Kanojo
description: Kuramochi Sakurako has become totally sophisticated since her high school debut. However, deep down inside, she still bears the scars of being dumped by a girl she used to like. One day after school, while walking downtown, Sakurako bumps into a random high school girl who turns out to be the very same girl who dumped her in the past! What's more, for some reason, that girl doesn't recognize her and falls in love with her at first sight and asked if they could meet again. Sakurako is furious at that girl for trying to pick her up based only on her appearance and comes up with a plan to get revenge...!

title: Protagonist x Rival (Webcomic)
description:
***“Don't you DARE try to get close to Mizushima-kun!”***  
  
Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that… though it's not the kind of problem you'd expect from this scenario.  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/kuu_u_)

title: Mikakunin de Shinkoukei
description: Đại khái phần manga của anime cùng tên, thánh nào chưa coi thì xin mời nhé. Cơ bản là em hàng Kobeni Yonomori đến 16 tuổi thì tự nhiên boy lạnh lùng Hakuya Mitsumine cùng em gái Mashiro xuất hiện. Rồi té ra boy đó là hôn thê, còn con em là em rể.

title: Toutoi. 4P Short · Stories
description:
A volume collection of sweet, short and fun 4 pages manga for everyone to enjoy and adore.  
(All are independent stories, done by various authors. having something cute/sweet making it "Precious". They can be read in any order since they aren't related to each other)

Chapter List :
1. Battle of Intelligence [by Kudo Makoto]
2. The Story of how My Wife was a  Goddess [by Konbu Wakame]
3. My Tomboy Friend [by Akitaka]
4. Deep and Distinct [by Ikuhana Niiro]
5. Hamster Life [by Niichi]
6. Mimicking Game [by Wakai Ken]
7. Predation [by Shiro Manta]
8. Film Club Couple [by Fujichika Koume]
9. Delinquent & Doctor [by Arita Imari]
10. Subscience [by Rasupe]
11. Summer Festival [by Rei]
12.  Ice Gaze [by Yuzuchiri]
13. Miss Daydreamer [by Yanagida Fumita]
14. Absentminded Childhood Friend [by Azuma Fuyu]
15. GENIUS [by Takaki Tsuyoshi]
16. Precious bug [by Nakahara Kaihei]
17. Sibling Play [by Itoyoshi Ryouichi]
18. Taking The Initiative Against a Deadpan Girlfriend [by Kaze no ko]
19. Aperi

title: Maigo no Onnanoko wo Ie made Todoketara, Genkan kara Detekita no wa Gakunen Ichi no Bishoujo deshita
description: One day, Kuroda Yusei, an introverted high school student with zero dating experience, returns a lost little girl to her house... when the most beautiful girl in his grade, Shirakawa Ayano, appears! "As thanks for saving my sister," she begins to approach him boldly for some reason, and every day is filled with mishaps!? On top of that, a busty otaku classmate and an attention-seeking junior girl also appear, and his daily life suddenly becomes more glamorous!?

title: Ashi Gei Shoujo Komura-san
description: Tsukinaga meets a new student attempting to reach her shoe locker; demonstrating her athletic ability she grabs the slippers with her feet! That's not all as Komurai Komura introduces herself to the class by writing her name with her foot!

title: Konna Joshi o Gyutte Shitai!: Short Stories
description: An anthology about girls you would want to hug.

title: Enami-kun wa Ikiru no ga tsurai
description: "The literature department of the university that I enthusiastically entered was a garden of women. "Enami is an aspiring young writer to be who realized that he is lonely. He wants to debut in a novel-like encounter seeking a suitable heroine against his opponent of destiny!

title: Ochikazuki ni Naritai Manga
description:
Matsubayashi wants to be friends with his prim and proper classmate Miyazen, and unbeknownst to him, the feeling is mutual.   
However, being a brash-looking delinquent, he has a lot of trouble communicating with her despite her valiant (and embarrassing) attempts to use references to his favorite media.  
  
---
*Not to be confused with the serialized version "Ochikazuki ni Naritai Miyazen-san."*

title: Ashita, Watashi wa Dareka no Kanojo
description: A bitter love story depicting the realities of love between female college students who earn money by renting themselves out to men as their girlfriends.

title: The Manager of the Baseball Club Is Strict Only With Me
Honey Lemon Soda
description:
Fifteen-year old Ishimori Uka is a very shy girl that can't stand being in front of someone. One day she meets a boy on the streets who's just as refreshing as lemon soda. He helped her when she was bullied and that boy made her wanting to change so she can properly express herself.
___
**Link:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Ribon](http://ribon.shueisha.co.jp/rensai/honeylemon/)

title: Nazeka Shitattekureru Gyaru
description: This is a story about a gyaru that admires you for some reason. This is a compilation of all the series’ chapters posted by Hachiji Nanakoro on social media. The Kindle version also contains exclusive omake chapters, character settings, and behind-the-scenes stories.

title: Bareteru! Kakuteru Naito
description:
Let's just say my best friend's... a magical girl. The Cocktail Knights are popular, secretive battle maidens who cleanse the people of their stress. No one knows of these girl's true identity... well they shouldn't! Only I, Riku Daichi (long time unrequited), knows of one of their secret identities. But we have to keep it under wraps. Presenting a love-comedy with confidential-levels of mistakes!.
___
**Note:** Some chapters are duplicated because most were released as twitter chapters and then compiled into a new self-published volume by the author with new order.

title: Omaera Zenin Mendokusai!
description: For some reason, Kunitachi Kunihiko, a language arts teacher, always finds himself quarreling with his student, Kazumiya Kazumi, an anti-social girl without any friends. When he tells her to make some friends, she declares: "Be my friend, Sensei."

title: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Darenimo Ienai
description: Chiaka là 1 đứa con nhà người ta, đẹp trai, học giỏi, có chân giữa dài 20 cm nhưng mỗi tội ế. 1 ngày đẹp trời cậu ta tỉnh dậy và phát hiện bản thân đã biến thành con gái !!

title: Wandance
description: Kotani Kaboku lives by suppressing his own feelings and matching those around him. He ends up attracted to Wanda Hikari who doesn't mind how she's seen by others as she's fully immersed in dance. To dance with her, he'll take on dancing despite his inexperience! Clubs, studies, job hunting, friends, love, what is it that's important? What will happen to you if you do something as useless as dancing? No no, it's completely fine to spend your youth dancing. These two are taking on both freestyle dancing and love!

title: Yeon-u ui Sunjeong
description:
Yeon Woo possesses such a delicate appearance that he could be mistaken as a female student. However, he has a secret crush on the school idol, Kang Haesol. But the shy and timid Yeon Woo has never said a word to her…

---
**Original Webtoon:** [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5483716), [Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=752532)

**Official Translations:**
* [Chinese (Simplified) / 汉语](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/LOVE/yanyudechunqing/list?title_no=1786&page=1)
* [Thai / ภาษาไทย](https://www.webtoons.com/th/romance/yeonwoo/list?title_no=2335&page=1)

title: Komori-san wa Kotowarenai!
description: Komori Shuri is a junior high school girl who is too nice to decline requests. Constantly doing favors for other people has given her incredible powers?! But even so, she is also an adolescent junior high school girl.

title: Bacouple
description:
“It's bad. I really want to kiss you right now.”
“Seriously?”
Kuroi and Shiraishi are an idioticouple (both virgins) who are making a name for themselves at their school! An annoying, cute, but slightly innocent romcom about two people who flirt regardless of the place or time!!
___
**Buy Elsewhere:**
- [Suruga-ya](https://www.suruga-ya.jp/product/detail/ZHORO62688)

title: Futaba-san Chi no Kyoudai
description: Neiko Futaba is the school idol, but little does anyone at school know what she's really like. Only her beloved younger twin brother Otohiro knows her overly clingy persona, much to his dismay. On top of that, it seems Neiko seems to be rather determined to seduce her brother in every way possible. Unfortunately (or fortunately) for Otohiro, it is just an everyday occurrence in the Futaba household…

title: Legendary Wizard
description: A young noblewoman once dreamed of becoming a magic user like in the old tales, but her time in magic school has dimmed her passion. One day, a mysterious man comes to her rescue in the forest, using magic like in the old stories. Despite the fact that he is clearly skilled in magic, he is thrilled by the idea of learning new techniques. Since the only way to do that in this day and age is in magic school, he alters his appearance to school-age and decides to accompany her back to school!

title: Yukidoke to Agapanthus
description: Natsuki, the prince of an all-girls school meets an innocent (girl) transfer student, Shun, who doesn't treat Natsuki like a prince, but instead treats her as a "friend." Natsuki excels in everything she does and even has a fan club at school. Even though she was looked at with admiration, her days were somehow unfulfilled... Although Natsuki feels uncomfortable with her first "friend", Shun's innocent smile and bright personality make Natsuki's heart flutter...?

title: Gin no Saji
description:
The latest work by Hiroshi Arakawa of the super hit "Fullmetal Alchemist"! Yugo Hachiken enters Oezo Agricultural High School surrounded by nature. He chases after a calf and gets lost, and is surprised to learn that chickens are born from the anus during practical training...etc. 

He is in the middle of his adolescence, bewildered by too many unexpected situations for someone raised in the city. He is supported and mocked by his friends and livestock, and struggles day by day in this graffiti of dairy farming youth!

---

- English release by [Yen Press](https://yenpress.com/9780316416191/silver-spoon-vol-1/)
- Indonesian release by Elex Media

---  
- **Won the 5th Manga Taisho Award Grand Prize in 2012**  
- **Won the 58th Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen in 2012**
- **Won the 1st Japan Food Culture Contents Award in 2013**

title: Ore ga Ojousama Gakkou ni "Shomin Sample" to shite Rachirareta Ken
description: Hãy tự nhận mình bị gay, và sẽ có ngày bạn được như anh main. Do bị hiểu lầm là gay nên anh đã dc đem đến 1 trường nữ sinh cực chất nằm sâu trong vùng núi non xa xôi ko có trên bản đồ với tư cách thường dân. Đây là trường chuyên đào tạo các tiểu thư nên anh có trách nhiệm hướng dẫn họ hòa nhập với đời sống xã hội. Và thế là anh thành harem king của 1 dàn loli trẻ đẹp

title: Ame Demo Hare Demo
description: Country-born Mikoto and student council member Ren have always spent their time after school together. But one day, that ordinary routine suddenly comes to an end… With Uchouten High School as the stage, the love and youth of these impressionable young girls is about to begin!

title: Fujiyama-san wa Shishunki
description: Fujiyama-san is 181 cm (approx. 5' 11'') and she is the ace player for her middle-school's volleyball team. Kanba-kun is 160 cm (approx. 5' 3") and has known Fujiyama since their preschool years. With his prankster friends, Kanba peeks into the girl's locker room right when Fujiyama is undressing. From then on, he could not get the image of Fujiyama out of his mind, so he decides to ask her out. She says yes. Enjoy their naive and secretive relationship as Kanba ogles his tall girlfriend in many different situations.

title: Ore wa Inu Dewa Arimasen!
description: After mindlessly accepting his teacher's request to join the animal care committee, Misaki Souma finds himself in a strange situation with his senpai, the President, who sees him as a dog!

title: SANDA
description:
In the year 2080, the world is like it is now, yet different. Government-arranged marriages, elaborate plastic surgery, and medical science are at the forefront of Japanese society.

Sanda Kazushige is a middle-school student who hasn't quite matured, despite being in the thralls of puberty. Put into a life-threatening situation by his classmate Fuyumura, Sanda discovers his uncanny ability to turn into a burly (and more grown) Santa Claus, and is thrown into a world of chaos to save his fellow students in only ways Santa Claus can do, while trying to solve the mysteries of the school he attends and the truth to where his supposedly-dead classmate Ono went.

title: Kikaijikake no Marie
description: Marie gets hired to be a maid. But not just any maid... A robot maid!? How will she get through her new life pretending to be an emotionless mechanical maid?

title: Koi to Utatane
description:
Hana, who loves to sleep and has a hobby of sleep research,   
is sharing her apartment with her student (and relative) Takashi Kiichi.   
There are lots of sleeping laws that can be used right away in such two lives…   
Let's sleep together with the right mood: our life together begins!

title: Maken no Hanayome
description: Every single classmate is a beautiful girl! That world is one where monsters run rampant. And the "Magic Swords" used to hunt monsters could only be wielded by women... Or so it was supposed to be. Naoto Fujiwara became the first man in history to be chosen as a partner by a "Magic Sword." What's more, he was chosen by the legendary Magic Sword, the ancestral Magic Sword 00 (Double Oh).

title: Umarekawatta Kensei, Kenshi ga Reiguu sareru Majutsu Shijou Shugi no Gakuen de Musou suru
description:
Lyus, once hailed as the Sword Saint, was reborn through some twist of fate with all his memories intact. Seeking to reach even greater heights, he enrolled in the Royal Capital's First Academy — the largest in the land. 

However, in a world where magic reigned supreme, swordsmen were relegated to the sidelines and treated with disdain. But such common perceptions meant nothing to Lyus, who retained all the power he possessed in his previous life. 

Wielding only his sword, he effortlessly overwhelmed the magic users, and in time, he became the beacon of hope for all swordsmen.

title: Ookami-kun wa Hayakawa-san ni Katenai
description: A story about the quiet transfer student, Ogami-kun. The blood of a werewolf flows through him. One day, while Ogami-kun was leaving school as a wolf, he discovered the hidden side of Hayakawa, a classmate who normally hates his guts…

title: Itou-kun wa Koi o Shiranai
description:
The new transfer student, Itou Kazuki, comes with a secret, hidden behind his bandage…  
  
When Itou-kun, clueless in love, meets Yoshiuchi Aika, clumsy romantic, what will become of this unconventional couple?

title: Watashi, 2-banme no Kanojo de Ii kara.
description:
Mối quan hệ giữa hai người "đứng thứ hai" dần dần trở nên méo mó và bất ổn!?

"Tớ cũng thích cậu, Kirishima… nhưng chỉ là người thứ hai mà thôi."

Tớ và Hayasaka đều có người mình yêu nhất, nhưng lại hẹn hò với nhau như những kẻ về nhì. Dù vậy, chúng tớ vẫn là người yêu của nhau—cùng nhau về nhà, lén lút gặp gỡ, và làm những chuyện chẳng thể nói với ai.

Nhưng vì chỉ là người thứ hai, nên nếu một ngày nào đó, người mà bọn tớ thực sự yêu cũng đáp lại tình cảm, thì mối quan hệ này sẽ kết thúc. Chúng tớ đã thỏa thuận như vậy. Đáng lẽ phải là như thế…

"Xin lỗi nhé. Tớ ngốc lắm, nên cứ ngày càng thích cậu hơn thôi."

Dù đã đến rất gần với người mình yêu nhất, nhưng cả hai vẫn chìm sâu vào mối quan hệ này, chẳng thể dừng lại, chẳng thể buông tay nhau…

Khi đã chẳng còn đường lui, tình yêu méo mó, nguy hiểm và không còn thuần khiết này rồi sẽ đi về đâu…!?

title: Miseru, Mitsumeru, Futari Dake
description: The thick clothes are just a camouflage to hide the fact that She doesn't wear anything under her clothes. I know this because I've been shown a lot. That girl… Hoshijima-san… is a crazy exhibitionist woman.

title: KAKAO 79%
description: Ayano Tsubasa and Ichinose Yuu are childhood friends. Since they were kids, they were inseparable. But one day, they have to part each other's company because they are both transferring with their families to new homes. Clueless of where they will each transfer, they were shocked to find out that they have transferred to the same school.

title: Koisuru Futari wa Kiba wo Kakusu ~Gap ga Arisugiru Couple no Hanashi~
description: Sengoku Yukiya and Ichijou Airi are high school students who met online and became close friends through offline meetups. "I want us to get even closer." Yukiya and Airi sense the beginnings of romance, but each harbors a secret they can't tell the other—Yukiya is the leader of his local delinquent all-boys school, and Airi is the leader of her local delinquent all-girls school! Their true identities absolutely must not be revealed!?

title: Koi wa Ameagari no You ni
description:
Akira Tachibana is a soft-spoken high school student who used to be a part of the track and field club but, due to an injury, she is no longer able to run as fast as she once could. Working part-time at a family restaurant as a recourse, she finds herself inexplicably falling love with her manager, a divorced 45-year-old man with a young son.  
  
Despite the age gap, Akira wholeheartedly embraces his mannerisms and kind nature, which is seen as spinelessness by the other employees, and little by little, the two begin to understand each other. Although unable to explain why exactly she is attracted to him, Akira believes that a concrete reason is not needed to truly love someone. On a rainy day, she decides to finally tell her manager about how she feels… But just how will he react?

title: Goukaku no Tame no! Yasashii Sankaku Kankei Nyuumon
description:
Middle-schooler Mayuki wants to enter Ohtomo high school to join her beloved senpai Akira. Problem is: her grades are so terrible there's no way she can make it into such a high level school.  
  
Thus her mother hires a high school girl named Rin as a private teacher to help her daughter. Seeing how the girl looks so much more mature than her, Mayuki ends up asking Rin to teach her more than just school subjects…

title: Unmei wa Yaku ni Tatanai
description: "Lần theo sợi tơ hồng, người sẽ tìm ra "định mệnh" vĩnh cửu của đời mình." Ngày nọ, thế giới xuất hiện những sợi tình duyên kết nối các cặp đôi tương lai với nhau. Tình yêu "nhờ duyên" mọc lên như nấm, dẫu vậy, vẫn có những con người ghét sợi tơ đó như nữ chính của chúng ta, Tsumugi. Nói là ghét vậy, cho tới khi chị ta được nối duyên..

title: Sannensa
description:
Mizuki and Kazuya, childhood friends, are 3 years apart.  
It's not really a so-called "Age Gap" but that makes some distance between them during their youth.  
From their childhood to the present, the story will be told about these two who are 3 years apart.  
  


---

**Links:**  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=596062)  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/shimazakikazumi)

title: The Cold Beauty at School Became My Pet Cat
description: The real identity of my beautiful kouhai who acts cold most of the time but gets shy when she wears a pair of cat ears is..?

title: MajiTora!
description:
Minami-kun spots a poster recruiting new members for the Magical Girl Club. Thinking "Cosplay cuties woohoo!" he decides to join… What the hell!? It's not cosplay, we actually become magical girls??  
  
A slice of life love-comedy revolving around magical girls and slippery slopes.

title: Seishun wa Sankakukei no Loop
description:
Because I've been watching her more closely than anyone else, I could tell. That she's fallen in love. And that the one she's in love with... is my best friend—our mutual childhood friend. Determined to let go of his own feelings and support her love instead, the protagonist, Tsubaki, makes up his mind. Thanks to his efforts, the two childhood friends—always by each other's side—finally end up together. After seeing it all through, Tsubaki spends a sleepless night, choking on the urge to scream... And then, when he next opens his eyes, he finds himself back one week in the past, to the moment before he gave up on his feelings.

(Source: ComicWalker, edited)

title: Nozo × Kimi
description:
Suga Kimio finds himself hiding in the girls locker room, unable to move or escape the situation as the girls in his school crowd in. Although he originally had no ulterior motives, he found himself panicking as he heard the girls coming in and hid in a locker. Komine Nozomi, one of the shy girls in his class finds him, but surprisingly covers for him. Perplexed but glad, Kimio goes home.  
  
Later that night, he gets a text from Nozomi who happens to live across the way on the same floor of the complex they both live in. She blackmails him into agreeing to show each other’s bodies when she texts him. Kimio has to abide by Nozomi’s insane demands or risk ruining his school life so they both start their little peep show through each other’s windows…  
  
Nozo x Kimi: 2-nensei-hen is the second season of the series, but continues the chapter count from the previous magazine.  
  
[See AnimeNewsNetwork for the anime.](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=16241

title: Yumizuka Iroha wa Tejun ga Daiji!
description: Yumizuka-san grew up as the daughter of one of Japan's leading families of archery. But she had a secret about her seemingly perfect life! A tempestuous romantic comedy about a captivating archer!

title: Watashi Datte Seishun Shitai Desu yo, Hontou wa.
description:
Một nữ sinh trung học với sở thích đọc sách, học hành và thể thao đều ở mức bình thường.  Otobe Yukari, sống lặng lẽ, kín đáo và luôn tự nhủ với chính bản thân rằng: “Mình chỉ là nhân vật phụ thôi…”. 

Ở trong lớp, Yukari không hợp với Fujimi Shouko, một cô bạn luôn là trung tâm của mọi sự chú ý.  Thế nhưng, khi cả hai bất ngờ cùng tham gia ủy ban làm vườn, Shouko lại trò chuyện với Yukari một cách tự nhiên khiến Yukari đã phải lòng cô ngay tức khắc.  “Làm sao để có thể gần gũi với cậu ấy hơn nhỉ…?” Yukari trăn trở, cho đến một ngày, cô vô tình bắt gặp Shouko đang khóc vì thất tình... 

Một câu chuyện tình học đường lãng mạn, hài hước giữa cô nàng tỏa sáng và cô gái mờ nhạt, mở đầu cho một tương lai đầy thử thách!

title: Fudatsuki no Kyouko-chan
description:
Fudatsuki Kenji is known in his school for two things: for being a delinquent and a siscon. He constantly follows his little sister Kyoko around, fixing her giant ribbon, and chasing off any boys who might be interested in her.   
However, the truth is much stranger than what people believe: he doesn't actually have a crush on his sister. In fact, he likes Hibino, the only girl in his class who isn't afraid of him.

title: By Spring
description:
Souta, a penniless, phoneless, destitute middle schooler, met a high school girl with a stray cat underneath a bridge…  
The girl laughed at his minuscule remaining change, and made a surprising proposal with "For this 24 yen of yours, I'll let you buy me," and then…!?  
  


---

title: Ao Haru Ride
description: Yoshioka Futaba có một vài lý do mà cô bạn muốn “thiết lập lại” hình ảnh và cuộc sống của mình khi vào cấp 3. Bởi vì trông cô rất dễ thương nên đã bị các bạn nữ ở trường cấp 2 tẩy chay, và bởi vì một lý do không thể hiểu được, cô bạn đã không thể diễn tả được cảm xúc của mình với người mà mình thích, Tanaka-kun.Bây giờ ở trường cấp 3, cô bạn quyết định trở nên mất nữ tính càng nhiều càng tốt để bạn bè không phải ghen tị với cô. Khi sống theo 1 cách thật thỏa mãn, cô đã gặp lại Tanaka-kun, nhưng bây giờ cậu đã đổi tên thành Mabuchi Koi. Cậu ấy cũng nói ra cảm giác của mình đối với cô bạn khi còn học cấp 2, nhưng bây giờ mọi thứ không thể lặp lại lần nữa. Liệu Futaba có thể tiếp tục tình yêu của mình mà cô bạn đã chưa bao giờ có thể bắt đầu từ 3 năm trước?

title: Hen na Chishiki ni Kuwashii Kanojo Takayukashiki Souko-san
description:
Takayukashiki-san knows many things that are way too weird (especially perverted things). With her, you will become a little wiser and a little more indecent <3  
A comedy manga that will satisfy your perverted curiosity!

title: Goodbye, In-law!
description: Because of a misunderstanding 8 years ago, Jung Da-ae and Lee Han-eol are mortal enemies. To make things worse, their siblings get married making these two in-laws! But then the bride and groom are killed in an unfortunate accident. In a moment of mourning and arguing in the middle of the road, Jung Da-ae and Lee Han-eol are hit by a truck, killed and transported back to when they were in high school! Is this their chance to fix everything?!

title: Mabarai-san wa Boku wo Karitai
description:
My hobbies are shopping and searching for sweets. The rest- kill the vampires.

One day the girl who transferred to my school froze the class with her shocking self-introduction. She dyes my gray high school life bright red.

A unique youth romantic comedy by "Self-proclaimed vampire hunting gal" x "High school boy living in the shade"!!

title: Kimi no Suizou wo Tabetai
description: One day, I – a high schooler – found a paperback in the hospital. The “Disease Coexistence Journal” was its title. It was a diary that my classmate, Sakura Yamauchi, had written in secret. Inside, it was written that due to her pancreatic disease, her days were numbered. And thus, I coincidentally went from Just-a-Classmate to a Secret-Knowing-Classmate. It was as if I were being drawn to her, who was my polar opposite. However, the world presented the girl that was already suffering from an illness with an equally cruel reality…

title: Bizarre Love Triangle
description:
Yano Shiki, a boy who only shows a facade.
Minase Akiha, a quiet and reserved transfer student.
Minase Haruka, the other side of Akiha.
This is their bizarre love story, one where the distance between them is limitless/zero.

title: Ienai Himitsu No Aishikata (Magazine)
description:
Highschool teacher Saeki Nao is secretly a hardcore otaku who loves yuri manga.
One day, at a doujinshi convention they participate in, Nao is eager to convey her feelings to "Nyapoleon", an artist she worships.
However, it turned out to be a girl from her school, Kurumizawa Haruka, and moreover, she had to help her.
After the event, they decided to go out for a meal, at Haruka's suggestion….
When she wakes up in the morning, there is Haruka in the bed…?!

title: Hirano to Kagiura
description: Basketball players. Bad boys who aren’t really bad boys. Roommates. Senpai-kouhai BL romance. It all started when Kagiura moved into the school dorms with what seemed to be a bad-boy upperclassman. But after he’s left in the tender care of his mother hen of a roommate, Hirano, it’s too much to ask for Kagiura not to fall in love…right?!

title: Tasogare Otome × Amnesia
description:
Legend states that the ghost of a student who died at Seikyou Private Academy still haunts the grounds to this day... A truth that first year student Teiichi uncovers when he stumbles into that very ghost, Yuuko! However, with no memories of her previous life, she enlists the help of Teiichi and opens a paranormal investigations club to unravel the school’s ghastly mysteries.

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

title: Watashi no Shiranai, Senpai no 100 Ko no Koto
description:
「Senpai, you dropped this.」  
  
That sudden call marked the beginning of a relationship of an aloof senpai and his cute overenthusiastic kouhai-chan. Despite not having any contact previously except for using the same train station to get to school, senpai unwillingly agreed to a promise: from that day on, they would have to answer one question every day no matter what it was without telling any lie.  
  
The disinterested senpai who doesn’t want to give up on his peaceful commuting time, and the passionate kouhai-chan who doesn’t want to give up on the only student taking the same train as her. This is the story of how their relationship will progress with just one question a day.  
  
A new fluffy senpai- kouhai romcom from the popular web novel!

title: Sei-chan Capacity Over desu!
description: When my favorite childhood friend Sei-chan moved in with us, he started teasing me such as pushing me over, sneaking into my room, and taking other liberties! The daily flirting attack from the handsome Sei-chan is too overwhelming!

title: Tsubaki-chou Lonely Planet
description: Ohno Fumi is a poor 2nd year high school student. Because of her father's debts, she's kicked out of her own home and has to rely on her own connections to survive. Thus begins her life as a live-in housekeeper for a reclusive writer.

title: Byakuda no Hanamuko
description:
A white snake who is a divine messenger and a childhood friend with a mystery. Entangled obsessions in a Japanese-style fantasy.
Tsubaki, a high school student with a predisposition for bad luck, has a one-sided love for his childhood friend Sakuya, who is both beautiful and talented. Then, one day while leaving school they are randomly attacked on the street.

In the ancient capital Kyoto, a lovestory defying fate unfolds.

title: Mikoto to Rei
description:
"Hey, Rei. Your hickey's showing, you know...?"

A story about a free-spirited gyaru, Mikoto, and a serious disciplinary committee member Rei. What will Rei do about Mikoto's teasing? Well, she's not completely against it...

(Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ijimeru Yabai Yatsu
description: [It is not just "bullying."] Nakajima was ruling over the class as a "bully." The subject of bullying is a fragile girl, Shirasaki-san. Going as far as violence, every day was horrible. Everyone in the class pretends to not see it. If they stop, then they will be the next target. Nakajima performs "bullying" as if possessed. It was clear that something was wrong. Why does he do such brutal acts? The reality is terrible...

title: Uza Kawaii Kouhai to Ichaicha suru dake no Anthology Comic
description:
Morals Committee Members, Drama Club, Photography Club, and boobs of all sizes - a full lineup of all kinds of cute kouhais! They'll laugh, tease, and even seduce their believed senpais! And they won't hold back to ask, "Aren't I cute?"  


---

**Contents**  
**Cover**: [Take](https://mangadex.org/author/bf1dd32e-94c7-43a0-ad91-af05d7897d5b)  
  
- Chapter 1. One Side of You by **Katou Yuuichi**
- Chapter 2. Ruruko Tachibana is Troublesome by **Tadano Natsu**
- Chapter 3. Sahara Won't Lose Today Either! by **Kutsugaeru**
- Chapter 4. Nishigaki Taking Advantage of Love by **Yasuda Kousuke**
- Chapter 5. Andou-senpai, Morals in Disorder by **Kashima Ui**
- Chapter 6. Afterschool Personal Lesson by **Takahashi Osamu**
- Chapter 7 by **Okada Anmitsu**

title: Kimi no Yokogao shika Mirenai
description:
The popular Fujimori Sachi never faces Kishimoto Arata, who sits next to her in class. No matter how hard Kishimoto tries to see her face, she brilliantly turns away from him. As a result, he has only ever seen her side profile. But she talks to him normally otherwise. This mysterious girl seems to have a secret…? A cute school romantic comedy about a girl who only shows her side profile VS a boy who won't give up ♪  


---

title: Amaesasete Hinamori-san!
description:
Ichigo Hinamori has always looked up to her senpai Yaya Suou for her poise, impeccable grades, and kind heart. But that all changes the day Ichigo stumbles upon Yaya wailing like a little kid in the nurse’s office. It turns out everyone’s favorite honor student is desperate to get off her pedestal and be spoiled rotten instead—and now she’s hoping Ichigo will be the one to indulge her!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

___
Suou Yaya is admired by the whole school. Perfect grades, beautiful, an exemplary girl overall worthy of the praise she receives. From afar, her childish underclassman Hinamori Ichigo yearns to be like her...

...That is, until she finds her beloved Suou-senpai is a LOT more childish than her, and wants to be spoiled rotten, lest she'll throw a tantrum.

title: Zettai Watashi no Koto Suki Daro
description: Sayaka's friend, Mako, is a bit weird. And she's totally in love with Sayaka. Or maybe not?

title: Kaichou wa Maid-sama!
description:
Ayuzawa Misaki is the student council president of the former all-boy school, Seika High School. In order to protect the girls, she battles the boys every day. On the other hand, she secretly works at a "Maid Cafe". But a popular boy from school, Usui Takumi, found out! Living in between the double identity of a Maid and a student council president~  
  
Also included in this manga is a short story called Toumei na Sekai in volume one (Ch 4.1).

title: The Student Council President Solves Everything on the Bed
description: Incidents have been happening around the school, and it's up to the Student Council to resolve it before things get out of hands. The S.C President, Washimiya Hikari, has been entrusted with the task of cracking the code while all council members gather clues for her - however, due to her weak constitution, she is unable to leave her room and must solve cases remotely. Not only that, she is also good-for-nothing without her uniform, so the vice president, Kise Souta, has been entrusted with a secret mission shared between them: To help Hikari change her clothes whenever she needs to solve a case...

title: Academy Player reul Jugyeotda
description:
Being a character of your favorite game is great! Sure, he’s just a minor NPC, but Corin knows this game like the back of his hand. With his knowledge and the main player Sihu’s abilities, everything’s going smoothly - until Corin discovers Sihu’s been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items. 

Horrified but powerless to stop him, Corin awaits the end of the game - only for Sihu to mysteriously fail at the last mission. 

Instantly, Corin travels three years back in time. Now, he’s determined to kill Sihu and take on his role - defeat the final boss and save the world.

title: Hello, Melancholic!
description: Asano Minato is hiding in plain sight. She’s tall, but she’s very quiet, and very withdrawn. She keeps her hair over her face and her head down. It’s not hard to see that she’s avoiding being seen. While eating lunch alone in her secret spot, she hears what is obviously an instrument. She immediately wonders why, since this high school doesn’t have a band. She knows that…because that’s why she transferred here.

title: After School Bitchcraft
description: When the Chemistry teacher secretly practices witchcraft at normal school, many things can go wrong! Fuyumi Renji realises this as Kirise Ririka somehow walks through all his magic barriers and interrupts his spellcasting! How could a normal high school girl ever be able to do this?

title: Rosario to Vampire
description:
The story revolves around Tsukune Aono, a boy who accidentally gets enrolled in a school inhabited by monsters and demons. He quickly befriends Moka Akashiya, a vampire who soon develops an obsession with his blood, and later meets other girls who soon take a romantic liking to him.  


---

title: Inaho-kun wa Nise Kanojo no Hazu na no ni
description:
Mori Shintaro, a new first-year student, yearns for the sparkling high school life of having a girlfriend and experiencing youth, but is ridiculed by those around him. His classmate, Inaho Sawatari, entered the school as the top student and is a highly regarded beauty. The two are not supposed to cross paths, but after an incident where they are mistaken for a couple, Inaho makes an unexpected proposal: "Shall we pretend that we're really dating?"
___
**Notes:**
- The pre-serialization series is [Houkago no Cinderella-kun](https://mangadex.org/title/147b8fd6-5232-45df-993f-35c908cf41a2/houkago-no-cinderella-kun).

title: Angel Densetsu
description: The story is of Kitano Seiichirou, a very kind and pure-hearted young man, with a horrifying, monstrous face. People being what they are, they think he's a terrifying delinquent, and there are plenty of chance misunderstandings (coupled with Kitano's convenient inability to understand what's happening around him) that propel him into the position of "school guardian", a.k.a. head thug on campus.

title: Miageru to Kimi wa
description: It's the start of a 120% pure love-com height difference story! After his first love confession is rejected, the troubled and short Yuuki Shibuki finds himself crying away his heartbreak at a park. Feeling depressed and blaming his short height and feminine looks for his failure, his pain is eased when he encounters a cool, hooded street musician who has a soothing touch and skill in the guitar. The next day he meets that same musician at the park and learns that 'he' was in fact a tall girl named Takamine Chikako and that she was playing the song he heard the last time specifically for him. Yuuki is quickly smitten by such an unimaginably dashing, handsome girl. It is not love, he thinks. It is a miracle.

title: Chihayafuru
description:
Chihaya is a girl in the sixth grade, still not old enough to even know the meaning of the word zeal. But one day, she meets Arata, a transfer student from rural Fukui prefecture. Though docile and quiet, he has an unexpected skill: his ability to play competitive karuta, a traditional Japanese card game. Chihaya is struck by his obsession with the game, along with his ability to pick out the right card and swipe it away before any of his opponents. However, Arata is transfixed by her as well, all because of her unbelievable natural talent for the game. Don't miss the first volume in this story of adolescent lives and emotions playing out in the most dramatic of ways.

---
  
- **Won the 2nd Manga Taisho Award in 2009** 
- **Won the 35th Kodansha Manga Award for Shoujo in 2011**
  


---

- [Chihayafuru Charity Fund Store](https://chihayafund.st

title: Dansou no Partner
description:
Mitsuru Masamune, a mild mannered high-schooler who hasn't had much of a presence since his birth one day had a roommate move in.
A silver-haired, blue eyed exchange student all the way from Germany, Leo.
They had a dignified appearance and had a cool way with their words with no room for timidity.
He used to think that Leo was a being far off from someone like him till he got to know about a secret of his after which their relation got a bit more special...?!

Cancellation notice: https://magazine.jp.square-enix.com/biggangan/information/20231125.html

title: Gorin no Megami-sama ~Nadeshiko Ryou no Medal Gohan~
description: The main character, Kominato Ryo, who is only engaged in cooking, was allowed to enter the prestigious Cho Gakuen Private School on the condition that he work as a cook in a student dormitory under the supervision of his father. However, the "dormitory" was the women's dormitory where future gold medal candidates lived. The nutritional requirements of top athletes are naturally high. Fill their stomachs and take on the challenging mission of building your body for the Olympic Games!

title: The Villainess and Miss Demon Lord
description:
Two girls, hand-in-hand, cross over to another world, into a magical academy set in a melodramatic Western fantasy novel. They transform into two people completely unrecognizable to each other: One is a rich villainess who is incapable of using any kind of magic, while the other is a young girl extremely talented in the field of magic, who's said to be the reincarnation of the Demon Lord. Originally set to save the world, the two of them unexpectedly fall in love.

"Male lead, female lead, may you two live a long and happy life together, forever. I, the villainess, am going to elope with Miss Demon Lord!"

title: Kanojo no Imouto to Kiss wo Shita.
description: Hiromichi Satou has been single his whole life, but, he recently got a girlfriend named Saikawa Haruka, and they have been dating for a month. His father remarries, and he gets a new step-sister Saikawa Shigure, the identical twin of Haruka. Sato and Shigure agree to keep their step-sibling relationship a secret from everyone, and Haruka. How will the story unfold?

title: Osananajimi wa Muhyoujou
description: Sayawaki has been friends with Haburi ever since kindergarten. Yet she only has an expressionless face which makes her unreadable to Sayawaki. One day, Sayawaki asked Haburi what her favourite type was, and her response…

title: Kawaihara-senpai wa Kawaii (Saotome-kun) ga Suki!
description: Saotome-kun is short and terrible at sports. He thought that studying was his only good point, but in his new high school, his grades are a far cry from stellar. As he was feeling down and thinking he had nothing, the academically brilliant, sporty, elegant, and beautiful "Perfect Student Council President" Kawaihara-senpai approached him. Having maintained her position at the top of the grade since she enrolled, she offers to tutor Saotome on one condition: he must wear a sailor uniform while studying with her.

title: Senpai, Chotto ii Desu ka?
description: Cô gái giàu có và được nuông chiều 不知火零(Shiranui Rei) không biết nhiều điều về thế giới xung quanh! Cô thường hỏi những điều không hiểu cho đàn anh của cô ở câu lạc bộ thư viện. Nhưng những câu hỏi của cô đôi khi lại khó trả lời lắm…!?

title: Gyaru to Otaku wa Wakari Aenai.
description:
Saotome is the top Gyaru in class - she's loud, known by everyone, and stylish. Otonashi, on the other hand, is the complete opposite. These two carry their own baggage that would ruin their built up identities… but what happens if they were to discover each other's secret?  
  
Read now to see the humorous life of how they do their best to avoid spilling the other's secret!

title: Kimi no Negai ga Kanau made
description:
For his high school debut, Shishidou Minto pretended to be an outgoing playboy, spinning lies about the girlfriends he goes through. This corner he backed himself into weighs heavily on his mind when he joins a school trip, and he's determined to use the occasion to get a girlfriend for real. But then an unimaginable incident strikes him and his classmates, setting the stage for a locked-room love comedy centered around the wishes of these boys and girls.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Soulmate
description: Two girls are friends, "sisters," and soulmates. Yu Qi, a 17-year-old high school student, wakes up to find that she and her 27-year-old self had switched souls. One has to relive the experience of meeting her lover again and the other has to bear the responsibility of being a girlfriend, despite being unfamiliar with the girl she's dating. Both worlds are always changing, but the only one who never changes is… you, who is always by my side.

title: Kareshi Tokidoki Kanojo
description: Akizuki Hodaka, a high school student just turned 17, met the school’s madonna, Shishizaki Chihaya due to a certain turn of events. Prepared to be shot down, he gambled it all by telling her 'I love you. Please go out with me!' And that how they started going out. But Chihaya has a secret Hodaka cannot even imagine…? A kind of love changes everything. The curtain raises on a new frontier in shonen love comedy!

title: Kanojo, Hitomishirimasu
description: Sumi Sakurasawa is shy. Even simple things, like going for a donut with someone or calling out to a stranger that they've dropped something, paralyze her with fear. Her strategy? Become a "rent-a-girlfriend" and make some cash while she practices her people skills! But raising the stakes even higher might not be the foolproof solution she thought it was...
