And even worse, to keep the gig, she needs five-star reviews, and that means no freezing up or freaking out on a date... How is that even possible?!

title: Kawaii nante Kiitenai!!
description:
Madoka is obsessed with shoujo manga—specifically manga that features younger, innocent guys who fall for their Senpai. So she should be thrilled when a gorgeous kohai comes to work at her father’s restaurant…except he’s rude and standoffish, and wants nothing to do with her. But when she protects him from some extra-pushy fans, he finds that maybe he’s found someone letting his walls down for…!

---
Madoka is a high school girl who loves cute younger boys. One day, Shikura arrives as a part-time worker at her parents' diner! Shikura is beautiful and handsome, but he's not super nice?! She thought she would never like him, but the way he sometimes looks is agonizingly cute! How can she not really like him?!

title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War Official Doujin
description: "Kaguya Muốn Được Tỏ Tình" là một bộ manga về "cuộc chiến tình yêu và trí tuệ" giữa hai thiên tài trung học, cả hai đều cố gắng làm cho người kia phải tỏ tình trước. Tuy nhiên, đây là một "spinoff ero" sẽ khiến bạn ước rằng nó thuộc về dòng chính của loạt truyện!

title: Mou Furenai Kimi
description:
In their high school days Shiraishi would tease her classmate Arashi constantly always touching his shaved head. Now, many years later, Shiraishi finds herself enthralled with a rising celebrity that she sees on TV an in magazines. This celebrity being none other that Arashi, her former classmate, now with long grown out hair. She wanders the streets hoping that by some happenstance she might once again meet him and be able to tell him the things she's kept in her heart for so many years.
___
**Links:**
- Alternative official raw: [Comic Walker](https://comic-walker.com/detail/KC_005466_S) | [Kadokawa](https://www.kadokawa.co.jp/product/search/?auth=%E5%BD%B1%E5%B1%B1%E5%87%8C%E7%A9%BA)

title: The Story of How the Girl of My Dreams Was a Stalker
description: The story of how the girl of my dreams was a stalker.

title: Ice Cream Kanojo
description: Except for being a little short, Kanta Date is a completely ordinary high schooler. This nobody however, managed to get a girlfriend. This girlfriend is a real poker-face and to the world, seems cold as ice. However, just for Kanta, she is really sweet. Different from her outward appearance and sweeter than sugar, she always manages to overwhelm Kanta.

title: Mysterious Girlfriend X
description:
One day, a strange transfer student appears before Tsubaki. Urabe Mikoto is an antisocial girl, whose hobby is just sleeping during class-breaks. 
One day, Tsubaki goes to wake her up and accidentally tastes her drool… And gets hooked on that!  
  
After that, he starts going out with her and gets to know her better. Her second hobby, as it turns out, is carrying around scissors in her panties 
and cutting paper into flowers… or whatever else is getting on her nerves…

title: Kono ato Mechakucha Rabukome Shita
description: I like romantic comedies. However, romance doesn't develop like that in reality. There was once a time where I thought that. Encountering a girl who fell from the sky, my school life changes with a clang.

title: Odoriba ni Skirt ga naru
description:
Haruma Kiki always dreamed of doing ballroom dance as the feminine "follower" role, but as she aged she only grew taller and taller, eventually causing her to give up ever looking good in a dress or anything ladylike. Now, as a second year in high school, she specializes in the masculine "leader" role—until one day, her partner suddenly leaves her. When Toribami Michiru, a short and pretty first year, shows up wanting to join the ballroom dance club, Kiki asks her to be her new partner, but Michiru reveals that she only plays the leader role—and she wants none other than Kiki as her partner.  
  
Bimonthly serialisation in Yuri Hime.

title: Ouran High School Host Club
description: One day, Haruhi, a scholarship student at exclusive Ouran High School, breaks an $80,000 vase that belongs to the "Host Club," a mysterious campus group consisting of six super-rich (and gorgeous) guys. To pay back the damages, she is forced to work for the club, and it's there that she discovers just how wealthy the boys are and how different they are from everybody else. [Viz]

title: Gun X Clover
description: Mikado High School trains the best students to be the best mercenary bodyguards. But Morito Hayama, a merc escort student with no rank whatsoever, is suddenly assigned to guard a person so highly valued that no escort has ever survived before. Will his subject survive the experience? Will he survive?!

title: Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.
description:
In this world, when human beings reach the age of 12, their bodies gradually change to the genders they wish to be. And by the time they are 14 years old, their appearances change to reflect their genders. But by spring of my eighteenth year, I am still without a gender…

---
Alt. Official English: [Square Enix](https://squareenixmangaandbooks.square-enix-games.com/en-us/series/just-like-mona-lisa)

title: Gotou-san wa Furimukasetai! (Pre-serialization)
description: Gotou-san, the prettiest girl in school, tries to get the attention of Maeda-kun, who sits in front of her. She secretly harbors a crush on him, but Maeda, who lacks self-confidence, doesn't notice her feelings. What is the future of Gotou-san's unwavering love?

title: Yoshioka-san Is in a Bad Mood
description:
Short tales about a girl who appears to be in a bad mood, and a boy who's nice to her.  
  
Creator-approved translations by [TheElusiveTaco.](https://twitter.com/elusive_taco)  
  
**Links:**  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/fukuchi_tsubasa)

title: Kimi no Koto Tabete Iii?
description:
I eat the same things at the same time. Your protagonist Omi Sorasaki is a high school student who's a devotee to the ordinary. But one day, a mysterious and beautiful girl transfers over and says to him "I have something to say to you alone after school." Omi's in a panic wondering "am I getting a confession?" as the things she has to say are…  
  
… and what happens after is only just the first wave of an assault on all that is ordinary! Thrust into an unusual world, a forbidden and "predacious" love comedy begins!

title: Shitsurengo, Kenaku datta Osananajimi Ga sato Kashi Mitai ni Amai - Sugar After Bitter
description: Yuu Sawatari, a high school boy, is sick after suffering a painful heartbreak. His nextdoor childhood friend, Cocoa Shirayuki, shows up to take care of him. From that day on, the distance between them grows closer... This is a tense, sweet, and slightly heartrending love story of a boy who has lost his love and his childhood friend whose love has long been unrequited.

title: Koi ni Koi suru Koibito Kankei
description:
Asako Ichijou, the student council president at a prestigious girls' high school, has been racking her brain about the ladykiller Nagi Tenma. That's the sort of person Asako is, but Nagi discovers Asako has broken school rules by bringing a shoujo manga to school... Asako pleads with Nagi to keep it a secret, and Nagi reveals her condition: "Become my lover."

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Bijutsubu Girl
description: Middle school life isn’t all fun and games for an art club girl either! From club activities to studying, games to manga, hobbies, BL, and “mufufu” fantasies… or even…love?! “Uchida” is a member of the Art Club. She’s got a lot of strange obsessions and she’s not great at dealing with people. A short candid manga about the ups and downs of school life with the classmates surrounding her and the adolescent boy who sits next to her.

title: Bokura wa Minna Kawai-sou
description:
Kazunari Usa's dream to live away from his parents is fulfilled when they allow him to move into an old boarding house called Kawai Complex. With his landlady providing him meals and his parents covering his rent, Kazunari finally achieves the peaceful life he longs for, as he is ready to enter his first year at high school. Or so it seems…  
  
Upon moving into the boarding house, Kazunari finds out that he has to share a room with resident masochist Shirosaki. He must also live under the same roof as Mayumi Nishikino, a drunkard with a hopeless love life, and Sayaka Watanabe, a seemingly innocent college student. Although he is surrounded by these unique characters, Kazunari still counts himself lucky to be living in the same building as Ritsu Kawai, a second-year student he has a crush on.  
  
As Kazunari settles into the boarding house, he soon realizes that the inhabitants of Kawai Complex are bound to add a twist to the life he has been hoping to live.
___
**Alt Official English

title: Furare Girl
description: The drop-dead-gorgeous and high-sex-appeal Akasaka Hibiki is going through breakup blues. Soon after being dumped, she's asked to become her schoolmate Aoyama-kun's mistress?! Aoyama-kun will try to gain Hibiki's affections through different means, so let's just hope he doesn't nosebleed to death in the process.

title: High Score Girl
description:
Haruo "tay quỷ" không ngờ có ngày cậu lại thua thảm bại 0 -28 trên chính con game yêu quý của mình!!!!! Càng cay cú hơn khi người knock out cậu chính là nhỏ cùng lớp Oono "danh gia vọng tộc", thầy cô yêu mến, bạn bè ngưỡng mộ!!! Còn Haruo, cậu chỉ là thằng nhóc ngáo ngơ học hành bết bát!  
Năm 1991, một nước Nhật đầy hỗn loạn, cuộc đụng độ duyên nợ và ti tỉ vấn đề "vò đầu bứt óc".

title: 1 x ½: Ichi to Nibun no Ichi
description:
Asuka Mori is infatuated with a certain someone. Trouble is that certain someone actually being the person who makes up half of her DNA: 
her mother Ayako.

title: The Idol and Her Egg Problem
description:
A rising winged idol hides a secret: every month, like clockwork, Amirare lays a single, shimmering egg. 

One day, just as Amirare tries to sneak away backstage in pain, she got caught in the act.

title: Ao no Flag
description:
The "youth pure love" story begins when three students in their third and final year of high school meet during a time when they are worried about paths for their futures. Waiting for them are sweet, painful, and heartrending days.  
  
**Officially published:**  
- In French by [Lisez!](https://www.lisez.com/kurokawa/19)  
- In German by [Carlsen](https://www.carlsen.de/reihe/blue-flag)  
- In Italian by [Panini](https://www.panini.it/shp_ita_it/blue-flag-1-mcamn135isbnr-it08.html)

title: That One Classmate Makes Me Question My Own Masculinity
description: Just a story of a strong boy and an even stronger girl. Everyone want to be protected, right?

title: Ora, Yomekko sa ikuda! ~ Kosupure JK no Himitsu no Aijou ~
description: A high school teacher who only loved 2D girls, suddenly falls for one of his students who is also an anime enthusiast! Somehow, they end up living together and get engaged in a secret JK relationship!

title: Yamaguchi-kun wa Warukunai
description: Shy Satsuki Shinohara's plan for a big high school debut are almost ruined by a pervert on the train, but she's saved by none other than the "gangster" student in her class, Yamaguchi-kun. He's already got a bad rap with the other students, and though Satsuki tries to approach him, he seems to always weasel out of her grasp. But she's not one to let a challenge daunt her, and she's out to prove that Yamaguchi-kun is so much more than he's cracked up to be.

title: Koukousei WEB Sakka no Mote Seikatsu "Anta ga Kami Sakka na Wakenai desho" to Boku wo Futta Osananajimi ga Koukai Shiteru kedo Mou Osoi
description:
Yuta Uematsu is a aspiring novel writer who has long had feelings for his childhood friend Michiru Okuwa, who had always supported his creative work. He finally decided to confess his love to her, even though he didn't feel like he was a match for Michiru, the most popular girl at school. When Michiru brushed him off with the words, "It's impossible!" and stormed out, Yuta was left stunned in disbelief. Michiru went back to reading "Digital Masters," a very popular web novel. However, "Digital Masters" was actually Yuta's work...

*Source: Natalie.mu, translated*

title: Kon'ya wa Tsuki ga Kirei desu ga, Toriaezu Shine
description:
Love filled with murderous intent– When Kamishiro Taku met his unrequited love Hanazono Mika, he saw a vision where he tried to murder Hanazono by stabbing her throat with an umbrella. In a harsh and cruel world he lives in, will his defiance bring him hope or despair?
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [COMIC DAYS](https://comic-days.com/episode/10834108156634679214)
**Alt Official English:** [K MANGA](https://kmanga.kodansha.com/title/10174/episode/339066)

title: Iljin Romance
description: Jin Daim has no friends, but likes drawing. Iljina is the most popular girl in school, even though she rejects every confession. Daim thinks she and her friends are an annoyance and disturbs his drawing time before class, but all he ever draws is her. Things get complicated when his secret sketch books gets discovered by one of Iljina's friends.

title: Ore ga Inai to Sugu ×× ru Hakanagi Kasumi
description:
Mùa xuân năm nhất cấp ba, Takase Michiru đã hạ quyết tâm: "Mình sẽ chẳng nỗ lực gì cho cái đời học sinh này đâu...". Thế nhưng, bạn cùng bàn của cậu lại là Hakanagi Kasumi - một nữ sinh vướng đầy những "tin đồn mờ ám"!

Với miếng bịt mắt và những dải băng gạc, trông cô nàng chuẩn xác là một "menhera", thế nên Michiru đã định bụng sẽ giữ khoảng cách. Vậy mà chỉ vì một sự cố tình cờ, cả hai lại vướng vào một mối quan hệ "bù trừ cho nhau"...!?

Dẫu mong manh yếu ớt nhưng vẫn luôn ngoan cường nỗ lực! Một bộ rom-com thanh xuân ấm áp dõi theo cô nàng nữ chính "yếu nhớt mà siêu đáng yêu"♡!!!!

title: I Want to Be Called a Vampire!
description: Aoi wants to go to the same school as her childhood friend Yuuna so she transfers to Vlad Academy, but everyone except Aoi is actually a vampire!?

title: My Awkward Girlfriend
description: A short series about Vietnamese high school setting when a top graded second year honor student that studied his whole life gets tired of study and want to experience youth. That's when a mystery heroine comes in, bring new shade of colors into the main character's life.

title: Ojou to Banken-kun
description: Senagaki Isaku will be a first year high school student starting in spring. Her grandfather is the third head of the Senagaki group, a yakuza organization, so she is feared by those around her. However, starting from spring, she hopes to make normal friends and normally fall in love. She is admitted into a high school further from her hometown, however, the overprotective young head of the Senagaki group, Utou Keiya, (26 years old) falsifies his age and enters the school with her through a backdoor admission…?! Keiya proclaims that love is too early for her although Isaku is perfectly ready. In truth, she has held an unrequited love for Keiya for quite some time.

title: The Whole of Humanity Has Gone Yuri Except for Me
description: This world somehow changed and isn't normal anymore… There's no boys to be found, and all the girls have become…

title: Logout Shita no wa VRMMO ja Naku Honmono no Isekai deshita: Genjitsu ni Modotte mo Status ga Kowareteiru Ken
description: While testing his brand new VRMMO, Kanzaki Reito was trapped inside the game for three years. He defeated the final boss of the game and was finally freed, but what he returned to was that something odd happened to the real world. A "little sister" of his out of nowhere, Reito can still use the same ability as in the game, and monsters appear. Will Reito make use of his overwhelming power and become the savior of this world?

title: 100-nichigo ni Kao ni Deru Kashiwada-san
description: A daily Twitter comic spinoff of [Expressionless Kashiwada-san and Emotional Oota-kun](https://mangadex.org/title/51c1e7cc-23f4-4a08-a961-c1ab75e2bb33/kao-ni-denai-kashiwada-san-to-kao-ni-deru-ota-kun)

title: Jun and Kaoru
description:
The same highschool, the same class, and houses next to another. Jun and Kaoru are childhood friends with a secret everyone knows about…
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Comic DAYS](https://comic-days.com/episode/14079602755589710432)

title: Iincho to Furyou-kun
description: Contrary to her appearance, Hatsuse Sakura is an idiot. Because of her, "honor student looks," she is appointed as the class president. To meet up to everyone's expectations, Sakura tries her hardest, however, for some reason since then Shinokura, who is rumored to be a delinquent, has been starting to approach her? The romance of two awkward people.

title: Yandere-chan Is Scary
description: This is a story about a scary Yandere-chan.

title: Himawari-san
description: The development of a gentle, warm relationship between a bookstore owner and a high school student.

title: Mabeop Hakgyo Apjeommyeol Cheonjae-ga Doeeotda
description:
In the game Aether World, **Baek Yuseol** is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. 

Can this so-called "**TRASH**" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?

title: Kingdom of Z
description:
Five days after the sudden appearance of zombies... The protagonist, Masaru, who is having it rough surviving at school, is splendidly saved from this predicament by high schoolers Sekigahara Miki and Nakiri Karin. Though Masaru is at first relieved, he ends up realizing their true intentions…!!

**Note:** The volumes merge parts such that 65 magazine chapters = 45 volume chapters.

title: Tonari no Kaibutsu-kun
description:
Mizutani Shizuku is the type of person who only cares for her own grades. But when she accidentally delivers the lesson notes to Yoshida Haru, Haru becomes convinced they are friends.  
Haru turns out to have a very innocent personality, but who would've thought that Haru would actually confess to Shizuku?  
A cold-hearted girl x super troublemaker romance with a fresh new perspective.

title: Arigatights!
description:
Tights… are to be worshipped! Tights… are the universe! Tights have infinite possibilities!  
High schooler first year at the height of his youth · Uechi Daia · was suffering.  
"I'm not distracted by my thoughts, but by that girl's tights! I don't want people to know how bad it is."  
  
Girls wearing tights are too cute! The inevitable comedy begins!

title: Danzai sareta Akuyaku Reijou wa, Gyakkou shite Kanpeki na Akujo wo Mezasu
description:
The duke's daughter, Claudia, was supposed to be the fiancée of the crown prince, however her half-sister, Fermina's, schemes had her sold off to a brothel. She didn't want to end it like this, so she climbed to the top at the brothel, but ended up dying from an illness. Except, when she opened her eyes, the face of when she was a child looked back at her. Realizing she had gone back in time, Claudia wins over more and more supporters using the tactics she learnt during her days as a prostitute to prepare for her nearing conflict with Fermina.

"If Fermina is considered a villainess, I shall aim to become the ultimate villain!"

title: Territory of a Shark Girl
description:
The girl in my class who is always sleeping is like a shark.  
  
Sharp eyes like a shark,  
Hair like a back fin,  
A skirt that is way too long.  
  
However, I want to get to know this shark-girl!

title: Shishunki Bitter Change
description:
Yuuta and Yui had their body swapped when Yuuta fell down from a tree.  
  
How will they co-operate in dealing with this as they grow up?  
  
[Original Web Comic](http://banbi.omiki.com/) (Raw)

title: Kamisama Hajimemashita
description: Momozono Nanami’s dad, a man with a penchant for gambling, disappeared after accumulating a huge amount of debt. Thus, she was chased out of her house by the debt collectors. When she met a timid guy being chased by a dog, he told her that he’d give her his house. She believed his persuasive talk, but when she went to his house… it turned out to be a shrine. Moreover, a guy with fox ears appeared, which made Nanami even more confused. What will become of homeless and confused Nanami?

title: Kirawaremono no Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei Shita Ore, Hametsu Furagu wo Heshi Orinagara Saikyou ni Natte Miru Koto ni Shimashita
description: The protagonist realizes he has reincarnated as Vento, a villain character destined to die in every single route of the  adult epic game "Fairys of Fantasia", commonly known as FOF. The protagonist struggles against fate to avoid these death routes, but thanks to Vento's innate talents, his new life actually turns out to be surprisingly fulfilling...?

title: Museru Kurai no Ai o Ageru
description: The rude guy Hibari met at the ramen place turns out to be Gaku, a band member attending her art school. As she gets pushed around by him, her "normal" world begins to change drastically.

title: Nejimaki Kagyuu
description:
Negisawa Kamo and Kagyuu Juubee: two childhood friends who made a fated promise to each other are once again reunited as Juubee reaffirms her dedication to defending Kamo's dream, and her own, with the monstrous power of her martial arts. However, they soon discover that force alone is not enough, it's character, individuality, that rules this school and pits the students against each other in a brutal contest of dueling personalities vying for supremacy. Because in this school, those with the superior strength, the superior character, are king, and those whose individualities are overwhelmed are discarded. Join Juubee, Kamo, and their companions as they struggle to overcome the hidden evils lurking within this school, and discover the voice of each other's hearts and true desires.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Shounen Jump+](https://shonenjumpplus.com/episode/3269754496687423980)

title: Hajimete desu wa!: Okumi Ojousama wa Hinako-chan o Beta Homeru
description:
"Your lunch, Shimoya-san? Pathetic~!"

Poor high school girl Hinako Shimoya lives in poverty and is left all alone in class because of it. But when the ultra-rich heiress Okumi Kanamori takes a bite of Hinako's homemade lunch, her delighted cry of "This is my first time~!" echoes through the room. A clash of poverty and privilege— as the two girls share more and more "first times" together, a friendship that money can't buy begins to blossom in this offbeat school comedy.

Source: Comipo (Translated)

title: Gal☆Cleaning!
description:
"They do not care even if I can see their panties!"   
  
High school student Daisuke Kaji, who is bad with gals, was made to deliver something to the house of the biggest monster gal, Chiriko Iega. Forced to bring Iega to her bedroom Kaji is shocked by her unimaginably filthy room! After being amazed by the level of cleaning knowledge Kaji demonstrated Iega extorts him into cleaning her entire room!  
  
The beginning of a gal love comedy!

title: Last Game
description:
Cô nhóc học sinh chuyển trường Kujou bỗng xuất hiện trước mặt cậu nhóc siêu hoàn hảo Yanagi và đánh bại cậu trong cả học tập lẫn thể thao! Bởi đây là lần đầu tiên trong đời phải nếm mùi thất bại, Yanagi đã thề sẽ lấy lại danh dự trước Kujou. 

Khi học cùng trường với nhau cấp 2 đến cấp 3, tình cờ nghe được rằng “Ai thích trước sẽ là kẻ thua cuộc”, cậu liền quyết tâm phải làm một việc. Trận đấu trải dài 10 năm của hai người bắt đầu từ đây...!

Mời các bạn cùng đến với LAST GAME, để được trở lại thời học sinh với vô vàn cảm xúc! Chắc chắn sẽ có những câu chuyện thú vị, hài hước nhưng không kém phần sâu lắng dành cho các fan của Shoujo Manga!

title: Dual na Kanojo no Taoshikata
description: Shindou Yuuichi gets a girlfriend on his first day of high school. The only problem is that she used to bully him mercilessly in middle school and he can't figure out why she's suddenly decided to like him. The next day she seems like an entirely different person. That can't be right, can it?

title: Happiness
description: Makoto Okazaki is your run of the mill high-schooler, a perfect bullying target and a closet pervert. One night he decides to return a DVD to a friend of his and ventures out into the darkness. He notices a person on a nearby rooftop. The person lunges at him before he is able to make sense of this, and bites into his neck, drinking his blood. The attacker stops. At this point Makoto notices that the attacker is a beautiful girl. She asks him: "Do you want to die or become like me?" He decides to live…

title: Akuyaku Reijou Desu ga, Kouyaku Taishou no Yousu ga Ijou Sugiru
description:
The villainess, Mystia, remembered her past life on her 10th birthday and has unwittingly turned the characters in the otome game "Kyun Kyun Love School" into yanderes! In order to avoid becoming the love rival of the "heroine" who will lead her to her downfall, she starts making every effort to break off her engagement with her "prince-like classmate!" That's was what supposed to happen... But, because of her kind personality, her favorability increased instead!

She also resolved the traumas of the "self-indulgent noble" and the "innocent yakuza teacher" causing them to hold warped affection for her. Furthermore, there was an exclusive maid she didn't remember seeing in the game... With all these abnormalities, can she change her situation by the time the heroine enters school?

An unstoppable and heart-thumping number of complicated misunderstandings! A suspenseful school romantic comedy that will paint you a picture of Hell!Mistia Erlaine is the daughter of a noble family who just

title: The "Perfect" Student Council President Was Throwing Up in The Classroom
Mino-san no Sore, Sawattemo Ii?
description:
There is something the first year Kobayashi Souta is concerned about: The mysterious girl Mino who sits next to him. What's her deal!?
___
**Official English:** [emaqi](https://emaqi.com/manga/can-i-touch-those-mino) - United States & Canada only.

title: Suki x Suki
description:
Touka Aizuki is a girl who can turn invisible, and no one can see her except for one person, Ryoutarou Mimori.  
  
Even though she is physically invisible, her love is completely visible!

title: Freezing
description:
Beings from a different dimension have started a war with mankind. To counter this threat, an academy called "Genetics" that trains female warriors called "Pandora," who can wield special weaponry and armor, was formed. Kazuya Aoi decided to enroll in this school because of a promise with his sister, an outstanding alumnus who died in battle. There he meets second year Satellizer L. Bridgette, nicknamed "The Untouchable Queen" due to her solitary demeanor but also top of her class whose battle simulation streak is undefeated, until he came… and slowly changed her.  
  
The Prequels gives back story to several characters; does not effect the main story.  
  
Most FTH and all LetItGo are joint with Vexed Scans.

There were 33 volumes when the series went on hiatus, however, the site producing the chapters is still ongoing.

title: Oni no Youna LoveCome
description: Akashi Tsukasa is a high-schooler, who has developed a ruthless reputation since childhood as the "Red Demon" when it came to defending the girl he likes. As a result, whenever girls see him now, they run away scared until one day he helps a girl named Shirakawa Kiko who was being harassed by a group of boys. Incredibly, she did not fear him and instead, smiles and sincerely thanks him. Could this be Akashi's true love?

title: Bite Marks
description:
A story about Ichigo and her oblivious(?) childhood friend, his terrible sleeping habits and his bite marks.  
  
[Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/un_jem)  
[Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/31640034)

title: Oya ga Urusai node Kouhai (♀) to Gisou Kekkon Shitemita
description:
Morimoto is getting bugged by her parents to marry (a guy). Her (female) kouhai suggests she fake her marriage so her parents would stop but they will scrutinize every guy she might choose no matter what. Since there's a new law that allows homosexuals to marry, her kouhai suggests herself; only this kouhai has confessed to her before. What will become of their married life?  
  
Incluedes additional oneshot: Anaerobic Love  
Your back is always facing me. I'm watching you way up close.

title: Motokano Sensei wa, Choppiri Ecchi na Katei Houmon de Kimi to no Ai wo Hagukumitai.
description:
The new teachers at high school student Touma Nijino's school are his ex-girlfriends who dumped him in the past! Moreover, both Akari Akamine and  Kohaku Shirasawa are still in love with him. He is happy to see them again, but... But he is not happy to see them again...

"Hey, can I kiss you?"
"Do you hate sleeping with me?"

They start competing with each other at the same time, trying to make a fait accompli with Touma before graduation. Moreover, they live in the same apartment complex as Touma and are trying to secretly nurture their love as a "commuter wife"...?

title: The Undying Engagement Seal of the Doomed Witch and the Young Master Who Leapt Through Time
description:
Michela is a 13-year-old student at the Clausura Academy of Magic and Sorcery, a school for magic-holders aspiring to become “wizards.” Unfortunately, she lacks even the most basic control over her powers, with all her attempts at spell-casting inadvertently ending up in explosions.

One day, Michela sets off a particularly nasty explosion that stood to consume anything and everything around her. Just when death seemed imminent—

A young man appeared before Michela, deflecting the blast in the nick of time.

Introducing himself as Eusius, the young man tells of a foreboding tale: that he has come from the future to save her… and that she’s fated to die at the young age of 18…

[Alternative Raw](https://comic-walker.com/contents/detail/KDCW_FL00201358010000_68/)

title: Boku to Kimi no Taisetsu na Hanashi
description:
Nàng hỏi xoáy, chàng đáp xoay - Cô nàng hot gơn phải lòng anh chàng "tỏ ra hiểu về con gái nhưng thật ra chẳng hiểu gì sất". Liệu hai người họ có thành đôi?

Truyện được Việt hóa bởi Spring Blossoms Team!

title: Janome-san wa Hohoemitai!
description: Former delinquent girl Janome is nicknamed "Medusa" because of her fierce gaze. Her goal is to become a cute high school girl, but that's just a distant dream. So she decides to ask the popular, charming boy, Kuwabara-kun, to give her "cuteness training." However, Kuwabara-kun isn't just a charming boy—he has some kind of secret...!?

title: Ichiban Tookute, Chikai Aitsu. ~Kimi ni Koi o Suru nante, Arienai Hazu Datta~
description: Yasutaka Iijima, the glasses boy in the corner of the class, has a hard time with Ema Kitaoka, a gal in the same class at high school. However, after coming into contact with her at a third-year camp, they start to talk to each other outside of school. They are both unsure of each other's "true feelings."

title: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut
description: Lux, một hoàng tử trước đây của một đế chế mang tên Arcadia bị lật đổ qua một cuộc nổi dậy năm năm trước đó. Lux vô tội trong việc nhìn trộm một nữ ký túc xá trong nhà tắm và đó là công chúa mới của vương quốc Lisesharte đang khỏa thân, và phải gánh chịu cơn thịnh nộ của mình. Lisesharte sau đó thách thức Lux đến một cuộc đấu Candy-Ride. Candy-Rides là vũ khí cơ khí bọc thép cổ xưa đã được khai quật từ di tích trên toàn thế giới. Lux sử dụng để được gọi là người mạnh nhất Drag-Knight, nhưng bây giờ anh được biết đến như là "bất khả chiến bại yếu nhất" mọi chuyện ra sao mời bạn đón xem

title: Puromisu Shinderera
description:
Hayame leads a modest, peaceful life as a housewife. One day she meets a jackass student named Issei, but thinks little of it. As Hayame's life falls apart around her, Issei makes an unexpected proposal which will turn her life upside-down.

---
“For me to have fallen this low at the age of 27... there has to be a reason for it. Happiness only exists because pain does too, after all.”

Full-time housewife Hayame lives a simple and peaceful life. But when her husband suddenly asks for a divorce and her purse is stolen, she is forced to live on the streets without a penny to her name. In the midst of all this hardship, a rich and mean-spirited high school boy named Issei steps into her life. Her encounter with this guy soon turns her "peaceful" world upside down...

---
**Note:** Chapters 53.5, 60.5, 65.5, 65.6, 65.7, 87.5, 87.6, 95.5, 108.5, and 111 through 116 have *not* been scanlated.

title: Class no Tenshi ni Kokutta Kekka
description:
Always soft and gentle, with a smile like an angel. 
I'm finally confessing my feelings to my classmate, Mikomori-san! I was thinking this'd be where our days together would finally begin... until I heard her shocking response!? 
A confession isn’t the goal, but the beginning!

title: Ojojojo
description:
Jigokumeguri Haru is the heiress of one of the largest business empires in all of Japan. She is not only rich, but also practically a celebrity. However, partly because of her heritage and partly because of her arrogant and aloof behavior, she has always been isolated from her peers and has never been able to make friends. Thus, she has—without success so far—transferred from school to school to finally find a place where she would be accepted.

This only begins to change when she meets her new classmate Kawayanagi Tsurezure, an outcast weirdo that dresses in 20th century fashion, talks little and smiles even less. Being both somewhat socially awkward, they thus begin an unexpected friendship.

title: Sora no Otoshimono
description: Sakurai Tomoki, 14 tuổi, một học sinh trung học "bình thường" có phương châm là "Hòa bình và yên tĩnh là tốt nhất", và thường có ước mơ gặp gỡ một thiên thần. Cậu cảm thấy thật khó khăn để sống thoải mái khi anh phải đối mặt với bạn cùng lớp Sohara Mitsuki và cũng là người hàng xóm bên cạnh nhà cậu có võ karate giết người; Eishiro Sugata, một nhà khoa học lập dị với mong muốn khám phá ra "Thế giới mới"; và Mikako Satsukitane, chủ tịch hội học sinh tàn bạo của trường. Một hôm, để tìm hiểu nguyên nhân, cậu theo lời Sugata lên đỉnh ngọn đồi gần nhà chờ đợi. Bỗng nhiên, một hố đen hiện ra và… xuất hiện một-cô-gái-từ-trên-trời-rơi-xuống theo đúng nghĩa đen! Cô gái tên Ikaros, xưng là angeloid thế hệ Alpha, tự nhận Tomoki là chủ nhân của mình và theo cậu về nhà. Từ đó trở đi, nhiều sinh vật được gọi là "Angeloids" đến; sự yên bình của cậu đến đây là chấm dứt nhưng đồng thời tìm thấy những điều dễ chịu mà các Angeloids mang lại cho cậu, và chiến đấu với các điều tồi tệ xuống Trái đất.

title: Akutoku Ryoushu no Musuko ni Tensei!? ~ Tanoshiku Mahou wo Manandeitara, Omei wo Henjou Shitemashita ~
description:
I am Owen Pepper, the heir of a Noble family. To begin with, there are two kinds of people in this world. The aristocracy, winners from birth, and the rest of the losers, the cattle. I am a winner, of course. Bwahahaha. Livestock, you can work hard for me today. It is the only thing you lot are good for! I have been reincarnated as a tr*sh aristocrat. My father was a villainous lord. And his son, Owen, has been deeply influenced by his father and has grown up to be a fat, incompetent boy! If this continues, my future is in jeopardy. … But I do not care about that! “I heard that there is magic in this world. If we are going to go to all this trouble, let us try to master magic!” And if you are having fun learning magic, you will soon be able to break the stigma! 
(taken of NovelUpdates)

title: Nise Kiokusoushitsu no Hachiyo-san
description: Class representative Marui, an ordinary high school boy, finds Hachiyo face-down by a river bed. Even though Hachiyo was regarded as the school’s strongest delinquent, Marui secretly has a crush on her. However, when Hachiyo wakes up, she suddenly can’t remember anything about herself?

title: Oh! Dangun
description:
There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence...
A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.

‘Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?'

title: Hikaru to Hikaru
description:
"Hikaru to Hikaru" is a comedy about Hikaru Katsuragi, a boy who is a descendant of the Iga ninja, sneaking into a girls' school.

In the Katsuragi family, if you don't master the secret "Kunoichi no Jutsu," which turns your body into a female body, by the age of 18, you won't be recognized as an adult, and his mother was worried about Hikaru's immature technique. In order for such a Hikaru to become a full-fledged woman, he is ordered to attend a prestigious school for young ladies, Kazami Girls' School, in the form of a woman.

title: A Sharp-Eyed Classmate
description:
With her fierce eyes and sharp impression, and wary of everyone, 'Ahn Se-young' is a woman to watch out for.
Everyone is cautious around her, but a lone boy stands in front of her.
"I like you, go out with me!"
"......What?!"
Se-young is taken aback at the sudden confession of love, but this was just the beginning...
The tug-of-war between 'Ahn Se-young', who shows an unexpected side to her as you get closer, and 'Nam Ho-yeol', the straightforward guy who tries to break down her impenetrable facade, begins now!

title: Fruits Basket
description:
Tohru Honda, an orphaned high school girl, is taken in by the wealthy Shigure Sohma when he realizes she has nowhere else to go. However, the Sohma family shares a secret, and it isn't long before Tohru discovers that there's a reason why her classmates, Yuki and Kyo Sohma, never let girls get near them, and never talk about their lives before they lived with Shigure. And before she knows it, Tohru has become so tangled up in the lives of each member of the Sohma family that she couldn't leave even if she wanted to.  
  
As she learns more and more about the truth of the Sohma family and the nature of their secrets, she desperately searches for a way that she can save them. But what can one girl do, especially when it seems that she may have been part of someone's plan all along…  
  
[Official English](https://yenpress.com/9780316360166/fruits-basket-collectors-edition-vol-1/)

---
- **Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Shojo in 2001**
- **Attained the Guinness World Record for Best-Sel

title: Tsukiiro no Invader
description: The astronomical event "Apple Moon" occurs once every 300 years. On that day, Sakuma, while visiting the ocean with his classmate to observe the event, ends up meeting a parasitic alien instead...?

title: Chou Shin-Uchuu Yori Ai wo Komete
description: Teradate Ten không thích dính dáng đến người khác nên chẳng xem TV cũng chẳng xem điện thoại. Thế nên cô là người cuối cùng biết rằng không những có một chiếc UFO hạ cánh xuống Trái Đất, mà vị khách ngoài hành tinh tên Lulucielamo Mocophishim Klasslamonira còn chuyển đến trường cô và chọn cô làm vợ!

title: Ane ni Naritai Ane VS Yuri ni Naritai Imouto
description: Một ngày nọ, Shio-chan về đến nhà và phát hiện ra rằng mẹ cô đã tái hôn và dự định sẽ đi công tác với chồng mới, để lại Shio-chan với em gái mới, Kafka-chan. Chỉ hơn Kafka-chan một ngày, Shio-chan lo ngại Kafka-chan sẽ cố gắng chiếm lấy vị trí chị cả của cô. Mặt khác, Kafka-chan quyết tâm khiến Shio-chan, mối tình đầu của cô, phải lòng cô.

title: Boy meets Maria
description: Taiga’s always worshiped the heroes he’s seen on TV. And now that he’s started high school, his fateful encounter with a certain girl compels him to make her his heroine. And she was known as the Madonna of the drama club, Maria. After seeing her perform on stage, Taiga falls head over heels and confesses his feelings to her and is tragically shot down. And to his surprise, the beautiful lady is actually a beautiful boy…

title: Humanity’s Existence Depends on Love Gambling with Another World’s Princess
description: Interactions between this world and the one ruled by the demon lord have grown increasingly common. Unaccustomed to teaching the denizens of another world, Itou Kazuki becomes perplexed when the demon lord's daughter, an avid fan of shoujo manga, transfers into his class. "If you make my daughter cry, I'll destroy your world."

title: A Yandere-Like Girl
description: A girl who only at first glance resembles yandere.

title: Boku Dake ga Inai Machi
description:
A strange phenomenon where one is transferred back to the moment right before something life-threatening occurs. This continues to happen until the cause of the threat is erased. It is as if somebody is forcing Satoru to stop it from happening. Then one day, everything is changed. What truths are revealed when Satoru comes face to face with his own past? How will they affect his future?  
___
**Note:** Was nominated for the 18th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize Reader Award in 2014 and for the 7th, 8th and 9th Manga Taisho Award between 2014 and 2016. Also nominated for the 40th Kodansha Manga Awards in 2016.

title: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka
description:
"Class 5's Chitose Saku is a fucking playboy!"

Chitose Saku is at the top of the school caste. He and his friends are textbook examples of normies, despised by the less fortunate. Surrounded by girls and boys of every kind, he's chosen to lead his second-year class by his laid-back advisor.
___
- Adaptation of Light Novel - [Anilist](https://anilist.co/manga/121795/Chitosekun-Is-in-the-Ramune-Bottle/)

title: Ichijou Karen wa Yuuwakusuru
description:
"At 17 years old, we'll have our first..."

Karen is head over heels in love with her childhood friend, the brusque and fierce-looking Mii-kun. Day after day, she makes amorous advances toward him in hopes of making him her future husband. But when it's just the two of them, she can’t help but feel a little nervous...? She's a headstrong queen in front of everyone else, but when faced with the boy she likes, she can't help but turn back into a blushing schoolgirl?!

title: Koi wo Shiranai Bokutachi wa
description:
Eiji, Naohiko and Izumi have been friends since middle school. Naohiko started going out with Izumi later on. Meanwhile, Eiji seemed to easily find his crushes one after the other, more often his seniors than not, yet maintained a laid back attitude when it came to being really serious about romance.  
  
Now in their high school, it has been a while since Izumi has left the city and is in a long distance relationship with Naohiko. Eiji, still a single, wonders if he has been missing something in his life. Maybe it's just his poor grades but for the time being, he wants to avoid Ikezawa, his strict, serious and diligent classmate, as much as possible. Furthermore, he is aware of Taichi, a boy from a different class, who has a crush on Ikezawa.  
  
The romantic story involving six boys and girls is about to unfold as they don't know love yet.

title: Ougo Mitsunaga wa Namagoroshi ga Tsurai
description:
"When we turn 18...."

In order to fulfill his cute girlfriend Karen's wish (?!), Mitsunaga has been holding back a lot. He may be a quiet, hard-headed guy, but he has as much sexual desire as anyone else and was even looking forward to it a little bit. However, on the anniversary day, something terrible happens?! He can't touch her because she's precious to him, but he wants to touch her more because he loves her...

title: Urushiha Sarara wa Koi Nado Shinai
description: Sarara Urushiha gets confessed to with surprising frequency by boys who have no good reason to confess to her. While she is indeed beautiful, her impression is that they may be doing it out of superficial reasons, but meeting Koroishi-kun has revealed an important possibility for her: that she's cursed.

title: Onna no Hadaka wo Nama de Mitai
description:
Wanting to see a naked girl in person, Tsuda Kouta attends a nude model sketching session where he was awakened to the arts.  
There, he also meets our heroine who speaks in Kansai dialect and a pure, sugar-sweet love begins to unfold.  
  
1. Onna no Hadaka wo Nama de Mitai
2. Kareshi ga Iru Onnanoko to Tsukiau Houhou
3. Konna Toki no Tame ni
4. Kore Dakara Kawaii Onna wa
5. Anata no Chinchin Kashite Kudasai

title: Kumanishi Bijutsubu Rafusuke-senpai
description: A libido-fueled art comedy featuring the secret art club activities of a delinquent girl and the boy who will make her his masterpiece.

title: Asahina-san no Bentou Tabetai
description: It was surely not love, but it was definitely love. One day, high school student Seiya Maki fell in love at first sight with a bad-looking lunch box prepared by the most beautiful girl in her class, Arisa Asahina. "I want to eat your lunch, so I want you to go out with me". Arisa feels ridiculed by his confession and angrily rejects Seiya, but she is gradually drawn to his unabashed innocence and the kindness with which he accompanies her through her troubles. However, one day Arisa discovers Seiya's secret that he can't tell anyone... Where will their relationship go, and why is Seiya attracted to Arisa's bento? Sad, bitter, loving and beautiful. A coming-of-age story.

title: Chiisai Boku no Haru
description: Suzuki Souta là một nam sinh cao trung trong đội bóng chuyền của trường đem lòng thích bạn cùng lớp Shinonome Asahi và cũng là một thành viên của đội bóng chuyền nữ. Hàng ngày Asahi tìm đến Souta vì cậu là một cầu thủ bóng chuyền giỏi. Thế nhưng hhi ở sơ trung, vì chiều cao của mình, ước mơ trở thành vận động viên đánh bóng không thể thành hiện thực như cậu đã kỳ vọng. Vì vậy mà cậu có thói quen từ bỏ mọi thứ. Cuộc sống trung học của Souta: Liệu cậu có đành lòng chấp nhận những gì vượt quá tầm với không? Hay cậu sẽ cố gắng trở thành một người có thể sát cánh cùng Asahi đây? Tuổi trẻ là một chuỗi những lựa chọn. Xin cậu, Souta, cố gắng lên nhé!

title: I Don’t Care. Let Me Go Home!
description:
A count’s daughter who scored hopelessly on the school's exam, Rururia Talbot!  
  
I was talking to my best friend Sarah while eating my favorite tart, before I ran into a fight between the Crown Prince Christoph and Duke’s daughter, Irene.  
  
The fantasy rom-com of a count's daughter who wants to return home peacefully begins!

title: Kono Sekai wa Tsuite Iru
description: Akito, a high school student who hates people around him, accidentally took a picture of a young girl during his daily routine of taking scenery pictures. He realized it was the girl who recently transferred to his school. He planned to talk to her about accidentally taking her picture, but… somehow the girl in the picture looks different?

title: Seinaru Kishi no Ankokudou
description:
Young Sain Forth has it made; as the famed Holy Knight, he has the people's love, the respect of kings, and the blessings of a literal goddess. His aspirations lie elsewhere, though. With his assistant Melia at his side, he leaves for an academy in a foreign kingdom, where he is treated as a deviant by his peers. It's his own fault, mind you—his stubborn insistence on wearing a custom, all-black uniform makes him stick out.

He isn't the only outcast in his class: Alicia, born into the Clan of Light but unable to use anything but fire magic, faces similar struggles, and the two quickly become allies. Alicia proposes that they enter the labyrinth below the school in search of a holy sword, but Sain has other plans in mind: a doom sword. And so, with his friends in tow, Sain ventures into the perilous unknown, driven by a wish to become the coolest, edgiest, most awesome thing in existence: a Dark Knight. There's just one problem. He can't use dark magic. Like, at all.
___
[Official Engl

title: The World Will Be Destroyed Tomorrow, so I Want to Rub Your Boobs
description: At the thought that the world was going to be doomed by a meteorite, Gotokuji risked all of his dignity to request Tanimura to let him rub her boobs.---Alternative raws: [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/1371889/series/105342), [Nico Nico](https://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/55590)

title: Kono Koi wa Fukami-kun no Plan ni wa Nai
description: An unexpected love starting from an unplanned kiss. Fukami-kun is a smart, good-looking guy who's popular with the girls. But in actuality, he's a disappointingly stubborn boy who refuses to accommodate anyone else's schedule, leading him to be rejected even after being confessed to. One day, a strange girl, Higurashi Akio, is looking for her cat around the school grounds, and the two of them somehow end up kissing by accident. Unlike Fukami-kun, Akio doesn't seem to care about the accident at all. At first, Fukami-kun is irked by her attitude, but gradually comes to hold an interest in the capricious Akio. A youthful love story between a disappointing boy and a strange girl begins.

title: Split Lover
description:
“If my true heart leaks, I wonder what feelings I will convey…” In this world, if your dissatisfaction rate reaches a certain level, your "Split" will satisfy your desire for you; Fission Syndrome.  
  
Makoto, a first-year high school student who fears Splitting and confessing to his crush, was accustomed to keeping his feelings hidden… Until, one day, in front of Makoto's eyes, his crush develops Fission Syndrome?! Moreover, it was a terrible Split that appeared…  
  
Received a grand prize at the 3rd Manga Box Editorial Club. "I can't hide my thoughts in this world," the Split Love manga is finally published!

title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
description: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Despite lacking friends or romantic experience, she started the Astronomy Association by herself, which is the only place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she dropped an association poster, but an upperclassman picked it up for her. The upperclassman introduced herself as Hayami, and Ayumu completely fell in love at first sight when Hayami recognized her passion! Ayumu's mind is now filled with love, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already adore something else. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!

title: Osananajimi no Mama ja Iya?
description:
People often say that falling in love is a wonderful thing, but what if the one you fall in love with wants to be your mom?  
A story about a boy who agreed to his childhood friend's proposition of becoming his "mom". He thought they were playing house, but she meant it for real.  


---

title: Ikemen Sugidesu Shiki-senpai!
description: A high school freshman bumps into a cool and beautiful upperclassman and falls in love at first sight. Upon seeing her at the Basketball Club, she fumbles her confession and the upperclassman takes it as her wanting to join the club.

title: Wind Breaker
description:
Jay's the perfect student. He's got straight As and he's the student body president. 

But after being coerced into joining the school's biking team, the Hummingbird Crew, he discovers a whole new world outside of studying. 

What new adventures will he face outside the comfort of his textbooks?

---

**Contents:**
- **Season 1:** 65 Chapters + Prologue + Special (0-65)
- **Season 2.1:** 65 Chapters + Prologue (66-130)
- **Season 2.2:** 117 Chapters (131-257)
- **Season 3:** 128 Chapters (258-375)
- **Season 4:** 53 Chapters (Ongoing) (376-)

title: Maria-sensei wa Imouto Gachizei!
description:
A romantic comedy with a busty half-blonde onee-san teacher and a hard-working scary delinquent.

**Hiatus:** Last updated with Chapter 7 in October 2018.

title: Our Wonderful Days
description:
"Let's stick together from now on, in high school!"   
  
Taking place in the rural countryside of Japan, Koharu's excited to begin high school life along with her friends Minori and Nanaya. To her surprise, a beautiful girl who just moved from Tokyo is also in their class! Unbeknownst to her, Koharu is soon to be reunited with an old friend. Are these girls' feelings for each other just that of regular old friendship? Or perhaps is there something more? Cherry blossoms, convenience stores, homework, clubs, tests and chores. Normal and wonderful days lies ahead!  
  


---

title: The Alien Next to Me Is Scary
description:
Your run of the mill high school boy who likes aliens, Marunouchi-kun, sits next to the Uchimura-san, who has taken a form that is certainly alien. But her true form is… a beautiful high school girl!?

Making waves on social media, a slapstick comedy where a beautiful alien girl makes passionate advances!!
___
**Alt Official Raws:**
- [KADOCOMI](https://comic-walker.com/detail/KC_000770_S?episodeType=comics)
- [niconico Manga](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/55404)

title: Neko to Kiss
description:
From Ikemen Manga:  
  
A fun romantic comedy revolving around Wada Erina, a high school girl who absolutely adores cats, and her classmate, Nekoyama Akira, who is unsociable and always wears a mask. Erina is usually nicknamed "Queen" by her classmates due to her cool appearance but when she talks about cats, she gets extremely excited.   
  
One day, a cat visits her yard. Lured by it cuteness, she gets excited and kisses the cat, and then?!

title: Hajimete no Suwa-san
description:
**“I’ve still got a lot to learn about the strange creatures known as “girls”…”**

Yamanaka Suguru always viewed his “first times” as challenges to overcome. But when a girl suddenly confessed to him and became his girlfriend, she introduced him to countless new challenges that he’s never known about.

*Source: Comikey Media*

title: Ijimerareteru Osananajimi no Hanashi
description: On the surface, she's a typical victim of bullying... but could something else be at play?

title: Kimi wa Ore no Yasashikunai Haru
description:
With a height of 192 cm and a scar on his face, Ujioka Tasuku is mistaken for a "scary person" by those around him, and his student life has been lonely up until now. On his first day of high school, Ujioka is determined to make friends and have a fun high school life, but a shocking encounter with Shimohoshizaki Kodzuru awaits him after she trips on a banana peel! She's completely out of it, but Ujioka is touched by Shimohoshizaki's hard work and she doesn't judge Ujioka by his appearance, so they decide to become friends!?
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [YanMaga Web](https://yanmaga.jp/comics/%E5%90%9B%E3%81%AF%E3%81%8A%E3%82%8C%E3%81%AE%E5%84%AA%E3%81%97%E3%81%8F%E3%81%AA%E3%81%84%E6%98%A5)

title: AniTomo - My Brother's Friend
description: Nanase, a polite, a old-fashioned girl, gets a boyfriend for the first time - her brother's friend. However, both of them have no idea what they should do next… Hand-holding would be too embarrassing, and 'dating' is something mature people would do.

title: Kimi ga Shinu Natsu ni
description:
Summer, ghosts, and my feelings for you.   
  
Yamano is a second-year high schooler in love.   
One day, out of nowhere, the very object of his affection, Tanigawa-san, appeared in front of him. As a ghost.   
It seems that she died after being involved in some kind of incident.   
  
To save Tanigawa from death, Yamano gets busy trying to change her future, but—…  
 A vague and fleeting youthful mystery.

title: Trap Heroine
description: Traps have existed since time immemorial; a fact that Chiroda Taishi laments, as he seems to have both an affinity and an aversion to being trapped.

title: Ayame-senpai wa Boku to Himitsu no Keiyaku wo
description:
On his way home from school, Mitsuya Daiki - an ordinary high school student - finds a girl covered in wounds. Upon closer look, he finds that the girl has animal ears, but she licks Daiki's ears and leaves. Daiki begins to wonder if it was just a dream, when Sakuragami Ayame appears upon him...? After telling her of the ability of Daiki's ears, Ayame feels responsible for dragging him into this, and proposes an oath of absolute servitude to protect him at all costs!
___
- [Alternative Raw](http://www.takeshobo.co.jp/book_d/shohin/2820601)

title: A Story About a Perfect Girl Breaking Down
description:
Minamino Himeka is the physical embodiment of the word *perfect* and she got her eyes set on Natsume-kun who doesn't really have any interest in her. Just how will Himeka make Natsume-kun look her way?  
  
*Sidenote: It feels like Teruhashi the manga without Saiki, offu~* (Hey, you're in the wrong manga)

title: Kimi ga Shinu Made Ato 100 Nichi
description:
A romcom centered around two childhood friends: Tarou and Umi.  
It took four tries professing his love, but he finally gets a 'Yes'.  
Not long after, Tarou finds that Umi only has 100 days to live!  
  
[Alternative Raw](https://comic.pixiv.net/works/5879)

title: Cheongchun Blossom
description: Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter -- love blossoms in all seasons.

title: Chiguhagu Trick
description:
Bộ romcom siêu hot, từng gây bão trên mạng xã hội, nay chính thức được đăng dài kỳ! Chuyện tình hài hước giữa cô nàng xinh đẹp thích cởi đồ và anh chàng mặt ngầu mê đọc sách giờ mới thật sự bắt đầu!
Bản dịch tiếng Việt sẽ sớm được ra mắt trong thời gian tới!

title: Medetai Sensei
description:
Tachibana Mami, a very petite 29 year old P.E. teacher, was out for a run underneath the cherry trees when she slips and falls and sprains her foot. A tall, beautiful, mature woman was passing by and saw what happened. Thinking Mami was a kid, she princess carries her to to her house. Afterward, Mami can't stop thinking about what happened.

A few days later when Mami is preparing for her classes before school starts for the year, a new teacher is introduced. It turns out that Sakurai Shouko, the new teacher is the same woman who carried her home the other day. 

Shouko ends up getting way too close to Mami, and it seems to be getting troublesome for poor Mami.

title: Tsuki no Oki ni Mesu mama
description: In middle school, Ayumu kept getting teased and pranked by Runa, even though he's a year below her. Now that she's in her second year of high school, she's ready to be the experienced senpai for the incoming freshman Runa.

title: The Story of a Girl Who's My Best Friend, She's Acting Strange Lately
description: My best friend is a girl I have known since elementary school.  She was like a boy, but nowadays she acts odd. We were like two guys, but now... she tries to increase the skinship and gets upset when I speak to girls.

title: Kiite kuremasu yo ne? Senpai
description:
One day, the most beautiful girl in school suddenly shows up at Kento Ikuno's door. She shows him a "ticket" written in awkward handwriting. This is the start of a romantic comedy about a "ticket to do anything I say" that came from his childhood.

[Alternative Raw](https://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/60455)

title: Datenshi Soprano-chan no Fukushuu
description: Back in sixth grade, Mirei hurt her best friend Soprano with heartless words after she confessed to her. Five years later, Soprano, now a famous model, transfers to Mirei's high school. While Mirei hopes to reconcile with Soprano and go back to being friends with her, friendship isn't what's on Soprano's mind.

title: Gamers!
description: The story centers on a fairly ordinary high school boy named Keita Amano. His hobby is video games, but apart from that, he has no conspicuous traits, and has never been in love. As Keita continues his gaming life, he suddenly becomes involved with the most beautiful girl at school, Tendou Karen, the president of the school's video game club. She shocks Keita when she suddenly asks him to join the video game club. Watch how their relationship evolves and becomes more complicated, especially when other gamers come into the picture, creating all sorts of misunderstandings and drama.

title: Ookumo-chan Flashback
description:
First-year high school student Minoru Suzuki, who resembles his late father like two drops of water, often sees visions of his mother's past as a high school student through the eyes of his father.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [MagaPoke](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/title/02099/episode/371442)

title: Kanojo ni Norowareterukedo Shiawase Nanode OK Desu ☆
description: Being kind to girls is the most important thing to 17-year-old Iida Harunari. As the kind of guy to carry the bags of all the girls in his class with him to school each morning, those around him sarcastically called him the "ultimate gentleman Iida". One day, he encountered a beautiful girl with a strange aura, Kageura Sari, but he noticed a cursed-looking monster emerging from her body. Iida was going to hurry and flee, but wasn't something amiss...? He was cursed by the heroine?!

title: Koori no Jouheki (Book Version)
description:
Inept at dealing with people, Hikawa Koyuki maintains a wall between herself and others. She spends her time in highschool away from others, all alone. At least until she encounters Amamiya Minato who keeps closing the distance between them for some reason?! The aloof Koyuki, the popular Miki, the boundary-less Minato, and the easygoing and kind basketball team member, Youta. This is the story of these somewhat complicated four, and their tantalizing, bumbling youth!
___
**Additional Links:**
- **Alt Official Raw:** [Shounen Jump+](https://shonenjumpplus.com/episode/14079602755350023318)
- [Official X](https://x.com/ramparts_ice)
- [Official Anime Site](https://korinojoheki-pr.com/)

title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e: 2-nensei-hen
description: The second spring at the Advanced Nurturing High School is welcoming Ayanokoji and Class D. The special exams aren't only what awaits them, but the unique freshmen as well. Kazuomi Hōsen and Ryūen. The two who shared the bad reputation between themselves during Ryuen's middle school days. Takuya Yagami, who proclaims to come from the same middle school as Kushida, is approaching her. And the capricious Ichika Amasawa who is pulling Ayanokoji left and right.

title: Omae mitai na Heroine ga ite tamaru ka!
description: Once an OL (Office Lady) around 30 and born with memories of her past life, when Tsubaki was around 4 years old, from the words of her half-sister who she also thought held memories of her past life, she recalled that this world was from an otome game. In the game, the half-sister born from a lover was the heroine, and she was the villainess noble girl who tormented her. Furthermore, the END always concluded with a suicide. But in this world, there were a lot of differences in the setting. Thinking that she might be able to save her mother who commits suicide, it's a story where she does her best in protecting her mother and the main capture target character, her cousin, from her half-sister's devil like clutches.

title: A Side Character's Love Story
description: Nobuko Tanaka is a college student working part-time at a supermarket. Due to her shy and plain nature, her name is constantly mistaken for "Mobuko," which has the kanji for "supporting role" (lit: "mob" character). So when she develops feelings for her kind co-worker, Irie, will she be able to gather her courage and grow closer to him? Will this "supporting role" actress finally get a chance in the romantic spotlight?

title: Rabukome to Kaijuu Taiji no Fumonritsu
description:
Tsubura Enjo, a high school girl with a shy and timid personality, has two close connections in her life: her childhood friend Anna and her classmate Sho, who is a big fan of special effects (tokusatsu) films.

One day, while exploring her late grandfather's storage room, she discovers an old ring. When she puts it on, she is suddenly transported 50 years into the past, right into the middle of a scene with a giant monster! To her shock, she finds herself on the set of a tokusatsu film, directed by her grandfather in his youth. 

Overwhelmed and scared, she is instructed by her young grandfather to help defeat the monster, leading to a tearful yet courageous battle against the giant creature!

title: Cylcia=Code
description: Kanata and his friends must find a way to return to their original bodies after they're trapped in the real world as their game avatars.

title: Rosario to Vampire Season II
description:
The story continues where the first season left off only months into the future. Yuokai Gakuen has been repaired and the new semester is underway. Tsukune and gang are back, and more powerful then ever. Anti-Thesis's true identity is relieved. With new adversaries looming on the horizon, and something much more sinister then the gang has ever faced before.   
  
Tsukune is battling with the monster inside him. With the help of Moka, Mizore, Kurumu, Ruby, and Yukari. Tsukune trains to get his vampire blood under control and the strength to protect what he holds dear.  
  
The new season focuses more on the girls, their past, and their families. New confrontations await them. New friends and allies will join them by their side. Together they will discover the secrets of Moka's rosary, and her lineage…  
  


---

title: Kin no Kanojo, Gin no Kanojo
description: The romantic comedy depicts a hapless protagonist and his beautiful love interest - The plot starts when the girl he likes fell into a lake and then appears the "Lady Of The Lake", who asks, "Did you lose your golden girlfriend or your silver girlfriend?" This leads the original to be split into two girls: the "Golden Girlfriend" is the graceful and ladylike type, while the "Silver Girlfriend" is the mischievous, foulmouthed, and straightforward type.

title: My Deskmate Sato-san
description:
Yamaguchi một chàng trai thông minh. Ngồi cạnh cậu là Satou, người chẳng hề giỏi bất kì điều gì, nhưng những hành động nhỏ và sự ân cần của cô từ từ thay đổi cảm xúc của Yamaguchi.  
Bộ truyện dựa theo bản Light novel cùng tên được xuất bản năm 2018, lần đầu xuất bản tại Việt Nam vào năm 2019.  
  
This is an adaptation of a LN of the same name, published in 2018.  
  
[alt. Raw](https://comic.pixiv.net/works/5377)

title: Ima Koi: Now I'm in Love
description: The manga centers on the relationship between a scary and popular, but actually gentle high school boy, and a "life-size" high school girl. Satomi decides to try her best with love in high school. She's curious about the boy who saved her from a pervert, but she has trouble deciding if the boy is scary or kind.

title: Homura-sensei wa Tabun Motenai
description: Nữ sinh trung học Hasumi có hứng thú với thầy giáo Homura, một giáo viên trẻ tuổi, vụng về trong giao tiếp, thường hay bị coi là yếu đuối và nhàm chán. Nhưng Hasumi lại nghĩ thầy ấy là một người tuy có khuyết điểm nhưng cũng rất là tốt bụng và dễ thương.

title: Sensei, Kongetsu Dou Desu ka
description: Murasaki có khả năng nhìn thấy tương lai của người mà cô ấy chạm vào. Là con gái của chủ nhà, hàng tháng cô phải đuổi theo Shijima Banri để lấy tiền thuê nhà. Lần nào cũng vậy, tác giả tội nghiệp Shijima hứa với cô rằng anh ta sẽ trả tiền thuê nhà ngay khi được xuất bản và được trả tiền. Murasaki giữ bí mật về khả năng nhìn thấy tương lai của mình và rất mong chờ nó, bởi vì cô thấy Shijima là nửa kia  định mệnh mà cô sẽ kết hôn.

title: Chikotan, Kowareru
description: Miyahara Chiko is a mysterious girl who never seems to talk to anyone and always wears a pair of headphones and a scarf. But what is she hiding behind that silent facade?

title: Color Change
description:
Nijimi-san is an ordinary high school girl, except her hair changes color based on her mood. Her classmate has cataloged most of her color changes, but there’s one color which is still a mystery to him…

**Note:** MangaDex uses the Twitter chapter numbering.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [X](https://x.com/search?q=from%3A%40Araragi_Nana_23%20%E3%82%AB%E3%83%A9%E3%83%BC%E3%83%81%E3%82%A7%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B8&f=live)

title: Zombi Shoujo no Fujimi-san
description: An ashen-colored adolescence vividly resurrects in a broken collapsed world. Saito Ryo presents a dystopian youth romcom!

title: Stalkers
description: The person I like. I want to know everything about the person I like. Because I like him. Because I like her. Everyone undoubtedly holds the desire to know more about the person they like. Within the varying types of love, this form exists as well.

title: Miniamaru Kareshi
description: Iroha Aoyagi is a normal 16 year old girl, except, she's never fallen in love. She suspects there might be something wrong with her; until she meets her classmate Kusakabe-kun who seems well-versed and cynical about matters of love. Will Iroha be able to handle someone like Kusakabe-kun?

title: "Kawaii" wa Kimi no mono
description:
Tamaru, a small, baby-faced "cute" boy, is in love with Morinaga, a tall, cool girl. Tamaru-kun thinks he's not good enough for her, but one day he sees Morinaga in a way that is too unexpected for him…?
  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/H1Q0eHg.png) Alternate Nicovideo raws](https://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/46465)

title: Nana Seiken to Maken no Hime
description:
The Apocalypse, a once-in-a-thousand-year catastrophe caused by the Primordial Sword. There was a family who tried to destroy the "original sword" on the coming day, but the operation failed. In order to prevent the next catastrophe, Sakuya, the strongest boy in the clan, flies a thousand years into the world of magic.


---

title: Renai Harem Game Shuuryou no Oshirase ga Kuru Koro ni
description:
Kohinata Asunaro is your ordinary perverted high-school student who likes light novels and romance games. He has no interest in having a "3D" girlfriend and is content just fantasizing on the pretty girls of his school to create his own imaginary harem. But one day he accidentally releases Zepfur, a demon who promises to make his fantasies a reality.  
  
The day after, one of those girls, Furuwada Serika, is summoned by Zepfur and explained the rules of a game: the girls of Asunaro's "harem" must earn points by competing for his affection. The winner will be the one whom Asunaro chooses as his sole girlfriend… and the losers will experience an infinite loop of horrible deaths in Hell. For Asunaro, it's just a romcom fantasy coming true. For Serika and the others, it's a battle for survival. Published in Monthly Shonen Sirius.

title: Mask Hazushite yo, Ishikawa-san
description: Ishikawa-san, the girl in the neighboring seat, wears a mask no matter what she's doing. One day, Izawa catches sight of her face without a mask and wants to see it more and more… Masked or unmasked, it's a cute romantic mask comedy!

title: Heroic Complex
description:
Misuzu Haruno is a handsome high school girl with a secret identity—she is Burning X, a super warrior protecting the peace. She, however, wants to become cuter, like the beautiful super heroine she admires, Blue Wing. But the truth is, Blue Wing is actually Aoi Ootori, an effeminate boy from the class next door! Indeed, Blue Wing is *his* secret identity, but he isn't exactly thrilled about it, and wants to be stronger and manlier, just like his idol, Burning X.

This is a romantic comedy in which two people are unable to reveal their true identities to each other!

title: Yuri SM de Futari no Kimochi wa Tsunagarimasu ka?
description: Mio has to temporarily live with her former childhood friend Sarasa for a couple of weeks. When she opened their living room door, she saw…

title: Pumpkin Time
description:
Boys grow up fast…  
  
The main character, Fujiwara Itsuki, quickly grew up and have now become a splendid high school girl! … Huh?!  
  
Appearing in front of her is her close friend, Ritsu, who has just come back from studying abroad and the days pass on while she continues to leave her identity undisclosed… Where will their relationship head towards after this?!  
  


---

**Links:**  
- [Official Thailand Translation](https://www.comico.in.th/titles/1268)  
- [Official Taiwanese Translation](https://www.comico.com.tw/3615/)

title: Kyou no Ashura Meshi
description:
A bottom-feeder JK and a yankee boy. Bento connects these two opposites in this coming-of-age love story!

One day, Omori Sizuka, a high school girl who loves to eat and is bullied by bullies, discovers the secret that Akira Kurose, aka "Ashura-kun," the only tough yankee at school, enjoys cooking. The next day at lunchtime, Akira summons Sizuka to the rooftop and asks her to eat his homemade lunch box to keep her mouth shut.

"A delinquent guy likes a chubby girl for who she is but he’s worried about her health cause she’s eating nothing but unhealthy food. So he starts making lunches for her so her diet gets better and then romance begins"

title: Sankakkei no Kowashi-kata
description: Koto, Aya, and Erika were secretly in love with each other. Koto's thoughts reach Aya for a short while, but Aya disappears as if she had been spirited away. Seven years later, however, Aya appears to Koto and Erika as she was then...

title: The Most Beautiful Girl in the School is in Love With Me, the xx Artist!?
description:
Amesaka Sora, an ordinary high school boy, usually enjoys drawing erotic pictures as a hobby. Since his failure in junior high school, he had planned to hide his hobby in high school... But one day, the student council president and the most beautiful girl in the school, Kisaragi Uguisu, finds out his secret...!?

A coming-of-age rom-com between a beautiful girl at the top of the caste system and one of those male extras!

title: Fèng Àotiān Xiǎoshuō lǐ de Huángmáo Fǎnpài Yě Xiǎng Xìngfú
description:
[From the Same Studio as the Manhua "Shut Up, Evil Dragon!"]

Transmigrating into the body of a yellow-haired villain in the early stages of a Yuri novel, Moon only wants to survive. But… why does the story seem to be going off track?

The princess has already been drugged, and even her pants have been removed—so why hasn't the protagonist appeared yet? Why does the protagonist’s childhood friend, a noble and pure saint, keep giving me flirtatious looks? Even my obedient and loyal personal maid has started gazing at me with increasingly dangerous eyes!

Where is the protagonist?! Please, someone save me!!

---

Official English: [Lolobun](https://www.lolobun.com/c/20104)

title: Yuriota ni Yuri wa Gohatto Desu!?
description: Watanabe Fuyu is a diehard fan of yuri, so she studied hard to get into an all-girls private school and quietly observe the S-class setting of her fantasies. At first, it seems like heaven… until she meets Yoshiokari Rika, a cheery gyaru who reads more like an otaku's dream girl than the refined, demure ladies she's used to reading about. Thrown off by the outlier, Fuyu is reluctant to become friends with Rika - and with their clashing archetypes, she's hoping this odd couple doesn't graduate into a rarepair.

title: Crush of a Lifetime
description:
Hyeji is a social media star with over 100,000 Instargram followers. She's received tons of confessions because of her popularity, yet despite that she's never been on a single date.  
  
But one day, she gets asked on a date—by another popular social media star that she's secretly been following, no less!   
  
On the day of the long-awaited date, when she's alone, Hyeji finds that the only way she can get a perfect selfie angle is if she takes it with her toes…  
  
Just then, Kisung, a part-timer there, accidentally opens the door, revealing Hyeji mid-shot, and to her date, of all people…!  
  
After her disastrous date, Hyeji decides she's done being Forever Alone and is determined to find The One.  
  
Hyeji starts school with her new ambitious aspiration, only to find she's in the same class as the cause of her tragic toe incident—Kisung!

title: Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo
description:
Otogi Katsura has had a reputation for being a beautiful girl at school since she entered the school. She is also named president of the class committee, but the vice president, Ichi (Ninomae), is also reputed to be a pretty boy. Unlike her public face, Otogi Katsura is an outspoken character and a martial artist in her own right. She is attracted to the perfect Ichi, who is also perfect on the inside, but she wonders if he also has a dark side.
___
**Award:** Won the 49th Koudansha Manga Award in the Shoujo Category.

title: Tsubasa-chan, Kimi wa.  Macchingu shita Onna wa Satsujinki
description:
A dull university student, Sousuke-kun’s only comfort lies in messaging Tsubasa-chan, a girl he met on a dating app. A cute and kind girl, talking to her only leads to good things for Sousuke. But who is Tsubasa-chan, really?   
During their messaging, by chance when sending a casual message, Sousuke opened the curtains to the play of his own hell.   
The fated girl, “Tsubasa-chan”, has set out to destroy his everything. So begins the unpredictable suspense story!  


---

title: Tokidoki Bosotto Russia-go de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san (Oneshot)
description:
Oneshot promoting the first volume of the Light Novel "Alya, Who Sits Next to Me, Sometimes Whispers Sweet Nothings in Russian". Popularity may result in a serialization!  
  
Follow the story of the ice-cold perfect beauty, the half-Russian Alisa "Alya" Mikhailovna Kujo, and your average high school underachiever, Masachika Kuze. She has a cold exterior, but speaks her love in a language she thinks nobody understands… Little does she know that he understands her just fine! Enjoy the silly slice-of-life romance between Snow Princess and Mr. Worldwide!

title: Machigatte Ita no wa Oredattanda.
description:
Furuya contemplates the accidental death of his girlfriend, Sara.
___
Published in *Jump SQ. RISE 2018 SUMMER*.

title: A Beloved Existence
description: Soyou, who received heart transplant surgery, discovered that the donated heart belongs to the father of a guy in her class! As they grow closer together, will they be able to help each other weather any storm?

title: To Love Ru
description: Rito Yuuki is a high-school boy who just can't confess to the girl of his dreams, Haruna-chan. One day when coming home and sulking in the bath-tub, a mysterious and barely clothed girl appears out of nowhere. Her name is Lala and she comes from another planet…

title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses - pixiv Side Stories
description: Side stories and illustrations from the author's pixiv.

title: Saenai Kanojo (Heroine) no Sodatekata - Koisuru Metronome
description:
Famed author Kasumigaoka Utaha had always struggled with her novel series, 'Koisuru Metronome' until she met Tomoya Aki; her biggest fan who inspires her to give it a proper conclusion and later becomes her personal editor. Now with Tomoya's passion and Kasumigaoka's determination combined, the two work together on their latest series while also discovering their true feelings and finding parallels between themselves and the characters within Kasumigaoka's novels.   
  
This is an alternate Story with Kasumigaoka Utaha as the Main Heroine.

title: Kanojo wa Rokurokubi
description:
A story about a long-necked girl's love life. Kanoi Natsuki and her childhood friend Itsuki visit the same school and there seems to be more between them besides friendship. As a rokurokubi, her quirk of stretching her neck is normal for her and her surroundings, but it's not always her choice to stretch it and although she has feelings for Itsuki, she can't tell him what she feels. Ultimately, she has to go through misunderstandings and shame. Itsuki, meanwhile, manages to make any awkward situations dissolve… or maybe not!?

**Note:** The oneshot version of the series is included in Volume 2.
___
