title: Necromancer Academy and the Genius Summoner
description:
Necromancers have built a name for themselves as fearsome practitioners of magic capable of dropping entire empires to their knees. Simon Follentia is a necromancer with incredible latent talent! After being scouted for the necromancer's academy, this genius is ready to be nurtured and taken to the next level. 

But could Simon's insane talents attract some unforeseen consequences?

title: Love Disasters of a Meddlesome Girl
description: A meddlesome girl, Setsuko, tries to speed along the painfully slow progress of the relationship between her two childhood friends, Yusuke and Saori. Problem is, they like someone else… A LOT!!!

title: Danjo-hi 1:39 no Heikou Sekai wa Omoi no Hoka Futsuu (Fan Colored)
description:
Fan created Colored Version of Original.

Satou Sou is accidentally swapped with himself in a parallel world with a male/female ratio of 1:39. He finds a kind family and lovely women at the place where he was switched. Seeing the outside of these women, he's relieved to see that the number of men and women has changed, but not much else. However, their inner lives are filled with conflicts and troubles.

T/L Note: More than color It's re-mastered edition. Whole manga is being remade in color. Effort are as big as making original manga itself.

title: Shachiku to Gal ga Irekawarimashite
description: No hobbies, no holidays, no girlfriend, Enomoto lives only to work. Although she enjoys high school life, Rico finds it a little boring. It just so happens that these two swap bodies!? Thrown into their opposite lives, what a crisis! However, talking to women in the baths, and using gal power to fight off exploitative bosses… It's surprisingly cool!?

title: Revelation of Youth
description: Lim Chungah is a highschool student whose household got swindled by her own trusted uncle. With her parents leaving in pursuit of finding her uncle, she is temporarily left alone to live in her uncle's empty house. HOWEVER, what if Chungah's family weren't the only ones duped by her uncle's con? Enter Millenium Adventist Church, the biggest cult in their community and one of her uncle's scam victims. Lim Chungah finds herself cohabitating with Kim Yohan, the cult leader's one and only son. Oh God, will their living situation be okay?!

title: Hokenshitsu wa Futarikiri
description: A collection of interconnected yuri stories in the nurse's office.

title: Gakkou de Guuzen Onnanoko no "Himitsu" o Shitte Shimatta Ohanashi
Ponko Tsundere na Osananajimi
description: Shouta Kanda, who returned to his hometown after entering high school, reunites with Sanae Kondo, a clumsy childhood friend of his when he was in kindergarten, he clearly remembers how clumsy she was, but thinks that she's most likely grown out of it, until…

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Double Seven-hen
description:
The second year has started! Mikihiko has been promoted to Course 1, Tatsuya has entered the new Magical Engineering Course, and trouble is brewing between Saegusa Mayumi's younger twin sisters and 1st year representative Shippou Takuma, a member of the 18 Assistant Houses' Shippou Household.  
  
Adaptation of the original novel's volume 12.

title: "Oppai Momitai" tte Sakendara, Imouto no Tomodachi to Tsukiau Koto ni Narimashita.
description: "I want to fondle boobs!" His prayer was answered by an angelic girl named Miko-chan. "I-if I let you touch my breast, will you go out with me?" It's a sweet story of their daily lovey-dovey life. Isn't it wonderful to have a girlfriend?

title: Gal to Tsuchinoko
description: One day, Nekota-kun, a simple high school boy and encounters a "mythological creature". Impressed by Nekota-kun's extraordinary vigor, Jun-chan, a simple high school gal, decides to go along with Nekota-kun.

title: Naze Nigerun Dai? - Boku no Shoukanjuu wa Kawaii yo
description: Happy, whom Heresy summoned when he was little, is actually a sweet, kind-hearted girl. ──Even if her looks are a tiny bit grotesque! At the Summoner Academy, Heresy is treated like a total anomaly. Even though he's just trying to act "normal," he keeps unknowingly getting dragged into some absolutely insane situations...!?

title: Dou Ganbatte mo H ni Nacchau Osananajimi
description:
Airi-chan, a naturally airheaded heroine, loves her childhood friend Yuu-kun. However, both her feelings of love and lust are sky-high, and she's always getting into lewd accidents! Meanwhile, the shadow of NTR by a shallow playboy is creeping around Airi-chan!? Good boys and girls who read this when they're alone should have a tissue in one hand, okay♫

(Source: Young Magazine Web)
___
[Alt Official Raw (MagaPoke)](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/episode/2550912964523273942)

title: Kimi ga Kirai na Koi no Hanashi
description: Good-natured Chihiro Hiyoshi takes being the class rep seriously, but her partner, Haruka Kisaragi does not. He's got too many rumors swirling around him, but when a chance meeting brings them into each other's lives for just a moment, they form an unsteady bond. But bad boy Haruka may be too much for a good girl like Chihiro to handle… but something in her may have just awoken a hidden softness in him, too.

title: Ore no Haitoku Meshi wo Onedari Sezu ni Irarenai, Otonari no Top Idol-sama
description:
A meddlesome high schooler, Mamori Suzufumi, helps her neighbor who had collapsed from hunger. The neighbor turns out to be none other than the extremely popular high school idol, Sasaki Yuzuki! Yuzuki had been excessively restricting her diet in order to maintain her image as the perfect idol. But when the worried Suzufumi serves her a homemade meal...

"...Aahhhhhhhhhnn! I can't take it anymore!"

With a face full of bliss, Yuzuki devours the meal completely! Seeing her eat so happily, Suzufumi decides to tempt her with her favorite dishes and make her succumb to 'food bliss.'
___
**Character Designer:** [Hizuki Higure](https://mangadex.org/author/58898e8a-597d-48fd-8cf3-e489cb2e9f7d)

title: Kanojo ni Naritai Kimi to Boku
description: Hime Sakuragaike has secretly been in love with her childhood friend Akira Yonezawa since they were kids, but Hime only recently found out that Akira identifies as female. Although surprised, Hime offers her full support, and this is initially kept secret between them for a few years, but Akira decides to start living as a girl full-time upon starting high school with Hime. However, since Akira garners a certain amount of attention, Hime takes it upon herself to aggressively stick up for Akira whenever necessary. Not wanting Akira to be singled out as an object of ridicule, Hime decides that her only option is to put herself in Akira's shoes.

title: Wǒ Shì Wǒ Qī
description: A clap of thunder on a clear day sent depressed salaryman Yi Qiu ten years into the past. Now, with the opportunity to revisit highschool as a girl and interact with her former friends…and her former self…she'll encounter action, occasional romance, more tangential subplots than you can shake a stick at…and just maybe, the possibility of changing history for the better.

title: Sayonara, Watashitachi ni Yasashikunakatta, Subete no Hitobito
description:
Thiếu nữ dành cả đời để trả thù bảy kẻ sát hại chị gái mình.

 Tại Thị trấn Akada bốn bề vây quanh bởi núi non có cậu sinh viên nọ tên Nakagawa Shiori. Cậu ta vì quá chán nản với cảnh bị bắt nạt nên đã ngừng tới trường. Rồi một ngày, thiếu nữ tên Satou Mei bỗng dưng từ đâu đến sống chung với cậu. Mei là người chẳng hề mở lòng với bất kỳ ai, nhưng cô lại tiết lộ cho cậu biết lý do mà bản thân tới thị trấn này.

 “Tôi muốn giết bảy kẻ đã khiến chị tôi tuyệt vọng tới mức tìm tới cái chết.”

 Ba năm trước, chị của Mei là Akari đã tự sát vì bị bắt nạt đến thậm tệ tại thị trấn Akada này. Vì trả thù nên Mei đã quay lại đây, đồng thời cô ấy muốn thực hiện nghi thức đẫm máu mang tên “Okakashitsutsumi” nhằm sử dụng sức mạnh của Đại Xà Thần “Okakashisama” để đồ sát bảy kẻ tham gia vào vụ việc.

 Vào đêm hạ chí tháng Sáu, Mei đã thành công thực hiện nghi thức. Giờ đây, nhờ thứ sức mạnh của thần linh cùng sự trợ giúp của Shiori, Mei lần lượt sát hại bảy kẻ đã giết chị mình. Trong khoảng thời gian t

title: Kinpatsu Yankee to Batsu Game
description:
As part of her punishment game, the transfer student, Shindou Eruko, must talk to the coolest delinquent in the school, which turns out to be Hoshi Natsuki, the blonde delinquent in the class next door. However, she soon found out that Hoshi-kun might not be as scary as he looks...
___
This manga is Konogi Yoshiru's fantasy take on [Shingeki no Eroko-san](https://mangadex.org/title/bdfc7777-f1ee-4131-82cb-2fb5861d32e1/shingeki-no-eroko-san-hen-na-oneesan-wa-danshikousei-to-nakayoku-naritai), depicting a setting with Eruko being in the same age as Hoshi-kun. It was later adapted in the main title as Eruko's dream sequence.

title: Hatsukoi Losstime
description: Koji Aiba, who had been living a school life unrelated to girls, suddenly encounters a mysterious phenomenon called "Lost Time" where time stops for one hour a day. Takashi, who is trying to regain his youth in such a static world, meets Tokine Shinomiya, a girl with amber eyes who can also move in the stopped time. In a world where only the two of them can move, they gradually grow closer and closer, and eventually his feelings for Tokine turn into his first love. However, she seems to be harboring a big secret that blocks her feelings.

title: Hibiki ~Shousetsuka ni Naru Houhou~
description:
The literature industry is suffering from the publishing recession. 
While the literary magazine 'Mokuren' was grieving over the present state of affairs, 
a composition intended for their Newcomer's Award was sent to their editing department. 
However, it completely ignored the application rules. It could have been torn to shreds, 
but the work caught the eye of a sole editor. As a result, their world began to change.  
  
**Awards:**
- 2017 Manga Taisho Award
- 2018 Shogakukan Manga Award

title: Fate/stay night [Heaven's Feel]
description:
The story takes place in an ordinary Japanese town, Fuyuki City. Hidden from society, there has been a deadly war going on in this town. Seven sorcerers known as "Masters" summon powerful familiars called "Servants," and they all fight each other until the last one. The last one is said to attain the Holy Grail, which will grant them a wish. Only few know when this War started and what the Holy Grail is, but the war is about to begin again this year.  
  
The main character is Emiya Shirou, who lost his parents in a fire and was adopted by a man who called himself a mage. Admiring his stepfather, he has been training himself to be a mage. However, he had no talent and he could barely use even one type of magecraft. His stepfather has already passed away, and today he's a mage without any skills or knowledge. He is involved in the Holy Grail War when he accidentally summons Saber, who is said to be the strongest Servant of all…  
  
Heaven's Feel is one of the routes in Fate/stay night.

title: Hametsu o Hikaeta Akuyaku Reijō ga Muri Shite Heroine wo Enjita Kekka Taida na Yosei ga Akogare Nanoni, Daini Oji no Dekiai Route ni Konwakuchu
description: A former corporate slave from a black company has reincarnated as Serafina, the villainess of an otome game!  Being a villainess is way too much work for her. Having already slaved away enough for a lifetime in her past world, she’s determined to spend this new existence in absolute, blissful laziness...!  With that goal in mind, her plan was simple: avoid her own destruction just to secure a life of unlimited naps. However, for some reason, the affection levels of the characters around her just won't stop rising...

title: Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance
description: Kazehaya Kamito has been summoned to the girl's school, Areishia Spirit Academy, which teaches noble young ladies how to make contracts with powerful spirits. On his way, he has the misfortune of catching sight of one of these lady spiritualists bathing. She is Clair Rouge, and she is contracted to a spirit named Scarlet, though she has her sights set on a more powerful spirit. Kamito convinces her to lead him to the school, but she stops on the way to make a contract with this powerful spirit…

title: Kyou no Yuiko-san
description: The story of the protagonist, Tomoya, and his everyday life with his girlfriend Yuiko-san.

title: Yesterday o Utatte
description: After college, Uozumi Rikuo, a boy without much ambition in life, takes on a job at a convenience store. The days pass by uneventfully for Rikuo until he meets his former love interest and classmate, but especially thanks to the unusual Nonaka Haru, and her pet crow…

title: "Issho ni Netaindesu yo Ne, Senpai?" to Amaku Sasayakarete Kon'ya mo Nemurenai
description: Bakuya a.k.a Lariat-senpai là một học sinh cao trung năm hai bị chứng mất ngủ. Một đêm, cậu gặp Kimidori, một cô gái năm nhất học cùng trường trong công viên. Cô tự nhận mình có thể chữa bệnh mất ngủ cho Bakuya, nhưng lại trêu chọc cậu mỗi khi có cơ hội.

title: Yuuko-san wa Miraretai
description:
A high school boy who can see ghosts but pretends not to, and Yuuko, a bored ghost who wants to be seen by someone. Yuuko's annoying antics gradually escalate…

A ghost comedy by Wakabayashi Toshiya, the creator of *Tsuredure Children*!!
___
**Chapter 2 BOOTH:** [Official Raw](https://booth.pm/ja/items/981859), [Official English](https://booth.pm/ja/items/1394372)

title: Gal to Oyasan
description:
Kotoha là nữ sinh năm hai trung học, luôn dốc hết sức cho việc làm thêm, chuyện học hành và gu thời trang của mình. Một ngày nọ, khi trở về khu trọ, cô phát hiện Itsuki – một sinh viên đại học – lại chính là chủ nhà tạm thời của mình!? Itsuki vừa giỏi dọn dẹp, nấu nướng, lại chu đáo hết mực, khiến Kotoha không sao giấu nổi sự vừa phấn khích vừa bối rối trước hình ảnh một “ông chủ nhà hoàn hảo” cùng thái độ cưng chiều quá mức của anh.

Một cuộc đối đầu trong yên bình giữa cô nàng gyaru học giỏi, sống tự lập, và chàng sinh viên đại học mang sức hút trời sinh bắt đầu từ đây.

title: Hina to Bambi
description:
Taku và Hinata là hai người bạn thuở nhỏ chuẩn bị nhập học tại Tokyo vào Mùa Xuân này. Lối sống thường nhật của họ ở quê nhà giờ chuẩn bị thay đổi sao...?
Một câu chuyện tình hài hước giữa hai người bạn thuở nhỏ trong sáng trong chuyện tình yêu nhưng lại quá thân thiết!

title: Ippiki Ookami na Onnanoko ga Kininaru Hanashi
description: A story the unexpected side of a girl who is a 'lone wolf' and doesn't hang out with anyone.

title: Manabi Ikiru wa Fuufu no Tsutome
description: Hiroshiman boy Onijiro "Oto" Otogi, and American girl of Fenno-Russian origin Paulina "Ponya" Otogi are 18-year-olds and a newly-wed couple in their third year of high school, only recently returning to Japan to finish their education after years of living as neighbors in the USA. Together, Oto and Ponya will learn about proper physical relations as they raid their high school life!

title: Shinyuu ga Onnanoko ni Natteshimatta
description: My best friend has become a girl

title: Arashi-kun no Dakimakura
description: Sora, a high school girl who loves her family, hurt her back after carrying her sleeping younger brother and went to the infirmary. It seems like she was having a wonderful dream whilst taking a break but, when she woke up… the beautiful Tsukinose Arashi-kun was sleeping in the same bed as her! It seems like Sora has been chosen by Arashi-kun to be by his side to help him sleep?? Although you’d think that NOBODY at the age of 16 needs a sleeping buddy, the sound of her heartbeat is resonating with the multi talented pretty boy. Watanabe Ayu`s attention drawing new story is an intimate romance that starts from sleeping side by side…

title: Parasol Alliance
description: A boy who is a twin lags behind his overachieving brother in both academics and popularity. He proposes to the girl he likes, herself a twin, but had confused her for her twin sister. Embarrassed and in a compromising position, he agrees to help her to win the affections of the boy she likes, his brother, lest she leaks his botched confession to her sister, hampering his chances with his crush.

title: Hirunaka no Ryuusei
description:
When her father transfers overseas, fifteen-year old country girl Suzume has to move to Tokyo to live with her uncle. Lost and confused in Tokyo, she bumps into a mysterious man. Who is he? And it turns out he's her homeroom teacher…?  
  
Chapter 47.5 (Heroine no Ryuusei) was a Heroine Shikkaku/Hirunaka no Ryuusei crossover for Betsuma/Margaret 50th Anniversary. It's the second chapter of the crossover between the two, the first chapter being Hirunaka Shikkaku. It's included in the Hirunaka Shikkaku & Heroine no Ryuusei entry.  
  
A Love Story in Moist Rainy Days included in volume 6 as chapter 40.5.  
More than Words included in volume 9 as chapter 60.6.  
Purple Love included in volume 12 as chapter 78.4.

title: Kusozako Choroin Nishiga Hachi (Pre-serialization)
description:
Nishiga Hachi plays the leading role in this comedy about living a day-to-day life with her friends.  
  
Manga Created by @kmtm3682 on twitter, posted to his Pixiv.  
  
**Links:**  
- [Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/kmtm3682)  
- [Artist's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=17344975)

title: She's the Prince and I'm the Princess!? (Webcomic)
description: Ichinose Haruma is handsome, but the girl he likes happens to be even more handsome…?!

title: Kanojo ni Awaseru Kao ga Nai
description:
Mutou is a high school student who was born with no face. He's fallen in love with his childhood friend, Kaori. 
She can't see his expressions or his gaze, but still they understand one another. ♥   
A man's charms don't necessarily lie on his face!

title: Shoutai Fumei to Kyoufu
description: Kaname Isurugi, who suffered facial injuries in an accident, has a hard time getting along with the people at his school ever since he entered. When school counselor Sugata asks Kaname to help solve the problems of the girls in his charge, Kaname half-heartedly makes contact with four of them. After a month passes without any response, Kaname begins to question his actions. Suddenly, Kaname has a shocking "fateful encounter".

title: The Shape-Shifting Witch's Kiss
description: Mugura Tooru is a boy so low-profile that even his family sometimes loses sight of him. One day, he encounters a witch. Since her true identity was found out by Tooru, the witch is cursed to lose half her magic, and she says that his most heartfelt wish must be granted in order for her to get her magical power back. And what's more, the thing necessary for her to restore her power every day is... a kiss?! A heart-pounding story starring the unlikely duo of an "invisible boy" and a witch!

title: Dungeon Kouryaku no Tame nara, Love Comedy Shinakucha Dame desu ka?
description: To conquer the dungeons that suddenly appeared on Earth a hundred years ago, students now attend academies to train as adventurers. Among them are two rivals: the academy’s strongest delinquent, Sainokami Kuroto, and the elite noble honor student, Mononobe Yukihime. One day, the two of them find themselves trapped in a dungeon… inside a room that they can’t escape unless they hold hands!? Will these sworn rivals be able to clear this high-difficulty mission and conquer the dungeon—!?

title: Mayo Chiki!
description: Konoe Subaru, a classmate of Sakamachi Kinjirou, has been serving as the butler of Suzutsuki Kanade in school. Due to an accident, Sakamachi discovers Konoe's secret…that he is actually a she!? Apparently she will be removed from her position if anyone at school finds out. What will unfold from this chain of events?

title: July That I Randomly Discovered
description:
What would you do if you found out that you were in fact a character in a comic? And an extra character on top of that? Change the course of the story, obviously!  
  


---

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Kyuukousen-hen
description:
The "Nine Schools Battles", officially called The National Magic High School Good Will Magic Competition. Every year, the best Magic High School students gather together, unfolding a story of frustration and glory by putting their young pride on the line.  
  
Adaptation of the original novel's volumes 3-4.

title: Gal Kazoku
description: My remarried dad brought a new mom and… a cute little sister…!? From the author of "Cross Account", Date-sensei's long awaited new work! A heart thumping family comedy oneshot with 49 pages!!

title: The Demon Lord's Love Life Isn't Going Well
description:
Entering high school, Fujimura Kotone dreams of making friends and finding love. However, her classmates avoid her because of her scary demeanor. One day, a group made up of two girls and a boy come into her class and kneel before her, proclaiming, "It's an honor to meet you, Demon Lord!". With their antics, will she be able to obtain the normal love life she desires?  
  
A reincarnation romantic comedy that transcends space and time!

title: This Delinquent Is Too Innocent!
description: A pure delinquent falls in love with a gloomy girl…

title: Usagi Drop
description: Going home for his grandfather’s funeral, thirty-year-old bachelor Daikichi is floored to discover that the old man had an illegitimate child with a younger lover! The rest of his family is equally shocked and embarrassed by this surprise development, and not one of them wants anything to do with the silent little girl, Rin. In a fit of angry spontaneity, Daikichi decides to take her in himself! But will living with this overgrown teenager of a man help Rin come out of her shell? And hang on, won’t this turn of events spell doom for Daikichi’s love life?!

title: Mokuyoubi wa Kimi to Nakitai
description:
“–Tôi có một bí mật về bản thân mình.”

Đây là câu chuyện về bốn con người đang học tại Đại học Đế Đô:

Aikawa Kaoru—người mang trong mình một bí mật không thể nói với bất kỳ ai.
Senmitsu Ryou—cậu bạn thanh mai trúc mã luôn ở bên Kaoru—cũng che giấu vô số bí mật của riêng mình.
Shimizu Reika—người mẫu mà Kaoru thầm ngưỡng mộ—cũng có một bí mật tuyệt đối không được để lộ ra.
Saotome Chiaki—người luôn được các cô gái săn đón—lại đang giấu đi một điều mà họ không muốn ai biết.

Bốn con người khao khát tình yêu nhưng lại trở thành những kẻ nói dối.
Hãy để tấm màn khởi động cho câu chuyện tình yêu vừa đau đớn vừa mãnh liệt—đậm chất xác thịt—của họ bắt đầu…

title: She's My Knight
description: Haruma Ichinose, 17, has been popular since he was born. So popular, in fact, that he figured no one could even come close...until he met Yuki Mogami. She's tall, cool, collected, and totally makes him crazy. He may just be in love...but can he deal with falling for someone even more dashing than himself?

title: Again!!
description:
After three unfulfilling years of high school, Imamura Kinichirou was finally graduating. Because of his delinquent-esque looks, he was feared by his classmates, has made no friends, and his greatest regret was not joining the ouendan (cheer club), which was now disbanded. After an accident on the day of his graduation, he and classmate Fujieda Aki are transported three years back in time, freshman again in body but with high-school memories intact. Can Imamura fix the mistakes of his past? Can he re-do his high school years in the way that he's always wanted? Again!! The universe suddenly shouts.
___
**Links:**
* Alternative Official English: [Kodansha](https://kodansha.us/series/again/)

title: Bazutta Bun Dake Kawaikute Etchide Juujun ni Tsukusu Yandere ni Naru Yankiigyaru
description: Pretty Gyaru or a badass yankee delinquent? Will these two sides of the person be able to live together in the same girl?

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Yotsuba Keishou-hen
description:
In December, Miyuki receives an invitation for the Yotsuba's new year's family gathering. However, unlike previous years, they specially added "Everyone must attend" on the invitation. Miyuki understands that "the time has come" — it is time to decide the next head for the Yotsuba Clan.  
— If she is elected, her brother will be free.  
— If she becomes the next head, she will be forced to marry someone else.  
Miyuki's heart is a mess.  
The truth of the Brother and Sister relationship is finally unveiled!? Yotsuba Keishou-hen begins!  
  
Adaptation of the original novel's volume 16.

title: Aroma-chan wa Konya mo Hazukashii
description:
Succubus Aroma-chan is so shy, well not really, but she can't confess to the person she likes!   
"Then, what if I just invade Yuuma-kun's dream and seduce him…?"  
Tonight, an ero-dream that cannot be seen by other people begins!

title: Cyclops Shoujo Saipu~
description: When Fuuka hit her second year of middle school, puberty kicked in. Now she's really tall and has huge boobs. Due to her hairstyle, her classmates call her "Saipu," after the cyclops. Her affection for her older brother was cute when she was a little girl and said she wanted to marry him. Now it just freaks him out, since she's decided she's adult enough to follow through on her childish promises. This 4-koma style manga is the story of the life of this cyclops girl!

title: Tsuru Tsuru to Zara Zara no Aida
description: Tamaki's family owns a pet shop specializing in reptiles and amphibians, though he himself doesn't particularly like them. He catches the interest of a girl named Saya, who really likes reptiles and amphibians. They start dating.

title: Sensei, Suki desu.
description: A bachelor for the past 11 years, Higuchi Yuuki is a male teacher in an all-girls school. He keeps wondering how to bridge the gap between himself and his students when he's suddenly confessed to by Ichikawa, one of his students! Although Higuchi rejects her, Ichikawa does all she can to get her teacher to turn her way – even if it means making him grope her and holding his hand in class! When Higuchi can't understand why she'd like an unimpressive and inexperienced guy like him, she kisses him! Will Higuchi be able to handle the feelings of his beautiful student, especially when she is not the only one to have fallen for him?!? A dramatic school love story unfolds!

title: A Yuri Manga Between a Delinquent and a Quiet Girl That Starts From a Misunderstanding
description: After a misplaced confession lands the letter of Touno Hitomi in the locker of Saijou Nagisa, both of them experience feelings of attraction towards each other…

title: Ganbare! Nakamura-kun!!
description: Nakamura is a shy boy who falls in love at first sight with one of his high school classmates, Hirose. But there's a problem: they haven't met yet. And Nakamura is a total klutz who might bungle things before they even begin!

title: Ore no Kanojo ga Bakemono Datta
description: Akiyama-kun is a young high school boy who one day decides to declare his love to a girl (Harukawa), but what he didn't expect was that she was a monster.

title: Yumemigaoka Wonderland
description: One day, a UFO suddenly crashes in the middle of an ordinary city, making the world change in unexpected ways. Suddenly, all sorts of wishes come true and everything seems possible… The series follows the stories of the people affected by these changes.

title: Kono Kyoushi, Zettai Wazato.
description: The beautiful Mio Saeki seems like a quiet young lady but when she's in the Japanese prep room she acts like an old man, eating squid sticks and talking about horse-racing. Only her teacher Shirokawa knows her true nature and despite his slightly sadistic teasing, they get along so well that she finds herself falling for him.

title: Iinari
description:
A boy falls in love with a girl, who is the student council president of their school.   
   
Unable to confess, he is gifted by a deus ex machina when he innocently uses his cell phone camera to spy on her. On one of his playbacks, the boy realizes that the girl is not wearing any underwear.   
   
But, the next day, when he recounts the previous day's events to the girl, she asks him to do her a favor. After some investigation, he finds out that the girl actually has a repressed exhibitionism fetish - she secretly wants to experience the thrill of showing her naked body to the world, but at the same time doesn’t want anyone besides the boy to know.  
  
Hijinks ensue as the two strike up a deal to give the girl opportunities to frolic around fabric-free. While this occurs, DRAMA ensues as they begin to fall in love with each other instead and question the NATURE of NUDITY.

title: Aishen Qiaokeli Jinxing Shi
description: Jiang Hao Yi, a normal high school student who is extremely scared of getting into trouble, suddenly becomes the Harem King of his school and gets confessed to by a bunch of beautiful girls! The worst thing is, Jiang Hao doesn't know any of the girls who confessed to him! What on earth is happening? This is a manhua that shouldn't be missed by fans of the harem genre!

title: Modokidomo
description: A guy decides to pretend to be a delinquent to get people to leave him alone. A girl who was a delinquent decides to act like an honor student because her parents asked her to. This is their story.

title: Black Kanojo
description: Hoshino Teru, a mediocre middle school boy has a crush on Amamiya, his childhood friend. However, "Micchan" stands between them, and brings chaos upon Teru's life.

title: Goodbye Declaration
description:
Kakeru Kiritani is a boy who is not good at socializing, doesn't attend school, and spends most of his time playing video games. In his last year of highschool, a fateful encounter awaits him! The one who appears in front of Kakeru is the complete opposite of him. She's naive, has a lot of fans and haters, and causes a lot of problems, but even so she's a beautiful girl who catches everyone's attention—Rena Nanase!

Torn between love and dreams, where is their last year of highschool headed!?
The hit song "Goodbye Declaration," which has over 100 million views on YouTube, has been adapted into a novel, and now it's going to crazily bloom into a manga!

Author:
Arata Iri (Manga)
Mitsuki Midori (Story)
Arusechika (Character design)
Chinozo (Original work, supervision)

title: Girl Crush
description:
Momose Tenka is a first year high school student who can sing, dance, and has a killer body. She's good at everything… except love. She meets a K-pop obsessed girl named Satou Erian, and is dazzled by her earnest nature.  
  
This is the story of two young girls dreaming of becoming K-pop idols! A heart-throbbing story about pure love!  
  
*Serialized in [LINE Manga](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0000965) (by Line Digital Frontier) and [Comic Nicola](https://ebook.shinchosha.co.jp/book/F914001/) (by Shinchosha),
follow latest news & updates at the [Official Twitter Account](https://twitter.com/girlcrush_comic)*

NB: The LINE link is not broken, but Region Locked.

---
Alt. Official English: [Viz](https://www.viz.com/girl-crush)

title: My Cute Deskmate
description: A guy and a girl are deskmates who like each other.

title: Back to You
description:
***"To me, he's my destiny. To him, I'm just a girl he knows."***  
  
A young woman grieves the unexpected death of her neighbor and former high school classmate, as she liked him ever since she met him. She had never gathered the courage to confess, and she wasted whatever little chance she had with him.  
  
During a drunken bus ride with a man she's been meeting from time to time, himself a former schoolmate, the bus gets into an accident, and both her and the man find themselves transported 10 years in the past.  
  
Together they agree not to tamper with the past because he staunchly refuses to change his already idyllic future, but she progressively starts seeing this as a second chance to save the life of the boy she loves.

title: Dugeundugeun Daejakjeon
description: "Don't you think we're missing that heart-fluttering feeling?" From elementary school all the way to high school, Nam Do-yeon and Jeong A-rin have gone from childhood friends to lovers. For a couple who strives for a perfectly rational relationship, a plan to reclaim that one missing piece of excitement— Operation: Heartbeat begins!

title: Osananajimi ni Modoritai Bokura
description: Hikari wants to go back to being childhood friends with Suzushi.

title: Sasameki Koto
description:
Sasameki Koto is the story of Murasame Sumika, an intelligent and athletically gifted girl who just happens to be in love with her best friend, Kazama Ushio. Unable to confess her feelings, Sumika can only stay by her side and watch over her. After all, the biggest obstacle to her love is something that she can't change. It has nothing to do with the fact they're both girls; Sumika just isn't Kazama's type!

Kazama is only into cute girls and Sumika's cool personality just doesn't fit the bill. Much to her friend's dismay, Kazama is always eager to share news about her latest crush. With the duo's knack for attracting trouble, it looks like Sumika's trials have only just begun.

title: Dragon Gal no Nailist
description:
“Do my nails——!”

In this modern age where demihumans are living normal lives, somehow, a dragon demihuman gal named Gotou Sayori asks Azuma to do her nails. It seems that she has a problem where her nails are too hard to get done…?
___
**Character Designer:** [Komupi](https://mangadex.org/author/f31f16ce-941c-4026-88d4-bcaedc785380)

title: Melancholia
description: An omnibus collection of interconnected short stories by Douman Seiman.

title: Dark Mortal
description: Gangnam lost his parents from a fire and has turned blind from the incident. He wasn't able to see anything but a hallucination called Kkamjang. Is Kkamjang actually a hallucination or something more? 'Your scars, your two eyes, and… even your strength! I'll change everything for you.'

title: Naisho no Ofutarisama.
description: Is it wrong to think about eating food all day...? Eliza, a young lady who is only interested in food is brought a delicious gift by a delinquent named Misaki. She's scary... but she can't resist the allure of good food!

title: Rine🐈‍⬛ to Hinano🐕
description: Daily moments between childhood friends who are secretly in love with each other.

title: I Have a Second Chance at Life, so I'll Pamper My Yandere Boyfriend for a Happy Ending!!
description:
She must avoid dying in her second chance at life?!
A choose-wisely romantic comedy! ☆

On the day of her high school graduation, Ichinose Himari was shoved off to her death by her boyfriend, Taniguchi Shion... At least, that's what she thought, but when she woke up, she had gone back to when she was a second year student! To avoid dying by Shion's hands again, Himari thinks of a solution - - and that solution is to completely show Shion how she feels about him!

Himari's series of unfortunate events begins!

title: Living-Room Matsunaga-san
description: Miko leaves the house of her parents to live with her uncle who runs a boarding house, but her first meeting with Matsunaga-san isn't good and then he discovers that she is one of her uncle's tenants. Even as a secondary student she surrounds herself with university students who have a very different life from her own. Can she fit into her new home?

title: Kono Koi, Okuchi ni Aimasu ka? ~Yuutousei no Shirahime-san wa Mondaiji no Ore to Mainichi Kiss shiteru~
description: Tên tôi là Kiminami Toui - thằng báo số một của trường. Tôi có một giấc mơ cho tương lai, và để hiện thực hóa cái ảo mộng đấy mà tôi chẳng đoái hoài đến ai. Song, mọi thứ bỗng thay đổi khi bố tôi sắp xếp buổi gặp mặt với vị hôn thê. Cô ấy tên Shirahime Rira, một cô gái không chỉ tài sắc vẹn toàn mà còn là con gái của chủ tịch tập đoàn. Hơn thế nữa cô còn là một người mẫu nổi tiếng với bí danh “S-Hime”. Nhưng tính cách cô lại trái ngược hẳn với tôi. Ẩn sau vẻ ngoài ấy là một con người hoàn toàn khác: toàn cản trở ước mơ và suốt ngày dọa hôn, thậm chí còn đòi dạy đời tôi nữa. Đúng phiền phức luôn ấy! Tôi mà không ra tay thì toang mất tương lai. Nhưng xem ra nàng công chúa hoàn hảo Shirahime Rira cũng có những bí mật và nỗi lòng riêng.

title: Azumi-chan to Kochou-chan
description: Asumi, whose earnest nature makes her a pillar of support for everyone, is dating Kocho, the most beautiful girl in their grade. However, the one thing he realised after getting together with her was that she was actually a "queen bee" type who is utterly self-centred and totally agressive. Asumi, who finds herself constantly at Kocho’s mercy, can’t stop her heart from racing at her every word and action! But is it actually Kocho who’s getting all flustered?

title: Hisokana Hana Emi
description:
"If I were to be honest, it would have been better if I were like everyone else."  
  
Because of her eye-catching looks, there are rumors that Yohira Shino plays around with men. Thus, she is both treated as a nuisance and feared by those around her.  
  
One day, she meets Yozakura Yuui, a sophomore upperclassman who Shino remembers disliking due to the former being an honors student. Howeover, due to some circumstances, they start to live together in the same dorm room. Though Shino initially opposes, she finds that there's something about Yuui that separates her from everyone she's encountered until now.   
  
[Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/Yumemitsuki125)

title: Majo wa Mangetsu ni Saku
description: Koichi Hotaka is a second-year junior high school student who is a bit of a shy. One day, he meets a mysterious girl, Shima, who calls herself the "Witch of Alstroemeria" and is chosen as her "contractor".

title: Koisuru Bukimi-chan
description:
Oobu Kimi is the kind girl who's bullied for being scary but really she's just misunderstood.
She's also in love with her classmate Tatsuyoshi Okita.
Will she be able to get into Okita-kun's heart? …that is, *before she unintentionally gives him a heart attack?*

Artist is credited as Yokoe Kouhei.

title: Crossdressing Pandemic
description:
Just as he was entering high school, Nanaki Koga experienced a certain accident and fell into a deep coma. After two years, he finally woke up.   
  
However, he found that the world had changed. While he was unconscious, a sudden craze hit Japan: crossdressing. Now the newest fad, approximately 90% of Japanese people dress up as the opposite gender.   
  
And so Nanaki re-enrolls in his all-boys school, in which every student wears a sailor fuku. And as luck has it, Nanaki has a surprisingly feminine face…

title: Ribunesu
description:
An invincible brother who's willing to do anything for his little sister.  


---

title: Shinozaki Himeno's Love Q&A
description: Shinozaki Himeno has no intention of dating anyone before she's ready to consider marriage; as such, the last year of high school is too early to her. However, she is confessed to by Maruyama, a weirdo who asked her out solely because a friend told him he should try out love. Moreover, he asked to date her for only one month. Since he'll ask someone else if she rejects, Himeno begrudgingly accepts, beginning an unusual relationship.

title: I Don't Understand Her Facial Expression at All (Pre-Serialization)
description:
Yotsuya-kun fell in love with a student from his class, Shirogane-san, yet he can't read her facial expressions at all and she always wears a mask, so he tries to ask her for the reason.  
  
The Twitter web comic pre-serialization of [Hyoujou ga Issai Wakaranai Shirogane-san].  
  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/byte0713)  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/2335832)

title: Yandere Kanojo
description:
Tanaka Manabu is a geeky student, on the way to school he meets a girl carrying a bloody bat. That girl is Ryuuzaki Reina, leader of the school's female delinquents. It's love at first sight. A gag manga (with a combination of 4koma and normal page) about having a yankee dere-dere girlfriend.  
  
Note: In the title of this series, "yandere" isn't refering to this term, but to the "yankee"+"dere-dere" combination.  
Yandere Kanojo came out in two editions. One is the "magazine version", Yandere Kanojo (Joker); and the other one is the "online version", Yandere Kanojo (Online).

title: Youki ni Naritai Shigure-san
description:
Yoshida is a gloomy second year middle school student whose precious youth has been spent stuck in the corner of his class without being able to make any friends. Shigure is the girl who sits next to him in class and she is as gloomy as he is. One day, she strikes up a conversation with Yoshida and declares, “I'm going to become a cheerful person!”.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Young Jump+](https://ynjn.jp/title/3318)

title: Osananajimi Lesbian Giwaku
description: A collection of oneshots drawn by Majoccoid.

title: I'm No Heroine!
description:
A girl obsessed with a novel suddenly finds herself transported into the thick of the plot. The problem is, she has taken on the role of the villain in the story. And she knows how this ends… it's off with her head! Maybe she'll just let this play out and wake up back in reality… But after a few too many deaths to no avail, it's finally time to go off-script. She's going to have a little fun with this tale. She's made up her mind… to live!

---
**Official Translations:**
* [Chinese (Traditional) / 漢語](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/namju_RJ)
* [French / Français](https://www.delitoon.com/detail/daf_1000570)
* [Japanese / 日本語](https://www.lezhin.jp/ja/comic/okotowari)

title: Sotodura Danshi no Shimizu-kun
description: Clumsy and unlucky Koharu Minami has a crush on the super popular Shimizu-kun. Shimizu is nice, friendly, and treats everyone with respect. He's perfect...or so it seems. Until one day Koharu accidently finds out about Shimizu-kun's true personality...

title: Aizawa-san Zoushoku
description: Mizutani Souta is confessed to by the school's famous frail beauty Aizawa Shino. Then came another one of her! And another! And another! Each with different attitudes, but all of them are Aizawa Shino herself. What will this sort-of harem love story come to!? Another tsukkomi-all-you-can offering from the creator of Fujimura-kun Mates!

title: 3-Gumi no Osananajimi
description: Depicts the journey of three sets of childhood friends - 'childhood friends with a physical difference,' 'childhood friends who are conscious of height differences,' and 'childhood friends with an age gap' - until they start dating.

title: Kimi ni Sasageru Otokomae
description: "I'm going to tell you I love you every day!" A younger handsome guy confesses his love on their first meeting! An uneven love story between a good looking boy and a manly girl begins.

title: Tsuji-kun And Miyazono-san
description: A comic about falling in love.

title: Eigo Chome Chome Sensei (Kari)
description:
Because of our teacher, English class won't start. The reasons being:  
1. She's uselessly sexy!  
2. She can't read the mood!  
3. She's excessively clumsy!  
  
The lesson always derails, but even so she doesn't give in.

title: TS Gakuen no Nichijou
description: At a boy's school where there are multiple students with OTMS constitutions that temporarily become female due to various reasons, commonly known as TS Gakuen, a childhood friend who was attending school together suddenly becomes a beautiful girl who feels embarrassed and serious There are a lot of special everyday scenes and exciting school life such as the discipline committee member who cannot accept his own female constitution and the students who are positively dressed in female uniforms and enjoy the cuteness!

title: Oda-chan to Akechi-kun
description: The school's top delinquent, Akechi Ryuunosuke, and the school's idol, Oda Maria. The two, who live in different worlds, start dating after Akechi confesses his feelings. However, at the moment of their first kiss, the memory of the burning the Honnou Temple comes back to their minds! A turbulent high school life begins, where grudges from past lives and love from this life are mixed together!

title: Chihiro-kun wa, Atashi Holic.
description: "I've been looking for you for a long time. You are my muse." Michi is in love at first sight with the earnest but forceful high school designer, Chihiro. Every time Chihiro touches her or compliments her, her "real self" that she has never known before begins to sparkle and shine. He takes measurements in a classroom alone with her, kisses her hand tenderly, and despite always being super pushy, he also shows a shy side?! The unpredictable Chihiro will keep you on the edge of your seat in this dramatic, doting love story!

title: Sakurasou no Pet na Kanojo
description:
After being kicked out of the main dorms for bringing in a stray cat, Kanda Sorata is forced to live in the smaller Sakura Halls where problem students are sent to live. Although he doesn’t mind his roommates, Sorata can’t wait to move out of Sakura Halls. But when Shiina Mashiro moves into the dorm, everything changes. Mashiro is an artistic genius who, at a young age, won many awards for her skills, but due to her childhood being so focused on art, she has no common sense and social skills. Forced to take the role of taking care of Mashiro, Sorata learns about himself and begins on a path of self improvement.  
  
Adaptation of the light novel series written by Kamoshida Hajime with illustrations by Mizoguchi Keeji

title: Hakiri-san wa Kimi Dake no Shinigami ni Naritai
description: An ordinary high school student Nikami, has no interest in falling in love, let alone getting married. One day when he's leaving for school, the Grim Reaper is standing there, with a giant scythe! Rather than killing Nikami, she introduces herself as Hakiri, and she came form the Underworld to help Nikami die. She claims that he will only die if he gets married! A first in human history. Nikami tells her that he doesn't have a girlfriend, but Hakiri responds with a proposal!

title: Hatsuharu ga Saku
description:
Nishino Yuzu was all pumped to start her second year of high school, but as she begins her new school life, she meets a strange new classmate in Shinjou Kanata. "I don't understand him. We can't get along." or so she thought, but through glimpses of how kind and dependable he is, she gradually begins to take interest. What could this feeling be…?  
  
Here you'll find a girl that you can't help but cheer on!

title: Poputepipikku
description: Pop Team Epic turns absurdist comedy up to eleven with its pop culture references and surreal hilarity. With two bonafide high school girl protagonists—the short and exceptionally quick to anger Popuko, and the tall and unshakably calm Pipimi—they throw genres against the wall and don't wait to see what sticks.

title: This Delinquent-kun Is Ungrateful
description:
The 16 year-old delinquent Gaku travels to the future in his friends time machine, only to end up on the door of said friends daughter Akira, age 28. Thus begins their time living together, filled with new experiences and gap love spanding age and generation! 
  
Note: This is an original from Manga Mee, a manga app, and is already completed there but pixiv raws won’t have all of them all at once.

title: Yano-kun no Futsuu no Hibi
description: Cậu bạn Yano luôn đến lớp với khuôn mặt đầy vết thương cùng những miếng băng cá nhân chi chít khiến cho cô bạn lớp trưởng Yoshida hết sức lo lắng. Vì quá bận tâm không biết liệu cậu có bị bắt nạt hay không nên Yoshida đã lén bám theo cậu trên đường về. Và rồi cô phát hiện ra rằng cậu đơn giản chỉ là… quá hậu đậu và xui xẻo mà thôi! Dù biết được sự thật nhưng cô vẫn không thể ngừng lo lắng cho cậu: “Muốn sơ cứu cho cậu ấy quá đi thôi!” Và thế là câu chuyện tình trong sáng giữa hai người dần nảy nở!

title: Do-teihen Reijou ni Hyoui Shita 800-nenmae no Akujo wa Hissori Seishun o Tanoshindeiru.
description:
Nora Nose, the "Nonpareil Villainess" , has been sealed away for 800 years for her crimes.
Her latest amusement is using her Farsight magic to see into the world of school.

One day, while gazing into the school as usual, she hears a voice pleading for help:
"I want to die..."
"If you want to die, why don't you leave your body to me?"

Nora possesses the voice's owner body, Cecily, also known as "Withered Grass Lady."
She must work to improve the situation surrounding of she, who was once bullied!

---
**Original Web Novel:** [Kakuyomu](https://kakuyomu.jp/works/16817330650682304831), [Syosetu](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9868hy/)

title: Masamune-kun no Revenge After School
description: The new manga will tell "after stories" about the characters, including Masamune, Aki, and Yoshino, among others.

title: Girls × Sexual Harassment Life
description: Sawari likes to harass her childhood friend, Kiyoto. Sexually.

title: Yuri na Kataomoi-chan
description: Yuina and Maya have been friends since kindergarten. They both like each other, but they both think that their love towards the other is unrequited.

title: Uso no Tsukenai Otoshi Goro
description:
The world is plagued with the strange illness, [Voice] that affects teenagers. But when one's feeling is disrupted, a "bunshin" or a clone will appear and it will say everything you truly feel.  
However, this illness does not pose any danger to one's life. Satsuki, a 2nd year high school developed this illness during that "incident" during her junior high school. Ever since then, Sayoi became protective of Satsuki and keeps anyone from approaching her. One day, they met Hiyama, another teenage boy who has the same illness. After meeting him, the twin's relationship started to change?!

title: Fuuka
description: Yuu Haruna just moved into town and is addicted to twitter. When he goes out to buy dinner he bumps into a mysterious girl, Fuuka Akitsuki, who breaks his phone thinking he was trying to take a picture of her panties. How will his new life change now?

title: Siren wa Kimi ni Utawanai
description:
Towa Takanashi is a descendent of Sirens and is infatuated with her classmate, Kei Shibuya. Torn between her feelings and the Siren's unique nature of yearning to eat the one they love, Towa musters up the courage to confess to him—only to get completely rejected on the spot! But what happens when she finds out Shibuya-kun's secret...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shiroyama and Mita-san
description: Tatsuhiko Shiroyama hates being stuck in the boonies. Greetings from strangers feels fake, part-time job prospects are limited, and he's been "blessed" with the nickname "Niyayama" from his classmates due to his creepy, unsociable attempts at smiling. He turned to the radio as a means to escape, and thinks about nothing more than saving up for a move to Tokyo where he can explore his passions. But Tatsuhiko's life changes forever when he saves a rich CEO from a rice paddy and is set up with his granddaughter, the equally as shy and antisocial Tamiko Mita. Together, the two stumble through the nuances of "dating", and Tatsuhiko's dreary days become a whole lot brighter.

title: Kono Sankaku Love Come wa Shiawase ni Naru Gimu ga Aru.
description:
At the start of the new semester, ordinary high school student Yashiro Tenma is in the same class as the two most beautiful girls in the school, Tsubaki Reira and Sumeragi Rinka.

Reira is a cheerful and beautiful girl, and Rinka is cool and a little scary.

Tenma wants to somehow live a peaceful school life by keeping a little distance from such overwhelming beauties, but one day he finds out Rinka's forbidden secret, and the situation changes completely!?

title: Shounen wo Kau
description: Ai Morikawa is a hard-working career woman at her job in Tokyo. After a long night at work, she returned home on the last train to find a handsome boy at her door. The sixteen-year old Nagisa is her sister's stepson, suddenly sent to live with Ai when his parents left for an overseas job. Wary like cats, these two loners fourteen years apart in age will have to make a new life together.

title: Koi wa Hikari
description: Saijou is a college student who has the ability to see the love in a girl's heart in form of sparkles. As no sparkles shine towards him, he avoids girls except his friend Kitashiro who he meet in middle school. But one day he meets a girl named Shinonome who wants to know what love is and he decides to become her friend as he considers both of them as similar.

title: Enishi-kun wa Masho (Harem) Taishitsu ni Mezamemashita
description: Enishi Kazumichi is a teenager who still acts like a child of death, because of that attitude he is often considered like a child even by his own childhood friends. When his feelings for the girl he likes are destroyed by his childhood friend, Kazumichi decides to be alone and starts eating his lunch in a quiet place at his school. But someone suddenly appeared out of nowhere and asked Kazumichi for help. Then, from that moment on, Kazumichi's life changed, filled with complicated harem problems. Will he be able to overcome the problem? and what kind of harem troubles will he face?

title: To Be Winner
description: Xiao He, a handsome medical student offline, and both a powerful and popular player online, beats the most wanted criminal on the server- the notorious female bandit, [Tao Zhi Yao Yao]. Unexpectedly, this much disdained bandit turns out to be the former first female e-sports player, [Wei Sheng Xin Yue]! Why did she change her alias? And why did she become a bandit? Offline, the two mistakenly walk past each other as strangers time and time again. What will they be like when they finally meet again on the e-sport stage?

title: Zàidù Yǔ Nǐ
description:
In senior high, Yang Mu Li and Xun An drifted apart because of a misunderstanding. Seven years after graduating, they've both returned to their alma mater as teachers: Yang Mu Li as a two-faced math teacher, and Xun An as a cool and aloof PE teacher. But it seems that Yang Mu Li… doesn't recognize Xun An?!   
   
Though many things have remained the same, the people themselves have changed. Can the feelings that once died come back once more? Meanwhile, the secrets they held during that one shared year of high school are slowly revealing themselves…  
  
—  
A webcomic by the author of Love Like Cherry Blossoms!  

---
Alt. Official English: [Inkr](https://comics.inkr.com/title/597-once-more) [Webcomic](https://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/Once-More/5f4c9f448c252b4b2221cb27)

title: O↑re↓mmusume JK ga Shou 4 Danshi Sugite Tanoshii
Cross Account
description:
Say hello to Daichi, a.k.a. Mr. Harmless. Because of his compulsive need to be liked, he never makes waves and maintains an easy going attitude. So easy going, everyone thinks he's a dud. But online he's a stud! His angry otaku online persona has garnered him thousands of followers! But real life and online life are two very different things. A lesson he's going to learn the hard way!
___
Included one-shots:
- Volume 2: [Haru yo, Koi!: Fuyu-hen, Haru-hen](https://mangadex.org/title/0de39efd-86b2-4738-85ba-95c0ab402a0e)
- Volume 3: [Gachipin.](https://mangadex.org/title/72cb65db-2d4a-4302-b5fa-6469aa852dde)
- Volume 4: [Gesu no Ongaeshi](https://mangadex.org/title/04d257a1-1e57-4f3d-934d-113b1834b2df/)

title: Nido to Jidori Okutte Yannai!
description: My childhood friend keeps asking me for a selfie to use as a reference for his drawing, what do I do?

title: Love Your Enemies
description:
Having mastered the art of lying her way through life, Yeonhee Bae has vowed to leave her past behind and make a fresh start for herself by going to college at 24. But when she runs into someone who knows a secret from her past that could completely ruin her reputation, her hopes for a perfect life suddenly start to crumble. Amidst college gossip, crushes, and jealousy, can the two set aside their differences and embrace each other for who they really are?  
  
- [Official English Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/en/romance/to-love-your-enemy/list?title_no=2114)  
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/LOVE/aishangyuanjia/list?title_no=1474)  
- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/romance/sweetenemy/list?title_no=1803)  
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/to-love-your-enemy/list?title_no=2477)

title: Umi no Misaki
description: Goto Nagi has travelled to the southern island of Okitsushima, and ventures out to see Umi no Misaki, a striking cape jutting out into the ocean. But when he arrives, he finds that there is much more to this cape than a wondrous view. There is something peculiar about the cape, and about the island's inhabitants.

title: Bless
description:
Khi còn là học sinh cấp 2, Udagawa Aia đã được tuyển chọn làm người mẫu nhưng thực tế, nguyện vọng của cậu là muốn trở thành một thợ trang điểm chuyên nghiệp. Và Sumisaki Jun, một gái trầm tính với dáng vẻ khom lưng xấu hổ vì những vết tàn nhang trên mặt, lại khao khát muốn trở thành người mẫu.
Một ngày nọ, cả hai bị buộc phải bắt cặp với nhau để tham dự cuộc thi nghệ thuật tại trường trung học Aoi. Hai con người chưa từng bộc lộ mong muốn thật sự của mình cho ai khác, cũng chưa từng dám thử đối mặt với thách thức để theo đuổi đam mê, nay lại cùng nhau tạo nên một đội đáng gờm. Cả hai đã khám phá ra được mong muốn thật sự của đối phương lẫn việc bản thân không thể chối bỏ đam mê của mình, với niềm khao khát mãnh liệt, Aia và Jun đã bùng nổ rực rỡ.

title: Kon'ya wa Tsuki ga Kirei desu ga, Toriaezu Shine -last-
description:
Kamishiro and Hanazono must face all odds, and his former allies, to save her from a fate worse than death and find a cure for the bloodlust disease, ID, which causes the infected to desire to kill their beloved.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [COMIC DAYS](https://comic-days.com/episode/13933686331610273806)

title: To Be Ordinary!
description:
Fukatsu Michitaka, a boy who just became a high school student, can't differentiate people at all because of his prosopagnosia (face blindness). However one day he runs into a girl whose face looks completely different from the rest. So in order to cure his illness and accomplish his dream of becoming "normal," he starts to get close to her.

---

 • Alternate official raws: [Kakaopage](https://page.kakao.com/home/%ED%8F%89%EB%B2%94%ED%95%B4%EC%A7%80%EA%B3%A0-%EC%8B%B6%EC%96%B4/55042409), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/want_to_be_normal), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/505023520).

title: Yomekura
description: Before she died, Taga Reiji's mother made arrangements to ensure her son would not be alone. What Taga did not know about these "arrangements" was that he would be enrolled in a special class at the school his mother founded where prospective fiance candidates would all vie for his hand in marriage. How will Taga's new life of constantly being surrounded by girls unfold and will he be able to choose just one?

title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War (Official Colored)
description:
As leaders of their prestigious academy’s student council, Kaguya and Miyuki are the elite of the elite! But it’s lonely at the top… Luckily for them, they’ve fallen in love! There’s just one problem—they both have too much pride to admit it. And so begins the daily scheming to get the object of their affection to confess their romantic feelings first…

Love is a war you win by losing.

title: Futarijime Romantic
description: Kumamori has always been in pursuit of the ideal romance. When she changes classes for her second year of high school, she is unexpectedly reunited with "Tajima," the partner of her first kiss. Unfortunately, he is dry and stoic when it comes to romance.... 200% heartwarming! A realistic but cute and romantic opposites-attract love story!

title: Love Me, Love Me Not
description: The story centers around Yuna and Akari who have two very different views of love: Yuna is someone who sees love as a dream and Akari is someone who is very realistic about her romance choices. Meanwhile, there are two boys, Kazuomi and Rio, who also have different views of love: Kazuomi's an airhead and doesn't understand the concept of love while Rio grabs the opportunity when confessed to as long as the girl looks cute.

title: Makoto-senpai no Mae de wa Kakko Tsukerarenai!
description:
Handsome girl x handsome girl!? A short love comedy set in an all-girls school!

Jun, a handsome girl character, is popular at the all-girls school.
To stay true to her character, she tries to live her life in a stylish and gentlemanly way, but whenever she's in trouble, the "true handsome girl", Makoto-senpai always appears...?
A short love comedy between two handsome girls!

title: Jakjeonmyeong Sunjeong
description: It’s hard dating someone who won’t give you the time of day. Su-ae Shim knows that better than anyone, having dated her indifferent boyfriend, Minu Kang, for years. She sometimes wishes she could be more like her charismatic stepsister, Ra-im, who seems to have it all. But life takes a turn for the weird when Su-ae discovers Jellypop, a sentient flip phone, in her locker. Jellypop has a lot to say about her love life, especially as Su-ae drifts further away from Minu and finds herself running into Minu’s friend, Eunhyeok. Add to the mix a growing suspicion that Minu and Ra-im might be more than friends, and Su-ae might need a miracle to navigate the ups and downs of high school romance!

title: It's Not Like I Don't Want To Love
description:
"Is Aizawa-san avoiding me?" were the words that Wataru asked to Ayano, his best friend, when he came to her for advice. But after giving him advice and seeing the 2 of them walking alongside each other, a strange feeling started to swell up inside Ayano.  
  
A story about that frustrating feeling known as "love"

title: Mao
description:
Onmyoji and Yokai? A girl's bizarre Taisho romance! When she was in the first grade of elementary school, her whole family was involved in an accident, but she is the only one who survived. In her third year of junior high school, she passes by the accident site again and is somehow transported back to the Taisho Era! The next day, Nanoka's physical abilities are awakened when she is told by Mao, a boy she met there who is an Onmyoji, "You are a demon, aren't you?"
___
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by [Elex Media](https://www.gramedia.com/products/mao-01) (2021)

title: Gou-dere Bishoujo Nagihara Sora
description:
Shouta's an otaku who's only love in the world is manga. One day, he happens to wish for one of his favorite character, Nagihara Sora, to be by his side…and so she does! But what is he to do when he finds that his gentle and weak Sora has turned out to be a violent gou-dere (an unstoppable force that does whatever she pleases for her master, out of her love for her master) who views the world as a ero-game to be conquered for his sake?

Note: the order of some chapters has been altered to match the volume release.

title: Gradually Close to the Heart
description: An accidental meeting brought the lonely Su Ye and the perfect prince Zheng Shu together which created brand new feelings. The interaction and feelings between the two were originally familiar made their heart race.

title: Onna no Sono no Hoshi
description:
The story starts when Kagawa, a student, delivers the class journal to Hoshi-sensei. As the students play word chain game "Shiritori" in the form of drawings in the remarks column of the journal, Hoshi-sensei becomes troubled...

---
- **Won the 25th Japan Media Arts Festival Social Impact Award for Manga in 2022**

title: Mekakure Danshi ga Ki ni Naru Manga
description:
A romantic comedy of Mekakure-kun and a girl who wants to be a beautician, updated on Twitter.  
  
*Mekakure (メカクレ) means to hide ones eyes with something, for example: hair fringe. (aka hentai MC)

title: Monochrome Lovers
description:
One day, suddenly, an angel came descending from the sky!?  
While heading towards his university entrance ceremony, Yuu meets an unsociable, mysterious girl. Yuu, who can't help but be curious of her — who is as free-willed as a stray cat — gradually shortens the distance between them. As various feelings mix around, their bond gets spun together, but what can be seen beyond that is…

title: Ren'ai Fushin na Reijou wa Reikoku Kishi-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai
description: One day, Countess Rosalie witnesses her lover, Hayden, cheating on her. Heartbroken, Rosalie becomes timid about love. However, she is then proposed to by the dashing future Marquis, Rufus…?! A school romance story between a love-challenged young lady and a notoriously cold knight!

title: Fukanzen de Fueisei de Fushidara
description: The story of Yugami Maiko, a girl with a fetish for teeth, and Hizumi Ryuuji, a guy who hates his teeth.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of the Petite Devil Kohai
description:
Sakuta may have cured Mai's Adolescence Syndrome in the nick of time, but now he faces a no less harrowing task-convincing her to officially date him. After managing to win that round of verbal fencing, he gets some well-deserved rest…only to wake up "yesterday," with all his progress reset. This inexplicable phenomenon seems to be centered on Tomoe Koga, and the only cure is to…pretend to be her boyfriend?!  


---

title: Aozora to Kumorizora
description:
The job is to take control of the target's body and lead them to suicide. But it's not so simple this time.  
  
**Links:**  
- [Original Story](http://vgperson.tumblr.com/post/30813169377/the-simple-job-of-driving-people-to-suicide)  
- [Rewrite the Manga is Based On](http://vgperson.tumblr.com/post/150563531430/azure-and-claude-2016-rewrite)  
- [Rewrite the Manga is Based On](https://note.mu/straightedge/n/n88e77311c759) (Raw)  
- [Series published on Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/772547/series/723) (Raw)
