title: Yancha Gal no Anjou-san (Pre-Serialization)
description:
Seto is a serious kid who leads a quiet high school life, until he starts to get teased by resident gal Anjou-san.
___
**Note:** While [the pixiv album for the Preserialization](https://www.pixiv.net/user/1016640/series/624) has 25 posts, there are only 23 Preserialization chapters because the 23rd post is [Serialization Chapter 2](https://mangadex.org/chapter/08210677-ed92-4e23-a901-5a837fe49be1) and the 24th post is [Serialization Chapter 14](https://mangadex.org/chapter/cead46cb-2915-4702-9e4c-978a1ca4df5c).

title: You Got Me, Sempai!
description: Two months after entering high school, Serina realizes that the lyrics of a love song have been written in her desk, and the writing seems to be the one of a boy. After writing down an answer, she gets approached by a senior, Mizukawa.

title: Sensei Lock-On!
description:
Enter Kadokura Kyouko, grade school teacher, 33 years old, single. She has a gentle and caring personality and loves her job. Unfortunately she is only popular with her pupils, so her prospects of ever getting married seems grim.  
  
Also enter Yamato Kazuki, university student, 20 years old, future goals = marrying Kyouko-sensei, becoming an astronaut (?). He's been in love with Kyouko-sensei ever since she became his homeroom teacher in 4th grade. Now finally an adult and having enough money to buy a ring, he decides to propose to her and she "in some way or other" agrees to become his girlfriend.  
  
But even though theoretically a couple now, their teacher-student relationship doesn't seem to have changed much. What will become of this unlikely pair?

title: Kokoro Irozuku Koi ga shitai
description:
A colorful ensemble romantic comedy from the web!

The heroines have a variety of personalities, including a "royal tsundere," "a childhood friend who comes on strong," "a natural classmate," and "a younger sister who's a bit of a jerk." A lovey-dovey ensemble drama with heroines with rich personalities and their respective partners! Please savor the sweet and sour and sad coming-of-age episodes...!

title: Hana to Hina wa Houkago
description: Hana and Hina are two high school girls working at the same character goods shop, but they are completely different from one another. Hana is petite, uncertain and shy, while Hina is tall, confident, and trendy. Yet they share a secret: their school has a strict policy against taking part-time jobs. They also discover that both of them share an irresistible attraction to things that are cute, be it the uniforms at their all-girls’ school or…each other! Just how long will Hana and Hina be able to keep their afterschool jobs, and their feelings for each other, a secret?

title: Bijutsu Tougou Kai
description:
Hachitani likes her Senpai at the Art Club, and she's slowly checking off the aspects that he likes about girls… and fittingly, indulging in rather *kinky* fantasies involving him.  
  
**[Author's Pixiv Fanbox.](https://www.pixiv.net/fanbox/creator/34426633)**

title: Princess of the Princess
description:
Heidi Nanzan dreams of meeting the perfect girl. So she comes to the girls school with one goal, to be a princess for her princess. At Choyuri Gakuen, it's girls as far as the eye can see.  
A no-boys-allowed yuri comedy!

title: Hitotsu Yane no Shita no
description: High School freshman Yuzuriha Kyuuta made a promise with his childhood friend Ririko to marry her when they grow up. Being separated from her since elementary school he now enrolls at her school, a former all girls private school for rich young ladies which has just opened its gates for male students, to meet her again. But upon meeting her, it turns out he has to live in the girls dorm and she is the dorm head!? And what's more, she doesn't seem to remember him at all! Just how will Kyuuta be able to keep his promise?

title: Jǐnguǎn Shì Xuébà Xìtǒng, dàn Xiǎosū Tóngxué de Hǎogǎndù Zài Wěnbù Tíshēng
description:
The stubborn, hyper-competitive top student Chu Xun, who has to be the best his whole life, just happens to run into Su Muqing, a genius girl who can read minds. He’s determined to become the number one student in the entire school!

It’s here! The Top Student System has arrived! Chu Xun’s learning ability is going up! Up! Up!

But… why do the system’s tasks feel so much like... dating?!

And so… Classmate Su’s affection level goes up~ up~ up~

title: Kaishin no Ichigeki!
description:
Shino Chigasaki is a high school girl who dreams of experiencing a romance likes those in shoujo manga. On the day of her high school entrance ceremony, she drops her commuter pass and the guy who picks it up bears a striking resemblance to the handsome boy in her dream…! Shino has been shot through the chest with Ichinose-kun's little gesture!? The comic version of "Kaishin no Ichigeki," a song written by Amatsuki, a popular singer.   
  
Manga adaptation of the music video of the same name by Amatsuki.  
  
**Links:**  
- [Amatsuki ver.](https://youtu.be/Q7AVA1e0qN4)  
- [Hatsune Miku ver.](https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm33546188)

title: Ii desuyo, Senpai
description:
A daily routine of relationship between Senior and Junior high school students after a kiss...

"It's okay, Senpai"

title: Liàn'ài Ràng Wǒ Yǒu le Chāonénglì
description: Art student Zhong Shenxiu encountered a problem during a sketching class. She couldn't "truly see" Xu Ke, a top student and the subject of the sketch. If she can't truly see the subject then she can't draw. Zhong Shenxiu put down her paintbrush. If she became a better student, she would be able to get closer to her, right? If she could get closer to her, then she could truly see her, right? Until the distance between them is no more--Face to face. Phew! Now I can finally see her! But! This is... Too close! Help! What Should I do?!!!

title: Dawn the Teen Witch
description:
Has anyone ever made fun of your dream?  
  
Magic is something everyone in this world desires. Dawn Hill, with absolutely no experience in magic, has been accepted to the best magic school in Wuzhou. The only problem is she's the "worst student" they've ever seen. Faced with ridicule, rejection, and contempt, can the stubborn little witch fight back?

title: I Want You to Say I'm Cool!
description: Kazuki confesses his feelings to a girl again and gets rejected yet another time. The reason? Just like all the others, she was already in love with Ren, Kazuki’s beautiful childhood friend. But things aren’t going to stay this way: “I swear I’ll get a girlfriend before you do, Ren!”

title: Yugami no Toriko
description: Delinquent Tanaka is feared by all and nicknamed the Mad Dog. He fought every day, and rumors and whispers about him filled the school halls. That is, until a gloomy-looking, ordinary girl in glasses suddenly appeared. She didn't fear him, but rather, everything she did got on Tanaka's nerves. "The way your face twists with emotion is very, very cute." The unique air about her captures and traps Tanaka in her twisted cage.

title: Tadashii Kodomo no Tsukurikata!
description:
The future where the Virus of Death shall destroy humanity awaits. In order for humans to avert that destiny, Raito is asked to travel back to the past. His mission: to make sure a normal high school freshman Tanaka Yuu makes children with his childhood friend Takane Kyouko!  
  


---

title: Puniru wa Kawaii Slime
description:
The slime he created transformed into a girl!? Kotarou, a young boy, is constantly pushed around by Puniru's freewheeling behavior. It's a fun and exciting daily life!

Won the 70th Shougakukan Manga Award.

title: Hagure Yuusha no Estetica
description: Summoned into an alternate world of Alayzard, Ousawa Akatsuki helps defeat the demon lord, brings harmony back into the world and, under the demon lord's last request, takes the demon's only daughter back into Akatsuki's own world. It turns out that being teleported into a different world is somewhat of a common occurrence back home. Those who return often come back with the power to use magic. So a worldwide organization, fearing people like Akatsuki, created Babel, a school to teach and keep tabs on the magic users. Akatsuki is able to bring the demon lord's only daughter into Babel as his sister, Ousawa Miu.

title: Tama no Gohoubi
description: Kanoko has never, ever had interactions with boys, but actually, "I want to try touching a boy (innuendo)" is her secret wish…! With that in mind, Kanoko enters high school and meets the strange genius, Tamao, whom she gradually becomes attracted to…? Delusions in full blast! Explosion of hidden desires? The story begins on a "male-relationship" beginner's love!

title: GE ~Good Ending~
description:
Utsumi is your everyday student. He is also a boy that has always had a strong sense of what is right in the world. With nothing but innocence and a mind that longs for his "significant other," Utsumi takes on one of the toughest subjects: love. With the help of the devious and mysterious Kurokawa Yuki, will Utsumi learn how to be fortunate in the game of love? Only through the ups and downs of real life, and the assistance of his friends, will Utsumi be able to take a bite out of life and learn just what love is.

- Alternative English: [Kodansha US](https://kodansha.us/series/ge-good-ending)

title: Getsuyoubi no Tawawa (Blue) (Fan Colored)
description:
Following the spirit of the origins of our popular big-breasted girls of Himura Kiseki-sensei, presenting a special Blue Edition of the weekly chapters of Yanmaga magazine's serialization "Getsuyoubi no Tawawa"!

---

Be sure to check out the published volumes released in Blue format in the Retail section, and the official English licensing by Denpa US (also in Blue)!

title: Akumu kara Mezameta Gouman Reijou wa Yarinaoshi wo Mousakuchuu
description: The Duke's daughter Farara was abandoned by the Crown Prince and was imprisoned with illness. The dream I had at that time was that my fiancé was robbed by a former friend as the president's daughter, Choko. "Who is Choko? Is my engagement ended?" Farara woke up from a nightmare and realized that she was 12 years old the day after she was engaged to the Crown Prince! I'm not sure, but I don't want to live the same life as my dream. Reflecting on her arrogant self, she decides to start over with the aim of a bright and enjoyable future. Happy fantasy to start over, where Farara (another world) and Choko (modern) struggle.

title: Karesen Joshikousei to Tokikake Ojisan
description:
Summer 1998, - me (40) and her (17) begin our youth.  
A 40-year-old businessman slips back in time to his youth! On the outside he is a young fit high school boy but inside, he is a model uncle. A nostalgic love story about a "time-traveling uncle" and a high school girl who loves his uncle-like appearance.

title: Suki koso Momo no Jouzu nare!
description:
Momoi Sango has started living at Aono Sou's home. Upon looking, anyone would think they are a beautiful girl, but in actuality, they are a boy (男の娘)... Sou's heart begins to waver as he makes sweets, competes in cosplay competitions, and with certain events occurring in the bath...

A cute and unpredictable ♂ × ♂ romantic comedy!!!
  
[Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/2960916/manga)  
[Cmoa Storefront](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/177712/vol/2/)

title: Choegang Geunyeo
description: Jin Sae-Mi is a cute girl with a small body, but she also hides a very big secret. She's the strongest girl on Earth!! Can she keep her identity a secret and confess to her crush, Si Young-Min?

title: Oni GF
description:
As children, Billy promised Kirika, an oni girl, that he would always protect her even after they got older. Ten years have passed since that promise and it looks like the roles have reversed?
___
Original comic posted by PeaCh88 on twitter.

title: Mikansei Demo Koi ga Ii
description:
Ichika started high school with a lot of expectations, but hasn't been able to make any friends because she's too shy to talk to others. One day in the school backyard, Yuuya - a known ex-delinquent, feared by all his classmates - approaches her, and for some reason invites her to go to a karaoke place with him…  
A beautiful and shy girl and an ex-delinquent, two introverted and lonely souls, make plans after school to achieve their dreams: be able to make friends!

title: Chiriko-senpai wa Tamatteiru.
description: The mysterious library committee senpai, Uzuki Chiriko, has a peculiar habit. That habit involves dragging her kohai, Makoto Matoba, into her unusual stress-relief methods. With her unpredictable and thrilling ways of releasing stress, Makoto's mind is constantly in turmoil!?

title: Toku no Takasa ga Afure Deru Ikemen Gyaru no Hanashi
Ninja Shinobu-san no Junjou
description: A slice-of-life series about a girl named Shinobu, a perfectly normal teenager and definitely not a ninja, nu-uh, no sir.

title: Tadashi Ore wa Heroine to shite
description:
After the manufacturing company of R-18 dating sims undergoes dissolution, an obsessed 30-year-old virgin visits a deserted shrine and requests to be sent to the world of their masterpiece, Kokorone Heartful.  
  
Although his wish is granted, the god mistakenly turns him into the heroine instead of the protagonist. Ordinarily the romancing choices are left to the protagonist. However, unless he completes the game as the heroine, he will be forced to remain in Kokorone Heartful as a woman forever.  
  
Will he be able to complete the game in this state?  
  
[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=880462)

title: Kimi no Kaketeru Tokomo Suki
description: Haruto, a shy high school student with poor communication skills, who faces a melancholy entrance ceremony, is stunned by a beautiful profile. The profile belongs to Rui, a girl who is also a new student, and she is missing her arm. An encounter between an awkward boy and an amputee girl marks the beginning of a new relationship. A new generation boy meets girl, who looks into the eyes of the heart.

title: Saikyou Rakudai Kizoku no Kenma Kiwameshi Antou Tan
description:
Roy Revel is a frontier aristocrat from a lethargic small country. He is known as the "fallen aristocrat" at the school, but he has a secret. 

"The patron god of the land of swords, Cloud the White Sword Saint. 
The patron god of the land of magic, the great sage Eclipse the Black."

The strongest and most admired of the two great powers is in fact Roy, who plays the role of an incompetent! In order to protect his family, Roy, the strongest nobleman who manipulates the fight against the Empire from the shadows, is interested in the beautiful girls at the academy who aspire to become sword saints and sages.

title: Hensoku-kei Quadrangle
description:
In high school, Maki Eiji was a delinquent, often skipping class and getting into fights. One girl, Chino Kotoha, was kind to him, until she was targeted by delinquents due to their apparent relationship. Suffering their attack seemed to have permanently changed her for the worse.  
  
Years later, when Eiji sees her again, he is overcome with guilt and regret. To his surprise, a mysterious scantily-clad woman suddenly appears, claiming she can send him back in time to make everything right! He takes her up on the offer, but things are not as simple as they may have seemed back then. It turns out that Kotoha had her own painful secrets in those days, and Eiji may not be the only one traveling in time to change the past!

title: Sougou Tovarisch
description: Kanna who usually enjoys being at the top of her class is outscored by one point on the first aptitude test of her high school career by the high-level kuudere/low-level dandere Yuu. Unlike Kanna, Yuu is naturally talented and couldn't care less about getting high scores, so she throws away her test immediately after after getting it. This incredibly bothers Kanna, who then in front of the class, scolds Yuu for throwing away her "symbol of how hard she worked". This gesture of kindness(??) causes Yuu to fall for Kanna. And of course, all unbeknownst to Kanna, who's all about herself anyway.

title: Baretemasuyo, Yuki-san
description: 学年一の美人とうたわれる女子生徒、夕木さんこと夕木飛鳥(ゆうきあすか)と席替えで隣の席になった美空凪砂(みそらなぎさ)。無口でミステリアスな彼女に緊張していたが、隣で眺めているうちに気づいてしまった。彼女のとある弱点に・・・！

title: “Oaite wa Ippan no Kata desu”
description:
What a super popular idol asked for was… a rental boyfriend.

Kaito, a high school student who's short on money but strong on justice, is suddenly asked by Nao—a top idol at the peak of her popularity—to become her rental boyfriend!!

At first, Kaito refuses. However, tempted by the generous payment and wanting to help protect Nao from a persistent stalker, he reluctantly accepts the job.

Little does he know, it's all part of Nao's plan. By creating the image of having a boyfriend, she hopes to tarnish her idol image and finally quit the entertainment industry!!!

Determined to help her achieve her wish, Kaito throws himself into the role of her fake boyfriend. Meanwhile, Nao, equally determined to leave the idol world behind, gradually finds herself drawn to Kaito……

From the creator of the *Rental Girlfriend* series, which has been downloaded over 300,000 times, a fake boyfriend–girlfriend romcom between a scheming idol and a ridiculously serious guy!!!!
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [n

title: Kyouryuu-chan to Kaseki-kun
description:
Rinko Shinobu may seem like a normal high school girl, but she is actually a hybrid between human and dinosaur. Although she usually stays in human form, sometimes her T-rex bits will pop out when she's distracted. The only person who knows her secret is the dinosaur nerd Kazuya Kobake, who tries his hardest to help hide her dinosaur form. But his distracting antics are drawing strange stares from their classmates and stressing him out…

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

title: Ike Loli
description: This is a love comedy about a highschool couple spending their time carefreely. The boyfriend, Tohru, has a habit of being a Lolicon/ is a Lolicon, while the girlfriend, Rumi, who has an appearance similar to a grade-schooler.

title: Yasashii Sekai no Tsukurikata
description: Yuu Tomonoga is a genius who was accepted to an American university at the young age of 13 and later accepted into the university's graduate program. Unfortunately, he loses funding for his research and decides to drop out and continue the research on his own. He travels back to Japan in hopes of getting funding, but he quickly runs out of money for daily living. Luckily, he gets a call from an old friend and accepts his offer to teach at an all-girls school.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Steeplechase-hen
description:
In July 2096, the summer event of the year for the national magic high school competition, known as the Nine Schools Competition will be held. However the rules for this Nine Schools Competition are different from previous years.  
One month before the Nine Schools Competition, significant changes in the rules and events were made which forced each of the national magic high schools to be busy up until the day of the competition.  
While Tatsuya is planning for the next Nine Schools Competition, an anonymous message is delivered. The message contains information that a new plot will occur during the Nine Schools Competition.  
While the competition is happening, Tatsuya runs through the dark forests of Fuji, in order to oppose the conspiracy of betrayal.  
The 2nd Year of the Nine Schools Competition has begun.

title: Kono Class ni Gal wa Inai (Pre-Serialization)
description:
Nanase is an honor student. She admires gals and decides to give herself a daring makeover, making for a heart-pounding high school debut. However, because she attends a preparatory school, there are no gals around, so she ends up floating alone with the delinquent Mamiya-kun...!?

A cross-purposes comedy brought to you by Shigure Tokita of *Don't Blush, Sekime-san*!

title: Don't Touch Kando-chan!
description:
*I'll die if you touch me!*

A romantic comedy about an ultra-sensitive assassin, who happens to be a schoolgirl!
___
**Alt Official Raws:** [comici](https://comici.jp/inabasiro/series/c206a74229d24/), [KADOCOMI](https://comic-walker.com/detail/KC_002716_S?episodeType=comics)

title: Senpai, Sore Hitokuchi Kudasai!
description:
A romantic comedy about a girl who's smitten with her dirt-poor senpai.  
One day, she musters the courage to ask him if they can go home together.  
Follow them on their very special kind of afterschool "dates"!

title: Falling Blue
description: Lin Ling is unfortunate in everything she does… Until the day she met Fang Wan, a kind and perfect upperclassman. She unconsciously grew attracted to her. Somewhere in the vast universe, there is always someone who is closely connected with you, and if fate allows it, you will never be alone.

title: My Stepmother Made Me Fall For Her
description: Ruan Tao, who originally wanted to dominate the entertainment world, encounters her malicious stepmother at the very beginning of her career. However, the stepmother is a great actress who dominates the world of entertainment with an iron fist. Ruan Tao can only submit and at the same time think about how to overthrow the evil stepmother's reactionary forces!As a result, she is arranged to participate in a romance reality show with her stepmother, but who is to tell her that it isn't a young love reality show with men and women courting each other? What is the plot when the stepmother holds her hand and asks with concern, fearing that she will hurt herself?

title: Otona ni Natte mo
description:
Ayano is a teacher with a steady job, a good relationship with her students and their parents, and a seemingly comfortable life - but when she runs into an attractive, charismatic woman at an old favourite bar of hers, they soon find themselves making some very rash decisions… and they may not both be being entirely honest with each other.  
  
From acclaimed mangaka Takako Shimura, a story of tangled feelings, secrets, and, frankly, just some awful human beings. You won’t want to miss this one!

title: Madowasenaide Yamori-kun
description: Mori and Yamori, who sits behind him, decide to change their image for the summer vacation. They make their summer vacation debut without any problems, but for some reason Yamori starts cross-dressing. And he keeps saying and doing flirtatious things...!? A hot topic on social media!! A comedy about the mismatched love between a handsome guy and a beautiful girl!

title: My Senpai's Voice Is Too Soft so I Tried Wearing a Hearing Aid, It Unexpectedly Made Me Go to Heaven
description:
The literature club's senpai always speaks too softly, so the kouhai tried to use a hearing aid.
  
This might continue depending on its reception on Twitter, so you better follow and retweet if you want to see more!

title: Dokuzetsu Shoujo wa Amanojaku ~Kabegoshi nara Sunao ni Sukitte Ierumon!~
description: Yukina-senpai là một cô gái cừa xinh đẹp vừa tài năng và cũng là hàng xóm của tôi. Vì lý do nào đó, cô ấy luôn độc mồm độc miệng với tôi, nhưng...tôi biết chứ. Chỉ là do cô ấy quá xấu hổ thôi, thật ra cổ cũng muốn ở cạnh tôi. Hôm nay, từ phòng bên cạnh, tôi đã nghe được- "Ehehe, mình đã được nói chuyện với Keita-kun rồi, hôm nay đúng là vui quá đi, mong là mai cũng được như vậy", tôi có thể nghe mấy lời dere của cổ.

title: Atsumori-kun no Oyome-san (←Mitei)
description: One day middle school student Nishiki, who lives in the countryside, meets high school student Atsumori, who came to visit from Tokyo. When talking with the cool Atsumori, she starts noticing her desire to leave the countryside for Tokyo. But the way to Tokyo is unexpectedly through a marriage proposal?!?

title: Handling the Demoness and Saintess
description:
After remarrying, Dad and his beautiful stepmother embarked on a honeymoon abroad, leaving Aunt Qian He, who coincidentally shared the same birth year with San Qiu, to move in. 
Expecting the start of an unabashed life at first, it never occurred to San Qiu that his aunt was a Demon-slaying Celestial Being. San Qiu himself, much coveted among Demons alike, found himself a constant target by Demons… 
Not to mention his long-lost childhood friend, Xiao You turned out to be the greatest assassin of the Banished Celestial Agency, an organisation managed by Celestial Beings. Xiao You simply could not stand the sight of Qian He, who came between her and the love of her life…

title: Koisuru Kichikujima
description: Love is absolutely forbidden! Kaworu, the "public disciplinary commissioner of justice," uses a chainsaw to purge all the men of their sins in order to protect the purity of the girls! Standing in Kaworu's way is the "boy with high femininity," Takahisa, and Kaworu's sister, Mari, the "demon public disciplinary commissioner." In this parallel world of "Freak Island" set in Santa Maria Academy, a storm of blood and love is about to... erupt!!?

title: L-DK
description: Shuusei Kugayama is the "prince" of his high school, but he always turns down confessions–including one from Aoi Nishimori's best friend. Although she initially hates him for this, when Shuusei moves in next door to Aoi, who lives alone, she starts thinking that he might not be such a bad guy after all…

title: Wandering Son
description: Shuichi Nitori is a 5th grade student who likes to bake and has always been something of a feminine boy. When he transfers to a new school, Shuichi is mistaken for his 6th grade sister on his first day. Then he ends up sitting next to Yoshino Takatsuki, a tall, boyish girl who everyone calls “Takatsuki-kun.” They both have secrets they can’t let anyone know….

title: Love-Kyo ~Kateikyoushi ga xx Sugite Benkyou Dokoro ja nai~
description: Aoi, an overly sexy tutor, appears before Hinata, a wholesome high school student! Moreover, Aoi looks exactly like the sexy actress Nanasato Sumire?! In the absence of his parents, can Hinata, who is at the mercy of Ms. Aoi, study without losing his mind?!

title: KANOIN: My Incubus (Girl)Friend
description: This is a love story between a man and an incubus.

title: A Story About a Blonde Virgin Girl Who Acquires Sexual Knowledge
description: My classmate is a clueless virgin without sexual knowledge.

title: Kimi wa Seifuku o Nuidara
description:
Kozu Ippei, a high school boy with a scary-looking face but mature (motherly) personality, runs into Yayoi, a cute but devious college girl. Misunderstandings lead to more misunderstandings, as they fall in love.

(Source: Ichijin Plus)

title: A Story About A Gyaru Behind His Seat Who Keeps Touching His Back
description: Author's participation of #漫画が読めるハッシュタグ on Twitter.

title: Shiranai Kanojo ga Dekita Hanashi
description: A romcom about a couple who have lost their memory.

title: Class de In-cha no Ore ga Jitsu wa Daininki Band no Vocal na Ken
description:
Rintsuki Suda, who attends Shirahoshi High School, is a gloomy and dull student at school. However, his real identity is Shion Nanairo – the vocalist of the band [Personia] – which is very popular among middle and high school students.

Classes always revolve around Shion, a mysterious and charismatic singer, whose eyes are always hidden by a mask. Rintsuki hides his identity and stays in the shadows during class. It’s all about not disturbing his family and his beloved sister!

Surrounded by his classmates who are his enthusiastic fans, he would break into a cold sweat while…..

title: Yandere-chan x Negative-chan
description: Collection of one/two-pagers from the author's Twitter featuring specific characters

title: Ore Seijo  ~Ore ga Seijo de Omae Akuyaku Reijou Saikyou Tag Otome Game Kanzen Kouryaku Itashimasu wa~
description:
Saintess Militia regained her memories on a trip to the ladies' room! 
My name is Tosaka Kakeru—a high school boy, and, more importantly, I no longer have a certain vital something between my legs!! I had been reincarnated into the world of an otome game!!! What's more, my best friend Mori Fuuma, who had been hit by the same truck as me, had been reborn as Bellrose, a villainess practically drowning in death flags!!!! A Saintess-and-Villainess tag team (with two high school boys inside) sets out to completely conquer the game while romancing a cast of handsome men, and aiming for the one ending where they both survive!

title: Bout na Kanojo
description: Nitta, a baseball boy in his first year of high school, has a crush on the strongest girl on campus who belongs to the wrestling club! Whether or not he will be turned on depends on the bout! A fresh, 1000% adolescent romantic comedy by a promising supernova!

title: Sensei Lock-On! 2nd
description: Continuation of the awkward yet cute relationship between Kadokura Kyouko and her former student Yamato Kazuki.

title: Geboku-san to Aruji-chan no Nichijou ~Aruji no Tame nara Nandemo shimasu~
description:
A sweet master-servant yuri comedy about an innocent master and a mad dog high school girl!
Satsuki, a small and innocent high school girl, and her servant named "Sato-san'' who is the strongest delinquent in the school...

title: My Bad Boyfriend
description: What happens when the scariest kid in school asks you out on a date? YuGeong struggles to survive what may just be the worst day of her life.

title: Watashi ga Iutoori ni Naru
description: In order to save her stupid and athletic crush from getting into a college that she thinks is a scam, Mei decides to apply for it herself. But here is where things get tricky: it is a magic school.

title: Suteki na Kareshi
description:
[from lost-translations]  
  
“I want a boyfriend!”  
  
Kozakura Nonoka always fancied having a boyfriend. Upon entering high school, she was certain that she was finally going to get one, but fast-forwarding eight months to December, she was still single as ever. Desperate, she attended a goukon (a group blind date) where she met Kiriyama Naoya, whose first words to her was “You’ll never get a boyfriend.”  
  
Now, what would this strange meet-up lead to?

---
- **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for Shojo in 2018**

title: S Watari-san to M Mura-kun
description: Intelligent and beautiful female high schooler Reika Sawatari and handsome and astute male high schooler Subaru Emura, both of whom with a certain fetish that nobody knows, have started their relationship after a certain event.

title: Mushi no Kanojo to
description:
Koutarou Mushino, a boy who hates insects, is interested in his childhood friend Kaede Emukae. However, there is a single drawback, and that is... she has a centipede body!

Between love and fear of insects, their hearts won't stop pounding in the popular artist Plan's first serialized love comedy!

NOTE: This a short-term serialization, and it'll be turned into a full-fledged one if it's well recieved. To that end, please click the raw link and check all chapters' pages.

title: Kono Koi wa Kore Ijou Kirei ni Naranai
description:
Apparently I have germophobia. Maybe because of that girls in my class hate me. One day, they threw me into Yukimura house, a place well-known in the neighbourhood as some hoarder's garbage dump . There I had a fateful encounter with a boy, who's also a hitman.  
  
 ~ Love story of germophobic girl that bloomed in the garbage house ~

title: Unbreakable Machine-Doll
description:
During the early 20th century, along with technological advancements, scientists were able to develop sophisticated magic. The combination of science and sorcery was Makinot, circuits made from spells that were put into objects to bring them to life and even gain a personality. It was developed as a military weapon and has now spread throughout the world.   
  
Akabane Raishin is now attending the Royal Academy to become the best in the world. Accompanied by the lovely teenage girl Yaya, who is actually Raishin’s puppet weapon, he plans on rocketing to the top of the class. However, his test scores come nearly dead last although his combat skills and determination are second to none. Raishin has to compete with the most deadliest of classmates if he wants to come out as the king.

title: Kounai Ren'ai
description: This school is full of relationships, with students and teachers each with their own secrets. (Source: U-NEXT, translated)

title: Asa made Jugyou Chu!
description:
Kagami Yuuki has managed to become a scholarship student in a high-class high school. Unfortunately, thanks to his gender-ambiguous name, the teacher Kakinozaki Ayana has registered him as a girl! It's apparently an uncorrectable mistake, so now Yuuki must live in the girl's dormitory of his new (co-ed) high school.  
  
At least Ayana's willing to take responsibility for her mistake; she volunteers to be his roommate. As one would guess, he and Ayana must make sure none of the other girls in the dorm find out he's actually a boy. Therefore, except for when he's in his classes, Yuuki has to cross-dress, or else both he and his teacher will be kicked out of the school and dorm!  
  
Link:  
[AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=13946) (OAV)

title: Mushihime
description: Takasago Ryōichi, một nam sinh cấp III, thường hay có một giấc mơ kỳ lạ về việc bị một nữ quỷ tấn công. Một ngày nọ, cậu bắt gặp một thiếu nữ vô cùng xinh đẹp, song cô gái ấy lại giống hệt nữ quỷ xuất hiện trong giấc mơ của cậu. Liệu đó có phải là một sự trùng hợp…??

title: Ichizu Bitch-chan
description: A story about a flirty kouhai seducing her senpai.

title: Yuki to Sumi
description:
Yukino Tachibana is a calligraphy prodigy.  
At the tender age of 16, she is already one of Japan's most exciting young artists, performing live calligraphy demonstrations to sell-out crowds on worldwide tours.  
With her refined, beautiful, and mysterious air, she is so popular at her new high school that she has earned the appellation of 'The School Madonna'.   
  
She is also as dumb as a post.  
  
As artful her brushstrokes, as demure her outward demeanor, the real Yukino Tachibana is far-removed from the image her classmates see on television and in the school hallways - in reality, apart from her calligraphy genius, Yukino is completely useless, rude, and possessing of a distinctly inflated sense of self-worth.  
There is only one classmate who fails to be fooled by her facade: run-of-the-mill protagonist du jour Tarou Nakamura. Sitting next to her in class, Nakamura doesn't really get why the rest of the school finds her so enthralling - he's much more interested in his crush,

title: Karakuri Circus
description:
Katou Narumi (19) suffers from Zonapha Syndrome, a rare ailment that stops his breathing unless he makes people laugh. He's been forced to abandon his training in Chinese kenpo and return to Japan, where he now works as a clown. The only problem: he's not very funny.  
  
One day he meets Saiga Masaru (11), the recent inheritor of a huge fortune, who gives him the first laugh he's gotten all day. When he realizes Masaru is being pursued by assassins, he steps in to protect the boy, only to discover that instead of conventional weapons, the assassins wield huge, eerie puppets. They soon encounter the mysterious Shirogane (age unknown), who controls a puppet of her own, and claims she was sent from France by Masaru's late grandfather to protect him.  
  
Their paths intertwine and diverge, splitting into two stories: Karakuri and Circus, puppets and performers, tears and laughter. The strange circus of living dolls that spreads Zonapha Syndrome, the human puppets known collectively as th

title: Daybreaking Romance
description:
Blacked out from drinking, just what happened with his crush during that time…?!  
  
Dong Saebyeok, a scary-looking but softhearted guy who falls for his cool-headed junior, Seo Gwangchae.  
Watch their cute campus romance unfold because no matter how bad the day is, the sun always rises!

title: Urusei Yatsura
description:
Ataru Moroboshi is the unluckiest man alive... and the most lecherous. In a race deciding whether alien oni will take over the Earth, he ends up representing Earth. His opponent? Lum, an oni girl! Despite the weight of the world on his shoulders, Ataru's stupidity (and lechery) get the better of him, and before he knows it, he and Lum are now married! On top of that, Ataru's unluckiness attracts all sorts of hijinks, chaos, and mayhem. Petty rivalries, exorcisms, period dramas, swim meets... Will it ever end?

---
  
- **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen/Shojo in 1981**
- **Won the 18th Seiun Award for Best Comic in 1987**

title: Pastel Love
description: "Millie" (golden haired), the perfect little girl whose life is fully equipped with everything, but because of her timeless mother, Millie has become an indifferent day-to-day person until she meets "Zen" (black-headed), an ordinary little girl whose life focussed on only studying, without Zen knowing that she herself was stirring up Millie's heart to beat again.

title: 17-sai Kara Yarinaosu Propose
description:
*“I wish I had liked you when I was a high school student …”*
Osamu’s girlfriend refused his proposal with these mysterious words. After that, in an accident, he time-leaps back to his high school days. 
He was trying to find her and make her fall in love with him again, but when he met her she had a twin sister…! ??

title: Higawari Wig no Katsura-san
description: The classmate you’re interested in is a slightly strange girl who wears a different wig every day to school!?

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Yokohama Souran-hen
description:
The Nine Schools Competition is over. Now it's time for the Annual Thesis Competition in Yokohama. If the Nine Schools competition was to show off their skills and power, the Thesis competition is a chance for students to show off their knowledge and ingenuity. But it seems this competition is being viewed by an unsavoury group as well. Will Tatsuya come out on top again?  
  
Adaptation of the original novel's volumes 6-7.

title: Kuroi-san After School
description:
Kuroi-san’s always doing something all by herself after class. And even though she makes sure no one bothers her, one day, a certain person happens to find out what it is she’s up to… and next thing he knows, he’s declared her accomplice?!
A short oneshot about two teenagers enjoying their hobby together.

title: Houkago, Koishita.
description:
Hayama Kao yearns for an existence that would make people notice her. Even in her final year of middle school when she confessed to the boy she liked for three years, he couldn't even recall her name.  
  
Now in high school, she is working as a temporary manager of her school's boys volleyball club against her will. Kao's older brother, an alumnus, currently a teacher and the advisor of the club, placed the responsibility on her shoulders to recruit Kuze Nagisa for the volleyball club if she wanted to quit being the manager.  
  
Even though silently observing someone as dazzling as Kiryuu in the club is the only redeeming thing about being the manger, Kao's body aches. She is at her limit and wants to quit being the manager. But no matter how much effort she puts on recruiting Kuze she simply cannot convince him to join. Then one day, she notices something that took her breath away. It was bluer than the sky, even bluer than the sea; it was Kuze Nagisa practicing volleyball all on hi

title: Otome Game Youchien wa Mobu ni Kibishii Youchien desu
description: Spin-off Comic from "The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs" Starts! A kindergartener mob life comedy! Even when they're tiny, they're still female chauvinists!

title: Shuui no Image to Gap no Aru Futari
description: This is a web manga that was made by @creamiyabi_0303

title: Kami-sama Drop
description:
17 year old Nowaki Asunaro has been forsaken by fortune since his birth. Every step he takes, bad luck awaits, whether it takes the shape of a falling bucket of water on his head or being blamed for crimes he never committed. Even for an exceptionally unlucky fellow like him, he still hopes to become friends with the love of his life: Hashihime Banri. The only problem lies in the fact that every time he almost gets close to her, his lack of luck blocks the way.  
On one typical day for him, filled with unfortunate accidents, he ends up having to protect himself from the rain in a forsaken and dilapidated temple. He becomes feverish from cold and hunger, but in desperation, he prays to the gods that he survive this day and become friends with Banri. Lo and behold, it seems like he accidentally summoned a God(?). Will this accident bring him the luck he never had?  
From the author of the hit romantic comedy, Asu no Yoichi! (Samurai Harem) comes a new supernatural love comedy of epic pro

title: Kokoro no Program
description: An elementary schooler, Usami Kyuu encounters Ichiko, a female robot trying to learn about [heart]. What awaits the two that start to live together... Boy X Robot Girl, Begin!

title: Unbalance X Unbalance
description:
A young man finds and returns a lost wallet and cell phone to a beautiful young lady, thus begins the destined relationship between two strangers. Sound typical? Well then, how about making the young lady the young man's future homeroom teacher, and give them both a twisted sense of right and wrong. And just for kicks, lets have the young man help himself to a self proclaimed reward from the lost wallet before returning it but of course, this scenario wouldn't be complete unless the young lady was very unforgiving when it came to teaching one of her students a lesson on morals.   
  
Note: Volume 1-9 KMTS releases read from Left to Right.  
Note: Volume 10 A-Team releases from the Japanese version, so please read from Right to Left.

title: Prunus Girl
description: Maki-kun goes to look at the results of his high school entrance exam results and meets a beautiful girl. Could this be a fated encounter? He's thrilled to find out that the same girl, Aikawa Kizuna, not only ends up going to his school, but is in his class. However, he's not so thrilled when he find out that Aikawa isn't a girl! Not a girl, and not really a guy, kind of both— and Maki finds himself getting along with popular Aikawa, getting pulled in to his pace!

title: Torao-kun no Suki na Hito
description:
A boy who knows nothing about love receives a love consultation.
___
**Notes:**
- As a oneshot, *Torao-kun's Love Consultation* (now Chapter 1) won an Encouragement Award from the January 2021 New Generation Sunday Awards. ([Shounen Sunday](https://websunday.net/8841/))
- MangaDex's chapter numbering follows the pixiv series's index numbering.

title: Haru Matsu Bokura
description:
Mitsuki had always dream of breaking out of her shell and finding true friends as she enters high school. However, she suddenly encounters a group of four good-looking guys from the basketball team, guiding her life into an unexpected direction…?  
  
**Note:** Vol. 14 contains 2 "half-time collection" chapters and 3 "extra period" chapters. The last chapter (56) is in 13th volume in original Japanese edition. If your last chapter's vol number cannot match, you cannot get "end" tag next to chapter on MD. Please stop changing the info and confusing the readers.

title: Arifureta Gakuen de Sekai Saikyou
description:
A comedy spin-off based around the characters of the main series.  
The series is based on the Bonus Short-Story "Arifureta Magic Academy" which was released along with the Light Novel volumes as Store Exclusives.

Special student Hajime Nagumo enters the largest magic school of Tortus to meet new friends, enemies and fall in love with the most powerful vampire in this world, Yue.

title: Kono Manga no Heroine wa Morisaki Amane desu.
description: Amane Morisaki is eager to take care of her younger childhood friend Kyousuke Aizumi, as they both enroll at the same university. But Kyousuke wants to become a mangaka and asks Amane to be the model for the heroine of his manga.

title: Dear Future You
description:
What if you could see your future boyfriend that you didn't even know of..?   
The school romance of a girl who can see the future.

title: My Delightful Boyfriend
description: A muscular youth who grew up in a rural environment has finally found his springtime high school life, and it turns out his romantic partner is the most popular girl of first year?! But, the truth isn't as straightforward as the muscular youth believes it as…

title: Fureru to Kikoeru
description:
"If I touch you, I can hear your thoughts."

This is the supernatural ability of transfer student Satori Osanaga, but to her, it's more of a curse than a blessing. Because of this power, her deepest desire is to avoid being touched by anyone. Unfortunately, while praying to be left alone at a local shrine, her hopes are quickly dashed; noticing her standing exposed in the rain as he is passing by, classmate Sou Izumisawa hands her an umbrella to take shelter in.

At school, Satori's strange attire and personality quickly ostracizes her from the rest of her classmates, but despite that, Sou treats her kindly, and she quickly falls in love with him. However, this has a devastating consequence for Sou, for Satori's painful power manifests within him. While listening to the inner voices of passersby becomes draining, the most painful thought he hears is that of his crush Mio Yuikawa, whom he discovers is in love with his close friend Takumi Shirase.

Distraught by this discovery, he quickl

title: Todo no Tsumari no Uchouten
description: Nekozaki Ren abused her powers as school council secretary to secretly set up a Miko Club in her school’s abandoned shrine. All of this so she could spend time with her crush, Yamada Mikoto, after school. But this wasn’t meant to last. Before long some people caught wind of their little club site, and with the school’s club building fully occupied, they saw themselves fit to use the shrine for their own club activities instead! Will Ren be able to reclaim her paradise?

title: Misanthrope na Kanojo
description:
Hanami Matsudai is awkward when it comes to love and she doesn't know the proper distance for human relationships. You might as well call her a misanthrope. Her peaceful life is disturbed when she meets the unpredictable Ran Ojiya who just won't leave her alone!  
  
The slapstick love comedy of an aloof and love-hating loner girl and a love-crazed handsome stalker begins!

title: Akkun to Kanojo
description:
The romantic comedy follows the everyday life of an extremely tsundere (initially aloof and abrasive, but later kind-hearted) boy named Atsuhiro "Akkun" Kagari and his girlfriend Non "Nontan" Katagiri. Akkun's behavior is harsh towards Nontan with verbal abuse and neglect, but he actually is head-over-heels for her and habitually acts like a stalker by tailing her or eavesdropping. Nontan is oblivious to Akkun's stalker ways, and thinks his actions are cute.  
  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=20553) for information about the anime.

title: The Best Smell
description:
Choi Kanggo was born with a sensitive nose that can smell through a person's feelings. But when a boy who likes him approaches..?!  
  
- [Original Webtoon (Naver)](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=5406761)  
- [Original Webtoon (kakao)](https://page.kakao.com/home/55508225)  
- [Official French Translation](https://delitoon.com/webtoon/le-parfum-de-tes-sentiments)

title: Daigaku Nyuugakuji Kara Uwasa Sareteita Bishoujo San Shimai, Ikiwakareteita Gimai Datta.
description: The three sisters, once clingy and needy as children, have now grown into beautiful young women—and for some reason, they've developed a strong possessive streak!

title: Ouji ga Watashi o Akiramenai!
description: Once upon a time there was a wonderful prince… A super rich and handsome prince with a genius IQ of 500, extraordinary physical prowess… An outrageously overpowered super star…!! What will happen when this ridiculously overpowered ultra-high spec boy and a certain ultra-level-headed ordinary girl meet…?!

title: Imori 201
description: In both middle school and high school, Kawashima hadn't had any luck with girls, but today he's had a miracle encounter! In the apartment building he moved to, there was a high school girl living right next to him and in addition to that, she's living alone! This situation that any man will admire has Kawashima hyped up! However, there was also something odd about it: She likes to drink beer. What is her identity? It's a slightly ecchi high school girl comedy!

title: Sayuri-san no Imouto wa Tenshi
description: Sayuri's parents divorced when she was young, her father took custody of her little sister, Mikoto, and she lived with her mother. Not having seen her little sister in thirteen years, Sayuri visits the park they played at as children and finds Mikoto there. Mikoto is a pretty girl, but why does she have wings?

title: Kimi ni wa Todokanai
description: Yamato and Kakeru are childhood friends. While Yamato gets good grades and is good looking, Kakeru's grade are below average and his appearance is pretty plain. Even though they are childhood friends, Yamato is in a higher level than Kakeru, and Kakeru thinks of Yamato as a "good guy." One day they are alone in their classroom and Kakeru asks Yamato, "Do you like someone?" to which Yamato murmurs "Kakeru."

title: Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi ga Shuraba Sugiru
description:
Eita, after entering high school, is aiming for the National University School of Medicine. His parents' divorce and his goal became the reason that he shuns anything to do with romance or love. One day the school beauty Masuzu with the silver hair who just returned to the country entered his life in the most unexpected way. His childhood friend since elementary school, Chiwa will not let this go without a fight.  
  
Adapted from the light novel series of the same name.

title: Houkago no Cinderella-kun
description:
It's a romantic comedy about the overbearing love between a popular, outgoing boy and a girl who is actually a cross-dressing boy!

---
**Notes:**
- Serialized as [Inaho-kun wa Nise Kanojo no Hazu na no ni](https://mangadex.org/title/52e2bba3-1948-4e65-a282-a73a0b036005/inaho-kun-wa-nise-kanojo-no-hazu-na-no-ni).

title: Dare ni mo Ienai Futarigoto
description: The story of best friends Haruno and Chikaki who discover their feelings for each other may not be the simple, enduring friendship they assumed it to be.

title: Shinigami-sama to 4-nin no Kanojo
description:
Minaguchi Kaoru is nothing special. He's no good at sports or school, isn't in any clubs, and he's not popular. He has no friends and isn't even interested in any of the girls he knows. He's also teased due to the fact that he loves shoujo manga. Unlike the harem daydreams of his peers, he dreams of finding his true love. Unfortunately, a shinigami comes to kill him, simply because he's a "forever alone" sort of guy. When he gasps out his intention of embracing life with his final breaths, though, she takes it back! As long as he follows through on his intentions, he won't be killed.  
  
To convince the shinigami that his plans are genuine, he declares that he will confess to the girl he likes, the very next day. Expecting failure with confessing to random girls in his school, he sends out love letters to four different girls. To his surprise, they all agree to be his girlfriend. Now, this shoujo-manga-loving guy has ended up in a kind of harem story, quadruple-timing four girls! Will

title: Oppai Misete
description:
A story about a boy who doesn't want to see the girl who wants to see his boobs.
___
**Defunct Raws:**
- [Jump Rookie! Page](https://rookie.shonenjump.com/series/X1vJnKYbtvs)
- [Twitter Moment](https://twitter.com/i/moments/1274764273340657666)

title: Kimi ni Somaru Monochrome
description: Hajime Haibara is a boy whose first love has faded away. A mysterious senior student, Bikyu, appears in front of him and invites him into a "new world." Hajime falls in love with Bikyu while being pushed around by her!

title: Gokusen
description:
Fresh out of college, Kumiko "Yankumi" Yamaguchi becomes a math teacher at an all-boys high school. 
Unfortunately for her, she's assigned by the school board as the homeroom teacher for 3-D, a class of delinquent students. 
When the class attempts to make a living hell out of Yankumi's career, they fail as her persistence and aggression gain her respect. 
However, little does anyone in the school know that Yankumi is actually heir to the Kuroda Ikka—one of Tokyo's most powerful yakuza clans.  
  
(Source: ANN)  
  


---

title: Fushigi no Kuni no Arisugawa-san
description: The innocent and naive Arisugawa Suzu has maintained a quiet life as a student in high school. While all the girls around her begin to feel curious about boys, she remains disinterested. Until one day on the train to school, after a short delay, she ends up being saved by the handsome Sousuke Nomiya, whom, to the surprise of Arisugawa, does not seem to be like other boys his age…

title: 100-nichigo ni Classmate no Seiheki o Kuruwaseru, Otoko no Ko Tenkousei ♡
Sekai no Owari to Majo no Koi
description:
Once upon a time, witches and humans lived in harmony. However, when human society was at its lowest point, the humans blamed the witches for their misfortunes and decided to burn them at the stake. For the sake of survival, the remaining witch population allied with those who desire to take advantage of their powers.

Centuries later, after the general public had forgotten about the existence of witches, a school named Sternenlichtl was built to house and teach young witches. There, Alice Keating is a renowned witch with budding potential—having already mastered most types of magic. When new student Mari Muguruma, who has no experience with witches and magic, is transferred to the school, Alice is given the task of educating her on everything she needs to know.

Having shown no aptitude towards anything she is taught, Alice struggles to see any worth in Mari. Yet, following an emotional outburst, Mari subconsciously uses her magic on something that requires a vast amount of skill: res

title: Gyaru Who Becomes Menhera (Emotionally Clingy) After 5 Minutes
Dance Dance Danseur
description: Junpei is happily snoozing away during his sister's ballet recital when a male ballet dancer steps onto the stage. Moved by the strength and skills the dancer displays, the boy discovers his love for this art. But after a certain tragedy happens, he vows to leave his past behind and turn into the epitome of manliness. What will he do when his love for ballet reignites?!

title: More Puzzling Than A Riddle
description:
What you need is "inspiration"! This is the beginning of a youthful riddle-solving comedy! 

Saki Junino, a student at Meichi Academy, has the looks, smarts, and athletic skill to be the best girl at Myochi Gakuen, but she also has an unusual fondness for riddles. Eita Ichinose is recruited by Saki to become a member of her riddle-solving club, and he has to figure out her brain-teasers every day after school! Wanting to spend time after-school with the beautiful senior, Eita will solve her riddles again and again... No knowledge or calculation required! You can try it for yourself!

title: Sunao Ni Narenai Aizen-san
description: Even though she likes Goto-kun, she's too embarrassed to be honest.

title: Onee-chan ga Kita
description: The story revolves around Tomoya Mizuhara, a 13-year-old boy who suddenly gains a big sister when his father remarries. 17-year-old Ichika is a little strange, and her affection for Tomoya is rather overwhelming, if not scary. On top of things, Ichika's friend Ruri is the ultimate sadist. Then there is Ichika's big-breasted quarter-Russian friend Marina.

title: Shikabane Shoujo to Ai ga Omoi Sei-kishi no Toubatsu Gakuen Life
description:
In a world where humans and fantastical creatures coexist. Shurika, a zombie, enters a boarding school where she learns to battle the "kyoujuu," creatures that threaten both races. There, for three years, the students live in pairs with members of the other race. Shurika is paired with Marie, a paladin with whom she has a certain affinity. But for some reason, Marie's affections for her is strangely overbearing...? 

Serialization began in August 2023 in Yuri Hime.

title: Frank na Ko wo Enjite Sukina Hito ni Chikazukou to Suru Hanashi
description:
Biting more than she can chew, Tasaki-chan approaches her crush Kirishima-kun with confidence brought from out of nowhere.  
  
This takes a heavy toll on her… but Kirishima-kun is no dummy an certainly not made of iron!

title: Liar Liar
description: At Academy Island, everything is settled through "Games" waged for a certain number of stars, with the strongest student being granted the ranking of Seven Stars. Hiroto, a transfer student, unexpectedly beats the strongest empress and becomes the pseudo-strongest in the school! A mind game of lies and bluffs begins!

title: Watashi no Tomodachi ga Sekaiichi Kawaii
description: Saionji Koharu is an admirable student council president. A beautiful and flouncy lady that happens to always be followed around by a girl named Maria.

title: Marked by King Bs
description:
One day, Kim Yeondoo, an ordinary high school girl, is suddenly terrorized by her former friend from middle school and stalker in KakaoTalk. In order to stop this, she changes her profile picture to a picture of a random guy and posts him as her boyfriend. But, it turns out that the picture she used is the school's scariest bully, Ji Hyunho?!  
  
As it turns out, the bullies are the tsundere, Ji Hyunho, the smart and cool class president, Seo Juho, and the young man living upstairs of her home, Kang Ahun. Not only that, there's also the My Way baseball boy, Choi Seunghyun, and the pure and lively, Jung Jisung.  
  
How did she end up getting entangled with the handsome bullies?

title: Bocchi na Bokura no Renai Jijou
description: When summer break ended, high schooler Ichijou Hajime found out that everyone in his class but him has gotten a girlfriend or a boyfriend! Hajime suddenly finds himself as a "loner", but then Ninomiya Chitose transfers into his class…

title: Hajimete Koibito ga Dekimashita
description: The times in a new relationship where both are each other's first significant other, and every action and every word feel like a leap to the moon and back.

title: Ore no Mental wa Genkai desu
description: Manaka, a high school student boy who's secretly an otaku, is sitting behind his friend drawing digital manga. A girl from the class who usually never speaks to him, approaches him and asks him if she can borrow his laptop, which contains sensitive data… and from that event, starts out an unfortunate love-comedy story. Which is the reason why the main character's mind is on the brink of breaking almost every day.

title: Miss Time
description:
Gold Miss* Lee Gaon made a successful career as a personal trainer and is in a rival-like relationship against the famous romance novelist, Jiho, famous for his notorious badmouthing.  
  
Gaon went to her frenemy Sera's wedding ceremony and somehow ended up helping her escape. And her groom? It was Jiho, the man who slung towards her mouthfuls of criticisms and insults one after another.  
  
They realize they were from the same highschool class…  
  
While Jiho was on his way to meet Gaon, the two were transported twelve years into the past…  
  
"That soft boy was that badass delinquent in highschool?! And he liked me as well?!  
  
**Gold Miss in South Korea is an unmarried woman with high socioeconomic status and level of education.*  
  
Raw: [Naver](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=5014489), [Kakao](https://page.kakao.com/home/56142110), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/miss_time), [Yes24](http://www.yes24.com/Product/Goods/93171916), [Bomtoon](https:/

title: 3D Girlfriend - Real Girl
description:
Tsutsui Hikari is an otaku, and he mostly avoids social life. Hikari has only one friend at school, who is also a social misfit, and he is mocked brutally by most of his classmates for being creepy and weird. One day, he ends up having to clean the school pool with Igarashi Iroha, who appears to be pretty much everything he hates in real-life girls. She skips school, has a blunt manner, doesn't have female friends, and seems the sort to be promiscuous. However, she is friendly to Hikari, and even stands up to the people who make fun of him. Hikari's bitterness and trust issues lead him to say pretty harsh things to Iroha, but she never dismisses him as creepy. After a while, it starts to look like Iroha may become his first real-life, 3D girlfriend! Will he be able to handle it?  

[Alternate English](https://comics.inkr.com/title/797-real-girl?utm_source=mgd) 
[Alternate English 2](https://www.azuki.co/series/real-girl)
  
The following are links to AnimeNewsNetwork for the anime and

title: Bunny and Her Boys
description:
"I don't care about a guy's appearance in the slightest."   
  
Bunny, as a freshman in university, experiences the worst first relationship of her life. Handsome guys were a no to her before,  
but when she finally decides to accept her natural instinct of liking handsome men, 5 of them appear in her life!  
  
But the question is who will turn out to be a shitty car and who will turn out to be a Mercedes-benz? Tune in to find out!

title: Haru to Natsu
description: Makoto meets a sweet, shy girl named Haruna helping out at the school's athletics festival. He confesses his feelings for her the next time he sees her, and she bluntly rejects him, only to call him later and ask him out herself! The source of all these mixed signals is Haruna's "evil" twin sister, Natsumi. Natsumi is the opposite of Haruna, she's a forward, crude girl bent on trolling the hell out of her twin sister. Makoto is then stuck in the shenanigans between the two sisters, especially when Haruna shows that she's not one to be trifled with.

title: Haru x Kiyo
description:
Although Koharu is a little taller than the average person, she's a 15 year old girl who lives a much simpler life than the average person. Having no experience with love, she thought she'd spend her days peacefully with her group of ordinary friends. However, a destined encounter will change Koharu…!!  
  
* Volume 3 contains the side story "Kota x Haru" (コタ×ハル).
* Volume 5 contains the side story "Kota x Haru: Hatsukoi High Jumper" (コタ×ハル～初恋ハイジャンパー～).

title: Hitoribocchi no Chikyuu Shinryaku
description: Koichi has looked forward to becoming a high schooler for one reason: to help continue his grandfather's coffee shop. But on the first day of school, a strange girl wearing an eerie mask tells him that she has come to take his life. She tells him that the heart beating within his chest is her own, and that she is an alien invader who has come to take over the world.

title: Sugiyuki Kako to Mitai Asu
description:
High school student Asakura Asaki finds himself trapped in a time loop, reliving the same day again and again. Just when the repetition starts to feel unbearable, he meets Sugiyuki Kako, a mysterious girl whose strange behavior reveals that she, too, is aware of the loop.

Desperate to escape, Asaki asks Kako for help, but for reasons she won’t explain, she refuses to break free. As the days repeat, Asaki tries every possible way to spark her interest and change her mind.

title: Queen's Academy
description:
Fumihiro, a high school student whose only merit is his cooking skills, has transferred to the humorous, elegant, and tea-scented Daiei Teikoku Academy.

Fumihiro ends up having a run-in with Charlotte, the student council president and queen of the school. She decided to have Fumihiro join the student council as an exclusive cook to change the lousy quality of school food.

However, within the council, there are spies, pirates, witches, knights, great detectives... a group of beautiful girls with super strong personalities! The Reiwa era's "national character" comedy opens here!

title: Tenraku Akuma! Demon's Core
description: An exorcist has just finished defeating a demon, when one comes falling out of the ceiling. However, she's nothing like the sexy, dangerous demon he had just faced. She has no horns, she's in ragged clothes, she's starving, and despite the fact that she claims she's here for his soul, it's clear that she's little threat. Instead of killing the demon, the exorcist is moved by pity to buy her some food. Now she's determined to tag along with him, eager to do anything she can to be useful!

title: Orange
description: The spring she turns sixteen, Takamiya Naho receives a strange, but detailed letter from herself, ten years in the future. At first she thinks the letter is a prank, but then the things written in the letter actually happen, including the arrival of the new transfer student who sits next to her in class, Naruse Kakeru. The letter reads just like her diary entries, down to the same characters. It is not until two weeks later, when Kakeru shows back up at school, that Naho finishes the letter. In the letter, her twenty-seven year old self tells her sixteen-year old self that her biggest regret is that Kakeru is no longer with them in the future, and asks her to watch him closely.

title: Akuyaku Reijou tte no wa Kou Yaru no yo
description:
The moment she awakens, Lady Cassandra Wendel realizes she has been reincarnated as the villainess from "The Tale of the Saint of Light's Salvation," a book she read in her previous life. If things continue as they are, she is destined to be condemned by the summoned saint and the men who flock to her. The villainess, who rose to power through wicked means in her previous life, decides to defy the script and condemn them.

"I'll show you what a true villain is!"

title: Sensei ni wa Mada Iwanai
description:
Iijima Otoha has a one-sided crush on her female PE teacher. Everyday after school she heads straight to the PE teacher’s office where she was promised they could spend time together. Starting at 4 o’clock, for one hour, she’s able to be all alone with her. The more time Otoha spends with her teacher the more her feelings for her grow. But, she won’t yet tell her about those feelings. This uncertain yet pure love story between two girls is now available in book form!  
  
![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png)Author's Twitter: <https://twitter.com/m_tenco29Q>

title: Classmate, Kamimura Yuuka wa Kou Itta
description: Shirasaki is incredibly bored by his unchanging daily school life and he ends up falling in love with his weird classmate Kamimura Yuuka, who rants about changing the world to his uninterested classmates. However, when she reveals the truth about the nature of their world to him, everything will quickly become stranger than he would ever have expected!

title: Futago Saien
description: Yuuya starts his dream of living alone. Then Sera, a famous beautiful girl at school and his self-proclaimed ex-girlfriend, and her younger sister Rise rush in. In order for the three of them to be self-sufficient, an exciting life together begins where they grow vegetables in their home garden and eat delicious food!

title: It Is My First Love
description: What do you do when your new boss is someone from your past? Someone you want to avoid? Will Jung Eunjae be able to resolve the misunderstanding with Lee Moonyoung, or will she run away again? A story about love, drama, and forgiveness.

title: A Story of a Senpai, Who Is Proud of Her Swimsuit Because She Thinks It Looks Cool
description:
A cute story about a senpai and a kōhai…  
and much more

title: The Two-Faced Transfer Student
description:
Batman would marry two face in this universe.  
  
(Double the waifu, double the fun)

title: Wolf Girl and Black Prince
description:
Erika lied to her friends about having a boyfriend by showing a picture of an anonymous guy who turned out to be a schoolmate of hers and was shortly recognized by her friends. Their conversations then was overheard by the guy, Sata Kyouya. Erika went to explain and proposed her idea of faking as lovers. However, Sata who gave off the nice-charming feelings guy turns out to be a black prince and used her reasons to blackmail her instead.  
  
Included one-shots:  
Volume 2: Junketsu Lullaby  
Volume 3: Pierrot ja Nee yo  
Volume 8: Kamatte-chan de Gomenasai!!  
Volume 11: Kimi wo Suki ni Natta Riyuu (The Reason I Love You)

title: The Treasured Sakura Tome
description: On the day before his death, Lin Feng is given a mysterious tome from the deity of love. Using it, he gains all sorts of supernatural abilities and skills from it to enjoy life to it’s fullest potential.

title: CHANGE
description:
A violent and muscular boy who dreams of becoming a national champion, unexpectedly turns into a cute girl, how will “she” achieve “her” dreams?  
  
[Official Chinese version](https://m.webtoons.com/zh-hant/drama/change/list?title_no=1259)  
[Official Indonesian Version](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/change/list?title_no=1194)

title: ChinChin KemoKemo
description: Mui-kun always had the animal magnetism… with animals. Unfortunately, it never worked with girls until his childhood friend Yuzuriha suddenly begin to take on various animal aspects, starting when she was offering a dance to the mountain spirit as a resident shrine maiden . Now she involuntarily takes on the animal spirit whenever she comes across one, most of whom disdain the confinement of human clothing…

title: Brothers and Sisters
description: Brothers and sisters, don't fight because of us!

title: Kaichou wa Maid-sama! Marriage
description: A collection of *Kaichou wa Maid-sama* specials.

title: Pink to Habanero
description:
“Tôi cũng muốn có bạn trai!”

Mugi, một cô nữ sinh trung học với chỉ số kinh nghiệm yêu đương là số không và không có năng lực giao tiếp với đám con trai, tình cờ va vấp phải Kurose một hot boy trung học, tuy vô cùng đẹp trai nhưng lại cực kỳ không thân thiện với các cô gái.

Thật là thô lỗ và khó chịu mà, nhưng… hình như mình vừa vô tình biết được công việc bán thời gian bí mật của Kurose !? (っ ಠ‿ಠ) っ

title: 5 Seconds Before Falling in Love with a Gal: Anthology Comic
description:
“You're bound to fall in love when a gal is kind to you!”

Despite dressing flamboyantly with a smidgin of lewdness sprinkle in, these gals occasionally show a pure side that will leave you mesmerized and…?

**Cover:** Kazawa Youhei
**Contents:**
1. Kazawa Youhei - Don't Tempt Me, Sakihara-san! / Don't Seduce Me, Sakihara-san!
2. saku - Kiyokawa-san Is A Gal No Matter How You Look At It! / Kiyokawa-san Is Definitely a Gyaru!
3. Urano Ritsu - The Childhood Friend Gal Wants To Give A Warm Welcome!
4. Hidari Ude - The Gal Likes Ramen!
5. Noki Kuzuri - Munching ♡ Kanna-chan ~A Recipe For Making A Gal Fall In Love With You~
6. Kamon Shoumi - The Inexperienced Gal Asks Her Teacher For Instruction / The Inexperienced Gyaru Asks for Her Teacher's Lessons

title: Omae ga Yattandaro!
description: Hanamura, a high school boy who loves lewd girls more than anything. One day, he witnesses it!! The decisive moment when someone (♀) is masturbating right on top of his own desk...!!

title: A Romcom Protagonist with Some Moves
Monotone Blue
description:
"We first touched each other so lightly and tenderly. You and me, we just look a little different, that's all."  
  
Note: "Monotone Blue" is the serialized version of a one-shot named "Escalate", published in the "Kemono/Jingai BL Special" anthology.

title: A Girl Who Has A Biased Opinion Of Me
Ami-chan no Nikki
description:
"On June X, we switched over to the short-sleeve uniforms."

Ami is the most beautiful girl at Tsubaki High school, who attracts looks from both boys and girls, but she has a secret that she can't tell anyone. That's all written in this diary ...

title: Shinu Hodo Sukitte Ittajan.
description: A boy named Aoi Asumori, a high school student with a peculiar constitution that can see spirits is secretly in love with his classmate Ai ichinose, who is very popular because of her bright personality. However there is a large number of spirits lingering in the background... Why are they coming after her? As an inexplicable incident creeps in, Aoi decides to become a hero that can protect her...

title: Koko wo Isekai to Suru!
description: If there isn't an alternate universe, then we'll just make one! Yatsusaka Yuudai, an enlightened high-schooler who lives by the motto "Live life in moderation". Jougasaki Kotonoha, the eccentric girl who wants to be in an alternate universe. It seems like the meeting of these two polar opposites will cause a huge disturbance in Yuudai's mundane school life! It's a weird story of an Isekai club that establishes an alternate universe… ish!

title: Fragtime
description: What would you do if you could stop time? Moritani for one is using her unusual ability to stop time for three minutes a day to observe the people around her. One day, she chooses to “observe” class idol Murakami’s panties – only to find herself in a very compromising situation when her classmate turns out to be immune to her power.

title: Oredake ni Kamatte Maka-senpai
description:
Puberty.  
When you are afraid to talk to girls and you can't be honest.  
My childhood friend from two classes above me, is the beautiful and cool "Maka-senpai"  
But only I can talk about "magic" with her!!  
With a little lie, starts a (not so) magical love comedy!

title: 45 Seconds
description:
Siyeon, who returns home after studying abroad for college, finds out about the 'Understanding Wine' course that her younger sister has picked for her.  
It's very popular because it's about tasting wine, but Sihyeon is a lightweight that can't drink alcohol!  
When she decides to correct the course and attended it, she is reunited with her high school friend Eunha… !?

title: Vampire Knight
description: Cross Academy is attended by two groups of students: the Day Class and the Night Class. At twilight, when the students of the Day Class return to their dorm, they cross paths with the Night Class on their way to school. Yuki Cross and Zero Kiryu are the Guardians of the school, protecting the Day Class from the Academy's dark secret: the Night Class is full of vampires!

title: Last Summer Vacation
description: "I ended up seeing that girl in my class who didn't want to be seen by anyone"—The bright and cute Mizuki who selflessly takes care of her sick mother—Seemingly the perfect “good girl” in every respect. But what about Umino, who saw a girl like that in a way she absolutely should not have? What is arriving at the end of escaping from reality? This is sure to be a road trip story about sad girls

title: Ichigo 100%
description:
Scene: The School Rooftop
The hero (me, Junpei Manaka!) sneaks up to the roof to see the sunset. When he opens the door, he startles a mysterious beauty. She panics and runs away, but not before Junpei has caught sight of her adorable strawberry print panties... in EXTREME close-up. With that vision forever burned into his memory, Junpei embarks on a quest to find the girl, and the panties, of his dreams!

title: Omamori Himari
description: Sixteen-year-old orphan Yuuto Amakawa has terrible cat allergies. So when he finds himself suddenly face to face with a beautiful girl who makes those allergies act up one morning, he’s left wondering about her identity. And when she saves Yuuto and his friends from a demon spirit with a very real, very sharp sword, she reveals herself as a sworn protector of the Amakawa family and a demon spirit to boot! Poor Yuuto, now that he’s living with an otherworldy samurai catgirl, his runny nose is the least of his worries!

title: If Her Flag Breaks
description: Hatate Souta, a young man who can see the "flags" that stand at the crossroads of life, transferred to “Hatagaya Academy”, a prestigious school in the metropolitan area. Not only does he meet beautiful girls in his busy school life, he even goes as far as living with them under the same roof! Surrounded by these flags, this enviable romantic comedy begins!

title: Kishuku Gakkou no Juliet - The Official Anthology
description:
The official Boarding School Juliet Anthology.

(continuing from Author/Artist: [Umino Mokuzu](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Umino%20Mokuzu), [Ohara Hiroki](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Ohara%20Hiroki), [Koppori Nama Beer](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Koppori%20Nama%20Beer), [Shimetta Seiya](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Shimetta%20Seiya), [Takeshima Eku](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Takeshima%20Eku), [namo](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=namo), [Puyo](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Puyo), [zinbei](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=zinbei), [Norio Tsukudani](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Tsukudani%20Norio), [rin](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=rin), [Tiv](https://mangadex.org/search?artist=Tiv))
