The Echo of Us (Pt. 1)

The Echo of Us (Pt. 2)

A Flash of Summe

title: Why Don't I Have Anyone by My Side?
description:
"I don't think anyone will want to be friends with me..." is the thought that has always run through Nayul's head.

One day, she's unexpectedly reunited with Seoyoon, a boy from her past, when he transfers to her class. Nayul and Seoyoon used to be best friends when they were younger, but after several misunderstandings and unknown reasons, he began to avoid her, still treating her coldly upon their reunion.

Will Nayul's foggy world ever brighten one day?

title: Give My Heart to You.
description:
I became deskmates with the girl I used as a character model for my manhua. And that manhua... is 100% yuri.

[Author's Weibo](https://www.weibo.com/u/5857459531)

title: Hiyokoi
description: Hiyori, a small and timid girl, goes to school for the first time in a year since an accident left her hospitalized. Follow her as she struggles with her social skills, tries to make friends and maybe even a little bit more…?

title: Her Kiss - My Libido Twinkles
description: After being hospitalized, Sana, meets a mysterious girl at the vending machine named Kousaka Ayane. They are both interested in each other and start spending time in their rooms. With every meeting Sana experiences new emotions which she hasn't felt before. After Ayane's doctor tells her that she is going to leave hospital she meets Sana one more time…

title: Kimi to Barairo no Hibi
description:
Mochizuki Nobara, who is often described as "serious" by those around her, is an ordinary second-year high school girl who yearns for romance but has yet to experience her first love. At the start of the new semester, the teacher asks her to help a student who has been absent from school to catch up with classes. However, that student is Setohara, an infamous boy who is the subject of many unsavory rumors around school.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: O! Ju Jesus-yeo
description:
Who cares if you’re invisible in high school when you can see and talk to the invisible? Reserved and quiet, Jamie Oh prefers to remain in the background and confide only in his friends, who happen to be ghosts. But when the most popular girl in school takes interest in him, his normal -- or rather, paranormal -- life takes an unexpected turn.


---

title: Fenrir-nee-san to Boku
description: Haijima Yousuke, bored of life, casually wishes for the world to be destroyed, even though he hates fighting and involving himself with people. And yet, when a terrifying monster suddenly appears and strikes down his beautiful upperclassman Kitami Touka right before him, Haijima knows that this time, he must fight. However, there seems to be more to Kitami than Haijima originally thought.

title: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai
description: Kyosuke Kosaka, a normal seventeen-year-old high-school student, hasn't gotten along with his younger sister, Kirino, in years. For longer than he can remember, Kirino has ignored his comings and goings and looked at him with spurning eyes. It seemed as if the relationship between Kyosuke and his sister, now fourteen, would continue this way forever. One day, however, Kyosuke finds a DVD case of a magical girl anime entitled Hoshikuzu Witch Meruru (Stardust Witch Meruru), which had fallen into the entranceway of his house. To Kyosuke's surprise, inside the case, an adult video game entitled Imoto to Koishi yo! (Love with Little Sister!) is hidden.

title: Me no Tsukedokoro ga Deep Desho
description: Mina is a girl who has a strong hope of finding her destined person. With that goal in mind, she tries her best with different types of guys wishful of finding the right person. Even when her childhood friend, a yankee named Yuito, is already by her side. Will she ever find her destined person? A romantic comedy, coming-of-age tale of love and friendship.

title: Risou no Kareshi no Hazunanoni
description:
After becoming a high schooler, Chiori begins to grow envious of how her peers are getting girlfriends and boyfriends left and right. "Having a lover seems like so much fun." "I wish I could get a boyfriend, too." "Why won't anyone confess to me?" When she voices her complaints to Issei, her childhood friend, he suddenly comes back with, "If that's the case, then go out with me."
Could this be the start of a dreamlike relationship?!

title: From Nightmare to Love
description: Ever since breaking up with one of the most popular boys at her university, Kan's life has become hell. He turned everyone against her, and the isolation and gossip has finally pushed her to the edge. However, she's suddenly confessed to by her classmate, the attractive but brash Yuya. He says he wants to help her, but for all his lightheartedness, he seems to have some demons of his own…

title: The Day I Started Fanboying for the Girl I Used to Dislike
Marumaru na Kanojo ni Dekiaisareru Hanashi
description: "My girlfriend dotes on me... Apparently."

title: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita Inaka Musume ga Bad End Kaihi ni Idomu Hanashi: Shinitakunai node Last Boss yori Tsuyoku Nattemita
description:
After being attacked by monsters, a countryside girl meets an all-too-sudden death, only to wake up and find herself as the villainess of the storybook she loved so much! Originally doomed to live as the main heroine’s enemy and die at the hand of the Demon Lord, she suddenly finds the Demon Lord proposing to her, unlocking an uncharted story route…?! With her story knowledge and incredible powers, this villainess is ready to dodge her bad ending and make a legendary comeback in this fantasy tale!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*

___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n7604hy/)

title: yrhm: Yurihime 20th Anthology
description:
An anthology of all-new manga by nine of the finest authors who've graced *Yurihime*. The yuri manga you should read right now is here.

**Cover:** hechima
**Illustration:** Aono Nachi
**Comics:**
1. Saburouta
2. Miman
3. Aono Shimo
4. Yuama
5. Kashikaze
6. Kodama Naoko
7. Manio (Hanasaki Manio)
8. Iwami Kiyoko
9. Takeshima Eku

___
Pretender by Kodama Naoko (Ch 6 in this) is located in [Girls Error Anthology](https://mangadex.org/title/d893fd52-ef3b-4517-9e3e-f0993cff8a17) as chapter 2.

title: Seifuku Shojo Miseifuku
description: Ko likes girls. Including his childhood friend from next door Mana, who treats him like a brother. She's popular with the boys because of her physical development... or not! The beginning of a sanctuary of fetishism as Ko conquers the uniformed girl!

title: Only Show Yourself to Me
description:
After moving to big city, small town high school girl Tano-San finds the culture shock immense and only wishes to go back to the country side.

That is until she meets the beautiful yet mysterious Rurika Towa, a girl who is super popular with boys and yet has no female friends.

Will an unlikely friendship begin between the two girls or will it turn into something more?

title: Absolute Duo
description:
《Blaze》— That is a weapon made by materialising your own soul with your enhanced will power. I, Tooru Kokonoe, have that ability which is said to be possessed only by one in every one thousand people, so it was decided that I would enroll in Kouryou academy that gives out 《Blaze》, and a school that teaches battle techniques. But for an unknown reason, my 《Blaze》 didn’t have a shape of a weapon but a protector, and it takes the form of a 《Shield》.

This manga is an adaptation of the light novel series by Hiiragi Takumi with illustrations by Asaba Yuu.

title: Hajimete Koibito ga Dekimashita (Pre-Serialization)
description: Ayumi and Senpai have zero relationship experience. Dating, kissing… Everything is new and confusing to them. Sometimes they're too shy, sometimes they're too bold, but they're always slowly getting closer as a couple.

title: Natsume-senpai ni Semarareru Hibi
description: [This series has been licensed officially in English by Kodansha US.] "I love muscles more than anything else!" Kaho, a first-year high school student who is a huge muscle freak, observes guys with nice muscles at school every day.Then she meets Natsume, the "Muscle Prince" of the basketball team, who looks at her "Muscle Notebook" and recruits her to be his manager?! Kaho's days of being assailed and pressed around by the muscles of her dreams have begun!

title: Suzuka
description:
Yamato is ready for a fresh start. So when his aunt invites him to stay rent-free in her big-city boarding house in hustling, bustling Tokyo, Yamato jumps at the chance. There’s just one teensy-weensy catch: It’s an all-girl housing complex and spa! Things get even more nerve-racking when Yamato meets his neighbor Suzuka, a beautiful track-and-field star. She’s not just the cutest girl Yamato’s ever met, she’s also the coolest, the smartest, and the most intimidating. Can an ordinary guy like Yamato ever hope to win over a girl like Suzuka?
___
**Links:**
- Alternative Official English: [INKR](https://comics.inkr.com/title/800)

title: In the Mood for Love
description: In her campus life, full of ups and downs, she may have a magnificent appearance, but in reality, she has the most timid personality.

title: She's Not an Angel
description: Father Daniel is the new teacher at the Keobiji Muncipality High school, a dump where all the local troublemakers gather. All is well until one night, while on patrol, he sees a woman… beating a man. Sensing something is wrong, he immediately goes to report it the next day. Except that, this woman is not who she seems to be. A strange relationship between a dedicated priest and a hot-blooded troublemaker is about to begin?!?!

title: Joou-sama no Eshi
description: Fujimaki barely scrapes by in school grade-wise. But he thinks all is well, because he just has to quit school and become a top-selling mangaka. It is that easy! One day he catches his hyper-intelligent classmate Yukimori masturbating to eromanga in an abandoned room in school. One thing leads to another and he gets blackmailed into drawing eromanga for her.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Kaichou Senkyo-hen
description:
It's September and summer break is over and a new term has begun, with it the time to decide on the new Student Council President starts.  
  
Adaptation of the concluding sixth chapter of the original novel's volume 5.

title: Kimi no Yokogao o Miteita
description: Hikari's your typical freshmen in high school who's been recently daydreaming about Mari’s, her shy best friend, a love story. She decides to ship Mari with Ootani-kun, their classmate, after finding out about his crush on Mari when his friend, Asagiri-kun, tried getting the two to talk. The main character is Mari, the leading man is Ootani, and Hikari is the typical best friend in the story. Not bad… right? A youthful story between four kids going through unrequited love.

title: Tokage Bakuhatsu Shiro
description: Lizardmen are hit by disasters today in a high school, where there are various races such as elves and beasts. But this lizard is quite delicious, and I'm sick of it!

title: Teishinchou Namaiki Gyaru ga Mikudasou to shitekuru
Yojouhan no Ibara Hime
description:
*By Seishun Scans: WARNING! This series contains scenes that may depict sexual harassment, attempted sexual assault, and/or verbal abuse. Reader discretion is advised!*

---

Shinra has a mother who rarely comes home. Everyday, she pinches her pennies just to survive. Rai, a popular guy from her school keeps bothering her, and she’s getting sexually harassed by the manager at her part-time job. After finally coming home after 2 months, Shinra’s mom promises to stay with her. Rai unexpectedly shows up at Shinra’s part-time job and sees her being sexually harassed. He urges her to quit, but she refuses. Shinra comes home only to find out that her mother has disappeared once again

title: Kawaisou ni ne, Genki-kun
description:
The protagonist Genki Hirota has what others would call a peculiar fetish. Knowing the abnormality of it, he had intended on giving up on love, however, his feelings towards his classmate, Yachimidori, gets smoldering? To cope, he draws out painful scenarios in which a character made in her image always suffers, however, when his comics gets discovered by the class idol, Sagisawa, he gets pulled on along by her whim.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Tonari no Young Jump](https://tonarinoyj.jp/episode/10834108156646927837)

title: Kisses x Kiss x Kisses
description:
An ambiguous and complex relationship that began with that single word. Reality, dreams, and love are all undecided from the moment the word "Kiss me!" comes out from the mouth of a high school student's best friend! 'No way I don't like you… … ?'' Strong negative is strong positive?!

- [Original Webtoon (Lezhin)](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/kisses_kiss_kisses)

title: Ninkoi ~Karenbo Hichou~
description: Mikado Shuuji is just an ordinary guy, but he has a very unusual knife that he uses for cooking. It's actually a famous short sword that marks its owner as the head of the ninjas, and now there are hot ninja girls coming after him to take it back. Hinamori Botan is one of those hot ninja girls, but her efforts to attack Shuuji mostly end up inadvertently stripping her. After she concludes that she does not want to steal the sword and kill Shuuji, she ends up deciding to serve him as a ninja instead. Now she must protect him from the other ninja that come to claim his sword and his life!

title: Today I'll (Make You) Confess
description:
The life of 2 "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety to confess to Lin Dai Xue, on the other side Dai Xue keeps making opportunities for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other well but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.  
  
[Author's Weibo](https://weibo.com/u/5548091947?refer_flag=1005055013_)

title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy
description:
"This isn't the life that I wanted."  
  
On the day of her wedding, Eunha, who has hidden the fact that she's a lesbian her entire life, decides to jump off a building and end her life, not wanting to devote her life to a person she can't love. Just as she leaps, she closes her eyes and wistfully reminiscences her first love whom she never told her feelings for… only to find herself 10 years back in high school when she opens her eyes. As she is reunited with her first love, will Eunha be able to turn back her ill-fated life? (From From Zero Scanlations)

title: Hanabi wa Samenai Yume wo miru
description: Olivia, the daughter of a duke, is betrayed by her fiancé, Crown Prince Luke, and is publicly executed. However, the moment Olivia thinks she has lost her life, she wakes up as Hanabi, a high school girl in a different world: Japan. What's more, it seems that Hanabi is being bullied at school...? The story of a duke's daughter's rise to power is about to begin!

title: Oogami-san and Cerberus!
description: When Oogami-san is confessed to by one of three dog-eared girls, Keru, Bero and Suu, they become friends and start hanging out with each other. Will this friendship eventually turn into love!? A love story between three identical triplets with completely different personalities and a beautiful lone wolf.

title: Oyasumi, Scheherazade
description:
Rumor has it that there is a witch inside room 13 of the girls' dormitory, who lures innocent, unsuspecting girls into her room at night to perform indecent acts on them….   
In truth, the girl in room 13, Herazato Shie, is just unable to fall asleep at night unless she tells someone a story about the movies she has watched. So every night, she invites anyone willing to come in her room and listen to another of her stories about movies.

title: Mx0
description:
During a flashback, an interviewer inquires Kuzumi Taiga, a prospective student for Seinagi Private High School, on what he would do if he could use magic, during his entrance interview. He replies, "take over the world", with an outburst of laughter, from an attractive girl, following his answer.  
After the entrance exam, the school rejects his application; although he recalls almost nothing after this event, he does recall the girl, and believes the cause of his school of choice rejecting his application involves her.  
Wandering around outside of the school the next day, Kuzumi tries to enter, but an invisible barrier blocks him. A teacher, Mr. Hiiragi, confuses Kuzumi for a student of the school ditching class and pulls Kuzumi into the school through the barrier.  
Seinagi Private High School is actually a magic school and Mr. Hiiragi has just accidentally pulled Kuzumi, a teenager with no magical skill, through the barrier into this school.

title: The Story of How I Sat Next to the Person I Like on the Morning Train
description:
She sleeps, she scores.
___
[Chapter 2 Official Raw](https://x.com/sensiya_sensya/status/1293162393321627649)

title: Yankee-chan ga Jimi Megane ni Koisuru Hanashi
description: A delinquent girl suddenly appears before the plain, glasses-wearing Tanaka! What will Tanaka do!? And where will the delinquent girl’s love lead!?

title: Classmates
description: Hikaru always thought his classmate Rihito was kind of a snob, until he stumbles across Rihito secretly practicing a song in an empty classroom. Hikaru agrees to become Rihito's music tutor, and with each lesson the two boys grow closer. But when Hikaru realizes that he's fallen in love with Rihito, will they stay classmates or become something more?

title: Yuri Hyakkei
description: A full-color manga featuring 100 scenes of girls love! Featuring classmates, senpai and kouhai, teacher and student, sisters and childhood friends!

title: Ultimate Antihero
description: Adapted from the light novel series of the same name. When humanity was threatened 5 years ago, the boy who saved the world was driven to despair and became regarded as the enemy of all of mankind. And now a new crisis approaches humanity. The curtain rises on a gallant drama about a hero falsely charged.

title: Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-san
description:
***This young lady is a troublesome shoujo manga fan.***

Nozaki Yumeko is a maiden in high school. She's greeted by the transfer student Miyoshi Ritsuo and drags him into her shoujo manga-style hijinks, much to his annoyance...

Welcome to the life of Nozaki-san -- who adores the world of shoujo manga and yet is completely oblivious that her own brother is a renowned shoujo mangaka -- in this comedy about a girl who's all about all things shoujo manga!!

*Note: Based on the original concept of*  *[Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun](https://mangadex.org/title/bc634b22-0c05-4a55-9b7e-3f55438a1ad3)* *where Nozaki's sister was planned to be the protagonist. Released as part of the special edition of* Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun Volume 13 *and takes place three years after the original series.*

title: I'll Answer, Your Mystery
description:
An assistant to the high school counseling teacher, Rinne Akegami is an introvert who only understands what is true. As if from a revelation from God, she can point out the culprit of any crime there. What complicated matters, however, is that not even she herself understands how she does this! 

This is where Touya Iroha comes in — he deduces "her deductions" in order to reveal the truth, once and for all!

title: Dreaming Freedom
description:
Jungmin Choi is severely bullied in high school because of a fallout with her childhood best friend Joohyun Ha. Her only solace comes from tormenting Joohyun in her ‘lucid dreams’ where no one can disturb her. One day, she meets a mysterious man in her lucid dream who offers her to get revenge on the people tormenting her…

---

**Links:**

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/congmengdaoziyou/list?title_no=2057)

title: Finder Goshi no Ano Ko
description:
Hajime, a girl who can’t seem to properly express her feelings into words, is worrying all on her own about the preparations for the cultural festival. This will be the last festival for her film club. There’s always been things she’s wanted to do for the festival, but like last year, she’s given up and the festival will probably end without her doing what she wants to do.  
That’s when she meets Kei Ichinose, another student at her schoolー

title: Honto no Kanojo
description: Moe confesses to Yuuka who rejects her harshly in a haughty manner different from her usual "good girl" personality… but Moe seemed to enjoy it?

title: Tada no Osananajimi to Couple Waribiki
Yuri to Koe to Kaze Matoi
description:
A high school girl who has never known love meets an older woman with a secret...
A junior in high school, Matoi Noshita has never liked anyone and is fed up with being involved in her younger sister's and friends' boyfriend situations.
One day, she meets Yuriko, who has just moved from Tokyo. At a local driving school, she asks her to drive her home on her motorcycle.
Matoi is perplexed by her own curiosity about a woman whose name she does not know and where she lives.
"What on earth is this feeling I am having for the first time...?"

title: Kanojo ni Naru Hi Another
description:
Sagara becomes a girl in his third year of middle school, and has to deal with his crush on Kurokawa, a female classmate.

---
**Extras:**
* Volume 1: Featuring Mamiya and Miyoshi from *[Kanojo ni Naru Hi](https://mangadex.org/title/fe64a71b-9101-48cc-bbff-531f41018b8a/)* five years after the events of volume 1 of that story.
* Volume 2: *S no Kaikoroku* (S の回顧録; Memoirs of a Sadist): Natsukawa gets slowly swept into a dangerous S&M relationship with his girlfriend Sakurai.
* Volume 3:  [Not scanlated as of August 2022.]
* Volume 4: A set of 4-komas and a brief epilogue story from shortly after Sagara began to live as a girl.

title: Persona 5: Mementos Mission
description: Ren Amamiya is about to enter his second year after transferring to Shujin Academy in Tokyo. Following a particular incident, his Persona awakens, and together with his friends they form the “Phantom Thieves of Hearts” to reform hearts of corrupt adults by stealing the source of their distorted desires. Meanwhile, bizarre and inexplicable crimes have been popping up one after another…

title: 2019 Rookie Danpyeonseon: Jiok Camp
description:
The anthology includes:
1. Momo Cinnamon (모모 시나몬, Momo) by Yun-Su Lee
2. Wangbi (왕비; Queen) by Yeong-Chae Hae

Everyone knows how the fairy tale ends. A true love's kiss awakens the slumbering Snow White, who then lives happily ever after with her prince. After all, main characters always get their happy endings.  
  
But what happens to the evil queen after? Exiled to the isolated, bleak Northern island, she awaits her execution; thirty days of waiting, with only a nonchalant guard as company. If she is to live, she must find a way out. Will she be able to escape in time, defying all odds? Or will she succumb to fate?

[MangaUpdates](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/kugmnnf)

3. Nancy wa Lara (낸시와 라라; Nancy and Lara) by Ri-Geon Lee

6. Eomma (엄마; Mom) by Samgueok
7. Oraeorae Haengbokage Saratseumnida?! (오래오래 행복하게 살았습니다?!; Will We Live Happily Ever Afte

title: I Will Hate You,  Sayama-kun!
description:
The Student Council President Ayukawa Wakana has someone on her mind. That someone is her junior in the Student Council, Sayama-kun!  
  
One day, Wakana daringly confesses to Sayama-kun, but her confession is returned with an overwhelmingly difficult "dating condition"…?!   
  
How will Wakana's one-sided love unfold–?! A popular artist's work, a troublesome pure love-comedy. Let the show begin!

title: Yoru's Marriage
description: In the summer her grandfather passed away, high school girl Kiyoi found herself abandoned. To protect her home, she decides to marry that man…!!

title: Hazuki Kanon wa Amakunai.
description:
Hazuki Kanon is your average female High-School Delinquent. She is often late and skips class in the nurse office, occasionally talking to the male nurse BJ (Kuronada Jun).  
  
Tamaki Daiji likes to film stuff that captivates him the instant he encounters it, disregarding consequences. His friend Kihou Tomoka tries to snap him out of it, whenever she sees him stuck while he is late for something else.  
  
One day Kanon catches his interest while she stands on the roof of the opposite building. After asking Tomoka, he decides to head to the infirmary where Kanon sleeps occasionally.  
  
Kanon wakes up to some strange guy filming her. He even has the audacity to call her "thumb-sucking while sleeping" cute and captivating. So she decides to let him keep the footage if he promises to keep her secret.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Logical Witch
description:
"There is another 'me' in this world".  
Futaba Rio from the science club turned into two person for some mysterious reason. Sakuta hid one of them in his house, not only that, Sakurajima-senpai said she would move into his house as well. Sakuta's vacation was completely messed up.  
"I hate myself"  
What's the secret deep in Rio's heart?

title: Douse, Koishite Shimaunda.
description:
"After school, I fell in love."

Surrounded by four handsome childhood friends, Mizuho is thrilled every day. ♡ Moreover... the youngest one of the group, Kizuki, has recently started to quickly get close to Mizuho?!

title: Shinchou-sa Kanojo
description:
The story of a big and a small girlfriend

title: Hana to Hoshi
description: Hanai is a junior higher and the best at table tennis. She's never lost, and she's won many tournaments, but after some freshman she's never heard of beats her like it was nothing, she starts losing every game after that and she can't get rid of that feeling of defeat. Now it's her first day of high school and she's decided to quit table tennis and live an ordinary high school life, but on the first day, she runs into the very girl that first defeated her. It turns out that she's also quit table tennis, but this girl always has a cold expression on her face and Hanai can't help but feel that this girl is always looking down on her and trying to mess up her perfect high school life. One day the girl falls asleep in class, and Hanai reaches over to wake her up. As she does so, the girl, still half asleep, looks up at her with a smile and almost kisses her. The girl later tells Hanai that she was having a dream about her, but Hanai coldly brushes it off thinking she's just messing with he

title: Owari no Seraph: Ichinose Guren, 16-sai no Catastrophe
description: Chuyển thể dựa trên Light Novel cùng tên, đây là câu chuyện về Ichinose Guren, câu chuyện xảy ra trước sự kiện Diệt Thế trong *Seraph of the End.*

title: Uso to Kiss wa Houkago ni
description:
Thanks to a bad mother obsessed with men, Rin lost a warm house when she was young. The one who supported her at that time was the family of her childhood friend, Momoka.

...but, at some point Momoka began dating men, one after another, as she indulged in the feeling of love. Almost exactly like the mother that had left Rin behind.
"I won't be satisfied if I'm not loved" Momoka boasts. After she's admonished by Rin, she suggests "Then, you do it Rin. Love me, in place of a boyfriend".
And thus, from kisses and lies, begins a girls' love story.

title: Mushijo
description: The main character, Hinako Yomotsuki, is a high school girl who loves the anime "Puri Puri" and devotes all her energy into otaku activities. However, in actuality, when she unites with a mysterious "Maji" centipede life form, she becomes a distorted hero who saves people. Now she fights both to save the town assailed by "Maji" and to protect her unrequited crush, Himoru-senpai.

title: Hahazuka-san wo ×× ni Shitai
description: High schooler Kajiki wants to be pampered by his beautiful, motherly, well-endowed female classmate, Hahazuka-san. Not as his sugar mommy, but as a literal mommy.

title: Akairo Crossroads
description:
Is being unable to see the red string of fate better?!  
Since the encounter on the day of the high school entrance ceremony, dog-like boy, Makita Keita and cat-like girl, Ohara Tamaki have had the worst relationship.  
The story starts to progress when the both of them are put in the same class.  
A little mysterious heart racing school youth graffiti begins!

title: An Imperfect Kiss
description:
A kiss that has changed her fate by luck? Or by misfortune?  
A poor girl's hardcore romance that unfolds in an exclusive private high school

title: Yeonha ui Mat
description:
Gong In-joo was dumped by her boyfriend, Ahn Geurim, for no reason. In-joo, who has been living while depending on Ahn Geurim all this time, feels the emptiness of losing Geurim and plans to get him back. The first thing in the plan is to arouse Geurim's jealousy! To do this, she tries to seduce Seo-yoon, a handsome junior she met during volunteer work, but Seo-yoon had a crush on someone…What will the end be for the two people who form an alliance to win over love…?  
  
[Official Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/drama/nianxiade/list?title_no=2056)

title: The Boy Who Belongs to Group "B" Cross
description: Protagonist Sakuragi Ryou was in the "A group" in middle school. At least until he got caught up some trouble and developed a reputation as a delinquent. Wanting to live a normal, peaceful life in high school he decides to do a reverse high school debut, aiming to be in the boring, middle-of-the-pack "B group". Above all else he doesn't want to stand out. But then one day he encounters the school idol, Fujimoto Erika, being harassed by delinquents and begrudgingly decides to help her out. She then starts to develop an interest in him, which is going to make his goal of not standing out tough…

title: Mafia's Daughter: Operation Makeover
description: A story about an ordinary boy named Mekh, whose life is about to change the moment he accidentally hit the infamous and easily-misunderstood girl named Saran.

title: I’m Going Out with the Beautiful Black-Haired (Unemployed) Takashina-san
description: Sugawara Hinode, sinh viên năm hai tại một trường đại học ở Kyoto, vô tình gặp phải một cô gái bí ẩn tóc đen xinh đẹp trong khuôn viên nhà trường. Sau lần thứ hai tình cờ gặp nhau trong quán rượu, biết được hai người cùng có điểm chung là "ăn không ngồi rồi", Takashina-san nói với Hinode-kun:" Hãy cùng nhau tận hưởng thời gian lười biếng nhé, Hinode-kun!"

title: Osananajimi ga Kaette Kimashita
description:
My first love childhood friend is back as a zombie?!

Tamaki, a girl who died in an accident, became a zombie and crawled out of the grave to convey her feelings to her childhood friend. Shin, a lonely high school boy, remains confused by the fierce attack of Tamaki...!

A surreal romantic comedy!

title: Gakuen Alice
description: Young Mikan runs away to Tokyo to follow her best friend, Hotaru, who has been enrolled in an exclusive, secretive private school for geniuses. But it turns out that Alice Academy is a lot more than meets the eye. If Mikan wants to stay by Hotaru's side, she has to both pass the strange "entrance exam" and face the even greater challenge of befriending her very odd new classmates. Whether it's Hotaru's gift for inventing gadgets, the cranky Natsume's fire-casting ability, or Professor Narumi's control of human pheromones, everyone at the school has some sort of special talent. But what ability, if any, does Mikan possess? Mikan is going to have to rely on her courage and spunk if she's going to stay in school, or even stay alive!

title: Someone Hertz
description: Mimei có chung sở thích nghe chương trình hài kịch đêm khuya với cô bạn Kurage vui tính và bí ẩn cùng lớp. Và cô ấy nổi tiếng với việc gửi những bình luận hài hước được đọc trên chương trình ư? Nhưng Mimei cũng muốn mình hài hước như cô ấy! Họ là bạn bè, là đối thủ, hay là gì đó hơn thế nữa...? Chương trình hài lãng mạn trên radio này đang được phát sóng!

title: Ano Ko wa Kishi
description: Since childhood, Katsutoshi Himemiya often dreamed of a medieval world where knights protected the princess. He lived his life vaguely thinking, “Maybe I was a knight in a previous life,” but when he met Asako Kishi at his high school entrance ceremony, he realized that his previous life was as a princess and hers was as a knight...

title: Motto Ganbare! Nakamura-kun!!
description: It was love-at-first-sight when Nakamura met his classmate, Hirose. The two became friends after the shy and awkward Nakamura finally worked up the nerve to speak to him, but being buddy-buddy with your crush is a whole new kind of torture! And as he watches some other guy cuddle up with Hirose like casual bros, Nakamura tries to keep his head from exploding. Why can't that be him?! Enjoy the hilarious new misadventures of Nakamura desperately trying to keep it together and not scare Hirose off. Hang in there, Nakamura!

title: 5Toubun no Hanayome (Fan Colored)
description:
Uesugi Fuutarou is a poor, antisocial ace student who one day meets the rich transfer student Nakano Itsuki. They argue but when Uesugi realizes he is to be her tutor, he tries to get on better terms. While trying to do so he meets four other girls.   
  
Manga's Official Twitter: [@5Hanayome](https://twitter.com/5Hanayome) 
  
5Toubun no Hanayome is the official romanization.

title: Love Letter -Yamamoto Souichirou Short Story Collection-
description:
Contents:
1. **Love Letter** (恋文, Koibumi)
Okamoto, a young middle schooler, wants to confess his love to a girl named Kamiyama through a love letter. However, things go out of his plan when Kamiyama shocks him with an unthinkable request.

2. **The Long-Awaited Neighbor** (まちにまったおとなりさん, Machi ni Matta Otonari-san)

3. **Middle-Aged Cat Guy** (ネコのおっさん, Neko no Ossan)
Kazuki's sister brings home a stray cat, who is actually a middle aged man in disguise.

4. **Wish For Sasa ★** (ササに願いを★, Sasa ni Negai o ★)

5. **Kaijuu Lizard** (怪獣のトカゲ, Kaijuu no Tokage)
Venturing into the hills to find her dog who ran away, Hitomi finds a strange lizard girl who is feeling lonely.

6. **Matsumoto Eiko Is an Average Girl** (松本エーコは普通の子, Matsumoto Eiko wa Futsuu no Ko)
A girl's quest to become more interesting to catch her crush's attention.

7. **Witch in Training** (みならいウィッチ, Minarai Witch)
Spring has arrived. Having just turned 13, the young witch Koharu has embarked on the traditional journey of indep

title: Ai da toka Fukushuu da toka
description: One day, Kaede Koshiba's day began with a strange feeling. As his family and classmates tell his things that he does not remember, Kaede realizes that he is being replaced "every other day" by a strange girl named Yuka Tsutsumi. Just as Kaede tries to solve the strange phenomenon that suddenly happens to him, an incident occurs that changes Kaede and Yuka's daily life.

title: Sensei's Pious Lie
description: Misuzu Hara is a 24-year-old high school teacher who, four years earlier, endured a traumatic experience at the hands of Hayafuji, the then-boyfriend of her best friend Minako. She has never forgotten the experience, but she has kept it secret from Minako to protect their engagement, and has rationalized it to herself as having occurred to her due to her being a woman, even if it has continued to negatively impact her emotional well-being.

title: Dragon's Savior
description:
"Napolly," an ordinary high school girl in modern times, was tired of a boring school life. 'The world is gone?!' The news is full of breaking news that the mysterious destruction continues, but the main culprit is seen in the eyes of the surviving Polly. White and brilliant silver scales, purple eyes with sadness and madness. 'The giant dragon I saw in the game!' In front of Polly, who can see the transparent dragon, the twin sister of Transparent Dragon, "Idae ah," appears, and the dragon's name is "Israel." Napolly, who was forced to take part in the power of Ideiya by half force to calm Israel, who was dumped by a wicked woman, headed to the second world of the past. Can Polly be friends with Israel, who is trying to destroy the world, and calm it down?  
  
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://kakaopage.co.id/content/Dragons-Savior/3422)

title: Yoshida Lemon Drops
description:
Kyoto University is a hotbed of supernatural abilities where geniuses and prodigies from all over the country gather. After failing the entrance exam once, Yamakawa Kashio became a student at Kyoto University, but he lost his only unique ability to study better than others, and spent his days in fear and depression as a zero-person with no unique ability. In front of Kashio appears Sawakita Yoko, a classmate who spent three years in the mandolin club with him in high school.

Yoko, who was a plain student like Kashio, enrolled at Kyoto University while still in high school, and made a name for herself as a female wrestler, becoming the most famous Kyoto University student ever! Kashio is overwhelmed by Yoko, who has become a distant presence, but Yoko has been waiting for Kashio to come to Kyoto University for a long time...!?

title: How to Drive Back a Classmate Who Always Teases You
description: The boy who has been suffering through his seatmate's teasing finally decided to strike back.

title: My ID Is Gangnam Beauty
description:
The ugly girl who was able to be reborn as a beauty, Kang Mirae!  
But… I feel like I've seen you somewhere?  
  
**Link**:  
[Indonesian Official Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/drama/jiangnanmeiren/list?title_no=875)  
[Japanese Official Translation](https://xoy.webtoons.com/ja/drama/seikei-bijinn/list?title_no=1146)

title: Mob Douzen no Akuyaku Reijou wa Dansou Shite Kouryaku Taishou no Za o Nerau
description:
"That's right. I can become a potential love interest as well."

A ray of inspiration strikes, in an otome game where men are treated favorably, the side-villainess starts a crossdressing revolution?!

The world is unfair. Just because I am an extra villainess, I'm doomed to always face the bad ending... If that's the case, can't I just dress up as a man and capture the heart of the game's heroine by becoming a potential love interest and live happily ever after?

The fiancé with the temper of a kid; the tsundere classmate; the puppy-like brother-in-law; and the beautiful icy-hearted prince, they are all my rivals. Just wait and watch, you handsome heartthrobs! I, Elizabeth Burton, will become a seductive knight who'd softly whisper love and capture the hearts of maidens with a mischievous wink! 

A heartwarming school romance comedy, where a crossdressing lady aims to become a noble and a fabulous love interest, begins!

title: How to Start a Relationship With Crossdressing
description: Ako Kobayashi is a high school girl eagerly awaiting her prince charming to sweep her off her feet, but she has to overcome one small problem: she is so afraid of guys that she breaks out in hives whenever she comes near one. She even rejects the popular Kei Kitaooji who is the first guy to ever ask her out. However, after Kei learns of Ako's condition, he comes to school the next day dressed as a girl and asks her out again.

title: Heartbeat Conquest
description:
I opened my eyes, but where I am?! Da-Eun instinctively realized she fell into the world of 'Handsome Boy's Love Simulation' as Diana. As she looks around, she sees hearts above the head of others! Men, women and even passing animals are all targets! Diana, thinking this is all a dream, creates a plan to start a reverse harem…  


---

**Links:**  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/dudu0__)

title: Shuukan Shounen Hachi
description: Fresh out of high school, Yasaka "Hachi" Hachiki enters the infamous Onigahama manga academy in the hope of becoming a pro mangaka. Well aware of his lack of talent, Hachi soon meets Mikeya Touma, a young prodigy who nonetheless thinks he has a long way to go. Despite the gap in their abilities, an incident suddenly sparks a rivalry between the two of them. Thus begins the tale of Onigahama's students and their merciless struggle to achieve their common dream.

title: The Curtain Call of the Dagashi Store
description:
A countryside boy meets a gyaru from Tokyo.  
Naturally, it paves the way to oneshota /ss/.  
  
Originally posted on : <https://twitter.com/Zen_1_1_Zen/status/1150270563325059072>  
Translation and Edition by yours truly, Dorofinu.

title: Inbura! ~Bishoujo Kyuuketsuki no Hazukashii Himitsu~
description: After an accident, our protagonist Amagi Kouichi becomes involved with Itanami-san, a well known beauty of his school and secretly a vampire.

title: Raou-kun wa Watashi ni Kamau
description: Harukaze Hino is not confident about her appearance. Her classmates call her "ugly" and make fun of her for the way she looks. But then, a delinquent boy in her class, Kurobane Raou, tells her that she's "cute"?!

title: Hatsukoi wa Nido Oishii
description: Mikumo and Sei have been friends ever since they were kids. They were so close that people would think they were a couple in middle school. Due to her parents job, she had no choice but to move with them to China and thus the two of them parted ways. He gave her his hat as a parting gift but she didn't get the clue behind it. A few years later, she returned to japan and reunited with him in high school. Will their first love reunite once again?

title: Tanimoto-kun and Tsuchida-san
description:
A story about a tanned, sportsy, and literary girl classmate who tries to mislead me.
___
[Alt Official Raw (X)](https://x.com/search?q=from%3A%40kurikimaru%20%E8%B0%B7%E5%85%83%E3%81%8F%E3%82%93%E3%81%A8%E5%9C%9F%E7%94%B0%E3%81%95%E3%82%93&src=typed_query&f=live)

title: Ao no Shima to Neko Ippiki
description: Souta Nakamura, a young city teacher, moves to the island of Nagishima after spending years away, expecting to meet his old upperclassman who offered him lodging, but finds out that he's gone and he's left him to take care of his teenage daughter Ao, a girl who is wise beyond her years, and who has the quiet island lifestyle ingrained in her heart.

title: Gaishutsu Jishuku-chuu dakedo Suki na Hito no Koe ga Kikitai Ko no Hanashi
Hataraku Maou-sama! High School!
description: In this spin-off of the popular novel series, the Devil King Maou and Emilia, the Hero, are reincarnated after their terrible battle as high school students in modern-day Japan! Add in the innocent Chiho, a fellow student with a crush on the former lord of darkness, and you've got a high school comedy devilish in its scale!

title: Uchuu Ryuugakusei Moru
description: Tatsumi, a pragmatic boy who doesn't make friends nor goes out for fun, meets Moru, an exchange student from space. And yet, he ends up accompanying her, although reluctantly, when she asks him to show her around the Earth...?!

title: I Don't Want to Be Bullied by Girls
description: The male protagonist, Ye Lin, met his childhood friend the "Little Overlord" Xiao Qin once again in high school. In order to seek revenge on his bully, Ye Lin worked hard for ten whole years. This story is about how a hot-blooded teenager can't help but be bullied by girls

title: Starting With a Lie
description:
To avoid accepting two simultaneous confessions from Xia Yiyi and Qiu Mang, Tang Tang told them he wasn't into girls. Due to the two girls' unwillingness to back down, they told Tang Tang that he must show them evidence that this was true. To cover up his own lies, Tang Tang decided to seek help from his friend Chen Qingye so they could put on an act to help Tang Tang get away from the unwanted confessions. Though constantly showing restraint, Chen Qingye always ended up accepting Tang Tang's propositions.  


---

[Official Korean Translation](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=5387696)  
[Official Thai Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/th/romance/starting-with-a-lie/list?title_no=1889&webtoon-platform-redirect=true)

title: Fukanzen na Hito no Tame ni
description: Hoshi is just your average student until one day, he encounters an oddball upperclassman stuck inside a locker.

title: Ω ni dake wa Naritakunai!!: Isekai Tensei Shitara Ane no BL Manga no Naka deshita
description: Aspiring manga artist Taisei Kuji is an assistant to his sister, a popular BL mangaka. One day, Taisei was unluckily run over by a truck and found himself reincarnated into the omegaverse world drawn by his sister!

title: Hosekibako Ni Ai o Tsumeyo
description: At five, she started humming melodies. At ten, she found her treasure. At 14, her world lost its spark. At 17, she starts to hear the music again. Mone Tsukimori, a slightly cheeky high schooler, has someone she can never forget. What is Mone’s past that only Anji-sempai knows...?

title: Does Love Need a Translation App?
description:
Hadam, who has just come back to school, learns that Erin, a French exchange student, will be living with her due to an administrative error.  
  
Will Hadam and Erin be able to conquer their grades and overcome their language barrier to understand each other's feelings?  
  
A tightrope romance that starts under one roof!

title: Otonashi-sou na Danshi no Tondemonai Himitsu wo Shite Shimatta
description: Hôm nay mình(nữ chính) được đổi chỗ ngồi mới, và người bạn hàng xóm bàn bên của mình là Urui-kun. Nhưng mà...Cậu ấy có gì đó bí ẩn lắm...?

title: Lady Justice
description: Marufuji Enta has a crush on Kenzaki Ameri and as they visit the same class for the first time the best day of his life starts! Ironically, he gets kidnapped until a mysterious hooded girl appears in front of the abductor's car to free him in the name of justice!

title: Seiseidoudou Futamata suru Hanashi
description: A story from the creator of *[Aho Girl](https://mangadex.org/title/7957/aho-girl)*, and *[Mangaka-san to Assistant-san](https://mangadex.org/title/258/mangaka-san-to-assistant-san-to)*. High school boy Naoya gets a confession from Momi, a cute and friendly girl. However, Naoya already has a girlfriend, Seki… but Momi is too good a catch to let go. Momi and Nagoya's goal becomes clear: convince Seki to accept being an item with the two of them. Will she budge?

title: Ore ga Doutei wo Sutetara Shinu Ken ni Tsuite
description: Ichijo Kazuya thought that he was murdered, but when he came to, he was back in his high school days. He lived his entire life as a playboy and had had countless sexual encounters with women until that fateful day that he was killed. He realizes that his murderer was his old high school friend Tanaka Masaki who was jealous of Kazuya's relationships and his built up anger eventually exploded. Taken back 15 years into his past, it seems that he has been given a second chance at life and given a chance to make different choices. He decides that the way to prevent his eventual demise is to make sure Masaki is more successful with girls and loses his virginity before Kazuya. But fate seems to be steering Kazuya towards the path of his previous life and keeps introducing the same girls he had sexual encounters with.

title: Chorokute Kawaii Kimi ga Suki
description: Oono Nana is a high school girl whose heart easily flutters at the nonchalant words of the opposite sex and she is very much aware of her "easy" disposition. One day, in the spark of the moment, she unexpectedly voiced her opinion out loud to Sudaka, the solitary yankee from her class. She was expecting to be attacked for it but she received a confession from him instead! And now she keeps getting easily swayed by Sudaka's straightforwardness!

title: Samgak-gimbap-eul kkaneun Beop
description:
A youthful romance for those who think they are unhappy.  
  
- [Original Webtoon (Naver)](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=4376294)  
- [Original Webtoon (Toptoon)](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/samgak)  
- [Original Webtoon (Daum)](http://webtoon.daum.net/webtoon/view/trianglenori)

title: The Protection of Lariensa Gelinus
description: Reading about Lariensa was an innocent pastime, but Song Yiseul never imagined becoming personally entangled in her story. When she wakes up in a fictional world like Lariensa’s best friend Marilyn, she quickly realizes that her favorite novel’s star desperately needs her protection. The thing is, Lariensa is just a little too sweet for her own good, which makes her an easy target for master manipulators like Sibel Noma Kahn. As Lariensa’s loyal friend, it’s up to Marilyn to save her from the boy who will one day ruin her life. But Marilyn’s desperate attempts to circumvent Sibel only seem to pique his devilish curiosity. With the antagonist now suddenly interested in her, Marilyn sets out to foil Sibel's sinister plot to use her to get to Lariensa.

title: Blooming Sequence
description: Seowoo, president of the film club, is standing outside in the rain, a welcome break from the noisy and chaotic bar behind her, when a girl with orange hair stumbles out the doors and practically into her arms. Then she begins singing “Dancing in the Rain” while… dancing in the rain. It’s a minute encounter, really, but Seowoo has seen the greatest romances bloom from the smallest moments in the movies. So when Hayoung shows up to join the film club, Seowoo – who’s not even sure what she herself is feeling – finds her heart skipping a beat.

title: Asa made Renai chu! ~Osananajimi wa Tokimekanai?~
description: An omnibus of assorted childhood friend stories, from the duo that brought you "Asa made Jugyou Chu!"

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl
description: Just before summer vacation starts, Makinohara Shouko, a middle school second year student, met a high school student named Azusagawa Sakuta. Sakuta gave Shouko a desire to live, then...

title: practiced liar
description:
"This world is full of noise."  
  
Due to his innate ability to "read minds", Miura is completely distrustful of people because he is constantly exposed to their true feelings. One day, he meets Abe, his junior at a university club, who is twice as quiet and expressionless as anyone else. But it turns out, Abe is a person who will talk non-stop like a machine-gun about his pure love for Miura (*only in his mind)!

title: Koisome Momiji
description: A girl asks Katsuragi Shouta to take a picture of her with Enoshima in the background. Embarassed by her cuteness, he takes the picture and runs away. He later finds out that she is an actress by the name of Shinomiya Sana. A TV drama, Koisome Momiji, will be shot in Shouta's town and Sana will be starring in one of the lead roles, as a passionate girl who whole-heartedly chases after the guy she loves. However, Sana has never experienced that kind of love. To practice for this role (and maybe truly fall in love) Sana asks Shouta to be her boyfriend!

title: Hina Change
description: Two childhood friends, a boy and a girl, used to share a secret magic. Now that they're in high school though… A story of secret love from an outstanding writer.

title: Haru to Koi to Kimi no Koto
description:
Mishima Hiroka is a young girl who doesn't understand love and wants to avoid it due to some trauma. Seta Airi is an ikemen who is secretly a narcissist and uncomfortable with the touch of girls. They both attend a boarding school where dating is forbidden. The only thing is… that rule is in name only.  
A sparkling story about love and friendship.

title: Onihime VS
description: Weak, bullied, and pessimistic about life, that's Setsuna Kashiwagi. On the verge of jumping off a bridge, a mysterious man appears behind him and offers the contract "10 million yen in exchange for your life in a year." Skeptical at first, he accepts. Waking up the next morning, thinking it was just a dream, he notices 2 beautiful women sitting beside him. They are Kanna and Rena, Oni princesses here to claim his heart in a year.

title: The Anthology of Elder Sisterly Mischieves
Sanbante Heroine no Sonogo
description:
"I lost. I can't be his girlfriend (heroine)."

Liara Natsuki, a bold, sexy, and curvaceous third-year high school girl, is widely acknowledged as "the third-best girl at school," but she is rejected by Kazuki Shikimura, the boy she has a crush on. When Kazuki's younger brother, Senri Shikimura, tries to console her, Liara jokingly says, "Maybe I should just go out with you instead." She is surprised when Senri agrees and confesses to her, "I've always loved you, Natsuki-san..."?

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump)

title: Baito-saki wa "Aku no Soshiki"!?
description: Arihisa Aokura needs money. He needs money in order to support his family of orphans and earn a living for himself. Looking online for potential employers, he found a posting for a part-time job in an "evil organization." Seeing that the pay and benefits were fairly substantial, he took the chance and the interview. He was somehow hired and now has to work as a henchman inside the evil organization "Antares". Will he be able to survive the onslaught of missions against heroes while providing for his orphan brothers and sisters?

title: Onii-chan dakedo Ai Sae Areba Kankeinai yo ne
description: The story is about the Himenokouji twins named Akito and Akiko who got separated due to certain circumstance and after years of living apart they suddenly began to live under the same roof once again. Things were fine at first until Akiko began expressing her love for her older brother. Now Akiko must fight to defend her extraordinary love for her Onii-chan as she battles against all odds and three other girls who are after her beloved Onii-chan.

title: My Sweet Girl
description:
I thought that I didn't need something like love.

I have a complex about my body because it's tiny and I'm merely skin and bones. I am Koeda Tsugumi (a first year high school student). One day, by chance, I let Sena Masamune from the class next door see my body?! But, after being with the straight forward, always-natural Masamune, the me, who's always hidden herself and secretly wanted to be a more girly girl, has started feeling these warm, fluffy feelings…
I present to you the pure and slow going love story of a romance-klutz!

title: Evergreen
description:
Yoshimatsu Hotaka is the president of the manga club and is always diligent with his school life and club activities, but even though he looks like a regular honor student in reality we have that there is something really odd with him; he has this bitter ~ heavy ~ melancholic look and is almost always looking at Awaya Niki, the beautiful, bright, radiant, super cheerful swimming club's female ace.  
  
Why does Hotaka act all bitter like that? And what will become of him as the sports teacher orders him to have at least 'one secret swimming class lesson' where no one is supposed to be looking, whereas he normally skips class activities due to personal matters?

title: P to JK
description:
Kako fell in love with Kouta, a guy who saved her in a mixer while she's posing as a 22-year-old girl, only to find out the next day that he's a police officer. Just when they were getting closer, he realized she's a high school student and distanced himself from her. But Kako continued her advances and accidentally got injured. Will he give into his feelings and keep this high school girl by his side despite being a policeman?  
  
Won the 41st Kodansha Manga Award for Shoujo in 2017.

title: Rutou-san ni wa Kanaimasen!
description:
Being the top student in the class, Rutou Kaname is always in the public eye; on the contrary, quiet and trivial, Wamura Chihiro usually spends time talking with her otaku friends in the corner of the classroom. 
Being front-and-back deskmates, Kaname and Chihiro should have no common language. However, as Kaname strikes up a conversation, a special friendship starts.

title: Osananajimi de Oyome-chan
description:
Yoshinari and Manaka have been together since they were born.  
The relationship between the two is a little (?) A little strange (?)  
Yoshinari begins to question his relationship with Manaka, but …  
a childhood friend love comedy that is difficult to change when it's close.

title: Wagatsuma-san wa Ore no Yome
description: Aoshima is a second year student in high school, who wishes he had a girlfriend. One day he wakes up for an unknown reason 10 years in the future, and he is married to the prettiest girl in school, Wagatsuma Ai! How has their relationship grown from mere acquaintances to husband and wife?!

title: Tashiro-kun, Kimi tte Yatsu wa.
description: Ebihara gets mugged by Tashiro, his junior in college. They somehow end up hanging out together after that, and Ebihara slowly begins to realise that Tashiro may not be as frightening or as weird as he appears to be at first glance.

title: Musashi-kun to Murayama-san wa Tsukiatte Mita.
description: Musashi and Murayama, both of whom stand out in class, decided to start dating! Follow their delightful adventures in this slow-paced 4-panel romantic comedy!

title: Tacchan, Docchi Toru?
description:
Let's be close friends together, the three of us ♡.

Tatsuya—nicknamed “Tacchan”—is a college student who ends up freeloading at the home of his twin childhood friends, Ritsuka and Futaba. The three of them were close friends, but the twins grew up to be cute, and their feelings of love for Tacchan seem like they're about to run wild!?

A slightly lewd and heart-pounding cohabitation romantic comedy ♡.

title: Onna o Naguritai!
description: A heartwarming romcom about a boy who can't help but want to punch girls, and the heroines.

title: Queen's Quality
description:
The adventures of mind “Sweepers” continue in this supernatural romance sequel to QQ Sweeper!  
  
As Fumi’s dangerous new powers blossom, Kyutaro might be the only one who can help her keep them under control. Then, when Kyutaro tells Fumi that he’ll never leave her side, she unexpectedly starts to fall for him!

title: Heisei Otaku Remembers
description: The year was 2006. A time when people made fun of you just for being an "otaku." One man who survived the Otaku Ice Age travels back in time to those days! Otaku, regain your lost youth!

title: Manin Densha to Watashi to Kare
description: The packed morning train isn't a good place to be if you're small; a fact that high schooler An knows all too well. So when a boy rescues her from the crowd one morning, she should be grateful… right? The only problem is, he treats her like a little kid! Who is her rescuer, and what will happen when she meets him again…?

title: Risouteki Boyfriend
description: "You're far from my ideal type and we hardly have any common features. From now on too, we won't get involved with each other that much."  That was what I thought, about the kind of person you were.

title: A Story About My Poker-Faced Childhood Friend Cosplaying as a Bunny Girl
Kono Naka ni Hitori, Ore no Yome ga Iru
description:
For the sake of finding clues about his younger twin brother who suddenly went missing, the protagonist changed his identity and infiltrated the academy his brother was attending. However, what clearly came to light there was a surprising truth! His brother had multiple fiancées...?

(Source: Ganma)

title: Hyulla's Clan
description: Surh Jung-woo developed Gynophobia because of his trauma when he was younger. Even as a college student he is still afraid of women, but Yoon hae-soo is a angel like existence for Jung-woo because of his fear. He starts dating after thinking he could trust Hae-soo, but while putting everything he has on line for her he falls into debt and gets cornered. After he gets betrayed by Hae-soo the person to save him is the most beautiful girl of this college, and the famous professor Pi Eun-na. What is this beautiful teacher after, and why did she help jung-woo?

title: Mix
description:
Adachi's second serialization in Gessan Shounen Sunday, follows the story of three siblings, students of Meisei Middle School. Takes place 26 years after Adachi's biggest title, Touch. Because of the legend left by Tatsuya Uesugi, Meisei Academy High School was well-known for their strong baseball team. But 26 years after their glory, the team has not been able to keep their record and has since lost their fame. Two stepbrothers, Souichirou and Touma Tachibana, aim to revive of the once-strong Meisei Academy baseball team and enter the National High School Baseball Championship.  
  
(Source: MAL, edited)

title: Anedoki
description:
The story centers on a 13 year old boy who is pushed around by a mysterious 17 year old girl. First she forces him to let her move in with him, then she takes his bed and that's only the beginning. What's in store for this innocent 13 year old boy whose life is being throw upside down by this girl!?  
  
Ah, the dream of 13! Kouta is our normal everyday boy, living with his fun-loving workaholic father. Lusting after the school idol in his class, playing games with his friend… there's nothing especially noticeable about him. But one day his father has to transfer to Sapporo and then appears a girl who volunteers to be Kouta's live in caretaker. And what a girl!  
  
Everything about her is mysterious: her mysterious incredibly showy body, her mysterious interest in our boy, and her mysterious need to sleep in the same room… Doki, doki…

title: The Story of Being Courted by a Childhood Friend With a Strong Personality
Zenbu Kimi no Sei - Extras / After Story
description: Extras and After Story of [Zenbu Kimi no Sei](https://mangadex.org/title/82476383-e6a9-41a7-b98c-87cc8be9efbb/zenbu-kimi-no-sei), mainly centered around Ryou and Nagisa. (the Official Raws are free to view)

title: Kataomoi-chu no joshi to tonari no zaseki ni narattara
description:
On the bus back from the field trip, I was seated next to Tosaki-san, who I have a crush on, but Tosaki-san fell asleep.
Meanwhile, my friend told me that he liked Tosaki-san, so he was glad that we were seated next to each other! However,
Tosaki-san was actually awake...

title: Please Go Home, Succubus-san
description: A certain Succubus-san arrived out of nowhere.  She is beautiful and always trying to have sex with me. Furthermore, she has transferred into my school. What will become of me tomorrow?

title: Ota x Nail ~Plamo Danshi, Gal no Tsume wo Nuru~
description:
Kaminuma Rikuto is an otaku high school boy who loves Plamo. He has been estranged from his childhood friend, the gal Amagase Misora, for the past few years, but due to certain circumstances, the two meet unexpectedly. The trigger is...nails!? It was awkward for the two of them to meet again for the first time in several years, but Rikuto's love of plastic models got excited and he took on the challenge of nail!

"Then, the relationship between the two, who had been confused, gradually grew closer..."

title: The Girl With Horns
description: Demons hide among us in disguise… The third-rate exorcist, Shouta, protects the peace of his school in his clumsy way. One day, he meets the beautiful horned demon girl, Rin, in the mountains. Due to a strange combination of circumstances, the two are bound together by a contract! From then on, the wild-natured Rin and the clumsy Shouta become a pair of quarrelsome lovers… I mean, exorcist partners, fighting and chasing demons away every day! A blood-pumping, exciting action exorcist series with beautiful girls!

title: Miss 180
description:
184 cm tall and known by the titles of “flower boy beauty” and all-around male fashion model is actually— a girl!  
  
**Links**  
- [Official Chinese Translation (Simp)](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/METROPOLIS/180shaonv/list?title_no=1494)
