- [Official Thai Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/th/drama/girl-180/list?title_no=2047)

title: Kuzuna Kimi Shika Aisenai
description: Sae's been going out with the handsome and flirtatious Shun for two months already. He’s selfish and a bit naughty, always teasing her, but before she knew it… she had fallen in love with him…? A blinding love with a stubborn boyfriend! ♡

title: Free Draw
description:
Han TaeSung, ex-gangster leader, wants to turn his life around and follow his dream of becoming a manhwa artist. Unfortunately, his high school life has more in store for him. From his old friends, rival gangs, and the over-the-top president of the manhwa club – it’s an action-packed high school sitcom!  


---

**Links**:  
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/qingchunbaiquan/list?title_no=262)  
- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/drama/qingchunbaiquan/list?title_no=178)

title: Seishun Scrap!
description:
A new program has been set in place for a certain area, where children are separated by gender into eastern and western territories. They're raised with no contact with the opposite sex, and made to only focus on their studies. Of course, there are a few bad apples, and the worst of these are sent to a co-ed school with the troublemakers from both sides. Unfortunately, this school soon became known as a place where the teenagers would battle to determine who was the strongest, and many boys and girls tried to be sent there.

At this school, the girls have an advantage, since the boys mysteriously get nosebleeds whenever they look at them. However, the strongest girl, Jun, is shocked to find that the strongest boy, Kyo, doesn't get a nosebleed when he looks at her! It turns out that both of them have had some experience with the opposite sex in the past, and they both have embarrassing secrets in the present...

title: Takane no Ran-san
description:
Ran is beautiful and stylish, with leading scores in her class. No boy on Earth would have the gall to try their hand with her, and no one would think that she’s so entirely innocent… except Akira. Join us in this innocent love story about Rin the “mountaintop flower” and Akira, whose parents own a flowershop.

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by m&c! Comics as **Ran The Beautiful Flower** (2019)

title: Koisuru Michiru-ojousama
description:
Young Lady Michiru harbors feelings for her sadistic tutor, Sakaki. However, all she receives in return are harsh remarks…
“I have no interest in children.”
“What are you expecting?”
“I'm disappointed.”
“Let's begin sex education.”

Will the young lady's feelings ever reach him…? Hey!! That last line!!
Sadistic tutor × little young lady, what does the future hold for these two?

title: Boku no Orion
description:
During a rainy day, Samon stopped at a flower shop to take shelter from the storm. There he met Koito, the girl from that store that goes a year behind him at school.  
  
After that, when he finds himself involved in the love affairs of his classmates and finds himself alone in his class, Samon projects his fury on Koito saying "What amuses you so much so that you are always smiling?", And ends up hating himself. That made Samon anxious, and on graduation day, for some reason, Koito gives him a diary.  
  
Actually, Koito admired Samon. In that newspaper he said "Life during middle school was fun because you were there …". Despite hating himself, Samon likes the things written about him in Koito's diary. Time passes and, upon entering the second year of high school, he reunites with Koito, who entered that school following him… [LemonadeScans]

title: Boku-tachi wa Mada Aoku
description:
*“Our grade’s top scorer, an unapproachable guy, only opens up to me. That’s so friggin’ adorable!”*  
  
 Saegusa is utterly bored of his high school life. Along comes Arochi Tooru, a guy with the brightest hair he’s ever seen, who transfers into his class. It’s an oddity already, for some guy with outrageous looks and a cold attitude, to transfer into a prep school. So he immediately draws the attention of everyone in his class. What’s more, he’s apparently a genius who cinches the top spot in their grade on their class exam.  
  
One day, Saegusa uses a common point of interest to approach Arochi, and the two start to become closer. But once they become friends, Arochi is actually really oblivious and cute! Saegusa just can’t take his eyes off this cutie!

title: 30 Minute Walk
description:
The romantic way back home of Galaxy Institution’s Wi Seong Eun (Moon) and Ji Gu Bong (Earth).   
The world's most thrilling time, this 30 minute walk.  
  
---

- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/jiae88)  
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0000277)  
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/30fenzhong/list?title_no=1218)  
- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/romance/30fen/list?title_no=1479)

title: Numa Sugite Mohaya Koi
description:
Because of a heartbreak in her past, Kirino decided to live more for her idol than for actual boys, but one day, transfer student Kametani-kun comes, who has a somewhat similar vibe to her idol! When Kametani-kun glares at the girls saying, “Don’t even think about talking to me!” on the very first day of transferring to the school, Kirino gets intrigued by him and learns his secret and…?!

(Source: K Manga)

title: Tokyo Ravens
description:
An Onmyodo School Fantasy of a Failing Private Onmyo Academy Student!!  
Tsuchimikado Harutora was born into a prestigious Onmyoji family, but he can't see "spirit energy". Therefore, he's been enjoying a peaceful daily life with his friends at an Onmyo branch school. One day, his childhood friend Tsuchimikado Natsume, heir to the head family, suddenly appears. Will this cause his destiny spring into motion!?

title: Takamori-kun wo Damarasetai!! (Pre-Serialization)
description: Một cô gái có khả năng đọc suy nghĩ người khác và cậu bạn kế bên có máu simp lỏ. Điều gì sẽ chờ đợi cả hai phía trước?

title: Eleanor Oujo wa Jiyuu na Seishun wo Okuritai
description:
Eleanor, the princess, has a second life!  
  
Eleanor Skye Eta, Princess of the Kingdom of Eta, was born to a life that was fixed from birth.  
  
The only thing she enjoyed was reading school memoirs of an unknown author.  
On the eve of her political wedding, she was led down a dark path by Kiran, a wild weasel she loved.  
  
She was led to a modern Japanese high school….!  
  
By a princess full of "hajimete"!  
Reverse trip to another world x unpredictable youth school story!

title: Diary of a Female Lead: Shujinkou Nikki
description: With a famous manga artist mom and a popular captain of the basketball club brother, Aoi grew up feeling inferior. With the help of her brother, Itsuki, and her classmate who is also Itsuki’s friend, Sena, their goal is to boost Aoi’s self-confidence by trying to fall in love with shoujo manga as a reference.

title: Nichijou Yametara Shitai Koto
description:
1. Cry for the Moon
2. Pink for Tear
3. Ano Ko to Nakayoku Naru Houhou
4. Idol Yametara Shitai Koto (What I Want to Do Now That I'm No Longer an Idol)
5. Oujisama tte Yobanaide
6. Shirotae-sama, Himitsu desu yo
7. Futaribeya: Aozora ni Shiro Ribbon (Futaribeya: White Ribbon Against the Blue Sky)
8. Futaribeya: Aozora ni Shiro Ribbon (Futaribeya: White Ribbon Against the Blue Sky)
9. Futaribeya: Ashita Me ga Sametara (Futaribeya: Tomorrow, When I Wake Up...)

title: Hitokuchi Choudai
description:
Sasame Yui, a descendant of vampires, feels out of place in her high school class. Unable to fit in with her human classmates, she's often late to school — something that the class representative, Sekiya, relentlessly criticizes her for. One day, angered by Sekiya's nagging, a dark impulse flickers through Yui’s mind—

"Maybe I should just... suck him dry."

But that thought marks the beginning of something far more dangerous—an ecstasy said to surpass sexual pleasure a hundredfold.

title: Infinite Stratos
description:
Students are trained in the Infinite Stratos academy to pilot the weapon system IS (Infinite Stratos). Although it is believed that only females have the ability to operate the IS, there is one man who can. His name is Orimura Ichika.  
  
Relaunch of the Infinite Stratos manga drawn by Yuuki Homura.

title: The Rock-Paper-Scissors Girl
description: Oẳn tù tì, người thua phải nghe theo bất cứ điều gì người thắng muốn

title: Seibutsu-bu no Tanabe-kun
description:
The beautiful student council president is cornered by the handsome biology nerd!

Kirishima Sakura is a flawless, elite beauty and the student council president. Her dream is to become Prime Minister one day, and she diligently fulfills her duties as president to sharpen her leadership skills. But one day, she meets Seijirou Tanabe, the school’s most eccentric guy and a handsome biology geek, and soon finds herself swept up in his obsessive passion for living things. And that's when Sakura discovers it... The hidden side of Seijirou Tanabe that no one else has ever seen!!!

title: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru @comic
description: Hachiman Hikigaya is a cynic. He believes "youth" is a crock-a sucker's game, an illusion woven from failure and hypocrisy. Unsurprisingly, he's not the most popular guy. Meanwhile, there's Yukino Yukinoshita - brilliant, beautiful, and chillier than winter in Antarctica. Would you believe she's not exactly beloved by her classmates either? The unlikely pair gets forced into a club dedicated to helping solve their fellow students' problems. But will an ice queen and a screw-up really be able to help anybody?

title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu
description:
The protagonist is a guy who is among the stupidest of the stupidest in the school. In this school your grades can, under the supervision of teachers, take a virtual form to do battle! However, if you leave an examination midway, you get zero marks. A bright and cute girl, Mizuki Himeji, had a high fever during her examination. Despite her potential to be the second highest scorer in the level, she obtained zero marks for having left due to her illness and is thus banished to the worst class, Class F.  
  
Grades mean nearly everything. For Class A: They have a smart-looking teacher, a plasma TV as big as the entire wall as their blackboard, personal laptops, personal air-conditioners, refrigerators, adjustable seats and all kinds of different appliances. Within the refrigerator, there are all kinds of drinks and snacks. Their ceiling is made of glass, the wall lets them put up high-class drawings and plants.  
  
As for Class F (the worst class): They have Japanese desks and seat padd

title: Inumimi Tsundere Doukyuusei no Hanashi
description:
My classmate Sakura Inumi is haunted by the spirit of a dog…
She has dog ears and a dog tail, apparently moving in accordance with her emotions…
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/24338901/series/139941)

title: Kurasu no Inkya Busu? ...Jitsu wa Chou Bijin Cosplayer Datta. Minna Shirazu ni Baka ni Shiterukedo
description:
Akira Hazama, a high school boy, hides his otaku nature and enjoys his school life as a cheerful person. However, he secretly goes to a doujinshi convention and has a fateful encounter with a...?
___
[JP Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@neko-oka)

title: Killing Line
description: Mako, a high school girl who has been abandoned by her father who disappeared, is forced to resort to papa-katsu (dating a sugar-daddy) to survive. On her first night, while she is taking a shower after finishing her business, her sugar-daddy is killed by a hitman, and he is about to kill Mako as well, but the hitman seems to recognize her somehow. Caught in a desperate situation, Mako has one last chance! Selling flattery in order to survive!

title: Kyuuketsuki-chan wa Kagami ni Utsuranai!
description:
Vampire-chan, who isn't reflected in the mirror, is troubled because she can't look fashionable today too. One day, by chance, she notices that she can only be reflected in people's eyes…!? Master–servant makeup romantic comedy drawn by the author of *How Pitiful, Genki-kun*!!
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Young Jump+](https://ynjn.jp/title/1389)

title: Zekkyou Gakkyuu
description:
Welcome to your first Screaming Lesson. A trip into another world hidden in plain sight.
1st Period: “The Devil’s Game” - It all started when a young girl picked up a discarded handheld video game. Who would have thought it would take her on a ride to hell?
2nd Period: “The Cursed Bond” - A blood-soaked tale of revenge, where two girls learn that not even the kindest hearts are immune to the power of hatred.
3rd Period: “Mary’s Table” - Can’t stomach your school lunch? Feed it to the class doll! But does it come with a price?
Extracurricular Lesson: “The Kind Mother’s Home” - A young girl finds a replacement for her cheap, nagging mother online. Unfortunately for her, she learns that when it sounds too good to be true, it probably is.

title: Chihaya-san wa Sono Mama de Ii
description: Chihaya-san wa Sonomama de Ii (Chihaya-san's Fine that Way) follows the life of an average high school girl, Chihaya, who thinks she is overweight and wants to lose weight. Unfortunately, its impossible for her to keep her appetite in check, especially with her childhood friend, Shima constantly bombarding her with food. Can Chihaya resist her urge to eat and succeed in her diet?

title: Ashita no Yoichi!
description: A boy swordsman, Yoichi and his father stays in mountain training for his descent from the mountain. Yoichi comes to the city to lodge and stay with 4 beautiful sisters. A new more severe "training" regiment awaits him.

title: Jiraikei Hoikushi-chan ni Honrou Saretai!
description:
When a high school boy named Yuki went to a nursery school to pick up his uncle's child, he saw a nursery school teacher named Satomi wearing Jirai-kei* fashion.

She has an expressionless look on her face that makes it hard to tell what she's thinking, but Yuki will find himself getting led along by this landmine girl of a nursery teacher, when she flashes him a smile from time to time!

(Source: BookLive)

---

*Note: Jirai-kei (Literally "landmine-type") refers to a fashion style based on cutesy clothes with lots of frills and ribbons, a style that is stereotypically worn by "landmine girls" who are outwardly cute, but mentally unstable with a tendency to have violent emotional breakdowns.

Previously posted on Twitter under the title: *Jirai-kei Hoikushi-chan ni Honrou Sareru Hanashi (地雷系保育士ちゃんに翻弄される話)* / "Led Along by the Jirai-kei Nursery Teacher", then released as a single-issue doujinshi at Comitia 140 under the current title. Later published in 1 volume by Number Nine.

* Alte

title: Hiiragi-senpai to Ofutari-sama
description:
After repeatedly changing schools due to her father's job transfers, Moemi decides to stay at her parents' home on the condition that she lives together with the daughter of her dad's boss. However, the girl she was told to live with is in fact... a boy! A senpai from the same high school, Hiiragi! Suddenly living together with an older boy starts off with a lot of excitement...?!
[Blueberry Scans]

title: Mozuya-san Goes on a Rampage
description:
Mozuya Koto is afflicted with the medically accepted disorder known as Dr Josef Tsundere’s Bipolar Personality Disorder, or just “tsundere” for short. With her golden hair, blue eyes, twin tail, and being rich on top of all that, Mozuya Koto comes equipped with all the basic necessities of being a top class tsundere. When Mozuya wants to be friends with somebody or when she likes somebody, she will take offensive actions that are completely opposite from what a normal person would actually do in the same situation and it is completely outside of Mozuya’s control.  
The manga is pretty serious most of the time, focusing on Mozuya’s troubles with getting along with people as she keeps turning violent due to her tsundere disorder.

title: Stay Awake All Night
description: Lian Mian is a normal girl, but she has the "eye of death" and is able to see people's mortality rate. Suffering from this curse, she tried to kill herself many times, but she just could not die! Upon hearing her cries, a Death God came. However, even his powers couldn't help her. What kind of spark will begin between the girl who wants to die and the Death God who will kill her? What kind of secrets are hidden behind the girl's powers? Can she resist the deadly temptation to dance with the Death God…?

title: Wakeari Senpai no Kanojo ni Narimashita
description:
"Ah, I want to die."

Sagami, who works part time at a convenience store, is a target of bullying - one of the reasons is her grades being not the best. Meanwhile, Onizuka, an ex-studious turned delinquent, gets tangled with her. With their fates now intertwined, how will they grow out of their pasts?

title: Princess Lucia
description:
Koizumi Yuta is a 14 year old boy who has quite a bit of a problem. The princess of the demon world, Lucia, has to procreate with him. That child would have the ability to engulf the entire world for 7 whole days. Mikamoto El and Kasukabe Rie are the two angels assigned to make sure that doesn't happen. Kasukabe Rie happens to be the girl he likes. Just how is he going to survive this ordeal?

Note: Volume 1 included Chapter 0 which was the one-shot & prequel to the series that was published a year prior

title: Adachi to Shimamura Koushiki Comic Anthology
description:
First official comic anthology for the much-discussed Adachi to Shimamura!  
  
Iruma Hitoma's popular novel series Adachi to Shimamura now in comic anthology form!

title: Ore Yome. – Ore no Yome ni Nare yo
description: Hinata has to meet her fiance to respect the decision of his grandfather. But she will never marry a man younger than her!? Will she never be able to… !?

title: Hoshizora no Karasu
description: Waka is a 13 year-old Go-lover! Learning from her grandfather, a pro go player, she comes to enjoy connecting with the people around her, regardless of age or gender. One day, she meets the young genius go player, Sagisaka Souji, in a match that tore at both body and soul, and so she decides to become a pro go player herself!

title: Yankee Nishimiya-san wa Choroi
description: The romantic relationship between a naive yankee girl and a boy with seemingly no common sense.

title: Asakusa Oniyome Nikki: Amazake Tenshu Kaoru wa Zensei no Yome to Heion ni Kurashitai
description:
*Shounen manga adaptation of the Asakusa Oniyome Nikki web/light novel series.*  
  
Maki Ibaraki is a high school girl who lives in Asakusa and loves Asakusa cuisine. This girl, who likes to poke her nose into ayakashi-related business and solve her problems by brute force, harbors a secret - she remembers her previous life. Her previous life was not that of a human, but of a demon princess called the "Ibaraki Kid," whose name resounded across the Heian period. Accompanied by Kaoru Amasake, the reincarnation of her "husband" Shuutendouji, the "Strongest Demon-bride" hurtles around Asakusa even today helping troubled ayakashi, such as Kappa Temari who is exploited at his part-time job, and a family of tanuki who run a local soba restaurant.  
(Source: MU)

title: Hundred
description:
<<Hundred>> — that is the only weapon that can oppose the mysterious life form <<Savage>> visiting the earth. The protagonist, Kirasagi Hayato, aims to become a <<Martial Arts Master>> using this Hundred. He managed to get into the battleship university <<Little Garden>>. However —

"I wanted to see you, Hayato!!!"
"H-How do you know my name?"

Around the roommate, Emil Crossford, who somehow knows him well (?), Hayato gets an uneasy feeling. What's more, just after the entrance ceremony, he gets asked for a duel by the campus' strongest martial arts master <<Queen>> Claire Harvey…!?

title: Kokoro no Mama de
description:
Kokoro Katayama, a high school student, spends days unfamiliar with the class. She wears makeup every day to give her confidence, but her face seems to be scared by her classmates.

One day, when she picks up her younger brother Shinta, she meets her classmate Kuroki. They talked for the first time, but the distance gradually shortened and their feelings changed little by little.

This is a healthy youth love story.

title: Latent Blue
description:
In this remote seaside town, different people meet with their own confusions and misgivings. In the face of the deep blue sea, everyone can find their own answers. The Deep Blue journey of scuba diving and ordinary youth begins!  
  
Author's weibo: [@x\_\_CECI\_\_x](https://www.weibo.com/hhhhhhhhhxhhx)

title: Ryuuzaki-san ga Ore no Mae dake de Dereru Riyuu
description:
Ryuuzaki-san, known as the most beautiful girl in our grade, is strangely cold toward me. Whenever our eyes meet, she glares at me like I'm a piece of trash. Then one day, I end up seeing something unbelievable about her. Ryuuzaki-san isn't human at all. She's a Dragonkin.

"P-Please don't stare at me that much!"

The school's top beauty shows only me her true face, and it turns out she's unexpectedly dere, leaving me completely flustered.

title: Aono-kun ni Sawaritai kara Shinitai
description:
Nếu là vì để được chạm vào cậu thì tớ chết cũng chẳng sao. Nghe kỳ lắm nhỉ? Nhưng đây là tình yêu của tớ. Tớ thích cậu nhiều lắm, Aono-kun!

Yuri-chan và bạn trai của cô ấy, Aono-kun, đã có một mối tình tuyệt vời cho đến một ngày, Aono-kun bỗng dưng qua đời... Họ sẽ không bao giờ đến được với nhau, và họ không thể chạm vào nhau. Đây là một câu chuyện về tình yêu chân thành nhưng cũng đầy những chông gai.

title: Philia to Eros no Aida
description: Hoshigawa Kurumi has a crush on her classmate, Nikaidou Nika, who sits in front of her in class. She's popular with guys so she has no trouble going from boyfriend to boyfriend. One day, Nikaidou borrows an eraser from Hoshigawa.

title: To Love Ru - Kentarou Yabuki 20th Anniversary
description: Special chapters published in *Weekly Shounen Jump* and *Jump SQ.* celebrating 20 years of work by Kentarou Yabuki as a manga artist.

title: Hoshino-kun, Shitagatte!
description: Hoshino, a member of the baseball club meets Yamada, a classmate who has just transferred to his new school. She cries loudly that she was "mugged" and makes a certain "request" to him. The world's funniest master-slave relationship between a clueless girl and a good-natured little guy is about to begin.

title: Park Sal Soneyo
description: Being the new girl is tough when you have to keep the fact that you're a yomul hunter a secret. Demons with human faces, yomul, run amok in Seoul, and it’s up to Seul Park and her father to destroy them. But her charmed life as a regular high schooler comes under threat when a mysterious and powerful yomul discovers Seul’s biggest secret—she’s half-yomul herself. To make matters worse, he plans to use the cutest boy in school to lure her out of hiding.

title: From Today I'll Be a Goddess
description: A normal, honest sophomore guy, whose life was changed when he became a super beautiful girl. Who was the one that caused it? Are there any more misfortunes lying in wait for him/her? What kind of charming experiences will he have…?

title: Otsukaresama, Kurose-kun
description:
I feel like I forgot about someone important...

Plagued by nightmares of his old hometown, Yuuma Kurose, a lonely boy with the ability to see ghosts, feels inexplicably drawn back to the place from his dreams. There, he stumbles upon Kaito Kiriyama, a boy shrouded by terrifying spirits. With a serious look in his eyes, Kaito vows he'll protect Yuuma. But the moment their skin makes contact, the spirits surrounding Kaito started to possess Yuuma!

title: 86—EIGHTY-SIX: Operation High School
description: This spin-off of the “86 -Eighty Six-” series takes place in the world where none of the tragic events occurred and the war never happened. Shin, Lena and other characters are enjoying their normal high school life akin to the one in Japan.

title: Skill of Lure
description: Jang sung-gi who is always misunderstood as a pervert and a worthless man. He meets a mentor who suddenly turns him into a very charismatic man? A tale of how an average guy who turns into the greatest "pick up artist" and a story about misbehaved men who are constantly trying to pick up girls.

title: Magical Pâtissière Kosaki-chan!!
description: Kosaki, Chitoge and Marika were bestowed upon powers of a magical girl who shall preserve peace in the world with Kosaki serving as their leader. Defeating a giant evil minion, the group then faces against the perverted mastermind behind the minion's creation, Doctor Maiko. Short in staff, Raku is called to help in the Onodera family sweets shop, much to Haru's protest.

title: Hongsineun Nal Joahae!
description:
Hong Shiho is a 20-year-old senior in high school who shook things up the day he transferred. With a complicated past and a lively personality, Hongshi welcomes everyone, but still finds it a bit difficult to treat them all equally. What color will each day be for Hongshi and his circle of friends?!

Told in both five-panel and story comics, dive into the colorful and diverse stories of Shiho and his friends, mixed with a spoonful of romance!

title: Futsuu no Koitte Nani?
description:
**Is my "red string of fate" connected to you?**

The high school first year "me" that fell in love at first sight at the school entrance ceremony. But that love was not normal...
A yuri story depicted from the point of view of three high school girls.

title: Let's Hide My Little Brother (Promo)
description:
The fate of a girl in a BL novel is a tragic one. Girls are either vaguely helpful, evil, or add nothing to the plot. So what happens when you turn into the older sister of a BL novel protagonist? 

The older sister who dies a tragic death at the hands of a madman who’s infatuated with your younger brother? 

You go with your gut instinct: hide him. Hide your brother from everything, especially men, that could harm him and you. That’s the task that Kyla Vesta is set with in this life, and a task that she’s determined to complete.

title: Mizu wa Umi ni Mukatte Nagareru
description:
Naotatsu is set to stay with his uncle as he enters a new high school. However, a woman he has never met, Sakaki-san, picks him up at the station.  
He now shares a house with a salaryman who quit to become a mangaka unbeknownst his parents (the uncle), a cross-dressing fortune teller, a college professor, and a 25 year old office lady all quirky in their own ways. Naotatsu, a high school freshman, begins the strange days of living under the same roof with them.  
  
Ranked #2 in 2020 by Freestyle Magazine  
Ranked #5 in the 2020 Manga Taisho Awards  
Ranked #5 in the 2020 Kono Manga ga Sugoi! Awards for male readers  
Won "New Creator Prize" in the 2020 Tezuka Osamu Cultural Award

title: Ki ni Naru Mori-san
description: Makishima-kun is a very shy 2nd year high school student who loves gardening and has problems socializing, which makes it difficult for him to interact and make friends. One day he meets Mori-san, a girl with a very serious expression who transforms into a tree every time she gets nervous… 2 Clumsy kids and a love story.

title: Nanoka no Kare
description:
First confession in life. but to see the face only a moment after confession!? calm and deep love story is about to begin.  
  
Nanoka's friends are only interested in boys, leaving Nanoka feeling alone and left out. The truth is, she had a boyfriend before, but was left so heartbroken by his lies that she's not interested in dating anymore. That's what she thought, until an overheard conversation moves her so much that she ends up suddenly confessing to a boy that she's never even seen!

title: Koi ni Koisuru Yukari-chan
description:
*Are Takagi-san and Nishikata-kun going out?*  
  
A girly(?) love comedy about Takagi-san's classmates. Made with the seal of approval from the original author, Yamamoto Souichirou.

---
- **Won the Takagi-san Cup Grand Prize in 2017**

title: Otokonoko ga Kouhai ni Kokuhaku sareru Hanashi
Straight Outta Manhwa
description: It tells the romance of Chun Namwook the main male character of a manhwa of more than 10 years old who appears in front of the high school girl Han Seonyeo. Inside of the manga “Seonyeo and Namwook” he comes from, the lead female character is also named Seonyeo and she looks like her. Seonyeo’s school life stars to get twist when Namwook comes out of the manga and began to live with her under the same roof.

title: Yuri na Watashi to Akuma na Kanojo (?)
description: As a child, Yashiro Nonoyama developed an intense fear of men due to boys constantly bullying her. Now in high school, she dreams of being reunited with her first love: a girl who protected her one day from her bullies. Yashiro is in disbelief when a transfer student named Mikoto Saionji arrives who looks a lot like her first love, but she later discovers that Mikoto is actually a guy, and that he was her first love. Yashiro learns that Mikoto is rapidly turning into a girl, and the only way to counteract this change is for them to passionately make out with each other every day.

title: Sweet Bitter
description: Mizuha is in a one-sided love with a college student named Ren. Mizuha's whole world revolves around him until she meets a guy named Chiaki who sits next to her and is a pudding loving weirdo, who freaks out if you insult pudding.

title: Marvelous Kiss
description:
At the start of his difficult journey to find a bride, the Strega (witch) young man named Noah was accidentally kissed (through CPR) by the popular male student, Mattis, due to some circumstances and turned into a girl!  
  
This phenomenon is called “Marvelous Kiss”. If an unmarried Strega kisses someone of the same gender, their gender will be changed into the opposite one.  
  
But, despite the gender change, Noah recklessly approaches Mattis to learn how to be popular! Will Noah ever be able to find a marriage partner at this rate…?!

title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau: Koushiki Comic Anthology
description: The first official "Sasayaku You ni Koi o Utau'" comic anthology is here! Talented authors with unique styles tell stories that begin with a crush at first sight. [Participating Authors] COVER: Aono Nachi. ILLUSTRATIONS: Yosuke Kaneda, Miman. COMICS: Aotsubaki Toto, Aono Shimo, Ito Hachi, Inui, Utatane Yuu, Sikusiku, Torii Shizuku, Nekotarou, Haruhana Aya, Mukunoki Nanatsu, Yuama, Yukiko.

title: Strike the Blood
description:
The fourth primogenitor - is the strongest vampire who exists only in the world of legends; yet when this masters the 12 kenju, the spread of the catastrophe of the vampires will appear in Japan.  
  
 In order to spy on and erase this, "fourth primogenitor," the government owned Lion organization have decided to send an attacking magician, "sword shaman" to complete the task. Yet unknowingly, the one who was selected to spy was actually a trainee "sword shaman" girl - Himeragi Yukina.

[OAV III](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=21273) (sequel to OAV II)

title: Home Room
description: Sakurai Sachiko, một nữ sinh cấp ba đang phải trải qua cuộc sống học đường vô cùng khó khăn và mệt mỏi khi cô thường xuyên phải chịu đựng những trò đùa ác ý từ một kẻ nào đó. Và mỗi khi cô gặp rắc rối thì thầy Aida, một giáo viên chính trực và điển trai sẽ xuất hiện để giúp đỡ cô. Đối với Sakurai, thầy Aida là một người hùng nhưng với thầy Aida thì Sakurai là...

title: One Morning I Woke Up
description: A boy suddenly wakes up to find out he's in the body of a High School girl. Who is she and how did he switch bodies?

title: Kodama Maria Bungaku Shuusei
description:
Follow the unique and intense activities of the literature club, consisting of the flawless Kodama-san, the president as well as its only member, and Fueda-kun, the promising applicant.  
  
Was nominated for the 24th Osamu Tezuka Cultural Prize.

title: Kimajime Seito Kaichou wa Koi ni Azato Sugiru
description: The cool beauty Miyako Teshigawara is the school's student council president. She is a serious-looking girl whom everyone respected... She has a crush on Shinobu Oshiro, a guy with glasses who is always reading! But the truth is that Miyako has never been in love before...? So she decided the only way to get close to him is to "get aggressive!"

title: B Gata H Kei
description:
B Gata H Kei revolves around fifteen-year old high school student Yamada, whose lascivious nature causes her to aspire to one day achieve sexual relations with one hundred different partners. However, her insecurities as a virgin lead her to reject every guy who attempts to make a move on her. In order to overcome this mental barrier, Yamada goes on a search for her “golden cherry”, an inexperienced boy upon whom she will bestow the right to be her first. One day while perusing a bookstore for the replacement of a dictionary she had defiled by highlighting all the sexual terms, Yamada has a fateful encounter with classmate Kosuda Takashi. Believing that Kosuda is the boy she is looking for, Yamada goes to great lengths to try and seduce him. All the while, she discovers the difficulties in making that first important step towards reaching her goals, not to mention, finding out her true feelings for Kosuda Takashi.  
  
Link:  
[AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclo

title: Kyuuketsuki ni Shite yo♡
description:
The high school girl, Kijima's career aspiration is to become a vampire…?
Can the vampire teacher, Hazama, resist his desire (appetite) in a thrilling situation where it would be a crime if he were to lay a hand on her?

title: Zettai ni Tokimeite wa Ikenai!
description:
After getting turned down by the guy she had a crush on for ages, Sakura thought things couldn't get much worse... until she realized that she had been seen! Embarrassed, defeated, and exhausted, the only thing keeping her going was that she was about to meet her cute little step-brother... until it turns out that her "cute little brother" was not only a tall, handsome guy in her class, but he was the one who'd seen her get rejected! Now Sakura has to pretend everything is cool, but with an over-protective "little brother" who sees the best in Sakura, and an aloof crush who starts to take an interest, Sakura's high-school life will be anything but easy!

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by m&c! Comics as **You Must Never Be In Love** (2019)

title: Kids on the Slope
description:
Nishimi Kaoru has moved from city to city and school to school because of his father’s job. So the first day at his new school was just routine for him. Being intellectual and the new transfer student, he has always been seen as an outcast and all Kaoru had to do was bear it until the next time he moved. But things were slightly different this time. First, he started to get close to the class president, Mukae Ritsuko, and, secondly, unlikely as it seemed, grew closer to Kawabuchi Sentaro. Sentaro was infamous for getting into fights, skipping class and was an overall bad boy. Strangely enough, the three of them find common ground in music, namely jazz, and Kaoru finds himself actually enjoying the new town.  

---  
- It won the 57th Shogakukan Manga Award for general manga.  
- Volumes 1-6 contain unrelated oneshot extras at the end.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Apollon on The Slope** (2010; including Bonus Track)

title: MonsTABOO
description:
Suzuki Maruka has a secret. When she was young, her father turned into a monster and killed her mother.  
Since then, she has been extremely lonely and accepting of her death, wondering what makes her so messed up.

title: Higashi no Kurume to Tonari no Meguru
description: Kousuke has a boring high-school life, but he sits next to his crush–the really popular, cute Tsukahara Meguru, who has a cool, stoic personality. One day, his parents announce that they're moving, but that he'll still be able to attend the same school. The new apartment building has a lovely river and friendly neighbors… and it is next door to where Tsukahara lives! Outside of school, she seems to have a completely different personality, friendly and a little quirky. She makes him promise not to tell the others at school how she acts at home, but why does she put on such an act for her classmates?

title: Hiyori-chan no Onegai wa Zettai
description:
Kadokawa synopsis:  
  
"My requests are absolute."  
　Hamure Hiyori can make any of her "requests" come true. Our love, which was never meant to begin, will turn my life and the entire world on its head.  
　She's warm, cute, and somewhat air-headed.  
　Even so, she has the power of her "requests" that no one can resist once they hear it, and yet, I, who's just an ordinary person, will accompany her on her fate.  
"But, please forget about it."  
　The world can easily come apart, but our love is the only thing that will never end.  
　This may be the last love story in a world that could never end.  
———————-  
Hamure Hiyori. From the moment she confessed her love to me, I thought we were going to spend our days as a normal couple. Until I learned of her special ability…  
This is a sweet and sad love story between a boy and a girl who has the power that will drag the whole world with it.

title: Ai Rabu Yuu yori Aishiteru
description: Kazumi Shinjou, who is a delinquent, and Risa Takaoka, who is a model student, become unexpected friends.

title: Otouto no Otto
description:
Ten years ago Yaichi's twin brother moved to Canada and married a man called Mike. A month ago, he died.  
  
Now Mike has arrived in Japan to meet Yaichi and his daughter Kana. Yaichi has to face his own preconceptions and come to terms with who his brother really was.  
  
[Official English](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/545416/my-brothers-husband-volumes-1-and-2-by-gengoroh-tagame/)

Adapted to [Live Action](https://www.cinra.net/article/column-201803-otoutonootto) in 2018.

---
- **Won the 19th Japan Media Arts Festival Division Excellence Award in 2015**
- **Won the 47th Japan Cartoonists Association Excellence Award in 2018**

title: Koi ni Dokubari
description: Youthful, real love between a pure girl x sharp-tongued boy. ‘The boy I’ve had a long unrequited love for has found himself a girlfriend. On top of that, she’s my best friend. Even though I’m the one who met him and fell in love with him first. Why did he not choose me…?’ Heart-broken Aya meets Ryuu, an unpredictable, older boy. Aya gradually begins to be drawn to this sharp-tongued, but kind Ryuu. However, this love isn’t straightforward at all. “When you fall in love, you can’t keep being a ‘kind, good girl’.” Ryuu’s words pierce her heart, doesn’t disappear and is painful, but…?

title: Oreimo: Kuroneko
description: Ore No Kouhai ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai follows the experiences of Ruri Gokou and Kyousuke Kousaka, as they both begin to explore the feelings that they have for each other. Will they be able to acknowledge their feelings for each other, or will they reach a standstill in their pursuit of happiness?

title: Gemini wa Otoshigoro
description: She was just my classmate until yesterday but now she's my cute girlfriend☆! But everyday is nerve racking with her almost identical twin brother around. This is the popular three man fluff + meddling brother romantic comedy!

title: Oniichan Control
description:
Hirose Goushi has a huge sister complex. So huge, he moves from his home town to Tokyo to attend Myouzen University in order to escape it!  
  
Three years later, Goushi's little sister Noa shows up and informs him that she's taking the Myouzen University entrance exam and that she will be moving in if she passed. Little does Goushi know, she has a similarly large (if not larger) brother complex.  
  
Read as Goushi attempts to hide his feelings for his sister, while she purposefully sets him up for failure.

title: Yuki ni Tsubasa
description:
Tsubasa lives in a hotspring town that is about to fade away from a bad economy. He is a middle school delinquent, and is beat up at school almost every day. He has a secret, though: he is a psychic, but he is embarrassed of this fact because his abilities are "lame" and not worth bragging about. One day, however, he realizes that he can read the mind of a mute girl named Yuki.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by m&c! Comics as The Snow Falling Into My Wings (2016)

title: Unmei no Hito to Deaeru Koisuru Apuri
description:
One day at school, a friend shows Hiroto Kyono a new app called "Meet your Soulmate".  
  
However, Kyono is indifferent to love and doesn't believe in fortune-telling apps…until Kyono meets a guy on the train who looks exactly like how the app described his soulmate!  
  
Could this guy really be his soulmate?   
  
How can Kyono close the distance between them so they can become friends? And then something more?

title: Kiryuin Kaya ni Chi wo Suwareru dake no Kantan na Oshigoto
description: It's a simple job, getting your blood sucked by Kaya Kiryuuin. Or…is it?

title: Missions of Love
description:
In class, she's a sort of zoned-out girl, and he's the year one class' most perfect, good-looking guy. But the two of them have a secret, and their extraordinary "love experience" will start now!  
  
Himuro Yukina, known as the "Absolute Zero Snow-woman" is a cold and observant girl. In addition, she is actually a popular cell phone novelist who goes by the name of Yupina. Sadly, with no other human contact than her cousin, Yukina is unable to express more romance in her novels. Kitami Shigure, your so-called "typical bishounen", who is really a womanizer, has fallen into Yukina's trap when she blackmails him, and they end up "love-acting" for the sake of their secrets.

title: 10 Nichi Go ni Hametsu Saserareru Kanojo
Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 2-nensei-hen 2nd Stage
description:
Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School—a dream-like school that boasts a 100% college and job placement rate, and provides 100,000 yen worth of points every month.

However, its true nature was a "meritocracy" where only a select few of the most academically successful students received favorable treatment.

Ayanokoji and the others, who belong to Class D, known as the "last refuge for failures," somehow managed to advance to the second year.
But their joy was short-lived, as they were at the mercy of the first-year students in a special exam held soon after the new school year began.

Furthermore, figures who are moving in the shadows to take down Ayanokoji have appeared, including those involved in "a top-secret exam communicated to only a few students" and "assassins from the White Room."

This work is a sequel to the comic series Classroom of the Elite: Year 2

title: 1×1/2-Ichi to Nibun no Ichi-
description: Remake of Taiyaki's 1 x ½.

title: Living with a Villainous Boss
description: All I did was defeat the highest level BOSS in the game and make fun of him while doing my usual streaming, and now he crossed over to my world and isn't going back??? Please give me advice on how to bring him back. URGENT, I'll be online waiting!!

title: Kohinata-san Wants to Confess
description: A story about the shy Kohinata-san as she tries to confess her love to her childhood friend, Kageyama-kun.

title: Ienai Himitsu No Aishikata
description: High School teacher Saeki Nao is secretly a hardcore otaku who loves yuri manga. One day, at a doujinshi convention they participate in, Nao is eager to convey her feelings to "Nyapoleon", an artist she worships. However, it turned out to be a girl from her school, Kurumizawa Haruka, and moreover, she had to help her. After the event, they decided to go out for a meal, at Haruka's suggestion... When she wakes up in the morning, there is Haruka in the bed...?!

title: Nigashita Sakana wa Ookikatta ga Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ookisugita Ken
description:
From a very young age, people noticed that Maria, the youngest daughter of a duke, was filled with potential. She was raised as the heiress of her house, until the birth of her baby brother relieves her of her duties. She scrambles to find a husband, but all the eligible bachelors in her duchy are taken! At this rate, she's doomed to the life of a spinster!

Maria decides to study abroad in Rubini in hopes of finding a husband, with the help of her distant relative, Aida. But in a twist of fate, the Crown Prince breaks of his engagement with Maria, even though they've never met before! "Huh?! I don't remember getting engaged!?"

title: Tsuredure Children (Pre-Serialization)
description:
A collection of hilarious 4-panel romcom comics from Wakabayashi Toshiya.
___
**Alt Official Raws:**
- [Archived Original Website](https://web.archive.org/web/20150519031125/http://tsuredurechildren.blog40.fc2.com/) - Contains the first 31 chapters in their original form.

- Some of the earlier chapters were, with additional bonus pages, released as doujinshis.

title: Nagai Aida Soen datta Osananajimi no Koto ga Suki ni Natte Iku Hanashi
Less Than Friends
description: Saeki Kaoru is the coolest girl in school, but she's also mysterious and intimidating. But in truth, she is just shy, and also have a crush on the meek Himura Miharu.

title: I'll Be with Them Again Today
description: When a new family moves in next door, Nao is curious to meet them. After watching them move in, she discovers that the family has two sons: Kyousuke, a handsome and playful boy who’s the same age as Nao, and Tomoyasu, the younger brother with a scary face and unapproachable personality. At school, Nao finds that associating herself with the attractive brothers could put her in a difficult position, so she pleads to Kyousuke to keep their situation a secret. How will Kyousuke react? And how will Nao, a seventeen-year-old with no experience in love, deal with his response?!

title: Kyoudai Complex
description: The virgin elder brother, Okada Naoto, and the younger sister who's unaware of the concept of chastity, Machi. Machi, who often teases her brother who's never been able to get a girlfriend, and also a virgin of 20 years, with offers to fondle her boobs. While the dominant one in the Okada family is Machi, the one that she's obsessed with is...?

title: Toshishita Yankee o Oseru Ken
description: A dangerous love comedy between a brilliant high school student and a younger delinquent starts! Nachi, a fan of a cute male character of a social network game, decides to make use of her abilities as the top student of her grade and becomes a part-time tutor in order to earn money and pay for items in her game. However, her student, Soushi, is not only younger but also a delinquent with red hair! Tutor Nachi, who is even prepared to face even death, starts to see Soushi's cute side…?!

title: Not Lives
description: Mikami is only in high school, but he is a game designer genius. He has created many popular games ranging from RPGs to Action titles, even puzzle games. At his classmate’s request, he decides his next project will be a romance game, so he begins to gather research material that will help him make another hit game. But when Mikami gets home, he finds a game called Not Alive that he doesn’t remember buying. When he tries to play the game, the CD seems to go inside him, and he awakens in a part of town that seems frozen in time.

title: Hello, Innocent
description:
From cotton candy scans:  
  
Yukito is a handsome scholarship student who also excels at sports. Just starting high school, he has never had the time to think about things like love.  
  
One day, he was saved by a girl he didn't know. Turns out, she's actually Yukito’s classmate who’s been absent since the school’s opening ceremony…

title: I Saw the Cool Beauty Famous for Being an Iron Wall Secretly Going Out with Someone
description:
The class's no. 1 most beautiful girl gets the tables turned on her by a plain girl.

| female | big breasts, females only, fingering, yuri |

title: Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist's Journey
description:
This is an autobiography that tells the story of Akiko Hayashi, the author as she was in her third year of high school at the beginning of the story. Through her friend Futami, Akiko starts going to an art class led by Kenzou Hidaka, an intimidating teacher who spends much of his time yelling at his students and keeping them focused on drawing with the use of a bamboo sword. Akiko is initially confused by the behavior of the teacher and her fellow students in the class, but she keeps going regardless, eventually becoming the mangaka she is today.

[Official English](http://www.sevenseasentertainment.com/series/blank-canvas-my-so-called-artists-journey-kakukaku-shikajika/)

---
- **Won the 8th Manga Taisho in 2015** 
- **Won the 19th Japan Media Arts Festival Grand Prize for Manga**

title: Fox's Wedding
description:
Ousuke is some random geek who seems to have terrible luck. He wishes for nothing more but to get rid of his terrible luck & to be able to have a normal, peaceful school life, and so he prays for that wish at a fox altar.  
  
Upon praying to a fox statue his life seems to take an unexpected turn for the better….or is it for the worse?

title: The Immortal Emperor Luo Wuji Has Returned
description: Huynh đệ liên tiếp phản bội, một đời tiên tôn cứ thế gục ngã. Tuy rằng thân xác đã chết, nhưng Thần hồn không diệt! Nhờ vào bảo vật "Thái Hoàng Kinh" thay đổi nhân quả, trở lại địa cầu, phá bỏ nghiệp chướng, diệt trừ thần phật. Kiếp này quyết dùng danh "vô cực " đạp lên trên Thiên Địa Nhật Nguyệt!

title: Koi Inu
description: Igarashi is now in college. The bittersweet memories that he left behind in childhood are now beginning to resurface when he meets his childhood friend Chiyo-chan again after 10 years.

title: Itsuya-san
description: Toki's had it rough. His parents are out of the picture, and he's ready to give up his education in order to get a job and take care of his sick grandma. When his school intervenes to help him out, he winds up living with the quirky substitute art teacher Itsuya and a mysterious girl named Kon. Itsuya also happens to have a little magic, and she uses it to help out those who cross her path — including the young pair boarding with her.

title: Tomo-Chan Wa Onnanoko (Fan Colored)
description:
Tomo Aizawa and Junichirou "Jun" Kubota are the tightest bros you'd ever see. They roughhouse and spar, but through thick and thin, they've got each other's back. Yet, there's just one small problem: Tomo is in love with Jun!

Since she was young, tomboyish Tomo has been just another one of the guys; due to his extreme muscle-brained nature, Jun doesn't notice any of her advances—not even when she explicitly confesses. To add insult to injury, for the longest time, he didn't even realize that she was a girl.

Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko! follows the comedic hijinks of Tomo and her friends as she tries to catch Jun's eye and escape the infamous brozone.

---
**Notes:**
- This colored version is from the "Coloring pages of Tomo-Chan until I finish, give up, or die" posts on reddit /r/manga by /u/fukai20.

title: Change 1 2 3
description: In Change 123, we meet Motoko, a girl with a very strange problem. In order to cope with her 3 adoptive fathers' incredibly intensive training methods, she developed multiple personalities, each with a different martial specialty. But what happens if none of them can beat her opponent on their own? And what further nugget of wisdom will be imparted by the great Kamen Raider?

title: School Rumble
description:
She's a second-year high school student with a single all-consuming question: Will the boy she likes ever really notice her? He's the school's most notorious juvenile delinquent and he's suddenly come to a shocking realization: He's got a huge crush, and now he must tell her how he feels.  
  
Chapter 232 does not exist, there's no chapters missing.  
  
Special Chapters:  
  
bb1 What's up Doc (February 9, 2010)  
Diamonds on the Inside (November 30, 2016)  
Give it Away (March 15, 2017)  
Hello Again (November 8, 2017)

title: Tonari no Seki no Kowai Onnanoko no Hanashi
The Disciplinary Committee Enforces Yuri
description:
That Public Morals Committee Member is being a pain. Let's make fun of her.

(**Each chapter is different and does not follow one another**.)

title: Seito Kaichou desu ga Josou Hajimemashita
description: Jun Shiraishi has longed for years to be friends with another girl, something she tells a guy who tries to ask her out one day. Spurred on by his feelings for her, he grants her wish by cross-dressing and making friends with her as "Nai".

title: Tsuri Chichi Nagisa
description: Shinta loves nothing more than girls, their school uniform, and their breasts. On the other hand, Shirasu was desperately looking for more members for the Fishing Club. Shinta, as the new transfer student, becomes the target of Shirasu for the Fishing Club. She persistently requests that he join the Fishing Club, but he strongly refuses because he has no interest in fishing. However, his joining of the Fishing Club becomes inevitable when he is saved from bullies by the well known "Tsuri-Chichi" Nagisa, apparently an expert in fishing. She has superb skills in fishing to a point where she can use her fishing rod as a weapon. Strong, yet kind, and having huge breasts, Nagisa becomes a trigger that changes Shinta's perspective of fishing as she guarantees that Shinta has the potential of becoming a professional fisher.

title: Shishiou Subaru ni Kara Mareru!!
description:
I just managed to beat her today....

A one-way battle with a girl who is super competitive and determined to win, no matter what it takes!
The days of never-ending competition begin!

title: Rewriting the Villainess
description: Laisa, the villain in the webtoon has been possessed by the body of the original webtoon writer, Yoo Do-Eun! It's unfair to be possessed by this world, but I'm a villain who is destined to die!? This is a story of a writer's strategy to change her ending.

title: The Young Lady Was Completely Exposed For Preparing a Bento For Her Childhood Friend
Persona 3
description:
A teenager who was orphaned as a young boy returns to the city of his childhood. Shortly after transferring to Gekkoukan High School, he is attacked by Shadows — creatures that feed on the minds of their victims. He soon discovers that he shares a special ability with other students at his new school. From them, he learns of the "Dark Hour," a hidden time that exists between one day and the next, swarming with Shadows. He joins the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad (SEES), and with his new friends, confronts the threat of the Shadows.  
  
Based on the PlayStation 2 game of the same name.

title: Yǒngzhě Shì Nǚhái
description:
I had a crush on my campus idol Luna.  
And one day the girl belonged to me flesh and soul,   
but not in my way, we exchanged our bodies.   
I became her! And her fragile body and D cup were all mine!  
All this is to blame a weird guy claimed to be a magician from another world.   
And he called me Hero who was to save the world which was in danger.   
So the Hero has to save the world meanwhile protecting his/ her body from bad guys and lesbian girls.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Home Alone
description:
Another day of house-sitting for Azusagawa Kaede. As long as her beloved onii-chan is by her side, she was fine with staying home all day, but a desire to change has started growing in her mind... Experience the adolescence story, with Kaede as the main character, in a way only possible through manga.

*From ComicWalker, translated*

title: Zero no Tsukaima
description: Louise is a student at Tristein Magical Academy. She is known to be quite a screw up when it comes to her magic. One day, a ceremony takes place where each student is to call forth a being or entity that will become his or her familiar. For Louise, her familiar comes in the form of a boy named Hiraga Saito. Somehow, he managed to get transported from his world into hers, and shortly after became her familiar.

title: Renai Symphony
description: Genuine and enthusiastic love, love, and more love! This is the start of a super-sweet school love comedy, let's go!

title: Otokonoko ni Nacchatta Joshikousei
description:
One day, high school girl Kamishiro Tsumugi suddenly becomes a boy...?! A new everyday life begins with her female childhood friend and the boys in her class.
___
This is a different story, set in the same world as '[Zenbu Kimi no Sei](https://mangadex.org/title/82476383-e6a9-41a7-b98c-87cc8be9efbb/zenbu-kimi-no-sei)'

title: Onee Danshi, Hajimemasu.
description: Regular high school boy Toru Takahashi is in love with high school girl Yuri Otogane, but she’s not really into guys. Toru decides to win Yuri’s heart by embracing his feminine side so he enlists the help of one of his “girly” friends, Toranosuke Sagara, to help develop his sense of beauty…

title: Osananajimi no Manga
description:
Haruaki has been observing two of his friends, Yuki and Toshi, who clearly have feelings for each other denying their relationship. More so, he keeps getting pulled into their shenanigans and it really gets on his nerves.

---

**Note:** Previously, it was a webcomic posted on Twitter, but later the author further developed the story to be sold on COMITIA140.

title: Tora Kiss - A School Odyssey
description: Taketora, or Tora for short, is lazy High School-er who attends a co-ed school on a mysterious island called Academy Island, that appeared out of nowhere 18 years ago, and is said to contain information that will save the world. What made the island so mysterious was an object called "the Monument" which "Data" can be pulled out by students who can correspond with "the Monument", the "Data" can bring out animal like creatures used for many things and has helped the world over. What makes the main character so special, and why is he such a low ranker? How can kissing be troublesome for Tora? Find out as his world is shaken by girls who are out for him!

title: Gakkou no Madonna Gyaru wa Kimogari Nagara mo Boku o Motomeru
description: The school Madonna calls out a gross Otaku for something.

title: Pochamani
description: Mugi is a chubby girl with a kind spirit and beautiful smile. She is comfortable with her weight, but thought that she would never have the opportunity to fall in love. When she meets Tagami, a boy who is a "pochama," or someone who likes soft and squishy things, love has a chance to blossom, and Mugi comes to realize that she loves herself as is.

title: Shonan Junai-gumi!
description: Eikichi Onizuka and Ryuji Danma are members of infamous biker gang, Oni Baku. When not out riding around, they can be found in school, trying to pick up young women. This is the story of the young Onizuka, who would later become the greatest teacher in Japan.

title: Watashi no Gochisou wa, Kimi.
description: A cute and dangerous love story of a popular boy with glasses in class and a girl who has a desire to eat him starts.

title: Haru to Arashi
description: Tsubomi is in her second year of high school and has a crush on her homeroom teacher. She plans to give her teacher a birthday gift, but unfortunately his birthday falls on a weekend… After finding out that her classmate Fuma Yabuki is her teacher's cousin, she tried to get him to help her but despite being related to her homeroom teacher, who is nice and warm, Fuma is very standoffish and doesn't want to help her out. Will this be the start or the end of Tsubomi's love?

title: Date A Live
description:
April 10th. Yesterday was the last day of spring vacation, so starting this morning it was a school day. After being woken up by his cute little sister, Itsuka Shidou believed that it would be the start of another normal day. As for predicting the chance meeting with the girl who called herself a spirit……  
  
Along with a sudden shockwave, the townscape vanished without a trace. In a corner of the street which had now become a crater, the girl was there.  
  
"—You, have you come to kill me too?"  
  
She is the disaster that will destroy humanity, a monster of unknown origin, and a being rejected by the world. There are only two ways to stop this girl: annihilation, and conversation. His little sister Kotori, wrapped in a military uniform, thus said to Shidou: "Since it's like this, just go date her, and make the spirit fall for you!" "Wh.. whaaaaaaaat!?" Enter a new age of boy meets girl!!

title: My Elder Sister's Friend
description: At the age of 14, her first lover was her sister's former best friend, Kyouko. It was a time where Noriko would meet Kyouko after school and be thrilled by the smell of her adult perfume and enchanting eyes, nothing like spending time with her boring classmates. But why did Kyouko and her sister stop being friends in the first place? This is the story of three women and their discovery of what true “love” entails.

title: Our Similarities
description: You must take the fall with me.The abuse people suffer during their childhood will all burst out all at once when they grow up. Some people choose to vent their anger to the outside world, but some people will only keep it in and torture themselves.

title: BOX! Kira Ito Tanpenshuu
description:
A work packed with stories that make you cry, smile, and heal. A compilation of original short stories, including commercial oneshots and manga previously published on Twitter or Pixiv.

List of Stories (in **bold** = scanlated):
+++**Volume 1 Contents:**
1. **Welcome to the Departed Spirit Funeral Home (Oneshot)** (ようこそ亡霊葬儀屋さん (読切版)): Original on [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/72034786), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/kilightit/status/1394956053461315585).
One-shot version of *[Youkoso Bourei Sougiya-san](https://mangadex.org/title/99f1aa23-d9b5-432f-ba51-591985f76607/)*.
2. **Welcome to the Departed Spirit Funeral Home - After Story** (一描き下ろし後日話)
A newly drawn after story of *[Youkoso Bourei Sougiya-san](https://mangadex.org/title/99f1aa23-d9b5-432f-ba51-591985f76607/)*.
3. **My Childhood Friend Is a Crybaby** (俺の幼馴染みは泣き虫だ): Original on [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/79083715), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/kilightit/status/1374662950787551232).
4. **Four Patterns o

title: Ayaka-san wa Damegitsune
description:
Ayaka, a fox spirit (kitsune), is not your typical divine being. Despite her supernatural origins, she is clumsy, overly eager, and struggles with her duties as a guardian spirit. Determined to help humans in her unique way, Ayaka’s well-intentioned but often misguided attempts lead to comedic and heartwarming situations.

Set against the backdrop of daily life and infused with mythological elements, the story follows Ayaka as she navigates her role in the human world, forming unexpected relationships and learning the true meaning of her responsibilities. With a mix of humor, romance, and supernatural charm, Ayaka-san wa Damegitsune delivers a lighthearted yet touching narrative.

title: Starting Today, It's My Turn!!
description: After Mitsuhashi’s family moves into a new neighborhood, he decides to use the opportunity to become a delinquent. Upon meeting Itou he finds out that he wasn’t the only one who had this idea. Making friends and foes along the way will these two take over their school or just end up as wannabes?

title: Full Metal Panic!
description:
Trouble always seems to follow the beautiful and sassy, Kaname Chidori. Though she is only a high-school student, Kaname is constantly the target of terrorism. Lucky for her though, the dreamy Sosuke, an undercover agent from Mithril, is one step behind her, ready to protect her at any cost. But will he be able to save her from harm every time she is in trouble?
___
**Character Designer:** [Shikidouji](https://mangadex.org/author/5841d294-69b1-4584-90a2-fd480b5f9b12)

title: Watashi ni Ai wo Oshiete
description: Though a bit of a fool, but hardworking, Suku, a second-year high school student and the new student council president, is in love with his reliable vice president, Ririka. However, for some reason, they always end up fighting. One day, Suku gathers the courage to confess to Ririka, but at that moment, he falls into a time loop. Every time he confesses, the loop resets! How can he ever date Ririka? A romantic comedy with a sci-fi twist, offering a heartwarming school story!

title: School Shock
description:
In XX AD, a new generation of arms race is emerging. “Vanguards” are the new type of weapons being used on the battlefield. Liu Li is a Vanguard that is about to retire. In her last 380 days she receives her final mission…  


---

**Wikipedia**

title: ผู้ชนะรักนี้ต้องเป็นฉัน
description: Although Captain is handsome, kind, and good at sports, he’s also an avid gamer. That’s the reason why Kiss decided to start learning how to play games in hopes of winning over the senior she has a crush on. However, this turned out to be the beginning of an unexpected online relationship between Kiss and Miguel, who is secretly the world's number one pro player!

title: Chigau Class no Suki na Hito
description:
On the evening of the summer festival, my sandals caused a foot blister so that I couldn't walk anymore, but then Takada-kun, a boy from my parallel class, stepped in to help me out.

A straight and pure-hearted love, as well as all the intricacy of adolescence that comes with it.

title: For You, I Will Follow Obediently
description: Xia Yu Xiang was born in a family devoted to raising butlers and was trained from a young age to dedicate his life to protecting his master. Finally, Xia Yu Xiang is presented with an opportunity to make use of his skills when he is recruited by the Zong Zheng family to be a butler. Zong Zheng Tong is a young, petite, genius girl with cold, distant blue eyes, and a stern, rigid personality. How will Xia Yu Xiang react to his new master?

title: The Always-Sleepy Classmate Wants Help
description:
When the new seating change comes to their class, Kogoshi-kun finds himself sitting next to the ever-tired Oki-san.  
She has a request, though: wake her up whenever she falls asleep without letting the teacher know.

title: Shinobi Shijuusou
description:
Chouko Manaka is the next heir to the prestigious Manaka family. Now she is entering high school and she has had enough with being surrounded by bodyguards, who have prevented her from making any friends. Her father is still worried though, so he makes a deal with her. If she transfers to Mizuno-o high school, where many of the students are also studying to be shinobi and can get one of these people to be her right-hand man by graduation, he'll consider her to be able to make decisions for herself.  
On the first day of school Chouko meets the son of their butler, who suddenly declares that he wants her to be his master?!

title: Hatsukoi to Taiyou
description: We can fall in love no matter how many times, but first love happens only once. “Romance is impossible in elementary school!” Koharuko, a 6th grader, is popular with girls because of her mature personality, but boys always pull a prank on her. She doesn’t like how childish boys are, so she wasn’t interested in anyone. On the other hand, since she fell for Ichijou, a brazen boy, everyday has been dazzling. It’s a real love story of a new generation set in elementary school!

title: Boku ni Hana no Melancholy
description: When Hana was a child visiting her mother's grave, she got to know a young boy named Yuzuru. He was Hana's first love. When she heard that he ended up moving away, she thought that it wouldn't be possible to see him anymore, but…?

title: Strobe Edge
description: Ninako, a high school student, has never been in love. She asks her friend Daiki, who has feelings for her, about what being in love feels like. She thinks he is a good guy but…? One day, on the train home from school, she bumps into Ren, a popular guy at school. With just a short conversation and his smile, she experiences a new feeling. Just what is this feeling…!? Ninako’s first love is starting!

title: Men Men Musubi
description:
1. Men Men Musubi
2. Osorosoroi
3. Fuusen Kazura wa Kyou mo Tobanai
4. Kuiki-gai Kandan-ryou
5. Flying Cosmos
6. Hatsu Arashi no Tsumugi Uta
7. Kuramujii Call

title: Moukin-chan
description:
Moukin Rui is a strange girl. She can turn her neck 180 degrees and jump down from tall trees without a problem.
There is a certain thing even a girl like her is worried about, though…

title: Midori no Hibi
description:
Seiji Sawamura is the toughest seventeen-year-old in town, feared by all for his fighting prowess and his deadly "devil's right hand." But at heart, Seiji is a softy, and all he wants is an end to his seventeen-year history of being a lonely single guy. Unfortunately his tough-guy reputation only serves to decrease his popularity with the ladies.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Midori's Days** (2007; complete)

title: Swimming Lessons for a Mermaid
description: Lee Soo-young takes notice of Shin Cho-ah at a swimming competition. Despite telling him that she 'hates water', it turns out that there's more than meets the eye… especially when she touches water.

title: Ame to Umi
description:
Một ngày nọ, sau khi đã nhập học cao trung được một tuần, Otosaka Ame vô tình nhìn ra hành lang thì bắt gặp bóng dáng của Kurasaki Umi – cô bạn cùng lớp, cũng là bạn chung trường sơ trung, người đã “cúp học không phép” ngay từ đầu năm.

Ngay cả khi chịu đi học, Umi lúc nào cũng chỉ cười xã giao và luôn nhìn xuống đất. Ame cảm thấy lo lắng cho cô ấy nên đã bắt chuyện với Umi…

Câu chuyện thanh xuân “boy-meets-girl” bắt đầu từ việc đối mặt với những “phiền phức nhỏ nhặt trong đời thường” – chính thức mở màn!!

title: Medusa-Chan Whose Emotions Appear in Her Hair
Yuutousei wa Unmei no Akai Ito ni Sakaraitai
description:
There's a red thread tied to my finger, and at the other end is... the yankee who sits next to me?

One day, straight-laced honor student Miyanari suddenly sees a red thread connecting him to his yankee classmate Hashiba. "There's no way this sort of person can be my destined partner!" is what Miyanari tells himself. However, perhaps through a trick of the red thread, Miyanari ends up in all kinds of situations with Hashiba, such as getting injured and being tended to, and getting trapped in an elevator together. As Miyanari continues to spend time with Hashiba, he realizes that Hashiba is nothing like his outwards appearance, and gradually comes to learn his kindness...

title: Shishunki no Iron Maiden
description:
Mayama Haruki and Himemiya Tsukiko have been childhood friends and neighbors for as long as they can remember, but after a girls-only meeting in fourth grade, Himemiya distanced herself from Mayama. Now in their 2nd year of middle school, Mayama has become an ero-freak who specializes in harassing Himemiya.  
  
Determined to unravel the greatest secret of girls, what happens on "that day", Mayama follows Himemiya and uncovers…!

title: Futsuu na Bokura no
description:
Our normal love story that is not "special".   
  
Tsubaki, who moved from Tokyo, fell in love with an older boy named Ibuki whom she met in the city during spring break. Shortly after, Tsubaki gave him a love letter and confessed that she wanted to have a "normal happy love" with him. However, Ibuki is deaf, and once Tsubaki found out the truth, he coldly pushed her away…?

title: Nikagetsugo ni Seibetsu ga Bareru Josou Danshi
description:
I enrolled in a prestigious girls academy, even though I'm actually a crossdressing boy?! But, in my class lies a secret as well...?

This prestigious school, St. Aster Girls Academy, is where I am entering as a first year. Unexpectedly, I had to crossdress in order to enroll! If my roommate or classmates found out I am a guy, it would be inexcusable!

title: Hatsukoi Tensei Near-Death Goddess
description: The reincarnation goddess, Ruri, falls in love at first sight with an ordinary boy, Kyoshirou Yosugi. Quickly abusing her authority, she reincarnates alongside him in the current world, intending to win his affection by offering him a cheat ability. However, she realizes that her powers can only be used during reincarnation. What fate awaits the man loved by the goddess of reincarnation...!?

title: Magic Kaito
description: Teenage magician Kaito Kuroba has a secret identity: that of Kaitou Kid, a famous internationally-known and wanted "phantom thief". Kaito took the identity after one day discovering that his late father was the original Kaitou Kid. Later on, he discovers his father, who died from an 'accident' during a magic trick, was really murdered because he would not steal the jewel Pandora for an evil organization. As Kaitou Kid, Kaito tries to find Pandora before that organization that killed his father do, and destroy it, leading Inspector Nakamori and his taskforce on the wildest jewel heists imaginable!

title: Maji de Watashi ni Koi Shinasai!
description: Kawakami Momoyo is a notorious, woman-chasing, large-breasted master fighter. She and her friends at school end up in all sorts of weird situations, often involving people attempting to defeat Momoyo. Now there are new transfer students from Germany joining their class. Who are these new students, and will they fit in with the crazy bunch surrounding Momoyo?

title: Stop!! Hibari-kun!
description: On her death bed, Kousaku Sakamoto's mother tells him that after she dies, he should go to Tokyo where he'll be taken care of by her friend Ibari Oozora and his family. Since his father died three years before and with no where else to go, Kousaku decides to go along with his mother's last request. However, he soon discovers that Ibari is the boss of the Oozora Group mob ring. Uneasy about his predicament, he considers leaving, but he has second thoughts when he meets Ibari's four daughters–Tsugumi, Tsubame, Suzume and Hibari–only to find out that Hibari is actually Ibari's only son. Now Kousaku must not only cope with living among mobsters but also with refusing Hibari's advances toward him.

title: Hitomae de wa Tsuntsun Shichau Tsundere Kanojo wo, Kantan ni Dere Saseru Houhou
description:
A cute oneshot about how our MC makes his tsuntsun girlfriend express her true feelings!  
  
Do support the artist! Link attached in raws.

title: I’m Cute Enough to Get Away with It!
description:
“I know it’s for my sister’s sake, but... Is it really all right to lie to a girl and sleep in the same room as her?!”

16-year-old shut-in Yoruhiko's twin sister, Akane, ends up in a coma after getting into an accident. Not wanting to ruin her perfect attendance, Yoruhiko decides to continue her record by going to school in her place. But, in order to do so, he must disguise himself as her and attend an all-girls boarding school! How will former recluse Yoruhiko keep up his act when surrounded by his sister's friends and roommate?

title: Kirawaremono no Koushaku Reijou.
description:
"Aim for a commoner life! I will spend my time as a commoner without getting a fiancé at the school!!"

The first party I attended when I was little. There, she was labeled as a "villainous daughter" by a noble woman, Luise. She is the daughter of the Duke of Otilie, who has become isolated in aristocratic society. While hated by those around her, she made her own efforts, but her time passed without being rewarded. While enduring such a difficult situation for her, Otilie decided to enroll in a school where royalty and aristocrats gathered...

title: I''s
description: Shy Ichitaka has a crush on his highschool classmate Iori, but ever since she posed for semi-provocative swimsuit photos in a magazine, she's had a lot of sleazy guys hitting on her. Ichitaka's afraid to make his feelings known for fear Iori will think he's just another creep.

title: Fruits Basket Another
description: The new series takes place in the same setting as the original Fruits Basket, Kaibara High School. It features a new female protagonist named Sawa who enrolls at the school.

title: Jinsei Hensachi 48 no Koukousei ga Kamisama ni Narimashita
description: Atsushi is a descendant of the guardian deity of the Heian period. His beautiful childhood friend, Yuki, is the daughter of the shrine erected to protect his family. But what Yuki doesn't know is Atsushi has a geas-like ability to command her to do whatever he wants! Will Atsushi be able to restrain his urges?

title: Peach Milk Crown
description:
Team Captain Yoichi Kouda is a high school track athlete "specializing" in 200m distance running. He has neither the speed for short distance, nor the stamina for long distance. And other events are out of the question because he has no agility whatsoever. What he does have is determination to train longer and harder than anyone else.  
  
On a team with a celebrated history but has declined in recent years, he is surrounded by teammates more talented but less motivated than he is, and he finds it harder and harder to motivate himself to improve, until the "cool beauty", Momo Tange walks into the picture, capturing the attention of the entire school, as well as Yoichi's heart.

title: Osananajimi ga Itsumademo Osananajimi Shitekuru Manga
description:
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/kage_bo/status/1186605245704486912)  
- [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/77427479)

title: The Story of the Captain and the Female Club Manager Going on a Date
description:
The Captain of the Judo Club is asked out by the Club Manager to go on a date.  
  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/perico_op?lang=en)  
- [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/778211)  
  
[Alternate Twitter Raw Link](https://twitter.com/i/events/1193562664418430976)

title: Tonari no Gyaru ga Miyabi Sugiru!?
description:
The new semester has begun, and the earnest high school student Kazesaki has just obtained his desired seat at the back row by the window. However, seated next to him is Tachibana-san, a gal who often has other gals gathering around her and they're always unruly. 

Kazesaki, whose peaceful life by the window has been disturbed, resentfully observes the behavior of these gals and notices that Tachibana-san's conduct is—unlike them—somehow more elegant...!?

(Source: Comic Zenon)

title: Minus Ondo no Serenade
description: Shouta Tanaka's father recently remarried, and to take advantage of their honeymoon, he leaves his son in the hands of his new wife's daughter, Kaoru. This begins a new cohabitation between the young Shouta and the impassive Kaoru, whom he particularly likes.

title: Hokenshitsu no Kageyama-kun
description: Hiyori, a high-school student with a complex about her small stature and elementary-schooler-like appearance, managed to get an injury thanks to her friends' teasing about her unrequited love. Unexpectedly, the infirmary is not only dark, but also has an underclassman, Kageyama, rather than the nurse. Even more unexpectedly, Kageyama suddenly confesses to being a vampire, having fallen for Hiyori at first sight, and then asks her to be his *food*. How is the modest Hiyori going to deal with this stubborn and addlebrained kohai?

title: My Girlfriend Will Be a Mangaka
description:
