Mizuno-kun knows a lot about comics. As his classmate and aspiring comic artist Kanzaki-san consults with him for romantic comedy advice, he gradually becomes more and more interested in her…!? A 100% pure and precious romcom!
___
[Video Comic (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=32ZedXNG3QM)

title: Genshiken Nidaime - The Society for the Study of Modern Visual Culture II
description:
Genshiken follows the lives of a group of college students drawn together by their shared hobbies, and the trials and adventures associated with being otaku.  
  
Genshiken Nidaime ("Second Generation") is a continuation of the previous series, with chapter numbering starting at 56.

title: Blue Archive - 1 Hoshino a Day (Doujinshi)
description: A daily slice-of-life adventure set in Jam To Cham's alternative Blue Archive timeline where Sensei came to help Abydos 2 years earlier.

title: Prism
description: Riding high on the memory of a boy named Hikaru with whom she spent a day during her last year of grade school, Megu went through middle school without romance. Now that she's a high school student, she has decided she is finally completely over her first love and can look towards the future. But! Megu meets a pretty girl on her first day of high school who gives her a big hug, and her name is Hikaru?!

title: Pink Ribbon
description:
Lumiao is a senior high school student who loves to dress up in frilly dresses and bows. One day she passes another student, the petite Yuxuan, on campus, and becomes convinced she has the perfect frame for the same style. But Yuxuan, a shy and short-haired sports-lover, resists her new friend’s attempts to both persuade and trick her into a new look.

But as time goes on, Lumiao realizes her feelings for Yuxuan go beyond friendship and she becomes obsessed with everything Yuxuan does and thinks. What is Lumiao to do when she learns Yuxuan has a crush on a boy in her class? She wants Yuxuan to be happy, but she doesn’t want to lose her. What will happen if she tells Yuxuan how she feels?

___

[Artist website](https://lufbsis.wixsite.com/mondayrecover)
[Artist instagram](https://www.instagram.com/monday_recover)
[Artist pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/2179028)

[Purchase the raws, support the author](https://www.bookwalker.com.tw/product/85166)

title: Utsumi-kun no Koi no Uta
description:
"Wouldn't you like to hear my love song?"

Shiori failed to make friends upon entering school, thus, she spends her time as a loner. The only support for her is the music of her favourite singer "Kanade," and she eagerly awaits the release of his new song. Then, by chance, she finds out that  this "Kanade" is actually her classmate, Utsumi! She can't believe she's about to meet her crush in real life, but to her suprise, once they're face to face, Utsumi asks her to be his girlfriend so he can experience love to be able to write a love song. 

A pure, heart-pounding love story that will make your heart skip a beat!

title: Beast No. 6
description: High school student Amatsuga Totono has a secret which no one must ever know about. His school's new counselor, Agou Nika, has a secret hope held in her heart. When the two of them cross paths during the springtime, their everyday lives of loneliness come to an end. Their battle to accomplish their aims, and to become the person they each want to be, starts now!!

title: Fluffy Punk, Nakamura-kun
description:
Seemingly delinquent high schooler Nakamura-kun is actually shy at heart with dexterous hands and as skilled as any domestic goddess. He falls for fellow student Hayashi-san, a beautiful ojousan and honors student at their school but…  
  
A moe gap love comedy about Nakamura-kun's cute handmade goods and using overflowing feelings for sweets making and plush toy production!

title: So, I Can't Play H!
description: One day, first-class Grim Reaper Lisara, for her own reasons, secretly enters the human world. After searching in vain for her target, Lisara is completely exhausted. That's when Ryosuke Kaga approaches her. To help Lisara out, he leads her out of the rain and to his cozy home, where he tells her, "I will do anything to help you." When Lisara hears that, she suddenly embraces Ryosuke and......?!

title: Tona-Gura!
description:
The Arisaka sisters (Hatsune and Kazuki) and the Kagura siblings (Yuuji and Marie) lived next door when they were smaller. So close that they could climb onto each other's verandas from the 2nd floor. They would always play together until one day the Kagura siblings had to move.  
  
It's been 10 years and the Kagura siblings are moving back! Yuuji's turned into a pervert and Marie isn't the crybaby she used to be?!

title: Sono Koi Yokini Hakarae!
description: A classroom suddenly becomes a battlefield of love! Love that transcends time and space! A Japanese-history teacher is confessed to for the first time in their life, but there's a problem! It's a highschool girl!? Using the advice of a general from 1000 years ago, can they navigate the warzone?

title: Foreign Gods
description: Tasuku Narukami is able to see strange spirits and monsters. As he begins to take care of the shrine his grandmother left to him, Tasuku is suddenly attacked by a demon! He soon discovers that he is the guard of the Totsugami, the path that spirits pass through to enter this world!

title: Nodame Cantabile
description:
The son of a famous pianist, music student Shinichi Chiaki dreams of studying abroad and becoming a conductor like his mentor. Unfortunately, his fear of flying grounds his lofty plans! As he watches other classmates achieve what he has always wanted, Shinichi wonders if he should quit music altogether.  
  
Then one day he meets fellow student Megumi Noda, also known as Nodame. This oddball girl cannot cook, clean, or even read a music score, but she can play the piano in incomparable Cantabile style. And she teaches Chiaki something that he has forgotten: to enjoy his music, no matter where he is.  
  
It received the 2004 Kodansha Manga Award for best shoujo manga.



---


**Officially Translated:**  
- In Indonesian by Elex Media

title: Yume no Shizuku to Hoshi no Hana
description:
The main character, Kaede Futami, has a premonition that her childhood friend, Ryo Ichimiya, who she has feelings for, will confess his love to her on the day of the fireworks display coming up in two weeks. However, she can't be honest in front of him and behaves carelessly, which makes it difficult for him to get closer to her. And if the dream doesn't come true, she will lose her precognitive powers. Will she be able to go to the fireworks display with him and confess her love as she dreamed?  
  
Based on the web novel that inspired the popular song あの夢をなぞって (ano yume wo nazotte) by YOASOBI.

title: Asahi-senpai no Okiniiri
description: Matsuri had lived her days peacefully, until one day she met her big brother's friend, Asahi Ryunosuke in a completely unexpected way. After a series of awkward events, they become closer. Now her days passed with the super popular "Asahi-senpai" teasing her to no end.

title: Kimi to Wonderland
description: Morimura Nobara, 15 years old. Because of a fall from the cliff three years ago, she can hear the voices of animals. Once she got used to it, she notices that there's a guy's voice that says 'I can hear you clearly.'

title: Fate/stay night
description:
The story takes place in an ordinary Japanese town, Fuyuki City. Hidden from society, there has been a deadly war going on in this town. Seven mages known as "Masters" summon powerful familiars called "Servants" and they all fight each other until the last one. The last one is said to attain the Holy Grail which will grant them a wish. Only a few know when this War started and what the Holy Grail is, but the war is about to begin again this year.

The main character is Emiya Shirou, who lost his parents in a fire and was adopted by a man who called himself a mage. Admiring his stepfather, he has been training himself to be a mage. However, he had no talent and he could barely use one type of magecraft. His stepfather has already passed away, and today he is a mage without any skills or knowledge. He is involved in the Holy Grail War when he accidentally summons Saber, who is said to be the strongest Servant of all…

title: Devil Number 4
description:
When the devil suddenly appears before her, Hanna, who never wanted anything, ends up signing a contract at the price of her soul.  
  
► Artist's Twitter: [@woomBeee](https://twitter.com/woomBeeee)

title: Shuumatsu no Harem - Fantasia Gakuen
description: Arc and Aurelia vowed to attend the same highschool, but only Aurelia passed the test. Arc ended up entering a former girls' academy! What battles await for Arc in this school life...?

title: Hadi Girl
description: Kagura Sae is a shy high school girl who can't express her feelings openly on the public. One day, she was visited by a fairy named Love Angel Raburin no. 100 and was contracted to nurture an egg from a God of Love in order to have a wonderful love by following the tasks given to her but if she fails to accomplish even a single task, she'll never have a successful love in the future!

title: Samugari ni Yuki
description:
My childhood friend, who's sensitive to cold, is such a pain! He gets close to me every chance he gets to feel my body heat! He has no sense of personal space!

Yuki, who's fed up with being in the same school as Sabu, rejects him ruthlessly and brilliantly, sometimes with physical force and sometimes with words of disdain.

We have the kind-hearted, beautiful, strong girl and the super sensitive-to-cold, disappointingly good-looking guy. This is an exciting and surreal school life romcom!

title: High Position
description:
Mitsuhiko Amano is full of regrets. A 46 year old salaryman who had just been laid off, he was told that his wife wanted a divorce, something that he might have been wanting for years. So he visits a soapland, a place he hasn't been since he started dating his wife 22 years ago. While there, a fire suddenly erupts, trapping Amano and a soapland girl in the bath. In a rare moment of bravery and decisiveness, Amano attempts to lead the girl to safety, only to slip and hit his head. As his consciousness fades, he sees the back of the soapland girl making her escape… A fresh set of regret blankets him as he passes out, that his wife Sachiko and daughter Miyu will be objects of ridicule that he died in such a place…  
  
Then he awakens. In front of him is Ozawa Satsuki, a girl he hardly knew but secretly liked in high school. And Takahashi, Nakao-san, and Iijima-kun too. All his high school friends in their high school uniform, in their, and his, old high school… He has slipped 30 years in

title: Ratman
description: Meet Shooto. He's a bit vertically-challenged. He also wants to be a hero. But guess what? Midgets can't be heroes! Ha! So he becomes a villain instead. Sort of. Not really. But w-wait a minute here, why is he so heroic if he's supposed to be the bad guy? And what about the so-called good guys? Why are they so evil?

title: Ui x Kon
description:
Two people who met for the first time today. Should we have the "world's best wedding" 3 years later…!?  
The Nanami High School that Ui enters is a special school where girls and boys spend their dorm life in a shared room, aiming for the world's best wedding! Kon, the guy chosen as Ui's partner by the super accurate matching system, is an ever so slightly malicious guy…!?

title: Onna no Ko ga H-na Manga Egaicha Dame Desuka?
description: Yukino Shiroi is the new cute girl in class, the kind of girl Kyousuke Kai can only dream about. Yet somehow they wind up going out together. It all seems too easy. But the girl has a secret: she draws the most ecchi manga he's ever seen. It's hard to say what will explode first, his heart, his mind, or something else…

title: Zankou Saisatsu
description: Kurume Amane, a member of her university’s photography club, believes that “girls in love are the cutest,” and is a total slut who makes her female subjects fall for her before sleeping with them and taking their photos. Amane had been struggling to take any decent photos, but one day, a beautiful girl named Mei showed up at the clubroom with a broken camera—

title: When Supernatural Battles Became Commonplace
description: The five members of the literature club awakened with extraordinary powers half a year ago. Although the members expected to be thrown into a world of super-powered battles at their school, their normal daily routine continued. No secret organizations bent on world destruction, no super-powered wars, no brave heroes or demon kings. However, the members still look forward to the possibilities of adventure, and continued to believe that with each day, they were getting ever closer to those days of fantasy.

title: Ore no Nounai Sentakushi ga, Gakuen Love-Comedy wo Zenryoku de Jama Shiteiru
description:
The story centers around Kanade Amakusa, a boy cursed with the mental power of "absolute multiple-choice"—a multiple-choice quiz will suddenly appear in his mind, and the choice he makes will become his reality. For example, he would have to choose between going nude from the waist up or the waist down in school. While in school, he is given another choice:  
1) A beautiful girl will fall before him.  
2) he will fall from the rooftop in female clothes.  
He chooses option 1, and a blonde girl named Chocolat falls before him.

title: Qyootie Q -Qilin Girl's Courtship-
description:
Kuchiba, a good looking girl feared for her fiery personality, decides that she's not going to get into any more fights now that she's a high school student.

However, on her very first day of school, she gets caught up in a scrap with a girl named Qisha, one of the "werefolk", who considers her an enemy because of a misunderstanding. Werefolk are a rare type of demihuman, with only 30,000 living in Japan, and Qisha has heard that Kuchiba has been busy bullying them.

Because of that, she challenges Kuchiba to a duel, but...

title: I Focus on Your Color
description: Photography is the art to grasp beauty with the one and only tool, a camera. Oji's dream is to become a photographer that photographs at the front lines of war, to take pictures of historical events taking place in front of his eyes. However, his childhood friend, Sumire, doesn't think that he is capable of becoming one. In his photography club, Oji shows his photos to the group, and his upperclassman, Ran, points out that Sumire is a good target to photograph. Oji manages to get permission to take photos of Sumire, and during his shoot, Sumire notices that Oji is acting differently than before. Later they find out that one of Oji's pictures won an award! Sumire congratulates him, but Oji sees beyond his award. He claims that he learned that he has much more potential than he thinks. Ran, overseeing this, plans to take Oji to the next level so he can capture true beauty through the lens of a camera!

title: Koi ni Utsutsu wo Nukasu Bekarazu!!
The Desperate March of Love
description:
"Hey, do you want to go out with me?"

Rei has been in love with Ami, a girl in her class. She confesses her feelings to Ami, expecting to be rejected, but to her surprise, Ami feels the same way! They become lovers, but there is something a little strange about Ami. She thinks about Ami all the time and loves her wholeheartedly, whereas Rei loves her, Ami, on the other hand, has a more liberal view of love and does not choose just one lover. Will Rei love for her win out, or will the unfaithful Ami get away with it?

title: Zoku!! jisatsu shitaikedo sore wa chotto kowaikara yandere kanojo o tsukutte kanojo ni koroshitemoraō to surukedo 100 nichi go ni naze ka nemu kan sareta hanashi
description: Continuation of A Story About Wanting to Commit Suicide, but It's Scary so I Find a Yandere Girl to Kill Me, but After 100 days, I Somehow Got ○○

title: Onii-chan no Koto Nanka Zenzen Suki ja Nain da Kara ne!!
description: Junior High student Nao's brother complex is so strong, it's almost at the point of incest. She's determined to make her brother, High School student Shuusuke, see her as a woman. So determined, that she goes as far as going into his room to throw away all his non-incest related porn. But as she's looking for his porno stash, she finds a photo album… and she's not in any of his childhood pictures. What is going on?

title: West-North's Grim Reaper
description:
Lee Yuna is a highschool girl who was supposed to die before dawn. The Grim Reaper visits her to guide her to the afterlife the night before but is hit with a twist. Unexpectedly, her life span gets extended last minute and now the Grim Reaper is tasked with protecting her for 70 more years!  
  
"I'll be the one taking you"  
  
A spicy high school life with a grim reaper!  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/seijun_yang)  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/2agm0JY.png) Author's instagram](https://www.instagram.com/seijun_yang/)  
- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/drama/baohuwosishen/list?title_no=833)  
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/FANTASY/baohuwosishen/list?title_no=843)

title: Kashimashi ~Girl Meets Girl~
description:
Being a girl is harder than it looks…  
For Hazumu, this couldn't be more true, because just the other day, she…was a he.  
  
Shunned by the girl of his dreams, Hazumu loses himself in the mountains and is promptly squashed by an oncoming space ship. The alien inside, feeling guilty, rebuilds Hazumu's body…but as the wrong gender!  
  
Now Hazumu must learn how to be the girl his parents always wanted while dealing with the trials and tribulations of being caught in a love triangle between two girls–his childhood friend, Tomari, and Yasuna, the girl who rejected him but is now strangely attracted to him/her!

title: Nyan Koi!
description:
The story is about a second-year high school student named Junpei Kousaka, who not only hates cats but also is allergic to them. Unforunately, he happens to have a crush on a girl, Kaede Mizuno, who really loves cats. On the way home from school one day, Junpei kicks an empty can and happens to accidentally hit the Guardian Deity of Cats. Now he's able to understand cats but was practically given a curse. He has to grant 100 wishes from any cat or he'll turn into a cat himself.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Meow Love!** (2013)

title: Aoyama Tsukiko desu!
description: Aoyoma Tsukiko has always been misunderstood due to her expressionless face. Having to repeat first year of high school again due to her usual bad luck, she strives to have a happy and cheerful high school life. Then meets her classmate who is a deliberate loner. However, due to her nature, she aims to befriend him, much to his annoyance. Can a friendship grow between a poker face, cheerful girl and the loner? Can she break through his walls?

title: Saenai Kanojo (Heroine) no Sodatekata ~egoistic-lily~
description:
A highschool otaku named Aki Tomoya runs into his dream girl one day…only to find that she has the faintest presence to his chagrin!   
  
Now with his otaku passions, Tomoya wants to turn the girl into a heroine in the only realm he is familiar with: 2D dating simulation game. To accomplish this objective, he scouts Sawamura Spencer Eriri, his half-foreigner childhood friend equipped with artistic talent, as the illustrator, and Kasumigaoka Utaha, a famous prodigy writer, as the script writer.

title: A Story About How She Grew Conscious of Her Childhood Friend
Akuyaku Reijou no Dere wa Ore Dake ni Barete Iru
description:
The protagonist was reincarnated into an otome game as the first prince. He had played the otome game in his past life, and knew that the villainess was actually not evil and had lived an unlucky life. He searched for the route where the villainess was saved through all media, but he couldn’t find it and gave up. But this time, he was determined to save her.

---
**Original Web Novel:** [Kakuyomu](https://kakuyomu.jp/works/1177354054918169629), [Syosetu](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3771gk/)

title: Josei Danshi
description: Three girls want to make a girls-only band, but they need a singer. This one cute voice turns out to be from a boy! What will happen when this boy gets involved with them?

title: Aishiteru Game o Owarasetai - Twitter Extras
description: Twitter extras uploaded by author Doumoto Yuuki as well as by some assistants.

title: Shoujotachi wa Kouya wo Mezasu Yukidoke no Oto
description: A side-story providing an alternative retelling of the events of the anime as well as original stories.

title: Seifuku Adventure
description: Itou Ayako is a third year in high school and the president of the public morals committee. Part of her job is to ensure that the amount of sexual relationships between students doesn't get out of hand. As president, she is expected to set a good example and be a role model for the other students. But what if even she wants to get a boyfriend…? Recently she's become a little bit interested in fellow committee member Kawai Harumori.

title: Major
description:
Shigeharu Honda is a Japanese League batter on the rise. His son Goro is a Little League pitcher who one day hopes to follow in his father's footsteps. Momoko Hoshino, Goro's schoolteacher, is the first woman Shigeharu has been interested in since the death of Goro's mother. The destinies of these three individuals will become intertwined as father and son experience both heartbreak and triumph on the baseball diamond. But when an unspeakable tragedy visits the family, it will take everything they have to pick up the pieces and reclaim their dreams.  
  
Won the 41st Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen category.

title: Dear Sir Hannibal
description:
Kibayashi Rento is a "Personification" of a supernatural being descended from a family of Ents (tree-oak people). One day his arm got torn off trying to save a cat from a tree. While he's looking for the arm, he crosses a girl, Kurashina Saya, who finds his lost arm. Saya is Rento's crush, and actually a fellow Personification descended from a family of Ghouls, whose main characteristic is appetite for humanoid meat. Can romance blossom between the two supernatural beings?   
  
Slight discomfort advised. Don't worry: because he's a plant, he can regenerate his lost body parts easily, including the aforementioned arm.
___
Included in Volume 3 of [Dreadnought Formation HXEROS](https://mangadex.org/title/50bac62c-3e1a-4237-a3a2-c64cc82d3677/dokyuu-hentai-hxeros).

title: His and Her Circumstances
description:
Miyazawa Yukino is the perfect model student. Pretty, kind, good at sports, always at the top of her class. But she's not all that she seems. It's all an act of deception; she is really the self-confessed 'queen of vanity,' and her only goal in life is winning the praise and admiration of everyone around her. When she enters high school, she finally meets her match: Arima Souichirou, a handsome, athletic, popular, and very intelligent young boy. Ever since he stole the top seat in the class from her, Yukino has hated him, and has been plotting on how to take back her former place as the object of all other students' admiration. What she wasn't expecting, however, was that Souichirou, the very boy she hated, would confess his love for her. Or that he would find out about her deception - and use it to blackmail her!
Together, they discover that they have more in common than they knew, and they slowly begin to bring out each other's inner selves.

---  
Also included are the following sho

title: Tokyo ESP
description:
Urushiba Rinka was a fairly normal high school girl, though she was a bit poor and her only family was her father. Then one day, she saw a penguin and some glowing fish swimming through the sky. Rinka might have thought it was a hallucination if there hadn't been another witness with her, a boy from her school with a strangely scratched-up face.  
 Contact with a fish caused her to pass out, and when she awoke, she had developed the power to move through inanimate objects… such as the floor of her apartment! Later, a call from her father showed her that she was not the only one the flying fish bestowed with hard-to-control superpowers! What exactly is going on here? And does Rinka's classmate know more about this situation than he's letting on?

title: A Wannabe Playboy Who Can’t Steal the Girl No Matter What He Does
description: A 4-panel spinoff following the guy who wants to NTR but can't no matter what he does.

title: Gal no Iki-san wa Otomodachiryou wo Moraitai!
description:
I am being forced to pay a “friendship fee”. after being threatened by a gal classmate. Being too poor to afford such a thing, I must find something other than money to pay as the friendship fee…!

Time to teach the cheeky gal a lesson! A special romcom oneshot about a contract of friendship between an arrogant gal and an extremely poor boy!

title: Midori no Tomarigi
description: Following her mother’s passing, Midori is now not only responsible for raising her little brother, Ai, but she’s also tied down by housework and other school commitments, making it hard to establish any form of social life… Until she meets a man in the courtyard at school. Will he change her life or will she change him?

title: Make a Girl
description:
Taking place in the near future, Mizutamari Akira, a brilliant young scientist who developed Salt, a robot that assists people in their daily lives, finds himself at a dead end after a series of failed inventions. When a friend suggests he could "power up" his personal life by creating a girlfriend. He develops an artificial partner, "No. 0," who quite literally becomes his girlfriend. Torn between her programmed emotions and her own evolving feelings, No. 0 faces an emotional conflict. Will love blossom between her and Akira, who is unused to connecting with others, or...?

(Source: MU)

title: Campione!
description:
A Campione – a Godslayer – is a supreme ruler.  
  
Since he can kill a celestial being, he can therefore call on the sacrosanct, divine powers wielded by the gods.  
  
A Campione – a Godslayer – is a lord.  
  
Since the power to kill a deity is in his hands, he therefore looms over all mortals on Earth.  
  
A Campione – a Godslayer – is a devil.  
  
Since for all mortal who live in the world, none can assume a power to match his!  
  
Kusanagi Godou, a 16 year old boy who played in the senior league as catcher and fourth hitter - that is, the cleanup - when he was in Junior High. However, an injury put an end to baseball.  
  
Though that was not the end for him. During the spring break of his third ,and last year in Junior High, he got involved in an adventure and ended up slaying one of the Heretic Gods, Verethragna. Thus, he became the youngest - and seventh - Campione.  
  
Now that he is a Campione, a godslayer, the young Godou must defeat the troublemaking gods, with the hel

title: Beware of Demons
description:
A small and weak bookworm gets into trouble with a domineering and handsome werewolf!   
"Anyone who messes with me will be punished!" sneered the werewolf.   
During what was supposed to be an unexciting game of punishment, unexpectedly, the completely ordinary little bookworm transforms into a handsome and alluring incubus!  
"You're my type, doggy." the incubus smiled wickedly.

title: Meitantei no Jouken
description:
In the second year of high school, the homeroom teacher dies in a murder case.
The main character, Maoka Riku, is elected to a troublesome committee and soon finds himself involved in a murder case.

Who killed my homeroom teacher?

title: Infinite Stratos
description: Students are trained in the Infinite Stratos academy to pilot the weapon system (Infinite Stratos). Although it is believed that only females have the ability to operate the IS, there is one man who can. His name is Ichika Orimura.

title: Migihara's Short Manga
description:
Short manga from Migihara's [Twitter](https://twitter.com/sgin001).  
Volume 1: The Lonely Spirit of the Spring  
Volume 2: Angel  
Volume 3: Assorted stories  
Volume 4: Ta-kun and Ko-chan

title: Kore ga Mahoutsukai no Kirifuda
description:
The master swordsman Rix, who has grown well and truly tired of the bloodstained battlefield, fakes his death in battle and retires. He has decided to turn his life around and enroll in the Magic Institute, despite having zero magic aptitude. Nonetheless, Rix is able to overwhelm the sorcerers with his base skills as a swordsman!

Unintentional as it may be, he continues to smash through all common sense within the institute. In doing so, he catches the Empress’s eye, drawn to his battle prowess——.

No, what I'm aiming for isn't to be the strongest, but to live a “peaceful and enjoyable life”!
___
**Character Designer:** [Mishima Kurone](https://mangadex.org/author/20fb6fc2-36b9-47a4-92f0-ba89c9517cfe)

title: Tensei Mae wa Dragon Deshita
description: The hero and the dragon defeated the Demon King, saving the world, but they died. Then they were reincarnated in another world (Japan)... This is their story.

title: 7 Jikanme no Note
description: Yohei is in the Woodwinds Orchestra at his high school where he plays the clarinet as one of the few boys in the group. The president of the group is Azumi who also happens to be Yohei's first girlfriend. Azumi has never had a boyfriend before and the couple has many awkward moments as their relationship is still fresh. With both Yohei and Azumi acting a little shy with each other, being intimate is difficult but their love for each other makes them braver.

title: Ikebukuro Hatsu, Zensekai Yuki!
description: It is still a shock to Saga Shigekata that he is standing at Ikebukuro Krea Academy, a relatively new school with a very particular curriculum. He was supposed to be attending a normal high school, but when his parents discovered the sketches he was drawing, they sent him here. This school is relatively new and is known as the otaku school where aspiring manga artists gather to learn about creating their own masterpiece. Shigekata meets a fellow first year named Miyakawa Hinari who seems to be in a cosplay costume but later finds out that not only is she Shigekata’s classmate, she is the president and founder of Krea Academy. He starts making new friends that inspire him to produce artwork with a lot of passion.

title: Sagesumu Shisen ga Saikou desu
description: A high school girl, Utako, has an unusual 'love'. That is, she was attracted to cold attitudes and when someone dealt with her in a bothersome way!　She has no romantic feelings for him, but is always attracted to boys who behave in this way. She met Narumi by chance, who was always languid and had a slightly teasing way of saying things, and he was exactly her ideal ♡ In order to become friends with Narumi, she tried to get to know him, but...?

title: Trinity Seven - 7-nin no Mahoutsukai Comic Anthology
description: Comic Anthology of Trinity Seven, extra chapters full of new things and comedy.

title: Gyeonwoo and the Priestess
description: Park Seong-Ah is a high school student by day and shaman by night. In the shaman's eyes, the people who are close to death walk upside-down… And one of these people is her crush!

title: Gozen 0-ji, Kiss Shi ni Kite yo
description:
Hinana is a high school girl who wakes up at 5am to prepare for school every day. She's also the Student Committee secretary. While she's quite serious, in reality she actually dreams of one day finding herself a prince. When a famous actor, Ayase Kaede, shoots a movie at their school during golden week, the Student Committee's members have to act as extras. Hinana thinks Ayase is just like the prince of her dreams until she finds out that in reality he's actually a pervert who has a butt fetish? A comedy romance starts.

---

[Alt Official English](https://kodansha.us/series/kiss-me-at-the-stroke-of-midnight/)

title: Harenochi Shikibu
description: Haruno witnesses a mysterious guy crying under the sakura trees. He thought it strange, but who would have thought the guy turns out to be his classmate, Hitose?! Hitose declares that he's going to establish the "Four Seasons Club", with details of club activities being very unclear. But swept up in Hitose's vigor, Haruno joins the club by announcing, "I will be with you"!

title: Mimitani-san, the Tallest in the Class
description: This is the story of Mimitani-san, the tallest kid in her class, and Makigai-kun, the short boy in the seat next to her.

title: Sakura Discord
description:
Sakura Kousuke is a boy who strives to throw away a past mired in regret. He transfers to a new school for his second year of high school, believing it will give him a chance to come clean.  
  
Unbeknownst to him, however, the appearance of five other "Sakura"s in his class will bring the past to his present, forcing him to come to terms with himself, his old friends, and a girl who, though being Kousuke's complete opposite, also knows him better than anyone else.  
  
A coming-of-age story, both light-hearted and dramatic, by the author who would later give us "Jitsu wa Watashi wa".

title: Pages in Search of a Bookmark
description: The story of two girls with a shared love of books falling in love at the library.

title: Stairway of Time
description:
Ryu Ji Hun And Lee Yeon Ah… We were the best couple.  
The love of youth… crazy and crazy. But that love… I killed him and ruined my life completely.  
If I can go back to the past, it would do so much… Not to be tied to you. Avoiding you.  
  
14 years later, in order to change this unfortunate reality of a greater unfortunate situation, Yeon Ah rises to the thirteenth stairway to the past, following a suddenly rising memory. If this is real… If she really jumped into the past, will she be able to avoid making this unfortunate mistake again?!  
32 years old Lee Yeon Ah went back to the past, 14 years ago.  
  
Can she really break her relationship with her first love and change her terrible past? Climb with us to the   
STAIRWAY OF TIME…

title: Touch
description:
Tatsuya Uesugi, the older brother who has no relationship with the word "hard work," and Kazuya Uesugi, the younger brother who tries his hardest in everything he does. 

They are twin brothers. They have known Minami Asakura, the only daughter of the neighboring coffee shop "Minamikaze" since childhood. You can't take your eyes off the "youth" of these three...!


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media (2008)

---
- **Won the 28th Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen**

title: Ai-Sensei wa Wakaranai
description:
Hasuo Tsukinari is lonely high school student. He hates school and thinks of it as a prison. After getting involved in an incident with his literature teacher Ai Iruma, he was forced to be a 'white mouse' in her experiments to study about love.

**Note:** The official English title on the cover (***I Don't Know The Love***) is a pun on I/Ai-sensei's name.

title: Akuyaku Reijou, Ore
description:
He was an ordinary working guy in Japan...but accidentally reincarnated as Asuka, the villainess of a popular otome game "Love Revolution Kingdom."

In order to avoid being executed, he must not let the villain prince fall in love with Asuka. However, when Asuka started to act like she(he) didn’t care about any of the boys, the characters including the prince became attracted to her.

Either love or friendship would lead him to a dead end...but all he wishes is to live his own life!!

(Source: KADOKAWA Global)

title: Hello, Hello and Hello
description: A captivating, heartrending tale of meetings and partings.

title: Seeking for Death
description: Kominato Riku is a high school student who aims to be a game designer. The girl next door is his childhood friend Haju, is in love with him, but he has fallen head over heels for the school idol Riko. And lastly, there is the transfer student, Nodoka. With that all said you’d think this is the start of some love-comedy harem, but a rumor spreads that Nodoka receives a message that says, “you will die soon”. Riku and the gang’s fate will change in a major way. Who will live, and who will love?

title: Watashi no Shiiku Gakari-kun
description: The first time for a shy girl to want to have a friend. But, mistakenly she talks to Hayamizu-kun the delinquent…! But, surprisingly Hayamizu-kun is xxx…?! Warm and kind?! A youthful love story.

title: Onideka!
description:
Kiryuin Hanao is the idol of her school. But when she suddenly becomes a giant she is forced to return to her old ways to protect her city. Alongside her friend Takezou Watanabe, will she be able to save the world?
___
* **Note:** There is no chapter 7.

title: Love in Focus
description:
Mochizuki Mako decides to leave her home and enrolled in a boarding high school school known for it’s photography program. She moves into the dorms with her childhood friend, Kei and her classmate, Amemura who hates having his picture taken. First love and dreams, what will this fateful Spring bring…?

[Official English](https://kodansha.us/series/love-in-focus/)

title: My Alien Days
description:
Manabu is a 3rd year middle schooler & former student council president. 
Suddenly he's in charge of new student Ruri but she is no ordinary girl - she's an alien! 
Manabu then loses the chance to be with his crush Mizuho 
who now has a thing for Ruri and gets nose bleeds from her cuteness. 
The teacher is of no help, her focus & nose bleeds are on Ruri's hot cousin who is also an alien!

title: Houmurareta Kimi e
description:
In ten or so years, in a future where resurrecting the dead is an everyday occurrence, the moon will collide with the Earth, bringing with it the end.
Before the apocalypse happens, Nekuro confesses to her best friend Kiri, who, seeing no hope for the future, takes her admirer's confession half-joklingly, until one day, Nekuro dies.

title: I Don't Need a Happy Ending
description: A collection of yuri shorts stories by Mikanuji, previously published in various other anthologies

title: Gakkou no Okujou ni Sumu Kappuru no Hanashi
description: A manga about a couple spending their lives as ghosts on a school rooftop.

title: Yankee no Onigahara-san ga Boku ni Dake Kahogo Sugiru
description: She is the strongest but overprotective. My childhood friend is the strongest Yankee who can shut up even crying children. But in front of me, she's a kind and loving big sister. Wait a minute, aren't you overprotective? The popular manga video that has been played over 2.5 million times on YouTube is now available as a web manga!

title: Haru no Houtai Shoujo
description: Haru, a fun, lovable, easygoing guy, has a problem: he can't control his ability to produce flames from his hand. With his girlfriend Natsu nearly burnt to death and the locals concerned about a serial arsonist, what will happen to this human torch?

title: Slow Jet Coaster
description: Honda Hiyori is a closet fujoshi who fantasizes about her two schoolmates, the cool and stoic Yamaguchi Rui and the bright and cheerful Niwa Ibuki, having a romantic relationship with each other. Day in and day out, she watches the two and posts her fantasies about them as BL manga on social media. However, the more she spends time with her bias, Rui, the more she finds herself slowly falling for him…

title: Ogamida-san wa Hetare-Gao ga Mitai
description: Sagahara-kun, a shoujo manga artist who uses his classmate Ogamida-san as a model, is always finding himself in embarrassing situations caused by her for some reason…!?

title: Shiryoku Kensa
description:
Miyashita Megumi, also known as "Gumi," was one of the only survivors in a plane crash thirteen years ago. Since then, she has been able to see two copies of every person and one of them always has a "C" on them. Thirteen years later, she now wears glasses, yet her left eye remains a puzzle. And then, her friend goes "missing."  
  
Based on the [Vocaloid song](http://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm15230821) of the same name.

title: Koi Yori Aoku (Oneshot)
description: Takamine, who can't find anything she likes, and Sakikura, who loves books. The two girls meet by chance and spend their after-school hours together. Are they friends? Or is it a nameless relationship spun between the two girls?

title: Yume ka Utsutsu ka
description: The main character, Iroha, is a first-year high school student who finds it difficult to talk to others. Even though it’s been about two months since she started high school, she still hasn’t had a proper conversation with any of her classmates. During every break, she quietly slips out of the classroom and heads to the courtyard by the old school building. She does this to meet and talk with a senior she met at the town library while studying for exams. This senior, who is a year older, has become a source of support for Iroha. However, the two of them share a secret...

title: Just a Story About Miyamoto Sakura Being Cute
description:
Miyamoto Sakura is cute. Why, you ask?   
  
1) She looks cute.   
2) The way her expression is constantly changing is cute.   
3) The way she gets so easily excited is cute.   
4) Still remembering the proposal from when we were small is cute.   
5) Her ti*s are surprisingly big.   
  
…See, with all this together, how could she be anything but? And so this manga exists to admire her, the purest manga in the world.   
  
Incidentally, my name is Ogami Hikaru. I’m Sakura’s childhood friend, and I'm apparently the reincarnation of the Norse Deity Odin.  
  
DESCRIPTION #2:  
Anyway, cute Sakura Miyamoto is a childhood friend and loves Ogami Hikaru.  
Hikaru's house is cohabiting with three beautiful sisters who claim to be Gods from Norse mythology.  
Hikaru will provide services like that.  
The end of Ragnarok's love of Sakura Miyamoto!?  
Hop in for a crazy but beautiful story.

title: Batsu Ichi Arasaa Joshi to Danshi Kokosei
description: Promise Cinderella's official spin-off depicting the daily life of the high school boy and the divorced young woman, half a year after the first chapter of the main series.

title: Momokuri
description: Yuki Kurihara is a girl who has finally been granted her wish of dating her crush Shinya Momotsuki (Momo). At first glance, she just looks like a normal but very cute girl. However, she is in fact a maniac over Momo, taking notes of his activities and never missing the chance to see him in a cute moment. Momo, on the other hand, is inexperienced in love, and just wants to make Yuki happy.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam - The Origin
description:
Zeon ace pilot, Commander Char Aznable, thought he could foil the Federation's plan to build a mobile suit by attacking their research base on colony Side 7. He was wrong. With a prototype already active, the besieged Federation forces strike back using their new weapon, the mobile suit Gundam, with devastating consequences. Amidst the fighting, young electronics wizard Amuro Ray is determined not to let his friends and family die in the crossfire. But what can one boy do to repel a squad of mobile suit-clad invaders?  

[Official English](https://kodansha.us/series/mobile-suit-gundam-the-origin/)
[Alternate Official English](https://comic-walker.com/contents/detail/KDCW_CW01000002020000_68/)

---
- **Won the Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2012**
---

**Links:**  
- [OVA on ANN](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=13105)

title: The Yankee wants to be an Otaku (Fujoshi)!
description: A romantic comedy between an Otaku and a Yankee that seems to be interested in reading manga?

title: Dekiai Yakuza ni wa Amayakasarenai!
description:
An age-gap love story between a caretaker who loves a little too much and a young lady who’s a high school girl.

Riko, the granddaughter of a yakuza family, has a crush on Iori, her overprotective caretaker.

He has always earnestly pampered Riko and been around her since long ago, and he has always been with her in everything she does.

And when she found out that Iori has a girlfriend, she decided to break free from Iori and give up her love! Riko tries her best to increase the number of things she can do little by little, but Iori doesn’t seem convinced.

title: Otonari-san Game
description:
Tsuruoka Maiko and Sasano Keisuke are childhood friends and just entered high school. Their families are neighbors and have been living next to each other for well over a decade. They’ve been getting along well ever since they’ve met, but recently there seems to be a divide between them. What could be the reason? (From: MU)  
  
**- *Status* : Cancelled at vol 1, but the author made a vol 2 of it on his own without a publisher.**

title: Nanai Sanami ga Kiratte Kurenai
description: Stalker - a person who stealthily hunts or pursues an animal or another person. Instead of running away from stalkers, who love to pursue you, how do you make them hate you? Inasaki's means to get Sanami to hate him requires more than just to disgust, ignore and to run away. What great lengths will he hurdle for her to hate him? Inasaki's story has just begun, but has he already been entangled in her web?

title: I Got a Girlfriend From a Shooting Star
description: What do I do if I like girls? I wished upon a shooting star, not expecting it to be granted straight away… so why did a spirit suddenly appear before me?

title: Dear, Only You Don't Know!
description: Everyone knows women are tricky beings, with layers upon layers of secrets they hide, but there are some secrets women must risk everything in order to keep hidden! These women with such hidden secrets are being revealed in the series, "Dear, Only You Don't Know!"

title: Please Go Home, Akutsu-san! (Oneshot)
description: Ooyama-kun normally doesn’t get involved with Akutsu-san, a delinquent girl in his class, but for some reason she makes his house her hang-out place! Will Ooyama do something horrible to her behind closed doors or will he chase her out? But dealing with Akutsu-san’s sexy, cute behavior in such a confined space… he’s sure to get flustered! He wants her to go home, but he doesn’t? A teasing comedy under a single roof!

title: Sekizui Hikinuki no Kei Omnibus
description:
Sekizui Hikinuki no Kei has posted many short stories on Twitter.  
This is an omnibus to collect them.  
  
Notice by BUSHIDO PR:   
I worked on the author's short stories with his permission, however, I deleted my translations (Chapter 1 to 5) in response to the author's request.  
  
- [@noumisozoo](https://twitter.com/noumisozoo)

title: Spotlight
description: Kyohei Saito, a first-year college student who's gloomy and negative—in other words, "depressing"—falls in love with Ayame Ogawa, a beauty and contestant of their school's beauty pageant. Will the depressing nobody's feelings reach the goddess who basks in the spotlight? The curtain rises on an ensemble cast drama of college students shaken by the glimmer and helplessness of youth!

title: Bokura ga Ita
description:
The start of high school life. To the girls, that also meant the start of their love lives. For brand new first year student, Takahashi Nanami (Nana for short), it was no different… She happens to end up in the same class as the incredibly popular Yano Motoharu, who rumors say that two thirds of all the girls are guaranteed to fall in love with. But will that hold true for Nana, who says that if she had to choose between like or dislike, she'd say she dislikes him!?  
  
--- 
- **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for Shojo in 2005**

title: I'm in a Secret Relationship
description:
[Dating is exciting every day ──.] Takase, a second-year high school student, is dating a popular person in the same class, Togawa. However, the relationship between the two remains a secret to everyone. They’re cool in front of their friends, but Takase is always thrilled by Togawa, who becomes lover-like when he's alone. However, one day, Kurono, a senior in the third grade, finds out that they are dating! Moreover, Kurono is interested in Takase …!? A wholesome story of a doting boyfriend and a slightly ditzy girlfriend ♪  
  
note: this is the serialized version of the original webcomic by the same author.

title: Love Revolution
description: Romance, such thing cannot exist between us!

title: Sayonara ja Nee yo, Baka.
description:
**Contents:**
1. Business Yuri Idol
2. Bishokuka na Kyuuketsuki
3. Nee-chan wa Kuso Yarou
4. Mahou Shounen to Tsukaima Onee-chan
5. Gakuen no Ouji to Hime
6. Kaizuka-san no Inu
7. Otaku no Koto ga Ki ni Naru Gal
8. Isekai Tensei Shita Tomodachi
9. Business Yuri Idol prologue
10. Mangaka no Koto ga Ki ni Naru OL

title: Uma Musume Pretty Derby - Admire Vega is Suki (Doujinshi)
description:
A series of short Umamusume comics made by [@k0koro_091](https://twitter.com/k0koro_091), mostly featuring Admire Vega and her relationship with her assigned trainer.
[Melonbooks](https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=2053756)
[DLSite](https://www.dlsite.com/home/dlaf/=/t/n/link/work/aid/hisubway/id/RJ01085548.html)

title: To Whom the Deer Falls
description: Lu Nanzhi reincarnated into a stand-in romance novel as vicious female rival, and her task is to make the heroine Chen Xi achive happiness. The industry beauty thought that attacking the heroine was also a way to ‘make the heroine happy’, so she took the initiative to pursue the heroine. But she gradually felt that the attitude towards herself from the surrounding characters seemed to be different from that in the book?

title: Kyuudaiten Demo Seishun Wo!
description: Chiharu Hiiragi repeated a year and is struggling to fit in with his class. While taking remedial chemistry in the infirmary, the person sitting next to him turns out to be a super shy classmate covered in a bedsheet. Wearing a ghost-like sheet, her face is hidden, and her conversations are awkward. Yet, for some reason, being with her feels comforting. Things about their age, about school, and the secrets they can't quite put into words... As they slowly share more conversations, their time after school begins to change. A slightly awkward, a little off-beat, passing-grade and clumsy after-school youth comedy starting from the infirmary, begins!

title: Green Plum Blossom Tea
description: Good girl Gugu meets cheerful girl Xingxing. Xingxing is everything Gugu wants to be - she has friends, youthfulness, dreams, and happiness. The meticulous Gugu sets out a long-term plan to reach out to Xingxing, but it seems that she doesn't have to go to all that trouble... Is Xingxing also reaching out to her?

title: Ojou-san to Yobanaide
description:
Cha của Misaki là chủ tịch của một công ty nọ, người lúc nào cũng chẳng rảnh rỗi dù cho cực kì giàu có. Ông quyết định giao phó con gái cho cánh tay phải của mình - cậu Miyashita chăm sóc!
Trong khi Misaki cực kì bối rối khi phải sống chung với một anh chàng đẹp trai lớn tuổi hơn mình, anh ấy lại lạnh nhạt bảo rằng: "Đây chỉ là công việc thôi".
Nhưng qua từng giây phút bên nhau, Misaki đã tương tư anh Miyashita tốt bụng ấy lúc nào không hay...

title: Furimuite Yukino-chan!
description:
"Have you possibly fallen in love with me?"  
  
”Yukino-chan” helped Arata who wasn’t able to attend school. He frequently talks with her on social media despite not knowing what she looks like. Turns out, ‘she’s’ a guy?! Despite being confused, this feeling of love won’t stop growing towards Yukino-san who’s kind even in real life.”  
  
Someday, if Arata's feelings go overboard and a confession slips out… will Yukino-san look back?!  
  
An earnest love that doesn't stop even when hurt.

title: My Delicious Dream Boy
description:
The loner kid who entered school a month late because he was sick became friends with the most popular boy in school! But later on, he discovered that this heartthrob with a good reputation is actually not human? The loner kid who easily gets nightmares catches the Dream Demon's eye.   
  
“Your dream is exceptionally tasty~”   
  
It’s hard to make friends at school. If you’re not careful, you might get eaten by the Dream Demon~

title: Everything Is All Laid Bare
description: When two mind-readers come together, romcom ensues.

title: Tsujiura-san to Chupacabra
description: An ordinary, bored, bullied high-school boy. A mysterious, frail and cute transfer student who just happens to be a feared delinquent and studies the chupacabra. They meet and start "going out" together. What can go wrong?

title: The Hidden Side of My Shy Childhood Friend
Nanashi no Asterism
description:
Tsukasa Shiratori, Nadeshiko Washio and Mikage Kotooka are three close-knit friends in junior high school. For almost a year, Tsukasa has been harboring a secret she can't tell anyone: she has a crush on Nadeshiko. She resigns to keep it locked away forever, but then discovers that Nadeshiko has a crush on Mikage. Not wanting to mess up their current relationship, Tsukasa decides to support Nadeshiko in any way she can. However, Mikage has a secret of her own that she can't share with anyone.  
  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/udonkimuchikaki/)

title: Citrus Anthology
description: Citrus official anthology.

title: Douse Naku Nara Koi ga ii
description:
Is the worst first meeting the best start to a love story?
On the day of her high school entrance ceremony, Hodaka, who has repeatedly moved and transferred schools due to her father's job, runs into a hard-to-approach boy wearing the same high school uniform at her front door. When they get on the elevator together, the worst thing happens...
___
**Links**:
* **Alternative Official Raw**: [MangaMee](https://manga-mee.jp/detail/53628)

title: Ao to Haru
description: This is a coming-of-age love story centered around Miyano Aoi, a shy high school girl. Soon after starting high school, Aoi catches the flu and when she is able to return to school, she finds herself alone and unable to join any group. One day, Aoi breaks her arm while saving her classmate Mitani Haru from slipping on the stairs. After that, she begins to interact with the friendly and popular Mitani, and the shy Aoi gradually begins to change.

title: Tanaka-san wa Gyutto Shitai Dake
description: Tanaka-san keeps breaking school equipment. What's her senpai, the student council president, to do in response...?

title: A Girl Who Says Too Much
My Universe
description: As a socially awkward college student, Hayeon lives a pretty boring life -- except she can communicate with outer space. One day, she meets Ujun, an alien who is curious about human nature. When she rejects his request to “borrow” her body, he takes over the body of her crush! As Hayeon helps Ujun adjust to human life, their friendship blossoms into something more. However, their love story faces many obstacles, including an alien plotting to invade Earth. What will be the fate of these star-crossed lovers?

title: Accel World
description:
No matter what age it is, the "Bullied Child" will never disappear. The overweight, Middle School student, Haruyuki, was one such kid. The only time he could relax completely, was when he would play a squash game on the local network the school had set up. He loved playing this simple game as he can forget painful times while immersed in it.  
  
It was fall. He was passing his time like this until one day, he had an encounter with the school's most beautiful, refined girl, "Black-Snow Princess"(Kuroyukihime), which changed his life abruptly. Introduced to the software she transmitted, Haruyuki learned about "Accel World." A program that enhances one's mind capabilities, with certain side-effects.  
  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=13857) for the anime.  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=15214) for the OAV (sequel).  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/

title: Senpai! Ima Kara Kokurimasu!
description:
Once Koharu's favourite actress told her that a good woman never gets dumped. Ever since then, Koharu has lived a life where she has neither failed a confession nor she got dumped.   
  
Prideful Koharu decides to take up a challenge and confesses to Kanzaki-senpai, 'the smiling guillotine' only to be turned down even before she gets to complete her sentence. This cannot and shall not be accepted! Koharu refuses to back down and decides to keep on confessing until she gets an OK from Kanzaki-senpai

title: Yo nimo Kahogo na Maou-sama
description:
Sena Yamada is a second-year in high school. For various reasons, she lives alone. She manages to get by by holding down a part-time job. One day, when she was about to be cheated out of her money, she was rescued by a demon king! He told her that she is a reincarnation of a saint and even asked her to move in with him...?　

The exciting life together of a hardworking JK and a pushy demon king is about to begin!

title: Murai in Love
description:
Murai, a high school boy who is acting strangely, confesses his feelings to Tanaka-sensei, an Otome game geek, but is kicked out. The next day, Murai, who has a new haircut, looks a lot like Tanaka's "favorite character"...?!

---
Placed 2nd in the webcomic section of the 2019 Tsugimanga awards.

title: Sonna, 14-sai.
description: [Everyone's saying, 'This is the kind of first love I wanted!'] Takahashi's seatmate, Shioya, immediately notices when she cuts her bangs. Since he always picks up on even the things she doesn't want anyone to notice, Takahashi can't help feeling self-conscious around him...?! A sweet, heart-fluttering glimpse into life at fourteen, packed with all the excitement of first love. Perfect for those who are fourteen now—and those who remember what it was like to be fourteen. ♪

title: ‘Masamune-kun no Revenge’ Tokubetsu-hen - Rental Kareshi Masamune-kun
description: It's Yasaka Private High School's 42nd Cultural Festival, and everyone's having fun with all the events and activities around the school. Aki's class 3-A comes up with an unique "Rental Boyfriend" service that caught eyes of many customers, boys and girls alike, and the rental boyfriend just happens to be Makabe Masamune, who's forced to play along to atone for a great crime he's committed…

title: Not-so-honest Kouhai
description:
Meet Yasu's kouhai Moriyama: she's assertive, deadpan and can be very passive aggressive. What will she make Yasu do today? A hug? Go home together? Take a picture?

**Note:** This is the pre-serialization Twitter Webcomic entry.

title: Ani ga Kareshi de, Gomen
description: When his father re-married, Kazuichi was a timid boy who was easily bullied by his younger stepsister Yami. Through hard work, Kazuichi has become a handsome young man who's the president of the Archery Club and admired by everyone. All in an effort to impress Yami as a reliable older brother, or as something more?

title: Himegoto: The Adult Virgin and the Experienced High Schooler
description: A small collection of yuri manga by Shimizu Hikarino.

title: Hummingbird Effect
description:
[Winner of Bomtoon's BL & GL Contest]  
  
A few generations ago, a mysterious phenomenon occurred. Humans now die after 1.5 billion heart beats; half the heart rate they originally had. Schools began teaching students how to control their emotions and regularly preformed heart rate tests.   
No one is allowed to use more than the number assigned per week.  
  
This is the story of 2 girls that chose to love in this world regardless of their heartbeats.

title: Gunjou Reflection
description: Koharu is a first year Performing Arts student at Funakoshi High school. Her class is full of famous popular people making the anonymous Koharu feel slightly awkward. However, "I want to try a task that only I can do it!", and it's with that resolve that her exciting school life starts. She will star in a mini play to welcome new students, believed to make the leading actors become popular in the future, alongside the mysterious Serizawa Ren…?!

title: Shuukan Shounen Girl
description: Each of this manga's chapters features a new girl. The first chapter starts out with Ichikawa, who mysteriously has a shounen manga show up on her torso each week, a malady she shares with her male classmate, manga-fan Aoi. The second girl, Kawamura, notices that a boy in her class is suddenly being duplicated!

title: The Valentine's Day of Two People Who Fight All the Time
description: To Tsun or not to Tsun, that is the question

title: Sumika Sumire
description: Kisaragi Sumi continuously took care of her parents and grandmother until she turned 60 years old without ever falling in love. One day, after her mother's funeral service, a cat calling himself Rei appeared and granted her wish to bring back her youth. What happens when Sumi gets a second chance in life as a 17-year-old high schooler?!

title: Cross Game
description:
My childhood best friends are four sisters!　

This is a refreshing and sad coming-of-age baseball story about Kitamura Koh, the son of a sporting goods store, and the daughters of the batting center and coffee shop "Clover"!　

It was the summer of the 5th grade in elementary school when Kitamura Koh woke up to baseball... 

It was a long and hot summer that he will never forget. 

(Source: ebookjapan, edited)
___
[Official English](https://www.viz.com/cross-game)
[Official Spanish](https://www.penguinlibros.com/es/content/498-sagas?id=352938&cod_agrup=03680&utm_source=mangadex)
___
- **Won  the 54th Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen in 2009**

title: After School Adventure
description:
She has a crush on her. So, she makes the first step and leaves her with a cute kiss. Except, they're both clueless about each other's intentions!  
GL with LGBTQ+ side characters as well!  
Ch 14 + 15 are NSFW (read at your own discretion) (also the reason for smut tag). Everything else is sfw.  
[Author's Weibo](https://www.weibo.com/milinainai)

title: Secret Playlist
description: An idol, who's the only one who knows my secret, is my classmate? A suspicious DM from an idol! Do you perhaps know that we go to the same school?

title: Karin
description: Karin is a cute little girl who also happens to be a vampire…with a twist. Once a month, she experiences intense bleeding from her nose–we're talking gushers! In other words, she's a vamp with blood to spare, so rather than stealing blood from humans she actually gives her blood to them. If done right, this can be an extremely positive experience that benefits the "victim" as much as the vampire. The problem is that Karin never seems to do things right!

title: Saito-kun wa Esper Rashii
description: Saitou, a rather arrogant kid, announces his super power to his class on the first day of high school. He imagines that it will make all the girls swoon, and he'll be crazily popular. Unfortunately, his ability to bend a spoon looks more like a cheap trick than a super power, and everyone laughs in his face. Soon he learns that he is not the only kid with superpowers at the school, and there is even a Super Powers Research Club. He soon finds himself dragged into the society of a friendly invincible girl, a violent telekinetic girl, and a mind-reader. Rather than being swooned over, Saitou appears to have the least impressive ability of the group! Is there any way for him to get the happy high school life he was hoping for?

title: Henyoku no Drops
description: The year is 3015, the ocean covers 90% of the planet, and it is normal for humans to fly in the sky. People who cannot fly are called "Drops" (the old generation), and Tsubasa is one of them. She lives in a world where there are almost no stairs or ladders, even though the buildings and space between floors is getting higher and farther.

title: Kagami no Kuni no Harisugawa
description: High school student Akira Harisugawa has been in love with Mao Satomi, a girl in his grade, ever since grade school. The only problem? They've been best friends ever since Akira saved her from being hit by a car, and he doesn't want to ruin their friendship! That is until one day, when he finds a mysterious mirror…

title: My Neighbor Keeps Poking Me
description: A RomCom following a girl who keeps poking something or the other; including the boy sitting next to her in class who just wants to study.

title: NakiNagi
description: A quiet witch meets a girl in love. Nakika was once a feared with of the deep sea, but has started a life on the surface to learn about "human emotions." Nagisa is a naive romantic and Nakika's best friend—and although she might not always understand Nagisa's infatuation, her compassion for Nagisa is deeper than the Pacific Ocean! As she uses her magical powers to support Nagisa's quest for love, she gradually learns about "human emotions."

title: Gakkou Ichi Kawaii Joshi ga Ore no Koto Suki Kamo Shirenai Manga
Cheongchun Love-some
description:
"It may be hazy blue, but that's alright"

Taking place a year after the epilogue of Seasons of Blossom, this story focuses on the new opening of “Cafe Blossom and NEMONE Atelier” as well as Bomi’s new classmate “Pureum” as they explore a new found youth. 

Campus romance, after school romance, office romance, it has it all.  

The heartwarming series is back with another youthful story!

title: 32 cm Height Difference
description:
This is the story of two very different girls.

With a 32 cm height difference, the length of their strides, their clothing sizes, and even the clubs they were encouraged to join were all different.

As Ritsu finds herself drawn to Uno’s cheerfulness, the distance between them gradually grows smaller.

title: Sukinahito no Tame ni Hentai ni Naru Koto o Kimeta Hanashi
description: The things we do for love.

title: Yandere Kanojo (Online)
description:
Tanaka Manabu is a geeky student, on the way to school he meets a girl carrying a bloody bat. That girl is Ryuuzaki Reina, leader of the school's female delinquents. It's love at first sight. A gag manga (with a combination of 4koma and normal page) about having a yankee dere-dere girlfriend.  
  
Note: In the title of this series, "yandere" isn't refering to this term, but to the "yankee"+"dere-dere" combination.  
  
Yandere Kanojo came out in two editions. One is the "magazine version", Yandere Kanojo (Joker); and the other one is the "online version", Yandere Kanojo (Online). Chapters are numbered to follow how they were numbered in the volumes, if you notice the numbers in the chapters don't line up with how they are listed, that is why.

title: Kimi wa Sukinosaurus
description:
A mysterious girl and a strange ammonite I met at my new school. I want to dream of the Cretaceous Period with my "favorite" girl! The humble and passionate adolescence of me and her, who devote their high school life to excavating dinosaur fossils, begins!

Youth Romcom about a transfer student boy meeting a fossil fanatic girl in his new school who is introducing him to the paleontology club

title: Adolescent Love
description: For nine years, I have always been in first place throughout my entire school life. I thought that once I entered high school, everything would stay the same. But, someone had actually taken my spot in first place! Unwilling to give up my spot, I switched up my appearance to make my rival fall into my love trap!

title: Horeta Hareta Panda
description:
Will my love destroy the peace of this town!?

After discovering to have incredible stamina, Hanna begins working part-time as a mascot in a costume. Although she is sometimes bullied by children, she was meant to do her best as the mascot hero "Panbuu" to protect the peace of the town - but her true identity is about to be discovered by Ubukata-kun, who is in the class next to her!?

title: Summer Is Hot!
description:
Han Yeoreum, his friend's younger sister, who appeared in front of Black Dragon at Dongdaejeong High School!   
  
Should I keep her unpredictable?

---

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/fengkuangxiari/list?title_no=1525)

title: Furuya-sensei wa An-chan no Mono
description: One day, An was working at the restaurant and sees a young man propose to a woman but get rejected. His "girlfriend" says they were never dating in the first place. Soon, she meets this man again at school where he becomes her teacher! Thus begins the unexpectedly tender romance between An and Furuya!

title: Love Dependency Disease
description:
Love dependency disease: I have a special body condition which will naturally attract some type of people to me, people commonly known as ——”yandere”.  
  
About my story, let me first come down from the surgeon’s table before speaking.  
  
“I won’t let you run away”  
“You’re mine”  
“I won’t let you be handed over to anyone else!”  
“Even if we die, we must still be together in the afterlife, remember that~”  
  
The girls’ words, they still echo around my ears.

title: Omutsu Joshi!
description: Shouta Oone was feeling that his daily school life had become dull. In the midst of his boredom, he coincidentally ends up learning the outrageous secret of his classmate, Ichigo Otohime!

title: Come Come Vanilla!
description: Regular high school boy Kaji Rikuo’s life is suddenly interrupted by a cute girl with cat ears named Vanilla. According to Vanilla, she was created from different mixtures of animals sort of like a chimera by her master, Ibu Kiriko, whom apparently has it out for Rikuo. Confused as to why somebody would want revenge on him, Rikuo become friends with the clueless and cute Vanilla. However, Vanilla can turn into a vicious animal able to hurt Rikuo with a simple command from Kiriko…

title: Usotsuki Ambivalence
description:
Amamiya Ichika, a girl with excellent grades, has a rival she detests: the top-scorer and cold-hearted student council's vice-president, Kizaki Tsukasa. While Ichika, in a flashy disguise, is working hard at her part-time job which is against school rules, Kizaki appears! Ichika introduced herself as Futaba to deceive Kizaki, but to think Kizaki fell in love with Futaba at first sight. ★  
Is this the start of a double life that can't be exposed…?!  
The curtain is raised on this misunderstanding-filled school romance!

title: My Charms Are Wasted on Kuroiwa Medaka (Oneshot)
Senshun Kansoku
description:
Wakamatsu Haruka (3rd year of middle school) finds the new student Hachiya Shuuto (1st year of middle school) sleeping on the train station and Haruka can't help wanting to take care of the small Shuuto.  
  
This is the story of a member of the baseball club and the leader of the school band.

title: Batsu Ichi JK
description:
Amane Anzu, a high school student, is actively looking for a boyfriend. However, most candidates tend to quickly lose interest when they find out she's actually a real divorcee. And if that's still not enough to drive guys away, the fact she has a daughter usually does the trick.

Note: each "volume" is much shorter (50-60 pages) than a usual tankoubon.

title: Who Can Define Popularity?
description:
The ugly and shy Che Qiu Yuan was rejected after he had confessed to the school diva. He was even crowned with the nickname, “Gorilla.” His self-esteem was crushed. Therefore, he decided to turn over a new leaf, “start a new life,” and transform into a dazzling prince charming. From then on, he thought he was invincible. However, one day, he was overshadowed by a narcissistic classmate.  


---

**Links**  
- [Official Chinese (Simp.) Translation](https://manga.bilibili.com/m/detail/mc28062)

title: Tonari no Seki no Inumimi JK ga Kininaru
description: The girl sitting next to Itou in his high school class really seems to hate him...?  Any time he looks at her she growls and makes a scary face. But... he kinda likes it.

title: Kami-sama ga Koi wo shiro to Itte iru!
description: Chiyoko, in her second year of high school, transfers to a co-ed school due to her dad's job transfer. Since she's only attended an all-girls school since junior high, she excitedly plans to fall in love in her new school. Out of the blue, she begins to see the love meters of 5 hotties and an options window as if she were in an otome game?! She encounters various types such as a glasses boy, a playboy underclassman, and a mysterious senior. Meet-cutes with boys come one after another. This is the beginning of a real otome game school life!

title: Corridor of Mirs
description:
One day, a girl woke up from a near car accident, and her name was Baek Nabi. After her chance encounter with a beautiful man, who saved her from the accident, Nabi starts to see things she has never seen before. Creatures who live off from human’s negative emotions are called ‘parasites’ . Nabi’s once normal life has overturned and becomes intertwined with several men all at the same time… “You’re a special existence. You just haven’t remembered yet.” A fantasy romance of Nabi and the mysterious beings around her.  


---

Official English translation by Comico's [Pocket Comics](https://www.pocketcomics.com/comic/208)

title: Kuchibiru ni Kimi no iro
description:
In this colourful world, I lost all of my colours…  
Then the boy shining in gold arrives to change it?  
Touching new series by Iwashita Keiko begins now!  
  
[PL] W tym kolorowym świecie straciłam wszystkie swoje kolory. Czy chłopiec w złocie, który się pojawił, to zmieni?

title: Love Potion Brewing
description: In order to learn about human society, a witch transfers to a high school and begins living independently. In class, she meets a boy who can see through her invisibility magic. Their relationship quickly deepens. Can the little witch find the friendship that she’s looking for? Will love blossom?

title: Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun Anthology
description:
Official anthology for Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun. This anthology features illustrations and manga drone by other mangaka, and includes *The King's Game, Nozaki-kun* by Tsubaki Izumi herself.

---
**Cover**: [Tsubaki Izumi](https://mangadex.org/author/191d502d-1560-4c60-91f9-27134f8d6e40)
**Illustrations**: [Yoshino Satsuki](https://mangadex.org/author/3a38d246-50d8-4938-a3ca-01f4a01b4a87), [Yamauchi Yasunobu](https://mangadex.org/author/33e95a04-a5be-4fe3-84f0-240f69320af7), [Higuchi Tachibana](https://mangadex.org/author/35de546a-9fbb-49ee-846d-df3865890a18), [Takao Shigeru](https://mangadex.org/author/177765c2-a196-41e8-8793-885e6571e661)

8. Konkichi
9. namo
10. Namisaki Yuka
11. Nekokurage
12. Nohara Yuta
13. Fuji
14. Miki Maki
15. Mijin Kouka
16. Minami Toutarou

title: Maria-san wa Toumei Shoujo
description:
Maria discovers her invisibility powers when she is 5 years old, but there's a catch – whenever she feels calm or depressed, she starts turning invisible against her will. The only way to turn back or stay visible is to make sure she has heart throbbing doki doki thoughts available at a moment's notice.  
  
What better way to keep her heart throbbing than to hide in her handsome senpai's house, naked and invisible, and watch his most private moments?  
  
A new scifi work with a slightly(?) hentai heroine by the same artist that brought us Midori no Hibi and Mahou no Iroha!

title: Zutto Otokoda to Omotteta Osananajimi ga…
Monnan Ori
description: Ori is the main character of an unfinished story written by "Grandfather". So far, she's lived the life of one being bullied, and hates herself for being unable to stand up for herself. An unnamed male is given the task to finish her story, and we'll see how Ori's life will continue from here!

title: Shiritsu Hakanai Gakuen
description: The line between brilliance and madness is razor thin, and oftentimes the actions of geniuses are beyond the understanding of those around them. Such was the case of Yuuka's friend, the perfect and pristine Seiwain Hanao, wielder of beauty, talent, and grace that surpassed anything the diffident tomboy Yuuka could hope for. There is a gap between them that Yuuka cannot even begin to cross. But once Hanao is elected as the new Student Council President, everything changes. And the next day, Yuuka comes to school without wearing panties. Hanao also doesn't wear panties. None of the girls wear panties. That's the new rule. The incomprehensible idol Seiwain Hanao has taken the chance to force a fragment of her incomprehensible genius onto the rest of the student body, and the security of underwear has been banished from their school forevermore.

title: Boku Girl Boyish-chan
description: Senpai, my girlfriend, who looks like a tomboy, is actually a bottom that gets easily horny.

title: Gal to Jimiko ga Koi wo suru Seishun Yuri Anthology
Kyouhan
description:
A boy called Yamamoto, who is the son of a priest, has a crush on his classmate Reina (the heiress of their little island's largest company). Because of a small kindness she showed him. 
One day, Yamamoto was called over by Reina. When they share a secret that they should not have stepped into, they are connected. 
A suspenseful tale of love and escape begins!!

title: Ryou Kataomoi Overkill!
description: "I never thought I would fall in love..." "But I'm not sure how I feel about this person, much less this other person!" You can't have it both ways!

title: Batsu-Gyaru
description: A cute and sugary oneshot of a gyaru chasing a guy.

title: Mizuno and Chayama
description:
In a small town where "water (Mizu)", and "tea (Cha)" are its sole lifeblood, the conflict between a major tea plantation, and the "opposition" who claims the tea industry is polluting the water, continues to grow.  
  
There resides Mizuno, whose father leads the "opposition", and Chayama, a girl bullied by her classmates for being the sole daughter of the tea plantation. Backgrounds barring them from even talking, they rendezvous behind closed curtains…  
  
  
Alternate summary:  
||Mizuno, a high school girl in an isolated province. While worrying about her father's mayoral election campaign, she also has to keep up with her studies and socializing. But she has a secret she can never reveal to anyone: at a given time, at a given place, she meets with another girl. When they meet, they tease each other, and yet she remains Mizuno's beloved.||

title: Akita sister! Ebina-chan
description: Spin-off of Himouto! Umaru-chan about Umaru's friend, Ebina.

title: Hoshi to Kuzu - Don't Worry, Be Happy
description:
Anzu is poor but very ambitious and aims for a bright future. Her first step is to be student council president but that chance is destroyed by the equally ambitious and egocentric Yamabuki. She just has to settle for being the vice-president.

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media Komputindo as **STAR & DUST: Don`t Worry, be Happy** (2022)

title: Otomari Honey
description:
A love-stricken 15 year-old girl visits her object of desire…  
  
Only to find that he already houses 3 other girls in his room! So what does she do to protect him? Why move right on in with them, of course! Hilarity and fan service ensues!

title: Osananajimi no Oneechan ga Sukitte Iu Betana Manga
description:
Just a short one-shot manga that was posted by the artist on Twitter.  
  
The summary is already the title itself.  
  
Enjoy~!

title: Nano List
description:
Milo lives in a world where interacting with androids is completely normal. And now, he lives with *two* androids built by his sister. How safe is he living with androids who have deadly strength? Why did his sister gift him a "bodyguard android?" Well, he's about to find out the hard way.
Source: Webtoon

title: Tamaranai no wa Koi na no ka
