Meanwhile, Yumii was hoping for Sheltis to become her Sen’nenshi, but because he fell, her wish is still unfulfilled. A multi-layered world fantasy where their feelings intertwine!

title: Let's Meet Again Tomorrow
description: High school girls meet and fall in love on the train.

title: What Color is it?
description: A oneshot uploaded to twitter by Nishizawa 5Miri.

title: A Badboy Drinks Tea!
description: Delinquent Funabashi Masaya, also known as Devil Ma-kun, a boy who has been repeatedly entangled and beaten up by thugs, perhaps due to his devilish face. When he enters high school, he intends to make a fresh start and lead a relaxed school life, but not only doesn't get approached when he is recruited for club activities, they avoid him at first sight. But then a female student asks him, “Would you like some tea?” and, he joins the Tea Ceremony Club hoping for a peaceful mind and life. Will he escape from a cycle of violence and master the path of goodness?

title: Kimi to Boku.
description: Shun, Kaname, and the twins Yuuki and Yuuta have been friends since kindergarten. It's a little hard to tell if they actually get along or not - but even as high-school students, they hang out together. Recently, they've had a new addition; a half-Japanese transfer student Chizuru, who has started to liven up the group.

title: After School Lessons for Unripe Apples
description:
That asshole is back as an entirely new level of asshole!   
  
In her final year of middle school, Hwang Miae is stuck with Kim Cheol, a boy she met briefly years ago - he's her classmate… and her neighbor. Now the other kids keep calling them a couple! In a flurry of uneasiness, Cheol starts to avoid Miae like the plague.   
  
You bastard! Do you think you're the only one going through this?   
  
But it doesn't stop there. Destiny won't leave them alone as Kim Cheol and Hwang Miae keep seeing each other everywhere… causing even more trouble. As strange friends intrude on their relationship, Miae experiences puberty the right way…   
  
A new project of <Cheese In The Trap> author Soonkki!

title: Absolute Darling Girlfriends
description: スパダリな女の子に翻弄される漫画

title: Majimoji Rurumo
description:
Shibaki is a high-school boy whose only interest is girls. It's just that he's been branded as the greatest pervert at school and the girls avoid him like the plague.  
  
One day he happens to find a book in the library about how to summon witches. He tries it as a joke, but it turns out to be the real thing. An apprentice witch named Rurumo grants his foolish wish for a high price. Shibaki ends up helping Rurumo and in return she refuses to take his soul. Doing so, Rurumo loses her position and puts her own life on the line.  
  
Rurumo must complete the task of getting Shibaki to use 666 magic wishing tickets before she can become a witch again. However, every time ticket is used, Shibaki's life shortens.  
  
Now, Shibaki has his own life on his hands. Make a lot of wishes and help Rurumo become a witch again or resist the temptation and try to live long life.

title: Clover Under My Feet
description:
Dogs, cats, rabbits, tigers, and foxes exist in this world. Everything was chosen in the past and nothing has changed since.  
…  
Is it true that nothing has changed?  
[Mutant] A 'breed' the world has ignored and refused to accept. To those who justify their beliefs and kept their eyes shut, they are none other than existences that go against the 'rules.'  
  
This story is about those whose identities are mixed.

title: Trying to Do Erotic Things by Using an Aphrodisiac
Never Understand
description: Yuri, one of the school's most handsome guys, and Jaerim, one of the school's ugliest, collide!...or don't they...Can't understand what's going on between these two! It's Out of Control!!

title: Ama Ama
description: Yuji's girlfriend Misaki may seem hard and cold on the outside, but inside she's actually soft and loving. As they prepare for their high school entrance exams, Misaki decides that they should temporarily cut off all their dating activities. Will they be able to study hard enough through this period to get into the same high school?

title: Hinadori no Waltz
description: Hinako Momose isn't very good with men and had been going to all-girls' school. For Hinako, the high school that she got into is a former all-boys school with only 4 girls who got in (including Hinako). Poor Hinako is getting teased by Mizuki, a boy who sits next to her in the class and the class representative Shun gives cold glares at her. What's going to happen to Hinako's school life?!

title: Uchi no Maid ga Class no Suki na Ko ni Niteiru (Pre-Serialization)
description: Eiga, the next head of the prestigious Kujo family, is in a serious predicament. That is, love. He wants to approach Himeka, a girl in his class whom he secretly has feelings for, but because it is his first love, he can't think of a good way to do it... At that moment, he decides to ask for advice from Maria, a maid of the same age who serves the Kujo family...!?

title: Gap no Arujoshi 2 Nin ga Yuri
Mikami to Sato wa Mada Yamashikunai
description: Mikami, who has zero romantic experience, thoughtlessly kisses his roommate and best friend Sato. What will happen next between the two friends?

title: Amalgam of Distortion
description: The story is about a boy who wants to confess his feelings to his childhood friend. Unfortunately, after choosing the place to confess, he gets crushed by a train and loses his lower half. He gets saved by a scientist that turns him into a monster instead of a regular human being. How is his life going to be like under the guise of being a monster? And what would his childhood friend think?!

title: Naraku Sama wa Inaka de Choro I
description:
With over 10 million followers, Nanao Naraku is a wildly popular high school influencer in the city. But due to her parents' job transfer, she ends up moving deep into the countryside. "I'll make everyone here part of my fan club!" she boldly declares, but her signature charisma has zero effect on Haruno, the boy assigned to show her around!? On top of that, she's thrown off by bizarre rural customs where city common sense doesn't apply, overly straightforward and unintentional praise, and cluelessly intimate physical closeness that completely ignores personal space... leaving Nanao totally shaken!

"Th-that close... I can't handle it...!"

title: Gekijouban Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Hoshi wo Yobu Shoujo
description: The seasons have changed and it will soon be the second spring. Tatsuya and Miyuki have finished their first year at First Magic High School and are on their spring break. The two go to their villa on the Ogasawara Island archipelago. After only a small moment of peace a lone young woman named Kokoa appears before them. She has abandoned the Naval base and she tells Tatsuya her one wish.

title: Takamine-san wa, Asuka-kun to Asobitai.
description: Takamine-san has the air of a haughty girl, but she loves to play like an elementary school kid. Asuka-kun is burly and fierce-looking, but he is actually gentle and kind. The two enjoy playing old-fashioned games together, but every time, they inevitably end up in a heart-stopping situation...?

title: Suki Kirai Kisu
description:
Living together with the person who rejected me?!  
  
I'm Hinakawa Nagi, 16 years old. I confessed to Tomoe, the boy who often made eye contact with me. But I was rejected in the worst possible way when he replied with, "Ew. Don't talk to me again, ugly." When I thought I have to hurry and forget about him, we ended up living together!! Even though he rejected me, he touches and kisses me… What is this strange but sweet relationship of ours?!  
  
This is an extremely sweet and fluffy cohabitation love story under one roof!

title: Koi Koi Koi
description: This is a romantic comedy about Sakura, a girl who gives her all for love and Matsuyuki, a boy who absolutely hates romance.

title: Shiokaze to Ryuu no Sumika
description: The story follows Mizuka, who lost her father and is taken in by her uncle, moving to a town steeped in the legend of the dragonpeople. Determined to start anew in this unfamiliar place, Mizuka finds herself at odds with Tenshin, a young ‘dragonperson’ boy lodging at her uncle's home…

title: Shugo Chara!
description: Everybody at Seiyo Elementary thinks that stylish and supercool Amu has it all. But nobody knows the real Amu, a shy girl who wishes she had the courage to truly be herself. Changing Amu's life is going to take more than wishes and dreams—it's going to take a little magic! One morning, Amu finds a surprise in her bed: three strange little eggs. Each egg contains a Guardian Character, an angel-like being who can give her the power to be someone new. With the help of her Guardian Characters, Amu is about to discover that her true self is even more amazing than she ever dreamed. [Kodansha]

title: Brave Star☆ Romantics
description:
Superpowers are now common among the world's population. The manifestation of powers is known as Girls' Witch Syndrome, and the origin of the sudden large scale bestowal of extraordinary abilities to children is an entity named the Mother Witch. Ayumu Takenami carries the title of Brave Star as the top ranking CARD member.  
  
CARD is an organization formed from the children and girls that have superpowers. After he dispatches armed kidnappers with his bare fists somewhere in the Middle East, Ayumu drops everything to go see his crush in Japan. Yuki Saimiya is an average 17 year-old high school girl with insignificant powers but wishes she could be more like the rumoured Brave Star. [Kamas]

title: Seifuku!
description:
**From AngryFox:**  
Yuusuke is a guy who loves flat-chested girls. On his first day in high school, he meets the girl of his dreams who is also his sempai, named Momoka. She asks him to join her club, which is in trouble due to the lack of members. Despite his childhood friend's warning, he decides to join the notorious and mysterious club...

title: Villainess & GalMaid
description: Pre-serialization oneshot of Gal Maid & Villainess.

title: Koakuma JK Psycho
description: After the Golden Week holiday, Kokoro Kasai, a stunningly beautiful and naturally charming high school sophomore, transfers to Shimotsuki High School. With her striking looks and engaging personality, she easily handles even the most daring conversations with a smile. Aspiring to become the student council president, Kokoro soon attracts the attention of some troublesome students with bad intentions. However, what they don't realize is that Kokoro Kasai is actually a psychopath.

title: Takahashi-kun wa Mite Iru.
description:
心が覗ける神アプリのせいで陽キャな数学教師と陰キャな保健教師がエッチに迫りまくる！！？

高校1年生・高橋衛には気になる女性がいた。それは見た目もスタイルもすべてが完璧な教師・鳴海綾だ。衛はそんな彼女のことを、昔出会った憧れの幼馴染なのではないかと疑っていた。悶々とする日々を送っていた衛はある日、異性の本音が覗ける謎のアプリ「ノゾキミアプリ」を手に入れる。綾が昔あった幼馴染かたしかめるため、心を覗こうとするのだが、彼女はとんでもない変態だった・・・！？

title: Kirika-sama wa Kishi ni Naritai
description: Published in Kirara Forward 2023-12

title: Kurusu Arisu wa Kuuru de Itai
description: Kurusu Alice wants to be cool. Even when she blunders big time in front of people...

title: Koi De Wa Nai to Omoitai
description: Keiichi, a high school student, is childhood friends with the cool and popular Souta. Despite always being swayed around by Souta who does things at his own pace, it was a relationship where he could always be next to and say anything. However, recently, Keiichi’s heart starts to beat fast because of Souta who said “It’s fun to be around Keiichi,” with a smile on his face. Keiichi tried to deceive his captivated heart by thinking “It’s not love,” but that lie is noticed by his junior, Sakuraba…?!

title: King of Idol
description:
Mahoro Harukana moves to Tokyo to achieve the dream of becoming an Idol. In order to do this, Mahoro will assist to the National Entretainment and Music School in Kamisaka. Everything goes surprisingly well, being great at singing and dancing, and even her teammates are astonished by her talent.  
The only problem is that… Mahoro is actually a boy, and a boy who wants to become The King of the Idols!


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media (2018; complete)

title: Urasaki-san wants to tell Omoteno-kun.
description: Urasaki-san is not very good at expressing her feelings. On the other hand, Omoteno-kun, who sits next to her, is very honest and open with his feelings. Urasaki-san is flustered by Omoteno-kun's straightforward expressions of affection as she tries to find a way of communicating her own feelings for him. A love comedy about about two people who are complete opposites!

title: Saiyaku wa Boku o Suki Sugiru
description:
Two families are tied together by a curse. Every 100 years, one person from each family must share the same fate for exactly one year. The pair will be subjected to twelve misfortunes, where one will get hurt while the other must sustain their injuries in return.  
  
When Kagura Izumi was seven, his parents died in an accident. Since then, he has been living an ordinary life. Until the day of his seventeenth birthday, when he meets a mysterious transfer student, Ichijyou Chihaya. However, this fateful encounter between them is only the start of their intertwined fate. For the next year, the two of them will be forced to face 12 misfortunes on the 13th of every month, a curse that has never left any previous pair alive.

title: Self-Proclaimed Experienced Gyaru
description: A self-proclaimed experienced gyaru going through the trouble of telling you she's going to the ocean with a handsome senpai after school.

title: Sakura wa Watashi o Suki Sugiru
description: Kiwa just broke up with her cheating boyfriend and right when she was wondering if there are no good guys out there, she was suddenly confessed to by her classmate, Sakura. Even though she already rejected him saying that he's not her type, Sakura continues to confess to Kiwa everyday. He's so sweet, it's embarassing! Who would have thought this cool guy would be so direct and passionate in his love!

title: Sakura Sakura (Morishige)
description:
Fifteen years ago, natality decreased greatly in Japan and the few who were born during that time are called the "LastGen."  
  
Hanasaka Haru, a 15-year-old LastGen kid, has never met any classmates before. Now, he goes to school for the first time and meets Himeshiro Sakurako. But Sakurako is not quite the ideal classmate he imagined, and his dream school life isn't turning out the way he wanted it to…

title: Ane Kurabe
description: Shun knew what to expect when he became a high school student. As he entered the gates of his new school, four beautiful girls suddenly surround him. These four girls are the same four girls he grew up with since kindergarten. The four girls are Rio the athlete, Miku the cook, Nana the nerd, and Yuri the student president. These four girls will be battling it out between them in order to win the heart of their beloved Shun.

title: Sekirara Hime to Minus Ouji
description:
A short spin-off that center around Momoki Riri's daily life as the "Boner Princess" at her school while the transfer student Onodera Shouta who, thanks to Momoki, gained the title "Impotent Prince", does his best to ensure no harms come to her due to her blunt, reckless words.  
  
This manga takes place after Vol.8 Chapter 47 in [Henjo - Hen na Jyoshi Kousei Amaguri Senko](https://mangadex.org/title/15331/henjo-hen-na-jyoshi-kousei-amaguri-senko). As of Henjo Vol.15+16, Sekirara Hime to Minus Ouji has been officially adapted as part of Henjo's Omake chapters.

title: Money, Romance and Me
description: Ougonji Kogane has been absurdly wealthy her whole life, with the riches she obtained from the business she made in elementary school she has had everything she ever wanted, and now sets out to purchase romance.

title: A Manga about a Beautiful Girl
description: A series of short comics by Mattaku Moosuke (@mmousuke on Twitter) about the cutest girl in class, Inuta-san, and the boy sitting next to her, Inukai-kun.

title: Relationship Guidelines
description:
“Ugh! Life’s been miserable ever since that one stupid kiss! I NEVER should've done that! 'You wanna try?' she asked—It’s all her fault, and now she’s ignoring me! I can’t stop thinking about her!!!" Poor, unfortunate Jiwon, stuck in a hormonal, teen game of cat and mouse. Kissed by her best friend, she’s left to her own devices to figure out what the hell is going on. Watch as cat turns to mouse, mouse to cat, and see how two childhood friends tiptoe the boundaries of their relationship.

---

- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://tw.kakaowebtoon.com/content/%E9%97%9C%E4%BF%82%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97/127)

- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/72869)

- [Official Thai Translation](https://th.kakaowebtoon.com/content/%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%94%E0%B9%8C%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%8C%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%94%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%81/90)

title: Union!
description: After being kidnapped by an "alien woman" Yuuta developed a severe case of gynophobia. Having to be in charge of a bath house, Yuuta couldn't be more inconvienienced by this. Just when he was thinking of trying to cure his phobia no matter what, a beautiful girl called Uni suddenly appears in front of him, and that's not all, that girl says she's the daughter of the alien woman who kidnapped and that her mother won an award by investigating him. Her mother feels truly grateful for this so she sent Uni to repay Yuuta with anything he desires and told her not to come back before she does it. What will happen after Yuuta asks her to cure his phobia in the least painful way possible?

title: White Angels Have No Wings
description: A Catholic school where everything seems tranquil and fine. But for Ayeon, a day doesn't pass without getting bullied until one day, Yeonhwa steps in against the bullies. Ayeon is grateful for Yeonhwa but what she doesn't realize is that there seems to be something more than just good intentions behind that beautiful smile.

title: Amelia no Koukiteki Romance
description:
Ameli, a model student and class representative in her first year of high school, has her world turned upside down after a month of classes when her secret is uncovered by Haruka, a second-year student with a devilish charm !

Amelia... What’s really hidden behind that pseudonym ?

title: Takara no Biidoro
description: Taishin has moved away from his hometown, Fukuoka, to a university in Tokyo to chase after Takara, a boy who had consoled him during the summer of his third year in high school as he cried. Though they were able to reunite with no issues, Takara pushes Taishin away, coldly asking him, "What do you plan on doing after meeting me?"

title: Kamisama Gakkou no Ochikobore
description:
Modern Japan, a very ordinary and ordinary world. But it's a little different. Gods exists in this world.

One day, Nagi, who is about to enter high school, suddenly receives a letter of acceptance from the "God's School" where people with supernatural powers gather. Even though she hasn't even taken the entrance exam? He says she passed the recommendation frame from a strange god, but Nagi's grades are the lowest in his grade among only elites enrolling! The daily life of a school dropout girl begins to move towards the extremely difficult national qualification "God"!

title: Poker Face na Doukyuusei-chan
description:
A sweet manga about a classmate who tries to keep a poker face because she's worried about her baby face, but her inner thoughts are leaking out.
___
**Alternative Raw**: [Twitter](https://twitter.com/watapome/status/1376495824398479360)

title: The Girl Who Transforms into a Cat Once a Month
I Swear We're Just Friends
description:
Rien is a transfer student at Arena Academy who wants a peaceful life. The successor of the Lisianthus Duchy fell in love at first sight with her.

Carlson, who has the face of an innocent man, is a genius in magic, who excels in both looks and family background. He only has one flaw.; he always beats up anything that irritates him.

"I like kind men."

Rien's determination with such words, Carlson's gentle face, and even the thought that this relationship will end once they graduate all clouded her mind. However, Rien still can't help but feel attracted to Carlson.

Can this friendship proceed smoothly?
____
When Rienne transfers to the elite Alena Academy, she never expects Karcion, the most popular mage in school, to recruit her into his club...and she definitely doesn't think he'll fall for her! But the grumpy Karcion soon makes it clear how much he adores her, and she starts finding him too cute to ignore. Still, he's a future duke and she's a commoner, so Rienne knows his feeling

title: That Wolf-Boy Is Mine!
description:
Kusonoki Komugi lives with her mother in Tokyo and can't get along with classmates. Because of her mother's business trip, she has to stay with her father in Hokkaido for a year. She thinks she will have opportunities to make new friends. She got to sit next to Oogami Yuu, a popular boy who tells her she smells good. One day, she discovers his secret…

[Official English](https://kodansha.us/series/that-wolf-boy-is-mine/)

title: Gosick
description: Lấy bối cảnh châu Âu những năm 1920, câu chuyện theo chân Kazuya Kujo, một học sinh Nhật Bản tại Học viện St. Marguerite, và Victorique de Blois, cô gái thiên tài bí ẩn với khả năng suy luận sắc bén. Cùng nhau, họ đối mặt với các vụ án kỳ bí, từ những bí mật trong trường học đến các âm mưu lớn hơn. Với nét vẽ tinh tế và cách kể chuyện cuốn hút, manga Gosick giữ trọn tinh thần của nguyên tác, mang đến sự kết hợp hài hòa giữa trinh thám, lãng mạn và không khí cổ điển

title: Kyou no Kira-kun
description:
In 360 days, there was bright days and disappointment while I was staring at you. Though they were neighbor, Nino and Kira never talk to each other…  
  
But when Nino knows about Kira's secret, all of her life changes and her everyday becomes more interesting!  
Their link will lead them to love close to paradise.

title: Black Jack
description: Câu chuyện xoay quanh việc chữa bệnh cứu người và những vấn đề y khoa, trong đó nhân vật chính là Black Jack, một bác sĩ tài giỏi nhưng “quái dị”. Điểm đặc biệt của anh chính là một vết sẹo dài trên khuôn mặt mà bất cứ ai trông thấy cũng phải khiếp sợ. Những người bệnh tìm đến anh đa số là những người, hoặc người thân họ, mắc những căn bệnh lạ hay bệnh hiểm nghèo mà không có vị bác sĩ nào có thể chữa được. Họ tìm đến anh với hy vọng anh dùng tài phẫu thuật kỳ diệu của mình để giữ lại mạng sống cho họ. Mỗi tập truyện là những câu chuyện xoay quanh việc chữa trị bệnh có một không hai của bác sĩ quái dị Black Jack. Qua đó, bạn đọc được chứng kiến công việc cực nhọc, những cuộc phẫu thuật đẫm mồ hôi và cả những lúc đứng trước quyết định sinh tử của một bác sĩ. Chính nhờ đó, câu chuyện của bác sĩ Black Jack đã truyền cảm hứng cho nhiều bạn đọc truyền tranh trong việc theo đuổi đam mê nghề y của mình

title: Chikyuu no Owari wa Koi no Hajimari
description:
Mahiru is a negative girl, who always feels that any stroke of fortune will create a corresponding misfortune. She only wished to live her high school life in peace, but instead, she catches the eye of the handsome school prince.  
  
Laughter, tears, and shortcuts?! An ultra-miracle love story begins!

title: D•N•Angel•
description: Daisuke Niwa is an ordinary, if slightly unlucky, middle school student. On his fourteenth birthday, he comes down with a 'condition' that has plagued the men in his family for three hundred years. When he sees his crush, Risa, he transforms into his alter ego, the phantom thief Dark Mousy. Unfortunately, when Dark Mousy sees his crush, Risa's twin Riku, he transforms back into Daisuke. The only cure for this craziness is if Daisuke can get Risa to fall in love with him...

title: Tottemo Tanpen Mangashuu
description:
Collections, in no particular order, of super short comics posted by author Hamita on Twitter/X and pixiv. The short story collections mainly include romcom and boy meets girl, but also include various genres such as scifi, gag, and suspense.

## Volume 1
1. An Imperfect Woman
2. Different Kind Of Different Kind
3. My Girlfriend Isn't Cute
4. Image Frequency
5. A Salesman Who Sells Greed
6. Maid Makeshift
7. A Goddess Without Inconvenience
8. One-Night-Only Passingman
9. Overhumankind's Planet

## Volume 2
10. Persistent Sports Girl
11. Misdelivered Love Letter
12. The Person Who Filled My Heart
13. A Beauty Soft And Fluffy In All Directions
14. The Apathetic Maid's Mismanagement
15. A Cold Senior And Warm Junior
16. The Ideal Cool Girl Who Is Only Kind To Herself
17. Duplicity And A Laughingstock
18. Robot And Landscape Painting

## Volume 3
19. The Soft-Spoken Conveni Clerk
20. A Girl Who Grasped A Secret
21. A Girlfriend Who Wants To Make Meals
22. I Want To Quit Being A Demon
23. A

title: Yomitai Hon wa Nai Keredo
description:
Ryouhei is a high school student at risk of repeating another year. For the first time in years, he visits the library to study. However, he encounters a cute girl studying opposite him! Even though there's no book he wants to read, he visits the library the following day, the day after that, and so on.   
  
The library is quiet, but his heart sure isn't! How will this quiet romantic comedy unfold?

title: Fukou-kun wa Kiss Suru Shika Nai!
description: College student Fukuhara Kouta has bad luck that causes problems everywhere he goes. One day, Shinomiya, a student with super good luck, helps him out. Now, in order to divide the luck between them, they need to be with each other all the time.

title: Ga-Rei
description: While many of us would probably scream at even the thought of a ghost being near us, Freshman Nimura Kensuke just thinks of it as a common everyday thing, seeing as how he has the uncanny ability to see so many of them on a daily basis. Things soon heat up for him when he meets a girl who changes his life from then on. Her name’s Kagura, and she has the power to summon a mighty “spirit devourer”–otherwise known as a “Ga-rei”–called Byakuei. So, what’s Nimura to do? Chase down the evil spirits and have Kagura summon the Ga-rei to devour them, of course! Now, come feast on their adventures like some ravenous Ga-rei!

title: The Senpai of the Art Club
It Should Have Been a Prank Confession...
The Story of a Delinquent Girl and a Serious Boy
Kenshin no Keishousha
description: Tokyo Swordia, formerly known as Tokyo Metropolitan, has been ruled by the "Swordie" since the Third World War 70 years ago. These Swordie, natural-born swordswomen with an attraction to blades, more or less rule the country, and are considered upper-class members of society. In order to raise his own social status, Kurou, a human, begins attending an academy of swordsmanship, surrounding himself with Swordies on a daily basis. How will he fare in combat against those born to fight?

title: Domina no Do!
description: Tsuchie Takeshi has dreams of playing with Hikari-chan as a child. He remembers her as a kind, sweet girl. However, one day on the way home from school, Takeshi is abducted and taken to a huge house, only to find out that she's become an arrogant, violent dominatrix. Furthermore, she says that he promised to marry her! How will he adjust to her new personality, and living with her as a new son of her prestigious family?

title: Oretachi wa Kyou Sex wo Suru
description:
Kenshi falls in love with Io at first sight, a quiet transfer student who barely speaks unless spoken to. Determined to win her heart, he spends a year slowly getting closer until they finally start dating.

**Award:** Won an Excellent Work in Shounen Magazine's 115th Newcomer Manga Grand Awards (Dec 2025).

title: Houtai Gokko
description: Hirose Itsuki is a high school girl who is afraid of getting hurt. One day, Hino, a celebrity at school who quit basketball because of an injury, asks her, "Do you know any good ways to pass the time?" Hino asks her if she knows of any good ways to pass the time, and they end up studying together. Itsuki then gradually becomes aware of Hino. A pure love story of a medical student begins!

title: How to Properly Care for Your Pet Wife
description:
What?! A game's pets are becoming human and moving into my house one by one?!   
  
17 year old introverted high school student, Zhu Ling, finds no interest in the real world. Until one day, a nude girl appeared before him when he was completing his pet collection in a mobile game! Said girl even proclaimed to be one of the pets in the game and demanded to move in with Zhu Ling and help him collect items!   
  
One by one, each pet in his collection turned into pet girls and gathered in his house.   
  
Hey! You're all really getting in the way of my gaming time!

title: Sensei, Kurokami ni Natte mo Kidzuite Kureru?
description: Kosugi Naomi is an unremarkable girl in all aspects, but she sports blonde hair that invites the wrath of her HR teacher, Hoshida Ryuuhei, a large and rough guy who often threatens to beat up his students. But Naomi takes in all of Hoshida sensei's yelling and threats with a smile and seems to invite more with her actions.

title: A Romcom With a Girly Guy and a Boyish Girl
description: Noa Kagura is a cross-dresser who gets asked out by Shinobu Takada, a boyish girl on their school's karate team.

title: Kawaii Kara Kimi Ga Warui
description:
Yukito is an average high school student with a gorgeous and outstanding twin sister, whose only similarity she shares with him is her face. Yukito, who's always getting compared to his sister, also has someone he likes - that person being his cousin, Taiki. There are rumors of the cool and popular Taiki and Yukito's sister liking each other. The relationship between Taiki and Yukito had become one where they'd both grown reserved around another, but using the preparations for the school festival as an opportunity, Yukito and Taiki both quickly grow close again! Yukito's heart wouldn't stop racing after being saved by Taiki when he was being troubled…! Moreover, in an unexpected turn of events, the two of them started sharing ""a secret""…?  
  
The secret love between two cousins!

title: Musunde Hiraite
description: School life never fails to be an alluring theme to the reader. Even more so if there's romance involved. Musunde Hiraite chooses to take a quite innovative path in the description of high school romance, as it doesn't simply focus on a single character's pubescent worries, but rather has a school-wide purview.

title: Honey
description: Little did Nao Kogure realize back in middle school that when she left an umbrella and a box of bandages in the rain for injured delinquent Taiga Onise that she would meet him again in high school. Nao wants nothing to do with the gruff and frightening Taiga, but he suddenly presents her with a huge bouquet of flowers and asks her to date him—with marriage in mind! Is Taiga really so scary, or is he a sweetheart in disguise?

title: Hoezura ni Kamitsuku Kisu
description:
"What a cute face…" he said stripping off his mask and kissing him  
  
Kyota, who hides his face with a mask due to his past trauma, closed off his heart and exists inconspicuously in class. However, he is persistently bothered by Arino, who he wants nothing to do with and reveals his face. Kyota is being teased as he turns red and resists. His crying face is all the more attractive to Arino…

title: Okujouhime
description: On his first day of high school, Mayuzumi has a fateful encounter with the President of the Student Council - nicknamed "The Rooftop Princess," a girl who manages to spark his interest the second he sees her. This meeting leads to a series of events which turn Mayu's life completely upside down.

title: Glass Mask
description:
Chigusa Tsukikage holds the rights to the play "The Crimson Goddess," a lost masterpiece that many would love to see brought back to the stage.  
  
Tsukikage, however, won't allow the cherished work to be diminished by an actress who isn't worthy of playing the title role. Fortunately, she has found two young actresses that just might be worthy: Maya Kitajima and Ayumi Himekawa. Though both actresses are exceptionally talented, only one can win the coveted role.

---
- **Won the Japan Cartoonists Association Award in 1995**

---

Published in Indonesian by Elex Media as **Topeng Kaca**

title: Takabisha Koujo wa Damattenai
description:
"Shut up!"

The decisive play of the villainess. Imperial Princess Claudia appears, cutting through a scene that is common these days. With her overwhelming presence, she quickly dominates the scene and imposes reality on the girl dreaming of a prince with no sense of responsibility and the duchess who has been turned into a villain! With her squire, Beryl, in tow, the Imperial Princess reaps evil after evil that creeps up on her in this painful love fantasy!
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2952gb/)

title: I Love You Baby
description:
You are the "first" of everything for me who is afraid of guys.  
  
A 7th grade girl by the name of Mirei is not allowed to do anything after school due to her strict parents, but one day she goes out on her own after her mom has left for work. That day, she meets a boy that seems to be younger than her. What will become of this meeting?

title: Sakurasaku Shoukougun
description:
Childhood friends Wakatake and Kagetora meet again after not seeing each other for more than 8 years.  
  
Wakatake is a boy who takes his studies extremely serious, as he is to take over the medical clinic of his parents one day. Kagetora is an impulsive girl, who spends most of her time fighting outside on the streets, instead of the class room.  
  
Now that Kagetora decided to enter one of the most prestigious high schools of the country to pursue the love of her life, she needs Wakatake to help her to pass the entrance test…

title: Kyou no Jugyou wa Ren'ai desu!
description: Several decades have now passed since Japan began pushing aggressively for nationwide romantic reform in a bid to reverse declining birth rates and scale back its aging population demographic. Her efforts have paid off tremendously, with Japan having been transformed into a country where romance is now heralded as its very beating heart, and recent developments have even seen high schools introducing "Romance Courses" and curriculums! In a twist of fate, our protagonist, Ukyou Sagari, enrols at the prestigious Yurigarden Girls' School and — what luck! — ends up dating 4 girls simultaneously! Together they strive to rise above the rabble and top the Romance Course!

title: Kimi ga Loafer wo Haitara
description: Rinne Miki is a normal first year's high school girl who loves fashion and is close with her friends. But, she has a caring personality too, so though she has opposite-sex friends, that never became romantic, and she lived her life without romance. But, on the day of the school festival, she meets Toma, a boy with a slightly mysterious atmosphere to him... though she's bewildered by how aggressively the younger boy approaches here, gradually, she starts to see him as...?

title: iShoujo
description:
This manga follows an omnibus format, in that the characters the story focuses on changes every so often. The first characters, Tetta and Ginko's story ends at chapter 3, but all the characters are recurring, and sometimes, show up again in the future chapters.  


---

  
There is a magic love app that supposedly helps people's dreams of love come true. The first story of this love app follows Tetta and Ginko, friends who have bickered since grade school. Tetta looks up the magic app on a whim, and ends up with an application that is connected to Ginko. When he manipulates the "Ginko" on the app, it affects the real girl. He's embarrassed to have it in the first place, but he can't uninstall it without inputting Ginko's measurements. Whether he actually likes Ginko romantically or not, it seems that this app could only make the situation worse!

title: Ame Nochi Hare
description:
Amagai Gakuen, a prestigious school for boys, was hit by an unusual spring storm during the entrance ceremony. Five boys - Hazuki, Toma, Yusuke, and Junta - were all caught in the storm's violence and were affected by a strange phenomenon. All of them were transformed into girls!!  
Inevitably they will meet someone and fall in love. Bikke wholeheartedly introduces this new, beautifully drawn series about boys and girls coming of age.

title: Senken Shounen Syndrome
description:
Mizuki Sora's first compilation of one-shots. Includes 5 short stories:

1. Chinmoku Girl no Little Cry (Silent Girl's Little Cry) Kohane is a high school student who has bad pronunciation since she was young. She refuses to talk since she's been teased by others because of her accent, and chooses not to, rather than being laughed at. One day, when Kohane was going to the teacher's lounge, she meets a senpai who had wounds from a fight and gives him bandages since there was no nurse in the office. Igarashi (the senpai) confesses to Kohane and helps out for her English pronunciation contest. The story is about Kohane accepting herself and finding someone who accepts herself with her awkward accent.

2. Senken Shounen Syndrome (Apprehensive Boy Syndrome)

3. Yankee Shoujo to Hinekure Danshi (Delinquent Girl and Contrary Boy)

4. Miren Boy Miren Girl (Lingering Boy, Lingering Girl)

5. Tsuiraku JK to Haijin Kyoushi Bangaihen

title: Today's Shou-Joke Manhwa
description: Transfer Student Ga Ya appears to Grand Master High School's three super elites! Who will be the one to steal Ga Ya's heart?

title: Rika
description: It's about a boy named Nishizawa Kazuya who is in 2nd year of middle school. Unlike his younger sister, Rika, he is good at a lot of thing and is the fastest runner in the school. Parents and others think he is responsible and hard working child. It seems that he is perfect good child but he has a secret that he can't tell anyone. Every day he enjoys taking a peek at his sister, undressing herself.

title: Kaoru Watashi ni Kiss wo shite.
description:
"You smell so good." "Sorry, but I might not be able to let you go."
 Touka, who secretly has a crush on her senior, is bewildered to find out he felt for her scent. Things develop quickly and she decides to support his dream of becoming a perfumer while they become dangerously close.

title: Houkago no Tetsugaku-san
description:
Ebisawa Ginpei is considered a delinquent. But that's not his true nature. (Maybe.)  
  
As he continues his (misguided) quest to learn about himself, he meets his classmate Chigusa Somei (a monster with a desire for 120% approval) and discovers the dangerous depths of philosophy!  
  
The wheels of adolescence are now set in motion for two people with mutual interests…!

title: "Aoi" Hikaru ga Chikyuu ni Ita Koro......
description:
The story starts with the death of Hikaru Mikado. That guy was a natural charmer, a “harem king”, but had no real male friends. After he died, he became a ghost, a soul, but Koremitsu Akagi can see him. Koremitsu though, isn’t really like Hikaru. His red hair and his evil-looking eyes make him look as a delinquent, even though he is very kind inside. Hikaru asks him a favour: he wants to fulfill a promise, which he couldn't fulfill anymore. The promise was to give his girlfriend and fiancée, Aoi Saotome, 7 gifts for her seventeenth birthday. Koremitsu accepts, and has to work hard to help fulfill Hikaru’s promise with Aoi.  
  
Adapted from the [light novel](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=103446) series Hikaru ga Chikyuu ni Itakoro

title: Akuma to Love Song
description: Touzuka High School is a public school with a pretty low grade point average. One day, a girl who has been expelled from the state’s top school, St. Katria Girls’ School, transfers in… her name is Kawai Maria. The reason for her expulsion was “violence against the teacher.” Because of her non-adorned, straight comments, Maria starts to become isolated from her class… What is hidden in her past and what will happen to her?

title: Nande Nanda-san
description:
Nanda-san is incomprehensible.

Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2022 No. 26.

title: Pride Complex
description: Park Chang-hyun had to move and move again because of his father's business. For the first time in 8 years, he's returned to the village where he grew up young. On his first day of high school, a certain beautiful young girl catches his eyes. Her name is Yang Surh Hee. She currently reigns as the school's idol but in the past they both went to the same school. Before his transfer he had a big fight with Surh-hee but their reunion went smoothly and he returns home… to find Yang Surh Hee!?!?!? "Yang Surh Hee is my house maid?!" "If you tell this to the school I won't forgive you, Park Chang Hyun!"

title: To Those Who Know of the Blueness of the Sky
description:
High school student Aoi Aioi lives with her elder sister, Akane, after a tragic accident took their parents away 13 years ago. Because Akane has since been taking care of her single-handedly, Aoi wants to move to Tokyo after her graduation to relieve her sister's burden and pursue a musical career, inspired by Akane's ex-boyfriend Shinnosuke "Shinno" Kanamuro. Shinno was part of a band until he left for Tokyo to become a professional bassist after the sisters' parents passed away, and he was never to be seen again.  
One afternoon, while Aoi practices her guitar in a guest house, she gets startled by the 18-year-old version of Shinno from 13 years ago! As if by coincidence, the current 31-year-old Shinno also returns to the town, but he has changed drastically. There are now two Shinno's in existence, but why is the Shinno from the past present?  
The story revolves around these four individuals as they confront their inner feelings toward each other and make decisions that will affe

title: ○○ Manga wo Kashite Kureru Otaku Tomodachi
Ark:Romancer
description: After experiencing tragedy firsthand, Amagi Souji does not feel that he is deserving of love or of loving anyone. It is not until a strange girl appears before him wanting to learn just what love is that he finds himself caught up in a battle between female warriors known as "Ark Processors." Will he learn to feel love again and will he be able to teach her what true love is?! Only time can tell!

title: Araki-kun wa Kainarasenai
description: A high school girl who lives alone in her parents' home, away from her sister and mother who are working as actresses in Tokyo. Under such circumstances, my family's birthday, for a long time, somehow, popular actor Shiraki Araki appears instead of the family! Araki rushed to the confused Yakko, saying, "He became a star to help him find her." "Keep me"…?! A gift (?!) that arrived at JK who was worried that there was nothing for me. It's the start of a half-lived love comedy with a superstar!

title: Suki ni Naranai yo, Senpai
description: Falling in love with a painting while at a school's festival, Iku is able to meet the gentle high schooler who created it. She falls in love at first sight and with that feeling in her heart, decides to enroll in that high school! But, what happens when she joins the art club and discovers her gentle prince has disappeared and a sleazeball has taken his place?!

title: Asking For Help At a Shrine
Kiss n Karess!
description: This is a girls love series. When a delinquent and a role model student start dating, they must conceal their relationship because of their reputations. People would be outraged and not approve of such a couple. Even though Alix and Skip are complete opposites like night and day, they manage to maintain a loving relationship.

title: Hero Mask
description: Shibuya Mirai is stuck in a world where heroes seem to no longer exist. Already on his first day at a new school, he's targeted by a group of delinquents. Right as his situation seems hopeless, a real hero finally appears before his very eyes.

title: Osasete! My Teacher
description:
Oshitani Aiko is a new teacher who worries that she can't do a good job of speaking when teaching.
After class one day, as she's despairing, two of her students accidentally run into her. The next day, the mood in her classroom has suddenly changed. Aiko's students start cheering for her, waving glowsticks in their hands -- she's suddenly become their idol! When a fellow teacher she likes happens to see the situation, he mistakes it for chaos, but she rushes to assure him it's just a show of student unity...  
A school idol for the next generation bursts onto the scene!

title: Awfully Damn Hug, Awfully Damn Kiss
description:
The beautiful Chae Young Un is used to dating guys and breaking up with them shortly after, but when one day she encounters the enigmatic first year student, Jang Yeon Ho, beating up a guy who had just stolen her wallet, their lives become unmistakable intertwined. Unable to leave him alone, Chae Young finds herself worrying and taking care of him as Jang Yeon Ho attempts to drive himself further and further into destruction. Is it pity or love that makes Chae Young Un care about Jang Yeon Ho? She's not so sure, but whatever it may be, Chae Young refuses to leave his side.  
  
Jang Yeon Ho is haunted by his past and Chae Young Un cannot leave him alone. And while Jang Yeon Ho tries to fend off her kindness, he slowly begins to find that living is a whole lot brighter with her by his side.  
  
A story about broken people finding love and redemption.  
  
- Contains the Oneshot Hidden Love (Chapter 19)  
When he takes off his gloves, when his hands are about to touch me, my heart start

title: Watashi no Koi de Shindekure
description: Yumi Katagiri (a pseudonym) is a high school girl who does a bit of compensated dating on the side. But her "customer service," is a little bit different from other girls'... She would continue this behavior night after night until one day she is discovered by her high school teacher. A unique romantic suspense between a lonely girl and a passionate teacher!

title: Okutou-san wa Hipparidako
description: A youthful romantic comedy about a tentacle gal high school girl and a weird biology nerd!

title: Imouto sae Ireba Ii. Gaiden - Imouto ni sae Nareba Ii!
description: Spinoff following Nayu as she endeavors to win Itsuki's affection by becoming his little sister by any means necessary.

title: Migi tonari no Ukyo-san
description: The story follows Ukyo-san and Sakata-kun who just got placed next to each other after changing seats. This one-shot was originally included in Jump RomCom Matsuri! as part of Shounen Jump's 2019 Valentine's Day celebrations.

title: Tomehane! Suzuri Koukou Shodoubu
description:
Tales of a high-school calligraphy club.  
  
A story about a high-school calligraphy club on the verge of breaking up that enters in a major competition while overcoming its problems. 
Yuki, a promising female judoist, and Yukari, a quiet Canadian-raised boy who just returned to Japan, end up joining the club for the sake of maintaining the membership required to keep the club. 
Together with the old club members and their unique characters, they gradually discover the fun of calligraphy and work together to win in the competition.  
  
Tomehane! was nominated for best manga at the first two Manga Taisho.

Live action series adaptation (2010): [MyDramaList](https://mydramalist.com/742-tomehane)

title: Vocalize
description: Sela Seo is a high school girl who has a complex about her deep voice. Ever since she was teased about her voice in middle school, she has been unable to say what she thinks out loud and has been unable to fit in with her class. In Sela's class was another outcast, Tatsuto Narukami, a boy who always wore headphones. She assumed he was just another “loner” like herself, but when she saw him singing behind the school building during lunch break, her feelings changed.

title: Nagareboshi Lens
description: Risa is a middle-school student who has zero experience in love, but hopes to one day find that special someone. After an unexpected event, Risa now finds herself entangled with the most popular boy in her grade, Yuugure. Could this be the beginning of love for Risa…!?

title: Super School Doctor
description: In order to fullfill his grandfather's dying wishes, Xiong Yu returns to China to marry a beautiful school principal Qiu Hongxin, but was rejected when she meets him as she has no feelings for him. In order for her to develop those feelings, Xiong Yu decided to become a Chinese medical doctor in the school. Now the peach is truly blossoming.

title: Shindere Shoujo to Kodoku na Shinigami
description:
The heroine, Akira, a 2nd year middle school student, lives on an island that being peaceful is its only feature.  
  
Everyone in her class are her childhood friends. they were thinking that this year too like the other years would be a peaceful year with the usual classmates.  
  
But at a time like this a transfer student called “Matsushirou Nishigami” appears, saying: “Anyone who gets close to me dies”.  
  
What is the true meaning of his words…?!  
  
Note: The author died before completing this work.

title: Zéshàng Jìmò Yínghuǒ
description:
The firefly by the water shines into the night, lonely but heartwarming.
Four teenagers meet, each with their secrets.
Trust and betrayal make an exciting youth in a colorful kaleidoscope.
“Meeting you was the best thing to happen to me.”

title: Namju ga Eopseumyeon Nae Seongjeok i Manghanda
description: High school student Han Jiseo is perfectly happy to be reborn as an extra character in a manhwa. Her side character always scores second place in the entire school, after all! The male lead, Ju Yiwon, is welcome to first place; Jiseo's happy so long as she can get into university. But one day, Ju Yiwon doesn't come to school... and Jiseo scores zero on a test. "Don't tell me... my grades depend on the male lead?!" If Jiseo wants to make it to university, Ju Yiwon needs to be present. Thus begins Jiseo's ultimate mission: make sure the male lead attends school! (Summary adapted by me from Kakaopage.)

title: Doubt!
description: Ichiru Kanzaki is given an offer he can't refuse: to clear his entire debt, he has to enroll in the high school his father works at and track down his father's illegitimate daughter, whom he has never met. But which girl is she?

title: The Boy Who belongs to Group "B"
description:
Protagonist Sakuragi Ryou was in the "A group" in middle school. At least until he got caught up some trouble and developed a reputation as a delinquent. Wanting to live a normal, peaceful life in high school he decides to do a reverse high school debut, aiming to be in the boring, middle-of-the-pack "B group". Above all else he doesn't want to stand out. But then one day he encounters the school idol, Fujimoto Erika, being harassed by delinquents and begrudgingly decides to help her out. She then starts to develop an interest in him, which is going to make his goal of not standing out tough…  
  
Adapted from the novel of the same name.

title: Ano Ko no Kodomo
description:
“I think I might be pregnant.”

Sachi, a high school girl, has a childhood sweetheart, Takara.
One day, feeling something wrong with her health, she buys a pregnancy test.
Using the test at a diner in a town far from home, she sees two lines that indicate a positive result…

**Award:** Won the 47th Annual Kodansha Manga Award for Shoujo in 2023.

title: Love Allergy Syndrome
description: Momiji, an Aruma, falls in love with Hiiragi, an Arumarch. However, Hiiragi apparently has an allergy to Aruma fur. Furry dork yuri ensues.

title: Yuunagi Marbled
description: Fujitani Ena walks along a beach with her dog and sees a girl named Nanjo Mishio at a beach that looked like she was there for a suicide attempt. She sees her again the next day, but over time she becomes the subject of various gossip topics.

title: Sorairo no Graffiti
description:
A girl who only brings about misfortune. A boy who has been blessed with nothing but good luck. When those two meet… what will happen?  
  
Original webcomic: <http://www.comico.jp/articleList.nhn?titleNo=10807>

title: Kioku Soushitsu no Ore to Tsundere Doukyuusei no Hanashi
description:
To avoid violating Mangadex rules and create a work that does not exist, follow an unofficial sequence that accompanies the sequence of post author's:
• ["Ch #0.1" - Kioku Soushitsu no Ore ni wa Kanojo ga Iru Rashii](https://mangadex.org/title/cb51c238-5544-4c71-ba79-048f8ea3fd91/kioku-soushitsu-no-ore-ni-wa-kanojo-ga-iru-rashii) (09/25/2023)
