title: Tomodachi Nano ni Kiss o Shita
description:
"M-mình muốn hôn cậu ấy quá đi~ Nhưng hai đứa mình chỉ là bạn..."

Aoi là bạn nối khố với Keita, cả hai thân nhau đến mức có thể nói là trên tình bạn dưới tình yêu. Nhưng Aoi lại dần có những cảm xúc đặc biệt hơn với cậu bạn thân của mình, cô nàng muốn làm đủ thứ chuyện "tình củm" với anh chàng lắm, nhưng vì hai chữ "bạn thân" mà nàng chần chừ mãi. Nhưng Aoi không biết là Keita đang giả ngủ trên bàn kia cũng đang chờ đợi cái gì đó, và cậu quyết định đẩy láo.

title: Jigoku Sensei Nuubee
description:
Nueno Meisuke, better known as Nuubee, is an exorcist who also happens to be the teacher for a 5th grade class at Doumori Elementary. While he uses many various exorcism techniques, his main weapon is his left hand, the Demon's Hand, which has the power of a chaotic demon sealed within it.

The series follows Nuubee and Doumori Class 5-3 though the many weird, insane, and downright silly supernatural encounters they face.
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/nube_off)

title: Mahou Tsukai to Hoshi Furu Niwa
description:
Upon discovering she had an affinity for magic during a routine test, Rio was offered an admission to a school for magicians like herself. She arrives at the school, anxious about what is expected of her powers. And to her surprise, her first task is to nab herself a familiar before the entrance ceremony! How will Rio ever complete her task on time, and WHAT is this 'Love Curse' she was bestowed upon by the Witch of the West!?  
(Source: <https://aoc.moe/projects/starfall>)

title: A Story About a Loud Person
Citrus Anthology: Lovely Party
description: Anthology added as a bonus book with the special edition of Citrus volume 8.

title: Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku
description: Akimi, a high school student living on a picturesque island in the Seto Inland Sea, lives with her mother, who stopped smiling due to her father's affair. One day, she becomes close to Kai, who has transferred to the island and is being swept along by his free-spirited mother's love affairs. Both harboring loneliness and emptiness within, they are drawn to each other, miss each other, and eventually grow together.

title: Hana ni Kamiguse
description: Even in her second year of high school, she has no friends. A young lady, Suu, who is a "loner" to the extreme, dreamed of a normal, uneventful adolescence. Then one day, a beautiful young man named Yuki appears in front of her. He was a mysterious boy who had lost his memory and was the first friend she had ever made. But what is he really...?

title: Last Menhealer
description: The girl that Kaname likes is rumored to be a menhera—a suicidal, depressed woman who has self-inflicted cuts all over her body. To be with her, he tells her a lie that leads her to believe that they are of the same kind. This is the story of a mentally ill girl and a boy who pretends to be mentally ill to stay by her side.

title: Kimi no Fude wo Oritai
description: Satake Akihito is a 16-year-old teenager who enjoys drawing and uploading his artwork on Hacitter (a slang term for Twitter). Although he doesn't care about other people's opinions, his recently viral drawing has garnered significant attention. Satake greatly admires an artist named Risumaru-san and hopes that Risumaru-san's works can also be seen by more people. However, when Satake sends a message to Risumaru-san, he senses something is wrong. Risumaru-san seems to wish for Satake to stop drawing, which confuses Satake because Risumaru-san had always been supportive before.

title: Graduate
description: Though Rihito's always been a loner, lately he's grown close to his classmate, Hikaru. The two of them have even fallen in love and tentatively started dating. But when Rihito's mother ends up in the hospital, the stress of it all becomes too much for him. Hikaru wants to be there for Rihito, but can Rihito learn to open his heart and rely on another person?

title: Jimiko na Watashi wa Iroke wo Dashitai (Pre-Serialization)
description:
Furukawa Koto, the plainest girl in class, desperately wants the elusive Kishi-kun to look at her.

---

Note: This is the original, pre-serialization web comic.

title: A Social Distance Rom-Com with Intense Intimate Contact After X Days
description: Just when they're finally going out, they cannot even touch one another until the intimate contact ban is lifted! This is a social distance rom-com about a girl who's suppressing her desire to be all over her boyfriend!!

title: Saaya and Sakura
description: Collection of short stories posted on [author's twitter](https://twitter.com/tsuruse852) featuring an age-gap couple - Saaya and Sakura

title: Hammer Session!
description:
Two prisoners managed to escape after the police truck carrying them crashed on the highway. One of them , Mr Sawazaki is a gangster who has sent 10 opposite bosses to hospital. The other called "You" - our protagonist - is a con artist whose cheating profile has piled up to approximately 100 billion yen. Accidentally, "You" then becomes the new teacher for the nearby junior high school, under the new name Takeda Shindo, and according to a deal of "Hammer Session" with the headmaster.  
  
The story is about a teacher who has a past record as a con-artist. It has its own unique taste, which makes it distinctive from other series about teachers, such as GTO and Gokusen.

title: Senpai wa, Ijiwaru ni Tsuki
description: Moe, a first-year high school student, has a crush on Hikaru, who is rumored to be a coldhearted prince. However, Hikaru already has a beautiful, talented and popular girlfriend, who is also his childhood friend. Hikaru also has another close childhood friend, Kouki, who asks Moe if she wants to do a bet with him. While holding Moe's hand, Kouki asks how long is she going say that she likes Hikaru? Will Moe chase after Hikaru or will she move on and fall for his childhood friend instead?

title: Shurabara!
description:
Yagimoto Kazuhiro is a high school boy known for setting couples up, but in reality, he just wants to get a girlfriend himself. One day, a girl asks him to be her boyfriend…but it's not what he thinks it is.  
  
adapted from the light novel series

title: Undercover! Chaebol High School
description: Da-kyung, who was an active member of a corporate criminal organization, belatedly learns of the death of her boss, whom she cared for like a father. Times later without knowing why her boss's death, she gets a clue, a college of rich people with most of the children of important people in Korea. Da-Kyung will go back to being a student to try to find out what happened, she is a well-trained assassin, but dealing with bullying and the stress of school life may not be as easy as it seems...

title: Taihen Yoku Dekimashita.
description:
From Paper Dolls Project:  
Nonoyama whose friend is only a stuffed animal spent her elementary and junior high school years as a true truant because of neglect and bullying. Now having the chance to reset her life as a high school student in an out of town school, she's determined to make friends and enjoy her school life! However, her high school life is a rocky road from day one…

title: Uso Koi
description:
High school student Kano is worried about her inability to find a boyfriend. Because it's her first time to fall in love, she has high ideals and can't take the first step… But then, she and Toki, who is her "least favorite type“ and on the same organizing committee for the school festival as her, decided to become a fake couple for a limited time?!

The most powerful bickering couple is born!

title: Ore no Kanojo ni Nanika Youkai
description: In a world where youkai and humans attend school together, a boy named Atsushi Fukuzumi falls for snow youkai Muku Shiroishi. Fukuzumi's passionate feelings melt Muku's heart…and the rest of her?! The first volume of an interspecies romantic comedy you're sure to fall head over heels for!!

title: My Alien Days Webcomic
description:
Manabu is a 3rd year middle schooler & former student council president. Suddenly he's in charge of a new student Ruri but she is no ordinary girl - she's an alien! Manabu loses the chance to be with his crush Mizuho who now has a thing for Ruri & gets nose bleeds from her cuteness. The teacher is of no help, her focus & nose bleeds are on Ruri's hot cousin who is also an alien!  
  
**Note:** Chapters 1-500 are all covered in the [serialized version of the series](https://mangadex.org/title/21849/my-alien-days).

title: Kusugutteetee!
description: Este é um Oneshot especial publicado no festival de comédias românticas da Weekly Shonen Magazine, que conta a história de uma garota que tem cócegas e seu amigo de infância.

title: How to Gracefully Divorce a Dragon
description:
Twenty-year-old Jeong Seyun, a rabbit descendant, knows that dragons are considered the chaebols of the beast world. But she'd rather have a relationship based on love than an arranged marriage with a dragon. And as fate would have it, as soon as she enters college, she falls in love with fox descendant Kim Hangyeol at first sight! She musters up the courage to confess, but... to the wrong person?!
Will Seyun's dream of a romance come true? (Summary adapted from Kakaopage.)

title: Ushiyama-san
description:
Ushiyama-san, the popular girl in class. I thought she was someone I would never have anything to do with…
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/75817)

title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move? (Fan Colored)
description:
Ayumu wants to beat his Senpai at Shogi so he can confess his feelings.  
Though the day of his victory is still nowhere to be seen,  
this is the story in which he may ‘checkmate’ her by other means.

title: Tonari no Seki no Kobayashi-san
description:
"Because I want to see that smile of yours again."  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Juuou Mujin no Fafnir
description: Second Lieutenant Mononobe Yuu has been sent to Midgard, to attend the all-girl's school where his sister Mitsuki is the student council president. The school is specifically for people who have "D" powers, who are needed to fight dragons, and both Mitsuki and Yuu fit the criteria. On his arrival, he meets and befriends another classmate named Iris Freya, who is having difficulties with her "D"-related schoolwork. They will do their best to succeed in this dangerous world.

title: Dasadanan
description: Kang Chan and Seyeon have been close friends since they were young after being introduced by their parents. After entering high school, Seyeon suddenly received a confession from Kang Chan and became aware of Kang Chan since then. Meanwhile, Naeun is displeased with their relationship. The trivial and noisy story of their love triangle and those around them…

title: A Story About My Childhood Friend Who Likes To Use Outdated Slang
description: - Creator-approved translations by [Hachirumi Scans.](https://twitter.com/HachirumiScans)

title: Hiro-kun ga Sensei
description:
Includes 4 stories about love with various types of childhood friends.  
1. Kiss in a Suit  
2. Loving Eyes After School  
3. Don’t Pamper Me, Hinata-kun  
4. Hiro-kun Is a Teacher

title: ReRe Hello
description:
Ririko lost her mother when she was five, and has helped out her father ever since. Her father raised his three children alone, and eventually started his own handyman business. Ririko is now a normal teenager in high school. But then one day, something horrible happens…  
  
Included oneshot:  
Volume 3: Mebuki Kimidori

title: Wheel of Reincarnation Rinne
description: As a child, Mamiya Sakura mysteriously disappeared in the woods behind her grandma's home. She returned whole and healthy, but since then, she has had the power to see ghosts. Now a teenager, she just wishes the ghosts would leave her alone! At school, the desk next to Sakura's has been empty since the start of the school year. Then one day her always-absent classmate Rokudo Rinne shows up, and he's far more than what he seems! After school one day, Rinne helps Sakura deal with the ghost of a boy who has a crush on her. Rinne, it seems, knows just how to handle such ghosts, and has the skills and tools to properly dispatch them to the afterlife (for a small fee of course). Sakura starts to learn more about her mysterious classmate, and her curiosity about Rinne draws her deeper into the amazing world between life and death.

title: Zettai Osananajimi Sengen
description: flag crushing childhood friend

title: Futsutsuka na Oyako de wa Arimasu ga
description:
She: because her parents died when she was young, she had to go work at a distant relative's restaurant.  
He: born to a rich family, representing the Kiryuu family and leaping forward in the business world.  
Whether their births or childhood environment, they were worlds apart. They had nothing to do which each other's lives - or so they thought.  
The start of a "Father-Daughter" relationship!  
  
Español:||  
Yo, que me quedé sin padres cuando era muy joven, solía trabajar en el restaurante de unos parientes lejanos. Él, nacido en una familia rica, es un popular hombre de negocios y heredero de una gran corporación. Nacimos y crecimos en condiciones totalmente distintas. Nadie pensaría que estemos relacionados. Y, sin embargo…||

title: Introverted Us
description: Do you ever wonder what the most popular boy at school is really like? As it turns out, he might be just as awkward and shy as any of us. That’s what wallflower Jayu Nam begins to discover after a chance encounter with Jahyeok Yeo, a boy in her class who seems to excel at everything in life. Well, almost. Underneath Jahyeok’s persona is a secret super-introvert who would rather just stay home, except his charming good looks keep forcing him into social situations. Together, Jayu and Jahyeok begin to learn a little something about friendship and maybe more…

title: Her Lies
description: Zhao Fugui, a high school girl who can see everybody's score in life, puts herself at the frontline every day to find the perfect boyfriend. However, she never imagined that someone by her side already held a perfect score, and that she's deeply in love with her...

title: Onee-chan no Tomodachi Dakara Te wa Dasenai!
description: Jiro Ninomiya had a problem. That is, his sister's friends Megu Kurotani and Erika Tenpaku are teasing him about something. Jiro, an adolescent boy, wants to touch their bouncy breasts right away, but if it's just a prank, his life could be in jeopardy, so he puts on a sorry face and tries his best to endure it. However, in reality, both Megu and Erika love Jiro, and it was a deliberate attempt to get his attention. Megu and Erika's temptations become more extreme as Jiro doesn't make any moves... A tactical love affair between two older sister friends who want him to touch her and a high school boy who they think they should never touch. Comedy!!

title: Chocolate Vampire
description:
This school is funded by Kagari Ritsuki family. Yuki is the youngest child of Kagari Ritsuki brothers, and and idol in the school. On the other hand, Kashiwagi Chiyo hates Yuki…  
  
The truth is Yuki is a vampire, and he always drink Chiyo’s blood. Why does she give her blood to someone that she hates? Is there any secret between those two?

title: Delinquent and Cooking Club
description: A delinquent asks the head of the cooking club to teach her how to make something as a present for the person she likes.

title: Kanojo-tachi wa Kataranai
description: No words needed to convey all of the feelings I harbor for you. A full-color, textless webtoon of sweet, innocent love…

title: Kono Naka ni Hitori, Imouto ga Iru!
description: As his father's will, Shougo was transferred to an academy where a lot of girls attend. "while attending an academy find a girl that will be your partner" in other word his father's will was Shougo to make a girlfriend. However he found about that there is his little sister separated from birth and he doesn't even know how she look like. Then in Shougo's birthday, he received a cake from unknown sender, and his cellphone's ring tone rings. "Happy birthday, Onii-sama. I adore you very much." it looks like his sister is also attending this academy, and also trying to get closer to him without letting him know who she is. Can Shougo "properly" reunite with his little sister, and make a girlfriend!?

title: Me wa Kuchi Hodo ni Koi to Iu
description: Having moved schools frequently throughout his childhood, Fujino has perfected the art of the false smile. Now attending his fifth school, that well-mannered smile is safely helping him make new friends, but one day, on the school roof, he stumbles upon a scarred boy sleeping under the sun. That boy is the "Mad Dog", the student all his classmates are afraid of. While Fujino is observing him, the boy opens his eyes, and then…

title: Tsuukaku Tantei - Tsuutenji Natsume
description: Ataru Mutsuki, a high school student, possesses a rare ability: whenever he experiences headaches, his intuition becomes incredibly sharp. He is summoned by the Five Senses Detective Agency, a group of Extremers (Extreme Sense Users), individuals who have pushed one of the five senses to its utmost limit. Their aim is to take on the "Brain Breakers," a criminal organization of people with superhuman abilities who commit all kinds of atrocities.

title: Lily Lily La La Land
description: There exists an all-girls school exclusively for up-and-coming young ladies where a system of exchanging keys to one another is acknowledged as a form of romantic confession. One fateful night when Emi Kewaki walked past the rumoured mystery-filled Room No. 101, a black shadowy figure came out from the room and the very next day recieved the key to the so-called forbidden room. A struggle for the key (and it's bearer) by the school's five top young ladies then ensues!

title: Futakaku Kankei.
description: A New Series From [Sakura Trick's](https://mangadex.org/manga/9300/sakura-trick) Mangaka. Twin sisters Airi and Himari have always been very close, and worn identical hairstyles, clothing and accessories. But after they enter high school, Himari starts to drift away from her sister. When cornered by Airi, she explains that she has "a promise with senpai to fulfill," no matter what.

title: Seishun Heavy Rotation
description:
Nao falls in love at first sight with the hottie prince Haruna-kun, who helps her overcome anxiety during the high school entrance examination. She safely gets into high school and feels that she’s fated to the guy sitting next to her. However, Haruna-kun is very popular and has a habit of saying “I hate girls who tell me they like me.”. Even so, Haruna-kun still messes with Nao.
Nao gradually falls in love with him as she gets to know him better. Haruna-kun may look mean, but he’s actually very kind.

title: Straightforward Girl
description: Someone has finally taken the hint.

title: Aoharu-sou e Youkoso
description: "Aoharu-sō is a boarding house where high school students with a variety of personalities gather. Hinata, who is like a little brother to everyone, Hamayuu, who gets carried away easily but has the temperament of a leader, Tachibana, who is good at playing the guitar, and Sena, who has his own pace. Then Kiritani, who is the same age as Hinata, moves in…?!"

title: DRAGON BALL Gaiden: Tensei Shitara Yamcha Datta Ken
description: A Japanese high school student is on his way to a Dragon Ball event with a friend. Suddenly, he sees a cute girl wearing a short skirt, but when he runs over to get a closer look, he trips and dies. Upon waking up, he realizes he's turned into Yamcha from Dragon Ball. Being an avid fan of the series, he knows what lies ahead in Yamcha's future, thus he decides to take matters into his own hands, in order to change Yamcha's fate.

title: Is There a Demand for a Harem Manga With Only XXX Appearing?
description: A oneshot about high school boy who is liked by hotties.

title: Freezing (Official Colored)
description:
Beings from a different dimension have started a war with mankind. To counter this threat, an academy called "Genetics" that trains female warriors called "Pandora," who can wield special weaponry and armor, was formed. Kazuya Aoi decided to enroll in this school because of a promise with his sister, an outstanding alumnus who died in battle. There he meets second year Satellizer L. Bridgette, nicknamed "The Untouchable Queen" due to her solitary demeanor but also top of her class whose battle simulation streak is undefeated, until he came… and slowly changed her.  
  
Colourized / Webtoon version

title: Sore wa, Honno Sasai na Koto de
Ano Sa, Maki-san
description:
A tale of slightly awkward youths in neighboring seats, woven with artwork filled with a sense of transparency. (@gangan_joker / X)

A oneshot published in the 2026/1 issue of Gangan Joker.

title: Nude Model and Other Stories
description:
Yamaguchi Tsubasa's first collection of short stories.

Content list:
- Nude Model (ヌードモデル)
- Onnanoko (おんなのこ)
- Kamiya (神屋)

title: #Love Comedy-zuki to Kossori Tsunagaritai
description:
Manaka Hoshizono, the most beautiful girl in school, and I are connected by a certain “secret hobby.” It’s the desire to “watch romantic comedies unfold!”—!?

[This is a preview manga for the new novel *#I Want to Secretly Connect with Romantic Comedy Fans*, to be released by Dengeki Bunko on July 10, 2026.]

title: Hakoniwa no Soleil
description: After visiting her deceased teacher's grave, Asahi Sena ends up saving a man falling from the stairs. The man, Itsuki Tobari turns out to be her deceased teacher's younger brother. They start to talk about things from the past, about the death of Itsuki's sister and the 11-year-old boy, Sena's best friend from the past, who killed her. Where and how is the boy now? Together, they start to find out what actually happened during that tragic day.

title: Shuuden ni wa Kaeshimasu
description:
A collection of stories:

1. **From Aiu Station on the Hiragana Line** (Hiragana Sen, Aiu Eki Yori)
Asaki has her life all planned out: she is going to win a beauty contest, become a newscaster, and marry into wealth. One day she is helped by a delinquent-looking girl named Tsune on the train and her plans begin to change...
2. **I'll Send Her Home on the Last Train** (Shuuden ni wa Kaeshimasu)
Sequel to Aiu Station.
3. **Girls' Planetarium** (Shoujo Planetarium)
Suzuki and Satou are classmates but barely interact due to their different personalities. One day Suzuki sees Satou getting picked up by an older woman and when noticed gets dragged along by her to Satou’s chagrin.
4. **Ephemeral Asterism** (Isshun no Asterism)
5. **Forever Girls** (Eien ni Shoujo)
A ghost named Mizuki returns to her old home to discover a family she does not know. There, she meets a child named Misao who is the only person who can see or interact with her. This is the story of their relationship as Misao grow

title: Kirio Fanclub
description: Aimi Miyoshi and Nami Sometani are two high school girls who often find themselves talking about a boy in their class, Kirio. This lighthearted romantic comedy follows the daily lives of these two friends and rivals on a journey that, for now, seems to be heading everywhere but love.

title: Wéixiǎn Xīntiào
description:
“Nếu không muốn thân phận giả bị lật tẩy, thì ngoan ngoãn hoàn thành bảy yêu cầu nho nhỏ mà tôi đưa ra đi, Kỳ Triều Nguyệt.”
(Nữ vương thiên kim thật mang xu hướng S rõ rệt × Thiên kim giả kiêu ngạo ngầm mang xu hướng M)
Rõ ràng là những yêu cầu vô lý đến từ người mình ghét nhất, vậy mà thân thể lại cứ thế không ngừng trầm luân…

title: 10th - You and I Fell in Love With the Same Person
description: A boy and a girl who are childhood friends fell in love with the same guy.

title: Koisuru Harinezumi
description:
To change from 'like' to 'love', what strategies must Ozawa use on Kazuki?  
Kazuki Heiji is the troublemaker. He gets into fights and is very cold to everyone. Ozawa Kii witnesses a fight between a classmate and Kazuki but he unexpectedly says he wants to become friends? And what's this about 'like' and 'love'…?!  

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media Komputindo as **Hedgehog in Love** (2019)

title: Nomi x Shiba
description: I fell in love very easily. Even though I myself didn’t think that I’m that kind of person. We became roommates unexpectedly in our second year. Having Shiba-chan as my roommate means I’m super lucky, right?

title: Kanojo to Camera to Kanojo no Kisetsu
description:
Miyama Akari is a poor high school student with a part-time job, and she's tired of fitting in with all the girls who do their best to look and act the same. One girl in her class, Sendo Yuki, is different from the others. She rarely speaks or interacts with the other girls in the class, and Akari finds her intriguing. After she follows Yuki during lunch one day, Akari sees a whole other side of her, one that is fascinated with cameras and photography.  
  
As Akari and Yuki become friends, Akari can't ignore her growing attraction to Yuki. To make matters more confusing, a boy from their class, Rintaro, has started openly and persistently flirting with Akari. High school is a bewildering time for the heart, and Akari's is no exception…

title: Gal ni Natta Osananajimi to Koi suru Hanashi
Show-ha Shou-ten!
description:
A high schooler who submits jokes to radio shows and a former child actor aim for the top of the comedy world!

---
Alt. Official English: [Viz](https://www.viz.com/show-ha-shoten)

title: Omae ga onna ni naru-nkai!
description: This is a ts story about two male bestfriends. One who is popular, cute and short while the other one's just tall and average. Usually you'd expect the cute one to ts but the other one ts instead hence the title. The ending is not what you would expect but it's still a wholesome ending nonetheless.

title: Mission! School
description: Ishikawa Takuya, a high-school student who doesn't stand out in any particular way, is surprised when his principal asks him to take care of some transfer students. He is even more surprised to find that there are actually 30 charming female transfer students in his care, who have come from a boarding school that was destroyed in a fire! At first it seems like a dream come true, but then he notices their knives… and guns… What kind of school did these girls come from?

title: Namsachin ui Beopchik
description: Jiun's first romance ends when her crush, Jae-i, confesses that he likes someone else. To make matters worse, Jae-i mistakenly believes that Jiun's crush is his scary-looking best friend, Seohyeon, and tries to help her win him over. Now, Jiun must deal with a bigger problem than her unrequited crush, the boy-friend she had never imagined getting close to.

title: Mahou Sensou
description:
Nanase Takeshi is a normal high-school student with a slightly traumatic past. You could say he's hard-working but in reality, he really cares about what others think about him. One day, however, he sees a girl wearing a uniform he had never seen before, who had collapsed on his school grounds. She is Aiba Mui and her appearance marks the beginning to a series of weird incidents. She once said, "to be honest, I'm a magic user and sorry……I turned you into one too."  
  
Adaptation of the [light novel](https://www.novelupdates.com/series/mahou-sensou/) series written by Suzuki Hisashi with illustrations by Luna-Lia

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Douran no Joshou-hen
description:
March 2097—Brazil deploys the strategic-class spell Synchroliner Fusion in South America, starting a wave of unrest that will reach as far as Japan, where the new school year is just beginning. Tatsuya and Miyuki have entered their third year at First High, but anti-magician sentiment has been steadily rising. As many young scions of the twenty-eight families gather to discuss what to do about the concerning political climate, a much more immediate threat sits just beyond the shores of Sado Island…

Adaption of Light Novel 21-22.

title: Tenshi-chan to Akuma-kun
description: Have you ever heard of names that are read in an unusual way or have strange meanings? You know the ones that'd make feel like you could die of embarrassement if you were to be called by them? Those are known as uber fail names. This is the story of two people who carry such a burden. (From: MU)

title: The Girl Who Let Slip "I Like You..."
Video Girl Ai
description: High-school student Yota Moteuchi is so unpopular that his classmates have given him the nickname "Dateless." So it's no surprise when the love of his life, Moemi, is not interested in Yota but instead is in love with Yota's best friend, Takashi. Yota turns to a video rental shop for comfort, but little did he suspect that the shop was magical and that the cute girl on his rented tape would pop out of the television and try to fix his ruined love life!

title: Rebirth of the Butterfly Girl
description:
Na Bibi and her only friend Dahee, both bullied by their classmates, have been enduring a painful middle school life. But after turning 17, Na Bibi gained the ability to transform like a butterfly and be reborn infinitely with a different appearance.   
  
With a brand-new pretty look, she is now ready to start afresh as a high school student. But her transformation stirs tensions with Dahee who disappears on her. Struggling with her identity, Na Bibi enters high school. She coincidentally ends up in the same class as Bang Yeonwoo, a student from the same middle school.

title: Love Rush!
description:
Hakuba Reiji was born with a rare condition that makes him look incredibly attractive to all the girls around him. And as he's turning 18, he discovers to his shock that this is not limited to human girls, as the Cupid princess Kokoro Roko Rokoko also falls for his charms.

The only girl who's seemingly imune to them is the one he actually has a crush on: his childhood friend Shizuku.

title: Aitsu no Daihonmei
description: Awkward Yoshida is hated by all the girls in school for his perceived closeness with hot guy Sato, who uses hanging out with Yoshida as an excuse to turn them all down. If Yoshida is merely an excuse, why does Sato taunt him in private about "his favorite"? Is it possible Sato's feelings run deeper than friendship? And what could he possibly see in the funny-looking Yoshida? Watch Yoshida's life turn upside down with hilarious results!

title: Lethal Romance
description:
A woman who is like a martial arts manhwa character "Yubi". A man who is like a shoujo manhwa character "Shinwoo".  
The two who are used to living in their own genres won't easily fall for each other!  
Will they be able to achieve a happy ending according to the standard of manhwa?!

title: Netsuai Prince - Onii-chan wa Kimi ga Suki
description: Due to the second marriage of her mother, lively high-school student Amamiya Matsuri becomes the younger sister of the super popular idol group of triplets "Terzetto"! Star celebrities for stepbrothers?! A forbidden secret love with a perfect prince ★

title: Monstrous Heart
description:
Su Yuan, a poor student, in order to not place any additional burdens on his family, accidentally got himself enrolled into a college named, Ogus University. But soon he discovered that this institution was actually established for the protection of monsters (demons); and the physically weaker humans, in order to protect their lives, had to form partnerships—called PAL—with those monsters. Furthermore, as a result of his unique scent, many are drawn towards him in hopes of becoming his PAL; and at same time, he is also subjected to various attacks. That was, at least, until the day he rescued a fox covered in blood from head to toe, only to then discover…  


---

title: Kodocha
description:
Sana Kurata, a child actress, faces many problems in her classroom, including a major one - her bullying classmate, Akito Hayama. Sana's outgoing and friendly nature leads her to work towards correcting all of the problems around her. Her 'meddling' irritates Hayama but at the same time captivates him, just as Hayama's gloomy nature irritates Sana and compels her to change him. As these two opposites attract each other, they face many hardships which bring them closer to a mutual understanding.  
 
--- 
- **Won the 1998 Kodansha Manga Award for Shojo**

title: Bloody Sweet
description: When the daughter of a shaman gets "strung up" with a centuries-old vampire, is it love or something more sinister that binds them? From Narae Lee, artist of the hit OEL manga ’Maximum Ride,’ comes the story of two misfits and their quirky, fantastical romp to find one another.

title: Shakugan no Shana
description:
Saving the World Is Easier Than Falling In Love  
  
Yuji Sakai is beginning what he thinks will be another boring year of school. But everything changes when the world around him stops, the surrounding people are engulfed in blue flames and a freakish doll-like creature begins sucking them up! Before Yuji suffers the same fate, a young redheaded girl with a sword appears and saves him. Yuji is drawn into the struggle between these creatures from another world: the Crimson Denizens and the girl Shana, called Flame Haze. He too has a crucial role to play in the conflict, despite the fact that…he's dead!

title: NG Life
description: Keidai Saeki is a high school student who remembers his past life in Pompeii, living as the Italian warrior Sirix. His friends around him are all also reincarnated - although they don't quite remember things the way he does. Keidai's wife from the past? She's now a middle school boy - while his best male friend is now a cute girl?!

title: Hanazakari no Kimitachi e
description: Japanese-American Mizuki has gotten herself into a high school in Japan… but not just any school! To be close to her idol, high jumper Izumi Sano, she's going to an all-guys' high school… and disguising herself as a boy! But as fate would have it, they're more than classmates… they're roommates! Now, Mizuki must keep her secret in the classroom, the locker room, and her own bedroom. And her classmates–and the school doctor–must cope with a new transfer student who may make them question their own orientation…

title: Love and Collage
description:
Maeda Hachibei is unlike most guys, who lust after gorgeous girls. This pervert lusts after their discrete parts, instead. When he moves to Tokyo to attend school, he finds himself living in a dormitory with five girls, each of which possesses one of the ideal physical features he desires: gorgeous blue eyes, bullet-train breasts, a deep dulcet voice, straight “anime-esque” legs, or a waistline shaped like fine Japanese pottery. How can he manage to keep his wits when surrounded by these women? If you think this sounds like a Love Hina clone, you wouldn’t be entirely incorrect… but Hachibei isn’t Keitaro.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Level Comics as **Love & Collage**

title: Te o Yaite Ita Osananajimi ga Itsu no Ma ni ka Seichou Shiteta Hanashi
description: Warm my heart, you baka.

title: Onegai Desu Kara Uketekure
description: An entire year has passed since she entered high school, but Chikage Kurokawa is still an aggressively shy loner. In order to acquire friends, she endeavors to utilize the power of laughter—and thus she forms a laughter-bringing tag team with him, the unpopular Makoto Fujisawa!? The aim is a dramatic turnaround: leaving this loner-life behind! So, please laugh, please!

title: Stand Up!
description:
Furuya Utako is shy and reserved, but because of her height (172cm), she sticks out like a sore thumb. Her mind is constantly plagued by thoughts of Harada Naoyuki, the popular boy who sits next to her in homeroom and claims that he'd like to be friends. She is a bit surprised at his straightforward attitude, but slowly the distance between them is starting to close…  
  
Included one-shots:  
Volume 2: Chotto dake Zeitaku na Jikan wo  
Volume 4: Akai Sea Glass

title: Looking for a Father
description: Hyun-Su Jung (29) was scammed by Jung-Mi Kim and is now in debt of $900,000. He is being chased by loan sharks and ended up kidnapping Jung-Mi Kim's daughter, Ha-Yeon Lee (17). But when Hyun-Su Jung calls to demand ransom, Jung-Mi Kim tells him she doesn't care about what happens to her daughter and hangs up. What will happen to the kidnapper and his victim?

title: The Love King and His Ornamental Wife
description: "Sir Alphonse... Ah, when I think of him, my heart burns with love. But, if I marry him, I'll become the Love King's queen and be banished from the country... an unfortunate end. Ugh, I hate this life! That's why I free want him to hate me... From that day onwards, the Duke's daughter, Louise, works hard to make her fiancé Alphonse hate her.

title: Kanojo ga Yankee no Couple
description:
**Link:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/104930798)

title: Sennou Skill de Isekai Musou!? ~Skill ga Baretara Shokei Sareru node Kenzen Seijitsu ni Ikiyou to shitara, Nazeka Bishoujo-tachi ni Aisareteiru Ken ni tsuite~
description:
Hugh Pnosis is a young boy burdened with the memories of his past life as an overworked corporate drone. All he wants in this new world is to live a carefree, easygoing life. However, the power he's granted is the "Brainwashing" skill... an ability that allows him to absolutely dominate anyone he chooses!

Without the guts to even entertain thoughts like, "I'll brainwash beautiful women and build a harem!", Hugh resolves to never abuse his terrifying power and vows to keep it an absolute secret. But he soon discovers a completely broken, cheat-level loophole: by casting "Brainwash" on himself, he can freely rewrite and swap out his own skills at will!?

title: Gan☆Kon
description: Tagamori Shinta is a student who routinely confesses with complete sincerity to any girls that he likes, failing every time with good reason. One day, after another failed attempt, he stumbles upon a strange shrine and ends up making the most important wish of his entire life. A romantic comedy packed with action on a celestial scale.

title: Haikei, Seken-sama.
description: A hidden youth depicted by an LGBT creator. Some 10 years or so ago, a high school student from a regional town named Rino Tachi went to an all-girls school, studied here and there, and enjoyed talking with his female friends. He was an "ordinary" girl, except for his pervasive feeling of unease within his body. A story of "love" set in a time that demanded even more conformity than now, about living one's fullest life while hiding the discontent. A story about searching for oneself.

title: The Beginning Is Always Like This
Trans Star
description: The story of a girl who decided to finally confess to the boy she has a crush on after a vacation. Only to find out that he caught the "TS disease" and turned into a girl.

title: Perowan! - Hayaku Shinasai! Goshujinsama
description: Inukai Shirou a male highschool student leading his life when suddenly his dog Mashiro turns into a human girl and now he must satisfy her wants or face the consequences.

title: Kisses, Sighs, and Cherry-Blossom Pink
description:
Collection of 7 short stories revolving around an all-girl's school.  
  
- Even if We're Not Friends  
"Even if We're not Friends," is about two girls who were friends in junior high but end up going to different high schools.  
  
- The Summer Closest to Heaven  
Tells the story of a ghost who accidentally possesses a girl, then takes advantage of the situation to interact with the woman she loves.  
  
- A Kiss, Love, and a Prince  
Takes place in the same setting as "Even if We're Not Friends," but centers around different characters. The main character is kissed by her sempai, who is playing opposite her in the school play, and freaks out because she always imagined her first kiss would be with a boy, preferably a dashing prince.  
  
- This Love from I Can't Remember When  
Tells the story of one girl's unrequited love.  
  
- Cherries For Your Lips  
Tells the story of a girl who's in love with her best friend.  
  
- If I Kiss Her Ring Finger  
Nana wants to take things farther

title: Himura-san wa Moete Shimau.
description: Himura-san is a hot-head when she's nervous. But this isn't going to stop Kei with his nonchalant moves. Will this young love survive the flames of love…?

title: Aishitagari no Maison
description:
Wakaba fell in love at first sight with a boy called Sou at the entrance exam day. She decided to chase him to a dormitory, but turns out that dormitory is built to fall in love!! Not to mention, anyone who become a couple will receive 100 million yen!   
  
This is the start of a dormitory-only love game involving six people!

title: He Is So Flirty
description:
On the kind Qin Qing's first day of transfer, she accidentally got involved in the middle of someone picking a fight. Qin Qing used a strategy to save her senior who's been ganged upon, not knowing that he's Wen Yufeng, the infamous school bully! From that moment forward, Qin Qing's peaceful high school life was gone forever…  
  


---

title: The girl I started dating won't walk next to me
description: She's at least three steps behind him at all times. The problem is that... well, it's NOT because she's shy...

title: Tantei Wa Mou Shindeiru - The Lost Memory
description: Kimihiko Kimizuka, a young man who four years ago became the assistant of a mysterious detective known as "Siesta" on a hijacked airplane. Together, Kimihiko and Siesta went on mind-boggling, globe-trotting adventures while combatting a secret organization, but all of that came to an end when they were separated by Siesta's death. In the present day, Kimihiko tries to return to an ordinary, boring life as a high school student, but things are never that simple, even though the detective is already dead.

title: Nakamura Koedo to Daizu Keisuke wa Umakuikanai
description:
Nakamura Koedo is in love with Daizu Keisuke, who’s been going to the same middle school as her. But despite being in the same class, they have never talked to each other for three years. Whenever Koedo wants to get closer to him, something always goes wrong. When she got to sit next to him, she gets a cold. When they were chosen as uniform models for a school leaflet, she can’t fix her bed head. When they were scheduled to run in the sports festival’s relay race, it gets canceled. It’s like their relationship is cursed before it even began. Now that they are about to enter high school, will she finally be able to convey her feelings to Daizu-kun?  
  
This manga is about Koedo’s and Daizu-kun’s daily life and the bizarre twists of fate they encounter. For when these two are together, things are never going well!

title: Keep Holding On
description: 8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak?

title: Mikansei Lovers
description: After meeting a man right out of her dreams, Kotono is on cloud nine however there stands one small problems to achieving her dreams…

title: Mihanada Pectolite
description: Top students Kawase and Kurihara have been locked in an intense rivalry since the start of high school, unbeknownst to Kawase. No matter how hard Kurihara studies, he can't seem to take the top spot. Kawase, taken aback by Kurihara's hostile and self-damaging behavior, becomes determined to help him in any way he can.

title: Iinchou-chan to Furyou-chan
description: A challenge at an empty classroom, late afternoon. Prez and delinquent girl face-off, but much to the latter's surprise, Prez hits first!

title: Kago no Shoujo wa Koi wo suru
description:
A boarding school academy where intelligent girls with attractive looks and figures are gathered.   
This academy is a special place unlike any other where an unusual physical exam and curriculum were established.  
On the day Chizuru (千鶴 - literally "one thousand cranes") transfers into such an academy, she encounters a girl called Fuyuko…  
This is the story of small blessings for the girls who come together through the experience of mutual hardships.

title: Neraiuchi!
description: New high school student Kunimura Kaoru joins the Archery Club in hopes of meeting an old acquaintance, but this Archery Club is a bit odd, and the girl he came looking for may be slightly different than he remembers.

title: Boku ni Koisuru Mechanical
description: Shinjou Maita is trying to get new members for his movie research society club when he stumbles upon angelic first-year Hotohara Shiori. Life seems to be looking up for him, until a strange woman appears in his apartment, warning him that his life is in danger.

title: Kuroko to Akuyaku-kun
description: Kayoko Kuroda is a first-year high school student who just wants to help people behind the scenes. But as she tries to live her mundane life as a “kuroko,”a stagehand who shines backstage, she has an unexpected close encounter with Rento Shishima, rumored to be the most dangerous boy in school! Just when she thought he was helping her with her backstage work, he declares he’s gonna make her the main character! Kayoko sees nothing but chaos in store for her school life with the unpredictable Shishima-kun!!

title: Hoshikawa Ginza Yonchoume
description: This story lets us look into the relationship of Matsuda Otome (a home schooled girl) and Nakagawa Minato (a high school teacher). Otome has been through a difficult past and is now under the care of Minato-sensei. Otome becomes suspicious of Minato's day-to-day routines and investigates. What will Minato tell Otome when she confronts her?

title: Kanojo no Koi ga Kanaeba ii no ni
description: A story about a circular love triangle between two girls and boy.

title: Skyfire Avenue
description:
Skyfire Avenue is a street that is 2048 meters long. There are 168 stores here, and each of the store owners is an extremely powerful adept.   
  
The Avenue does not permit any vehicles or any robots to pass through it, much less mecha. Even the patrolling police must move about on foot.   
  
This is because this is a street for pedestrians, a lane for nobles, hidden away within this high technology world. Lan Jue, the greatest of the mercenaries, code-named ‘Zeus’, has secluded himself here in Skyfire Avenue after the death of his wife.   
  
The name of his shop is “Zeus’ Jewelry Store”, and here in Skyfire Avenue, he has been given the title, Jewel Master.

title: Unbalance School Life
description: A former boys' school recently integrated into a co-ed high school. Shinya Sanada spent the beginning on his high school life in a hospital, so he arrives to what he thought was the boys-only dormitory a month late. What's waiting for him is his former childhood friend, although he's much more womanly than he remembers. Shinya decides to adapt to his new life at school.

title: Suzuki and Nakamura
description: A manga about two (self-professed) good-looking classmates who happen to sit next to each other and their daily conversations.

title: Faster Than a Kiss
description: After losing their parents, Fumino and her brother hop from one relative to another. Getting tired of all those moves, she finally decides to quit school and work to support her brother on her own. As they sat on a park bench, her teacher appears in front of her and agrees to her demands of marrying and supporting both her and her brother!! Is he serious or just playing around…?!

title: Back to the Chanbi
description: Gyeono Kang, a lucky high schooler, used to enjoy the mutual love he shared with the prettiest girl in his class, Chanbi Baek. She was always all about him until an accident wiped her memories of the past year, and just like that, she no longer had feelings for him. But what about Gyeono, whose heart still beats for her? Is it even possible to win her back? Did she really like him back to begin with?! Somebody help!

title: Kurosaki-kun wa Dokusen Shitagaru ~Hajimete no Koi wa Ama sugite~
description: Kurosaki-kun, the boy sitting behind Moka, an ordinary high school student, is the leader of the football club and so popular that there is a fan club in a neighbouring school. Because of the girls who flock to Kurosaki-kun, Moka is often unable to sit in her seat. Mocha gets close to Kurosaki-kun suddenly when she meets him in the school's old library. Kurosaki-kun is a misogynist and unfriendly man who doesn't take to girls at all, but he smiles brightly at Mocha and asks her if she wants to be his girlfriend. He is like a different person...?

title: Life, Once Again!
description:
"Would you like to live once again?" 

It was a peaceful and normal life an average person would live. Getting a job, meeting ‘the one’ and getting married, then living life with your own loving family. I was living that life. 

Then I got an offer to start life again.

 The excitement of starting life once again quickly faded away. Faced with the fading memories of my past life, growing fainter and fainter as each day passed by; the fear of not being able to meet my wife and daughter overwhelmed me. To make matters worse, the opportunity to become an actor, a dream that I had given up before, was tempting… 

"If I live this life differently from my previous one, there’s a chance that I might not be able to meet my wife and daughter!"

Stuck between family and the dream I had given up, what will be my choice?

---

[Official Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/51569746)

title: Vanguard
description:
From the live action series with the same name, Vanguard, has been renewed. It features a girl named Lei Xiaoyu that has caught the attention of a mysterious assassination organization! The tsundere Wu Yue of the Vanguard was assigned to be Xiaoyu’s protector. A love story full of youth, campus life, and action?! As the plot was revealed layer upon layer, the brutal truth gradually appeared…  
  
**Information**  
Marked as "completed" on the website itself.

title: Akumade Sukisugiru dake
description:
Freshly in love with the school's notorious occult freak, second year Kurumi is delighted when her confession is met with a “yes”. But the dates that await her will be much more difficult than she thinks…

From the mind behind *One More Day With Ai-chan* comes a heart-warming tale of young love and self-discovery.

title: Zekkou 10 nen
description: Just one of those typical childhood fallouts...?

title: Golden Sparkle
description: With an absent father and having had a traumatic experience in pre-school, Himari Uehara has problems dealing with girls, and knows nothing about sexuality. He joins a boys-only high school, makes a good friend, and his now happy school life is marred only by the disconcerting changes in his body. His new friend, Gaku Asada, realizing Himari's ignorance, offers to teach Himari how to take care of his male physical needs…

title: Otonari-kun wa Kyou mo Watashi o Komaraseru
description: Minato, a worry-prone high school girl, finds herself seated next to Mineichi—tall, intimidating, and downright scary... or so she thinks. At first, every day is filled with anxiety, but as time goes on, she realizes he's not so scary after all. In fact, he's making her heart race in a whole different way—how troublesome!

title: The Love between Two Perfect and Useless People
description: This is the oneshot for the serialized manga by Komaki Maria: Wolf Falls in Love with Moon.

title: The Mean Boy and The Bullied Girl
description:
Local mean boy is trying to bully smol girl, cause tsun tsun.  
  
Local smol girl lets him, cause tsun tsun.

title: Aki/Momo
description: Mutually unrequited love yuri.

title: Zombitch wa Bitch ni Fukumaremasu ka?
description: This is a story about a girl with no life experience. After being told by a friend that she is behind in experiencing life, Sakina starts having strange fantasies about her childhood friend and now boyfriend. One day while imagining strange things, she makes eye contact with an old man, becomes embarrassed, and runs away in shame. Only to get hit by a truck. Now, if she doesn't keep her excitement up by experiencing things with her own body, her heart will stop.

title: Azusa Kasasagi and the Seven Enemies
description: The story begins with a new problem for second-year high school student Azusa, who aims to receive a college recommendation from her designated school. Around her are enemies, enemies, and enemies.

title: Katasumi no Heartbeat
description:
Description Ch 1: The story of a teenage girl who always only had a background presence, taking on small roles like being a plant in their school plays, never really standing out until a cute boy in her class starts giving her the right supporting words. 

A compilation of one-shots that will make you heart flutter.

title: Kimi ga, Suki.
description: A single volume collection of short romance stories by Kamena Yuu.

title: Dreamland
description:
Dreamland is a series based on a dual universe: on one side, you have the real world, and on the other, the world of dreams, imaginary and crazy.  
We follow the life of Terrence and his friends between those two worlds. He's a shy high-schooler who would like to seduce Lydia, a girl he's liked for a long time. But one day, his life changes completely when, during one of his nightmares, he overcomes his greatest fear: Fire. That marks the beginning of his double life as a normal high-school student during the day and the flame controller at night in Dreamland.

title: Kawaii Haruki-kun
description:
- Additional Info: 
[Volume compilation on Artist' Booth](https://petitpoisson.booth.pm/items/3841980)

title: Shin Mazinger Zero
description:
The inventions of world renowned scientist Juzo Kabuto are peerless. But Professor Kabuto lives with a heavy heart after his research cost the lives of his grandchildren's parents.  
One ominous day, Juzo Kabuto gives his eldest grandson Kouji a terrifying inheritence - a giant robot known as Mazinger Z, a machine that is the pinnacle of Juzo's legacy. This super weapon is capable of making Kouji Kabuto the most powerful person in history, with the destiny of the world in his hands. Mazinger Z has the potential to become the savior of humanity… or the calamity that ends it. With Mazinger Z, Kouji Kabuto can become God or Devil.   
But when Kouji begins having visions of lives he's never lived, will he be able to keep his grasp on reality long enough to survive what awaits?

title: Sensou Gekijou
description: Ruri is a 16 year high school girl whose heart is in a daily battle between good represented by the angel and evil characterised by the demon. The outcome of the match will determine Ruri’s personality….!

title: Yuki Musume wa Fureaitai
description:
Because he found out that his classmate, Shirayuki Tsurara, is a *yuki onna*, our protagonist Rei was pressed into spending his time helping Tsurara not melt…Let's begin this “yokai” romcom so sweltering you’ll melt! (Originally published in *Young Jump Heroines*.)

Uses the same characters as [Shirayuki Tsurara Doesn't Want to Melt](https://mangadex.org/title/cefbdb4e-2a83-46ed-b4dc-dad2556c0471).

title: Doku Doku
description: Freshman-year literature university student Yoshida moves into his new apartment next to an arts student from the same school. In his desire to start his life anew, what might a chance encounter with them bring?

title: Kiss My Ass
description: Yakushiji Teruki is bound by a demon that brings pain to humans. That demon's name is hemorrhoids, which is an illness in his anus. All of a sudden, a girl by the name of Miura confronts him. What does she, the unsociable classmate want from Shiki-kun and his….anus? Find out!

title: I Want to Get Married to My Wastrel Childhood Friend
description: Himari and Issa have been friends since childhood and made a promise together. After so many years does Issa still remember?

title: Fukaku ni mo Kyun to Kita
description: Mitsu is a girl who dedicated her youth to the junior high school track team; however, she retires after suffering from an injury. One day, her bag, which she dearly treasured, fell onto the train tracks. A boy then suddenly risks his life to retrieve her bag. Having missed her chance to say thank you, she finally meets him again in high school. Despite her efforts to thank him, the boy constantly gives Mitsu the cold shoulder… This is a love story about an honest, straightforward girl and a cold, popular boy.

title: Koi wa Hito no Hoka
description: Tsukumo Sayo made a promise with a child demon when she was 5 years old. Now, 10 years later, that demon is tired of waiting for her, and suddenly he appears in front of Sayo to fulfill that promise. "I'll definitely make you fall in love with me." Well now, which side will fall first?

title: Hanaeui gil
description: Hong knows she's into women, but it's easy for Yesul to mistake Hong's actions for friendly behaviour. Will the two every become closer than friends? This is the story of Hong's first love, and her group of friends figuring out who they are and what adults they invision on becoming.

title: Kiss de Egaku Ittousei
description:
Chitose can’t take his eyes off the guy from the class next door, dozing off in class by the window. Each time Chitose leans out the window to sneak a look at him, he’s always there, dozing off as expected. His name - Seno. He’s a year older, but according to rumours, he was absent for a year because he was involved in a fight.

Chitose is a friendly and sweet-hearted high-schooler and Seno is a mysterious guy. The two polar opposites gradually open their hearts to each other…

A chaotic and heartwarming school-love between a cheery puppy and a questionable grade repeater.

title: Shitsurakuen
description:
Himoto Sora is a transfer student with a sense of justice and dreams of becoming a knight. Upon arriving at Utopia Gakuen, she learns of a virtual reality-like game played by the male students in which they use girls as weapons in battles for status and treat them as commodities. Seeing one of these girls being abused she steps in and through some sort of error unwittingly becomes the first female participant of the game.

title: Ookami-san to Shichinin no Nakamatachi
description:
A long time ago… Wait… it's not really that long ago. There lived a certain Ookami-san… She's bad-mouthed, and not to mention flat-chested. Even so, she's still the heroine. She works for Otogi Ginkou, a group who does favors for others and demands something in return when necessary.  
  
Well then, watch as Ookami-san and company unfold many weird… really weird stories. Behold, Ookami-san and her Seven Companions.

title: Gohoubi wa Yoru ni Choudai
description: "How is it? Sweet, right?" Hinano, a library committee member, discovers Haruna-kun, who's famous for being super popular, sleeping in the library. Moreover, Hinano gets entangled with Haruna-kun and is robbed of her first kiss ...! She goes home trying to forget about it, but what is Haruna-kun doing at her house? Her mom suddenly drops a bomb that they will be living together for half a year?! A heart-pounding cohabitation love story with the sweet, free-spirited Haruna-kun~♡

title: Mushihime 2: Hiruko
description: At the end of the battle, Insect Princess Kikuko disappeared along with Ryoichi. The town seemed to have regained its peace, but… Kikuko's genes continue to carry life, and finally, a new Princess is born who will bring terror to the world.

title: Beyond The Manhwa
description:
You, who in the manhwa that I draw, can we meet beyond this squared space that I created?

title: Ichijou Hanao wa Koi wo Shiranai
description: Hanao Ichijou, is a second-year high school student attending an elite girls' school. She is planning to marry someone her parents have arranged for her after graduation, but no matter how many arranged meetings she goes on, nothing seems to work out. Determined to understand what love is before getting engaged, Hanao decides to try commuting by train, using a shoujo manga she read long ago as her guide. There, she has a shoujo manga-like encounter with a boy. She asks him, who seems handsome and experienced in romance, to teach her about love.

title: Missy's Geek Raising Plan
description: What is the experience of a campus hottie chasing the campus geek? He Fengqi transformed from a dead fat geek into a handsome guy, and was rejected by the beauty! But accidentally discovered that the beauty likes the geek! How will the campus hottie chase her? anxious! Waiting for an answer! Why does the goddess have a unique taste? Is it human nature distorted or forced by life? Read to find out!

title: Salm i Uri reul Sogiljirado
description:
"Once I enter university, I'll definitely study hard and change my life for the better!" Kam SaHam, a broke college freshman is bent on changing her life by pursuing Fashion Design. However, in a curious turn of event, she ends up pretending to be loaded amongst all the rich kids in high society (Hi-So). Will she get called out or could she somehow find love amidst this chaos?  


---

title: Let's Kiss Once Just For Fun
Inugamihime no Shimobe
description: Inudzuka Taromaru is a first year high school student who looks like a delinquent. One evening, while he's at his part-time job, he ends up with a white-feathered arrow through his head! He's told that this arrow means he has been chosen as the sacrifice for "Inugami-Hime," who lives on top of the nearby mountain. However, this mysterious "Inugami-Hime" turns out to be a cute girl who has chosen him to be her servant, not her sacrifice. Their life together is just beginning! [tethysdust]

title: The Story of a High-Schooler Who Wanted a Girlfriend but Had a Sour Face
description: A senpai with a sour expression and a kouhai who's a gloomy otaku like each other.

title: Awajima Hyakkei
description: This coming-of-age omnibus series will follow the girls at a kageki school; each chapter will center around a different girl.

title: Hana-kun to Koisuru Watashi
description: Responsible class president Nanase Sakashita couldn't be more different than the class-cutting loner, Hana. But when he saves her from a pushy classmate, the two strike up an unlikely friendship. Nanase is determined to help set him straight and keep him in school, and Hana is equally determined to show her there's a life outside the classroom. Will the two be able to overcome their differences? [Kodansha]

title: Falling to  Where I Belong
description: Heart warningly honest Cheng Fei Chi X A proud and an innocent Zhen Ye Ming, a youngster who doesn't think that relations are important. their love will never change! The fallen leaf belongs to the pond and I belong to you!

title: Girly Debut
description: The protagonist, Kagari, is determined to find a girlfriend, but when he enters a high school, there is only one girl there... Disappointed, Kagari enters his classroom only to find that everyone there is cute except for him...!? A boy-meets-boy coming-of-age drama begins!!

title: Dog Run!
description: A story where something blossoms between a boy and a girl.

title: Ano Ko wa Kishi (Pre-Serialization)
description:
After having recurring dreams where he sees a knight defending a princess, a boy named Himemiya realizes that his classmate Kishi might be someone he's known before.
___
Note: Originally a one-shot. It was later picked up for serialization. The one-shot was reused as the first chapter for the [Serialized Version](https://mangadex.org/title/5294637b-2217-4df7-aa25-800a26500933).

title: I'm in Love with the Villainess ~Another Revolution Story~
description: Me reencarne en mi juego otome favorito, aunque mi personaje favorito no es ninguno de los protagonistas masculinos, si no la misma villana!

title: The Story of a Man Turned Girl Who Fell in Love with a Trap
description: In japan, there's a virus that could change one's sex. Hibiki-kun, who is a trap was exposed to the said virus along with his friend. Hibiki-kun's friend, Akira turned into a girl while hibiki-kun stays the same as a trap. Romance bloomed between them.

title: Koori no Jouheki
description:
Inept at dealing with people, Hikawa Koyuki maintains a wall between herself and others. She spends her time in highschool away from others, all alone. At least until she encounters Amamiya Minato who keeps closing the distance between them for some reason?! The aloof Koyuki, the popular Miki, the boundary-less Minato, and the easygoing and kind basketball team member, Youta. This is the story of these somewhat complicated four, and their tantalizing, bumbling youth! In its original webtoon form!

**Note:** Was originally posted on XOY beginning in Winter 2017. In 2019 it moved to LINE Manga Indies. Then in 2020, it was picked up for serialization by LINE Manga.
___

title: Watashi-tachi wa Kakechigatteiru
description: The story follows the shy and elegant "Idomu" Takaku, who becomes interested in his beautiful classmate Hazuki Shinohara, who sits beside him in class. She seems to keep everyone else at a distance, but the truth is that she has no idea how to communicate with others. Hazuki is secretly interested in Idomu as well, but the two have no idea how to communicate their feelings to each other.

title: A Girl Who Unconsciously Acts Boyish
description: The original webcomic that *Mutou and Satou* is based on. A story about a tomboyish girl and her senpai.

title: Nakigao Yuri Anthology
description:
"Show me your crying face."
A slightly unique yuri anthology consisting of seven completely original tales centered around the theme of "crying face"! Enjoy each unique "crying face"!

Includes the following chapters:
1. You Are My Ideal
2. Kanojo no Namida ga Amai Riyuu
3. Afureta, Sono Saki
4. Watashi ga Inakya Dame!
5. Kurushii Koi
6. Zatsuon
7. Ne

title: Ore to Kanojo no Moe yo Pen
description:
Meet Kimijima Sen, an aspiring manga artist who specializes in hot-blooded battle shounen genre. In order to polish up his techniques to achieve his goal of professionally debuting, he became the assistant of the pro manga artist Ikoma Agito-sensei. A not-so-normal high school girl who loves drawing moe manga, eroge and has an extreme fetish for beautiful girls and big breasts. Together, they must work to get their manga serialized.  
  
Adapted from the light novel series by Murakami Rin, the author that brought you Omae o Otaku ni Shiteyaru kara, Ore o Riajuu ni Shitekure!

title: Seven Days
description:
Bright and early one Monday morning, Shino Yuzuru asks Seryou Touji out on a lark when they run into each other at the school gate. Seryou, who's immensely popular, has the odd habit of going out with anyone who first asks him out at the beginning of the week, promptly dumping them at the end of it.  
  
"Anyone" apparently includes male upperclassmen like Shino – and as a boyfriend, Seryou is perfect – unfailingly thoughtful and kind. Shino, obviously, has no intention of being in a serious relationship with Seryou. It's not like it's actually love or anything like that. Right?

title: Gohoubi Ni Kisu Shite Yo
description: ...Does that mean that Hina will kiss me 15 times? Handsome girl x Kouhai girl pure yuri side story to Ikemen Sugidesu Shiki-senpai!

title: Kore wa Ai ja Nai no de, Yoroshiku
description:
16-year-old Izumi Haru has been enthusiastic about love movies ever since she was young. Being a hopeless romantic, there is nothing more important and beautiful than love.   
  
However, the love that she has seen around her is far from idealistic. Yet, the hope for a beautiful love story was not lost when she ran into Kujo Tsubasa and his girlfriend in the classroom one day…

title: X (CLAMP)
description:
From Viz:  
Kamui Shiro is a young man who was born with the power to decide the fate of the Earth itself–a destiny he can barely bring himself to believe. But as other players in the prophecy begin to gather around him–the "Seven Seals," with the power to protect the Earth, and the "Seven Harbingers," who are fated to destroy it–he has no choice but to come to terms with his fate.

title: Kanojo wa Sore wo Gaman Dekinai
description:
Kusabana Ryouta is a normal highschool boy, except that he always wears a full body dog suit and never takes it off.  
Things were just like always until he accidentally drops the bag of the girl he likes, and her sports pants fall out. And just when he picked them up - wondering how they smelled -, the new homeroom Teacher Kizawa Ayame AKA Ayane-Chan catches him in the act. Pleading that he will do anything if she doesn't tell anyone about this, she agrees, but asks him: "In exchange will you let me sniffle your body?".

title: Boys Over Flowers
description:
Eitoku Academy is a school that caters to children and from rich, high-society families. Hence, Makino, who comes from a poor family, is considered by others as the "weed" of the school. The school is ruled by the "Flower Four" group, more commonly known as the F4. The F4 leader, and son of the wealthiest, most powerful family in Japan, Domyouji Tsukasa, takes an interest in Tsukushi because she is the only girl at Eitoku who does not fawn over him. However, his hot-headed nature and bullying ways are originally a major turn-off for Tsukushi, who has her sights set on Rui Hanazawa.
___
Volume 37 is comprised of three short stories that happen after the ending

title: My Princess Charming
description:
Twenty-one-year-old Yuna is tired of having guys hit on her all the time. As popular as she is, she's been single her whole life. Just when she decides to make herself a boyfriend to fend off guys, she meets a handsome guy who looks good enough to be her boyfriend. But wait, the guy is actually a girl! In fact, rumor says that Min is a lesbian. Nonetheless, the two decide to pretend to be in a romantic relationship.

Read the official English translation on the Pocket Comics app!

title: QQ Sweeper
description:
Kyuutarou Horikita is the tall, dark and handsome… cleaning expert of Kurokado High. His classmates find him mysterious mostly because he's hard to get to know. One day in his club's room in the school's oldest building, he stumbles upon a sleeping maiden: transfer student Fumi Nishioka.  
  
With nowhere else to go and having the eyes to see spiritual dirt, Fumi will learn from the cranky Kyuutaro how to rid the school of the grime that attracts spirit-damaging bugs, and how to fight the bugs themselves.  
  
Has she finally found a place she can call home in the large house of Kyuutaro's small family of sweepers? Will her brazen goal of marrying a rich guy disgust or amuse them? And her heart, once it learns the way of purifying cleansing, will it be cleansed in return—in spite of her missing memories and her ever-looming secret?

title: Ouji-sama no Dakimakura
description:
Mahiro, the head of the disciplinary committee, is assigned to take care of Asuma, the most tardy student in school. Rumor has it that Asuma will never wake up once he falls asleep, no matter what you do. This makes Mahiro worried, but eventually, they become roommates...

One morning, when Mahiro tries to wake up Asuma, who is fast asleep, he is suddenly pulled into his bed! Asuma, who was not supposed to fast asleep, wakes up with a start and says, “It looks like I can wake up when I hug Mahiro-kun!!”

Since then, Asuma has become very attached to Mahiro, and the distance between them is gradually growing closer...!

title: Seeing The Spark Again
description: Through an old camera in the club's storage room, Gu An saw something that should not exist. She was a shooting star from three years ago named "Xinghuo." Why do you stay in the night sky? Why am I the only one who can see you? Gu An, who usually follows the crowd, wants to investigate and take the initiative for the first time in her life. As an observer and "the most important friend," Gu An and Xinghuo set on a journey to find the former club members and fulfill their dreams from three years ago. "It's... been exposed." "But, I'm really happy. Thank you, Gu An."

title: Boku ga Boku de Aru Tame ni
description:
Second-year high school student Shun Asakura has been together with Sana Wakatsuki since they were kids, and has had feelings for her for just as long. In fourth grade, Shun's family had to move, but he couldn't tell Sana how he felt before he left town. He's regretted putting a lid on his feelings for seven years since then, until he finally returns to the town where Sana lives. He resolves to tell Sana how he really feels. But there, he meets someone named Ayumu Fujisaki, who greatly resembles him, and what he thought of himself, like an ideal version of him.

Note: Volumes each contain an extra chapter of One Week Friends, taking place after the main timeline.

title: Charai Hayama ni Kyun to Kita
description: Ashina, a member of the library committee is made to supervise her kouhai, Hayama, who is on probation for hooking up with a fellow student. As time passes, they become friends and maybe more…?

title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! (Official Colored)
description: Tenth grader Yugi spent most of his time alone playing games…until he solved the Millennium Puzzle, a mysterious Egyptian artifact! Possessed by the puzzle, Yugi becomes Yu-Gi-Oh, the King of Games, and challenges evildoers to the Shadow Games…weird games with high stakes and high risks!

title: Wěizhuāng Xiǎochǒu de Wángzǐ
description: RanK is a popular idol group in the country, RON(Qiu ChenYu) goes with the handsome-cool-guy route, but KIMI(Yu Lang) is set up as a noisy comic character. However, Yu Lang’s real character is not like that. His childhood friend Ying Yue always watches him silently from behind, hoping her best friend can break through this situation as soon as possible…

title: Koi Shite Sotto, Kiss Shite Motto
description: The serious committee president Yoka, and the impudent yankii, Igarashi. They begin a secret relationship, and their slightly mischievous, healing, sweet love is not to be missed!

title: As Sweet as This
description:
College student Eunho Lee is a recessive Omega with a sweet tooth. The handsome owner of a café and his cookies both captivate his heart and he applies as a part-timer. However, only Betas are hired and so Eunho hides his true gender and finds himself in a nerve-wrecking daily routine, steadily falling deeper for his cold but good-natured boss.

title: Koji Koi
description: The protagonist lives and works in a boarding house and has a phobia of boys, however she finds herself having to manage her fear when two new boys are hired in the boarding house who will live and work there. One is a silent boy who confesses he hates girls, the other is a school friend who can't stand the protagonist because of her elusive character…

title: Umimachi Diary
description:
A letter comes to the three Kohda sisters in Kamakura, bringing the news of their father's death. A father they hadn't seen since he divorced and left home 15 years ago. Despite feeling indifferent about their father, Yoshino, the middle of the three, and Chika, the youngest, go to Yamagata to attend his funeral on oldest sister Sachi's request. There, they meet Suzu, their young and reliable half sister.

title: Sasen Sareta Saikyou Kenja, Kyoushi ni Natte Muteki no Class o Tsukuriageru
description:
Monsters have long threatened humanity’s existence. To fight against these beings, Keith, the youngest person to ever become a sage, joins a knight order and shows immense success on the battlefield. However, that doesn’t last long, as a quarrel with an incompetent higher-up gets him fired from the order. With nowhere to go, Keith is assigned as a teacher, and with his talent for bringing out the best in his students, his class is about to reach unbelievable heights…

*Source: Manga UP! Global*

title: I Want to Kiss you, in that Moment
description:
A collection of moments wherein characters kiss one another on a whim.  
  
Diversas histórias curtas sobre pessoas que beijam por querer beijar, não importando-se com o momento ou lugar.

title: Sunny
description:
The story of an orphanage, the children who live in it, and the beat-up old Nissan Sunny 1200 which provides a trio of boys with a means of escape from their bleak everyday lives.

[Official English](https://www.viz.com/sunny)

title: Hen na Chishiki ni Kuwashii Kanojo Takayukashiki Souko-san (Webcomic)
description:
Takayukashiki-san knows many things that are way too weird(especially perverted things). With her, you will become a little wiser and a little more indecent <3  
A comedy manga that will satisfy your perverted curiosity!

title: The Prince's First Love
description: The flawless Prince Nazaire changes schools in hopes of wooing a bride… only to encounter the tyrant Cassius Li! At first, the two cannot stand one another, as they constantly infuriate each other. Yet between ball dances, rescues, and secret rendezvous, Nazaire and Cassius begin seeing each other for who they truly are. But love between a prince and a commoner could never happen, and if Nazaire hopes to ascend the throne, he will have to give up Cassius. Torn between love and duty, can the prince and tyrant reach their happily ever after?

title: Mahiro-chan no Kakushigoto
description:
Mahiro, the perfect beautiful girl, is perfect today! She has excellent grades, is a great cook, and even has a great personality. All I can do is watch her. And then, an incident happens!

---

We know Victoria's secret… But do we know Mahiro-chan's secret?
