title: Oshikoi Capriccio
description:
Mitsu Himekawa, a second-year high school student, secretly loves BL. Together with her best friend Rui Majiima, she spends her days fantasizing about her male classmates. One day, one of her observation targets, Shou Kagomiya, tells her, “Himekawa, you actually like Rui Majima, don't you?”, shocking her.

A chaotic love triangle (?) woven by a BL-loving gyaru and a handsome yuri-loving guy!

title: Will the Prez be Able to Follow the School Rules Against Romance
The Song of Wind and Trees
description:
It is 1880 at the all-boys school, Lacombrade Academy in France. Serge Battour is a cheerful and kind new student who is trying to fit in with the rest of the student body, despite the taboo of his Romani heritage, made obvious by his dark skin. However, his roommate Gilbert Cocteau, known for sleeping with anyone at the school to manipulate them to his advantage, is not helping the situation, especially when he makes it his personal goal to bring about Serge's downfall.   
  
Originally serialized in the 1970s, The Song of Wind and Trees is considered by many to be the first true yaoi manga as well as the first shota manga. In 1979, this series was awarded the prestigious Shogakukan Manga Award for shounen/shoujo manga.  
  
A bit of warning: the work includes scenes of rape and child abuse.

title: Omae Watashi no Koto Suki daro?
description:
Tsubaki Izumi of "Oresama Teacher" and "Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun" with her first new work in SEVEN years!   
It's a hilarious oneshot about the beginning of a relationship between a bullish but clueless heroine and a shy boy!

title: Chao Hua Xi Shi
description:
Studious and strong-willed An Kele has always tried to live her life unswayed by others, preferring to judge people with her own eyes. Due to her mother working overseas, she moves in with her aunt and soon encounters a handsome host named Yan Shu. Though fascinated by him, she is determined to work hard in school and be noticed by her upperclassman, Bai Yiran.

Unbeknownst to An Kele, the name "Yan Shu" is just an alias of her classmate Ye Ling, who moonlights as a host to alleviate the crippling debt left behind by his absconded father. While Yan Shu charms with his confident smile and silver tongue, Ye Ling is a brooding school truant—the type of person that the diligent An Kele can't help but dislike.

Though their relationship starts off both bitter and sweet, An Kele and Ye Ling find themselves tied together by fate—and so, the duo face each trial and tribulation that comes their way, chasing the bright future that comes with the rising sun.

title: Hitomebore
description: Struck by love at first sight, Hikari consults with her friend, Fuyu, about love.

title: Hachimitsu to Clover
description:
From Viz:  
Takemoto lives in a run-down student apartment, where his greatest worry is when he'll next be able to afford to eat meat and whether he'll get to class on time. Although he's away from home and living on his own, Takemoto is far from finished growing up. Along with his crazy cast of friends, Morita, Mayama, Yamada, and Hagumi, Takemoto sets out to discover life and his true self.  
  
Was adapted into a live action film in 2006 and a live action tv series.  
In 2003, this manga won the 27th Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo.

title: Jiāohuàn de shàonǚ
description:
This story tells of a high school student named Sia. In the school, there are two of them who are named Sia; one is a popular student who has everything and looks perfect, whereas the other Sia is a quiet person who often gets bullied by her classmates.  
One day they were met with an accident which resulted in both experiencing critical conditions. In this critical condition, both were destined to exchange bodies for three months. What happens after three months? Will they return to their respective bodies? Curious? Read the story to find out what happens!

title: Maison Ikkoku
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Despite the obstacles thrown in his way by the residents, who are all crooked, the brave Godai is single-mindedly devoted to the new caretaker, Kyoko Otonashi. 

However, there is a huge and steep obstacle that stands in the way of his love for Kyoko. Kyoko is a widow whose husband died after six months of marriage... 

This immortal masterpiece is now available again in a new edition!

title: Sawagashii Senpai ga Asobi ni Kuru
Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
description: Natsume Makoto, a first-year junior high school student in Choufu, Tokyo, is suddenly confessed to by a fellow freshman named Hayama Aki. Aki told him that her grandmother once told her about meeting a boy named Natsume Makoto in the future. Having never met before, Makoto is convinced that Aki is mistaken. When Aki brings up a painting of a fireworks, Makoto decides to help her find the Natsume Makoto she is looking for. The following year, the two head to Nagaoka, Niigata, to attend the city's famed fireworks festival, suspecting that the painting is linked to it.

title: When Our Names Match
description:
Jin and Junghyeok are childhood friends, but they have been in a cold war for years! What happens when their souls swap? One day, both of them found their old name tags from middle school and went to bed with old memories in mind… to wake up in the body of the one that they hate the most!   
  
How will they deal with day to day life?   
  
Is there a way back?

title: Koi Suru Lip Tint
description:
"Our eyes met right now, right?"

Ako Miyakomoto, a first-year high school student, accidentally put a lipstick on the clothes of Harumi Aikawa, a super hot guy. When she tries to take Harumi's clothes to the cleaners, she takes them off and is told cold-bloodedly, “Throw those clothes away."
Ako then witnesses Haroumi-senpai being secretly photographed by a schools girls. Then, she takes a shocking action that surprises even Harumi...?

title: Usotsuki Lily
description: Hinata Saotome is suddenly asked out by En Shinohara, a gorgeous boy in her grade. What she doesn’t know, though, is that his hobby is cross-dressing! En has always hated men, and whenever he sees his own reflection, he punches out whatever is doing the reflecting (windows, mirrors…). To combat this hatred, he dresses up as a girl. Hinata decides to go out with him anyway, despite his weird hobby.

title: Sugars
description:
[from lost-translations]  
  
She's hiding behind her real feelings.  
He's an airhead who plays along with everyone…  
She's the newbie everyone hates…  
He likes her but can never admit his feelings to her…  
She doesn't really bother with stuff like love…  
  
…are just few of the people who are a part of this intertwined connection from middle school up to university.  
What would these intersecting red lines of fate lead to?

title: Megu Miruku
description:
Getting a girlfriend, it's just about the most important thing to a guy when he enters High school. For a fortunate few, all they need to do is look to their right at the familiar face that has always been there smiling and caring. But sadly this isn't the case for our protagonists Meguru and Shou. For starters, they're both guys and on top of that, they haven't had a single female friend since primary school.  
  
Perhaps it's their friends showing off the spoils of their romantic pursuits. But something snaps between the childhood friends and each claims they would both be better off if the other was a girl. Though the boys have should have known that you should always be careful of what you wish for. Because that very night, Meguru discovers that he has been turned into a girl! But then, on their first day of school, the two finds themselves surrounded by cute girls. Are the boys regretting what happened? Is this the start of some sort of love triangle? line? cube? some other kind o

title: An Antisocial Streamer Girl Who Is About to Be Exposed
description: An Antisocial Streamer Girl Who Is About to Be Exposed

title: A Story about JK Who Has A Crush on DK Who Likes Mature Women
description: A high school girl tries her best to make her crush look her way. The thing is, her crush only likes waaay mature women.

title: Koi no Ghost
description:
A heartwarming ghost comedy BL by the author of *Ore ga Shuyaku na Wake ga Nai!* ☆

One day, high school student Aragaki notices that a ghost is haunting him. Aragaki thought he was the only person who can see the ghost, until his crush and classmate, Asahikawa, points it out! What's more, Asahikawa says that the ghost told him that Aragaki likes him...? Could this eerie situation actually lead to Aragaki finding love through the help of this ghost?

title: Kimi wa Nani mo Shiranai
description:
The story starts off with Megu, our heroine getting rejected from her latest confession. Its been a few months since she started high school and she's already confessed and been rejected ten times! For Megu, she is envious of her childhood friend Nao, who got confessed to by a girl during their middle school graduation and is now in a happy relationship. She also wants to have a love where the person you like, likes you back and with this reasoning, Megu is determined to get a boyfriend no matter what.  
  
However, her continuous pursuit of love gave her the playgirl impression on men, even the popular playboy Aikawa refused her. Later on when Aikawa discovers the real reason behind Megu wanting a boyfriend, with a beaming face he proposes they date each other which Nao strongly disagrees.  
  
(Source: Rizzz)

title: Rokujouma no Shinryakusha!?
description:
Now that he enters his high school career, Satomi Koutaro begins his life living alone in an apartment that only costs him 5000 yen per month, an extremely cheap deal even for this small apartment. There's a catch: the apartment is apparently haunted by a cute ghost that has driven its prior occupants away. Next thing he knows, not only is there a ghost trying to drive him out of his new home, but magical girls and other unique female characters turn this small apartment into a battleground of sorts.

*Source: MangaHelpers*

title: Hibari ga Naitara Tsukamaete
description:
"In order to meet you, I…"  
  
Enomoto, currently a college student, often finds himself reminiscing the days spent with his childhood friend Shimura, who had always been beside him up until six years ago. Due to a sudden transfer, Enomoto didn't get to ask Shimura where he was moving and he hadn't heard anything from him since.  
  
Until one day, he suddenly reunites with Shimura in his Philosophy class in college. Enomoto is over the moon, but Shimura seems to feel differently…

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Maya and Claudine (MayaKuro) Short Comics Compilation (Doujinshi)
description: A compilation of short twitter comics about Maya Tendou and Claudine Saijou (a.k.a. MayaKuro) from the anime Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight.

title: Ane ni Narisumashite Ikemen ni Kokuhaku Suru Otouto no Hanashi
description: The story of a younger brother who impersonates his sister and confesses to a handsome man.

title: Fukakouryoku no I Love You
description:
The protagonist, Kodama Hoshinagi, a first-year high school student, is constantly pressured by Wataya Senpai, a natural and charming senior. In the past, she had a one-sided love for him, but tried to keep her feelings to herself in order not to be bothered. However, despite knowing that it would hurt her, her feelings for Senpai grew out of sheer force majeure.

(natalie.mu)

title: Linda
description:
A story about remembering an unforgettable first love.

**Note:** The author also made a [music video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rbxY2NoB_hA) based on the comic.

title: Koi toka, Kiss toka, Karada toka.
description:
"I'll grow up a little more this year!?" I go to the same school as the sempai I've always yearned for. but he is a little careless and a player!?  
  
Pt-Br:||  
"Eu vou crescer um pouco mais este ano!?" Eu vou para a mesma escola que o senpai. Eu sempre desejei isso, mas ele é um pouco descuidado e um pegador!?||

title: Seiken Tsukai no World Break
description: The "campus sword & sorcery" story is set in a private high school that brings together "saviors," youths with awakened memories from past lives. Some of them are Shirogane who fight enemies with weapons and techniques gleaned from the Puraana powers from their own bodies. Others are Kuroma who wipe out enemies, with magic to manipulate the Maana powers that surpass physics. A boy named Moroha Haimura enrolls in this school. He is the first person in history with past lives of both Shirogane and Kuroma.

title: Love & Kiss
description: Sweet Highschool romance of a naïve girl. Do you have a special someone?

title: Yuri Yuri
description:
Missed connections + misunderstandings + misperceptions = happy ending. 
From Namori, the creator of the laid-back yuri sensation Yuru Yuri, comes another slice of life of the Namori World. This complete collection includes all five volumes of the old school yuri shoujo doujinshi Yuri Yuri, plus Yuri Yuri After~, depicting the aftermath of volumes 1-4. Do you remember your first love ー that fluttering heart, the confusion, the frustration?

title: Momo's Iron Will
description:
Inuwashi Momo, a lovely and delicate girl, lives with her handsome brothers who have been dearly taking care of her since their parents' death. Of course, she loves them… maybe too much…  
  
In order to protect her kingdom, Momo acts coyly while using GPS to track them and doing whatever it takes to get rid of girls interested in her brothers, like a soldier. But one day, Momo meets a boy who wants to overthrow her perfect kingdom!

----------
- [Official English volumes (Kodansha)](https://kodansha.us/series/momos-iron-will/)

title: I My Me Mine
description: "Let's make it an unforgettable high school life." Akira Itsuki just wants to make friends. Middle school didn't go as planned, that's why she's determined to do better at high school and make tons of friends. However, before high school starts, she saves the "delinquent" Amamiya, who lives next door, from a certain incident. After this, Amamiya wants to befriend Akira no matter what, but due to his reputation, Akira's high school life might be over right from the start.

title: Onee-chan no Midori-kun
description: The manga centers on Sui, a girl in her third year of junior high. She doesn't really get along with her older sister's boyfriend, Midori-kun, since he always treats her like a kid and makes fun of her. But Midori-kun is suddenly asked to be Sui's home tutor.

title: Himitsu no Otsukiai wo Shiteimasu. (Webcomic)
description: [Dating is exciting every day ──.] Takase, a second-year high school student, is dating a popular person in the same class, Togawa. However, the relationship between the two remains a secret to everyone. They’re cool in front of their friends, but Takase is always thrilled by Togawa, who becomes lover-like when he's alone. However, one day, Kurono, a senior in the third grade, finds out that they are dating! Moreover, Kurono is interested in Takase …!? A wholesome story of a doting boyfriend and a slightly ditzy girlfriend ♪

title: Glow!
description:
Ever since he was a kid, Morisaki Aki has been loved by the spirit of misfortune. After starting high school, he is coerced by his upperclassmen, Akabane and Tokunaga, into joining the gardening club – but as it turns out, said club was just a cover for… the loan shark club!  
  
Aki gets involved with upperclassmen that not even the teachers would want to cross. And thus begins his unfortunate high school life. However, unbeknownst to him, mysterious feelings begin to bloom. These three guys with their clashing personalities grow together to paint a bold graffiti tag of teenage angst!

title: Zeze-kun and Nagahama-san
description: A rom-com about a couple who smother each other with love and praise.

title: Love Slave
description:
'It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a high school girl in possession of dog ears, must be in want of a (spoiler).'  
  
In the not too distant future, when living animal ears can be transplanted to people, dog crazy Hikari has a pair of dog ears and has convinced her beloved Inukai-senpai to get a pair as well. But there may be side effects…  
  
This is the same world as Usa-bility and Mimi Mix! and we're back to girls dating girls. As always, it's complete fluff and super cute.

title: Fechi Senpai@Kaihatsu Chuu
description:
A new work by Kitada Ryouma, author of "The Story of a Manga Artist Confined by a Strange High School Girl"! 
The main character, Andou Touri, is unable to make friends because of his rough appearance. Though it may not look like it, he loves cute things and posts illustrations on social media to share his tastes with others.


When he got worried because his drawings were not getting traction, a senior member of the art club said she had the solution to his stagnant numbers in social media and proceeded to take off her ***** in front of him!?

Will this awaken your fetish!?
A oneshot about the "fetish renaissance"!

title: Coming Across a Beautiful New Teacher Having A Forbidden After-School Scene With a Student...?!
Misukhan Pyohyeon
description: Jaewon has known that he likes males since he confessed his feelings to a boy named Yoonsung in elementary school, but when Yoonsung tells him that liking other boys is weird, Jaewon tries to hide his "weird" feelings and push them away. Now in high school, he's developed a strong crush on his kind, handsome classmate Karam, and Jaewon decides it's time to finally confront the reality that he might be gay. He asks for advice over the internet and befriends another gay student named Junseo, who becomes Jaewon's emotional support in his quest to win Karam's heart.

title: Our Love Counseling
description: Confessing your feelings the girl you love is never easy. Even more so if she's one of the school's two most admired idols. Kobayakawa, now a high-school student, has been going to the same class as his crush, Kawai Yui, since elementary school. When he finally decides to call her out, he's so nervous that he ends up confessing to be in love with the school's other beauty, Kawashima Asuka,…?!

title: DOLO's Destiny Pill
description:
Jana’s a talented artist, but she’s also an awkward high school girl. When her first love Conrad transfers to her school, she’s over the moon until this popular genius very publicly denies knowing her. Before she dies from the online shaming, the mysterious creature Dolo has just the thing for her — a capsule to change her destiny! All it requires in exchange is something valuable to her. What will Jana sacrifice to make her dreams come true? Nothing could go wrong… right?

---

Related c96.5: [Once More](https://mangadex.org/title/42121/once-more), [The Heart Has Its Reasons](https://mangadex.org/title/43892/the-heart-has-its-reasons)

title: Yagate Kimi ni Naru (Webtoon)
description:
Yuu has always loved shoujo manga and awaits the day she gets a love confession that sends her heart aflutter with bubbles and blushes, and yet when a junior high classmate confesses his feelings to her… she feels nothing. Disappointed and confused, Yuu enters high school still unsure how to respond. That's when Yuu sees the beautiful student council president Nanami turn down a suitor with such maturity that she's inspired to ask her for help. But when the next person to confess to Yuu is Nanami herself, has her shoujo romance finally begun?

This is a webtoon release of Bookwalker.

title: Yagate Maken no Alicebell
description: Seiji Harada usually avoids girls due to the fact that he believes that they are the source of all problems. As he enters his high school years, he is forced to join an all-girl school that recently began admitting male students. Now surrounded by all girls, he begins to realize that all members of this high school possess special powers, including himself

title: Yamada-ke no Onna
description: Her grandmother divorced thrice, her mother divorced twice, and her sister is a single mother. Yamada Mitsuba is a 1st year high school girl who is raised in a women-only family. She's the prodigy of her year, but rather than independence, she dreams of a happy family and a faithful husband. However, of all people, she ends up falling for the blonde boy with a bad reputation, Kubo Ryuunosuke...!

title: My Childhood Friend Was a God
description: This is a story of a special boy who becomes a God once he turns 18 and his ordinary childhood friend.

title: The (Inner Voice of the) Girl Next to Me Is Loud
description: Ever since he was little, Kobata-kun has been able to hear the inner voice of other people. However, as he enters high school, he meets with his seat neighbour, Niiya-san.

title: Miku Will Get Her Heart Broken in 7 Days
description: There are two routes for this, a bad end and a good end.

title: Hekikai no AiON
description: Tsugawa Tatsuya just lost his parents in an accident… but he's trying not to let that keep him too down as he starts high school. While trying to obey his father's final wish for him to become an upstanding man, he ends up helping a girl who was being bullied. Despite her exceedingly cold nature, he just can't leave her alone… which may not necessarily be to his benefit, as he ends up getting wrapped up in a world where things like parasitic mind-controlling bugs exist...

title: Saku-chan to Nozomi-kun
description: Onodera Saku posed as a boy up until the end of elementary school in an attempt to console her mother, who tremendously grieved the death of her elder brother. Seated right next to her, on the other hand, is Nishioka who grows out his hair beyond the usual length for boys and because of that is picked on. Following a conflict with his classmate he decides to cut it short. Next day he helps Onodera when her toilet bag is snatched away by that very same boy. Fast forward. Onodera no longer dresses like a boy and finally confesses her love to Nishioka, but is rejected. How did it turn out this way?

title: Jikanwari no Soto
description: We may not know anything about that girl who's in the same class and has the same route to school yet— a sweet, sour, and embarrassing omnibus of three girls drawn by Toyobayashi Sakane, a "more than youth but less than romance" expert!!

title: Boku no Ushiro ni Majo ga Iru
description: Nanri Ryusuke has transferred schools 3 times this year because of his parents’ divorce and he is determined to make a good impression at this new school because it appears that he's staying for good this time. However, his seat is in front of the weird girl in the class, Fujimori Miya, who claims she is a witch and who everyone in the school avoids. Miya, for some odd reason, takes a creepy interest in Ryusuke and makes him the subject of all her crazy experiments and spells.

title: Usa-bility
description:
Usami-chan has always wanted a pair of rabbit ears, and she finally managed to have a pair grafted. Will Mikura-kun think she's cute? But there's just one problem… she's suddenly become very 'sensitive'.  
  
For fans of Mimi Mix! - this is the same world, but it's not yuri. Four chapters total.  
  
It's the minimum possible ecchi, everything is off camera - maybe two milli-Toloverus.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The Shinji Ikari Raising Project
description: Stunning, hotheaded Asuka Langley Soryu has been friends with Shinji Ikari since they were little. And she always sort of assumed they'd stay together-until the day the beautiful, brilliant Rei Ayanami showed up in class! When Shinji starts to get curious about Rei, Asuka needs to figure out if she wants to be just friends with Shinji, or something more. But why are so many people keeping an eye on these relationships-people like homeroom teacher Misato, school nurse Ritsuko, and Shinji's mother-NERV's chief scientist, Yui Ikari…?

title: The Fairy Captivity
description: A dystopian fantasy. In this futuristic world, humans are ruled over by faeries. The young master Yue Hu encounters the fairy Fei Liai, and gradually uncovers the truth and dark secrets behind them…

title: JK Hawawa-chan
description: A collection of random one-shots and one-pagers about Hawawa-chan, who constantly gets into suggestive and/or embarrassing situations, including around the one she loves.

title: My Secret Brother
description: Hanmi told a lie on the first day of her new school just to get Lee Gun to notice her. But her shallow plan backfired and now everyone thinks she's dating Junhyuk… her actual cousin!

title: Level 1 no Saikyou Kenja - Noroi de Saikakyuu Mahou Shika Tsukaenai kedo, Kami no Kanchigai no Mugen no Maryoku o Te ni Ire Saikyou ni～【WEBTOON】
description: Haruto, a guy reincarnated into another world as an 'unusable hero' by the conspiracy of an evil god. Not only does he lack cheat abilities, but he's also cursed with the inability to grow beyond level 1 due to his fixed status! However, he discovers the true power of his fixed status and becomes the level 1strongest sage! A fantasy of reincarnation into another world, winner of the 7th Net Novel Grand Prize, now serialized and colored as a webtoon!

title: Shuukyuu Shoujo
description:
Yuuki kun was one of the star players on his junior high school team; along with his childhood friend Shinichi. Due to a promise that he made with his female childhood friend Miyuki, Yuuki kun has decided to take the long road to the J League by joining a normal school club and winning tournaments, instead of taking recommendations like Shinichi did….  
  
When he checks the club of his selected school, the best club in the country; he quickly notices that the club is completely devoid of any members except for a weird girl that goes by the name of the Fujisaki Rin. She along with her friend Ayane seem to have driven everyone out of the team….  
  
But is it really that Rin and Ayane want to dissolve the soccer club? or could they possible want something else??…. And just what is exactly the promise that Yuuki made with his childhood friends? Well, regardless of the answers it seems that Yuuki isn't in for a smooth sailing, as he completely seems to have fallen into Fujisaki's hands…

title: Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai +
description:
A "what if" alternative version of the original story, on which the cast gets acquainted in a different manner.  
  
The basic premise is that Kodaka, a rude looking and easily misunderstood transfer student catches a glimpse from a conversation between Sena (the most popular girl on school) and "her friend" Renka (a character from a visual novel); after a short discussion followed, Sena decides to give it a try and make some friends with Kodaka's help.

title: Yamato Nadeshiko Shichihenge
description:
It's a gorgeous, spacious mansion, and four handsome, fifteen-year-old friends are allowed to live in it for free! There's only one condition - that within three years the guys must transform the owner's wallflower niece into a lady befitting the palace in which they all live! How hard can it be?  
  
Enter Sunako Nakahara, the agoraphobic, horror-movie-loving, pockmark-faced, frizzy-haired, fashion-illiterate recluse who tends to break into explosive nosebleeds whenever she sees anyone attractive. This project is going to take more than our four heroes ever expected: it needs a miracle!

title: LIFE
description:
Ayumu Shiiba is studying for the all-important high school entrance exams. She is struggling to get by, but thankfully has help from her best friend Shii-chan, who is at the top of their class. Test results come back and their friendship falls apart when Ayumu surpasses Shii-chan’s scores and gets into her high school of choice while Shii-chan doesn’t! Losing Shii-chan is so painful for Ayumu that she starts cutting her wrists for comfort. Hoping for a fresh start, Ayumu arrives at her new high school and finally opens up to a new friend, Manami. But will Manami prove to be the friend that Ayumu truly needs or send her further in a downward spiral?  
  
* In 2006, this manga won the Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo.
* Was adapted into an 11-episode Japanese series.

title: Kirisaki Karin wa Korosasenai
description:
Kirisaki Karin was raised to be an assassin by an assassination organization. 

One day on an mission, she attempts to kill a women's manga artist. She was just trying to get the job done in a professional manner as usual, but her world changes drastically when she reads *TokiMero*, the target's serialized manga! She develops a strong yearning for the heartwarming adolescent school life!

Hanashi immediately quits her job as an assassin, and for the first time, enjoys a normal student life, but an assassin is sent after her by an organization.

The start of the assassin's daily romantic comedy begins!
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [GANGAN ONLINE](https://www.ganganonline.com/title/1986)

title: Love Roma
description:
A story of love at first sight - literally. When Hoshino sees Negishi for the first time, he asks her to be his girlfriend. Shocked, Negishi nevertheless agrees to allow to Hoshino to walk her home, where he explains why he is in love with her. Touched, Negishi begins to feel something for this strange young boy from her school.
___
**Buy The Original Koudansha Version:**
- Amazon: [All 5](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B002DE6IW0), [1](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/4063143309), [2](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/4063143465), [3](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/4063143546), [4](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/4063143759), [5](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/406314397X)

title: Let's Kiss in Secret Tomorrow
description: Popular Saya and shy-guy Yuuto started dating in middle school after they discovered their shared love of a popular online game. But when Yuuto's high-school debut is too successful and he becomes the hottest guy in school, Saya panics and pretends they aren't going out, so as not to be harassed by his conniving hangers-on. But can their relationship last through the secrets and the beauties?

title: God of Novels
description: “Do you like novels?” By putting the most beautiful of words alongside each other, you can create a story that radiates with grace. Such masterpiece novels have the power to move people’s hearts… or at least that’s what Chitani Iciya hoped was true. For the young writer who debuted in middle school, his novels unexpectedly came under more and more criticism until his writing spirit broke. He’s the type of person who thinks that they could never possibly become a protagonist in any story. On the other end of the spectrum lies Koyurugi Shiina, a beautiful up-and-coming novelist that claims to have seen the God of Novels. Their paths collide as they contract to work together, starting the pair’s relationship as they each progress forward with the help of writing…

title: Byousoku 5 Centimeter
description:
A tale of two people, Tono Takaki and Shinohara Akari, who were close friends but gradually grow farther and farther apart as time moves on. They become separated because of their families yet continue to exchange contact in the form of letters. Yet as time continues to trudge on, their contact with one another begins to cease. Years pass and the rift between them grows ever larger. However, Takaki remembers the times they have shared together, but as life continues to unfold for him, he wonders if he would be given the chance to meet Akari again as the tale embarks on Takaki's realization of the world and people around him.  
  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6696) for the anime movie.

title: My Classmate, Maejima, Is Really Cute
description: Maejima is really cute.

title: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru - Futari no Elder
description:
Chihaya is a boy that is looked down because he looks like a girl. Due to that reason, he isolates himself at home. His mom suggests that he should go to Seiou Academy which is an all girls school. Thus, the story started…  
  
Based on the visual novel of the same name by Caramel BOX.

title: The Princess (♂) and the Guard Dog (♀)
Hanakagari
description:
Student yuri. You can read them separately, but they are somewhat tied together.

(source: Pixiv, translated)

1. Senpai and Kouhai (後輩と先輩)
2. That Girl at Cram School (塾のあの子)
3. A Hopeless Romantic Wants to Give Up on Love (恋をやめたい恋愛体質)
4. A Friend's Love (友人の恋)
5. Cheating and Atonement (浮気と償い)
6. The Day I Realized (気付いてしまった日)
7. 500 Times Over (500回繰り返す)

title: At Least, Like That Snow...
description: A bittersweet story of young love. An original work, published as a doujinshi at C79.

title: Senpai! I Didn't Do It on Purpose! (Pre-Serialization)
description:
As soon as you're in love with someone, you're in a lucky streak...! A sexy cute ♡ romantic comedy about one couple!

---

(Source: Weekly Young Magazine, issue 13, 2022).

title: Pretty Face
description: Due to a terrible bus accident, Randoh (the main character) wakes up one day to discover he has the face of an attractive girl thanks to a rather perverted plastic surgeon. But not just any girl's face–it's the same girl that he has a crush on. To make matters even worse, he runs into the girl and she thinks it's her long-lost twin sister. When Randoh moves in with her (quite willingly) he is torn between helping out this girl by pretending to be her sister, and wanting his old face back.

title: More, Forever, Tighter.
description: Meet four couples, each with their own cute little quirks.

title: Chiaki-Sempai no Iu Toori
description: Second-year student Anna works on the Culture Festival's Executive Committee together with the school's famous Chiaki-senpai. However, everyday, she's forcibly swung about by a self-confident, flashy, lazy, and ultra-insincere Chiaki-senpai–!?

title: Minus
description: Until now, Aru can’t speak because of an incident. With the help of his little friend, Kiran, and his other friends, Aru is trying to continue his school life as usual, even though communication will be very different from before.

title: Half a Step Behind a Two-Seater
description: Ваншот від Хаміти.

title: Kimi wa Natsu no Naka
description:
Chiharu Saeki and Wataru Toda are two high school students who share a common hobby: they love to watch movies. After they meet, they become fast friends until one day, their relationship takes a sudden twist. What does it mean to love someone? What can you really do about it? Follow the story of their adolescence and witness their relationship as it unfolds through a brilliant summer.  
  
***[All English chapters have been removed due to official licensing by KodanshaUSA/PenguinRandomHouse]***

title: Ore to Ichino no Game Doukoukai Katsudou Nisshi
description:
A romantic comedy involving Souji Shirosaki a student, who is in high school, whose personality can not leave out people in need. And Ichino Moritsuka, 16, a friend in the same class as Souji, who lives alone in an apartment near the mountains. Together, they discover they have strange psychic powers, founding a club game.  
  
Adapted from the light novel series.

title: Kenka Banchou Otome - Koi no Battle Royale
description:
For as long as she's been aware, the heroine, without a single relative, lived under care of the state. Both of her parents' faces were unknown to her.  
  
In front of this heroine, a young boy appeared.  
  
The young boy's name was "Hikaru". It appeared that he was the heroine's twin brother, separated at birth. He had a proposal for the heroine.  
  
"Could you go to school in my place?"  
  
The heroine was shocked by this crazy suggestion.  
  
Furthermore this was an all-boys school. The only high school in this prefecture for delinquents.

title: Fukanzen Shinsei Kikan Iris
description:
Three quarters of the world is now barren wasteland. The other fourth is soon to follow. The Earth has been invaded by an unknown species called "phantoms." Humans have been creating androids and advanced weaponry to fight off the phantoms. Many different kinds of androids have been designed, from housekeeping androids to mercenary androids. Iris is an advanced mercenary android that can kill 6000 phantoms in a mere 2 minutes. Nagi Ichizaki Zyr finds her in a junkyard one day and he decides to take her home and repair her, without knowing that she is the hope of the world.  
  
adapted from the light novel series of the same name

Wikipedia
[Chinese (Traditional)](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%8D%E5%AE%8C%E5%85%A8%E7%A5%9E%E6%80%A7%E6%A9%9F%E9%97%9C%E4%BC%8A%E8%8E%89%E6%96%AF)
[Japanese](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%8D%E5%AE%8C%E5%85%A8%E7%A5%9E%E6%80%A7%E6%A9%9F%E9%96%A2%E3%82%A4%E3%83%AA%E3%82%B9)

title: Onee-chan Zu ga Kiwado Sugiru
description: "I'm going to be in a relationship with my step-sister!" Wait, who decided that?! There was no way he was going to fall in love. Since that traumatic event from 2 years ago, he avoids love like the plague--When his dad gets remarried! Now he has 2 sisters?! This must be some joke!! Even though Aoba wants nothing to do with the sisters, they always find themselves in sticky situations. Can they open his "door" to love? The beginning of a juicy story bound to make life a home a very ending love battle!"

title: Kami-sama wa Ikiru no ga Tsurai
description: Even in the god's world, the stratified society exists. The patron god of the Hoozuki Shinto Shrine, Kagachi, lives as a god who doesn't stand out in a shrine that is called the Abolished shrine. He is pessimistic towards everything and always says, "Living is painful…" One day, a girl appears in front of him. Her name is Nonomiya Haru. She forces herself to step into the shrine and live in it. Falling in love with a human girl, seeking for death all this while, the god's love story begins here…!

title: Shoujo Shounen Gakkyuudan
description: Haruka Nakatani, a boyish girl, transfers into an elementary school where her new class is strictly divided into two groups: girls and boys. But because of this unusual girl, who loves to play baseball, the class atmosphere is about to go through a change as well as Haruka herself…

title: How to Legally Get It on With a High School Girl
Kore wa Koi no Hanashi
description: The male protagonist Utsumi Shinichi is a well known established 31-year old author but has lost his inspiration and is currently living as a shut-in at his grandmother's house in the countryside all alone without barely taking care of himself. Then one day a 10-year-old girl named Haruka stops by and asks Shinichi for permission to take care of a stray cat in his garden. This young girl causes an unexpected reaction in him and he agrees. Shinichi learns that Haruka is an aloof and introverted girl whose parents are barely home: her father travels a lot and her mother is sick in the hospital. After meeting Haruka, Shinichi's editor Oogaki convinces him to use her as inspiration for a new romance novel. Shinichi isn't interested in Haruka in a romantic way, but he pities her because she reminds him of his tragic child self and his lonely childhood. Eventually, they develop an awkward friendship, and somehow they can't leave each other alone. What is in store for them? Why does the laidb

title: Koinimo Naranai
description:
"That's the first time I've seen crying so beautiful."  
  
Tajima finds himself taken in by Koga's crying face – but little did he know, the reason behind those tears was the death of his goldfish at the hand of Tajima's cat, Buuta. While figuring out how to apologize for that, he stumbles across a secret of Koga's.

title: Tonari no Randoseru W
description:
Every day, Yamada Ichirou takes a path to school that crosses with the girl he likes, Fujisaki Shiori. Every day, he thinks that maybe it will be the day he'll have the courage to speak to her. However, hundreds of days have passed and he still hasn't even managed to say one word.  
  
One day, the overly developed 11-year-old Sakura Moe and her mother move in next door to Yamada. While her mother's away, Moe runs over to Yamada's house in a bath towel, demanding that he "rescue" her. Unluckily, that day also happens to be the first day ever that Shiori comes over to Yamada's house on an errand about schoolwork. Now she not only thinks he's a stalker, but also a pedophile! Will Yamada be able to convince her it was all a big misunderstanding or has he lost the girl of his dreams before he even got the courage to say "Hello"?  
  
—  
  
Published in a Shounen Magazine ([Jump SQ.19](http://www.mangaupdates.com/publishers.html?pubname=Jump+SQ.19)), please do not edit Demographic to Seine

title: Yaeno Haruka wa 8-nin Iru!!
description:
Yaeno Haruka is my childhood friend.
We grew up together since we were little. She's lovely, she's kind, she's the person I like.

The morning after I fought with her──
When I woke up, a blonde gyaru, the “second version”, was there.

title: Shinigami Mina no, Shiseikatsu.
description: Imase Kyouya, a high schooler who can see what others cannot—‘non-humans’—has lived a lonely life because of it. Determined to start fresh and make friends, he vows to avoid the supernatural at all costs. But his resolve is shattered when Mina, a self-proclaimed ‘strongest shinigami,’ suddenly appears to claim his soul.

title: Amagami - Various Artists
description:
A collection of stories focusing on all the heroines within the Amagami series.  
Other artists contributing: Otoufu

title: Genderbent to Be Her Type
description: takahashi naomi is a high school boy that confessed to his crush but got rejected , but after that fateful day , he woke up as the other gender and faces new problems in his life...

title: Kusattetemo Kimi ga Suki
description: First-year high school student Ichiro is super popular with all the girls at school, but he only has eyes for his childhood friend. One day when Ichiro was finally ready to confess, a terrible misunderstanding occurred and now the girl he likes thinks he loves BL Manga!

title: Sasori to Otome: Scorpio & Virgo
description: Saotome is a novelist who is currently having a writer's block. He has been assigned a new editor and the new person turned out to be Sasasori, his ex-classmate from high school. Saotome is now left feeling awkward because the two actually had a pseudo-romantic relationship back then.

title: A long-distance relationship next door
description: The male and female leads, college students, are neighbors. Even though they live right next to each other, they don't encounter each other. But gradually, they acknowledge the other's existence, and fall for each other.

title: Koi desu ga Koi Janai
description:
Ujihara-kun is a playboy who doesn't get serious when it comes to love. He often do something behind her girlfriend and do not refuse when a girl approaches him, until a certain schoolmate caught him in the act. He turned her into an accomplice and the two had a risky relationship but will it only be just a form of skinship or something more will develop?

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Himitsu to Itta Sono Kuchibiru de, Princess wa Ouji wo Sagasanai
Volume 3: Kare ni wa Ienai Yoru, Kossori Neko wo Nusumu Tabi ni Deta

title: Sodom no Hana ni Kiraboshi
description:
1-2. Sodom no Hana ni Kiraboshi  
"He and I live in two different worlds." At least, that's what she thought until that day‒‒‒  
Morino is a 2nd year middle schooler who tends to have a shy personality. One day, she sees Hasumi, one of the popular guys at the school, crying all by himself. Morino tries to encourage him, but she also had a deep secret...

3. Hajimari no Oto.
A beautifully-illustrated story of a deaf girl and the words and feelings she want to express.

4. Sodom no Hana ni Kiraboshi  extra

title: Haruto-kun to Chiharu-chan ga Jirettai
description: Touko loves shoujo manga, especially the kind that gets her heart pounding... But shoujo isn't real life...or is it? On day Haruto and Chiharu appear in front of her, flirting like in a manga! But these two aren't dating!? And they're just childhood friends!?? No way! Check out Touko's daily observations, which are as exciting as they are frustrating☆

title: Zero In
description: Kou Shiraishi was your standard high school boy with lots of problems, mostly bullies, until the day that he meets Mikuru Nazume during a bank heist. Not only is Mikuru the school idol, but she's also an agent for Minkei, a covert paramilitary section of the National Police Agency. They team up as Kou and Mikuru journey to become stronger, both in their own way.

title: Imasugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai!
description:
Rikuto had a new younger brother Ayumu after his father’s remarriage. However, little did he know that Ayumu was actually a girl and it was under her mother’s orders that she pretend to be a boy to him. Every day, his heart beats a little faster around his overly cute brother (sister), while her heart aches in having to hide her true identity from her kind brother.  
  
With the arrival of spring, Rikuto and Ayumu begin attending the popular private school Asaoka Academy, with Ayumu dressed up as a girl. As Rikuto becomes friends with his classmates, he notices that they all have something missing. His friend from middle school, Matsuri, has lost sight of what it meant to be a girl. The cool-mannered Mao dresses as a boy even though she is a girl. The extremely shy class rep Kimika wishes to change herself. With Ayumu by his side, he sets out to help them seek out what they are missing.

title: Kimi o Utsushita Natsu
description: On a hot summer day, under a blue sky, a troubled boy meets—

title: Shukufuku no Ceska
description: The small island republic of Nankan is home to the Makari Academy, a school governed by the whims of its richest students from the royalty of neighbouring nations.  Ceska, a genius polyglot and fanatical anthropologist, is asked to act as interpreter and chair for the squabbling members of this Council of Royals, particularly to prepare for the arrival of the first ever students from the Yaguu - those who cannot use magic, in a world where magical blessings called Lua are supposedly conveyed by the goddess Saryaa.  When the Yaguu - and their enigmatic crown prince Shiki - arrive in Nankan, tensions run high; when a tense Council meeting somehow ends with the disappearance of Lua from the entire world and a mysterious homogenisation of language, Ceska decides to investigate what is going on - as no-one is quite who they seem to be on Nankan…

title: My Male Friend
description: Normal 21-year-old college student Song Ara has been best friends for 15 years with a hot guy that catches the eye of all girls, Kyung Hoon. More comfortable hanging with him than any other girl, this is the story of love that begins with this one male friend.

title: Tokyo Babylon
description:
"Do you know that the cherry blossoms are so beautiful because of the corpses buried under them?"  
  
Teenaged Subaru Sumeragi is the 13th head of the Sumeragi clan. Together with his twin sister Hokuto and the   
mysterious veterinarian Seishirou, Subaru travels around Tokyo, calming the ghosts that threaten the city.

title: Bambi to Dhole
description:
Giới thiệu truyện
Biệt danh của Yukimi là Bambi. Một cô gái nổi tiếng với một mặt là một người đáng tin cậy dù là ở trường học, hay là ở nhà. Tuy nhiên, cho đến khi một nam sinh chuyển trường đến phát hiện ra một mặt khác của Bambi. Tuy nhiên, chính cậu ấy cũng giữ cho mình một bí mật…

Một nữ sinh trung học không biết cha mẹ ruột của mình x Một học sinh chuyển trường đang nuôi một cậu con trai nhỏ.

Tưởng chừng như hai người bọn họ không bao giờ hợp nhau. Nhưng họ đã gặp nhau.

Một câu chuyện tình yêu thanh xuân trong sáng được dệt nên bởi hai con người hoàn toàn trái ngược!

Xin cảm ơn nhóm dịch Aiiro Fansub đã cho phép chúng mình được tiếp nối bộ truyện này.
Chúng mình sẽ tiếp tục dịch bắt đầu từ chap 11 của bộ truyện.
Các bạn theo dõi các chap trước ở trên trang web này để ủng hộ nhóm dịch nhé: Ở đây

title: Blue Wings
description: Ming Lan was adopted into a new family, but her foster mother Nan Xi treated her as a replacement for her dead daughter. However, her two new brothers, Ming Qing and Ming Jing did not welcome her. Ming Lan’s quiet life under this new roof was disturbed by pranks and false smiles….

title: Nishimori-san Chi no Shinobu-kun
description:
16 year old Azuma Kousuke used to called a prodigy in high school, but because of Shinobu Nishimori he was reduced to being just another student. But now, everything changes after Azuma discovers Shinobu's secret…   
  
Come enjoy another Date Tsunehiro highschool story!

title: Nagato Yuki-chan no Shoushitsu
description: The spin-off of "The Melancholy of Suzumiya Haruhi" begins! This time the main heroine is Yuki! The story revolves around Yuki and Kyon, about their school life, their club activities, their comedic schoolmates, and the bits and pieces of romantic times that the two have together!

title: S•A
description:
Her whole life, Hikari Hanazono has been consumed with the desire to win against her school rival, Kei Takishima–at anything. He always comes out on top no matter what he does, and Hikari is determined to do whatever it takes to beat this guy!  
At age 6 Hikari lost to Kei in an impromptu wrestling match. Now, at 15, Hikari joins "Special A," a group of the top seven students at a private academy, for the opportunity to trounce the guy who made her suffer her first defeat.

title: Hazama Sandwich
description:
Riri, a high school girl who can see other people's likability, enjoys observing people.
Every day she enjoys the changes in human relationships from a step back... that was supposed to be the case! But when her friend Hiiro confesses her feelings for her, she gets caught up in a complicated (?) relationship...!

title: Seishun Protagonist - Boku-tachi wa Ren'ai Kajou
description:
"Every person is the protagonist of his or her own life. But how many of us can truly live. How many of us can truly be the hero of our own lives?" Youth Protagonist.

This is a love story about a high school boy who thinks he is incapable of love for one reason or another, and a girl classmate who falls in love with him.

title: Change As We May, Our Promise Won't
description: Yuuri Hirano had promised a girl during her childhood that she would kiss her when she reached her marriage age. Thinking this was just a joke, she, however, met that girl again on the first day of high school.

title: Uchi no Kore ga Kore na mon de
description: A love comedy between a fujoshi and a fudanshi!! Natsume Makoto, a college student, started dating a person while hiding her love for yaoi. She eventually mustered the courage to come out of the closest, but it turned out her boyfriend, Sudou Kojirou, also loves yaoi. Moreover, he's the complete opposite of Makoto... Their relationship is still developing, but their lives as otaku does not slow down. Also around them, unique "yaoi otaku" friends are gathering together...!?

title: Kimi Wo Hitori Ni Shite Agenai
description:
*"I won't let you be alone."*

Chigusa, who struggles to express herself, ends up building walls between herself and other people. She's always alone at school, until one day a stunningly beautiful boy transfers to her school. To Chigusa's surprise, the boy turns out to be Iroha, the only person she ever considered a friend in her childhood. Iroha tells her that he changed schools just to see her. He effortlessly crosses the walls Chigusa has built around her, steadily closing the distance between them.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: He Can't Be This Dumb!
description:
Renowned for its exclusivity, only the children of Korea’s elite can attend International Island High. But when Kang Doha, an ordinary girl from an average family, is given a lucky chance to enroll, she’s thrust into an unfamiliar world of money and power. Despite trying to fly under the radar, she somehow ends up in the same dorm as Rowoon, the most popular guy in school! He seems to have it all, but when it comes to girls, he’s completely clueless. Can Doha teach him how to win a girl’s heart?

---

---

- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/80355)

title: Shinigami-chan wa, Choroi
description:
A grim reaper infiltrated a high school to kill a boy.

Originally published in Weekly Shounen Magazine 2021 No. 19.

title: Dokidoki Dokidoki
description:
The main character, Suzuran, is an ordinary high school girl who is in love with her classmate Usagi. However, she accidentally has the ability to turn back time when she gets excited. She just wants to have a normal romance, but because of this ability, nothing goes right. What's more, she accidentally ends up being targeted by Usagi...!?

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game ~Ame ni Utareru Kimi ni Kasa wo Sasou~
description:
This is the sequel to the manga series of "Haibara’s Teenage New Game+".  This part focuses on the adaptation of Volume 2 of the light novel.

**[Official English Light Novel](https://j-novel.club/series/haibara-s-teenage-new-game)**

title: Schrodinger's Nekomiya-san
description: Hakone asks out his classmate Nekomiya who he fell in love at first sight with, only for Nekomiya to admit to being a cross-dresser, but is Nekomiya telling the truth?

title: HameKoi!
description:
Most people have a secret they just can't tell others. 
For me, I have two. I have someone I like, and the other is...

**I am crossdressing while attending an all-girls' high school.**

I, Mizuki Saiki, have an older twin sister named Miyuki: and to suit her own purposes, she is practically forcing me to crossdress, so that I can attend her all-girls school as a female student in her place.

*"This way, I can stay together with my beloved childhood friend Kaya-chan... as long as I don't get found out!"*
Earnestly trying to hide the fact that he's the only boy in a place full of girls... This is a comedy about a heart-pounding mission that's swirling with ulterior motives!

(Source: Gangan Online)

---

* Alternative Official Raw - [Twitter](https://twitter.com/_SisterRiver/status/1853273420945113516)

title: Hinekure Chaser
description:
"My hero alone… is how it was supposed to be! Why is that guy always by his side?!"  
  
Hirokawa Hozumi was saved by Odajima Yamato, whom he then fell in love with, changing schools to chase after him. Because Yamato's childhood friend Misaki is always by his side, Hozumi becomes frustrated. Everyday, he takes out his anger on Misaki and Yamato gets angry with him. Although he is happy to be the recipient of any feelings Yamato has for him, Yamato one day punishes him with a kiss…?

title: Shaman After School
description:
“Without human faith, we cannot exist.”  
  
Shin Seonnyeo was born with shaman power, but she refused to be a shaman.  
One day, two deities came and asked her to become a shaman.  
The deities offer to grant her a wish if they can regain their old power.  
Can Seonnyeo spend a peaceful life after school?

title: Tsurara-chan wa Yuki Gal
description: A oneshot about a teacher at a school who has a yuki-onna student who's trouble in more ways than one!

title: Kamiya does not let me call
description:
"Senpai, please play me!”

Isamu Asano spent his days alone in a corner of Sakuragawa High, absorbed in online mahjong. Then one day, his highly social underclassman Sakura Kamiya invites him to join the school’s mahjong club and he finds himself trying real, face-to-face mahjong for the first time.

Confident in his skills, Asano expects to dominate. But whenever Kamiya-san sits in the kamicha seat, his specialty, calling tiles, stops working, and he can’t seem to get the upper hand at all.

Is it the psychological tension unique to live play? Or is she reading his thoughts?

As he wrestles with those questions, he gradually realizes that Kamiya’s presence is growing larger in his heartin this mahjong romantic comedy.

title: Clear as Day
description: Kumagai always gets visited by Takegawa, her childhood friend, but she knows that he only has it in for her friend, Misaki.

title: Wo Zhen Mei Xiang Chongsheng A
description:
Little had I known, I Chen Hansheng; the former elite of society and a Diamond Bachelor, was reborn. When I woke up, I was a senior graduate in high school? 
Later, Chen Hansheng was walking near the crosswalk, he seemed hesitant. A precious girl; Shen Youchu and two other girls; Bai Yueguang and Xiao Rongyu, who will he pick? All of them? One of them? Two of them? Read to find out. 

Side Note:  Diamond Bachelor is a slang word that means someone who’s insanely rich and single.

title: Hinata no Blue
description: The story starts with Hinata Naru entering the first year of high school. She had always been a quiet girl who would only hang out with her childhood friends You-chan and Micchan, but decided to change her ways after entering high school. She wanted to make many new friends, but had been having a hard time doing so due to her shyness; her life takes a turn for the better, though, after she meets the student council president Natsuno Sora and he become her first friend! And also.. maybe something more?

title: Haru no Ongaeshi
description: There is a female cat, Meet the Cat God-sama, the female cat asks to have a human form so that she can return the favor to her owner… Poof!, change happen!

title: Inki na Aitsu wa Hancubus
description:
The straightforward and kind Sora Mishima, is an ordinary high school girl who wants a boyfriend. One day, she had an erotic dream. She then went to school and met the new transfer student, Akane Kandachi. Even though he looks rather bleak and dark but for some reason, all his classmates were fascinated by him…?
Or perhaps, half-fascinated?!

title: Change Revenge
description: This necklace shall transform its wearer into their desired form... A boy who obtained this magical necklace x the prince he yearns for. What will become of this love whose true nature cannot come to light...?

title: The Childhood Friends Are off in Their Own World
Nogizaka Haruka no Himitsu
description:
The main character, Ayase Yuuto is your average boy without any special traits. He attends a private high school where he is one of the many and doesn't stand out, until, one day, he happens to discover the secret of the school princess Nogizaka Haruka, and his life changes drastically from there on.  
  
Haruka, the school's most unattainable girl, is so idolized in the school for both, her looks and intelligence, that her classmates nickname her Nuit Étoile (The Silver Star of the Night) and Lumière du Clavier (The Shining Princess on the Piano). However, nobody knows that it is only a fake role she assumes to hide her true nature. In reality she is a die-hard fan of anime, manga, and otaku culture.

title: Revolutionary Girl Utena
description:
After young Utena's parents die, she wanders the streets. Just as she's about to drown herself, a prince comes to her rescue, telling her she must grow up to be a brave noblewoman. From that day on, she strives to become not a princess but a prince. Years later, she receives a mysterious rose-crested ring in the mail. Will she meet the prince again?

[Official English](https://www.viz.com/revolutionary-girl-utena)

title: Majo-kun to Watashi
description: In a world where there are people with magical powers, of which only a few individuals know of it, the young Nagi meets Mashiro-kun, a boy who owns them, as rarely happens. However Mashiro-kun is not able to control his powers, making bad things happen every time he is in contact with girls… But despite this, Nagi wants to get close to him…

title: Kissing Until Love Blossoms
description: "I want to smell… I want to touch… I want to kiss…" Feelings that cannot be satisfied by just staring at the boy you fall in love with. Kiss… is the desire emitted by a girl in love. An omnibus of oneshots by Fuji Momo.

title: Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san (Fan Colored)
description:
Our nameless - and spineless - hero attracts the attention of one of his classmates, a sadistic young girl named Nagatoro. However, in between the bullying and teasing, something else begins to blossom.  
A lovey dovey(…?) story between a shy nerd and a S-Dere (Sadistic Tsundere) begins.

title: A Girl Adjusting to Match the Preferences of the Person She Likes
No Longer a Heroine
description:
This could be any girl. Imagine being a heroine of a love story. Hatori also believed that one day she would get married to her childhood friend, Rita. But that's not how the world works! This is a hilarious comedy that honestly paints a painful unrequited love story of this young girl!

[Official English](https://yenpress.com/9781975346485/no-longer-heroine-vol-1/)

title: Hoken-shitsu no sensei to seito-chan
description: A Nagori Yu project, originally posted on twitter, compiled in pixiv

title: I'll Make You Shout I Love You!
description: One day, Konoha receives a talisman at a shrine that will allow her to hear the thoughts of her childhood friend...?

title: Kaijuu no Hanataba
description:
It is the day before the entrance ceremony of high school. Honor moves into the “Sunset” share house by herself and meets an eccentric resident named Yanagi. What is the first emotion that this girl, who had to grow up to be an adult due to her lonely upbringing, comes to know? 

A sweet shared life between a clumsy man and girl is about to begin!

title: My Clueless First Friend - Side Stories
description: Side stories for My Clueless First Friend (Jijyou wo Shiranai Tenkousei ga Guigui Kuru) posted on the author's Twitter and Pixiv. Several of these chapters later got added to the regular main manga volume releases as (bonus) chapters.

title: Ichijou Kaname to wa Kakawaranai
description: This series is a painful love story of a return to the past to erase the first love. Ritsu, the main character, goes back to the past to change the future since her lover Ichijou Kaname is going to die, and she tries her best to avoid him and suppress her love, in order save him.

title: Kimi ni Furu Kotonoha wa
description:
Một ngày nọ, Komatsu Hinata, một học sinh trung học yêu tiểu thuyết, gặp một tên lưu manh tóc vàng ở tàu điện trên đường đến trường.
Hinata rất vui khi cũng có người quan tâm đến cuốn tiểu thuyết yêu thích của mình và vô tình bị kích động, nhưng cậu lưu manh lại có những lời lẽ không hay và điều đó làm Hinata tổn thương nên đã vô tình thốt ra những lời quá đáng.
Nghĩ rằng họ sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại nhau nhưng Hinata lại gặp lại tên lưu manh trên trường và hóa ra cậu lại là Igarashi Yukito, bạn cùng lớp chưa bao giờ đến trường kể từ hôm nhập học–?
Một câu chuyện tình yêu xảy đến với hai người chưa từng biết đến tình yêu.

title: Guilty Girl
description: One day, fate (and a stack of apology letters) brings together Tadashi, a strict member of the school’s discipline committee, and Komachi Matoi, a rebellious girl who breaks rules just for fun.

title: Kimi wa, Ore ga Suki Datte Ittara Donna Kao Suru Darou.
description: Popular playboy Kanzaki has his eye on Asahina, who practices basketball diligently. Only problem is… they're both guys! Or so he thinks…until an unexpected accident uncovers his crush's true identity as a girl. But why is Asahina cross-dressing in a co-ed school? Rivalry and romance begins in the basketball club!

title: Seishun Forget!
description: "Live with Sincerity" is Natsuki Taiyou's motto. It's first day of high school and Taiyou was heading to a school and Taiyou meets Hinata during the way there. He fell in love at first sight and suddenly confessed to her. Her answer was yes and she runs away without saying who she was, but it turns out that she was his classmate. Taiyou felt a destiny between them. However, on the next day, she doesn't remember who he is. why could it that be…?

title: Life Alive! - Kimi to Hajimeru Gakuen Sousenkyo
description:
Hokuto Kuzuhara is a delinquent known throughout Sekai Private Academy. His way of life being so hated by his family that they give him an ultimatum: find a girlfriend within a year or move out. That said, though, months pass and he still has had no luck and it seems like he never will. It is then during this predicament that he is approached by the student council vice president with a plan that would both save him from moving out… As well as help her with her revenge.  
  
Adaptation/promotion of the light novel series written by Asano Hajime with illustrations by Yuugen.

title: Bouryoku Tantei
description: Odaka Youichirou is a number one problem child, and a violent delinquent. However, he also uses his skill with violence to solve problems at school, such as a girl's problem with a stalker or an issue with peeping tom pictures. However, he has now involved a new teacher, Tsukimoto-sensei, in his activities.

title: Mayu, Matou
description: Clad in school uniforms practically breathing with life are the girls of Hoshimiya Girls' Academy. When a certain “incident” rocks the academy, hidden feelings will be entwined in this pure girls' love story.

title: Oniichan wa Boku ga Katte Ageru
description:
Toma Shiratori, the older brother, is a well-received popular teacher at school,
but in order to force himself to act such an appearance he's in competent in front of his sister.
Chiyuki Shiratori, the younger sister, is a delinquent school girl who just sleeps during classes,
but at home she takes care of her brother and does cleaning, laundry, and cooking.
A story about an older brother who wants to be kept, and a younger sister who wants to take care of him.

title: JC Sasha-chan to Classmate Otaku-kun
description: The original version of the webcomic.

title: Sano-kun wa Ijiwaru
description: Sano, the handsome and popular guy who sits next to me in class, has made it his hobby to tease me. He always acts like a prince in front of his other friends, so why am I the only one he treats this way? Somehow, though, despite his nosiness, he still always pays attention to me. It's the kind of nosiness that could make a girl's heart skip a beat!

title: Come on a My House!
description: From Lovesick Alley: Ever since she was little, Hina has always had a routine of visiting a particular vacant house. One day, she notices a stranger sleeping inside. Why is Hina so fixated on that house and who is that guy sleeping there?!

title: Hitori to Hanasu no de Seiippai
Akai Ito no Shikkou Yuuyo
description:
College student Keiji possesses the dubious talent of being able to see the red string of fate. One day, he suddenly notices a red thread tied to his own finger! He is tickled pink on catching sight of it and immediately follows the thread, but the thread leads to his own kouhai named Hiro!  
  
"My soul mate is a guy!?"

title: She Will Do Whatever It Takes
Mars no Kiss
description:
Yukari is a “bad girl.” She rebels against her controlling mother by dyeing her hair, polishing her nails and having an older boyfriend. Miki is a “good girl.” She’s tall, quiet and smart. And a bit aloof.  
  
The two are forced to share a double desk at the beginning of the term which annoys Yukari no end. Yukari’s initial reaction is disdain and derision for Miki’s behavior. But, one day, after school, she sees Miki in the Art Room, gently kissing a statue of Mars and her heart starts to race. When someone comes up from behind, both Miki and Yukari know that they’ve been seen, and everything changes between them.

title: AM8:02, hatsukoi
description:
From KCG Scans:  
  
The story is about Hiyori, a girl who studies at an all-girl highschool and secretly admires Okise, a boy she always sees when taking the bus to school. He's always around friends and seems unreachable to her, but, one day, she gets the opportunity to speak to him..

title: A Cruel God Reigns
description:
Sự hy sinh điên rồ đã kéo cậu bé Jeremy xuống vực thẳm, lang thang vô định và đánh mất tiếng nói. Liệu rằng Jeremy có bao giờ trở về được thế giới loài người?

Đến với "Ngự trị ta, vị chúa tàn bạo - Zankokuna Kami Ga Shihaisuru" để cùng Jeremy và những người cậu yêu thương thoát khỏi khu rừng hỗn độn giữa tình yêu và bạo lực, tìm ra con đường giữa lằn ranh sinh tử.

Sau cùng, liệu con người có thể thoát khỏi vị chúa tàn bạo vẫn hằng ngự trị chúng ta? Hy vọng bạn sẽ theo dõi đến cùng và tìm được câu trả lời cho riêng mình.

title: Ore no Kimochi wa... ~Osananajimi Triangle~
description: Guy thinks his two childhood friends like him.

title: Toppuu to Beat
description:
Niike, a high school first year prone to forgetfulness and doing too many favors, is asked to drop in on her classmate Nemoto who's been absent from school. Supposedly, it's just him living in his house alone, yet the presence of "something" seems to linger...?

(Source: Manga Plus)

title: Springtime of Girls
description:
Akane, who's always longed for a fateful encounter like in shoujo manga, has entered a prestige all-girls high school, ran into a beautiful upperclasman Iori and fell in love on first sight. Wanting to get closer to her, Akane joins the student council, but how will she approach the flawless Iori-senpai?
A school yuri starring a heroine reject fantasizer girl and a perfect senpai who's always on her guard!

title: Amahara-kun+
description: The main character is a trap, whose sole purpose is to convert others into trap by whatever means possible. He seeks boys with feminine features or behaviors and through very comedy based tactics convinces them to embrace the trap life style.

title: Kami Sen.
description: Izumi Koutarou's family have lived in Izumi Hot Spring for generations. But the spring suddenly dried up a couple of years ago, resulting in a family huge debt. As they prepare to skip town to flee from debt collectors, the guardian deity of the house, Konoha-sama, appears. Konoha-sama, (who was supposed to be a really fearsome god), appears instead as a cute girl–wearing no clothes. What will happen to their family debt problem? And what is the power of Konoha-sama?

title: My Girlfriend Is Coldhearted
description: **Alt Official Raws:** [pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/20581224/series/49457), [niconico Manga](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/39117)

title: Hanaori-san wa Tensei Shite mo Kenka ga Shitai
description:
When a former demon king and a former hero are reincarnated in a peaceful world, they accidentally begin to fall in love!

Narukami Ryusei is a NEET by profession. He spends his days hiding and playing video games, but he was actually a demon king in a world other than this one. Here, the hero who once defeated Ryuusei and is now a high school girl, Hanaori Mitya, arrives to visit him...
___
- [Official Twitter (JA)](https://twitter.com/orehaji_mo2)

title: Teramachi-senpai Wants Him to Understand
description: "A story about a certain manga club where the senior student helps her junior elevate his drawing skills. Tiny (but shapely) tits are amazing! Or at least that's the feeling I wanted to painstakingly pour into this work." -Fujita Nagisa

title: Sanoba Witch
description: One day, high schooler Hoshina Shuuji, who can sense peoples' feelings through his ordinary five senses, accidentally sees the popular Ayachi Nene masturbating in the school library. Nene is a member of the Occult Club, and commonly offers her classmates advice through fortune-telling. When Shuuji goes to apologize to her, he learns two things: the Occult Club is going to be closed due to lack of members, and Nene is actually a witch that is collecting 'soul fragments' that come from strong emotions. After he accidentally absorbs her collection of soul fragments, he decides to join her club, help her collect more, and try to find a way to give back the ones he took.

title: Disciplinary Committee Members and Gals want to Understand each Other
description: Minato Sudo, now in his second year of high school, has become a member of the discipline committee, just like last year. Just as he is determined to maintain discipline this year, he meets his classmate, the gal Himemiya Aika. Sudo points out that she is completely against discipline, with her short skirt, exposed chest, and heavily dyed brown hair... but as he gets to know her, his heart gradually changes...

title: S- Kimi to, Kanojo to, Unmei to
description: In the year 2045, VR-Capable brain implanted communication terminals have become widespread. With the advent of this world changing technology, the world has become an almost unrecognizable place. From e-sex indistinguishable from the real thing to advanced artificial intelligence, it seems anything has become possible. Except for, of course, the redemption of my pathetic love life.

title: Yurayura Q
description: Kyuuko is born between a Shinto priest and a kitsune mom. Though her eight older siblings are blessed with both beauty and intellect, Kyuuko doesn't mind that she is different. This is the story of Kyuuko going through life with her very own charm.

title: Rather Than Being an Award Winning Actress, It's Better to Study at Qing Hua
description:
Award-winning darkhorse Dong Fang Fei Fei, also known as the beauty who specially attracts scumbags was sent back to the high school when she was 17-year-old after being reincarnated. In order to avoid the fate of being killed again, she must gain admission to Qing Hua University.
Dong Fang Fei Fei roared: "You want an illiterate like me to get into Qing Hua University?!"

title: Welcome Back, Aureole
description: Bright and sociable Kazu and sober and serious Moto have been friends since they were kids. Even if they grew apart and became friends with different groups of people in high school, they still knew and understood each other well. However, Kazu slowly starts to become aware of Moto as more than just his friend…

title: Classi9
description: After being accepted by the Melite Conservatory of Music, Taki Ren, travels all the way to the City of Music, Vienna, to fulfill her dream of becoming a composer. However, there's one problem: Melite is an all-boy's school! Her classmates are all musical geniuses, but they also come with problems!

title: Love Comedy wa Okirai desu ka?
description: Aida is a man with a decent appearance who fell in love with the class idol Yano Kokoro and changed his seat in class to get closer to her. He studied shoujo manga which (as he claims) all girls on the planet love and tries to use that knowledge to win over her heart. However, Yano is a realistic girl who doesn't seem to be too fond of that approach…

title: Persona 5 - À la carte Anthology
description: Collection of various stories based on the Persona 5 video game.

title: The Kind of Person Who Would Fall in Love With You If You're Nice Enough to Them
Mousou Fragments
description: An anthology collection of small stories from this Twitter author's mind.

title: Kowaku no Kowai no
description: Ageha has always been a timid girl, but ever since she met Kagari—a strange student whom no one else seems to see—things have started to get worse. While her classmates treat her like she’s disturbed for talking to herself, Kagari stays by her side, protecting her and telling her over and over again how much she loves her. However, what Kagari understands as “love” is far from human, and little by little, Ageha begins to lose the ability to distinguish between the people and the strange creatures surrounding her.

title: Hoshi ni Negai wo
description: Shinonome Nozomi, a first year, joins her school's Astronomy Club in order to look out for shooting stars and have her wish granted. Her fellow member, Musashi Shouta, however does not want her around because she has disturbed his plans to live out a peaceful and private life in the Astronomy Club. Nozomi, however, insists on staying. Soon after, Shouta discovers that he has the ability to summon shooting stars at will by snapping his fingers. What will the two Astronomy Club members do upon making this discovery? And what exactly is Nozomi's wish…?

title: Akuma to Hito to no Ma
description: Miyazaki, a high school boy who has been present where a cute erotic classmate is being attacked by a defect. I suddenly got help, and of course I was messed up ...! The secret relationship between Miyazaki and her begins!

title: Renai No Jugyou (Pre-Serialization)
description:
In 20XX, the Love Education Law was enacted. ``Love'' has become a mandatory subject in a response to the declining birthrate. Michitaka Sato, a high school student who has given up on romance and works hard on his studies, is on the verge of failing school. When he attends a supplementary class to avoid repeating a grade, Mai Aihara, a beautiful girl who is a problem child, appears as his partner...? Suddenly, he begins to study love alone with the beautiful girl in the three C's. Close contact, close quarters, and behind closed doors! Does Aihara-san have a secret...? A love-learning romantic comedy between a beautiful JK girl and a boy.

Serialized July 8, 2024 in Gagan Online.

title: Shishunki no Futari
description: In order to eliminate the villains that ran rampant around the world, the assassin Tsuji strives to kill everyday. On the day of the junior high school graduation ceremony, he killed the bully as requested, but it was witnessed by his classmate, Shirayuki-san. This is the story of the bloody romance between a killer and his stalker!!

title: Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi ga Shuraba Sugiru Ai
description: A spin off based on Ai's usual antics of "trying to get closer to Ta-kun" from even before affiliating herself with the Jien Otsu club.

title: Jewelry - Hane to Kotori no Subarashiki Hibi
description: Hane is finally starting high school after being in and out of hospitals throughout most of her childhood. On her first day, she musters up the courage to greet one of her classmates, Kotori, only to witness him fist-fight upperclassmen. Seeing the fight, Hane faints and is readmitted to the hospital, and while she's recovering, Kotori surprisingly comes to visit her. Could this delinquent be more than meets the eye? "A sparkling new love story"!

title: Oboreru Knife
description: A beautiful and mature sixth-grade girl from Tokyo suddenly has to move out to the country side of Japan with her family. The girl, Natsume, then meets a boy and from then on she begins to feel 'something' in her body, like a surging wave.

title: Oko-sama Star
description: At high school, Kaido seems to be a scary delinquent, but he’s leading a second life as the star of a sentai superhero live show! When sentai superfan classmate Honda discovers Kaido’s secret, Kaido will stop at nothing to make sure it doesn’t get out, but despite himself, the charismatic performer finds himself falling for his biggest fan… [Kodansha]

title: True Love
description: Ai just loves her big brother, Yuzuru! He's so kind, so reliable and so cool! He always protects Ai from trouble and when she cries, he cheers her up! He's the perfect big brother. But, bad things happen soon. Her parents divorce and she and her brother are separated! Now, after 9 years, one day, Ai, now 14 years old, finds a tall boy in front of her school! Who is this boy-?

title: My Special One
description: Could you resist an idol’s pull? Sahoko is a gloomy, ordinary high school student, with a deep hatred for attractive men that goes all the way back to her middle school days. One day, Kouta, a super-famous national idol who’s used to being loved by everyone, walks into her family restaurant. Their first meeting goes horrendously, as expected, yet Kouta keeps coming back, and Sahoko might just be warming up to him. But she promised herself never to fall in love ever again… Who will win?
