title: By My Side
description: A short manga about the story of a school girl who has a flower growing from her hair and the teacher she spends time with during that period.

title: Their Ark
description:
Once upon a time, there lived a family who hunted animals for sport. Their actions were met with punishment, cursing all their descendants through the maternal lineage to live a life transforming into animals.

Flash forward to modern day times, where all relatives of the family have adapted to their circumstances, and have found their own happiness while living a comfortable life. But for the boys and girls entering puberty, this time feels extra special and different...

What does "affection" mean? Why does it change us? This is a story about a special family going through their adolescence--a difficult time for anyone.

title: The Girls Who Aren’t Really Dating
Dansou Kareshi ga Kanojo ni Himitsu o Akasu Hanashi
Uchi no Futeki na Gangster
description: Born as a daughter of a gangster family, Hanazame Ranko longs for an "ordinary romance". However, the young head of another group, Sumikawa, always bothers her! People are scared away because of Sumikawa, who is said to be the worst in the underworld! However, he always sticks by her and if she falls in love with him, whe can't go back to "normal" anymore. A heroine who never wants to fall in love x a young head who plays with her, a love struggle without justice, breaks out here!

title: Hasumi-kun to Hasumi-san
description: Một câu chuyện về hai bạn trẻ có họ giống hệt nhau.

title: H2
description: Kunimi Hiro and his best friend Hideo were baseball wonders… Until Hiro found out his arm was permanently damaged, rendering him unable to play anymore. A frustrated Hiro goes through the trouble of specifically finding a high school with no baseball team… Only to later on find out the doctor who examined him was a quack and his arm is perfectly fine. Hiro is quick to reinstate his dream: Creating a baseball team for his school and getting to face off against Hideo in the Koshien… The number one premier league for high school baseball.

title: Ore no Kiss dake Oboete yo
description:
Kousei is straight-forward, kind to everyone, and considered an oasis by his class. However, his tolerance for erotic things is that of a grade schooler and he isn't very good when it comes to love... Because of that, he keeps this inferiority complex a secret.

On the other hand, Nao is always surrounded by girls. 

One day, Kousei happens to see Nao kissing a girl...

After Kousei reveals he worries about not seeming mature enough, Nao tells him, "You could just kiss someone and get it over with?" 

A kiss with...Nao? Could he do something like that?

The class' most popular guys being brought closer to each other is set in motion!?
 
A love story that deepens with heart pounding kisses!

title: Corpse Party - Blood Covered
description: It's about a group of high school friends in Kisaragi Academy. Kisaragi Academy was built on the grounds of Tenshin Elementary School, which was demolished after a string of disappearances and gruesome murders. After a mysterious earthquake, the students find themselves trapped in an alternate reality Tenshin Elementary School, where the murders of others trapped before them have continued unabated…

title: Girls Go Around
description: No one can make the perfect decision every time. Everyone has those moments that they wish they could redo and alter their decision. This story revolves around girls that got their second chance.

title: Puku Yuri
description:
Tankoubon, containing the following chapters:  
  
1. Pukuyuri ~pierce~  
2. Pukuyuri ~kiss~  
3. Yuurii (side story)  
4. Just the Two of Us (Futari daka) (prequel #1)  
5. Futari nara (prequel #2)  
6. Zutto Futari de (tank-only extra)  
  
Note: chapters 1-5 were first published as original doujinshi and distributed at Comiket during the years 2011-2015.

title: Carnivorous Princess Yegrinna
description: Shik-nam doesn't need women. Who needs them when you've got the catharsis of an intense math equation? Then comes the complication. The animal kingdom is furious with what the world has become, so they sent Yegrinna, the dog princess, to punish the sinful humans for dirtying the world, and she lands right on top of him. Wait, what the hell?!

title: Clannad
description:
Clannad is set in a high-school located in a Japanese town. Tomoya Okazaki is a third-year student who doesn't take his studies seriously. Always late for class, he's seen as a delinquent by the rest of his classmates who are busy preparing for their entrance examinations. Needless to say, he doesn't have too many close friends either.  
  
Tomoya seems not to mind too–until he meets a few other girls from his school. Though he doesn't care much about them at first, he soon opens his heart to them as they get to know each other better.  
  
Clannad is a romantic youth drama that's likely to be more down-to-earth than Key's other works. But like Kanon and Air, Clannad's story is expected to be another touching and heart-breaking weeper.  
  
Based off the game of the same name by Key.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Masumasu Academy, an Academic City floating in the Pacific, is home to children with mysterious powers known as "Fiction". "Fiction" grants them enhanced physical prowess, as well as one additional ability. What will happen when a time stopper, Kazuma, meets a cute girl with the ability to move at lightspeed, who knows and is searching for him?

title: Kuroko no Basket: Replace PLUS
description:
Within Teikou Middle School's Basketball Club, there was a powerhouse team, a group of five prodigies known as “the Generation of Miracles”. There was one more player, highly esteemed by those prodigies, a phantom sixth man. The team managed to pull off the outstanding achievement of three consecutive championship wins. Afterwards, a certain incident took place and the team fell apart. This story takes place while they were still in middle school, before each of them went their separate ways.

An adaptation of the *Kuroko's Basketball —Replace—* novel series, stepping into the court!

title: Shitsuji Kuroboshi wa Kashizukanai
description:
We follow the daily life of a slightly capricious butler who doesn't really listen to what others tell him. It is then that he meets a high school student named Murasaki who falls in love with him.  
  
This is the beginning of a love story between not a really obedient butler and a girl in need of love.

title: Mukuchina Sensei ni Zenryoku Kokuhaku Shitara Manzarade mo Nakatta Ken
Ninkoi
description:
A new love story series of a modern day ninja. The main character is Matsuei Anko. On the only remaining ninja hideout in modern Japan, Anko, a twelve-year-old child that trains from day to night just to have the strength and power of guys, but eventually becomes frustrated with the difference in strength.  
  
”I don't want to be feminine, I want to be a strong ninja instead," was Anko's wish to the owner of the prestigious Kazan-Inge (Kazan Home Temple), as she takes the exam to be a master specialist ninja…

title: Yakyuu-bu no Hino ni Koi wo Shita
description:
"If I'm going to fall in love, I definitely want it to be with a guy who's as dazzling and charming as a prince!" With that ideal in mind, Risa encounters Hino, a classmate who's on the men's baseball team at school, and she sees a surprising side of him. Ever since that day, Hino has made her heart race, despite him having zero delicacy, being singlemindedly focused on baseball, and being the total opposite of a prince...?! This is a story of unexpected and frantic puppy love over a guy who otherwise really irritates her!

Source: Kodansha

title: Give Me Some Attention
description:
A new school year is one where everyone is excited to make new friends. Meanwhile, self-appointed loner Nam Sumin plans to not talk to anyone and lie low. However, contrary to his earnest wishes, he ends up in the same class and roommates with Lee Jaeha, the epitome of a social butterfly… 

Talk about a dreadful connection…!

title: Ashita no 3600-byou
description:
Oribe Natsuho goes to a school trip where she fixes a messy shrine; when she comes back she accidentally goes one hour back in time, but a classmate with bad personality of her, Kayano Keiichi, finds this out:  
what will happen from now onwards?

title: Mikako-san
description:
The future, romance… everything is "undecided," yet the remaining days of high school seem as if they'll be over in the blink of an eye. Ichimura Mikako, 17 years old. Midorikawa, the strange guy who now sits next to her after a seating change and oddly prefers red pencils. At first, Mikako didn't think much of it, but after learning that they both love the same band, their relationship begins to change bit by bit…   
  
The day-to-day life of a 17-year-old girl woven together in a soft literary style.

title: Juukinzoku Kanojo
description: The Heavy Metal Music Group at the high school consists of just Amanokawa Rinko and the main character, a teenage boy madly in love with her. The club is intended for people who enjoy the music genre to discuss their passion for heavy metal. However, there’s only one kind of passion going on in this club house located in the outskirts of campus, and it is definitely rockin’.

title: Balls Friend
description: The Sweet 18 Ji-eun has been BFF's with her friend next door Min-cheol for more than 10 years. Normally there isn't "just friendship" between boys and girls but they have been claiming that they're just friends for past 10 years… However they come to school together, and gets out of school together, visits each other when each other is sick, and when they go play the both of them goes alone… Will they really be able to remain as just friends like this…? A story far from love~ but closer than just friendship~ Ji-eun and Min-cheol's strange school diary [Balls Friend]!

title: Poker Face Josou Danshi to.
description:
Masa is a high school boy who has the ability to see someone's three sizes just by looking at them. He got that ability because of his mad obsession with fashion and style, thanks to his idol "SEN".

When Masa eagerly wishes to meet his idol in person, the time that he could finally meet with SEN has come, but when he meets her in person, he realizes that there's something off. 

Indeed, SEN has a secret that Masa didn't realize until he met her in person...

title: Seesaw Game
description: - [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/2463004)

title: Akuyaku Ouji ni Tensei Shita Hazu ga, Jitsu wa Dansou Akuyaku Reijou deshita
description: "You're... a woman?!" The evil prince who was my favorite character in an otome game is actually a crossdressing girl?! Is... this the start of the love story between the male lead of the game and the cross-dressing evil prince (♀)?

title: Osananajimi wo Erabanai Yatsu wa Kasu da!
description:
The protagonist, Nekomiya Kotone, loves her childhood friend the heroine, but hates fateful encounters.
Every day she dreams of a future where she is together with her childhood friend Kitsunezaki Sakino, but one day she herself had a "fateful encounter...?"
A bright yuri comedy!

title: I Can’t Believe Yours Truly Turned Into a Girl.
Boku to Kanojo no Game Sensou
description:
Kishimine Kengo a boy, moved into a high school that was an all girl’s school until several years ago. In spite of the so called harem environment where he was surrounded only by girls, he wasn’t good at socialising and his sole hobby was immersing himself in reading. He lived a quiet life.  
  
But, he decided to participate in club activities that he hadn’t done until now and so his high school life changed into something stormy and full of drama. He joined the one where he played modern games – in short, the game club. Kishimine was supported by the beautiful student council head and a perverted teacher and he displayed unexpected talent. Now the curtain has been raised on the exciting gaming life of an ordinary boy.  
  
adapted from the light novel series of the same name

title: Tonari wa Futsuu no Nijika (-chan)
description:
Living together with a beautiful girl… Or so she thought!?

Aira is troubled by the gap between the image people have of her and her real personality. That is until she meets the free-spirited Nijika. Will this encounter encourage Aira to express her true feelings?

title: Nagahama To Be, or Not to Be
description: Nagisa may look like a delinquent, but he's just a typical teen trying to figure out what to do with his life. Nagisa's best friend, Issa, already knows what his own passion is: fish! Issa often skips school to work at the Nagahama fish market, and the two boys hang out near the ocean almost every day. When Nagisa suspects that Issa has a girlfriend, it turns his world upside down. Is he in love with his best friend? Could his best friend possibly like him back?

title: Kyupiko! - Fujimatsu Tenshi no Mismanagement
description: Fushimatsu Fushio is an unpopular loser who is screwed over by a lazy Cupid, Kyupiko, who gives him the curse of being hated by the entirety of womankind. Years later God realizes how horrible a situation this is for the poor boy and kicks the lazy Kyupiko out of heaven until she fixes the situation.

title: Master of the Fox Bead
description: Lee Jinhwa lived an ordinary life until she swallowed a fox bead gifted by a mysterious peddler, mistaking it for a wish-fulfilling marble. Little did Jinhwa know that her actions would lead her to be haunted by Koo Miho, an infamous nine-tailed fox who wishes to retrieve the bead. To add fuel to the fire, Jinhwa soon discovers that she's also become a target for various spirits and demons, and the only way to extract the cause of the issue is for Miho to kill her... or kiss her!

title: Boku Datte, Kiss Shitai
description: Natsushiro Seiichi, a first year high school student who is living a smooth sailing high school life. However, his everyday life changes after he encounters a popular beauty, Miho, in the first school year!!

title: A Shoulder to Cry On
description: Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse’s office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn’t show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It’s not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love.

title: Frogman
description: Michiru is a high school boy who isn't really good at anything, including sports and socializing. He likes watching one of his classmates, Haruka, as she practices swimming. Haruka happens to be the only member of the swimming club associated with his school. As she and the coach search for members, she notices him and innocently believes he's been watching her because he really wants to swim. Michiru is unable to say no to her invitation to the club, even though he's never swam before and has no idea how it's done. Michiru finds his life changing as Haruka patiently teaches him how to swim.

title: A Story about a boy who crossdresses every day for the sake of his favourite female teacher.
description: Men are best when in girl's clothes.

title: HEN
description:
Chizuru Yoshida is not your typical high schooler and she's all too aware of it! She has a talent with getting what she wants from her male lovers and often comes across as cold and manipulative…  
  
In truth, despite her experiences with guys, she has never been in love. That's until the fateful arrival of newly-trasferred student, Azumi Yamada, at her school. It was love at first sight for Chizuru–indeed an unexpected turn of events for the story's vixen!  
  
Not only was she in love, but with all things…another girl. Chizuru goes through a brief stage of anger and denial and tries to convince herself that she couldn't possibly be attracted to such a simple-looking, shy, and naive girl! To her despair she finds herself constantly thinking of Azumi, so she finally resolves to become friends with her, but it's not too long when she starts to push things along with Azumi…

----

* [Hen (1993)](https://mangadex.org/title/eb89077b-78fb-4404-a6d7-a70200f663a3/hen-suzuki-kun-to-sato-kun-n

title: Oidasaretara, Nanikato Umaku Ikimashite
description:
Alec, the youngest brother of the Moonalt family, the pride of the kingdom, is suddenly banished from his family home.
His parents were disgusted by his purple hair and eyes, which no one should have been born with, and shunned him.
Wandering around with nowhere to go, Alec meets two adventurer-like girls named Lilina and Teal.
This is the beginning of the expansion of his closed world!

The beloved boy's warm and friendly fantasy life is about to begin!!

title: Yagami-kun wa, Kyou mo Ijiwaru.
description: Just by talking to the famous Yagami-kun, Shizuku’s high school life has become hard even from the start—!?

title: Agasa-kun wa Yande iru.
description: One day, Ichigotani Nanako receives a sudden confession from Agasa Yuki, the genius prince at school who's also her junior in her club. Surprised by this, the natural airhead Nanako blurts out, "I''ll be in trouble if you die though!" and ends up dating Agasa-kun. Anyway, Agasa-kun has an extraordinary obsession and possessiveness, and he has no mercy for any bugs that come near Nanako!

title: Seibetsu Fushou ni Koi wo shimashita.
description: 大学一年生のヤマトが教室で出会った理想のヒロイン、ハルの性別はなんと…!? 恋愛も性別もグラデーション…!?

title: Kyutto Musunde, Suki
description: Yuito lost his hearing whom Hikari likes. Does Yuito understand Hikari's love for him?

title: Alice no Hanamuko
description: The vampire princess Alice goes to the human world to find a groom in order to inherit the throne, and finds an unlucky man with a very powerful aura.

title: Lo-Fi After School
description:
A compilation of eight short stories:  
—–  
**Girlfriend in the Sky**: How can a girl get her boyfriend to hold hands with her?  
  
**Ankoku-san**: A pop tale about a girl full of negative thoughts.  
  
**Kami-sama Make-Believe**: A girl watches over the town she lives in, believing the world is going to end. Soon she is joined by a boy who has no place to go, and they watch over the “last days” of the world together.  
French: ||De par son télescope, une jeune fille observe les derniers instant de la ville où elle vit, croyant que la fin du monde est sur le point d'arriver. Bientôt, elle est rejoint par un jeune garçon impassible, ayant beaucoup de temps à revendre. Ils veillent ainsi ensemble sur les "derniers jours" du monde en jouant aux Dieux et décident de profiter du peu de temps qu'ils leur restent.||  
  
**Downtown Train**  
  
**Harumage.**  
  
**ekstasis**: A silent story about what might happen if a boy could freely touch the hair of his beloved.  
  
**Ao**  
  
**Aft

title: Onegai Teacher
description:
A story mainly revolving around a tight-knit group of friends in high school and how they cope with several life-changing events that are never too far off from intimate relationships. The main character is a boy named Kei Kusanagi who suffers from a very rare disease that causes a comatose state referred to as a "standstill" whenever he is under severe emotional distress.

---
**Note:**
- The title was never "- sensei," the Japanese characters "ティーチャー" phonetically spell "teacher"

title: A Bitch and a Punk
description: Middle school, year 2, Summer. The me who was unable to say “don’t go” or that “I liked you” to her in the past appeared before me 3 years later. The story of a boy and a girl confronting the time spent apart from each other.

title: Cotton Candy
description:
1-3. Cotton Candy  
4. Bitter or Sweet?  
5. Haru to Miniskirt  
6. 37℃  
7. Aki Iro Irozuku  
8. Tori no Yukue  
9. Countdown  
10. Cotton Candy 1.2.3

title: If I Love, It's Unrequited!
description:
[If it's an unrequited love, my gender changes! But will you still like me?]  
  
Saebyuk ends up liking high school girl Kyungi who he meets everyday at the bus stop. As his feelings become deeper and turns into a one-sided love, Saebyuk turns into a girl because of the hormone resonance disorder. Kyungi appears to be interested in female-turned Saebyuk and approaches Saebyuk, with the two becoming friends.

title: Akane Matsuri
description:
They are friends but not just friends.
This is a 4-koma manga about high school girls who just live their daily lives.

Akane: Short bob with black hair. She lives to enjoy life.
Matsuri: Cool blonde hair, serious at heart.
Azuki: Cute and petite dark girl.
Momiji: A sensible person who always quietly watches over everyone.

title: A Buoyant Girl Confessed to Me
description: A girl with the ability to float in mid-air when her mood becomes buoyant confesses to the boy she likes.

title: Mochikawa
description: A story of a high school girl named Mochikawa.

title: Hatsukoi no DNA
description: A teacher is loved by the daughter of her first love.

title: Seishun Otome Banchou!
description: Hirata Mihane has a scary face and isn't ladylike at all. In fact, she lets her temper get the better of her and often lets out small bursts of violent behaviour—even though she doesn't mean to. Because of this, the entire school calls her a "Satsujinki" (murderous monster). Even so, she's in love with the kind and popular Touma-kun, who doesn't mind the way she looks and is always nice to her. But… will Touma ever see her as a love interest?

title: The Flowers of Evil
description:
Se-Joon and Se-Wa are siblings with a dark, complex relationship. Se-Wa, a girl considered psychotic by others, is attached to her brother… a little too attached. In her eyes, there is only Se-Joon, and no one else. And what of Se-Joon's feelings?  
  
Title comes from French poet Beaudelaire's compilation of poems, 'Les Fleurs du mal'

title: Princess Lover!
description:
Teppei Arima is a second-year high school student who lost both of his parents in a traffic accident on their way home from a family trip. His grandfather, Isshin Arima, happens to wield the puppet strings in Japan's vast economy and demands that Teppei becomes his successor as the head of the Arima Group. To prepare for his debut into high society, Teppei enrolls in an elite academy for the scions of the rich and powerful.  
  
Adapted from the visual novel of the same name

title: Gosam Mussang
description: 1000s of years of history lies dormant in the hidden world of martial arts. Yet the struggles have never ceased and the masters emerge and fight on, now with a high school as its battleground.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Koritsu-hen
description:
Late April 2097—the use of strategic-class spells doesn’t stop with the Brazilian military, as the Great Asian Alliance deploy Thunderclap Tower in the Gulf of Guinea. Magic fans the flames of war, which soon engulf the entire world. As public opinion inevitably turns against magicians as a whole, Edward Clark, a researcher of the USNA, proposes an expansive space development endeavor called the Dione Project to promote the peaceful use of magic. Taurus Silver’s name appears on the list of chosen candidates, which leads to people uncovering the truth—that this is in fact Tatsuya, throwing him and Miyuki into yet another trial.

Adaption of Light Novel 23.

title: Seven Sisters!
description: To Minagawa Ichiri, both good things and bad things are bothersome. That's why his principle is to avoid doing anything that would cause such a thing. However, there is one thing that he can't avoid - because of his parents' jobs, he was constantly transferring from school to school. This time, he has transferred to Reimei Academy, one of the five famous private academies called the "Seven Sisters." On his tour of the school with vice president Kirishima Shitone, an attack occurs! The attacker seems to go after people with long black hair and a sword in an attempt to find and exact revenge on "Double Edge," who killed one of her best friends using a power called "Idea," where she brings her principles into reality using a wrist band called "Codec.

title: Kore wa Ai de, Koi ja Nai
description:
From Lovesick Alley: 
Contrary to her girly appearance, Yaotome Ren is still inexperienced in love because she dreams of having a once-in-a-lifetime romance. Enter Hidaka Yuusei, whose sadistic and strict attitude annoys Ren, and because of that, the two don't get along. What's gonna happen if one day, Ren wakes up from an accident, only to realize that she's now a different person?!

title: Chihayafuru: Middle School Arc
description:
When they were in elementary school, Chihaya, Taichi, and Arata were united by the strong bond of competitive karuta. Arata goes to a junior high school in Fukui, and Taichi goes to a prestigious school where he has to study hard. Even though they are separated, Chihaya continues to play karuta by herself. However, Taichi declares that he will quit playing karuta... In this spin-off adaptation, newcomer Tooda Oto captures the delicate and turbulent lives of Chihaya and her friends in middle school!

---

- [Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/10da010)  
- [Artist's profile](https://chihayafuru.fandom.com/wiki/Oto_Toda)

title: Kurenai Ouji
description:
Is their meeting a coincidence? Is their love inevitable?  
Sakura Koujirou is a demon prince who descends to the human world in order to take human souls. But after a strange turn of events, he somehow ends up living with a human girl, Hana… This is a story of young love, sweet and touching.

title: Kimagure Orange★Road
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A slightly sweet and sour coming-of-age romantic comedy about a strange love triangle between a boy with psychic powers, Kyosuke Kasuga, a sukeban, Madoka Ayukawa, and Madoka's kohai, Hikaru Hiyama. 

Kyosuke, the eldest son of a supernatural family, meets Madoka, a beautiful girl with a red straw hat, while strolling in the town he has moved to...

title: Kanojo ni Nekomimi wa Tsukimono Desu!
description: Toufukuji Kaede, a high school boy who loves cat ears and is an otaku, can exorcise spirits with his spiritual sensitivity. He spends his days talking about anime and manga with his senior, Nanajo Reito, in the game club he belongs to. One day, when he goes to the club room, he finds a beautiful girl with cat ears there! She asks him to exorcise the cat spirit that is possessing her and causing her trouble, but he can’t do it because her cat ears are too cute! A slapstick school love comedy between a cat-eared beauty and an otaku spirit medium!

title: Okusama ga Seito Kaichou! Extra Story
description: A collection of Nakata Yumi's oneshot released as part of Okusama ga Seito Kaichou! vol.6-vol.13 Special Edition.

title: Otogi Matsuri
description:
The manga starts off with a very odd killing. Then, it jumps to a few days later where Yousuke ends up breaking a small shrine. It later gives him the guardian Suzaku - just in time too, for he must face the murderer that opened the manga.

Note: Retail links are for the New Edition which has 8 volumes instead of 12.

title: Hug Shite! Kaeru-san
description:
A BL story about two polar opposites in their youth♡ Takanashi, the student council president, is good-looking, smart, and admired by all the students. Recently, he has been sneaking off to a frog-branded milk tea shop - for every cup he buys, he gets a hug from a frog mascot. It's a soothing hug that relieves the pressures of everyday life. Before he knows it, he's curious about the person inside...

A classmate who seems rugged but is always there for him x A student council president who seems like a perfect superhuman but is actually too cute!

title: Tsuma, Shougakusei ni Naru. Spinoff: Hatsukoi Aite no Kimi wa Dare?
description: Now in high school, Takeru goes to his elementary school reunion and runs into Marika, his first love. This causes him to remember his elementary school days when he was in love with her, his classmate who'd recently become mature.

title: Suki de Gomen
description: For 6 years, Kouta has been harboring a secret crush on his childhood best friend and well-known playboy Haruto. All this time, he's accepted that his crush will stay just that, unrequited. However, one day, it seems like Haruto has noticed…? Little by little, their relationship is changing!

title: Together With Woo Rae
description: Rae rejects an invitation to go to a semester-end party from the most popular student on campus, Sungwoon, But what happens when Rae's new part-time job is at a strange bunny boy costume bar… and his customer is a drunk Sungwoon?!

title: elDLIVE
description: Chūta Kokonose is an orphan who lives with his aunt. For as long as he can remember he's had a voice in his head, but other than that he's a normal boy - right until the day when a strangely-looking thing follows him home and teleports him to a place filled with more fantastic creatures. It's a space police station, and Rein Brickke, the Chief of Solar System Department, tells him that he's been chosen by the computer as a possible candidate to join the police force, although Misuzu Sonokata, a girl from Chūta's school with an angelic face and ill temper who turns out to be one of Rein Brickke's subordinates, doesn't think him suitable for such a job. Chūta, who was shocked at first, decides to take aptitude test after being urged by the voice in his head and to prove Misuzu wrong.

title: Wizdoms
description: Deep in the forest lies a mysterious school of magic: Wizdoms, an institution attended by beastmen of all kinds. These studious fantasy creatures have come to live, learn, and perhaps even fall in love in this enchanting space. In this collection of BL stories by master mangaka Nagabe, follow the beauty and surprising humor of magical beasts with human hearts.

title: Ookami-kun no Kakushigoto
description:
Con người đã tiến hoá vì đã đạt được năng lực từ "Thuộc tính" của động vật.
Misako, một con người bình thường không có năng lực từ thuộc tính đã gặp gỡ một cậu sói đen thuộc  loài sói xám tại Học Viện Cấp 3 Juusaki. Mặc dù cả hai không có điểm gì giống nhau, nhưng họ dần ý thức được sự tồn tại của nhau... Một câu chuyện thanh xuân vụng về nhưng chân thật của loài thú.

title: High Spec Lovers
description:
A romance about an unlikely couple.  
  
Asakura Rin and Hasegawa Kengo are a perfect couple that everyone admires. They are attractive, have perfect conduct, and excel both in sports and academics. They are the embodiment of a perfect boyfriend and girlfriend. However, for Hasegawa, things are not what they seem…

title: Convenient April Fool
description: Yuki calls Arai to go to the school's rooftop. There, she asks a question on April Fool's Day.

title: Getsuyoubi no Koibito
description: Straight A student Yuka is a little too honest for her own good and has no friends but unexpectedly begins dating Haruomi after he helps her out of a difficult situation. The only problem is, Haruomi has a strict policy of dating someone by each assigned day, and Yuka would be the 'Monday's lover'. How will this turn out?

title: Here Comes the Fiancée!
description: His fiancee lost her parents so she will be living with the Hyuns, but Sang-Won is a middle schooler and the fiancee is a 24-year-old adult!? Sang-Won tries to deny that his fiancee is 9 years older than him, but seeing that she does not act her age, he then feels comfortable around her. The fiancee seems kind and innocent on the outside, but on the inside…

title: Have You Heard the Rumors About Mizuki?
description: Have You Heard the Rumors about Mizuki? Read this webtoon to know more about Mizuki.

title: 10 Years in Friend Zone
description: Geralmente, quando uma pessoa é rejeitada depois de admitir seus sentimentos para alguém, a rejeitada tentará seguir em frente. Eles certamente não permanecem amigos ... A menos que você seja Shiho e Yul. Os dois nasceram no mesmo dia e há dez anos frequentam as mesmas escolas. Eles também estão jogando um joguinho onde Shiho confessa seus sentimentos por Yul, e Yul diz a ele para se esforçar mais. O resultado? Shiho se tornou um aluno perfeito, e todas as garotas da escola gostam dele. Mas agora os dois começaram o ensino médio juntos e parece que o pequeno "jogo" que eles jogaram pode ter mais jogadores. As regras estão mudando rapidamente - é tarde demais para algo mais acontecer entre Shiho e Yul?

title: Absolute Territory
description: A female college student's secret which she cannot reveal… That is, wearing a high school uniform and taking a picture! Chemistry unfolds between the female college senior wearing a high school uniform and a male nurse resulting in an explosive romance!

title: Don't Provoke a Reborned Bamboo Horse
description:
Qiao Yu, the man I humbly guarded for more than 10 years, unexpectedly cheated in front of me!   
This is not the worst part. While I was fleeing from the difficult situation, I had an accident with the elevator. I fell into darkness together with the elevator. When I woke up again, I'm back to where I first meet him!   
Qiao Yu, if I'm unable to avoid meeting you once again, I'll make sure to protect my heart and never to fall in love with you again! Remember!   
It's not wise to provoke your bamboo horse.  
  
Español  
Yu Qiao, el hombre al que he estado protegiendo humildemente durante más de diez años, ¡me engañó delante de mí! Eso no fue lo peor de todo. Mientras huía desesperadamente, tuve un accidente en el ascensor. Caí en la oscuridad junto con el ascensor. ¡Al despertar de nuevo, había regresado al momentos antes de conocerlo! Yu Qiao, si realmente no puedo evitar encontrarme contigo de nuevo, me aseguraré de proteger mi corazón y de no enamorarme otra vez de ti. ¡Nunca más

title: Konyakusha o Sutetara, Tanoshii Mahou Gakkou no Seikatsu ga Matte Imashita!
description:
Misha, the daughter of a viscount, regains memories of her past life after being betrayed by her fiancé, Rudolf.
In her previous life as a Japanese woman, she had also been betrayed by her fiancé and died tragically. Furious, Misha punches Rudolf and breaks off their engagement for good.
Determined to move on, she decides to pursue her long-held dream of enrolling in a magic academy.
However, after rescuing a mysterious handsome young man who collapsed on the day of the entrance exam, her life begins to take an unexpected and dramatic turn…?!

title: Love, Probability, and the Winning Formula
Autumn Wind and Rain
description:
Zhang Luofeng is just trying to live a peaceful life - all he wants is to fit in at school and make friends! He even has a crush on Yin Qiuqiu, the beautiful but cold Student Council member. The only problem? He’s the young master of the Sui Feng Clan!   
A tale about the ups and downs of high school life, Autumn Winds is about fighting back against bullies, the thorny path of adolescent love, and, finally, the importance of letting go. Real men stand against the current and bravely fight for their dreams.

title: Deochi Mitaina Settei wo Fuyo Shite Kuru Henshuu no Aira-senpai
description:
"Today, let's try a rom-com where people can see through clothes!"

At the Secondary Literature Research Club, club president and aspiring editor Takiuchi Aira proposes outrageous rom-com settings for the club to experiment with. But to the aspiring novelist Sasai Sakkai, those settings suddenly become reality, starting with Aira-senpai's clothes actually becoming see-through.

As they use a mysterious power that turns fictional settings into reality, the aspiring writer and aspiring editor work together to create one rom-com plot after another in this fresh romantic comedy.

title: Tomokoi
description: A high school debut with a classmate. A Kabedon from a cram school friend. A date with a hobby friend. A love confession from a childhood friend. This is a collection of four love stories between friends! Experience a dreamlike love from a male friend that will fulfill a girl's desire for a pounding heart. This is the first omnibus by an up and coming shoujo mangaka!

title: Atashi No!
description:
From KCG Scans:  
  
It's a battle that they can't afford to lose! The straight-laced and well-mannered Akoko and the unassuming Mitsuki. The two childhood friends are not at all the same type, but they easily get along with each other. But what happens when they both catch feelings for the same boy?

title: Megane na Kare to Fechi Kanojo
description:
My girlfriend is special. 

Koharu and Ibuki-senpai are a newly dating couple. For Koharu, an extreme glasses fetishist, Ibuki-senpai is kind, handsome, and looks great in glasses—the perfect boyfriend!! The cool Ibuki-senpai is at the mercy of Koharu's excessive love for glasses, but he's also happy with her straightforward expression of affection...

A lovey-dovey coming-of-age comedy about a well-matched (crazy) couple.

title: Tadaima Shinryakuchuu!
description: Yuki is an herbivore high school boy who ends up living with Muir, a rugged, sloppy, erotic, and cute math teacher, and female alien. In fact, Muir's aim was to acquire Yuki's excellent offspring with infinite possibilities and invade the earth!?!

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai Side Stories
description: A collection of side stories of [Kimi ga Shinu Made Koi wo Shitai](https://mangadex.org/title/0c44cf39-3d6c-4472-815b-9e163613cfe9/kimi-ga-shinu-made-koi-wo-shitai).

title: I Really Love Those Kind of Stories Where the Positions in a Boy-Girl Relationship Gets Reversed After a Few Years. The Girl on Top, of Course
Madogiwa de Amu
description:
Ota-kun is being bullied. Yamagishi-san, who sits in front of him, can't bear to see it and starts exchanging letters with him. Ota-kun decides to give Yamagishi-san a hand-knitted bracelet as a birthday present, but…!?
___
Published in Weekly Shonen Jump No. 19 2022 (April 25 Issue) on April 11, 2022.

title: The Plain Girl Changed at the End of Summer Vacation
Momorubu
description: The Momoru Club, is full of odd people acting, well, oddly. The goal of the club it is reflected in its full name "The Liven Up The Moyama Shopping District Club". However, most members cannot do even the most basic of service related tasks. It is good that these characters act oddly, how else are they going to liven up the Moyama Shopping District?

title: Shin Seitokai no Ichizon
description: A year has passed since the previous Student Council members have moved on. Now Ken, who's still the Student Council Vice President, has to struggle to get the unwilling new members to assimilate into the Student Council, while learning about each of their past.

title: Seishun Rikon
description:
In the beginning spring of high school life, "Sakono" Ikumi and "Sakono" Touma were utter strangers. The only coincidence is that they have the same family name and in the same class, but when they noticed the whole class had started to call them "husband and wife".  
This is a story of their love story in a husband and wife relationship, their youth days which lasted around two years a bit.

title: Love Hotel Princess
description:
"The top of her grade year round and all too perfect student council president who repels everyone, Watanuki Leila, has a secret.  
  
Her family's home is a love hotel!?  
  
While desperately trying to hide that fact, Sangatsu Owaru the new secretary has accidently discovered that?”

title: Usotsuki Sensei to Emonona Watashi
description:
Ameya is a sensible high school girl who has multiple part-time jobs to help out with her family's finances. One day, the principal gives her an offer too good to refuse—he'll double her scholarship if she just provides a certain teacher with a meal once a week.   
  
The catch is—Kairi-sensei is literally a demon, and his 'meal' is Ameya's touch!

title: Swing Girl
description: In recent years, more and more girls are experiencing the development of "tertiary sexual characteristics" during the later years of their puberty – that is, the rapid masculinization of a certain part of their external genitalia. Ooi Haruka is one such girl, who has until now kept the changes in her body a secret from everyone but her family. However, after an embarassing incident involving the guy she's been crushing on in a crowded train, she wakes up to discover herself at school, surrounded by a group of students calling themselves the "Bra Girls (Swing Girls)." And they know her secret!?

title: Two Girls Who Are Roughly the Same Height but Whose Proportions Are Completely Different
Yuusen Shoujo ~Plug-in Girl~
description: Six years ago, Tsukihiko was caught in an assassination attempt on a little girl, Sami, when he attempted to be her shield. This incident nearly killed him and the girl together, but the little girl was the daughter of an extremely powerful family. With its vast amount of resources, the family was able to keep both Tsukihiko and Sami alive by recreating both of their bodies with cyborg technology. This has forced Sami to permanently rely on wired connection to her life sustaining computer. On the other hand, Tsukihiko has become a cyborg "Knight," sworn to protect Sami from harm's way.

title: Sora Tobu Violin
description:
Yoshida Yoshio, a boy who has been playing the violin since he was a child in order to live up to his parents' expectations. He feels burdened by this situation and is unable to fit in at his new school, leading a lonely life. One day, Yoshio spots a girl he has never seen before, Amano Tessera, in his classroom. Suspicious of her existence, Yoshio chases after Tessera, but...

*Source: Natalie, translated*

title: Tachibana-san wa Niya Tsukenai
description:
Due to her parent's work schedule, Itsuka Tachibana has decided to live alone. In addition to the freedom of life, she is lucky to be in the same class with Nao Shimizu, a boy she is secretly in love with, at her new school. However, her joy is short-lived when her house is demolished and she is ordered to move out!  She is now a homeless child, and through her mother's advice, she ends up staying at her mother's friend's house.  Her eyes light up at the spacious and beautiful place she is staying, but when she tries to take a bath, she runs into a half-naked  Nao, her "crush"...?!

This is a romantic comedy with a 24-hour "restriction rule"!

title: The Boy I Confessed to Likes Small Things
Merry Marbling
description: When he was young, Lee-ahn found and returned a large bag of money and garnered fame as a "Christmas Angel." Since then, Lee-ahn has been very conscious of how others perceive him. Yugeon, who has just moved into Lee-ahn's building, could care less about the gazes of people around him. He acts out at school and even ditches classes. When she learns of Yugeon's arrival, Lee-ahn's mother hopes that he will take care of the outsider for the sake of his reputation. Reluctantly, Lee-ahn obeys his mother. However, Yugeon realizes that Lee-ahn used him for his own image. When Yugeon threatens to tell Lee-ahn's schoolmates about it, Lee-ahn gets defensive... "I don't care if you tell them. Just know, whatever happens next is not my responsibility." I was just going to end things with no regrets... Just wait! Do whatever you want!! Like a beautiful marbling that doesn't mix with water, these two create a beautiful dissonance.

title: Atashi, Kiss Shita.
description:
[from lost-translations]  
With all the intertwines of love, entangled red strings, and perturbed hearts, Mitsui Haruka brings us eight stories that begins by taking that one intense first step.  
  
"Cosa posso fare per dare una mossa alla nostra relazione?"

title: Kanade
description: A high school student has been seeing visions of a girl in his dreams, when suddenly he meets her at school. Oddly, they can both see (and touch) each other's guardian spirits. What is relationship between them, their guardians, and the truth behind the dreams?

title: Hatsu Haru
description: During its early stage, it's hard to notice it. During its intermediate stage, it's still difficult to discern it. It hurts. It makes you cry. That's right—this is what you call "First Love." The most popular guy in the school falls in love for the first time in his life, let's see how this story unfolds!

title: Strawberry Panic!
description: Aoi Nagisa is a new transfer student to St. Miatre, one of three all-girl academies on Astraea Hill. She finds herself lost on the first day, and runs into Hanazono Shizuma, a beautiful and highly respected senior among the students. Shizuma kindly offers her help, while Nagisa is stunned into silence by her beauty. This is the beginning of a highly enjoyable and romantic shoujo-ai story, with many colorful characters adding spice to the story with their adorable antics.

title: Katsu!
description: Satoyama Katsuki is a carefree 15 year-old high school kid, and a pretty lazy one at that. However, he secretly has a crush on a girl who happens to share his name: Mizutani Katsuki. Upon finding out that Mizutani's father used to be a pro-boxer, and she herself infatuated with the sport, he reluctantly joins a boxing gym in order to impress Mizutani. Satoyama is quick to find out he may have the blood of a genius boxer running through his veins…

title: Hanarete Kudasai, Meisen-san
description:
In a society where people with monster dominate, high school student Makoto Tatara has a friend in this unusual world. Her name is Toko Meisen.

Having a beautiful girl as a friend might make any guy envious... but there’s a twist—she is a ghost, a spirit-like existence! Their bond is one of "Soul-mates" (friends who share life energy).

To make things even more chaotic, her sense of personal boundaries is completely broken, leading her to naturally do some rather suggestive things! Can Tatara maintain his friendship with Meisen, or will things take an unexpected turn?

Note: Depending on audience feedback, this might turn into a full series!

title: Gokudou Juliet
description: The man I fell in love with is the man who killed my father! Yamato is a high school student who wants to become a police officer just like her late father. One day, she is rescued by Jin, who went to the same school as her, when she got caught up with a man. Yamato is gradually attracted to Jin's kindness and strength. However, Jin is the son of the yakuza and is suspected of killing Yamato's father…! It's a love battle for the truth between the son of a yakuza and the daughter of a policeman, two people who never cross paths!

title: First Breakfast
description: BL, baguette and love story.

title: Gakuen Dragon Slayer
description: A school is transported into a fantasy world that is at war with dragons, and everyone in the school is given a powerful dragon slaying sword, and told the only way to get home is to help win the war. But there is a catch, to use the swords power you must be…a virgin!

title: Amairo IsleNauts
description: A new teacher finds himself a newly appointed position as a teacher at an all girls school… on an island… in the sky! How will he make do in his new surroundings? Or the residents of this island who seem like they came from another world? And what's more, how will he fare at being a teacher?

title: Ranker rang Yeonae Ganeung
description:
All Myeong Seong-a wants to do is spend her life playing video games. 

Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Kang Hanjun, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! 

Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into An Tae-ui, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! 

Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Hanjun from discovering who she really is?

title: Koi no Otemae, Choudai Itashimasu.
description: Nanako enters high school looking for an afterschool activity and a romantic interest. She thought she'd found both in Yukiya-senpai of the Tea Ceremony Club, but the cool and handsome Yukiya rejected her club application. Nanako wasn't about to give up, though, and Yukiya finally allowed her one week to prove herself worthy of the Tea Ceremony Club. A sweet love story for two over tea!

title: Junsui Adolescence
description:
A student-teacher romance.  
  
**Stories:**  
- Summer Window Syndrome  
Why doesn't Nanao want the school doctor to call her by her first name?  
- On My Tiptoes in October  
Nanao sees a different side of Matsumoto.  
- First Love Canon  
Another teacher gives Matsumoto and Nanao some advice.  
- Liars' Engagement Part A + B  
In the first half of "Liars' Engagement," Nanao and Matsumoto disagree over Nanao's plans for her future. In the second half, Nanao confronts Matsumoto.  
- Lovesick Over My Best Friend  
Focuses on two side characters.  
- Chatting in Our Pajamas  
Kiyo is in love with her friend Nanao, but knows that Nanao is already with someone else.  
- Bursting with Impatience  
Focuses on Matsumoto's feelings.  
  
**Extras:**  
- Summer Window Chatting at Night  
- Summer Nude  
- Prologue: Hidden Name  
- Mental Age Limits  
- Hatsumoude Syndrome  
- First Time

title: Watashi no Waltz
description:
One day a girl submissively becomes another's pet dog...
Just so you know it's not the lewd kind!

---

A oneshot submitted for the August 2018 issue of Gangan Joker but didn't make it to serialisation.

*Additional Retail:*
> [Rakuten Books](https://books.rakuten.co.jp/rb/15552828/)

title: Nuide Moraou ka
description: Asking Her to Take it Off

title: Majime ni Otsukiai
description:
Raised in a household with the mottos "illicit sexual relationship prohibition" and "serious and sincere", Minami is currently in the companionship of her senpai at work for the 3rd month <3 they are in a pure relationship where they haven't even kissed. But Minami has a secret that she can't tell to the mature and calm him… That is, she reads ecchi manga at home and has delusions about them, in other words "a pervert who's always on their best behaviour"…!  
  
At that time, she accidentally drops her ero-manga at her workplace…!?

title: Fake Slackers
description: After classes were divided, not only were the two infamously and widely known "problem youths" placed into the same class, they became deskmates. They were obviously exam prodigies but they pretended to be slackers, their entire beings immersed in this skit. They had to compete for last place during exams; playing games every day on the surface but studying seriously behind others' backs. Come and gossip about the two guys in our class who always have to compete for last place: the one who always plays tricks in solitude (He Zhao) x the one who would rather destroy humanity than concede (Xie Yu).

title: Joeun Haksaeng
description: After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.

title: The Untold Story of a High School Debut
description: You should always be careful when making a high school debut, especially around the quiet girl from your middle school…

title: Gojikanme no Sensou - Home, Sweet Home!
description:
"The youth ensemble of love, food and war…"

Discontinued due To Author Death (Mangaupdates)

title: Dependency X
description: A perverted Alpha seme and a contributing Omega uke. The dailies of a young love, a display of affection that kills many normal people, "My reliance on you, is like the earth revolving around the sun, the planet revolving around the sun, and the universe revolving around the stars "

title: Kobayashi ga Kawai Sugite Tsurai!!
description: This is the beginning of my legendary story! …the truth is, I'm wearing woman clothes but that's a secret!!

title: Ashita mo Kimi ni Ai ni Iku
description:
University student Saku longs to have a fairytale romance, but even though he has no trouble getting with girls, they all break up with him for the same reason: he doesn't make their heart flutter at all!

And then there's Misumi, the university's resident heartthrob who's wildly popular with the girls, and who's taken a sudden interest in Saku. He doesn't laugh at Saku's fantasies and listens to them sincerely, and if Saku is nearby, he'll go to him without fail. Misumi seems to always say or do the right things that make his own heart start to flutter a little, so Saku starts to look to him for tips and techniques on how to make his fairytale romance come true.

But before he knows it, he's suddenly falling in love with Misumi instead...?!

title: Natsu-Yuki
description: A boy's unforgettable encounter with a Yuki-onna. A cute and fluffy story!

title: Yubisaki ni Koi wo Sakasete
description: To Saki, Koiro has been her long-time friend since grade school, and someone she deeply admires. After having her nails painted by Koiro to match her, she returns home and thinks back...

title: Kimi no Ashiato wa Barairo
description: Haruka and Takumi had their bodies swapped when they fell down a staircase at a shrine. After several years of searching for a way to go back to normal, they find themselves increasingly aware of each other as their physical sex…

title: Holy Girl Paradigm
description: Paradigm Girls Academy, a famous catholic combined middle and high school. Not interested in love, Aoi hopes a school life among the virtuous Ojou-sama would turn her into a graceful and high-class lady herself. Riri thought joining a girls’ school would allow her to finally find love. Bonding over having their dreams meet a harsh reality, a beautiful friendship(?) begins.

title: Our School Teacher Kim
description: At our school, there's a new teacher, Suzy, and the perfect role-model of a teacher, Sunwoo. This is the story of two very different teachers with the last name Kim.

title: Shinonome Yuuko loves short stories
description:
"A man is a very small and ephemeral being, whose life would be summarized into a fifty-to-sixty page long short story. But I want more people to appreciate how fantastic their lives as short stories are. Short stories are indeed short, but they are full of interesting things once you read them. Even if your life is not an epic saga, it is still enough to touch others."  
  
Shinonome Yuuko is a book-loving librarian girl who has a secret identity…

title: Ranshi no Kuni no Alice
description: Book-loving student Mitake Alice is a normal-looking girl when she has her glasses on, but when she takes off her glasses… she becomes the most beautiful woman in the world. Alice without her glasses is so beautiful, she has even charmed all of the fictional male characters in the fairy tales that she loves to read. Now, the fairy tale female characters like Snow White and Cinderella are out on a hunt to annihilate Alice to gain back each of their corresponding princes. Will Alice survive the onslaught of princess assassins?

title: Boku to Kotori-chan
description: Kotori-chan and Hi-chan promised to marry each other when they grow up. But 10 years forward, the only one who’s actually “grown” is Kotori-chan, while Hi-chan still looks like a grade schooler. Hilarity ensues.

title: Saeki-san to, Hitotsu Yane no Shita: I'll Have Sherbet!
description: Entering 2nd year of high school, Yumizuki moved to apartment because 2 hours commuting from home was tiring. However when he and the delivery company reached the apartment, another tenant already started to move to the apartment he supposed to stay. A beautiful girl who just returned from America, Saeki Kirika. Because of their personal circumstances none could concede, and then Saeki propose to share the apartment…

title: Miseijuku Succubus
description: I love you, but should this love bear fruit, I would become a creature that would bring you harm... I know this, yet these feelings just won't stop. Where will they take me...?

title: Teacher Addiction
description: A high school girl with a sex addiction is gently (?) raised again by a sadistic teacher? Misao is a high school girl who lives alone. She seems normal at first glance, but she can't stop having sex no matter how hard she tries. The person who buys her one day... is somehow her form room teacher at school!? She's shaking, but the teacher makes an outrageous proposal to her...!? A dark and heart-warming avant-garde romantic comedy interweaving two somewhat shady people.

title: Uenobon Anthology Booklet
description: Anthology booklets featuring various artists, included with special edition copies of Ueno-san wa Bukiyou volumes 6 & 7.

title: The Student Council President's Intention... (♡)
description: The StuCo President, Chiyoka, is at odds with the delinquent, Ootori, on the surface, but in actuality...

title: Student Number Zero
description:
Io Sado, a member of the occult research club, is curious about his classmate "Attendance number 0", who is noticed by no one.
When she invites her classmate to join the occult research club as usual...

An encounter between two people that shakes the world.
A coming-of-age occult battle begins.

title: Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi ga Shuraba Sugiru + H
description:
A spin-off of Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi.  
  
Features a 3rd character to spice things up.

title: Zekkyou Gakkyuu Tensei
description: A reboot of the award winning series Zekkyou Gakkyuu, with brand new stories.

title: Dirty Dress
description: In her childhood, Min Ju was naturally talented, receiving praise for her abilities. However, her confidence takes a hit when she meets young Han Seol. Feeling a twinge of jealousy and a sense of inferiority towards Han Seol's talent, Min Ju tries to keep her distance, but Han Seol continues to approach her...

title: The Way It Was Before
description: Introverted sophomore Autumn Lyne likes being alone with books... until she's forced to befriend her sister's bandmates. She then forms a special bond with one of them, the charming Michael Summer, who has more to him than meets the eye. Heartwarming and bittersweet, this coming-of-age tale chronicles the memories of a young woman as she comes to terms with the changes in her life brought about by her first love. Because sometimes, the best way to move forward is to look back.

title: Gyaru ni Kakomareta!
description: After the seat change... I ended up surrounded by gyarus!? A thrilling school life with three gyarus!

title: Koi to Senkyo to Chocolate
description: Oojima Yuuki is a normal student looking for romance to spice up his inactive lovelife. A member of the Food Research Club, he spends his idyllic days with seven other members, including his childhood friend, Sumiyoshi Chisato, who also happens to be the club president. As the upcoming student council president election arrives, the favored candidate, Shinonome Satsuki proposes that clubs with no merit to the school be disbanded. Worried about what could happen to the club, the Food Club members consult with their former president, who proposes that Yuuki run against Satsuki as an opposing candidate. As he learns about the various problems that the school faces, he decides to run in the election.

title: Girl in the Birdcage
description: Yeonkwang Arts High School makes a clear distinction between the talented and the mediocre. The talented receive full benefits of the Gifted and Talented program—funding, training, opportunities to participate in exclusive art contests—while the mediocre are left to fend for themselves in the hopes that they, too, can one day make it into the prestigious program. Talent equals power in this competitive school, but when Chung-eun, a G/T student, falls for Yumi, a non-G/T student, the tables are turned. While Chung-eun is blinded by Yumi’s charms, Yumi’s got a hidden agenda.

title: Sarracenia
description: With no money for food and no place to stay, a high school girl is in dire straits. Kanda Issei, who works at a game app company, reaches a hand out to the girl, Miu, out of genuine kindness and the slightest ulterior motive...!? A "girl you can't leave alone" who exudes a dangerous charm that is both child-like and adult-like. After meeting her, the man's life that was mediocre...!?

title: The Sunshine Powerhouse
description:
Choi Kang is really a soft-hearted guy, despite his completely opposite looks. He is determined to make friends at school, but Haessal wrongfully gets the impression that he's a bully. Kang's online friend "Bada-nim" consoles him, as he tries to clear up the misunderstanding. Will he succeed? And what will happen to him and Haessal?  
[Official Chinese Translation](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/2091/)

title: MuvLuv
description:
Takeru and Sumika have been neighbors and friends since they were little, but when a mysterious girl arrives, and is found in bed with Takeru, their daily lives will be thrown into chaos.
