title: The Person I Love Ts’d and Became a Girl
Yankee×Jerky
description: Delinquent girl Aira Onizuka is skipping class at the back of the school building as usual.  Ruu Ookami, who is in the same class as her, comes to see her. Ruu is a werewolf, a species that can change its form into a wolf! Ruu said she came wanting to thank her for the jerky she gave her when she was a wolf, but…! Two lone wolves meet, a girls' romantic comedy with both having a crush on each other!

title: Ichirei Shite, Kiss
description:
Since middle school, An has been devoted to archery for six years. However, the last tournament of high school is ending without those results being preserved. Despite having mixed feelings, An has decided to retire, and she is passing the club president title to her kohai, Mikami Youta who has great ability… however, Mikami swings An around with suggestive behavior…?  
  
An Kishimoto aime le tir à l'arc, sport qu'elle pratique depuis longtemps. Maintenant élève de troisième année, elle décide se retirer du club, amèrement. Elle laisse sa place à son kohai, Youta Mikami, nouveau prodige du club. Mais Youta ne semble pas vouloir voir An partir aussi facilement…

title: We Experienced the Affair
description: Kaji Kotori is a shy girl and was always bad at making new friends, especially with guys. Since the start of high school she has been made fun of by Kaji Yukito who’s the centre of attention of the class. Rumours are that he was a delinquent during middle school but he doesn’t look like one. Here comes the life of Kotori and how she adapts to love.

title: One Bowl of Soupy Cheese Gyudon
description: Izumi Kurou has found his ideal gyudon, but a girl keeps coming to the restaurant and annoying him with her very strange food combinations.

title: Hoteru Watashi ni Koi wo Oshiete
description:
Miku is a high school student who is very good at fantasizing, but knows nothing about real boys. At school, she hides her interest and acts as a pure character, but one day her childhood friend, Shida, finds out that she's been reading erotic manga!

"I thought my life was over...but then Shida-kun asks me if I want to gain some experience with guy...?"

It's a romantic comedy about a girl with a delusional brain and a teasing boy in a public bathhouse.

title: Kuchidome Ryou Cider
description: Fuji, the class president, was angry at Tachibana, a gyaru in her class who never listens to her. Because of this, Fuji decides to relieve her stress by smelling Tachibana's gym clothes, only to be interrupted by Tachibana herself during the act. How will Tachibana react, and what will Fuji do?

title: Koi to Kemono to Seitokai
description:
A heroine that can see spirits ─ Kawai Sakura. A life of fear and daily threats suddenly turns into an ikemen paradise? What is happening?  
  
(Credit: [Chibi Manga](https://mangadex.org/group/743/chibi-manga))

title: Sunshine & Bright Stars
description: Realistic and nuanced slice of school life. A cute, positive, and enthusiastic junior bumps into a girl who does hip-hop, and is emotionally shy and slow despite looking cool. The sweet, tangled-up, heartwarming, and GL story of chasing love.

title: Okubyou na Hakushaku Reijou wa Momegoto wo Nozomanai
description:
Amelia is a plain girl who is Sophie's fan and follower. One day, she sees Marion, Sophie's fiance, with Rozetta, another girl.
"I wonder if His Highness will look at me more if I earn Rozetta's ire..."
To prevent Sophie from becoming the antagonist, Amelia begins to coach Sophie in love. However, this attracts the attention of Sophie's tsundere brother?!

title: A Story about A Quiet Gyaru Who Got Confessed by an Extremely Straight-Forward Boy
description: When a super straight-forward guy confessed his love to a quiet gyaru, you can expect things to be different.

title: Can't Say No
description: As one knows, talking too much can cause problems. This happened to Guan Cheng when he misspoke during Latin Dance and accidentally caught the attention of Yu Yunfei, who slowly intrudes on his life. “Wait, this man, where have I seen him before?" What will this dense and straightforward man do when he meets an overly attractive male?

title: Ro-Kyu-Bu!
description: Subaru has only ever wanted to play basketball, but right after having transferred to a high school specifically to play in their basketball club, the team captain, whom Subaru looked up to as a hero, vanishes, leaving behind rumors that he ‘eloped’ with a grade-schooler! The team is disbanded and the members are shunned by their schoolmates. In the middle of this, Subaru’s aunt, who teaches in grade school, asks Subaru to come coach a girl’s basketball club at her school. At first, Subaru wants nothing to do with it, but the determination and drive of one of the girls on the team gives him a change of heart.

title: Wish Made by a Star
description: Seo Yeonji who was rejected by her childhood friend, fell asleep that night while cursing him. The next morning she woke up and acquired a weird ability to see information about the people around her.

title: Koudouryou no Seizana Hibi
description: Sebuah cerita tentang asrama perempuan di mana setiap siswa mengambil nama dari salah satu konstelasi zodiak.

title: Astro Boy
description:
It is the 21st century, and technology has progressed further than humanity itself could imagine. 

2003, Tobio, the son of the head of the Ministry of Science, is killed in an accident. Mad from his grief, his father, Dr. Tenma, orders immediately the construction of a new, robot Tobio - a child of science.

While initially delighted at seeing his son reborn, gradually Tenma grew fed up at the fact that this new Tobio could not age and grow. In this newfound frustration, he sold him off to a robot circus. There 'Tobio' was given the new name Atom (Astro Boy). 

Later, he would be taken in by Professor Ochanomizu, who serves as his guardian. 

Human-robot conflict occurs over and over again, and is a major driving force. Atom never gets appreciation for his work in stopping plots and conspiracies on the international and even intergalactic scale solely because he is a robot. The authorities doubt him because he is a robot. 

And as a robot, he has difficulty fully connecting with not j

title: Agassi neun Monmallyeo
description: The classmate she's crushing on is secretly a butler at a butler cafe?! To win him over, Bang Gowoon is serving up desserts at 999% sweetness in her all-out effort to capture his heart. A sweet and fluffy romantic comedy about fresh love and even fresher desserts.

title: How Small and Innocent
description: The daily life of Cui Haomin, who lacks facial expressions but has plenty of points when it comes to love. This is the story of childhood sweethearts, and the male lead is the younger brother from No Words.

title: The Grown Dog Bullies Its Owner
description:
"You there, be mine!"

School grass Xia Zhixing, unwilling to reveal his identity as a streamer, borrows the face of the mysterious top student Lin Lang.

Unexpectedly, the student that resembled a cute little puppy had actually desired him for a long time...

"Senior, the reward I want is you."

title: Jump+ Garyoku Manga Shou Koushiki Name [Lovecome Bumon]
description: Holding the first love letter of her life, a high school girl…

title: Marry Marry Me!
description:
*Let's get married.*  
  
That's the promise they made before being forced to separate. After 5 years they've met again but, will have time and distance torn each other apart even more? And what will happen to that promise…?  
  
Includes oneshot: Summer Chocolate Mint Kiss

title: I Don't Know If Amatsuka Hijiri Is a Boy or a Girl!
Kimi no Sumire
description: Recently transferred to a new school, Sumire meets Toujou, a boy they all call, “The school’s solitary Madonna.” After stepping between a fight with Toujou and some others, he takes a liking to Sumire and they begin to spend their school days together. Although beautiful on the outside, Toujou is surprisingly brusque. Despite not making any effort to interact with others, he’s surprisingly sweet to Sumire, which gets Sumire’s heart thumping. One day, after Toujou’s injured in a fight, he suddenly kisses Sumire…!

title: Hoshikuzu Drop
description: Shino is a high school student transferring schools from Tokyo to Ibaraki. When he's late for his first day at school, he meets a beautiful girl, Sera Ichigo, standing in the shade. As the day goes on, he gets carried away and accidentally wounds up in the Astronomy Club. There, he discovers that Ichigo is actually a member! Let Shino's sparkling youth days begin!

title: Battle Mexia
description:
Battle Mexia, an RPG fighting game where every action and feeling seems real. In a future where gaming dominates all classes – if you are a professional player, the Government will take care of you forever – what will happen to the main character when he enters a school where Battle Mexia is the main subject?  
  
Note: The series is considered as completed since the author, Tooru Sakurai, has passed away.

title: Kimi wo Mawashitai
description:
One day, a tiny girl named Shina appeared inside a roll of toilet paper in the Yamaguchi's residence toilet. She made a stunning impression on a typical middle school student, Nobuo. "What if I use up all of the paper? Would I be able to see her… na… na… naked?!"  
  
It's the beginning of a story about love, lust and… a sh*t ton of other adventures!

---
Official Release:
- Polish release by Wydawnictwo Kotori as **Najlepsza na świecie** (2017)

title: Cheeky Angel
description: Megumi Amatsuka, a rough and tumble nine-year-old boy, always dreamt of becoming the "manliest man on earth." Upon receiving a book of magic from a sorcerer whom he saved from a group of local thugs, Megumi summons a genie in order to make a wish. But due to a sick twist of fate, the genie turns out to be an evil one, and Megumi winds up being the "womanliest woman on earth"! Six years later… Megumi is the most desirable girl in school, but deep within her hot-mama facade is the same trash-talkin,' punk-stompin' boy.

title: Bloody Romance
description: The first love that I experienced was a delicious red.

title: Tenshi Dattara, Yokatta
description: All Kako wants is to have the important people to her smiling. She treasures her two childhood friends so much, which is why she won’t confess to Taisei about her feelings for him. One day, after Taisei’s recovery from an accident, he then tells Kahoko that he and Uina have now started dating. She believes that their relationship is “unbreakable”, or so she thought it was…

title: Fortune Arterial
description:
Kohei Hasekura is a sophomore who transfers into a prestigious public school–an English style six-year school, serving junior high and high school students. The school, named Shuchikan Academy, is on an island, Tamatsu Island, off-shore from mainland Japan, and the only way to get there is by boat. But under the peaceful surface, this prestigious academy holds a dark secret. Some of its students are vampires! And Kouhei will be dragged deeper and deeper into the mystery of the school and the girls that attend.  
  
Adaptation of the visual novel developed by August

title: Ooh La La
description:
[Mối tình đầu, vừa lém lỉnh vừa đáng yêu]

Yoon Gomyung và Kim Minhan là một đôi.

Chẳng phải kiểu “ai tỏ tình trước” mà đến với nhau, cũng chẳng phải suốt ngày quan tâm lo lắng cho nhau.

Thế nhưng nhờ chút cảm mến xen lẫn một chút hờ hững, chuyện tình của họ vẫn cứ thế tiếp tục.
Một bộ truyện tình yêu vừa nghịch ngợm, vừa ngọt ngào.

title: My Japanese Sisters
description: 老爸突然再婚，外表凶恶的高中生霍天麟突然多了两个来自日本的妹妹！然而这两个天降系妹妹却有着惊人的秘密！霍天麟将如何与她们相处？她们又将如何看待霍天麟？

title: Kawaikunai ne, Kouhai-kun
description:
"You're really not cute!!!"  
  
Akutsu is still only an underclassman but he's got all the girls' attention. Plus, not only is he good in his studies, he's also the ace of the baseball club.  
  
Even though Ida doesn't want have anything to do with Akutsu but somehow they're often together…?  
  
Don't tell me he actually likes me!?

title: After Falling Like Dominoes
description: A young witch must decide on which she loves more: learning magic or the boy she has a crush on.

title: Kataomoi x Kataomoi
description:
One day, high-school student Hanamoto is called out by a guy named Furuya, who's in a different class. At first, he thinks that Furuya might be trying to confess to him, but it turns out that he just "wants to be friends." Hanamoto is nonplussed – and perhaps a bit disappointed – but he agrees, and soon finds himself spending more and more time together with Furuya.  
  
But what, really, is this innocent-looking boy's reason for brazenly seeking out Hanamoto's acquaintance?

title: Shin Mazinger Zero vs. the Great General of Darkness
description: After finally defeating Dr. Hell, Kabuto Kouji has to battle the forces of the Mikene Empire. Against an enemy unknown even to Minerva X, who has seen countless alternate timelines, Mazinger Z faces his most desperate moments! (MAL)

title: Kedamono Kareshi
description: After the re-marriage of her mother, Himari went to her former city. However, she'll meet again the boy who traumatized her in primary school! The worst thing is what she'll learn after getting back from school…

title: Ma Chérie
description:
After a heartbreak, a girl say yes to every girl confessing to her.

One day, she meets her Chérie at her school's infirmary.

title: Shakaijin Kareshi to Daigakusei Kanojo
description: A oneshot uploaded to twitter by Tony Hashimen

title: Hotarubi no Mori e
description:
A collection of one-shots for each season of the year. The title story focuses on Hotaru, a girl who is lost in a forest in which is said to inhabit many spirits. Appearing before her, Gin, a young boy captivates her at first sight, but she dares not to touch him out of fear that he will disappear.  
  
The reprint contains the same main story and three different oneshots than the original printing. Chapter 2 (title story) of the original print corresponds to Chapter 1 of the reprint.

title: Ping
description: In the modern age, there remains martial arts clans from long ago, all vying for power. Amidst a fight, the son of a security man meets a mysterious girl who kisses him out of the blue…

title: The Fan & M Museum
description:
I want to find out the secret of the natural and slightly H Mizuki-sensei......!!!?

Tenma Akitaka, a curious junior high school boy, has something he can't stop thinking about. It's his homeroom teacher,  Mizuki-sensei. Her glasses and dull outfit gives her a plain appearance, but for some reason she always visits the old school building with her cute face!!!!

Tenma's intellectual curiosity gets the better of him and he decides to investigate her secret. However, the more he investigates his sensei, the more her naughty and natural happenings are revealed to Tenma! He is supposed to be investiigating her, but all he can do is satisfy his H-seeking curiosity! Can he keep up with Mizuki-sensei's naughty happenings and explore her secrets?

The teacher is a natural and satisfies your intellectual curiosity in this exciting, secret, observational romantic comedy...♪

title: Ookami-kun Got a Girlfriend for the First Time
Amagami - Love Goes On!
description:
This adaptation focus on each heroine based on the Amagami visual novel.  
  
V.1 - NANASAKI Ai  
V.2 - MORISHIMA Haruka  
V.3 - SAKURAI Rihoko

title: Usami's Little Secret!
description:
The school idol Usami-kun has a secret …!? When  
I happened to know Usami-kun's secret, I decided to make friends with him for some reason.  
A youth story that depicts the love and growth of students starting from sharing secrets!  
  
Note: This series has been licensed by Pocket Comics.  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Fukashigi Philia
description: Their city is filled with criminals and three incredible high schoolers. Yugo, Rikiya and Tasuku are determined to clean up the city with whatever means necessary, even if that means using violence. During a typical night of wiping out gangs, Tasuku comes across a beautiful girl held prisoner. She helps him survive what would have been a mortal wound by allowing him to see the future. Tasuku takes her home where he finds that her name is Noa, she doesn’t speak at all, and has no memory. Even more fascinating to Tasuku, she bears the same tattoo as the person he has spent years searching for.

title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Hannerōre no Kizoku-in Gonensei Ichi - Koishite Mitai O'hime-sama
description: Half a year has passed since Yurgenschmidt inaugurated its first underage aub. Hannelore, now an archduke candidate for the country’s top-ranked duchy, is in the midst of a crisis. Despite her natural indecisiveness, she finds herself pressed to choose from a growing list of marriage candidates. Her father suggests Kenntrips and Rasantark, her childhood friend,s but then her half-brother Raufereg throws his hat into the ring. And what about Wilfried, the apple of her eye? Convinced that Liebeskhilfe, the Goddess of Binding, is toying with the threads of her fate, Hannelore turns to her dear friend Rozemyne for guidance. In the debut volume of this battle fantasy, the divine avatar fights to settle an engagement! Features two original short stories and four-panel manga by You Shiina.

title: Gokudou Reijou, Neko wo Hirou.
description:
One day, Akira, the granddaughter of the head of the Momiji gang, brings home a ragged young man named Nora who she finds collapsed in a garbage dump. At first, Nora shows a rebellious attitude, saying "I won't accept charity from the yakuza," but gradually he begins to call Akira "boss" and become attached to her...

The story depicts the misunderstandings that surround Akira and Nora as they live together.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Code Geass: Lelouch The Private Home Tutor
description:
Why has Lelouch become C.C.’s tutor?!  
  
Lelouch and Nunnally were living in peace, but then one day a spoiled rich girl with absolutely no common sense named C.C. moved in next door. At the request of his mother, Marianne, Lelouch has taken on the task of ensuring her education – and now he’s made a contract with C.C. to be her personal tutor…?!   
  
A high school AU comedy begins!

title: Sewayaki Mafia to Hakkou Shoujo
description:
A girl who was sold by her mother and left without relatives is taken in by the boss of the most terrifying Chinese mafia. She thought her life was over, but she was taken to a luxury boutique to get clothes...?!

"Don't be mistaken. These favors from me are so that I can sell you at a high price."

A love comedy between a tough-looking boy with a sharp attitude and a cute girl with a good heart!

title: Hyena-kun wa Mitomenai
description:
A special short story for the kemomimi series! The boy that first appeared in *Thoroughbred wa Yuruganai* is…?

title: Relax and Fall in Love With Dignity
description:
“I quite like your unreliable side.”
Subaru, the next-in-line club captain of the archery club, always found herself at a loss when dealing with her junior, Mikumo, whom is the club’s problem child. Subaru is a serious person who tries to meet the expectations of those around her, but she tends to hurt herself as a result. However, there are also times when she is saved by Mikumo’s easygoing nature and distinct vibe. This is the start of a young love story in which Subaru is sweetly smitten by a somewhat laid-back junior boy.

title: Hatsukoi, Futatabi.
description:
Due to the nature of her father's job, Maruko Juri has been changing schools since her elementary years. Since she changes school way too often, she has never really made any memories with anyone except for two boys whom she used to call by A-kun and B-kun. Somehow these two boys had left lasting impression in her memories. Particularly A-kun, the boy who made her heart skip beats, the same boy who promised to propose to her seven years into the future after it was decided that she would be leaving his side for the time being.  
  
Juri, now a high school student, somehow made her way back to the same city where she met the two boys after her father got transferred again. She is ready to not get carried away but deep down she hopes to meet the two boys again as she prepares for her very first day in her school. As she starts introducing herself to her new class, a boy steps in, hugs her in front of the whole class and asks her to go out with him. The boy is none other than B-kun. But s

title: Otoko o Misete yo Kurata-kun!
description: Kurata Yuki is staying alone at home while his parents are off on their vacation. His childhood friends Nekoyanagi Mei and Inui Sayo are helping him with the household stuff in the mean time. Mei is outspoken and active while Sayo is calm and knowledgeable. They have known each other for their entire life and they treat each other like they were real siblings. Little do any of them know, they’ll be involved in a love triangle a year from now.

title: Territory M no Juunin
description: Ema Okunishi is a freshman who has come to a new city because of her parents' divorce. Still traumatized by the divorce, she can not get used to her new school and start conversation with her new classmates. One day Ema will visit a restaurant in the neighborhood and will have an unexpected meeting …

title: Walkure Romanze - Shoujo Kishi Monogatari
description:
Walkure Romanze's story revolves around Takahiro Mizuno, a student studying at an academy with jousting as its main focus for sport. Takahiro acts as an advisor to the riders of the sport. Takahiro goes through each day tediously until the time of the annual competition draws near. Due to some odd circumstances, his childhood friend Mio Kisaki is enrolled into the competition. As she has never even rode a horse once in her life, Takahiro senses the fear in his friend and becomes Mio's coach.
___
Adaptation of the visual novel developed by Ricotta.

title: RiN
description:
Fushimi is a high-school student who also aspires to be a mangaka. Rin is a model who appears to be able to see the future. What will happen in the future?


---

Published in Indonesian by **m&c! Comics**

title: The Girl Sitting Next to Me Who Is Always Quiet
description:
**Links:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Twitter](https://twitter.com/roron34/status/1441962179641561094)

title: Oogiri
description:
A collection of nine short stories written by NisiOisin with the collaboration of nine different artists:  
  
**Musumeiri Hako (Girl in a Box)** - Artist: [Akatsuki Akira](https://mangadex.org/?page=search&artist=Akatsuki%20Akira)  
A delinquent finds a girl abandoned in a box… and takes her home…  
  
**RKD-EK9** - Artist: [Obata Takeshi](https://mangadex.org/?page=search&artist=Obata%20Takeshi)  
In future scientists found that heaven exists but you need to do a certain amount of good deeds in order to get there. So what happens with people, who don't have enough of them?  
  
**Nani Made Nara Koroseru?** *(How Far Can You Kill?)* - Artist: [Ikeda Akihisa](https://mangadex.org/?page=search&artist=Ikeda%20Akihisa)  
Reika asked her neighbour friend Kyuu "how far could he kill?" when they were playing in sandpit. After that coversation they driffted apart. Ten years later Kyuu meets Reika carring a big box. She told him, it's dog corpse.  
  
**Hanger Strike!** - Artist: [Fukushima Te

title: Bocchi the Rock! - BoKita ga Irekawaru Hanashi (Doujinshi)
description:
Circle MIX-ISM's "Bocchi the Rock!" Volume 3 is here!

One day, Bocchi-chan and Kita-chan suddenly swapped bodies!? They try to hide it, but their bandmates quickly catch on. The Gotou family is also perplexed by Hitori-chan (who is Kita-chan), who's suddenly so outgoing.

This body-swap comedy is full of slapstick humor and even a little bit of lewd content!

title: Joshikou no Ouji-sama to Osananajimi no Jimiko-chan
description:
A story about an orthodox Prince(girl) of a girl's only high school and her childhood friend(plain looking). Don't you agree that plain looking girls who are actually strong willed are really moe???

By the way, the plain girl's full name isn't featured, but it's Tanaka Mitsuru-chan.

PS: This work is a part of YuriComi 2021: https://www.pixiv.net/en/tags/%E3%83%A6%E3%83%AA%E3%82%B3%E3%83%9F2021/artworks

title: PUNKS △ TRIANGLE
description: Chiaki, a student at a clothing college, had a dream. It is to have Ai, a charismatic model who changed Chiaki's life, walk down the runway wearing clothes he made. When he finds out that his dream will come true if he wins the competition, he becomes enthusiastic, but despairs when his co-production partner turns out to be Enaga, who is both unattractive and extremely clumsy. One night, Chiaki gets tangled up with a delinquent, but it is Ai who saves him. He also sexily asks him to teach him how to have a night out...? The heart-pounding dilemma of an extremely pure boy who is torn between a "mysterious model" and a "natural-looking, hot-headed guy" (actually the same person)!

title: Tama Hiyori
description: As a boy, Taishi saved a tiny chick (as in an actual bird) that was being bullied by its brothers and sisters. And now it’s grown up into a hot girl who wants to cater to his every whim! Did we mention she lays eggs, too?

title: My OTP Is So Sweet That I Want To Fall In Love
description: Sự xuất hiện của cậu bạn Minh Vũ lớp bên đã khiến Du Thanh trải qua những cung bậc cảm xúc thót tim, thất tình, tủi hờn và bất đắc dĩ. Một chàng trai tưởng chừng như bình thường như vậy sẽ luôn chiếm trọn trái tim cô. Sự ra đi của anh thực sự không rời xa, anh sẽ tiếp tục đồng hành cùng cô trên một chặng đường khác.

title: Ryuubi Tokuko wa Shizuka ni Kurashitai
description:
The heroes of the three kingdoms' war have been reincorporated in high school girls! Loyalty and hostility concern love in this world…? Wei, Wu, Shu, during the Three Kingdoms period they were warriors who fell in the mind and fell down in the chest… But what do they do in Japan?!  
  
Los héroes de la guerra de los tres reinos Wei, Wu, Shu Han reencarnado en chicas de secundaria. ¿Cual serán sus objetivos en esta nueva vida?

title: Dating to Survive
description:
The exorcist fell in love with me, a ghost...?!

A survival love story of a ghost who resorted to a false confession to survive from the exorcist.

title: Buyuden
description: Take Isamu is the best at everything he does at school, from looks and smarts, to his luck with girls and his abilities as an athlete. He considers himself to be in the top percent of his age group and is incredibly bored with interacting with the so called "normal people". That is until a new student, Kaname Moka, transfers into his school and, as she is quite pretty, Isamu asks her out. Moka mishears what he says and thinks he wants to challenge her to a fight, as she grew up on boxing. Determined to win her heart, Isamu decides to become a great boxer, with the help of new friends and allies he and Moka meet along the way.

title: Getting into Ecchi Rom-com Situations
description: Just typical romcom ecchi situations for a typical romcom MC.

title: Kousuke X Natsuki
description:
[#BL Manga] [Omegaverse]
*Even if they can't put their gratitude and love into words…*
A story about two people who deeply understand each other!
A Puppy-like Alpha × Tsundere Omega Childhood Friends Omegaverse Story
When he goes into heat, the uke becomes honest...
This is the daily life of Kousuke × Natsuki!

title: Dekiai Nante Zuru Sugiru!!
description:
Miyu, a second year at high school, is in love with “love,” and has the hobby of observing the school’s hottest guys during break time, her enthusiasm for it never failing to amaze her friends, Ayuto and Eri. But when Eri asks Miyu why she won’t pick the handsome and cool-looking Ayuto, whom she has an inseparable relationship with after finding out they were fans of the same band, Miyu replies that Ayuto is just a friend. In contrast to Miyu’s lack of interest, however, is Ayuto, who has a crush on her that everyone but her can see! 

Suddenly, Miyu ends up exchanging contact details with the cool and popular Imai-senpai at Ayuto’s part-time job, leaving her in high spirits! Meanwhile, Ayuto, who knows about Imai-senpai’s womanizing tendencies, is worried… 

It’s a sugary romance comedy between these two!!!

title: Gisou Honey Trap
description: Keiichirou Mishima is a 15-year-old guy living with his mom until she suddenly decides to fly to Paris to be with Keiichirou's dad. His mom arranges with his uncle Shirasaki to let him stay at his mansion with his two cousins Marie and Tomari, who he met many years before when he stayed with them for a short while. However, Keiichirou has forgotten nearly everything about back then, including why his cousins apparently now hate him.

title: Steps
description:
Ah-chan and Ryouko, childhood friends eight years apart, are now teacher and student. Though Ryouko wants to rush into things, Ah-chan can’t take one step beyond her role as a teacher. After receiving a matching cellphone charm as a present, Ah-chan buys paired rings for a return gift, only to realise that she’s lost the charm…!?  
  
The distance between them shrinks away in “STEP UP”; a girl in love with Ryouko appears in “STEP FORWARD”; and then “step by step” calls for tears of joy with wedding dress x wedding dress… The road to love between Ryouko and Ah-chan is bountiful.  
  
Also included are “Leave hickey?”, about the radiant proof of love school girl Kimu carves into the body of the art teacher Miyano-sensei; and “secret love”, not previously published in a commercial magazine!

title: Shikabane Hime
description:
The story starts off with a bunch of high-school students, taking a dare to enter an abandoned building which has been half-destroyed by fire. It is rumoured to be haunted. Just a rumour, right? Not when real corpses start showing up, things begin grabbing them, and finally zombies going after them!  
  
Shikabane Hime is there to save the day. The immortal girl, "Shikabane Hime," has a mission to "kill" 108 corpses. It’s a contract she has made with a Buddhist monk, Keisei. After 108 corpses, she will finally gain happiness and go to heaven.  
  
Licensed in English by **Yen Press**.

title: Seishun Radio Pinchers
description: A sporty blond has joined the Robot Research Club?

title: Sigeup Yeonae
description:
‘Date me for 20,000 won an hour.’

Cha Do Hyun is a poor college student. One day, he got a ridiculous offer from Lee Sana, a younger student at the university. Should he accept the offer from this girl, who was looking for a good place to bury a body on campus? Everything about it is suspicious, but having just been fired from his part-time job, the offer is too sweet for Cha Do hyun to turn down!
“You are totally worth the money”
“Keep that thought to yourself!”

A woman with nothing but money, a man with everything but money, and their suspicious dating service.

title: Tokimeki Tonight
description:
Ranze Etou is an adorable immortal girl with a vampire father and a werewolf mother who would throw things at each other when they get into childish fights. Ranze, however, just wants to live like a normal girl and lead a normal life. Unfortunately, she is "blessed" with the power to turn into anything she bites. For example, if she accidentally bites a cake the wrong way, then she will turn into a cake. The only way to return to normal is to sneeze! Ranze is in love with Shun Makabe, who is a handsome human boy at school. However, a human girl (without much hair) named Youko also likes Shun, and she will do anything to reveal that Ranze is not a human!! Things get even more complicated when Ranze meets Aaron, who is the prince of the Spirit World. Aaron falls in love with Ranze and first sight, and he will do whatever it takes to win her away from Shun… Tokimeki Tonight was one of the hottest mangas in Japan, and you sure don't want to miss this hilarious comedy!  
  
NOTE: This manga

title: The Perfect Girlfriend
description: Suwa is perfect. She has perfect grades, perfect looks and is the idol of everyone at her school. However this "perfection" has created an odd distance between her and her fellow classmates. That is except for Takeda, the boy who sits in front of her in class. It seems Takeda is the only person that is able to speak to Suwa normally and much to her chagrin he is starting to think she is not all that perfect.

title: Futaribocchi no Yoru
description: A short Oneshot about a girl that gets locked out of her home and has to stay over at her childhood friends house.

title: Hajimete Miru Mono
description: Senpai is invited to go to the movies with his adorable kouhai.

title: Amagami - Precious Diary
description:
Based on the dating simulation game, Amagami (Gentle Bite).  
This adaptation focus on each heroine based on the Amagami visual novel.  
V.1-2 - Ayatsuji  
V.3-4 - Kaoru  
V.5 - collection of short stories

title: A Single Round at Romance Is Enough!
description:
One day, I became the heroine of a love simulation game, Deborah. After seeing that I would be sent back to my world after achieving a Happy Ending, I finally managed to receive the confession of the male leads through many struggles.

[ Normal Ending achieved! ] ‘What? Normal ending? Didn’t the happy ending with the female lead and male lead end well?!’

The second round started again after failing to achieve a happy ending. ‘Oh, I don't know, tell them to stop this!’ It's none of their business to decide my life. I have to be happy! Unlike the first round, I’m going to do what I want to do... But aren’t the male leads acting a bit weird?!

---
Romance simulation video games are usually a mess-free way to date handsome men, but after Shiyeon Choi wakes up in one, she wants out! In her new gamified life, she quickly realizes how rude the male leads are. Thus, Shiyeon decides to "Bad End" all of her love interests, determined to give them a taste of their own medicine. But despite beati

title: Natsu no Mamono
description: I've always loved Murata-kun. Isn't this feeling love? -- Murata-kun, an omega, is confessed by Sato-san from another class. But the way Sato-san is coming on to Murata-kun is completely Alpha's... You will be unintentionally drawn into the 'earnest love and lust between a man and a woman', which is depicted in fresh strokes through the world of the Omegaverse.

title: A Frustratingly Slow Story About Two People
description: A fan-made promo by an artist to support the light novel for "I Know That After School, The Saint is More Than Just Noble"

The manga's story centers around Sachi Maruyama, a girl who has just entered high school. In her new school, she finds that no club activities really interest her, so she is invited by an upperclassman from her middle school — now the student council president of her high school — to help with student council activities. There, she finds Karasuya, a boy she had met three years ago on a baseball field. [ANN]

- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1518!)

title: Hiiragi Shougakkou Ren’ai Club
description: The main protagonist is a 5th grader at a private school that is a part of an educational institution where boys and girls are strictly separated and that goes all the way to high school. She is afraid that she can't make a boyfriend so she decides to make a new club where members rehearse going with partners for practice.

title: Zou no Haji, Tsuru wa Odoru
description:
Hanada was always self-conscious about  his rough skin, cracked and peeling, like a hide of an elephant. In contrast, a beautiful girl in his class had everything he didn't, an open and outgoing personality, clear and radiant skin, lustrous hair, even her steps bounced like a crane in dance. But she proved more than those attractive attributes, and he found himself drawn to her, even as he despaired at his chances. But an unexpected invitation, and a clash of hope against insecurity...

Winner of the 25th Kuratsui Manga Award [Free Division] Oshitsui Award.

title: At the End of the Road
description:
After a car accident, Taemin finds himself in the body of Siwon, who was a victim of bullying at school. No longer a pushover, he starts standing up for himself but then meets Woojin, an old friend from the past. Somehow, Woojin immediately picks up Tamin's 'scent' from Siwon. What happened between these two in the past and how will it affect their future?

title: Sonogo no Isshuukan Friends
description:
**This synopsis contains spoilers from the original One Week Friends series.**

Kaori Fujimiya used to be a girl who lose her friends' memory every Monday, but she managed to regain all her memories. However, high school ends and everyone follows different paths. Yuuki Hase has feelings for her, and even apart, he wants to be more than just friends, will he be able to move forward in this relationship?

title: Galge no Sekai yo, Youkoso!
description:
Takenori is a major fan of Dating Sims. One day, he receives a strange eMail that tells him he can be the main character and asks him to insert the source material for his new world.  
  
Takenori inserts his favorite Dating Sim "Eternal Innocence" and after strange things he mistakens for a dream, wakes up - to find that all the heroines from Eternal Innocence have come to life in his usual surroundings!  
  
(Source: MU)

description:
**Links:**

title: A Wisdom Tooth
description: The unspeakable secrets between a handsome dentist and his patient's classmate.

title: Someone I Thought of as a Friend Asked Me Out on a Date
Saranghaneun Yeoreum Haneul
description: Baek Gihu, who loves the sky more than people, takes pictures of the sky with his camera. One summer day, a girl named "Haneul"—her name means "Sky"—transfers to his class and sits in the seat next to him.

title: Warau Kanoko-sama
description: Although she doesn't get along with people very well, Kanoko considers herself a perfect "observer." Her hobby is observing the students in her third year junior high class and keeping a journal of the classroom drama. But what will happen when Kanoko becomes involved with some of her classmates?

title: Bokura ni Namae o Tsukeru Nara
description: In the third year of high school, Izumi Tohsaka reunited with his younger brother, Kaoru Yano. Seven years after my parents divorced, I decided to live together in a dormitory shared room again. Lower voice, red-dyed hair, mature look, unknown surname… Izumi is attracted to him who has changed everything and doesn't even realize he is his younger brother. Even though they are supposed to be siblings, this emotion in my heart…?

title: A True Face I Didn't Know You Had
description: Spin-off of ["I Want to Know your Real Face"](https://danke.moe/read/manga/real-face/)

title: Rejoice in Your Enemies
description: His beloved crush was snatched up by the nerdy new student.  Furious, Ren Zhichu tries to harass that nerd at every chance he gets. Unexpectedly, during their interactions with each other, Ren Zhichu actually develops feelings for that nerd...

title: Sakurairo Dialogue
description: Set in a rural town in the northeastern region of Japan, this coming-of-age story follows a girl who feels suffocated by life in the small town and a boy who is here to escape from the city. They meet through a certain piece of music, and gradually open their hearts to each other.

title: Seiheki o Kuruwaseru, Otoko no Ko Tenkousei ga Arawareta!
description: Takehiko who has the soul of a "real boy" who always insists on Katsuragi to be a real boy, but Katsuragi bullies Takehiko the Tsundere.

title: Tenshi Girl
description: It all started with a banana. When Sayaka finds a banana lying in the street, she barely has a moment to question it before Yoshiko gobbles it up. But that night, the spirit of that same banana visits her and transforms her into an angel! Her mission? To help souls in need! Which is how she winds up at A-kun's house and must grant his true heart's desire. Except, that desire is to marry Sayaka?! Can this newly transformed angel figure out what the heck is going before things get even more confusin? Find out in this parody spin-off to Hiroyuki's wildly popular, Aho Girl series!

title: Yankee Danshi Koukousei to Iroke no nai Arasaa Taiiku Kyoushi
Koi to Himitsu no Gakuseiryou
description:
In Asahi's school, there are two types of students: the ones from the elite class and the ones from average one.  
  
After an accident in her house, she starts living in the rooms of the elite class, but no one must know, or else she would be expelled. By chance, a black haired guy from the elite discovers her secret…

title: Jigoku Ane
description: Hiroki's older sister got caught up on a bus accident. By the time she wakes up, he found out she has lost her memories. But this didn't actually seem to be the case, there's someone else's memories inside her!

title: Otoko Tomodachi Mitai na Onna Tomodachi
The Magician's Daughter
description:
The story revolves around Suzunoki Hatsune, a normal high school girl… or so she strongly wishes, because she has no desire to succeed her stepfather as the strongest onmyouji in modern Japan. 
Still, she has the ability to see spirits, and as luck would have it, her emerging abilities are pointing her to a terrifying truth behind the deaths of her parents… and her stepfather may be involved!?

title: The Boy Who Could Stop Time and the Girl Sitting Next to Him
description: I can stop time for as long as 3 seconds. Today for sure, I'll … her.

title: The Secret of Friendship
description:
Eiko is something of a plain Jane and a doormat, while her best friend Moe is a head-turning beauty. Despite their differences, their friendship is as strong as ever.   
Guys are always asking Moe out, but her answer is invariably "Only if you promise to put Eiko before me."  
  
Also includes:  
Sonokare Shira Bemasu

title: Junai Sensation
description: Two boys best of friends until one day one of them gets killed saving the life of the other. The boys spirit wanders watching him until one day he ends up possessing the body of a girl who tried to kill herself .

title: The Guy Inside Me
description:
Who would've thought that rivals, the academic tyrant, Xu Sheng, and the top student, Zhao Zhan, would exchange bodies a few times and then start to like each other secretly! After many clueless situations the two became closer to each other, after they experience some funny stories and incidents, they finally understand their feelings for each other.  
  
¿Quién hubiera pensado que los rivales, el tirano académico, Xu Sheng, y el mejor estudiante, Zhao Zhan, intercambiarían cuerpos unas cuantas veces y luego empezarían a gustarse en secreto? Después de muchas situaciones sin pistas los dos se acercaron más el uno al otro, después de experimentar algunas historias e incidentes divertidos, finalmente entienden sus sentimientos por el otro.

title: Nagisa-chan no Oukina Oukina Kakushigoto
description:
Nagisa-chan has a crush on her childhood friend. One day, she suddenly starts growing to a giant size!
In order to return to normal, she needs to "be able to say what she really feels," but...
The romantic comedy with the largest height difference begins now!!

title: 3LDK no Ou-sama
description: Misato's parents are the landlords of an apartment where there are some handsome young men, but they are all shut-in and have other problems: Yamada is a narcissist who lives in delusion, Yoshida is a typical otaku who calls a 2D character his wife, Sasaki is a novel writer with lazy attitude and his room is always full of garbage. Misato has to deal with them everyday. Taking care of shut-in handsome men, is it a blessing? Or maybe not…

description:
An anthology featuring braless girls.

title: Freezing - Pair Love Stories
description: The Freezing Pair Love Stories manga tells the story of how the various Pandoras and Limiters met. The first chapter focuses on the characters Ganessa Roland and Arthur Crypton.

title: BUTTER!!!
description: Each of the high school students in the small dance club is there for a different reason. Natsu joined due to her love of hip-hop dance, and Haba Takahiro's presence is all thanks to some relentless bullies. Whatever brought them all to the club, they're now learning about the different styles of social dance from the skillful vice president Kazumi and the hesitant president Hajime. As they learn the joys of dancing, they will also grow closer to each other…

title: Hyoutenka no Nukumori
description: A masochistic-boyfriend and a sadist-girlfriend.

title: The Living Dead!
description:
Aoyama Keita had a crush on his classmate Haida Monako, but he was too shy to tell her. One day, when Haida suddenly passes away, he is finally able to confess to her through a letter he places at her funeral. Little does Keita know, she returns as a zombie and blackmails him into letting her stay with him with the threat that she will tell everyone about the love letter if he doesn't. Now Keita has to hide Haida from his parents, classmates and the outside world because everyone else thinks she is dead. To make matters worse, as a living dead, she craves flesh from time to time and Haida doesn’t care if it comes from Keita…

[Wikipedia](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%8A%E3%81%B3%E3%82%93%E3%81%90%E3%81%A7%E3%81%A3%E3%81%A9!)

title: Kenage na Seitou Kaicho to Yokoshima na Fuku Kaichou
description:
A student council president in a puny student council no one knows about tries her best to attract new members despite running in circles. One man joins as the vice president with his eyes on the president disregarding his duties as a member of the student council. It's a gag comedy about their muddled days.  
Includes both the 2012 web serialized and doujinshi versions.

title: Kono Koi, Kanaimasuka?
description: The latest work by Uri Amemiya-sensei, a master of love stories that evokes overwhelming sympathy on the web! Four high school boys in love will spell out their unrequited love stories in an omnibus. A love that sprouted while commuting on the train to school, a childhood-friend-turned lover, among others! Heart-pounding, you-don’t-wanna-miss stories that paint the fresh excitement of the moment you fall in love!

title: Shindou to Moujuu
description:
Sano Ken'ichi is known to others as a prodigy and he doesn't mix well with his surroundings. Suzuki Erina, on the other hand, is called a beast and is often made fun of by those around her. After their first interaction, these two friendless loners quickly became close friends.

However, both their families have their own complicated circumstances which their parents are worrying over in their own way. What sort of change will their meeting bring to their family!?

This story also showcases the changes and growth undergone by the family members of the two protagonists.

Twitter Compilation

*Note: The story was first published as part of a doujinshi collection in 2018. It was restarted as a series in 2021 on Twitter. Characters and children of characters from Katou Mayumi's three "Aru" series also appear in this story. *

title: SWAN
description:
The dreams and passions of dancers for all ballet and manga fans. A masterpiece of ballet manga, depicting a girl who, 
while troubled and hurt, blossoms her unfathomable talent! 

A high quality volume long-awaited by fans, it includes color pages and chapter covers from the serialization, 
as well as newly-drawn manga showing what happened to the main character.

title: The Tower of Mysterion
description: The carefree days of a group of friends turn into horror as female students begin to die random gruesome deaths in their town.

title: The Flower Boy
description: College student, Han Soyi, has been unable to move on from the lingering affection she has for her ex-boyfriend. She tries to sort out her complicated feelings by concentrating on her studies, and receives a flower pot from a local elder to use for a class at school. But little does she know, the pot she receives happens to be a cursed pot, where a man's soul lies trapped…

title: Warawanaide yo Shijima-san
description:
Shijima is always happy and laughing. But what is her dark secret…?

Boy-meets-girl horror!

Published in *Weekly Shounen Jump 2026 No. 37·38*.

title: Cat Street
description:
From [Condensation](https://mangadex.org/group/108/condensation):  
  
The story centers around Keito Aoyama, a former famous child actor. Due to a childhood incident, she retired from her career early and withdrew from normal society. Now 16, she passes her days in boredom and without purpose. But one day she runs into a stranger who takes her to El Liston–a free school for high school students like herself, who don't have a place where they belong. Though hesitant at first, Keito decides to enter El Liston and subsequently, she begins a new stage in her life. With the help of her only remaining childhood friend, Taiyou, and her new classmates Rei, Momiji, and Kouichi, Keito slowly finds the courage to open up to others and to accept their support. Will Keito return to acting? Will she find true friends? Love?

title: Sousou no Frieren - Gaku Paro na Shutaferu (Doujinshi)
description:
**Notes:**
- The author skipped chapter 2.

title: Koi ni Wazurai
description: Scandal: Hashimoto Misaki is a member idol group Lily-Puri. Her girlfriend, Nagisa, thinks that Misaki might be too close with one of her members, Ayame. Furthermore, a magazine has been trying to break a scandal about Misaki. The magazine eventually gets just the scoop they need that puts the pair's relationship in jeopardy.

title: Bokura Souiun Janai Node.
description: I'll share my secret with you and you alone.

title: Momoyama Kyoudai
description: Arima and his little sister Chihiro are the twins of the Momoyama family. Six years ago, they've overheard their parents say "We will tell them the truth when they turn 16." The two worried that they might be adopted during those six years, but the truth they learn on their 16th birthday is even more shocking! Also includes an award-winning one-shot.

title: Hime-dol!!
description: Inspired by his grandfather's skills, Kiriyama Kyoutarou's dream is to become a hairstylist. For that he enrolls in Yumemino Private Academy, also known as Tech High, the first combined technical high school in the country, more specifically he enrolls in the Beautician Department. Little did he know that his neighbor in class is Samejima Alto, an infamous female delinquent renowned for her monstrous strength. Even after that meeting his school life proves to be quite eventful as he stumbles upon a mysterious idol's secretive practice, discovers a connection with the biggest up-and-coming idol around and receives a rather unexpected request from the fearful Samejima - "Can you turn me into an idol!?". A story about following your dreams, even when everything and everyone seems to believe they're unfit considering who you are.

title: Odagiri-san ni wa, Kirikirimai
description:
“I know I am no match for him, but these feelings are overflowing out…!!”   
Four girls have fallen in love with boys older than them: the four Odagiri, each one with their own great personality.  
To be avoided, to love, and to be loved too much (!?)… This is the start of four love stories, of four girls who can’t hold back their feelings and are making their way to the adult world!

title: Yamanko!
description: Though it was a bit strange, three people ended up meeting. One, who looks younger than her age and able to see the supernatural. Another who is possessed by a "Yamanko" which refers to "Yama no ko", or a mountain child. She was possessed due to her bloodline and due to the possession, she has superhuman abilities which she can call upon. Finally, an awkward person who enjoys writing poems. Coincidentally, the three are also classmates.

title: 1st Kiss
description: He is her younger brother, although the two have no blood relationship but she always considers him to be her biological brother … can only be brother that’s all. of course he doesn’t want to be like that, but he is also afraid that he will create distance with her more and more far away. If their first meeting in life was not like that, would they have another result? The girl he loves is right in front of his eyes but is like a wind and can’t hold … Can only as younger brother? How must he do to let her know that he can also become a guardian for her whole life?

title: Hachimitsu ni Hatsukoi
description: I don't have family, friends or a boyfriend. But there's someone I love. We have that strange relationship: childhood friend.

title: Koaka Head
description: Itou Takeru was highly unpopular in middle school, but one girl, Watase Nagisa, always treated him with cheerful kindness. Over time, he fell in love with Nagisa, though he never told her. He followed her to the same high school after graduation, determined that he would eventually confess his feelings for her. However, he didn't look at the chosen school too carefully, and he ended up in a special arts class with Nagisa and many other girls. He and his friend Yuto are the only boys in the class, but it isn't the paradise one might expect. Some of the girls are friendly, but some seem determined to make his life a living hell. Will Takeru be able to handle his new high school life, and will he ever tell Nagisa how he feels about her? (MU)

title: Two Playing House
description: A mild schoolgirl Nazuna and the cool schoolboy Shoutarou unexpectedly and meekly come together in this heartwarming school love comedy.

title: Mischievous Butterfly
description: Sakura, a 1st-year student at a music high school, loves playing piano. She also quietly loves her friend, Nanoha. Nanoha has adored listening to Sakura play the piano ever since they were children. As the yearly music competition for upperclassmen comes around, Sakura will have to deal with her passion for both the piano and Nanoha.

title: Day by Day
description: A childhood friendship ruined by a confession?!

title: Tsumugu to Koi ni Naru Futari
description: Tsumugi, a high school girl who likes to be alone, ends up staying at the home and workplace of Ryotarou Sakaki, who goes to the same school as her due to her mother's sudden move!

title: Last One
description: Hirano Yukito is at the end of his rope. He's decided to kill himself - all he needs is just one more little push. But things don't always go the way you think they will… Semi-finalist for Afternoon's Spring 2016 Four Seasons Award.

title: Student Council's Discretion
description: Hekiyou Private Academy's student council members are decided through what basically is a popularity contest. Since good looking girls are admired by both sexes, unlike boys, the student council room became known as paradise. As the pillar of the student council, Sugisaki Ken seeks to create his own bishoujo harem due to his love of girls.

title: Three B(r)others
description:
The school's three most popular guys are actually someone's exasperating brothers—and someone who loathes attention at that! Haejoo craves a life of mundanity and obscurity, but she's plagued by her three jaw-droppingly handsome brothers who stand out even when they're doing nothing more exciting than breathing. At school, she goes to great lengths to hide the fact that they're related, but what happens when she finally gets busted? Will Haejoo be able to achieve the quiet life she seeks despite being stuck in a school with her three older brothers?

---
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/comedy/annoying-brothers/list?title_no=3498)

title: Kyonyuu Tights ~Kuro Tights Bishoujo to Icha Ero Shichau~ Anthology Comic
description:
Eight short stories involving girls with big boobs wearing tights.
