title: Hokenshitsu no Kagishimete
description: The secret pleasure of Notozawa Nadeshiko, the demure and conscientious head of the health committee, is checking the underwear of the pupils who visit the infirmary?! As the first friend of the new transfer pupil, Aichigawa Ikumi, Nadeshiko tells her about her secret love of underwear. For the sake of friendship (?), Ikumi tries to oblige. Today, too, their friendship blossoms in the infirmary, just the two of them…?!

title: Seishun Away
description: Rambunctious high-school student Hayate is the lone girl in an all-boys soccer club. One day, honors student Yuuto suddenly asks her out, starting a cute opposites-attract romance.

title: 685 DAYS
description: "I'm sorry…" The second year of high school enters the new semester after the time when Juyeon and Mihyang, who became awkward with the rejected confession, avoided each other due to misunderstandings and worries. The two meet again, and with a fluttering heart, a slightly different special story begins. From the thrilling confession to the day when the first snow falls for the two, <685 days>

title: Kyouseiteki ni Akuyaku Reijou ni Sareteita no de Mazu wa Okayu wo Tabeyou to Omoimasu
description:
After being reincarnated in a game world, Ravie Heathfen, has been forced to play the role of the villainous noble lady after the game's heroine placed a slave curse on her. When the magic suddenly came undone, she gained back her bodily freedom and also memories of her past life but she has to make sure that the heroine doesn't find out or she'll lose her head!

She wants to escape immediately but it's just impossible with the horribly skinny state her body is currently in. So for now, she'll just have to settle with eating porridge first and start building back her physical strength!

But her fiancé the prince, the muscular knight, and others would unexpectedly come and start quarrelling with her. It seems that our skinny young lady's escape plan will be filled with plenty of great difficulties!

---
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5602ga/)

title: Musaek Sonyeo
description: Com um novo ano eletivo, Eunwoo termina se sentando perto da Jinah uma garota sombria e pouco sociável, em uma tentativa de se aproximar da sua colega acaba em uma situação muito mais complexa do que poderia imaginar. Uma história sobre os desafios das emoções da juventude, uma obra de estreia de Lame!

title: Ashita mo Kiss shite ii desu ka?
description:
Various romance one-shots.  
1. Mainichi Kiss shite ii desu ka? ~Kaki Oroshi Bangai-hen~ (Hatsuharu)  
2. 16-sai, Oomi no Natsu (Anmitsu)  
3. Isumi-senpai wa Amakunai (Rukana)  
4. Daisuki Sugite Gomennasai! (Fuuko Yui)  
5. Datte Kimi to Kiss shitai (Aoi Suzumine)  
6. Kimi to Hajimari no Kiss (Hana Ayana)

title: LL Sister
description:
Konakai Futaba loves her older sister more than anything else in the world. Kind, beautiful and intelligent, Ichina was everything that Futaba wished that she could be… she even encouraged Futaba when she was feeling down.  
  
As such, Futaba went to the same highschool as Ichina, hoping to be reunited after two whole years of being apart…  
  
…but sadly, Ichina has completely changed from the sweet, gentle sister that Futaba remembers.

title: Kisu wa kossori to.
description:
*Collection of oneshots*  
  
**1. Taka no Me wa Gomakasenai**  
Mami, who is about to graduate from high school, is looking for a chance to confess to her three-year-older childhood friend, Harutaka. On the way home from school, while Harutaka is sending her back by car, Mami who can not suppress her feelings says "I do not want to return" -!?

title: Gampuku
description: A series of illustrations from Hiramoto Akira's collection of works. Most of the illustrations are from Prison School.

title: Raising A Bat
description: High school senior Min-kyum has been left to his own defenses after his parents kicked him out of their lives. His new house is in a shabby neighborhood, the site of several mysterious assaults that have left victims with bite marks on their necks and blood loss symptoms. After moving in, Min-kyum heads out for a meal…then somehow wakes up at home with strange marks on his neck. He tries to shrug it off, but his deskmate at the new school looks suspiciously pale and familiar…

title: Residents of Hanayashiki
description:
Sakura Aki is a penniless high schooler who likes to cook and does other "unmanly" things. His grandfather and father are disciplinary on gender roles and beat up Aki everytime he does a thing that women would usually do, like cleaning. When his father leaves him absolutely broke, and with his grandfather realizing Aki's "unmanly" flaws, he sends him to live at one of the dorms at an all girls' school that he runs, a school where distinguished young ladies of the country attend, the Hanayashiki - Flower Estate-, to teach him a lesson.  
  
He meets Kitahiro Renge, a girl with un-ladylike manners and a meat loving obsession. An encounter that's going to save Aki Sakura or just another problem in sight?!

title: I Was Asked "Wanna Have Sex on Sunday?" and Was Horny For an Entire Week
Kimi ga Tsurarete Warau kara
description:
"I want a love that's full of smiles!" Popular on the Web! The long-awaited all-color romance manga that makes will make you feel all warm and fuzzy just from reading it!  
  
Yukiya Sora's heartwarming love stories will make you smile. She meticulously depicts the innocent flirting and playfulness of lovers and married couples. It shows that happiness can be found in our normal daily lives.   
  
It includes the main stories of 5 couples and 5 additional extras.

title: Fools
description: Eungi has been in college without being engaged with others. One day by encounter, he finds the secret of underclassman Jeongwoo. Why are you so nervous to forget? A love story that’s both easy and difficult.

title: Uchuu no Hate no Mannaka no
description: Mirai who has entered highschool is always alone. Much like a dream, her classmate Twinkle Shinba Rin has invited her to the astronomical department!! In the clubroom, there is a group of four handsome classmates ☆ The world of dreams will change with this!

title: Trans Horizon
description:
Shin Jaemin who lacks self-confidence and is much more timid than his peers, spends his middle school days being bullied by his classmates. If there’s any hope, it’s the new and fresh Idol group 'ROSE'. On the day of high school’s entrance, the freshman representative shows up in front of an exhausted Jaemin, who spent the previous day watching Rose’s performance videos.   
That representative is 'Yu Do-Yeong', one of his favorite Rose members. And they'll involve Jae-min in very 'special' fate.

title: WataShu: Why Can't I Stop Being the Heroine?
description: Haruka Ikeda has a problem she's facing, it seems she can't stop being the heroine! So there's only one way for her to deal with this.

title: Tada-san wa Kawaii
description:
"Tada Satsuki, she's a popular handsome girl who is kind, cool, and... cute?!"

A short story of girls love comedy between a cool handsome girl and a cute dork who adore her secretly.

(Published in Comic Yuri Hime Magazine November Issue 2022, as honorable mention of Yuri Hime 27th Comic Awards)

title: Caramel Honey
description:
Ayato transfers into a new school, hoping for a fresh start. Sadly for him, the school turns up to be filled with deliquents, and the most feared of them all has his eye set on him. It doesn't help that whenever Ayato accidentally takes off his glasses, everyone around him suddenly becomes completely smitten by him!  


---

title: Beast Master
description:
Yuiko Kubozuka is a high school girl who loves animals. Unfortunately, animals hate her and flee from her whenever possible. So when a new classmate, Leo Aoi, turns out to be a scary guy who resembles a wild animal than anything human, she is intrigued. Not only because Leo has an affinity with animals which she envies, but also because he isn't the wild animal that he seems to be. He seems to hide a very sweet disposition behind his scary features.  
  
Or so she thought. The truth is revealed when they are attacked and Leo immediately behaves like a wild animal and gets violent like a blood-thirsty animal, just to save Yuiko.  
  
Will Yuiko be able to tame this wildest of all animals or will he be just like the others and flee from her? Or the better question, will she flee from him?  
  
Included one-shots:  
Volume 1: Fly  
Volume 2: Saboten Summer Surprise (Cactus Summer Surprise)

title: Yashahime
description:
Can the three teenage daughters of demon dog half-brothers Inuyasha and Sesshomaru 
save their parents, themselves, and both realms from the menace of the seven mystical Rainbow Pearls?

Living in the present day isn’t easy for Sesshomaru’s daughter Towa. 
She can’t remember where she came from, must conceal her mysterious powers, 
and is either worshiped or feared by girls she just wants to be friends with. 
But she has no way of returning to her own time until the day 
a demon attacks and she is transported to feudal-era Japan.

There Towa, her twin sister Setsuma, and her cousin Moroha —Inuyasha’s daughter—
have a mission bestowed upon them by the mystical Tree of Ages. 
With only vague memories of their past to guide them, the three young women set out to find their parents, 
heal a rift in time, and fulfill their royal destiny...

title: Okitsune-sama de Chu♥
description:
Our protagonist, Moji Shimeta, just so happens to fulfill the stereotype for being a worthless human. His inability to carry out a conversation has left him at the bottom of the barrel as far as friends are concerned.  
  
That Shimeta fell in love with the school idol Ishikawa Yuuko, however that kind of love is absolutely, perfectly, and completely impossible. During this time, the messenger of the gods, Osaki, appeared to grant Moji's request with a price attached concerning Moji's cooperation in catching some runaway evil spirits. However to catch them all, Osaki uses Moji as a vessel to become a servent of Uganomitamanokami (aka Inari) called Youko. Lots of Ecchi situations and humiliation abound at Moji's expense.

title: The Story of a Girl Who Can See Where Others Are Looking
description: Day after day I'm being stared at!

title: Ponytail ni Yureru
description: A middle-schooler gets enamoured by a girl's ponytail.

title: Last Paradise
description: This is a story about Myunghan, who has just entered high school, Sihoo, his childhood friend, Seungchan, who suddenly appears between the two, and the strange triangle that develops between the three of them.

title: Boku no Toshishita no Onee-chan
description: Aiba Minoru (30), a high school teacher who fell in love with his high school student Nanami Kashiwagi, tries to rejuvenate himself with the power of chemistry, but… he ends up with the body of an elementary school student!! TOO YOUNG TO LOVE!!! An agegap romcom!!

title: Ryuu to Itsuki
description: 「好きな人が記した、僕の知らない『あなた』への愛を綴った日記を燃やす。」龍の青臭く、そして衝動的な一つのアクションが、時間逆行を引き起こし、龍と彼が好きだった樹の人生に大きな変化を与え…！！

title: Shoujo Shikkaku
description:
A mysterious transfer student arrives to the third year, class C for Hanazono Girl's Middle School.  
Akane is a plain and simple girl who was tired of her overbearing friends, and silently thinks that it would be okay if the world were destroyed. One day, all the girls of the class awake to find themselves in a deserted school, with mysterious timers counting down. Each girl is shackled to another girl, and these pairs must work together to survive a 7-day Battle Royale. As it turns out, Akane is paired with the mysterious transfer student.  
  
Friendships crumble, hopes are lost, and sanity is tested as the game starts off with a bang!

title: Nandemo Oshiete Kureru Osananajimi no Ohanashi
description: The boy teaches the girl nearly everything he knows when she got troubles.

title: Cider to Nakimushi.
description:
A collection of short doujin stories by Canno. All slightly romantic, with open endings.  
  
−Gold star, happy end  
−A dead-end, after all  
  
−The secret door that fleetingly opens  
−Welcome to the Occult Research Society!  
−The bamboo and the tiger  
  
−Cinderella  
  
−Just waiting for spring  
−Summer ends

title: Uchi ga Kingdom
description: When her father decided to move their family to a rural area, Miki Hayakawa and her younger brother went along with his plan. They didn't know that when they got to their new home, their father would tell them, “I'm going to declare our home independent from Japan and make myself the king.”.

title: Gomen ne Hatsukoi
description: Junior high school junior year, winter. Chiho and the friendly Sosuke kindly accept Mahiro, an out-of-season transfer student. Chiho and Sosuke are childhood friends who live next door to each other. They are not family, but they are special to each other - and Mahiro yearns for their relationship. These feelings eventually turn into her first love for Sosuke...

title: A Girl's Trial
description: An unexpected series of trials begins for a girl who was close to the bottom of the school hierarchy. The winner gets a prize!

title: Hana o Meshimase
description: After Shion's mother passed away, she was left with her father who loves to gamble and evade his responsibilities as a father. Due to that continuous pattern, Shion moves in to live as a live-in employee with 25-years-old florist Shun Mamyuuda. As she begins to learn the value of flowers and life, will she also find her place in love?

title: Mahoromatic
description:
Mahoro is a battle android created by Vesper to defend the Earth against alien invasions.  
  
Having fought long and hard on behalf of Vesper, she only has 37 days left before she stops functioning. However, if they remove all her battle functions and equipment, Vesper can lengthen her life to 398 days. As thanks for her hard work, Vesper lets Mahoro choose how she would like to spend her remaining time.  
  
She chooses to work as a maid for a boy named Suguru Misato.

title: Infinite Stratos - Sugar & Honey
description:
The newest IS spinoff that stars Charlotte! This monthly webcomic is sure to show you more of her life that hasn't been shown in the light novels nor the anime. With stories that is as sweet and enticing as its title, you'll be wanting for more. Be sure to not to miss out on this serialization about the ever adorable Charlotte, Ichika and the others!  
  
Related:  
> [Infinite Stratos - Official Anthology Comic](https://mangadex.com/manga/4768)  
> [Infinite Stratos2 - Official Anthology Comic](https://mangadex.org/manga/16466)  
>[Infinite Stratos Black Bunny/White Bitter](https://mangadex.org/manga/16181/)   
> [IS!(4koma)](https://mangadex.com/manga/4779)  
> [Infinite Stratos](https://mangadex.org/manga/425)  
Relaunch:  
[Infinite Stratos (YUUKI Homura)](https://mangadex.com/manga/9064)

title: #B ga L suru 4 Page Anthology ~Sono Toki Boku wa, Koi wo Shita!~
description:
“I think I’ve fallen for you…”  

A 4-page shorts collection of BL stories depicting such moments. Includes works of 29 popular and talented authors. Look forward to it.

title: Yandere x Stalker
description: It's a Yuri story of Yandere Shimazaki and stalker Ushida. This story show you a daily life between a yandere and stalker love.

title: Shoujotachi wa Kouya wo Mezasu
description:
Shoujo-tachi wa Kouya wo Mezasu is a series all about finding oneself and a direction in life… no matter how far off the beaten path it might be.  
  
Buntarou Houjou is a high school student who has a talent for writing, but no real direction in life or any plans for the future. His classmate, Sayuki Kuroda notices his talent, decides to help him find a way to use it properly by enlisting him in her bishoujo game development group.  
  
When Buntarou is cornered in the men's bathroom at school by Sayuki, he is surprised when he is asked out on what he thinks is a date, and even further surprised when he finds out that it's not a date, but a job interview. Reluctantly agreeing, the two start recruiting other members for their team but will they learn more about game creation, or life itself along the way?

title: Baka & Test & Shokanjudya
description:
At Fumidzuki Academy, classes are separated by academic achievement. The smartest kids are in A Class, while the dumbest are in F Class. This chronicles the daily life of the students in F Class. Instead of grades, they have to worry about homosexual stalkers, crushes, ambiguous genders, and waging academic war on the upper classes! (From: MU)  
  
Official Romanization: *Baka & Test & Shokanjudya*

title: Junai Tokkou Taichou!
description: When the school's two biggest troublemakers get into a tussle, there's nothing left for them to do but fall in love! In Love Attack, you'll find a rollicking brawl of a good time as the roughest guy and girl in school get themselves into trouble–and find themselves in love.

title: I Will Make You Happy!
description:
Dove, a child of heaven with black wings.  
He was made fun of for years because of the way he looked…   
He wants to become a formal angel to get revenge.  
However, to become a formal angel, he must make his nominated human happy…   
Dove’s nominated human is Jang Yena. She is good-looking, has good grades, and is an all-around sportsman!  
Does the perfect Yena wish for ‘love’?  
Will Dove, who has never been loved or been in love, be able to fulfill Yena’s wish?

title: A Foreigner, Bilingual Girl, and a Kindling Relationship
description: Know what you're saying in the language you're speaking.

title: That Summer
description: Kim Jumi's life is like that of any other teenager preparing for her CSAT's: all work and no play. But one summer day, she witnesses something on the rooftop of her school… From then on, she finds herself getting tangled up with two boys who are in a complicated relationship.

title: Sensei, We're With You!
description:
Late-bloomer Gomi-sensei (Trash-sensei) has never even once dated a girl before. He's on lots of dating apps, trying desperately to somehow find a partner. But these precocious, modern elementary school students watch over their constantly anguished teacher…? They're supporting their unpopular teacher's dating life - it's a wholesome children's manga!

The first 7 chapters were occasionally serialized in Tonari no Young Jump (not as a series that appeared every episode; rather, sometimes an issue would include 3-4 chapters scattered in between other series). With the eighth chapter, it was moved to Grand Jump.

title: You Are My All
description:
The delinquent Kusunoki admires one person - and that is an upperclassman from another school who saved him while he was being beat up; brimming with manliness (but physically small) - Hayato-san. Though large in both body and attitude, Kusunoki is completely submissive to Hayato. He becomes Hayato's underling and escorts him to and back from school, cooks him lunch, and thinks of Hayato all the time when they can't meet. Kusunoki realizes that his feelings are of love through his friend's remarks. Just being subservient to him is not enough, but he wants to do more with the cute and cool Hayato-san…  
However, his confessions are always being disturbed by Hayato's nasty friend, Misao, and Hayato himself, who is very simple-minded and pure…

title: Momo-chan no Hito ni wa Ienai Nayami
description:
Momo-chan has a secret that she can't tell anyone…

Creator-approved translations by [TheElusiveTaco.](https://twitter.com/elusive_taco)

title: Haruka Kanata
description:
Haruka Ichijou dan Yusuke Kanata menghadiri sekolah anak laki-laki bersama.
Kesalahan Yusuke dalam eksperimen kimia menyebabkan tubuh Haruka tiba-tiba berubah menjadi seorang gadis.

title: Doukyuusei ni Koi o Shita
description: Sunao is a female high school freshman who's extremely scared of boys. She hoped that it'd get better in high school, but the cool and reserved boy next to her, Izumi, only seems to make it worse. And by some weird coincidence, the two ended up training for an upcoming soccer match together?!

title: Marriage Purple
description: Rin Suzumiya gets into the high school of her dreams, but she ends up in the same class as Yukichi Sakamoto, a total jerk who always picked on her when they were in elementary school. It seems like nothing's changed about Yukichi in the three years that they hadn't seen each other, so when he tells her to write her name on a piece of paper, she does it just to make him go away. However, Rin completely misses that it was a marriage registration form! And to make matters worse, Yukichi refuses to give it back unless she stops avoiding him for 3 years! How is Rin going to survive high school now that she's stuck with such a tyrant?

title: Suki ni Natta Doukyuusei wa Shuukatsusei deshita
description: The classmate she's interested in actually wants to die…?!

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Boku no Koto ga Suki Janai
description:
My girlfriend Chisa is in love with another guy. I won't do anything she doesn't want to, and I won't lay a finger on her. Simply because she has someone she likes who isn't me. However, I know that one day she'll show to me the same face she shows to the one she loves, and I'll continue being her boyfriend today too——.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [MagaPoke](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/title/01769/episode/347962)

title: I Can't Give You the Valentine's Day Chocolate I Made!
Kurahime to Koikarasu
description:
Asaki Hibana (16), a member of the Hibana family, a prestigious family of exorcists, is a once-in-a-century genius, but because she can see demons that ordinary people cannot, she is regarded as weird by those around her, and she is worried about not being able to make friends. Asaki's grandfather, the current head of the Hibana family, tells her that her condition for quitting as an exorcist is to capture the Hibana family's sworn enemy, the Yatagarasu clan. While Asaki is struggling to find Yatagarasu, a mysterious transfer student, Amahara Ten, appears in front of Asaki and suddenly kisses her hand and says, “I am Yatagarasu, the crow whose life you saved.”.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Manga Park](https://manga-park.com/title/99830)

title: Momiji to Kouyou
description:
Konno Ao is a beautiful high school girl known as “The Prince”. Touyama Kouyou, a boy who used to tease her relentlessly back in elementary school, kept confessing his love to her.

“I dislike boys; I like girls.”

That was the reason Ao gave when she rejected him. But after that, the person who appears before her is… “Momiji”, Kouyou transformed into an exceedingly cute girl.

Carrying past guilt and current love, Momiji declares, “I’ll prove I can be the best girlfriend to you.”.

Even though it shouldn't, for some reason, Ao's heart begins to race. The curtain opens on a springtime-of-youth romcom full of mistakes.

title: Prince Prince
description: The top female stars of the school are in constant competition. Each has a harem, gets excellent grades, and is beloved by all. How will the supreme Prince be decided? Kaoru may look the part, but she's a reluctant Prince.

title: Ashita wa Kitto Tomodachi Janai, Yone
description: Akari và Mikage là bạn thời thơ ấu từ khi học mẫu giáo. Akari thích Mikage, nhưng không nói cho cậu ấy biết. Akari muốn ủng hộ hạnh phúc của Mikage, người được các bạn nữ chú ý. Tuy nhiên, Mikage đã từ chối cô gái vừa tỏ tình và nói "Chúng ta hông thể vì tôi có người tôi thích rồi."

title: Horror Anthology Comic Shikaku Kureta Ai
description:
From just beyond your field of vision—

The gem of horror anthologies, “Comic Shikaku (Blindside),” returns with an all-new lineup!

Nine brand-new stories that explore the thin boundary where love and madness meet.

title: Watashi to Dasshutsu Shimasen ka?
description: Cô ấy có vẻ ngây thơ và ít nói trong lớp. Nhưng Tojino-san thực sự là một người đam mê những trò chơi vượt ngục (gần như bị ám ảnh)! Tsunemi, một cậu bé “suy nghĩ quá nhiều về mọi thứ” đã phát hiện ra sở thích của cô. Bây giờ hãy để trò chơi bắt đầu!

title: Class Maid (Shimamura)
description: Otaku schoolboy Arise Riku, who is solely interested in female anime characters, is a fan of Yu-Tan from the maid cafe. However, he comes to find that Yu-Tan is actually Maejima Yuuko and sits next to him in class. He decides to give up his feelings, but...

title: Mai-HiME
description: Yuuichi Tate is overjoyed: He gets to go to a brand new high school. Of course, then he just happens to find out the school he choose is under frequent attack by strange creatures called ''Orphans'', and the school set up a special task force of female members called ''HiME''s, using various elements as their powers, to battle these invaders. That's not all, though. Each member of the HiME task force has their own, unique ''Key'', another person whom, upon being discovered, can team up with the HiME to create a ''Child'', a combative unit specifically needed to effectively battle these Orphans. And with Yuuichi's luck, he just happens to find out he's not just the ''Key'' for one of the HiMEs, but for two… Two highly competitive, rival schoolgirls. And that's only the start of the trouble.

title: @17 Years Old, We Start Living Together From Today!
description: "I was planning for us to stay just friends… but I'm not holding back anymore." I'm living with my childhood friend turned savage! My heart won't stop throbbing as each day passes and he just won't give up…!! After entering high school, Hiyori is finally able to fulfill her dream of living alone. Or so she thought… Her childhood friend Soushi is there waiting for her at her new apartment. He suddenly kisses her and Hiyori is unable to hide her confusion. Is he teasing her? Or is this for real…? For the first time, she begins to see Soushi, who she'd never paid too much attention to before, as a man. At the age of 15, Hiyori begins her radical, new life living with Soushi!

title: Rena's Indecent Misunderstandings!
description: Rena, a young woman with an irresistible charm, constantly finds herself, despite herself, in ambiguous situations. Yet behind every obscene misunderstanding lies a far more mundane and unexpected reality, far removed from what the perverse imagination had conjured up.

title: Spice Girls
description: Teacher Graduation - sequel to "[in secret...?](https://mangadex.org/manga/13445)"

title: Koi wa Inamono Komarimono
description:
One day, Takeda, an overly serious model student, suddenly received a passionate confession of love from his rival Fukamachi, a frivolous elite who's top tier in looks, brains and athletic abilities. Takeda has only ever seen Fukamachi in a hostile manner and he's been going all out in rejecting the latter's persistent advances.

Then one night, he got dragged into helping Fukamachi who was out helping his private detective brother to look for a lost cat. That's when Takeda saw an unexpected side of Fukamachi who he always thought he would never be able to get along with...

This is the bumpy high school romance between a carefree, frivolous and handsome natural genius and an overly serious and straight-laced model student who just don't get along. Less...

title: Gyugyutto Takahashi
description:
Videogames x Showa Culture x Glamour! A voluptuous and fascinating book for those that enjoy the Showa Era and playing video games! A large collection of stories, published in Harta by Benitsubaki's author, Takahashi Hirona, all in one volume!

Two glamorous folk tales, including "Glamorous-suteyama", a glamorous rearrangement of the Ubasuteyama legend!
When a witch fostering a planet sprays it with some water, torrential rains begin to pour from above in "My first planet"
"Shiramari" is a super idol whose singing voice makes people so happy they could die!
And of course, the series of 16 shorts "It's okay to play games", the antithesis of being given a cold look while you're playing video games!

Full of bright, fantastical ideas, all these gems from Harta's new wave, Takahashi Hirona, in a single volume!

title: Tsukiatte Kudasai
description: A young high school boy falls in love with the ghost of a student.

title: Na man ui Gyeyakcheonsa
description: After being traumatised from getting forcefully outed, Yeonho, a closeted gay, is a "single-for-life" who has never dated anyone. One day, Yeonho gets hit by a shooting star, and he woke up to see someone, who calls himself "Cupid", sharing his bed! The strange man promised to end Yeonho's one-sided crushes, but will he really…?

title: Nagi no Asukara
description: A story between the Sea and the Earth. Childhood friends Hikari and Manaka, who live in the sea, together with their friends Kaname and Chisaki, are forced to attend school on land after their own undersea school is closed. But due to a special encounter, their lives gain a new twist.

title: Kyun to Shite, Yamagami-kun!
description:
Ookawa and Yamagami were childhood friends, close like brothers...or were they? Their relationship became strained after Yamagami, who used to be a bit of a dodder, transformed into a high-spec, elite, glasses-wearing guy.

"Oh, I wish I had a kinder, cuter female childhood friend."

Whether Ookawa's wish was granted or it was a whim of the gods, Yamagami was cursed with the following: "When he sneezes, he turns into a woman" and "When he feels love, he turns back into a man." (Ookawa is cursed to remain a virgin forever.) The key to this "love" lies with his awful childhood friend, Ookawa...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: No Bra
description: This is a story about 2 childhood friends, Masato and Yuki, that reunite as teenagers. Masato is surprised to find that Yuki has become so cute, but even more surprised to realize that Yuki was, and still is, a guy. Yuki's affection for cross-dressing leaves Masato with feelings of discomfort and fright.

title: Dreamcide
description:
Hazin Nam had always been plagued by nightmares, but one day, he dreams of an apocalyptic world seven years in the future where humans are fighting to survive among demons and zombies. Hazin dismisses the dream as another nightmare until he finds out Yuri Hong, the girl he had seen in his dream, has transferred into his school….  
  
With his ability to switch back and forth between his school life and the oncoming apocalypse, will Hazin be able to prevent what causes the world’s destruction?

title: Hana to Konjou: Boudai Danshi ni Koishimashita.
description: Kitayama Hatsuki works part-time at a flower shop where she met an intimidating “officer” - Takamiya Ryo. As it turns out, he is the brother of the owner, currently attending National Defense Academy, and was just teasing her with the scary act. Their clumsy flirting is super cute.

title: Nagareboshi ni Negau Hodo Bokura wa Sunao ja Nai
description: Hokuto always seems to have the same dream where he suddenly wakes up and begins to cry. His friend had been involved in an accident but the doctors could not find any serious symptoms despite her falling into a coma. So why can she not wake up?

title: Aishiteruze Baby★★
description: Kippei Katakura is a 17-year-old playboy who spends his time chasing girls, careless of their feelings. But when his 5-year-old cousin Yuzuyu comes to live with his family after her mother's sudden disappearance, Kippei is put in charge of taking care of her. As Kippei gets to know Yuzuyu and starts to understand how she feels, he also begins to realize that all girls were like Yuzuyu once…

title: Mei no Naisho - Make Miracle
description:
Mei Haruna is an effeminate young boy who was raised by his witch mother as a girl and always thought of himself as female. His mother was the only family he had, so after she died, he transfers to an all-girls high school and comes to reside in the school's dormitory with his talking familiar cat Abel, and his roommate Fuuka Honjou, who is also a member of the public morals committee. Shortly after arriving at the school, his new friends discover after a magical display in the dormitory community bath that he is actually male, though this comes as quite a shock to him despite him being aware of the physical differences between him and normal girls.

Despite him being found out, and after some helpful intervening of the perverted student council president, the principal of the school decides that he can stay at the school. The next day, Mei comes to school with Fuuka and apologizes for hiding the fact that he was a witch, and informs the others how he is apparently male. The other stud

title: define.
description: A oneshot by Itsuki Tsutsui, published in the 2018 February Yurihime

title: Sakura no Sono
description: By all appearances, Sakura and her friends are normal, albeit sheltered junior high school girls who enjoy talking about love and walking home from school together. However, they also happen to inhabit a strange and supernatural world populated by mysterious, gigantic beings and unusual plant and animal life. Amid their peaceful lives, Sakura becomes very interested in something only alluded to exist in an old book: dicks.

title: Kirakira to Giragira
description: Lulu Himeji moves house and transfers schools from Sparkle Academy to a school with a very different... "vibe". Waiting for her there is her childhood friend, Zen Gokurakuji. But is he the same as she remembers...?

title: Rookie Pitcher
description:
Jisoo, who dreamed of becoming a fairytale illustrator since she was young, dropped out of school to achieve her dream and went to her grandmother's house, where she meets Dowon.  
  
Dowon, who was worried about not having a dream, is interested in Jisoo who is trying hard to achieve hers.  
  
"The more I try to catch my dreams, the more distant it becomes. When will the day I finally reach my dream come?"

title: Suu-haa-suu-haa-suu-haa-suu-haa
description: Anh main trộm đồng phục crush để ngửi rồi bị phát giác?!

title: Manatsu Labyrinth
description: Akegawa Manatsu, a normal high school girl, and her friends are stuck in school and can't escape, due to some unknown phenomenon. While trying to escape they encounter mysterious things.

title: Ane Comi
description:
The one thing not ordinary about high school student Ryouta is that he has an aspiring manga artist for an older sister. She is so dedicated to her drawing that, despite being 21, she's never really been in a romantic situation. Unfortunately, when she gets her first real job, it's to write an erotic manga. Desperately, she enlists the reluctant Ryouta's help, as a 'model', to figure out how exactly to draw this sort of manga.  
  
The girl, Mana, has no problem with seeing the scenes she plays with her brother as nothing but a hollow reference for her works... But she fails to realize that her brother seems to become more and more flustered with each 'live performance'.

title: Imouto LoveRu
description: What would you wish for if you could make a single wish? Sakura Yamato, an anti-social genius, knows his ideal wish. When at home, as he lives alone, he spends most of his time with his little sister collection, fawning over anything little sister related. Other than them, his only other conversation companion is a stuffed rabbit memento of his long deceased older sister. But one day, the rabbit starts speaking out of nowhere, and claims its feeling for Yamato won't lose to anyone else. After transforming into a woman with rabbit ears, she states she is his sister, coming from Heaven to give him a single wish from God.

title: Opposites in Disguise
description:
The Class Rep and the Student Council President couldn't be more opposite to each other. Unfortunately, they have no choice but to convince their high school that they're in love. When every little thing can end with the two at odds against one another, no one knows how long it will be until they can't keep up the act. Or what might happen if they do.  
  
When does it stop being an act and become. . . something else?

title: Tobita-kun to Sudo-san
description: Sudo Nagiko acquires a boyfriend unwillingly. The boy named Tobita decided to be her boyfriend after calling her ugly. He does not seem the type to take no for an answer, especially after showing Yandere tendencies.

title: The Expressionless Boyfriend and the Quiet Girlfriend
description:
Two people wearing matching earrings, a cool boyfriend and his expressionless girlfriend. How will they react to each other―?

---

description:

Story of blooming romance between recently reunited sisters.  
  
[Shounen]

title: Wazato...
description: A oneshot about 2 schoolgirls.

title: Crayon Days - Daikirai na Aitsu
description:
Because she loved drawing and wanted to do something special, she went to a famous art school.  
And there she met…

title: Ookamidomo no Shitsukekata
description:
Origawa Industry Public High School is a school filled with rough men. There's only one girl in this high school packed with wolves. But this little sheep isn't an ordinary person!  
  
Also includes the following short story:  
Konna watashi ja nashi desu ka?!

title: Aoi-sensei wa Shishunki
description:
Hibari, a high school student, is actually going out with the biology teacher, Aoi. A love between a teacher and student must be kept a secret! Mail, phone, dates, kisses…anything lover-like are all banned! It's a relationship where they will break up if there's even a rumor about them. Because of that, the feelings of love must be protected…  
  
It is a pure and restricted love with the serious biology teacher, the love of a heart throbbing every day will begin!  
  
Pt/Br:  
Hibari, uma estudante do ensino médio, está saindo com seu professor de biologia, Aoi. Um amor entre professor e aluna que deve ser mantido em segredo! Cartas, telefonemas, encontros, beijos… qualquer coisa que se pareça com um relacionamento está banido! É um relacionamento que terminará se houver algum boato sobre eles. Por isso, os sentimentos de amor devem ser protegidos…   
  
É um amor puro e restrito com a professora de biologia; o amor de um coração pulsando todos os dias começará!

title: New Danganronpa V3 Comic Anthology
description:
WARNING: THE FOLLOWING COMIC ANTHOLOGY CONTAINS SPOILERS FOR NEW DANGARONPA V3! READ AT YOUR OWN RISK!  
  
Based on the game of the same name, a variety of authors and artists write a large offering of short stories starring the various characters featured in the game. The stories range from being lovingly heartfelt, packed full of comedy and gags or being downright evil or messed up sometimes!  
  
Note: These are NOT doujin. These are official comic anthologies licensed by Spike Chunsoft, the developers of the Danganronpa series.

title: Nisekoi Doumei.
description: Aizawa-kun is my fake boyfriend, my partner in our sweet, secret crime. One fateful day, in a classroom after school, we saw his girlfriend and my boyfriend stabbing us both in the back. That’s where our relationship as co-conspirators started. As an imitation of theirs. Our relationship is sweet, but painful. Within the lie, I feel a twinge in my heart from my true feelings. This is our love story.

title: Hantsu x Trash: Very Naughty One-shot Collection
description:
《青春水球社》是由日本漫画家小林雏作画的漫画。主要讲述了滨路好不容易考上高中，但是每天却都无所事事，对什么都不感兴趣只幻想着跟女孩子亲热。  
某天2年级学长中岛突然邀请他加入社团，还夸口说社团里的女孩子都随他摸任他揉，这番话让滨路完全无法招架而决定加入，结果才发现是“水球社” 。第一天前往社团，他所展现的过人弹跳能力就让2年级的萩原学姊相当惊讶，她的鼓励让原本有些失望的滨路打算试试看。

title: Nonfiction Phrase
description: Movie lover Seo Dongju and genius composer Han Dawoon's first encounter couldn't be worse! But after they accidentally reunite at school and get acquainted, they grow more and more curious about each other… The two boys’ chaotic and heart-fluttering melody unfolds~

title: The World of Mine
description: A story about boys and girls in an art club.

title: Someone else's BL Manhwa
description:
Seunghee may seem like a regular high school boy, but he's got a few secrets: he loves to cross-dress and read BL comics. He's looking for a match that will accept him, but it's classmate Seungtaek who spies him on a date gone bad. Now that someone at school knows he's gay, can Seunghee's life remain ordinary the way he likes it?

description: A Young boy and girl live under one roof and go through the ignorance and troubles of youth. The warmly-influenced ultra-popular girl goes through a mix of confusing feelings as she experiences her youth.

description:
A manga anthology by Kuzushiro

1) Ryuuzaki-san to Torao-san
A side story of Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san about Otome Ryuuzaki and Mari Torao, vice-president and president of the student council at their high school.

title: I Could Just Tell
description:
somehow i can understand.  


---

title: "Bungaku Shoujo" to Shinitagari no Pierrot
description:
The "mysterious school comedy" centers on the unusual members of a high school literary club. Tooko Amano, a high school senior who calls herself the "literary girl" as the club president, is actually a supernatural creature (youkai) that devours stories, she tears pages from books to munch on them. Her club subordinate is Konoha Inoue, a second-year high school boy who writes stories every day for Amano to eat. He once wrote an award-winning novel, but he wrote it under the pen name Miu Inoue so readers thought the author was a mysterious 14-year-old bishoujo novelist. The stress from the novel's fame and its movie and television drama plans turned Inoue in an introverted recluse.  
  
Adapted from the "Bungaku Shoujo" series of light novels

title: JK Yuusha to Inkyo Maou (Pre-serialization)
description: When the Eighth Generation Heroine Asuka Kagurazaka agrees to mutually lay down arms with the Dark Lord, he has but one stipulation... Can he crash on her couch???

title: Yankee-chan Can't Be Honest
description:
"My childhood friend is... pretty cute."
Yuusuke Hiyoshi, an ordinary high school boy, is Meiko Yashiro's childhood friend, the most feared Yankee girl at school! Wanting to help her find some female friends, Yuusuke suggests, "Why don't you try shortening your skirt first?"

This is the Innocent Yankee Girl x Honor Student Childhood Friend's cute and complicated love comedy!

title: Senpai no Tokubetsu
description: From the 25th Sunday Battle 8, theme: oshi.

title: High Teen Boogie
description: Momoko Miyashita is at the top of her class at school, but her home life is another story. An orphan, she lives with her aunt and cousin and works long hours at their coffee shop. One day, a transfer student named Shou Fujimaru joins her class. He looks like a delinquent with his pompadour, motorcycle, and leather jacket, but in reality, he's the son of a distinguished family. He falls in love with Momoko, and is ready to do anything to meet her standards, but a romance like this won't be accepted by the people around them…

title: Seitokaichou no Ura no Kao
description: Thì có "anh này" và "chị này" đang hẹn hò với nhau. "chị này" là hội trưởng hội học sinh và thích bạo dâm XD.

title: Koibito ga Ubu Sugite Komaru
description: Hasegawa, a quiet high school student who had been suddenly confessed to by Hiyama, the class' outgoing and cheerful guy. When Hasegawa asked, "What do you do when you're dating?" Hiyama's proposal was a diary exchange. Despite the unexpected innocence, Hasegawa accepted the confession. Two classmates who had never spoken in class gradually closed the gap and discovered love—a pure and innocent youth story!

title: Top Dog Kim Jian
description:
A loser named Kim Jian transferred to Sujung High School... But actually, he’s the top dog of them all... and he's a girl!!
Jian’s parents, worried about their troublemaking daughter who’s been in fights with boys in the past, want to send her only to an all-girls school. But Jian wants to attend a co-ed school.
In the end, she’s allowed to go—on the condition that she'll disguise herself as a boy and keep it quiet...
But it’s already getting noisy!! -_-^

title: Please Show Up!
description:
One day, Kim Jiyong, an ordinary student, dreams of a girl named Jeong Jihye and falls in love with her at first sight. But when he tries to find her... it turns out that the woman committed suicide 2 years ago?! The romantic story of Jiyong who wants to return Jihye's life, Please Show Up!

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/LOVE/qingxianshenba/list?title_no=1652)

title: Perfect Complex
description: Soo-hee Cheon is a high school teacher dedicated to her job. When summer vacation begins, she decides to download a dating app to spend the night with a girl to relieve some stress. But, when she arrives at their agreed upon meeting location, she meets a familiar face…

title: A Typical Scene in a Locker Room
description: She likes him… ?

title: Cube x Cursed x Curious
description:
Yachi Haruaki is a high school boy. He is naturally resistant to curse and his father Honatsu sends him cursed instruments called "Worse" to let him break the curse. One day, Haruaki receives a black cube from Honatsu. At the night, he encounters a naked silver haired girl stealing rice crackers. She is the human-form of the black cube, an instrument of torture called "Fear in Cube". Haruaki and the girl 'Fear' fight together against other 'Worse' instruments and their owners using Fear's 32 mechanisms of torture.  

[See AnimeNewsNetwork for the anime.](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=12992)

title: Ordinary Girl
description: Evelyn's life is so monotonous. Well… at least until a boy who claimed to be from the world of magicians came to fetch her.

title: Okubyoumono ni I Love You
description: Due to his scary face, Shougo has been alone since entering university. But unexpected events lead him to become close with Hina, from the same university. Shougo, elated at the fact he's become friends with the cool and kind Hina, finds out that Hina breaks out into hives when people treat him with affection - a "love allergy"?!

title: Katteni Kaizou
description:
The story follows the crazy misadventures of Kaizo Katsu, a former child prodigy turned weirdo after his female childhood friend, Umi, kicked him off a jungle gym in the playground, and he got a huge bump in the head.  
  
With this set up, Kaizo (believes he is a cyborg) and his classmates, Umi (will go revealing her dark side with every chapter), Suzu, and Chitan (an inferior being?), will treat in every chapter a different topic of life with the hilarious and interesting way of thinking of the author Kumeta. The attacks of different geniuses/weirdos will create a lot of funny situations.

title: Uma Himesama to Shika Ouji
description:
Mahoro is a high school girl who loves her teacher.
She studied hard to get her teacher to like her, but as a result, she is now a college student making her debut in a rural area, and is at a loss for what to do with her life for the first time!
What will Mahoro see in the ancient city of Nara?

title: My Wife Is the Union Leader of Martial Arts Circles
description: He was originally just your average joe, but he was chosen by the female martial arts union leader, Murong Ying, to be her husband because of his pure yang physique. The 11 years of cultivation he absorbed from Murong Ying helped kickstart his cultivation career, allowing him to dominate the campus, become an escort, become an island owner, and fight on his own path. After finally reaching the immortal realm, he became the world's number one hero.

title: XO Sisters
description:
Our protagonist Jo Cheul-Hee is a delinquent who enjoys picking fights and aims to take control of his new school where he gets transferred, but what he doesn't know is that it's an all girls school.  
  
Being the only male student there, everyone thinks he is gay!

title: Happiness
description:
This is a collection of eight stories (there are 9 chapters, because story 6 is composed of chapters 6 and 7).  
  
Story 1: Teased and Stepped On, What Blooms is a Passionate Flower  
Describes the relationship between a girl and her teacher.  
  
Story 2: Lolita #7  
Features the relationship between two cousins, an older male and a younger girl. One is a teacher, while the other is a student – both at the same school. When the elder cousin doesn’t come to class for several days, the school administrators send the younger cousin to the elder cousin's home to investigate further.  
  
Story 3: Song of the Devil  
  
Story 4: What If?  
  
Story 5: Happiness  
  
Story 6: A Room of Clouds (chapters 6 - 7)  
A simple minded girl who tries to live her life the best she can.  
  
Story 7: Indigo Elegy  
  
Story 8: Underground Doll

title: Cherry Pink & Sugar High
description:
Since he was a child, Yukishiro Ibuki has always had a complex of getting red-faced whenever someone gets close to him. But thanks to his efforts, he successfully creates a persona of being the "aloof student council president"! His high school life is smooth-sailing... until his childhood friend Kagachi Rin, who knows his past, transfers into his school! Ibuki is wary of Rin's assertive advances, but...?

This is the start of an electrifying "special training" with his childhood friend who gets too close.

title: Fukuwa-san in the Back Seat
description: A boy tries to make his shy classmate ventriloquist girl speak.

title: Chou Shin-Uchuu Yori Ai wo Komete (oneshot)
description: Lulu, an alien princess from outer space, suddenly appears in front of the high school girl Ten Teradate. Ten is told that she has been chosen to be Lulu's companion, and the two begin to live together. At first, Ten felt confused about the situation, but gradually she is moved by Lulu's heartfelt feelings...

title: Do You Like an Assertive Kouhai?
Tsukihime－A piece of blue glass moon－Anthology Comic STAR
description: An anthology of Tsukihime－A piece of blue glass moon－created through a collaboration of artists who love Tsukihime.

title: Tani the Mask
description: The story is of a masked boy, Tani, a strong young man, who has a crush on a girl named Shima Rihoko, the school volleyball star. He gets into trouble trying to get her attention, besides facing the thugs of the school. He’s a very jealous guy, and will not let anyone get close to Shima-san.

title: Choku!
description: Mizuhashi Nao is a 16 year old, who is shy and friendless. He passes his class breaks in the toilet playing games where he won't be bothered. One day an upperclassman appears peaking from above and with a huge nosebleed that covers him with blood. Her name is Serika. Wait, a girl?! What is a girl doing in the boys restroom? And why did she just ask him out on a date? Nao's world is about to be turned upside down.

title: Mukashi wa Chibi no Kobundatta no ni…
The Girl Who Buys the Same Drink as Her Male Friend Every Single Day
description: Why do you always buy the same drink as me? Do you like me or something?

title: I Like Gal-chan Who Only Wears Glasses When Studying.
Mirumo-sama ga Miteru
description: Maki, who lives next door, is a messy childhood friend I'm a bit interested in. For some reason, the cat she picked up, Mirumo, started talking only to me, Yuichi Kuchioka! Huh? It's going to help me get closer to Maki?

title: Yamada no Gakkyuu Nisshi
description:
Yamada, a super serious girl, is the only female student in a previously all-males school. Not minding that she is called "boring," and "overly-serious," by those around her, she spends her days working hard to get a scholarship, for which she'll do anything. 

One day, she is told by her homeroom teacher that if she can get a truant classmate named Murata to go to school, he'll give her good marks and Yamada reluctantly agrees. When she heads to the game center Murata's at, standing before her is a frivolous boy who's surrounded by girls?!

title: My First Evil
description:
In the spring of Kyoko's first year in high school, Eiko, a girl like a sister to her, returns with her younger brother, Jiro.  
The return isn't that big of a deal, but Jiro (self-proclaimed super mad scientist) has it in his head that he wants to operate on Kyoko! And, what's even more, the two of them are actually high ranking members of an evil organization on the run from the heroes of justice!  
As if high school didn't have enough problems already, now she has to deal with these two living with her.

title: After School, There Are Faces That the Cool Minagawa-san Shows Only to Me
Rabukome Jikken Manga
description: Released on May 5th, 2023 for the COMITIA144 doujinshi event, a one shot about a boy and a girl simply talking in a classroom.

title: Ghost Wife
description:
Gisin, who appeared suddenly like a ghost, said something strange like Do you want to be my wife…   
Soon after, ghosts became visible to Eunah and started to chase after her wanting to eat her.

title: Ikioi dake de Kaita Gyaru-chan to Otaku-kun no Romcom Manga
Oi!! Oba-san
description: Tooru Sawada not only goes to the same school as his young aunt Sugako but has to live with her under the same roof! Somehow Tooru always ends up being dragged into his beautiful and mischievous aunt's pranks and shenanigans.

title: How Can I Be Your Model? There's Just No Way!!
description: She might've said no, but her actions tell a different story...

title: Ore no Koto Suki da to Omotteta noni
description: Hana Yoshikawa, a scatterbrained high schooler, leads the person sitting next to her in class, Haru Miyao, to believe that she has feelings for him. However, when he confesses his feelings for her, she rejects him. But is there more to it? A series consisting of short, 4-page chapters.

title: Mazinger Z
description:
One of the first Super Robot manga and the one that introduced most of the traits of the Mecha genre. Constructed with the Super-Alloy Z, Mazinger was built by Professor Juzo Kabuto as a weapon against the Mechanical Beasts of the evil Dr. Hell. Koji Kabuto, the grandson of Professor Kabuto, becomes the pilot of Mazinger Z when his grandfather is killed, and battles from there on against Dr. Hell and his allies. This is the first series that introduced the concept of a pilot inside a Mecha, which all series from then on have followed.  
  
**Note: the scanlation uses Kodansha version which altered the chapters order, includes TV Magazine chapters, some pages were altered(like redesigns for Sayaka, Professor Yumi and Brocken) and there's missing pages, the missing chapters of Shonen Jump serialization along with some TV Magazine chapters were moved to Great Mazinger volume 1.**

title: Hana to Rakurai
description: A bunch of love problems surround her life. Futamura Umiho is a girl with a weak personality. A new flower is about to bloom! A fresh and inspirational story is blooming. A love between flower and thunder!

title: Switch Oshitara Ore ga Joshi!?
description: Truyện romcom của 2 thanh niêm ế ở làng quê nọ, chắc chắn không có gì gei cấn ở đây cả

title: Omote demo Ura demo Ijimerareteru (Fan Colored)
Yankee ni Deshiiri Saremashite.
description: Urara is an ordinary high school girl who loves cats and is loved by them. Today, seeking solace from cats, she visits her secret hideout where she can interact with many stray cats. There, she is approached by Izumi Hyuga, a delinquent covered in blood, who asks to be certified as a "kitty master" and become her apprentice...!?

title: Madonna Lily
description: Juri, Makoto, Mitsugu, and Kanon serve on the student council of a prestigious girls' high school and are the school's flowers, admired by all for their beauty and excellence. They are the symbols of purity of the school, like the Madonna Lilies, the white lilies dedicated to Mary, the Holy Mother. Yet, there is a hidden side to these girls: Juri's life revolves around a forbidden love; Makoto is involved with sugar daddies, and so forth. The fact that these white lilies are getting stained by their own sediment cannot be stopped by anyone any more.

title: Seasons of Canvas
description: Soo Ah gave up her dream of becoming an artist due to her parents' opposition, Jade came to Korea to find her mother who had never seen her face since her father's death. She works as Butler at the Yuchae School, a noble school attended by Soo Ah. Looking for traces of her mother, Jade meets Soo Ah, who hangs on her dreams, helping her out, the developing feelings of love.

title: Lock On!
description:
Utsuru Sanada is a professional photographer at the age of 17, he can guess the exact 3 sizes of any girl, he can memorize anything he sees, and he can counterattack karate moves (most guys would want these abilities). Why? Because he has superb photographic memory called “Shutter Eye” (as in the shutter of a camera). He meets Niko Kurihara, the female protagonist, who dislikes men, is a master of martial arts, and is of course beautiful. Utsuru attempts to prove to Niko that he is not the guy she thinks he is so that he can take a picture of her. He starts by investigating Niko’s friend’s date, who appears to be a deceptive guy according to rumors…  
  
Ran as a one-shot in 2009; started serialization in 2010.

title: Samurai High School
description: In a modern country where the government is controlled by a Martial Shogun and samurai receive much respect, there lives fraternal twins of the Sakakido family. Kou, the brother, is very feminine, excels at cooking, cleaning, arts and crafts. Tsukiko, the sister, is masculine, loves fighting and is a combat genius. The twins learn about the Samurai High School, where men test their strength and women test their femininity, but the only way they can attend is by swapping places. If they are to be found cheating, they will be executed so they have to overcome their gender differences and maintain their secret.

title: Garden in the Closet
description:
Kouki is a high school student with a large build who fits in effortlessly with the guys. Yet deep down, he often feels bewildered by the topics of their conversations and finds himself unable to openly share his extensive knowledge of plants. 

One day, a transfer student named Misaki joins their class. However — for some reason — Misaki remains completely invisible to Kouki alone. While everyone around him interacts with Misaki as if nothing's wrong, Kouki is left wondering: What kind of expressions is he wearing as he speaks to him? 

Before he knows it, Kouki finds himself constantly tracking Misaki with his eyes; through him, he is destined to confront a world he never knew existed.

**Alt Raw:** [Pixiv](https://comic.pixiv.net/works/13052), [Cmoa](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/356612/vol/7/)

title: Kinkyori Ren'ai
description: Uni is a prodigy with a cool reserve who is accomplished in everything except for English. One day, she insults her temporary English teacher and he overhears her. He asks her to come to his office after school and, somehow, she starts receiving private tutoring from him?!

title: Koi no Iroha wo Oshiete
description: From Himnae Scans : Rin gets dumped by her first boyfriend after a week of dating because she's "too uptight", all this in front of Matsukaze-senpai, to whom she eventually ends up confiding...

title: Yamada-san wa gyaru ni nari kirenai
description: Yamada-san wants to be a gyaru, but she doesn't know how to become one.

title: Tensei Shimai no Otoge Kouryaku - Ane, Chanto Flag Tateyou yo!
description: Himari is the plain sibling, whereas Yuri, her older sister, is the perfect superhuman. Yuri, Himari's pride and joy as well as the source of her inferiority complex, suddenly disappears one day. A year later, Himari gets a phone call from an unknown number, and it is Yuri who has reincarnated in an Otome game! Himari is supposed to help Yuri navigate her way to the ending of the game so that she can return to reality, but Yuri has skipped through all the flags...?

title: I'm a Good Kid, But I Still Want to Do It!
description:
"Don't provoke me too much, what if I lose my control?"  
Sudou kun gets angry but.. "what will happen, then?".  
Kaori was curious,and unconsciously provoked him in a room just the two of them. "Sudou-kun… do you feel it?"   
  
What will happen to honour students couple? what will happen to their relationship?  


---

Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Shiotaiou na Watashi ga Amayaka Sareteimasu
description:
“You’re being way too sweet to the salty me… How troubling!!” An older company worker, a soccer club ace, and a childhood friend… Salty girls who want to live life quietly vs. overly sweet ikemen, a new one-shot series that will make you laugh and have your heart flutter.

Contains 4 one-shots:
1. Shiotaiou na Watashi ga Amayaka Sareteimasu (塩対応な私が甘やかされています; My cold self is being spoiled)
2. Osananajimi Renai Ron (幼馴染恋愛論; The childhood friends' dispute)
3. Tadashii Heroine no Tsutomekata (正しいヒロインの務め方; How to be a proper heroine)
4. Baito Senshi wa Shizuka ni Kasegitai (バイト戦士は静かに稼ぎたい; The part-time worker wants to earn money)

title: Kanaete Aizen
description: Aizen Kanou, just like any high-school boy, yearns for a girlfriend. But he's so painfully shy he flees when any girl tries to talk to him. Except his childhood friend, Yuzu, who scolds him for being so shy. But she leaves behind a temple love-charm. That night in his room Kanou uses the charm to demand heaven grant him his wish for a beautiful girl. When he wakes up in the morning, he finds his wish has been granted–and the beautiful girl is himself.

title: Akuma no Ikenie
description:
Hajime lives with the twin sisters of the family of the Komatsu shrine. Inori is of a very spiritual bent and often tries to use her 'powerful' heirloom rosary to protect her friends and family from evil. The other sister, Kanau, is more practical. She often spends time trying to keep Hajime from groping women, which he is always doing by accident.  
  
Amidst strange vampire-like murders in the community, Hajime has had a dream of a hot female demon called Satan that is lusting after his blood. Soon enough, she appears in his waking life, along with her alter ego Lucifer. After an embarrassing situation at school, Hajime and the shrine twins end up taking Satan/Lucifer into their home. Why are these demons attracted to Hajime, and what do they really want?

title: Oshi Atteru Futari
description:
"The student president is always so perfect, I admire him so much... he's really my ideal person." Mashiro Amane is a second year high school girl with a thing for handsome boys with black hair.

She's secretary to the student council, and all she can think about is Tsubaki, who looks like her absolute ideal guy. Meanwhile, Tsubaki is a third year student and president of the student council. He's cool, he takes no nonsense...and when he's with Mashiro, there's one thought looping in his head: "She's so cute!" The student council watches on as this will-they-won't-they romance unfolds, obvious to everyone but the pair themselves. What will they do when their feelings for each other are finally revealed...?!

title: Seiseki Fushin no Onna no Ko: Ore "Soko o Nantoka…"
Heartsick
description:
As two girls with completely different personalities meet each other, their share of interests resulted in them coming together. However, both of them face a hard journey ahead by being in different cities and having difficult parents…  
Author Weibo: <https://www.weibo.com/u/5360925536>

title: Doridosim
description: With Kang Dol's crush on Yang Yang growing larger and larger, he decides to confess his feelings. With his back turned against her, he makes a courageous confession. But when he opens his eyes and turns around, instead of Yang Yang, he finds Min Dosim standing in front of him. Oops?! But the more shocking twist is that Dosim, the school's most popular girl, mistakenly obliges and they decide to go out! What is Kang Dol supposed to do to fix this mess?

title: Emochi Does Not Care About the Otaku!
description: [Alt Official Raw (niconico Manga)](https://seiga.nicovideo.jp/watch/mg784379?track=ct_episode)

title: Nonke to Gachi no Osananajimi
description: On Valentine’s day. The top ikemen (cool boy) in the school, Hiko, is the most popular in the school among the girls again this year! At this time, the girls all gather, aiming for the ikemen Hiko… “Take this! My heart’s desire!” Reverberating through the hallways is a passionate confession. And the person who delivered the handmade chocolates was his childhood “boyfriend”!    The Hiko who wants to stay friends and the Ken-chan who wants to become lovers, the intersection of the two different meanings of “like”–…? An earnest and simple “pure romance”? Comedy!

title: Kokuhaku Biyori
description: This is a collection of short stories depicting the beginnings of love by Nakamura Hinata. Four cute and tender stories to bring a smile to your face.

title: Kitchen Princess
description: Najika is a great cook and likes to make meals for the people she loves. But something is missing from her life. When she was a child, she met a boy who touched her heart–and now Najika is determined to find him. The only clue she has is a silver spoon that leads her to the prestigious Seika Academy. At Seika she meets two brothers Daichi and Sora, could one of them be the boy from her childhood?

title: Dr. Duo
description: For Shinonome Keisuke, high school student Kotone Tasuku is the only person in the world whom he can communicate with. Once a brilliant surgeon, Shinonome passes away at a young age, only to wander the world as a ghost, a ghost that only Tasuku can see and talk to. When an accident leaves Tasuku’s hot childhood friend Takeuchi Mai’s younger brother severely injured, the only way that he can survive is if Shinonome and Tasuku work together to become the most unusual and possibly talented pair of emergency surgeons the country has ever seen!

title: Watashi wo Misete, Ore wo Mite
description: High school student Mochizuki loves to dress up as a woman. While he was out cross-dressing one day, fellow student Amano, who's known for being a playboy, tries to pick him up! Not wanting to be found out, Mochizuki runs away. However, the next day at school, Amano discovers the truth and tells him he'll keep his secret under a certain condition…

title: Yoru ni Kikasete
description:
Miya's classmates hurry her to stop Harutaka from leaving the school, as Itone plans to confess to him. However, amidst the chaos, she mistakes Harutaka's name and shouts out a different name in front of many people.
After becoming the school's laughingstock, Harutaka persuades Miya to start calling each other by their first names, just so the joke dies out.
A few days later, they're set up to go with their class to the mountains for a training camp. This is when Itone finally finds an opportunity to confess to Harutaka, and they start going out.
Miya, finding out about it, is shocked and hurt because she thought she could become someone special to Harutaka.
Yura, Haturaka's friend, finds her being all emotional and tells her that she should start liking him instead. He takes the opportunity and asks her if he could kiss her, to which she complies.

title: Pure Love Hippocrates
description:
Being a medical student, what is the authenticity of a medical student?  
  
Jang Joon Hyuk, a ex-mechanical engineering student, feels like a boomer around all the freshmen when he goes back to medical school!

title: Yokoshima Syndrome
description: A boy is suffering from a condition where his pheromones are strongly attracting some random girls around him, and it's driving them crazy. He asks a girl in his class for help, and she offers to teach him how to handle this problem...

title: Shiinake no Hitobito
description: One day a high school student named Haruhiko who is aiming for Tokyo University has discovered a very important secret. From the closet, appeared a beautiful girl with a black pony tail, Utsuki who came from "Moon Village" with her Ninja Troop said to him, "It's been 7 years, master."

title: 1 Love 9
description: Takuma Miyabe is a boy from an island who moved to Tokyo because his island doesn't have a high school there. However, the ratio of male and female is 1:9. There are too many female students in his class, and as a result, they flirt with the still innocent Takuma.

title: Mune ga Naru no wa  Kimi no Sei
description: We were sharing the same feelings but he didn't realize it at all. Even though, I love him. That's what I have always thought for these past two years…

title: Blue Sky Yell
description: Aozora Yell centers on Tsubasa, a girl who saw an inspirational brass band performance at the finals of the Japanese high school baseball championships one summer. Tsubasa vows to join the band when she enters high school, and she happens to meet a certain boy there.

title: The Seven Deadly Sins High School
description: This spin-off manga is a comedy which will re-imagine the sins from the original manga as high school students.

title: Ore no Pantsu ga Nerawareteita
description: Murakami-kun's dream is to have an ideal relationship with a normal girl like in shoujo mangas. One day, a girl finally confesses to him but to his surprise, all she wants is his underwear! Now, what kind of love story will unfold with his underwear at stake?

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury - Rough Sulemio Comic
Akaiito
description: A red thread exists between a guy and girl that are fated to be together, a bond that can't be seen by the naked eye. Finally, this fated romantic love will begin to open its curtain.

title: Naze Toudouin Seiya 16-sai wa Kanojo ga Dekinai no ka?
description: No matter how hard he thinks about it, Todoin Seiya cannot figure out why he doesn’t have a girlfriend in his 16 year lifespan. Physically attractive, naturally smart, athletic and, on top of that, comes from a wealthy and politically significant family. And it’s not like he hasn’t tried either; but every girl he asks out flat out rejects him. Seiya sets a goal for himself to get a girlfriend by the time high school ends and rejection isn’t going to stop him from trying again. But it sure is heartbreaking when you get rejected this many times without knowing why.

title: Boku wa Uchuujin ni Koi o Shita.
description: Tomonaga Kairi is the top student in his year and and a skeptic when it comes to the universe. But one day, he accidentally gets involved with the eccentric Nanbu-senpai, president and the only member of the Space Research Club. What will happen to Tomonaga when she tries to get him to join her club before it gets abolished…!?

title: Her Smile So Sweet
description:
Xu Jingshu of second-year class 1 is a cold person who doesn't talk a lot, and if it weren't for the teacher constantly sending her out of math class as punishment, she may as well be invisible.
That is, until the transfer student Chu Youning shows up. He's attracted to her candy-sweet smile, so on certain afternoons, one could see the god of studying, Chu Youning in the upstairs independent study room teaching math to Xu Jingshu.

title: Lament of the Lamb
description: The members of the Takashiro family share a terrible curse: only human blood can slake their thirst. Sent away after the death of his mother, Kuzuna Takashiro remained blissfully unaware of his 'condition.' When Kazuna's teenage hormones begin to rage, his uncontrollable bloodlust suddenly rears its head…

title: Tensei Yuusha wa Joshikousei!?: Maou no Dekiai ni Komattemasu
description: The hero who lost to the Demon King in his previous life has been reincarnated as a high school girl!? The Demon King is a high school boy! Sages, Wizards, Tricksters, Ex-Heroes and friends unfold the most fun and messy school life  - The fateful romantic comedy of reincarnation is about to begin!!

title: Sanctuary Amnesia Girl
description:
An alternate universe story starring the yuri couple of "Kannazuki no Miko" and "Kyoushiro no Towa no Sora" fame, Chikane and Himeko.  
  
In this series Himeko is a nun who leds a peaceful but lonely life, having lost both her parents and her beloved older sister.  
  
One day she finds a girl hung inside the church, impaled by a sword. The girl, who strongly resembles Himeko's dead sister, is still alive and calls Himeko's name. She reveals that her name is Chikane, but she has a memory loss about everything else.  
  
From that moment, Himeko starts to be targeted by a group of people who want to obtain the "Dragon Cry", which is said to be hidden inside her body. Chikane (after trying to know Himeko "more intimately") vows to protect her.

title: The Kouhai with a Crush on Me is Trying to Make Herself Very Appealing to Me
Au Tabi ni Hikuku Natte Iku Onnanoko
Boku-tachi wa Mada Aoku: Daigaku Nyuugaku-hen
description: Issei Saegusa is a young man who met Touru Arochi, a brusque transfer student, during his senior year of high school. After a series of twists and turns, the two are accepted into the same university. The morning of the entrance ceremony arrives with great anticipation. Although Issei wants to spend more time with Touru, he doesn't want to neglect his studies, either, because he is studying aerospace engineering. Toru, on the other hand, wants to improve his social skills in university. Then, he meets someone new right away...?

title: Kimi ni Sasageru Negaigoto
description: It's Tanabata season, and Yumeno and Nozomi hang their wishes on the bamboo branches. Their wishes are closer to fruition than they initially expected, though…

title: Hell's Angels
description: Amagane Rinne, an up-beat schoolgirl, has died. Even though she is dead, she still needs to go to school. But if she's dead, where would she go to school? In Hell, of course! But making friends in a school filled with demons isn't as easy as it sounds (and it doesn't even sound that easy)…

title: Marmalade Boy
description: All Miki Koishikawa wanted was an ordinary family and that's exactly what she had until her parents decided to move in with another couple (as in switching spouses!) and turned Miki's world upside down. Now she lives in a house with four parents and her totally cute stepbrother, Yuu. It's bad enough being brought into her parents' strange soap opera, but Miki will star in a soap of her own as she deals with friends having affairs, trying to survive in school and ending up torn between her long-time crush, Ginta, and her new stepbrother!

title: CHERRY X CHERRY
description: Kamishiro Tomoki is an Otaku who is studying for college. One day, he received an outrageous "package" from his father: 9 year old blond girls who are his dad's illegitimate children from one of his business trips…… The twins, Selly and Riru are completely spoiled and drives Tomoki crazy. Not only that, the sisters have a "secret" plan to kick out Tomoki and claim the house just for themselves. Will Tomoki manage to make peace with the girls? Read and find out!

title: Moriguchi Oritō School of the Fine Arts
description: Moriguchi Orito is transferring to a new school, but being lost in the fog he can't find his way to it and end up bumping into a beautiful girl and got struck by a vision of her in a very sexy pose. Seeing him with his cellphone in his hand, she thinks he took a picture of her and runs away crying, "My life has ended!", dropping her own cellphone in the process. Finally finding his way to the school, he realises that it's full of very weird people, and that his new seat is next to an empty desk where a bag is hanging with the same strap as the one on the cellphone the beautiful girl dropped…

title: Run Wild
description:
As soon as Jiang Cheng finds out he's adopted, he's abandoned by his adoptive family and sent to live with his deadbeat father, who has a gambling addiction. Everything about his new life, from his pathetic father to the unfamiliar environment, makes Jiang Cheng depressed. But then he meets Gu Fei, who's like a shining bright light in this run-down city, and the two become each other's salvation and hope.
(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mairunovich
description: Kinoshita Mairu has a cute name and she's apologetic for it, because she's ugly. In fact, she's apologetic for her very existence because she's not cute. Classmates call her "Poison Mushroom" behind her back and even her own brother treats her with disdain. However, all of that is about to change with the help of her transgender mentor/neighbor, Fuwari-chan, and the "school king," Kumada Tenyuu!

title: Brother My Brother...
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Nanako enrolls in Seiran Academy, a prestigious girls' school, which is a girl's paradise for gorgeous students known as " Lady Kaoru," "Saint Juste," and so on. The selection committee for the school's social group "Sorority," of which every new student dreams of joining, begins. 

Sorority members are selected by upperclassmen, who vote on their family background, education, appearance, and other factors. Nanako thought she had no connection to this world, but for some reason she was chosen as a candidate...?

Contains 2 oneshots in volume 2: **'Summer in Canterbury'**, & in volume 3: **'Early Spring Trembling'**.

title: Do You Want Me to Lend You a Lighter?
description: In truth, I never wanted to become a teacher. In a moment when I was fulfilling my own responsibilities on the path I chose after giving up my dream, 'Do you want me to lend you a lighter?' A cheeky male student offered. It feels like my life as a teacher is at odds with this cheeky kid, who comes with genius talent, overflowing wealth, and fame as a bonus. A story of school life entwined with dreams, talent, and love.

title: Ambiguously, Again
description:
I realized it was love the moment that person left.  
  
Hiding their feelings for each other, Sehyuk and Yina, who were just friends, eventually end their ambiguous relationship and part ways. Eight years later, Sehyuk, who hears about Yina’s engagement, realizes that he hasn’t moved on… Youthful days that can’t be reversed, a romance of two people who had to live resisting their strong attraction towards each other.

title: Hana to Hoho
description:
This manga features Hohoko, a high school student who lives with her musician father. Yahiro, another student who helps in the school library along with Hohoko, is a fan of her father’s group, Hana to Hoho, and realizes who her father is. Hohoko, a book lover, and Yahiro, a music fanatic, write messages to each other in the school library, where private conversation is forbidden, and thereby gradually get to know each other. Hohoko is decidedly drawn to Yahiro, but what he really likes is her father’s music. The fact that he became friends with her because of her father weighs down on her heavily. Gradually, a secret about Hohoko’s mother that her father has kept from her, along with Yahiro’s views on love that result from past trauma, become clear. The two characters’ chance encounter constitutes the story of one summer in their lives, drawn with a touch of tranquility.  
  
Won a New Face Award from the 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival in 2020.

title: Meteor-san Strike desu!
description:
Everyone lies when they are young, but the lie Kobayashi Hiro told when he was just six haunts him daily to this day. He claimed that he was abducted by aliens, and, even though it was quickly discovered it was a hoax, thanks to national attention, the town became a hotspot and tourist stop for UFO fanatics.  
  
So when the beautiful Yamada Meteor transfers to Hiro’s school, claiming that she is an alien and Hiro is the only one that can save the planet from destruction, he thinks that the whole thing’s a prank. He quickly learns that she isn’t joking.
