Meteor is here to test if humanity is worth saving from the monstrous asteroids headed toward Earth. To prove humanity’s worth to the universe, Hiro must complete the assigned missions, even if they are a little perverted.

title: Haruyo, Koi!
description: Kumoro Tsuyoshi is in his third year in middle school, and is in the midst of studying for his entrance exams. He wants to go to the same school as his childhood friend, Kamijou Haru, who's two years his senior, since she's his crush. Will he succeed?

title: Hatsukoi Shinjuu
description:
Fall from a building, fall in love.  
Shinji was a high school guy without a future.  
He went up to the roof of a building with plans to jump, only to run into his beautiful teacher, Shinanoya-sensei!  
Then she made a shocking proposal that would change Shinji's destiny…  
An exuberant tale of double suicide from the pen of a genius!!

title: His Mystery Girl
description:
The glamorous daughter of the city’s richest family falls from grace- quite literally, as she falls off a building and dies! However, her story is just beginning.
___
**Background Artists:** [Lao Wu](https://mangadex.org/author/986fcf5b-73cb-4b07-ac01-a0acdf9e3297), [Youxia Zhier](https://mangadex.org/author/5a6c167d-4fa8-44ca-b79f-b8c54a09c87f)
**Colorists:** [Amu](https://mangadex.org/author/798b4cd9-1d55-4ef1-9ef0-fa30c8786f90), [MAY Zi](https://mangadex.org/author/fd82d970-a724-4a4b-b443-845d388d606f)

title: Maruko to Suugaku Ouji
description: Momose is a Math genius! He thinks all things can be calculated… That was until he met Maruko Ai, a chaotic girl who believes in 'love angels' and other such things. Maruko has a one-sided love for Momose's childhood friend, and now Momose is surrounded by many problems he can't calculate. And his biggest problem of all… Is it love?!

title: Itsuka, Kimi ga Tonari de Mezametara
description: Aizawa Daichi and Hoshiakari Mei are childhood friends, who meet again after 7 years, one of them hides a secret. A story of a boy and a girl who living to the fullest.

title: My First Blue
description:
***The sparkle, pain and excitement of youth. I will surely reminisce about this first love story with "You".***

Ogino Miho is a first year who has always wanted to fall in love. Soon after starting high school, she gets placed behind the soccer club's Murata-kun, who she ends up talking with more and more each day.... Her first feelings, her first conversation, her first lover––. A story that brings back memories of all your firsts, "your" love story.

title: The Devil and Me and Ichikawa-san
Reverse x Rebirth
description:
Nanase Hina is a girl with an androphobia. She's very happy that she's finally able to enroll in Seika Girls Academy and even became roommates with Yukino Kaede, whom she thinks is the ideal girl; beautiful, refined, and perfect. Except… Kaede is actually not a girl.  
  
Except for the first chapter, the story is mostly from Kaede's point of view. The author herself said he's the real protagonist.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion - Savage Dog Asuka and Grown-up Shin-chan (Doujinshi)
ONCE
description:
Mo Li's appearance is Bai Jiu's salvation, and the hope and light in Bai Jiu's eyes are treasures that Mo Li is willing to do her best to protect. ...Can we give each other another chance?

[Original Webcomic](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/10925/)

title: Aruitou
description: On a hill overlooking the sea, in a town that retains its old-world beauty, a new and gentle love story begins!

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Angelic Days
description: Imagine a Neon Genesis Evangelion where choosing the right girl is more important than saving the world! That's the gist of Angelic Days–the hit manga that Eva fans have been waiting for! Based on a popular PC and Playstation 2 game released only in Japan, Angelic Days takes the angst-ridden Eva pilots and sets them in a lighter, brighter world.

title: Kimi ga Shinanai Hi no Gohan
description: Semimaru is a loner with his only redeeming feature to be studying. Visiting him every night is his female childhood friend, Mika. During an accident, she became a gluttonous spirit ghost while in coma and said, "I cant die because my stomach is empty!". Since then, to let Mika die in peace, he cooks meals and dishes for Mika. However, eventually, the meals slowly change into a "For Mika to Live" cuisine of handmade dishes to preserve her spirit. This is heartwarming story.

title: Haibara-kun wa Gokigen Naname
description: Although Mio wanted to become good friends with Haibara-kun who transferred to her class. But the first impression she received was the worst ever! But since with her grades, she was in danger of getting retained for a year, she has to go beg Haibara-kun to help tutor her??

title: Husky and Medley
description: A manga adaptation based on an internet thread in which a girl attempts to reveal her "perfect" classmate's weak point by confessing her love for her - and the development of their relationship from there on out.

title: Koganeiro
description: "Koganeiro" is about a group of high schoolers in their second year who are confronted with the possibly life-altering decision of what to do after high school.

title: Sayuu Byoudou Shugi
description: Kamio has a one-sided crush on the Basketball Club's manager, Kitano. During their train ride home together, he accidentally touches her chest, and then something strange…!?

title: Naisho ni Shite ne
description:
English:  
Akane is a second year student who enjoys his student life. Tojo, one of Akane’s classmates, is Akane’s new roommate. Until last year Tojo was an ordinary, serious and excellent student, but one day, he suddenly dyed his hair red, got a piercing and started wearing fashionable clothes? The roommate's life began in surprise. One day, Akane saw Tojo sneaking out of the dormitory in the middle of the night! Tojo was Ignoring the dormitory rules and going out to work at night. What is going on? Seems like Tojo has something he wants to keep secret, Akane worries that something might happen to him and is unable to remain indifferent?!  
Welcome to <<Must stay secret>>

title: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru
description:
Mizuho can't believe his ears when Grandpa's will is read out. Grandpa's final wish is for Mizuho to attend the same academy as Mizuho's mother. The catch is it's an all-girls school. With the help of his friend Mariya however, he gets a makeover good enough to fool everyone at the academy.  
  
Based on the visual novel of the same name by Caramel BOX.

title: Boku no Hatsukoi o Kimi ni Sasagu
description: Takuma and Mayu's story began when they were only 8 years old. During his childhood, Takuma was constantly hospitalised due to his heart condition. He soon became friends with Mayu, the daughter of the doctor in charge of his case. Day by day they grew closer and closer. However, the summer when Takuma was 8, he made a promise to Mayu that he couldn't keep… Their story unfolds as they grow older and their bond gets stronger…

title: The Panther's Pet
description: In a world where beastmen and humans coexist, Gaku attends a college that consists of mainly beastman, a rarity in the world. Despite being the subject of his study, he's still not had much close interaction with them... That is until a chance encounter under the tree with Rui. Rui's the resident troublemaker who just so happens to be a leopard beastman. Soon a casual favor quickly leads Gaku into catching the eye of real predator!

title: Uso Kano
description: The boy of my dreams, Iriya-kun, wants a girl to act as his fake lover?! Oh god! This is a great opportunity~ I shall definitely take it! But….

title: Itazura na Kimi ni Mask-goshi demo Koi wo Uchinukareta
description:
“Did you just fall in love with me?”

A mischievous, teasing, but innocent girl in an agonizingly sweet adolescent love comedy, hidden behind a mask.

title: Seiyuu Ka!
description:
Kino Hime is a 15 year-old girl who just started her first year in a high school for voice actors (Seiyuu) called Hiiragi Academy. She dreams of becoming the voice of the main character in one of the most popular series in Japan, "Magic Fighter Lovely Blazers". The academy is the number one school which allows students to make their voice acting debuts and also includes other departments such as general education, sports, music, acting, and art.  
  
Of course this Academy is full of celebrities, too. Two of Hime's upperclassmen are none other than the two rising idols of the group "Idol Unit AQUA".  
  
But Hime's dream is hard to fulfill. Her voice is not really suitable for a voice actress and her new classmate Kudou Senri doesn't waste time in pointing that out. Will Hime prove everybody, especially Senri, what she is capable of despite the first appearance?

title: Oishii Bonnou
description:
[Amagasa Kanro, 16 tuổi, một thiếu nữ không thể cưỡng lại sự cám dỗ của ham muốn!!]
Một câu chuyện hài siêu kịch tính với cảm giác mới lạ giữa một JK (nữ sinh trung học) và một anh chàng đẹp trai bí ẩn! Vô số rắc rối gây ra bởi sự ham muốn(thể xác*) phóng túng trong môi trường học đường.
Ể?! Kotoshiro-kun, cậu định giải quyết chuyện này bằng cách lố bịch như thế à?!
Hãy tận hưởng những tiếng cười không kém phần oái ăm bắt nguồn từ câu chuyện ngọt ngào này!

title: Osananajimi Ni Koishitara
description: Koyuri and Sei-chan are childhood friends who have lived in the same condominium since they were born. they grown up together, but they haven't talked since she was bullied because they were too close and she decided to stop talking to him when they was 6th grade. Now that she's a high school student, she's changed her mind and wants to fall in love and make a boyfriend ...!?

title: Nowhere Boy
description:
"Welcome to Survival, 'I Am Unhappy,' the exciting game show to find the world's unhappiest person! The grand prize… is a wish granted by God!"  
  
When the victor of the game show wishes for the end of the world, God accepts this wish with a set condition: the world's end would proceed over the course of 100 days, and during that time, he is allowed to 'change his mind' only once.  
  
Oh Duk Hee, a quirky comic artist who specializes in unhappiness, is chosen by God to make the unhappiest person on Earth happy again. With the pressure of mankind's destruction riding on her shoulders, will she be able to change his mind before it's too late?  
  
The competition to choose the world's unhappiest human?! The hybrid school fantasy action story by Jung Pil Won!

title: A Scary Story About Small Animals
Future Photography
description: A camera that I picked up by chance takes pictures of the future?!

title: Masamune-kun no Revenge Anthology Comic
description:
Official anthology comic for *Masamune-kun's Revenge*, written and drawn by various artists.

**Cover:** Hattori Mitsuru
**Illustration:** Aonagi Nobu
**Chapters:**
1. Mizu Asato
2. Isaki Uta
3. bokkun (Ichijou Rei)
4. Aruya
5. Itou Ryou
6. Suzuki Manatsu
7. Kirusu
8. Yatomi
9. Dosei Fujiko
10. Yuzuhi

title: Koi to Kenketsu
description:
A story about blood donation and love involving a gyaru and a glasses-wearing high school boy.

---

Additional Links:
* [BOOTH](https://booth.pm/ja/items/6027781)

title: The Moon at Daybreak
description: Pu Reum Han led a normal high school life, that is until, he dreams of a lady, looking for his help to find her missing baby. But what if that baby is inside him?

title: Yuugure Light
description: 4 companions are living in the same mansion. There’re sharing the same school, their family, their future but also…love stories. But now, their journey to become adults is about to begin…

title: Seishun Cinderella
description:
High school girl Shion decides to confess to the boy she likes. However, even before she can say "I like you", she receives her answer: "If you want to confess, at least do something about your appearance".  
  
Ten years later, Shion works and has much more style, but still can't manage to have a normal relationship with a man. Ever since she got that answer, time has stopped for her. By pure chance she finds a photo from that time and, as she tears it up, she finds herself catapulted back to the same time as the photo. The modest high school girl from ten years ago has returned, but now she knows how to put on makeup and dress fashionably. And so, Shion has a second chance to live her high school life and erase her regrets.

title: Force Field Girl
description: A boy who is bullied gets saved by his…Force Field Girl!

title: Natsuzora and Run
description: Second baseman Kaizu Chiaki is a normal senior high schooler who aims to reach the Koshien with his teammates and worries about his future career. One day, a new teacher arrives at his school. Her name is Takamine Touko. Crossing the boundaries between teacher and student, Chiaki and Touko find themselves gradually attracted to each other.

title: Sugar Soldier
description:
Makoto is determined to step out of her model sister's shadow and have her own high school debut, but when Makoto's sister shows up unexpectedly at her school, her plans suddenly go awry?  
  
Included one-shot:  
Volume 9: Hapi★Supi / Happy Spirit

title: Virgin † Maiden
description: When a virgin boy performs a demon summoning ritual, a succubus appears in the form of the girl he likes! The serious student council president, Takuma Amagi (a virgin), and the well-behaved vice president, Yuri Sagimiya (a virgin).

title: Popcorn Avatar
description:
One rainy night, Wada, a young teenage boy, standing near the edge of a bridge over a raging river - is on a depressing brink towards committing suicide. Suddenly, a beautiful blonde foreign girl, named Lisa, mysteriously appears. Who is this cheerful girl? And why is she dressed as a cheerleader? Wada wasn't interested and tries to ignore her, but Lisa kicks him off the bridge, and says "try flying." And to his surprise, he does. This power, where did it come from?  
  
It seems that there is a war between the diva's and asura's. And by fate, the result of this war is tied to Wada. Upon learning this, Wada does not look very pleased. Was this his purpose - his destiny? What will he choose? Does he even have a choice? After all, Lisa, the goddess cheering him on, is surprisingly his classmate.

title: Hontou wa Suki na no ni
description: The two, Natsuki and Naoto, have grown together since kindergarten. As they grew older things changed a lot. Naoto now instead of being a crybaby and shy child has become a formidable man, which makes Natsuki feel attracted without knowing why. What will happen to the attraction that is starting to feel Natsuki? If Naoto realize … what would you do …?

title: 500cc
description: 'Sang-eun' is greeted by a pretty sunbae, 'Jian', who she meets in her first university class! When Jian leaves momentarily during their freshmen welcome meeting, Sang-eun follows... But while comforting the upset Jian, she ended up confessing?!

title: Youkai no Oisha-san
description: Youkai are mysterious, trouble-making spirits and demons that have tormented Japan for centuries. Kotoko’s grandfather exorcised them for a living, but Kotoko never thought that her family lineage was an asset. Then she meets Kuro, a youkai doctor. Youkai have doctors? Now Kotoko is learning firsthand that healing youkai is a lot more challenging than getting rid of them!

title: Chisana Kanojo
description: Oneshot anthology about the daily life of a couple with a height difference

title: Yoake no Polaris
description:
*"You're a student!" "So what?"*

While carrying Yura, the beautiful English teacher, the flirty Haga impulsively kisses him in the midst of the sports festival, in front of the whole school, no less! Yura summons him to the counseling office after school the next day. Unexpectedly, the teacher finds himself being hit on by Haga, much to his dismay. Although he started off just wanting to tease him at first, Haga ends up being serious about Yura, who’s a little coarse and cute, and wants to kiss him over and over again?!

title: The Voice Inside His Head Is—
Messing With a Female Friend During Lunch Break
description:
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=960581)  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/namiru_iroiro)

title: Saudade ni Kuchidzukete
description:
“I am never gonna fall in love with a man.”

That's what Ayumu said to Makoto back in middle school. But when Makoto meets Ayumu again at a class reunion, she seems happily married with a smile on her face…!?

title: First Love, Lasting Hate
description: Eunha, whose dream is to become a teacher, has finally become a university student. However, she discovers that her childhood friend and first love, Ha Seungmin, is also in her class. Seungmin used to be a bully in middle and high school and had almost cut ties with Eunha. But now, he seems to be getting closer to her.

title: Bocchi the Rock! - Gotou-san! Moshikashite Okottemasu ka? (Doujinshi)
Ladies versus Butlers!
description:
Hino Akiharu lost his parents when he was an elementary student and was taken in by his uncle's family. One day, he sees on the news about the newly-established Hakureiryou Gakuin, a school which was re-built from an elite girls' school. He decides to take the exam for that school and succeeds in entering the House Management Department (the place to train maids & butlers). He wants to become a butler, although his appearance scares the ladies. Akiharu has a sinister look in his eyes, a scar on his right eyebrow, and bristled up hair. Add 3 piercings on his ears and he indeed has a typical bad boy look on him.  
  
He meets his "nemesis" at that school, Saikyou Tomomi, a girl with a two faced character who traumatized him many times since they were kids. Another girl named Cernia Iori FlameHeart chases after him because of his looks and calls him suspicious. Still, Akiharu starts finding his feet at the school and his relationships with the girls also get better…

title: Sensei to Seito wa, Ai wo Shiranai.
description: Người mà tôi yêu thương nhất trên đời hóa ra không hề yêu thương tôi. Tôi lúc này đây không còn cách nào khác ngoài căm ghét chính người ấy. Đây là một câu chuyện giữa hai con người không biết yêu dần thu hút lẫn nhau.

title: Necro;Chronicle
description: Sakuragi Kazuma is just a normal boy who believes in the status quo, to his girlfriend's chagrin. But his life changes after he is reanimated by a necromancer who wants to conquer Japan. What will happen next…?

title: Zutto Yuusen Earphones na Onnanoko no Hanashi
Iwata no Kuseni Choushi ni Noruna!
description:
This boy looks so cool, so it can't be helped if I fall in love. "We've been so close ever since middle school, so now, I can't tell him I like him…" is what Akemiya feels with an unrequited love towards Iwata. But upon entering high school and becoming friends with the two popular hotties, Fujiwara and Shirotaki, Iwata is starting to get cocky!!   
Iwata and Akemiya, the super popular side characters of "Fujiwara-kun wa Daitai Tadashii" presents the long-awaited super popular spinoff series that will make your chest squeeze, give you warm fuzzies, make you laugh and make you cry ♪.

title: Soutaisei Moteron
description: Tachibana Kazuya, Kumazawa Daigo, and Niinuma Hiroko all want to be popular. But they don't know how to do so! So, they try and create a club to research and find out how to become popular.

title: Wakaouji-kun and Tonomiya-san
description:
A love comedy unfolds on Wakaouji-kun, a perfect high school boy… or a demon that pretends to be, and Tonomiya-san, a Takarazuka-like girl.  
  
**Note:** Takarazuka is an all-female musical theatre troupe where some of its members, otokoyaku, are trained to act and look manly.

title: My First Obligatory Chocolate
description: I got my first chocolate for valentine this year, even though it's obligatory because someone felt bad at me.

title: Weekly Boys' Romance
description:
Five boys, living under the same roof, yet indifferent to one another, are given an ultimatum: "No girl problems, or you're out". With each of them harboring their own unconventional romance, can they succeed in protecting their clumsy, innocent love and rebuild their friendship?  
  
  
A love/hate drama filled story about 5 highschoolers who live in the same house.

title: Pink Lemonade
description: What is love? To some, it's like the high of a sugar rush with butterflies in their stomach. For others, it's a distant memory that leaves a bittersweet aftertaste. But in every love story, sweet and sour intertwines, creating a dense and gentle experience. Hm... if I could explain it figuratively, it's similar to a glass of pink lemonade.

title: Bocchi the Rock! - Gimme Everything! (Doujinshi)
description: A slapstick manga, where Kita-chan wants Bocchi to call her cute.

title: Sorry I Couldn't Protect You!
description: Is this fate? Chess, a close friend of Benjamin, appears before him looking for a roommate. Will this meeting rekindle the friendship they once had? Or will this turn out into something better? Watch out as their story unfolds . . .

title: Shitsuji Shoujo to Ojou-sama
description:
Hinata is a student at a prestigious all girls private school and looks up to Tsugeyama Saki, the shining star of the school. As the younger sister of Saori, the head mistress of the school, Saki is the most popular girl at school with her warm personality, beauty, top academic skills and is pretty much the perfect girl.  
  
Hinata suddenly learns that her parents got extremely into debt, fled the country and pretty much left her out to dry. The headmistress Saori, out of compassion and seeing Hinata's importance to the school, makes Hinata an offer to become a butler in return for providing room and board for her. Not having much choice, she accepts and is assigned to none other than Saki. Hinata soon finds out that Saki puts on a façade at school and is not the perfect girl everyone thinks she is.

title: Aoba-kun's Confessions
description:
A love for a person she can't say 'I love you' to is about to start. Mayo is a very shy girl. She meets Aoba-kun in her weird part-time job, and they begin to spend their secret time alone, but…  
  
The boy she meets is the one she is closest to but is also the one she can't love. A far too clumsy, secret, unrequited love.

title: Appetite
description: Dohoon can’t find a reason to live. He hoped to get a fresh start at his new high school, but things are no different—the bullies make fun of his limp and no one wants to be his friend. Then one night, he runs into a classmate, Aji… Having seen something he shouldn’t, the two make a deal: Aji will protect him for the time being, but when he turns 20, Dohoon will have to pay up.

title: Nui ni Koishite Ii desu ka?
description:
Ikumi is a high school girl whose hobby is making stuffed toys. When she is rescued by Ayato, an elite student at her school, she decides to give him a handmade stuffed animal as a thank-you, but she witnesses him secretly throwing it away in the shadows. Then the "curse" of the stuffed animal is activated, and Ayato is turned into a doll...

---
Note: Originally a oneshot published in LaLa 6/2023 issue on April 24, 2023. Serialization started in LaLa 10/2023 issue on August 24, 2023.

title: Itsumademo Mukashi no Kyorikan na Osananajimi
Yuri Manga for Studying Japanese
description:
A Story about a thailand student learning japanese with her japanese teacher  
100% Smoooooth guarantee  
  
Artist Twitter : <https://twitter.com/garunstudio>

title: Yankee to Yandere no Karera ni wa Tomodachi ga Inai
description: One is a delinquent-looking pervert, the other is a haraguro yandere. Place them together. This is their daily comedy school life.

title: Bokura no Suki wa Warikirenai
description: "From now on, I'll protect you".  Yui, a high school sophomore, returns to her hometown for the first time in eight years due to the reunion of her divorced parents. Reunited with her popular older brother, Hayato, and her handsome grown-up childhood friend, Ritsu, a fascinating new life is unavoidable! ...Until she realizes she may be in love with her brother. "Date me? You can use me as a disguise to hide your feelings for him." A heartbreaking love triangle!

title: Shitty Story of a Super Loser in Love
description: A high-spec (but disappointing inside) high school boy meets his "Woman of Destiny…" but she has a special secret…?!

title: High-School DxD - Akuma no Oshigoto
description: Manga adaptation of the short stories found in the eighth volume of the light novel.

title: Mokyu...
description:
**Mokyu** is an *onomatopoeia* which means **"cute (and fluffy)"**  
  
Source: *[Stack Exchange](https://japanese.stackexchange.com/questions/24756/what-does-the-japanese-onomatopoeia-%E3%82%82%E3%81%8D%E3%82%85%E3%82%82%E3%81%8D%E3%82%85-mean)*

title: Shoutotsu! Futatsuboshi Sakusen
description:
"I love you." "That's disgusting."  
  
The fidgety and red-faced kouhai who confessed to him turned out to be Shuichirou. Although Atsushi rebuffs Shuichirou in less than 3 seconds, the latter relentlessly confesses his love every day. Even saying his type is "girls with big boobs" doesn't stop Shuichirou.  
  
In the midst of that, Atsushi tries to get Shuichirou to back off by doing perverted things to him…?!

title: Gongjunim Hakgyo Gasinda
description: Kim Seol is the candidate to become North Korea’s next leader and its very own “Princess.” However, Seol lives as an ordinary South Korean high school student, completely unaware that she is the daughter of Kim Jeong-un. To protect her daily life, the youngest-ever “Black Agent,” Jeong Su-hyeon, has infiltrated into her high school. A School Romance Comedy that unfolds as a secret agent meets an oblivious princess!

title: Hajimete no Seifuku ga Niaisugiteiru Osananajimi
Piece
description:
One day, Mizuho, a university student, receive news that her classmate in high school, Origuchi Haruka, passed away. Mizuho doesn't remember being best friends with Origuchi, but apparently, Origuchi told her mother that Mizuho was her best friend. And now, her mother wants Mizuho to help her find the boy Origuchi dated during high school. Mizuho told Origuchi's mother that Origuchi was a very plain girl, and she was never seen with a guy, but her mother told Mizuho that Origuchi got pregnant and had an abortion when she was in high school. Mizuho was shocked, but she still starts asking her other classmates in high school and following the traces Origuchi left behind.  
  
Winner of the 58th Shogakukan Manga Award (2013) in the Shoujo manga category.

title: The Kabocha Wine
description:
Transfer student, Shunsuke Aoba , arrived at Sunshine School only to find the premises empty. He was secretly gleeful to be the first to reach the school, oblivious to the fact that it was Foundation Day and a rest day for the institution. At that moment, a big-sized "L"(Eru) beauty by the name of Natsumi appeared before him and the two of them hit off together even though Shunsuke was so much smaller than her.   
Shunsuke's mother runs a women's apparel business but the shop is in need of manpower. He offers to help out but fumbles a lot because he does not know how to interact with the ladies. Eru decides to step in and help out around the shop and this pleases Shunsuke's mother. This is a romance story that shares the joys and woes of the "SL" combination between Shunsuke and Eru.  

---
  
- **The Kabocha Wine won the 1983 Kodansha Manga Award for Shonen**

title: Cherry Boy, That Girl
description: What happens when you take a good, long look and realize that your boyfriend is prettier that you? And what happens when you go to a high school with so few girls that you're considered a goddess? But then again, your pretty boyfriend is also attending the same school…

title: Death, She and I
description: Yukari is a girl who can see the deceased. Yuusaku is a boy who can hear any phenomena that has a voice. Through their encounters with the inhuman, they learn fear, sadness, and compassion; and grow as humans.

title: Tagonanja
description: Standing next to my crush was this perfect guy. I was passing by when he made an offer… is this guy serious?

title: Hatsukoi
description: Hirono Yuusa always believed he was special and destined for greatness – until tragedy struck in his final year of middle school. Now jaded and disillusioned, he's completely given up on trying to be anything more than ordinary. But when he starts to notice classmate Himekawa Ichigo struggling to do his best against all odds, he can't help but want to cheer him on.

title: The Dumb Senpai and the Level-Headed Kouhai
Fuguu no Reijou wa Kitai no Hikari Mahoutsukai ni Misomerare Hanahiraku ~Sakihokoru Junai no Hana~
description:
Countess Sylvia is also famous in the school. The one who supports her is her gentle and lovely fiancé Randall. With him, Sylvia was able to work hard at any time. However, she witnesses Randall's closeness to a beautiful noblewoman, famous at the school. Sylvia is in the depths of shock and despair, but one day she meets Albert, a rare light wizard and famous, and her fate changes.
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3231hr/)

title: Impure Same Sex Fraternizing is Against School Rules
description: A oneshot about 2 schoolgirls.

title: Faster Than a Kiss - Future
description: Marriage of teacher Ojiro and high schooler Fumino, whose parents have passed away. Includes a total of five stories following their wedding day.

title: High School Return of a Gangster
description: A gangster dies saving a bullied teen — and wakes up in the boy’s body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy’s suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he’s not who he says he is, things start to spiral...

title: The Place Where Hands Never Touch
description:
A collection of six oneshots about people and relationships.  
  
title 2. A design that won't shut up - A boy wants to touch his girlfriend's hand, but she seems reluctant to let him touch her at all.

title: Chrome Shelled Regios - Missing Mail
description:
In this school fantasy story set in the distant future, creatures contaminated by pollution have overtaken the land, forcing humanity to live in isolated mobile cities called Regios. One such city named Zuellni is a self-contained school in which freshman Layfon Alseif has just enrolled. Layfon reluctantly joins the 17th Martial Arts Studies Unit led by the third-year student Nina Antalk and embarks on a series of adventures.  
  
This version recounts a slightly different version of Layfon's story.

title: Yura-kun no 10% ni wa Himitsu ga Aru
description: "My classmate Yura-kun is always languid. He might be a vampire…" Kyouko's wild notions actually turn out to be true!! Once Yura-kun finds out that she has a "rare blood type", he begins to approach her. Are his actions out of love? Or is he just out for her blood, following his instincts? She's being pushed around by Yura-kun, who does everything at his own pace!!

title: The Tsundere Wife and the Crybaby Husband
description: (6-page short manga)

title: I'm curious about the girl who's always hanging out next to the popular girl.
Such a Cute Spy
description:
North Korean spy Anna Rhee must seduce the South Korean math genius Donggu Park and return with him to North Korea!  

[Official Korean (Lezhin)](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/cute_spy)

Note: Life of Ruin is a pen name of [Lee Hyunmin](https://mangadex.org/author/45b9fad4-8bde-41bd-893f-5b4bf5a652b5)

title: Machi de Uwasa no Tengu no Ko
description:
Akihime is a seemingly normal girl attending junior high school, but she is actually the daughter of Ryokuhouzan's tengu. She lives with her mother in the human world, living a normal human life. However, her childhood friend Shun is constantly trying to convince her to go to the mountains with him, so that they can become tengus together. Despite his continuous urgings, Akihime refuses because she has feelings for her classmate, Takeru-kun.  
Machi de Uwasa no Tengu no Ko won the 2009 Shogakukan Manga Award for best shoujo

title: Two&Too
description: Ah, the young and in love. Read to see where Shen Nantang's lighthearted university endeavors take him!

title: Raiyou to Aoume
description: Jun Samekawa, a first-year junior high school student who was blessed with friends and a boyfriend, had a safe and enjoyable life. One day, she meets Kei, a high school girl. And thus begins a complicated love triangle...

title: Rosario+Vampire (Official Colored)
description:
Love bites when monster girls compete for the affection of one average human guy!
All-around average teenager Tsukune can’t get accepted to any high school save one...but on his first day, he finds the rest of the student body doesn’t appear average in the least. Best of all, the cutest girl on campus can’t wait to fling her arms around his neck! Wait a sec—are those her teeth around his neck too...? Does Tsukune have a chance in H-E-double-hockey-sticks of raising his grades at a school where the turf war isn’t between the jocks and the nerds but the vampires and the werewolves?

title: I Want to Keep Your Cuteness to Myself
Kikoetemasu yo, Yukimiya-san
description: One day, I found out. That my classmate Yukimiya-san has a habit of talking in her sleep in an outrageous way... I can't help but be curious about the sleep-talking that comes out of the cool and silent Yukimiya-san. A sleep-talking Love Comedy!

title: Bitter Sweets Chocolatier
description:
Toujou Moa is a high school freshman gal. She is madly in love and has been making sweets for Valentine's Day, but it seems like things aren't going as planned. In her growing frustration, she throws her failed sweets, only to have them caught in the face of her teacher, who just so happens to be there…

A special 26-page Valentine's Day one-shot that will sweetly melt your hardened heart.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/71819)

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Campus Apocalypse
description: Shinji Ikari attends the NERV Foundation Academy and lives a life of relative normality. One night he encounters Rei Ayanami and Kaworu Nagisa fleeing the scene of a violent explosion and is eventually recruited to assist them and Asuka Sohryuu Langely in fighting the Angels, who have taken on human form, in order to retrieve their cores to support the world tree, Yggdrasil. Should the Yggdrasil die, their world would be thrown into a chaotic state where parallel streams of existence collide, eventually bringing about the destruction of all things

title: Love Bui!
description: High school teacher Sei Sakura has a secret she can’t tell anyone: she's aroused by the combination of human features with animal traits like horns, tails, and scales. To keep this hidden, she lives her days as a strict, iron-masked "demon teacher." But one day, her routine is completely shaken by the sudden transfer of a gyaru girl, Bell Makimura!

title: Don't Cry, Girl ♥
description: Thanks to her parents' incompetence, Taeko is sent to live with an acquaintance of her father. But when she rings the bell of her new home, she's greeted at the door by her new roommate, a completely and utterly shameless nudist named Masuda. Why exactly is he presenting himself in the buff to an innocent high-school girl…? Of course, their shocking first meeting sends Taeko's 17-year-strong values tumbling to the ground! "Is he for real?!" "Am I going nuts?!" It's too late for tears, so *Don't Cry, Girl* - a hilarious teen comedy ♪!

title: After School Nightmare
description: Like most teenagers, Mashiro Ichijo has a secret. But Mashiro’s secret is that he’s neither fully male nor female! So far, Mashiro’s been able to live his life as a boy, but all this changes when he’s informed of a new class he must take in order to graduate from his elite prep school. To pass, he must find the “Key”…and the only way to find it is to enter into a nightmare world where his body and soul are put at the mercy of the worst kind of enemies: his classmates!

title: Bìyè Dào Jìshí
description: With graduation just around the corner, a straight boy was confessed to by his classmate. Faced with an unexpected confession, Wu Ying first refused. But the other party keeps persisting to be close to him “in this way”…

title: Ichigo 100% - East Side Story
description: A short sequel of Ichigo 100%, focusing on Touyou Aya and a new encounter.

title: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsu no Ma ni ka Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken (Fan Colored)
description:
Mahiru is a beautiful girl whose classmates all call her an “angel.” Not only is she a star athlete with perfect grades—she’s also drop-dead gorgeous. Amane‚ an average guy and self-admitted slob‚ has never thought much of the divine beauty‚ despite attending the same school. Everything changes‚ however‚ when he happens to see Mahiru sitting alone in a park during a rainstorm. Thus begins the strange relationship between this incredibly unlikely pair!

_Adapted from the Light Novel with the same name,
Serialized in Square Enix Web Magazine [Gangan Online](https://www.ganganonline.com/title/1480)_

title: Hen-Zemi
description: Matsutaka Nanako is a normal university student, who happened to enroll in Abnormal Physiology Seminar. She tries to keep her mental state sound, but other abnormal classmates start to influence her personality…

title: Elf to Hitotsu Yane no Shita
description: Uesugi Kage is a high school student in her second year who has been unable to find a new love because of her past love at first sight. When the apartment in which she lives is to be demolished, she comes face with her landlord, Hojo.

title: Kandachime
description: Takuma Zushi just wanted to be left alone. He sleeps in class and skips club. While going home, he sees a girl walking into the woods and decides to follow her. There he witnesses a fight between two sword masters with the prize being the ownership of the "Kandachime", a sword that can take human form. That girl, Otowa Hagane was about to lose when he naively steps into the fight…

title: Sokoni Osuwari!
description: Shuuya Inukai is a model student at a high school who one day attracts the attentions of an ojou-sama, Kantori Isuzu, when she realizes that he is bearing, on his forehead, an X-shaped scar…that was also present on her pet dog's forehead…which leads her believe that Shuuya is actually the reincarnation of the said animal. And now Shuuya's days as Isuzu's pet begin.

title: Ryuunen Shita Senpai to Moto Kouhai no Hanashi
Hankei 15cm no Hatsukoi
description: A story of a bright and straightforward high schooler and his pure, devoted childhood friend. Keita and Tomoya are childhood friends living in adjacent apartments. They always thought they'd remain friends forever, but one day Tomoya suddenly announces that he’s moving and reveals his long-held feelings.

title: Trouble With The President
description: After a failed one night stand, the bold woman secretly left, leaving behind a provocative message with a lipstick mark. The man, however, swore to find this woman. The next day, all the major media outlets released a 'Wanted' notification at the same time. Tong Tianai was on her phone when she saw the notification, which made her face turn completely red. "Qin Jinyang… the Qin Association President…" Because of that lipstick mark, she had become the Chief Executive.

title: TandB
description: The daily life of Tiana and Breathe, Set as girls in Korea

title: Mathematical Girls
description:
Just after the high school entrance ceremony, "I" meet a beautiful girl: Milka. Milka is a mathematical genius. She gives me many math problems, she shows me many elegant solutions. Milka and I spend a long time by discussing math in the school library.  
  
One year later, I meet another mathematical girl: Tetra. Tetra is one year younger than me, and asks me to teach her math. While I teach her, she begins to understand math and to love its elegance gradually.  
  
In the first volume (series), we talk about Fibonacci Numbers, Harmonic Numbers, Finite and Infinite Sums, Factorization, The Bazel Problem, Partitions of the Integer, and Generating Functions.

title: Zettai Joousei
description: The male lead has gynophobia (fear of woman) due to a traumatic experience. Following the recommendation of his sister, who is a nun with little brother-complex, he enters a previously all female school that now has a 9:1 female to male ratio. Then the Queen of the school demands that he work for her as her secretary! How will the gynophobic guy cope working so close to the Queen?

title: Magical Girl Chronicles
description: Stories of a city's inhabitants guarded by a magical girl, as well as her own stories and questions she answers.

title: Date A Origami
description:
4-koma spin-off from the Date A Live series.  
  
Warning: Will contain spoilers.

title: Girls Saurus DX
description: Shingo Chiryuu isn't much different than any other guy except for one thing... He's afraid of girls. Now he finds himself surrounded by girls, including the one whose attack originally instilled the fear in him, as he attempts to cure himself of his gynophobia.

title: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen (Fan Colored)
description: While you were admiring the girl in the next seat, she might be eyeing you up, too…? A new kind of “neighborly” short-form pure love comedy!

title: Marmalade Boy Little
description: Set 13 years after the original series, the story focuses on Miki and Yuu's little siblings.

title: Star Dream Idol Project
description: The shining lights, the magnificent stage! Friendships created through singing, making a future through dancing, the girls embark on their journey towards their dreams! One who has lost status due to a scandal is hiding a plot behind her back. A pair of bosom friends, separated by fate. A girl who tries to exonerate her mother sets off on her journey for a talent competition. When the stage turns into an empty battlefield, she uses her voice to chase after her dreams.

title: Outside Flower
description:
"Mister, are you a virgin?"  
  
Masamoto, a 29-year-old guy. He has serious problems relating to people, in addition to being single. But, to change that, one day he decides to go to a gay meeting place and get a date. But, while he was hesitating whether to go in or not, a high school student appears who seems to be lost, Sakuya, and he catches his eye. This action immediately caused him to run away from the place. But one day, the two of them meet again at the cinema. After talking for a while, both realize that they have similar tastes. But then, Sakuya-san says he'll help Masamoto get a partner…?!

title: Seikaku Kuzu de Nani ga Warui
description:
Hanaura auto-proclaimed himself to be trash, and among other things, he chose to be alone in his classroom. However, all of a sudden, he is confessed to by the most popular guy in school, Tsuzuki!?  
  
Hanaura can't reject him properly – his time together with Tsuzuki ends up being perfect, but when it comes to himself, he can't return those feelings to begin with…

title: Hoshi no Koe
description: To what distance would you go for your one true love? In a future filled with a boundless potential for interstellar peace and prosperity, Mikako joins a research team to explore the recent contact between humans and alien races. She ventures out into space, leaving behind Noboru, the one young man she loves. As she travels deeper into this new frontier, her only connection with her boyfriend is through cell-phone text messages. But the years pass, and Mikako barely ages in the timelessness of space–while Noboru grows older and considers moving on with his life…In this timeless romance between star-crossed lovers in the most tragic of settings, there are some places man may not be ready to go. Summary taken from Manga-Sketchbook.

title: Barajou no Kiss
description:
Most girls are crazy about jewelry, but not Anis Yamamoto. Not since her father gave her a rose choker as a child, claiming it was a protective amulet which would safeguard her from harm; however, if she ever took it off (a feat easier said than done!), she would be afflicted by a 'punishment' of some sort. Not like it matters to her though, since the attention, it attracts around school from faculty and students alike isn't something she's particularly fond of.  
  
But after a certain incident causes the choker to disappear, she realizes that this punishment her father spoke of might have been a bit more than she bargained for!

title: Chu-Bra!!
description: It's about a girl who loves underwear so much she tries to start an underwear club at school.

title: Me and My Professor
description: Yali Han must live with the handsome professor because of her financial problems. At first all was well, but one day an unexpected thing happened…

title: Dungeon de Nariagare! ~Osananajimi kara no Kirawarete Goblin ni Saekate Nakatta Ore ga, Dungeon Ruler no Shidou wo Uketara Tsuyoku Nareta no de Imouto to Musou shimasu~
description: It has been 30 years since dungeons were established in Japan. Kyoichi has been accepted into the same extremely difficult high school as his childhood fiancée, Tsubaki, but... Rumor has it that he kneels before a goblin, and he becomes the target of class teasing. He tries to turn the situation around by exploring a dungeon, but is beaten up by a group of goblins. Thinking of his younger sister, Koyoi, he is ready to die, but... He is saved by a dungeon ruler named Kyoji. This encounter changes Kyoji's destiny.

title: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu: Twi-Yaba
description: A collection of short comics and  small stories published on Sakurai Norio's Twitter.

title: Sonna Me de Mitekure
description: Mikado – a narcissistic, spoiled, school-idol type rich boy – falls in love at first sight with an awkward, plain-looking scholarship student who's completely immune to his charms.

title: Gal to Kouhensachi Danshi ga Yobikou de Koisuru Hanashi
description:
Mashiro, a high school girl, is not very good at studying. Her grades are so bad that she has been accepted into a prep school...

She hates studying, but she can do her best if she thinks she can meet good-looking guys from other schools! At the prep school, she meets Kippei, who has a high deviation score in both face and study...?

title: Fushigina megane to tonari no yankee
description: Miyashita is a girl who has glasses with which she can see the thoughts of her classmates in the form of text balloons, thanks to these glasses she will discover that someone likes her.

title: Osananajimina Kimi Ga Tamaranaku Daisuki ！
description: 高校1年生な橙田旭には、隣に住む同い年の幼なじみがいる。彼の名前は紫ノ宮和音、旭にとって唯一の推しで大天使で世界一尊い存在。可愛くて時にかっこいい…そんな和音がたまらなく大好きな旭のハピネスコメディー!

title: Saving My Class 8 Seniors
description: After the high school entrance exam, rebellious Qingjun Cao and her friends, Jingjing Ceng and Qing Yan, were lucky enough to attend the same high school… and be in the same class. In it, she meets the gentle Jia Lu, the full of life Qiyang Si, and the cowardly Haiwen Tong. Each person is hurt in their own way: misunderstood, lonely, not acknowledged… this is her spring, as well as his. Luckily, I have you this time.

title: Lovely Bakery
description: From Sunday Battle 8, 27th contest. Oneshot theme: gourmet food

title: SUPER HXEROS (Official Semi-Colored)
description: When the mantis-like aliens known as Kiseichuu descend on Earth, they have one goal: eradicate the human race. They do so by absorbing humans’ H-energy–the sexual passion that fuels so many people and keeps the species reproducing! The government has assembled an elite team of superheroes to fight the bugs, aided by technology that allows them to transfer their erotic energy into super powers. High schooler Retto Enjo is recruited onto the team, partnering with four beautiful girls, one of whom is his childhood friend Kirara Hoshino. Though they were once close, they’ve grown apart in recent years, since Kirara turned distant and aloof after an encounter with the Kiseichuu in her youth. Can Retto save the world, keep his team together, and maybe even melt his childhood friend’s newly cold exterior?

title: Keima to Penguin
description: 将棋男子の補修の見張りとして選ばれたのは、記録が伸び悩む水泳女子。はじめは練習の時間を削られることに苛立っていたが、道は違えどプロを目指す同志の「何事も経験」という言葉に動かされ...？

title: Yamero Suki ni Natteshimau (Pre-Serialization)
description: A high school boy named Matsuura has always lived his life by putting up a front. While he can easily see through the true nature behind others' smiles, he encounters a formidable opponent in the form of a cheerful, twin-tailed beauty named Kyuuragi, who is part of the popular group. Whether it's intentional or innocent, her every move and gesture is cunningly calculated, catching Matsuura off guard… “Stop it! I'm going to fall for you!!!”

title: Ouchi de Koi ga Matteru
description: Warm and bittersweet, a temporary life under the same roof. Ui is a third-year high schooler cramming for exams who ends up moving in with distant relatives: a kind grandmother and her grandson Rintaro, a first-year who acts cool but is secretly a grandma's boy. As they live together, something warm stirs in Ui's heart. Meanwhile, Rintaro finds himself increasingly caught up in Ui and her carefree ways...!?

title: Hunky Dory
description: The protagonist Yukari and the twin brothers Shun and Ou have grown up like a family ever since they were children. However, their relationship begins changing on the first day of high school…?

title: Kanojo no Sekai
description: A girl finds out her quiet classmate's secret and decides to blackmail her.

title: My Beautiful World
description:
A girl who is afraid of people. And then approaches a small light. New Release of the author of Pinocchio.  
  
Every person in this world changes, it could be anything like their desires or personalities. What if behind a person smiles hides a dark malice or depression? How will someone react to it if that person have the ability to see their hidden facade? This is the story of a girl who can see the ever changing form of humanity as she dives into the mysterious realms of the unknown and real life.

title: You Two are so Close, Are You Dating?
Boku no Ie ni Oide
description: In order to live a normal high-school life, Mirei started her first part-time job. But after receiving her first paycheck, she almost kills a highly-ranked bishounen…?! An encounter with a super poor and pessimistic innocent girl, is this a beautiful miracle?!

title: Kodomo wa Wakatte Agenai
description: A narrative of self-discovery masquerading as a coming of age romance, a family composition drama, a procedural detective story, and a super-powered thriller. Sakuta Minami openly professes the many loves of her life: Matsumoto Leiji anime, her family, swimming, Magical Plastering Girl Buffalo Koteko, but the unanswered questions surrounding her mother’s separation from her natural father have nagged her all her life. Moji Shouhei, an anime geek with prodigious talent for calligraphy, holds in his gifted hands both a physical key to the roof of their high school as well as the figurative key to finally unraveling the mystery of Minami’s father.

title: Tonari no Ren-kun wa Chotto Kowai
description:
These two guys are nothing alike, but they've been friends since elementary school. Ren looks scary at first glance, but he's soft and mushy in front of Tadaomi! If only they knew about their feelings towards each other....

Notes:
- Originally published on Twitter and Pixiv.
- Includes 14 extra chapters.

title: Usotsuki Ouji to Nisemono Kanojo
description: Narumi Luna is a high school student who only wants to make friends, but her tough appearance keeps everyone at bay. When she rescues a black cat from a cruel fate, she gets kicked out of her apartment. With nowhere to go, a chance encounter with the school’s elite changes her life…?

title: Chameleon wa Tenohira ni Koi o Suru.
description:
Nội dung: 

Nam diễn viên Fujinaga (sinh viên năm hai đại học) yêu thích diễn xuất. Nhưng cậu thường xuyên trượt các buổi thử giọng nên dần mất tự tin. Đó cũng là lúc cậu gặp Keito (sinh viên đại học năm thứ nhất) bị khiếm thính bẩm sinh. Mặc dù đây là lần đầu tiên Fujinaga trải nghiệm ngôn ngữ ký hiệu nhưng cậu vẫn có thể đọc được chuyển động của tay trong nháy mắt vì cậu đã luôn hành động với mong muốn "truyền tải" thông điệp nhiều hơn bất kỳ ai khác.
Cuối cùng, cậu quyết định thử ngôn ngữ ký hiệu bằng cử chỉ, điều này khiến Keito ngạc nhiên vì tài năng của cậu trong quá trình học tập.

Sinh viên đại học khiếm thính x diễn viên không mấy thành công. Một câu chuyện tình yêu cảm động kết nối những trái tim thông qua ngôn ngữ ký hiệu

title: How to Put a Spell on a Teacher
Lunchtime Accomplice
description:
Một bí mật giữa thanh thiên bạch nhật — Có hơi nguy hiểm khi tôi được cứu chỉ vì nhìn cậu ăn...?

Một nam chính luôn đổ bỏ những bữa trưa của mình vì vết thương lòng trong quá khứ, và một nữ chính không bao giờ tiết lộ với ai rằng cô là một người ăn cự nhiều... Hai người này làm gì trên sân thượng vào giờ ăn trưa thế...?

title: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game (Yokoyomi)
description:
This is the horizontal version of "Haibara-kun's Strong and Youthful New Game", which is available exclusively in digital format.

**[Official English Light Novel](https://j-novel.club/series/haibara-s-teenage-new-game)**

title: Girls Saurus
description: Shingo Chiryuu isn't much different than any other guy except for one thing… He's afraid of girls. He was attacked by an overweight girl because she was turn down from confessing to him, which caused him to develop a fear of women, seeing them all as "dinosaurs". Even despite all his efforts to get away from the girls, they seem to always found their way to him, making trouble along the way. Now he finds himself surrounded by girls, including the one whose attack instilled fear in him, as he attempts to cure himself of his gynophobia.

title: Koboreru Yoru ni
description: The story follows Yoru and Tenjaku, who have both grown up in an orphanage. Yoru went to the orphanage at the age of 10 after suffering domestic violence from her mother. Tenjaku, who was the same age, took care of Yoru at the orphanage. Several years have passed, and now Yoru is a second-year high school student who still has feelings for Tenjaku.

title: Take My Money
description:
One day Mina, a rich student who's both beautiful and popular, falls in love with an upperclassman. Even through Mina's countless efforts of using money to get the upperclassman's heart, the prince's heart won't budge.   
  
Can Mina's one-sided love story be successful?

title: Their Story
description: A normal life of young teens added with a touch of sugar to add the sweetness.

title: Asa Okitara Ha ga Gizagiza ni Natteta
Hammer Session! In High School
description: Six months after the events in Hammer Session!, the genius swindler Otowa Yonko returns with the goal of acquiring more formidable achievements. A chanced encounter with his former partner-in-crime Mizuki sensei however, prompts him to come to Hanazono High School to help solving his fellow students' problems, using his signature Hammer Session.

title: Koi ga Saku Koro Sakura Doki -Charming Scarlet-
description: "A girl who has not done Love. A boy who isn't interested in Love. If such two persons do love, the world will change how?"

title: Shanimuni Go
description:
Ide Nobuhisa has always been a boy full of vitality and a young promise in the field of track running. However one day after a competition, he stumbled over the prettiest pair of legs he had ever seen! Their owner, a young girl practicing tennis makes a promise with Ide that she will teach him how to play. After seeing the name tag on her racket bag, Ide puts all his efforts into passing the test for accessing the same high school she goes to, Makunogama.  
  
In his first days in his new high school, Ide discovers two things: an old friend of his is also attending, and nobody knows of a girl with the name he saw on the tag! He and his friend join the school tennis club, where they meet another first year, Takita Louis (Ruui), a very good tennis player with a little of an attitude problem.  
  
However things start to look better for Ide when his dear missing girl appears in the school! As it happens, he misread her name on the tag… Takada Hinako was well known as one of the members of

title: Little Witch Academia - xxx (Doujinshi)
description: Akko y Diana tienen una noche de pasión lésbica.

title: Danshi Toilet de Machiawase
description: Original doujinshi story about a girl and a boy meeting up at the boys' toilet.

title: Anata To Watashi Wo Tsunagu Mono
description: Oneshot from Yuri Hime.

title: Kanzen ni Moteki ga Kita to Omotteiru Otoko no Manga
description: Senpai-kouhai-osananajimi love triangle.

title: Trainees
description: Cha Hyeseong watches his crush drift away into stardom. He tries to preserve their relationship by enrolling into a school that produces idols – the same one she attends. He's immediately assigned to debut in an idol group that focuses on acting, which brings more trouble than he asks for.

title: Zen Martial Arts Academy
description: Zen is a type of inner power energy that is essential in Marital Art World and the amount of Zen everyone has is different. Mingyum is a person without Zen, who wishes to become East Asia Strongest Martial Artist. Due to his argument with his sister on what Major she wanted him to take at school and what he wanted, he left, wandering around only to end up in a bad neighborhood. He ended up saving a girl, but got himself beat up in the process because he had no Zen. Then he got saved by a foreign girl who suddenly appeared and announced she is his fiancée. What will happen next?

title: You're Mine
description: Mai's in high school now, and she's just started going out with her childhood friend Yoshioka. However, it feels like that hasn't really changed anything between the two of them. Bit by bit, they try to figure out what their relationship is, and what it means to be more than just friends.

title: Hatsukoi Kouzoushiki
description:
A collection of 6 stories.  
  
1. Otona no Onna wa Muri wo Shinai  
  
2. Dream at Dawn (NSFW)  
Chika found herself in a compromising situation with Mariya, who is sleeping over her house after a pajama party. But Mariya dislikes anyone who tries to sexually harrass her. Will Chika get in trouble?  
  
3. Behind the Thick Frames  
  
4. BACKSHOT  
Suffering the smoldering summer heat, Ema finds herself preoccupied with the bra of the girl she is sitting behind in math class.  
  
5. The Structural Formula of First Love  
Maki is suffering the consequences of a curse she cast 13 years prior.  
  
6. Not For Sale

title: I Will Definitely Confess Today!
description:
Born from a korean father and a filipino mother, Dan Kim has always been bullied for his looks until the arrival of his little savior, Chaeeun Han. The two became close friends and as time passed, Dan slowly developed feelings for Chaeeun. Sadly, the two parted ways in middle school and has not been in contact for 2 years.  
  
Now in college, Dan is determined to tell Chaeeun how he feels but with a growing competition for Chaeeun's affection, will he be able to succeed?

title: Uchuu o Kakeru Yodaka
description: First year student Kohinata Ayumi is asked out by her crush, Shiro! While waiting for her first date with Shiro she receives a mysterious call from one of her classmates, Umine Senko. She then witnesses Umine fall off a building?! What on earth is happening…?!

title: Yue Shi
description: On the night of lunar eclipse, demons cause the world to be in chaos, the child with red hair and scarlet eyes bearing Solomon’s power, shall descend—

title: Okusama wa Shougakusei
description: The story is set in the near future when the marriageable age was lowered in response to the declining birth rate. A 24-year-old man marries a 12-year-old girl in this gag comedy.

title: Kakumei no Hi
description: Kei is a normal–if very pretty–young boy in high school. One day, he falls ill and is taken to the hospital. They find, much to everyone's surprise, that "he" actually has a female genotype even though "his" phenotype is male!! A little bit of surgical work solves the problem, and cool male hero Kei becomes innocent female heroine Kei. And what a female! "He" was cute before, but she is a beauty now.

title: I Hate Love
description:
The various, daily life of the female student who hates love, Han Yeonsil. A romcom you can relate to!

---

title: Gyaru-kun no Koi wa Kitto
description:
You don't know how I feel, so why are you being kind to me?

Yoshi, who is super-cheerful, has a secret after-school date with Fuji, a sober boy who is the complete opposite.
It's supposed to be "practice for Fuji-kun to find a lover", but Yoshi secretly has a crush on Fuji!?
If love is revealed, this relationship will end
But his heart throbs at times when Fuji-kun is too cool!
In fact, whereabouts of the love of the super brave Gal-kun...

A plain handsome guy who doesn't know love x a brave gal-kun who is timid about love.

title: Okyuuryou wa kareshi desu
description: Ayano, a first-year high school student, falls in love at first sight with Iori, the director of a design studio. When Ayano confessed her love to him, they started going out. But only contractually! When Ayano signs on the dotted line, their love comes with stipulations! Is Iori's love for Ayano true?

title: Shikabane★Cherry
description:
Miu has always been aggravated with a certain problem: She has a weak constitution and spends most of her days either sick or extremely exhausted.  
  
After falling ill before a very important date, she decides to take a large quantity of a mysterious medicine which was supposed to cure her and keep her looking fresh and energetic. To her surprise, she finds it has turned her into one of the undead instead!

title: Rough
description: Yamato Keisuke, a promising freestyle swimmer, and Ninomiya Ami, a talented diver, are the offsprings of two rival families owners of confectionery shops. Two generations ago, Grandfather Ninomiya came up with an idea for an owl-shaped cake, but Grandfather Yamato quickly raised to the challenge and thought of a similar cake–but in Yamato's the owl had ears. Because they're priced the same, Yamato's extra ears were crucial, and that made the business of the Ninomiya confectionery suffer. Grandfather Ninomiya then fell ill worrying about his shop. Before his death, his last words were "I was killed by the Yamatos", and since that moment the two families have been sworn rivals.

title: Concerto
Baseball Yuri
description: 野球部員に恋してる子と、マネージャーのお話し

title: Futago no Ouji ni Futago de Konyaku Shita kedo "Ja nai Hou" dakara Yami Mahou wo Kiwameru
Suki yori mo Chikaku
description:
She has a new neighbor who's so handsome! …but he's also devilish.  
and the worst part is that he's also her homeroom teacher!!

title: Perfect Scandal
description: From Lilac Scans: Mikoto Kawase is a new actress who wants to be acknowledged by others but has no love experience. She then notices that scandals in this field can make newcomers known. It is then that she spots a boy from her high school who is a member of a famous boyband. Unexpected luck for her and she decides to pretend to be interested in him. But how far will this lie go?

title: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku (Fan Colored)
description: In a certain place, there are two neighboring high schools. Chidori High School, a bottom-feeder boys' school where idiots gather, and Kikyo Girls' School, a well-established girls' school. Rintaro Tsumugi, a strong and quiet second year student at Chidori High School, meets Kaoruko Waguri, a girl who comes as a customer while helping out at his family's cake shop. Rintaro feels comfortable spending time with Kaoruko, but she is a student at Kikyo Girls, a neighboring school that thoroughly dislikes Chidori High.

title: 1cm Inexperienced Us
description:
Lee Hae-min who attends the elite school, Choegang High School!  
The reason why he, who is a model student, transferred to Choi Hwa High School, the complete opposite of Choegang High School, was to find a handsome man..?!

title: Takkoku!!!
description: Tamano Kako and Marunouchi Gaku were the best of friends, but Gaku had to leave with his father to travel the world. However, Gaku promised that if Kako waited, he would come back in 10 years and they would go out. However, right after Gaku left the law of Takkoku was created: If you confess your love to someone, you must beat them at a game of ping pong; if you touch each other before the game, that person will be punished. If you win, regardless of the other person's feelings, you automatically go out. However, Kako is called the best ping pong player in Japan and Gaku has never played ping pong before AND he wants to be the one that confesses. How will these two people's love flourish under these conditions? Will Gaku ever be able beat Kako at ping pong?

title: Lemon Soda Flavor Kiss
description: "A kiss from my best friend!?" Rio and Leo have been childhood friends since kindergarten. However, as they start their last year of high school, they're in separate classes for the first time. It's during this first day of the new school year that Leo suddenly confesses to Rio and kisses him.... What's going on!?

title: Haru to Natsu to Nacchan to Aki to Fuyu to Boku
description:
Ephemeral but beautiful days that are in danger of shattering...

Shima and Natsuo lives in a normal countryside that you can find almost anywhere. They are normal high school boys that you can find almost anywhere. However, their blissful love is unique only to them and cannot be found anywhere else.

title: Kokoro Botan
description:
During the high school entrance ceremony, Koga Eito from the special class helps Kasuga Niina from her poor health. His gentle manner captivates Niina, making her confess her feeling towards him. Thus, the trials in love of this couple begin.  
  
As time passes, Niina finds it difficult to continue loving him since there are instances when he seems to be playing with her feelings. For her, going out with Koga may bring a grim future to her.

title: Wing-Man
description: Kenta is a young boy who dreams about being a super hero called Wingman. All his classmates love it when he disturbs the courses to apply his holy judgment, as much as the teacher hates that. One day while coming home he finds a beautifull girl in a bikini. Aoi Yume, she gives him a wonderful item, the book of dream which can make anything written on it true, and so began the life of the real super hero for our dear Hirono.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure - Clamp in Wonderland: JoJo's Bizarre Married Life (Doujinshi)
description:
Meet Jotaro Kujo and Noriyaki Kakyoin. Both high school students who have special powers called Stands, they traveled around the world to defeat the villainous DIO Brando and save Jotaro's mother Holy. But now… they're married?  
  
A doujin based on the Stardust Crusaders arc of the long running series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. It's made by CLAMP, a group known for series like xxxHolic, Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle, and Cardcaptor Sakura. Because of its… content, it is considered a rite of passage for many a fledgling JoJo fan (alongside the infamous Duwang scans).  
  
Contains spoilers to Part 3.

title: My Love Confession to My Cool Senpai
Kemeko Deluxe!
description:
10 years ago, high-school student Sanpeita dreamed he was engaged to a beautiful girl. One morning, an unknown homely girl suddenly pressed him for marriage. The homely girl was named Kemeko.  
  
In order to escape, Sanpeita left for school where Kemeko followed and showed up with an uproar. A larger disturbance was when Sanpeita was targeted by a rice cooker on the school's rooftop.  
  
As Sanpeita and his childhood friend Izumi were being attacked by the rice cooker, Kemeko saved them both. What is the girl's true shape!?

title: Bijutsu Souko no Rapunzel
description:
On the 4th floor of the school building, there's an art storage room.
They say it's haunted by the ghost of a female student with endlessly flowing golden hair.
The truth behind the students' whispered rumors is Amane, Shusuke's childhood friend.
Ever since losing her father, she lost her voice and has been supporting herself by continuously painting.

(Source: MangaPlus)

I thought the distance between us would stay like this?" A love story between a cool catcher and a stupid baseball pitcher, childhood friends and battery-mates. The pitcher Yuudai and Shoutarou, the catcher, have been childhood friends and a battery since they can remember. The third year baseball players retired and now it's time for the the second year players to start aiming for the Koushien! However, before the autumn tournament, Yuudai suddenly starts to have the yips, which leads to an unexpected change in their lives. After embracing the same dream and chasing the white ball for 10 years, the distance between the two swayed... What will become of them?

title: Karappo no Aine
description: The string quartet that was formed, the friend who passed away... The boy who threw away his past dreams, memories, and the pain that comes with them to live a steady life: Yoshiki. One day a girl calling herself "Aine," the same as his deceased friend, appears before him... A music youth story of healing, played by two Aines and I.

title: Ani Imouto
description: From BookWalker: A collection of stories from the author of the breakout hit *Velvet Kiss*. Whether they're the opposite sex, same sex, a relative, or much different in age…Starting from the titular work, the forms of the emotions of various relationships between two people, sweet and painful, are collected here in six stories, plus two more bonus chapters for existing stories.

title: Tokimeichatte Gomen ne?
description: Nakagase Mirai is a flawless class Rep but has no luck with men. Entrusted by her teacher to convince a classmate to start attending classes, how will she get the seemingly fragile shut-in, Tenma Riku, to go to school?!

title: Koi no Kami-sama
description:
A collection of one-shots publlished between 2007-2008 published on various magazines and the Nisekoi pilot chapter:  
  
1. Island (2007, Akamaru Jump)  
For the last 400 years, an island has been completely surrounded by walls, isolated from the rest of the world. Aira and Marue have always dreamed of voyaging outside the walls, where lies a devastating truth unbeknownst to them.  
  
2. Koi no Kami-sama (2007, Weekly Shonen Jump)  
Tsuchibe Taichi, a boy who loves shoujo manga and believes in love above all else, ironically has the worst luck in love. His latest attempt in love is at the new transfer student, but a strange otherworldly force seems to be repelling him from her.  
  
3. Williams (2007, Weekly Shonen Jump)  
William is a young boy who idolizes Aradoff, a character from a popular novel which told Aradoff's adventures, and always dreams of having a grand adventure on his own. William's meeting with the novel author finally puts him on an adventure to prove that the novel

title: Boku wa Shitteiru
description:
High school student, Sunao, was commuting to school when he noticed a salaryman on the bus. On his ring finger, were teeth marks hidden by a ring. Who left those marks? Is it a sign of possession? Or maybe…  
  
Before he knew it, Sunao's head was filled with fantasies about him. One day, he runs into the salaryman at his part time job at an izakaya. He drunkenly confronts Sunao and kisses him…!?  
  
These straightforward and painful emotions are too young to be called love. A love between a high school student and a salaryman!  
  
Also included is an extra, "6th Year Obsession," featuring the two of them after the events of the main story!

title: Sorairo Girlfriend
description:
A girl named Hiromi dreams to become a prince. One day a cute girl named Juri transfers into Hiromi's class. 
Due to Hiromi's cute looks she is bothered by Hiromi's classmates. Juri blatantly rejects her classmates' invitation 
to join their group so she earns some scorn from Hiromi's friend, but Hiromi doesn't wish to bother her.  
  
After Hiromi takes initiative to speak to Juri, Juri becomes attached to Hiromi and nicknames her Romeo.   
  
Thus the story between Juliet/Juri and Romeo/Hiromi begins.

title: The Boy with Glasses Never Gets Flirty
Ikemen Joshi Demo Kawaii Heroine ni Naremasu ka?
description: "Bisakah kamu membuat diriku menjadi seorang princess (Heroine)?" Sumeragi Tsukasa — siswi SMA yang dijuluki ikemen, seorang artis populer, dan selalu dikerubungi cewek-cewek. Sedangkan Mikage Himeno — cowok SMA yang sudah debut jadi mangaka tapi proposal serialisasinya selalu ditolak. Saat tujuan mereka saling bertemu, Mereka langsung sembunyi-sembunyi latihan untuk menjadi seorang heroine dan nggak boleh ketahuan sama siapa pun! dan itu yang bikin situasi diantara mereka menjadi mendebarkan!

title: Hoken no Sensei
description:
Kazusa is an adult (who looks just like a middle-schooler) that is coincidentally the new school doctor of the primarily female Wakabane Middle School! He knows everything about how the female body works, so just what lies in stock for our supposedly not-perverted hero?!

[Wikipedia](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%81%BB%E3%81%91%E3%82%93%E3%81%AE%E3%81%9B%E3%82%93%E3%81%9B%E3%81%84)

title: Tsukiaitai noni Nakanaka Tsukiaenai Osananajimi no Hanashi
1999 - `Subarashī Sekai Shinsō Kanzenhan'
description: A story about how two friends tries to stop the antichrist, while the are making efforts to deal with their lives.

title: Negima!? Neo
description:
Welsh magister magi in training, Negi Springfield (ten), is sent to complete his magical training in Japan. Although he's an English teacher in an all girls academy, his class is quite extraordinary for normal school girls… middle school girls, 32 of them, average age 14!  
  
Features the same characters and locations as [Mahou Sensei Negima!](https://mangadex.org/manga/121), however, this series has a different story than the original. The new storyline explains the addition of punctuation to the title.

title: Date A Live - Dead end TOHKA
description:
April 10th. Yesterday was the last day of spring vacation, so starting this morning it was a school day. After being woken up by his cute little sister, Itsuka Shidou believed that it would be the start of another normal day. As for predicting the chance meeting with the girl who called herself a spirit...

Along with a sudden shockwave, the townscape vanished without a trace. In a corner of the street which had now become a crater, the girl was there.

"—You, have you come to kill me too?"

She is the disaster that will destroy humanity, a monster of unknown origin, and a being rejected by the world. There are only two ways to stop this girl: annihilation, and conversation. His little sister Kotori, wrapped in a military uniform, thus said to Shidou: "Since it's like this, just go date her, and make the spirit fall for you!" "Wh-whaaaaaaaat!?"

title: Beware of Your Boyfriend
description: Da-In and Si-Hyun are in the same class, but they’ve never spoken to each other. One day, an unfamiliar guy appears and says he is the Lee Si-Hyun from the future, and that they’ll go out with each other. Da-In doesn’t believe him, but as his predictions come true, she starts to trust him. As Da-In shows interest in Si-Hyun, their classmates say they are flirting with each other. However, Si-Hyun has a twin who looks exactly like him. Just what is the identity of this unfamiliar guy…?

title: BEASTARS (Fan-Colored)
description:
In a world populated by anthropomorphic animals, herbivores and carnivores coexist with each other. For the adolescents of the Cherryton School, school life is filled with hope, romance, distrust, and uneasiness. The main character is Legosi the wolf, a member of the drama club. Despite his menacing appearance, he has a very gentle heart. Throughout most of his life, he has always been an object of fear and hatred by other animals, and he's been quite accustomed to that lifestyle. But soon, he finds himself becoming more involved with his fellow classmates who have their own share of insecurities and finds his life in school changing slowly.  
  


---

title: Mainichi Shine Shine Itte Kuru Gimai ga, Ore ga Nete Iru Suki ni Saimin-jutsu de Hore Saseyou to Shite Kurundakedo…! (Pre-serialization)
Shigatsu no Kimi, Spica.
description: Sei inadvertently enrolled in a theological school and suddenly finds herself failing to make any friends! Right at that time she meets Taiyou and Mizuki, which marks the start of their briilliant school life.

title: Cake Ouji no Spécialité
description: That day, everything should have gone well for Miu. Alas, during her date, the high school student is dumped… Annoyed, she decides to console herself by indulging in her favorite pastime: eating treats!! Her steps lead her to the entrance of a picturesque pastry shop of which she had previously been unaware. Entering the mysterious establishment, she notes with amazement that the beautiful Hayato works there. A high school classmate known for his unequaled coldness, he turns out to be an apprentice pastry chef of talent, whose creations erase the worries of all those who taste them! Discovering a common interest, Miu and Hayato become friends. They do not yet know that the recipe for love may already be preparing tricks for them…

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets (Official Colored)
description:
A high school romantic comedy with five times the cute girls! A high school boy must work part-time to help five sisters study so they can graduate, but the only thing these quintuplets have in common is that they all hate studying!

Five girls who want to do anything but study, and their tutor: a high school boy who’s got book smarts and not much else. Futaro Uesugi took the tutoring gig because he was desperate for cash, but when his students—the five beautiful daughters of a wealthy businessman—find five times the excuses to slack off, what can he do?! At this rate, the sisters won’t graduate, so if he wants to get paid, Futaro must think of a plan to suit each of them… Which feels hopeless when five out of five of them think he’s a loser!

title: Hayaku Otona ni Narinasai.
description: Being an adult is a burden. I'd rather stay as a teenager forever. But, thanks to my handsome biology teacher, Mikasa, I'm slowly learning about the adult world?! What will I learn in today's lesson? The adult love comedy, finally in comic form!

title: Tawawa on Monday (Blue)
description:
A salary man is quite depressed, especially on Mondays. At his lowest point a well-endowed High-School girl calling herself Ai-chan stumbles breast-first into his face. The concussion she gave him served as the start of their relationship.

**Notes**
- This page refers to the Blue Tankobun Edition released alongside the conventional b&w edition starting November 16, 2020
- Not to be confused with the Tankobun collecting the Weekly Tawawa Offering uploaded to author's Twitter every Monday since February 23, 2015 and published since December 31, 2015

title: Another Face
description:
