In the game, Clathilas embodies the archetypal villainess: she mercilessly torments the heroine and ultimately meets her own demise—a predetermined fate. However, instead of being overwhelmed by such a sorrowful outcome… the reborn Nao Ōgami discovers something even more urgent:  This world lacks any notion of Boys’ Love?!

title: Sumire 17-sai!!
description:
Sumire is a 17 year old high school girl who wants nothing more than to make friends with her new classmates. She's so dissappointed that they all seem to hate her, calling her a pervert, a dirty old man, creepy, weirdo… alas, what is a poor lifesized puppet to do in this cruel world.  
  
*Sumire 16-sai!!* was published after *Sumire 17-sai!!*

title: Peach Girl
description:
It's not easy being beautiful. The envy, the jealousy, the vicious rumors spread by your best friend. That's life for young Momo. While everyone thinks that Momo is a wild party girl, the reality is that she is just shy and lonely. Can Momo confess her love to her classmate, Toji, or will her best friend Sae steal him away? It's a bittersweet drama of growing up and fitting in that will charm readers everywhere.  
  
Won the 1999 Kodansha Manga Award in the Shoujo category.

title: Minna! Esper Dayo!
description:
The psychic comedy follows an ordinary (virgin) high school boy named Yoshirō "Yocchan" Kamogawa. His life changes overnight when he wakes up with the ability to read other people's minds. Yoshirō is not the only one to gain powers in his town. Teru-oichan, an (apparently virgin) worker at a café near Yoshirō's school, gains telekinesis — but he uses it for sex toys. Yōsuke Enomoto, a (probably virgin) senior and former basketball player at Yoshirō's high school, gains teleportation — but only while naked.  
  
[Source: ANN]

title: Iwanai Ienai Iitakunai
description: Yuri Hime Oneshot from September, 2014

title: Serious Joke
description: In March, when the new semester begins, Han Seok, who was attacked by a cat on his way to school first meets Han Ki Woon, who takes care of the cat that attacked him. The two meet again in the same classroom by chance and Han Ki Woon, who hits the wall like he's strangely frivolous, continues to be interested in Han Seok!

title: My Smartboy
description: Nari is a typical first year college student with one major hang-up – her height. She is often mistaken for an elementary student because of her stature. She has never had a boyfriend and thinks that her appearance is to blame. One day, her beloved smart phone turns into a handsome young man and this preposterous event turns her life upside down. Will Galaxy become more human or remain in his robot-like state as Nari navigates her college life with him by her side at all times, running into even more outlandish situations while keeping his identity under wraps.

title: Inishie Otaku no Koiwazurai
description: Otaku culture has finally become mainstream, and Megumi can’t quite get used to it. Divorced, with a teen daughter, Megumi thinks fondly back to her days as an anime and manga otaku—in 1995. That year, she transferred to a new school and decided to start fresh by hiding her otaku interests. She found herself taken under the wing of a basketball ace named Masamune, who’s got a kind heart and looks just like one of her favorite characters. Though Megumi catches a whiff of destiny in the air, she’s crushed to learn that Masamune detests otaku… [Kodansha]

title: Kimi no Amai ni oi
description: Kouta and Tougo are childhood friends who live in Kansai. Kouta, who loves sweets, made a promise with the successor of a Japanese confectionery shop, Tougo, when they were kids, being that they would get married if the latter could make delicious Kaiten-yaki. After becoming high school students and confirming that neither of their feelings have changed, they became lovers and were lovey dovey every day. Though recently, a popular western confectionery shop has opened nearby, and Tougo's shop is in a big pinch! Furthermore, when Kouta accepts an invitation from the handsome store manager of the western confectionery shop, Satoru, the relationship between the Kouta and Tougo takes a turn for the worst…?!

title: Lovely★Complex TWO
description: Sequel to Nakahara Aya's well-loved series Love★Com. This is a collection of short stories focusing on a few side characters and new ones while subtly providing an overview of what has become of the original characters from the major series.

title: Itsuka no Haru
description: Ichihara Yui is a 15 years old high school girl. On the first day, she meets Itsuka Daisuke and mistakes him for a teacher. To her surprise, they meet again in the classroom but he is in fact a high schooler too. Indeed, Itsuka is 25 years old and he wants to enjoy the high school life he has never been able to get ten years ago.

title: Kimidori
description: "Will you take pictures of ghosts for me?" Shouma, whose hobby is photography, meets a person while searching for a photography subject after school. The person, with tears in his beautiful yellow-green eyes, was drawing a picture of someone without a face. Shouma, who couldn't forget him (Ukuhara Akira), visits his class the next day and asks him to become his model. He refuses bluntly, but Shouma, who can't give up, persistently tries to find out more about Akira ...? A curious and lively photographer x A hazel-eyed boy with a closed-off heart.. The clumsy and conflicted youth of immature high school boys.

title: That Time I Got a Black-Haired Gyaru Behind Me When I Changed Seats (Fan Colored)
Koi Nashi Ai Nashi
description: Short comedy spin-off for Koi Dano Ai Dano, follow the quirky adventures of Kanoko and her high school classmates and teachers!

title: Stardust Wink
description: I’m Anna. I’m fourteen years old and I’ve just entered the ninth grade. Sou and Hinata, who live in the same apartment complex as me, are my childhood friends and we’re all the same age. I thought that from now on we’d become even closer friends, but then Sou suddenly did that to me…!!

title: Wa!
description: At Takamanohara School, lots of the students have crushes, but all on different people. In fact, if you trace out who likes who, it makes a full circle! This is the story of that circle of crushes.

title: Orpheus no Mado
description:
The story begins in Europe, during the first years of the XX century. On a background of intrigues, machinations and a Europe that is going straight toward World War I, three kids meet at a strict conservatory in Germany. Julius met Isaac at the famous Orpheus' Window and later in another event met Klaus there. The legend told that two lovers met at Orpheus' Window would end in unhappiness. But Julius met two different persons, and they didn't know Julius' secret. In fact, Julius is a woman who's forced to dress up and pretend to be a guy. But she isn't the only one who has secrets. Klaus, for example, is Russian. Is he a communist spy? Then the whirlwind of fate began.

Outside of Rose of Versailles, Window of Orpheus is considered to be Ikeda's representative work and the culmination of the themes of her works up to that point.

Note: Has a gaiden known as Collage. Additional gaiden were written by Ikeda, but illustrated by her longtime assistant Erika Miyamoto.

title: I Confessed to a Lone Wolf Girl (Fan Colored)
description: A man confesses his love to a lone wolf girl.

title: Romansa & Difabel
description: Adapted from a famous story from an indonesian storyboard website "ffschan" anonymous users, Romansa & Difabel. tells about Awan, a high school student who has to help Difa, a neighbor who is Awan's classmate who has to sit in a wheelchair due to an accident. this story are focusing to their daily lives.

title: Midwinter Ice Cream
description: A oneshot by Kurachi Yone, who also made Mikansei demo koi ga ii.

title: Ore Koi!!
description: Crossover between Ore Monogatari!! and Nisekoi.

title: Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san (Official Colored)
description: A full-colour version of Manga One’s “Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san”, to commemorate anime adaptation! You can read full-colour, hand-picked episodes of “Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san” and “Ashita wa Doyoubi” that were broadcasted as anime!!

title: Ultra Marriage Galaxy
description: A perfectly ordinary alien boy comes to earth to find a suitable wife.

title: Nousatsu Junkie
description: Naka is an aspiring young model with a problem: her face tenses up into a terrifying spectacle whenever she gets nervous on photo shoots! Naka's rival is Umi, the hottest model at their agency. But Naka soon discovers Umi's secret–and hilarity ensues behind the cameras!

title: Hana Haru
description: A werewolf love for a human girl In a cold winter, little girl Hana and her family found a boy covered in blood, the boy is a werewolf baby. They picked up the boy, named him Haru, treated him and accepted him as a family member. A human girl and a werewolf boy who grew up over time. From now on their story begins.

title: Koi no Kaori
description:
Collection of oneshots:  
  
1. I Await Your Reply  
A girl confides in a friend she met online.  
  
2. Sorry I'm Obsessed  
Mimi has realized that she has feelings for Kuro, but before she can ask her out, she discovers that she might have some competition for Kuro's heart.  
  
3. Sweet Temptation  
Risa finds herself intrigued by a girl whose family runs a bakery.  
  
4. Sweet Desire  
Will Risa get a taste of what she's been craving? Chika from "Adorable to Me" makes an appearance to offer her some advice.  
  
5. Love*Aroma  
A girl is entranced with the way her new art teacher smells.  
  
6. Love*Preparation  
Childhood friends meet once again as student and teacher, but there's more in the way than just school. This chapter leads into "Steps", another collection by Takemiya.  
  
7. Love*Aroma 2  
Kimu confronts her new feelings.

title: Yamada-san wa Chanto Shitai
description: Yamada is on cloud nine dating Akkun. She pours her heart into making him homemade lunches every day, but her world comes crashing down when she spots him walking with another girl… (MANGA Plus)

title: Otomen
description: Asuka is a guy who has likings for girly things like shoujo manga, baking, and sewing. However, his mother forbids him being so and wants him to grow up manly. He starts learning kendo and karate and grows up to be stoic guy. But can he fight the urge of falling in love and hiding his real identity?

title: U19
description:
Year 2036, Japan is under the adult party power and make children's life miserable. But for "rebelious-edgy-teenager-with-funny-scar" Kudo Eiji, It doesn't matter because he has his childhood friend Akari to cheer his everyday life. For Eiji, Akari is his emontional mainstay. Someone that can make him calm.  
  
But then, one day adult party decide took Akari and transfer her to another school. It emotionaly stress Eiji out. Little did Eiji know, this awaken some power inside him.

title: The Class President's Circumstances
description: The class president has a crush on Takahashi! Now, she just needs to gather enough courage to talk to him… Huh? Why is she stripping all of a sudden?! A short comedic slice of life.

title: Couple of the White Room
description: One of the older yuri manga out there. Resine comes to a new boarding school to find she is rooming with Simone, a rebel who is rude to her from the start. However, Resine and Simone end up falling in love…

title: Kyousei Harem Keiyaku
description: Our protagonist Haruka has been given the gift of precognition. He’s led an ordinary life so far, without really giving question to his special ability. However, one day, he foresees someone close to him die in an accident while travelling. It’s only after he sees this insufferable vision that he gathers the determination fight against the future, but… in such an unthinkable way. What will the future hold after Haruka rises up against a fate that’s already been decided…?

title: Saihate no Serenade
description:
An intense suspense about a piano prodigy and her mother's murder by the industry's hottest talent, Hino Hiroko!

A country town in Hokkaido. Ritsu is a junior high school student who lives in a house with a piano teacher, and Saya is a transfer student who attends the school. As the two grow closer through a piano competition, Saya tells Ritsu that she wants to kill her mother.

Time passes, and ten years later. Ritsu is spending her busy days in the editorial department of a weekly magazine in Tokyo, when a body is found in her hometown in Hokkaido, causing a commotion.

A memory of ten years ago and a ten year gap. As if ignoring the length of time, the story now begins to move forward.

title: Koi ni Itazura
description: A transformative love story about the determination of a girl who can’t be honest with herself.

title: Eden no Otome
description: In the distant future, humanity is now only made up of women. Kohane Sumino has just enrolled into the prestigious Shirasakuya Academy that contains within it a secluded courtyard garden maintained by the Gardening Club. Legend has it that if two people pledge their love for each other underneath a pair of trees in that garden, they will be bound for eternity. Kohane seeks out the garden on her first day of school, where she meets Rekka Hanatsuka, the friendly self-proclaimed acting president of the Gardening Club. Although Kohane proves to be fairly popular early on, she soon learns that paradise is not without its thorns.

title: Yuri Manga
description: A oneshot posted to pixiv by Sinogiasa.

title: Girlish Sweet
description:
The distance between lovers, chance-meetings after years apart, the bitterness of youth… Through hurtful pasts, these girls learn to live for the present out of love for their girlfriends.  
  
Published in April 2010 by Hakusensha, Takemiya Jin's first volume is a collection of her "red sailor uniform" series of original yuri doujinshi (first released between February 2008 and November 2009).

title: Madowaseru Onna-tachi
description:
Her smile makes my heart clench sweetly in my chest. The first love of a high school girl, a mysterious bunny, a sister who blindly loves her brother, and a glamorous librarian... A collection of thirteen "fascinating women" stories. Please enjoy the beauty of the gems of the manga magazine HARTA.

**Contents:**
1. "Mugiwara Boushi no Onnanoko" (麦藁帽子の女の子) by Takahashi Natsuko
2. "Harutatsu Ane" (春立つ姉) by Kurokawa Yumi
3. "Tsukumo Kitan" (九十九奇譚) by Ameishi
4. "Nee-san, Okite" (ねえさん、起きて) by Umenoki Bino
5. "Nare no Hate Waltz" (成れの果てワルツ) by Kari Sumako
6. "Itoko no Onee-san" (いとこのお姉さん) by Tomi Akihito
7. "90 59 88" by Ohtake Masao
8. "Momonoki Haruko no Aijou" (桃ノ木春子の愛情) by Unoshima Yoh
9. "Perapera Marumaru" (ぺらぺらまるまる) by Yamade Kanae
10. "Aoi Yoru" (青い夜) by namo: Kuroda and Shimamura get trapped in a classroom and everything gets worse when they see two of their teachers are having sex.
11. "Miss Hohokabe Toshokan no Maryoku" (MISSほほかべ図書館の魔力) by Matsumoto Suisei
12. "Bucchouzura no Bun

title: My Secret Affection
description: It’s been thirty years since meteorites from space turned everyone on Earth gay. In a world where heterosexuality no longer exists, Takanashi Kazusa falls for her childhood friend Ayumu–a boy. Though she’s doing everything she can to act normal whenever they hang out, her love for Ayumu is growing stronger by the day. How much longer can she hide her secret feelings?

title: The Story of How My Childhood Friend Gave Me Chocolate on Valentine's Day after I Didn't Get Any from Anyone
Contact x Contact
description: When Kusa Aoi changes seats, she finds herself sitting next to Enomoto Wataru, a boy who she has never had any contact with and whom she thought she would never get along with... but it turns out that they share a common hobby. They gradually become friends and start spending more and more time together. This is a love story that begins unexpectedly in the ordinary life of a high school student.

title: Neo Parasyte f
description: Parasites: shape-shifting aliens whose only purpose is to assimilate with and consume the human race… but do these monsters have a different side? A parasite becomes a prince to save his romance-obsessed female host from a dangerous stalker. Another hosts a cooking show, in which the real monsters are revealed. These and 13 more stories, from some of the greatest shoujo manga artists alive today, together make up a chilling, funny, and entertaining tribute to Hitoshi Iwaaki's manga horror classic!

title: Blue Blazes
description:
It was the early 1980s, a hot time when a new movement was beginning to emerge in the world of manga and anime. There was a young man who had aspirations of becoming a great mangaka. His name was Moyuru Hono. However, all he has is ambition, but nothing concrete has been done yet...?
___
- **Won the 18th Japan Media Arts Festival Excellence Award in 2014**
___
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Level Comics as **Blue Flame: Comic Bomber Early Years** (2011)

title: Wake Wakannai Kimi ga Suki
description: Ichihana is a rising JK who dreams of a blooming life in high school... but she is also full of love and fashion, and should win the championship. However, she is named a member of the class committee (cup maid) by a lottery. And the other member of the committee is Izumi, a super nerdy otaku who has never spoken to her! She thinks her future is bleak, but Izumi's unexpected side makes her nervous! They are complete opposites in every way, but love comes out of nowhere.

title: Namida Usagi ~Seifuku no Kataomoi~
description: When Momoka, a very shy girl who loves rabbits, is forced to change her seats, she finds herself at sitting at the back of the class, next to a boy she has never spoken to before, Narumi. Everyone thinks that he is strange and all of the girls are afraid of him. Why? There is a rumor that he is cursed and that the girls sitting next to him will never find love. Momoka believes in the rumor and fears him, but she gradually discovers the true Narumi and eventually new feelings are taking a hold on her. Is it friendship or… love?

title: Shoot for it! The Mesugaki Way!
Eoneun Jeom
description:
Saet-byeol, a sharp-tongued Omega hiding his secondary gender, has no intention of ever finding a mate. But everything changes when he discovers that his classmate Yul, an emotional Alpha with a fate complex, is his destined pair. The catch? Yul believes Saet-byeol is a Beta and mistakes his feelings for simple friendship.

Determined to ignore his growing attraction, Saet-byeol keeps his distance. When Jae-young, an openly dominant Omega, transfers into their class and immediately captures Yul’s attention, Saet-byeol finds it harder and harder to keep his own heart frozen.

A cold-blooded secret, a one-sided fate, and a love triangle that defies logic. How long can they keep their true desires buried before everything starts to melt?

title: When the Day Comes
description:
We're in a relationship where we've broken up but haven't really broken up.  
What will happen to us when we haven't been truthful?

title: Akaneiro ni Somaru Saka
description: In order to protect the girl Yuuhi Katagiri, a new transfer student, …from danger, Junichi Nagase is forced to kiss her. Not understanding what happens, she screams at him, not knowing that her father has arranged for her to marry him.

title: Good Morning Call
description: Nao Yoshikawa stays behind to live by herself when her parents leave to inherit her grandpa's farm in the country. On the day she moves into her new apartment, she discovers that it was rented also to Hisashi Uehara–a cute, super-cool, popular guy from her school. Not only did their housing agency unexpectedly close down, the landlord of the apartment tells them that they had to pay more for their aparment then they had expected. With no money and no home to return to, Nao and Hisashi decide to live together as flatmates.

title: Half & Half
description:
Our heroine is girl named Hina-chan. She is in her 20s. Hina has a handsome boyfriend now, but she will always remember her first love, a boy named Itsuki. When other kids would tease Hina, calling her ugly, Itsuki would defend her, and try to cheer her up and make her feel better. He and some of his family eventually moved away, leaving Hina heartbroken. But the memory of her first love will always make Hina feel nostalgic and happy inside. Itsuki’s grandmother still lives next door to Hina, so she still has a connection to him, somehow.  
  
One day, Hina has a dream of Itsuki, and she is feeling especially nostalgic about him. She is just mentioning her dream to his grandmother, when they are interrupted by the arrival of a stranger. It is a tall, beautiful woman. Wait a minute… it’s Itsuki! Itsuki is not joking, either. She explains that she is really a woman on the inside, and now she is dressing that way on the outside.  
  
Hina finds herself falling in love with Itsuki, regardl

title: Mitsume no Onna no Ko ni Kokuhaku Suru Hanashi
Niji, Amaete yo.
description: You like that person right? And that’s how it started. A shuttering, saddening, deep pure love story will start.

title: Suki o Tsutaetai
description: Published as part of the 45th Sunday Battle 8. Theme: anger.

title: Childhood Friend & Me
description:
The story of me and my childhood friend, who's so cute I just want to eat her.

GL oneshot, fluffy. A manhua I made to practice over summer break in high school, the art and writing are both pretty rubbish. I hope you don't dislike it.

title: Soshite Bokura wa Warai Au
description: A childhood friend, who he has had an unrequited love for, for many years, is dating another childhood friend. Unable to heal the wounds of his broken heart, Takashi, who is suffering alone on the rooftop, is suddenly joined by Yota who appears in front of him. After meeting Yota, Takashi gradually becomes more positive. A story of two clumsy people who meet after school.

title: Swimsuit World
description: A bunch of school kids live in a world where people wear swimsuits all the time, as everyday clothing.

title: Short Manga Scribbles About the Person Next to Me
Boku Koi Conductor
description: Nakamura Kouta is a freshman in high school who dislikes girls. One day he is visited by his childhood friend Karen, with whom he lost contact over time. Karen is a tomboyish girl, who refers to herself as “Boku” (a first person pronoun usually used by males). She asks him to help her become more feminine to win the affection of Itsuki-san, a colleague at her part time job. Even though he is reluctant at first, he more or less voluntarily agrees to help her out in the end. But making a lady out of the clumsy Karen with nothing but his extensive galge experience as reference proves more difficult than he could imagine.

title: Kimi no Na wa. Another Side: Earthbound
description:
Mitsuha is a young girl living in a rural town named Itomori and is fed up with her life. One day, her family and friends notice she's suddenly acting strange. Little do they know, a high school boy from Tokyo named Taki Tachibana found himself randomly switching places with her when he fell asleep. But he has no clue how to act as a high school girl in an unfamiliar place!  
  
This is the story of the hit novel Kimi no Na wa. from the perspective of Mitsuha's friends and family as they deal with her strange new quirks—and avoid disaster.

title: Kimi ni Happiness
description: Bubbly girl Aizawa Yume gets to know the cool boy in her class, Kashiwagi Kou — who tickles her nose with a sweet scent and only smiles from time to time. Yume gradually develops feelings for Kou-kun… but one day after school, she catches him with…?!

title: Asuka
description: Takamichi Mishima is a boring high school student in the film study club. One day, his everyday life changes completely. He is planning a film about Asuka, his dream heroine, when Asuka appears before him. Mishima, who believes that [his own feelings brought Asuka into existence in this world], begins his dreamlike days.......

title: Sekai wa Kimi o Sukuu!
description:
Contains five short stories.  
  
1-2. Sekai wa kimi (w)o Sukuu!  
Harusawa Hiro, a 16-year-old girl, is always saying what she thinks and has no friends. One day, she yells at the famous Yamazaki Ryou from class C.  
  
3. Boku no Candy / My Sweet Heart  
Kubo Yukiya confesses to the girl he likes: Hoshino Mimi! She looks like an angel but is nothing like that at all…!  
  
4. Clear Note  
Hasegawa Rumi is a rather shy girl that likes books. One day, she has to do the class-duties with the popular Kazama. They seem to have nothing in common…  
  
5. Green Boy x Blue Girl

title: Incomplete Theorem
description: A youthful school life story centered around two problematic teenagers, a germophobic tsundere boy and an airhead girl with a sleeping disorder.

title: Codename: Sailor V
description: Before Sailor Moon, Minako Aino was a normal 13-year-old schoolgirl until a fateful day when a white cat introduced himself to her and tells her she has the power to transform into the hero, Sailor V. Using a magic pen to transform, Sailor V fights the evil agents of the Dark Agency as she strives to protect the earth.

title: Yamamoto-kun no Seishun Revenge!
description: Ryuga Yamamoto is a first-year high school student who weighs 130 kilograms due to a strange disease. He was bullied at school and at his part-time job because of his ugly appearance. Even in such a situation, he is blessed with a few people who understand him, he is able to help a classmate and is able to receive medical treatment.

title: She Who's Perfect at Vocal Practice
Moyuru Haru ni Deiau Bokura
description: Takanashi Haru, a plain and unassuming boy with black hair and glasses, secretly has a crush on the popular teacher Nanjou. His crush is accidentally discovered by his classmate, Sanada Kazuki, a flashy and popular guy who is the complete opposite of Takanashi. Sanada takes an interest in Takanashi's unrequited love for Nanjou and tries to help Takanashi attract the teacher's attention.  But as Takanashi starts spending more time with Sanada, he begins to experience Sanada's kindness... Maybe Sanada isn't just the flashy guy he appears to be...? What will become of this usual pairing...!?

title: Shinbunbu no Komatsu-san
description: Komatsu Akina is a passionate photographer for her school's newspaper club. When Aoi-kun of the Student Council confesses to her, all of a sudden she has this huge decision to make. Since she has never dated before, Komatsu is confused as to whether or not she should date the extremely popular Aoi-kun, who is constantly surrounded by pretty girls. She continues to struggle with her own lack of confidence and her budding feelings for Aoi-kun, but decides that sometimes she just has to take a leap of faith and go for it!

title: Zennou no Noa - The World of Lost Memories
description: In the year 2038, a white light descended on the center of Tokyo and stole the memories of over one million people. The cause of this horrible incident was not determined, and no cure was to be found. The government formed a separate city beneath Tokyo to house and care for the victims of the incident and branded them as "KIDz." Regardless of their age, they truly are like children, and they must be retaught everything they once knew. Noa Ikurumi, who lives in this isolated society, is just taking one day at a time and dreaming of finally being allowed to go back out into the world. But Noa's life will once again change drastically on the day that he is taken hostage by a terrorist with some surprising information about his identity...

title: Suki na Hito ga Kaku Moji ga Suki ni Naru
Mamiya-san to Issho
description: Sasara is a strange girl who always responds to love confessions with "Sure, only if you die." One day she was confessed to by the beautiful and popular Mamiya, a third-year upperclassman. Sasara was surprised that Mamiya loves her even though they're both girls, but she responded like she always does. The next day, she found out from her classmates that Mamiya had been a missing person, and realized the one she is seeing now is a ghost. Sasara ran out, cried and said Mamiya is dead because of her, but also smiled because Mamiya had met her condition and proved her love. The two of them started dating. Sasara set out to unravel the truth behind Mamiya's death.

title: The Sleeping Prince and the Health Committee Member
Komatta Toki ni wa Hoshi ni Kike!
description:
Fujishima Takara, a high school student, will soon start living in a dorm due to having lost all of his family except for his father, who's always away for work. Takara has to share a room with Hosaka Kiyomine. Living together isn't easy, and many rows ensue. Kiyomine is very introverted, while Takara is just the opposite. At first, the two get on each other's nerves because of those differences. But things turn towards friendship and later on towards love.  


---

title: Kiss/Hug
description: Ryuu, a super-businesslike transfer student from England with black hair and blue eyes just arrived! During the night of the Tanabata festival, Ryuu and Yukino became attracted to each other at first sight. He then declares, “You will be mine!” This brought confusion to Yukino, who has zero experience in love. But could she actually be falling in love

title: Bokura no Kiseki ~another stories~
description:
Bokura no Kiseki ~Another Stories~ is a volume featuring three sides stories for Bokura no Kiseki along with a few other works (mostly previously published in Arcana) by the author, Kumeta Natsuo.  
  
The volume was published in July 2018, a couple months after volume 18 of Bokura no Kiseki.   
Another story #1 also appeared in the July 2018 issue of Comic ZERO-SUM alongside Bokura no Kiseki ch. 75.

title: Kanojo wa Rokurokubi (Pre-Serialization)
description: **Buy:** [Suruga-ya](https://www.suruga-ya.jp/product/detail/ZHORO44333)

title: Natural
description: Riko (whose real name is Ayako) was already in high school when she gained a new younger brother. Miguel is a nine-year-old Peruvian boy rescued by her father in the midst of turmoil before he came home to his loving family in Japan. Miguel had a good grasp of Japanese but he didn't seem to be warming up at first. He was overly polite and he barely smiled. But Riko was determined to make sure that he felt that he was now a part of her family, introducing him to the world outside and to the game of basketball… Now Miguel is in high school, fresh out of the international school. And he has proven he can be good at many things: in academics, in sports… but even though he seems to be really good at basketball (showed the students their first live look at a dunk), and though he seems to really like it, he seems unwilling. What is he afraid of? What is he pushing away?

title: Love Under the Sunset
description: One is careless and the other is cold, expressionless, and independent in mind. Once they meet under the sunset, what kind of bonds will these two young people create?

title: Nekonotemo
description:
What will happen to an ordinary human teacher who falls into a youkai school, with his only ally(?) a sexy but air-headed nekomata? A slight ecchi and heartwarming read brought to you by the author of “Sore wa Totsuzen, Unmei no Aite ga”  
  
A short story about a cat demon and a teacher.

title: Young Bad Education
description:
**Vol 1: Young Bad Education**

**Vol 2: Young Good Boyfriend**

Locked out of his home one day, Mizusawa runs across Takatsu, his homeroom teacher, drunk on a bench. In a stupor, Takatsu confesses he has been watching Mizusawa for three years and kisses him. Mizusawa had no interest in 37-year-old Takatsu…until that day. With a smirk on his face, Mizusawa begins teasing Takatsu about the incident, much to Takatsu's horror. But, when Takatsu starts attending marriage interviews, Mizusawa realizes he wants his homeroom teacher.

title: Chouchou Koi
description: Shiori Michishige has always dreamed about meeting her "fated lover." During the spring break preceding her first year of high school, Shiori starts dating Itsuki Karusawa. Although she thought she had finally met her destined soulmate, Itsuki cheats on Shiori and the two break up. Shiori then makes her high school debut with every intention of finally finding her true destined lover and take revenge on her cheating ex-boyfriend… but Itsuki happens to be in the same class?

title: My Student Can't Be a Psychopath
description:
Psychopaths are known for their crimes on TV, but not all of them are bound to become criminals… They live next to us without us knowing what they are, wearing a mask to hide their true nature…  
Kim Young Hee is a newly appointed nurse in a high school infirmary. One day, one of her student declares " I am a psychopath…"

title: Ura mo Omote mo Kimi ga Suki
description: From Maiu Cafe : The boy everyone admires at school, the tough guy in class, the sweet girl from the club, that one smart guy… Be the only one to know their true selves! A series of emotional stories that will make your heart race!

title: My Classmates Are All Very Strange
description:
Liao Yuqing, who’s just an ordinary female high schooler, somehow bumps into a Prince Charming-like* student on her way to school?! At the same time, the highly anticipated foreign mad dog, pretty boy student, Ryan, finally meets the frightening Demon King—Chu Feng. Surrounded by these four people, an ordinary teenage girl and her eccentric schoolmates begin living an unordinary daily life.  
  
T/N: "Prince Charming" literally translates to "White Horse Prince" in Chinese.

title: Mathematical Girls - Fermat's Last Theorem
description:
"I" (Boku) love math. Just after the high school entrance ceremony, "I" meet a beautiful girl: Milka. Milka is a mathematical genius. She gives me many maths problems, she shows me many elegant solutions. Milka and I spend a long time by discussing maths in the school library.  
  
One year later, I meet another mathematical girl: Tetra. Tetra is one year younger than me, and asks me to teach her mathematics. While I teach her, she begins to understand mathematics and gradually to love its elegance.  
  
In this second volume (series), we talk about Pythagoras' Theorem, Elementary Number Theory, Group, Ring, Field, and Fermat's Last Theorem.

title: Bad Boy Who Lies In Love
description: Just an ordinary girl who had just started her high school life, but she never thought that something would happen and she ended up getting involved with the most senior naughty guy in school. Plus she was asked to be her boyfriend. And what will his life be like after this?

title: Kurage no Hone wa Ao
description: One day in summer, when the cicadas are chirping loudly. Haruka Nanami, a sophomore in high school, receives a confession from Kudo Satoru, a student at a neighboring high school. Haruka is at a loss, saying, "I've never even talked to him before..." Kudo suggests that they start out as friends, and the two exchange contact information. At the same time, at a railroad crossing in the town where the two live, a series of similar accidents occur day after day. They are madly in love. They want to be together, but they can't.

title: One Semester Servant
description: Instead of trying to express his feelings to the girl he likes, Revan gets bad luck because his love letter was found by her friend. Because he didn’t want the letter to leak, he had to be Yesika’s servant for one semester!

title: Bokkonrinri
description: Rin had quit calligraphy after her mother's death. Then upon seeing the calligraphy of a high school calligraphy masters, Uchida Dougen, she started learning again. Rin entered the same school as Dougen and the current calligraphy club or more like Dougen fan club. When the student council president announced that the club would be disbanded, Rin had to take action to keep the club going. Dougen, who had come to support the president, ended up joining the club because Rin's word sparked his interest. Unbeknownst to her, Dougen is somewhat of a playboy. What will become of Rin and her beloved Calligraphy club?

title: Itsuka Sora kara
description:
Nakagawa Yuki, a popular boy at school, lives a fulfilling life, always assuring his friends Shinichi and Midori that he is happy. However, on his 17th birthday, his father tells him, "You're an alien," and he discovers that he has awakened to the ability to transform into other people. Then, by chance, Shinichi and Midori see Yuki transformed into a girl, and Shinichi falls in love with him at first sight...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: School Rumble Z
description:
**Contains:**  
  
- 4 fantasy stories (1 plausibly tying into the main story)  
- 1 story taking place before the events of the main story.   
- 1 story taking place after Harima announces he's a mangaka  
- 4 stories occurring after the final chapter (Showing the final couples and a glance to the future.)

title: Doll's Folklore
description: The sole survivor and witness to the serial kidnapping case that drew national attention 10 years ago was Oyamada Yousuke. In the end, a total of 108 children vanished into thin air and the case remains unsolved. Since that incident, Yousuke has been able to see evil spirits and has been attempting to seclude himself from society. But one day, he meets Kanno, a member of the anti-doll organization. She explains that the spirits that he has been seeing are called dolls and are the manifestation of people’s incredibly strong emotions. Yousuke accidentally releases a doll named Makina that even the organization had to resort to simply imprisoning her instead of destroying her. However, Yousuke learns that Makina has a connection to the kidnapping case that he was involved in years ago!

title: Kage Kara Mamoru!
description: In times gone past there was a Lord, one who loved Konnyaku. He loved it so much that he ordered his ninjas to protect the family of the finest Konnyaku makers in his land. The protection of the family continues even to today, Mamo-kun, youngest of the ninja family protects the innocent and naïve Yuuna from sinister forces, though more often from herself.

title: Fudanshi Sensei!!!!!
description: Fudanshi Sensei!!!!! is a rom-com about an otaku high school teacher and his relationship with one of his students. The story begins with biology teacher Kazuto Kiryu visiting the club of Ageha Saotome, who actually sells BL doujinshi! Mr Kiryu gets a lot of attention from the female students for being a cool teacher, but he is actually a fudanshi!

title: Kimi ni Koi o Suru nante, Arienai Hazu Datta
description:
A plain guy who attends a prefectural high school in Minamisou in the Chiba prefecture, Iijima Yasuki, lived through gray days in his Science class.  
  
Despite this, on the last night of the study training camp just before summer vacation, he helped the school’s number one beauty, Kitaoka Ema, when she was in trouble.  
  
Now for some reason Ema has become pleased with him. However, she only talks to him outside of school. In the classroom she pretends not to know him.  
  
Just what is Ema thinking?  
  
There is a hierarchy in the school, with a disparity between a plain-type glasses boy and a flashy-type girl.  
  
Two existences that were supposed to run counter to each other; a passing love story.

title: Back to the Highteen
description: Bo-Young is 28 years old and still struggling to finish college because she can't afford the tuition. After being unceremoniously dumped by the boyfriend she had supported over the years, Bo-Young gets the chance to get herself out of her stagnant life when she accepts a position to pose as a high school student for a year. All she has to do is avoid getting caught.

title: Sam-i neun Jaesaenghanda
description: After her parents died, Sami gave up her life of fortune to live independently, doing odd jobs to make ends meet. When she starts to get involved with two of the most popular boys at her high school, Sami faces twists and turns -- Chan is her neighbor, and Pyojun makes her have conflicted feelings. Things get more complicated when she finds out that Chan has feelings for Pyojun as well! With her mom’s only keepsake in hand to keep her feet on the ground, Sami navigates obstacles that she wasn’t prepared for -- and aren’t even in her budget!

title: Arisa
description: For years the rash tomboyish Tsubasa had communicated with her twin through letters. She had formed the idea that the gentle Arisa led a joyful school life. But upon Arisa's sudden suicide attempt, Tsubasa vows to find the reason behind her twin's actions by taking her place at school. But will this supposed joyful life be too much for Tsubasa to handle? What does it have to do with the people disappearing from Arisa's school…

title: Confession from Tomorrow
description:
Today's high school's entrance ceremony! Even after middle school, 'Dajoon' is still popular. But 'Siyoon' feels a strange sense of incompatibility with him…  
  
One day, when Siyoon happens to go to Dajoon's place, what he sees is… his violent side?!

title: Onnanoko Tokidoki Otokonoko
description:
Yuusuke & Akira used to be childhood friends, but haven't seen each other in 10 years after Akira's father was temporarily transferred for his job. Now cute Akira has come back and is living next door, and she's looking to keep Yuusuke to the promise he made to her when they were little.  
  
The problem? Akira is actually a guy!

title: A Manga That Shows That Male-Female Friendships Can Be Formed
description: Male-female friendship can be formed

title: Wagamama Mille-Feuille
description:
A Collection of one-shot stories by Chisako.

Desire Parade: A girl who loves money meets a rich girl that is willing to spoil her.
Indigo Applause: A twin thinks she's not as good as her sister.

title: Fire Train
description: The clue to the missing persons case is hidden behind a child who is both beautiful and sinister.

title: Shinai Koi
description: Sakura is an incredible kendo fighter who uses an abnormally short shinai. She regularly trounces boys who underestimate her skills. One day two kendo fighters, even stronger than her sensei, attack her dojo asking questions about someone called Narukami Koharu. Apparently, there is a lot Sakura doesn't know about her family history, and it could very well get her killed. Now, Sakura must try to live up to her father's legacy.

title: Kyou Kara Mongen 7:00 Desu
description: Touka find out that her mother, before her death, has hired an housekeeper who look after her. But her housekeeper is an unpleasant 25-year old man who loves trouble her, and who decides that from now on Touka's curfew will be at 7:00 PM.

title: 17-sai, Kiss to Dilemma
description:
From Chibi Manga:

At 17-year-old, I didn't know anything about life or love. And I didn't see my cousin as a "man"...
I dont want to know anything, but love changed everything.

**Note:**  The following alteernative language titles do not have a language flag.
- 17 sai, KISS Lil Dilemma (Maltese)
- 17-Sai, Póg go Saincheist (Irish)
- 17-Սայ, համբուրեք երկընտրանքի առջև (Armenian)

title: Naisho ja Tarinai yo
description:
Collection of oneshots:   
  
- Naisho ja Tarinai yo  
Actually we are married…! Together with the senpai that I adored, a secret newlywed life. But, senpai always treats me like I’m a little kid…  (from Chibi Manga)  
  
- Moshimo Oshimen ni Gohoushi Dekitara  
Minori-san finally gets to meet her favourite, uber-popular idol group "Ciel" and even gets to work with them! However, they are not what they seem… despite that, our heroine is determined not to tolerate this!  (From: MU)  
  
- Ikemen Heroine-chan ♥  
  
- 24h Honey  
  
- Kuuki-chan to Yankee-kun ('Girl With No Presence' and 'Yankee Guy')  
Nitou Saya, a 15-year-old scaredy-cat with a weak presence, suddenly finds herself ambushed by the infamous delinquent Kasai Arata-kun. To make matters worse, she ends up kissing him accidentally - and their bodies swap! Will her life turn into an awful disaster or will this incident develop into an unexpected opportunity?  (From: MU)

title: Chou Donkan Mob ni Heroine ga Kouryaku sarete, Otome Game ga Hajimarimasen
description: Shinoyama Masahiko reincarnated into the world of an otome game as a mob character. Being an ordinary guy, he didn't think he'd be involved in any way, so he decided to just live his second life without any regrets. Nevertheless, he ends up solving all the troublesome events of the game for the sake of the love interests. Seeing his actions, the heroine of the game ends up pursuing him instead. However, Masahiko's so stupidly dense that even the love interests cheer for the heroine.

title: Akira Toriyama's Manga Theater
description:
A series of three manga tankōbon released between 1983 and 1997 that collect several one-shots written and illustrated by Akira Toriyama. The stories were originally published in various Shueisha magazines between 1978 and 1994.

Volume 1 (1983)
- Wonder Island (1978-1979)
- Tomato, Girl Detective (1979)
- Pola & Roid (1981)
- Mad Matic (1982)
- Chobit (1983)

Volume 2 (1988)
- Today's Highlight Island (1979)
- Escape (1982)
- Pink (1982)
- Dragon Boy (1983)
- The Adventures of Tongpoo (1983)
- Mister Hō (1986)
- Kennosuke-sama (1987)
- Sonchoh (1988)

Volume 3 (1997)
- Mamejiro (1988)
- Clear Skies, Karamaru (1989)
- Cashman - Saving Soldier (1990)
- Dub & Peter 1 (1992-1993)
- Go! Go! Ackman (1993)

title: Gakuto no Vector
description: A classmate learns that Minazu Aruto loves reading novels and short stories so she recommends a club that the school has called the Philosophia. The classmate doesn’t really know what the club is about but the name sparks a curiosity in Aruto and he decides to find out what it is. He goes to the old library on campus where he meets and is introduced to all three members of the group: Tomoe, Takaho and Kaede. Without really being explained what the Philosophia club is about, Aruto finds himself joining what he thinks is a literature club.

title: Koe kara hajimaru koi no ohashi
description:
A love that begins with the girl falling in love upon hearing the sweet sound of a voice.

Author's Twitter: https://twitter.com/nonno0588

title: Donten Prism Solar Car
description: When 10-year-old Kaneda Shota was involved in a car accident that claimed the life of his father, it changed the course of his life forever. Even though his mother got a job and tried her best to support her son, money was always tight. Now, unable to afford college, Shota works a part-time job, in addition to his full-time job at his uncle's factory. He dreams of one day saving enough money to go to college. He lives alone, on the second floor of one of his uncle's warehouses, and doesn't have any friends. Everywhere he goes, he rides a bicycle, with headphones to block out the flashback-inducing sounds of the cars. His quiet way of life is about to be interrupted. Due to pressures from the economy, Shota's job at his uncle's factory is going to be cut to half-time/half-pay for a while. In addition, Shota's uncle has agreed to lend the first floor of Shota's warehouse to a college club. This club is building a solar car to enter in a race, and they're hoping to get Shota to lend them

title: Invisible Girl in Love
description:
**1) The Restaurant of Many Orders** (Soko wa Chuumon no Ooi Ryouriten)  
A young woman frequents a certain French bistro. She would really enjoy the food they serve if only it weren't for the bossy chef owner. "You may not like me, but I love your food."  
  
**2) Invisible Girl in Love** (Toumei Ningen no Koi)  
A story about a socially awkward girl who's kept to herself for so long that she may as well be invisible to her classmates. Then, one day, she falls in love.  
  
**3) Matryoshka**  
A sweet analogy of the Russian doll: Matryoshka.  
As each doll is opened up to give another one, so do each memory containing his feelings towards her.  
  
**4) The Selfish Couple**  
  
**5) Drops.**  
A series of interconnected vignettes depicting how something as ordinary as rain can alter the course of people's lives.

title: Onegai Kami-sama!
description: Through a moment of carelessness Totally-not-Marimite fangirl Yuzuriko meets Miyu and is thrown right into the dazzling, fateful encounter she has always dreamed of. But the manga left her ill-prepared for the real deal.

title: Mathematical Girls - Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems
description:
"I" (Boku) love mathematics. Just after the high school entrance ceremony, "I" meet a beautiful girl: Miruka. Miruka is a mathematical genius. She gives me many math problems; she shows me many elegant solutions. Miruka and I spend a long time discussing math in the school library.  
  
One year later, I meet another mathematical girl: Tetra. Tetra is one year younger than me, and asks me to teach her math. While I teach her, she begins to understand math and to love its elegance gradually.  
  
In this third volume (series), we talk about logic puzzles, Peano arithmetic, epsilon-delta, Cantor's diagonal argument, Hilbert's program and Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems.

title: A Love Confession Awaits Her
description: A girl tries to troll her kouhai; it does and doesn't work.

title: Motosaya
description:
Momori and Eisaku dated in junior high. But because of Eisaku's abhorrent behavior, they broke up after a short time…  
  
Two years later, as Momori struggles to find a new love, Eisaku reappears before her. But the boy she remembers doesn't match the one she has in front of her. Could she have made the mistake of not seeing the real Eisaku? Would there still be time to start again?

title: Senobishite Jounetsu
description:
Pureness and harshness, heartrending yet lovely.

“Sensei, I like you.”

Sutou-sensei is confessed to by a student of hers. In the space between her position as a teacher and her own feelings, her emotions waver…The 4-koma “Senobishite Jounetsu” that raised controversy with mixed receptions during its serialization is included here, in this completely transparent yet unscenic collection of works.

Also included:
- Akakunaiito 
- Sakurahime
- Osake-san
- Shougatsu Sousou
- Oyome ni Ittemo
- Ame to Neko
- Fuufu Kakigōri
- Juugoya ni, Ofuro

title: MeltyMoment
description:
Any moment in the routine of daily life can be a step closer to love. Follow Takeru as he becomes closer with the school girls around him. What kind of girl will he fall in love with?  
  
Based on the eroge (visual novel) of the same name that was developed and published by HOOKSOFT.

title: Handsome Girl Being Made to Understand Something in a World Where Sex Practice Is Introduced in Health and Physical Education
Houkago no Luminous
description:
Before Kanata appears a transfer student, Mashiro, who claim to be his fiancée. Here begins the sci-fi love story involved in both earthlings and aliens!

*Source: Comic Growl*

title: Read and Fall in Love
description:
Aoharu(Youth love) stories that most of us have experienced and struggled.  
  
This manga contains 4 stories and they’re all one shot.

title: Mobile Magical Girl
description: Dai Hong is dead or alive, or maybe alive or dead? In the end, will he choose his childhood friend, or this outsider, who happens to be… a magical girl?

title: Cut
description: My red string is connected to yours. A confession received from a peculiar childhood friend. And so, Seunghyun and Donghwa begin dating. While in the middle of a normal date, plain old Donghwa gains the ability to see the red string, and notices that Seunghyun’s red string is going off in some other direction…!

title: Love Live! Superstar!! Liella! Kila2 Life Comic
description: A cute snapshot of Liella!’s sparkling daily life!!

title: The Heroine’s Friend Strikes Back
description: Reborn as a side character wrongfully accused and executed, Mia resolves to rewrite her fate. Returning to the moment she first met the villainous heroine, she vows to stand tall and fight back, sparking a thrilling rebellion against a fabricated destiny.

title: Tenshi no KATTE
description: A beautiful girl who fell from the skies! Alsera was naked because she is an angel! What a pickle my life has turned out to be because of this gorgeous angel who doesn't feel ashamed to lay everything bare!!

title: Brand New School Day
description: Shinjou wants to enter high school as a new man, since he had not been very popular back in Middle School. As he's trying to edge his way into society with his new look and personality, he happens to bump into Kurai Kako, a classmate from Middle School who had been just as invisible as he was. With her new look and personality, has arrived for just the same reason he has, and she's looking forward to snagging a boyfriend for high school. They'll just have to make a bet – who'll get a boyfriend/girlfriend first?

title: Dr. Rurru
description: A planet-threatening space disease, the "demon flu", has infected an inhabitant of Earth, and a space doctor is needed! The Space Medical Bureau has chosen Dr. Rurru for the job, but – unfortunately for Minao Hitoharu, the infected patient – she has a tendency to mishear and misspeak (with a mind towards ecchi) to comical effect.

title: At Summer’s End
description: Natsukawa, a member of the beautification committee, often finds her gaze lingering on her schoolmate Aihara. One fateful day off, she spots Aihara walking alongside another girl... As summer’s heat stirs the air, a delicate tale of first love begins to take shape...

title: Ao no Rettou
description: A light-hearted story about a boy who encounters a girl who is surprisingly a genius at ski jumping. A mini-series by the author of Shokugeki no Soma and artist of Tis Time for "Torture," Princess.

title: Futaridake no Kyoushitsu
description:
It's the last day of school before vacation and Yuki waits for the perfect opportunity to give Koharu her chocolates and to confess her feelings for him, but she can't bring herself to do so when the classroom is still filled with her classmates!   
She even pleads the curtain to conceal them and give her the chance to take the chocolates out of her bag. When will Yuki finally muster up her courage to confess? Will the perfect opportunity ever present itself?

title: Tsuki to Sekai to Étoile
description: Yozora starts her high school days at the Moonlight Academy, a school that specializes in music. She is chasing after Umiyuri-sama, a girl with a heavenly talent for singing.  (From: MU)

title: Nozokimi
description:
A college girl likes to draw people. 

One day her classmate in college peek at her drawings.

This simple event will scare her.

Why is that?

title: Hoshigari-chan no Kareshi Ka Keikaku
description: The two of them know each other's fap material, and they even rub each other out. Such childhood friends are Junto and Sato. One day, the AV that a classmate lent them showed a**l sex! Sato, gushing with curiosity, says that he wants to try it, and begs Junto to put it in. Junto gives in to the seduction, and…!

title: 090 - Eko to Issho
description: Hiroshi found a broken cellphone on the street and went to a shop to get it fixed. When it got delivered to his home, he got a life-sized girl instead but it is still a cellphone. Hiroshi only wants a normal cellphone that he can brag to his classmates but he can't return this one because of the expensive return fee written in the purchase contract. This is how Hiroshi discovers the advantages and disadvantages in life of owning a cellphone-girl, which he named Eko.

title: Bukimi no Tani-kun
description:
Is this love at first sight a bug? A sci-fi romantic comedy about a humanoid machine and a human girl!

In this world, humanoids are widely used for various purposes, such as housework, work, and conversation partners. However, due to certain circumstances, Komiyama-san doesn't have a humanoid, and a humanoid named Tani-kun is delivered to her home. As soon as Tani-kun makes eye contact with Komiyama-san, he falls in love at first sight and proposes marriage...!?
Life under the same roof with a humanoid in love begins now!

title: The Comic Changes My Destiny
description: When the book of destiny can portray and change the future, when the characters in the pen become a living reality, the comic world and the real world overlap! Ordinary female college student Luo Youzhen is about to experience an unprecedented experience, and embark on an adventure journey… A hidden cartoonist, a cartoon character with abilities, a hegemonic young man next to him, a mysterious female killer, who represents justice Who is evil? The comic legend that crossed the dimension opened!

title: Futagami☆Double
description:
Futagami Sousuke, 14 years old, is a normal student, wishing to live a normal life. But everything changes the day he sees a doppelganger of himself in his house.  
Since then, the girl he has a crush on, Amane, will introduce him to another side of his world he had no idea about, and it won't be anymore the dear peaceful days for Futagami.
___
Published in *Weekly Shounen Jump 2010 No. 05·06*.

title: Wèicéng Zhīxiǎo de Nà Yī-rì
description: A lot happened that day… An older brother flees with the adopted younger sister. The two survive with only each other after getting labeled as “The Murderer’s Children”. In those days where they accompanied each other, the two children carried their own concerns. And during someday no one knew, they developed feelings for each other…

title: I'm No Angel
description: In a rainy spring day, first year high schooler Midori Saejima saw a tall, handsome fellow student take care of a stray kitten. Without knowing the boy's name, she fell in love with him at the first sight. Due to sickness, Midori returned to school three days after summer vacation – only to find out that she was "volunteered" as a candidate for student council. After a series of embarrassing accidents, both she and the mysterious boy she had a crush on, Akira Sudo, were elected as members of the student council. Being the first student council of this newly established high school, they are about to create "new traditions" for their school and a bittersweet love story for themselves.

title: Buttobi!! CPU
description: This story revolves around the life of Akira, a student who has been saving his money for over three years to finally obtain a computer. Unable to get the model he wants he is offered the same model from a shady man in an alley. What happens next is something that will change his life forever. For he didn't look at the box closely enough to note that it isn't Model 9821, it is actually Model 2198, a super advanced gynoid who's sole purpose is to serve and protect her "master".

title: Kiyona Yubisaki, Bukiyona Tsumasaki
description: Ichigaya and Tomoki are high school students who don't really know each other. One day, Tomoki falls asleep during class and wakes up to find that the "cool" Ichigaya has painted his nails with a classmate's nail polish. The only way to get it off is to go to the home of Ichigaya. There, Tomoki steps into the lonely life of Ichigaya.

title: The Story of My Youth
description:
Once your chance is lost, you'll never get it back.

Author's Twitter: https://twitter.com/SHIROMANTA1020
Author's Pixiv: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/10509347

title: E→Robot
description:
What appeared before high school student, Yuuki, was a mysterious cute girl—Ai Roborovskii!! The truth was that she was a robot created by the hands of Yuuki's father who was a professor in Robotics. And this Ai's strongest weapon was…eroticism!? A super slapstick, robotic, erotic comedy!!  
  
**Included one-shots:**  
Volume 2:  
- E-Robot *(Pilot)*  
- SUPER hERO *(Previously unpublished; The 66th JUMP Treasure Newcomer Manga Award honorable mention (2013))*  
  
As a part of the JUMP START initiative, the first three chapters of E→Robot were published in English in VIZ Media's digital Weekly Shonen Jump.

title: Illuminating Emotions
description: A lovely story about a girl who cries easily by nothing and a boy who blushes for everything

title: Shinde Seishun ga Sakumono ka!
description:
"It wasn't a suicide!"
Takato is pushed off the school roof by someone unknown and turns into a ghost. In order to find the culprit, he seeks cooperation from Naruse, the only classmate who can actually see him. However, Naruse turns out to be an extreme "[Blank]"...?

title: Uma x Tra Lovely Derby
description:

title: Cheer Cheer
description:
The Otohime Private All-Girls High School is a very prestigious school and full of pretty girls. However, there is one male student attending the school, the director’s son Ouji. Ouji is a creepy pervert who can get away with anything because his father doesn’t punish him. He’s got video cameras all over the school to get footage of his classmates naked or near-naked and constantly sneaks around with cameras to get photos of them. The school is his paradise.  
  
All this will change in the coming year, though. His father has decided to make the school co-ed, but with only baseball players so that they can aim for winning the National High School Baseball Championship at Koshien Stadium. In preparation for this grand dream, the director insists that the girls of the school establish a cheerleading squad. Seeing his glorious world collapsing around him, Ouji latches on to the most hopeful thing he can find: the cheerleading squad. Now he and the reluctant student council president, Itsu

title: Hide in the Flowers
description: Short stories of romance between girls who strive to improve on their magic in an academy.

title: Yankee Figure
description:
Figurine otaku Hitsuji Yamashita gets bullied. Tough girl Sakura Sakurai beats the !@#* out of anyone that pisses her off and in ch.1 she ends up beating the hell out of the bullies because they were disturbing her sleep.   
  
Anyway when she turns to Hitsuji, she ends up putting him in a leg lock because he forgot to thank her. She stops and then realizes who he was. A black cat passes by and grins and suddenly there's a puff of smoke and in the smoke the goddess of destruction Sakura Sakurai has shrunk to the size of a doll. There is more than enough ecchi that takes advantage of Sakura's new size. And with her having to keep this tragedy from spreading to people's ears, she has to keep it a secret and Hitsuji helps.
