title: Hatsukoi Canvas
description: Sakurako Kagawa has never had a friend through primary and middle school. It turns out that the reason for that is because she always seems to draw the weirdest drawings. Newly serialised with the high school art room as the stage, it's sure to make your heart beat, a pure and bright romantic story.

title: Tonari no Atashi
description: Nina's neighbor, Kyousuke, is starting high school while she's still stuck in junior high. Just walking to their nearby schools together isn't enough for her–especially since they keep running into Yuiko: a beautiful, outgoing girl in Kyousuke's grade who also seems to harbor feelings for Nina's next-door neighbor.

title: Janus no Kagami: Tatemanga-ban
description:
Based on the 2019 television drama adaptation of the 1980s manga, Hiromi, a timid and quiet high-schooler, was forcefully raised by her grandmother. Due to her abuse, Hiromi created an imaginary version of herself in the mirror, named "Yumi," and would play by talking to her as a child. By the time Hiromi becomes a high school student, she only remembers playing with the mirror, but one day, she hears a voice coming from inside her reflection asking, "Is what Grandma says really right?"

Triggered by this voice, Hiromi's alternate personality freely controls Hiromi's body and ventures out into the night without Hiromi's knowledge...what sort of dangerous activities will "Yumi" force her timid host into, and what will become of this dynamic?

title: Your Vision
description: A girl who is introverted and incompetent finds a bow in her room. After wearing it, she sees something unexpected… Adolescent feelings, afraid of discovery, and longing for new knowledge. My love for you comes not from you, but because I like you. My gaze is on you and you only.

title: The Chronicle of Teenage Boys
description:
Simple and shy, the boy has a crush on his class president, but the two-faced class president teases and rebuffs him! Oh my, will the first spring of his life be a good one or not?  
  
This story is divided into two stages: their high school years and adulthood.  
  
- [Author Twitter [NSFW]](https://twitter.com/dalegeyu)  
- [Author Pixiv [NSFW]](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/18133979)  
\_\_\_  
  
Ele, que é inocente e tímido, começou a desenvolver sentimentos pelo representante de sua classe, mas o representante tem suas emoções em altos e baixos! Ah, será que na primeira primavera de sua vida, poderá dar frutos?  
  
Nt. Essa história é dividida em duas etapas: eles jovens e a idade adulta.

title: Kare to Kanojo no Chiguhagu
description:
Koume, who has always admired the rumored "princess carry" is in her first year of high school. On her way to school, she meets a boy, Daisuke, who's extremely athletic, but extremely small. The only thing big is his attitude.  
  
Our first impressions suck! Plus, we're in the same volleyball club!  
  
I can't believe it's with Daisuke! or so I thought… but my heart won't stop thumping hard. What is this–!?

title: Cross Days
description:
Yuuki Ashikaga is a high-school freshman in his second semester at Sakakino Academy, who from his regular visits to the school library, grows enamored by Kotonoha Katsura, a fellow classman who comes by to read. Despite already having a boyfriend, she genuinely reciprocates his interest. However things get complicated when, following a brief encounter, his sister, Chie Ashikaga, introduces him to Roka Kitsuregawa, an acquaintance who also becomes infatuated with him. Out of jealous spite for her rival, Roka attempts to dissuade Yuuki by claiming to like Makoto Itou, another schoolmate. Her lie dramatically backfires, as Yuuki, aware that Makoto is Kotonoha's boyfriend, goes to ask her about the affair.  
  
Note: Cross Days takes place in the middle of the original School Days storyline and provides an alternate take on how things might have turned out.

title: Kokage-kun Bewitched
description: Yumeko dreams of being a pampered princess, but reality has her living in a shitty old apartment building. With a forest on the roof. And a witch in the forest. Tadaa! Maybe she can get this witch (who is a guy, weird) to magically grant all her wishes, up to and including making her destined prince (high school crush) fall in love with her.

title: Dragon Who
description: Roa Coatl is on a mission. He must find the descendant of Quetzalcoatl to make her his wife and continue his great race of dragons for 'that day'. However, with no knowledge about love and having no interest in women, will he be able to accomplish his task in human world?

title: Tonari no Hana wa Kyou mo Ichiban Kakkoii
description:
Unbeatable in fights, blond combed-back hair, and has a flower-shaped scar on his forehead. No one has heard rumors about “Hanaoni'', the legendary delinquent, for half a year.
Shion is a highschool student who adores and idolizes Hanoni, and aims to be a “cool deliquent”. He copies Hanaoni’s appearance and spends his days getting involved in fights with thugs.
Azami, who is Shion’s classmate and a member of the disciplinary committee,treats his injuries and watches over him.
Thugs came to Shion and tried to pick a fight with him, and…!?

title: Saigo no "Arigatou" wa Sayonara no Imi Datta
Tantei Gakuen Q Premium
description: Continues where Tantei Gakuen Q ended two years later. They are still in Dan Detective School solving cases.

title: Koko Kara Saki wa NG!
description: Haru, who's NG (No good) with boys, transferred to a class full ikemen and bishounen! Will romance spark between Haru and the boys?

title: Dekoboko no Waltz
description:
This story centres on a female teacher who is around 180 centimetres (about 5 feet 11 inches) tall and a male student who is about 160 centimetres (about 5 feet 3 inches) tall as they aim to perform a beautiful dance. The inexperienced pair have lessons in secret. Though the effort is enjoyable, the waltz they perform is clumsy.

Harumi is a high school boy who has been hiding his love of cooking from the world since a certain incident. However, by chance, he is asked to make lunch boxes every day for Mizuhara-sensei, a female teacher known as the "Giant God Warrior".

title: Kongouji-san wa Mendou Kusai
description: There's no chink in this heroine's armour. Whenever you open your mouth, all you receive is logical argument after logical argument. Kongoji is always right, annoyingly so. Yet Kabayama has found himself in love.

title: Youth Diary
description: After overcoming a miserable life, she entered the university with an excitement. Dabom, who have million of dreams and desires for university, encountered a villain from her very first day... And it's somewhat awkward/unfitting from the start! "Would my campus life be okay this way?!"

title: Asami-sensei no Himitsu
description: A promise of love that Sensei remembers. However, his young student (and also his first and childhood love) has completely forgotten… And he'll make her remember by any means necessary.

title: I Am Here!
description: Hikage is a reclusive 8th grader who no one seems to notice. She finds comfort in her blog, and the people who comment on it. Everything changes one day when two cute boys notice her. These boys are the most popular kids in the entire school. When one of them tells her something that she's always wanted to hear, she might not be as invisible as she thought…

title: Hitorichan no suki na hito tte dare nano kashira?
description: While coming back from a bath during the school trip, Sasaki and Kita hear some concerning rumors about Bocchi's love life.

title: Miniature Garden Escape
description: One day, you appeared before my eyes.

title: Ekikoi: Ojousama wa Ekiin-san ni Muchuu
description: After a fateful encounter in the station platform, Botan, an innocent high school girl falls in love with Koganei, the handsome station attendant who helped her. Koganei was a man adored by everyone in the station since he is very polite and kind. It is not enough for Botan to just be satisfied only looking at him, so she decides to make her first love confession ever! But, it seems like the Koganei she likes has another face… Be careful, Botan! Don't get fooled by his appearance!

title: Boku wa Mada Sono Kanjou wo Shiranai
description:
I just started junior high school, and I, Kanae Masaki, am completely baffled.

Our homeroom teacher, Ms. Toa Tsugushiro, gave us an English question, and even though I answered honestly, she told me I was wrong.
‘Translate “I LOVE YOU”’... I mean, what else could it possibly mean besides ‘I love you’?

A problem that doesn’t have a single, definitive answer shouldn't be considered a valid question in the first place.
And so, with that complaint locked and loaded, I head toward the English prep room today to confront her again...

title: Itose-sensei ni wa Kanawanai.
description: Watanabe Izumi has been in love with Itose-sensei since the day of the school entrance ceremony, when he helped her with some guys who were hitting on her. Since then, Izumi confesses her love for her teacher everyday, but he keeps ignoring her. What can she do to make Itose-sensei notice her?

title: Sairoku Hon Sukida! ! To Tsutaete! !
description:
**Links:**  
- [Author's Site](http://hakoya.soragoto.net/)  
- [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=68831)  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/2maho2/)

title: Narue no Sekai
description: Narue is an adorable schoolgirl with a secret. She's really an alien with powers right out of a sci-fi comic! But growing up is never easy, and sometimes it doesn't help when you're from outer space. Join our spunky heroine as she faces androids, alien invasions, and her very first date while her life turns from a romantic comedy into a space opera!

title: Datenshi Koumori-kun no Junai
description:
First-year high school girl Riku Shiraha is reunited with her childhood friend Mitsumori-kun after six years, and she finds his "bad boy" persona to be strangely alluring for some reason!? A love story woven with you, my childhood friend — who was once so angelic — now fallen into darkness.

(Source: Palcy, translated)

title: Obaka-chan, Koikatariki
description: Since childhood, Neiro has been known for being good at fighting, making people fear her and giving her the title of Kansai's strongest woman. Wanting to find romance, she decides to transfer to a high school in Kanto. Instead, what faced her was a specially assembled class of delinquents.

title: Chicchai Toki Kara Suki Dakedo
description: Tsubasa and Shou have been friends ever since they met in kindergarten. Now they're starting high school at the same school, in the same class. Tsubasa has been in love with Shou for years, but never found the courage to talk to him about it. Still, she thinks he may feel the same… until they meet a girl who changes everything. Could she be the one whom Shou truly loves? And what does that mean for Tsubasa?

title: Cute and Cruel
description:
I said, "Can't we just call each other by our first name?"  
This is a small Yuri story.  
It is a sequel, but it is a complete piece so you can read just this book.

title: Hoshino Heartbeat
description: Even though Ibuki is a beauty, she is said to be a "difficult person" as she is unable to express her feelings well. She flirts with guys for a month but always ends up saying, "It wouldn't be fun to be with me." At this time, she witnessed the transfer student, Hoshino, charging his own body! He calls himself an "AI" and in exchange for her silence, he said that he would provide Ibuki with the "sweet love" she desires...!? A strange, forbidden love story between an AI and a human begins.

title: Mythic Punch
description: Aritake Deigo has decided to move out and go live on his own no matter the cost. The reason for this is that he can no longer stand living with his family anymore. All he wants is to find a place to live a miserly life of self-loathing. While talking to an apartment agent, he encounters a strange blue-haired girl carrying a snake statue. When he starts hearing a faint voice come from the statue, he grows curious and touches it. A blinding flash of light ensues and he loses consciousness. Upon waking up, he finds out that he has been possessed by Lyssa, the Goddess of Madness. As a result, if he doesn't live a life of happiness, he will be taken over by the Goddess of Madness and die!

title: Mimiko Coming!
description: I'm gonna bite my brother because I love him! For some reason, Mimiko decides to confess her feelings to her brother, because she can't go on like this. She can't help but bite her brother when he's in front of her. Mimiko's dangerous habits in the second year of junior high school makes her older brother full of wounds every day.

title: Ghost Marriage
description: Su Sheng was born with the Character Yin. A fortune teller came to her house and told her parents that she must marry a dead man or she wouldn't live over 18 years old. A few months before her 18th birthday, weird things started to happen.

title: Wicked Cupid
description: The Koinobori yakuza family's souls are expensive commodities, a source of great pride to those of the demon world's soul bank. But when the Koinobori heir, Ryuji, is born with a pure soul engrossed with fairies and angels, it's up to Maria to become his personal cupid and reform him so that he continues the Koinobori's lascivious family line!

title: Kiss de Seiyaku
description:
Kotori Karaishi's family has a curse placed on them, of which they can only kiss one person their whole life. Kotori has tried her best to protect her lips…until a playboy became interested in her.  
  
Pt/Br:||  
A família de Kotori Kaeaishi é amaldiçoada, na qual eles apenas podem beijar uma única pessoa durante a sua vida toda. Kotori fez o seu melhor para proteger os seus lábios… até um playboy ficar interessado nela.||

title: Gyakuten Honey
description: One day, Kengo Yagami found some of his classmates teasing a turtle that lived behind their school - and he beat them up. But when the turtle spoke, he was so shocked that he kicked it as hard as he could. Unfortunately, the turtle was actually a god, and as punishment, he switched Kengo's body with his childhood friend Mitsuka's, and their new bodies are causing both of them a lot of trouble at school…

After living in December 24th, Christmas Eve on endless repeat- Mokhwa seems to be the only one who's aware of the existence of the time loop. And on this repeated day, he spends time with his childhood friend 'Choi Gyun' despite having cut ties with him a long time ago.

title: I Only Want To Meet You
description: Boy meets dragon girl. Boy released dragon girl from 1000 year old sleep. Boy get’s engaged with said dragon and live happily…no, WRONG STORY!!! This is a story about an ordinary boy who was the reincarnation soul of the god of matchmaking apprentice. Meet Jin Fairytale when he suddenly finds out he is turning into a god and had to resume his previous duty as the god of matchmaking apprentice in the modern world and juggle the responsibility of living a normal life and having to babysit the dragongirl he accidentally release. See Jin go on an adventure with his partner dragon girl and tying the red strings of fate to fellow lovers…but something went horrible wrong in this world. a man is in love with a chicken? this guy is into another guy? hello? it’s actually the soul of the girl? wtf.

title: Heart of Thomas
description:
As winter draws to a close, German boarding school student Thomas Werner dies one morning. He leaves behind a single letter addressed to his fellow student Juli that reads "Here is my love. Here is the sound of my heart."  
  
With his faith shaken to the core by the words, the scholarly Juli sinks to the depths of despair. His cynical roommate Oscar finds himself watching over Juli's fragile mental state while keeping his own feelings for Juli under wraps. Then new student Eric enters the school - and he has an uncanny resemblance to the deceased Thomas…  
  
Enter the world of a boy's boarding school in Germany where all will be revealed about the suffering and redemption that comes with love. Even today, this early work of Hagio Moto is still regarded as a brilliant masterpiece.  
  
This is volumes 11-12 of Hagio Moto Works  
  
1 Bianka (ビアンカ)  
2 Tou no Aru Ie (塔のある家)  
3 Cake Cake Cake (ケーキケーキケーキ)  
4 Sara Hill no Seiya (セーラ・ヒルの聖夜)  
5 Sangatsu Usagi ga Shuudande (３月ウサギが集団で)  
6

title: The Ki Sisters
description: In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome… to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don’t judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary-- I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who’s out to find love! The problem is… everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in “kiss” or “kill”?

title: Kitto Kiss o Suru Toki
description: Shin and Mitsuya – and Shin's little brother, Satoru – have been friends since childhood, and Shin is super proud of his hot best friend and his adorable little bro. But when Shin finds out that Mitsuya isn't being entirely honest when he professes to have never kissed anyone before, he can't help but wonder just who Mitsuya has kissed before…

title: Muyong Jiyong
description: Cha Ji-Yyoung is a journalist who makes a terrible mistake and is forced to make amends for his fault. He is forced to crossdress and enter a woman's university to reveal corruptions. His interesting life as a 22-year-old female dancing student begins.

title: Change
description:
Yuuta and Yui had their body swapped when Yuuta fell down from a tree.  
  
How will they co-operate in dealing with this as they grow up?

title: Ayakashi Hisen
description: After playing Kokkuri-san, a game which enables this world and the spirit world to communicate, 16 year old Miku is attacked by an evil spirit. Is it just a coincidence that ghosts then, start trying to kill her?…or is it not? Can her classmate, Kanyama Riyou, an exorcist from a Shinto Shrine be able to help save her life?

title: Shoshimin - Shunki Gentei Ichigo Taruto Jiken
description:
Kobato is a high school freshman who wants to live a normal life, not become a great detective. He tries to lead a quiet and modest school life with his like-minded friend, Osanai, but one mystery after another keeps coming his way. Even though he doesn't want to stand out, Kobato is compelled to solve mysteries. Will he ever find peace?

(Source: Magazine Pocket, translated)

title: Hakoniwa no Lavender
description: What had she been protecting, was it a bond or a cage?Having lost their parents, twins Himari and Kaoru grew up with only each other as their entire world. “As long as I have Kaoru, I don’t need anything else”, Himari strongly believed in those words. But one day, after school, she came across and witnessed a side of her brother that she’d never seen before. A girl standing far too close to him. An unfamiliar, bewitching look on Kaoru’s face. From the moment she understood what love was, the delicate world the two of them shared began to quietly shake.

title: Cinema Next Door
description: The walls are thin, and it's hard not to know what your neighbor is up to, especially when they cry loudly every time they watch a movie.

title: Renchi na Himoto
description:
Mogami Himoto shouldn't have any problems. He's rich. He's smart. He's athletic. He's incredibly attractive. He's an "ikemen."  
  
Meeting Yaenami Yukka plunges his life into chaos. First, she mistakenly accuses him of molesting her and broadcasts the news to the whole school. Then she ropes him into pretending to be his fiancee… which might not be so bad if not for the self-defense mechanism which results in her punching any ikemen who comes close to her. And then there's the curse…

title: Hanazono ni Miki ga Tatsu
description:
"Miki-kun. You are the only male student admitted this year."

A traditional and prestigious school located at the end of a deep forest.
For more than 100 years since its foundation, "Sakurarin Gakuen High School" has been famous as one of the most prestigious schools for young ladies in Tokyo,
However, due to the declining birth rate, it was decided to make the school co-ed.
However, only one boy, Miki Tohno, has enrolled in the school.

Surrounded by classmates of different genders, cultures, and living standards,
Will Miki  be able to keep his position as a special student?
It's the beginning of a school life filled with hardship and happiness.

title: Nasakenai Bokura no Irokoi Moyou
description:
A brand new youth comedy from the perspectives of an awkward high school boy × introverted childhood friend.  
  
Fuka Kano looks forward to a sweet and sour youth, after reading shoujo manga her sister had.  
  
Although she spend time with my childhood friend Aiji Akaji, she is not able to confess to him, it's feels like she is running around in circles…! ?  
  
On the other hand Miu Utsumi, a classmate, is a very outgoing and charming girl. So Kano gathers up her courage to talk to her, but turn out she is troubled by how she is not aware of her own thoughts!  
  
Where will their High School life go!!?

看到了姐姐的少女漫画后，开始对又酸又甜的青春产生憧憬的高中生·不破

title: Lock Up Prince
description: Lost in an Otome-Game!? A heart-pounding, inescapable, virtual love!!

title: Tonight, My Sister and I
description: "I've never thought of you as my sister." Then, a brother's lips brushed against those of his sister...Haruichi, who is two years older than his sister Natsumi, is the kindest, the coolest, and the bestest older brother one could ever have. It's easy to be jealous of how well they get along, and yet... the balance between the two begins to crumble as Natsumi starts her first year of high school.Haruichi is jealous of his friends getting closer to his sister, and Natsumi is angry at her brother for having a lover that looks strangely similar to her...With their hearts and minds whirring, they will share a night that could take them beyond mere siblings...

title: What Does It Mean to Be...?
description:
After a near death experience, Angel wakes up in a new body with a new name. Everything is the same, except him; he's mysteriously become a girl. Despite claiming he used to be a boy, people treat Angelyn as if she was here from the very beginning.

This is the story of a boy who became a girl, and the journey of trying to discover what does it mean to be...

title: Seibetsu Sagi de Gomennasai!
description:
On the Island of Eden, people awaken to their unique ability called "Xeno." People who are able to use Xeno are called Xenotakers.   
That has nothing to do with this story though! In a sudden turn of events, Yohane gets asked out by the most popular boy at school?!

title: Breathless
description:
Shen Fei and Yi kun had been living under the same roof for years, and ever since childhood, Shen Fei has had a special feeling towards Yi kun. Without realizing it, Yi kun started to grow feelings towards Shen Fei. This is a story of a romance between 2 loving teenagers in their last year of middle school.

_Note: This scanlation is based on a Chinese translation of a [Korean Manhwa](https://mangadex.org/title/00e3ccc4-0ec3-4fd2-9c2e-a574b463f2af/there-s-only-you-in-my-heart)_

title: 360° Material
description: Taki is the cool yet strange guy in Mio's class. She bumps into him at the subway station after school and saves him after he almost gets pushed onto the tracks. The next day, he returns the favor by saving her from an incoming car. This marks the start of Mio's love.

title: Sonna Koi
description: The Angel (Cupid) Yuzune has just been lazing around reading romance manga instead of hooking couples up. God gives him an ultimatum to get Sumire and Yuuji together, or he's fired. Should be a breeze for a cupid who knows all the romantic cliches, but Sumire has other ideas...?

title: Darkness of the Sea, Shadow of the Moon
description:
Twin sisters contracted a mysterious bacteria from a trip and suddenly gained enormous power. 
One psycho sister began trying to kill the other because they both loved the same man, 
while the other sister and her boyfriend began to flee as everyone else became innocent victims…

title: Dominant
description: Uno Seika, who entered a high school and felt alienated, one day met a young man in a mansion and touched the guitar with his guidance. A story of music and love-hate begins that surrounds an innocent girl and a mysterious young man.

title: Heart Crush
description:
"I-I like you, professor."
"I think it's better for you not to do that."
"Ah, you're leaving tomorrow anyway. I know, I know it! That's why I wanted to tell it to you." 

Yoo Daon, a second-year resident of Korea University's Thoracic Surgery Department.

That night, when she made her last confession gathering the utmost courage that she ever had in her lifetime, saying she won't let her slave life end so pathetically, a wave of sorrow suddenly hits her.

"Youngest! Professor Kang didn't leave! He said that he's going to stay at the hospital!"

And that's how the second act of slavery in her life has begun. In order to solve the tragedy of an irreversible confession, she was appointed to become the assistant of the genius professor who holds the title as the youngest, shortest, best in all possible records.

"I think that confessing to the professor was a huge turning point in my life. I gained strength and courage. It's like b-bungee jumping, you know...?"
"So you used me as a bungee

title: Suki ni Nattara Dame Desu ka?
description: After Kaname jokingly called out his teacher Natori for ogling a male student, Natori-sensei was so shaken up that he couldn't teach properly. Later when Kaname was called into Natori's office, Kaname confessed that he himself is gay and that Natori doesn't need to worry about rumors. Even though Kaname has no intention of blackmailing Natori, he decided that he'll spend his time teasing Natori.

title: Orange Chocolate
description:
A romantic comedy with a distinctly Japanese flavor. Next-door neighbors Chiro and Ritsu have been best friends since childhood. Ritsu, the youngest son of a family of traditional nichibu dancers, is thrust into the public eye as his career takes off, and his growing fame begins to test the pair’s friendship.  
 But when a wish made at a shrine actually comes true, Chiro and Ritsu find themselves inhabiting each others’ bodies. A further complication arises because Ritsu is not just a dancer, he is a famous onnagata, or female impersonator, popularly known as the “Courtesan Prince.”

title: Hitorijime Boyfriend
description:
"Would you like to break up with me again or to be held – which would you prefer?" My former friend with the beautiful face, whom I've run into again after so long, only says things that cause me trouble.  
  
In the winter of sixth grade, Kensuke was upset about having to separate from his best friend Hasekura in middle school, and he ended up breaking off their friendship. Three years have passed since then, and Hasekura comes in contact with Kensuke like nothing had changed. Kensuke was happy they could repair their friendship, but Hasekura says something completely out of left field…

title: Ai o Chikau ni wa Hayasugiru
description:
Nobana Amei, who spent all three years of junior high as a recluse. After transferring to a high school with a “Share Mate” system where students pair up for school life, Nobana becomes Share Mates with the popular, handsome Arisugawa Sakura, but...?! 

This is a school romance comedy about a reclusive girl and a handsome guy with his own secrets.

title: Kiss Shite Sugar-kun!
description: While reciting dialogue from a play in the empty archery clubroom, Satou's naked body is discovered by Yanagawa, the ace of the Archery Club. Suddenly, Satou embraces Yanagawa. The feeling of Satou's white, smooth skin and the shape of his buttocks get stuck in Yanagawa's head. The next day, Yanagawa's archery slump magically ends, and now he feels great. Is this some sort of "good luck charm" where they need to hug each other every day!?

title: Marugoto Anju Gakuen
description: Kaguya is a boy in an all-girl's school for demons [fox spirits, succubi, werewolves, etc.]. He may not be the only human there (there are daughters of demon hunters attending from time to time), but this is still an all-girl school. And his attempts to conceal his gender lead to silly and unbelievable (yet deliciously enviable) situations.

title: Miyuki
description:
Masato Wakamatsu, 16 years old, is working at the beach one summer. Having made a bad impression on his classmate/crush Miyuki Kashima, he makes a pass at another pretty girl. To Masato's shock, the girl turns out to be his younger stepsister Miyuki (15), who has been living abroad with their father for the past six years.  
As school progresses, Masato starts dating Miyuki Kashima. He and his sister Miyuki are living alone together, and he is troubled by his conflicting emotions: filial and romantic feelings toward a sister who may or may not know she is not related to him by blood.  
  
This manga was very popular in Japan.

---
- **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen/Shojo in 1982, along with Adachi's very popular, Touch**

title: Seishun Trickers
description:
Seto Atsushi, the student council president, is tired of spending his days in the student council where there’s nothing but boys, and decides to recruit new members, but on one condition: they must be girls! Then Ozawa Kanae, a former delinquent, shows up in the screening for the secretary position carrying a bamboo sword…?! This is a collection of five related oneshots with a specially drawn short extra, "Classified!! Student Council Report!!"  
  
[PL] Seto Atsuhi, przewodniczący samorządu szkolnego, jest zmęczony życiem z samymi facetami w samorządzie. Postanawia, że zrekrutuje nowych członków, lecz muszą być to dziewczyny! Wtedy Ozawa Kanae pojawia się z… mieczem bambusowym?!

title: Ware wa Ken-ou!!
description: Yoshiaki is entering a school that is famous for its fights and violence. He chose to go there for just that reason, and he intends to be the strongest one there. When he first arrives, he helps out a girl called Homura, who is being picked on by some guys. When she asks him to be her "sword" afterward, Yoshiaki doesn't know how to respond. Apparently, students of the school team up in pairs; a "sword" and a "master". Others advise him not to associate with the girl, who is a "Rank F", as she probably won't live very long. However, Yoshiake is not thrilled with the idea of abandoning her to die.

title: Ushiro no Shindere-san
description: Karugasaki Tora decided to repeat a grade and turn into a delinquent just so he could be popular, on his best friends advice. However, his plan backfired and nobody talks to him in his new classroom. The only thing he can look forward to is seeing the cute girl sitting next to him, but after trying to talk to her she immediately kicked him and threw him out the window. Later the same day, though, he saved her and a little girl from being hit by a truck. No longer able to avoid him, the girl reveals that she's a ghost playing a shinigami's game. She must get the boy she likes to return her feelings at times given by a pair of hourglasses so she can return to life, or fail and be sent to hell together. Unfortunately, her feelings have awakened for Karugasaki…

title: ENT. - Ore no Kagi ga Hazusareta K Noukai
description:
In the world, people can be classified into three types: strong carnivores; middle carnivores and herbivores.  
Somi Han is referred to as "Invisible girl". She befriends a fellow herbivore, Yujin Ko. However Somi Han feels that Yujin Ko is more like a tiger pretending to be a rabbit. Meanwhile, the entertainment industry is in an uproar with the appearance of a fanfiction writer called Foxstar. With incredibly detailed and accurate information about the personal lives of many of Korea's hottest stars, celebrities are more than nervous.  
What happens when Somi and Yujin discover each other's secret identities?

title: Hayo Tsukiau Hanashi
description: A oneshot story about a plain class rep. girl and a delinquent-looking guy and how they quickly started to go out.

title: Shoujo Holic
description: A girl's father is relocated by his job. She's recently found the "boy of her dreams" and decides that she's staying no matter where her parents move to! She's sent to live with her grandmother and enters the same high school her mother attended. It's a religious school run by nuns. She meets a very strange girl who thinks she’s cute and shows quite an interest in her.

title: Open Sesame
description: Danjou Yamato is a high-school student who lives in the countryside and is the boxing champion of the region. However, when his family has to move out to live in Tokyo, he is transfered to a school in Tokyo that was previously an all-girls school. Girls have a lot of power and give the guys a hard time. But Yamato will not bow down to the power of the girls, and on his way to claim power for the guys in the school, he finds out something about his past… something that he had forgotten long ago…

title: Loveroid
description: Han Narum is a boy who believes small things are the best. A little girl found him. "I found you. My boyfriend." And at the same time that he asked "what's that mean?" someone else appeared. What? The robots known as loveroids transform into adults if they receive a loving confession? And the winner of the "loveroid game" in which the loveroids fight will gain 10 billion won?! A light and lively battle comedy, start!

title: Futsutsuka Mono no Ani Desu ga
description: Every family has its share of problems, be they big or small. Shino Tadokoro has the perfect high school life, full of romance and friendship. Her biggest problem is her shut-in brother Tamotsu. She stubbornly keeps his existence a secret, telling even her closest friends that she is an only child. Completely oblivious to Shino's concerns, Tamotsu suddenly declares that he is giving up the shut-in lifestyle. Is there still time? The curtain rises on a tale of family reconstruction! [Kodansha]

title: Revenge of the Fallen Angel Soprano-chan
Kaichou, Sukitte Itte mo Ii desu ka?
description:
1-3.5: Kaichou, Sukitte Itte mo Ii desu ka?  
From Chibi Manga:  
  
Shizuru, the president of the student council is a hard worker and beautiful. However, one day, she started being in competition with the vice-president, Ran…  
  
4: Mister Serious And Miss Idiot

5: TEA TIME LOVERS

title: Ootagawa Junjou Lovers
description:
Straightforward Yamada Hirono falls in love with Ogata who gives his all for baseball. As her number of unsuccessful confessions climbs to the double digits his wish for her to leave him in peace to pursue his sport finally seems to get through to her. Will she really stay away, though, or will she be there to push his back when things get tough?  
  
A romantic comedy between a spunky, strong girl and a rigid but dedicated guy brought to us by Ozaki Akira the mangaka behind "Atashi no Banbi".  
  
Also includes oneshot of * [Haru x Kiyo](https://mangadex.org/manga/9727/haru-x-kiyo)

title: 11 Eyes -Tsumi to Batsu to Aganai no Shoujo-
description: [Wikipedia](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/11eyes:_Tsumi_to_Batsu_to_Aganai_no_Sh%C5%8Djo)

title: Nyubiwa Oldeubiui Gongsaeng-Gwangye
description:
Kwon Jungwoo is a player of the Tamer Class in the MMORPG game 'The Hymn of Karel'. After failing to receive the class buffs he’s been waiting eternally for, Kwon Jungwoo decides to abandon his last remaining hope for the game. And then, he coincidently meets 'ChaRongRong', a newbie player, while offloading his high value items at the auction market. Since he was going to quit the game away,  and with the intention of just helping out a newer player,  he light-heartedly initiated a harmless friendship that… 

[Party] ChaRongRong: Bcuz of how far Ive come
[Party] ChaRongRong: Even if a sick melee asks me to party up
[Party] ChaRongRong: I wont abandon you, Hyung
[Party] Mocha: What an honor lolol
[Party] Mocha: but if a kickass melee asks to you party up, just do it
[Party] Mocha: itll be easier… 

Jungwoo should definitely not let Cha Rong Rong's words go as if they were just coquetry but..

title: Mori no Takuma-san
description:
Karin Sakuma is a 16-year-old girl whose idealized standards for the perfect guy have left her without ever having a boyfriend. This importance on how something looks even extends to things she buys, often without practicality in mind.  
  
One day, Karin's mom sets her up on a blind date with Takuma Morino, a guy who satisfies all of her requirements, but she later discovers that he is also overweight. Although Karin doesn't initially recognize him, she and Takuma had once played together as kids, during which time Takuma developed feelings for Karin and asked her to marry him, to which she nonchalantly agreed. Although he asks her to marry him again, she turns him down, but Karin later tells Takuma that she wants to spend more time with him to see what will come of it.

title: Bokura no Katakoi Melancholy
description: Kanei Tomoya came back to his previous high school to be a substitute teacher in Physical Education. He met his fellow teachers on his first day and everything is sailing smoothly until Seta Kousuke came, his arts teacher back in high school. Everything became worse when he accidentally broke Seta-sensei's phone and was asked to be his lover in the span of his four months stay. Now will this "relationship" turn into something good or something bad?

title: The Last Ji Soo
description: Our protagonist, Yang Ji Soo, dreams of becoming an author. Once day, playboy Hae Sung, famous for only dating girls named 'Ji Soo,' approaches her. Although she's already dating Do Hyuk and feels uncomfortable with Hae Sung's approaches, something bothers her. 'How does he know so muchc about my dating history…?'

title: Fudanshism - Fudanshi Shugi
description: Miyano Amata, known as the "Perfect Prince" for his intelligence, looks, and cool personality, is asked to substitute for his sister as an attendant at a doujinshi convention disguised as a loligothic girl. There he meets a girl from his class and they become friends, but he must crossdress in order to be with the girl while learning about the fujoshi fandom.

title: Ties of Compassion
description: Ryun is an unmotivated high school student who feels like there's nothing to do in life. Min is her childhood friend who is annoyed at his own popularity. This series is about their daily lives, who they meet, and how they grow.

title: Koibana Kiseki
description: Boy meets girl, but in this case, the girl is part of a family specializing in fighting evil spirits. Kamishiro Renge battles evil spirits with the help of her assistant cat Tama. The boy is… just a boy. Yuta fell in love with Renge the moment he met her, but will he be able to keep up with her profession? Will she be able to lead a normal life with Yuta?

title: Daily Butterfly x Daytime Shooting Star
description:
Hibi Chouchou + Hirunaka no Ryuusei crossover in the May 5th issue of Margaret in 2014.  
  
Hirunaka no Chouchou - a Shocking Day for New Discoveries  
A shopping mall date with Suiren and Kawasumi. But… Suiren gets lost?! She and a small girl find themselves at the Lost Child centre where suddenly Suzume and Mamura come along!  
Released as chapter 75.4 in volume 12 of Hibi Chouchou.  
  
Hibi Ryuusei - Suzume’s Parallel School Diary  
The Suzume who steals everybody’s attention at the high school entrance ceremony. Though she's no great beauty, she does things at her own pace and is a hot topic amongst everyone. In the middle of this, the only person who doesn’t notice her, Kawasumi – will he become interested?!

title: A Girl Who Wants to Get Close With the Girl She Likes
Ota⇄Dol -  Oshi ga Watashi de Watashi ga Oshi de
description: High-school girl Asahina Azusa has an attractive figure, top grades, and is recognised in school as the perfect bishoujo. However, her real self is actually a mega idol-otaku! Being a fan is my everything; I’d even throw away my life to be a fan!! During the concert of her favourite idol Chida Chikashi, she gets involved in a certain incident and ends up inside his body…!? An idol-otaku (doruwota) x idol member boy-girl body swap high tension love story!!

title: Moe Kare!!
description: Wakamiya Hikaru, an otaku, wants a boy who will protect her. One day, she gets kissed by a beautiful, perverted boy whom she calls the "Perverted Prince." Later on, she meets a guy who looks exactly like him, but their eyes are different. What's happening?! A manga full of twists and turns that will surely leave you wanting more!

title: Momi-Baraishi
description: There are demons who prey on beautiful young women and possess them. Fortunately, there is a magic user roaming the city who can banish them, but he needs to make physical contact with the women in question to banish the monster. Specifically, with their breasts. This is the story of this traveler and his witch companion…

title: Yoimachi Apartment
description:
Takao, who has started living alone as he got into university, lost consciousness due to being famished after noticing, he’s got no money. As he collapsed, he was saved by Tougo – a university student living next to his apartment, who also belongs to the occult research society. The next day, after coming across Tougo again, Takao was told by him: ‘They come out, you know. Here, I mean.’ – apparently ghosts appear in this apartment. Then Takao, being frightened by the emergence of strange happenings such as mysterious voices and rapping sounds in his apartment – at that moment, Tougo came and saved him ––
A pure love between a kind senpai who likes occult things and looking after others X lonely kouhai who has a natural disposition of attracting haunted things.

title: Meitantei Nanka Janai! Koukousei Tantei Battle Royale
description: Akira Tenno the famous young detective with a mysterious dark past is transferred to another high school where he meets another young detective Himeko Kurotsuki who she consider him as her rival,it was then they are forced to team up as partners to compete in the Detective Grand Prix competition to see which one is the best detective team.

title: Rockin' ★ Heaven
description:
Sawa applies to Heaven’s Wing Academy, thinking she would look cute in the uniform. But she never expected the academy to be a previously all-boys’ school! And the head honcho of the school, the class president himself—Ran—doesn’t seem to like her one bit and takes no pains to hide it. At first, adjusting to life at the academy is tough. Sawa is bullied and teased, and the boys in the class even throw her new shoes in the water. While attempting to retrieve her shoes, she falls into the water and is unexpectedly saved by Ran, who up until this point has made her life hell. The newfound gentleness in Ran intrigues her—and she finds herself falling for him. What will her days be like for the rest of her school life?  
  
*Includes the following side stories called:  
- Endless March in vol. 1  
Yayoi, a student studying piano, can't get along with her teacher, Terawaki. But as they continue the lessons, both of them will overcome their obstacles.  
  
- Home, Sweet Home in vol. 4  
A sho

title: I Love My Yandere Cat Girl
description: A high functioning autistic boy named Kouji and a yandere cat girl named Yunari try to overcome the many trials in their lives while slowly falling deeply in love with each other.

title: Mushi to Medama to Teddy Bear
description:
Usagawa Rinne, a normal female high-school student, spent happy days with her lover, Sakaki Guryuu. However their peaceful days were suddenly shattered. On the night of Sakaki's birthday, Sakaki witnessed Rinne's death after her eye was gouged out by a girl named "Gankyuu Eguriko"…  
  
adapted from the light novel series "Mushi to Medama"

title: Ganda(o) - Chaotic love between tomgirl prince and tomboy princess
description:
**Read this comics left to right**
Gan, a high school student with a girly face who frequently engages in transvestism, meets Dao. She is a mischievous middle school girl who develops feelings for him.
What will the outcome of this romantic comedy be?

title: How to Turn You Around
description: Stop being interested in me! Yeo Eunsol is the best person in hiding. All he dreams of is a quiet high school life. Yet everything becomes ruined because of the popular Ra Jisoo! First love romance ♥︎

description:
Eight short stories about girls trying not to piss themselves.

title: Satan's Deepest Cry
description: Oh, how unfair the heavens, and strange the world… Wings were forged for flight, so why has god forsaken the ducks, chickens, and ostriches? Teasing their dreams of soaring through the sky but confining them to the very earth. In a world where everyone is born with God's blessing, he is the only anomaly. Can Ergera outclass the God that abandoned him, whilst simultaneously saving the people he loves?

title: Trinity Seven - 7-nin no Masho Tsukai Eichi no Sho Koushiki Guidebook Eichi no Sho
description: The ultimate book that complements "Trinity Seven" such as character introduction and magic analysis! A special dialogue between Kenji Saito and Akinari Nao and a newly drawn comic are also posted. In addition, tribute illustrations drawn by super-luxury writers are also included! - Google Translated

title: Missions of Love: Couple Arc
description: Yukina and Shigure are now in love with each other, but they end up attending different schools. Yukina's mission heats up in order to make them more lovey-dovey! "Teach me adult love!" But what's Shigure's answer? And then a new problem arises for them?! The sequel to the blockbuster hit, which has sold over 2 million copies, is now bringing even more excitement!

title: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai - My Angel Ayase ga Konna ni Kawaii. (Doujinshi)
description: A Doujinshi with Ayase as the main lead.

title: 5 More Chances
description: One Sparkle a day, does not keep her away...

title: Signal All Red
description:
Esper Academy’s Class President elections are underway! Who will come out on top? Hazama, a regal girl born with psychic powers, Taiyo, a brash boy who developed them later, or… love?

Golden Future Cup Oneshot #2 2024

title: The Nether World Mix of Jiang Long
description: Originally, Zhang Muji just wanted to be a part-time job to buy gifts for the goddess, but he found a strange door. Zhang Ji door of wood of greedy has angered a senior official, and thus be punished to do more part-time, Zhang Ji heart of wood very reluctant, part-time and earn money salty fish What is the difference! Zhang Muji even thought of an idea to charge the gods from various quarters of "doors to the construction costs" a fortune …… "Do not be bullied by a master of the game! Or you are the government should shake turned from head down!"

title: Hatsukoi Monster
description: Nikaidou Kaho is a daughter of a rich family and her whole life everyone's been nice to her. When moving to her new high school dormitory, she almost gets hit by a truck but is saved by a boy. It's love at first sight for Kaho but when asking him his name, he tells her she's weird. Kaho is shocked since it's the first time anyone's ever said mean things to her. Soon enough, she finds out that the boy who saved her lives in the same dormitory and so she bravely confesses her love. The boy says his name is Kanade and agrees to go out with her. Unfortunately, the following day Kaho finds out that her first boyfriend is a 5th grader.

title: The Season You Passed
description: What sort of lives were we living ten to fifteen years ago?

title: Dora-Q
description: Một seri mới từ tác giả của seri Home Room đình đám, Chiyo. Kurosaki Ameri, bề ngoài chỉ là cô nữ sinh bình thường nhưng thực ra chính là một Ma Cà Rồng đang phải che dấu thân phận ở thế giới loài người. Tại đây, cô đã trót đem lòng yêu cậu trai ngỗ nghịch Paco và rồi trong lúc thổ lộ tình cảm của mình với anh chàng, một sự cố bất ngờ đã xảy ra khiến cho cô bị bại lộ thân phận.

title: Chieri no Koi wa 8 Meter (Fan Colored)
description: Một học sinh trung học bình thường, Yumeji Kotaki, được chuyển đến lớp của mình bởi cô bạn thời thơ ấu Chieri Omine - người đã cao tới 8 mét! Yumeji được giao nhiệm vụ làm “người chăm sóc” để hỗ trợ cuộc sống học đường của Chieri. Cuộc sống hằng ngày của họ tràn đầy những tình huống thú vị vì sự chênh lệch chiều cao! Nhưng sự chênh lệch đó chẳng phải là vấn đề gì to tát cả!

title: 17-sai Degree Celsius
description:
Our main char falls with a big bang for the new beautiful transfer student Natsuki. While he keeps it in himself, he finds out that Natsuki is quite the rebel who does what she wants, she's strong enough to break his mean senpai's arm and send him to the hospital, and she's the one who just broke his bass guitar. He still follows her around and find out that she's quite nice but tries to distance herself from others. The reason is that she's getting married as soon as she graduates. This is also the reason why no one really punish her for doing the stuff she does in school.  
  
Still our main char falls more for her and it seems like the love is mutual?  
The hindrances in this story at the end of first chapter are the marriage and the mean senpai who falls for Natsuki after hearing her sing in a instrument shop.

title: MeruPuri: Märchen ☆ Prince
description: All high school freshman Airi Hoshina ever wanted was to someday live in a cozy home with a loving husband, and find joy in the little things in life. As a result, she makes it her daily mission to get to school on time because school legend has it that the longer one's non-tardy streak is, the better boyfriend one will find. But just when her daily routine is working like clockwork, an occurrence of fairytale proportions threatens to disrupt her grand plan.

title: 1/3 Sanbun no Ichi
description: I want to fall in love with a handsome guy! I want a boyfriend! Two new handsome transfer students appear before Ajisai! On the Shonan and Enoshima stage, this love will begin!

title: Love Allergen
description: In a small village, there is a legend about a person born from a sakura tree one thousand years ago. Though she appeared human in form, she could not understand love, and was therefore cruel. She was eventually destroyed. Now, the mythical Sakura tree is going to attempt to create human life once again. This time it is up to two high school students, the incredibly beautiful Tasuku and the love-allergic girl Honomi, to teach the Sakura Child about love.

title: Kawaii Anata
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- Maple Love  
Two college students become friends, but one of them has fallen for the other..  
  
- Love Letter  
A girl asks her friend to give a love letter to a boy for her. Too bad she has no idea her friend is in love with her…  
  
- Cycling Under a Starlit Sky   
  
- Kawaii Anata (Your Cuteness)  
This is about a boyish girl who doesn't think she's cute, and her love interest, who does.  
  
- Winter-tinged Thoughts  
Shizuru is in love with Matsuri, who in turn is in love with Aya. Oh, dear.  
  
- A Lunch Made with Love  
Retells some of the events of "Winter-Tinged Thoughts" from Izumi (Shizuru's best friend)'s point of view.

title: Self-Satisfaction Yuri Manga
description: Sulitnya menahan hasrat untuk bermesra-mesraan di depan publik dengan si doi.

title: Honeybee and the Acacia
description: I was an Acacia flower in my past life? In order to get rid of this sudden sweet fragrance (coming from me?) I have to find my destined Honeybee!

title: Coffee Doduk
description:
A cafe in the mountains behind the school <Coffee Thief>  
  
Rumors spread that there is a 'man who buys time' there.  
A year ago, 'Yoo Narae', who was through an accident, went there with the Grim Reaper, 'Saewoo' and tried to steal time manager watch to come back to life…

title: Kimi to Houkago. (Haru Aoi)
description: I thought that just looking from afar is love and the happiest time for me. The time spent on the veranda unknowingly made me realized that I was wrong.

title: GDGD-DOGS
description: Tezuka Kanna, 15, is a girl who loves manga. For that reason, she specifically enrolls in a course for manga in Tokiwa High School as a freshman! No one knows though, that she is already a debuting manga artist. …But wait, what's this?! Three handsome guys suddenly appear, and what's more they know!!! Kanna (God) vs. Those Guys (Devils)!!! What would happen next?!

title: Puchi Houndo
description: There are some days when it'd be better to just stay in bed… so says Kazuma, an apprentice demon-hunter, on the day when he finds a strange creature in the forest. It's not a bloodthirsty monster, but a young half-human, half-dog girl. Just what type of creature is she? And why does Kazuma sees her at his school right after escaping from the encounter?

title: Secret Sunflower
description: From Yuri Hime November 2019.

title: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru - fumifumi's Kisekoi (Doujinshi)
description: A small collection of moments between Marin and Gojou.

title: Heart Beat Plan
description: A VR game called "Heartbeat Plan" has gained over whelming popularity worldwide and was just launched in China. The game's main topic is related to love and exploration. Our introverted heroine found out that her secret crush is also playing that game, and thus a tangled love story is about to begin quietly…

title: Did you Burn your Mugwort Mochi?
description: The titular character, Yomogi, is a high school freshman who sees her friends falling in love, but she prefers money over boys.

title: Jimiko na Watashi wa Iroke wo Dashitai
description:
Koto Furukawa is a plain girl who is always staying in a corner of the classroom silently and without trying to stand out. A girl like her quietly held feelings for a boy named Yuuta Kishi, a game otaku. She would always get saved by the dependable Kishi-kun whenever it seemed like the boys from class would make a pass at her. In order to keep a boy like him around, she ends up trying a "sexy approach" as a result of consulting her older sister, a gal. Kishi-kun isn't such a pervert — this is what she believed while she tries to get his gaze fixed on her thighs after unexpectedly shortening her skirt!?

(Source: AlphaPolis)
___
Note: This is the 2023 short-term serialization published by AlphaPolis.

title: Ketchup Ninja
description: After the ninja abolition act was passed in Japan, ninjas were forced to relocate. How will 15 year-old Shinoko handle transferring to an American high school, when she can barely speak English and is still a ninja in training!?

title: Satou and Tanaka – The Blood High School
description:
Satou is a vampire who fell in love with a human, Kumiko. But his love was spurned so he vowed to come back in 50 years. Years later, Kumiko is now an old lady with a granddaughter, Tanaka, a high school-er who is a splitting image of her in her youth. Satou has now infiltrated Tanaka's high school in a mission to make her grandmother fall in love with him.  
  
Chapter 0 was part of Arcana 04: Vampire as "Crossing the River".

title: Sen'ya Yuri Ichiya
description: Posting original yuri short stories.

title: Only Love
description: Bully × The first love of many, an interpretation of the deepest love. Reborn as a high school sophomore, it was the best year in Meng Ting's short life. She wants to live it to the fullest, she wants to dance again, and never mess with the demonic boy who later raises his butcher knife - Jiang Ren. This summer, around the corner of the school building, Meng Ting heard Jiang Ren, the bad boy, laughing wildly: "What kind of girls do I like? Girls like Meng Ting."

title: Kanda-kun to Serizawa-san
description: Short story of a Genius kid and the girl who has a crush on him.

title: Ashita wa Ieru Kana
description:
Oda Ayumi is in love with her childhood friend, Ootani Ichita, who is actually also in love with her but is too shy to take the next step.  
  
Ootani was practicing practicing his confession when he was overheard by classmate Takatsuki. Now Takatsuki is helping Ootani… even for a good friend, isn't he too dedicated?

title: Uma Musume - Ganbaru! Koi Suru Neicha-san (Doujinshi)
description:
A story between Nice Nature and her trainer who is completely oblivious to her love advances. 

Support the author at:
[Twitter](https://x.com/pphmKo98)
[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/351442)
