title: Tsuredure Children (Official Colored)
description:
A manga about high school kids going through the high and lows of relationships. Watch as they learn a few things about life, love, and sushi while they're at it.

The colored version started on the author's Twitter, later given a volume release.

title: Lucid Encounter
description:
A one-time dream connecting reagent was made with the intention to meet Daniel, the prince that she has an unrequited love for, even in a dream. However, it was her rival, Kaiden that took the reagent, and it wasn't a one-time thing?

Lizen, who has perfect grades and physical skills, is bright and strong on the outside, but hides her wounds on the inside. Kaiden, a man who is blunt and cold, but more warm-hearted than anyone else. Lizen is connected to Kaiden through dreams every day, and not only gets caught in a huge conspiracy surrounding the throne, but also gets confused with her emotions....

An oddly continous meetings in their dreams. Is it because it's just a dream, so it's easy to pass off as a joke, or has it become sincere feelings because of the dream.

"There's no point in 'if.' I already have feelings for you. I like you now even if I don't dream about you."

---

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc30980)

title: Inkya Danshi ga Keiken Shita, Urayamakeshikaran na Love Comedy
description:
Aku, si bocchi pendiam, tiba-tiba memiliki sebuah kisah cinta hanya karena satu momen!? Siapa sangka kebahagiaan seperti apa yang tersembunyi di dunia ini...!"
Channel video manga romantis populer di YouTube, "Hometenobasu," kini menjadi sebuah manga!
Berlatar sekolah sebagai panggung utama masa muda, cerita ini menyajikan kisah cinta dramatis seorang bocchi pendiam yang berbalik menjadi sosok populer!

Source YT : @Homenoba

title: Boys & Girls
description:
A collection of sweet, romantic oneshots.   
Story 1, Boys & Girls: A girl visiting relatives has time to consider her relationship.   
Story 2, Diner All-Nighter: Aiko decides to pull an all-nighter at a diner in hopes of finishing her essay due the next morning. However, she gets a fortune that today she’ll have luck in finding love.   
Story 3, Borderline: One day, Maya trips down a staircase as she is walking her dog, Coco… and suddenly can interact with him like a human!   
Story 4, West Mammoth Prefectural High School: At West Mammoth, students can stay enrolled for as long as they like, even if it means being in their 72nd year of high school. Kamekichi gave a love letter to Tsuru back when they were in their early years of high school, and he still waits under that tree every year for her to come.   
Story 5, Treasure Room: Michiru is a hoarder, and her boyfriend Kazutoshi wants her to clean it up. She decides to comply and discovers something in the midst of her cleanup…   
St

title: Sensei to, Watashi wa
description:
The secret only between the two of us…   
  
The handsome yet cool Hidou-sensei and the loner honor student with no friends, Renko. Actually, these two are secretly married! However, this marriage is a lie due to some circumstances!?

title: Photo Kano - Your Eyes Only
description:
Based off the popular Japanese PSP game, Photo Kano (or Picture Girlfriend) is about a boy, his interest in photography, and his romantic encounters with various girls at his school.  
  
The main heroines this time are Sakura Mai and Muroto Aki

title: Yashikoh Shodai Seitokai
description: Seriu Ichiro has always been in the shadow of his older sister, Rei, who did great things as the student body president in her high school. Although he was the student body president at his middle school, he was sick of the responsibility and wanted to live free. That’s when Ichiro decides to attend Yashio Academy, literally a brand new school, where his class would be the first ever class of the school which meant a fresh start for Ichiro. He meets a fellow school mate, Hatsuse Sakuno, on the way to Yashio and as soon as the two walk through the school gate, it's announced that he is the new student body president. As much as he tries to fight fate, he soon accepts the position of student body president on one condition: that Sakuno acts as co-president.

title: Inshin no Yuki
description:
The debut work of 13-year-old mangaka Hoshiki Nana!  
Shiho has never felt "like" or "dislike" towards anything, but could this wintry encounter change that…?

title: Pink Lady
description:
"Gyeo-Wul, an art student, is having trouble drawing. One day, she bumps into a handsome guy and takes his notebook by mistake. The notebook had drawings with an art style she is not used to and tries to draw better than him. But, it turns out that the guy knows who she is." ([Source](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=53027))  
  
*Parts 2-3 of the Epilogue and Volume 0 have yet to be scanlated.*

title: Demo Miyu-chan ni wa Boku ga Inai to
description: Meet Miyu-chan, the world's most demanding girl with separation anxiety and a need for control, and me, who just can't say no. A 39-page story about codependency from a rising star. (MANGA Plus)

title: Picture of Tears
description: Sae and Riko have been best friends since childhood. But as they grow up, Sae notices more and more the differences between them, and starts to have doubt about whether their friendship is going to last…

title: Midori no Himitsu
description:
“The special you, whom only I know.”

A short and sweet love story.

Published in [Dessert's January 2022 Issue](https://go-dessert.jp/dessert/2022/1.html).

title: Mushihime Kanzenban
description:
It's been 10 years since the hugely successful *Insect Princess* was born. Is Kikuko back!? *Insect Princess* has been given significant revisions and is now back in this *Complete Edition*! A terrifying, violent horror that depicts everyday life as it is corroded by evil and swallowed by death!

**Note:** This new version sets things up for [the sequel](https://mangadex.org/title/e94fafaf-2390-4162-8c41-6dd7c4eef978).

title: Special Relationship Law
description:
Everyone has their own little secrets.
My secret is about a special someone,
who isn't like anyone else.

title: ItaKiss
description:
High school senior Aihara Kotoko has had a crush on Irie Naoki since freshman year. But she's been discouraged from confessing to him by a few things: he's a member of "Class A," the top ranking class in school, whereas she's in "Class F"; he gets the top score on every exam; and he's so smart, popular, and handsome that he's been class president every year. When Kotoki finally musters up the courage to present him with a love letter, though, Naoki outright refuses it, telling her point blank–with a look of disgust and boredom–that he doesn't like "stupid girls." Poor Kotoko's worst nightmare! Her heart is broken, but then a change in circumstance forces Naoki and Kotoko to be together every day…!?  
  
Itazura na Kiss is a gem to the shoujo demographic, as it is the mother of a lot of cliches found in today's shoujo series. Despite the fact that it is 2 decades old, it still stands out as unique for it has the series follow the main characters well into their life, over a span of 10 y

title: Jurassic Academy
description: Love blooms at a Jurassic Academy.

title: Hadaka no Taiyou
description:
A+ student Ichinose Taiyo is the brains of his class. His grades are always high, he's generally liked by his classmates and everyone thinks he will get into a good college then onto a financially well-off career. But his life long dream that no one else, not even his family, knows about is to be a manga author, which realistically speaking has near impossible odds of working out. The reasons why he keeps it a secret is because he'd rather not try if he's more than likely to fail and also because he doesn’t want to end up like his classmate Anezaki Runa.  
  
Runa is also aspiring to be a manga author but is obsessed with it to the point where everyone keeps a distance from her because of her anti-social and weird habits. But one day, Runa finds out about Taiyo’s secret and forces him to pursue his dream. Taiyo learns that throughout his life, he has cared too much about public perception which will continue to limit his ability as a manga author unless he opens himself up even if it m

title: Ganghada! I Seo-yeong
description: School's strongest, Kim Woo Jun and his formidable rival Lee Seo Young who threatens (?) his position. Woo Jun is always vying with Seo Young for the uneasy top spot, but somehow, to Seo Young, it's just a cute game. As the competition becomes a part of their daily routine, new feelings start to sprout between them...

title: Bodyguard
description:
[Adapted from Liu Xiahui's novel of the same name] The mountain village boy Ye Qiu came to the bustling city and became the personal bodyguard of the wealthy daughter. Let's see how the bodyguard gets rich and reaches the pinnacle of life.  
  
*Manga Toon Summary*  
Village young man got a job in down town city-being the bodyguard of three girls from a rich family. Usually, the bodyguard will win the girl's heart by his great skills but it is not the same with this ML…. He win's all the girls' heart with cooking on top of his skills!

title: Love and Heart
description: After a messy breakup, college freshman Yoh Yagisawa returns home only to find she has an unexpected male roommate! Introducing himself as her old childhood friend who moved abroad, handsome Haruma Hirose is back to do a homestay. He's totally hot, super nice, and always there when Yoh's in trouble... but could Haruma's timing be a little too perfect? Plus, the house next door, where he claims to have lived-didn't the family there all commit suicide...?

title: "Babumi" Tappuri! Anthology Comic
description:
Ten oneshots about being pampered by little girls.

---
**Cover**: [Haruken](https://mangadex.org/author/c25b8f02-507d-4599-b57c-fb3e34f36993)

**Author list**:
1. Picao
2. Noripachi
3. Mintarou
4. Amacha
5. Kiyomiya Ryou
6. Teiryoku Loli Type
7. gum
8. Chilt
9. Oohori Yutaka
10. Stu-Hiro

title: Koi ni Koisuru Succubus-chan
description: Shouldn't a succubus yearn for pure love? Succubus girl Ui, who longs for love like in shoujo manga, decides to study abroad at a high school in the human world! Even though she dreamed of young love, because of the unusual ability she touches the opposite sex, things have been happening since the first day of enrollment!? But her classmate, Tsukasa-kun helped her...!? Pure & young love is about to start ☆

title: Ninomae Shii no Tsukaikata
description: After being awarded the Nobel Prize, child prodigy Alice T.P. Riida runs away from home and creates the first Artificial Human, Ninomae Shii. Along with Shiratori Jun and Kurosaki Yaoki, Shii now struggles to find out for what reason he was made for.

title: Futsuu tte Nan desu ka?
description:
Sora is a high school student who desires nothing more than a peaceful and boring everyday life. One day, a classmate confesses her feelings to him, but he becomes so flustered that he completely freezes up.
In truth, his daily routine is far removed from what anyone would consider a "normal" high school experience. However, a certain encounter is about to bring a major turning point to his world...?

title: Love Monster
description: After failing the entrance exams to her school of choice, Hiyo Osora gets an acceptance letter from SM Academy. But she didn't even apply or take its exam! When she arrives, there's something amiss – all the students are… monsters!? And the head of the student council says he's her fiancé right before he sprouts giant black wings! What strange fate brought Osora to SM Academy, and what supernatural fate awaits her after this!?

title: Bad Luck
description:
A girl found out she has the power to curse anyone around her.  
  
(Hilarity ensues.)

title: Sensei Fukoku.
description:
Youichi has been childhood best friends with Yuzuha, a girl 5 years older than him. When she ends up getting hired as his teacher, Youichi must grapple with his feelings toward her and the age gap standing in his way.

Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2025 No. 14 for JUMP FUTURE PROJECT 2025 WEEK 3.

title: Hoshi wa Utau
description: In a small town in the countryside, close to the sea, a young high-school girl lived alone with her cousin. When life seemed to her too painful and too sad, she contemplated the sky and refreshed herself by looking at the stars. But one spring night, she met a boy who sealed her destiny…

title: Gozen Zero ji, Furyo o Hiroimashita.
description:
Kayamori, who is living alone due to certain circumstances, comes across a handsome, ragged delinquent at the garbage dump one night. Seeing the lonely-looking boy, the words slipped out of her mouth: "Would you like to come over?"

The two awkward friends begin living together.

title: Death Code
description:
One day, Kyung-min, whose self-esteem has hit rock bottom from being bullied by his friends, suddenly receives an invite to DeathCord, a chatting room where you can kill people through voting. 

Anonymous death penalty vote in the chat room! Anonymous participants invited to the chat room are keen to kill people for their own reasons. 

However, one of the chat participants becomes the target of the death penalty, after that, the participants in the DeathCord chatroom start struggling to identify each other...

A murder game that won’t end unless each other kills each other!

title: Ace Maid
description: A Maid must always be beautiful and stronger than anyone else, and respect her Master. The Maid who has all these qualities is called "Ace Maid". And there is a Tournament, a Festival, to select the No.1 Ace Maid in Akihabara.

title: Suki na Hito no Suki na Hito
description: The top most popular boy and girl in the grade: Hashida-kun and Kaneishi-san. No one knows if they are dating but, they look good together and rumours never cease to follow them. Chiyo recklessly harbours an unrequited love for this Hashida. She becomes acquainted with Hashida as their seats are next to each other and she also discovers that Hashida harbours an unrequited love for Kaneishi. However, Kaneishi also harbours an unrequited love for someone else――

title: Shinobi yoru Koi wa Kusemono
description:
Since long ago, a bitter rivalry and feud has long existed between two clans, the Toujo and Toyoda families. Because of this feud, it has long been Kanade's job as a shinobi to ensure the safety of Keigo, a member of the Toujo family, ever since childhood. Her devotion to her duty as a guard is a source of contention for Keigo, who would rather have her as a childhood friend than as a protector.  
  
Of course, this protection extends all the way to school, so when kanade comes across the Eishi Toyoda in class, the heir to the Toyoda family, she is initially hostile. After an attack, Kanade soon discovers Eishi is not exactly who she expected, and that threats to Keigo's safety do not just exist from the Toyoda family but within the Toujo family itself.

title: Kakugo wa Iika Soko no Joshi.
description: The most popular guy at school may not be so popular at all? To prove his worth, he confessed to the most beautiful girl in his grade, but she flat out rejects him! The boy does not give up, no, but when he tries to get close to her, he may be just falling for her for real?

title: Nerd Nam ui Heukhwa reul Maga Bogetseumnida
description:
<What happened in St. John’s College>

She transmigrated into a novel that is only 1% romance. It was a 19+, mature, smut novel. However, she never cared that the novel she transmigrated into was considered trash by everyone else.

"Thank you very much for reincarnating me as an extra who doesn't even appear in the original story!'

Though, she had no plans of interacting with any of the main characters! After graduating, she plans to become a daring author and live a carefree life, free of stress!

Fate, on the other hand, seems to have an entirely different plan...

"It's here, the place where tragedy will befall in the near future..."

Due to some mix up, Genevieve, who planned to enrol in Four Gates Academy, ended up enrolling in Saint John's College.

Whether this is fortunate or not, it was only after she entered Saint John's College did she realise that she had transmigrated before the main characters even appeared!

Unfortunately,  just as she peacefully started her third year,

title: Baeru Koi Toka Shirimasen
description:
Despite being a popular and beautiful model, Tachibana Leica, feels inexperienced inside. Even though she’s in middle school, the people around her are in love with someone else, while she hasn’t fallen in love, leading to her feeling anxious.

But as fate would have it, she’s fallen in love with a boy in her class who would be considered a background character, Kurose Sumi. Soon after Leica confesses to Kurose but that confession gets mistaken as something else entirely! Leica resolves not to give up but will Leica’s feelings ever end up getting through to Kurose?

title: Kamiki Kyoudai Okotowari
description: High-school freshman Iroha’s life is about to change. Her mother just got remarried, and they’re both moving in with her new partner and his sons. The elder son is really hot, but he’s far from normal … and together with his cute younger brother, she’s now stuck with them both morning, noon, and night! The mean elder brother and Iroha just can’t see eye to eye, and as the distance between all three of them decreases, cohabitation has never been so heart-poundingly exciting!

title: When I Got Reincarnated as a Spider With My Goddess
description: This is a spin-off manga series for the isekai-fantasy novel.

title: Te o Tsunaide Sanposhite
description: Yuki has been living with her vulgar mother since she was a child and doesn't want to be like her. But when Matsushita-kun, who she recently liked, confesses his feelings for her...?

title: Sunshine as ever
description: When we meet again, will we still be as important to each other as we used to be?

title: Angel Game
description:
This world had rules. Rules that weren't meant to be broken. If only we had known those rules, everything could have been avoided…  


---

title: Takidani High Comic Club
description: Masaki Masamichi has his heart set on joining the legendary manga club of Takidani High School. After all of his effort to get into Takidani High School and prepare for his club entrance, he finds out that a horrible change has happened to the club of which he dreamed. How will he cope with the disappointment of learning that his long-awaited club life consists of drawing ero-manga?

title: Kagerou Meikyuu
description:
When high school student Souji Kushiki, an academic achiever and talented athlete from a well-to-do family, returns home from boarding school, he finds that his sisters Harumi, Youko, and Saki have changed. Their strangely clingy behavior borders on the inappropriate and bizarre, yet Souji just brushes off their odd behavior at first.  
  
However, when Souji arrives at school the next day, he learns that, during the summer, one of the students in his class was pushed to his death in front of a subway train. And what's more, two other students were stabbed by an unknown culprit. Are the victims linked, and could Souji's sisters have anything to do with the murders?

title: Clover
description:
A series of one-shots about four sisters, each focusing on a different sister.  
  
The first is about a good girl who is tempted to break the rules.  
  
In the second, two girls begin a pretend relationship with each other. But when one of them actually falls in love, will her heart be broken?  
  
The third story is about a student council president who's always late for meetings.  
  
In the forth story, a girl has been in love with a "witch" for as long as she can remember.  
  
In the extra chapter, Midori (from chapter 2) worries that her girlfriend has fallen out of love with her.

title: Soshite Akuma wa Seigi wo Kataru
description: At Chesthill, a boys' school where the students are judged only for how right their acts are without regards for their wealth or birth, the top student is granted the position of “Angel”, head of the “Angel Council” who guides his fellow students to be right. Taiga, a teacher arrived from a country in the far east firmly believes in that which is right and aims to guide his students towards being right, but one student, Lucas, the black sheep of the school nicknamed “the devil” has other plans than going along with the ideals of rightness that the school embodies. After the Angel is murdered and Taiga is framed for the murder, he has no choice but to accept Lucas' offer to save him and follow the mad, coquettish Devil in his quest to solve the mystery of the Angel's murder and become the new Angel.

title: Ohayou, Oyasumi, Aishiteru.
description:
With their parent's approval, Makoto has started living with two good-looking brothers.  
The older brother, Souta, just feels like they're burdened with Makoto.  
But Makoto can't help but be interested in Souta…  
Living together under one roof, a parent-approved love begins.  
There is a lot of flirting every day!!

title: Koi to Mirror
description: "The way the person I loved was in love with me was like a mirror reflecting me..." One day after school, Ao, a second-year high school student, is confessed by a classmate. It was the person who his crush likes. He's torn between wanting the person he loves to be happy and his uncontrollable infatuation. This is a coming-of-age love story interwoven with three unrequited loves!

title: Magnet na Watashitachi
description: To help out her family, Ichihara Tsumugi often looks after her little niece after school. One day, she has an unexpected encounter with the rude, scary-faced boy from her class, Uchimura Aki. What will happen now?

title: Narita-kun o Semetai
description: Fukatsu Amane, a second-year high school student, is an otaku girl whose hobby is drawing BL manga and posting them. One day, she accidentally discovers an overly cute side of Narita-kun, a flirt in another class. Just when she was having a hard time making manga, she asks Narita to be a model for her manga...?

title: One Night with a Contract Boyfriend
description: Jeong Hyun and Han Seong were friends, but ended up having a "contract relationship" due to Hyun's confession. Hyun, who has a dream where he breaks up with Sung(Seong), will later find out that it was a prophetic dream…?!

title: Bokura no Koi to Seishun no Subete
description: The Vice-President of Archery Club, Chiharu Mukaitera, was in deep slump. Due to great pressure, Chiharu couldn’t shoot arrows as he wanted. Chiharu receives a guidance from a genius newbie, Nagaame Fushimi. Chiharu, who is good at cooking, satisfies and fills up Nagaame’s stomach, and Nagaame persistently attacks Chiharu saying he wants to eat meals together. Chiharu promises him to do so since he thought taking care of one’s health condition is important for archery, but Chiharu finds himself being drawn to Nagaame’s archery posture….. The popular drama CD ‘My Love (Boku Koi)’ series, finally coming out as a comic!

title: Kawaiku Naitemo Nigashite Agenai
description:
Aoba is a first year high school student who is really close with his older brother's best friend, Shima. After he entered the same high school, he has been having lunch and going back home together with them, especially with Shima.

But he finds himself feeling unsettled when Shima sometimes looks at him with a burning gaze that seems as if it's coiling around him!

title: Sekai de Ichiban Hayai Haru
description: Maho Haruta is a 26-year-old manga artist who has completed a major hit. She is finally supposed to start a new serial, but suddenly she sends a letter to her editor, Arashi, confessing that she cannot draw anything. In fact, the manga Maho has been drawing has a secret, and she still has "a certain regret" in her heart...! If I could do that time over again. This is a time-slip story where that thought changes everything!

title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You x Blue Sky Yell - 45° Eyebrows
description: Eight-page oneshot featuring Kimi ni Todoke's substitute teacher Kazuichi "Pin" Arai who makes a pass at two girls, who happen to be Youko Sugimura and Maki of Aozora Yell's brass band.

title: Kitto Kawaii Onnanoko Dakara
description: A collection of oneshot about high school love stories

title: Touching Melody
description: How certain were you that it wasn’t a dream? Was there a certain moment where you’d think ‘Ah, deja vu’. This happened to the MC who met a senior from his dreams, even though their graduation tore them apart… They met again via teleportation?! Just what is happening? How are they able to teleport and switch places?!

title: Otoko no Ko ni Toriko
description: Yuri is the beauty of her class. Her mature manner of dealing with men seems to get the attention from every male around her including Taniya-kun, whom she loves to tease and monopolize. But will she ever see beyond his image of the young, inexperienced boy?

title: Hajimete no Honeytrap
description: this one shot is from ジャンプGIGA 2020 SUMMER

title: Hirahira to Gunjou
description: Kasumi is a cheerful girl and is loved by all her classmates, but she hides a secret: a butterfly-shaped birthmark on her ankle. Naoshi, a gloomy and lonely boy, and Kasumi's childhood friend, is the only one who knows this secret, but the two have not spoken for several years. Kasumi wants to be Naoshi's friend again, but he avoids her… Why?

title: Josou Kareshi to Dansou Kanojo
description: Love comedy manga of their crossdressings

title: Untouchable Lover
description:
Youko has a protector in Shige-san. He has guided her, helped her, and always maintained a respectful propriety since she was a little girl. The difficulty is that Shige-san is a ghost, a poltergeist who only communicates with her by throwing small rocks to signal his disagreement or to show her what to do. But now that Youko is beginning to feel the first stirrings of young love, will Shige-san’s guidance help her find her true happiness?   
  
Grand Prize winner of Afternoon's Spring 2016 Four Seasons Contest

title: T.R.A.P.
description: The Izanami High School soccer team is reeling after one of their own, Masaki, is killed unexpectedly in a traffic accident. It seems impossible to fill the gaping hole left in the team by Masaki's death. However, with one player short, they won't be able to go to any of the championships they had all dreamed about before. One day, a mysterious transfer student, Amakusa Kain, tries out for the soccer team, and his skills stun the team's ace! Will Kain be the push they need to move forward from this tragedy as a team and begin once again to chase their championship dreams?

title: Himitsu, Hitotsu
description:
1. Himitsu, Hitotsu  
2. sister*sister  
3. A Love Awakened By A Kiss   
4. The Seasons That Follow "Goodbye"  
5. I’m Sorry, I Love You  
6. Summer, The Sun's Rays, and Your Back

title: Sayonara Folklore
description: Hayase has gone to this school for years, so she knows that you do *not* touch anyone on Monday, and if you do, there's a little incantation that must be recited. But Mashiro has just transfered in, and does not know these things. Hayase explains that we do not touch on Monday, because not too long ago two girls did - and they fell in love, became lovers and tried to die together. Therefore, if you don't recite the charm, you might fall in love with whomever touched you…and that would be bad. Of course Hayase explains this after Mashiro has touched her…on a Monday.

title: Kageki Shoujo!!
description: "I Sarasa Watanabe, will be Lady Oscar!" The "Koka Revue" was founded in the Taisho Era (1912-1926) and was composed entirely of unmarried women. Sarasa and her classmates are fed up with the lectures in the pre-college class, so they ask the instructor for some practical training...?

title: Bosabosa Melancholy
description: Shion is anxious about having to find a new hairdresser to cut her hair, when suddenly a strange girl from an unknown hair salon calls out to her.

title: Yeolbul Romance
description:
If you don't want to die, date!  
A romance story of a girl named Hwa-Ja full of heat trying to live her life.

title: The Devil Who Can't Fly
description:
A lonely girl finds a devil doll on a rainy night. What will happen?   
  
[Naver Best Challenge Version](http://comic.naver.com/bestChallenge/list.nhn?titleId=517382&no=22) (Raw)

title: Rebirth From 0 to 1
description: Shelly Natsu is a girl who suffered too much from school bullies' torment and died when she fell off a school building. After her death, she actually reincarnated into her classmate, the tall, rich, and handsome Ewan Duncan. While she begins her counterattack and takes revenge, she also begins an ambiguous relationship with Ewan's best friend, who was previously Shelly's secret crush. The most motivational story of all begins!

title: Tokubetsu ni Naritai
description: It’s only during rainy days that Kae can get closer to Ichi, the most popular guy in the school, because he always gets under her umbrella. But Kae wants to be close to him everyday, not only during rainy days. What can she do to be special to him?

title: Boku wa Ookami
description:
Rina hates perverted guys. She mixes up her new classmate, Ookami-kun with someone else…  
  
But the truth is, he is a real wolf! Is this sensation of the beginning of love?!

title: Backyard Junk Universe
description:
A collection of Katou Takuji Twicomics.

**Contents:**

2. Magical Girl Akirara ☆
3. Isekai Hero G-Shine / Otherworld Hero G-Shine

title: Meet You
description: The day I coincidentally met you, my story began to change.

title: Soshite Haru wa Tonari to Naru
description: Feared for his appearance, the quiet Onitake Yuuma keeps to himself on the school's rooftop. But after meeting the bright and outgoing transfer student Puichi Koharu, his lonely routine begins to change in ways he never expected.

title: Teiichi no Kuni
description:
Akaba Teiichi is beginning his student career at an elite private boy's high school, which was originally renowned for producing many excellent naval officers. In its current incarnation, his school regularly turns out many important politicians and bureaucrats, and networking starts from day one. Teiichi is determined to become the school's student council president, a position which will help launch him into the political sphere after graduation. He has run his life so far by maintaining a perfect image, while never neglecting the darker side of politics.  
  
He has plenty of help to reach his goal. Teiichi's father, who is now an important bureaucrat, lost the position of student council president during his high school years, and that loss has continually hindered his career. He's determined to support his son's success in any way he can. Teiichi also has his loyal best friend and second-in-command, Koumei, helping him with strategy. On the side of emotional support, Teiichi has h

title: My Marital Delusions!
description:
"My partner is just a male friend."  
  
So-mang Park wants to have a relationship at least once in her teens. But true love leading to a dreamy romantic marriage is just a crazy delusion that'll never happen. In reality, So-mang Park and the word "date" just don't belong together. Then one day a ray of hope shines upon her. Is this what flirting is? This is a story of a cheerful yet delusional girl's quest for romance.

---

• [Official S. Chinese](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/douhuanxiangdaojiehunle/list?title_no=1598)

title: Kimi tte Donna Nioi nano?
description: When Soushi saves Himiko from a pair of foul-mouthed classmates, he demands to let him smell her in exchange…?

title: Sensei Nishii - Homura-sensei wa Tabun Motenai
description: The sequel of "Homura-sensei wa Tabun Motenai".

title: Shinomiya-kun no Sekai ga Owatte mo
description:
Shinomiya-kun's aloofness attracted Yukino's attention and because of that, she started to see a new side of him. And now, even though he loves school, Shinomiya-kun has to quit school due to home circumstances. To be able to continue seeing him, what would Yukino do?  
  
Included one-shots:   
  
* Yoru to Asobu  
"Lucid dreams, they are dreams in which the person is self-aware. I escaped my hospital life night after night in my dreams."  
  
* Sakimachi Alyssum

title: Gesu to Kami-sama
description: Ao is an insouciant, uncaring individual, a typical high-school boy specimen. What he doesn't know is that the transfer of a cold and equally indifferent girl into his class, and the secret behind the rumors that sweep the school following her arrival, will bring only unwelcome change to his life, forcing him out of his shell and into the workings of the divine upon this world.

title: Maburaho
description: The prestigious Aoi Academy caters to an elite collection of young magic users. But 17-year-old Kazuki Shikimori is a student who passes muster in name alone. He is the youngest in a long line of sorcerers, but the family's long-running talent for the black arts ended with this average student. That doesn't stop the female population of Aoi Academy from vying for his attention, though! His impeccable DNA will start a teenage war of lovesick girls!

title: Magical Iroha!
description:
Not particularly good at sports, not very popular, and not very good at school, Naoki's middle school years are filled with video games and erotic books. But one day, a cute girl called Iroha appears, claiming to be his daughter from 20 years in the future. Apparently, in the future magic has been discovered, and she has come back in time by magic to protect her beloved papa from a dark future.

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Magical Iroha** (2012; complete)

title: A. - Answer
description: Mitsu, who lost her memories after an accident at school, is trying to relearn who she is. She found a scribble she wrote a day before her accident that said I like 'A'". Who is this 'A'? Her boyfriend's name is Hongou Hideto and there's no 'A' anywhere in his name. Did he know anything? Is he hiding something from her?

title: Junai Tokkou Taichou! Honki
description: This is the sequel series to Junai Tokkou Taichou! by the same author. It takes place after volume thirteen and focuses more on the relationship of Hirata and Chiemi as well as the new relationship between Yukari and Ohno.

title: Gekouchuu ni Ame ga Futtekita Kara Kouhai no Kasa ni Irete Morattara...
Heaven's Door
description:
A compilation of short stories by Keiichi Koike.  
  
- **Knockin' on Heaven's Door**  
- **3,000 Leagues in Search of Mother**  
 - **Lazarus Franco's 4 A.M.**
 - **The Ronin and the Sea**
 - **Looper** 
  - **Kenbo's Diary**  
 - **Sponge Generation**  
 - **Airway** 
  - **Stereo Scope**
- **Horizon**  
- **Landed**

An astronaut sent on a space mission promises his wife and child that he will come back to them.  
Published in English in Epic Illustrated #26, October 1984

[Official English](https://lastgasp.com/products/heavens-door-extra-works)

title: Bullet Honey
description: Every little girl dreams about finding her prince charming and becoming a bride, nursery girl Rino is no exception. Precocious Rino falls in love with the timid and weak but very handsome and kind nutritionist Kazuki. And so carried for that love, she declares firmly "If you marry me, I'll definitely protect you!!"

title: Hello Again
description: Onoda is avoiding his childhood friend Hiroto because of what he did in the past, while Hiroto is wondering what happened and why he is being avoided. But because Onoda was ignoring a teacher in school, Hiroto had to drag him into the counselor's office, and as a result their friendship started blooming again. Will Hiroto find out why he is being avoided?

title: Star Flowers
description:
Hachisu, a boy with a good grasp of the world around him, gets sat next to a girl in his class called Ageha, who is utterly lost in her own existence. Hachisu feels irritated every time he sees her and thinks that that will never change.

The sad love story of two people who come to understand the complexity of human emotions by interacting with each other.

title: Yuri Yuri (Doujinshi)
description:
A series of original doujinshi that Namori published under her circle ELEGY SYNDROME, each volumes contain several extra stories by various guest artists.  
  
Volumes 1-3 & 5, were done by Namori herself. The rest of these volumes are extra stories from other artists.

title: Bulpyeonhan Donggeoin
description: Haewon, who suddenly had to find a new room, decided to live with his brother’s friend, Minjae, when the latter told him that he would give him a room. While Haewon kept wondering about his roommate’s attitude for no reason, he suddenly began to recall his forgotten highschool past.

title: Gobaekhamyeon Kkeutnaneun Manhwa
description:
Clumsy girl Song Sena can't help but make mistakes!
She's had a crush on her classmate, Daese, ever since he lent her an umbrella. But somehow, every time she tries to confess, things go awry...!

"Tomorrow, I'm going to properly tell him that I like him for sure!"
Will Sena's feelings ever reach Daese?

title: Akira (Official Colored)
description:
Akira lấy bối cảnh ở Neo-Tokyo sau tận thế vào năm 2030, một đô thị rộng lớn được xây dựng trên đống tro tàn của một Tokyo bị hủy diệt bởi một vụ nổ khải huyền có sức mạnh huyền bí đã gây ra Thế chiến III. 
Cuộc sống của hai người bạn tuổi teen Tetsuo và Kaneda trên đường phố Neo-Tokyo đã thay đổi mãi mãi khi những khả năng siêu nhiên bí ẩn bắt đầu thức tỉnh bên trong Tetsuo, người mà trở thành mục tiêu cho một hoạt động mờ ám của chính phủ và một tổ chức sẽ không bao giờ dừng lại trước bất cứ điều gì để ngăn chặn một thảm họa khác giống như thảm họa đã san phẳng Tokyo. Cốt lõi động lực của cơ quan này là nỗi sợ hãi thô sơ, ám ảnh về một sức mạnh quái dị không thể tưởng tượng được chỉ được biết đến với cái tên AKIRA

title: Kanchigai Hime to Usotsuki Shimobe
description:
[It's okay to be a servant, I want to be by your side…!]  
[You'll treat me really really well?]  
  
Mayuri, a girl who wanted to be acknowledged as herself shares the same room with her senpai, Akira who is the student council president and a beautiful person envied by others. But, Akira has a big secret…?  
Somehow, her real self is a "boy"!?  
Moreover, he makes a petition of wanting to be Mayuri's servant…?  
  
Thus, the wonderful room sharing life of the domineering (!) beautiful girl, Mayuri and a boy wearing girl's clothes who's also a bit of a trickster (?) Akira starts.  
  
Takamiya Satoru's lyrical love comedy.  
  
Pt-Br:  
Kasahara sempre amou o cara perfeito do livro que ela lê. Mas um dia, Fukai, seu colega de classe no clube de literatura, desafia esses padrões. Os dois decidem desafiar um ao outro, indo a um encontro, ambos fingindo ser o tipo ideal do outro.

title: Boku wa Kiss de Uso wo Tsuku
description:
Kitazono Meiko falls asleep in the library one day, only to be awakened by a kiss! She is unsure of who it was that kissed her, however, since there are multiple boys still in the library. Could it be the popular boy Shinoda-senpai? Or the super-cool Mikoshiba-senpai? The boy-next-door type Mogami? Or the cute underclassman Hachiya? Who could it be? They're all possible candidates, but which one does Meiko like the best…?  
  
Volume 1 Extras/Oneshot:  
- Soprano  
Volume 2 Extras/Oneshots:  
- Anna no Kami ga Nagai Ryuu  
- Hakka Drops

title: Otome no Houkago
description: Otome is a girl who is half Japanese. During high school, she encounters an animal-loving and mildly mysterious Natsume-sensei. She is also struggling with her social relationships. With this encounter, will her school life change?

title: Nana Mix!
description: Nanami transfers to St. Marivel (Mary Bell) High School from America as she looks for her childhood friend, Kotaro. In a school where the ratio of male students to female students is 1:20 respectively, Nanami gets involved in a conflict with a male student who is almost twice her size. As Nanami was about to engage in battle, she catches a glimpse of Kotaro and stops, allowing the male student to grab hold of her! How will she get out of this situation?

title: Ohisama ni kiss
description:
Beautiful x clumsy = Moe #1 ♪  
  
To be honest, I think I’m pretty popular.  
But I don’t really know much about love and thought that girls were all the same… That was until I met you. While being with you I end up looking like a fool. If it were other girls, I could easily sweet-talk them anytime, but in front of you my mind goes blank.  
Real love sure is on a completely different level…  
  
Reading this, you’ll feel all warm and cozy and your heart will beat for them ♪ At the time of serialization, there were casualties en masse because of this cuteness! Pure guy x pure girl –> cozy romance!

title: Shokuinshitsu no Himegoto
description: Nishio, a stoic math teacher, doesn't get along very well with Sakaki, the beloved gym teacher. However, after one drunken night, Nishio finds himself in Sakaki's bed where he is suddenly kissed and confessed to…?

title: Boku to Kimi to de Niji ni Naru
description:
Rui is a beautiful and studious high school student. However, because she is so direct, she has often been misunderstood, so now she is the subject of absurd rumors, and alienated by the rest of the girls in her class. Then one day, a chance encounter with a free-spirited guy named Shou turns Rui's meticulously-ordered life on its head.  
  
And so, a "rainbow school daze" between a super dry girl and a care-less guy begins!

title: Goth Loli-chan to Mondaiji-kun
description:
The high school girl Ayame's love of gothic lolita style is found out by Mizuno Hiro, a boy known as the school's biggest delinquent. Ayame fears that her hobby will become exposed at school, or suffer some other terrible consequence, but for some reason, Hiro invites her on a date instead. As they spend time together, Ayame begins to feel that he is not as bad as he is rumored to be.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Sensei no Boku
description:
Yuu is a healthy high school student who harbors a crush for his Kyouko sensei. He absolutely loves everything about her and after fretting about the subject for some time he decides to confess; to his surprise Kyouko Sensei is also in love with him and agrees to date him.  
  
…. The catch is that Yuu doesn't know why Sensei is in love with him, neither he knows her preferences when it comes to how to behave to her partner….  
  
And by the time of when Yuu learns this we have that "Yuumi" is born, now Yuu doesn't know if he should somehow enjoy his new relationship or regret it.   
  
Same author of Amaharakun-plus.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Invasion-hen
description:
The Parasites Invade Again!

The year is 2097. After being attacked by a parasite, Lina escapes from the United States of North America and returns to Japan to join Tatsuya and Miyuki. Meanwhile, Kudou Minoru, who has been infested by a parasite, attacks the hospital to take Minami away.
___
Adaptation from the original novel volume 26.

title: Gaussian Blur
description:
Day after day, honor student Hwang Dong Wook gets called out by the bullies in his class to serve as their punching bag. Day after day, the last-ranked student Choi Yool is shunned by her classmates because of her beauty and her grades. As it happens, the sullen boy and the carefree girl sit next to each other in class. When the top student is asked to lure her into the bullies dirty schemes, their lives take an unexpected turn…  
  
[Original webtoon from Daum](http://cartoon.media.daum.net/webtoon/view/blur)

title: Koi wa Kitsune Mouyou
description: A young boy from the fox tribe comes down from the mountain to attend school and find a mate, and ends up falling for the school's outcast.

title: Crimson Hero
description:
All that matters to 15-year-old Nobara Sumiyoshi is volleyball–she's an awesome player with big-time ambitions. But sometimes it seems like a girl just can't get a break in the competitive world of high school volleyball.  
Nobara's family wants her to inherit the role of "young mistress," serving rich patrons at her family's old-fashioned Japanese restaurant. No thanks! When Nobara transfers to Crimson Field High School, known for its top-notch volleyball team, it turns out that her mother will stoop to dirty tricks to keep her off the court. With assistance from her feisty Aunt Momoko, who's got some connections at Crimson Field, Nobara decides to start playing offense.

title: Kimi no Kiss de Me o Samasu
description:
A collection of oneshots by Hatsuharu, including I Wake Up With Your Kiss, Love Equation, The Flower That Blooms Within You and Me, and Our Sound.  
  
Wake Up With Your Kiss  
I have been looking after the helpless Haru for many years now as a childhood friend. He can't take care of himself, yet he's talented at soccer. I always watch senpai, who I have a crush on, while also keeping an eye on Haru. I don't want senpai to misunderstand my relationship with Haru…  
  
Love Equation  
I love studying, but a classmate has told me that I should take interest in love as well. Then, there's this certain boy that persistently begged for my assistance in order to tutor him, as he seems academically challenged. Reluctantly, I accepted, spending my spare time with him tutoring at the library. As I tutor him and at the same time, getting more acquainted with him, I start to have these unknown feelings for him…  
  
The Flower That Blooms Within You and Me  
I'm a very popular girl at school that

title: Back to the Jack
description: Meguru is an ordinary schoolgirl on a school trip. They stop to take a break and she is determined to confess her feelings to the boy she likes, Yashiro. When they get back on the bus, however, a strange man grabs her and says that he’s bus-jacking them. He shoots Meguru for putting up a fight and she thinks, fading into oblivion, “I wish I could go back in time”. The next thing she knows, she has woken up in her bed at home and quickly finds out that it’s the day before! What in the world?

title: Kiniitteru Manga
description: A girl is struck by the handwriting of the boy next to her…

title: Jibun Daisuki Aise-san
description: Immediately after entering high school, Aisaka Kanade fell in love with Aise, a naive classmate. He thought he finally succeeded in confessing his love to her, but what he got back was a surprising reply...! Three self-loving love comedies!

title: Lost Lovers
description: Losing memories after a confession?! A crossdressing boy and the one he loves are cursed to never fall deep in love, and are forced to repeat their confession over and over. What is the antidote to love? Can there be miracles in true love?

title: Koibana! Koi Seyo Hanabi
description: Due to some mishaps during her entrance exams, Hanabi Marui finds herself entering a school of mostly boys. This is a problem for our heroine, as she has a huge disgust for the male gender. But then she meets someone who slowly turns her world upside down. This series follows the trials she and her friends go through with love.

title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann - The Gurren High School Version
description: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann: Gurren Gakuen-Hen (Gurren School Edition) manga that re-imagines cast of TTGL Robot Mecha in a parallel world, at a high school. The people are the same, situations are a bit different with more Ecchi-ness and fanservice for male and female readers. This more or less pokes fun at not only the Anime in general, but also many school based Mangas.

title: Mint na Bokura
description:
The twins Maria and Noel have always lived together and are very closely linked. When Maria decides to enter Morinomiya School because of the beautiful eyes of its basketball coach, Noel, who refuses to be separated from his sister, decides to enter the same establishment. Unfortunately, there are no spots left for boys. He thus decides to pass himself off as a girl! But school life is not easy when one must constantly play in a comedy! Especially when Noel rapidly falls in love with Miyu, a fellow classmate, while he himself is courted by another student.  
  
Read left to right.

title: Dekiai Honey Baby
description: Rio's family moved when he was a kid. Although he thought he didn't need any friends but became close with the neighbor's son, Watanabe Takeru. Years later, they are already in high school but Rio is trying to avoid Takeru since junior high - when he realized his feelings were deeper than friendship.

title: Ponkotsu Ojou-sama to Inkya Sewagakari
description: An extremely naive young lady appoints a shady boy she happens to meet as her caretaker! This is the start of a romantic comedy about a young lady crawling her way up the ladylike school ladder!

title: That Feeling's Name
description: Pixiv Oneshot

title: Oh My Ghost
description:
Have you heard a ghost who is afraid of scary stuffs like darkness, horror movies, ghosts, and etc? and loves to eat sweets? Yup you read it right…. This Ghost can eat. Logic is useless here in this series.  
  


---

title: Mashikaku Rock
description:
Miyako's living her life diligently following rules, just as her deceased father wanted her to, but one day Azuma Koutarou sees her play guitar and blackmails her into joining his band. How will she face it?  
  
Also includes:  
- Tonari no Hanako-san  
- Sayonara Sankaku  
- Tsui Me de Otteshimaimashita.

title: Clothing Bin of Love
description:
Enough one-sided love! The hottest gossip in Going High School, if you go to the used clothing box, give it money and shout the name of the person you like, then it will tell you the feelings of that person..! Song Aram, who’s only interested in grades and money, is not wavered by that rumor. In that daily life, the school’s popular boy, Jung Jinwoo suddenly comes into her life. What should she do about this rascal who might run off to who knows where?

title: Mahouka Koukou no Yuutousei 2nd Season
description: The days of Miyuki and others as first-graders also entered the second half, twenty-nine-six years and one month. As an exchange student with Shizuku, a beautiful girl with blond blue eyes, Lina moves in to the Magic Department high school. Her visit, which had a certain serious secret, was the beginning of change and eventful days for the girls of Fukayuki and Honokari Magic High School! A succession of incidents, deepening friendship, and love!?

title: Kawaisa Amatte Sukisa 100-bai!!
description: A compilation of yuri oneshots by Meno.

title: Oneshot Romance
description:
Collection of oneshots.
1. Press the shutter of your eyes
2. On your marks
3. Your heart
4. Extra's Attention
5. Let's go home together
6. Her ex-boyfriend

title: Sekai ni Futari Dake
description: A short story filled with the sweetness and sourness of youth, that you might find resonance in too! Each time there's a different couple unless you see the same couple from the previous chapter. May you be blessed with the sweetness and sourness of youth love.

title: Courting a Prince
description:
A genius student that is ignorant to the ways of Boys Love.  
A sister with aspirations of becoming a BL mangaka that wants to use her younger brother’s writing and make her characters come to life.  
Wait; there was actually a dreamy prince-like boy that resembles the lead character in real life?!

title: Watashi no Chiisana Ohime-sama
description: Soga Tsukihi had a childhood prince that she used to play with. Now at present time, she's a competitive highschooler who one-sidedly competes with Ouji Kanade, a popular girl in her class. After getting a little closer with Kanade, she happens to see her prince again.

title: The Otaku Girl and the Girl She's Dating
BanG Dream! - Momo's 's Bandori Single Image Compilation (Doujinshi)
description:
A collection of stand alone single page comics/images by Momomomomom  
  
Note: The genres may vary depending on the image.

title: Toraneko Folklore
description:
All through middle school, Touto was the tough kid that people either fought, feared, or avoided. Resolving that his high school life will be different, he studied hard and entered a prestigious high school. Despite his harsh demeanor and odd behavior, he manages to make two friends right off the bat, two hopeful students who are also trying to recreate themselves. Timid Miyakoe, who is interested in the occult, was always overlooked in middle school, and she wants her presence to matter in high school. Chubby Yuta wants to erase his school history of being constantly bullied.  
Everything is going well until Miyakoe disappears while investigating a scary school myth. Going after her, Yuta and Touto encounter a dangerous cellphone monster! When all seems lost, Touto's cellphone-strap good-luck charm comes to life to give him the strength to defend his new friends. It seems that Touto's high school life is going to be much stranger than he could have ever imagined!

title: Game
description:
1-3. Game  
A transfer student who's also a secret writer has a crush on a classmate lookalike who happens to be an artist, team up together.  
  
4. Nakushimono/Okurimono (Something Lost/Something Given)  
  
5. Acchi/Kocchi/Docchi (This Way/That Way/Which Way?)  
  
6. Kiss Chuchu  
  
7. Nani ka? Nani mo? (Something? Anything?)

title: Crazy For You
description: Sachi goes to an all-girls high school, and is quite the clueless one. At her first goukon, she meets a boy called Yuki-chan, who finally ends 17 years of a boyfriend-less life, and…!?

title: Second Home
description:
"My home cannot be like this."  
  
The story of a quiet male student and his next-door neighbor… who is married.

title: Haru no Yume wo Hashiru Kimi e
description: Aiko, hiện đang là học sinh năm nhất trung học, tình cờ hội ngộ với đàn anh Masumi – người cô từng ngưỡng mộ khi còn học cấp hai – và được anh mời làm quản lý cho đội bóng chày. Aiko thầm dành tình cảm cho Masumi suốt từ thời sơ trung, nhưng không rõ anh có biết điều đó hay không, bởi Masumi luôn tỏ ra lạnh lùng với mọi thứ ngoài bóng chày. Đúng lúc Aiko đang cố gắng quên đi mối tình đơn phương này, thì một thành viên trong đội bóng tên là Shiba Motohiko bất ngờ xuất hiện và khẳng định rằng cậu từng quen biết Aiko từ thời cấp hai...

title: Demi-chan wa Kataritai Koushiki Anthology Comic
description:
**Cover Illustrations:**
Hikari: Azu
Sakie: Souji Hougu
Tetsuo: Petos
Kyouko: Moukon Icchokusen
Yuki: Yasu

**Color Illustrations:**
Yamamoto Souichirou
Hiramoto Akira

**Comics:**
1. Moukon Icchokusen
2. Yasu
3. Kobato Neneko
4. Azu
5. Souji Hougu
6. Yoshimoto Masume
7. Yoshitani Kouhei
8. Ichihara Hikari Z
9. Menea The Dog
10. Umakuchi Shouyu
11. Tottori Sakyuu
12. Nieki Zui
13. Mutsuki Mutsu
14. Sagara Riri
15. Miyakoji
16. Kimura Mitsuhiro
17. Edo Pine

**Afterword:** Petos

title: Juu-hachi Ren
description:
My first love has the scent of cigarettes.

Shinoda Asumi is 18 years old, 171 cm tall, and in her third-year of high school. She is done with all her club activities and she is struggling with her future plans. Amidst her confusion, she falls head over heels for a man. The smell of cigarettes, piercings in his ears. This man, smaller than herself, is a mysterious, unsuccessful novelist.

A story of first love, woven between a girl wondering about her future and a novelist caught up in his past.

title: Love Sick
description:
Shiki threw everything away for the sake of revenge. But at the new school where she disguises herself as a male, she meets 4 popular rich guys… Haru (spring) the prince, Natsu (summer) the bishounen, Aki (autumn) the womanizer, and Fuyu (winter) the cold-hearted genius.  
  
What awaits Shiki? And will she get her revenge…?

title: Asakusa Oniyome Nikki: Ayakashi Fuufu wa Imayo Koso Shiawase ni Naritai
description:
*Shoujo manga adaptation of the Asakusa Oniyome Nikki web/light novel series.*  
  
Maki Ibaraki is a high school girl who lives in Asakusa and loves Asakusa cuisine. This girl, who likes to poke her nose into ayakashi-related business and solve her problems by brute force, harbors a secret - she remembers her previous life. Her previous life was not that of a human, but of a demon princess called the "Ibaraki Kid," whose name resounded across the Heian period. Accompanied by Kaoru Amasake, the reincarnation of her "husband" Shuutendouji, the "Strongest Demon-bride" hurtles around Asakusa even today helping troubled ayakashi, such as Kappa Temari who is exploited at his part-time job, and a family of tanuki who run a local soba restaurant.  
(Source: MU)

title: Go! Hiromi Go!
description:
In high school, Hiromi Hashiba studied so much and cared so little for her appearance, she earned the nickname “Nerd Hashiba.” 
Now, having entered T University, Japan’s most prestigious university, she decided to get rid of her old image and debut a new life in college. 
However, her radical look and behavior stood out too…

title: For you 99%
description: Jun entered the same high school as his best friend who is also his unrequited love, Doha. Jun suggests to start a fake relationship with Doha who have no intention of dating despite his popularity as dating practice but… Can Jun protect this relationship despite having Dami who has fallen for Doha at first sight as an obstacle?

title: Watashi ga Riaru de, Yuri Nante.
description:
I like yuri manga, but I can't be yuri in real life...

Konomi and Haru have been childhood friends since elementary school.

Haru and I are both otaku, and I took it for granted that we would be best friends forever. She has confessed to me over and over again, a whopping 106 times! I've had enough of this!

...Then I heard that my friend Kinu was dating a girl from another school.
I love yuri manga, but I can't imagine myself dating another girl in real life....

title: SAVING YOU
description:
A mysterious new student is sent over to a private academy for one important reason; to keep tabs on a certain group of girls. Loyal to the one who sent her, she is reluctant to get close to them. But to these girls, they see a potential new friend.

Deprived of a normal life, she slowly starts to live the life she secretly longed for: attending school, building friendships, and love... But will this bliss last forever?

title: Daisuki Datta yo, Sensei...
description:
Daisuki Datta yo, Sensei…  
A girl whom experienced unsuccessful "threads" of love with her teacher, encounters her fated person!?  
  
A very kind, dramatic love!  
  
Includes oneshots:  
Ushiro kara Nibanme no Kanojo  
Yumi loves Sakura and her crush happens to be friends with a guy called Sakura! She only eyes for her sempai, not Sakura, but this changes when she was caught watching Sakura getting slapped by a girl and he called her a peeping tom. He even told her that she "should give up" on her crush, what does he mean by that…?  
  
Toraware Beast (Captured Beast)  
Having just transferred into a new school, Shiori's "experienced" look has given her an opportunity to make friends, but in reality she is not experienced in love at all. To maintain this image, Shiori desperately hides the fact that she is a HUGE book otaku. Meeting another book fan who is a mysterious beauty, Shiori ends up in an unpredicted circumstance. What now will become of Shiori's hope for an elegant school

title: Welcome to the Ocean Club!
description:
The story is set in the school’s marine activities club. It’s a small club consisting solely of Rena, the senior member, and Haruto. One day, Seto-chan, a prospective new member, turns up and declares that her condition for joining the club is that ‘the two of them don’t get together’. It seems she has feelings for Haruto. But Haruto’s heart belongs to Rena... ?

[23rd Dengeki Manga Grand Prize](http://dengekitaisho.jp/archive/23/comic1.html) winner

title: Gakuran no Nakamade Sawatte Hoshii
description: An all-boys school is good – since being recruited into the student council by Sawane, we continued our relationship of friends with benefits. Is this taboo? Or is it immoral? Regardless, I don't care, because I love Sawane. I have Sawane, and aside from me, Sawane doesn't……

title: Mishounen Produce
description: It's the start of high school, and Kako decides to "produce" her bookworm of a childhood friend, Kousei, so that he can become a good-looking and popular school idol. She models him after Lawrence, a character in a manga she likes, but as Kousei's transformation becomes a huge success and he extends his new character beyond what she asks for, what will Kako do? Will she find herself left behind in the wake of his newly found popularity?

title: The Dangers in My Heart - Our Hearts Have Irregular Meters (Doujinshi)
description:
A heartwarming romantic comedy manga that captures the daily life of Ichikawa and Yamada ☆. Ichikawa's days are filled with laughter as he is swept away by Yamada's natural behavior and gets nervous. And the serious development of the story will make the readers nervous. This is a very satisfying book that allows you to enjoy the charms of the two from various angles.
___
**Buy:**
- [BOOTH](https://umehatago.booth.pm/items/4154386)
- [Melonbooks](https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=587905)

title: Houkago x Ponytail
description: Natsuki, an otaku high-school girl who'd much rather spend her money on manga than pretty dresses, accidentally injures a creepy-looking mangaka, Kiritani Taichi. To repay him, she agrees to be his character model until he fully heals. But what's this? Kiritani-san appears to be hiding a secret from her? What will become of these two?

title: Puri Puri
description: All he ever hoped for was to be one step closer to becoming a priest, but Masato Kamioda gets more than he bargained for when he suddenly finds himself as the only male student in a pilot program at an all-girls divinity school.

title: Lovers' Kiss
description:
When a rumor starts going around about Rikako and the school's notorious bad boy, Fujii, she decides 
they might as well make the rumors true. But things don't go exactly as planned and she starts developing feelings for him.
This two-volume series focuses on Rikako, her sister and their friends/classmates in a series of loosely-linked stories.

title: Shinigami Detective and the Ghost School
description: At the old and abandoned school campus, some students committed suicide in the past, leaving behind a blood curse. A student, dubbed 'Shinigami/ The God of Death' by other students, went exploring the old campus with his friends. Halfway, someone dropped their flashlight and a dismembered woman's body is discovered.

title: IS - Otoko demo Onna demo Nai Sei
description:
IS (Pronounced Aiesu in Japanese) is not your everyday manga. This manga strictly deals with cases of intersexuality. IS stands for Inter Sexuality.  
  
This manga deals with very serious issues concerning intersexual people. The pain they go through, the troubles they confront, and ultimately their inability to reproduce and even find a partner who will accept them as they are - It's all there in a form of manga.  
  
First volume has different cases but from volume two onwards manga becomes a longer tale of Hoshino Haru, IS and their life, trials and tribulations towards the adulthood.  
  
IS won the 2007 Kodansha Manga Award for shōjo manga.

title: School Beauty's Personal Master
description: An unlikely once-in-a-lifetime master from the rural countryside, a mysterious jade pendant that can see into the future… Lin Yi is just an ordinary student, but he bears another heavy responsibility - to pursue the campus queen! And it’s on the orders of her dad! Although Lin Yi really doesn’t want to deal with this high-maintenance young lady, you can’t disobey your elders. He has no choice but to transfer to a school all the way in Songshan City…

title: Aizawa Koharu wa Shi ni Isogu
description: Ai cũng có Quyền được sống, vậy sẽ ra sao nếu ai cũng có cả Quyền được chết? Đây là câu chuyện kể về cuộc sống cấp ba của hai cô cậu thiếu niên tại thế giới nơi "An tử" (hay "Chết nhân đạo") được hợp pháp. Cùng tận hưởng thanh xuân này trước khi chết nào!

title: Twin Role
description:
The ace of the arts department, Izumi, goes by a different alias on the internet: Iz.   
Together with the composer Kanon, they make music videos. Izumi admires Kanon as a woman greatly, and the two chat with each other every day. One day, Sagami transfers to the music department of the school and Sagami and Izumi dislike each other very much. But Sagami's true identity is Kanon!  
He realizes that Iz=Izumi, but Izumi doesn't know and acts very coldly towards him…!?

title: Hana no Kishi
description: Ever since the day Ran Kurono's older brother, was killed while protecting Sei Ohtori, she has dedicated her skills and life to one day becoming the First Knight of the next head of the Ohtori family, even concealing the fact that she's a woman forever. For generations the Kurono family has served the Ohtori family as their First Knight, but 11 other lower knights with ill intentions of using the Ohtori family's authority vie for that title. Not only that, but Sei is being tested to see if she is suitable for having the title of head of the family. Upon entering Saint Locks Academy, the days of both Ran and Sei's trials begin, all the while being helped by Sei's untidy and unrefined fiance, Ibara Tennou.

title: Your Ghost Boy
description: Wang Zi Yan, a University student, has always had a body different from everyone else’s. When his body is touched by moonlight, he will become invisible. One night, after getting off work, he uses this ability to save a woman. That’s how an uncontrollable love story started! A soft and cute boy VS a rich, confident woman, how will this love story turn out?

title: Trinity Seven: Revision
description:
Mitsunari Miyazawa is a high school student who aspires to become a writer. Suddenly, in a battle he gets involved in, a demon takes his life, and Mitsunari awakens to the power of the "jealousy" mage and is revived. Together with his partner, the grimoire Lydia, Mitsunari's life as a grimoire begins now--!

Translated via DeepL so this description could change in the future.

title: Ore to Atashi no Kareshi-sama
description:
Hayato and Chouko are twins who are as unlike each other as night and day. Chouko is a shallow princess who's main concern is her own looks and cute things, while Hayato is the cool but overpotective brother with a penchant for sabotaging any potential relationships for Chouko. So it's only natural that he would do the same when Chouko confesses to the school prince, Tsukiyono (albeit, mainly for his looks), and finds herself with a date.  
  
Things become very, very complicated, however, after an argument over Chouko's love life ends up with them both tumbling down the stairs. Bizarrely, they both find they've switched bodies, with Hayato in Chouko's body and Chouko in Hayatos. Whats worse, and much to Chouko's horror, Tsukiyono starts to fall for Hayato in Chouko's body even without knowing who he is.

title: Hatsukoi Shimai
description: During a fateful visit to Tsunojo Girls' School, Chika Matsusato meets the girl of her dreams–cool upperclassman Haruna Kanzaki. Even though they spent only one short day together, Chika will never forget Haruna's kindness, and has made it her life's goal to study hard and get accepted into Tsunojo Girls' School so that they can be together. But will Haruna share Chika’s feelings…?

title: Nodame Cantabile - Encore Opera-hen
description:
A two-volume sequel of the *Nodame Cantabile* series. Chiaki and Nodame are back in Japan, Nodame for her first recital there, and Chiaki for his first Opera Concerto.

(Collected in volumes 24 & 25)

title: Long Time No See
description:
By Boomer Squad:  
  
While out shopping, Mo Xiaoxia runs into her high school sweetheart, Lin Han, on the street. A series of chaotic yet heart-racing memories slowly begins to surface in Mo Xiaoxia's mind – the story of the two girls.

title: Iinari! Aibration
description: Shizukuishi has a problem. Well, a number of them, actually: She wets herself chronically. She occasionally loses complete control of her actions. She's being hunted by an army of robot maids. The root of all her troubles is the soul of the ancient destructive giant Daidara-bocchi, which is sealed in her womb. But she's not alone. By chance, she became attached by a thread made of light to Kouki, a "contractee" who helps maintain the burden of the seal within her. Together, Shizukuishi and Kouki face her troubles and fight against the evil robot maids, but if they get too close to each other, then something terrible could happen...

title: Haru Wa Watashi Wo Baka Ni Suru
description:
**From LemonadeScans:**  
A lonely, troublesome boy who does whatever he wants; an uncontrollable playboy… But, Nao is "friends" which Sasaki Shun, who is like this…?!

title: Kyouai Gakuen Online - Koukan-do 0 = Dead End
description:
A bug occurs in the world's first full-dive maiden game, and developer Yuri enters the game to investigate. But because of a bug, the good-looking characters have turned into crazy freaks! 

Welcome to a game where the wrong choice kills you in real life.

title: Big Spender in a Busted Game
description: Though the fantasy game "Mystic World" is maddeningly difficult and money-grubbing, Luda just can't quit playing. So it's borderline traumatic when the final boss, Lucid Black, destroys her precious kingdom in the final stage. But luckily, our heroine wakes up in the beginning stage of Mystic World as her game character, Princess Luda Earl Grey. Armed with tons of S-rank items and her credit card, Luda might just have a shot at saving Milk Tea Kingdom from the deadly Lucid. And the first step in her plan... is to enroll in the same academy and befriend her worst enemy!

title: Shuriken to Pleats
description:
With the Meiji Restoration and the abolishment of the Samurai system, the once feared and respected ninja were forced underground, to continue their work in absolute secrecy. In modern times, the descendants of a certain ninja clan have continued their ancestors' legacy by employing the ninja arts in their work as bodyguards for the rich and famous.  
  
This is the story of ninja Mikage's life as a normal high school girl!

title: Ookami-san to Shinizokonai
description:
A therianthrope x a blind girl  
A classical fantasy romance!!  
  
Being a shunned therianthrope living in the slums, Julius met a blind human girl one day. He is having his heart healed by this girl who is unaware of his true nature…

title: Clear Color
description:
My world has always been a colorless bubble. But she burst it with nothing more than her smile and her words, turning it into a kaleidoscope of vibrant colors.  
  
(Source: Batoto)

title: Hajime-chan is No. 1!
description: Okano Hajime is an ordinary - or maybe below ordinary - girl who was forced to take care everything in the family since she was young, because her family was very poor. Hajime had five younger brothers, who were quintuplets, and they were scouted by a music company. Thus, the realistic yet dreamy older sister had to try harder to watch over her restless brothers and to pursue her own idol, who was in the very same company.

title: Confession
description: Gathering your courage to confess in person

title: 【Oshi no Ko】(Fan Colored)
description:
The story begins with a beautiful girl, her perfectly fake smile, and the people who love her selfishly for it.

What transpires behind the scenes of the glittering showbiz industry? How far would you go for the sake of your beloved idol? What would you do if you found out reincarnation was real? The star of the show is Aquamarine Hoshino and the stage is but a mere facade. Will he manage to reach the climax before the world of glamour swallows him whole?

title: Unubore Heart's Cry
description:
Despite being popular, Yuri was rejected by her crush who was a plain boy. Now she's seeking a top-tier boyfriend who will match her beautiful self, so that the boy in the past will regret what he's lost.  
  
[RUS] || Эта манга повествует о том, что не всем красавицам везет в любви. Хотя, кто знает?..||

title: Haruchika
description: High school students Kamijou Haruta and Homura Chika are members of a wind instrument club that is on the verge of being shut down. The two are childhood friends and they spend their days practicing hard, while also trying to recruit new members. When a certain incident happens within their school, they work together to solve it.

title: Lord of Destruction
description: Noritaka Sawamura is a teenager; until this day, everybody has been making fun of him. Now he enters the high school which is an opportunity for him to restart a new life! He loves a girl of his school, but he needs to be a little bit stronger to be recognized by everybody. So he joins the Thai boxing section. His entertainment is very special, due to his master who seems to be a little mad. Noritaka will make you laugh, for sure!

title: Spinach Bouquet
description: Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn’t it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That’s what Jiwoo is looking forward to… But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dongchan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dongchan isn’t the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn’t want Jiwoo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Jiwoo tries his best to adjust to life in the country…until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit? (Source: Lezhin)

title: Futei de Furachi na Ani desu ga.
description: She has 3 good-looking brothers…but they're a little bit overprotecting….

title: Tsugi wa Ii yo ne, Senpai
description: Mao, who had repeated a year for some reason, decided to start over in the second year of high school. Hachiya, a junior high school boy in the soccer club, became in the same class as Mao who repeated a year. Even though he is in the same grade as her he doesn’t break his honorifics, in which Mao found difficult, but…

title: Seishun no After IF
description:
What if Sakura didn't disappear when she was 16? What if there was a route where the entirety of youth flowed alongside quiet everyday life, leading to a miraculous happy ending? This story is one man's wish, and it depicts another possibility for what happens after youth.

Released at Comic Market 92.

title: Takara-kun and Amagi-kun
description: Takara Shun, a high school student who belongs to a popular group in the class, and Taichi Amagi, a pure boy who is not a conspicuous type but is liked by people, realize their love for each other. Even though they start dating in secret, it is difficult to be honest.

title: W Juliet
description: Sixteen-year-old tomboy Ito Miura has become fast friends with her schoolmate and fellow drama enthusiast Makoto Amano. The problem? Makoto's a boy who must pass as a female drama student in order for his family to approve of his acting ambitions.

title: Obey Me! The Comic
description:
There is only one rule you have to remember... "One master to rule them all!"

It's the long-awaited comic for the outstandingly popular demon-training mobile game! When they're selected to be an exchange student at RAD, a school for demons, our protagonist finds waiting for them... Seven demon brothers and a student life at RAD that's shaping up to be a wild ride...!

title: Blazing Transfer Student
description:
Noboru Takizawa is an ordinary high school student who has transferred into a new school. 
His chaotic transfer student life begins the moment he steps on a landmine in the schoolyard. 
From there, Takizawa often finds himself transferring into other schools, moving others with his hot-blooded passion, 
and fighting against injustice within the school's structure. This is the tale of a high school legend! 

---

**Links:**  
- [Shimamoto's Twitter](https://twitter.com/simakazu)  
- [OVA on ANN](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=1148)

title: How to Train You
description:
Gyuyeon Is an Bullied Boy in highschool Changes his Life after accidentally Kissing a Famous Gyaru at school

And Ends Up Haunting Him.

title: The Screw People
description:
The story revolves around high school student Neji Yamato, who has worries that keep resurfacing. He keeps asking himself, "Just who am 'I,' who is nothing at all?"

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **The Screw People** (2019)

title: 2023 These Days Love Special
description:
'scrolling through social media, dating lightly, ex-lovers like friends' These days, dating is like this? Haha Really? lol) A spring day full of excitement.. I will be satisfied with the webtoon again this time. ^^

title: Are you Messing with me?!
description: Naota and Usami really like to mess with each other. Will this be all for gags?.. or will it turn into something more?

title: Over Drive
description: Shinozaki Mikoto is a student who's life is really routine. Going to school, going home, going to school, going home… nothing changes… until the day the girl he likes talks to him and introduces him to bicycling. His life now has a new meaning, and a bright path has shown itself to Shinozaki. Experiencing both failure and success throughout his training, he works hard to become the best cyclist in the world.

title: Koi no Youbi no Sezaki-san
description: Tooru Hoshimaki is a high schooler who doesn't believe in love... but when the girl whose personality mysteriously and fantastically changes each day of the week begins showing him attention, he might change his mind!

title: Subete ni Iya Girl
description: Hating girl is a manga about a girl with an arrow stuck through her head named Asumi, and the boy interested in her, named Ryouji. It's full of goofy humor and silly storylines, yet the relationship aspect of it touches on real life at times, and ends up quite endearing. Check out this silly-sweet manga and laugh at the insanity that is life with a girl that has an arrow through her head.

title: Futariyogari na Melty Charm
description:
"Wait, why the hell am I kissing this guy right now?!!"

The story is set in a certain magic school.
Eve, a dog beastfolk, is excited about the "Buddy Selection Ceremony". The moment his Buddy is announced, everyone is in an uproar.

That is because his Buddy is none other than "Aura", a genius wolf beastfolk who has some dark rumors surrounding him! (Just who is this guy?!)

Even so, Eve approaches him to try and become friends with him, but Eve coldly rejects him with an "I don't have the energy to talk to you"! He's harsh and their magics are the polar opposites of each other, so they couldn't be a worse match...

Can you really live together with someone like that...?!

A fluffy, chaotic Buddy BL!!
Mysterious Lone Wolf x Cheerful Puppy!!

title: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru - Brushing Teeth Together (Doujinshi)
Heibon de Arifureta, Shiawase na Renai.
description:
This is a sweet, heartwarming romance between a young high school couple: Yukari Mishima, the school's idol, and Yamato Onodera, a boy who tends to fly under the radar. It is a relationship you can’t help but want to root for.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Koi wa Aete no Gyaku Bunny
description:
