This series is about the middle sister, Miu, and is contemporary to the main series. It shows most of the same events from Miu's point of view, but with some differences.

title: Boku ni Natta Watashi
description:
Welcome to Momoko's waking nightmare. Things were settled, they were! She was SUPPOSED to have gone to a normal school, made normal friends, and led a blissfully normal life. But the universe is just cruelly, irredeemably, monstrously unfair, so instead she found herself thrown out of home, stuck in an all-boys boarding school with a roommate she hates, cursed with a hideous haircut and wearing clothes which, to be frank, she wouldn't be seen dead in. And the only thing worse than her current situation is the one that she'll be in if anyone ever realizes that she is, in fact, a girl. Everything is wrong! Particularly the fact that, even though she's surrounded by amazingly gorgeous guys, her chances of romance are less than zero. But with life this complicated, something's bound to give - and so it does.   
  
from SIH

title: Wǒ de Nǚyǒu shì Èliè Dàxiǎojiě ma?!
description: 【Ding… Ding.. System activated, game starts】【 If the Player taking over the capture target, points will be rewarded】… If it’s for the sake of conquering beauties, I’ll wear the golden crown; if it’s for reward points, I’ll move forward by any means…

title: 1-ko Shita kara, Kiss Sasete.
description:
"The coastal town in which I live, has everything but also nothing."  
  
Sakura is a 2nd year high school student who spends her days ordinarily. She believes high school life should be much more free, gorgeous, and filled with sparkles every day. But in reality, it's not like that at all…  
  
To this kind of Sakura, Ao-kun, who is one year her junior, appears before her. Since meeting Ao, Sakura's ordinary days are now filled with sparkles――  
  
This is a sweet, youthful love story between a super positive boy and super negative girl!

title: Ani Koi
description:
I Wana Fall in Love Like the Animation  
  
Takatoki is a high school boy with an intense obsession for manga and anime. He desperately wants a typical anime romance with a girl who falls into a typical female anime stereotype. His childhood friend Chiyoko, a very unladylike girl who is a notorious fighter, tries in vain to get his mind back to reality.  
  
One day, the two of them run into a girl in a sailor schoolgirl outfit being threatened by a generic band of thugs. As Chiyoko beats up the thugs, Takatoki learns that the girl, Asadzuma Youtsugi, is a cosplayer who wants to lead the life of an anime character. Was this Takatoki's fated first encounter with his future anime lover!?

title: Raiden Shogun Is My Wife?!
description: Luke is obsessed with Raiden Shogun from the videogame he plays called Genshin Impact and he refuses to date anyone, but her. One day his best friend Gina tells Luke a rumor about a mysterious old lady that appears at a park and will grant any wish in exchange for a random favor no matter how impossible it may sound. Luke and Gina let their curiosity get the best of them and they decide to meet the old lady. Little do they know that their wishes will be granted, but not in the way that they expect.

title: Koisuru Mitsuba
description:
Even at school, the sober Mitsuba is attracted by the popular Sakurai-kun. But then, something big will happen…  
  
Mitsuba is not very good at talking, and disappears in class sitting at the back corner of the classroom. She hasn't made a single friend, but when the hand of the most popular boy in school is stretched out to her… she begins to sparkle in her own way.

title: Subarashii Kiseki ni Yasashii Kimi to
description: Enoki is practically the poster-boy for what a typical nerd looks like: short and slight, complete with big round glasses and social awkwardness. His main hobby is playing video games, and he's used to not having many friends at school. Then, he meets Shirataki, a former member of the baseball club and his exact opposite; tall, muscular and sporty. Despite their many differences, the spark of friendship between the two boys begins to grow into something more...

title: Sono Voice, Yuuryou Desu ka?
description:
Voice actor otaku Suzuna meets a boy with the ideal handsome voice, Tachibana Waku.  
She wants to get friendly with him but Waku is acting cold…  
"So heart melting you can't help but smile!" A younger tsundere boy and a girl obsessed with him scenes o’ plenty! Whispering sweet nothings, tin-can phones, handsome voices, loaded with moe situations! Settled firmly in the first position of comico novel category, continuously receiving good reviews and high praises from its readers. Now it’s time to raise the curtain on this youthful love started with a voice!

title: Bokura no Shikisai
description:
The daily life of high school boy who can’t say “I love you” to his beloved classmate because he’s also a boy. But his days are changed to meet a mysterious elderly man who might be also gay…

[Official English](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/610952/our-colors-by-gengoroh-tagame/)

title: Gaku☆Ou ~The Twinkle Star Story~
description: Coming to earth to live the highschool life he's always dreamt of, Hirito finds himself in a bathroom on top of a naked girl! It turns out she goes to the world renowned Konoeghara Academy. Hirito is shocked to find the school only consists of seven students in total! Why in the world does one of the most prestigious academies in the nation only consist of seven pupils…?

title: Saekkaman Sunjeong Ilji
description:
“I’m gonna live a normal life!”

Cho-eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university. Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?

'Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?'

Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-eun finally achieve the campus life she’s always dreamed of?

---
**Link:**
- Alternate Official Raw - [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11903391)

title: Himitsu no Psycho-san
description: Kazumi, who has a terrifying appearance, cannot be dealt with by anyone at school. However, in fact, he is a boy who is good at handicrafts. That triggered a secret exchange with Saeko, the “best angel in school”. One day, Saeko's appearance changes as if she was possessed by the devil. At the same time, Ichimi is becoming more and more "stumbled" on something ...? One of the idiosyncratic constitutions favored by the dead and Hayaeko's school x horror x fantasy opening that can force the dead to become a Buddhahood!

title: Rewrite: SIDE-B
description:
Đây là một trong các thế giới quan của Rewrite, để hiểu được toàn bộ câu chuyện, bạn phải đọc song song Rewrite:Side-B và Rewrite:Side-R.

Một thành phố hư cấu có tên Kazamatsuri, chính sách bảo vệ cây xanh và trồng rừng đã biến nơi đây thành thiên đường xanh mát với nhiều thảm cỏ và hoa trên đường tương tự như những tòa nhà mọc chen chút nhau trong các thành phố lớn. Tuy phần lớn thành phố mang hơi hướm của thôn quê, cũng có rất nhiều yếu tố đô thị truyền thống. Dù được thiết lập trong một khung cảnh hiện đại, thành phố này có một điều gì đó rất thần bí, mang mác cảm giác của sự hoài niệm. Địa điểm diễn ra các câu chuyện là trong một trường trung học. Nam sinh Tennouji Kotarou, 17 tuổi, vẫn vô tư tận hưởng quãng đời học sinh của mình cho đến khi có nhiều sự việc bí ẩn bắt đầu diễn ra xung quanh… Chuyển thể từ visual novel của công ty Key vào năm 2011. Key cũng là nguyên tác của các visual novel và anime nổi tiếng như AIR, Kanon, CLANNAD, Angel Beats!.

title: Cupid 13
description: Không một ai sống sót sau khi bị hắn nhắm đến. Mục tiêu của hắn lần này là một thiếu nữ ngây thơ...

title: Shiba wa Kyou mo Baka!
description: Maybe I was confessed to by my childhood friend !? An energetic and foolish high school boy, Shiba isn't sure if he was confessed to by his childhood friend Ryou. To find out if he can also like boys, Shiba offers to give Ryou a massage. While Shiba comes to the conclusion that he can date Ryou, Ryou rejects him?!

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Last Night, Here With You (Doujinshi)
description:
It is the morning after Claudine slept together with Maya in the latter's bedroom and, given that she only vaguely recalls last night's events, she begins to wonder if all she did with Maya was simply "sleep." [Yuri Doujinshi]  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

title: Chibi Demo Iiyo
description: Wataru and Souta met in their first year of high school and have been best friends since. Souta has a tendency to make fun of Wataru's small build and he doesn't miss a chance to make a comment about it. There is only one thing that bothers Wataru, and that is Souta always treating him like a child. But will Souta ever find out the secret Wataru has been hiding?

title: Oniichan dakedo Ai Sae Areba Kankeinai yo ne - Imouto 4-koma Booklet
description:
Special booklet included in the July issue of Comic Alive in 2012 to commemorate the anime series announcement of OniAi.

---

- Chapter 9 by momi
- Chapter 10 by Gin (Ishizuchi Ginko)
- Chapter 11 by Kouji
- Chapter 12 by Hayashi Yuuichi
- Chapter 13 by Sugano Manami

title: Kujaku no Kyoushitsu
description: They're a group of peacocks who dance gracefully with their beautiful plumage that mesmerizes all eyes. Will Mariho's destiny be changed after meeting them…?!

title: A Foolish Avenger
description:
Sunday Webry Newcomer Award, September 2022, Free Division, Honorable Mention.

A pathetic boy is swiftly rejected by the girl he likes. Frustrated, he tries summoning a demon to curse her - but not only is the demon he summons is totally his type, he accidentally sends her back! How far will this boy's desperation go?

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Maya and Claudine in Hogwarts School Of Witchcraft and Wizardry (Doujinshi)
description:
Claudine wonders how Maya is able to so perfectly call forth a patronus when Claudine herself is struggling to achieve the same. (Doujinshi - 2 Volumes Total)  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight ☆

title: Yukidoke no Koi
description: On a snowy day, under the shadow of blooming cherry blossoms, Somita sees a man crying by himself. Later, Somita discovers the man is none other than Someya-sensei, a popular teacher at his high school. Somita makes friendly overtures towards his teacher, and as they get to know each other little by little, Somita realises his feelings for Someya-sensei. But Someya is still haunted by an unrequited love…

title: In August
description:
There was a confession letter in the time capsule that my childhood friend and I buried. While office worker Buntarou is on his way to his hometown for summer vacation, he reunites with his childhood friend, Ittetsu, with whom he hasn’t spoken in fourteen years.  
Inspired by the letters from the time capsule, Buntarou and Ittetsu entwine their bodies as they start a relationship that they call a “thoughtless love affair”…  
This summer’s encounters will heal the wounds that they’ve carried in their hearts without knowing it.

title: Yuu & Mii
description:
Aimu Yuu (remark: his name sounds like "I'm you") is a high school student who just moved into Yaninari Sou, a cheap boarding house in Tokyo despite the rumor of this place being haunted by ghosts. Upon his arrival, he finds out that he's sharing room with a female ghost named Mii, who immediately takes a liking to him and insists on clinging to him till he dies. Not only that, but Yaninari Sou is filled with weirdos like Hinata Teruaki, an antisocial guy, Gouda Karuma, a 8-years ronin with luxuriant hair, Ogura An, a weird Shoujo Mangaka, Buraide Mari, a former pro wrestler, and last but not least, the mysterious landlord Ooya Oya who's always wearing an armor suit. The only normal person Yuu can find here is his classmate Ooya Ai, the landlord's daughter, and she also seems to take a liking to him, but will this be enough to help Yuu get through his high school life in peace?  
  
The title "Yuu & Mii" is a pun on the English phrase "You and Me".   
A parody manga with a lot of weird

title: Kyoushi mo Iroiro Aru Wake de
description: Komori Tadamachi loves teaching at an elementary school, the only problem is fellow teacher Takigawa Kyou. Always being compared to the perfectly composed and devastatingly handsome Takigawa is really destroying Komori's self-esteem. Still, Komori finds himself being drawn in by Takigawa's effortless charm…

title: The Brief Return of Dr. Slump
description: The sequel to *Dr. Slump* brings us back to Penguin Village for more goofy hijinks with Arale, Senbei, and the rest of the gang!

title: Quoth the Boy
description: A troubled otaku boy is obsessed with his favorite anime character, Aris Chan. When a small-town girl moves to his school, the boy believes she's his idol come to life! The boy? Ga-Ra. The girl? Tae-Bok. Two people, two stories, one wacky and heartwarming romance.

title: Dark Mermaid
description: Seul-bi has lost direction in her life due to the intense trauma of school violence. Then, Hae-on, a mermaid, arrives to ease their pain. Over time, their feelings for each other transform into something deeper than a simple friendship, and together they seek bloody revenge against their bullies.

title: Daisuki na no ni Inkya Sugite Omoi ga Tsutaerarenai Osananajimi
Aiseyo Bakemono
description: Reiji Kuze is the son of doctors and the new transfer student in his last year of high school. As someone whose socioeconomic background and academic grades are in the top 98th percentile, Reiji immediately stands out like a sore thumb in his new school. And in high school, standing out means you will be targeted. Presumed to be a delicate prince swimming in cash, Reiji gets picked on by the third strongest person in the school... and beats him and his entire gang to a pulp without breaking a sweat. As if Reiji didn't stand out enough already, he seems to have caught the interest of the king of the hill, Akira Ohara, the cat-like lone-wolf that nobody can seem to tame...

title: Bloody Romance
description: 'My first love tasted red.' From having my heart race whenever I see you, thinking about you all day, and caring about even the small things that you did... Was it all just because your blood tasted good?

title: The Strongest Scholar System
description: Adapted from the novel 'The Most Powerful Learning System', Su Mo discovers that the secret to academic excellence is... love. Who says dating gets in the way of your studies? With the Learning System installed, anyone can become a star student instantly!

title: Tonari no Koigataki
description: Hiro-kun and Icchan are both very important childhood friends to Akane. She thought they would always and forever be good friends, but...

title: Ichinose Kyoudai wa Gaman Dekinai
description: A new big beautiful guy is transferred in Hoshino's class. Wait! He's Ichinose, the troublemaker of middle school. At that time Hoshino has written a love novel between Ichinose and his new stepbrother. When the novel was discovered by a classmate, they make fun of them and triggered Ichinose's wrath. Then ichinose transferred. Maybe was Hoshino's fault? And now he's back!

title: In That Relationship
description:
Do-yeon, who grew up together with her Childhood Friends, Won-young and Won-hyuk.  
  
 Do-yeon, who had been thinking about Won-hyuk since childhood, made a public confession to Won-hyuk on the middle school festival day, and was dumped.  
  
 Slowly, the relationship between the three ends when the twins immigrate abroad a few months later, and the public confession case remains a dark history of their lives. After a while, Won-young, who returned to Korea without notice, appeared in front of Do-yeon and confessed…  

___

title: Mizuiro Splash
description:
Masato Kyobashi suffers from an illness that does not allow him to do any strenous activity, but he becomes the manager of his school's swimming club.  
  
This is a manga about his everyday life in the swimming club surrounded by beautiful girls.

title: Nal Meongneun Geon Geumjiyang!
description: Nam Haesul, who is handsome but famous for his dog-like personality, is only nice to his childhood friend, Yang Miru. "It's clear that he's nice to me because he likes me!" But is it really like that? Miru has no idea about Haesul’s true feelings. Then one day, she finds out about the 'black heart' that Haesul harbors! Cracks are starting to appear in their 10-year friendship...! The wild growth story of a wolf boy and an innocent girl!

title: Sneeze!: Naoki Urasawa Story Collection
description:
A curated collection of eight short stories and essay manga by famed mangaka Naoki Urasawa, creator of the acclaimed series Monster and 20th Century Boys!  
  
Urasawa's characters confront fantastical elements ranging from psychic powers, to alien visitors to planet Earth, to attacks by giant monsters. On the flip side, the author philosophizes about his real-world experiences with the wild and wacky international music scene.  
  
Plus, a classic, funny animal tale, in Urasawa's inimitable style!

title: Kanojo no Ai ga Omo Sugite Tsurai
description:
Mitsuya Haruyoshi is a devout Christian High-school boy since his father became a priest after his mother cheated on his father. He tries to avoid lust and desire because his father wants him to become a priest.  
  
One day his female childhood friend Sonoda Hanako, the daughter of a sweetshop owner who goes to the same school invites him home.  
  
Turns out her family shifted business to a sex shop to counter the effects of declining birthrates on their business. She reminds him that he promised to marry her when they were children and even gave her a ring made from Aluminum foil. She also notes that Christians only do lewd stuff with people they are married to, so if she does lewd stuff to him he'll have to marry her.

title: Ginen Shounen
description: Matataki is a high school student who enjoys photography. One day, he finds out that he can see the future when he looks through the viewfinder of his camera upon seeing the girl he likes, Mirai, kissing a stranger under a bell that is rumored to bring two people together for eternity…

title: My Hero!
description: It's been a month since she entered high school, and Jun has started noticing a particular guy hanging around her classroom. When he suddenly confesses, she's not sure where she even knows him from, or how she feels about him. But come what may, he seems pretty intent on sticking around…

title: Satomu Fallin' Love
description:
Satom, a super unfriendly and shy boy who really wants a girlfriend, is confronted by an angel and a devil who have their own reasons for appearing in front of him...?
He is approached by an angelic demon and an evil angel!
A beautiful, breathtaking, dream-filled comedy of love!

title: Boku × Kano
description:
Hayashi Shoutaro is an otaku and a student who sucks at studying, the results showing on every test. And if that wasn't bad enough, he also calls out things like, the one who scores the lowest has to clean the classroom by themselves. In his class, there is a girl he likes, Kanda Yayoi, who always gets top scores and is popular among the whole class.  
  
When he arrives home after cleaning the classroom, he's met by his perverted, otaku sister who has him cross-play (cross-dressing cosplay) to go to an anime merchandise display. There he meets Yayoi, who it turns out is also an otaku, and she falls in love with his cosplay persona…?

title: Hello Again
description: Ever since he was young, HeeMin has always liked his neighbour, SeonWoo hyung. HeeMin had given up on SeonWoo after he had moved away. However, coincidentally, SeonWoo is searching for a roommate and HeeMin is able to meet him once again. But, the love rival that has appeared in front of HeeMin now is none other than his older brother, YooMin!

title: Silent Witch: Another—Kekkai no Majutsushi no Nariagari
description:
After memorizing his magecraft textbook in a single week, Louis is accepted as a scholarship student at Minerva's Mage Training Institution. But surrounded by nobles, the rough and rowdy boy from a poor, remote village is treated as a problem child and feared for the way he trounces his opponents in magic battles. And yet Louis still finds teachers he respects and friends he can rely on as he grows into the man who will become a Sage. Learn all about the notorious deeds of the Barrier Mage's youth in this prequel to Secrets of the Silent Witch.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Goshuushou-sama Ninomiya-kun
description: Shungo is a normal high school student living in a huge house. One day, his sister Ryoko sends Mayu and Mikihiro Tsukimura, two siblings, to live with him to help Mayu overcome her problem. Mayu's problem: androphobia (fear of men), and Ryoko wants Shungo to help her overcome it. How? By making Mayu and Shungo share the same room, bed, and even take baths together. To make things even worse, Reika Hojo, the student-council chair, somehow ends up becoming their maid.

title: Haru
description: Returning college student Jin-woo, who failed at making his first love work, vows never to date again. Somehow, he becomes acquainted with Haru, an engaging exchange student from Japan, when he helps her out one day. He must also face his ex-girlfriend, Cha Hee-yeon.

title: No Words
description: This is a two-person comic without any dialogue. A blossoming romance between a boy and a girl.

title: Kuginashi Bon ni Kaze ga Fuku!
description: Kuginashi Bon is a middle school boy suffering from severe gynophobia. One day, a group of weirdos suddenly move into the apartment next door and declare they want to help him overcome his condition…

title: Princess Tutu
description: Ahiru wishes to become a beautiful ballerina, but her two left feet always get in the way of her dreams. All of that changes when she is given a magical pendant and is suddenly transformed into Princess Tutu, a graceful dancer who is lighter than air. But not all is well for the crowned princess of pirouettes. The boy of her dreams has a broken heart, and Tutu must collect the shattered pieces to make her beloved Mytho whole again, before a darker dancer takes his heart away forever.

title: Robotics;Notes
description: In 2019, childhood friends Yashio Kaito and Senomiya Akiho are in their last year of high school. Together, they are the only students in the robotics club, which has lost its school funding. Akiho is passionate about robots, and longs to complete building the robot her older sister Misaki began in this same club. Kaito doesn't really care about robots, and is obsessed with video games, specifically "Kill Ballad Online." However, he stays in the robotics club due to his friendship with Akiho. Now, just after Kaito is accused of cheating in his favorite game, Akiho decides to risk her club's existence in exchange for the funding to finally finish her sister's giant robot…

title: Teru Teru x Shounen
description: 7th grader Oshiro Shinobu, the daughter of one of Japan's old family lines, was seperated from her parents due to certain circumstances when she was only 6. Because of this she now lives with one of her distant relatives, Kouda Shougo, who is a teacher the at the school she now goes to. Aparently, a childhood friend by the name of Oku Saizou is transferring into Shinobu's class, but wait… This timid and hesitant boy in actually a ninja who serves Shinobu come for the sole purpose to protect her…?!

title: Narukawa-kun wa Nakasaretakunai
description: A new era of adolescent love between an innocent girl who's a dom and a headstrong boy who's a sub!

title: Tiji-kun!
description: Hanagasumi Highschool is located right in middle of Kabukichou, Tokyo's #1 red-light district. Because of this, the students are constantly robbed and harassed by yakuza, gangs, etc. In order to ensure the students' safety, the Student Council came up with one solution: befriend the legendary "Tiji-kun", the strongest man in Kabukichō. Two students, Motobu Tomoko and Akazawa Ryo, were assigned the task. But when they find out the true identity of the mysterious "Tiji-kun", having a peaceful school-life turns out to be harder than it seems.

title: Short Program
description:
Probably one of the most difficult feats in manga is to tell a compelling short story, and Mitsuru Adachi is a master of the medium. This selection of some of his best short works include two tales in the dangerous life of a pretty private-eye-to-be; a boy's stop-off on the way changes his life's destination; five short-shorts in a quirky cafe; Japan's future ace pitcher can't even throw a ball; when a school play goes bad, the world is a stage for love and karate; a drama of rugby and past lives; two off-beat time-travel tales; and more! Mitsuru Adachi's low-key but high-impact stories are a must read for any manga aficionado.  
  
This collection, titled simply Short Program, collected stories by Adachi published between 1985 and now.  
  
||Volume 1: (from Viz)  
Story 1 - Change  
Story 2 - Take Off  
Story 3 - Short Program  
Story 4 - What's Going On!? (Part 1)  
Story 5 - What's Going On!? (Part 2)  
Story 6 - At the Intersection  
Story 7 - The Current State of Affairs  
Story

title: Osananajimi to, Kiss shitakunakunai.
description: Hiyoko, Ibuki, and Chihiro have been friends since childhood, growing up together as close as siblings. But when they entered high school, that relationship began to change. Chihiro confides in Ibuki about his long-standing crush on Hiyoko. But Hiyoko herself has feelings for Ibuki. What will happen to their relationship?

title: Ouji-sama to Haiiro no Hibi
description: Atsuko is a young high-school girl who leads a troublesome life. Working a scandalous job for the sake of survival, her reputation is in tatters and she is scorned by her peers. But one day she is noticed by one of three rich boys, Itaru, which she resembles in an uncanny way. Immediately she finds herself whisked away from her everyday life and into a new world where she is forced to take on the role as Itaru's double and replace him as the 'Prince'.

title: Alice 19th
description: Alice Seno seems like a normal girl in high school. She's a bit shy, she's got a crush on a boy named Kyou, and she's got an older sister who is more popular than she is… pretty normal stuff, until Alice has an encounter with a mysterious and magical rabbit girl that changes the course of her life, and Alice is introduced to the sublime power of the Lotis Words.

title: Magical Trans: The End of Mahou Shoujo Bu!?
description: Set shortly after the conclusion of Magical Trans, the Magical Girl Club has been ordered to disband, forcing Minami to decide: Stay a man, or stay a woman.

title: Oko-sama Box
description: Kawasaki and Fujita have been best friends since early childhood. Kawasaki has secretly been carrying a torch for his cheerful buddy, but Fujita only has eyes for the girls around him. The delicate balance of their relationship is shaken when Fujita gets himself a girlfriend in high school. What is Kawasaki supposed to do with his feelings now?

title: GALS!
description: Self-styled Kogal queen Kotobuki Ran and her friends just wanna have fun, which includes shopping, hanging out, and scamming meals off gullible guys. Unfortunately, their "hood"—Shibuya—is in constant danger of being despoiled by dirty old men, street gangs, nasty Kogal rivals, and other societal evils. But with a little help from her friends and a toughness born of coming from a family full of cops, Ran takes on the bad guys (and gals) with gusto!

title: Bukiyou Gal to Jimi na Joshi no Yuri Manga
Fist of the North Star - Strawberry Flavor
description:
In this *very* zany take on the dramatic series by Buronson and Tetsuo Hara, the end of the century… wasn't so bad, actually. A *very* special and brave Holy Emperor, Souther, wants to become more "involved" and to be on "friendly terms" with the noble Kenshiro & his posse. *Especially* Kenshiro. Due to his very outgoing nature, he also crashes the homes of his other buddies, often when they *especially* don't want him to show up!  
  
Join Souther as he releases his feelings in heart-throbbing, mind-bending confessions, settles complex and engrossing territorial disputes with deep and intricate consequences, enjoys the simple and introspective pleasures of a quiet dinner, and climbs the top of the rough and brutal pyramid that is the idol world - with the help of his best buddies, of course! Maybe even Kenshiro will be there - who knows!  
  
By the time it got its anime in 2015, *Strawberry Flavor* had sold over 1 million copies in Japan. The anime was composed of 2-minute long, abri

title: Yukihime-kun wa Watashi no Yome
description: (From Pixiv) A manga about childhood friends.

title: Love and Sweet Drugs
description:
One day, I couldn't eat sweets and became weaker to the point of making my heart nearly stopped beating; until I met someone who could make my strength stronger and longer for a period of time - a patissier!
But, after his girlfriend's death, he wouldn't make any sweets anymore and opened a café instead, selling the bitterest coffee ever.
So, to save my life, I'll definitely make sure you return to making sweets again!
Please, please~

title: Kamisama Kazoku
description: Samataro Kamiyama is the envy of his classmates. He always gets the best seat in class, never has detention, and his best friend is both sweet and pretty. He's also surrounded by his loving family, gorgeous older sister and adorable younger one… but hey, that's just what life is like when you're the son of a god! It's always clear sailing, never a cloud in the sky… and poor Samataro is bored to tears. How can he ever learn to be a god if he can't make it on his own as a human first? It's the last straw when his divine parents take their intervention a little too far… but can he really survive a normal life, free of miracles and magic?

title: Perfect Relationship
description:
One day, she stumbles upon two boyfriends kissing.  
A strange relationship they had to bear since that day!  
But even before the the shocking incident and the confusion setting in, they were already living under the same roof!

title: Peach Branch Bubbles
description:
Tao Zhi, an infamous figure in Laboratory School 1, dominated the bottom rankings all year round. One day, according to rumour, Miss Tao somehow fell for the legendary academic big boss—the school’s only hope to defeat neighbouring schools, the top scorer in the college entrance exam: Jiang Qihuai. Some research revealed that the boss’s type was someone who was 1) good-natured and 2) good at studying. Those who scored less than 700 points weren’t even worth mentioning. Tao Zhi wasn’t good-natured either, so she started practicing 5 exams/3 years*, turning herself into a ruthless test-answering machine that woke up early and stayed up late to study for 2 weeks, and scored 350 points.

Tao Zhi: Look, I like you so much, how about you let this one go and let me take the test again?

How to conquer a Bking**--from 300 to 700 points--in what world does a lady as beautiful as a flower who comes from a rich family like me get looked down on, isn’t it because you’re a coward king?

*referring

title: BanG Dream! - Dense As We Are (Doujinshi)
description: Childhood friends being denser than a black hole when it comes to love.

title: Youth Torture Romantic ☆ Tokita
description: Yoshino, a boring ordinary boy is suddenly confessed to by the most popular girl in his class, Tokita. But when Yoshino wakes up the next day, he finds himself......

title: False Memories
description:
Wan’s got a face that scares everyone away before he can really become friends with anyone. So when Ha-woon befriends Wan on his first day at his new school, Wan is elated. Ha-woon must be an angel! It doesn’t take long, though, for Ha-woon to betray him in a terrible way, and Wan discovers Ha-woon might be more devil than angel. But then an accident happens that gives Wan a second chance at friendship with his angel. And it all starts with one big, fat lie.  
  
French   
Wan a un visage qui fait peur à tout le monde, avant de pouvoir vraiment devenir ami avec n'importe qui. Alors, quand Ha Woon se lie d'amitié avec Wan lors de son premier jour dans sa ouvelle école, Wan est ravi. Ha Woon doit être un ange ! Cela ne prend pas longtemps, cependant, pour que Ha Woon le trahisse d'une manière terrible, Wan découvre que Ha Woon pourrait être plus diabolique qu'un ange. Mais alors un accident se produit ce qui donne à Wan une seconde chance d'amitié avec son ange. Et tout commence par un t

title: Aisaseteyo Sensei
description:
"I can’t just pretend like it’s nothing. I’ve fallen in love with you, Sensei." University Professor, Hatano Hotaru made a mistake last night- He slept with a student, a straight one at that. “In the end he’ll get tired of me. I don’t want to fall in love with a straight guy.” Or so he thought, but this younger boy won’t let him go…?
A BL about sweet, cute, and passionate love!

title: Amagami LS ~Haruka Another~
description:
A spin-off alternate story based on the PS2 dating sim 'Amagami'. Unlike most other Amagami manga, this one is an original story not adapting any content from the game and instead telling a new story focused on Haruka.  
  
Two years ago, Junichi Tachibana had a date on Christmas Eve but was stood up instead. Since then, he has had a hard time showing others his true feelings in fear of being rejected again. However, as luck would have it, Junichi may have a second chance at love when he meets several girls whom he becomes romantically interested in.

title: Song of the Cloud
description:
These people have been living unhappy lives because they've never been able to do what they want.  
  
Ga Yeon's smart, but wants to become a singer. However, the Korean educational system strongly enforces studying to students without considering the goals and dreams of the student. She's been forced to live a life of suppression.  
  
Jae Hee is a piano player, but he's been living in constant delusion of his life. He has mental problems and cannot distinguish reality from a dream.  
  
Dong Woo and Min Seo are a couple who are talented musicians but cannot make music they wish to make because of the current situation of the Korean music industry.  
  
Hyuk's a very good guitar player, but is forced to be in an idol band, rather than what he really wants to be. The 5 come together to make a band of their own.

title: Nakanmon!
description:
Hirahara Tsukasa just moved to Tokyo from Hiroshima, and she's late on her first day of school because she misses the bus. But this leads to a chance encounter with four other people in her class, and somehow, the five of them became friends?  
  
Crybaby Tsukasa, the sharp-tongued yet soft-hearted Himeno, the understanding Ichihara, as well as Agatsuma and Onda… these five different personalities come together to create a youthful school life story—

title: Ojama Yuurei-kun
description:
Reijirou Yuuki, known by friends as Rei-kun, a boy notorious for being late to school, is suddenly hit by a truck and killed on one of his many rushes to class. He then roams the earth as a ghost, only being visible to his classmate Kodama. Reijirou finds himself and Kodama in many adventures involving his ability to possess, and gets himself tangled up with the lives of his classmates and friends, including Takeshi Gama: the bully, Kaoru Tachibana: the perfect transfer student with a secret, and Bell: the demon working a part-time shift as a shinigami.

Later in the series, Reijirou goes beyond his neighborhood to other parts of Japan with Bell to raise his reincarnation credit score, leaving Kodama behind.

(Source: MU)

title: The Story of J
description:
When J, the man everyone fears, returns to town, the city's delinquents are in an uproar. Some challenge him, some try to use him, some try to get close to him. Where will J end up at the end of the long struggle…?  
  
Serialized in Weekly Young Magazine from 1983 to 1984.  
Volume 1 released in September 1984.  
Volume 2 released in February 1985.

title: Body Warmth Communication
description: Madoka is in love with the girly manager of her basketball team, Yuma. As she's having more and more trouble keeping her feelings in check, Yuma does something that starts a fight between the two. Will their feelings overcome the fight…?

title: Shiina-san no Oshi Jijou
description:
好きな人が推しキャラのCVでした
椎奈恋白は告白をした。が、「推しです」と言ってしまったせいか1mmも伝わらない。しかし、告白した相手が実は自分の大好きなキャラの声を担当していることがわかり…。告白ヘタ女子と天然新人声優男子がすれ違う、胸きゅんラブコメ開演!
[author’s twitter](https://twitter.com/aoi_963)

title: Chibi Devi!
description:
Sawada Honoka is a 14-year-old girl who is very timid. She easily gets bullied by other classmates. Honoka is a non-believer in God, angels, and devils. Though one day, a devil baby was dropped into her room while she was sleeping. What will Honoka believe now?  

----

Indonesian release by M&C! Comics as Chibi Fairy!

title: Kinyoubi no Houkago wa Houshi to Kiss wo
description: Ishigami often ends up getting involved with delinquents, which gives others the impression that he's a scary kind of guy, isolating him from his peers. In order to help restore his image, he pairs up with Suzumura, a member of the disciplinary committee, to do community service. Suzumura happens to be famously flirty, and after the community service, he suggests kissing practice...

title: Bocchi no Saki ni, Koi no Uta
description: A thrilling secret love story about a lonely high school girl and a popular boy.

title: Tenjou Tenge (Official Colored)
description: Soichiro Nagi and Bob Makihara have always been the meanest street brawlers around. When they enter Todo High they plan on carving out a reputation as the strongest fighters in their new school—easier said than done in a place that's dedicated to training its students in the art of combat! After realizing they're the new fish swimming in a tank full of sharks, Soichiro and Bob enter the Juken fight club as rookie members. However, the Executive Council—the archrival of the Juken Club—soon launches a surprise attack. Soichiro and Bob have a chance to show their stuff, as long as they don't get curb-kicked in the process!

title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Materials Collection
description:
The Materials Collection (美少女戦士セーラームーン設定資料集) is a photo-book with all of Takeuchi Naoko’s preliminary and prototype designs of the characters specifically for animation. It includes illustrations of each character, minus monsters-of-the-day and other one-shot appearances for all five seasons of the series.  
  
This collection is especially useful for Sailor Moon cosplayers who are looking to create the most accurate representation of a specific character’s outfit possible. Some of the prototype characters never made it into the final cut for the anime (like Diana the Moon Fairy), so this is also an interesting read for serious fans of the show.  
  
(Source: Miss Dream)

title: Rock 'n Roll
description:
High school students Mayama and Sayama. They’re childhood friends and best friends—the two of them do everything together. But lately, it seems like Sayama has been getting a lot of attention…?

Inseparable Childhood Friends: Signs of Change in Their Everyday Lives

title: Ikimono-suki no Anima-san ni wa Honno Choppiri Doku ga Aru
description:
Anima Rui is a beautiful girl that loves animals!
She knows a lot about them!, but…
She has a weird timing when it's moment to speak about it.

title: Uso wa Hitotsu mo Tsuitemasen
description:
"From now on, keep an eye on me, okay?" Ichinose Kaname and Aizawa Ryo are high school boys who live in the same dorm room and practice together after school despite belonging to different clubs . One day, Ryo is suddenly asked by Kaname to "protect him." Kaname says it's because the seniors in his dorm are teasing him too much, and Ryo accepts. However, when it comes down to it, Kaname has an even more serious agenda...

Chiaki-kun Mimamori Kurabu (Spinoff From)

title: Katasumi no Kioku
description:
Sumino, a first-year high school student, enrolls in a prestigious soccer school in Kamakura but breaks his leg soon after joining the team. Unable to practice and feeling out of place, he spends his days wandering aimlessly and his nights partying. Then one day, he meets Aoki, an older man working at an izakaya, and slowly begins to experience emotions he has never felt before. A story of one unforgettable summer, both the worst and the best.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: R-15
description: Very few people know that one of the country’s leading erotic novel author is 15 year old Akutagawa Taketo that has just entered as a freshman at Hirameki Academy. Unlike regular high schools, this school only accepts those who are accomplished or geniuses in their particular field, ranging from authors like Taketo to mathematicians or musicians. Taketo feels comfortable being in the presence of other brilliant minds but is afraid that his talent might project as him being perverted. Is Taketo going to be able to keep his secret?

title: Hana wa Kuchi Hodo ni Mono o Iu
description:
This is a world where plants can grow from human bodies.

But due to a certain "incident", plants no longer grow from the body of Hana, the protagonist of this story. After her class had a change in seating arrangement, the boy who moved next to her confessed to her and slowly, her colourless days begin to change.

This is a beautiful love story that paints the subtleties of a pubescent girl's delicate heart and the vibrant colors of plants.

title: Romance Debut!!
description: Yuzuki had a quiet, dull junior high school life. However, now he's finally made his "debut" upon entering high school. With his new hair, clothes, and attitude, he was able to join the popular group of students, but for some reason, it's his dull classmate Shitara who’s popular with the girls.

title: Moshimo, Tokyo
description:
Book compiling art and oneshots showcased at the "Moshimo, Tokyo" exhibition.

Contains a **different** oneshot by Inio Asano to the one titled "Moshimo, Tokyo".

title: Love Letters in Early Summer
description:
In early summer, an innocent girl was born as brightly as a summer day. The sun in her heart had long since forgotten. And a cold heart has been waiting for years to melt only for her.  
  
Can fate forge between them now?  
  
Can two hearts that are no longer familiar to each other be together again?  
  
The early summer scenery from today begins, to sweeten you and me.

title: Infinite Stratos Black Bunny/White Bitter
description: Web comic series focusing on IS heroine Laura Bodewig.

title: Rough♥Boyfriend
description:
1-2.5: ♥ Boyfriend  
Naoto is Hajime's childhood friend. Naoto may look cute but then again, his attitude gets on everyone's nerves. Even though Naoto's like that, Hajime still has his eyes on him. The problem is, Naoto hates homosexuals – so much that he wishes they will become extinct and rot in hell!  
  
3-3.5: All About My Brother  
Shinji has always loved his younger brother, Haruki, more than any older brother should. Yet when he receives an unexpected warning letter demanding payment on a delinquent loan, he is left speechless. With everything Haruki could ever ask for provided by loving parents, he demands to know what could it be that would cause Haruki to be so greedy and irresponsible. Can Shinji really handle the truth behind Haruki's unusually selfish actions? Will he give up on Haruki altogether?  
  
4-5.5: Piano Lesson  
After his parents' divorce, Hara Shuuji left Tokyo to live with his mother and attend the local school. With hopes of starting a new and peaceful scho

title: I Don't Like That Smile
description:
"That cool face of yours… I want to mess it all up," Ritsuki told Sumire at the gym. A game between the school's most popular boy, Ritsuki, and a friend has begun. The game was to win the heart of Sumire, who was rumored to be the biggest slut in school. As Ritsuki becomes closer to Sumire, he starts to see Sumire's true colors. A bittersweet love story of 2 people with broken hearts.  

---

• [Comico raws](https://www.comico.jp/comic/115)
  
• [Comico English translation (Pocket Comics)](https://www.pocketcomics.com/comic/115)

title: Shutendouji
description:
As a baby Jiro was delivered to his foster parents by a massive oni, who said he would return for Jiro in 15 years. When the time comes Jiro must contend with enemy oni, dark cultists, and their minions while attempting to protect both his parents and girlfriend from their depredations. Ultimately he must embark on a journey through the past, future, and other dimensions to embrace his destiny as Shuten Doji reborn.  


---

**Links:**  
- [OVAs on ANN](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=732)

title: Yamato Nadeshiko wa Kujikenai.
description:
Ever since she was a little girl, Henmi Nadeshiko has always dreamed of finding the perfect boyfriend when she reaches high school. Nadeshiko was very popular in junior high, partly because of her looks, but she turned down all her suitors, while dreaming about the wonderful boyfriend she would meet in high school. She worked hard to make herself worthy of her future boyfriend, but her single-mindedness only drove away the people around her. Nadeshiko decided, "The man of my dream is destined to find me no matter what!!!" so she "sealed away" her good looks behind a pair of bottle-bottomed glasses, but six months into her high school life, no prince has appeared. 

A coming-of-age love story unfolds between a dreamy idealistic girl and a fierce-looking but pure-hearted boy.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Gazing at the Moon
description:
"You are the Child of the Moon. You must come along with me to the Moon Palace."  
  
Bora is a high school student who has the ability to see ghosts.  
  
One day, a Moon Rabbit finds me and drops a bomb on me. You're saying that I have to travel to the moon when I, due to my useless ability, can't even get into a single relationship?  
  
There's no way! I won't go! I'm going to escape my hopeless love life!   
  
Will Bora be able to have a relationship without any accidents?

title: Kiss made no Kyori
description: Kaji, Yuzuha's unrequited love, is a good friend of her younger twin brother Hayao. He's the same age but goes to a different school and since theyre in elementary, he's been going in and out of Yuzuha's home. She's been in love with him all the time, but can't make a serious face when around Kaji. Now they both change to the same high school and there's the chance to decrease the distance between Kaji and her…!?

title: Picking Light
description:
Growing up happens inadvertently, Li Chuan and A-Cheng both people are like playful demons, in the shadow of the schoolyard and on the basketball court, they pass it quietly.  
*Free up to episode 23 on Wecomics*

title: Love Kids!!
description:
High schoolers Rin and Kyo are childhood friends from kindergarten. They're so close that there's virtually nothing they don't know about each other.   
  
Rin, who had been pining for Takahashi-kun, his father's lover, for many years, finally gave up, wishing instead for his father and Takahashi's happiness. After his broken heart was comforted by Kyo, Rin is finally able to stand up again, but then suddenly, Kyo confesses to him…?!

title: Shiritsu Hamana Konaka Koutou Gakkou Danshi Ryou no Tomadoi
Okorippoi Onnanoko to Issho na Otokonoko
description: Girl seems angry but she's just extremely expressive in her feelings towards the boy.

title: Hageruya!
description: Shouta Tanaka is a high-schooler with an unusual problem; he’s going bald! Worried what his classmates will think, and how it will affect his future, things seem grim for Shouta. But then his biology teacher approaches him one day and states “I will find a cure for your baldness!” Could this really be the answer for his problem?

title: Slow Step
description: Slow Step follow the adventures of schoolgirl Minatsu as she looks for a man and tries to stay on top at school. She's got the school bully to worry about, two potential suitors, a pervert for a PE teacher, and a gang of criminals in hot pursuit.

title: Never Mind, Darling
description:
After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day.
Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire.
As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires.

title: Infinite Stratos 2 - Official Anthology Comic
description:
An anthology comic of Infinite Stratos by various mangaka.

**Cover**: Nekonyan (ねこにゃん)
**Illustrations**: [Kekocha](https://mangadex.org/author/8bc91f02-c309-4647-9d1f-8202a9d70ec3), [Ichiri](https://mangadex.org/author/8f721884-0785-4948-a109-9d2183468814), [Sasamori Tomoe](https://mangadex.org/author/e2d72835-cebc-4294-810a-1bd7b6905bf0), [108 Gou](https://mangadex.org/author/6f0b8c47-1c19-499b-9a5b-857d8f0101b3)

**Chapters**:
1. **Beautiful Girl's Epic Battle** by Mitsu King
2. **Drugs Rolling** by Mimi Mimizu
3. **Do You Like Bunny Ears?** by Suihi
4. **The Case of Orimura Ichika's Murder** by Peke
5. **My Chest is Rin-rin** by RoGa
6. **Melting Alcott** by Asagawa Keiji
7. **IS Master Cinderella Girls** by Hitsuji Hako
8. **Kittens Tea Party - Midnight Edition** by Shiina Yuuki
9. **Charlotte Attack** by Yaya Hinata
10. **"Just A Little More" Battle** by Hisama Kumako
11. **Memory Ball** by Mori Airi
12. **Houki's Confession** by Macchi
13. **IS "Immoral Students"** by Tsutsumi

title: My Boyfriend
description: A big forehead. A big smile. That's how Maru and Miyaji met each other. They quickly become friends and as it always happens, they start falling in love. Follow two teenagers learning what it is to love and the everyday happenings in their ordinary but exciting high school life in *My Boyfriend*.

title: Ai no Shintairiku
description:
Nikotama Souhei is transferring to a new school and vows to enjoy a new life, living a lifestyle true to herself. Adopting the name "Sara", Souhei heads to school in a girls' uniform, ready to grab life by the knads and twist. Sara's no pushover: bright, hyper and frequently violent. She is like nothing anyone at the school has ever encountered. Especially her sweet, upstanding classmate Naruse Kaito who finds himself knee-deep in Sara's "Brave New World".  
  
A nice bit of shoujo fluffiness unique for featuring an honest-to-goodness, non-apologetic trans hero.

title: Tweeting Love Birds
description:
Ohtaka is pissed! University baseball is not what he expected, and it’s all because of Chun, the odd little person who blithely chirps and constantly circles in his tall shadow. Everything Chun does only deepens Ohtaka’s scowl. His irritation skyrockets when Chun demands Ohtaka stay in the baseball club for his sake and steals Ohtaka’s first kiss!  
  
When two people from Chun's past are thrown in Ohtaka's face, his agitation suddenly turns territorial – and he's not sure why…  
  
Will Ohtaka figure out this unfamiliar game that plays for keeps? Get ready for a fast pitch of romantic comedy and surprising love!

title: Tsubaki-chan no Nayamigoto
description:
After Yutaka, a boy in the same class as Tsubaki, confesses to her, the two start going out. Because Yutaka doesn't talk much or send any mails, she begins to think it was a mistake to date him. But then she realizes he's actually quite different to what she at first thought. So what will happen to these two now…?  
  
Enjoy this pure, sweet love story.

title: Gwisin Byeolgok
description: When Ah-ryoung was only a baby, her mother made a pact with a demon named Nachal, who would claim Ah-ryoung's body once she turns 15. She has inherited her mother's considerable spiritual powers but that “gift” that allows her to see ghosts even from an early age, has made her an outcast for the other kids. She has finally turned 15 and it’s now time for the demon to claim her body… but then an accident happens…

title: Sensen Spike Hills
description: Nomura Nobuo was a normal highschooler, until his "gift" convinced him of his separation from the masses. When his gift is unmasked by Kaburagi Jirou, it marks the start of a war. A war on society itself. The War Front: Spike Hills.

title: Dear Mine
description:
Satoko is a domestic girl with a kind heart. She lost her father when she was little, and her family has been very poor ever since her father's company shut down. However, life is happy enough when you are optimistic, and Satoko enjoys her daily life heartily. One day, she is rescued from a attacking dog by Fuuma, an extraordinarily mature 10-year-old boy. Little does Satoko realize that this boy is the head of Wakudera Corporation, as well as her future husband!  
  
Volume 1 extra is Undying Flower (Karenai Hana), a yuri oneshot.

title: Buta-san Daisuki Nunone-chan
description: Nonona-chan's friend, Nunone-chan, is a slightly unusual girl. She uses pig meat and organs, which she always carries around with her, to express her pure love for Nonona-chan. Nonona-chan likes Nunone-chan, but doesn't like pig meat and organs. One day, Nonona-chan avoided her at school, and...

title: Medete, Junjou
description:
Collection of stories:  
  
1-3. Akuma to Candy  
Kitagawa Nami confesses to Yagami-kun, who asks her why she likes him. She reminds him of the time he gave her candy when they were riding the train to school. He scoffs at her reason and dismisses the confession, teasing her about the rejection at every chance he gets. However, Nami finds that Yagami-kun can be kind when he wants to be and that she may be starting to change his mind…  
  
4-6. Medete, Junjou  
One day Nonko, the protagonist, saw Jou, his professor of classical literature, cry. Realizing that his professor has a past that he can't reveal, little by little, Nonko is attracted by this teacher…  
  
7. Love Letter From Mike  
  
8. Kanko no Otoshidama  
  
9. 3-nengo no Hatsukoi.  
A boy changes his appearance to get revenge on his ex for dumping him.   
  
Pt-Br:  
Coletânea de de mini-séries e One-Shots da autora

title: The Delinquent Housewife!
description: The manga's slapstick comedy story follow's a second-year high school student whose older brother's wife moves into the family home. The move was supposed to be only until the couple could find a new home. However, the husband suddenly goes overseas for business, leaving his wife to live with his younger brother and other family. Contrary to the student's image of the woman as an ideal housewife, his sister-in-law is completely inept at cooking and cleaning.

title: Good/Bad Fortune
description:
Hãy cẩn thận khi đối mặt với họ, vì họ có thể thay đổi cả số phận của bạn!

Khi vận may và xui xẻo lại là một loại năng lực thì bạn sẽ làm gì để sống cùng với nó? Areka Putra, 1 thiếu niên vừa lên lớp 10 đã phải sống với năng lực "XUI XẺO" ngay từ khi sinh ra. Cậu sẽ gặp phải xui xẻo khi các "Dấu hiệu" xuất hiện và cậu hoặc phải gánh lấy nó, hoặc tìm một nạn nhân và đối mắt với người đó trong 10 giây, rồi người đó sẽ phải gánh sự xui xẻo đó thay cậu. Cũng vì vậy mà cậu bị dính phải những lời đồn tiêu cực và bị xa lánh. Mọi chuyện vẫn sẽ cứ trôi đi một cách cô độc như vậy nếu như Areka không gặp Aya( hay Laila Putriani), một cô gái năng động và đang là một ngôi sao quảng cáo mới nổi. Nhưng nhan sắc hay tài năng không chỉ là điểm đặc biệt duy nhất của Aya, mà mọi người xung quanh đồn rằng Aya có khả năng "ban phát" sự may mắn cho bất kì ai ở gần cô ấy.

Xui xẻo/May mắn, liệu câu chuyện về hai con người đối lập này sẽ thay đổi ra sao? Liệu Areka có thoát khỏi cuộc sống đầy xui xẻo của bản

title: Girl Reborn
description: Eunsung one day wakes up to find out he's a girl! He's able to hide his change of gender from everyone… or so he thought. His secret is discovered by his crush on day one and moreover, she asks him to pose as a nude model for her! How will Eunsung's life start anew as a girl?

title: Plain Love
description:
A compilation volume oneshots:  
  
1. Jimikoi (Plain Love)  
Wakana i.e "bakana" is your typical, flashy, yet not-so bright girl that loves plain boys! Kagano happens to be that boy, and when she confesses, she thought she may rejected, but he told her he'll think about it! Now all Wakana has to do is to not be a "bakana" when trying to win his heart…  
  
2. Columbus no Yuuutsu (The Melancholy of Columbus)  
Shiono is a girl who has "double face," out is quite a refined, intelligent, beautiful and well-mannered young lady while inside is a common, intelligent little girl and instant ramen lover… One day, Shiono discovers that the simple delegate and classmate with lens, Satou-kun, is also someone who is hiding something… this makes her feel a connection with him. The point of being 'the continent," that she discovered… Something will emerge between Satou-kun and Shiono?  
  
3. Mimimoto ni Furu Kimi no Koe  
4. Gojouzaka-san Chi no Kirei na Himitsu

title: Smash!
description:
Smash! is about two childhood friends (Shouta and Miwa) who share a common love for Badminton. Miwa, who's in love with Shouta, tries to persuade Shouta to apply to the same badminton school as her but the latter being of a carefree, easy-going and dense nature, brushes her away and states that he only plays badminton for fun.  
  
However, Shouta's perspective of badminton quickly changes after a fateful encounter with Yuuhi (a mute girl). In his search for his badminton goddess Yuuhi, Shouta met Anan and thereafter, decides that he's going to pursue badminton more seriously…

title: This Is My Mansion. Could You Leave Now?
description:
Seventeen-year-old Marissa, the daughter of a marquis, has been planning revenge against her uncle’s family, who barged into her mansion and acted as if they owned the place after her parents passed away.
When she turns eighteen, her title will finally be returned to her…
Until that day comes, she has endured constant bullying at home and at school, all for the sake of enacting grand revenge on those who tormented her.
In the midst of this, her fiancé Deliol suddenly breaks off their engagement.
It turns out he is in love with Marissa’s uncle’s daughter—her stepsister Roxanne—and believes she is his destined partner.
Marissa, who never liked Deliol to begin with, gladly accepts the annulment.
“If it’s come to this, I’ll make sure he gets what he deserves along with my uncle’s entire family!”
So she swears in her heart.
But despite her strong will, Marissa’s body has grown frail from years of mistreatment.
Unable to look away from her condition, Raid, a classmate at the academy and the

title: Kowamote Danshi no Bentou ga Umai Riyuu
description:
"Mizukawa-kun, I made a bento for you."

Huh?? Why?? Why did this scary-looking guy make me a bento!?

It is now lunch time. Mizukawa is your average boy who was just about to have his usual bread for lunch when Tsuchiya, his classmate who's constantly shrouded in dangerous rumours, suddenly gave him a bento.

"You'll get hungry just eating bread and it's unhealthy too."

Huh? Is Tsuchiya actually a nice guy? And his bento is actually delicious...

This is the debut commercial work from the promising new manga artist, Machida March! With Tsuchiya's bento being the catalyst, thus begins an innocent love story between the average boy, Mizukawa and Tsuchiya, the scary-looking boy who's good at cooking.

title: Sora Log
description:
Our protagonist, Hikaru, is a member of the astronomy club at her school. On one beautiful starry night, she encounters a tall boy with blonde hair that looks almost white. However, he turns out to be…?!  
  
Side note from Aerandria: Convoluted naming scheme in volume 2 is from the mangaka, see table of contents.  
  
Included one-shot:  
Volume 4: Melodramatic Library

title: Spring Snow
description:
This story is a love story weaved by a cursed girl, a cursed straw doll, and a mathematics teacher.  
A slightly sorrowful, warm love story that started in the season of spring.

title: Red Honey
description: A handsome girl joins the volleyball club because she has a crush on the volleyball captain, thinking that first come first served, despite their popularity with girls…… But one day, she discovers her identity that she is the only heir to the queen of the Blood Tribe! From then on, the love triangle between the Blood Tribe, Half-Bloods and Humans begin with many unexpected twist and turns……

title: Crash!
description:
Crash is about a girl named Hana who has a very unusual gift. Her home is a talent agency and she helps her mother using her "gift".  
  
She literally has nosebleeds when she sees someone with celebrity potential.  
  
Naturally, this is a secret she keeps from her classmates. On the company's anniversary, Hana is sent to find a new awesome talent. And that's when the story unfolds…  
  
Included one-shots:  
Volume 3: Wagamama Hime no Yakusoku  
Volume 5: Piyokko 24  
Volume 7: Good★Game

title: Akikan!
description:
The story revolves around a typical high school boy named Kakeru Daichi and the can of melon juice soda that he bought from a vending machine. The can suddenly transforms into a beautiful but standoffish girl that Kakeru nicknames "Melon," and more "Akikan" ["empty can"] girls appear. However, Akikan girls need to be infused with carbon dioxide from kissing to survive.  
  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=10209) for the anime.  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=10743) for the OAV.

title: Otonashi-kun no Rule
description: Otonashi keeps others at bay by following a strict set of rules he has imposed on himself. But one day, a tall girl wearing cat ears and a flashy shirt, with absolutely no sense of personal space, takes a sudden liking to him. Caught off guard, his quiet daily life begins to change, little by little...

title: Yotsunoha
description: Nono Nekomiya, Makoto Yuki, Iori Yuzuki and Matsuri Amachi all used to attend the same school. As close friends they spent their days in peace together as part of the light music club until the fateful day in which the school they attended closed down, forcing all students to transfer with the four friends ending up at different schools. Before they left they placed a time capsule under a tree at the school, promising to meet again, with Matsuri running off in bitter anger. Upon returning on the promised date, 3 years later with no contact in between, they find their time capsule has been dug up and turned into a lost and found game by an old teacher of theirs. While following clues left by the teacher, the four begin to remember past memories of life at the school as well as old feelings they may have for each other.

title: Hiiro Ouji
description: In order to capture the vampire lurking in a high school, Mana, an exorcist, transfers in. However, Okamoto-kun, the vampire in question, is one who has changed with the times, and gets by on blood transfusions. What will our serious-minded exorcist do now, when confronted by this carefree, easy-going vampire?!

title: Neko to Mahou wa Kiss de Hodokeru
description: Lucas, an inferior student at a magic school suddenly had cat ears and tail! He's unable to block strong curses so he asks Dylan for help. Dylan, unlike his younger self, is now a cold and arrogant student council member who somehow still cares for Lucas, his childhood friend. "While investigating, I found out that the only way to solve this curse is... To have sex with a man!" And then Dylan said, "The curse, I'll remove it!"

title: Love Alarm
description: "Someone within a 10 m radius likes you." With these words, LoveAlarm, an app that alerts users to the feelings of others, turned the world upside down. For struggling but optimistic high-schooler Kim Jojo, the day it-boy Hwang Sunoh rang her LoveAlarm felt like the start of a beautiful romance. But when the app that was meant to bring people together begins to dig up the darkest of emotions, Jojo quickly realizes that people may have been better off before they lived in a "ringing world"...

title: 2.5-Jigen no Oshi ga Classmate ni Narimashita?!
description:
"I'm completely addicted to the 2.5D swamp, and in my class, Rinto Kogami, the actor I'm most in love with, transfers to my school!"
You can see the various sides of my guesses in the classroom, and their school life starts to become too precious and tough!
A short love comedy with lots of insight into the "guessing game"!

title: 2.5 Jigen Kareshi
description: Koino Tsumugi is a sixteen year old otaku who only has eyes for "Tokki" – a 2D character in her favorite otome game! She has no interest in real boys… Then one day she's rescued by a guy who's the spitting image of Tokki…?!

title: Hatsukoi Jihen
description:
Sana's first boyfriend, Yamato, was not exactly the looker, but he was kind. And that's what Sana loved about him. So when he suddenly dumps her without warning, her heart is left completely shattered. Having lost faith in the world, Sana vows to leave her past self behind, and transforms... into a full-on delinquent!

Three years later, when Sana had all but forgotten how it feels to love, two guys unexpectedly appear in her life. Koichi, the student council president and school celebrity. And... Sana's ex, Yamato?! Sana barely recognizes her ex, who has undergone a complete transformation of his own, becoming a heartthrob teenage actor! With conflicted memories and emotions on the rise, where will our protagonist's innocent heart take her?

title: Kakushite Kisetsu wa Ao wo Shiru
description:
Sano Natsuki là một cậu nam sinh trung học đang muốn giấu nhẹm ước mơ trở thành họa sĩ manga thiếu nữ. Một ngày nọ, trước mặt cậu bỗng xuất hiện Harumiya Hina – một mỹ nữ bí ẩn với combo "áo thun dị hợm, tính cách kỳ quặc và sức ăn kinh khủng"! Oái ăm thay, hai người nói chuyện cứ như ông nói gà bà nói vịt, chẳng hiểu nhau gì cả!!! Giữa bầu không khí sượng trân và đầy gượng gạo ấy, bí kíp mà Hina đề xuất để giúp cậu giành được hợp đồng xuất bản lại là một cú sốc không tưởng...!?

"Hay là bọn mình hẹn hò đi!"

Một thời thanh xuân rực rỡ mang khao khát phác họa nên tình yêu bỗng chốc vượt ngoài tầm kiểm soát. Vở kịch tình cảm hài hước, dở khóc dở cười và hoàn toàn không thể đoán trước chính thức vén màn!

title: Haru x Mei
description:
From the author of "Seishun Cafereria", this is a short love story about Haru and Mei. An age gap couple.

The original Japanese raws can be read on the mangaka's Twitter @pris_pdlt

title: No One Will Be Rewarded
description:
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=10259775)  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/6th_manager0211)

title: Papillon - Hana to Chou
description:
Ageha, an ordinary (and rather unpopular) girl, is constantly overshadowed by her popular and beautiful twin sister, Hana. Because Ageha grew up in the countryside with their grandmother while Hana was raised by their parents, the two girls ended up with drastically different personalities.  
  
For the most part, Ageha remains a silent and hidden student in the school, with only one friend (who isn't all that nice either). In fact, nobody even really knows that she is Hana's twin sister, because despite looking alike, there is still a large gap between their levels of beauty and popularity. When Hana finds out that Ageha has a crush on a cute boy named Ryuusei (who is actually Ageha's childhood friend from the countryside), Hana becomes curious about their relationship.  
  
However, after hearing that Ryuusei hates people like Hana, Hana becomes irritated and using her charming personality, actually manages to snag Ryuusei as her boyfriend! Ageha is left with no one, but thanks to th

title: The Lonely Sub Will Find Love With Only One Dom
description:
Golden Retriever Dom x Pretty Loner Sub
[Reverse Submissive] Dom/Sub Universe.
—
Alfonso is a Sub who boasts the school's top grades and abilities however, powers of a Dom are ineffective to him. That is until he meets Asuka, a new student and a Dom.
Asuka challenges Alfonso to a duel with the condition that if he wins, Alfonso will become his partner.
Alfonso accepts with the intention of beating the cocky junior, but his body suddenly reacts to Asuka's unexpected words...!

title: I Am Sukeban
description:
His family name is Suke and his given name is Banji, but he's known as Sukeban. Any town the Suke house settles in just can't contain the violent nature of this family, forcing them to move time and time again. Because of his name, Banji ends up transferring to Amazon School as a female student! However, this situation coupled with Sukeban's rebellious nature undoubtedly will result in mayhem littered with maddening jokes and lewdity.

The manga has been adapted into two live-action films and an OVA.

title: Aim for the Ace!
description:
Oka Hiromi, a freshman at Nishi High, joins the school's prestigious tennis club because of her admiration for Madame Butterfly. Despite her clumsiness, Coach Munakata recognizes her potential and chooses her for the next competition.

Hiromi's unexpected promotion earns her the disapproval of her fellow tennis club members. But with the support of student council president Toudou Takayuki, she begins a rigorous training program under Coach Munakata.

title: Yamamoto Zenjirou to Moushimasu
description: Hotate is a 10 year old girl who was living at her grandmother's house since her mother died. One day her grandmother tells Hotate that she can't care for her anymore because of her age and that she's going to have to live at her uncle's house. After moving to her uncle's house, she attends a new school, but things aren't easy because of her special ability to see the dead. Can she make friends with students in her new class? And what's the secret behind the bond between her and her uncle…?!

title: Kimi to Deattekara Boku wa
description:
"It's about time you gave up."
Honda, a gay and shy high school teacher, is forced to consult with Endo, a student who doesn't decide his career path at all, but Endo makes him mean.
However, Endo gradually opened his heart to Honda, who was devoted to it.
On the contrary, the gentle hand touching the suddenness, the strong eyes staring at me, and the straight and feverish thoughts of Endo, who is increasing day by day, keep running away saying that I can't...
A single-minded Spadari high school student x a high school teacher who has given up on love is frustrating and sweet, youth love.
The two of us are conscious in the bath together.

title: Osananajimi wa Dasa Bitch
description:
Akira, a college student, is a cherry boy who has a distrust of girls due to past trauma. What suddenly came to such a roar was Kanoe, a childhood friend who was a "bitch" because he was dressed in flashy fashion! "While I'm crazy!" Soe puts out a strong dialect and actively seeks a physical relationship with her disliked Akira.
A little erotic romantic comedy sent by "a man who never wants to get rid of" and "a woman who absolutely wants to get rid of"!

(MTL Synopsis)

title: Starry Night Club
description:
The curse of twelve stars, a girl who plays piano with a dream of becoming a chef, because of an odd job that she pretends to be a boy. What's waiting for Yue Hui is a mysterious mansion and 12 boys who have the curse of 12 stars which fall upon each of them. What's awaiting her? Where are her and the boys' destiny leading to?   
A love song for 1000 years, the legend of 12 beautiful stars, everything is in《Starry Night Club》

title: Jishou "Heibon" na Iyashi no Seijo desu ga, Ouji kara Konyakusha to shite Shuuchakusareteimasu.
description: Flora's motto is to be discreet, quiet and ordinary. However, she fits the royal family's requirements to be a candidate for the prince's betrothed! Flora changes her appearance and spends her time in seclusion, but when Ray, the most conspicuously beautiful young man at the school, sees her true form...

title: Koizora
description: Mika is just a normal high school student who dreams of having a wonderful love. And then one day, she happens to meet Hiro, the guy of her destiny. While experiencing many sad events, and while getting hurt, the time she spends with him is still one of the most happy moments in her life…

title: Valkyria Chronicles 2 - Aliasse of The Blue Light
description:
This manga is loosely adapted from the game "Valkyria Chronicles".  
  
Related:  
Valkyria Chronicles: Wish Your Smile  
Valkyria Chronicles: Anthology Comic

title: Hitsuji Sensei ga Shuki Shuki Sugite Wota Wota Shitai
description: Hinata finds out that his beautiful but cold new math teacher Manaka-sensei has a secret hobby outside of school.

title: Share Kiss Love - Danshi San-nin, Joshi Ohitorisama
description: Three guys, One girl. A share house with handsome guys, falling in love with the cooking story will begin…!!

title: Sonna Me de Minai De
description:
Honami has a thing for glasses boy on a usual day in the class, comes a super cool glasses wearing boy?!

Included one-shots: Suki Sugi Chatte Gomennasai, Namida ga Yuki ni Kawaru Koku

title: Boku no Idol
description:
This year, the student council has decided to add an exciting new contribution to the school's culture festival; an Idol performance! However, they don't actually have the money to hire any real Idols, so someone's going to have to train up an idol group from their female classmates. Hirano Harufumi is that unlucky someone. He has no interest in Idols at all, but he must put together a performance or risk expulsion from the school for his failure.  
  
Not surprisingly, most high school girls are too embarrassed and self-conscious to dance and sing in front of their classmates in a skimpy outfit. When Harufumi tries to think about who he would like to see as an Idol, his thoughts are drawn to his cute, shy, clumsy childhood friend Aizawa Momoka. Will Harufumi be able to convince her to be an Idol before it's too late?

title: Kimi to Koi no Tochuu
description:
Just when I thought it'd start with you, you disappeared; I would've never thought this… Yuna has lost trust in love after her first boyfriend Takumi broke up with her. Hayato from her class has already confessed to her twice and now finally she approached onto love another time. But Takumi appears in front of her!! What will the swaying Yuna do!?  
  
Note: Volume 3 includes the oneshots “Kirameki ☆ Lucky Charm” and “Kirakira 17.”

title: Oretachi One Set
description:
"We are friends… but can I touch you?"
The two topmost handsome guys in the school have a secret they can’t tell anyone!
-A cool, mysterious guy and a flirty, cheery guy!!-

title: My Boyfriend​ is a​ Vampire
description:
Being beautiful is never easy, especially if you're an eighteen year old boy like Gene who is constantly mistaken for a girl because of his delicate good looks. Gene is, in fact, anything but delicate. He is the ringleader of a group of tough kids in an all boy's school, and he's quick to beat the living daylights out of anyone who even hints that he resembles a girl.  
  
If that wasn't hard enough for a regular teenage guy to cope with, his life is about to take a shocking turn for the worse. When Gene stumbles upon strange happenings in the forest, he gets sucked into a world of vampire intrigue and sinister romance that he never knew existed. And he learns that there are worse things than being turned into a vampire: being turned into a girl?!  
  
(Source: Mangaupdates)

title: Kore wa "Suki" ja Arimasen
description:
Mitsunaga, whose older brothers are a star athlete and a famous actor, finds himself somehow being worshipped by Minase—the beautiful and well-known girl at their school—just like his brothers are. When he asks Minase if that means she likes him, she shoots back, “This isn’t liking you—it’s worship!” …!?

A fresh new kind of romance ⇔ worship!? An oshikatsu love comedy♡

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

---
Note: Originally a one-shot published in The Hana to Yume 3/2026, it was picked up for continuing serialization 2026-04-20.

title: Whisper of the Heart
description:
Shizuku Tsukishima loves books. One day, she notices that the name Seiji Amasawa appears on the checkout cards of nearly every book she's borrowed! 
Before she realizes it, her heart is pounding for a boy she's never met… and that's when a mysterious black cat and Shizuku's sense of wonder 
guide her to an unusual shop–and introduce her to someone she's been curious to meet!
Amazing things can happen…when you listen to your heart.

title: Mei-chan's Butler
description:
Shinonome Mei remembers being rescued by a butler when she was a young girl. But did that really happen? When Mei's parents die in car accident, this butler, Rihito, reappears, wanting to take her to her grandfather.  
  
Mei's grandfather is very wealthy and Mei turns out to be the heiress to his fortune and is forced to transfer to St. Lucia Academy, so that she can become a proper lady.  
  
When Mei's childhood friend Kento hears about this, he decides to enroll in a butler school so that he can stay close to her.  
Mei-chan falls in love with Rihito, her butler. Does Rihito love her back? In the meantime Kento, who is in love with Mei-chan, also isn't planning to sit back and do nothing.

title: Great Mazinger
description: Great Mazinger starts after the defeat of Mazinger Z. Tetsuya Tsurugi is the new protagonist, piloting the powerful Great Mazinger, a creation of the once thought dead Kenzo Kabuto, the father of Koji Kabuto. This time the enemy is the Mycene Empire and its powerful robots.

title: Girl x Girl x Boy
description:
From Wings of Yuri:  
  
High school story about the a love triangle between 2 girls and a boy.  
Fuuka likes Riri. Riri likes Itta. Itta likes Fuuka.  
This isn’t a typical love triangle, though!

title: Boku Kara Kimi ga Kienai
description: Hotaru managed to get in the high school where Haruna-sensei teaches to see him again! However, on her first day there, she meets a very unpleasant guy who looks just like her beloved sensei…?

title: Honey Buddy
description: Being loved by new era yankee and old-style yankee, a love triangle. it's troublesome for being popular (only among yankees though). A funny!! love comedy!!

title: Boku wa Oresama ni Narenai
description: Yamada, the most popular guy in school, has a secret he can’t tell anyone: he used to be an overweight bullying victim. After lots of hard work, he managed to reach his current position in life, but what happens when the most popular girl in school, Manyo, learns the truth?

title: Atashi no Idol
description: Starting where “Boku no Idol” left off, the school’s Cultural Festival is now over and the idol performance was a great hit! However, Aizawa Momoka has started to develop feelings for her childhood friend Hirano Harufumi. Can Momoka overcome her shy disposition in order to let Harufumi know how she feels? Or will her new fan club and clumsy nature get in the way?
