title: MIYATA MIDORI’s One-Shot Collection
description:
"Love Letter From Koigokoro": Mei delivers love letters to support those in love. One day, she meets a boy named Raia… 

"Love’s Destiny": Mako loves fortune-telling. After her morning horoscope tells her she might meet her destined one today, she starts noticing her classmate Kyousuke… 

"Muni with the Jinx": Muni is always unlucky due to being possessed by a jinx. One day, her crush, Makino, sees her secret poetry notebook and… 

"Gakyou Shojo": Ayameko can’t stand her classmate Ei, who is always drawing. But one day, she finds a sketch of her boyfriend Yuuta in Ei's notebook… 

"The Sun's Sweet Revenge": Miyo has started dating her childhood friend Haruhi, but she’s too embarrassed to tell her friends, so it remains their secret…

title: Yuri Pop
description:
1. Hime-chan wa Tereya-san (Bashful Little Hime-chan)  
Tsukiko goes after Hime-chan but she got rejected in comedic ways.  
  
1.1. Bashful Little Hime-chan's Summer  
  
1.2. Bashful Little Hime-can's Winter  
  
2. Senpai wa Tokubetsu desu (Senpai Is Special)  
  
3. Kanojo wa Imouto (My Girlfriend Is My Little Sister)  
Sentani Miharu, an upperclassman, and Kaburagi Yuyu, an underclassman, have decided to go out with each other. Coincidentally enough, Miharu's and Yuyu's parents got married after that event. Now Miharu tries to fight off the invitations of lust with her new little sister.  
  
4. Tsukiko wa Bakakawa (Tsukiko Is Stupidly Cute)  
  
5. Hakushaku no Okiniiri (The Count's Interest)  
When the mysterious "Count" takes interest in a 1st year student she instantly takes possession of her by stealing her first kiss! The 1st year is outraged that the Count would such a thing a tries to avoid her but the Count will not give up on winning her over!  
  
6. On

title: B-Shock
description:
Nitta Arata is a typical 21 year-old junior attending college of science and engineering at Toaru University. He is bright, he's in the engineering program after all, but he definitely is from a working class background. He has been working his way through college for the past 3 years without major incident, so being swept up in a warped experiment of an equally warped professor was the last thing he expected in the second half of his college days.  
  
One day, Arata received a letter asking him to meet someone whose initials were "N.H." at a relatively secluded location on campus. The letter looked suspiciously like a "love letter", but Arata had his doubts. More likely it was a cruel practical joke perpetrated by one of his buddies, especially when the initials matched those belonging to "Nogi Hatsune", also know as "Miss Engineer", the reigning heartthrob of the engineering department. Why would somebody like her be interested in a nobody like himself? The short answer was that she

title: Small
description:
"Why do I keep crossing paths with you…? ♡"  
  
Everyone experiences those feelings at least once.  
Sometimes it feels like you're getting smaller in front of someone you like.  
The problem is, I'm actually getting smaller!

title: Chocolate Cosmos
description: Sakurai Sayuki was born with sharp eyes that make her look like she's always angry, even though she's not. Because of her looks, other students misunderstand her as a bully and scary girl, when in fact she's "a romantic." A fifteen-year old who has never had a boyfriend, she now starts her high school life with hopes of love…

title: Boku Dake o Mite Kure
description: The main character, Yoh, was in love with his childhood friend Taishi. He was happy and had no doubts about his daily routine of taking care of Taishi, who was crippled. Except that he is a man and he has fallen in love with a "woman"...

title: Draw Me in Your Panel
description: A love story between a desperate gyaru and a straightfoward aspiring mangaka!

title: Otona-chan
description: A high school student, "Otona-chan" is popular among both guys and girls with his cute looks. But instead of being treated like a child, he wants to be treated like an adult and really admires cool adults. And then comes a student teacher to his class, who is very much adult-like and he falls hard…

title: Sensei!
description:
It's the story of a high school girl, Hibiki, who falls in love with one of her teachers. The two start dating, but run into a lot of trouble (since they have to date in secret). Hibiki's friends cover for her, and part of the story is also about them.  
  
Includes a oneshot in Volume 1:  
Tomodachi Nante Iwanaide  
A short story about Kumiko's five year unrequited love to Kanata. Kanata has always seen her as the girl who ate a beef bowl and a good friend. Will that finally change?  
  
French:  
||  
Hibiki et ses amis sont à l'aube de leur dernière année de lycée, et bien qu'autour d'elle tous semblent être amoureux, elle se demande ce que c'est que l'amour.  
Suite à un malentendu, elle va s'intéresser à Itou-sensei, son professeur d'histoire et prendre peu à peu conscience de ses sentiments…  
||

title: Dounimo Nannai Soushi Souai
description:
When they were in elementary school, Keita gave Genji a cruel nickname. After that, he was saddled with being teased every day by his classmates! Every time they came face to face, it was nothing but fight, fight, fight for those two.  
  
However, that relationship came to a sudden end when Keita changed schools. Then, many years later, they met again in high school…  
Genji, the player and Keita, the handsome hunk.  
  
Is the distance between their hearts close, or far apart? The heat of wanting to touch but not touching. When these polar opposites are attracted to each other… will it be the birth of a strong couple?!

title: Mai Ball! Half Time
description: A series of official doujinshi by Mai Ball! author Sora Inoue, featuring new illustrations of characters from the series and the author's thoughts about them and his creative process.

title: Love and Terrarium
description: At a Catholic boarding school, a lonely girl and a lonely boy spend Christmas break with each other.

title: Yumegahara-san wa Yumemigachi!
description:
"Sexiness is a fundamental truth...!!"

One day, the uptight morals committee rep Asagiri stumbles upon his classmate Yumegahara in the school library—drawing erotic manga. Turns out Yumegahara, who's shy around men, is using her own steamy comics (with herself as the heroine!) to train herself to be more comfortable. Determined to reform her scandalous ways, Asagiri volunteers to be her practice model. But Yumegahara's imagination knows no bounds... and before he knows it, she's the one turning the tables, "You'll take responsibility... won't you?"

title: Death/Communication
description: Ninomae Iko, has lived in a house of only her dad and brothers, who all practice kendo. Looking to become a little more girly, she transferred to an all girls’ school. Here, rumor has it, a magical cup filled with red wine will grant any wish if your blood is dropped into it.

title: Hana no Breath
description:
Azami has always been attracted only to boys, especially the handsome Gwyn. Intelligent, sporty, attractive and just a little older than Azami, she's sure he would be an ideal boyfriend. Then, on the day Azami finally gets the courage to confess her feelings, everything she believes is suddenly called into question when she finds out that Gwyn is actually a girl!

Despite her initial shock at learning Gwyn's secret, Azami quickly realizes that love transcends gender, putting her feelings for Gwyn before her previous prejudices. But it turns out Azami isn't the only girl who's got her eye on Gwyn!
___
Azami is rigidly heterosexual and has been putting the handsome, smart, sporty Gwyn on a pedestal. However, when she finds out Gwyn is actually a girl, her prejudices are downplayed by love for Gwyn. That is also when Azami joins a tough competition as she is not the only girl to set eyes on Gwyn

title: Dream Fossil
description:
Dream Fossil is a collection of 15 short stories by the late Satoshi Kon. These stories, serialized in a variety of magazines in the 1980’s, give a rare glimpse into the early stages of Kon’s uniquely compelling style of storytelling. The buds of dream-like themes and imaginative worldviews that would blossom in his later animated works are also readily apparent. Yet the flights of fancy are anchored by knowing, empathetic portrayals of the very human nature of each story.  
  
 [Official French](https://www.amazon.co.uk/Fossiles-r%C3%AAves-Satoshi-Kon/dp/2811633014)
[Official English](https://kodansha.us/series/dream-fossil/)

title: Blaze
description: Girl blackmails supposedly younger genius teacher boy with a classic pic. Kinky things happens.

title: Hajimete no Otsukiai
description: Compilation of Short Stories.

title: Tonari no Banken
description: Hana and Kiyo are childhood friends who are now university students. They have been together since  nursery school and their houses are even next door to each other. It was natural for Hana to be with Kiyo anytime and anywhere without any feelings of discomfort.  However, one day, Hana noticed that Kiyo was popular with girls and with that, their relationship suddenly starts to change.

title: Minna ni Ienai Koto ga Aru
description: This story centres around four students - the female transfer student who avoids getting close to others, Doushima Sachiko; the handsome yet mysterious Orihashi Soutarou; A girl who always seems somewhat on guard, Satou Momo; and the popular boy who just did a shocking reveal to the whole class, Mitsuya Yuuma. Each of them hold a secret they can't tell others. How will their high school life play out as they get involved with one another.

title: Sunrise!
description: Takamachi Moka has been away from school due to a lung illness for so long, she has to repeat a grade. Stuck in the first year while her friends move on in the second year she eats lunch alone until a boy with a cat falls down next to her?

title: The Rows of Cherry Trees
description:
A pioneering work in the dazzling Shojo school story genre, depicted with fluid brushstrokes. 
The ballet, the jealousy and reconciliation among classmates, with an hint of sadness that lingers in the air.

title: Kimi ni Sasayaku
description:
If you were to experience an "auditory hallucination" in which the voice of an ASMR streamer you’re used to hearing seems to whisper right in your ear, would it be real?
The silent fantasy begins — a whispering voice guiding me!

title: Hatsukoi Nisshi
description: Okubo Souka hates girls but what happens when he's paired up with the quiet Magura for class duty?

title: Kare wa Diablo!
description:
In order to realize her dream of a romance with her senpai, Meiko uses black magic. Unexpectedly, she summons the demon king Lucifer, who also ends up as her homeroom teacher!  
As part of their contract, Meiko is forced onto the path of a witch, but in reality, she's just Lucifer's slave! And now that she has magical powers, she activates her super strength whenever she eats Anpan. What will become of Meiko and the great demon king Lucifer?

title: Dancing With Unwelcome Guests
description:
A new semester of 8th grade—Ji Haero ends up in the same class as her ex-boyfriend, the one who secretly dated her and then dumped her.

But wait, what now? It’s already painful enough being stuck with the guy who broke her heart,
and now he says he likes someone else in their class?

And of all people… that someone is Choi Jinyoung?!

There’s a secret between Ji Haero and Choi Jinyoung—one that absolutely no one can find out… Surrounded by nothing but unwelcome guests, can Haero survive the chaos of adolescence in one piece?

title: Lucky Number 13
description:
Satou Hiroshi is the kind of polite, innocent, cute boy who's popular with guys and girls alike. But word-of-mouth has it that anyone who dates him will be plagued by a series of unfortunate events and near-death experiences – eventually being forced to institute a break-up "under pain of death"…  
  
Will bespectacled, "uncool", baseball-crazy Tsumabuki Kasumi prove these rumours wrong – or experience them first-hand? But after falling for Hiroshi's cute smile upon their (rather weird) first meeting, he's determined to tempt fate and find out whether he can finally break out of this unlucky streak and strike it lucky in his love life!

title: Ochite yo Shirai!
description:
Shirai, a hot guy from the same class as I am, is the academy's #1 most popular person. He's even kind to an outcast like me, but I'm sure there has to be a hidden side to him!
The protagonist thought only she wouldn't be fooled, and finally, what she witnesses is...!? She'll want more and more, this is the beginning of a pampering romantic comedy!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump)

title: Onizuka-san wa XX ga Hoshii!
description:
If you can't push... push hard and get crushed?!

A special 61-page oneshot from an up-and-coming author!!

title: Butler, please!
description: Mari is an outcast in school despite belonging to a rich family and her butler is No. 1 at school...?!Somehow we have to turn the outcast into the queen of the school!Here is a romance between a girl and a boy who are complete opposites!

title: Auto Focus Pink
description:
In the summer of her second year of high school, Hinoko meets Yoichi, a childhood friend of her best friend Nijika. Hinoko is attracted to Yoichi, but her heart is bitterly broken… when he continues to be single-mindedly devoted to Nijika even though she is unaware of his feelings.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Houkago no Love Call
description: Ueda Wataru, a high school teacher, was rejected by someone he'd loved back when he was a student himself. Because of this, he has been timid in love ever since. However, he's now fallen in love with his student's father, Ippongi Kazushi, a Yakuza. Ueda can't help being fascinated with the good looking Ippongi's sweet words, even though he knows that he shouldn't…

title: Sunde Mitsukete Kirameite
description:
I should have wanted to go back to my friends.  I want to get closer than that.

Hayakawa Akira, a third-year high school student, changes seats and sits next to his childhood friend Kuno Sumika.

Akira, who has many friends and is active, and Sumiya, who likes astronomy and is quiet.
The two grew up in the house next door from an early age and were their best friends despite their opposite personalities.
However, when I was in elementary school, I had a trivial quarrel, and I couldn't say "I'm sorry" to each other, so I was estranged.

Akira feels awkward to start preparing for the school festival in the same group,
Sumiya has been kind to me as before ...

title: Azakoi
description: Masumi, a second-year high school student, is said to be absurd even though she just wants to please others. She is in love with Minato-senpai at the same school, but she is afraid to take a step and cannot convey her thoughts! At that time, her popular junior, Moji-kun, appeared and said that he would "help her in love" ...! ??

title: Unmei no Onna no Ko
description:
The short stories of Tomoko Yamashita.   
First girl: There was a girl in the middle of the gruesome incidents. ‘I thought that I was invincible.’  
Second girl: A recollection of ‘a girl’ who didn’t love an excellent boy, ‘me’.  
Third girl: The future where you are cursed when you are born. The only girl who wasn’t cursed is nervous about her undecided future. ‘She is pitiful for not being cursed!’

title: Till The Next Time
description: This is a story of 18 years of a relationship that started from the span through other's time, throughout their youth, going through lies and hatred, and eventually becomes alright by the end of the day.

title: Hana ni Kedamono
description: That was the first time I fell in love. The first time I met Hyo-kun, time stopped and I could not breathe. My heartbeat became louder and I could not take my eyes off of him. Although Hyo-kun told me "he wants to be with me", he is a guy who has kissed many girls. This love has many difficulties… it's tender yet painful, but even so I can't stop my feelings for him. I'm sorry… I fell in love with a "beast". This is my first love.

title: Gochisou-sama
description: Hiroto, a part-timer without a steady job, is on his lunch break in the park when a cute little boy appears in front of him and stares enviously at his bento. The child looks so irresistibly cute and hungry, Hiroto shares his lunch with the boy. When the child's father, Suguru, finally shows up and sees his picky-eater son enjoying a meal, he offers Hiroto a housekeeping job! The father is a pilot and cannot be home all the time, and needs a caretaker for the boy and their beautiful home. Just as things start going well for Hiroto, he begins to fall for Suguru…and learns that the previous housekeeper had to resign because of romantic involvement with the dashing pilot! Can Hiroto keep his emotions in check?

title: Sensei ni wa Kanawanai
description: "Do you really understand what kind of place an all boy school is?" To scare this teacher off I pushed him down on the infirmary bed, but… how did I end up under him!?

title: Seichoutsuu
description: Subaru Kashino travels to a high school in the countryside for a sports training camp where he meets Kei Natsume,  a library committee member.  Subaru expectedly finds himself curious about the boy in the library. Then one night Subaru has a sensual dream about his new friend. When it's time to return to Tokyo, Natsume suggests instead of calling each other to write letters. Confused, but intrigued, Subaru decides to start writing to Natsume.

title: Tig-Hug Planet
description:
Since her parents are a little bit slow, Matsuda Erika (or Eri for short) has taught herself to be independent and extremely reliable. Moreover, she devotes herself to taking care of those around her—even if some of her classmates find her behaviour overbearing and annoying. One day, a strange new transfer student is introduced to her class. This boy speaks in choppy sentences, has little to no facial expressions, and goes by the name Nogina Kaname. Instantly, Eri feels compelled to take care of this martian-like new boy in her class.  
  
This manga is a revised version of "Kimi to Hatsukoi", a one-shot found in Mako to Aki-chan no Koigokoro.  
The oneshot "Kirai, Suki?" included at the end of the story has yet to be translated.

title: Kurogane-kun to Saikyou no Koi
description: SeishunScans: When Sayo saved a handsome young man named Kurogane who had collapsed on the roadside, he quickly became very attached to her. To her surprise, he even asked her to become his mentor! Now, she finds herself caught up in a quirky master-student romcom, with an oblivious young man turning her world upside down.

title: Nanba Deadend
description:
Nanba Tsuyoshi is leading a double life. He's part of a hardcore delinquent family, and he's supposed to go to their traditional Ichimatsu high school and be the top fighter. Instead, he's secretly attending the high-class Shirayuri high school, as a normal kid. For a while, things seem to be going well. He has the skills of a top fighter, so he just sneaks into Ichimatsu to knock out his competitors. Afterwards, he switches back to his mild-mannered, Art Club president, student council president alter ego. With a little help from a few trusted friends, he's kept the two lives safely separate.  
  
Everything gets a little harder when his little sister Ginko decides to attend Shirayuri high school. Will he be able to keep his identity secret from his own sister, as they attend the same school? And how will he deal with Yayoi, a Shirayuri student with a huge crush on his punk persona? Will he be able to keep up his double life until graduation?

title: Puchimon
description: Adventures of Melty and friends that attend an academy in order to become questers!

title: Boukyaku no Cradle
description:
The world is in a tense political situation, and one country has instituted a new mandatory education program for all children fifteen and up. It's a half-year program that puts the children through military training. Kazuki has traveled to an installation on Yurikago ("Cradle") Island for his half-year of training along with many other boys. Kazuki has no special physical talent, but he has a remarkably good memory. His closest friend in the training, Sai, is top-notch at everything and not particularly liked by some in their class.  
  
One day, their relatively ordinary life in training comes to an abrupt end. Kazuki awakes to find the island facility in ruins. He has no idea how much time has passed, or what has happened. Soon he meets up with Sai and a strange little girl with a cat, and they begin to try to figure out their situation. What has happened to the island, and to their country?

title: Potemayo
description: A 4-koma manga involving a small, cute, soft like a stuffed toy, human-like creature with animal ears named Potemayo, her nonchalant owner Sunao, a similar creature named Guchuko and Sunao's zany classmates.

title: Xiàohuā de Zuìqiáng Tèzhǒngbīng
description: Liu Mang, a top class sharpshooter from the God Eagle Special forces, tried to use his military skills to peep on the beautiful girls at his school. Unfortunately, in the process of doing that, he accidentally uncovered one of the school's most well-kept secrets, which brings a lot of unforeseen problems upon himself. By defeating everybody that stands in his way and surrounding himself with many beautiful maidens, he manages to cement himself as an immortal legend in history. Based on a popular online webnovel.

title: Asaha Furu
description: Inoue Wakaba is a high school student who wishes to live a quiet and normal life. Moving back to her hometown, a memory that she doesn't want to touch resurfaces.

title: Waltz no Ojikan
description: When Hime Makimura was young, her mother told her that she could be like a princess someday. Now that Hime is in middle school, overweight and unpopular, life is a cruel disappointment. Tango Minami is a popular high school boy who hides his job as a ballroom dance instructor to maintain his image. But when Tango's mom urges Tango to take Hime as a student, everything gets turned upside down! Will Tango's classmate find out about his embarrassing job? And will Hime find the self-confidence needed to be like a princess on the ballroom floor?

title: The Story of Zoomers in a RomCom
description: When zoomers attempt a love life.

title: 00 Day of Summer Holiday
description: It's closing ceremony and romance blossoms amongst the bubbles..

title: Only I Can See Them!
description:
What if the school's anonymous message board shows real names only to me?
Every day various secrets are uploaded anonymously on the school's anonymous app 'Secretly'.
'Min-ju' who has a crush on his childhood friend of ten years 'Ha-young', ends up seeing all the real names on anonymous posts because of an error while downloading 'Secretly' and discovers that 'Ki-joo', the boyfriend of 'Ha-young' is cheating on her...

title: Sakura Buntsuu
description:
A collection of one-shots.  
  
- Cosmos no Saku Niwa  
  
- Together With Master (Goshujin-sama to Isshou)  
A "PET" is a love animal, created for the express purpose of pleasing their master. This is a short story of how one PET became endeared to her master, and vice versa.  
  
- Kuchinashi  
  
- The Cherry Tree Correspondence  
A sweet story set in the Taisho period.  
  
- Snowflakes Fluttering Down Through the Clear Sky  
A love story about a princess and a knight.  
  
- Wishing on a Star  
Two friends deal with grief.  
  
- The Cherry Tree Correspondence: Another Story  
Another pair of girls begins exchanging letters.

title: Kimi to Koi o Shitta
description:
Shino was living in peace in the countryside until the day she met Kento, a boy coming from Tokyo.  
Black hair, glasses and smart, that boy might be unsociable but he’s nice and Shino can’t stop her heart beating very fast when she’s with him… That’s the beginning of their love…

title: I Was XXX By My Idol
description: Breaking up with boyfriend just because she's chasing after her idol! How ridiculous... More ridiculous thing is that she finds herself in the bed with her dream idol when she wake up the second day! The most ridiculous thing is that for the sake of her idol's reputation, they become a fake couple...

title: Houkago, Kare to Kekkon Shimasu.
description: Nanami Meguro is a 2nd year high school student who wants to fall in love. As a substitute for her hospitalized father she works at a part-time job to earn money. With a new system that provides money to minors (15+) that marry, she jumps at the chance to participate in a mixer limited to students, but...

title: Hashiba Kaede wa Tokimekitai
description:
From Sunday Scans

Hashiba Kaede, a high school girl who has never felt her heart flutter before, asked Oda-kun and Mori-kun, the handsome guys duo, to teach her about the excitement of love when they became student council members together!!

title: Sakashita-senpai no Koigokoro
description: Chie had always tried hard being a student vice president at school for the sake of her crush that is the student council president himself. She is currently a third year and is on a brink of graduation, so her goal is to ultimately confess to him. While she is busy working within the last days as the vice president, she particularly gets closer to a certain kouhai. Will Chie be able to confess before her days in the student council is over?

title: Silent Kiss
description: On the first day of high school, Haruka meets the boy of her dreams but, he was the kind of guy who wouldn't allow anyone to get close. The distance between them does not shrink, even though she wants to get close to him. As a matter of fact, he has a secret that he can't tell to anybody…!? Very painful dramatic love story!!

title: Mikazuki no Ojousama Bibouroku
description:
"My Lady, you look so beautiful today... I'm so excited!"
A quiet high school girl lives in a luxurious mansion, and her butler, Mikazuki, is obsessively in love with her.
The stones the Lady steps on, the dust in her hair, the cream she leaves uneaten, the bathwater after she soaks... Mikazuki loves and wants to know everything about the Lady, and today he continues to shower his overprotective and perverted love on her.
However, in fact, Mikazuki and the Lady harbor a secret that they have not revealed to each other...

title: Neko Neko Honey
description: Nekoya Ai is a cute teenager who turns into a cat uncontrollably when he is under emotional distress. After being cornered by delinquents, he gets help from a scary-looking guy who turns out to be a real cat lover and his classmate to top it off. Will Ai be able to keep his shapeshifting condition a secret?

title: Hibi mo Tsumoreba Koi to Naru
description: When he was young, Oto would visit his grandma in the summer. But, because he was from Tokyo, Oto had no friends to play with and sat alone in the shade. That was until a boy two years older named Sora came and invited Oto to play with him and his friends. To Oto, Sora was his knight in shining armor and was destroyed when he disappeared the following summer, making Oto regret not communicating his true feelings for Sora. Several years pass, and it's finally Sora's last year of high school. All he wants is to focus on studying for his university entrance exams. Sora thought his only distraction would be his loudmouth best friend, but on his first day back, he runs into an old face - or rather, that old face runs into him, professing his love for Sora all the while.

title: Sana: “Sashidashinin Fumei no Shiokuri” Another Story
description:
The short story *Sana*, told from the perspective of Kuramoto Sana, a main character in the mystery novel *Care Packages From An Unknown Sender*, has been fully adapted into a comic!

The days she spent with her husband, and even “that moment” are revealed……

title: Student Council Daily Life
description: Sidestory of Seitokai no Ichizon.

title: Dangerous Mania
description: After breaking up with their respective exes due to certain circumstances, Nono and Kazuma suddenly find themselves in a relationship. How much does it really take to make things work?

title: My Favorite Mistake
description: In a world full of cliche's, KOTA TAKAYUKI; a cliche loser, and AKANE TSUBAKI; a cliche delinquent are both outcasts and wanna start a new life... However with Kota's overly cautious social anxiety and Akane's reckless personality are faced against the challange of "meeting new people" such as the SPORTY KID, the QUEEN BEE, and the GYARU, what can Kota do to survive a lifelong time's worth of embarrassment?! The chances of being popular is starting to turn low... but never zero.

title: Asaoka High School Baseball Team Journal - Over Fence
description: Minori is the manager of her high school's baseball club, which has been defunct up until five years ago. Even now, it's a little rough, since there currently are no seniors in the club at all! None of the second year players know why the club closed so many years ago, or about the baseball history all their fathers share…

title: Kimi to Kyunkoi, Shiyou
description:
I'd like that you feel the same than me…  
Five stories about sweet and painful loves.  
  
1. Kimi to Kiss Shitai. by Makino  
Sugi-san had witnessed her player classmate Ryou hitting on her homeroom teacher. Sugi hates his type the most, however, he seems to take a liking to her…?!  
  
2. Sensei, Anone. by Haruki Saki  
Yara Ikumi has fallen in love with her sensei! She often tries to confess to him, but he bluntly rejects her. Can she ever succeed in winning his heart?  
  
3. Kanpeki Kareshi Kanojo - Water-Proof Passion by Miyoshi Maki  
Kawahara Natsu thinks that Ichijou is the perfect boyfriend material, so she confessed to him! But he rejected her, saying he wanted someone cuter! What will Natsu do? Keep loving him (a bit delusionally) of course, but will she ever get him to change his mind?  
  
4. Hoshigari na Honey -Saya by Kuramochi Mari  
Saya is in love with Kudou-senpai, but he sleeps around and never would accept anyone to be his girlfriend. Saya then proposes to him th

title: Zoo to Issho
description: Teppei-kun has two childhood friends. He finds himself in a situation when they suddenly tell him to choose!

title: Rainbow Parakeet
description:
Rainbow Parakeet is a genius actor and a fantastic mimic, but also a thief. He can act out any role to the best of his abilities, while robbing the richest members of the audience during his performances. His methods are a mystery, even to the detectives charged with apprehending him: Police Inspector Senri and his daughter, Police Detective Mariko Senri.

The English release of Osamu Tezuka's Shakespeare Manga Theater included chapters 1, 15 and 43.

---
**Volumes 341-347 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Sweet First Love
description:
English:  
Do you remember the taste of your first love? You might have already forgotten the taste of your first love, or you have buried it in your heart, or you are currently experiencing your first love, but ignoring all that, the first love is sweet, shy, and happy. What kind of sparks will be created when you meet the person that used to be your first love?  
  
Spanish:  
¿Recuerdas el sabor del primer amor? Es posible que haya olvidado el sabor del primer amor, tal vez lo haya enterrado en su corazón, o tal vez este experimentado el primer amor en este momento, sin importar qué, el primer amor es dulce, tímido, feliz. ¿qué tipo de chispas sería la persona que solía ser el primer amor cuando se volvieran a encontrar?

title: Houkago Melancholy
description:
A high school girl is in love with her good friend, but he already has a girlfriend. She decided to hide her feelings and go about her normal day. But when she gets set up by a friend to go to karaoke, a sempai takes interest in her. How will things turn out for our heroine?  
Source: silverflame9

title: Girl's Cocoon
description: A trilogy of beautiful, dangerous, and cruel truth between adolescent girls...

title: Sono Koi ni wa Wake ga Aru
description: Aoi, a first year student in all-boys high school, is a violent but beautiful boy. Viewing his good looks as a burden, he ruthlessly rejects every guy that approaches him. Until one day, Aoi notices Azuma, who's been "observing" him quietly from the sidelines. To his surprise, Azuma's attitude actually makes him feel safe, and he slowly falls in love?!

title: Rakuen Noise
description:
Tôi đã giả gái và đăng một video biểu diễn âm nhạc lên mạng, rồi đột nhiên tôi trở nên nổi tiếng với tư cách là một nữ sinh trung học bí ẩn (thật ra là con trai) làm nhạc sĩ mạng. Tôi nghĩ rằng mọi chuyện sẽ ổn thôi vì tôi không lộ mặt, nhưng mà giáo viên nhạc ở trường Cao trung tôi theo học, Misao Hanazono, đã phát hiện ra danh tính thực sự của tôi. Và để cô ấy giữ bí mật, tôi phải làm theo những yêu cầu của cô ấy...

Cuộc sống Cao trung vốn vô vị và nhạt nhẽo của tôi đã trở nên nhộn nhịp khi làm quen với ba cô gái qua cô Hanazono――Rinko, một thiên tài piano có tính cách kì quái, Shizuki, một tay trống có sở thích cắm hoa, và Akane, một ca sĩ hay trốn học――Ba cô gái này đã khiến cuộc sống của tôi trở nên nhộn nhịp và tràn đầy rắc rồi.

Tình yêu, thanh xuân và ban nhạc, boy meets girls!

title: Shion-kun no Oose no Mama
description: A romantic comedy about a rich young man who admires delinquents and makes a fierce advance on a former delinquent girl.

title: Naisho no Kawai Ko-chan
description:
Note: Began as a one-shot published in the 2022 No. 21 issue of Margaret on October 5, 2022. Serialization started in the 2023 No. 5 issue on February 3, 2023.

Kana is a lovely girl who loves cute things. However, everyone calls her "Sato-kun" due to her handsome looks. For this reason, she's insecure and hides her true self until a certain thug finds everything out. Will things start to get better for Kana or everything will get worse?

title: Haruru's Short Stories
description: Memories of youth, dreams and inexperience.

title: Salad Days
description:
Love is something that is fresh…like salads. Days when people experience love are days that will never be forgotten… These precious memories are "salad days".  
  
Salad Days is a collection of one-shots about people and their first love, or finding new love.

title: Nǐ de Yǎnlèi hěn Tián
description: In order to become a normal person who can cry, Zuo Xiaoxia began to collect other people's tears. But who would've thought that she'd become entangled with the school hunk in the process?

title: Lovely Allergen
description: Yue Zhishi and Song Yu are not blood related brothers, Yue Zhishi, who was fostered by the Song family since childhood, loves to cling to his older brother, Song Yu, who is three years older than him. However, Song Yu always deliberately maintains a distance. Song Yu, the brother who pretends to be indifferent, and Yue Zhishi, the brother who is a clingy little puppy. But what others don't know is that he understands his own heart, he choose to exercise self-control and maintain a distance because… Yue Zhishi is Song-Yu’s only allergen.

title: Sayonara, Children
description: "Abdominal Perforation Syndrome" - when children enter puberty, a hole forms in their belly. It closes automatically as you grow up, and having gone through this experience is a sign of adulthood. This story centers around junior high school student Asahina Chimaki and those around her, as they are torn between childhood and adulthood.

title: Go Da Gun
description:
This is all about a 16-year old guy named Gan(family name: Goda) who, along with his various fighting -video-game-styled pals, opposes the very naughty Hanged Cross gang on an alarmingly regular basis.   
  
As the story begins, Gan is a juvenile delinquent who has been booted out of one too many schools for chronic bad behavior. Gan's father, a hotdog supercop with the moniker of "Dan Goda," is fed up with this situation to the point where he decides to send Gan to his old educational institution: a fighting school called Roujuu Private High School. There, Gan learns to harness his raw abilities into "Gunfighting," the family martial arts style resembling firearms. Think .44 Magnum punches, Shotgun Fists, Sniper Stances, and you've got the essence of Gun-Fu down.   
  
At his new school Gan also falls madly in love hot chick, Yuki and runs afoul of 17-year old transfer student and sure-to-be-rival Garrick Rider, prodigal master of the Hanged Cross technique. Fights over Yuki's affecti

title: Sorairo Flutter
description: Noshiro Dai, a 17 year old boy, transfers to new high school. But one of his new classmates -Sanada Kou- is always alone and distances himself from others. Then one day Noshiro hears rumors that Sanada is gay.

title: Seishun Girigiri Overline
description:
"You're gonna regret it if you stay with me."  
  
Oshima heard the rumors that his boyfriend, Hiyama, is quitting baseball. Upon hearing the upsetting news, and after being told that he's a nuisance to the baseball team and his boyfriend's career, he tries to convince Hiyama to stay on the team. What will happen to their clumsy love story after they graduate high school?!

title: The Tale of Taro Yamada
description:
With their father going away for an extended time without any warning whatsoever, the Yamadas have to get by on their own. Tarou, the eldest son, carries the biggest burden of all: supporting his large family.  
  
Of course, Tarou's money problems are overshadowed by his appearance, as many girls and even guys trample all over each other to get his attention. Experience the joys and tears of being poor AND beautiful through the life of the Yamadas!

title: Suki tte Iu na!
description:
Tokita Eiji, the handsome Student Council President whom the entire student body admires, and Okamoto Oriya, who leads a very ordinary school life: the two don't have anything in common at all, but one day, Oriya suddenly gets romanced passionately by Eiji…!  
  
"Oriya, I think that we should get married soon."  
  
What will Oriya do with Eiji's perverted love?!

title: Gao Neng Strikes
description: A hundred years after the Cataclysm, a completely new profession was born. They controlled iron, copper, phosphorus, gold, silicon, carbon……At the start he immolated the female lead to the heavens, Gao Neng saw his own hidden gifts, and was frozen in shock: iron 100%, copper 100%, tin 100%, silver 100%, gold 100%, phosphorus 100%, sulphur 100%, silicon 100%……

title: Bye-Bye Mitsubari
description: My childhood friend who loved messing with me moved away 10 years ago but now he’s back. My everyday life is filled with sweet despair!

title: Island School
description: Uma misteriosa escola onde é dito criar novos seres humanos que irão conduzir a evolução da humanidade… Mas certo dia, a escola localizada em uma isolada ilha se transforma em um parque de massacre. Com Inteligências Artificiais eróticas espalhadas por todo o lugar exterminando a vida humana, a maneira de se fugir desta ilha foi…

title: Bokura wa Itsumo
description:
The series is composed of four protagonist.  
  
Nori: An energetic, upbeat girl who was heartbroken sometime ago due to her childhood friend. Now she is headed to meet Haruna, the lonely kid she always played with back then, but to her big surprised grew up into a hunk.  
  
Kyou: The school's prince. From a distinguished family: he is handsome, smart, athletic and rich. He has never struggled for anything in his life, be it money or women. Haruna's sudden return throws him off momentum.  
  
Saeka: She, Nori and Kyou are childhood friends. She is mature, composed and understands the two quite well. Although beautiful, she has been in love with her teacher since middle school and therefore never gone out with anyone. Will her feelings be answered or will she find an unexpected love around the corner!?   
  
Haruna: The boy who comes back after having been away for many years. His reason for returning is unknown. The guy who’s clouded with mystery shows interest in Nori. Does he really

title: Pinocchio
description:
"A story of people wanting to be happy, and a boy looking for happiness."  
  
Pinocchio follows an ordinary high school girl, Choi Ha-Ram, who stumbles upon a ghost that only she can see! As if this encounter wasn't enough to turn her life upside-down, Ha-Ram gets a new neighbour who brings with him her forgotten past.  
  
*Note: The author has explicitly split the story-line into multiple parts. These parts are represented by Vol.#.*

title: Mabataki
description:
​1. アンテロースの休日
2. みどりのなかのみずたまの
3. 初夏の葬式
4. 人魚姫
5. さらば人間
**5.5. Digital Edition Exclusive Benefit:** 人魚姫 -100 years ago-

title: Ginger Honey
description: On his way home from school, Minoru discovers his older brother, Yoshino, making out with his male gym teacher! To confuse the matter even more, he also notices his brother's best friend, Seto, shooting longing glances at Yoshino! And for some reason, that revelation makes Minoru's chest hurt. Could what he's feeling actually be love?!

title: Miracle☆Gift
description: Vào ngày giáng sinh, Santa hứa sẽ tặng cho bạn một cô bạn gái. Bạn sẽ chọn ai đây?

title: Fuwafuwa Complex
description: A heartwarming love story between a beautiful boy and a girl with curly hair!

title: Amadare no Koro
description: Suguru and Yoshiichi were neighbors who were always together, until the day Suguru decided to move away. When they entered junior high, as promised, Suguru came back. But he was unable to transition into their high school, so he is thinking of applying for other schools. Yoshiichi's image of the Suguru who's always by his side shatters a bit. He became upset, lonely and jealous.

title: Fetish Berry
description: An unhealthy obsession with boys' hands, voices, and other things. Protagonist Mizuhara Hiyori has a difficult-to-explain fetish. In order to live a peaceful life, she hides her fetish away from the world and entered Blue Star Academy. There, she meets Narita Naohisa, a beautiful boy who discovers her fetish one day at school. How? Because he possesses all of the lovely qualities that Hiyori fetishizes! However, Narita-kun turns out to be a rather troublesome teenager…

title: Yukimura-sensei to Kei-kun
description: Yukimura-sensei is famous for being beautiful. It's true that he's both terribly beautiful and capable… However, he's also somewhat ferocious. Although Kei is treated coldly by him, he continues to stay over at sensei's place for spiritual nourishment. Kei is constantly stunned by sensei's sweet love-struck side, yet the atmosphere around him freezes when he finds out about sensei's ex-boyfriend. Will he be able to make such a charming person fall in love with him?!

title: Himitsu no Hanazono
description:
Misono who falls in love with a handsome “boy” one day as she was taking a break from her running. She believes that she shall never meet this “boy” ever again, but after warnings about problems with her foot, Misono decides to not run for a while and help out with the drama club. There she meets her “handsome prince” once again, but it turns out “he” is not who she thought he was…  
  
ITALIANO  
Hiyama Misono è una ragazza che frequenta la scuola superiore ed è iscritta al club di atletica leggera. Un giorno la sua amica Sayuki, iscritta al club di teatro, le propone di sostituire un'attrice per la recita scolastica, altrimenti sarà difficile vincere contro un altro istituto, ma lei non vuole accettare. Ultimamente però non va molto bene con la corsa, anche se si impegna tanto e le viene consigliato dal medico di prendersi un periodo di riposo e accettare la proposta dell'amica. Misono non sa cosa le aspetta nel futuro, l'unica cosa che sa,è che deve continuare a correre!

title: Bee-Be-Beat It!
description: Dokuritsu Tenjin Gakuen is a special school that give grades through "Battles" instead of tests. So everyday, the students engage in all-out battle and get points based on their rankings. Two students Hattori Kyousuke and Kujou Hachie (aka Hachi) are childhood friends. While Hachi is the strongest freshmen girl of the school, Kyousuke is just an above-average student, but he cannot remain mediocre forever because Kyousuke made a promise: to defeat Hachi and marry her, or else Hachi is forced to wed her perverted cousin. Can Kyousuke get strong enough to fulfill their promise?

title: To the Yesterday You
description:
We’ve been together since we were kids…  
  
But then you left me without warning.  
  
“I’m here from the future to save you.”

title: The Student Council's Circumstances
description: Mitaka High School has a student council filled with super handsome men. However, the reality is ... it's just a group of rough, bad boys that everyone is forced to listen to. Hitomi was caught by them on her first day as a transfer student. Moreover, she was forced by the Student Council President, Subaru, to "become my woman"!?!?

title: Braid into Love
description: A young boy finds himself fascinated by the long hair of the boy in class who sits in front of him.

title: Chalk-Written Love
description:
"Let me help you gain some dating experience." One day, rookie male teacher Moegi is approached by a male student seeking relationship advice. But what happens when Moegi himself has zero dating experience? A romantic comedy about "learning about love" by Akari Kajimoto.

[Part of the 10th anniversary Jump+ One-shot collection](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/web_pages/2019/)

title: Fumikiri, Kimi no te, Sakuramichi
description: Atsumi Kohaku, middle school sophomore, 14 years old. She’s perplexed by her physical changes as she grows up. She’s slowly finding herself unable to see her good guy friend Toya as “a friend”. What answers will she arrive at in her journey from “girl” to “woman”? A bittersweet tale of youth that everyone can empathize with.

title: Yamitsuki Marisu - Fly Me to the Moon
description: The protagonist Souta Sengoku, a normal high school student is targeted by Maris Hiduki, the reincarnation of Kaguya Hime. Maris is trying to find the way to go back to the Moon and she drags him in because she assumes that Souta is the reincarnation of her servant.

title: C 93 Andou × Oshida Paper | Ashiname Manga
description: Andou has a lewd moment with Oshida's Feet.

title: RDG - Red Data Girl
description: Izumiko Suzuhara is a 15-year old girl who has been raised at Tamakura Shrine, part of the Kumano Shrines World Heritage Site. She destroys any electrical device that she comes into contact with. Despite being shy, she wants to try living in the city. Her guardian Yukimasa Sagara recommends that she enroll at Hōjō High School in Tokyo, accompanied by his son and Izumiko's childhood friend Miyuki Sagara. While in Tokyo, an entity named "Himegami" appears. Izumiko learns that she is a yorishiro, a vessel for a shinto spirit known as a kami, while Miyuki learns that he is a yamabushi, a warrior tasked with protecting her.

title: My Classmates Are Vampires!
description:
What?! Me? The Vampire Queen?!! My name is Han Yeseul, I’m an ordinary human living in a world where humans and vampires coexist, I was about to enter my dream high school when… because of an error with my application form, I was transferred to an exclusive vampires school.

I couldn’t let them know that I was a human, so I dyed my hair and put contact lenses to pass unnoticed…. However, everyone in the school now sees me as one of the Legendary are “pure blood” vampires and even call me their queen!!!

I've been faking successfully for now, I just need to maintain it for a year so I can transfer to the high school of my dreams as I was supposed to. Or at least, that’s what I was pretending to do until one of my vampire classmates Changyeol discovers my true identity after hearing me talking alone in the bathroom.

Will I really be able to survive this School full of blood sucking demons for a year and stop getting involved in more bizarre situations?!

title: Looking for an Idol
description: Chikako Fujitani (18), 1st year at the Hanano Women’s College starts living alone at the same apartment as Kanro (An aspiring mangaka from the same school.) and Chiaki (A bus guide who pretends to be a college student to get a man.) While on the “Country-Bumpkin” tour she encounters Iwata, reconnects with her middle school crush, Nagae, and meets the landlady’s son, Makoto. It’s the kind of story about the bold and flimsy feelings of college students on an awkward, realistic love.

title: The Distance Between You And Me
description: How can I not like you?

title: 【Oshi no Ko】After story
description:
This work takes its own route from the original "Oshi no Ko" manga from chapter 158. It portrays a daily life of Aqua and Ruby.

What would happen if Fuyuko Niino actually stabbed Ruby Hoshino, being envious of young idol's success?

title: Inochi Mijikashi, Koi seyo Furyou Shounen!
description: If you don't date her, you'll die! That the prediction made to that delinquent boy. but what will be his destiny…?

title: Note wo Otoshita dake nanoni
description: A timid boy dropped his notebook in class and found his crush reading it...

title: Heavy x Heavy
description: Marui Madoka is a slightly plump first year high school girl who loves to eat. She's not very assertive when it comes to romance but a strange turn of events has brought her closer to Kuga, a popular senior in her school. Madoka finds herself getting more and more attracted to him even as she tells herself that she doesn't suit him. On the other hand, Kuga seems to have a mystery of his own...?

title: The Sparrow Bride
description:
"A sparrow who yearns to live a long life aims to capture a human to fulfill her goal… through marriage?!"  
  
In a world where wildlife birds are able to permanently turn into humans once they seal a marriage contract with a human, Jo Ahyoung enters university with the goal of finding her potential marriage partner to live a longer life. Rather than hoping for a romantic meeting, she makes up her mind to take any human that can provide her with a stable and secure living. But is that as easy as she thinks it to be…?

title: Passionate Lullaby
description: Kogure is a normal high-school girl who loves shoujo manga and food. She wants to fall in love, however there is one big problem - she's terrified of real guys. Then, one day, she runs into her ideal guy, and he's real!  (From: CoyoMoose)

title: Ochite Chika Chika
description:
When Mimi is scouted as a reader model, she's excited for the opportunity to meet super-popular male model Ryota. The only problem is, Ryota is nothing like what she expected. So why did he pick her to model alongside him in an upcoming project? Is this the start of her modelling career, or just a big mistake? (From: Shoujo Sense)  
  
Included Oneshots:  
- **Hokenshitsu no Ouji-sama**  
  
- **Skirt o Nuida Sono Ato wa. (After Stripping Off the Skirt.)**   
"What, isn't it fine to cling to you? As fellow models and girls."   
"No… Though we're both models and girls… buuuut (>\_<)"  
  
[PL ] Hinako świetnie radzi sobie jako modelka od paru lat, kiedy nagle pojawia się nowa gwiazda: Mashiro Yuu. Słodka i kobieca – czy Hinako dalej pozostanie w świecie modelingu? A co jeśli Yuu nie jest tym, kim się wydaje być…?  
  
Hinako has been a successful teen model for several years, when suddenly a new rising star appears: Mashiro Yuu. Cute, innocent and feminine - how can Hinako stay at the t

title: Wǒ Xiǎng Yào!!
description:
Zhong Xiangyao suffers from a mysterious illness.

This is a coming-of-age story about losing control, and a heartfelt tale about honesty.

When everyone else has learned to conceal their true feelings and wear masks to get by, the only person who can't pretend is treated like the abnormal one. But is he really the one who's sick... or the only one who's still seeing the world clearly?

Starting high school, Zhong Xiangyao has just one goal:

To be an ordinary person.

title: Mushihime (Fan Colored)
description: A dark romance about a high school boy who falls helplessly in love with a beautiful girl who has to eat people to survive.

title: Bonbonzaka Koukou Engekibu
description: Junna Shoutarou, who just entered Tokeizaka high school, falls for the school's madonna, Hibino Makoto. Meanwhile, the school's notorious homosexual, Tokudaiji Hiromi, targets Shoutarou as his new victim. Shoutarou, who under Hiromi's threats, joins the drama club and discovers that Makoto is the drama club's vice president. Perfect–except everyone thinks Shoutarou is gay with Hiromi!

title: Fukurousou Aki Arimasu
description: Ever since she underwent a desperate surgery to save her failing vision, 15-year-old Okada Toshio has sought solace in the world of sound, falling in love with the voice of the actor from the anime Samurai Detective. When her grandfather suddenly forces her to live on her own, she encounters a boy her age with a remarkably similar voice. But how will he react to her cravings for his voice…?

title: Gokuraku Seishun Hockey Club
description: Hana Suzuki loves only two things in life: eating and sleeping. So when her handsome classmate Izumi Oda talks her into joining the school hockey club, how is she going to survive getting up early, working hard, and playing well with others? True, the Grand Hockey Club is full of boys - super-cute boys at that - so maybe it won't be so bad after all…

title: Docchi ni Suru?
description:
You're asking what we're deciding? Of course – who's gonna put it in first!  
  
The super normal university student, Hiroo Eiji has a problem. That is, he can't become popular because he always has two extremely handsome but forceful childhood friends, Haruki and Ikumi, beside him. However, when he received the first love letter in his life, both childhood friends confessed, saying, "You can't go out with a girl. I've been in love with you all this time…" and then they set him up and do super perverted stuff with him…?!

title: Warring Gods Student Council
description:
Katsuragi lost his parents in an accident and is now all alone. He missed the first months of school and now he arrives to be put through a lot of weird occurences. The school he is attending is said to be the center of the universe and he must fight to become the king. His opponent however was a crybaby he used to protect. Does he have what it takes to fight against his childhood friend, deal with girl problems and prove his nickname, the unsinkable?  
  
"If you actually decide to go for it… and do become president of the student council… I'll let you have your way with me… This school is at the center of the entire universe… I belong to you, Musashi."  
  
Those were the words of Vice President of the Student Council, Kagura Mami that were said to Katsuragi Musashi on the first day they met.  
What's the secret of that school? What's the mystery behind it all? And what's the past that haunts Kagura and Katsuragi?

title: Yanikasu nan desu ka, Kemuriga-sensei
description: Rindou, a newly appointed teacher who is strict about school rules and disliked by the students, discovers that the popular school nurse, Kemuriga Kuyuri, is actually a lazy smoking addict... A secret night between two teachers who appear to be complete opposites begins.

title: Ookina Noichi to Chiisana Hinayuki
description: Tanda Nao is filled with concern because his cherished childhood friend Hinayuki has been hanging around with a classmate he doesn't trust: Noichi. Hinayuki is petite, delicate, and docile, while Noichi is big, quiet, and rough... Nao is worried because he doesn't know why they are together!? Could it be that these two are in some kind of relationship ...!?

title: Marin to Yuurei
description: Marin is just an average timid girl, who one day meets a pretty girl in the classroom… except the girl's actually a ghost; a rather outgoing ghost that possesses Marin whenever she feels like it!

title: Kimi to Aoi Haru no Hajimari
description: Suehiro is a quiet girl, who prefers the excitement of her books to the real-life anxieties of friends. She'd been perfectly happy in her own little world until ultra-popular guy Takasago asked her out as part of a punishment game right in front of the class, bringing Suehiro front and center. Mortified, she tries everything to get away... but he persists, and insists he's serious! How will she deal with such an interruption to her previously quiet life?

title: Gyakuso Rendezvous
description: The story is about the cute & fateful relationship between a short arrogant guy who likes to dress as a woman & a tall modest girl who just prefers to wear men's clothes.

title: Boy or Girl ???
description: A " normal " love story about two " normal " persons

title: Logick
description:
Every day is boring, too boring…  
Until a witch casts her spell on it?  
Masa, a second-year student at a third-rate art school, draws because he doesn't know what else to do with his life.  
Then he meets Aoi, an attractive first-year girl, who seems, somehow, like she might be a witch.  
Will Aoi and her secrets light the fire in the gloomy Masa's heart?  
Though it doesn't seem much like living, life goes on, as young men yearn only for yearning.  
Though every day seems so inconsequential, the special spark of that time of life defines what it means to be young.

title: It's time for the Kiss, my lady.
description: For my first, I was taken by my butler. Nene who attend's a young lady's school has a one-sided love for her Sakuma, her butler. But, she i told on her 17th birthday that she is to marry some whom she has never met before. Even so, not giving up on Sakuma, she asks of him to teach her about dirty things. If he does so, will she be french-kissed, or even more? A highly thrilling and stimulating love story.

title: Classmate
description:
This is a collection of short stories about third-year high school students who are nearing graduation but haven't found hope in it.

Comitia 129 
B5 / 20 pages

title: Sakura to Sensei
description: Minato Sakura has decided to, on her bicycle climb the slope in front of her school every day, but already on the first day she realize that it was much tougher than she thought. Just when she's about to give up, a boy passes her and gives her the strength to continue. Later Sakura gets to know that the boy actually is her new teacher, Fujiharu Keisuke.

title: Sahara-sensei to Toki-kun
description:
My heart can’t stop pounding!! A physical education teacher X A Yankee’s frustrating romantic comedy!!

Toki-Kun is a yankee who gets into fights. But despite his appearance he is actually a gentle guy. He gains favor with Mr. Sahara, who is not only a physical education teacher but his homeroom teacher. The loud gong of a straight-gay unrequited love echoes out!!

title: Lion to Hanayome
description:
Yua, a high school girl, is dating with her teacher in secret. One day, she lost her grandmother, who was the only member of her family, and suddenly Yua was left alone. At that time, she receive a proposal from her boyfriend as known as her teacher, who always supported her. "I'm supposed to have a happy honeymoon, but my teacher has a big secret…!?" Romantic marriage after school is intricately intertwined at school and at home!  
  
Viet  
||Yua, một nữ sinh trung học, đang giấu mọi người việc hẹn hò với thầy giáo chủ nhiệm của mình. Một ngày nọ, bà của Yua, người thân duy nhất của Yua đột nhiên qua đời, bỏ lại Yua một mình. Ngay khi ấy, Yua nhận được lời cầu hôn của bạn trai aka thầy giáo của mình! "Mình dự định sẽ có một tuần trăng mật hạnh phúc, nhưng thầy ấy có một bí mật lớn …!?" Cuộc hôn nhân lãng mạn sau giờ học đan xen với những bí ẩn phức tạp ở trường và ở nhà! Mời mọi người đón xem!||

title: Steel Septum
description:
Omaezaki Sanemichi was born into a near-perfect existence. His family is wealthy and powerful, and he's good-natured, smart, and athletic as well! All the girls at his high-school dream of having a Cinderella-style romance with him, and, though they are desperately jealous of him, none of the boys can come up with a legitimate reason to publicly hate him.  
  
But one day the unthinkable happens: Sanemichi's family's flagship company collapses and his father flees. Sanemichi and his former servants, the teenage siblings Natsuno and Asasuzu and the absent-minded old man Furukawa, are left without a dime. Will Sanemichi be able to maintain his gentlemanly behavior despite the humiliation and many hardships that face him?

title: Hydrangea
description:
A young city girl has to adjust to her new environment, with new people and new events. What awaits her?  
  
NOTE: This comic is read from right to left.

title: Saruyama!
description:
Haruna Aizawa thinks that school life is just like a monkey mountain–all the monkeys form cliques, get into fights, and get back together again. The school that she just transferred to is no exception. There's even a boy called Macharu Yamashita who reminds her of a baby monkey!  
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Haruna Aizawa cree que la escuela es como una montaña de monos: todos los monos arman distintos grupos, se pelean, se amigan. La escuela nueva a la que acaba de trasferirse no es la excepción. ¡Inlcuso hay un chico llamado Macharu Yamashita que es la viva imagen de un mono bebé! Sin embargo, Haruna no logra mantenerse ajena a las costumbres, porque tiene cierta debilidad por… ¡¿el mono bebé?!

title: Koi to Kimi to Kaerimichi
description: Một câu chuyện dài 42 trang tập trung vào mối tình thời thơ ấu, nơi hai người có mối quan hệ trên mức bạn bè nhưng chưa đến mức người yêu.

title: Otonari wa 1-ken de 2-do oishii
description: Asuza Akimoto is in love with the student body president Ousuke Kobayashi, but she would never dream of confessing to him. Then one day she discovers that he has moved into the house next door to live with his uncle, a novelist. When she is offered a part-time position helping them with housework she takes the opportunity to get closer. However, not everything will be easy when living next to two handsome young men!

title: Vampire Kisses: Blood Relatives
description:
The absolute last thing Goth-girl Raven and her vampire boyfriend, Alexander, need is another hitch in their nighttime-only romance. But dark trouble hovers on the horizon when they discover that Alexander's cousin is raiding graves with a motley crew of hooligans! Is there something behind their sudden interest in Dullsville?  
  
A collaboration between Harper Collins and TokyoPop comes a manga based on Ellen's novel series, Vampire Kisses.

title: Ano Natsu.
description:
Six men and women are reunited at a high school reunion. Our heroine Tamaki meets her first love again, which was unrequited, nine years after graduating high school. The next day she wakes up to find she has time slipped 10 years into the past and is once again a 17-year-old?  
  
A love story of redoing your youth!

title: One Piece in Love
description: The tragic and treasured daily lives of three high school students with the same names as members of the Straw Hat Pirates, and their occasional outbursts after they form a One Piece fan club. An official One Piece spin-off gag manga with no fear of God, drawn by the Pacifista of the gag manga world, Ihara Daiki!

title: Kiyoku Yawaku
description:
Yuma is having trouble warding off perverts every morning on her way to school. Her classmate Suwa starts going to school with her, in order to protect her, and the two become a couple. However, Yuma is also interested in her biology teacher who rides the same train as her every morning, and…  
  
The work depicts each character's growth and daily love life, particularly high school girls, in an omnibus format with several complete episodes. 

Content: 
ACT 1: Yuma-hen
ACT 2: Kanna-hen
ACT 3: Mizuki-hen
ACT 4: Ai-hen
ACT 5: Kazue-hen
ACT 6: Roku-hen
ACT 7: Momoka-hen.
ACT 8: Nene-hen
ACT 9: Asami-hen
ACT 10: Final chapter: Kanna-hen
  
---
- **Won the 33rd Kodansha Manga Award for Shojo in 2009**

title: Sorry, I like you
description: Rie and Yuri have been friends since childhood. Living together every day, Yuri thinks Rie needs a boyfriend. Does she even need one?

title: Mountain Demon
description:
The drama club discusses their next play, based on the local legend of the Mountain Demon.  
  
Author's weibo: [一条废狗狗狗狗](https://weibo.com/u/6055804589?refer_flag=0000015010_&from=feed&loc=nickname&is_all=1)  
  
Translated with author's permission.

title: Legend Hustle
description:
Na Hae-Il, whose father works as a scholar, constantly travels around the world. Hence, it is difficult for Hae-Il to enjoy a regular school life. One day, a mysterious white haired girl appears, claiming that his father sent her! The fourteen-year old German girl claims that she is Hae-Il's fiancee and continues to drag Hae-Il into weird situations. Changes in his body, enemies flying at him continuously…  
Who are they, and what is hidden within Hae-Il's gloves?

title: Amanojaku Gambler
description: “I want you to fall in love with me, so I can’t lose!” Kajio witnesses Nanase Dai, who goes to the same cram school as him, coming out of a pachinko parlor. He’s charmed by Nanase’s attitude, which is the exact opposite of the honor student he sees at school, and confesses to him without thinking. Despite being rejected, Kajio makes a bet that if he’s able to get Nanase to fall for him within one month, Nanase has to go out with him – and Nanase, who loves gambling, accepts the challenge. In the final summer of their high school lives where love is wagered, what will happen to these two in one month?!

title: Moeru Seito Kaichou
description:
An arsonist, a pervy class president, and a yandere walk into a school.  
  
Everything is on fire, and the president gains a harem of death.

title: Kill This Love!
description: Trainee killer Ahn Eun-young receives her first mission to become a full-fledged killer. The mission is to kill So Si-ho, a boy from the same class who transferred a few months ago. Eun-young pulls the trigger with trembling hands, but... This target is not ordinary...?

title: Rewrite: SIDE-R
description:
Đây là một thế giới quan khác của Rewrite, để hiểu được toàn bộ câu chuyện, bạn phải đọc song song Rewrite:Side-B và Rewrite:Side-R.

Tiếp tục là chặng đường khám phá những bí ẩn và sự thật không ngờ đến của Câu lạc bộ Nghiên cứu những điều huyền bí, với Tennouji Kotarou, Kanbe Kotori, Senri Akane, Ohtori Chihaya, Nakatsu Shizuru và Konohana Lucia. Chuyển thể từ visual novel của công ty Key vào năm 2011. Key cũng là nguyên tác của các visual novel và anime nổi tiếng như AIR, Kanon, CLANNAD, Angel Beats!.

title: Kimi o Chuushin ni Sekai wa Mawaru
description: One day, Kayo is caught playing games on her PSP by her teacher, Haibara-sensei, and it ends up getting confiscated. Enraged, she goes to his office after school, where she finds out he isn’t what he seems.

title: Isn't the Contrast Cute?
description:
It's all about contrast here!  
  
The most handsome boy at school, who seems cold and arrogant, is actually afraid of talking to girls! The gentle and talented top student is really the cold-blooded prince of a gang! The carefree and unkept girl, is, in fact, a young lady from a billionaire family! The sharp and sexy senior is a girl who can’t resist cute things! Their so-called ‘super stern’ teacher is, in reality, a fujoshi who ships her own students!   
  
Jiang Zhiling just wanted to find a part-time job and make some pocket money to support her father’s pursuit of invention. By accident, she discovered who all these people really were underneath their masks. Soon, she began to think she was attending a school filled with fakers!

title: Ikiteru Kimi ni Hanataba wo
description: This one-shot concerns a boy who plants flowers and a girl who eats them.

title: More than a Friend
description:
Life is hard enough as it is without the complications love interests bring. However, it becomes even more complicated when the interest in question is a friend. How does one choose between what is right and what is wrong? The male friend you've always been with or the one that's recently come back?

This is a set of five short stories about the trials and tribulations of five different women:
1) Diamond
2) Only 5 cm
3) Inside the Mosquito Net
4) Inside the Mosquito Net 2
5) Hide and Seek

title: Oniyuri-san and Himeyuri-san
description: On campus, student council secretary Oniyuri Itsuki and student council president Himeyuri Shizuku are popular total opposites. While their respective fans are divided into factions, their actual relationship is….!!

title: Under the Cherry Blossoms
description: Short story about a teacher and one of his student and the weird habit they catch out of the blue one day.

title: Reversi
description:
Nitori Aoi has a self-proclaimed fetish for tanned skin and splendid muscles. What will happen when Aoi's friend puts Tsukamoto Mizuki, her favourite tanned boy on library duty with her?  
  
Pt/Br:  
Nitori Aoi tem um fetiche autoproclamado por pele bronzeada e músculos bem-definidos. O que vai acontecer quando a amiga da Aoi coloca Tsukamoto Mizuki, seu moreno preferido, para fazer as atividades da biblioteca com ela?

title: Yowamushi Danshi, Renai Hajimemasu
description: Kawachi's enjoying another day of watching (more like stalking) his favorite guy, the very nice Yuto Shinozuka, from the shadows. As he's peeping on Yuto putting away some stuff in the gym storage room, something unbelievable happens…! Caught witnessing Yuto showing his true self, Kawachi panics and blurts out that he'll keep quiet if Yuto pleasures him! Kawachi feels terrible because what he's doing is basically blackmail! But, he just can't help himself. A relationship that starts with blackmail… Can it work!?

title: Omote demo Ura demo Ijimerareteru (Official Colored)
Marriage Royale
description: Marriage Royale's story revolves around the male protagonist, a high school student named Tsukasa Hinomoto, who is told one day by his parents that he was adopted. Furthermore, they tell him that his real father is a manager of a large company, meaning he is very rich and holds a lot of power. Tsukasa's real father wants his son to marry a good woman, so he sets up an event known as Marriage Royale. Beautiful girls from all over Japan will come together at a school built especially for this event and vie to become Tsukasa's fiancé. The school is located on an isolated island near Japan, and Tsukasa himself is taken there to live in a mansion in the care of two twin maids: Miku, the elder sister, and Miu, the younger.

title: Hyakki Koiran
description: One day, Unohana unexpectedly meets two brothers — and they both happen to be demons. Nobody can see them except for Unohana, a schoolgirl who can see what nobody else can see. But when she is attacked by the spirit of a black dog, even more strange forces are awoken.

title: Oh My Boy!
description: Just because of his short stature and his sweet and adorable looks, Arya has only ever received rejections from his crush, Saras. Tired of getting his heart broken, he decides to move on by changing his appearance and becoming the ideal Saras likes as revenge. Unfortunately for him, it seems the universe plans to test him for a while longer.

title: Kirakira no Hibi
description:
1-5) Every morning high-school student Nanami catches sight of this one surfer he secretly begins to admire. Incidentally, however, it is later on a certain day that they reunite in a classroom! Turns out that this one-year-older senpai, named Shuu, is in fact one who, while characteristically mature, is unsociable to the extent that he’s even notorious for being someone difficult to approach. Even so, for some reason, Nanami becomes the sole person that he can smile at and laugh with, over and over again… As they repeatedly spend more time together after school, by midsummer, Nanami finds himself receiving a kiss near the seaside?! And so, a story of dazzling first love ensues.  
  
6-7) Kamatte Kawaii Hito  
In order to overcome his debilitating fear of cats, Natsumi Hayato goes to visit a cat cafe. But could his reaction to one of the staff he meets there be even more difficult to conquer than his phobia?

title: Ao to Sakura
description: Fujieda Ao, một học sinh cao trung không hoà nhập được với lớp của mình. Sau giờ học cậu hay đến thư viện nơi cậu gặp cô ấy. Cô rạng rỡ, vô tư, và hay cười; đối lập hoàn toàn với cậu. Cô ấy tên là Hidaka Sakura. Ao dần bị Sakura hớp hồn. Từ cuộc gặp gỡ ấy, hạt giống “tình yêu” đã dần nảy mầm.

title: FLOWERS - Alternative Ending Coupling Relay (Doujinshi)
description: A sequence of one-panel comics of alternative pairings, mostly related to non-canonical endings of the FLOWERS games, arranged as a relay.

title: Onna no Ko wa Koi o Suru to Mousou Shichau ndesu.
description:
"With my beloved boyfriend I want to do that and this…" Every girl who's fallen in love before will nod because they're full of "No-Good Fantasies"! This should fill your maidens' hearts for sure!  
  
  
1) Do you Really Love me? - Minase Ai  
I love him but he's from a different world… that's how I thought but then I caught Itou-kun kissing my desk, is it that he likes me….  
  
2) Invention Princess - Kumagai Kyoko  
Shizuka - super genius inventor has continued to look at her first crush since she first approached him at age ten. Originally to capture him she created useless inventions in a crazed rampage of wild delusions.  
  
3) Why the Boy Reads Shoujo Manga - Hattori Miki  
The one Rinko likes is the kind, cool, honest shoujo manga hero Jun-kun (two dimensional). She's fast approaching a dream as she has feelings for Sekimoto Mako!?  
  
4) Public Moral Committee Chairman's M Note - Souda Momo  
I, the public moral committee chairman sneakily wrote erotic delusions on a secret

title: Mekakushi no Kuni
description: Mekakushi no Kuni is the story of high school student Outsuka Kanade who can sometimes see a person's future with a touch, and transfer student Naitou Arou, whose ESP is limited to past events. When Kanade glimpses an unfortunate incident coming, can she change it? She soon befriends Arou, who's no novice. While Kanade's power is limited to the near future and is somewhat uncontrollable, Arou's is permanent and he can even use it to see an object's "memories". Are these teenaged seers of the past and future made for each other? And who's right: Arou with his "hands off" policy about meddling in people's lives, or Kanade whose more proactive stance has already had unhappy consequences?

title: School of Romance Fantasy
description:
"My school suddenly turned into the romance fantasy novel I was reading?!"

Sanho, the protagonist, becomes the only commoner at a prestigious academy academy and the only one who remembers the real world.

While she's still trying to make sense of the bizarre situation, a sudden mission alert pops up.

To uncover the truth behind this strange new world, she must complete missions that involve winning over three male leads...

In a world unknown, can Sanho complete the missions and face the truth?

title: Heaven at the End of 4th Floor
description: A ghost cannot move to their afterlife if they're holding a grudge in this world. While trying to find out why she's still stuck at her high school, ghost girl Yoon longs to have a living friend. One day, a handsome boy named Sean visits her in the utility room, and he willingly becomes her friend. They soon become best of friends, but Yoon finds out that Sean is suspiciously involved in her death.

title: Dei Ecchi Ei
description:
Ai Shiratori is your average junior high school student with a crush on a boy, Hikaru Kamishiro. With a love so rampant and true, and an imagination as wild as any girl's Ai sometimes has rather… ecchi dreams. But none of those dreams could ever prepare her for the reality that came to her in the form of the Archangel Raphael.  
You see, Hikaru Kamishiro is not your average boy. Hell has plans for him and Heaven isn't about to let those plans come to fruit. While Hell sends their Hell's Apostles to get Hikaru to commit the seven deadly sins and drag him into hell, Heaven sends their secret weapon: Ai. What is Ai's mission? Nothing short of consummating her love with her beloved Hikaru… but wait by consummating you mean… sex?! Can Ai handle the Archangel's request and save her true love?

title: Tensei shitara MOB deshita
description:
One day, Grete, the daughter of a viscount realizes that she has been reincarnated as a character of an otome game. But that character is neither the heroine nor the villainess - she is, unexpectedly, a mob character! Moreover, it turns out that if she continues to live according to the scenario, she will be caught up in a fire at the magic school she attends and die without a moment's notice.

As a measure to avoid the death flag, Grete transfers to the Department of Potions and Medicine, which has zero applicants every year, and aims to become a pharmacist!
However, a super-beautiful elite teacher arrives as the new head of the pharmacy department, and she has interactions with the heroine and the villainess... She just wants to survive quietly, but for some reason, she often attracts attention.

The unlucky woman's struggle to survive in another world is about to begin!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Who Wants to Be Girl
description: My queen I love secretly became my best friend! And my good friend was in love with me secretly? Waking up, young boy HaoXi Chen found himself became an adorable girl, WTF!! His world is totally rocked. His queen Eirwen Luo became his best friend, his best friend Feng Hou had a hidden love for him, the rich girl Zyna Liu got close to him, and those bad boys and the president of the student union appeared in his life in turn. Moreover, why is there an unreliable boy who views himself as a great man. What’s wrong with my world?

title: Spica ~Chika Umino's Early Shorts Collection~
description:
A collection of short stories originally published in Japan between 2000 and 2004:  
* Fuyu no Kirin (April 2004)  
* Spica (October 2002)  
* Midori no Koiru (August 2000)  
* Hana no Yurikago (December 2001)  
* Yuuhi Candy (June 2000)  
* Innocence o Machinagara (February 2004)

title: We Met in Ueno
description: The meeting in Ueno between Lin Ge and Hiroki Asano began with a misunderstanding, but the two gradually built up their friendship despite language and cultural differences. This is a cute and funny story of a Chinese boy and a Japanese boy!

title: Saint Mariya
description: Mariya enters Graad Academy and looks forward to her school life. However, something strange occurs in the auditorium due to a mysterious evil action...

title: My Heart That Beats for You
description: Who says that girls must be innocent, cute and sweet? And who says that quiet and cool guys can’t have the heart of a maiden?

title: B.O.D.Y.
description: Everyone thinks 16-year-old Ryoko has weird taste in guys because she can't stop drooling over Ryu, the strong silent type who sits next to her in class. When she discovers he works for a host club–where women actually pay men to date them–will she finally wise up? Only one thing's for sure in B.O.D.Y.–you can't put a price on love!

title: Mascara Blues
description:
1. Mascara Blues
