title: Shoujo Kageki ☆ Revue Starlight - To Love Is To Suffer (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya wonders how she should go about showing her affections to and asking to spend more time with Claudine. Navigating one's first love is quite difficult.  
  
Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki ☆ Revue Starlight

title: Can You Hear Me
description:
During a big campus carnival, five people escaped to the beach to play a card game.
Lin Weixia then got the chance to ask Ban Sheng a question.

Lin Weixia: "What do you want to be?"
Ban Sheng: "A shark." He then paused and asked, "What about you?"
"A fish tank." she answered.

Everyone knows that sharks and fish tanks can never be together.

The handsome and arrogant boy × the cold and cool academic girl.

title: Manken no Kyuu-san
description: Kyu-san, A cupid that loves manga, comes to the human world to draw manga. Today, a love consultation might get her the material for the next story!

title: Take Dake Dake! - Takedakei Gentei
description: Bushido Academy gathers people who are descendants of the military commanders from the Warring States Period to fight for leadership. As Takeda Shingen's descendant, Takeda Tetsuro is forced to join Bushido Academy. Joining him is Sanada Rieko, who is descended from Sanada Masayuki, a loyal retainer of Takeda. Can they unify everyone together in a school where various warlord students battle for control? The curtain rises on this magnificent picture scroll featuring a Warring States themed academy.

title: Debiluzu Hanii
description:
Popular phys-ed teacher Toshimitsu Sugaya has been given the assignment of keeping an eye on a gang of thugs in the school, particularly their leader Tatsumi Yoshino, the "Devil of Nami High." However, he soon finds out that not only is Yoshino a decent guy, but he's been idolizing Sugaya for over a year! It doesn't take long for Yoshino to win over the reluctant teacher and the two start a secret love affair. Can a teacher/student relationship really work and how long can these two hide their secret?  


---

title: Mugen Spiral
description:
From Tokyopop:  
Yayoi, a spunky high school girl, has inherited spiritual powers from her mother, and she uses these powers to protect people. During a fight with the devil Ura, Yayoi's power turns the devil into a black kitten. Now, even though Ura doesn't hide his desire to "eat" Yayoi's power when he gets the chance, they develop an interesting relationship: the two begin living together, and Yayoi takes her new feline "friend" on her adventures.

title: Mamore! Shugomaru
description: Being a bodyguard isn't easy, especially when you’re a danger to everyone around you!

title: AniHina
description: Take one Ronin, an academic failure, and drop him into a dormitory where 5 women reside. Add a little clumsiness and what do you get? Humpty Dumpty? The Three Stooges? Well…sort of. Keitaro Urashima is a dunce. He's been trying forever to get into Tokyo U with little success and what's worse, his parents kick him out the door. When turning to his grandmother Hinata for help, he stumbles upon a group of crazy women whose worlds he turns upside-down. And maybe he does get a little love in the end, if the giant onions and earthenware don't kill him first. Of course…that's after the ladies are through with him. This is a humorous tale of a guy surrounded by women who strives to make into college while being kicked in the face with a lot of hard-knock love on the way.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni - Hirukowashi-hen
description: Rena has fallen in love because of the Beads of Fuwarazu, a hidden treasure passed down in Hinamizawa! Who will be her love interest...? Rena runs amok, Keiichi and his friends try to help her, and Hanyuu can do nothing!

title: Orange x Dreamin' Sun
description:
A series of 10 episodes from the Orange x Dreamin' Sun crossover that Takano-sensei published on her social media accounts.  
  
Twitter (JP): [@manga\_ichigo\_t](https://twitter.com/manga_ichigo_t)  
Twitter (EN): [@ichigo\_takano](https://twitter.com/ichigo_takano)  
Instagram (JP): [@ichigotakano111](https://www.instagram.com/ichigotakano111/)

title: Ultra Maniac
description: At first glance, Nina Sakura seems like a typical teenage girl. However, she's actually a transfer student from a witch school! Now enrolled in a Japanese middle school, Nina is hoping to improve her grades, make some friends, and practice love spells on her unsuspecting new classmates. Shy Ayu Tateishi has just made a new friend at school. But this new friend, much to her surprise, is no ordinary classmate. Nina Sakura may look like a normal middle school girl, but she's got a big secret. She's a witch. Or, rather, she's studying to be a witch. And apparently, she's not doing her homework. Her spells are devastating in their ineffectiveness and often result in the most embarrassing situations for poor Ayu. But things wouldn't be so bad if Nina's sorcery didn't make Ayu look silly in front of the one boy she secretly adores. All she wants is a simple love potion. What she gets, however, is a new best friend who almost flunked out of witch school!

title: TRANS BOY
description:
Sorato Kenzaki is an ordinary boy who attracts not so ordinary women. He constantly gets confessed to by weird, and often dangerous, girls. So when a rich ojou-sama asks him to become a hero he plays along and agrees. But lo and behold he actually gets transformed into a superhero!
___
Originally published in *Weekly Shounen Jump 2004 No. 37·38*.
Compiled in *Official Databook Perfec To Love Ru!*.

title: Katakoi Triangle
description: Sekiya-san of the cultural library has an unrequited love for Yuuki-kun. The one who cares about Sekiya-san is the popular Kasai-kun, who is also Yuuki-kun's friend! And, what's this? Yuuki-kun is rooting for Kasai-kun?! It seems that everyone's feelings are one-sided… or are they?

title: H₂O - Footprints in the Sand
description: Takuma Hirose is a young, male high school student, who is blind for unknown reasons. After his mother died an unexpected death, it left a deep emotional scar on him, which caused him to become very lonely and reserved. Due to this, Takuma and his father move from the city out into a rural area and Takuma is enrolled into a new high school. At his new school, he meets several new girls, three of whom he gets to know the most out of anyone else. They are, the firm and obstinate Hayami Kohinata, the kind and obliging Hinata Kagura, and the cheerful and mysterious Otoha. As Takuma interacts with these girls, his medical condition gradually begins to heal.

title: Jigoku Sensei Nuubee NEO
description:
In this sequel to *Hell Teacher Nuubee*, former student Inaba Kyoko has grown up and followed the path to becoming a teacher! Now, she's going to teach 5th grade alongside the teacher who inspired her, Nueno Meisuke, called “Nuubee”. Nuubee was an exorcist teacher who, with the help of his Demon's Hand, guided his students safely through many supernatural dangers. Together, they will now get to know their new class, and help them safely through difficulties both supernatural and mundane!
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/nube_off)

title: Please Tell Me Today's Fortune!
description:
My day always starts with 'Today's Fortune'. I follow whatever it says including lucky colors, places, and objects. What?! I'm going to receive a love confession today? I've been waiting all day, but there's no news. Suddenly Eunchan, the most popular boy in school, confesses to me!  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/rmqhada)

title: Can't Go Too Far With the Unrelenting Duke
description:
How can her one-night stand be her student's guardian? Amelie escaped her life as an abused housemaid and became the youngest professor at the Royal Academy. When a prophecy reveals that the person she marries will die an untimely death, she decides to spend a passionate night with a handsome stranger before succumbing to her destiny. However, she is shocked when she comes face to face with her one-night stand again, for not only is he her student's guardian, but he's an unrelenting duke who will stop at nothing to win her over. Will the star-crossed lovers beat destiny and find their happily ever after?

[Official English version](https://www.pocketcomics.com/comic/8297?languageCode=en)
[Official Korean Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=6531518)

title: Ura Sekai Communication
description:
Gold Award in the 21st Dengeki Grand Prize.

Later published in Weekly Comic Dengeki Daioh magazine in September 2014.

title: It’s Neither Windy or Rainy, and nor Is It Clear
description: This is an era of concealing oneself. Who can see through the frivolous wholeheartedness or the stubbornness underneath the scar? Lin Zhi Leng, who is strong on the surface, has always believed in liking gentle and soft herbivore men. Until one day, a guy who has an evil smile appeared at her side… From there it began. A story only belonging to them began: Perhaps there is no sympathy in this world, but I am willing to accompany you and stay at your side forever.

title: Toshishita Oukami-kun wa "Mate" ga Dekinai.
description: Our first meeting in 10 years... and we're hugging each other while naked?! I'm now living under the same roof with my childhood friend who went overseas and came back a very good-looking guy. On my way home from work, I got caught in the rain, so I hurried back to take a bath. That's where Yoshiki, who had been away for 10 years, was taking a shower! Despite the situation, he just said? "It's been so long!" and started to hug me! Yoshiki used to be a shy cry baby who I protected as a younger brother, but now he's a totally different person. He's very friendly, quick to hug, and kisses me while saying? "Let's get married."...Is this what happens to everyone who goes overseas?!

title: Carbonard Crown
description: Fujisako Aiko is a girl attending Enishida Academy. One day she happens to see some foreign looking girls at the academy that are her age. She befriends them and one is cold and pretty, another is cheerful and happy. However she soon finds out they are a royal family from another kingdom!

title: Amakute Zurui Wana no Naka
description:
A cool and cunning guy, Jun-kun has stolen a kiss away from Momo! She is supposed to have no luck with love but a sweet storm has finally arrived!  
  
Included one-shots:   
Torokechattemo Ii no?  
Himitsu no Sankaku Kataomoi

title: Ie wo Oidasaremashita ga, Genki ni Kurashiteimasu ~Cheat na Mahou to Zense Chishiki de Kaiteki Benri na Second Life~
description: Lela is a reincarnated girl who was banished from her parents' home and raised in the middle of nowhere. Thanks to her spartan education for gifted children, she has grown up to be a splendid, brainy young lady! She uses her knowledge from her previous life to create useful magical tools, but when she is accepted into a nobleman's academy...? She falls in love at first sight with a handsome knight, gets into a fight with her half-sister, and has a string of unexpected troubles...?

title: 50 Pixel Days
description: Bori Kim's grades are suffering from her constant doodling in class. However, once her drawings catch the attention of a startup game developer, she finds herself with a new job as an illustrator for a dating sim, as well as developing a romance of her own…

title: Tonari no Kanata
description:
Collection of 4 oneshots  
  
- Nostradamus to Sakaki-kun (Nostradamus and Sakaki-kun)  
A girl meets a boy who can see the future — what will happen?  
  
- Himitsu Mittsu (Three Secrets)  
  
- Tonari no Kanata (Together But Apart)  
  
- Keep a Diary

title: Kiss made, Ato 1-byou
description: Izuru said he'd stop one second before he kissed Rikka… So why are they really kissing right now!? Rikka's first kiss is on stage performing a play…! Rikka and Izuru have been friends since they were kids. Izuru's always bossing Rikka around. Rikka has to write the script for their school festival play, which is a relief because at least she can steer clear of Izuru, who's playing the leading role of the prince… But on performance day, the princess gets sick, and Rikka has to take her place! She's dreading the final kissing scene. They're just supposed to pretend, but now… their lips are… touching…! She knows it's Izuru… but he looks like a handsome prince, and… he's actually kinda hot…

title: Kunoichi Joshikousei Otonashi-san
description:
Otonashi-san has just transferred into a perfectly ordinary high school.  
Silent and impassive, she's actually a kunoichi, a female ninja! (Not that she hides it well…)  
See what a ninja, the famous traditional Japanese hero, would be like as a high school girl in this off-beat, four-panel manga!  
Don't miss Otonashi-san's quirky appeal!!

title: Pure Love Seasons 1: Haru - Hajimete
description:
Collection of short stories.  
  
Gekou Jikoku Made Ato Go Fun by Makita Nao  
This is a sweet story between a humorless boy and a bubbly girl. They’ve never talked to each other, but one day they’re trapped in the same room. What will happen to them?  
  
Sakura no Kioku by Yoshinaga Yuu (originally included in volume 2 of Hatsukoi Asterism)  
Her graduation ceremony is approaching. Because she wanted something else, she decided to break up with her boyfriend, but…

title: Nijipuri
description: On the last day of school, Mihane confesses to her senpai the long-term admiration she's had for her ever since they met, as well as tells her that she will try her best to enter Niji no Oka Girls' Academy next year, the school to which her Senpai is going to attend. Now, one year later, she's managed to pass the entrance exam to the prestigious school and is taking the bus to the school. Unfortunately, she takes the wrong bus, but encounters an interesting first-year girl, like her, that is also set to attend Niji no Oka Academy.

title: Shuuden Elegy
description:
Kenji and Tama first met on a station platform. Tama's eyes were red from crying after being dumped by his boyfriend and he was curled up like a ball, just like a cat. Under his watchful glare, Kenji actually thought that "love at first sight" really does exist. Even though Kenji falls more and more in love with him every time they meet, Tama still laughs and cries whenever he talks about his ex-boyfriend. Yet, suddenly, he kisses him…  
  
"It's because I like you that I want you to cheer you on."  
  
"I want you to know that such kindness exists, too."

title: Hanipman!
description: Returning student Do Sang-gu. Ko Young-hee, the center of the top idol <Sugar Red>, appeared in front of him, who suffered from health anxiety and trauma from an accident as a child. Because of the delicious scent, she felt for the first time in her life, she chases after Sang-gu, a poor returning student...?

title: Onaidoshi no Onee-san
description:
This one shot was release in Comic Alive March 2014 by the Mangaka who did Neptunia and kono naka ni hitori imouto ga iro.  
  
A snapshot of a pair of twins. One's a ditzy, big-boobed oneechan, while one is a typical younger twin otouto. Ecchi ensures.

title: Watashi no Uchuu
description: Upon transfering to a new school Alice meets Uchuu, a gloomy classmate.  He reveals to her that their world is a manga of which he is the protagonist. With this revalation Alice starts occasionally noticing text bubbles appearing accompanied by the feeling of being watched.

title: BanG Dream! - Kokoro Adores Misaki (Doujinshi)
description:
A short, but wholesome Bandori (fandom) work by fnyn\_yc also known as NuN.  
  
Original Source: <https://twitter.com/fnyn_yc/status/1216091498233520129?s=21>  
  
Artist's Twitter: <https://twitter.com/fnyn_yc>

title: Absolute Duo - Tea Party
description: Absolute Duo - Tea Party is a spin off of the original series. this spin-off focuses on the girls and summarizes the events to the chapter 5 of the manga and finish introducing a new character.

title: Super Darling!
description: It’s not that she tries to keep to herself, exactly: It’s just that everyone seems to look right through her! Naturally, Sakuya Tohno has a complex about it. She says she’s just like air: ever present, but never seen. All she wants is a friend, but building relationships isn’t exactly easy for someone who is, for all intents and purposes, invisible. But then she hears a legend about the “Thousand-Year Sakura” and how, if one makes a wish beneath its perpetually-blossoming boughs, it’s sure to come true. So in a moment of desperation, she races to the tree, only to find four very attractive boys waiting for her… And at that moment, beneath the cherry blossoms of the ever-blooming Thousand-Year Sakura, something incredible happens!

title: Hajimete Koi o Shita Hi ni Yomu Hanashi
description:
Junko Harumi went through high school prioritizing her studies, in order to get into the University of Tokyo. Nevertheless, she failed her exams. In the end, she entered a lower-ranking university and ended up working as a teacher at an average cram school. And, by the age of 31, she hasn't gotten married yet!  
  
Since then, Junko's become disheartened, and, despite how unpretentious her current employment is, she's walking on thin ice because of her lack of productivity! Everything seems hopeless, but could it be that a delinquent student would turn her situation all around!?

title: Ichi Ni no San!
description:
While messing around with each other in junior high school, Choco groped his best friend Bun's chest. From then on, Bun has been harbouring impure feelings for Choco. But the naive Choco straightforwardly declared: "Bun-chan, I like you!"  
  
Bun knows perfectly well that he meant it in a platonic way. Still, he can't help feeling depressed. To save their friendship, Bun tries his best to hide his true feelings from Choco.

title: Kanojo-tachi no Meshi ga Mazui 100 no Riyuu
description: 相内葉介は自身の生活力の無さから、幼馴染みの香神紅緒に家事全般の世話をしてもらっていた。だが、才色兼備で完璧かと思われた紅緒にはある致命的な欠点が！？　新感覚リアル・メシマズラブコメ衝撃の開幕！

title: Fair Bianca
description: Photography club member Yano received an unexpected confession from upperclassman Akutsu, the handsome but often oblivious school charmer. But Akutsu, having confessed, continues to treat Yano just as he did before. Akutsu's easy acceptance of all confessions towards him, coupled with him treating his own confession of love to Yano as a thing of the past, confuses Yano. Yano becomes more and more aware of Akutsu and also increasingly anxious…

title: Hoshikuzu Shared House
description:
Anzu Nakamori came to Tokyo from a farmhouse in Aomori, dreaming of becoming an amazing model. When she arrives in Tokyo with her head full of dreams, she is delighted to discover that the stylish place she's going to live is a shared house! But when she opens the door to her new home, she finds a man standing there shirtless! An odd first meeting, but one that could lead to something interesting...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Kanetsuji-san wa Oyogenai
description:
Karen Kanetsuji é super talentosa e é a garota mais popular da classe. Um dia, Kawahara Sanpei, um rapaz cujo único traço é saber nadar, descobre um segredo da diva da classe: ela não sabe nadar!! 

Um one-shot do mesmo criador de Harukana Receive e Silver Pole Flowers, Nyoi Jizai!

title: Akiiro Bousou Biyori
description: Aki is head over heels in love with a classmate but doesn't know how to confess.

title: The Young Maiden in Love Is a Carnivore
description: A short story about a young maiden who falls in love for the first time.

title: Awa Koi
description:
*A girl, who wants to love, fell in love with an impregnable guy who refuses to love…*  
  
Club activities were everything for Yuka during middle school. But now, in high school, she will definitely get a boyfriend. She's very excited about it, but…?!

title: Tingling Boy
description: A slight tingle in your heart yearning for love.

title: Mr. Fullswing
description:
Baseball, girls, gags, and one big idiot, that's Mr Fullswing for you. The new generation of sports/gag manga has been born with the release of this insane series. 

Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media Komputindo as **Mr. Fullswing**

title: Konna Mirai wa Kiitenai!!
description: Kayo is a cute and cheerful girl who's popular with guys. She's only 17, and a very bright future lies ahead of her! Oh wait, stop… Actually, maybe not so bright! In order not to have any regrets later she has to try her best and fight for her love!

title: The Flashpoint of Young Men
description: Though he seems completely indifferent to romance, high-schooler Manabu works part time as a writer for an erotic magazine. One day, right when some classmates were about to pick a fight with him, he was saved by Yamaguma, an underclassman. Apparently Yamaguma, who is popular but unfamiliar with romance, is upset about his older sister working at a nightclub. While trying to desensitize Yamaguma of his excessive reaction to Manabu's erotic writing, they…? The heat of their connected hands is the folly of youth. A bittersweet diary of first love.

title: All for you!
description: A volume that filled with cute and naive beginners of love. Yuna has fall in love at the first sight towards the baseball club ace Sanada-senpai. her friend always told her "he is out of your league". but there's no way she could just give up like that?

title: Tonari no Binetsu
description:
This is a spin-off prequel that revolves around the high school life of Kikka and Mashimo before the events of the main series 200 M Saki no Netsu. Release date 23 June 2022.

Because of bullying, 3rd year High School boy Mashimo Chitetsu transfers to a new school. At his new house, he meets his classmate – Kikka Tsumugu. So the school life between the young couple began.

title: Kimikiss ~Sweet Lips~
description: Kimikiss Sweet Lips is a collection of one-shot stories that tells about the relationship of an ordinary high school boy named Aihara with the 9 heroines from the Kimikiss series. This manga is from the same game and anime adaption.

title: Kimi ga Suki
description:
Aki has always liked her basketball club friend, Mase. However, she can’t seem to gather her courage to confess to him. On the day when she finally decides to tell him, she is confessed to by a guy from a different Junior High!! A horrible accident follows and Aki finds herself not being able to choose between the two – Mase, whom she truly loves or Koichi, whom she’ll always feel indebted to…  
  
A related story set after the conclusion of the series can be found as chapter 1 of the [Genshoku Tsundere Danshi Semekare anthology](https://mangadex.com/manga/4537).

title: First Love Lunch Box
description: Despite the fact her mother's a model, (famous for being on the magazine Charisma Housewife), Sae's usually left home alone. And although she has what classmates call a 'sub-space stomach', Sae can't cook. In an attempt to help a friend with her love, Sae becomes closer with a classmate named Yuuki, who works at a cafe. Will Sae actually learn to cook? Will this closeness develop into a one or two-sided love?

title: Melting Summer
description: A kiss in the summer changes the relationship between two childhood friends.

title: Akiba Romance
description:
Closet otaku and school idol 16 year old Aiba Hina announces right at the start that she is going to quit being an otaku, but apparently she was going to stop being otaku because a manga character said he hates otaku. Fujoshi power max!  
  
She tries to sell all her most precious otaku collections at I-books at Radio Kaikan 3F, but ends up getting seen by a classmate who was working there part-time at the register.  
In order to hide her identity as an otaku she decides that the only way to salvage the situation is to assassinate the classmate who saw her in the store!?

title: Where Tangents Meet
description: As Landon and Rachelle venture into falling in love with one another, they hit ruptures in the road. The more they learn about each other, the more they discover about themselves in the midst of encountering jealousy, scandals, accidents, and misunderstandings. Despite the losses and hurt they face together, they reconcile and create an unbreakable bond that guides them not only into a stronger relationship, but also to self-acceptance.

title: Daburu Sutoroberii Bitaa Keikusu
description: Double Strawberry Bitter Cakes is a story that begins when a high school girl, Sachi, who is good at making sweets, interacts with Kurono and Shirahaku brothers who are popular at school.

title: Keigo Shinzo Short Story Collection 2017-2021
description:
Keigo Shinzo's first ballerina-like short compilation in 6 years! 

Love, war, aliens, and disease. Wishing for the days that make you feel shy. The first short story collection in 6 years by Keigo Shazo of "Hirayasumi" which also won third place in the "Manga Taisho 2022"!　
 
The collection includes 8 works that have not yet been collected into tankobon. This is a sentimental collection filled with sparkle, frustration, and hope!

1) Departure (Hibana 5/2017 issue)
2) Izakaya Naisensou (Hibana 6/2017)
3) Bijutsubu no Umino-san to Yamada-kun (Morning 27/2017)
4) Shimizuke no Subete. (Hibana 7-8/2017, 2 Parts)
5) Itsudemo Furatto Nomeru Tomodachi ga Hoshii yo (Hibana 9/2017)
6) Tokyo Alien Brothers Gojitsudan (Vol. Exclusive)
7) Matsumoto Taiyou ni Naritakatta yo (Mangaka-hon Vol. 4: Matsumoto Taiyou-bon, 2017)
8) Akusei Lymphoma de Nyuuin Shita Toki no Koto (Big Comic Original 19/2021)

title: The Girl in the Diary of Unrequited Love
description:
A collection of six short stories centering around romance and family:  
  
1- Musume no Toshigoro no Musume  
  
2- Torikahebaya de Aimashou  
  
3- Genshoku Megane Danshi Hyouhon  
  
4- Machibito Kitari (New Year's Fortune: Waiting for the One)  
  
A chance meeting of two strangers at a train station on New Year’s Eve…  
  
5- Chichi to Musuko to Buridaikon (The Father, the Son and the Yellowtail Radish)  
Micha, formerly Hamada Mitsuru, is gay, in a loving relationship and living as a transvestite in Tokyo. Having kept this a secret from family what high jinx will follow when Micha's father turns up unannounced?  
  
6- Katakoi no Nikki Shoujo (The Girl in the Diary of Unrequited Love)  
Takashi accidentally found his father's diary and in it, it tells a story of his father's love for a girl with green flower hair pin. So who is this girl? What's Takashi going to do about it? Read it to find out the bittersweet story of an unrequited love.

title: After 18
description:
I hate him so much, so why is he always here?

---
Note: In 2023 the author completely removed this version of After 18 from Webtoon and began publishing a remake under the same name.

title: Kanon - Honto no Omoi wa Egao no Mukougawa ni
description:
*Kanon* là những câu chuyện tình đẫm nước mắt tại một thành phố mùa đông tuyết đổ vào năm 1999. Quay lại nơi đây sau 7 năm xa cách, cậu trai trẻ Aizawa Yuuichi lần lượt hội ngộ cùng những cô gái có giao tình đặc biệt với mình từ ngày thơ ấu. Đến khi anh dần nhớ ra những kỷ niệm từng có với họ thì bi kịch cũng lần lượt ập đến, song hành cũng các hiện tượng siêu nhiên kỳ lạ tựa như đang tấu lên khúc nhạc của những mối chân tình mang màu sắc cổ tích giữa đời thường.

Chuyển thể từ visual novel của công ty Key vào năm 1999. Key cũng là nguyên tác của các visual novel và anime nổi tiếng như *AIR*, *CLANNAD*, *Angel Beats!*. Tác phẩm kể câu chuyện của các nữ chính theo góc nhìn của chính họ thay vì của Yuuichi như trong visual novel nguyên tác, và tập trung vào Minase Nayuki khi dành trọn nội dung tập đầu tiên cho cô.

title: Parfait Tic!
description:
Fuuko is a happy and cheerful girl. One day, two cousins, Daiya and Ichi, move into the apartment upstairs. Cold Ichi and mischievous Daiya gave a very bad first impression! All three are going to the same school as well! How will Fuuko's high school life turn out?  
  
Note: Based on the manga, a TW-Drama will be aired by the name "Love Buffet."

title: Kataomoi to Parade
description:
Close friends since childhood, Touma has a long intensifying unrequited love for Takaya.  
  
"I want to be his princess", "He is my hero" – though he has a rough personality and mouth, Touma thinks like a maiden and is hurt every day by his own servile thinking and self-deprecation as he cannot express his love.  
  
And it doesn't help that Takaya has gotten himself a girlfriend since starting university, and as Takaya's "nursemaid" and close friend, Touma can't avoid close contact.  
  
At the same time, club senpai Yonezawa and a mysterious woman have gotten close to Touma; and here starts the harsh and painful changes in unrequited love for Touma –  
  
"But my world is filled even with just one word from you."

title: I Want to Kill the Yandere Prince Everyday
description: Trouble brews for a sucker for pretty faces! A dirt-poor commoner and ray of sunshine, Jiang Jiao Jiao(straight guy) falls for Zhong Ming Yu's (male) looks at first sight! After an unexpected accident, the once cold and aloof young lord has transformed into a dainty, fragile ["Little Sister Lin"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Daiyu), even using his good looks to win the affections of the other party!! However, as their relationship deepens, Jiang Jiao Jiao begins to uncover Ming Yu’s dark, obsessive tendencies and a massive family secret spanning two generations...

title: Kawaii Akuma
description: Akiyoshi Tooru is the perfect student with glasses. Unfortunately, he’s always been told that he was 'cute' and 'pretty' which forced him to develop an inferiority complex as a young man. The very same Akiyoshi received a confession from a boy of rare beauty, Naruse Fuuta. Of course, Akiyoshi rejected the confession from another man. However, Naruse lost it, underwent a complete change of attitude, and attacked him! Now knowing the fearsome nature of Naruse, what fate awaits the fleeing Akiyoshi?!

title: Reset
description: “No matter how many rejections you get, I’ll always be by your side…” Sou, a senior of the basketball club, is Touma’s childhood friend and lover. Although Sou is popular among his teammates and friends, male and female, once he has a steady partner, he gets obsessed with them, and eventually clings to Touma in tears when the relationship ends. Their relationship began in secret when Touma took advantage of Sou’s heart of glass. No matter how deep their relationship goes, Touma is on pins and needles, wondering if Sou will find out the truth. Maki, a teammate who noticed Sou’s distorted possessiveness finds it hard to leave Touma alone…!

title: Qǐng Yǔnxǔ Wǒ Zìháo
description: Cringe incarnate? Desperately forcing the bit? Hopelessly chuuni? The new transfer student, Chen ******, can't stop making a spectacle of himself, turning every day at school into another clown show. But what if there's another explanation? What if, all this time, he's been protecting everyone by waging a lonely war against another world?

title: Usotsuki na Pierce
description: Miku met her first love again years after being rejected by him. The innocent girl from the past still exists, but Miku wears her current self like an armour. Will her first love be able to help her find herself again?

title: Wedding Peach
description:
One day, Momoko is attacked by Pluie, a demon who's after her keepsake ring left by her mother.
Just then, the angel Limone gives Momoko the Sacred Mirror, allowing her to transform into the legendary Love Angel Wedding Peach and drive away demons!
And so, Peach and her fellow angels fight to protect the lovers of the world from demons pursuing them for their "wave of love"...!

title: Boys of Summer
description: Bud Waterson comes to college with raging hormones, and he has to compete with post-teens like him. All the odds seem to be against Bud when his roommate turns out gay and girls he likes don't reply!. When the girl of his dream also turns away from him, Bud joins the baseball team to prove himself

title: Dear My Girls
description: Elizabeth March is one of four daughters from a prestigious family. The only reason she stands out from her sisters' extraordinary beauty and talent is because she's talentless. After her acceptance into the same academy all her sisters are at, Elizabeth encountered a chain of interesting things including getting off at the wrong start with a rich boy named Adrian.

title: Manga-teki Tenkai de Kare wo Otoshitai!
description: Nekota-chan loves her senpai Inumura-kun♂. Nekota-chan is a perfect beautiful girl (?) who is popular at school, and is always full of confidence. “There is no way I will be rejected!” But, no one expected it! Inumura-kun was too much of an airhead and did not see Nekota-chan as a love interest.....! In order to win Inumura-kun's heart, Nekota-chan begins a fierce attack using all the approaches she has learned from the romance manga that Inumura-kun loves!

title: Niexiaoqian Toushijihua
description: I never knew that the boys' bathroom in the abandoned school building stood on the grounds of an old temple, let alone that it's being haunted by a ghost, Nie Xiao Qian. She lost her original form and is now a loli, and as the latest reincarnation of her lover Ning Cai Chen, I'm obliged to restore her original form!?

title: Manabiya
description: Takeru, who just graduated from middle school, learns that his father has suddenly remarried. While being happy for him, Takeru leads, what he believes to be a boring life. His only hobby is taking pictures of things he finds 'nice' with his cell phone. Upon entering high school, he is taking pictures of some cherry blossoms, when he sees a strange foreign girl and accidentally snaps a picture of her. And thus begins Takeru's interesting new high-school life.

title: S no Yuiitsu M no Zettai
description:
1) Solely S, Absolutely M  
2) Jitter Bug  
3) My Dear Cat  
4) Bet!!  
5) Love Planetarium  
6) M's Dejection  
  
[PL] Zbiór oneshotów autorki Reimei no Arcana.

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media Komputindo as **Solely S, Absolutely M** (2022)

title: Asobiai
description: Otani-san is too straightforward with her desires and pleasures, and has sex with many different people. Yamashita-kun is a pure boy who wants to monopolize her. This is a strange love story between these two. They have all the issues of possessiveness, jealousy, fighting, boredom, crying, worrying, moping around, and it's just troublesome. Why do people nevertheless keep falling in love and falling in love? This is a revolutionary work that explores the universal illness of “romance”!!

title: SPACE
description: Chiaki Kirino is a regular high school boy with nothing. No family, no money… and no home in the near future – unless he finds a job before graduation. His heart is also empty, always looking at the same boy, Fujio, never finding the courage to start a conversation, partly because he knows he has nothing to offer. Just being in the same space with Fujio makes him content, or so he thinks. But one day Fujio comes and sweeps him off his feet in a sudden confession. What is really happening, and how should he react to this?

title: Joousama no Inu
description:
In today’s world of computers and cell phones, few people have time for superstition and ghost stories—but that doesn’t mean that they aren’t real! Amane Kamori is a powerful medium from a remote village in rural Japan. Her guardian is Hyoue Inugami, a demon dog whose powers are literally fueled by her kiss! Together they protect humans from vengeful spirits and bring peace to the dead.  
  
But when Amane’s family moves to the big city of Tokyo, all the magical power in the world can’t help her survive high school! Her chilly demeanor and lack of social graces make her a campus misfit. Popularity comes much easier to Hyoue, whose sexy good looks (in his human form) bring him lots of female fans. But Hyoue’s lapdog loyalty to Amane only leads to more woe, as jealous classmates can’t understand what he sees in her. If only they knew…

title: Shutendoji - The Advent of Evil
description:
Demon summoner - what is this? And why?… These are the main questions Touya Douji is trying to answer. Just where should he be looking for them? Maybe, inside himself?

The Doujinshi & Manga Lexicon
[Vol. 1](https://www.doujinshi.org/book/201691/Goumaden-Shutendouji-1)
[Vol. 2](https://www.doujinshi.org/book/201692/Goumaden-Shutendouji-2)
[Vol. 3](https://www.doujinshi.org/book/201693/Goumaden-Shutendouji-3)
[Vol. 4](https://www.doujinshi.org/book/201694/Goumaden-Shutendouji-4)
Vol. 5
Vol. 6
[Vol. 7](https://www.doujinshi.org/book/201697/Goumaden-Shutendouji-7)

title: ON AIR'S
description: ライブ配信アプリって知ってる？　トップレベルのライバー達はスマホ１つで１日に何十万円も稼ぐんですって！　親の借金で超ビンボーな女子高生・橘千代子、通称チョコちゃんはクラスの友達からライブ配信アプリが儲かると聞き、よくわからないままライブ配信を始めてみた！　でも大失敗してしまう！！　そこに現れたクラスメイトの金城萌香から一緒に配信をやろうと持ちかけられてライブ配信を始めてみると、そこには今まで知らなかった新たな世界があった！　ライブ配信アプリの最大手・パピリオライブで配信をはじめたチョコと萌香（モカ）はふたりでON AIR'Sというチーム名を名乗る。いじわるなライバルや凶悪なトップ・ライバー達との激戦を勝ち抜いてパピリオ・ロイヤル・カップの頂点を目指す！

title: Love in the Mask
description: Suh Hyun-bin grew up under the cruel hand of street gangsters, but after her little brother dies, Hyun-bin runs away and is taken in by a rich family to be trained to become a bodyguard. However, she must hide that she is female, and pose as a man. And so, for eight years, she grows up as a cold, male, bodyguard. It looks like she'll be this way forever–until a fateful encounter with Lee Yun-ha shakes her very foundations, and leaves her conflicting with herself, as her feelings of love clash against her feelings of duty.

title: The Box of Letters
description:
Two girls have feelings for each other but neither will admit it. Instead, they play mind games with each other.  
  
Note: This story will make more sense if you're familiar with the casket letters supposedly written by Mary, Queen of Scots.

title: Sensei to Watashi
description: Yoshino Haruka, 16-years-old, substitutes for her sister at an arranged meeting and ends up falling in love with Kunihiro-san… To discover the day after that he is her new home room teacher! How are the two of them going to deal with this forbidden relationship?

title: Chikyuu wa Boku ga Mawasu
description: Shuhei Kurata is stuck. Going to a new school where he doesn’t fit in, standing still as his old friends leave him behind. Watching silently as the woman he loves slips further and further away. He feels detached and out of place, as if maybe it all might be a dream. Perhaps it is.

title: Sound of Bones
description: A selection of short stories. The stories deal with the same themes as Parasyte and his other work, and in only one of them is his art style noticeably more primitive.

title: Corpse Party - Coupling x Anthology
description: Corpse Party - Coupling x Anthology is a 145 paged Japanese anthology manga, primarily based off of Corpse Party, featuring a collection of random stories that does not follow any specific timeline.

title: Kotaro Makaritoru!
description: Kotaro Makaritoru is a manga that follows the antics of the long haired protagonist, Kotaro Shindo, a skilled karate expert, sole member of the Kyokutan-ryu Karate Club and an uninhibited pervert, who spends time feuding with the Student Council and Discipline Committee, along with various clubs within Tsurugamine High School, due to his habit of stealing panties, fighting, and his trademark rule breaking hair.

title: Giant Cinderella
description: Saotome Makoto is a girl with a height of 173cm, due to heredity. Influenced by her other brothers, she grew up being physically stronger than average girls. However, just like any other girl, Makoto wishes to be a princess and the one that will treat her like one is none other than a senior she saved, Ichijou-senpai?

title: Hatsukare
description: This is about Chihiro, a teenager who has only gone to an all-girls school and has no experience with boys whatsoever. One day, a boy that she sees at the train station every day asks her out and thus she begins her first relationship. This manga portrays the up and downs of first love with a good dose of humor.

title: Kimi wo Utsushite Hanasanai
description:
Rio Inumaru, a sophomore in high school, has a best friend, Kagetsu Sarukata, who is a beautiful girl that everyone looks back on. Rio always thought that she was a “draw” with the cute Kagetsu and that no one would ever notice her. However, Haruta is the only classmate who even talks to Rio. Rio has a faint crush on him. However, Rio discovers by chance that Haruta also likes Kouzuki. Rio is hurt and unintentionally leaves the classroom, but her classmate Echizenya, who is always in the corner of the class, chases after her.

Dramatic love story between the best looking guy who acts plain and his cute best friend who is a “complement” of the girl.

title: Koi to Yokubou no Susume
description:
A collection of stories:  
  
- Koi to Yokubou no Susume  
I'm going out with the school's most popular guy. I don't want to be used and thrown out like the rumor say…? (From: Chibi Manga)  
  
- Itazura na Ningyo  
The love story between two childhood friends and the magical legend of a mermaid who can grant a wish of unrequited love.  
  
- Koi wa Beniiro  
Beniko, an old fashioned high-school girl is suddenly forced to eat lunch with the new teacher in charge, Nomoto-sensei… (From: Chibi Manga)  
  
- Kare no Yubisaki  
Moemi has a crush on the new guy at school, and she's not afraid to show it. The problem? His family runs a traveling kabuki troupe—and they're leaving town in ten days' time. Can she win him over before he disappears from her life for good? (From: Shoujo-Sense)  
  
- Bishoujo Ouji

title: Nagi-kun no Okurimono
description: Koyori is a high school girl who wants her childhood friend Nagi-kun to see her as a woman instead of treating her like a little girl…!?

title: Teens House
description: Here, young people, girls and boys, are living under the same roof. Mahiro is living with other people for the first time and everything is making her nervous and exited! Will her destiny will change? Will she find love? Or something else…?

title: Kiss ga Lemon Aji ka Kenshou Shitai Onnanoko
Everything for the Sake of Love
description:
Everything For the Sake of Love  
Akira is a kind girl who loves to be with her friends. Because of her high success rate in matchmaking, her friends have given her the title of "Queen of Introductions" (Matchmaking Queen)! But for some reason, Aki-chan can't seem to get a boyfriend for herself…  
  
Also includes the one-shots:  
If Someone Like Me Would Do  
Chocolate Contest

title: [2♡♡8 Youth] Unrequited Love Defense
description:
There are times in our youth that are awkward, messy, and unforgettable that stay with us forever. In the heart of adolescence, this is the story of first love. 

Mingyu has quietly loved his childhood friend, Jiwoo, for as long as he can remember.
Every time she laughs, complains, or casually drifts closer, his feelings deepen slowly but surely. The problem? Jiwoo has always had a thing for a very specific type: big, muscular "beast-like" guys. That's the total opposite of Mingyu. Thankfully, she’s never seriously liked anyone in real life so Mingyu has stayed in his role as the dependable “guy friend,” standing loyally by her side. But one calm autumn day, his peaceful world is shattered. “Joo Mingyu… I think I’m in love.” Out of the blue, Jiwoo falls head over heels for Kang Taemin, the captain of the school volleyball team. Now faced with the terrifying possibility that this might be her first real love, Mingyu realizes: it’s do-or-die. Determined not to lose her, he sets out on a

title: Kimi Iro Parasite
description:
"The two of us won't be able to break this relationship for the rest of our lives." After a certain incident, high school student, Sakaki, has in essence, been made to follow everything his friend, Nishi, says. Although he has accepted this matter, Sakaki still feels somewhat down about it. While Nishi wants to continue having Sakaki all to himself, Tachibana appeared between them. Tachibana seems to want to get closer to Sakaki however... 
This is a triangle love story of heaping feelings...

title: Love-X
description: A comedy about a puppy love affair that develops unexpectedly

title: Mahoujin Chronocanon
description: Karino, a girl who had been imprisoned, was finally allowed out into the world where magic was the norm. Karino possessed magic power, but she didn't know the proper incantations. So she enrolled in a magic academy with Touma, the boy who rescued her, in order to learn how to use her magic.

title: Hime to Knight to, Tonari no Watashi.
description:
A collection of stories:  
  
1-3. Hime to Knight to, Tonari to Watashi.  
The one I'm falling in love with isn't my knight but I can't seem to forget about him… Just what should I do with these feelings of mine?  
  
4. Bokura no Koi no Yamai  
Her close friend Hiiragi has suddenly forgotten her! Will she be able to get his memories back?  
  
5. Seito Kaishitsu, Megane no Uso. - Kare ga Doku o Haku Riyuu  
Under hypnosis, the megane student council president confesses his love to me?! But wait! Is it only under hypnosis, it is really true?

title: Fantasy Maid
description: Are you single? Are you an otaku? Would you like to buy a "wife"? Do you fantasize about eating, having fun, shopping, and sleeping with her? Can you promise to take responsibility and love her for a lifetime? Would you use your life to pay for a contract? A fantasy that belongs only to you; a maid that belongs only to you.

title: Motto Anata wo Sukininaru Tsuitachi
description:
From Chibi Manga:
"For the first time, I knew, that the innate days I spend with you when we're together, will become a treasure."

1) "The day that I fall in love with you even more" ーーa boy who dislikes his voice and a girl troubled over her naturally curly hair. The first date of a long-distance relationship couple who are going out with the knowledge of each other's complexes......?

2)"Guard dog-kun and birthday" ーa delinquent childhood friend who disappeared 3 years ago. And on her 20th birthday, he came back as a police officer......

3)"Angel-kun's whisper" ーmy friend's younger brother who was as cute as a girl, suddenly visited me on a night that made me want to escape......!?

4)"The graduation ceremony good luck charm" ーa high school couple who are approaching the last day of high school life without becoming 'adults'. They planned an in-school date so they were waiting in the early morning but...?

If I'm with you, even a trifling day will surely become a precious treasure.

title: Sudden Unintended Romance
description:
Ever wanted to hear someone’s thoughts?

Second year high school student Yoo Jin is a girl who’s firm about her ideal type. One textbook example of her particular taste of cool-type handsome guys happen to be the president of their class, Shin Hyunsol.

When a small accident enables her to hear his thoughts, Jin discovers that the inside of Hyunsol’s mind is the total opposite of what she thought it would be!

title: Return
description: Morisawa Kai and Sato Tatsuki are best friends. However, unlike Kai, Tatsuki is completely unreliable, lazy, and ill-tempered. One day Tatsuki takes Kai out driving in his new motocycle only to get into a bad accident that leaves Kai dead. However, Kai's spirit ends up in a body of a girl named Fujii Marika. After seeing how cold and unaffected Tatsuki as well as everyone else was after his death, Kai transfers to his previous school in which he starts noticing flaws to Tatsuki's cool mask…

title: Majime Kyoushi to Youjo
description:
「結婚はまだ早い？　そっか、まずは彼女からだよね！」

マジメと評判の小学校教師・岡本ヒロムにはある“秘密”があった――。学校内では平静を装い、何も問題を起こさない岡本だが、自分のクラスの高野ひなに求婚されて早くも暴走寸前!?

title: Aqua Planet Chronicle
description:
1. Aqua Planet Chronicle
2. Aqua Planet Chronicle After
3. Aqua Planet Chronicle Around
4. Aqua Planet Chronicle Jade
5. Aqua Planet Chronicle Blue
6. Aqua Planet Chronicle Final
7. Aqua Planet Chronicle Monthly Sachisachi

title: Charao-kun to Haraguro-kun no Himitsu
description:
Niina Keito is always surrounded by girls who're into casual relationships because of his showy looks and "playboy" demeanour, but he's actually a pure-hearted shoujo fan who's never even had sex before! On the other hand, there's Takizawa Ryou: the picture of a studious, courteous prince in front of the girls but secretly a mean-spirited guy who doesn't care for them one bit.  
  
These two polar opposites are newly stepbrothers and therefore forced to live under one roof, but this, as well as the fact that their true personalities are completely different from their chosen images, are the two secrets they've both agreed to keep for each other.  
  
But one day, quite out of the blue, Takizawa kisses Niina and says, "Choose me. I'll love you for who you are"!?

title: Usotsuki wa Bakunyuu no Hajimari
description: 少女は、虚無の臨界点に達するストイックな胸を持っていた。 幸せを逃すまいと口にした一つの""嘘""が、彼女のバストを大きく揺るがす！？

title: Kirakira Shousekai
description: Shiho who spend a plain high school life, saved by the popular Fujiyoshi-kun it's the start of a throbbing heart…!?

title: Vanilla to Orange
description:
"Will you kiss me? I'll die if things stay like this..."

Kai, a high school girl, encounters a couple who have broken up over a trivial matter at her part-time job. Just as she was thinking that she wanted to be careful and cherish her own love life, she unexpectedly reunites with Azuma, who had been dumped, at a committee meeting!? While feeling uneasy around Azuma, she is flustered by his help, and then she encounters him again when he is being dumped by another girl...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hajimete, Moratte ii desu ka?
description:
"Things you want to do… Want to do it with me?"   
Yuuki has a list of things she wants to do with a boy and Kiritani wants to help her?

title: Mari Wa Happiendo de Onegaishimasu
description:
The dream of the sharp-tongued and mischievous schoolgirl Mari is to become a housewife by the age of 20. Pretending to be a lady, she is trying to find herself the perfect husband for this purpose. And then the super-popular musician Aoi unexpectedly proposes to her! "Let's me marry you, and you, in return, become my vocalist." A calculating ulcer high school student and a genius musician-dunce: a love comedy about a completely incompatible couple begins!  


---

title: Five
description: Hina has repeatedly transferred schools due to her father's job, and has always dreamed of a normal high school life. At her new school, however, she finds that her class is comprised solely of guys! On top of that, five mischievous boys from her class have taken a liking to her…?!

title: The Devil of Victory
description: Tanakamori Asami, 16 years old. Because of her father’s debts, she’s forced to transfer from her elite school to her current one… Her new school is entirely full of strange people, in fact it’s kinda like a zoo… But there she meets the beautiful Akira. Thanks to the charismatic Akira, Asami slowly, slowly gets used to her new school. However several trials appear to Asami such as her family’s finances, her classmates, and even in love. Her everyday life is bursting open in this romantic comedy!

title: 13 Game
description: On his seventeenth birthday, Amamiya Kota was going to ask his classmate Misora Hiyori out. Tragically, he dies in a car accident but is given a second chance back in the living world on borrowed time. He gets entered into a competition called the 13 Game where other people like Kota who were supposed to die return back to the world and given an option: locate and kill 13 other players or suffer the fate of death. Each player is assigned to a handler, mysterious beings with special powers, who use them as if they were characters in a video game. Kota’s handler, Merume, explains that there are players like him all over the country, each with a unique ability that helps them kill, and Kota has to kill 13 players within 1 year. With his demon hands ability that was inspired from his hobby of magic tricks, Kota must unwillingly participate in this cruel game if he wants to live.

title: Chiya no Kiss de Kimi o Koroshite
description: Subaru is more gallant than anyone, faster on her feet than anyone else, and - she is a kisser. To save the man of her dreams, she sets out on a journey in a strange world of sand and sea. The Arabian Nights of Fate, where a kiss invites you to join the journey!

title: Every Day Class Visits!
description: Mio Yakama is an ordinary elementary school student. At least until her mother takes a rejuvenating potion and ends up going to class with her ...

title: Sensei 〆Shimekiri made Matte!
description:
From Chibi Manga:
It's a secret to everyone that I'm a manga otaku…which was what I intended it to be! The worst guy at school, Subaru found me out, and a love of H is more dangerous than manga!?

title: Boys Love
description: By coincidence two high-school boys who take the same train become friends and more. As their relationship changes, they realize that they are different from others – but are they mistaken?

title: Caterpillar Operetta
description: Yanahara Taichi joined the Acting Club for the first time, but the only problem is that he gets too embarrassed to do anything! As the 3 girls in the Acting Club help him with his troubles, Yanahara eventually gains the courage to do something outrageous, but it only stirs up trouble!

title: Himitsu na Kimi ni Koi o Shita
description:
Listless, lazy, and with eyes that seem to shut everyone out—Naoto Shizu is a classmate shrouded in mystery.

Yuu finds herself drawn to him, and one day on the way home from school she accidentally uncovers his “secret.”

The more she learns, the deeper the mystery becomes, yet her desire to know more about him only grows stronger.
But what is the greatest “secret” that Shizu has been hiding...!?

**A refreshing romance that captures the true feelings of a girl in love!**

(Source: MangaUpdates)

title: Itagaru Kimi ga Tamaranai
description:
The beautiful Moeka Ichigaya has a crush on the fresh and handsome Tamaki, the catcher on the baseball team.
Today, she cheers for her favourite player from the stands so that she can see him in action.
During a game, Moeka's eyes are on...

The ball is crashing into Tamaki's crotch.

Yes, Moeka loves the sight of a handsome man in agony..!
A coming-of-age baseball story about a man who is single-mindedly devoted to his balls is about to play ball!

title: Keyaki Shoutengai Sakura no Yu
description:
Tatsumi Azuma, a third-year student at Keyaki High School, accidentally bumps into and fractures Shunpei Eguchi’s hand. Shunpei Eguchi is a second-year student at the same high school, rumoured to "kill anyone who makes eye contact with him."

Out of fear of retaliation, Tatsumi pleads with Shunpei that he would do “anything”… Who knew that Tatsumi would end up helping out at Shunpei’s family-run Sakura Bathhouse?!

Brought to you by Tsubaki Yuzu, the heart-warming story of a fierce, intimidating junior and a sociable, bespectacled senior!

title: Koi wa Seeno de Hashiridasu
description: Yuka, who made her high school debut in Shintenchi, is the only acquaintance of the baseball club Ace Hiroto...?

title: Between the Stars
description:
Yoon Byeol’s world is turned upside down when his brother, Hyesung, gets into an accident. But when Byeol visits him in the hospital, he’s surprised to find him in an expensive private room and learns that Hyesung received compensation for the incident. When he goes to confront Sung Woon, the person who pushed his brother down the stairs, Byeol is met with another surprise: Woon knows about a dark side of Hyesung that is hard to believe. What is their relationship, and why would Woon push him?

**Note:** only the Korean side stories are explicit with lightsabers. The official English, Japanese, Thai, S.Chinese, and T.Chinese are heavily censored.
