5. Isaki Uta
6. Andou Masaki
7. Manishi Mari
8. Itou Itto
9. Yasuda Kousuke
10. Atou Rie
11. Morino Hon
12. Ueno Meguru

title: Get Love!! ~Field no Ouji-sama~
description:
Sagara Yuki is a high school student who's shorter than all the other guys in his class. Moriyama Miki is the girl who admires him despite his small stature. Follow the hijinks and the romance between Sagara and Moriyama as they become closer and conquer the obstacles to their love! Was soccer mentioned?  
  
Volume 1 is a prequel to the actual series which begins in Volume 2.  
  
* Contains the following short stories:  
  
- I Want to Protect You (Volume 1)  
Yuka is in love with her childhood friend, Haruki. The problem is that Haruki has a peculiar body condition - when people get near him, he gets attacked because of his pheromones. What will happen when they start dating?  
  
- Valentine Nanka Kowakunai!? (Volume 4)  
Moe-chan plans to give Kyou-kun her homemade chocolate, but will she be able to when the rest of the male student population are after it too?  
  
- Mousou Otome (The Delusional Virgin) (Volume 6)  
High school girl Chihiro is, in fact, a shoujo manga author! She

title: Massugu Kimi e
description: "The days when I laugh and the days when I cry, there are words I want to tell you who has been by my side."

title: Haru no Ogawa wa Dokidoki Suru yo.
description: When Fujii Nanami comes across a group of delinquents beating up another boy, her first instinct is to run away. But forgetting what she saw is harder than it seems, and when she goes back to treat his wounds, she finds her fear of him beginning to fade as an unlikely friendship springs up between them…

title: Kare wa Hitsuji wo Kabutta Ookami
The End of Unrequited Love
description: One-sided love master Haeri has a confession success rate of 0%. Yechan accidentally witnesses the humiliating 19th confession scene. Haeri vowed never to like anyone again, but started having a crush on him again, and decided to get Yechan's help to prevent her 20th confession... Will this love be successful?

title: Kimi wa Maru de, Ano Hana no You de.
description:
"No matter how hard or painful it is, I’ve once again, fallen for you…"  
On the day of the junior high entrance ceremony, Hinagata Nazuna fell in love with a second year student, Ichikawa Nao. She soon discovered that he already had a girlfriend, the basketball club manager. As time passed, Nazuna decided to let go of her unrequited love for him and aimed to find a new love interest upon entering high school. However, on her first day of high school, she unexpectedly came face to face with Ichikawa Nao again…

title: 3 Level Combination
description:
From Noctis Op.92:  
What exactly is the difference between a robot and a human?   
  
In a dystopian future in which robots are becoming increasingly commonplace, a young boy named Hogu lives in near poverty with his grandmother and sister. Though he innately possesses a kind soul, he is ostracized by his classmates and frequently bullied. At the beginning of the story, we find Hogu, friendless and alone - until he meets a robot girl…and our story begins.

title: Under the Ceiling
description:
An ever changing (and unusual) love triangle story, set in modern Japan.  
  
Story 4: (by Lililicious)  
Uchida is in love with Nakano, but feels like she can't tell him because she turned him down when he confessed his feelings to her years ago. One day, she sees him with another girl– Kobayashi. The three begin spending time together, Uchida wondering all the while if Kobayashi is in love with Nakano and vice versa. It isn't until much later that she finds out the true object of Kobayashi's affections…

title: Bukiyou / Hero
description: Hanazawa Ritsuki, a freshman in high school, came to know of Sakura Yuu in the early summer of her first year of high school. Sometime later, around summer, Ritsuki witnessed Yuu crying alone in the school building as the sunset. Since then, Ritsuki couldn't ever take her eyes off of him. What was the meaning of the tears and expression on his face? Ritsuki seeks to know the secret of the clumsy hero.

title: Celeb, Binbou Ryuugaku
description:
A poor high school student, Juichiro, who lives a modest life, is suddenly visited by a super-celebrity young lady, Ken, who is very interested in the life of ordinary people.

She has come here through a dubious program called "poor exchange program" and is very interested in the lives of the common people.
Everything from the cup noodles to the vegetable garden in the kitchen is under her observation.

A handsome comedy about the slapstick disparity between the naive and natural Ken and the ocan-type boy, Juichiro.

title: AAA
description: Ogata Aoi is in her second year of middle school and is the president of the student council. The middle school she attends is one of the best in the country and is called "AAA." Aoi goes there to meet her first love, but after a surprising meeting, she's finding out that her first love is a gang leader in the neighbor school, called "CCC" (lowest level). Maybe it's only a coincidence, and that gang leader and her first love just happen to have the same name. After all, they look completely different from each other. But now, Aoi wants to find more about this person…

title: Kimagure Orange Road (Official Colored)
description: Secretly-psychic Kyosuke has just settled into a bustling school filled with brand-new faces, but he wastes no time making waves! With both the shy and mysterious Madoka and the high-energy Hikaru spinning in and out of his life, Kyosuke’s dizzy with the first sweet rush of female attention! But will his instincts lead him into the arms (and heart) of the right girl?

title: Blue Archive - A TL;DR look at Ancient Egyptian Mythology Featuring the Abydos Foreclosure Task Force
description: A TL;DR overview on lesser-known Egyptian Mythology using Blue Archive Students in a light-hearted school play-like educational comic.

title: Hengen no Hanko
description:
Abe Kuzuha is a high school girl, the daughter of an Inari shrine that has been around for generations, and she has always been able to see things that other people cannot. 

For the past few days she has been hearing strange voices coming from somewhere: "A disaster is coming to this land, save that person." While she is worried about the voice, a mysterious boy, Izumi Shinta, suddenly appears to Kuzuha and tells her that he has come to take the "fox promotion test." Her encounter with him sets her fate in motion.

title: Douyara Kanojo wa Uchuujin rashii
description:
My first girlfriend's a dangerous alien!?

In the spring of my freshman year of high school, I got my first girlfriend, but there is something wrong with her.
On our first day of dating, she said, "Actually, I'm not an Earthling!"

I thought she was one of the eccentric types, but, apparently, she's really an alien!?

title: Unmyeong eul Mideusinayo?!
description: As fate would have it, men appeared in front of Jinah who didn't believe in fate! Who will be her fate?

title: Mizuiro Ether
description:
1. Dreading Spring - a girl is sad that her friend will be moving away.  
2. Flower of My Heart - a woman tells her granddaughter a love story from her past. [Extra: Flowers in the Shade](https://mangadex.org/manga/24639/sayuri-hime)  
3. Heart Pendant  
4. Usotsuki Mille-feuille  
5. Aqua Blue Cotton  
6. Tears of Pearl - a girl befriends a mermaid. [Extra: Summer With a Mermaid](https://mangadex.org/manga/24639/sayuri-hime)  
7. Half Moon, Ephemeral and Eternal - about a musician adjusting to her new celebrity status.

title: Tsuyo Girl
description:
Straight black hair and blonde mesh
Large earrings in her ears,
Dark red lipstick on her lips.

Kanzaki Yuki is a college student who wears a strong fashion style.
Despite her strong appearance,
She worries about not being able to make friends,
She is a normal girl on the inside, worried about not being able to make friends, and happy to be called beautiful.

Then she gets the good news that there is someone who wants to be her friend...!

title: Go Off Yourself Optimistically!
description: He did it all for the sake of love. Onodera Yuzuki, a man with an absurd fate, begins his life-threatening confession!

title: Champagne
description: Shunsuke Sakaki is a part-time university lecturer on Western European history. Ema Sakiyama, his student and Roppongi’s top hostess, asks for his help in settling a dispute with a customer who sent back a glass of champagne. With help from Rin, Ema’s friend who is oddly knowledgeable about champagne, it looks like Sakaki is gradually coming to understand the profound world of champagne, but…?

title: Usotsuki wa Shinshi no Hajimari
description:
Do these two men have any redeeming qualities whatsoever? Quirky story with some questionable humor.  
  
Med school student Jonathan pockets psychotropic drugs from the university hospital and deals them to college students. But when he's inevitably discovered by his professor, Paul Thomas Haskins, Jonathan must give up his body in exchange for the professor's silence!

title: Ijiwaru Houteishiki
description: For Mizuki, her life turned for the worse when her long-time neighbor and tormentor Ryohei joined her high school as a student teacher. Now she can't seem to catch a break from him in school nor at home! What can she do now that this sadist keeps leading her around, making her day to day life a living hell?!

title: Sekihan-chan to Sumomo-kun
description:
Watari Maika has been in and out of hospital since she was little, and consequently missed out on most of her school life. Now about to start high school, she is determined to fit in with her new classmates and start from scratch with a high school debut, but manages only a short stay before she again falls ill and is forced to stay home.  
Six months pass before she is able to return, just in time to visit the cultural festival, and as she'd feared, none of her classmates remember her ever having been there - exept for a rather tall, pretty maid with long hair she does not recognize. Watari is delighted to have found someone who remembers her, and immediately pleads for friendship - and now Shun Momoi has missed the timing to let the girl he fell in love with at first sight know who he is out of uniform.

title: Galism ~Renai Joutou 3 Shimai~
description: Adventurist parents left three Ugajin sisters alone in the house and now they are living in freedom paradise! But their parents adventure financer wants the sisters to protect the peace in Manten Academy from the shadows.

title: Senpai wa Ikemen ga Suki
description:
A confession of love!? 💖

Originally published in COMIC DENGEKI DAIOH-G VOL. 145.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/watch/mg966441)

title: Naisho no Kyouko Nee-san
description: Kyouko Shinonome, the strongest delinquent girl in school. She is loved by everyone as an older sister for her perfect appearance, personality, and skills. However, Kyouko has a secret as an "older sister" that she can't let anyone know about: she loves her younger brother, Ayu!

title: Iinchou no Himegoto
description: Ayano, the committee chairman got drunk at a ballgame after party. Next morning, when she came to, she finds herself in Kagura-Kun’s bed! Plus she is in her undergarments?! Kagura-Kun, who is in the same class as her, is the 10th head of the famous Kagura lineage. Having had one night stand with someone so omnipotent, Ayano can’t help but feel anxious. What should Ayano do?

title: Last Summer Sparkle
description:
Every day is more exciting when your best friend becomes your lover...!
Kyouhei is a third-year high school student whose future plan form is still blank.
Lately, Kyouhei has found himself preoccupied—all because his best friend, Eiji, confessed to him.
Ever since the entrance ceremony, they've been inseparable. But now, Kyouhei wonders—will Eiji's confession change everything between them? 
He can’t stop worrying about it, but before he knows it, his heart has already started pounding at the sight of Eiji whose cuteness he never noticed!

title: Hana wa Knife wo Mi ni Matou
description:
1-3) Hana wa Knife o Mi ni Matou  
Kako Saeki is a senior in high school. She has been modeling and harboring her love for her favorite art teacher, Enjoe. Her heart breaks when she finds out that her love is actually engaged. Now, Kako's innocent love takes a dangerous turn when she finds out who he's engaged to…  
  
4) Yori-chan's Feelings  
An insight of how Yori-chan, Kako's big sister, is thinking.  
  
5) Beautiful World   
Near the Ipson village, if you venture into the forest, you'll meet a lonely demon. If he talks to you, he's going to tell you your fortune, but don't expect it to be something good. This demon has been named by the villagers that are insulting fortune teller. One day, a beautiful red-haired girl named Alice becomes this demon's friend. He doesn't want to look into her future, but he might need to.

title: Hanakoi Issaishou
description: A boy and girl bond over bonsai.

title: Re:blue
description:
After graduating from junior high school, Tsubaki got a job. One day, her boss said to her, "You're a loser if you keep running away from your life", which made her decide to quit her job and enter high school!
There, she meets Kira, a very sexy boy who knows Tsubaki's true identity. The first step she takes - what awaits her ahead is a series of days of being loved with no way out!

title: A Yaoi Fangirl Falls in Love with A Real-World Boy
description: My hobby Yaoi was disclosed!? I could get close to my secret classmate, but don't realize my true personality...!

title: Hana ni, Kamitsuku
description:
From KCG Scans:   
  
Suzu is your typical school girl looking to live an ordinary school life…  
  
…Up until she realizes that she's attending a school populated with vampires, who have the ability to attract and hypnotize women for their own thirst.  
  
Then comes Akishiro, a relatively quiet boy but is a vampire, who attacks Suzu and ends up sucking up most of her blood, to the verge of death.  
  
However, what happens when Akishiro develops a weird affection for Suzu, where he can't bear to see her being bitten by anyone else?

title: Houkago, Kimi to Koi o Shite.
description:
Anthology of seven pure love stories.  
  
1. Girl's Revolution - IKEYAMADA Go  
2. Haru ni Naru Made Matte (Wait Until The Spring Comes) - MINASE Ai  
(Also included in [37°C no Boyfriend](https://mangadex.org/manga/8672))  
3. Puberty BABY - CHIBA Kozue  
To Eri, Kaoru is like a troublesome little brother or a cute puppy. She's been taking care of him for fifteen years since they live in the same apartment. She thought he had no interest in girls but that changes when she catches him with a group of girls and flirting!  
(Also included in [7 Genme wa Himitsu](https://mangadex.org/title/5916/))  
4. - SHIRAISHI Yuki  
(Also included in [Akuma de Koibito](https://mangadex.org/manga/2847))  
5. Because, it's love - ICHIKAWA Shou  
6. - HOSHIMORI Yukimo  
7. - HATTORI Miki

title: Fushi no rinne
description: Zen, a girl with the power to erase memories about "herself" from other people's memories, thinks that her power may have something to do with transfer student Ren's amnesia, and decides to probe Ren.

title: Ore ga Suki tte Ittara Dou Suru?
description:
"Be the same reason I am. Everything you do to me."

High school boys Ippo and Tokio have been friends since elementary school. The distance between them, which was once so close they could carry each other on their backs, grew wider as time passed. This was to hide "certain feelings" Ippo has for Tokio. But one day, when he dozed off during class, the feelings he had been hiding started to overflow because of Tokio.

title: Chocolate.
description: "You don't need a reason to love someone, it just happens when someone is really dear to you."

title: Sono Omokage Shitteru
description:
She didn’t want to fall in love, but then she met a boy she was interested in…

Special oneshot by Sakisaka Io, celebrating "Bessatsu Margaret" 50th anniversary since launch.

title: Last Game (Official Colored)
description: Yanagi is rich, smart, a girl-magnet, and always at the top of his class… well, until Kujou transferred in his primary school. She was quiet, plain, and poor, yet not once has she failed at beating Yanagi, both in academics and sports! Yanagi has made it his life goal to defeat her and thus, followed her from elementary until college over the past 10 years. Only when he decides to change the rules might he finally win. Here comes their last game!

title: Kiss Him, Not Me SPIN-OFF MANGA
Kimi to Hamu Hamu shitai no da!
description: Kamiya, who loves small animals, discovers that Matsuyuki, a kendo rival from another school, can transform into a hamster...!?

title: I'm a Robot.
description: High-performance AI Ando Robowo will enter high school for a performance test! A school comedy about Robowo's love and friendship!

title: Boy of the Female Wolf
description:
Eun-soo Cha is the main character of the story. Eun-soo has hated her Mother ever since she was abandoned by her. Raised by her Grandma, she became a wild child that likes to fight. She has even disguised herself so well as a guy that people won't believe her even if she says she's a girl. She can fight well, and is even referred to as hot by girls. One day, however, her Grandma's already bad health worsens, and she promises not to fight anymore. When Eun-soo's grandma dies soon after, she decides to leave Dae-Jeon (where she lives) and goes to Seoul to live with her Mother, despite still hating her, because she has nowhere else to go. There, she runs into one of the best fighters, at her new school, and immediately gets on his bad side. What will happen? Will she break her promise to her grandma? Will love bloom?  
  
Based on the Korean Internet Novel, "암컷늑대의 BOY" by i� 키i조아 (iCookieiLike)

title: Amagami - Dreamy Forever
description:
The one her brother Junichi has fallen in love with is that natural queen Morishima Haruka. And with Junichi longing to the date with Haruka on the upcoming Christmas Eve, Miya who has always cheers him on, is now…  
  
> Part of the Amagami series

title: Rensou Mode
description: Nicknamed “The Prude,” Aizome Maiko is a misunderstood girl who actually has explicit fantasies. When a boy with a delinquent’s face, Yajima Keisuke, ruins her dream romantic encounter, she forces him into slavery by getting him to carry out her ridiculous plan to reach the man of her dreams. What has “The Prude” have in store for Yajima and will her ridiculous plan succeed?

title: The Return Of The Prince
description: Satake Kou attended the wedding of his sister where he was reunited with his cousin, Fumihiro, who used to be a very dumb fat guy – but it seems that he has now transformed into a charismatic prince! Kou became undeniably self-conscious about this while not being aware of Fumihiro's high regards towards him since they were little. Fumihiro's admiration has turned into something complex. How would Kou respond to Fumihiro's feelings?

title: Complex
description: Junichi and Tatsuya are two childhood friends who just so happen to love each other. We explore each step of their lives, from grade school to the golden years, through the good times and the bad, revealing that a relationship between two men is nothing but complex.

title: Michizure
description:
Class president Hashida witnesses a female schoolmate being bullied in an unused toilet in the old school building. Using the excuse that he's gathering evidence, he secretly takes photos and videos of the victim Ayase every day, while she's being made to take off her clothes. But one time, he also witnesses something else...

(Source: Comic Fuz)

---

Additional Links:
* [BookLive](https://booklive.jp/product/index/title_id/1686273/vol_no/001)

title: Between the Lilies is Troublesome
description: Aida, a member of his high school's art club, imagines that Kurosaki-senpai and Mr. Hakuno are in a ``yuri relationship.'' In fact, it was Aida that these two liked! Without knowing this, he is always sandwiched between two girls, and his delusions never end!?

title: Fujishiro-san Kei.
description:
Fujishiro-san lives by the motto "industrious, diligent, sincere, and punctual." But for some reason her eye is always drawn to the mysterious but good looking guy in her class, Kuze-kun. While he teases her, she falls in love?!  
(Not to be confused with the one-shot by the same name.)

title: Mustard Chocolate
description:
Tsugumi Rinko can’t wait to escape the tedium of high school for the challenges and rewards that accompany life at a fine arts college. She only has two problems: 1) She has few social skills and fewer friends. 2) With less than nine months remaining before her crucial admissions test, she has no practical art experience.   
  
Winner of 2011 New Face Award at 2011 Japan Media Arts Festival Awards.

title: Cool na Doukyuusei no 10 Nengo
description:
“Having you sit next to me is... depressing. Don’t talk to me.”

Himuro Kuru—When I first met her in high school, she was an extremely cool, beautiful honor student who wouldn’t let anyone get close to her. But now…

“Hey, hey. Is it okay if I… stay this close to you today?”

Sakuragi Kuru—Ten years later, she’s married to me,  Sakuragi Susumu, and she has become a cute girl who wants to be lovey-dovey with me every day!?

At school, on dates… every time she actively gets closer to me, her cold heart begins to melt…

title: Hoshi ni Ochiru Efude
description:
Ryousei and Shougo are two artists involved in a continuous and ambiguous sexual relationship. Shougo thought that claiming Ryousei as his own would alleviate the feelings of helplessness, regret and loneliness that are plaguing him. Ryousei, although captivated by Shuugo, began to realize that he was just being used.  
  
An opportunity eventually arrives for both Shougo and Ryousei to display their paintings at Shougo's elder brother's art exhibition in Tokyo. Shougo, who has had a complex about his elder brother ever since childhood, thought that "I may be able to return to Tokyo if this goes well", which gradually increased the pressure to succeed. Beneath the starry sky, a paint brush paints a story of youthful love.

title: Ageha 100%
description: Little Rin Fujiwara hated her own face a lot. It was not until her 6th birthday that a make up box she got as a present changes her perspective completely. In front of the mirror, Rin would play with the make up, which becomes like a magic that makes her stronger. Rin believes make up can change both appearance and heart, because it gives the confidence a girl needs. Years later, Rin attends her first high school year. She decides to help other girls there to become pretty as well, using her make up box. Rin, hidden under the identity of Ageha, a legendary make up stylist, with a help from her classmate Kisaragi, who has to hide his real identity by crossdressing as a woman, is willing to do magic in front of the mirror and change girls “just like when a caterpillar transforms into a butterfly”. How to meet Ageha and have her make you more beautiful? Easy, just write your name and class on the butterfly card and put it on the bulletin board on the 3rd floor. Ageha will come for sure, s

title: Ouji ka Prince
description: Tsunagi's a high school girl who admires the famous, beautiful and distant imperial prince: Koji Ninomiya. Tsunagi's life takes an incredible turn with the arrival of a new classmate, Haruhi, who amazingly - and suspiciously - looks exactly like the famous prince…

title: Ousama ni Kiss!
description: On the outskirts of Tokyo, Toubuisazaki High School is known for its mottos of "Yakuza are your friends!" and "Seize the chief's weakness!" Amidst these scary rumors is the king of the school, high school student Maki: a person with an abrasive personality, who thinks of his classmates as servants. It's a mystery that Yoshifumi, the school nurse, loves him.

title: A School Frozen in Time
description: On a snowy school day like any other, classmates and childhood friends Hiroshi and Mizuki arrive at school to find the campus eerily empty. Before long, they find themselves trapped inside with six other friends, and even stranger, all the clocks have stopped at a very specific moment–the exact time when a former classmate jumped off the school roof to their death three months earlier. It turns out that this departed friend is their way out of their current predicament and may even be among their group…but no one can remember who it was that took their life on that sad day. The students must face themselves and their past memories to piece together the identity of this suicide victim or risk a similar fate–with their lives lost and forgotten inside these frigid school walls.

title: Little Busters!
description: Naoe Riki là cậu bé mồ côi cha mẹ. Bốn thành viên của nhóm Little Busters là Natsume Kyousuke, Natsume Rin, Inohara Masato và Miyazawa Kengo đã xuất hiện như vị cứu tinh của cậu, họ cùng nhau chơi đùa và có một tình bạn vô cùng thăm thiết. Câu chuyện sau đó bắt đầu từ năm thứ hai cao trung của Riki, tình bạn của các cô cậu trong nhóm vẫn bền vững. Tuy nhiên không muốn để phí tuổi học trò tươi đẹp trước khi thi vào đại học, họ đã quyết định "sẽ làm một điều gì đó...." Chuyển thể từ visual novel của công ty Key vào năm 2007. Key cũng là nguyên tác của các visual novel và anime nổi tiếng như AIR, Kanon, CLANNAD, Angel Beats!.

title: Blue
description: Anna entered the same high school as the person she loved. But that person is in fact her cousin, Reiji. While continuing to conceal her feelings for him, she begins to suspect that Reiji is in love with Rumi, her best friend. But what is Rumi's real secret…?

title: The Moon
description:
"The Moon" is a giant robot created by the millionaire Baron, spending 2.5 trillion yen (at that time). Baron proclaimed that **"God is Dead"** and created The Moon as a replacement, to serve as a new power to bring justice in a world of wickedness. He entrusts the operation to kids with a pure heart, as he believes only children are the ones able to enact true justice.

Note: Volume count based on the bunkoban.

title: Aisare Seijo wa Yamiochi Akayuku wo Sukuitai
description:
Lacking magical powers, Sphere, the daughter of an earl, has been confined to her mansion since she was a child. When her stepmother and stepsister arrive after her father remarries, she realizes she has been reincarnated as the heroine of an otome game. She immediately uses her knowledge of games to acquire the powers of a saint and enrolls in the magic school where the game is set. Her goal is to be united with Ewald, one of the characters she loved even before her reincarnation. She then goes on to save the villainous character who has fallen into darkness and find happiness.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mikado-Kun, Kyo Mo Biju Ga Idesune
description: A first-year high school boy blessed with exceptionally good looks, in other words "great visuals," the protagonist Ruki Mikado. Constantly surrounded by people and praised daily with comments like "Your visuals are amazing!", he enjoyed his position as the most popular student in his grade. Although Ruki seems to be living a carefree and easy high school life, beloved by everyone and positively received no matter what he does, he harbors a trauma he can never forget...

title: Gakuen Psycho-Pass
description: Spin-off of the series Kanshikan Tsunemori Akane (Psycho-Pass) Tsunemori Akane is a new transferred student at the Psycho Pass Academy. She'll join the Disciplinary Comitee and become involved with its members.

title: Aishite Nai, Kamo.
description: Ema's parents are dead set on marrying her rich and handsome childhood friend Towa, but she has a horrible first impression of him. She also assumes that he also dislikes her as he is only mean to her. But, could that be the case? How about Ema? Does she really hate him as she claims?

title: Boyfriend
description: Hijiki (a girl with an unusual name) has just entered a new school, and on the way there she encounters a mysterious boy alongside a beautiful lake. Hijiki has some secrets of her own, and will this boy be able to listen to her silent pleas for help…?

title: Kimi to Parade
description: Kikuchi woke up one fine morning to a message from his ex-girlfriend telling him that she was seeing someone else. Having to go to work after such a crappy experience, he was faced with his university friend Sera's boyfriend, Akaboshi, who also happened to be his adorable student. Usually Akaboshi is rather stoic and aloof, but in front of Sera, he just brimmed with so much happiness. Sadly, Sera harboured a secret that will threaten their relationship and poor Kikuchi, being Sera's good friend, knew about it. As a result, he is caught in between. It didn't help that Kikuchi's falling for his student too…

title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪
description:
Nanami Haruka is a shy teenage girl who has a dream to become a talented song writer. She is accepted by Saotome Gakuen, an elite entertainment industry school developed for the sole purpose of nurturing future idols. The classes are taught by famous idols; facilities include top notch recording studios and live theaters. Most importantly, only a small portion of the most talented, natural born idol students are allowed into the prestigious Shining Agency after graduation and introduced to the nation.  
  
The school randomly pairs up a singer to a song writer but as fate would have it, Haruka ends up being paired with 3 very different boys all striving to become the next big idol; Ittoki Otoya is upbeat and lively, Shinomiya Natsuki is bright and intelligent, Hijirikawa Masato is cool and calm. Haruka, determined to make all three boys into future idols must work harder than anyone else and overcome her shy personality if she wants to reach her dream.  
  
Based on the visual novel of

title: Matsuri Special
description:
Matsuri is a girl like all the other high school girls. She likes boys, especially one called Wataru, but he hardly notices her even though she watches him like a crazy gal. "Tough girls aren't my type," he once said, and now even three street guys call her a tough chick?! Nothing too good to say to the wrestling Princess. Being this kind of princess is nothing to be proud of for Matsuri so it's a secret that she keeps from her school mates, because it's her father who wants to make her a wrestler…but what will happen when she's discovered fighting those three guys by Arata, the bad boy who can even "fight cows"? Discover it and keep track of Matsuri Special!  
  
[PL] Matsuri Special opowiada o licealistce, która szczególną uwagą darzy swojego kolegę z klasy, Wataru. Niestety, Matsuri nie należy do dziewcząt popularnych wśród chłopców i często nawet nieznajomi chuligani, spotkani na ulicy nazywają ją ‚twardą laską’. Cóż poradzić, skoro Matsuri ma tajemnicę, która skrzętnie ukrywa. Nie

title: Makoto no Koi wo suru Mono wa
description:
Nanase moves to Tokyo to attend university. She dreamed of a bright and exciting campus life, but she fails to make friends and finds herself completely alone. Then one day, she starts talking to Hiyama, a philosophy student she's been interested in for a while who attends the same lecture, and her world begins to shine...

It seems her fateful love must have begun right then...

title: In A Heartbreak
description: After being heartbroken by his crush towards senior, he is immediately confessed love by another senior. Also, they are twins?! It is a tough love between two brothers towards one student.

title: Koi wa Genjitsushugi de Yumemigachi
description:
Two people who met through ivies.  
A relationship that started from a shared secret.  
A man who became the home tutor of a shut-in high-schooler.  
A teacher and student that chose to separate.  
  
Honest, inexperienced, and pure through and through –  
This is a collection of 4 of such love stories.

title: Hatsumei Princess
description:
Super genius inventor Shizuka, a.k.a. the walking National Treasure, fell in love at first sight with Hajime-kun when she was 10 years old. She hasn't stopped pursuing him for 6 years!
Every day, she worked hard to invent something that will get Hajime-kun to fall in love with her.

**Will she ever be able to win Hajime-kun's heart?**

title: Sono Hoshi o Bokutachi wa Koi to Yobu Koto ni Suru.
Love Deathster
description:
"A confession of love with your lives on the line…"  
  
A class of 140 students are brought to an Experimental Town, where a being called 1st claims to be they're "tester" and commands them to display true love for the sake of his test. Confessing your love and having it reciprocated means the pair will be able to leave, but failure means death.  
  
**Note:** Originally serialized digitally through Jump+. Only the first three collections were published physically and all later releases were digital exclusives.

title: Tsuchi no Shita de Matsu
description: The Biology Club operates quietly in the old building of an all-boys high school. There gathers a group of teenagers with their romantic troubles and the resident talkative dog who looks over them. These are their slightly warped and naive love stories.

title: I'll Like You More Tomorrow
description: After being placed in a different class from his usual group of friends, all Do Jihwan wants is to spend an uneventful and quiet year in school. That plan goes down in shambles upon meeting one Kang Chanyoung, a popular and up-to-beat guy who has no qualms in saying what’s on his mind.

title: Change Guy
description: It's nature vs. nurture when a nerd swaps bodies with the toughest guy in school! Tuji and Usoo have swapped…their bodies! After becoming the subjects of a mad scientist's experiment with her latest invention - the quantum teleporter - their bodies are switched, leaving only their minds and spirits intact. Usoo, who was once a model student, must face the life of Tuji, a teenage menace. Never having an enemy in his life, he now has to deal with the handful of Tuji's list, but will his kinder, gentler demeanor ward off his rivals? Or will survival determine his future? Will he become the hardened fighter that matches his new exterior?

title: Granulated Sugar
description: Gosutorai has very shoujo-like dreams, even though he's a boy. He decides that he wants to have his first kiss only at his wedding, and his girlfriend, Kogure Nao, thought that was cute. But dreams are still just dreams, aren't they?

title: from End
description: Shinomiya Rui is a new high school teacher who loves connecting to her students. Rui Hayase, a student with the same name, will not open up his mind so easily to her. One day, Rui is found shoplifting, instructed by his father to do so. The reason for this is…?!

title: Haikei, Niisan-sama
description: Yutaka gets his yearly letter from his beloved older brother, but this summer something about it is different…

title: Our Manga Club
description:
Five students' lives change and intersect. It all happens in our manga club.  
  
Author updates around every month.  
  
**Moderator's Note:**  
Do not report this series for not being of Asian origin, this comic is an exception due to being heavily inspired by Japanese culture and manga art styles.

title: Kyoshiro and the Eternal Sky
description: This is a story about a Kuu, who is thinking about her prince all the time, she has dreams of him all the time, of him telling her to come with him. One day, as she goes back to school, she meets with someone who looks like him. Before long, the story gets complicated with mechas and stuff–what will become of Kuu?

title: Anata no Juni Oshiete Kudasai!
description:
Chiaki Aida attends an all-girls school in the town where her uncle is a teacher, and expects a harem school life, but... real girls are very problematic!

Will Chiaki be able to have a successful school life at an all-girls school?

title: Yumekoi
description:
"Their love was a dream." - A member of a boy band, a very popular and charismatic musician, the guitarist of Dada!! I've been dreaming of such yearning love with a boy, who is just out of reach everyone present. But I really would want to live this love that has become a reality?  
A collection of hearthwarming and romantic stories by Anashin.

title: Ruka to Ita Natsu
description: Toono-kun’s life has gone out of control, all due to a strange accident that he can’t explain. There was a flash out in the school yard where his younger sister Yayoi was doing track and field, and a number of people were injured, including Yayoi. Yayoi was lucky and got out of the hospital the next day – only she doesn’t act like herself anymore. What Toono has discovered is that his little sister is gone, and has been replaced by a soldier named Luca from 31 years in the future – and he alone knows it!

title: Purikyuu
description: Katsuragi Anna is a former ballerina who tries to find herself when her dreams of ballet stardom fall flat. She is tricked into joining the archery club by her friend… only to find that the president is her childhood rival, Jinnai!?

title: Moshi Ano Ko ga Tracen Gakuen ni Itte Nakattara. Spe Senpai no Baai
My childhood friend I reunited with has turned into the academy's prince
Kiken Junai D.N.A.
description: Ami has always been jealous of her little brother Chihiro, who's a popular model for girls' clothing. Now he's old enough to attend her school, and all the boys are crazy about him, even knowing he's a boy! Still, he's her brother and Ami loves him, but are her feelings for him beyond those of a sister for her brother?

title: Utopia
description: The story of two extra-ordinary people in ordinary love.

title: Sailor Suit and Himawari
description: In order to forget her impossible love towards her foster father, she rebounds on any guy she can get her hands on (Amagi), but…??

title: Boku no Sekai Kimi no Real
description:
A collection of 4 short stories.  
  
1) Boku no Sekai Kimi no Real  
Mayu falls in love with Naoki Hagiwara at first sight. For some reason, Naoki seems to look sexy in her eyes. But of course, she can’t tell him that along with her feelings for him. The two get into a fight, but afterwards Naoki seems to be oddly closer to her.  
  
2) My Katekyo-sama  
Emi is unconcerned by her failing grades, but when her mom hires a hot college guy to tutor her, schoolwork suddenly seems much more interesting.  
  
3) Kimi no Omou Tsubo  
Mii-chan is in love with her childhood friend Kaname. But Kaname is four years older than her. Can she ever get him to see her as more than a little kid?  
  
4) Ore no Usagi-chan  
Taichi has confessed his love to Megu. But even though she loves him back, Megu can't date him! She has a secret fear that she is afraid he will discover!

title: Confidential Confessions
description:
From Tokyopop:  
  
Confidential Confessions is a shocking new manga series that deals with many of the hard-hitting issues that teens face today. Using emotionally moving storylines and multi-dimensional characters, each groundbreaking volume tackles such topics as teen prostitution, rape, HIV, stalkers, suicide, and sexual harassment.  
  
V.1 - Tobira (MOMOCHI Reiko)  
1. The Door  
2. Mistakes  
  
V. 2 - Namida (MOMOCHI Reiko)  
1. Tears  
  
V.3 - Memai (MOMOCHI Reiko)  
1. Dizziness
  
V.4 - Itami  
1. Pain  
2. Distortion  
3. Tomorrow  
4. Forbidden Kiss  
  
V.5 - Himitsu (MOMOCHI Reiko)  
1. Secret
2. Wish
  
  
V. 6 - Uwasa  
  
Series order as published by Konansha:  
1: Itami (いたみ) (Pain)  
2: Himitsu (ひみつ) (Secret)  
3: Memai (めまい) (Vertigo)  
4: Uwasa (うわさ) (Rumor)  
5: Namida (なみだ ) (Tears)  
6: Tobira (とびら) (Door)

title: The Timekeeper's Final Summer
description:
“I will die this summer.” Eden is a member of the Timekeeper family, who possess the ability to travel back in time. Their date of death has been set since the day they were born… and the summer of 2018 is when Eden is destined to die. On that fateful day, , he decides to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But Jay, who is straight and only cherishes Eden as a friend, is flustered by Eden’s confession and reacts badly. Caught up in his thoughts, Eden is met with a fatal accident—and thus his time travel begins. He finds himself on the last day of the high school summer camp training where he first met Jay. Given the opportunity, will Eden be able to change anything that happened on that day, 20 years ago?  
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

title: Okamoto Lynn Short Story Collection: Flip Flap
description:
A collection of short stories including:  
- Kimi to Toukan / Exchange with You Murakami likes her mysterious classmate Mako Fujisaki, but she never talk to anyone. He says he has seen her naked and transformed into a raven, but noboby believes him. Murakami decides to confront her to tell him he is not lying but Fujisaki just answers him that he will die if he rides his bycicle. He don't believe her words but soon he realizes Fujisaki's words were true. What will happen to Murakami and who is this misterious girl really?  
- Allumage Kumiko left Japan for LA in hopes of becoming a famous actress, but so far has only managed to get jobs as a stuntwoman. Now that her brother is getting married, she's coming back to Japan to visit, but once she arrives, something goes terribly wrong…
___
**Buy New Edition:**
- [Amazon](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/4088900014)

title: Venus Capriccio
description: Takami and Akira are childhood friends who attend the same piano classes. Compared to the rough and boyish Takami, Akira is more feminine and cute and is also more skilled in piano. Takami thinks of Akira as a younger sister, but one day, Akira suddenly kisses Takami and says he likes her…?!

title: Ameshita Shizuku wa Ase ga Suki
Bit Bit Bit
description: If I met you again, would I be able to make a different choice? A reunion with my first love.

title: Oshiete, Kurogane-kun
description: When it comes to cooking, Haruka cannot do anything right. She develops a crush on Kurogane-kun who appears to be a nice, shy boy. As Haruka strives to get closer to Kurogane-kun she discovers that not only is he secretly a devil, but he is also known as the household prince!

title: Getsuyoubi Kara Kataomoi
description: Despite his one-sided love, a prince at school encouraged his crush to confess to her crush. But he also could not resist confessing to her. What will happen?

title: XX ga Kirai na Joshi nanka imasen!
description: 「××が嫌いな女子なんかいません！」の主人公は、BLマンガ家を母に持つ男子高校生・相良夏樹。BLマンガを何気なく読んで育った彼は、物心つくまで"男の人同士で「好き」って言ってる"世界が普通だと思っていた。やがてそれが当たり前ではないと気付くも、いつしか夏樹は同年代の男と話すとBLチックなやり取りを妄想してしまうようになり、同性との会話を苦手に感じている。クラス委員長の霧島撫子は、そんな夏樹にも優しく接してくれる数少ないクラスメイト。撫子に惹かれた夏樹は、思い切って彼女に告白するのだが、それをきっかけに彼女の秘密を知ってしまい……。

title: BanG Dream! - YSD - Yukina-chan's Seduction Doctrine
description: Yukina wants to romantically convey her feelings to Lisa, but doesn't know how. With the help(?) of her classmates, will she be able to do it with their questionable advice?

title: The Chain of Youth
description: Jia is an average girl who, along with the majority of her classmates, has fallen head over heels for Yoona, a girl so pretty she's practically the school's idol. They're on two totally different levels, but Jia can ignore her feelings no longer! But who is Yoona, really? Stay tuned to see what romance unfolds between these two!

title: Yǔchuān Wùyǔ
description: You Qiuzi. Who in the school doesn’t know her name? With a terrifying aura that screams antisocial, her overbearing attitude and a face laden with heavy makeup repel others with little difficulty. However, under her fierce appearance is a wounded heart, and all that unfriendliness is simply a mask to detach herself from social interactions. After five long years, her mundane daily life was once again lit up by the return of her childhood friend, Gao Tuoyi. At the him who is now both unfamiliar yet familiar, in order to see his smile again, she who is bad at socializing will just have to take action.

title: Nostalgia
description:
1. Makka na Tulip wo Kimi ni (Red Tulips for You)  
Red tulips for you, and you, and you.
2. Nostalgia
3. Kinmokusei
4. Yume no Hanashi
5. Dandan (Warmth)  
Matsuki and Nishimori have been best friends, but when Matsuki develops romantic feelings for her, he decides to confess. His unrequited love means little to Nishimori because she doesn't see him the same way and she's perfectly content with the friendship they have now. Can the flames ever be rekindled or will it remain cold?
6. Makka na Tulip no Hanakotoba

title: Me after you
description: Have you ever wondered what it's like to be a fangirl in secret? Meet Soeyeon, a high school student head over heels for one of the country's rising idols, Minyun. It's a feeling she's ready to hide all her life. But when Soeyeon finds herself in a situation beyond her wildest dreams, how far will she go to keep her secret?

title: 3-gatsu no Hekireki
description: Yori is a first-year high school student who has a permanent disability in one of her legs due to a traffic accident. She ends up having to repeat a grade as she had to take a break for medical treatment and those around her now keep their distance from her. That is until she reunites with Yayoi for the first time in 10 years, a childhood friend a year younger that she doted on like a younger brother. However, Yayoi, whom she has not seen for a long time, seems to have an unusual obsession with Yori, like being extremely jealous of her oshis or telling her to marry him when they first met.

title: Rui ni Tokimeku Hazuganai!
description: Kei, a high school girl, has an unrequited love for her senpai, Kurotaki from the soccer club. When she can finally get closer to her senpai, she was disturbed by her younger childhood friend, Rui?! "I'm in a position to attack Kei anytime", "Do you still see me as your younger brother?". This guy... is cute but super cheeky! From a childhood friend to a fastball love!!

title: Boyfriend (Beta) Side Comics
description:
Not to be mistaken with the Boyfriend (Beta) Anthology manga, this is a collection of very short side comics which were released from April 2016 to October 2017 as in-game rewards in the Japanese mobile/browser game called Boyfriend (Beta) (a.k.a. ボーイフレンド（仮）). It is accessible via the website bf.amebagames.com.  
  
These comics are intended to show the point of view of the 45 in-game characters from their respective in-game scenarios. The whole scenarios can be unlocked by playing the game.

title: Shin Kotaro Makaritoru! Juudouhen
description:
Having to repeat his final year in Tsurugamine High School, Kotaro is drawn to Judo through the encounters he make with first-year students Kumi Mifune, Sanshiro Saigo and Daigo Daigo. Having lost to Kotaro, first-year Judoka Kumi Mifune endeared to learn the Karate discipline in order to defeat Kotaro. However, the ambitious delinquent Judoka Daigo captured her as a bait to take on Kotaro and take over his long-standing Kyokutan dojo. Sanshiro Saigo who happened to be with Kumi was taken as well and caused the Judo Club to be involved in the conflict with Kotaro.  
   
With the return of many previous characters (though many of them just making brief appearances) such as Shikato Tenzen, Momotaro Ushirono, Teruhiko Tenkouji and Kyoushiro Inamori; mixed with the appearance of new characters such as the leaders of the male and female Judo Clubs; Toshihiko Iga who seemed to know Kotaro very well and Rumiko Mitsugi whose panties Kotaro and Tenzen could never "possess" respectively, the new

title: Love Live! Comic Anthology µ's Sweet Memories
description:
The third official anthology for Love Live! School Idol Project.  
Each chapter is done by a different artist.  
  
Cover: Yuki 

**Chapters**:
1. **µ's Hospitality Operation** (µ's no Omotenashi Sakusen, μ'sのおもてなし作戦) by Tokita Arumi  
2. **Minalinsky and the One-day Maid Experience** (Minalinsky to 1-nichi Maid Taiken, ミナリンスキーと1日メイド体験) by Nanaji Yuuki

9. **µ's Kitchen** (μ'sキッチン) by Nakane Nata  
10. **Honoka-ism!** (穂乃果イズム!) by Kinosaki Kazura

title: Nageki no Marie
description: Mariko was tormented by a boy during her primary school days for her flashy appearance, and has dressed plainly ever since. What happens when she ends up meeting her bully again as she becomes a high-school student?

title: Senpai no Mizugi
description: Honda is on the swim team while his high school senior, Momotani-senpai, acts as his private coach after quitting swimming. One night after they get drunk together, Honda finds Momotani wearing a woman's swimsuit, seducing him! How will Momotani react to his attraction to him, and will their friendship be affected?

title: Shingeki no Kyojin - Fake Lovers (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing Eren x Historia   
  
Based on the Highschool AU of Attack On Titans, Eren and Historia get into a complicated but convenient situation

title: Kimi made Ato Mou Sukoshi
description: Haruko is a girl who worries about her height. Sho is a boy who worries about his shortness. Haruko befriends the cheerful Maki, Sho is friends with the caring Kouta. This is a warm and touching story about their youth.

title: The Prince who was attacked by the Princess
Metto-kun wa Ikemen Desu
description: Makoto is a girl, but because her name sounds like a boy’s, the school mistakenly placed her in the boy’s dorm. On her way to the dorm, she encounters a guy with hair that looks like a helmet. Turns out, this Helmet-senpai is one of her dorm mate! Makoto starts to fall in love with Helmet-kun because he is kind. His helmet hair is covering his face all the time so Makoto really wants to see his face. But, how will she find out more about Helmet-kun with the other two members? One is a cheapskate and the other, a narcissist. What will happen to Makoto’s love?!

title: Go Nagai Short Stories
description:
Collection of most of Go Nagai's short stories under one title, with each volume mainly focusing on a central theme.

title: Wild Pitch
description: Sakuraba Kenji is an aspiring baseball player, however due to some circumstances he gave up on baseball, and moved to a new High School so that he is able to give up on it totally. On the day that he visit the new school he will be attending, he meets a girl, Mamiya Itsuka who mistakenly does something to him, causing him to faint. When he awakes, he realizes that the place he will be staying at is Itsuka's home!

title: Obscene Devil But It's Fine
description: “Is it wrong to have a dirty mind?” A story about a girl whose relationship with her boyfriend crumbles whenever she has wild thoughts

title: Risou no Koi no, Sono Ato ni.
description: A collection of cute short stories about high school students in love.

title: Toutoshi Splatter
description: An extremely beautiful and irresistibly cute girl wants to find the love of her life, but those who fall in love with her will lead to heart palpitations and death.

title: Magical Angel Creamy Mami and the Spoiled Princess
description: Megumi Ayase gets treated rudely at her agency, Parthenon Productions, after Mami joins. While having feelings of insecurity and rivalry against Mami, who suddenly appears, she does her best to live her ‘moderate’ idol life.

title: Damage Danshi
description: Aiba is secretly in love with her childhood friend Yoshi, who has one weird ability–he temporarily becomes good-looking when he takes in damage! What will happen to their relationship when his face doesn't go back to normal!?

title: Saku Love
description: A story about young love in spring. A comedy about three boys and their adventures in school and new romances.

title: Harukaze BITTER★BOP
description: Chiyoharu used to be the leader of the troublemakers, until one day an innocent prank results in a major fire at the school. When his three cohorts take the blame and are expelled, Chiyoharu tries to go on with his mundane life, beating himself up with guilt. Then he meets the mysterious, muscle-man Souza of the North Wind and a ditzy self-proclaimed detective who are trying to solve the mystery behind Souza’s amnesia…It’s nonstop comedy and action from there!

title: Glasstaion Shoukougun
description: Class president Nijou is a talented athlete, popular honor student... and a total people-pleaser who can't stop living up to others' smothering expectations of him. When his teacher asks him to check on Toomi, a classmate who's stopped coming to school, that chance meeting leads to an unexpected connection that neither young man expects. Toomi sees right through his diligent facade, and Nijou can't forget the cool comfort of Toomi's undemanding touch. But when Nijou discovers the reason behind Toomi's frequent absences — that he's been working as an online cam "girl" — he doesn't know how to react. How can he bring up what he knows? And how will it change their relationship?

title: The Elite Princess's Chief Guidelines
description:
An unhappy marriage that began with an imperial invasion. And the news of her brother's death in battle.
On the brink of despair, Princess Isabelle is drawn back to her happy childhood.

The past, which she had dismissed as a nightmare, comes back to haunt her,
she vows to change the future.

As valedictorian of the Kabbalah Academy, you can dream of a new future.

How will she fare among her less-than-friendly classmates?

title: Fujoshi na imouto de sumimasen
description: The story of an otaku girl named Yuuko and her struggle as she fights solo against her handsome, normie brother who has gynophobia (with everyone except his sister).

title: Boku wa Ane ni Youbun o Suwaremashita
description:
A boy finds out the long, hard and grueling way that he shouldn't resent his overachieving twin sister's presence… because resentment begets cold revenge.  
  
A cautionary tale telling the reader that cruel words cut deep, and not only on the receiving end.

title: Keppeki Danshi Kouryakuhou
description:
Things are not as they seem when straight-A student Takumi finds himself tutoring class clown Sakura.  
Even though he senses that something is off, Takumi continues to help Sakura study until one fateful encounter changes everything…

title: Otome no Gunzou
description:
Collection of the mangaka's oneshots on pixiv and twitter and a new 30 page inter-species romance story.

* Chapter 2 was initially published as part of [Majo Shuukai de Aimashou](https://mangadex.org/title/4f68cbf4-60ee-47d7-925e-8c7c86385037/let-s-meet-at-the-witches-gathering) ([Chapter 3 on this site](https://mangadex.org/chapter/781bc28a-da1a-4a8b-ad3a-f0a2729c6525/1)).

title: Imadoki!
description: For Tanpopo Yamazaki, life at the elitist academy in Tokyo seems way out of her league. The children of wealthy families snub her, other students make light of the fact that she actually tested into Meio, instead of relying on family connections, and the cute boy she saw tending a dandelion the day before wouldn't even acknowledge her existence. Hoping to make friends and have some fun, Tanpopo starts up a gardening committee, but will this help her survive in a school where superficiality and money reign supreme?

title: From Today on, I'm a Boy
description:
"If nobody notices that you are a girl until we graduate, I will give you a billion won."

"I'm in."

The bet was on. Will Shiru be able to hide her identity until she graduates?!

---
Formerly hosted on Foxtoon, but can no longer be found on that site.

Most sources for the series list 77 chapters, however, there are in fact ***85*** chapters total. Unfortunately, this includes the official English translation.

title: JC no Miryoku wo Tanoshimu Kenzen na Anthology Comic
description:
Anthology that depicts the charms of middle school girls, including club activities, daily life, and first love, capturing the once-in-a-lifetime sparkle of neither being an adult nor a child!
___
**Cover**: Kagome (籠目)
**Illustration**: Karei (かれい)

**Author list**:
1. Oohori Yutaka
2. Oono Imo
3. Hamaji Aki
4. Oumi Noko
5. Sugawara Kenji
6. Kagamitsuki
7. Konbu Wakame
8. Zaima Rishin (as Rishin)
9. Nishizono Fumiko
10. Dosei Fujiko

title: Muramasa
description: Shiro Masakatsu is a boy people can't stand to touch, whether they be male or female. One day, he sees a girl with a weird katana finishing a fight with someone, so naturally, he ran away. He later meets the same girl at school, and another katana-wielder picking a fight with her. But it turns out these katanas have abilities, called Youtou, making them cursed katanas; but to use their Youtou, a certain condition has to be met…

title: Mizuiro no Machi Made
description:
"I'm going to transfer."  
  
Homare is a high school boy who loves both girls and boobs, and then there's Kazu, his cool childhood friend who spoils such an honor. Even though they went to school together every morning, Kazu's transfer had already been decided, but on the way home, he suddenly kissed me?!  
  
"I didn't want you to forget when I've moved."

title: Botsuraku Sunzen desu no de, Konyakusha wo Furikirou to Omoimasu
description: Alicia, an ordinary girl with zero magic power and average looks, is engaged to Ricardo, a "noble loved by the spirits," a duke's son with great magic power and good looks. Alicia is just trying to enjoy her school life as a herb geek, but her fiancé is always harassing her because of his superiority and his constant attention to Alicia! Alicia is determined to take this opportunity to break off her engagement to Ricardo! But will Alicia, who is super insensitive and a natural, be able to recognize Ricardo's love for her? This is the start of a magical school love comedy!

title: Hot-Blooded Woman
description:
What is a sweet, soft-spoken girl (Ha Li Kang) to do when her brothers, having just learned fencing and martial arts, decide to test some moves out on her in order to "tame her" and make her into their "little slave?" She runs to her knightly friend (Te Hu Kang, not related to Ha Li) for protection, of course. However, what happens when, instead of comforting her, he tells her that she is a coward for running away like a puppy who needs constant protection? No, she does not break down and cry like a weak girl. Instead, she resolves to grow stronger. With rigorous training everyday, Ha Li goes from being a scared girl who cries for help to becoming the Jjang (boss of a gang) of the Doberman gang. However, events lead to Ha Li getting in an accident with a truck. Afterwards, she is reborn into the body of a beautiful, but weak, rich girl Aram Han.  
  
At her new school, everyone is surprised at the sudden change they see in Aram, who has gone from a gloomy, good student to a rude, caref

title: Ouji to Hero
description:
Hana, a country girl, has to move to Tokyo because of her father's work, and what's this? Her school is like a castle, her classmates have their own chauffeurs, and everyone is all sparkly and beautiful?  
  
"I didn't realize that at the same time while my world was changing, my indecisive love was also starting to bud…"

title: Koto no Ha
description: Cruel words turn into swords which pierce the hearts of the people they are directed at. Will a boy and a girl be able to overcome the misunderstandings created by their words?

title: Ossan ga shougakusei
description:
A middle-aged salaryman wakes up in the morning to find himself in the body of an elementary school girl...? This is a heartwarming comedy about a schoolgirl with an OP old-man's soul!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title: Kakumeiki Valvrave
description:
True Calendar (T.C.) 71 - A new age where 70% of the human population lives in space thanks to the development of "Dyson Sphere", a city in space.  
The world is divided into two main powers: The Dorssia Military Pact Federation, a power which grew out of a military alliance, and the Atlantic Rim United States (ARUS), which grew in power as it expanded its trade agreements. The minor nation of JIOR has declared neutrality between these two forces and maintains its peace through economic prosperity.  
Within the JIOR's Sphere, Haruto Tokishima lived an ordinary life as a high school student in the division known as "Module 77"—until the Dorssian military begins their sudden invasion!  
But the whole world will be shaken when Haruto meets the mysterious humanoid weapon, Valvrave!

title: Hey, Mr Secret
description: Xiang Queque, a cartoonist who had low self-esteem since childhood, turned into a beautiful swan in college, solely to disguise her stupidly dorky self. Who knew that the cold and handsome classmate that made her terribly nervous would turn out to be her new screenwriter consultant! However, she didn't know that he had a close connection to Shudong, her online friend of several years.

title: Berandal Love Comedy
description: A romance comedy story of a naive delinquent who is determined to be the strongest delinquent for the sake of his school.

title: 35cm
description:
In elementary school, Ban Hana was always the tallest in her class.
But while everyone else kept growing… she didn’t.
Now in high school, Hana finds herself face-to-face with a tall, broad-shouldered boy she barely recognizes — so tall she has to crane her neck just to meet his eyes.
And that boy?
It’s Han Gyeol — the same kid who used to be shorter than her.
The height difference hasn’t changed.
It’s still 35 centimeters.
But this time, everything else has.
A story about a 35-centimeter gap — and how their positions completely flipped

title: Red Road
description:
Kazuka is your average high school girl with the exception of having an irregular personality. She wakes up one morning slightly later than usual to find a red thread attached to her finger…  
  
And for her, it isn’t “who” is at the other end, but “what” should she do about it…

title: Kimi wo Suki ni Natta Riyuu
description: Chika has always been a negative girl, one day Shimizu-kun (the cute guy from the class next door) confesses to her, since that time, she began to question that mindset ~

title: Sono Saki wa Private Desu
description: A girl who fell in love with the entertainment industry-the high school girl and fledgling actress, Hinako. Although she was aiming to enter a small company, being unable to perform made her everyday filled with frustration. When she finally gets the chance to audition for a big company, the successor of the company "Continue" suddenly tells her "I'll make you famous in three years, so stay by my side." What?!

title: Seishun Outsider
description:
<No matter how captivated you are, this cannot become love>  
  
“I like you.”  
  
After ranting about his recent break up, Hisashi received a confession from Kazuya.  
  
It slipped out of Kazuya's mouth by accident. Because of his mistake, Kazuya was frazzled and didn't want to know Hisashi's reply. He told Hisashi that he'd like them to remain good friends, and Hisashi agreed.  
  
But as Kazuya wants to express his affection towards Hisashi, and Hisashi considers getting back with his girlfriend, Kazuya slowly becomes more and more depressed each day…  
  
A heart wrenching love story between a student who doesn't know much about love x a pure-hearted delinquent.

title: Kuzu na Kemono wa Aishisugi
description:
"I'll definitely get your heart and body."

Although Aoi wants to enjoy her normal youth, she is made to take care of her childhood friend Soma. What's more, Soma is a trashy beast who won't refuse any woman! Aoi thought, "I cannot give in my body and mind for this guy!"

But "I feel like sleeping with you today," he says, taking her to bed, using her as a body pillow, and even kissing her...!? But Aoi, who can't let go...

title: Wsamarus 2001
description:
Compilation of assorted stories published in different magazines.  
  
**From [MangaHelpers](https://mangahelpers.com/m/wsamarus-2001):**  
This is a collection of bizarre images, shorts, and short stories. One of the most notable stories involves a young girl whose sick-seeming friend insists that she be taken to the ocean. Without asking any questions, she enlists the help of a random passing driver to fulfill her friend's strange wish. The reason for it will end up being stranger than she could have guessed! Another story involves a young girl whose older sister has an illness that has left her asleep for 8 years. One day, her older sister wakes up, and the two share their first real day together. [tethysdust]

title: Cherry Juice
description: Cherry Juice is about Otome and Minami, two step-siblings. Minami is a popular boy who takes cooking at school, and Otome is an average girl who is in love with Minami's best friend. Cherry Juice's main focus is on the love lives of Minami and Otome, who are in love with other people…. or are they?

title: Sorairo Lemon to Mayoi Neko
description: Ever since her childhood friend "Ryou-kun" moved out of their small hometown, Seto Nagisa takes photos everyday in the hopes of showing Ryou-kun when he returns as promised. As she's taking a photo one day, she and her friends bump into the rising-actor Kamijyou Yamato, who has moved to the small town after some unsavory rumors began to spread about him in the entertainment world. Nagisa and Yamato immediately don't get along, but is it possible that they are actually becoming friends?

title: Meteor Prince
description: You have been chosen to be my 'princess' – always unlucky, high-school student, Natsuno Youko. A naked guy… dropped in front of her!!! Io came to earth to search for the most tuned in Hako to bear his child…?!

title: Otome Hatsuden
description: That love lights up the city--. Japan is utilizing "Otome Power Generation," a new type of electric power released by adolescent girls. This is a story of a small love affair between Chisaki-san, one of the power generators, and Iwai-kun:

title: Kyou kara Watashi no Akuma-san!
description:
Hina is a high school girl who has just lost her grandmother, who was her only family and guardian. In order to fulfill her grandmother's last living wish to see Hina dressed as a bride, Hina sneaks into the church on the night before the funeral...

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

title: Weak Prince Chases Love
description:
The previous weak prince turned into a shining hottie, but is dressed as a fragile girl one day when he runs into the school tyrant. What the hell is happening?   
  
These are the events that unfold as the weak prince becomes an apprentice to the school tyrant and chases love…

title: All Purpose Cultural Cat Girl Nuku Nuku
description:
From ADV:  
  
When inventor Kyusaku Natsume transfers the brain of his son Ryunosuke's cat into a top secret android body, he doesn't lose a family pet…he gains a daughter!  
  
Nuku Nuku may appear to be a teenage girl, but her cute and cuddly exterior hides both the superhuman strength of the world's most advanced android chassis and the lightning-quick senses of a domestic feline. She’ll become the sister Ryunosuke never dreamed of, and she’s on a mission to save her new family from disaster!

title: Girls in Bloom
description: "I'm from Shibuya, and the countryside is the worst," "I can talk to anyone, but I'm not friends with anyone," "Every day I wish the earth would explode," "I stole the teacher's panties because I wanted her to notice me," "I was born beautiful, but I choose to be alone," "My first experience led me to buy expensive underwear," "I'll do it with anyone, but I don't know what true love is," etc. Everyone has a "secret" under their uniform, crying and laughing. Set in a rural girls' high school, this is a rainbow-colored tale of mischievous youth played out by seven girls, seven different in color.

title: King wa Nakayoku Naritakunai
description: “On the contrary, I'm curious about my seniors" Shifuji Shido, who is good-looking and literary and martial arts, is a "king of the school" that is recognized by both himself and others. When I looked at the popular junior, Atsouto Okawa, for some reason he liked it――!? I'm swayed by younger handsome guys!

title: Osomatsu-kun
description:
Meet the Osomatsu boys—sextuplets who look, speak, dress and talk like the same. They only add to the hyper eccentric residents of the town who easily break any boundaries defined by common sense. Check your logical thinking and reason at the door and immerse yourself in everyday lives of unique characters who are wild both in appearance and temperament! (Source: Studio Pierrot)

---
- **Won the 10th Shogakukan Manga Award in 1964**

title: The Cherry Orchard
description: The drama club at Ouka Academy has a yearly tradition of putting Anton Chekhov's The Cherry Orchard every year for the school's founding day festival. These four interwoven tales of love and friendship focus on four girls in the drama club as they prepare for this year's presentation.

title: Lip ni Shadow
description: Childhood friends Nagi and Chikage live in the same company-owned housing. Just what is the "love magic" that Chikage uses to cure Nagi's sadness?

title: My girlfriend is an evil girl
description: Bei Xiuzhi was originally a mediocre college student. Unexpectedly, due to an accident, he passed away and became a Japanese high school student, Kitahara Xiuji. The optimistic life on campus is over again, and before the confession that comes, Kitahara Hideji has only one wish: to study hard! Become a winner in life! But just when he wanted to pursue his studies, Fukuzawa Dongmi frequently criticized him. In front of this evil woman, what should Kitahara do?

title: Kami-sama no Sonata
description:
A collection of oneshots:

1. Kamisama no Sonata
A lonely ghost finds another deeply tortured soul with her love for the violin. Despite the years separating them, they both know the pain of being different which causes their bond to become stronger. But is there a happy ending for someone living and a ghost?

2. Mahoroba no Yobigoe
A boy she always knew from afar is about to be crushed by the train before her very eyes, but not before he looks directly at her, causing Maomi to drift and land… 2000 years into the past! Historical references to Yamataikoku and Queen Himiko.

3. Ipaasha
A playboy prince of a small country needs to win over a frivolous princess of a successful kingdom for the sake of his country. What he didn't expect was his feelings for the princess's timid maid. What will happen when the princess finds out about them? Will the prince forsake his country all for his forbidden love?

4. Taiyou mo Wasure Sasete
Saho fall in love with the chairman of a gardening club - Tog

title: Haruiro Stalker
description: Ao Momose has a stalker who's ruining his love life, but instead of chasing the stalker off, he asks her out on a date so he can dispel her delusions about him.

title: Mutant Sabu
description:
The loneliness and sadness of a boy, Sabu, who has awakened to paranormal abilities.... 
In prehistoric times, humans had the mental ability to speak with their hearts and minds instead of words. 
Following the development of language ability, the ability that should have degenerated is revived!? 
A transfusion of blood from a girl awakens the psychic powers of a boy, Mutant Sabu, and he is born! 
The short series about a hero with unusual abilities is now ready to begin!

---- 
- **1966 7th Kodansha Children's Manga Award winner, shared with Ishinomori's very famous other work Cyborg 009**

title: The Story of Someone I Know
description:
[As soon as you want to reveal your secret, it turns to be a spell.]*  
  
There is a secret in every love.  
And sometimes you want to reveal that secret that you’ve been hiding deep inside your heart.  
  
When the long unrequited love becomes burdensome;  
When you wander between love and friendship;  
When you can't be sure of your feelings;  
When you don't have the courage to speak from your heart..  
People often reveal their secrets like this:   
  
"This is about someone I know…"  
  
The one at the end of a long unrequited love, Baek Jaehyun  
The one who started a new unrequited love, Cha Seungtae  
The one who loves without knowing what love is, Jung Woojin  
The one who doesn’t know it’s love, but still loves, Lee Seung  
  
I would like to ask you through a common, unrequited love, that you may have heard of at least once somewhere.   
  
What kind of secret love do you have?

title: Susu, Han
description:
Lee Susu is an easy-going girl who has lived in the countryside ever since she was a child. However, she has no choice but to stay at her brother, Lee Han's, house in Seoul after the high school in her village was closed. And there are big and small misunderstandings between the awkward siblings… A story of the daily life of a brother and a sister.

- [Official Japanese Translation <Lezhin>](https://www.lezhin.jp/ja/comic/asahinihikaru)
>
