- [Original Webtoon <Mr.Blue>](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/jt_sr_0051)
- [Original Webtoon <RidiBooks>](https://ridibooks.com/books

title: Toraneko no Shitsukekata
description: The cute-faced but super strong delinquent, Kotarou, and the excellent, sports all-rounder honors student, Yamato. The two are seen as polar opposites, but they​'re actually in a lovey-dovey relationship. Seeing his beloved Yamato's nape and lips fills Kotarou's mind with "perverted thoughts". But when he's touched, he panics and throws a punch…?!

title: 17 [Juunana]
description: It's the start of their senior year, and Shiika happens to be in the same class as a guy named Megumi. It's a mystery to her why his voice echoes through her mind.

title: Amazing Sarutobi
description: Nikumaru, meaning "meatball" in Japanese, is a seventeen-year-old student at Ninja High School, a special school for the training of ninja. He is short and chubby, but he possesses a super technique known as the "kamikaze", where he stirs up a whirlwind with his feet. The series introduces his many adventures and pranks as Nikumaru meets with his rivals both in and out of school.

title: Ore dake ga Shitte iru
description: Although high-schooler Arima Shougo is actually terrified of anything related to the supernatural, he was forced to join his high school's "Occult Research Club" because he can see ghosts. A series of events leads him to a chance encounter with the ghost of Yoshizawa Takumi, a junior student who is rumored to have committed suicide. Arima helps fulfill Yoshizawa's only wish that keeps him lingering with regret. While doing so, Yoshizawa's kind and gentle personality underneath his calm and collected expression slowly captivates Arima. What will happen on the final day that Arima fulfills that wish completely...?

title: Shuchiin Academy’s Graduation Party ~Kaguya-sama Wants to be Celebrated~: Last Official Fanbook
Sensei, Suki
description:
Please, teach me about things we can't do !  
  
#1. Ijiwaru na oni Kyoushi…a pretentious and cruel teacher give her private lessons after school?!  
  
#2. Geki Kawa Kyoushi…a morose girl with glasses and a handsome teacher = don't tell me it'll have some alchemy between those two?!  
  
#3. Kiken na Hokeni …A kind and gentleman teacher is in fact not what he seems to be…!!  
  
#4. Onna Kyoushi no Ikenai Koi…Though she's dreaming about an adult and handsome man, she'll become close to a high school boy…?!

title: Ouji-sama Nante Iranai
description:
_Via Google Translate:_
Kotoko Tojo is a very ordinary high school girl who exercises, studies, and looks normal.  The only thing that isn't typical is that she has a childhood-friend fiancé! Moreover, her partner, Isho Nishizono, is the best handsome prince in school! Kotoko is in a situation which many envy, but for some reason she's desperately hiding the engagement.

The opening of the Doki LOVE Gakuen Romance of the ordinary girls and the prince of the school ♪

title: SummerCode
description: Yin Luowen's mother died in a sudden traffic accident. After receiving a parcel sent by her mother before her death, the "accident" seemed to be premeditated. Yin Luowen embarked on the journey of revealing the secret. Just as the truth of the incident became clearer, the identities and secrets of the four men who were associated with them began to surface...

title: He's My First Love
description:
Timid and self-conscious high school student Karin never paid much attention to boys until she met Kiriya, a popular student from a nearby boys' school. Karin and Kiriya embark on a romantic journey despite Karin's classmate Yuka's best efforts to sabotage their relationship, but Karin soon learns that living happily ever after isn't on the curriculum when she becomes Kiriya's center of attention, as well as embittered Yuka's bull's-eye on her dartboard of hate.  
  
Included one-shot:  
Volume 10: Kiriya at 13 (Spring)

title: I'm Only Embarrassed in Front of You
description:
A girl named Dana, who grew up on an island, loses the bucket list notebook she wrote while looking forward to her first school experiences.
The one who finds that notebook for her is Cheon Sehwa, a somewhat secretive boy in her class.
Dana approaches Sehwa, showing her interest in him, but Sehwa finds Dana’s attention overwhelming.
Yet the more he’s with her, the redder his cheeks get, and the tighter and more uncomfortable his chest feels.
But somehow… Sehwa doesn’t really dislike it.

title: Moyashi Otoko to Tane Shoujo
description:
1) Moyashi Otoko to Tane Shoujo  
My dad died in a traffic accident eight years ago. One day my mother brings in an unreliabe ”bean sprout man” into our house. Together with my selfish mom and my obstinate self, the transient and strange life of the three of us begins here… In order for a girl to grow up, she needs a grown up man.  
  
2) Kingyo no Aza  
A girl becomes jealous when she hears that her childhood friend now has a girlfriend. In an attempt to break the two up, she takes advice from a talking fish?  
  
3) Headphone to Kodomo  
A high school boy witnesses his crush being involved in a traffic accident outside the school. The incident leaves the boy able to communicate to his crush through her headphones?  
  
4) Hiyoko Densha wa Kyo mo Yuku  
A high school girl is confessed to by her best friends' brother. Does she return his feelings or do her feelings with her best friend (a girl)? which one she will chose?  
  
Pt-Br:  
Coletânea de One-Shots do autor:  
  
1. Moyashi Ot

title: Kare no Tokubetsu na Kare
description: Despite being good looking, all Hiraoka Tatsuya ever wanted was to lead a peaceful and ordinary life. However, his life turns upside down with the addition of a new student, Suruga Daichi, a famous actor. As the student council president, Tatsuya is assigned to look after him. What will happen to him now…?

title: Charming Rock Boy
description:
Fujisaki Maki once had a peaceful life, but one day, she decides to help Nobitani, who was being bullied, and now everyone's bullying her! Because Nobitani feels guilty, he gives Maki tickets to a famous local band called 'East Robo'. Maki decides to go and during the concert, the leader singer plays a ballad and is looking at Maki?!  
  
A continuation from Nousatsu Rock Star.

title: My Hero!
description: Kae, who can’t seem to be as honest as she’d like to be, and Hiroto, self-conscious about his (lack of) height and childish appearance, are known for bickering all the time. Kae has kept her crush secret from Hiroto, but when he returns from summer vacation a tall and handsome flower boy… will she finally be honest about how she feels?

title: Hatsukoi Izonshou
description: Saki doesn't realize how strong her feelings for Ryo are until it's almost time for them to graduate and go separate ways.

title: No Dating Allowed in School
description: This webtoon follows the high school life of Ji-hye as she navigates through her complex friends, unexpected encounters and the school’s rule of no dating on campus!

title: Omi-sensei no Binetsu
description: Omi Tsukasa, who still holds a flame for his close friend and first love, Su-chan, becomes a new teacher assigned to his old school. There he spots Su-chan's doppelganger, a student named Sugimoto. Upon finding out that Sugimoto is Su-chan's nephew, Omi starts having an interest in him, much to the annoyance of his target of interest.

title: The Perfect Replacement
description:
My twin sister's been replaced!
My sister is perfect — so much so that she's been chosen as the hero of another world called Rowold. While she's off saving this new world, she's been replaced by Moomyung, an aloof Rowoldian. He's not the most convincing substitute, so I'm helping him out. But I'm learning from him too.

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc28079)

- [Official Thai Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/th/bl-gl/perfect-substitute/list?title_no=2871)

title: Hand Painted Eden
description: From Kirby Scanlations: After graduating from high school, Minori decides to attend art school against the protests of her mother. While throwing herself into her work, she happens to meet two fellow male students. Fujioka Takashi, and Kagami Touma. Kagami, who uplifts people with his confidence and kindness. Fujioka, whose confidence inspires. Thanks to these two boys, Minori is able to overcome the struggles she’s been facing her entire life. But what happens when one of them wants something more…?

title: Hatsukoi ni Oboreta
description:
Compilation of short stories:  
  
1. Hatsukoi ni Oboreta [Part 1]

2. Hatsukoi ni Oboreta [Part 2] 

3. Hatsukoi ni Oboreta [Part 3] 
  
4. Sweet Cool  
Suzu's boyfriend suddenly broke up with her at the end of summer vacation. She pretended that it was alright while he was there, but as soon as he left she began to cry. The kind and cool Jun was passing by and gave her some sweet chocolate to cheer her up. The next day, they discover that they go to the same school. What will happen with this pair whose introduction was so sweet?  
  
5. Juonteki na Kanojo aka My Grudging Girlfriend:  
After losing a bet to his friends, Ginji, a well known playboy of his school, has to ask out Kei Natsumi, “the darkest woman in school”, as the kids call her. Natsumi always spends her time in the library reading horror books and it’s not that Ginji is afraid that he’ll be turned down but he’s afraid of her gloomy atmosphere. Will he be able to light up her life?

title: 24 Colors ~Hatsukoi no Palette~
description: Nanaka loves to paint. So when she enters high school, she gets excited at the prospect of joining the arts club. However, there are only two members–the mysterious Chihaya and the energetic Kento. They're both good-looking guys, and Chihaya shares Nanaka's love for painting! Alongside the two gorgeous guys (and Nanaka's best friend)… what will happen?

title: Hatsukoi Lollipop
description:
Seo has been in high school for little more than 2 months. She likes schools that allow casual clothes, however the annoying, stupid guy, Narusawa Shin is really hard to deal with. Could such men really be?!  
  
Included one-shot: Mikazuki Lock

title: You Make Me Swoon
description:
Face it, high school's hard. From friends to grades to looks, everything matters. Luckily, Ha Nami's got most of that taken care of. Her grades are at the top of her class, she's got two loyal friends, and she's pretty to boot. Unfortunately, she's also got a curse. One that makes it impossible for her to talk to anyone she likes. Like... "like" likes.

---
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://www.lezhin.jp/ja/comic/mihana)

title: Katori-kun to Nanahoshi-san no Koi Shuukan
description:
One week love story of Katori-kun, a high school boy who has no friends but wants to live a quiet life, and Nanaboshi-san, who loves Katori-kun a little too much.  
  
Finalist of 25th Dengeki Comic Award (2018)

title: Spice to Custard
description: Tsukimori-kun is clever, hard to associate with, and his eyes behind the glasses are really cold. Everyone in class scared of him, but I’m not the same. that’s because i have a reason…

title: Jinbe
description:
Jinbe is a very subtle and soft tale by Adachi, and certainly it'a story that deals a theme a bit more conflicting than most of his other works.  
  
At first sight, Jinbe is the story of a young 17 years old girl, Miku Takanashi, who lives alone with her step father Jinpei Takanashi (nicknamed Jinbe or shark).  
  
Jinbe has been living with Miku since his marriage 4 years ago, and considers Miku a God's sent gift from his high school sweet heart late wife. While Jinpei does his best as an over protective and jealous father, we have that Miku holds feelings for Jinbe which are much stronger than the ones an adopted daughter is supposed to have. The main core of the story is to deal how the strong, tender and unrequited feelings of the young Miku put to test their step - father and step - daughter bonds, without jeopardizing any of the happiness that she feels by being close to him as a proper daughter.

title: Kud Wafter
description: Cốt truyện được mở rộng dựa trên tác phẩm Little Busters!, diễn ra lúc kì nghỉ hè đã bắt đầu và sau khi chuyến dã ngoại kết thúc yên bình. Các thành viên khác của Little Busters đã trở về nhà để nghỉ ngơi, để lại Naoe Riki và Noumi Kudryavka trải qua mùa hè của riêng họ trong kí túc xá ở trường... Chuyển thể từ hai visual novel của công ty Key vào năm 2010. Key cũng là nguyên tác của các visual novel và anime nổi tiếng như AIR, Kanon, CLANNAD, Little Busters!, Angel Beats!.

title: Harem☆Lodge
description: Midori lost her mother when she was young and now her father's gone too. But her dad left her with a surprise: a fiancée named Tetsuya. So now, Midori has to live in a good-looking men only apartment (Harem Lodge), which is actually filled with weirdos. What is going to happen to her? Well we just have to wait and see…

title: Sono Aegigoe, Hitorijime - Fujoshi ga Motete Ii n desu ka?
description: "I won't hand you over to anyone, Yume." One day, Taiyo, a handsome delinquent, fell from the sky right in front of hard-core yaoi fan Yume. He's got a mean stare, blond hair, and he's terrifying… "RUN!" Or so Yume thought, but he actually has a super sexy voice! What's more, he spends every day fooling around with his male classmate! Yume thinks about hearing him moan… Then starts fantasizing about it… Then her foot slips, and… suddenly she's on top of his face… "Ah! Wait… No… If you move your lips down there, I'm going to… Nh! I can't take it…!" An overly earnest and pure punk boy and a perverted girl's comedic love story begins!

title: Renren Zakari
description: On the day of her high school entrance ceremony, Sumika, who only wants to live quietly, becomes horribly lost and ends up in the infirmary instead. Her desire for a peaceful school life is denied, however, for her hopeless sense of direction sends her on a collision course with two gorgeous guys: a playboy and a…monkey?

title: 7 Jikanme Rhapsody
description:
Toudou Rinko is a serious and reliable class representative, now in 2nd year of high school. It happens that the first male person she starts to notice is her homeroom teacher, Saku Makoto. She ends up helping the nonchalant and playful teacher with his "Love Guidance Room."  
  
Also included is Tanaka sensei's earlier 1998 work "Light Right Rabbit"  
Usami is a high-school student who likes children. After an incident on a school trip, he plays with the children at their kindergarten. The children call him "Usagi" because of his magic trick. He also happens to be in love with one of the kindergarten teachers.

title: Legend of Iczer
description:
Not to be confused with [Golden Warrior Iczer-One.](https://mangadex.org/title/362fdfa6-526d-476c-bb8e-172f829afca1/golden-warrior-iczer-one?tab=chapters) 

This is Iczer-1's story before she came to Earth. Here is the birth of  Iczer-1, but only the first volume is complete.

title: Ani ni Ai Saresugite Komattemasu
description:
Loved by a handsome little problematic brother…  
  
He is blunt, but a kind brother, Haruka. a sister who's very close to him, Setoka. But, one day, haruka's secret is leaked out —-!?  
  
A unbeliavable love story with a handsome brother, start!!

title: Kamishiro-kun no Onozomi no Mama
description: ろくでなしの父親と2人暮らしする女子高生・真昼は、早くこの底辺生活から抜け出したいと、学業にバイトにと日々がんばって生活している。しかしある日家に帰ると、父が多額の借金を残して姿をくらましていた。借金取りに追いかけられた真昼を救ったのは、クラスメイトの御曹司・怜爾（れいじ）。しかし彼には、真昼を助けたある理由があった。

title: Seishun Survival
description:
1) Youth Survival  
Summer camping trips are supposed to be filled with joy and laughter, but why is Kiriko so unlucky~~? At first it was that weakling four eyes, Kazuo and cutesy Hana-chan destroying the pork soup, but then they never came back after asking them to go pick up some wild herbs! Oh, fine! So she and Satoru went up the mountains to get them, but who knew they’d get lost too?!  
  
2) Liar Love Letters  
When Ritsu's boyfriend asks to break up, she complies - only to find that he's angry about it. To make her pay for dumping him so easily, he puts on a bet. Trick Ritsu into falling in love, and win a good amount of money. When she overhears this, Ritsu is determined to shoot down all the boys out to trick her. But what happens when she comes across someone whose lies capture her heart?  
  
3) Sword and Heart: Dangerous Relationship

title: Tok, Tok
description: Jae Hyeok, who lost hope in dreams due to a certain event, finds his life sparkling with light again as he spends time with one of the seniors at his school club.

title: Ao Natsu
description: Rio was looking forward to spending her summer vacation in Tokyo, meeting boys and going out with friends. But after a change of plans forces her to stay the (whole!!) summer with her grandmother in the countryside, she’s devastated … until she meets Ginzo, a handsome, mysterious guy with incredible talent and a hidden past … [Kodansha]

title: Seiten Koukou Idol Bu!
description: Misaki, a former delinquent transfers schools in hope of changing her life. But everyone is afraid of her until she meets Akira, the club chief of the idol club.

title: Today's Venus
description: "The ordinary me...? The most beautiful in the world from today? By the way, who decides that standard?" Kang Hana, an aspiring actress who always failed auditions because of her ordinary appearance despite her outstanding acting skills. Then, one day the global beauty company <S Group> stated that 'her appearance is her ability' comes at her with a scout offer. And one person is bound to learn Kang Hana's greatest secret...? [2021, 1st place Award-Winning Work]

title: "Aishiteru", Uso dakedo.
description:
#1: "Aishiteru", Uso Dakedo
He's a liar. He's a player. He's the worst. Even if I knew that…why did I fall in love with him?  
This is the story about the encounter between a charismatic handsome boy and a serious girl…  
  
#2: Majou wa Geboku ni Koi wo Suru  
  
Runa was supposed to be able to wield magic. And Cloez is bound to her as her servant. But even if Cloez is always by her side as her attendant, she is unable to capture his heart…  
  
#3: Mayonaka no Orion  
Not scanlated yet  
  
#4: Mamotte nanka Yaranai!!  
Not scanlated yet

title: Ai Ore! ~Danshikou no Hime to Joshikou no Ouji~
description:
When Akira announces he was a boy in the first book "Ai wo Utau Yori Ore ni Oborero" so does the fact Akira goes to Dankaisan the boys school next to St. Nobora (Mizuki's school). Things start to get rough when pressure against Mizuki dating a boy from that school rise.


---

**Note:** Because Shinjo Mayu stopped her job relationship with Shogakukan, she continued her incomplete manga in Asuka and called it Ai Ore! This can be considered a continuation of Ai (w)o Utau Yori Ore ni Oborero! or even as a second series.

title: Back to High School Life
description: I have a body of a high school girl, but a mind of around 30-year-old woman. I went back in time so that I could redo my first sexual experience with my destined partner!! Can Risa get back the youthful days that she regretted?

title: The Transfer Student Who Came Down to Earth
description: It's Christmas Eve. Failing to confess to Yuji Sunbae, Gyunwoo meets a boy dressed in a space suit who's fallen like a shooting star. It's been a month since he's taken care of the strange boy who has nowhere to go, and today is the day of the high school entrance ceremony! Gyunwoo is excited to hear that he's attending the same school as Yuji Sunbae, but a transfer student who looks ex.act.ly. like Yuji Sunbae appears in front of him…

title: Tenjite Koi to Iki
description: Một ngày nọ, trong dãy phòng học cũ của trường, giáo viên dạy cấp 3 Yoshitake tìm thấy một tờ báo xưa từ thập niên 60. Trên đó ghi tên Yosuke Haruoki, tác giả một truyện ngắn, và Mikumo Sakagami, nhân vật chính trong câu chuyện ấy. Sau một loạt những sự trùng hợp kỳ lạ, Yoshitake và Yahiro, đồng nghiệp của mình, bắt đầu có một linh cảm cực kỳ hoang đường: rằng Haruoki và Sakagami chính là kiếp trước của họ.

title: National High School of Economic Freedom - Saesil High
description: The government of South Korea establishes an experimental school designed to develop young, financially independent entrepreneurs. Ryuk and his childhood friend both enroll, each enrolling for separate reasons. Ryuk wants to coast off of the 10000000won(approx $10000) that you receive as part of your admission package so he can be financially independent of his parents. The girl wants to gain experience to start her own restaurant to repay her single father. However, they both soon learn that the school is much harsher than the promotional material made it out to be. A dog eats dog world of economic turbulence!

title: Plain Marriage
description:
Contains:
1. Gyaku Proposal Hanayome
2. Futarijime Hanayome
3. Sakizome Hanayome
4. Omoi Hanamuko to Karui Hanayome

title: How to Massage
description: Short story on how to massage: Two students sit together and start talking about stiff shoulders, massages… and various other things their active teenage minds come up with.

title: Tomato ga dwaela!
description: "Shin Yi-seok, a transfer student from the countryside who is rumored to be scheming due to his rough appearance, witnesses the cunning secret of Jo Hae-joo, the first-class student in the school, whom he fell in love with at first sight... Questions about him gradually grow like a snowball. Shin Yi-seok's unrequited love for Jo Hae-ju, who is red on the outside and white on the inside, begins!"

title: Ue kara Kataomoi
description:
1. Ue kara Kataomoi  
"If you don't want to be exposed…you better do what I say."  
Aya is suffering a one sided love with the cool Nikaido. but then he happen to know her secret. In order to shut her mouth, Nikaido tells her his conditions….  
  
2. Ai no Shirushi  
  
3. Kimi Bakkari no Natsu  
  
4. Sweet Lesson

title: Chat
description:
Our protagonist Kang Hae Yo is not an ordinary high school girl by any measure. She is in fact a jjang of her school and her gang is the most powerful in Seoul. But she wants a normal life and a normal boyfriend. Her hot-bloodedness always get in her way. And her quick-temper when she encounters "wimps", by her standards, make her desire all the more unreachable.  
  
This is the year 2002. Every youngster gets to chat online once in a while. And Kang Hae Yo is no exception as she goes on the web under the nickname "playgirl18". She doesn't really know her way around the computer But her sub-jjang, Yoon Ji Ni, teaches her the "necessary things for online chatting" – like how to be girly. Hae Yo begins to find for herself a new life from online chatting. She begins to think of online chatting as her only way out from gang life. What will happen?

title: Kingyozaka Noboru
description:
The plot takes place in a small town made up of many hills and slopes where Nishiki, a high-school girl, 
has taken on the title of a Sukuiya trying to do her best to help grade-schooler Akai.

title: Ganzi Monster
description: Eunho Cha is, without a doubt, the biggest outcast at school. He spends his days avoiding bullies and daydreaming about his crush. He'd give anything to be popular, so when he discovers a face editing app called Icing, he spies an opportunity. With Icing's help, Eunho now looks like a superstar... or at least Ganzi Monster (GM), his online alter ego, does. But just when GM and his dance videos are starting to get popular, someone discovers his secret, and Eunho's days of being invisible are about to come to an end...

title: LovePlus: Manaka Days
description: Based on DS Dating Sim "LovePlus".

title: Danouryoku JK Narumogawa-san
description: Youkai girls who have poor abilities which don't matter live their life hard in their own way!!

title: Over Time - Gamer Joshi wa Koi wo Shiranai
description: Saya is a high school girl who is a game geek. She is actually a game distributor named Akua-chan, but she didn't tell anyone at school...until now!　Her classmate Sakurai finds out that Saya is Akua-chan!　Saya asks him to play a game with her just once. Saya is shy when it comes to anything but games, and Sakurai is bright and popular. Let's play the love story of these two opposites!

title: Days of My Youth
description:
A tsundere top student vs a girl horrible at school, "Since I like you, I'll make sure you study well!" In a highly selective school filled with straight A students, Gu Shan Dao is just an ordinary girl that wouldn't try her best, and she is convinced that she'll be able to make it through high school without putting in any effort. A studious and outdated student council member is about to mess up her life! A ‘Study club plan’ will change her life forever...

---
Alt. Official English: [Webnovel](https://www.webnovel.com/comic/days-of-my-youth_28041903808272101)

title: I Fell in Love with You
description: I've been watching you attentively from close by… because I fell in love with you. Only once… although we have spoken only this one time.

title: Senpai, Koreijou wa Out desu.
description: She can't communicate with others, and the only place she can let herself go is to cheer for the baseball team. She thought she wanted to have a dreamy youth in high school... but by chance, she is forced to become the manager of the baseball team...?　There, she meets a super unfriendly, handsome guy who gives off an aura that scares the crap out of everyone...

title: Jumping Over
description: A special story between an ordinary high school student, Woo Yeon-Hee, and a boy who fell from the sky.

title: The Mysterious Man
description:
Ruka is a high-school girl who holds affections for her teacher, Tokio. But one day, a mysterious person shows up and claims that he has come from the past! Not to mention, he calls himself by the same name as her beloved teacher, Tokio. What’s more unbelievable is that both “Tokio” have the exact same scar engraved on their palm…  
  
1. Mysterious Person  
2. A Small Love Story  
3. The Demon Chroe  
4. Alice in Wonderland  
5. Sugar-Coat  
6. Star and Heart

title: Koi Cha no Osahou
description:
Get ready for hot tea and hotter action in this tale of opposites attracting on the tatami mats. Poor Tokumaru Madoka is just a regular energetic guy that can't seem to go even five minutes without breaking something. One day, his hapless sister has had enough, and she forces him to join their high school's Tea Ceremony Club, hoping to instill a little discipline in her hopeless klutz of a brother.  
  
Tea Ceremony Club president Hasune Kazuma is Tokumaru's complete opposite. The tall, dark president is the pinnacle of restraint, having been taught from a young age how to uphold his family's traditions. The sophisticated president and his awkward pupil conceal a brewing attraction, but they can't avoid steaming each other up. Even full to the brim with passion, will the two of them be able to bridge their differences and get along with each other?

title: Hikkaki Mawashite Sore Kara Medete
description:
A mysterious handsome guy who's good at teasing... High school days of being constantly pestered by him begin!

Miyako, a lonely girl who is self-conscious about her sharp eyes, is saved by a young man named Kou when he picks her up. When they first meet, Kou teases Miyako about her eyes, which Miyako finds unpleasant, but on the other hand, Kou becomes more and more interested in Miyako...!?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title: Make Eye Contact with me!
description: 'Hayoon' faints when making eye contact with others. She meets two men with whom she doesn’t faint with. However, both seem to strangely dislike Hayoon… Can Hayoon overcome her ‘fainting phobia’ while being with them?

title: Doki Doki Summer Beach
description: During his free time in Okinawa, Ken is suddenly forced to couple up with a girl.

title: Hanseishite Kameda-kun
description:
What is love? A middle-school boy suddenly finds himself confronted with this momentous question.  
  
The story of Kameda-kun's first love, told by his friend.

title: Koisuru Yakuza-chan
description:
I'm going to confess to Nishi-san on today's date, and I absolutely have to get rejected...!
A youth rom-com between an ordinary high school student and a yakuza girl!

title: Tokyo '80s
description: It's the story of a trip from a teens league of friends in Tokyo of the 80's till today, mirroring their paths and relationships.

title: Koisuru Bicchi-kun
description: Sugiura-kun became an assistant for the manga artist he admired most, only to find out he is a complete slut. Being attacked every day in bed immediately after working, he must deal with the perverted and frustrating sensei. Despite this, Sugiura-kun finds himself thinking "maybe I like Sensei."

title: Winter Spring
description:
Two men of contrasting colors appear in front of Ha-yeon, who is suffering from color blindness.

title: Fruits Basket (Official Colored)
description:
Tohru Honda, an orphaned high school girl, is taken in by the wealthy Shigure Sohma when he realizes she has nowhere else to go. However, the Sohma family shares a secret, and it isn't long before Tohru discovers that there's a reason why her classmates, Yuki and Kyo Sohma, never let girls get near them, and never talk about their lives before they lived with Shigure. And before she knows it, Tohru has become so tangled up in the lives of each member of the Sohma family that she couldn't leave even if she wanted to.  
  
As she learns more and more about the truth of the Sohma family and the nature of their secrets, she desperately searches for a way that she can save them. But what can one girl do, especially when it seems that she may have been part of someone's plan all along…  
  
Fruits Basket received the 2001 Kodansha Manga Award in the shōjo manga category and the "Best Manga" award at the 2007 American Anime Awards

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - Yuchi's 's Love Live Single Image Compilation (Doujinshi)
description:
A collection of stand alone single page comics/images by Yuchi. (Also known as Kireha and Salmon-1000.)  
  
Note: The genres may vary depending on the image.

title: Saikyou Kyoushi
description:
Fujita is raising his elementary school son all by himself. His enemy is the stiff teacher, Ibuki, who is actually called a "dangerous type" and a feared retired Yankee! Ibuki's forceful and savage face as well as his sometimes gentle face, Fujita who is tossed around by the two faces is?!?  
  
The clumsy adult's real love is here. Yamato Nase's best book in history has finally arrived!!

title: Bokura ga Ai o Sakebu Toki
description: Clumsy, shy Mayuko has two true loves in life: being wrapped up in her futon, and listening to the latest from her favorite girl group, KBF47. She spends her lunches alone listening to their music and indulging in fan bliss, but on the one day she decides to practice one of their songs, who should catch her but the school's infamous lone wolf, Ohba-kun! Mortified, Mayuko is frozen in place...until Ohba-kun reveals he's a KBF47 fan, too! Their unlikely friendship gives Mayuko the confidence to grow, but the pair attracts attention, and not all eyes are friendly...! A charming tale of youth, friendship, and the power of shared fandom. [Kodansha]

title: Love And Trap
description:
1: Love & Trap  
After being bullied at elementary school, Mochida 'Maki' Masaki learns to use his own body to enchant and trap the most powerful person at school to protect him from potential bullies. However, a chance encounter sparks a complicated friendship with notorious classmate, Aihara Ryuuji, which soon changes Maki's life – and ultimately, his view of love.  
  
2: Love & Honey  
Maki begins to question the point of his relationship with Aihara.  
  
3: Love & Whip  
Maki discovers that Aihara's cousin, Aihara Kaede, has a thing for Aihara and a bit of contempt for Maki.  
  
4: Love Blood  
Sawaguchi Mirai takes a train to the countryside to get away from his own life, and unexpectedly finds love.  
  
5: Us, Blooming  
Now working at a flower shop, Murakami Takashi is very set on winning the heart of Sakurai Ryui, the beautiful object of his secret and burning love – but his pervy manager, Fujimori Haruhiko, keeps getting in his way.  
  
Extra: Let's Visit The Aihara House

title: Akuma wa Sasayaku
description: A devil whispers sweetly into Sumida's ear…

1. Strange Flavor (ストレンジ・フレーバー)

3. Nemureru Mori (ネムレルモリ)
4. Dear…  
5. Hako no Naka no Himegimi (箱の中の姫君)
6. Natsu no Owari ni (夏の終わりに)

title: Wakeari Kiss
description:
From Senpai Scans:  
Yamabuki-kun is a flashy playboy - someone who's completely different from Mosako. But when he miraculously grows a pair of cat ears, she's the only one who can help him…by kissing him?!

title: Otonari ni Spica
description: Hikari, who lives next door to Shizuka Sato, an average, average high school girl, is a super-bishojo boy who is famous in the neighborhood. Shizuka feels a complex for Hikari, who looks like a beautiful girl from every angle, but Hikari doesn't want to leave the side of her childhood friend Shizuka...?　I wonder if I... am being loved by a handsome boy...⁉ This is a coming of age love comedy between two childhood friends!

title: Cinderella's Plot
description: Isn't Cinderella in the fairy tale who puts on high heels and becomes a princess? Why I'm a man, who just temporarily wore high heels for fun, became a princess also?

title: To Julie
description: At the end of the first year of Joo-won's High School, To meet / get his daily needs, He studied dedicatedly while working as a part-time job worker, Because he was the only support in his family, who can earn for his own. After being recognized for his skills and dedication towards his studies, he received a (transfer proposal) to get better education from a prestigious high school, So from the new semester he transferred to a private Hana High School. Joo-won, who said he would study consistently at the new school, For some reason he couldn't get focused on his studies because of a soft pink wind which was flowing around him... And the woman he calls anxiously Julie? Who is she? His destiny or a strange person in his life After all, who will Joo-won choose, his dream or his destiny? let's wait and see which path he will choose at the end.....!!

title: We are in love
description: Shi Guang and Xia Ling, he's an office worker, and she's a college student. For these two, who're halfway there into society, this new cohabitation life is full of surprises and unknowns.

title: Love Live! - Love Signal (Doujinshi)
description: NicoMaki Doujin

title: Bloody Kiss
description:
Katsuragi Kiyo inherits a mansion AND vampires from a grandmother she never met. How does her life change after her so called fortune?  
  
This manga also contains an extra story in both volume 1 and 2:  
  
- Angel Koiuta (Angel Love Song)  
Mizuho is a young girl who just had an argument with her boyfriend, Kei-chan. On the way home, she met a fallen guy from the greenhouse along with a guitar who called himself Tenshi. Mizuho took him home and asked him to form a group for the competition to win a cruise dinner so she could make up with Kei-chan. So will Mizuho get back together with her boyfriend or will something else spark?  
This story was released as a oneshot in the furoku book Glittering X-Mas Story 2003.  
  
- Kyuuketsuki no Onegai (Please Mr. Vampire)  
Miku heard that there is a place where you can ask to become beautiful. She wants to be beautiful to be able go to the dance with a boy she likes. However when she goes to this place it turns out that te person who can mak

title: Junjou Haraguro Kareshi
description: Yuuki is a cute boy, who is Akane's childhood friend. Akane starts to fall in love with a guy and she confides in Yuuki. But Yuuki would not have it, as he kisses Akane. For the first time, Akane gets to see the real Yuuki?!

title: Kanon
description: Do nghề nghiệp mà bố mẹ Aizawa Yuichi phải đến châu Phi, anh chuyển về nhà dì sau 7 năm xa cách. Thời gian đã làm phai mờ những kỉ niệm của anh về những con người nơi đây, kể cả với cô em họ Nayuki. Nhưng dần dần những cô gái Yuichi từng gặp trước đây đã xuất hiện, thời gian đã qua và những việc đã xảy ra trong cuộc sống của họ tạo nên giai điệu cho câu chuyện. Bí mật dần hiện rõ, và kí ức trở về không chỉ riêng với Yuichi, mà còn với tất cả những người xung quanh anh, đầy bi thương. Một câu chuyện cảm động với những sắc màu cảm xúc, sự bí ẩn và siêu nhiên giữa mùa đông lạnh giá. Chuyển thể từ visual novel của công ty Key vào năm 1999. Key cũng là nguyên tác của các visual novel và anime nổi tiếng như AIR, CLANNAD, Angel Beats!.

title: Miyatake Miracle
description: Towa has a big complex towards her brother. One day she meets Miyatake, a friend of her brother and her first impression is not at all positive and on the contrary, she is annoyed by the boy; however, every time she has a problem Miyatake appears and stands by her. Will his sweetness be able to reach her?

title: Ikujinashi no Kimi ni Sasageru
description: Hinata Karui and Seiji Matsuyama have been friends since childhood. When they were kids, Hinata loved Seiji innocently and affectionately, but one day he is attacked in a park by an unknown pervert. From then on, the relationship between the two changes drastically.

title: Shinigami Lovers
description: Onda Miku was just a regular high school girl who loves nails. But suddenly, she got into a terrible accident, and the shinigami (death god) Sei fastened his chain of death onto her wrist! Sei may be hot, but he is a bit scary. Being tied together with him, just what kind of fate awaits Miku!?

title: Suiren
description: "When I'm in the water, I'm not sure whether I'm crying or not." Rio belongs to the swimming club and is an excellent swimmer. She has even been told by the club adviser to help out Yokoyama, a member who can't swim, because she's good at teaching others how to swim. She is also a close friend to Jun, another swimming club member. What will happen to these three?

title: Seifuku, Kekkon
description:
Hirata Nao, an ordinary sixteen-year-old girl in a single parent family, was happy leading an ordinary life with an ordinary dream to get married and make a warm home with the man she would fall in love with. However, her life is turned upside down when her father left her and her two younger siblings in debt of ¥10m (approx. US$100k) in search of a national treasure to repay it!  
  
With a huge debt to pay off, collectors at her door every other day, and two young siblings and herself to feed, she works part-time in three different jobs everyday, yet the return is close to nothing. But she doesn't give up hope.   
  
Per chance, or be it fate, Nao encounters Chikage Saga, an honour student of the advanced class from her school, who comes from an extremely wealthy background. Chikage offers her a part-time job with a pay so high that she would be able to pay off her debt in no time! Being at her wits end and considering the lucrative return of the job, Nao signs the contract without a

title: Benkyou no Jikan
description:
When Nao recieves a terrible grade on the latest test, there's only one person to turn to: Andou-kun, the silent boy with his long hair covering his eyes. He gets great grades, and is semi-willing to help Nao out. Turns out that under all that hair, there's a cute boy…!  
  
Includes 3 short stories:  
- Benkyou no Jikan  
- So, Stand by Me  
- Green Days

title: Dakara Bokutachi wa Osananajimi wo Yameta.
description:
We were childhood friends back then. Tomoe Yako, Takehiro Furuya, and Kyotaro Mikagami The three of us, who lived near each other, always played together in good harmony. However, by the time they graduated from junior high school, Tomoe had emerged as a pianist and Takehiro as a karate fighter, creating a big gap between them and Kyotaro, who had nothing... One day, Kyotaro was told, "You shouldn't get in the way of those two," and he realized that he was a hindrance to them. He spent his high school life trying to keep his distance from them and avoid them. But on the day of graduation, Kyotaro goes to see them and what does he see? The gears of their childhood friendship are becoming more and more twisted, and where they will end up--!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Ume Shigure
description: The story of castle otaku, Ume, meeting a sexy blonde escort girl named Shigure…Is that really it or is there more? Read and find out!

title: 12-Sai
description: The age where one is neither a child or an adult, 12 years-old. The story of 12 year-old girls and their first loves.

title: Haruyuki Bus
description: A boy riding on a bicycle is always observed from the bus at the same time of the day and the same place. One day, a girl happens to meet his gaze. Her eyes met his. Though it is a usual bus running everywhere, it is always carrying different feelings of passengers, such as painful love or one-sided love.

title: Twin Connect
description: They said that twins are always close to each other, but the twins Rizki and Rizka are always competing in everything, even in love affairs!

title: Guardian Dog
description: Kurosaka Gengo is just your normal highschool boy, who likes to skip cleaning duty. However, Gengo's peaceful life ends when he comes across a strange man. That man claims to be an alien and is in need of Gengo's body to survive on earth. Not only does Gengo deal with the alien, but with others that are after him!

title: Shireba Shiruhodo
description: Mori-san has found a comfortable place to be in her friendship with Shinohara-kun, but can it stay that way forever? Are they really “just friends”? The more she knows, the more she realizes that things may not be as simple as they seem.

title: Dream Lover
description: I grew up with a crazy crush on the boy next door, but he moved away and I never heard from him. Unexpectedly, one day we actually met again at the university, and he became my teacher? How should I catch him in my heart?

title: With!!
description: Masago is an average student. Everything about her is average except for her older brother, Shirou. He’s the president of the student council and everyone admires him. One day, while walking home with her brother, they get into an accident and her brother dies saving her. After Shirou’s funeral, Masago goes to the house of her brother's best friend, claiming to be her older brother.

title: Our Studio
description: The cutie gamer friend's at my martial arts studio!

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Drunk on the Moon (Doujinshi)
description:
Claudine visits Maya's room to chat with her about a book she's just finished, but finds her acting a bit strangely.   
  
Tendou Maya x Claudine Saijou (MayaKuro) Doujinshi.  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

title: Aoi Haru yo Saraba!
description:
Tochimo began going out with the optimistic and spontaneous Yoshino. While their trivial day-to-day repeats itself, their problems increase by the day. “I want to stay with you.” “This is how I truly feel. This is how I truly feel, but…” “Someday, someday, I’ll have a ‘normal’ relationship with someone, get married and…” “I wonder if this won’t work out…” “I’m just thinking about the end.” While Tochimoto was feeling troubled, Yoshino suddenly appeared. “Hey, Tochimo… Let’s run away.” “...I wonder if this is ok.”
This is a story about their bittersweet youth.

title: Kimi ja Nakya Dame Nanda.
description: Nanoka's grandfather, right before dying, tells her that she's not alone – she has a brother. But when Nanoka arrives at the address her grandfather gave her, she finds out that there are two brothers there! They aren't related by blood, and Nanoka has no idea which one is her brother. Is it Aoi or Kou?

title: Ura Peach Girl
description: Kairi and Momo are attending university together and are finally happy…but Sae has been left behind after failing her last year of high school–she should've attended class a bit more! Follow Sae's adventures as she reunites with a childhood love and deals with high school life once again.

title: Uma Musume Pretty Derby - The Scenery of a Roommate (Doujinshi)
description: A series of Umamusume comics made by [TKtk(Takateke)](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/14211892) involving the Umamusume girls' antics with their respective roommates.

title: Choose Wood and Dwell
description: Eight years ago, the innocent, rich heir Jiang Yumian pursued his tutor Qin Heng; eight years later, the roles are reversed. The nouveau rich Qin Heng reunites with his first love Yumian by chance. This time, he decides he will hold tight to him and not let go.

title: Koisuru Koakuma
description: Doujinshi made by [Satomori Umi](https://x.com/satomoriumi) released for GirlsLoveFestival47 (GLFes47).

title: Amagami - Sincerely Yours
description:
A second-year high school boy finds himself uneasy during Christmas time due to an experience in the past. However, this year at Christmas, he gets his last chance to ask out a graduating female senior named Haruka Morishima or one of several other classmates. The story of the anime will be arranged in an omnibus format, with each heroine getting her own version of the story animated. Each heroine will sing her own version of the ending theme song.  
  
Based on the visual novel by Enterbrain with the same name.

title: Natura-turaly
description:
1: Natura-turaly  
My twin brother and I, we like and dislike the same things. Whatever we do, we do together. I thought we'd always be together – it seemed obvious. But a man appeared, claiming to love my brother. Is the world I thought would go on forever starting to collapse?!  
  
2: Veranda Nite (On The Veranda)  
A boy moved to a new apartment but when he goes out on the veranda to smoke, he encounters something out of this world.  
  
3: Count 3632  
A boy is trapped in an elevator with a very unfriendly novelist.  
  
4: Step One  
Suichi does not like to socialize with people. Why does Hana keep finding excuses to talk to him?  
  
5: Test Play from Itai Ero  
A couple's relaxed routine is disrupted when the one partner proposes a new kind of play. To his surprise, his significant other discovers a higher affinity to his role than expected.  
  
6: Michidzure  
A boy who is easily roped into things meets a cool beauty who is a natural asshole.

title: One Reason Why He Hates Me
description: Seowoo is head over heals in love with Doyoung, except there seems to be a major problem… Doyoung hates him. After a love fairy visits Seowoo, he's given a chance to make Doyoung fall in love with him, but only on one condition- he needs to find out the one reason why he hates him.

title: Book Club
description: "For those who have courage…for those who do not fear death…open this book and turn the page!” goes the magazine in which this manhwa is serialized in. And for good reason. Peek into the horror within this particular book club. The president Kyungdo is a crazy maniac about books and while Eunsae tries to protect him from them, he is just so crazy about them. His fate in fact is connected to the legendary library of Alexandria, the greatest library that was ever destroyed, and Truman Capote’s In Cold Blood.

title: Majo to Hatsukoi
description: Seira Murahoshi, a 16-year-old girl, can see the auras of people. Because of that, everyone calls her a witch. One day, as she is walking to school with her only best friend, Mika, she meets a boy shining with a golden aura who rudely asks her if she is the "Witch of Himesaki", even after he breaks her sunglasses!

title: Shine Star
description:
Kim Shine is a famous track star at the school Sun Yoobyul transfers to. He's got a handsome face, great athleticism, and an evil girlfriend!  
  
"If I can run a little faster–even faster than Kim Shine–will he look at me?"  
  
"Track Genius, Sun Yoobyul," who's more interested in eating than running, and "Track Idiot, Kim Shine" who's only focused on running. A drama about the growth and youth of the boys and girls in the track & field department.

title: Twitter 4koma
description: A collection of Flowers 4koma strips published by MEDALDA on Twitter

title: Shinshoku Syndrome
description:
'I don't need any help.' 'It's easier to do it yourself than to rely on others.' That's what Souko told him. But he slowly getes close to Souko and told her that she doesn't need to baby him.

___

1. Shinshoku Syndrome (侵食症候群)

2. あたたかな場所

3. ボクのペットになりなさい。

4. Haitoku Ronri / Immoral Logic (背徳論理) - A forbidden romance between a student and teacher. After a few years, the student returns as a teacher himself. How would they face the past?

5. あたたかな場所 HARU Side:

title: Sheryl - Kiss in the Galaxy
description: In the near future on the starship Galaxy, Sheryl Nome lived with her parents Abel and Sally. The government tracked her parents down who were rebelling against mandatory human enhancing implants and Sheryl was the only one who got away alive. Barely surviving on her own on the streets, Grace O’Connor, a manager at a talent agency brings her in to make her a star. Several years later Sheryl is enrolled into the Erato Music School where she meets Amagi Lilies, a brilliant singer and they become friends. However, tragedy strikes and Lilies dies trying to save Sheryl. To make sure her parent’s sacrifice was not in vain and to keep her promise with Lilies, Sheryl enters into the entertainment world to become the greatest singer in the universe.

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - An Overprotective Alpha and a Bullheaded Omega (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya (alpha) and Saijou Claudine (omega) have finally become an official couple. However, Maya's tendency to be a helicopter girlfriend sometimes gets on Claudine's nerves. Meanwhile, Maya believes that Claudine's tendency to be too trusting of others can be risky. The two will have to figure out a way to resolve their issues.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Kyuukyoku Venus
description: Poor Yuzu is an orphan who's too clumsy to hold a job. She's reduced to living in a playground—until a handsome stranger named Hassaku informs her that she's heir to a fortune, and whisks her into a world of wealth, power, and more hot suitors than she can shake a scepter at! But there's a catch: Hassaku must turn this klutz into a lady of refinement, or Yuzu will lose everything!

title: Imprinting Coffee
description: Student council president Hayato's adolescent love story.

title: Schadenliebe
description:
From Lilyka:

High schooler, Hitsuka, is unhappy and dissatisfied with her life and projects her discontent towards fellow classmate, Chisako. She is envious of Chisako, who is at the top of her class in terms of popularity. And while Chisako seems perfect in every way, that all comes crashing down when she has an accident while on a trip. She now has to live with an incurable disease known as “Nekushi Illness.” “It affects the mind, body and spirit, causing fatigue and overall weakness.” While one girl has struggled all her life to be happy, the other girl will finally see what life is like feeling the same way.

title: Onsengai no Medusa
description: In a certain hot spring town lives a high school girl who has a "Medusa" syndrome.

title: GIRL
description:
The countdown of the human species began.  
The sun has come closer to Earth, causing radioactive rays that kill all female fetus. Some mothers even died during their daughter's miscarriage due to hemorrhage.  
  
Confusion reigned homo sapiens' first phase of extinction: mate competition, countries vying for a solution, families losing their loved ones. The government has required all females to take tests to collect data for research on developing a cure. Ho Su was identified as the one who is immune to the radioactive rays emitting from the sun. To prevent war between nations over her, Professor Yun has kept his founding about her immune a secret and has persuaded Ho Su's father to let him freeze Ho Su in hibernation, waiting for a time when the situation has stabilized from chaos to experiment on her for a vaccine.  
  
30 years later.  
It is now the year of 2042. The world has became a place dominated by males. Women are virtually extinct with their number-count in the hundreds a

title: Negiho (Ito) Bun
description: An alternate take on Mahou Sensei Negima! In this universe, Negi and co. still have their teacher/student relationship, but Negi's an adult and the rest are kindergarten students! (enjoy the cuteness)

title: Kurono-san wa Occult ga Suki!
description:
“Even if I'm a scaredy-cat, I like scary stuff!”

An exploration tour with Kurono-san that's palpitating in various ways!

She's a scaredy-cat, but Kurono-san loves the occult.

Yuuki-kun gets summoned by her, half-forcefully. To find occult items she loves, Kurono-san gathers up her courage and goes to actual locations!

A bright and fun horror and comedy series!!!

title: Ten no Ryuu Chi no Sakura
description:
Sakura Karukaya liked her life: she was just a high schooler who loved rhythmic gymnastics, being raised by her older brother and sister. However, both of her siblings were hiding secrets about themselves and Sakura that would make her realize that the world around them was not what it seemed. Now, with the help of a mysterious dragon named Yoiyami, Sakura will have to confront these forces and the power within her if she wants to rescue her beloved brother and sister.  
  
[PL] Sakura lubiła swoje dotychczasowe życie. Była smukłą i wysoką dziewczyną ze zdolnościami do gimnastyki artystycznej. Jednak jej życie zmieniło się, kiedy dowiedziała się, że jej świat został zbudowany z iluzji…

title: Starry☆Sky~in Spring~
description:
From Huffly Parfait Scans:  
  
Perched atop a hill with a clear view of the stars, Seigatsu High School is a boarding school specializing in astronomy. The only girl enrolled in Seigatsu High School, Yahisa Tsukiko, lived an idyllic life alongside her two childhood friends, Kanata and Suzuya.  
  
Then one day, Tomoe Yoh arrived, transferring from France. From awkward beginnings, these four opened up to one another and grew to become irreplaceable best friends. But during the spring of their junior year, further changes have been blossoming within their relationship…

title: Eiken: Remake-ban
description:
In 2001, author Seiji Matsuyama penned *Eiken*, a manga about the eponymous high school club filled with the bustiest girls on the printed page (and one awkward reader self-insert). 

Now, 23 years later, Eiken returns in this new serialization, with completely new art by (adjusts glasses) …Generative AI?

title: Kiss to Koukai
description:
**Kiss to Koukai (Kisses and Regrets)**  
The distance between us wouldn't diminish. It's painful, lonely, and my heart squeezes in pain. At that time, if I had been more honest, would it change anything…? Yeah, right. That's why this time, so I won't regret it, I'll…

Hinako is the only girl to receive special attention from Katsuragi-senpai, the popular Kyuudo club president protected by his male club-member guards from all girls, not just fangirls. But Hinako's preferential treatment resembles nothing so much as a senior's spartan training of a junior. At first happy over how Katsuragi-senpai diligently takes time to teach her "many things," Hinako later questions why her so-called enviable position saddens her.  
  
**Ikenai Koto (Something I Shouldn't Do)**  
Yui vehemently refuses to have her little brother's friend Haruka stay over at her house for the three days his parents are away…  
  
**Kimi no Button Kudasai (Give Me Y

title: Kinou no Tomo wa Kyou no Kare
description:
"With a friend I've always loved.
The first day of our exciting relationship begins..."

title: Mikazuki to Nagareboshi
description:
From Whitelies Fansub:   
  
Hasegawa Mitsuki, a college freshman. Mitsuki has been thinking about the same person since she was 16 years old. That person, being 18 years older. A Coffe Shop Manager, Asai Ryusei, a divorced man with an only son.  
To Mitsuki, Ryusei is a really important person but, her romantic interest for him is slowly…?!

title: Lovely★Complex - Digital Colored Comics
description:
Risa Koizumi is the tallest girl in class, and the last thing she wants is the humiliation of standing next to Atsushi Otani, the shortest guy. Fate and the whole school have other ideas, and the two find themselves cast as the unwilling stars of a bizarre romantic comedy duo.  
  
Lovely Complex Plus is actually volume 17 with the final chapter called Love Com Final. The first two chapters are about before Koizumi Risa and Otani Atsushi met each other. The third chapter is about their first encounter and a little bit of what happens to them after the ending of Lovely Complex.  
  
Contains a side story called Hoshi ni Natte mo Aishiteru (Even When I Become A Star, I'll Still Love You) in volume 12

title: Itoshii Akuma
description: Super handsome and charismatic Naruse Fuuta, who harbors feelings for honor student, Akiyoshi Tooru, advances to the same university. However, due to their different majors, they begin seeing less of each other. What happens when Akiyoshi becomes acquainted with Naruse’s old friend, Hiyama Chiaki, and goes along to his mixer party?

title: Osananajimi to Trunks: Ano Musume wa Honto ni Onna no Ko?
Fushigi na Yuunagi
description:
A school wonder life of two girls!

Nagi, a girl who sees stars in her eyes when she wanders, and Yu, who cares for her. 
Their friendship is at the mercy of mysterious events that occur one after another.

title: Sekai no Owari to Guruguru Bambi
description: Riko Sahara is overjoyed when she learns she passed her high school entrance exam. However, she is hit by a truck on her way home, and she comes to the realization that she doesn’t know love yet! She survives by a hair and enrolls in high school, where she meets Usami-kun. Riko is strangely drawn to Usami, only to find out he has a secret…

title: Goshujinsama ni Ki wo Tsukete
description:
When his twin sister breaks her leg, she forces Tsuda to substitute her at her secret job as "Ruu", a waitress in a maid cafe. Of course, on his first day, classmate Kaname shows up! But they're not close and Kaname has a hard time remembering people's faces…  


---

description:
Collection of stories:  
  
1-3. The Prince's Lifestyle  
4. Your side even the stars don't know  
5. Twinkle Star's Troubles  
6. The Love Letter Murder Case

title: Gakkou Hotel
description: Welcome to the School Hotel, where the people who can’t show their true self at the afternoon school, can be themselves. One day, Tenno Toriko, a highly intelligent student at Kenrin High School was invited to the School Hotel…?

title: BanG Dream - LisaYuki à la carte (Doujinshi)
description: Originally posted on the web in piecemeal, this is a cute and fluffy smorgasbord featuring Yukina and Lisa.

title: Korosareru nara, Isso Sakura no Ki no Shita de
description:
- (1) Dead Friend's Love Letter (Chapters 1-3)  
One day, Yukino received a weird message  
from her best friend Saho.  
Then when she came to school she heard about  
her death. Truth is, she killed herself because  
she was persecuted by her schoolmates…  
So why is her last message "run"…?  
  
- (2) I’d Rather be Killed Under the Cherry Tree (Chapter 4)  
Sasagawa is not the type who can easily make friends, yet Saho opens to her and they slowly end up to be the best of friends. When Yukino enters their group the balance is somehow broken. A short oneshot about friendship, love and betrayal. This is Sasagawa’s version of the story: Dead Friend’s Love Letter.  
  
- (3) (Chapter 5)

title: My Boyfriend
description: A love story as sweet as cotton candy. Highschoolers date too.

title: Sokuochi 2 Koma No Kaede-Kun♂
description: Manga 2 Koma About Kaede-kun and Ryuu's Fun and Funny Daily Life, And A Little Romance

title: Kawaii No Nani Ga Waruino?
description: Two schools in conflict with a river between them. Marika, the top student at the fashion high school who loves cute things, and Sakuragi, the top student at the technical high school who is always up for a fight. The two never had anything to do with each other, but one day, Marika spots Sakuragi in front of a clothing store... A fashion yuri comedy about making delinquent delinquent girls cute!

title: Yuuri-kun to Chihiro-chan
description: Tokoh utama, Chihiro, akan segera masuk sekolah menengah atas dan berharap dapat bertemu kembali dengan teman masa kecilnya, Yuuri. Meskipun mereka berdua bersekolah di sekolah dasar yang berbeda, mereka telah bertukar surat selama bertahun-tahun dan akhirnya memutuskan untuk bersekolah di sekolah menengah atas yang sama! Namun, ketika ia bertemu kembali dengan Yuuri setelah sekian lama, ia mendapati bahwa Yuuri adalah gadis yang sangat cantik, berbeda dengan laki-laki yang ia ingat! Terlebih lagi, tampaknya Yuuri juga menganggap Chihiro sebagai seorang gadis...! Apa yang akan terjadi pada kehidupan sekolah menengah mereka setelah reuni yang tak terduga ini?

title: Change 2!!
description: Kisaragi Maki is the heiress of a yakuza group. She only dreams about being a normal high school student, and becoming an ordinary bride. However, when she sees blood, she changes completely and becomes violent. Will she be able to keep living an ordinary life?

title: Beyond the Feeling
description: This oneshot involves the Drama Club's President Yuki-chan and her best-friend Saori-chan. A very energetic Saori reminds Yuki why she became the Drama Club's President in the first place.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The Legend of the Piko Piko Middle School Students
description:
The National Defense Junior High School "NERV" is training pilots of the new weapon "Evangelion" in preparation for a decisive battle against mysterious giant life forms. Will Shinji and his friends be able to become Evangelion pilots at a school that gathers talented gamers from all over the world?!

[Official English*](https://digital.darkhorse.com/books/d991ed973f7e42e580f4be2c355f355f/neon-genesis-evangelion-legend-of-the-piko-piko-middle-school-students-volume-1-tpb)

    *Official English release discontinued by Dark Horse. No tankobon past Volume 2 have been released since January 3rd, 2018.

title: Color
description:
Originally a one-shot, but has been extended as a series due to popularity!  
  
A blooming love story begins between Sumire and Touta, two neighbors who have been together since childhood.

title: My Idol Is Too Cute!: Anthology Comic
description:
“You can have me all to yourself.”

Beautiful, cheerful, and popular with everyone. But these unattainable idols are all lovey-dovey with me at home!? A heart-warming anthology comic for boys who want to be captivated by idols' gaps!

title: Seishun Sanka!
description: Hoshiro, who had studied earnestly in order to impress girls with his brains, ended up in an all-boys high school! Now what? Well, it's off to the school's legendary wish-granting Tanuki Statue to pray for love! But what happens when his earnest wishes are overheard by the school idol?

title: Zettai Ren'ai Program
description:
A guy is 100% perfect. But… he's an android?!!  
  
Includes three oneshots:  
Volume 1  
Hatsukoi Kouho  
  
Volume 2  
Ore no Subete ga Kimi no Mono  
Gosenfu no Love Letter  
  
[PL] Chłopak jest w 100% idealny. Ale… jest androidem?!!

title: Sengaku
description:
Sengoku Academy Private High School. 

This mysterious academy allows students to increase their power by overwriting the family crest that each of them has somewhere on their body. 

At this particular high school, the new female student Toyotomi Hideyoshi aims to escape from a life of poverty by using information as a weapon. But things get complicated as soon as she catches the attention of the outstanding problem student Oda Nobunaga.

title: Aohare Otome
description:
Yura is a girl with no friends or boyfriend. However, the moment the handsome soccer club captain accidentally kicked the ball to her face, the revelation came to her ... "I want to be his ball!" (Translation: I want to be his lover!).

Yura then decides to join the women's soccer club so she can get closer to him. The members and advisors in the women's soccer club, which are full of antics, start to move to get their ideal lover.

title: Chick Bomb
description: A girl harboring feelings for her childhood friend receives some help from little balls of fluff… For better or for worse.

title: Naisho no Jikan
description: While at school, Mahiro is the super straight-laced honor student. But she has a secret… after school, she works at a cosplay cafe owned by her uncle! Will she be able to peacefully live her double life after her classmate Hinata discovers her secret?

title: Perfect Twin
description: Shibata Tonami has an ability to see various mirages whenever there's rain, which isolates him from others who don't understand him. However, after his encounter with Kawakami Miki, a beautiful girl who has an ability of her own, everything in Tonami's life changes.

title: Hajimari no Natsu
description:
Shinji, Manabu and Chinatsu are neighbor and childhood friends. Because they hide their thoughts from each other, their feelings became lock inside their heart. At that time, Manabu informed the other about "that things". And he could trust his friends forever. But what will happen when they grown up and start to change the way they feel about it…? 

Included is the oneshot: I Just Love You.

title: Koi no Mizu Kudasai
description:
From Café Scanlations:  
A girl who sealed her love for her childhood friend…   
A girl who was being treated as a replacement of a rabbit by a fluffy lover Senpai…  
A glasses boy from an elite school who can't help but notice a girl from a dropout school…   
A girl who seeks refuge in the library because she dislikes interacting with others…   
A girl who admires witches…   
The five girls are put under a magic spell known as love…   
A fluffy and light omnibus love story.

title: Yungsu's Spring
description: Spring was never Yungsuu's favourite season, until he met this girl. From the moment he captured her with his camera, he knew he was in love. She, Iyang, was charming (in his eyes), although in reality, she nothing but. Furthermore, he found and peeked at her artbook, revealing that she may have a shocking hobby that may change his mind about her (or not)...

title: 2 Million Dollar Girl
description: When a case of mistaken identity results in her kidnapping, the would-be target is tasked with handing over her own ransom... But one thing leads to another and then everything turns topsy-turvyin this bizarre kidnapping story!

title: Nikomekko
description: Nico Kusahara, a high school girl, has been cursed by the devil to save her life, and if she smiles, bad things will happen to those she cares about. Nico has to keep her smile in check and leads her high school life as a cool-headed student council president, but one day, Shibahama-kun, the hottest guy in school, confesses his love to her⁉ A new kind of love comedy in which you must never laugh!

title: Yurara no Tsuki
description: Yurara Tsukinowa is a quiet girl who can see spirits and sense their emotions. Not wanting to seem abnormal, she hides her secret until she meets Mei Tendo and Yako Hoshino, two guys who use their spiritual powers to ward off vengeful spirits. The dormant guardian spirit in Yurara arises and a strong-willed beauty with the power to release souls emerges!

title: Pui Pui!
description:
Jin Araki, a very dense student whose parents are archeologists, finds a lamp in a package they sent him. 
When he casually polishes it the academy idol Sierra Zadou abruptly appears dressed in a maid outfit!
This is just the start of a "comical" nightmare for the both of them...

title: Sisters at War
description: Two girls who wanted to be voted the best. «Principled» and «Ugly Ha-Ra», compete for the first and second place in the art school. A deadly war begins between the girls to become «true geniuses».

title: Hanada
description: When she stands, she is a peony; when she sits, she is a lotus; when she walks, she is a lily. Oozing sex pheromones in full throttle, is the perfectly flawless princess, Hanada Ran. And now that she's transferring from her high-class all girls school to a co-ed school, she's decided to search for her prince! First she meets Kashiwagi Eiji, a lively boy who insults her–he's the last man she'd ever want. Then she meets the student body president, Watabe Shizuru, a perfect prince, and sets her sights on him! But then her parents announce that she has an arranged marriage with the son of the people who saved their lives… the Kashiwagi family!?

title: Oouso Swing
description:
"Everyday, no matter what, we tell some sort of lie."  
  
Shirose Sayo has always been mildly interested in Saeki Aoi, mainly because he's different from the other guys in her class. However, upon graduating middle school, Sayo's image of Saeki is destroyed and she finds he is not the mature young man she thought he was. A year later, they meet again by chance through a group blind date. They clear up their misunderstanding and become friends… but there's one uncomfortable issue. Saeki is in love with Mina, the girlfriend of Daichi, Sayo's older brother!   
  
Includes oneshots: * **Futaba no Totemo Sainan na Hi*** **Bride on Loan (Hanayome Kashidashichuu)**

title: Rin to Hanasaku Majo No Koi
description:
Suddenly, a person's face turns black, and they die a few days later. Futaba Rinka possesses this special ability, and after the death of her parents, she ends up living with her cousin, Nishimiya Saku. Ever since she was a child, Saku has been Rinka's only source of emotional support. He was also her first love. However, Saku has a secret that he hasn't told Rinka...?

A love suspense story between a girl with special abilities and a mysterious young man!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Hate no Kouya de Bakansu o
description:
A collection of one shots: 

1. Futaribocchi no Ever After (ふたりぼっちのエバーアフター) (2019) 
A fairy tale about a mysterious young man and a child living deep in an enchanted forest. 

2. Kaeru no Ouji-sama (蛙の王子様) (2019) 
High school story loosely based on the Brothers Grimm's "The Frog Prince". 

3. Hate no Kouya de Vacances wo (果ての荒野でバカンスを) (2020) 
Shin, who is on a solo mission to cultivate a planet, regularly reports to engineer Rukiya, an engineer who remained on earth. 

4. End roll (エンドロール)

title: Chocomimi
description: Meet Choco and Mimi, best friends in eighth grade. Choco is serious and reliable while Mimi is silly and spoiled rotten, but they both have a flair for fashion! Follow their adventures as they tackle junior high one fashionable day at a time!

title: Kanojo ni Kubittake
description:
Everyone knows Ichiro Kaku—brilliant, wise, multi-talented, and impossibly handsome. As the student council president with a 100% approval rating, and a genius girlfriend at his side, he’s the flawless star of the academy.

But where there's light, there's a shadow... and that shadow is Jiro Kaku. Ichiro's younger brother exists solely to keep Ichiro perfect—yet no one even knows he exists.

That all changes when Jiro encounters a mysterious talking severed head, and his ordinary invisibility collapses into chaos! A suspenseful and eccentric high school comedy unfolds as a zero-presence boy and a headstrong (and head-only!) girl team up in a bizarre, fast-paced partnership!

title: Mitsuai Celeb
description:
A collection of short stories.  
  
- **1 - Friendly Fire by Yokoyama Mayumi**  
Azusa was recently dumped by her boyfriend, so her best friend, Naoto, tries to cheer her up. However, the following morning Azusa wakes up next to Naoto, naked and covered in kiss marks… What the heck happened!!?!  
- **2 - B・F Romance by Mitsuki Kako**  
The first meeting was caused by Misato's hair getting caught on Nagao's button. The second time, coincidentally the same thing happened. A fated meeting with a boy with a hidden secret.  
- **3 - Ookamitachi no Shiikuhou by Shiiba Nana**  
Meguri's parents are overseas so she is entrusted with her new friend's family. She's living together with two bullying brothers in a gorgeous house. And there is only a brief time to be pleased…  
- **4 - 7 Days by Konno Risa**  
Satsuki of the track and field club is attracted to Kishimoto-kun, who motivated her to get out of her slump. But he's going to transfer in a week.  
- **5 - Mikkai Coffee Flavor by Motomi Ky

title: Te wo Tsunai de Koi wo
description:
Sekiya never really had any problems with his kyuudo club teammates. Until one day, he overhears fellow club mate Nagashima saying that he doesn't approve of Sekiya.  
  
Aggravated by it, neither of them can concentrate on archery practice, and so the cheerful club president Tatsumi-senpai tells them to become friends by holding hands on their way from school every day.

title: Sugar Family
description: Because of their parent's remarriage, high school student Satou Yuka, suddenly finds herself living together with her stepbrother, 23-year-old high school teacher Satou Taichi. Actually, their parents have not registered their marrriage and therefore they aren't even siblings by law; but since both parents aren't around, they end up living together! Taichi who has a very serious case of sister complex, wishes for Yuka to call him "onii-chan." But Yuka's reaction is very cold?

title: Osananajimi de Oshide Ite!
description:
Sakira and Toru have known each other since childhood. They have always been into the same things, and now that they are in high school, they are into Korean idols. ‼︎ ...but in fact, Sakira has always liked Toru. When she decides to confess her feelings to him... Toru participates in an open idol audition show. ⁉︎ 
"Toru is quickly becoming famous. I want to support him because I'm an otaku too, but I also want him to be my own personal favorite...‼︎"

title: Koisuru Hetare wa Itsumo Bukiyou
description:
Takumi, a handsome high school student, has a crush on his classmate Mei. Normally, Takumi is a cool guy who is popular with girls, but when it comes to Mei, he becomes a clumsy idiot! He is so conscious of her that he can't say "I love you" or he gets lost fantasizing about being in love with her. One day, Takumi is finally called out by Mei, but...

A love-comedy about a handsome guy who gets swept away by love and a beautiful girl who is a bit dense about love.

title: Dash!
description:
Akimoto has just started his high school career at Miya High and he is burning with enthusiasm. Not because he's in the springtime of his youth, or because he has his eyes set on some beautiful upperclassman; rather, Akimoto is overjoyed to finally be able to meet his long time Judo idol Saitou! Akimoto has watched Saitou ever since his middle school days, but the real Saitou isn't matching up to the Saitou of Akimoto's dreams. Foul-mouthed, with a bad attitude and a superiority complex, Saitou decided to use Akimoto's admiration against him and turn him into his slave.   
  
But Saitou has a deep, dark secret that he is hiding from his kouhai. Will Akimoto still look up to Saitou when it is revealed? Join Akimoto, Saitou and the rest of the Miya Judo team in this charming tale of high school love between senpai and kouhai.

description: A daily school life story between Mokou & Kaguya.

title: Monster Girl
description:
Monster among us!? Weird but it's the truth. They're among us... Going through life normal humans. What's different is they're physical appearance. But, their heart is pure!

Please enjoy this work by Tadatada!

title: Dou Nannyo?!
description:
One morning, Satomi wakes up late for school. As she starts running to school, she crashes into Keshi. After staring at each other, they realize that they have switched bodies! Now Keshi is in Satomi's body and Satomi is in Keshi's body. They decide to live their lives in each others' bodies until they can fix their problem. But things start to get complicated when Mariko, Satomi's best friend, tells Keshi, who is in Satomi's body, that she likes Naoshige, Keshi's best friend. Since Keshi likes Mariko, he has no idea what to do about the situation.  
  
Includes other stories:  
  
- Tomodachi Sando  
   
- Mushibana ♥  
After graduating from middle school, Hirai Yuka hopes to gain many new friends and a handsome boyfriend in high school. But, right before entering high school, she manages to get a major toothache which completely ruins her class introduction. This, in turn, destroys any chance of her obtaining new friends and a boyfriend.  
Forced to go to the dentist and feeling like

title: Soredemo Kimi ga
description:
Español:  
La tranquila Nazumi conoce la vida real del popular Kasai-kun en los exámenes de recuperación. Al enamorarse de él se le confiesa y ¡¡Esta decidida a obtener una respuesta!!. ¡¿Sus sentimientos llegarán este pequeño diablo, Kasai-kun?!  
  
English:  
The quiet Nazumi gets to know the real life of the popular Kasai-kun in the make-up exams. When she falls in love with him, she confesses to him and is determined to get an answer!

title: Consumua and Sudutist
description: Jung Woo spends most of his time nerding out, looking at various fanworks of his favorite characters. One day, he meets the artist of his favorite fanworks, Yoo Jooin, and the more he spends time with her, the more he falls for her. An artist and her number 1 fan: a match made in heaven?
