title: Who's Mr. President?
description: Welcome to Krisopras Highschool, an elite and prestigious school among the country! Yet, it's kind of weird... why does this elite school hide the identities of its student council's members?

title: Miraculous Ladybug - Kiss Me! (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Luka x Marinette, minor Felix x Marinette

title: Akuma no Ichigo
description: The shy Ichigo is interested in creating Western-style clothes. But that trivial hobby will let her make an unexpected encounter that we call love…

title: After The Work Is Finished
description:
The freshman Taeyong, who he met at the theater club, believes thoroughly in Korean superstitions (?) He creates unusual situations where he always gets entangled with Seonho.   
However Taeyong, who was trying to find marital compatibility through a fortune teller wrote Seonho’s name with red letters.

title: Bunny and Grouchy
description: Eccentric girl Yin Ying finally got into the university of her dreams, but she unexpectedly discovers that Ji Yuchuan, the arrogant and gifted senior, is her first love whom she lost contact with for four years. After a huge misunderstanding, the two started a "game", pretending to be a couple. His life is now disturbed by her social butterfly behavior, yet his heart never seemed to stop beating - On the road of my chasing dreams, you were there. The curtains of this show of confusing love is about to be lifted~!

title: Like Doodling
description: Park Nada is an average student that dreams of drawing her own pure Love Manwha and plans to draw manwha quietly while keeping to herself until graduation. Her plan falls to crumbles when she unknowingly enrolls into Bansa High; a infamous school filled with delinquents and terrifying teachers. But not all is lost as two of the most popular and beautiful boys of Bansa High become interested in her. Join Park Nada as she tries to survive high school and her own real life Love Manwha.

title: It's Not Like That!
description: AKA Sonnan Janee Yo! / It's Not Like That    Meet Shizuki Maku - to say she looks "above average" would be a slight overstatement, but it's especially bad compared to her older twin brothers, the highschool heartthrobs Retsu and Tetsu. She always wondered whether or not she really belonged in her family, but things take a shocking twist when her brothers plant the suggestion that they may not be related after all.    Now she's supposed to pick one of them to be her boyfriend, all the while defending herself from all the other girls at school who want to keep her "brothers" for themselves! Life isn't easy when you're the ugly duckling!    Sonnan ja nee yo received the Shogakukan Manga Award for shoujo manga in 2006.

title: Brothers Conflict feat. Yusuke & Futo
description:
Manga featuring Yusuke's and Futo's stories of how each brother falls in love and tries to get Ema.  
  
Based on events in the light novel series *Brothers Conflict* and its otome game (visual novel) and anime adaptations.

title: 1-nichi 10-pun, Ore to Hug wo Shiyou
description:
One day, Chisa witnesses her boyfriend having an affair. Moreover, she was also seen crying by her classmate Toudou, the most popular playboy in the school!! The next day, she was getting strangely involved with him but Chisa ignored it all. However, Toudou kept on approaching her with "Should I make you forget about your ex?" and suggested that they become "hug buddies"—??

---

title: Rin!
description: Katsura, a second year in his high school's archery club, has a hard time controlling his nerves. His "secret weapon" is his brother's best friend and childhood buddy, Sou! One hug from Sou and Katsura's nerves are soothed to a peaceful calm. But he can't keep Sou around him forever. As he wonders how he'll survive without Sou's hugs, his friend Kouichi suddenly asks if he can be the one to save him, and kisses him! What now?!

title: Sagara-kun dake wa, Kobamenai
description:
"I wanted to kiss Riko for the first time."

Riko, who is not good at being close to people, met Sagara, a handsome and popular guy, on the school rooftop. Riko is star-struck and repels him, saying, "I always feel uncomfortable," but Sagara repeatedly kisses her and accepts her without refusing.

Riko has not been in a relationship with anyone but has started a relationship with Sagara who is famous for not only kissing...

title: Mars Gaiden - Namae no Nai Uma
description:
The first story, "Namae no nai uma", is a "Mars" prequel telling the first meeting between Rei and Tatsuya and the beginning of their friendship. Moreover, they've also presented other main characters such as Kira and Harumi.  
  
  
The second and the third stories, "Nemuru Raion" and "1 Karatto no Kajitsu", are oneshots not related to "Mars."   
  
The first tells of the strange relationship between Isomu, a guy who pretends to not have any fear, and Ayame, a girl with particular behaviours; on the contrary, the second tells of Nina, who has some family problems, and Rui, her classmate who is interested in a close friend of the her's. But what if he's interested in Nina?

title: Sakura no Uta - The Fear Flows Because of Tenderness.
description:
Kusanagi Naoya lost his mother at a young age. As his father was a painter who traveled across the world, the only person who could help Naoya cope with the loss was his friend, Misakura Rin. Unfortunately, she moved away while they were in elementary school.  
  
Now in high school, the colder, steeled Naoya deals with the death of his father. When things look like they will turn for the worse for Naoya who already has trouble opening up to people, a new transfer student comes to his class…  
  
Based on an unreleased visual novel by Makura.

title: Beyond Your Pheromones
description: During their heat, Alpha and Omegas will release their pheromones to attract each other and form a mark, but betas do not have pheromones. But the beating of the heart tells the body where it belongs; thus, everything becomes irrelevant, no matter our gender or pheromones.

title: Urakata!!
description:
Ranmaru Kurisu comes from a family of hardy, rough-and-tumble fisher folk, and he sticks out at home like a delicate, artistic sore thumb. It's given him a raging inferiority complex and a permanently pessimistic outlook. Now that he's in college, he's hoping to find a sense of belonging. But after a whole life of being left out, does he even know how to fit in?!  
  
It's two months into Ranmaru's college career, and if he's learned one thing, it's that he's really uncomfortable around other people. But when he stumbles into a zombie mob attack, he's forced out of his comfort zone in the most dramatic way possible! Of course it's just a movie shoot, but when he wakes up from his ignoble faint, he's been whisked away behind the scenes with the Art Squad! Could this group of weirdoes be what Ranmaru's been looking for all his life?!

title: Waruiko no Mikata
description:
1. Warui ko no Mikata  
A young couple awkwardly tries to take the next step in their relationship.   
  
2. Kono Otoko de Ii no ka?  
A girl finds herself caught between two brothers, one nice, the other bad.   
  
3. Citrus Sweat  
A girl goes on a group date only to be stuck with a dude obsessed with being physically fit.  
  
4. Zutto Kimi no Oujisama  
A girl tries to chase after love, but is hindered by her childhood friend whose dream is to be a prince.

title: Misunderstand
description: This is the story of a misunderstanding that occurred among high school students. Does the situation get worse? Or is a beautiful story about to unfold?

title: Kokoro Rental
description: Plain girl Rinko Souma rents the heart of her crush Souta Hisakawa. But what late fee must she pay after she decides not to return the rental?

title: Tsuki ni Hoero
description:
1-2) Howl at the Moon  
Miki is the bodyguard of the super-model, Ran. He's also the only person who knows that the golden-eyed Ran is in fact a werewolf. Not only does Ran have an animalistic sex-drive, he's also inhumanly strong. “Then, why does he need me as his bodyguard?” Miki wondered… And then, Ran was stabbed by a fan while protecting Miki…  
  
3) Intoxicated by the Moon  
Luke, the owner of the modeling agency where Ran works, is also a werewolf. Madoka, his assistant/secretary is always walking in on Luke seducing women in his office… but when the full moon appears, Luke is always at Madoka's house… why!? The appearance of a young new model complicates things even further…  
  
4) LOST  
Every night, Ray relives the nightmare of shooting his detective partner Steve. Unable to sleep at night, he constantly needs sleeping pills to survive. His new partner, Brad, is tortured watching Ray growing more gaunt every day. When undercover FBI agents start showing up dead, Ray's night

Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine share moments of intimacy in the bedroom while quarantining in the dorms due to the COVID19 pandemic. 

Maya x Claudine Unofficial Fanbook #2

description: Shiori's dad remarries and she couldn't be happier. Not only has she gained a new mom, but a hot, older, yet sadistic stepbrother as well?!

title: High School Lala Love
description: "I've always dreamed of falling in love at an all-boys school!!" Right when Hinata finally gets accepted to a boys' school, his dad gets transferred overseas and Hinata's sent to live with a family friend. A little nervous, he heads to the address, only to find a guy who's just his type waiting at the door! A lovestruck Hinata forgets all his worries in an instant. Excited, Hinata starts fantasizing about all the ways things might go, getting very turned on. He can't help touching himself, and gets caught red-handed by the guy of his dreams! What will become of his life as a strapping young schoolboy!!?

title: Water Cube
description: Model student Daisuke Mizuki has a secret swimsuit fetish. What will happen when he gets caught taking pictures of girls in swimsuits by his teacher!?

title: Cyboy
description: When he was younger, Kujou Kiyosumi was incredibly awkward and nerdy. One day in elementary school, he courageously confessed his love to a girl, but she told him in front of the whole classroom that he was 'disgusting' to be around. Shocked, Kiyosumi asked the coolest guy in the class, Sagiya Maki, to help him become more likable, too. Thus, began the days of training and now in high school, he had finally achieved most popular status alongside Maki. Everything seemed to be going along smoothly until…

title: Hana no Yurina Gumi
description:
If there are two girls, that means it's yuri!  
Enthusiastic fujoshi and doujinshi artist Yurina sees yuri everywhere at her all-girls' school… except in the eyes of the best friend who cares for her.

title: Tora to Ookami
description: Mii is a BL (Boys Love) fanatic who helps her grandmother run a family restaurant. Her monotonous life is turned around when two beautiful college boys come to eat! One is the kind Tora, and the other is the snotty Ookami, who refuses to eat the restaurant's food. More than boy troubles, Mii needs to save the restaurant from corporate big-shots who want to renovate the area! And what role will the boys play in this?!

title: Absolute Awakening Angel Mistress☆Fortune
description: Tachikawa Kisaki is a 14-year-old girl who's a drop-out ESPer. Her object of adoration is Hashiba Giniro, a superb ESPer who could use ESP at the age of five. Watch them as they become the team of "Fortune Tiara" and "Fortune Quartz", while carry out their duties as a combination!

title: Midori-kun wa Junjou
description: Mirai always dreamed of going to an all-girls high school because she thinks that boys are violents and idiots. One day, cleaning the school with her friends, she meets Midori, an ex-delinquent boy from the neighboring all-boys high school and invites them to a goukon. he is completely unpredictable! The exciting days start now!?

title: Kirio Fanclub FC
description:
A special spinoff which depicts the public and private lives of characters that were not touched upon in the main story. Also included are tribute works from a luxurious cast of artists! A book filled with love by fans for fans.

Liking the worst possible person…… "If you love me, you will fufil my wish, right?"  
Yui confesses her love to Hiro who hides a dark personality…   
  
Yui Confessa il suo amore a Hiro ma ha una personalitò oscusa….

title: Dream Saga
description:
This fantasy adventure fairy tale is based on an adorable sweet girl named Yuuki Wakasa. She's just your typical 5th grader and big sister who's responsible for her three little brothers.   
One day while walking home she catches a red magic stone that mysteriously falls from the sky. Yuuki soon discovers the stone's magical powers when she looks in the mirror and sees a reflection of a beautiful dark-haired girl who reveals to Yuuki the secret powers of the stone: it allows her to travel from the human world to a dream world known as Takamagahara.   
Yuuki then realizes that she is the 'chosen one' who must save the Sun from being destroyed in the dream world; otherwise both worlds will fall into complete darkness forever …

title: Nitamonodoushi no
description: It began with a mistake. When Tanaka and Nakata are given each other’s papers back, they come to a horrible realization... They have almost identical names. And test results. And body types. And taste in fashion. And sports scores. And hobbies. The list goes on, and as annoying as it is, at least they know they always have each other. And maybe, just maybe, their similarities run even deeper.

title: Shinu Toki wa Mabayuku
description:
"All this time, have I been smiling with this face? All this time, have I been walking around shamelessly in this body? Why was I even born?"

Mirei Houryuuji is a timid, chubby and plain 3rd-year high school student that has a complex about her appearance. Her best friend, Kousei Miyama, is a cool and kindhearted guy that never once considers her ugly. But then, a traumatic incident befalls, making the shamed and heartbroken Mirei decide to undergo plastic surgery. At last, she bids farewell to Kousei, telling him that she wants to start over in a faraway place where no one knows her. Thus begins her new life in Fukuoka.

This is the sorrowful love story of a girl who tries to leave her painful past behind in order to find happiness.

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Mutual Observation Line (Doujinshi)
description:

1. Make You Say "I love you!"  
First one is about a girl who wants to date the president of the cooking club but keeps failing at her attempts.   
  
- Aijo Ippon!!

Third one is about a girl and a guy who are obsessed with trains.   
  
- Pipg Pong Dash Girl  
Fourth one is about a snobbish girl who can't be nice to her childhood friend who she likes.

  
The oneshot Sukitte Iwaseru Houhou is basically the first chapter / prologue to the story.  
  
The main story continues in Volume 2.  
Cute and popular, Nanoka seems to be the type of girl who could get any boy using her so called “tactics”. Accepting confessions and dumping boys at the snap of a finger, she’s never truly been in love… until she met the Cooking Club President, Haru. How can she catch this upperclassman’s attention when she can’t keep herself composed enoug

title: Tomodachi Hitori Dekirukana
description: As a member of the discipline committee, Akira makes a round of the school every day after class. Even though he'd planned on going home after a quick check, his finding Mitsuru, another second year, coming out of an unused room completely changes his life. Learning that, out of boredom, Mitsuru calls other students to empty classrooms after school to do naughty things, Akira warns him to stop before he ends up getting in trouble. But not only does Mitsuru not heed his warning, he gets even wilder… Can this naughty and twisted friendship develop into something more?

title: Tenshi 1/2 Houteishiki
description: Yuiko is an average high-school girl who just has one wish: for her lips to stop being chapped and become smooth and soft! By a chance encounter, she enlists the help of Sugimoto Mana, the school prince who is one year her junior. Can Mana help Yuiko with her dry and chapped lips and will they also find love in the process?

title: Junjou Escape
description: Aki Kitagawa was outed as being gay by his best friend in middle school, after which he moved away to get a fresh start. Since Aki began attending high school, he desperately tried to hide this secret from everyone. However, one of the students at his school, Yoshida Koutarou, discovered his past and forced him to become friends with benefits.

title: Haikyuu!! - Hatsukoi Combat (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

title: Theory of Paradise
description:
A land covered with snow-white sand, an air with a foul smell of sulfur, and a land where it was difficult to breathe without a purifier. A gloomy future where even tomorrow’s life could not be guaranteed.

Faced with a desperate crisis, humanity sculpts the dragon’s corpse to create eight cities. The chosen move to a new city, and the unchosen are left in the desolate Dead sea.

The ‘Theory of Paradise’ will be supported by three pillars. The three of them will be attending the school at the same time, dreaming and sharing the same senses, so they will surely acknowledge each other’s presence.

1000 years after the city was built, three youths who were abandoned and destroyed by the world faced an old prophecy.

“Tell me, you will never love me.”

“You said there was a light outside the tunnel, but to me, the light was you.”

Even in the gloomy dystopian era, the three main characters, Eun Woo, Jae Hee, and Yoon Hwan, were constantly in dynamic. They faced their fate head-on and conti

title: Love Battle Manual
description:
"The wonderful memories of childhood will usually make you regret taking it for granted!"  
  
Ke Pinyi, who excels at academics and serves as class president, is nicknamed an iceberg because of her serious personality which causes people to find it difficult to get close to her. But in reality, she is a girl who likes to read shoujo manga and fantasize.  
  
One day, she accidentally witnesses the confession of a classmate at school, and her secret of reading mangas was discovered! What's even more surprising is that this person was actually her childhood friend who went abroad when she was a child—Guan Yuxia…

title: Koisuru Tenshi wa Tsumibukai
description: Set in a world of angels with various kinds of wings. Misora, a young girl who attends a preparatory school, tries to be a good girl every day in order to win the "Angel's Halo," a prize given to the best students. One day, she is appointed as an elected member of the student council. At first she is happy to hear the news, but it is run by students who embody the "seven deadly sins," such as wrath and gluttony. Misora is assigned to the duties of the student council together with the most beautiful boy in her class, Agoshi, who is also appointed as member of the student council, however...

title: November Gymnasium

description: A one-shot collab between Hatta Ayuko (Ookami Shoujo to Kuro Ouji) and Mizuno Minami (Nijiro Days). Sata Kyouya is the school’s guidance counselor and he has to deal with an odd group of students.

title: Yuzu Chu♥
description: Kei has a secret crush on Yuzuyu, the most popular girl in the classroom. One day, he is attacked by unknown warriors and the one who rescues him is Yuzuyu herself, dressed in a weird costume, claiming that she is his property and that he can do with her as he pleases from now on.

title: Amae-san wa Amaetai no ni
description:
Amae Shinyu is a high school girl with the mysterious power of being able to see into people's hearts.

When she meets her first love, Masanao, who has a shining and beautiful heart, for the first time in several years on a blind date, she is overwhelmed with emotion!
Shinyu tries her best to make him like her, but she sees the inside of Masanao's heart and......?

title: Tomodachi no Uta
description: Akane is a nice and cheerful girl whose dream has always been to become a singer and reach many people with her voice. To achieve it, she even gave up on having a normal and fun time with her high school friends… until one day she meets a girl, Fumi, and by befriending her undergoes major changes in her life. This is the story of their friendship and their shared love for music.

title: Seirei Gensouki: Konna Sekai de Deaeta Kimi ni
description: Celia＝Claire, a noblewoman from a count’s family, graduated early from Bertram Royal Academy at the age of just twelve and went on to become an academy instructor. A prodigy mage, Celia devoted herself entirely to research from a very young age. As a result, she grew up with few friends and little experience of a normal childhood. One day, she unexpectedly takes charge of a frail-looking orphan boy named Rio as her student. However, Rio turns out to possess extraordinarily high abilities, far beyond what one would expect from an orphan— And thus begins an unforeseen bond between a young genius professor and a mysterious, gifted boy…!?

title: Natsu no Mayu
description: *She isn't dirty at all. Why can't she see that?*

title: Shape of Love
description: The story of a girl who loves a girly-looking boy, and a boy who is scared of her.

title: Yano-kun ni Oshi Hen wa Dekinai!
description:
Matsuda Satoshi, 16 years old.
She pretends to be an ordinary high school girl, but she is a serious dollar otaku!

At a concert of her favourite idol group, LOVE LETTER, she meets a handsome guy who looks exactly like her favourite Yachin (Yatsugi), who is a love-leader.
This handsome man is actually a classmate of the non-existent Satoshi..!

A guesser is a classmate and a classmate is a guesser...?
A heartwarming idyllic comedy about a handsome guy who looks just like your guess, who loves your guess, who chases after your guess, and who shouts his love to your guess!

title: Don't Leave After School
description:
In order to repay a favor, Yu Le ended up being a scapegoat, severely insulting the school idol Gu Yan.  
Gu Yan has been glaring at him, from the beginning of class, all the way till the day's end.  
In order to get his "revenge", Gu Yan kept finding trouble with Yu Le.   
Originally, it was just to teach Yu Le a lesson, but who could have expected the "revenge" would actually change. Gu Yan felt that Yu Le was gradually pleasing to the eye, making it harder to make a move…

title: Woof Woof Again Today!
description: The country dog, Woli, becomes a human overnight. She’s meeting again with her old master named Yunjin, at the school that she went to for adaptation to human society. Now that this opportunity has come, let’s be human friends with the Master… It’s not a shame! Woli just can’t stand it since she wants to be patted on the head by her master’s hand and lick his hands too! Can Woli develop a good relationship with Yunjin?

title: Obake ga Kirai na Yankee wa, Horaa ga Suki na Mesukousei wo...
description:
"Won't you please… create a manga with me?"   
  
The girl I fell in love with at first sight loves horror manga!? How will the love story of these opposite two unfold…?

title: Stars and Dawn
description: He secretly kissed me in a dream. Will the family's ability to predict future in dreams make it come true?

In this small town, within the 49 days after a person dies, you can see the dead's spirit. She once admired this small town where you can still spent time with the ones precious to you within these 49 days, but…  
  
Includes two oneshots:  
Soko ni Koi Ari (そこに恋あり)  
Kimi wa Nanimo Hoshigarazu (君は何もほしがらず)

title: Planetary Eyes
description: The arrogant and cold Yu Xingji, the leader of the Twelve constellation deities, traded his memories in exchange for reincarnating a thousand times in order to find his true love. During his 1001st reincarnation, he's reborn into the life of a college professor, where he meets Qin Ling, an aloof young man in possession of strange spiritual powers. When a strange event suddenly happens on the school campus, Yu Xingji couldn’t help but find himself standing in front of Qin Ling to protect him during the most critical moment!While the relentless reincarnation cycles may have erased the memories and appearance of his lover, only the emotions carved in his bones and engraved in the heart will guide them to reunite once again.

title: Super Girl UFO
description:
Shinpei Natsuki is a run-of-the-mill high school boy who just so happens to have a new housemate, foreigner Yuuhou Maria, nicknamed UFO-chan. Turns out she lives up to her name, as she is a Space Patrol Officer sent to Earth to track down the demonic alien species Space Vampiers. Shinpei excitedly joins Yuuhou on frequent trips back and forth in time in her UFO, to prevent the earth from hostile alien takeover, all in the while getting his memory wiped to protect Yuuhou's secret.  
  
In the lower margins is a short strip titled "The Professional" about a hitman sent to take down the mob boss Calpis Souda, with many goofy things happening along the way.

title: Nandaka Ii Nioi
description:
1-3) Somehow Good Smell  
Konishi's colleague Nagumo is a first rate slob, unable to keep himself or his surroundings clean at all. But for some inexplicable reason, the scent of Nagumo's body makes Konishi feel relaxed and safe. Is it just a scent fetish or…?  
  
4-5) Not Loveiy*  
Michiya is always getting in fights at school because he wants to get stronger to protect his beloved neighbor Natsuki. Natsuki has suffered from asthma attacks since Michiya was little, but now he's an elite saleryman…  
  
  
*lol this isn't a typo, this is the English title that the mangaka wrote

title: Oresama Ouji
description: Sawa hates Judo. She was once really good at it, but boys always rejected her because she was so strong. Now she's entering high school and the gorgeous captain of the Judo club has selected Sawa (against her will) to be the club manager! He also claims he knows her from the past… How will Sawa deal with managing the sport she hates most, especially since the captain seems to like her?!

title: Koi wo suru nara Kyoushitsu de
description: Classmates who spend a year together. It is because they are close that they fall in love, and it is because they are close that they are frustrated.

title: My Younger Brother's Friend
description:
Ga-eun is a junior in college who lives with her younger brother, a senior in high school. Ever since their parents' death, she has tried to stay strong and confident amidst juggling school and raising her brother. And after getting dumped by her boyfriend, dating is the last thing on her mind... until she gets involved with three of her brother’s friends. Which one will she choose? The cheeky, handsome childhood friend Dowan? The calm, collected, and responsible class president Sangu? Or the quiet and intimidating but kind-hearted Jun?

title: 100% no kimi e
description: Always giving in to many little things, Yuzu transfers from a prestigious girls' school to a co-ed because of her family. Since the first day, she felt uncomfortable with the too open ethos of the school. While trying to fit in, she met a guy who she is irresistibly attracted to. He, Yuzu, and a puppy, form a map of love together.

title: Full Metal Panic! COMIC MISSION
description:
Basically, it's a retanking of some chapters from Full Metal Panic!. It's sort of like FMP! Fumoffu.. meaning that there's no mecha plotline, only short stories. Also there's an extra story not presented anywhere in each volume of this series.  
  
> Part of the Full Metal Panic! series

title: Rabbit Hole Waltz
description: A timid artist and a starry-eyed writer try to find their place in the city. With some perseverance and a little bit of luck, what they're looking for may be right around the corner.

title: Hidarite no Love Letter
description:
A Collection of Oneshots

Story 1: Hidarite no Love Letter
Nishino has been sitting next to the most popular guy in her class, Minami Taiga. Nishino loves Minami, for the main reason that Nishino has always been ignored or made-fun of by her classmates except for Minami. One day, Minami notices the messages that Nishino has been writing on her left hand, which kindles a new connection between them.

Story 2: Ferris Wheel at Sunset

Story 3: Natural Union

Story 4: Such a Dangerous Distance

Story 5: Nude Time

title: Kurumi Ayako wa Koi ga Wakaranai
description: Ayako Kurumi is a high school girl so capable at criminal profiling that she astounds the police. She's certain her classmate, the harmless Yoshii, is a serial killer. When asked on the details why, she begins to show symptoms similar to lovesickness...? The romantic comedy of a girl genius who faces the feelings of love!

title: Hito wa Sore o Koi to Yobu
description: His cute appearance always brings trouble to Tominaga Jun. The moment he enrolled in an all-boys high school, he got confessed to by classmates and upperclassmen alike. The manly Jun, whose appearance is totally the opposite of his character, bluntly rejects all the confessions, sometimes having to resort to his fists to make himself understood… but he eventually begins to feel something for the student council president, Sakuma…

title: Chibi to Pocchari de Renai Shimasu kedo, Nani ka?
description: Puniko, manager for the basketball club, has always been self-conscious about her weight. She thought that she had no chance in love… until Shou-kun, the basketball team's diminutive yet popular ace, confesses to her. Can Puniko really find love at last? Is such a love even possible?

title: Hello Dosa
description:
Hello again it is nice to meet you again in this life?   
"This is a story of a genius master and a girl he must keep.“

title: Sweet Monster
description: They're called Monsters: people with the power to assume animal forms, kept segregated from the rest of society. When he was young, Riku befriended a Monster boy named Tsukasa, only to be separated from him. Now, at an academy for Monsters, Riku has finally found his childhood friend. But can he overcome the distrust of his more-than-human classmates and reconnect with Tsukasa? And will their adult relationship be as close as their childhood friendship…or even closer?

title: Toriyama Akira Mankanzenseki
description:
A two-volume bunkoban reprint of Akira Toriyama's Manga Theater, retitled "An Emperor's Feast of Akira Toriyama".  
  
This version, while omitting several one-shots from Manga Theater, includes the two-chapter Alien X-Peke (1996), published after the end of Dragon Ball, as well as the full-color seinen manga Lady Red (1987).   
  
The second volume also includes "The Anime and Me" (1989), a full-color essay manga from the first Dragon Ball Z Anime Special magazine, as well as a new afterword by the mangaka.

Featured one-shots include:

Volume 1:
Lady Red
Go! Go! Ackman
Dub & Peter 1
The Elder
Young Master Kenosuke
Mr. Ho
Mad Matic
Pola & Roid
Wonder Island
Dragon Boy

Volume 2:
Alien X Peke 
Soldier of Savings Cashman
Karamaru and the Perfect Day
Little Mamejiro
The Adventure of Tongpoo
Chobit
Escape
Pink
Tomato the Cutesy Gumshoe
Today's Highlight Island

title: Saboten no Himitsu
description:
Miku Yamada has a longtime crush on classmate Kyohei Fujioka. But no matter how many times she tries to show him how she feels, clueless Kyohei just doesn't get it. Frustrated, Miku gives up on him, only to have him start calling her "Cactus" for being prickly when he's around. Will Kyohei ever figure out Cactus's secret?  
  
- Includes other stories:  
  
Okosama Brat  
Taishi stays at Rie's house because his parents work overtime. Rie thought that he was actually her real brother! Now, Taishi says that she's "idiotic now and then". People think of Taishi as cool and mature, but Rie knows that he's just a brat inside…  
  
Sono Saki no Sweet  
Hidaka Mao was confessed to by her crush Chihiro-kun in junior high, but as soon as they started going out, she became unable to communicate with him. She is still confused about her feelings, but will this year's Valentine's day bring them together again!?  
  
————————————————  
Italian/Italiano:  
Miku è segretamente innamorata del suo compa

title: Aiai Is Loved
description:
The hectic lily school life of Aiai, a high school girl who is confessed to by two beautiful female classmates!

Published in the Monthly Comic Beam November 2024 Issue.

title: 1 Milky Way Street
description:
Milky Way Village is a charming, rustic town where the Milky Way galaxy illuminates the night sky. At its heart stands Night Compass, a cozy doll shop run by Baek Young-ha and his family. While Young-ha is passionate about creating and repairing dolls, his skills aren’t as refined as his parents’. Still, he’s determined not to let that stop him from pursuing his dream of sharing the joy of handmade dolls with the world - starting with his own community. Welcome to the Milky Way High Doll Club, where Young-ha and his friends navigate the rough patches of youth, one stitch at a time!

---

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - It's All Your Fault (Doujinshi)
description: You ha estado enamorada de Chika desde siempre, cómo resultará todo esto después de una valiente confesión.||

title: Release the Spyce Secret Fragrance
description: Compilation of the 1 Komas in the Release the Spyce Secret Fragrance Game

title: Endless Summer
description: Hai đứa trẻ cùng tuổi, cùng tên, nắm tay nhau đứng trước ngưỡng cửa của một mùa hè sẽ thay đổi cuộc đời chúng mãi mãi. Khi thế giới dường như không muốn lắng nghe trái tim của chúng, chúng sẽ bên nhau đối diện với thế giới ra sao?

title: HEN - Suzuki & Satou
description:
Ichiro Suzuki, a straight young man who becomes besotted with another guy, Yuki Sato, convinced his bishounen love is a girl trapped in a boy's body. Interestingly, author Hiroya Oku is one of the characters in the story, the best friend of Sato.  
  
The first three volumes of this series collect Oku's early short stories, including prototype versions of both Hen series.

----

* [Hen (1993)](https://mangadex.org/title/eb89077b-78fb-4404-a6d7-a70200f663a3/hen-suzuki-kun-to-sato-kun-no-baai) - Suzuki & Sato
* [HEN (1997)](https://mangadex.org/title/91bbcc02-bc0f-4492-bf5d-e42cfe03dfe5/hen) - Chizuru & Azumi

title: Ore no Suki na Ko ga Burakon Sugiru!!
description:
A total of five oneshots.  
  
1. Ore no Suki na Ko ga Buracon sugiru!!  
Okano Shuu has a crush on Ogata Saeka for 10 years, who has a brother complex. She is always sticking closely with her brother, Ogata Eiji. And this trio are childhood friends. Shuu tries to make Saeka realize him.  
  
2. Amakute♡Okashi na Sugar Love  
Yuko loves wagashi (some type of sweet), and a popular boy at her school, Tsugumi, which happens to be a wagashi maker! Ever since her discovery, she has been a regular at his shop to have her beloved wagashi and to see Tsugumi. However, it seems that his shop has suddenly gained popularity, making Yuko jealous…  
  
3. Chouko to Ippon Shoubu nano da!  
  
4. Hana to Hana  
  
5. Hitorijime Concern

title: Trinity Seven-san
description: Lilith becomes a prey to the soft-shelled magic, Levi and Rogue sell doujinshi, and a war between Arin and Holy's legal wives breaks out...!? A slapstick theater where the characters of "Trinity Seven" go wild! Opening-!!

title: Natsuki Crisis
description:
A Martial Arts Whirlwind with a Spirited Young Girl Who Loves Karate!
Natsuki Kisumi is a strong-willed second-year student at Gouju High School and a member of the karate club. Her skills are so impressive that even the club captain, Yanagisawa, recognizes her talent. However, her boyfriend, Osawa, is less enthused about her karate obsession. He wishes she would embrace a more traditionally feminine demeanor.

Anime adaptation: [AniDB](https://anidb.net/anime/3352) | [ANN](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5329) | [MAL](https://myanimelist.net/anime/2083/Natsuki_Crisis) | [AL](https://anilist.co/anime/2083/Natsuki-Crisis/)

- Indonesian release by m&c! Comics (2000)

title: Critical Lovers
description: Mizuno Chihiro is unable to control his urges and becomes erect very easily. Because of his constant tardiness, he was sent to participate in the re-development system together with two other problematic senpai: Takatou Shinobu and Kandori Akira. Sharing a room with Takatou, Mizuno became erect when he helped Takatou, a manga artist, with his smutty works. Takatou tried his best to help Mizuno, falling in love with Mizuno along the way. However, he refuses to admit his own feelings, hurting Mizuno in the process. What should Mizuno do?

title: Still Drawn Towards You (Pre-Serialization)
description:
When we meet again, will we still be as important to each other as before?---

**Note:** Please support the creator and read the original webcomic [here](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/13063/).

[Artist Weibo](https://weibo.com/u/6483859755)

title: My oc is Fine
description: Living in an orphanage, Tong Yexun has always been a child who never got along well with others. Since she is lonely, she used a paintbrush to create Shen Qiu, a little boy who is the same age as her. He grows up alongside her through the power of her paintbrush.  One day, Tong Yexun, gets bullied, hiding in a corner, alone and wiping away at her tears. The tears dripped on onto one of Tong's drawing papers, becoming wet. The boy in her painting slowly opened his eyes as if he had sensed something... From then on, he had a soul.

title: Koi suru Kyou mo, Kono Tsuugakuji de
description: Kosaka and Okano ride their bicycles together every morning. Since they switched classes in their senior year of high school, they have been in different classes, and their paths have somehow crossed...?

title: Watashi no Suki na Hito
description:
Compilation of one-shots:  
  
Watashi no Suki na Hito  
The reliable class president, Megumi, is in love with her childhood friend, Yuu, who is notorious for being scary-looking.  
  
Lovely Friendship  
Hayaka and Minazou share the same interests and are perfect for each other, but when they change from being friends to dating, it somehow becomes difficult…?!  
  
Yukimachi Bus  
A story about first love in a snowing countryside.  
  
Notebook  
An honest boy healing a heartbroken girl.

title: M to N no Shouzou
description:
Mitsuru is beautiful, graceful and admired by many people, but she has a weird problem—a single, violent movement against her can get her begging sweetly for more! Her nickname M, also stands for masochistic.  
  
Natsuhiko, is a guy who found out Mitsuru's secret on their first day of senior high school. Even so, he has an equally bad problem—the mere glimpse of his reflection can send him into a flying fit about how beautiful he is! He is nicknamed as N for narcissistic.  
  
They both hope to minimize their chances of being exposed because of their weird behaviors.

title: Ru~mu! Room No.1301
description:
**From Operation Boredom:**  
High school Student Kinugawa Kenichi is one of the members of the class committee and also the boyfriend of the super cute Ooumi Chiyako. However, one day, a new student, Kuwabatake Aya, transfers to their school, and demands that Kenichi be her boyfriend…?! Who exactly is this girl, and how does she know Kenichi?

title: Seiho Boys' High School!
description: Five minute walk to the sea. The closest train station takes 50 minutes by car. Famous private dormitory male high school Seihou is located in that super remote place. What will happen at that place where men are crazy for love?!

title: Kedamono Ni Lollipop
description: Unlucky Himari Kawashiro, a shy and awkward high school student, only wants to be accepted by her peers. While trying to organize her school cultural festival without much luck, she accidentally stumbles upon a serious-looking cat eating cookies in an empty classroom. While fangirling over how cute it is, it transforms into her (now naked) classmate, Sennojou Shionji. He recruits her to be his sugar-toting assistant…and thus begins their odd partnership.

title: Usotsuki na Suki
description:
I will show you the way to make that popular guy falling in love with you.

"You don’t know me! Don't be so pretentious."

He is always in front of my eyes, making fun of me. He always sees me with that kind of face and it's intolerably sexy! But even if I want to be honest with him, I can't. At the next culture festival, I wonder if I'll change that?

title: Onzoushi wa Osananajimi o Hitorijime shite Aishitai
description:
"Please...just stay close to me."

Chiai, an ordinary high school girl, has a good-looking childhood friend, Ai, who is a scion of a big company. Chiai thinks that Ai is like a younger brother to her, who always spoils her. But the true nature of this cute childhood friend is that he is a doting, possessive man who will do anything for Chiai...?

A love affair with a childhood friend all to himself!

title: Hakui no Kanojo (Pre-Serialization)
description: A male science teacher and a female school nurse at a local school live in the same apartment building. Sometimes she visits his room and they drink together. A situation arises that causes some awkwardness in their relationship. Will they be able to resolve things?

title: Midnight Make Love
description:
*Collection of stories:*  
  
*1. Sleeping forest Vampire*  
A bunch of vampires sleep in their coffins at one place in an enchanted forest. Alexander's sleep got disturbed by Miharu, who keeps getting into his coffin when he's drunk. What will become of the two of them tonight?  
  
*2.Help me, Alice!*  
Kazushi is sorting his things before going to university. Suddenly, he finds his favorite book "Alice in Wonderland" and falls asleep while reading it. He dreamt about the scenario from the book and meet the Rabbit, who proposes him something kids shouldn't read about.  
  
*3. Sasakawa-kun's lucky item*  
Sasakawa Yukinari, despite his name, keeps getting into dangerous accidents. Upon finding Fortune Club Card, he decides to take his future in his hands and follow the fortune teller's advice. But why do his lucky items must always be so embarrassing?  
  
*4. Fall from grace ~From the world you fell~*  
A member of popular idol group "Sirius" created a scandal. As punishment, he had

title: You're My Girlfriend
description: It's about a girl named Hatsune with a "bad mouth", for lack of a better description. She's kind-hearted, but her mouth spews the total opposite of what she means (which is probably due to the fact that she grew up with only male influence). And so she is seen as an arrogant, vulgar girl at her school, but all she wants is a boyfriend. Well, that is, until she gets accepted at the Maidens' Club, where she meets a guy named Kirie, with a somewhat unique habit that happens when a girl comes within a foot of him. And everyone says he's gay, even Hatsune. How will these two fare? Will Hatsune have a boyfriend at last? Will he be more than just a friend?

title: Crepuscule (Best Challenge version)
description:
Orphaned Lark Alfen is taken to his new home by distant relatives. It's been said that his late mother was a vampire, so everyone is scared of him and doesn't want him around. He gets bullied a lot until, one day, he meets a black-haired boy named Setz who has red eyes like him. They become friends. But as a rumor spreads that Lark is also a vampire, his guardians decide to send him back to the orphanage. When Lark hears about their plans, he decides to run away, and Setz invites him to his home… in the world of real vampires.  
  
Note: This is the original best challenge version of Crepuscule.

title: Gakuen Heaven
description:
Keita Itou—a boy with no special qualities other than superb luck—suddenly receives an acceptance letter from the renowned all-boys Bell Liberty Academy (a.k.a. BL Academy). Attracted by the school’s prestige, he decides to attend. However, on the day of his transfer, he gets into a freakish traffic accident. Luckily, no one is injured…but the incident arouses the attention of both the Student Council’s president, Tetsuya Niwa (a.k.a. the king), as well as the head of the Budget Council, Kaoru Saiyonji (a.k.a. the queen).  
  
Keita works to discover the reasons behind his invitation to such a remarkable school, struggles to find his niche among such brilliant and beautiful young men, and attempts to win the school-wide contest that will grant his wish of permanent placement at BL Academy! Along the way, he develops intense relationships with the rest of the hunky characters: clever Naruse, the captain of the tennis club; pensive Shinomiya, the captain of the archery club; sensitive Iw

title: Aoi Kiseki
description:
From Nagareboshi Manga:  
  
All the girls are crazy over the swimming prodigy Wakatsuki Ran. Ageha, who wants to find love but isn't really looking that hard, bumps into him one day, and after surviving his sarcasm instantly pegs him as a "stupid, obsessed swimmer". Nonetheless, she is amazed by his talent and asks him to teach her to swim like him. How will their relationship develop?

title: I Won't Forget This Love
description:
A collection of one-shots by various authors.  
  
"Ready Go!"  
by Yoshii Yuu  
I hate poor guys! And yet, when I went on a date, I fell in love with a guy who's a freelance worker… and he came to our date on a bicycle!?  
  
"Peach Or Lemon"  
by Kuramochi Mari  
After a small coincidence, I fell in love with him, but it seems that he already has a girlfriend!? And here I was, thinking that this love was fated to be…  
  
"The Flower That Blooms In You"  
by Mitsuya Omi  
Tsukina is secretly in love with her twin sister's boyfriend. After he lost his eyesight in an accident, she pretends to be her sister to take care of him, and then…  
  
"Field Trip On Monday"  
by Torikai Akane  
Shino got confessed to by two girls on the same day. For now, he doesn't mind dating the first one…  
  
"Snow, Piling Up Feelings"  
by Kimura Ayako  
Since I love him, I keep acting awkwardly around him and fall out of sorts with him…  
This is a story about a sad and heart-warming first love.  
  
"Sen

title: Tenkousei wa Iyaiya Watashi ga Mamorimasu!
description: The transfer student is a high-spec boy who is the scion of a prominent company that finances the school. Many students approach him for his money and status! I don't like it, but I will protect him! Will our heroine be able to?

title: Kimi wa Toumei
description: On typical days, he seems transparent and colorless, but the moment he enters the water, he shines brighter than any other. I fell in love with him the day I saw him canoeing… My first love.

title: Kirara no Hoshi
description: The story centers around a quiet high school girl who ends up inheriting a minor entertainment talent agency. To pay off her newly obtained debts, she sets out to discover new talent and stars on the rise.

title: Do as you please
description:
A story about a young man and a neet doing whatever they please. A Doraemon parody  
  
<https://twitter.com/kanengomi53>

title: Stop! Time!
description: The third entry from the infamous God series of web manga. This is what happens when the creator of "Umbrella Sword" tries to make a love comedy.

title: Gangster Hero
description: Mu-Sik’s group, Saengcream-Pa is on the search for ‘Ares’ Heart.’ Their only lead, Jae-Yeong Jung is no help. When Mu-Sik Gae, the great number two is suddenly forced into living with this selfish orphan, he thinks it’ll only take a few days. But it doesn’t and as time passes, whether it may be as planned or his own emotions, Mu-Sik cannot help but feel his heart flutter when he’s near her… Where in the world is that diamond?

title: Love x Joint
description: It's love at first sight when the princess of industrial development meets the prince of special advance family! A story about first love that gets your heart puzzled and pounding.

title: Handsome Girl
description:
Hagiwara Mio is a 14-year-old teen actor. She's currently in love with her neighbor, teen actor Morimoto Teruomi. She is given a role in a short drama, but is dissatisfied that her roles always involve being the bossy antagonist. She was cast as the rival of her friend, Sawagi Aya, in the drama.  
  
Excited at the fact that Teru is also in the drama, Mio accepts the job. On the first day of the shoot, Mio meets Kumagai Ichiya who calls Mio a bad actress. With their first meeting getting off to such a bad start, a chain of problems for Mio began to pile up.  
  
Volume 8 includes 2 Omakes (oneshots) entitled:  
Angel & Adventure  
Radical Romance

title: Knock Your Heart Out
description: No matter how many times she sleeps with Arai, Negishi realizes that neither her nor Arai’s feelings were being conveyed. Their sex felt “like” love, but only feeling “like” something wasn’t the same thing as having it. What is Negishi supposed to do in order to get Arai to understand her true feelings?

title: Magical Girl II
description: One day, high school student Masanori is given a magic wand by his mother as a crime prevention item. Although Masanori is annoyed by his mother's crazy comments such as "I'm the princess of the magical kingdom!" and "Masanobu, you should transform too!", he chants a spell to transform in his desire to be free...?!

title: Otouto no Kyorikan ga Baguttemasu
description: Hana Yoshida, a high school freshman, falls in love with her classmate Taisei Hagita. But when their parents remarry, Hana and Taisei become sisters and brothers. Hana puts her feelings away and vows to become a good family. But when Taisei starts living in the same house with Hana, she feels too close to him, and every day is filled with excitement...?

title: Susuhara is a Demon!
description: After a perfect girl encounters an infamous delinquent, her life is thrusted into a whirlwind of chaos! Strap in for a ride jam-packed with terribly embarrassing flirting techniques, kick-ass delinquents and existential dread by the buttload! Nothing could possibly go wrong in this perfectly imperfect love story. (Updates every other Tuesday!)

title: Countdown to Love
description:
If only I could be the one to reach you...
After an ankle injury dashes Hoon's hopes of becoming a basketball star, he begins to see a timer in the sky. He believes it’s a countdown to the day he dies, until he discovers one day that his classmate Haedam can see it too...

title: Click
description:
Joonha is a normal, healthy boy of sixteen who has cruised through life without too many problems.  
  
Imagine his surprise when a recent trip to the bathroom suddenly reveals that he's not normal at all! With a shriek of "Oh, my Gosh!!!," he finds himself missing, well, something he never thought he could live without. The impact is too much for poor Joonha and he soon passes out.  
  
While in his half-conscious state, he overhears the incredible truth: his family is abnormal in the weirdest possible way. After puberty, their chromosomes undergo some kind of mutation, which converts their bodies into the opposite sex! Which means his father is really a woman who has been living as a man since the gene change took place. Now Joonha has to leave behind 16 years of life as a man and live as a woman. What will his childhood friend Jinhoo and the girl he has always liked, Heewon, say when they find out?!

title: Aishite Kudasai, Sensei
description: Kitou Hijiri, a student, confessed his feelings to a Chemistry teacher named Nakatani Ayano whom he had fallen in love with 8 years ago. Somehow when he was young, he lived beside Ayano and bear feelings for her. Ayano, in turn, could not resist Hijiri’s determination and strong feelings towards her. What will be the ending of their taboo love?

title: Summer Doodle
description: Oneshot from the author of Cross Game and Touch.

title: Sakura no Kimi
description: On my way to school, I walk by you.

title: Amai Sasayaki
description: Our main character, Acchan, finds out that the man her mother had an affair with 10 years ago is still around, and a storm of memories, curiosity, and passion surfaces.

title: Akuma de Koibito
description:
Devil and Boyfriend  
Ever since she was young, Rinko has always been labelled as a 'Ohito yoshi baka' by everyone except for a young boy, Itsuki. Since then, Rinko has always had strong feelings for Itsuki but will he ever be like that angel-like person she met as a child or stay as the Akuma she has now gotten used to?  
  
  
Includes two extra stories:  
  
- That's the Rabbit's Forest  
Madoka has to do some housekeeping for a young man, an artist, who comes across as a jerk: but soon she finds out something unusual about him….  
  
- Because, It's Love  
While Jun is washing mops, the guy beside her becomes soaked through an accident. She hands him a handkerchief that's special to her. Before she could ask for it back, he gets dragged away with her important handkerchief!

title: Oboreru Kurai ni, Aishite Ageru
description: In a world where it is whispered that somewhere out there is a "turn of fate" who are instinctively attracted to each other... Koyori is not fond of boys, but at Tensai Academy, she meets the super-beautiful sergeant Mihiro, who suddenly kisses her, and is told that Mihiro is Koyori's "master."

title: Sakuran
description: New One-Shot from the mangaka of Psyren. 15 year old Eita gets inhabited by a species from space who challenges him to guess its name within five years or else he will be taken captive back to its home planet to be examined and study as a biological species from the planet Earth.

title: The Polaris
description: On a pitch-black night, corporate wage slave Qi Yan sees his first love — the one that had passed 10 years before. After quite a bit of pestering and persuasion, he finds himself forced into the miserable lifestyle of working during the day and investigating at the night. The topic of the investigation? Finding out who the culprit is. Can the top who had passed years before successfully manage to be resurrected?

title: Don't Bully Me Naoto-San
description: Hello everyone and welcome to this alternate story set in the world of Nagatoro, where the roles are reversed. Don't expect the story and characters to be the same, though; everything is very different, and I haven't planned the ending yet. I hope you enjoy it, and thank you so much for your support.

title: Yakeppachi's Maria
description: Teenage delinquent Yaketpachi's has a spectral woman as the closest thing to a female influence in his life: Maria! The manifestation of the women Yaketpachi lacks in his life, Maria needs a body to become corporeal, but the only thing around is a sex doll, which is easily ravaged by a hard life and the target of rough pranks. Yaketpachi and Maria are joined at the soul, but ripped apart by an uncaring society. How much strain can Maria's plastic body take before it cracks beyond repair? Yaketpachi may want to move heaven and Earth to provide a life for Maria, but do teenagers truly know love?Osamu Tezuka brings the battle of the sexes to a paranormal comedy, where Yaketpachi and Maria explore their teenage years in High School, with all the trials and tribulations that come with it. There's the queen bee of the school to tussle with, a dating club that heavily skews towards one gender (and against Yaketpachi), and even rival spirits out to earn their own revenge against their accident

title: Ai ga Love Shite You Nano sa
description: Oono, a member of the school's disciplinary committee, is unable to perform his uniform inspection duties because his adoration for Takeuchi distracts him. Takeuchi mistakes this for Oono hating him and is sad at the idea of being disliked by the model student. Thus, Takeuchi is relieved and willing to reciprocate when he finds out that it isn't hate but instead love that makes Oono so very awkward around Takeuchi.

title: Under the Rose
description: Under the Rose is a love story between two sisters who meet years after their birth.

title: The Final Loop
description:
Collection of four stories about bullying and how people can react and survive it.  
1) The Final Loop  
2) And Then There Was You  
3) Watercolour Girl  
4) Gorbachev's Seed.

title: Netsugen wa Koko
description: Nanao is obsessed with Sakai's hands…

title: be our guest
description: Izumi wants to inherit her mother's resturaunt, however, she has no natural cooking ability. Izumi's childhood friend Reiji also wants to inherit the resturaunt, however, he's a cooking prodigy.

title: Toshi Densetsu
description:
If you the one you loved were known as the “Murder Devil”, would you kill your lover? Or, would you wait to be killed?  
  
Includes:  
Toshi Denestsu Yomigaeru Sattujin Oni  
From a psychological test, he is diagnosed as having a trait of a murder, and because of that, she is attacked with a lot of unsolved incidents?!  
  
Migigawa no Akai Yami  
Is this a curse from the girl, who was bullied and committed suicide, which causes her right eye to see only the color red?

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club - ShizuKasu no Chucchu (Doujinshi)
description: ShizuKazu sedang bercumbu di ruang klub tanpa mereka sadari teman-teman sedang mengintip di balik pintu.

title: Datte... Gaman Dekinai
description:
I've been loving you all this time, but you never look at me. My hearth throb has almost reached its limit. That's why I'll try to seduce him. But he's so mature. He looks like a small kid, but his inside is a very manly, cool man.  
  
Misa è al primo anno di liceo e per via del suo corpo attira le attenzioni di tutti i compagni di scuola. Ma il suo unico amore è l' eroe che la protegge da quando era molto piccola.

title: Forget Me Not (OKAFUJI Mai)
description: Junko Omori lost her boyfriend, Kon Shiomi, in her third year of junior high school, and three years passed without her being able to recover from her grief. On the first day of her senior year of high school, a new student comes to visit Junko, but it is Kon's younger sister, Ai. Junko feels a trace of Kon and is filled with mixed feelings when Ai tells her that she entered the same school because of her admiration for Junko. The spirited Mai Okafuji depicts a supreme girl-meets-girl story that is both fragile and beautiful.

title: Suki ni Nattara, Owari
description:
An impeccable, prim-and-proper childhood friend gifted with both beauty and brains. This describes Tsubasa Konoe, a girl admired by nearly all the boys, and today she again receives yet another confession that she will end up rejecting. After all, she is only attracted to people who she deems "special."

"It's Over If You Fall In Love" is a 5-page oneshot about the protagonist getting caught up with a lovestruck girl like her.

(Source: Shounen Jump Plus)

title: Professor
description:
“You're the only person I can entrust with my legacy. Will you continue to write it?”

Park Minwoo, a graduate student, inherits the legacy of a world-renowned scholar.

The great challenge of a humanities student from a third-rate university begins!

title: Wild School
description:
Summary: You-Geon, a high school student, is saved from drowning by a mysterious girl his own age. Indeed, this girl is a North Korean agent trained to kill. The encounter which will completely change You-Geon’s peaceful life means that this mysterious girl never leaves You-Geon alone for a second worried he might reveal her secret to someone. The atmosphere at the high school won’t ever be the same…  
  
Taken from Stand Alone Scans

title: Sambong Barber Shop
description: Ha Il Kwon's debut work. The "beauty" virus is spreading around the nation, targetting ugly girls and driving them to madness. Park Jangmi wonders - why must life be so unfair? As she ponders, she stumbles upon a mysterious barber shop, with a mysterious barber…

title: Kokage-chan wa Koi no Noroi ni Maketakunai
description: 花園瑚景は普通に恋する女子高生であったが、ある日突然原因不明の…恋の呪いにかかってしまう！？しかも呪いが原因で「好き」な人に好意を伝えられなくなってしまい悪戦苦闘する瑚景であったが大好きな明澄くんに想いを伝えるまでは負けられない！！想いを伝えるためには知恵を尽くして体当たり束縛アリな恋の駆け引きバトルを繰り広げる…

title: Horromance
description:
“If it’s okay with you... Would you like to join the Occult Club with me?”

Anna, a gloomy and introverted high school student who has a bunch of fears, has a one-sided crush on Jungwoo. For someone who is the complete opposite of Anna and is bright and friendly, she wouldn’t think twice about becoming friends with him… Not until she finds out Jungwoo is obsessed with occultism?!

title: Law of First Love
description:
“Can I sit next to you?”

As one lives, there are these moments in life… Where suddenly, the world feels like a coming-of-age romance painted in pastel hues, when the sunlight shines through the leaves of trees, and everything starts to sparkle. When you're slowly drifting through water... As well as when someone, in particular, starts to shine brighter than the rest.

People who haven’t experienced this won’t know… That when one falls in love at first sight, new opportunities raise without notice. So, this is our story about our first love.

Witness Haejun, Yoon, and Chanwook’s story about their first love through a webtoon.

---
