- [Original Webtoon <Comico>](https://www.comico.kr/comic/1195)

- [Original Webtoon <Lezhi

title: Koi*Oto
description: During her summer break before entering high school, Mimori Ichigo goes to her grandmother's house near the ocean. There, she helps out at her grandmother's shop. One day while walking her grandmother's dog in the evening, she meets a boy named Kouki. They meet again, but this time she also meets Kouki's cousin named Taiga. For some odd reason Kouki has no memory of when they met and Taiga begs her to not tell him either. Later, she and Kouki sneak out to watch the fireworks, but they separate dramatically. When Ichigo goes to high school, coincidentally, Kouki and Taiga are also there, but they have no memory of her. Are they faking it or are they just lying? If so, why lie?

title: Tensei Akuyaku Reijo Otoko ni Natte Hametsu Flag Okaihi Shitai Dakenanoni, F-Class no Gekokujo toka Dekiai Toka Shirimasen!
description:
男の子になったり女の子になったり？？？
サバイサル学園無意識チートざまぁコメディー！

どのルートの末路も18歳で死ぬ、死亡フラグしかない“悪役令嬢”リザベーナに転生した主人公（元34歳OL）。
死亡フラグ回避のため自らに呪いをかけ男として生きることに。
しかし、その呪いは日が出ている間は男(リザーク）、日が沈むと女（リザベーナ）の姿に戻ってしまうものだった！
７人の兄と両親からの溺愛を味方に、この世界でリザ（リザベーナ・リザーク）は上手いことやっていけるのか！？

title: A Mangaka's Wish Fulfillment Romcom, But I Got Rejected On Page 1?
description: I was debating between the current Light Novel title or just calling it "Romcom".

title: Girlfriend (Kari): Murakami Fumio-hen - Secret Smile
description: A school graffiti story overflowing with Fumio's charm! This story charmingly and cutely depicts the daily life of Murakami Fumio, the "flower of the library"! What are the hidden feelings of this slightly shy girl...? *The digital version does not include the bonus serial code.

title: Mako to Aki-chan no Koigokoro
description:
This is the story about the talented swimmer Mako and the careless Aki-chan. What will happen between us since they are completely different? Mako loves that womanizer of Aki-chan and then she confessed to him “please, let me became a special person for you”. But isn’t Mako a little bit too positive…?  
  
Pt-Br:  
Essa é a história sobre Mako e Aki-chan. O que acontecerá entre eles, sendo que os dois são completamente diferentes? Mako ama o Aki-chan e então ela se confessou para ele: "Por favor, me deixe ser uma pessoa especial para você"… Mas será que Mako não está sendo positiva demais?

title: Drop
description:
This is the story about a forbidden relationship. An innocent girl falls in love with a boy who has a secret…  
  
**Included one-shots:**  
- Uwaki na Kizuato *(浮気な傷跡)*  
- Oroka na Toomawari *(愚かな遠回り)*

title: The Girl in the Sailor Uniform
description:
/Inglés   
"G" is the most popular boy of the school, or was, before a mysterious girl transfers to his class. Everybody gets excited to have a new classmate, so much in fact that… they completely forget who "G" is.  
This is the Story of a boy trying to recover his popularity and a girl who doesn't want any attention working together to recover what has been lost.   
The Girl In the Sailor Uniform by Gabriel1999 is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License. <http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/>.  


---

title: A Good Librarian Like a Good Shepherd
description: The story is set at Shiomi Academy, a vast, prestigious academy with a Daitoshokan (literally, "great library") that rivals Japan's national library. As a member of the Library Club, Kyoutarou Kakei goes to Daitoshokan to enjoy reading by himself. He then meets a second-year girl named Tsugumi Shirasaki through the efforts of a so-called "shepherd" who fulfills people's wishes. Eventually, more girls join the club thanks to the "shepherd."

title: Tsunrize ~Tsundere Akuyaku Reijou Liselotte to Jikkyou no Endo-kun to Kaisetsu no Kobayashi-san~
description:
"That's some serious tsun! Way too much tsun, Lieselotte! Isn’t she overdoing it here!?"

"What Lieselotte just said basically meant 'Let me join you,' but because of how roundabout her wording is and how arrogantly she usually behaves, they totally got the wrong idea about her..."

One day in the courtyard, Crown Prince Siegward suddenly receives an oracle from the gods. But in truth, it's actually live commentary and analysis being provided by two Japanese high school students! Guided by the "Voices of the Gods", everyone begins their struggle across both the other world and modern-day Japan in order to cut down the destruction flags of the lovely and adorable tsundere villainess Lieselotte!

title: Interval Zero
description: General Course Student Kadokura spends his days stressfully looking after the Sports Course students who live in his house, at his father's (their coach) behest. Although he doesn't get along with the Athletics ace Kima, after a meaningful conversation one night, he kisses Kadokura.

title: PSY & JK
description: マナは恋に忙しいイマドキのJK♪だけど実は…ちょっぴり超能力が使えてしまうのです！！今日もサイコキネシスやテレパスを練習しながら、いつか大好きな彼の心を…ムフフ。

title: The Real Antismoking Campaign Manhwa
description: Brilliant usage of modern media for antismoking campaign. Park Hyung Suk from Lookism makes an appearance.

title: Natsukanaide Tora-kun
description:
A girl who falls in love way too easily is working hard to take over her grandparents' café. To stay focused on her dream, she swore off love completely. But one day, a new part-timer shows up at the café—he looks like a total delinquent, and things start to get complicated…

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

---
Note: The one-shot published in the December 1, 2024 issue of The Hana to Yume and was serialized.

title: Mashiroiro Symphony -Twinkle Moon-
description: Covering the route of Onomiya Yutsuki, the charismatic, boyish member of the drama club. How will Shingo be able to help her become more feminine?

title: Yasashii Watashi
description: Seriu meets Yae, an older woman in the photography club, who is something of a celebrity at her university for her free-spirited speech and behavior, especially her magnificent travels from man to man! What's intriguing, though, is their relationship. Frustrated and formerly part of the tennis club, Seriu thinks that his girlfriend has a bit too much baggage, but he unexpectedly gets off to a good start with her! Even though they hurt each other with their honest confessions, they grow with each other. Yasashii Watashi is a whirlwind love story that passionately depicts genuine human relationships.

title: Huā Hé Cìwèi Táopǎo le
description: Rich girl Hua Manman is forced by her father to study hard in a normal university without exposing her identity. There, she meets a commoner schoolmate— the handsome, cold, and slightly scheming Xiao Ye. The two of them come from different worlds with different values, and during their clashes, they find another…adorable side other than that of the cold hedgehog/foolish rich daughter. (Synopsis: Gourmet Scans)

title: Chiisana Ai to Suteki na Hibi o
description: That day, when I met you, the world changed colour.

title: Semete Sukitte Iwasete
description: Ririe is depressed after being dumped by her boyfriend when her brother's friend, Yuzuki, sees her. Yuzuki is bitter at Ririe, saying that she is not a good judge of character, but afterwards she worries about him in every way. But Yuzuki is always worried about her, and she finds herself becoming more and more aware of his kindness.

title: Aisupe @
description:
From Kirei Cake:  
  
Aisupe @ is a love comedy story based on the online game “ai sp@ce” that features various well-known heroines from popular games and shows such as D.C. II, CLANNAD, and SHUFFLE!

title: Kono Machi ga Bokura no Sekai
description: Suzu is a girl who is pretty content with her small town life and enjoys climbing up trees. Yet, there is a part of her that wishes for a change to sweep into her life and her wish just might come true in the form of a new transfer student…

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Tendou Maya Erased (Doujinshi)
description:
Saijou Claudine has vague memories of a girl that she used to be close to…. however, that girl doesn't and has never existed.  
  
Tendou Maya x Claudine Saijou (MayaKuro) Doujinshi.   
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

title: Suki Shika Iwanai
description:
What do you need in love? Experience? Good looks? No, it's stupidity!

This is the popular author Fukushima Haruka's first serial in Betsukomi! The strongest romantic comedy with the toughest heroine you'll ever fall in love with!

title: Beautiful Sunshine!
description:
Kasumi Kishimoto is 15. Having arranged to stay with her aunt, she is surprised to learn that the other four people in the house are all male.   
  
The manga was originally 5 volumes long. Then it was reprinted in bunko 3 volumes (each bunko volume has more pages than the original volumes), and after that, it was reprinted again in 2 wideban volumes (even more pages per volume). Basically, the content and the length of the story is the same, they just come in different formats.  
  
Bunk release 3 Volumes.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Beautiful Sunshine**

title: Bloody Kiss
description:
Wakaba has no memories about her first love. The only thing she kept from her first love was a matching pendant. One day, the vampire of rumors, Yukito, came into her school… and he has the same pendant as her?! Wakaba is sure that Yukito is her first love! Just after telling him, he kissed her. But why is he so cold with her after that?!  
  
Includes two other side stories:  
Un Chocoholic  
Bloody Honey

title: Asa Chun!
description:
**From HaruHime:**  
Her childhood friend she hasn’t seen in four years have become incredibly cool guy? And what’s more, the two of  
them are going to be going about their lives under the same roof? Will Akane’s heart continue to pound every day?

title: Tonari de Hanasaku Oto ga Shita
description: Love. It comes all of a sudden, even to delinquents. A pint-sized punk is fascinated by the earnestness of the black-haired, pessimistic committee chairman; two punks start going out only as a defiance to everyday monotony; two boys cut classes at their usual spot, the rooftop, where they end up having an adult relationship.

title: Haikyuu!! - Usotsuki Canon (Doujinshi)
description: Hinata blurts out a confession–but is soundly rejected. When he realizes why Kageyama rejected him, though, he quickly takes it back to avoid hurting Kageyama, convincing him it was a misunderstanding. Both Hinata and Kageyama are caught up in lies, to themselves and others.

title: THE FAN & M MUSEUM (Pre-Serialization)
description:
Akitaka Tenma visits the library of the old school building to join the newly established Literature Club. There appears the advisor Mitsurugi Mizuki. What will happen to their messy relationship?

Akatsuki Akira Mini Manga Series

title: Rubbers 7
description: Welcome to Rubbers 7, a small Japanese convenience store with a reputation for some odd owners. Rumors of mob connections and one rather eccentric boss with a passion for Ping-pong tend to keep business low. But when a young, quiet girl is framed for shoplifting and ends up working for the store. Can her touch, with the help of her unusual coworkers, including a shy boy and a drag queen, turn the fortune of the store around?

title: My Fake Love
description:
A high school girl, Rai, secretly has a crush on her childhood friend, Do-gyeong.
To hide her feelings, she pretends to be an idol fan.

Just when she couldn't give up on either her one-sided love or her fangirling—her favorite idol transfers to her school?!
With Neulchan’s transfer, the relationship that seemed unchangeable begins to shake.

"We're just friends, so why are you jealous?"

A summer-lit school romance about a childhood friend turning into a girlfriend!

title: The Red Thread
description:
When Dean, the captain of the swimming club, takes the podium during Pharm’s university orientation, something unusual happens. Though the two have never met before, they’re unable to hide the turmoil that suddenly wells up inside them as they can’t help but feel that this isn’t the first time they’ve laid eyes on each other. Perhaps the red thread of fate links them together from their past lives...

**Note**:
This is the manga adaptation of the Thai novel "*The Red Thread*" and it's drama adaptation "*Until We Meet Again*".

title: Katakoizakari
description:
Oneshots  
  
1. Mainichi Kimi no Koto bakari  
  
I have always loved him because we're always together since we are childhood friends. I couldn't imagine him finding someone he loves… I can't suppress my feelings anymore!!  
  
2. Iori-kun no Nayamigoto  
  
She went to karate training camp with her childhood friend and…  
  
3. Boku no Riiko-sama  
4. Christmas Candy  
5. Sono Yubisaki ni

title: Rewrite: SIDE-TERRA
description:
Kazamatsuri, a modern, well-developed city renowned for its burgeoning greenery and rich Japanese culture, is home to a boy named, Kotarou Tennouji, a frivolous and nosey high schooler .

Kotarou spends his days joking with his childhood friend Kotori and pranking his rival Yoshino, all the while seeking greater contentment and connections in his life. In truth, he holds a secret- the superhuman ability to permanently rewrite his physiology, which lets him modify his strength and speed to his liking. With such traits, Kotarou is naturally drawn to the supernatural, and is led to meet the president of the Occult Research Club, the “Witch” Akane Senri.

But that was the beginning of a battle for the fate of the earth!

title: Bakuman. (Official Colored)
description: Moritaka Mashiro (Saiko), with his superb drawing skill, is invited by his writing genius classmate Akito Takagi (Shujin) to tread the difficult path of the mangaka!! His sights are set on his naive yet earnest joint dream with Miho Azuki, who is aiming to become a voice actress!! Saiko and Shujin team up as writer and artist, aiming to be serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump, make a hit, and then release an anime. They bring their manuscripts into editors and set off on the road to becoming pro manga artists!! This is a new-age story of manga success!!

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - SeeSaw Game (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine, both of whom are young actresses-in-training at the illustrious Seisho Music Academy, have recently started dating. However, Claudine doesn't feel like their romantic relationship is any different from their prior friendship relationship, so she decides to be more proactive in getting closer to Maya.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Chissai Shitsuren
description:
Dialogue-less story about a girl searching for a cat.  
  
Entry of the Silent Manga Audition.

title: Datte, Kimi ga Warau kara.
description:
Let’s get into a time machine and return to that time.   
Where it was always fun and you were always laughing, to that time…  
"I only have three more months to live"   
Yui who just transferred to a new school in the countryside becomes Ryo’s classmate. Yui who is suffering from an illness has a "wish" that she can’t tell anyone, but Ryo wants to grant her that wish but…  
After death, reality hits Ryo and Yui.  
This is the story of the eternal promise that was made by the two of them.

title: Kosu x Kosu
description:
Kosu x Kosu is a oneshot about Isumi Seiji, a high school art student who frequently coaxes female students into becoming his models, and Takamiya Ayase, the student council president who always reprimands him.  
  
After repeatedly refusing to become Seiji’s model, Ayase decides that the only way to stop him is to disband the art club. As she attempts to do so, however, she is cursed by a third party, and the only one who can free her from the curse is none other than Seiji.

title: Liàn' ài chābān shēng
description: Middle school days: young, inexperienced, and magnificent. Chen Jiani left behind a love letter, and then disappeared from Yao Tianhai’s life. Two years later, they meet again, but Chen Jiani doesn’t recognize Yao Tianhai. “Stupid girl, we'll meet again!” Yao Tianhai is a bit angry.

title: Kare-Kano.
description:
Middle schoolers in a long distance love. And what happens when they see each other after so long once they got into high school…!? A mature love story.  
  
French :   
Deux collégiens qui vivent un amour à distance. Que se passe-t-il une fois qu'ils se revoient après si longtemps ?  
Une fois qu'ils sont entrés au lycée…!?  
Une petit histoire d'amour toute simple, sans prétention.

title: Chinko no Tsubuyaki
description: While on a high school field trip, a school bus crashes into the shrine of a penis God. This serves as the catalyst for a group of four high school boys to switch penises with each other.

title: Young Girl, Young Boy
description:
Akira is a cute Junior High School boy who has a great singing voice that his sister is always raving about. She thinks his voice sounds like an angel's and in a truly sister-like fashion, she plots to get her younger brother into a dress and wig so she can see him look like an angel while he sings too. So at home one day after school, she gets Akira to sing karaoke, and then dresses him up in a frilly dress and a wig of long hair!  
  
Nearby, a talent scout hears a beautiful clear voice. He follows the sound and can hear Akira's singing coming out of Akira's house. He is thrilled to see the voice belongs to the girl in the cute dress. But Akira tears the wig off and insists that he is a boy. After a moment of thought, the talent scout begs to recruit Akira to be the next new FEMALE idol singing sensation! Akira refuses at first, but finally relents when he realizes he may get the chance to meet Ruri, a currently popular female idol singer. And thus "Mizuki" is born, the angelic new G

title: Fortune Arterial - Character's Prelude
description: Fortune Arterial's story revolves around the male protagonist Kohei Hasekura, who transfers into a prestigious public school–an English style six-year school, serving junior high and high school students. The school, named Shuchikan Academy, is on an island, Tamatsu Island, off-shore from mainland Japan, and the only way to get there is by boat. This is a series of characters' introductions to prelude the main story.

title: Little Busters! Ecstasy
description:
In the Little Busters! Ecstasy (EX) series:

* V.1: Tokido Saya - School Revolution
* V.2: Sasasegawa Sasami - Black Cat Fantasia
* V.3: Futaki Kanata - My Minroud

title: My Brother's Body Is Too Useful!
description: The two siblings who unconditionally swapped bodies have to pursue each other's crushes in order to swap back. One minute we were bickering, and the other minute, we're swapped. I will only swap you two back if you guys get each other's true loves.. But, hehehe~ My brother's body is so useful!

title: Hadashi no Seimei
description: Asuka Sakurai has no romantic feelings. She never thought it was special and she never regretted it. Ten years ago, except for that moment- a story of imagination and choice surrounding a person who does not fall in love, drawn through the friendship of four men and women.

title: I Will Start the Contract Family From Today
description:
Hinako, a high schooler, is left alone without any relatives to take care of her after she lost her beloved mother.Overcome with sadness, she agrees to be a live-in employee at the handsome CEO Yukihito's house after a series of events.To keep up appearances, Hinako ends up getting married to Yukihito... but he actually has 4 children?!!

A heartfelt story about a couple with a complicated past, along with their children’s strong personalities.

(Source: Gourmet Scans)

title: Itoshi no Kanojo wa Kakure Otaku
description:
Naruse, a high school teacher, has a beautiful girlfriend who is a manga artist by profession. They have been seriously dating for about two years, but even after all that time, he doesn't even know what kind of manga she draws. On the other hand, Ondeko, who is attracted to how Naruse looks with glasses, has a secret that she has not yet told Naruse...?

(Source: Flowers, translated)

title: black peach flower
description:
"I'll be your captive."  
Love potions DO exist.

title: He's Dedicated to Roses
description:
"If you were a girl, we would never have met."  
  
"Well- to…to be honest with you- I AM a girl-"  
  
Plain when she is a girl, but hot when she is a guy, Choi Ida has been all his live the slave of Mimi, a rich and spoiled girl. When the stress of Ida is to much to bear with it, she goes into the streets looking for fights, disguised as a guy, Yodah, admired and feared by a lot of people.   
  
But things start to get complicated when Naru, a guy that despite thinking that Ida is a boy, falls in love with her…

title: Beware of the Great Beauty
description: A devil appeared in front of me, who was suffering because of my appearance, and made an attractive offer! I can make the look I want with just one click? CUTE! SEXY! PURE! LUXURY! Raise stats to create the look you want?! But you know... I thought I would be happy if I became prettier... but that doesn't seem to be the case?

title: Pinkscrap
description:
A special edition/side story of the popular series "Namaikizakari." (Cheeky Brat) featuring the couple Tono-kun and Ami-chan! They've been dating for a year, but they still haven't progressed beyond kissing. What will become of their "first time"?! This collection of short stories also includes the elusive first one-shot version of "Namaikizakari".
The volume contains several stories.

 - Pinkstrap
- After School Aurora I 
- After School Aurora II
- Bonus Chapter 1
- Bonus Chapter 2

title: Renai Game
description: Very determined Kaji decides to become an apprentice shoemaker with rumored is the best in the field. Mao accepts it after verifying the sincerity in Kaji's words regarding his intention of wanting to learn. Mao shows your "castle" in making the shoe making, there Kaji gets his first kiss under the context of "If you stay here you have to do the work of an adult."

title: Manken ni Bishoujo
description: Ayasa, a first-year student in a new highschool, decides to release her feelings for beautiful girls and enter the Manga Club. When she opens the door of the club room, there is an overwhelming beautiful girl over there…!

title: Yasashii Hari
description:
Ryoutarou is a boy who likes to knit. He has a younger stepsister that he spoils and cares about a lot. He thought that his life will always continue to be as peaceful and quiet until one day, he encountered a beautiful lady standing still in the rain without even an umbrella over her. Since then, his heart can't seem to settle down.

Thus our knitting boy has fallen, right into his first love.

title: Akuma no Hanazono
description: He is the "Devil", who loves flowers. All girls feel loved when he's around. It was all the same for him until he saw a crying girl that ran into his garden. He thought she was like any other girl, but eventually, she was the prettiest flower he ever saw…

title: Sato Zakuri Tanpenshuu - Shoujo, Shoujo, Shoujo na no.
description:
A collection of one-shots.  
  
1. Shoujo, Shoujo, Shoujo na no  
Hirako Bell, a pretty middle schooler had moved to the country. She currently dislikes the country due to her love for the city life. She also aspires to be a model, and therefore applied with an agency. She had also made a certain friend. Will Bell pass the audition? What about her new friend?  
  
2. Solitary Girl  
A strange disease has forced most mankind to extinction, leaving only a recently awakened girl Kana, and a robot teddy bear. Kana remembers a certain boy during her slumber, so searches for him and anyone in general throughout the now empty world. Will she find anyone?  
  
3. Under Heaven  
Miyata Chikami is a very popular girl at school that wishes to live a simple life. When she gets home, she is suddenly in debt situation, and one man had taken her to his place, as what her dad had arranged. He was a strange one, but she was quickly attached to him. Will Chikami ever have her simple debt free life, or w

title: Aquarion EVOL
description:
The "Abductors", invaders from Altair, come to the planet of Vega with only one purpose: to harvest humans. Neo-DEAVA, a military academy based near the city of Neo-Kowloon, exists to train men and women to use technologically-advanced fighter planes known as "Vectors" in order to fight back against the Abductors, but members of opposite genders are forbidden from merging because of certain "Guize stones" that block such so-called "unholy unions". The story follows Amata's and Mikono's enrollment into Neo-DEAVA, their fight against the Abductors, and the discovery of their link with their counterparts from 12,000 years ago.  
  
Based on the anime that aired from January to June 2012.  
  
Link:  
[AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=12547) (anime)

title: Ryuunosuke-kun wa Yasashikunai
description: Love Story about two childhood friends who met each other again after seven years apart.

title: Eccentric Hobby
description: One day, high school student Nagakura (normal dude) receives a love letter. Heading to the promised tree, the one who was waiting for him is Nishioka (super otaku) …dressed in a sailor girl uniform!! Super eccentric "campus love" comedy in 4-panel comics~

title: Omae Allergy
description: Kanou Hiroto, a high school student, experienced sexual harassment as a child, which led him to develop an allergy to men. Due to this, he isolated himself from guys until he met Ohshiro Kei, who approached him without knowing about his condition. Ultimately, Kanou struggles as Ohshiro relentlessly pursues after him. Will Kanou accept this twist of fate?

title: Blade Girl: Kataashi no Runner
description: One year after losing her leg, 16-year-old Rin is tired-tired of the painful physical therapy, tired of being treated differently, and tired of her stupid, heavy, awkward prosthetic leg. All that changes when she encounters the Blade Runners, a group of one-legged athletes who run with “blades”-carbon fiber prosthetics specialized for competitive running-made by their gifted prosthetist, Kazami. The blades are light, flexible, and formidably difficult to control-Rin can barely walk with one, much less sprint. But as she tumbles to the ground again and again, she rediscovers many of the things that she’d forgotten, and finds a new goal: to compete in the Paralympics. [Kodansha]

title: Tomodachi to Koi no Mannaka
description: That day, that time, if I hadn't met you, I wouldn't be experiencing these feelings…

title: Rental Hearts
description: Amamiya Nonoka is a human that can see spirits. Because of the strange ability she posseses, she has no friends at school at all. Suddenly, one day two handsome brothers appear in front of the lonely Nonoka. Aki and Kou, the two of them came to borrow Nonoka's "strange ability"? Not to mention, they are renting parts of their bodies to continue living…

title: Girls und Panzer -Anata-tachi Kenkanasai! (Doujinshi)
description: Conjunto de diferentes historias de Oshida x Andō.

title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun - Misa x Misa (Doujinshi)
14R
description:
A volume of 5 oneshots.  
  
1) 14R  
Kawamura Tamaki, 14 years old.  
Seen as a very serious class rep by everyone around. But, what does it mean to be serious? She too falls in love, and…!? A blinding underworld unraveled here!!  
  
2) Mahiru ni Kakedasu  
  
3) Watakushi-sama  
  
4) Koi wo Hajimeru Bokutachi ni (For Us Who Begin to Love)  
A girl, Kawai Oto, and a guy… Will they fall in love?  
  
5) Daily News  
Two twins support each other through everything, but can a guy tear them apart?

title: Kuchibirue no Libido
description:
キス、したい。
犬井は隣の席の星名さんのくちびるに憧れ、キスを求めていた。
「でも、できるわけない。」
叶うはずのない願いに悩んだ犬井は、星名さんとおそろいのリップグロスで、キスを疑似体験することに。
しかしリップグロスはなかなか見つからず、崩れ落ちる犬井だったが、そこに星名さんが現れて――!?
果たして、犬井はキスの味を知ることができるのか……？

title: Moshi Moshi, Kame-San.
description: Career, dreams, the future... Kameyama decided to skip this pointless discussion and headed to the rooftop to escape from the approaching reality. There he meets the boy "Rabbit", who he has never seen in school before and somehow doesn’t even own a phone!? Who is this handsome stranger?... A tear-jerking one shot about the threshold to adult life.

title: Sora to Kimi to.
description:
Ten and Rio are friends from the old days. They will become high school students starting from this spring, but Ten still carries certain memories in her heart….?  
  
Included one-shot:  
Volume 4: Junai Joutou!!

title: Haato Sagashi
description:
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=9417)  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/nikaidooooooooo)

title: Life x 01
description:
It's been a rough day for our leading lady, Ana.  
  
First she finds out that indeed she is half-dead, but then she learns that in order for her to return to the world of the living she must survive a battle royale of sorts with her classmates.  
  
With limited spaces available will our Ana make it back?

title: P x P
description:
PxP (Chp.1-3) :  
Himeno Ruri is Vice President of the School Council at Seiou Academy! Recently, at a council meeting, a strange matter has come up: "P", the mysterious thief for hire. Who is he, and why does he only steal particular items?  
  
[Oneshot]- Baby It's You:  
Because of her beauty and status as a school idol, Akami is somewhat forced to take part in a school play. Only problem Akami has is that, the role she's suppose to do is a ''male'' role and she isn't experienced in acting at ALL.

title: Zhè jūrán shì Xiàoyuán Rìcháng
description: This is a simple and funny daily life between campus friends.

title: Liànliàn Xiǎo Tián Gěng
description: Odinary university student Lin Xian and the campus' Prince Charming Yan Yu Sen are of two different worlds that will never collide, yet one day, they met each other unknowingly. Until an unexpected encounter, Lin Xian found out that this so-called Prince Charming had another side that no one ever knew about. Just which side is his true-self? Lin Xian's originally undisturbed campus life has begun...

title: Zutto Suki Datta Kuse ni
description:
1-3. Though I'd Always Loved You  
When Saki was in elementary school, she was dumped without notice by Chikage who was eight years her senior. She was extremely shocked because she believed that he would be her future husband! With a change of attitude, while at the high school entrance ceremony she decided that she dreamed of finding a new love, but at that time she met Chikage again, who has now become a teacher. As usual, she is shocked to realize that she still has feelings for Chikage. How does Chikage feel about Saki…?!  
  
4. My Lovely Beast  
Modoka decides to confess to her long-time crush, but accidentally gets the wrong person!?  
  
5. Love, to Burn, Fingertip  
Mari wants to be a manicurist, but is too shy to ask to paint someone's nails. Is her dream already out of reach?  
  
6. In my Shining Eyes, I See Your Face  
When Tae falls down the stairs, it might just change her world…

title: He Loves You
description: Fumi is a first year high school student who likes shoujo manga. Ever since meeting Haruma at the school's entrance ceremony, she's been harboring her yearning for him. However, there's competition in the class' group of good-looking guys, whom she wants to be able to talk to as well. By chance, she saved Haruma's childhood friend, Shino from a pinch. The two have been eating lunch together since then, and Fumi naturally started to talk with others in the group as well, including Haruma. Due to some trauma from middle school, Fumi had been keeping her distance from him. She wanted to be rid of the self-conscious Fumi who realized her feelings for Haruma. On a day when the three arranged to go out, Fumi waited at the meeting place and heard Shino saying pestering words in order to kiss Haruma. And so Fumi, in shock…

title: Naisho no Toguro-san
description: Toguro-san, a shy and reserved girl, changes personality becoming aggressive and arrogant when she is possessed by snails.

title: Dekiai Robot
description: Sakurai Yoshino is a 16 year old girl and in love with a senior from the soccer club. Valentine's Day is coming up, and she wants to give him some chocolates but her father interferes, giving her a robot bodyguard! But this bodyguard is unexpectedly cool…A sweet, short tale about love.

title: Sensei Datte Kareshi desu
description:
This spring, Yumabuki Yuo will be a second-year student at a high school. At the opening ceremony, the new art teacher, Wataru Naruchika, a childhood friend of Yao's, appears in front of her. Yui and Wataru are next door neighbors and have been close family friends since childhood. But...they actually became lovers 3 months ago! Childhood friends, lovers and teachers! The two are on the edge of their seats together with "Mr. Naruke"! 

A fearless adolescent love comedy!

title: Hereditary Triangle
description: A story regarding a 'little odd love triangle'...

title: God of Color
description: The colourful story of Aya, Hina, Kei, and their classmates, trying to figure out the mystery behind Risa's sudden disappearance. It all begins with the discovery that her disappearance has some correlation to the online dating site called "Amore." Hina proposes that they should try out the site first-hand themselves, and upon doing so, they encounter something completely unexpected?!

title: Romantic - Soichiro Yamamoto (Secret) Short Stories
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Soichiro Yamamoto's Forbidden Collection of Secret Works.

Soichiro Yamamoto, author of "Teasing Master Takagi-san" a very popular romantic comedy that has sold more than 3 million copies, has a collection of short stories finally appear!

Romantic is a collection of his treasured one-shots, including previously unpublished ones!

title: 12 Nin no Yasashii Koroshiya - Leo Murder Case
description: The main character is a fairly good looking guy who works as a Host at a very rich bar, and despite his apparent lackadaisical attitude, he remains the bar's top Host. But that's just his cover. In fact, he's also part of a secret assassination group.

title: My Dear Fluffy Fox
description: Naturally attractive human child vs arrogant and innocent nine-tailed fox! When a human is studying in a school full of monsters, it is like a sheep falling into a wolf's den, weak and helpless? No no, the cute character Wei Zhi said, can brush the furry hairy every day, it's not that bad~ but he actually stroked the bully nine-tailed fox and brought him back home? Duan Jingtang explodes: Let go of my tail Wei Zhi!

title: Taranta Ranta
description:
From Shoujo Manga Maniac:  
The main character is named Hikaru. She misses her dead brother and speaks to him in her mind as she begins her first day of high school. Here she has many ordinary adventures.  
  
She becomes fast friends with a girl named Nene, who lets nothing stand in her way and pushes Hikaru to kiss her new crush, Michiya, who reminds her of her brother. He lets her kiss him, which as it turns out is not a good sign. He seems to be a jerk, whose personality is nothing like Hikaru's brother's.  
  
Michiya's best friend Jun warns Hikaru ahead of time. Later, Hikaru finds out the bad side of her new friend Nene. When Hikaru understandably gets upset about this, Nene gets angry at her and tells her to find another friend.

title: Misao Inagaki Horror M Anthology
description:
A complete collection of Misao Inagaki's early oneshots from the Horror M magazine, known for extremely high quality horror manga and for its splatter horror series.

title: Koi Furu Colorful - Zenbu Kimi to Hajimete
description: Mashiro lives on an island surrounded by sea. One day a glittering young boy comes from Tokyo and their love begins…?

title: After School Special Supplementary class
description: Shinheung High School, where fighting skills are the result of grades, and the survival story of inferior students who chose friendship over competition.

title: Sorry, I'm a Cat!
description:
Shiraishi Yayoi is an ordinary girl with nothing special about her.
Her father, on the other hand, is a self-proclaimed genius physicist.
One day, she is used as a test subject for his research and enters a matter transfer machine.
Due to some trouble she is fused with a cat, and Super Cat Yayoi is born!

title: Tanpo
description: What is Tanpo? Basically it means security collateral. In this story, the Suzumiya family have run deep in dept that they pawn off their three daughters Yukari, Ai, and Midori as guarantees for the money they'll receive. Well, they mistake some piece of trash called Ishihara Yuujirou for the Daikoudan Group. Unfortunately, Ai-chan is the one that the rest of the family/staff coerce into tempting Yuujirou with her body to initiate sex with her in order to secure money for the debts.

title: More Than Just "Like"
description: An Shen, who is constantly ridiculed for his weight and has always been looked upon as inferior, secretly likes one of his cold, mysterious seniors. However, what An Shen doesn't know is that this male student has secretly been observing him as well. Between these two, could it be more than just simply "liking"?

title: Bomba!
description:
Tetsu Otani is a junior high school student with a weak heart. Despite the hardships of being so meek at school, he has an intense crush on one of his teachers: Reiko Mizushima. However, one of his least favorite teachers, Kito, intends to propose to her. Since Kito is very violent and often pushes Tetsu around, the thought of him and Reiko together infuriates Tetsu. Before him appears a ghostly white horse, and the next day, Kito is found dead.  
  
Tetsu realizes that this horse is the ghost of Bomba, a horse Tetsu's father told him he was charged to take care of during the Pacific War. Now, whenever Tetsu feels intense hatred for someone, Bomba will appear and cause that person to die.  
  
[Official English](https://kodansha.us/series/bomba/)

———-  
  
Also includes the 1972 oneshot, "Devil's Mountain" (魔の山, Ma no Yama) at the end of the volume as a bonus.
 *The English release is based on the Tezuka Bunko version of Bomba. However, Devil's Mountain (and the following one-shots) a

title: I Want to Fall in Love Like in a Manga!
description:
Rena Sakura is a high-school student with a secret: she's a professional mangaka. And although she's never been on a date, that doesn't stop her from drawing steamy shojo scenes for ChaMi magazine. But when the gorgeous Tomoya Okita finds out her secret, she finds herself asking him out to get some real-life experience in love!  
  
Includes the following oneshots:  
  
1. Magic Lesson (Magical Project) in v.1  
A girl uses her magic to transform her dog into a human boy.   
  
2. Bewildered Princess in v.2

[Official English](https://www.viz.com/fall-in-love-like-a-comic)

title: Boku no Kawaii Stalker
description:
Ikeda, high school student, is the stalker of a nice, easy-going guy named Aizawa Kentaru…  
  
Aizawa's things suddenly started disappearing one day. He informed his friends of this, only to find out later that all his things were taken by Ikeda who clumsily claimed to be his stalker and asked his permission to be appointed as his "official stalker". Will Aizawa accept Ikeda's offer?

title: Sungnyung Bubble Tea
description:
If you find that your life is boring and lacking anything special, all you have to do is make something happen yourself!

After realizing that her life doesn't have any impact, Sunhee Hong decides to define the genre of her life herself.

Through a sparkling romance, will Sunhee, who decided to become the protagonist herself, be able to live a special life with the male lead?

---
**Link:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11652736)

title: Tenshi Datte Azatoi
description:
A calculating woman vs. a man who won't flirt with her! A love battle of pride is about to begin!

Sumire, a super cunning girl, always has boys wrapped around her finger with her sly techniques in her search for a high-spec boy who is suitable for her. Then, Miyuki, a high-spec boy who is returning from abroad, comes to Sumire as a transfer student...! She tries to woo him with her techniques, but it doesn't work and she struggles. In fact, he sees right through her techniques and chides her...? What will happen to the rough-and-tumble girl's love?

title: Aseul-Aseul
description:
귀찮기만 했던 죽마고우 여사친에게 불쑥! 
치명적인 매력의 남사친 등장! 

양가 부모님들의 진한 인연으로 
기어다닐 때부터 중학교까지 함께 지낸 죽마고우, '김의곤'과 '신비'. 
어린 '신비'는 '의곤'과 결혼하기로 결심하고 의곤 덕후가 되었다. 
'의곤'은 '신비'의 거침없는 '들이댐'을 무려 10년이나 받아냈고, 
고등학교만큼은 제발! 떨어져 다닐 수 있기를 두 손 모아 빌고 있었다. 

똑부러지는 신비는 성적이 항상 탑이었고, 
특출난 운동신경과 싸움실력 이외에는 잘하는 게 없는 의곤. 
어차피 진학할 고등학교가 다른 건 뻔한 일이었다. 그랬어야 했다. 

최고의 명문사학, 상상고등학교. 
신비의 합격은 결정된 것과 다름 없었고, 의곤은 해방의 꿈에 부풀지만, 
하필이면 정의의 주먹을 휘둘러 구해낸 사람이 상상고 이사장의 손녀일 줄은... 
수영의 수자도 모르는 의곤은 '수영특기생'으로 합격통지서를 받게된다. 

명문고등학교에 나란히 합격한 '의곤'과 '신비'! 
의곤은 한번도 해본 적 없는 수영을 해야한다는 압박감과 
소박한 꿈, '여자친구 만들기'를 저지하려는 신비의 압박수비를 
3년이나 견뎌야한다는 생각에 한숨만 나온다. 

'의곤'과 같이 상상고 수영부 소속 '차신우'는 천부적인 재능과 외모로 인터넷에서도 유명하다. 
어머니의 죽음과 더불어, 자신에게 관심은 없고 오직 여자와 정치뿐인 아버지를 향한 경멸이 
신우를 삐뚤어지게 만들었고, 안 좋은 친구들과 어울렸지만, 최근 관심있는 게 생겼다. 

자신의 배경, 외모 때문에 득달처럼 달려드는 다른 여자와 달리, 
순수하고, 솔직하고, 귀여운 신비에게 점점 마음을 빼앗기게 된다. 

"뭐야, 아무사이 아냐? 그럼 신비 내가 만나도 되는 거지?" 

갑자기 가슴이 요동치는 '의곤' 
'신우'의 등장으로 신비에 대한 마음이 꿈틀대기 시작하는데...

title: Sayonara Note
description:
"Taku-chan is my hero."  
  
The cheerful and caring Takumasa and the quiet Ken: there's a deep reason why these two started exchanging diaries, although it may seem childish. They've been doing it for five years and now it has become their special daily routine, which connects them to each other. That's why they should've known everything about each other… but Takumasa is surprised to hear from his classmate that Ken's in love!  
  
*There is an extra about another couple that is still untranslated.

title: Haikyuu!! - Insensible Fight (Doujinshi)
description: The entire team knows that Hinata and Kageyama are dating. Except for Hinata and Kageyama.

title: Reizouko no Naka wa Karappo
description: Shimizu, a spoilt rich high school boy, leaves his home to become a comic artist and ends up rooming with his friend, Umeya. Umeya is so poor that he's got nothing in his fridge except mayonnaise to eat with the rice!

title: Never Say No.
description: Anzu currently works part-time at a beach house. However when serving male customers, she can't help but be cold and shy. When she accidentally spills a drink on one of them, a male co-worker who saves her turns out to be her childhood friend, Rei. Anzu is happy to reconnect with Rei, however, Rei might be after a bit more…?

title: SOS! Falling in Love With a Moth!
description:
Season One Summary: Miao Xiao Fan is a normal girl, but her mom is a gu master. After cultivating her own gu, she wants to let him live in our home!? Xiao Fan’s peaceful life has turned upside down! Moths are so gross!  
  
*gu: 蛊虫. A worm that needs to be cultivated that, when strong enough can shapeshift into other forms. When mature enough, their masters (gu masters) can implant them into other beings and can usually take control of those beings.

title: Yuri Game
description: A girl has an encounter that opens her mind to new possibilities.

title: Sakurai Mei no Tsukurikata
description:
Ryuuko and Sakurai Mei were childhood friends. After being separated for several years, Ryuuko returns with the intention of confessing to Sakurai. To his surprise, Sakurai is changed from a cheerful girl to a gloomy loner. Fortunately, a miracle happens; they body swap! Now, it's his chance to help Sakurai regain her shining smile.  
  
Nakamura Ryuuko y Sakurai Mei son amigos de la infancia. Después de varios años alejados uno de otro, Ryuuko regresa con la intención de confesar su amor por ella. Pero cuando se reencuentran Sakurai Mei no es la misma chica alegre y brillante que solía ser sino una solitaria y sombría. Luego de un hecho inesperado Ryuuko se propone a volver hacerla sonreír como en los viejos tiempos pero ¿Un cambio del destino de encargará de lograrlo?

title: Wonder 3
description:
(from DMP): Three extraterrestrials are on a mission to see if Earth is qualified to be part of the Galactic Control which is an order where only certain planets can be part of. If Earth isn't qualified then the planet will be destroyed. To progress in their mission, the three beings abduct three earth animals as disguises for themselves. With their extraordinary powers they already have, they were best known as the Wonder 3.

Sentai can be translated to "task force" and a lot of Japanese anime/manga/live action shows are generally aimed at children with the main characters as protectors of Earth where they can transform and gain superpowers. Ever seen Power Rangers? That's a Super Sentai series.

Wonder 3 takes place in an alternate Earth in the year 196X and the world is overrun with war and violence. The Galactic Federation consisting of all the advanced species of the universe convene to decide the future of Earth, but due to a lack of information they decide to send an elite team,

title: Himitsu no Shitsuji-kun
description:
"If you don't want your 'secret' to be exposed, would you listen to my "wish"…?" Satsuki is both beautiful and smart, and she's popular in the whole academy, but actually, she has a "secret" that she can't tell anyone. One day, she witnessed her classmate, Okuno-kun, working part-time at a butler tea house. As a "bargaining point" to get Satsuki to keep quiet about this, he agreed to listen to her "wish", but then…?!  
  
Also contains three other short stories:  
  
- Kimi no Suki na Hito (The Person That She Likes)  
  
- Omou, Clavier (Think Of You, Clavier)  
  
- Bijo wo Hirotte Sodatemasen ka? (Would You Like To Adopt And Raise A Beauty?)

title: Karada ni Shokubutsu ga Haeta Onnanoko no Hanashi
description: A guy likes a girl in his class so he confesses to her, only to find out that she has vines growing on her body. What is this mysterious affliction, and how does it affect their love for each other?

title: Sasayaki wa Bara no Shita de
description: "Whisper Under the Roses" is a school story set in the early 20th century.

title: Haikyuu!! - Hyakuman Kai Ai wo Sakebe (Doujinshi)
description: Iwaizumi Hajime x Oikawa Tooru

title: Strawberry 100% (Official Colored)
description:
Scene: The School Rooftop  
The hero (me, Junpei Manaka!) sneaks up to the roof to see the sunset. When he opens the door, he startles a mysterious beauty. She panics and runs away, but not before Junpei has caught sight of her adorable strawberry print panties…in EXTREME close-up. With that vision forever burned into his memory, Junpei embarks on a quest to find the girl, and the panties, of his dreams!

title: Charisma Doll
description: High school first year Sara has a secret…she’s really the super-popular singer SALA! However, as an idol her gender is kept a secret from the world in order to sell her music. But can Sara win when she wants to be just Sara…?

title: Hatsukoi Rhapsody
description: "People always say that your first love is the most special…" A sweet story of lost and found.

title: Tsukushite Agemasu
description:
French :  
Yuzuko est une fille toujors optimiste et qui a une tendance à dire tout haut tout ce qui lui passe par la tête.  
Alors que ça lui arrive pour la énième fois et qu'elle insulte son interlocuteur, elle est sauvée de justesse par une magnifique soubrette du café voisin :"Maid and Butler". Ce qu'elle ignore c'est que la soubrette en question n'est autre que le garçon le plus populaire du lycée : Itsuki….

title: Kedamono Kareshi!
description: Tada's friend Enami is a very popular, perfect, good-looking guy among guys and girls alike. Tada, who admired him, found out that Enami's actually a very selfish, pushy person who refers to himself as "Ore-sama…!!!" What is Enami's real intention, showing his beastly side to Tada and expressing his lust without any concern for the place they're at?!

title: Suki Dakara Kisushita no?
description: It happened on a sunny day right before summer: Fujisawa Souta's first kiss. It was with his older classmate, Ayase Chihiro. It's now their summer vacation, and yet, nothing has happened between the two of them! What's worse? Fujisawa discovers that he wasn't actually Ayase's first kiss, and now regrets kissing him.

title: Dress Him Up
description: Yeonwoo's plaid sense of style is a lost cause, but a Stylist for Hire ad just might save his social and romantic life. Designer Jaehee starts the makeover project of a lifetime, but can he transform this walking fashion no-no into a runway model for the graduation show —without falling for his handsome charms?!

title: Daybreak
description: Marcus has a crush, and Cog is completely unprepared for the hijinks that follow. Hopefully in their efforts to grow closer, they can brighten each other's day.

title: Love Is a Promise
description: Because of the promise Ganendra made with a woman when he was little. He became obsessed with the promise to be perfect for the woman. But, what will he do when the woman comes back looking completely different?

title: Ardour
description: Ardour is currently the hottest pop boy band. All the members, Sheng Ye, A Yao, and Wei have the looks, skills, and talents that drive their fans wild. Lian You Yi is a normal fifteen-year old girl. However, she doesn't know anything about Ardour, even though her father is their manager! To save her father from getting fired, due to his inability to take care of the band, You Yi ends up becoming Ardour’s new manager. What she hasn't bargained on is the band members' cocky attitudes! How will You Yi manage the band? What will You Yi have to do in order for her father to keep his job?! And will one of the boys show kindness to her, and maybe, just maybe, will even romance spark?

title: Tonari no Hoshi no Ouji-sama
description: A girl with a scary appearance meet a guy with hidden agenda = a burgeoning love comedy

title: The Perfect Duo
description: The cutest girl in our school isn’t so innocent after all! Will she and I be able to create the perfect cartoon?

title: Koisuru Lazy
description: A serious girl and lethargic boy’s youthful, pure love starts!! One is methodical and serious, while the other is lethargic but can do anything…!? Meet the regrettable prince, Miyano-kun. A story about two people who never seem to cross.

title: Boku no Robot
description: The story revolves around a girl who is wealthy Rei-kun’s robot. What kind of relationship will those two have!?

title: Death Meeting Support Center
description: Do you want someone dead? Maybe there's a bully harassing you at school? Just contact the Tranquility Support Center. They'll deal with your problem by killing the person harassing you! Of course, there is a price to pay, but it's worth it, right...?

title: Sailor Fuku ni Onegai!
description: When Hina hits a homerun ball and goes to get it back, she realizes she has damaged a shrine with the baseball. When she touches the object inside the shrine, the object is absorbed into her, and she becomes the shrine's god. Now she is protected by the shrine's guard dogs, Shishi and Koma. On her journey she meets other spirits, guardians, and the legendary nine-tailed fox.

title: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru - itchiji9's Kisekoi (Doujinshi)
H
description: Kobayashi Shinobu, first year high school student, transfers to a new school only to get dumped by her boyfriend and have a teacher who breaks all her conventional preconceptions. He smokes. He leaves class without warning. And at night, he works as a host. Will their relationship develop into something more than student and teacher? Read H and find out!!

title: Random Walk
description: Yuka is a freshman in high school, living in the apartment next door to her mystery writer father and his new wife. The one thing she learned from her father was to "fall in love as many times as you can, and become an attractive woman." Now that she is in high school, Yuka is determined to meet her one true love. Will the day finally come when she will meet her destined one?

title: Toraji-senpai no Shiiku gakari
description:
The first day of her long-awaited high school life ♪

Ruki was so excited that she ended up being late. As she rushed to the entrance ceremony, she heard a voice coming from inside the gym storage room! There, she found a ferocious beast, or rather, a handsome man being held captive!!

The person in the storage room was second-year Toraji-senpai. He even told her, "Ruki is my zookeeper!" But Ruki is constantly at the mercy of this elusive senpai who is sometimes mean and sometimes kind...!? Can she tame this free-spirited handsome man?!

A thrilling love story ♪

title: Bibi
description: Nabi has a talent for copying any piece of clothing she sees. Due to lack of money, she has given up her dream of becoming a great designer to help her mother with her imitations shop. During the Seoul Fashion Festival, Nabi meets Jehu, an over-excited guy who attends Baekje Art School. She will regain her confidence and try to enter this famous school.

title: Come Spring
description: The normal meeting inside the normal life. The slightly special destiny that becomes entwined inside it.

title: New Sakura Diaries
description: The classic "Sakura Diaries" is revived in modern times!! Yashiro Heita, commonly known as Yajirobe, is a job-hunting ronin who moves to Tokyo to try his best to find a job, but is unsuccessful. He is staying with his uncle and is determined to try his best to find a job again, but there is a woman he admires. Just as Heita is about to get a job and confess his feelings to the girl he has a crush on, a high school girl (self-proclaimed) appears in front of him and calls him "big brother"!! Without even knowing who she is, the two enter into an illicit relationship...!! A love triangle that seems like it will bloom but never does is about to begin...!!

title: Konya, Sensei no Ude no Naka
description: Midori appears to be living the treasure box life. She's got a famous mom, lives in a mansion, eats high class food and has plenty friends, everything should be perfect, right? When she met him though, that's when her walls broke away.

title: Koiyami - Hayari Kami Another Story
description:
The cute avatar Saeko promises to fulfill any wish you might have. All she asks for is friendship for life, and specially, death.  
  
1. Michiru (by Momono Moto)  
2. Tsukasa (by Mihoshi Megane)  
3. Yuu (by Nakahara★Momota)  
4. Kiyomi (by Chidori Peko)  
5. Saeko (by Kajitani Shino)

title: Horror Gourmet
description:
A doujinshi anthology that simulates the feel of 90s shoujo horror magazines. Targeted at women and girls and thus is listed as a shoujo manga. 

Note: Sawhore Uploads scanlated some chapters in their site. Volume 1 is complete while 2 only has a few chapters.
Note 2: DO NOT make a mangaupdates page for this as it is listed as a magazine.

title: Senpai to Kanojo
description: Tsuzuki Rika has just started her high school life, hoping to have a "sweet love". But she fell in love with a senpai, who's in love with another girl… no matter how hard she tries, her love is unlikely to be returned… sweet, yet painful adolescent love.

title: Kuro GAL wa zatsu ni manabitai!
Time and Reason (Pre-serialization)
description: A story of four siblings and how they end up with their destined partners.

title: Yoo Ah Dok-Jon
description:
From volume one's backcover:  
  
「 Don't Interfere with My Life!! 」  
  
Handsome face and all around sportsman, also the young master of an enormous rich family…Chung-sol High school's No. 1 Han Sang-Ah!! This young master who doesn't lack anything ventures running away from home?! Officially permitted runaway time is 3 years! During this time there is something he says he must get in his hands…!! From then on starting to confront him are woman!! woman!! women!!!  
  
Harem Flood Mixed with Comedy and Action! Explosion of Heart Fluttering Pink that would tail all Korea's Bookstores!!

title: Hamaya-kun!!
description:
Hamaya-kun shoots evil!  
A little love and a little horror!

title: Aoiro melody
description:
Have you ever heard the sound of falling in love?

"I love singing, but this is a secret to everyone."
Ao Sakurai, a first-year high school student who is shy and always reads the air around her and acts.
Her secret hobby. It's singing a song.
Blue sings freely alone in an empty classroom. She thought that this kind of daily life would continue as usual ... without anyone noticing.
The next day, Ao was preparing for a graduation ceremony <prom party> in the classroom with her friends. Suddenly, Shin Narita, the student council president and a popular second-year student at the school, came to the school. He is blonde and handsome, and Shin is the exact opposite in appearance and content.

title: Shiro no Koro
description: Fuji moved to the countryside from the city. There he met Daichi. It was their youth, the time when both were still white. One with innocent love and kisses, another not aware of what first love feels like. The distance between city and countryside seems to be the same as the distance between the two of them. Will they be able to overcome the hardship?

title: Boy's Lipstick
description: Well-known beauty blogger ‘B-magic’ was forced to dress up as a man to transfer schools, and Li Yunjiang could see the color of people’s emotions. The unparalleled color she exudes makes Li Yunjiang’s cold heart skip a beat. He then helped her with her job as a beauty blogger, and became interested in makeup… This is a romance story about beauty and fashion.

title: Hongou Univ. Otome Campus
description: マジキューコミックス「真・恋姫無双 外史祭典」にて、『北郷学園 乙女キャンパス』を連載していた名苗秋緒個人集が登場!

title: Watashi no Mahoutsukai-sama
description: After being instantly rejected by her crush, Takatsuki Yoshino gets seen by her absent-minded classmate, Sakura. Seeing how she seemed sad, Sakura decides to show her some magic tricks to cheer her up. Soon, Yoshino starts to talk more often with him and the two of them get closer… until Yoshino gets a bit… jealous?

title: Fure Fure Shoujo
description:
Momoko is a shy girl who spends all her time reading girly novels. She longs to fall in love like the heroines in the stories she reads, and one day her dream seems to come true! After a fateful encounter worthy of a novel, Momoko decides she's in love with Oshima, her school's ace baseball player. But how can she get closer to him?  
  
After consulting her precious books, she eventually ends up helping to revive the unpopular traditional Japanese cheering club to cheer at the school's baseball games. However, they've only got just enough members to keep it from being abolished, and none of them seem to know exactly what they're doing. Their first performance is so dreadful that people even blame them for the baseball team's defeat! Their ragtag cheer squad will have to get its act together if Momoko is to have any chance of realizing her fiction-worthy romance!

title: Joshibu ni Koi!
description: Sakura is the leader of the Girls Club which is only for girls who have had bad experiences with men. However, as she gets to know the Archery Club's popular idol, Aoi, she battles with herself on whether to let her feelings out or to keep them from her fellow club members…

title: Saita Cosmos Cosmos Saita
description:
A defenseless snaggletooth girl × genius boy coming-of-age comedy about college entrance exams!!

“Will you teach me how to study?”, Tamura, a genius student aiming for the University of Toukyou, is studying for his entrance exams in the classroom after school with Mishima, a snaggletooth girl with silky smooth hair and a lovely scent. And they're alone together… However, Mishima's study methods are so unique and unpredictable that Tamura is left flustered and nervous!

title: Happy End no Uragawa
description: Four friends: two boys and two girls. With both girls liking the same boy, how can everyone get their happy ending?

title: Suki ni Naru Made Matte
description:
Compilation of short stories.  
  
- Suki ni Naru Made Matte  
Whenever it was break time, Hikami-kun sat at my desk and talked with his friends. I was concerned about it, but since he is a popular guy I couldn’t say anything about it. On that fateful day, I dropped Hikami-kun’s cell in the fish tank, and now I have to be his slave?!  
  
- Uso to Koi no Hajimari  
Akane does a favor for her friend, Tomoko, by agreeing to show her childhood friend, Ken-kun, around Tokyo while pretending to be Tomoko! Will she be found out?   
(Also published in "Koibana" anthology, Ch.4)  
  
- 1/3 no Kareshi  
Kogure Yuuya takes an embarrassing picture of Fukada Rei, but he says he will only delete it if they meet again at the same place later. What will Rei do?  
  
- Deatta Toki ni Boku wa Mou Inai  
High school student Yuu finds herself pursued by a hot guy rather… spiritedly.

title: Dare mo Oshiete Kurenai Tomodachi wo Tsukuru 100 no Houhou
description: Tabe-chan, a girl with cute glasses who enrolled in a high school far from home, finds herself alone even during recess. She spends her breaks alone, forever making origami, going to the bathroom, and pretending to be asleep… But an encounter with Yazawa-kun, the strange boy sitting next to her, changes her life forever! A girl-meets-boy comedy about wanting to make friends!

title: Dokidoki Majo Shinpan!
description: Nishimura Akuji is an ordinary middle school student, until one day he gets a phone call from the Angel Realm. He's been chosen at random to be a Witch Trial Judge! He meets his new "master," a tiny angel named Lulu, who explains that their job now is to find the God Witch hiding somewhere in town, or risk her taking over the world. Using various methods, Akuji and Lulu have to hunt down suspected witches and subject them to decidedly embarrassing trials in order to expose their true forms. They're going to need all the help they can get before they run out of time!

title: Miss★Universe Universe
description:
Hoshi Taichi is enjoying his university life. He is popular on campus and full of confidence, but in fact, things were different in high school...

One day, at a university social gathering, Taichi meets Tanaka Hanako, the woman who revolutionized his life. What on earth happened between Taichi and Hanako in high school? And what will Taichi do when they meet again after such a long time? A sci-fi slice of life drawn by Itagaki Paru, the creator of "BEASTARS" and "SANDA"!

title: Riesgo en zona de trabajo
description:
"Esta tarea final del semestre es una tarea de equipo"  
Cho Chan-hee, quien es un estudiante que regresa y no puede llevarse bien con la gente debido a su personalidad tímida, debe tomar la inicativa de encontrar un compañero de equipo, lo cual le preocupa.  
Mientras suspira y mira a su alrededor, encuentra a Lee Juwon rodeado de mucha gente, y siente una profunda envidia. Sin embargo, una vez terminada la conferencia, Chan-hee inesperadamente se le acerca primero y le propone trabajar en un proyecto en equipo…  
¿Cómo se volvió peligrosa esta tarea en equipo, mil, diez mil?

title: By Hero
description:
From Intercross:  
  
Sendrick is a little bird that has always hated humans the most in the world. All his life, he's been running from them out of fear, but soon, he accidentally encounters a human tomboy-ish girl named Kayana. This unexpected encounter might actually change a lot in Sendrick's mind.

title: Sono Gokudou, Tennen ni Tsuki
description:
Sawa, a high school girl with a strong sense of justice. One day, she saves a man who's in trouble, and gets involved in something unexpected…!?  


---

title: Bushi-chan & Menhera-kun
description:
The rumors of the prince-like existence of the school, the center of attention. 

I thought he was a handsome guy, but he was a clingy boy with emotional instability! Every time I thought he was my fateful love ♡, he was too clingy and shaken. 

A friend,, advises me to "get along with a big girl with a strong mental state." But I thought that there was no such girl ...

title: Kisu Yori Yasashiku
description: Chihiro Ayase and Sota Fujisawa are lovers. They like each other, kiss each other, and touch each other often. When they decide they want to experience something better, they find that the reality is that sex isn’t as easy as it seems. Chihiro and Sota are scared to go further, and they’ve even been interrupted during their attempts! But even though some obstacles stand in the way of their goal, they still share the same love.

title: Kakugo wo Kimete
description: Tetsu is the son of a Yakuza boss who yearns for a 'sweet love ', and meets his exact type of man, Senou. Senou, however, makes a living by scamming people and in turn, he attempts to force Tetsu into making an adult video. A strong couple appears: "A no need to hold back" kind of chivalrous love!

title: Otome Game Heroine no "Hikitateyaku no Imouto" ni Tensei Shita node Tachiba wo Ubatte Yaru Koto ni Shita
description:
Stella, the older sister, is airheaded and tactless but loved by everyone: Stella. Mimosa, the younger sister, is an oblivious loner who’s bullied: Mimosa.

Reincarnated into the world of the otome game she played in her previous life, Mimosa is the protagonist Stella’s twin and existed as her sister’s supporting role. If things followed the game’s scenario, she’d soon be ruined by her sister, who aims to become a holy knight... but she refuses to accept that! Determined to turn things around, she joins forces with Chiro, a fallen, and slightly dangerous, guardian spirit: Chiro.

She becomes an apprentice to the holy knight Lord Leonhardt, whom she meets in the forest: Leonhardt. As she keeps up her strength training, fate (the scenario) begins to change...?

**A fantasy about an unlucky girl who flips the script and rises to the top.**

title: Yata Miran to Seishun ni Joutou!!
description:
Yata Miran, a first year at Flower High School, is already barreling down the path to being a total loner not even two months into the school year! But she's completely unbothered by this. Instead, she revels in her solitary youth and dedicates herself to drawing Boy's Love (BL) art of the two popular guys in class—Nerima and Kirishima. Then, one fateful day, her BL notebook winds up in the hands of one of the very subjects himself, Nerima! Now outed, this loner girl's high school life is turned completely upside down…!! And so begins this aloof (?) BL fangirl's wild, high-energy coming-of-age tale! (K MANGA)
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/yatamiran)

title: A Toast to Ratafia
description: 季節感ガン無視のハートフルなラブコメになります。

title: Koi bakkari no Sekai de Watashi wa Kimi to
description: Chieri has just entered Middle School and joined a classroom full of people who only talk about romance. With a class like that, Chieri couldn't fit in. Fortunately, she met Sakura and Ichika who were also having a hard time socializing. Together, they can stay being themselves. But time stops for no one. Slowly, they're starting to change too…

title: Mada Hayai!!
description:
Hulin, the only daughter of the country's most powerful merchant family, is brought up to be a flower, a butterfly and a sweetheart, and grows to be a huge woman.
One day, however, a birthmark appears on her three-tiered belly, indicating that she is the destined mate of the second prince...
I know I have to come forward, but it's impossible with such a fat body. I was going to hide for a while,
She hears that the second prince, who is in a desperate search for a mate, is coming to visit her family, and she decides to study abroad in a neighbouring country at a moment's notice!
A slapstick love story with adventure and friendship, set in a school ☆.

title: Human System
description:
"Exactly, what am I?" A human-made robot that is used for battles meets a blind girl, Lilina, while running away. He is slowly captivated by Lilina as she doesn't see him as a robot, but suddenly someone who targets the both of them appears? Moreover, Lilina also has a secret of her own?

Included one-shots:  
Gekkou Romance (Moonlight Romance; 月光ロマンス)  
Akai Ito (The Red Thread; 赤い糸)

title: Uso kara Deta Makoto
description: When Kensuke Niikura was in the third grade of elementary school, he lied when he introduced himself in a class at his new school, saying that he had a girlfriend named Makoto. For the next four years, until he entered junior high school, Kensuke continued to make up the story of his "imaginary girlfriend." He became a junior in high school. One morning, "Makoto" appears in front of Kensuke in his second year of high school...?!

title: Joousama no Shirousagi
description: Nishina Yukito, who is the only boy in a family of girls, moved out of his house in hopes of a peaceful life. One day, he sees something strange on the roof of the school. It's a spaceship and a mysterious girl with a crown emerges. She introduces herself as the imperial Princess Lacey of Planet Kura-ura, who claims that she is searching for the "White Rabbit", who is supposed to help her fulfill the wishes of ten humans… and Yukito is the rabbit?!

title: Kono Kyoushitsu ni, Suki na Hito ga Imasu.
description:
A trial relationship with a yankee, an unexpected reunion with a junior who broke your heart, a cultural festival with the boy of your dreams... A love that will last a lifetime is born in the classroom!　

A handsome and pure sweet story that will definitely make you want to fall in love!

title: My Lover
description:
One day, Emi receives a telephone call of a confession to her popular and beautiful older sister. Without thinking, she hangs up. But on the day that she enters high school, by some unknown coincidence she meets this caller who had confessed over the phone…  
  
And thus, an overflowing love begins…

title: Yabai Kimochi
description: Tooru is a shy and quiet student who has developed a special crush on his close friend Ryouji, the most popular member of the high school swim team. In front of Ryouji, Tooru hides his feelings and acts as if he is just one of Ryouji's good friends, but in a moment out of the blue his world will be turned upside down as Ryouji will confess a secret desire for Tooru. Dazzled, Tooru can barely hide his excitement for Ryouji and quickly accepts his offer. As time passes, Tooru's happiness begins to fade knowing that his affair with Ryouji was just a fling based out of Ryouji's sexual curiosity.

title: Mayonaka no Stellarium
description: Kobayashi Aya has always dreamed about the amazing and bright youth she would have, entered in high school, but the truth is life is not a movie.. or not?

title: Kimi to Kami Hikouki to. Meguri
description: A re-tale of Matcha Hazuki's original manga "Kimi to Kami Hikouki to.".

title: Shiro Bara Gakuen Vampire Rose
description: "Supernatural things don't exist in this world!" Kaho Mira absolutely hates all things supernatural, so why does Hikaru-sempai keep persuing her to join the Supernatural Research Club?! But one day, Mira barely escaped the clutches of the White Rose Academy vampire, Rose. Now, she had no choice but to join the Supernatural Research Club with Hikaru-sempai for help! And they unravel much more about Rose they never knew before…

title: Aozora no Sunda Iro wa
description: Aiming to become a sensei like his former sensei, Sugiura Sakae came to an elementary school as a contract teacher. Coincidently, his former sensei, Fukada Ryuuji, is currently teaching here. Ryuu-sensei is Sakae's idol, as well as his pillar of support. However, the "Ryuu-sensei" he'd once so admired is totally different now. Feeling bothered, Sakae slowly realizes that his feelings for sensei have transformed into love. But what about Ryuu-sensei?

title: Defense Bakari no Koi ja dame!!
description: Nao is seen by her classmates as the "Cool Queen." However, she is just extremely shy. How will she deal with suddenly becoming the basketball team's temporary manager?!

title: Legend of Hikari
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Joining the Rhythmic Gymnastics Club, a fateful encounter ensues! Hikari Kamijo transfers to Aika Junior High School, where she fatefully meets the next Rhythmic Gymnastics Queen, Hazuki Shiina, and the Gymnastics Club's Hope, Takaaki Oishi!

In the midst of a crowd of top athletes, Hikari faces an athlete selection test to compete in a national junior high school competition....　

This is the first volume of the rhythmic gymnastics manga that was a big hit in Weekly Margaret in the 80's, depicting the agony and love of an athlete with a flexible brush stroke!

title: Chew and Swallow
description: Minjae Kim was the kind of guy who caught your eye. That’s where all the trouble began for Taehwa Lee. The two met in high school, hit it off and then some. All the rumors said that they were together. Intimate. Abuse, betrayal, lies and love, if that was the only truth, they wouldn’t be in this mess.

title: Arisu-kun no Koto wa Naisho
description: It's a secret between you and me. Don't tell anyone. It all started with what he and I saw through the gap.  Your heart won't stop racing.

title: Stand By Me, Love Letter
description: I entered high school and got a love confession from a guy I don't know but I can't stop thinking about him?

title: LORE | REKINDLED
description:
LORE | REKINDLED is a transformative project dedicated to the S1/Pilot era of Rachel Smythe’s Lore Olympus. Rekindled will attempt to re-interpret and reconstruct the foundations laid by Rachel Smythe in S1 of Lore Olympus’ publication, while also remaining true to the themes and messages of the original myths upon which Lore Olympus is based. We hope you enjoy this re-interpretation of The Hymn to Demeter - also known as The Abduction of Persephone - expressed through the lens of a meta re-interpretation of Lore Olympus. Made by the fans, for the fans. 

Disclaimer: This is a non-profit, transformative fan project drawn and written by @genericpuff. All brushes, textures, and font packs used to replicate Lore Olympus’ art and style are sourced legally, and panel art is created from the ground up. All Lore Olympus-relevant character designs and branding belong to Rachel Smythe. All interpretations of Greek characters, mythologies, and themes are purely fictional and should not be used i

title: Amagami - close to you
description: Discontinued after the first chapter.

title: Maria x Maria
description: Legend has it that males in the Seryo household are bound to be luckless when it comes to women. Masaki Seryo, a 15-year-old high school student, is a testament to this. As he hopes to leave his nagging female-dominated family behind and moves to the dorms, he falls into an even more baffling situation involving the same thing he's attempted to escape—women.

title: Kasugai-kun wa, Mousou JK to XX shitai
description: High school girl Mikami Kiri is considered by those around her to be a neat and tidy highbrow. But the truth is that she is just a normal (?) JK who loves naive boys and fantasises about them every day. One day, she meets a boy who is not so nice to her. One day, Kiri is confessed to by Kasugai, a playboy who is the complete opposite of a naive boy. Kiri is interested in Kasugai's story of his first experience, and in return for listening to his story, he kisses her. From that day onwards, their impure relationship begins as they recreate Kiri's fantasies - or does it?

title: Katakoi no Tsuki
description: Kurumi likes Souta-kun, but what happens when Kurumi witnesses Souta-Kun hugging one of her friends? Could Souta-kun already have someone he likes or is Kurumi misunderstanding? What can she do if that girl is her friend, too?!

title: Toshishita Danshi♥Share House
description:
Collection of one shots:  
1. Toshishita Danshi♥Share House  
Force to live together with a junior under on roof! but….this junior guy, contrary his cute looking face, he's a wolf approaching all the heroin!!! got attacked by mean butler, got a kiss stolen by tsundere boy!  
  
2. Oazuke Shitsuji♥  
  
3. SP ni Kataomoi♥  
  
4. Yuuwaku HONEY  
To get someone as cool as you to look my way, I'll do my best with my first attempt at seduction!!   
  
5. Sekirara Voice

title: Gēnbān Jiànxíshēng
description: Qin Qianliang was unjustly labeled as the school bully due to persistent rumors. One day, while working part-time, he found himself saving a boy named Cui Yucan. Shortly after, a new transfer student arrived at school, and to Qianliang's surprise, it was Cui Yucan. From the moment they reunited, Cui Yucan latched onto him, insisting they become best friends. Qianliang, who always kept his distance from others, thought a simple rejection would make him back off. But Cui Yucan didn't give up. Instead, he boldly declared that he would become Qianliang's "sidekick"...?

title: Ghost Logic
description: Yumeko is a girl obsessed with the occult, but her best friend Satoru is a skeptic. But then, Satoru dies and comes back as a ghost that only Yumeko can see.

title: Nee, Sensei?
description: This story is about a relationship between a teacher and his student, Homura. It just so happens that Homura's older sister Kaori was the teacher's first girlfriend. Back then, the teacher would always use Homura as excuse to run away whenever something happened and he would never get in the "mood" whenever he was with Kaori. One day, he saw Homura's exam paper and noticed that Homura wrote "I like you, sensei" in the upper right corner. Will he accept Homura's confession?

title: Dress-up Yuka-chan
description: Meet Yuka, a 6th grade fashionista who, thanks to her ability to put together just about any outfit on the fly, can disguise herself as nearly any age she wants. She’s just a little bit crazy, and has been known to pass herself off as the older sister of her actual older sister. This manga is the tale of her life…

title: Chicken or Beef?
description:
A beautiful girl suddenly appears before Kotarou, your typical tough guy who's bent on his manly ways. Kotarou falls head over heels for her at first sight, but little does he know, the beautiful girl is none other than his childhood friend and role model, Tsukasa, whom he thought was a boy!? 

Despite Tsukasa looking like a gorgeous girl, she still acts like an elementary school boy. Kotarou swears to maintain their friendship just as they did before... but what will happen when faced with the dilemma of love and friendship?

title: Maruoka-san Chi no Kyouikugakari
description: Hatsune is a useless, devious girl. One day, Hatsune's father decides to make her live with a fastidious boy! Kaede-kun, being fed up with how unladylike Hatsune is, decides to become her tutor.

title: 5Toubun no Hanayome: Character Books
description: After the second season of the TV anime was decided, the five heroines of "5Toubun no Hanayome" as known as Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba and Itsuki were having their character books and issued one by one from November 2019 to March 2020 in monthly! They includes the colored illustrations, promotional illustrations in book stores, and unrevealed default settings! "The name of best episodes" with the unique charisma of each heroines are coming with "the interviews with Mr. Haruba."
