The books are also included the analysis of each heroine who makes you "love them once you see them!"

title: Roar!!
description:
Enami confessed to his crush, Ritsu, but was turned down.
Just as he thinks this love is over, he stumbles upon Ritsu's secret...?!
A rom-com that perfectly captures the bittersweet struggles of youth!

Source: MangaPlus

title: Non-chan to Watashi
description: Risa and Takumi are childhood friends, but due to a fight in the past, they stopped talking to each other. Now university students, Takumi is a famous playboy who goes out with a different girl every day, and Risa still regrets not having been able to apologize for what she did six years ago…

title: Soft Shell
description:
A poignant and intelligent collection of short stories linked to the progression of the seasons.:  
  
- **Soft Shell** (やわらかい殻, Yawarakai Kara): A hikikomori suddenly meets the woman who lived in her apartment until a year ago.
- **Falling In Love With The Sky** (空に恋する, Sora ni Koisuru): The tale of a young woman who has found her soulmate. 
- **One Piece (The Dress)** (ワンピース): A university student is overjoyed when her first boyfriend buys her a one-piece dress.
- **The Name Of Water** (水の名前, Mizu no Namae): A handmodel is troubled by her anonymity.
- **Tough** (タフ): A graphic designer is stressed by her boyfriend's absence and lets her frustration out at work. 
- **Wind Grass Child** (風草子, Kazezoushi): Like its Biblical equivalent, Salome, this one-shot tells a tale of desire and obsession.

title: Seifuku no Binetsu
description: Yamashita who's in Chi's class is popuar and loved by the girls, but, he's always involved with her. He often aggressively tries to kiss her, or even more than that... Even though she loves her senior, she can't turn down Yamashita...... it's full of the feelings of love of an actual high school girl.

title: Koi ni Ochiru 5byoumae
description:
"How would it feel to be touched that hand?" Matsushima, the eldest son of a large family, has a crush on his perfect classmate Tsujimoto. 

A prequel to Shokuinshitsu no Himegoto

title: Onsen Takkyuu Companion!
description: 非常勤講師で潜り込んだ就職先は、寂れた温泉街にある廃校予定の「ゆのさき温泉高校」。そこで出会った女子高生・由乃花は天真爛漫な卓球少女だった!?

title: Variee Garden
description: The messenger Ed, who was living in the boarding house of the private Edwards Academy, a school for magic users and humans, met Delta, a lost messenger with amnesia. Delta was living a peaceful life with his new master, the witch prince Garret, who was helping Ed's brother Sid in his herbal store. After an incident at the academy, Delta and Ed moved into Sid's house, but one day, Delta disappeared. Furthermore, none of the others remember Delta. When Ed, alone, searches for Delta, his brother Lido, the last pure witch, appears and leads him to Delta. Delta has become trapped inside the Great Witch's illusion. Although he is unable to bring Delta back, he discovers that Delta is a mere survivor from 500 years ago, and the memories of Elle, a messenger he met 500 years ago, also return and she begins to tell him that Delta was once Elle's "mother of hearts." ......!?

title: Kiwametsuke Gakuya Ura Ouji
description:
Akari is an average high school girl who fails to see why the other girls in her school are so interested in Ryusei, a young talented kabuki actor also attending their school. Akari happens to run into Ryusei at school and accidentally ends up bruising Ryusei in the stomach with her bookbag. By chance, Akari ends up following a cat all the way to a kabuki theatre and runs into Ryusei once again.  
To make up for her mistake, she volunteers to become Ryusei's assistant until he is healed. The reclusive and socially inept Ryusei accepts only because she gets along with his pet cat, the very one she followed all the way to the theatre. Ryusei's strict father and Naoki, another kabuki actor who loves Akari.

title: Momokuri (Web Comic)
description: Yuki Kurihara is a girl who has finally been granted her wish of dating her crush Shinya Momotsuki (Momo). At first glance, she just looks like a normal but very cute girl. However, she is in fact a maniac over Momo, taking notes of his activities and never missing the chance to see him in a cute moment. Momo, on the other hand, is inexperienced in love, and just wants to make Yuki happy.

title: Ichigo Jikan
description: Ichiko is all set to move into her new dorm… except there isn't any space left! She ends up with a key to a small apartment nearby. But she's not the only one assigned to it…! It happens to belong to a cool older guy, Ran, and he isn't too happy with the new living arrangements!

title: Chun Hyang Bi Hwa
description:
Chun Hyang is a ring with Yun Sun Chun’s godly power sealed inside. It is passed down among the females of a certain family.  
  
A normal highschool newbie, Se Lop Lee, is kidnapped by a trainer on her 17th birthday… she’s the reincarnation of Yun Shun Chun, but as soon as she found out who she was, the enemies of Yun Sun Chun's long-gone empire start to show up trying to kill her. In the middle of all that, she’s stuck with her past love!

title: Penguin Prince
description:
1) Penguin Prince  
Ranka has an intimidating personality which scares her classmates, thus earning her the nickname of ‘witch.’ Her classmate Murakami, in the meantime is labeled as a ‘prince’ by the girls. So Ranka was surprised to discover Murakami’s embarrassing secret: he keeps a small penguin toy that he brings around everywhere and he panics if anything ever happens to it! Through their shared secret of this, they both begin to see what lies behind the ‘witch’ and the ‘prince.’  
  
2) One Thousand Years Love Song  
It's about this boy who is always enthusiastic when it comes to class activities and attention, and a girl who scored the highest in Japanese history in the same class. She and the boy are appointed as the class representatives. And of course, she has a secret crush on him. Having to spend time with him everyday, she finds herself unable to suppress her feelings for him anymore…  
  
3) Sitting Straight Tea Time  
t's about a girl who is being forced to learn how to

title: Sarashi Asobi
description: President of the student council, Ohba Ren (dubbed ‘the empress’) is a kind hearted and caring girl, but due to her harsh way of speaking she is feared by all in the school. A grim reaper aware of Ren’s impending death takes an interest in Ren and starts an “Exposing Game” to reveal Ren’s true personality!

title: Koakuma Lion
description:
Uno and Reo are neighboring childhood friends. One day, a friend tells Reo that he should become a model. Now, they are high school students, and Reo has become an extremely popular model… yet he acts like a spoiled child around Uno!  
  
Includes 2 other oneshots:  
  
- **Renai@Home**  
Ren and Ai are childhood friends as well as neighbors. Will their relationship change when a young girl claiming that she's from the future show up begins calling them Papa and Mama?  
  
- **LIFE+B**  
Sonoda Mio has always been such a tomboy at school but when at home, she works in her family's flower shop. Her family's VERY GIRLY flower shop. Mio doesn't want anyone at school to see her all girly, so when someone walks in, wearing the school uniform, she goes and hunts him down the next day. But when she tells him not to tell anyone, he….!!?!

title: Macross F - Dakishimete, Ginga no Hate made
description: The Super-Dimension Cinderella VS. the Galactic Fairy? Can their destined Prince Alto accept their feelings? A moe version of Macross Frontier, ready for take-off!

title: Loving You Loving Me
description: The love story between a female teacher and a 3rd year music major living together under the same roof.

title: Spring's calming blue
description:
"They're blue, and sparkling."
—Those eyes, which I had always thought were ugly...
He looked straight into them and said those words.

Sowa has no friends.
Because of his sharp, intimidating glare, he constantly gets targeted by delinquents, spending his days caught up in endless fights. But one day, he is approached by Kyoshiro, a senior at his school.

Kyoshiro is bright, reliable, and popular—the exact opposite of Sowa in every single way. At first, Sowa gives him the cold shoulder, but...

An overly caring, handsome upperclassman × A cool, clumsy, lone-wolf underclassman.
A pure, heart-fluttering youth BL romance that will gently melt your heart!

title: Jazz for Two
description: Tae Yi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can’t help but hope, maybe, just maybe…it’s his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Se Heon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Tae Yi can’t control his anger. How dare Se Heon play his brother’s song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? “If I ever catch you playing the piano again…that’ll be the end of you.” And with that begins their story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - There Is No Way Tendou Maya Would Go to a Love Hotel! 2 (Doujinshi)
description:
(Sequel to "There Is No Way Tendou Maya Would Go to a Love Hotel!")

Maya and Claudine wake up in bed together after spending an intimate time in the Love Hotel room they booked for the night. This is the story of what happened between them afterwards.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Tanaka-kun wa Mite Iru.
description: PART 4 of Series Kami-sama App de Onna no Ko no Kokoro o Nozoitara do XX datta

title: Shisen no Saki ni
description: Yuzuha was just dumped by a guy who rides the same train as her. But who else takes that train? Yousuke, a 12 year old who has developed a crush on Yuzuha. This is a story of the honest love that Yousuke feels.

title: Human Cat Family
description: The basic story: a high school student (Nanase Hokuto) living away from his parents (who are in Australia) shares an apartment house with three older girls. His exposure to their whimsical and teasing nature leaves him pretty much despising females. However, the high-school idol (Taniyama Maina) ends up having a crush on him. Her best friend is Nakajima Atsumi, your typical sukeban. Hokuto's best friend, Moriyama Syuuichirou, is the young-punk biker. These two friends conspire to hook Hokuto up with Maina, much to Maina's delight and Hokuto's chagrin. Into this setting we interject the jealousy of the rest of the high school, a female rival for Hokuto's attention, a number of fights, the inevitable parents recalling Hokuto, and Maina threatening to run away from home. We could go on, but pretty much everything is in here.

title: Nar Kiss
description: Honjou Naru is an 18-year-old young man who studies at Libre University. For his entire lifetime, he never once had a girlfriend. The reason for this is due to his abnormality: extreme narcissism, which is only triggered if he sees a reflection of himself. To prevent that, he needs to wear contacts all the time. One day, his contacts fell off and they were stepped on by the most handsome guy in school, Takashina Mamoru! This chance encounter would change his life forever…

title: Kiniro no Corda - Starlight Orchestra -COMIC-
description:
This is the official comic book adaptation of the latest in the popular "Kinkiro no Korda" series!

Yui Asahina is a violinist who failed the music course at Hoshinade Gakuin and entered a regular course.
After a reunion with conductor Ichinose Ginga, she sets her sights on winning the "International Student Orchestra Competition," in which orchestras from all over the world compete...?
From Yokohama Hoshinade Gakuin to all over Japan and the world.
This is a story of high school students who regain their grand dreams.

title: Betrayalism Romance
description: Bae Shinju, Jang Maro, Yoo Hana, and Cho Jihoon were close friends since elementary school. During their 2nd year of High School, Maro chooses to confess to Shinju. Shinju's refusal to respond to Maro out of concern for their friendships came across as a rejection. But... On that very day, Jihoon and Hana began dating. "This is a betrayal!" "A betrayal!"

title: Blazing Ninjaman
description: Since the beginning of time ninjas have been regarded as people with great skill and power, the Blazing NinjaMan (Shinobi Mantaro) is one such young man. There is only one problem, the era of the ninja has come and gone. How can Shinobi consider himself a ninja in modern day Japan (1990s) and survive the daily rigors of high school life.

title: Hikitateyaku no Koi
description:
A collection of short stories:  
  
1) Hikitate Yaku no Koi [A Foil's Love]  
Chie's always played second. Friends with pretty Chika-chan she's only ever attracted the attention of boys seeking the role of Chika-chan's boyfriend. No one sees her for herself. But is that the case with Horikawa-kun?  
  
2) Isshun no Tsuki [A Glimmer of the Moon]  
Mizuho is in love with Shugo-sempai, and even manages to kiss him secretly under the cover of darkness. Only one problem. Shugo is the boyfriend of Mizuho's older sister!  
  
3) Koibito Kyoukaisen [The Dividing Line for a Lover]  
Aya is still a high school student. There is no way she is going to attend an Omiai (matchmaking) meeting with some strange guy! No matter how great this Keisuke guy seems to be…  
  
4) Doko Demo Issho [Always Together]  
Manami is always teased by her classmates for being ugly. Only Satoru-kun defends her. In fact, he declares he loves her! But this world is so cruel… they will have to find another world to live i

title: Mayonaka Lolita
description: After she took some medicine, Michiryuu suddenly became a little girl. People used to say that she was really perfect. That's why she wants to go back to normal quickly. But the condition if she wants that happen is to find "a person she'll love". But that's completely impossible for her! So what will happen to Michiryuu…?

title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time - TOKIKAKE
description:
After 17 ordinary years on Earth, Makoto Konno's journey was about to be ended by a freak accident. Then, life gave her a reset button. With her new found time-leaping powers, she immediately sets out to wipe off all the little annoyances in her daily life, from failing grades to iffy relationships she can't handle. But as her time-leaps get more frequent, she is forced to realize that every change she makes has profound repercussions that she can't foresee…and should her powers fail her, the consequences could be disastrous…  
  
This was set as a prelude to the 2006 animated film of the same title, which was in turn loosely based on the 1965 novel.

title: Rokomoko
description:
Hiroko never had the experience to have a boyfriend. She started recently to live with her childhood friend Tomoko who pretends that she had a lot of boyfriends…  
  
Then Hiroko started to have feelings for Takeru who’s in the broadcasting club like her. But when she tried to approach him at the school festival she suddenly discover the truth…

title: My Borrowed Body
description: What do you do when your body gets switched with your crush’s?! Sang-yu is a painfully shy 18-year-old who has a crush on the class president, Darim. But there’s no way she’d ever return his feelings: Darim is popular, smart, pretty…and she likes their classmate, Ho-young. The three used to be friends when they were little, but a lot’s changed since kindergarten. All this gets jumbled when Sang-yu and Darim have a life-changing encounter at the neighborhood park. All of a sudden, Sang-yu and Darim have a lot more to talk about, and Ho-young finds himself feeling stirred as he watches the two grow closer.

title: Miterannee yo
description: Natsume is the loner type. He doesn't like to get involved in people's issues, nor does he put himself in the spotlight. Kudou is the exact opposite. He uses his looks and charms; a perfect player. These two don't know each other, despite attending the same college… until Kudou steals two of Natsume's girlfriends, consecutively. Now that his pride has been hurt by the same man, what will Natsume do?

title: Shikametsura ni Kiss
description: Two childhood friends, a birthday and no plot.

title: Alto
description: Alto, a 12-year-old kid, has arrived to Porto Grande, the largest city in the country. His dream is to fly an airplane which only women can pilot. In order to fly, he disguises his gender and age and enrolls himself in an all girls school. What kind of a school life awaits him behind those closed doors?

title: Naannimo Dekinai Gal ga Yuiitsu Dekiru Koto
description:
A live-in romantic comedy with the most enviable stepsister in the world—she’s both a “divine artist” and a “gyaru”! This is the story of Shinta Arashiyama, a high school student who won an unbelievably unlikely “lottery.” 
1. The gorgeous, envy-inducing gyaru transfer student, Suzuka Ichinose, became his desk mate.
2. This gyaru became his stepsister.
3. And on top of that, she was the “divine artist” he had been a huge fan of.

But Suzuka Ichinose was a gyaru who couldn’t do anything at all except draw!? His ordinary life is turned upside down, and Shinta Arashiyama becomes the caretaker of the school’s No. 1 gyaru! The world’s most enviable live-in romantic comedy begins!

title: Sai x Ai
description: She loved a teacher. But that kind of love is forbidden! Still she kept love him, and didn't care about it. One day, she met a boy in white clothes in the greenhouse of the school. She saw his kind eyes and she smelled the odor of wood coming from him. For the first time, Tsugumi felt her heart beating for someone. But after that encounter she understood that this guy was her teacher…!

title: Cinderella Lesson
description: Haihara Yuuki is a serious and flawless girl when it comes to school-related works. Kosaka Seiji is a popular boy with a sharp tongue. Coincidentally, after Kosaka saw her natural face, he offered Yuuki to be his dance partner with a mission.

title: Girls und Panzer - Gesture I Love You (Doujinshi)
description: Ando y Oshida tiene problemas en cómo responder a cartas de amor que recibieron, esto las llevará a resolverlo de una forma interesante.

title: Love Automation
description: Kouta and Kirishima Honoka are friends and really close. Actually Kouta is in love with Honoka but he doesn't have the courage to tell her. One day after returning from school he found a naked girl in his house lying in a doll box… She happened to be LALA, a prototype android sent by the ministry of welfare as a love assistant due to the decreasing rate of couples.

title: Amefuri Rhapsody.
description:
The town that I just arrived at. The broken treasure. I spotted you in the rainー  
  
The relationship that became peculiar because of a certain incident when they were young, Ako is holding a set of complicated feelings towards Touzou… Please enjoy the omnibus story that contains all sorts of 'tears.'

title: Suki Kirai Suki
description: Inoue Azusa's classmate, Saito, is extremely good looking, but he has the worst personality ever. For some reason, he started noticing Azusa and gets her in a lot of trouble. Although he's very annoying, Azusa gradually becomes attracted to him. However, Azusa's classmate, Kou, is not only handsome and is the president, but towards Azusa he is…?!

title: Unrequited Love
description: One of Zhenhua's trilogies, this love is unforgettable, yet no one knows it. Because of a single, lasting encounter when she was younger, Luo Zhi has had a crush on Sheng Huainan for eleven years. His appearance was so radiant, and since then, Luo Zhi's diary has become a one-sided love story that belongs to her alone. Because of Sheng Huainan, Luo Zhi followed him all the way and was admitted to his university. Because of multiple encounters, Luo Zhi and Sheng Huainan finally approached each other...

title: Marumaru na Kanojo ni Dekiaisarete Imasu. (Pre-Serialization)
description: 学校一のモテ男（？）に告白された委員長の話。

title: Poop Manager: Praise the Cat Lord
description:
"With sufficient late night strolling, she got lucky and picked up a black kitten wearing a huge diamond! Is this a cat? It takes over her bathtub, steals her food, and even needs her to warm the bed? She could endure that for the diamond, but the cat is constantly trying to escape! One day, the company has a new big boss. She was surprised to see the diamond around his neck is exactly the same as the one on the black cat that she picked up on the street…  
"

title: Kagakushitsu no Ouji
description: Inuzuka is known as the eccentric prince of the school's chemistry room. His classmates always stayed away from him because they see him as a weirdo. The class committee member, Akai, is asked by the teacher to "Please get along well" with Inuzuka. However, Inuzuka's interpretation of "Please get along well", turned out to be "Please go out with me" and hence begins the high school love comedy!

title: Show Me the Money
description:
Hilarious manhua (Taiwanese manga) about a girl to whom money means everything.  
  
Dahasu Zuhn's father has just gotten into debt and now his son, Dahasu Zuhn, is in poverty. He meets a girl called Amei Jin who's super strong and has a reason to get money. Dahasu also attends the High School, Freedom High School where he can get in for free. He meets Jin at the school and learns that she needs money for a special reason. Now he is her slave because he owes her 20,000 yen. Whatever shall Zuhn do?

title: My Beast
description: Hae Jun is obsessed with Sae Young. He wants her to be his, but he also wants her to come freely to him so he targets her sister instead. Wanting to protect her, Sae Young finally gives in to Jun's pressure and agrees to be "his woman". She expects him to treat her horribly, but from time to time she starts to see a gentle side of him. Her sister is also not the victim who she poses to be and little by little Sae Young finds herself trapped in some very twisted "love games". Is what Hae Jun claims to feel for her really love?

title: Mou Tamago wa Korosanai
description:
Collection of oneshots:  
- Kyou wa nan no Hi (Today is Such a Day)  
Today is a special day, isn't it?  
  
- Matsurika ni Kuchinashi (Cape Jasmine)  
- Watari-kun to Fureta nara (If I Touch Watari-kun)  
- Mou Tamago wa Korosanai (I Won't Kill Eggs Anymore)

title: Koi to Gunkan
description: Endou Kana is a cheerful schoolgirl who has a secret crush on… the mayor, Minato Kouichi, a perfect gentleman and well-liked leader of the post-war town. With the help of her friend Akira, she investigates him, until the trail leads her to an abandoned-looking house where a strange and scary foreigner lives. He and Kouichi seem to have some kind of relationship, but what is it? Kana’s and Akira’s take on that question are completely different and there’s still a chance both of them are wrong!

title: Shirokuro-kun to Anzu-chan.
description:
A person who appear in front of Anzu after she made a wish "I want a boyfriend" to God during new year is…!?  
  
[PL] Osoba, która pojawiła się przed Anzu, kiedy wypowiadała życzenie „Chcę chłopaka” w Nowy Rok, to…?!

title: Jutten!
description: Jutten! is about a boy who goes to his first day of high school, thinking it'll be full of awesome (pervy) meetings with sexy girls and whatnot, but instead has a lot of bad luck and gets peed on by a dog–amongst other things. A girl who uses her bike to drive over his ass sorta helps him and gives him a handkerchief with a 10 yen coin in it (hence the the serie's title) and … very plausible stuff happens afterwards.

title: Koisuru Futago to Megane no Blue
description: The best gift for all girls is the most painful and awesome!

title: Zenbu Chodai
description:
Meet Queen Sakura Himeko. She is smart, good at sports, and most importantly, beautiful. Perfect at everything she does, Himeko has lots of loyal supporters and followers. She states that her boyfriend must be as perfect as her, and kneel before her all the time. This is a qualification not many can meet. However, after switching schools, she meets Ozora Ren, a guy just as perfect as her… and somehow even better than her?! He’s now her new rival, and he’s definitely going to make life at her new school harder. What can Himeko do to stay at the top as #1?  
  
  
Note: An omake was included in Megane - Hazushitemo Ii desu ka? as the third story, Kimi wo Choudai.

title: Tokimeki Academy ❤ Class of Princes
description: If you wanted to find a good-looking guy, where would you look? The answer is easy – it’s the “Tokimeki Campus”. Here, the whole place is overflowing with princes! However, most of them already lead a wonderful love life. Starting from a narcissist, you’re going to be introduced to the colorful stories of the campus!

title: 38cm
description: If someone likes you, no matter how petite you are, they can spot you in a crowd with a glance!

title: Ano Ko ni Koisuru Yamada ni Koishita
description: Miyu, Yamada, Akane are in a love triangle…? Miyu is in love for the first time. One day, Miyu saw Yamada, her classmate, kiss Akane-senpai!! But they're not going out, Senpai is in love with someone else?! But secretly, Yamada really likes Senpai. And Miyu can't seem to look away from Yamada…

title: Kininaru Ano Ko wa Kaeru-zuki
description:
Junpei Kujirai has just entered middle school. He wants to become friends with Kaoru Gero, who loves frogs—but Junpei absolutely hates them!!
As he struggles every step of the way to close the distance between himself and Gero-san, he also encounters a cast of highly distinctive upperclassmen and classmates…!?

An all-new, never-before-experienced youth comedy finally begins

title: Demian Shoukougun
description: Azuma and Takayama used to be really close friends as children, until one day Takayama disappears to the USA without telling Azuma. Unable to forget about Azuma, Takayama returns years later and enrolls in Azuma's school. He finds his old friend cold and unwilling to restart any kind of relationship… but why? Takayama is a light hearted, happy guy who gets along with everyone around, even though Azuma's odd behavior hurts him. Azuma is cool and distant, and seems not to care about anything around him…

title: Senaka no Otoko
description: Sitting behind him in class, she only sees his back. Hana, a Gyaru, is irritated by Nioka's cold indifference toward her. But at the same time, she longs to know who he is really is, beyond the barrier of his back…

title: Sekai no Owari, kun ni Koishita
description:
Sana Natsukawa is a second year high school girl with a one-sided crush on her childhood friend, Shun. But somehow things just keep getting in the way, and she can never find a chance to talk to him. Suddenly, it seems like fate is finally on Sana's side, as she and Shun become classmates! This is her chance to finally get close to him again! Or so she thinks... when a mysterious boy named Kariya appears before her and stops her in her tracks. "Could it be, a rival in love?!" she wonders, ready to fight it out fair and square. It's then that Kariya shares an unbelievable prophecy to Sana: Shun and she's descendants will destroy the world?!

Source: carbon scans

title: Kirarin Revolution
description: Kirari Tsukishima is a beautiful young 14 year old. One day, she encounters a turtle stuck in a tree. She saves the turtle, but then falls after saving it. An idol from a famous group called SHIPS saves Kirari. Kirari falls in love with him at first sight. Kirari now wants to become an idol like him. She discovers that being an idol is not all fun and games, and that in order to persevere in both her love and career, she must overcome any challenges that fortune has in store

title: Order wa Boku de Yoroshii desu ka?
description:
1. Order wa Boku de Yoroshii desu ka?  
Akari always goes to a particular coffee shop, but not for their coffee. It's to see Naruse Hijiri-kun, a waiter who's totally Akari's type. And then suddenly one day she finds him waiting outside her school?  
  
2. Haru Koi  
Kaede has been trying to befriend her desk neighbour Muromachi Isami, but when she greeted him, he yelled at her?! In fact every time she greets him, he glares at her. Not giving up, Kaede tries to see the good (cute) side in him…  
  
3. Power of Love  
Mikoto has always felt lonely ever since her parents divorced, but she starts living in a new family with a dad and a son in her age, Shou. As much as tries to have a happy family in her new home, Shou seems to be reluctant, but our happy-go-lucky Mikoto will not give up!  
  
4. Flying Start!  
  
5. Haru ni Arashi to Yuki ga Furu!/Futta!!

title: Ijimerarekko no Akuyaku Reijou Tenseiki: Dai-2 no Jinsei mo Fukouda nante Joudan ja Nai desu!
description:
One day, while Kusakabe Kanon is being bullied as usual on the rooftop of her high school, an unexpected accident causes her to fall along with one of the girls bullying her. She passed away, but... she ended up in the world of the popular otome game "Koi no Iku Michi" from her previous life. Moreover, the person who has been reincarnated as is the villainess, Flora! It's no joke that her second life will also be unhappy! It might be a game world, but even the villainess has a family she wants to protect. She will use her power to change the future and become happy!
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8156im/)

title: They are here! Powerpuff Girls Z!
description:
Blossom (Momoko), Bubbles (Miyako) and Buttercup (Kaoru) are three normal girls, living in a peaceful town. Suddenly, a big ice mountain arrives in Tokyo, and when Ken accidentally breaks it, both good and evil powers comes out of it. When the three girls got hit by this strange power, they turned into transforming super heroes, who promised the mayor to protect Tokyo. However, the black power hits several animals, and they all turn evil, especially the extra smart one, Mojo.  
  
It's up to the girls now to save the day! Even if it means that the Powerpuff Boys Z will lift up their shirt or if they'll arrive in mortal danger! Get ready for a big adventure!

title: Penguin Highway
description: One day, penguins are spotted in the suburban town that fourth-grader Aoyama calls home. The penguins make their sudden appearance in a residential district nowhere near the ocean and disappear just as mysteriously. Where could they have come from, and where did they go? Aoyama is determined to get to the bottom of it! This is the slightly curious, unforgettable tale of that summer.

title: Renai Kyoutei Nukegake Nashi!
description: A childish student, Shirou carries a torch for his teacher, Oka. Masami, a good friend of Shirou's, who has cherished him like a brother, is confronted by Ryuuji, another friend of theirs, concerning his true feelings for Shirou. Masami and Ryuuji conclude a gentlemen's agreement, in which neither of them can hit on Shirou. Ryuuji orders Masami to act as a substitute and take care of his sexual desires in Shirou's stead.

title: Tsuki to Taiyou no Piece
description: During her 1st year of high school at Christmas time, Mimi met two handsome boys with really bad personalities. After advancing to 2nd year, all three of them ended up in the same class where they became the class representatives.

title: Noah!
description: Noah decided to follow the one she loves to the art high school Saint Rinnell. And then she will start a love story like those her parents used to tell her…

title: Kimi Shika Iranai
description: Kimi Shika follows the story of young Totoki Atsumu in his attempt to win over and bring back the real smile of the first and only girl he's ever liked, Kurihara Akane. That would be simple, if it wasn't for Akane's unusual past…

title: Whisper of the Heart: Happy Time
description:
A sequel to the manga that was made into a movie, "Shiawase na Jikan" is comprised of two stories. 
The first is a continuation of the first book, two years into the future, and Shizuku is now preparing for her entrance exams.   
  
The second story, "Kikyou no Saku Koko" (The Blooming of the Balloon Flowers), is an unrelated original story. 
Tsuge Takayuki is a normal college boy, who, one day, sees a girl admiring the flowers in his front yard, 
and was reminded of a girl who stood by the flowers one year ago, crying in the rain. 
He falls in love with her, but will her injured heart accept his feelings?

title: A Scary-Looking Girl and Sleeping Boy-ty
description: She looks super fierce in appearance. Ji Xiongxiong, who is often mistaken for a gang leader, is actually a poor and soft girl. One day because she wanted to make extra money, she got acquainted with her schoolmate, Ling Ruobai. Ling Ruobai was cursed since childhood, he easily fell asleep anytime and his soul would randomly attached to certain objects. In order to prevent this secret from being known by others, Ji Xiongxiong was forced to become Ling Ruobai’s bodyguard, and the daily life of laughter and love began...

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! - KazuMegu Valentine's Day 2018 (Doujinshi)
Ookami Lover
description: A girl visits a dog shop owner everyday and is suddenly confessed to by the scariest guy in school! What is she supposed to do?

title: Chiwawa-chan
description:
The victim of the dismembered murder case was "Chiwawa-chan" whom everyone knew. She had many friends. But in truth, nobody knew anything about her...

In addition to the title story, six others, like "Memories of Summer" and "Chocolate Marble-chan," are included in this collection of gems of short stories.

title: Seishun Shonbori Club
description:
Momosato only dreams to live a normal high school girl life. Which means, find perfect love with another high schooler.   
But poor Momosato seems to be victim of a curse : each time she finds love, that one will find it too but with another girl. That's why her comrades consider her as their Cupidon against her own will.

title: Akai Ito Kudasai
description:
Arisa is a first-year high schooler obsessed with the idea of a "real romance". The sigh she is waiting for is the comfort and familiarity of someone's touch. When she is saved at the school festival by her Senpai, Kyoushuke, she grows interesed in him but he doesn't seem to believe in destiny at all.  
  
Pt/Br:  
Arisa é uma estudante do primeiro ano do ensino médio obcecada com o "romance real e sua pessoa predestinada". O sinal que ela procura é sentir a familiaridade e conforto com esse alguém. Quando ela é salva durante o festival por um Senpai, ela demonstra interesse nele… Embora ele não pareça concordar com o pensamento de que o destino exista.

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Position Left (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine are the top two actresses-in-training at the prestigious Seisho Music Academy, with Maya as the Top Student and Claudine as the Second-Ranked Student. They are also secretly dating. Recently, Claudine finds herself upset because Maya won't let her touch her, so Maya challenges Claudine to try and take the "Top" position from her.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Sono Kuchibiru, Itadakimasu
description:
What the poor Sana is aiming for is the boy who has a mysterious mole on his lip: Aki. You won't be troubled over eating with a mole on your lip, so if she gets Aki, she won't be troubled over money… or so she thinks, but Aki is also poor?! With their Culture Festival's Best Couple Contest prize as "A year's worth of free school lunches", what willl happen when the two join forces?!  
  
Includes 3 other oneshots:  
  
- Sukitte Iccha XX Nandesu!  
Kurashima Touko has been working up the nerve to finally call out the President of the Disciplinary Committee. However, she accidentally sends it to the wrong person, Takimoto Chikage! He is a delinquent that is totally opposite of her ideal man, however, Takimoto likes Kurashima!  
  
- Narabuna Kiken!!  
Miku and Natsume have always been fighting with each other until Natsume suddenly asks Miku to pretend to be his girlfriend!!! At first, Miku is quite opposed to the idea, but slowly…  
  
- Koi ni Nante Naranai!  
Sakashita Yue is known f

title: Donten ni Sirius
description:
Due to the nature of her father's job, Hinoka has transferred schools several times. When her friends from her first school ceased contact after her transfer, Hinoka resolved never to become close to anyone again. Now in her seventh transfer school, she joins the idle astronomy club, thinking she could continue living her life alone. But what happens when she meets a boy who shines like the brightest star, Sirius, on a cloudy day?  
  
 Included one-shots: Bousou Otome★Muu, Suppinpin!

title: Nine
description: Niimi Katsuya and his best friend Karasawa Susumu, star sportsmen in track & field and judo respectively, spot a beautiful girl, Nakao Yuri, at their new high school. When they find out that she is the daughter of the baseball team's coach, they immediately volunteer to join the failing team in order to try and get closer to her. But as they learn more about baseball, they start to understand what it means to be one of the nine players on the team, and dream of entering Koshien.

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Jewel Quartet (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya is enjoying a relaxing day at the Seisho Music Academy dorms when, suddenly, she encounters four different versions of her dance partner and close friend, Saijou Claudine: Elementary School Claudine, Middle School Claudine, High School Claudine, and Adult Claudine. She's very startled by these odd circumstances, and the Claudine of her time period, as well as the rest of the Starlight girls, try and help her figure out how she ended up with a harem of her favorite person.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Aozora Pop
description: Kazuki Orika, a 15-year-old girl, aspires to become a model like her beautiful mother, who passed away. Without the knowledge or consent of her father, Orika enters an amateur model competition, only to reunite with her childhood friend, Miyazaki Kanata, the cameraman, and make new friends with models Yano Mito, Yano Haruto, Kunimi Riko, and many others. But modeling isn't all fun and games. Will Orika be able to make it big?

title: To Where the Rail Goes
description: They say when you end up seeing the train's smoke black you get your wish fulfilled. At least this is what Asahi truly believes. Read this cute oneshot to find out what happens next and also to see "where the rail goes".

title: Dekiai Yankee Nimewo Tsukeraremashita
description: Yuzu is an unlucky girl who caught a cold on the day of her high school entrance ceremony. When she finally returns to school, her best friend Saori tells her that she has the school's biggest delinquent, Ren Shidou, in her class. Yuzu, who is ordinary and longs for a normal high school life, dismisses the story as nothing to do with her, but she runs into Ren, who is injured under a cherry tree. Yuzu is frightened, but still treats his wounds, then, Ren forcibly calls for her after school...?

title: Kimi Hayate
description:
"Before I met you, I have never experienced these feelings before—"  
A love story about youths running full speed to the ones they love!!

title: Kyuuketsuki to Bara Shoujo
description:
Chiyuki is a pure girl who doesn't know love. Yomiya, a vampire in the same class, wasn't very good at it, but he encountered anemia and fell down...! If I had no choice but to suck blood, Yomiya, who liked the taste of her blood, declared that he would fall in love with Chiyuki.

---

(Source: MangaUpdates)

title: He Loves Me
description: Always dreaming of a handsome prince on a white horse, Gong Jiwoo has been waiting for the day to confess her feelings to her prince Han Taejoon. However, the least expected person has got her fired up with jealousy. What will it take to make you mine?

title: Miunohri to Swan
description:
She is a fat ugly girl with a short body; she's a girl who used to be a loner, loser and always hated by everyone. It only takes one of a stranger's ‘abracadabras’ to turn her into a beauty and to stop the bullying.  
  
Though it comes with a price: she can’t kiss "him" or go under any rain, or she'll become ugly again.

title: Ichido wa Kanojo ni nattemitai!
description: Seri is a 20 years old female college student who has never had a boyfriend; however, one day, she meets Chihiro, a childhood friend who is 2 years younger than her and is now a high school student. Chihiro calls on Seri to help her make up for what she couldn't do due to her hospitalization. Together, they go on a trip and suddenly Chihiro confesses to Seri…

title: Chinashi to Shishou
description:
What connects two clumsy people who don't know who their friends are?

One day, Kami-Doji Takuto, who hates to be part of a group and leads an independent life, receives a call from his classmate Shirase Chinashi. When she opens her mouth, her line is not what he expected: "May I call you master?"

Ichinashi refuses, but her disciple moves don't stop! What will Takumi do in the most unbearable situation in his life?

title: Okujyou no Bye-Bye
description: Nogi is a fearless and respected karate black-belt who beats up bullies without breaking a sweat. But to Fujiwara, he's just "Kei-chan": best friend and object of his secret affections. Can their friendship survive? Or develop into something more?

title: Haraguro Ouji no Ijiwaru wa Mohaya Koi
description: Hanako, a plain girl in the corner of the classroom, discovers the other side of the "fresh prince" Aoi, whom she had only seen from afar. She also finds out that Aoi-kun asked her, "Won't you be my girlfriend?"

title: The Heiress vs Young Ruffian
description: Bad luck! My dad kicked me out of the house! And to avenge that, I face a playboy whose grandfather was a gangster! And moreover I go to a noble school to become the housekeeper of four demons...?!

title: Akaku Somaru Kiss wo Shite
description:
Contains the following oneshots：  
  
Akaku Somaru Kiss wo Shite  
  
Maintaining that Yui’s blood is “special,” bishie Seiya monopolizes his childhood friend slash prey, incurring the intrigue of other vampires in school and “I want to taste your blood, too!” trouble for Yui. Yui believes that Seiya, trailed by the inevitable fangirls, will never fall for her, but “I can’t stop my heart from racing when he kisses me.”  
  
Koukou devil shitemasu  
mou matenaitte iwaretemo!?  
kodomo atsukai shinaideyo!!  
senpai wa kyo mo furareteru  
Dakara, kawaiitte iuna!

title: Usotsuki Ouji no Karekano Gokko
description:
A poor commoner chatterbox accidentally entered the celebrity high school and the unthinkable happened…?  
  
Includes oneshots:  
  
The Female Teacher is 16.  
  
Mouai Idol!! (Blind Love Idol!!)  
"Please be an idol only for me" says Hattori to Nazuna. A cute love story of idol and her manager.

title: 6 Weapons
description:
People wearing rubber suits from Pluto are invading earth!  
  
It's k tho.  
  
The 6 Weapons will protect Earth with excessive violence!  
  
Want a better summary? Too bad.  
  
Only one season was produced.

title: Hatsukoi Hakusho
description:
From JShoujo Scans:  
  
1. Natsuiro Memorial (A Summer-Colored Memorial)  
First love is a sweet poison. A painful, but unforgettable love. Two years have passed since the graduation day and they meet again during a high school reunion. His appearance has changed, but…?  
  
2. Kimi to Watashi no Kakaomoi (Our One-Sided Love)  
  
3. Suki yori mo Kirai (Hate Over Love)  
  
4. Yuki ni Negai (w)o (Wish Upon the Snow)  
  
4.5. Akiiro Memorial (A Fall-Colored Memorial)  
Extra chapter of Natsuiro Memorial

title: Can the Confession Be Cancelled?
description:
'Half-white' was preparing to confess with an excited heart.
However, the confession was erroneously passed on to 'Seol Park-ha' like a yangachi.
White, who desperately tries not to get caught, and the mint she enjoys above her head.
Will White be able to escape from him and confess properly again?

title: Cherries Fight
description:
Manami, a highschool girl, joined the class party where there was fun, laughter, and drinking. She had the best night of her life until the next morning, when she woke up to find that she wasn't alone. She quickly looks over to see that lying next to her is her "friend" Motoyoshi Hajime. Did they actually do anything together?!! To the inexperienced Manami, her world is turned up-side down as she tries to figure out how to deal with this situation…  
  
Includes:  
  
1. Cherries Fight  
  
2. The Fastidious Princess and the "Mature" Prince  
  
3. Miss Pageant's Anego  
Kakei Masumi ran an all-girl gang in middle school. Now in high-school she tries to bury her past, pose as a bookish honor student–and keep a tight leash on her temper. All this is at risk when Ohara-kun picks her to compete in the school pageant. Why her?   
  
4. Secret Incompetent Swordman

title: Devil x Devil
description:
1-2) Devil x Devil  
Hotei is a low-level devil that lives off of human energy. But lately, he’s having trouble getting any, due to a newcomer in town named Suzaku. Suzaku has been hogging up all of the girls in town, leaving Hotei hungry and desperate. One day, a human boy gives Hotei a piece of candy. Although there is a danger he’ll have a bad reaction, Hotei eats it, and turns into a young boy! Knowing that Suzaku prefers young boys, Hotei decides to use his appearance to leech off of Suzaku and have revenge. But with a turn of events, Hotei finds himself at the receiving end of his prank!  
  
3) Spirit Mage  
  
4) Transformer - not scanlated  
  
5) Start From the Fingertips…  
  
6) Heartshock

title: Inochi
description:
“I killed my sister. Now I will live as her.”  
  
Mischevious Nobara and good-girl Kotori are identical twin sisters. After their father’s death, they lived with their grandmother and mother, respectively, but one day, while they had switched places, Kotori was murdered!  
Because she was robbed of her most precious daughter, Nobara’s mother’s hair turned pure white!  
Nobara, who is tormented with guilt, decides to live as Kotori in order to protect her mother…!?

title: Syrup at the Pen Tip
description:
Our hero is a high school boy who is also a mangaka. A handsome mangaka! A hard worker mangaka! And he attends a famous school for mangaka! He also always finishes his work before the deadline!  
  
Our heroine is a clumsy editor. She’s always doing her best but she’s still an idiot. She never finishes her work before the deadline and makes mistakes in the number of pages.  
  
So what will happen when the two of them meet…?

title: Ningyo ga Fuchi
description:
Ever since she rescued him from drowning, Kou has had feelings for his classmate Ayame, who he refers to as a mermaid. But much to his dismay, Ayame is in love with someone else: Kou's older brother, the advisor of their school's swimming club.

Kou, who is willing to die for Ayame's love, believes that she is foolish for chasing after someone who will never reciprocate her feelings. Even so, Ayame continues to desire the affection of Kou's brother, hoping that he will eventually notice her. Although she was the one who initially saved him, can Kou return the favor to Ayame one day?

title: The Keyaki Tree
description:
(from MangaUpdates):

Based on novelist Ryuichiro Utsumi's works.
Published as the Hitobito Series (人びとシリーズ):

- The Keyaki Tree (欅の木)
- The White Rocking Horse (白い木馬)
- The Reunion (再会)
- My Brother’s Life (兄の暮らし)
- The Umbrella (雨傘)
- At the Art Gallery (絵画館付近)
- Through the Forest (林を抜けて)
- His Hometown (彼の故郷)

title: Tenkousei Jinno Murasaki
description: Midori is known for his ability to fight. What can a guy do when a transfer student claims to be his childhood friend and suddenly confesses? Also on top of that says he wants to protect him!!! Strange and dark things keep happening around the guy, who is he really? A mix of violence, death, humor and curtness!!!!

title: Tomadou Mayoi wa Tonikaku Zurui!
description: 星良高校ゲーム研究部には古い習わしとして、三つの公式ルールが存在する。１：勝負は両者合意の下で成立するものとする。２：勝者の「おねがい」を一つ敗者は叶えてあげる。３：負けてから文句は言わない。先輩たちがふざけて作ったこの遊び心のせいで僕（向居タケヲ）は、後輩の十惑まよいにゲーム研究部の部長という立場を奪われてしまった。ゲームマニアとしてのプライドと、部長の立場を取り戻すため、今日も僕は十惑くんに勝負を挑む！　あ、また色仕掛けか？　それとも変則ルール？　なんだその可愛い仕草は！　君は本当にズルいぞ、十惑くん！

title: Hatsukoi to Akanezora
description: Hitomi moved to the countryside, and is bored, in comparison to her former busy life in Tokyo. However, that changes when she meets a certain boy…

title: Timing
description: Woojoo is conflicted by a one-sided crush on his childhood friend, Inyoung. He is worried about confessing his love to Inyoung and losing his friendship with him entirely. That’s how the school semester begins, and a new problem arises… a love letter?!

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - The Rumored Two (Doujinshi)
description:
Asami has always admired famous child actress Saijou Claudine ever since she saw her play the renowned role of "Arrie" many years ago onstage. Now that she attends the same school as Claudine, she has been hearing many curious rumors about the object of her admiration and the top student of the class, celebrated thoroughbred actress Tendou Maya.  
  
Tendou Maya x Claudine Saijou (MayaKuro) Doujinshi.

title: Drop
description: Falling in love, sparkling, shining, and melting together…

title: Naisho no Cinderella
description:
Sabishiro Haruka is a dull high school girl who accidentally got her secret found out by the school's popular guy, Hijikawa Kotoba!

"That's it. This is the end of my high school life..."

While she was feeling despair over this, she received some unexpected words from him instead. And somehow, that's how she also came to learn a secret of Hijikawa's that he's kept hidden for so long! Since that day, their life as shared keepers of each others' secrets begin...!?

This is an exciting and youthful love story about shared secrets that's especially dedicated to all of you who can't reveal your real selves!

title: Maria
description: Maria is a girl attending a Christian private school. Her mother is sick and in the hospital, her family poor. They live off the money of a man whose identity is unknown to Maria. He is called “Daddy Long-Legs” and he supports Maria and her mother with only one fee: Maria becoming his bride. Just who is this mysterious man? Is it the doctor? Someone she does not know? A boy from school…?

title: Early Spring Trembling
description:
A collection of Ikeda Riyoko oneshots. There is significant variation in what oneshots are included between the editions, though all hold the titular oneshot in common as the opener.

**1977 Edition:**

- **Early Spring Trembling** (ゆれる早春, Yureru Soushun):
Sakioka Junko stands out among her peers with her attractive appearance and that annoys the other girls. Kasai Makoto, tired of hearing whining from the girls, offers to quarrel with Junko's best and, for obvious reasons, only friend. The enemy is defeated and goes into sobbing, but suddenly, Kasai, who really did not want to harm the girl, wants to console her… (MangaUpdates)
- **Stardust Märchen** (星くずの童話, Hoshikuzu no Märchen)
- **A Summer in Canterbury** (カンタベリーの夏, Canterbury no Natsu)
- **First Love Story** (初恋物語, Hatsukoi Monogatari)
- **Winter Daphne** (沈丁花, Jinchouge)

**2014 Edition:**
- **Early Spring Trembling** (ゆれる早春, Yureru Soushun)
-  **White Egmont** (白いエグモント, Shiroi Egmont)
- **Freesia's Morning** (フリージアの朝, Freesia n

title: I Live in Isekai Zero: Will the Reincarnated Save the World?
description: Events prior to the main series from 10,000 years ago , how the first generation of outlanders come , who summoned them and for what purpose and the link with the current time and events!!

title: Bijin Kakumei
description:
1-3) Bijin Kakumei  
During sixth grade Yuki made a love confession to Shin, an extremely beautiful boy. She was extremely shocked when he started teasing her and called her fat and ugly!!  
Three years later, Yuki has become beautiful by putting in great effort everyday because she wanted to get back at Shin. She transformed into a very beautiful girl!  
She was accepted into the same high school as him to plot her revenge, but her childhood friend Migiwa who knows everything about Yuki's past is attending the same high school!?  
  
4) Gothic Boyfriend  
  
5) Hooligan Girl's First Love  
  
Extra) Omake 4-Koma.

title: Youkya no Furi shite yatte mita
description: ``Ah, I guess I'm going to start living with people from another world again.'' Both my self-proclaimed and other-named yinkya. It's hard to control a high school girl's youth, where there are so many positive situations. While she was looking for a way to survive, a handsome man appears to help her and acts as her boyfriend!? Use whatever you can, even if you're a fun girl! Non-stop honest girl Mikoto's youth survival story -!!

title: Countdown 3600 Seconds
description:
Mo Fei, a seemingly regular high school girl, possesses a special ability to see a 61-minute countdown to a person's death! To her surprise, this ominous countdown appears on her best friend, Ran Guo'er.

While investigating her best friend's supposed "suicide”, she crosses paths with Jiang Yu, a person dedicated to justice, multiple times. The two help each other, and follow the “suicide” case, unaware of the many cases to come…

title: Twinkling Stars
description: A girl sees stars in the people and things around her. Some are bigger and shine, others dull and dim like her own. She meets two boys from school one day who show her that all stars can shine brightly, if you see them the right way.

title: Kaiki Ningyou-kan
description:
Kaiki Ningyou-kan's first appearance was in Shoujo Friend Zoukan: Suspense & Horror 01/1992

This volume collect 6 horror stories by Kanako inuki, the first 4 all being about dolls.

- **Playing with Dolls** - O Ningyou Asobi (お人形遊び)
- **Mannequin** - (マネキン)
- **Blue Eyed Marie** - Aoi me no Mari (青い目のマリー)
- **Ventriloquist's Love** - Fukuwajutsushi to Koi (腹話術師と恋)
- **Ritual** - Gikishi (儀式)
Shoujo Friend Zoukan: Suspense & Horror 01/1991
- **I Can Fulfill Your Love Wishes** - Koi no Negai Kanaemasu (恋の願いかなえます)
Shoujo Friend 06/1990

title: Houkago Toshoshitsu
description: Spring of the second year of high school. Kaho has been chosen as a member of the library committee with her "first boyfriend" from junior high school, Hayase, whom she had never spoken to before. An awkward atmosphere fills the air as the two are alone after school. Kaho and Hayase are in an awkward atmosphere when they spend time alone together after school. 'Were we ever together?' ... A sudden question from Hayase-kun with a mysterious smile. The distance between them is too close for them to stop their hearts from racing... and their first love starts up again, full of heart pounding!

title: Brothers Conflict feat. Tsubaki & Azusa
description:
Manga featuring the events around Ema, Tsubaki, and Azusa in the story *Brothers Conflict* from the two brothers' point of view.  
  
Based on events in the light novel series *Brothers Conflict* and its otome game (visual novel) and anime adaptations.

title: Princess School
description: Takaki loves ranking the popular and beautiful girls at his school. The one standing at the top is the foreign transfer student Emilia Shutrause, and being a student from Europe, she is extremely popular among the male students at Takaki’s high school. Although he was just a spectator of this school idol, that would change when one day he accidentally bumps into Emily (Emilia’s nickname) and he finds out her secret…

title: Usotsuki Kusuriyubi
description: Emi "Niko" Nikogawa has just entered Lotus High, a school where new students receive a ring upon entrance. There is, of course, a legend surrounding this ring– if you trade rings with the person you like, your love with continue eternally. But what happens when Niko trades rings through odd circumstance, and with a boy who says he'll never love anyone…?!

title: 5Toubun no Hanayome - The Last Festival, Fuutarou's Side -Itsuki √if- (Doujinshi)
Rabu Kare - Gokujou Men Dokuhon!
description:
A compilation of 6 sweet stories about finding love and learning how to keep it.  
  
Story 1: Karada no Iinari – by Watari Sakou: Uika Tonoda and Kuniyoshi Hazama are very experienced when it comes to sex….in theory at least. They know every theoretical term about sex, pheromones and all sorts of things related, yet either of them has never experienced it for itself. What will happen when these 2 will meet? Will they be able to leave the talk aside and finally take action?  
  
Story 2: Oni Kare – by Tsukishima Haru: Wakaba Endou only wishes to finish her driving lessons soon so she can get a driver’s license. Although she thought it will be easy at first, nothing is easy when the one who’s teaching you is instructor Kenzaki. He complains about every small mistake that she does and won’t give her any points in her lessons unless she does them perfect. Wakaba always complains about the fact that he’s so strict, but at least he’s good looking…  
  
Story 3: Himitsu no Kinchan! – by Iwas

title: Evergreen Days
description: Chemistry teacher Kousaka appears before Takuma, who is living the peaceful life of a high school student. This teacher who doesn't act like a teacher captures Takuma's interest, but unexpectedly Kousaka's words touch his heart, and interest transforms rapidly into love. These two, who met over a shared cigarette, go beyond their respective roles and begin a new relationship!

title: Tobenai Majo
description: A one-shot about a witch who can't fly!

title: Blue-Haired Guy
description: Jo Juyeon, a blue-haired guy who dreams of a normal school life. However, unusual events start happening around him.

title: ToHeart2 ~colorful note~
description:
This manga is based on a visual novel with the same title produced by Aqua PLUS. The story revolves around a high school student named Kono Takaaki. He spends his Spring high school days with girls; which include childhood friends Yusuhara Konomi and Kosaka Tamaki, and he encounters various girls of unique personalities.  
  
The name implies it is a sequel to “To Heart”, but there is no relation between them except that the story of “To Heart 2” takes place two years later at the same school of "To Heart".

title: Rudolf's First Love
description: My childhood friend is a super popular hottie... But could anyone ever notice someone like me...!?

title: Doggerel
description: Higa and Nonami are classmates. Nonami is quiet and seems to get separated from friends in class. Unlike Nonami, Higa is friendly and nippy. One time, Nonami – being the most intelligent student in class – reluctantly helps Higa with his studies. After that, he starts to develop feelings for Higa…

title: Senpai, Socchi ni Itte mo Ii desu ka?
description:
One day, Maya discovers that her senior at her part-time job lives next door to her apartment. Worried about her senior living in an empty room...?

(natalie.mu, translated)

title: Love Exchange
description: I used to hate studying English. Reading all of those textbooks and avoiding the gossip of my classmates about my exam results… So annoying. But now I have to speak English every day and I even downloaded a translation app on my phone. Why exactly? …It’s all because of her.

title: Futari no Tokubetsu Jugyou
description: Udagawa is scared of being hated by people, and acts a lot brighter than he is. One day, he is paired with the unsociable Watabe for an assignment, and is told “I hate people like you” when he tries to talk to him. After receiving such a shock, he gradually starts speaking more frankly to Watabe and finds himself feeling comfortable around him. Wanting to be liked by him, Udagawa tells him his true feelings. Before he knew it, Watabe had turned into a precious “true friend” to him…

title: Kami-sama Onegai!
description: Life was a mundane chore for student council member Hasumi Ryou until he picked up a charm on the floor. Suddenly, a junior high-school student with bad grades appears in his room calling him Kami-sama (God-sama) and asks for help to pass her high school entrance exam. Not to mention that it doesn't make sense that his room changes into hers everyday after school. Ryou abandons all logic and decides to go with the flow, his heart touched by the earnest desire of the girl who wants to graduate to high school.

title: Pump Up!
description:
Kayama Miharu enters her new middle school and immediately becomes friends with Mori Mizutama, a very cute guy she first takes to be a girl but is really a boy. However, though Miharu likes Mizutama, she cannot tell him, especially ever since the older Kawagoe (yes, a boy) seems to have taken Mizutama's interest instead. Miharu tries to be cute for Mizutama, but finds it practically impossible, as he is both more talented at home economics and more cute than herself. Then, Mizutama joins the Kawagoe's soccer club instead of the comedy-lovers' club the two of them had decided on earlier…  
  
Also contains the story Fuyu Hanabi (Winter Fireworks).

title: Two Pawns
description: Kaede Yukimura is a gorgeous girl who has been challenging every person in her class to a shogi bout. If you win against her, she will confess to you in front of the whole school. As more and more classmates lose against her, the reason behind her bet begins to slowly unravel…

title: Saint Dragon Girl Miracle
description: Anjuu Sendou is a nice girl who just started her first year in the Seiryuu Academy Middle School. She is currently living away from home as a boarding student with her pet named Lime. Her father is a sorcerer and her mother is an expert in chinese kenpo. They are both famous, especially her mother who is called Dragon Momoka. Because of her mother’s fame the executive committee wants Anjuu to join the student council. But the council’s president thinks that she is a weak girl, so to prove him wrong she decides to catch the school thief. But when things get harder, she wishes to become stronger. So her pet suddenly transforms into a small child with wings (it can’t transform into a dragon yet, because it’s only a child) and tells her about her power. During a second assault from the thief, Anjuu, with the help of Lime, transforms into a new Saint Dragon Girl, defeating the enemies and becoming the school’s protector. Will the student council’s members find out the true identity of the “

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - My Single Wing (Doujinshi)
description:
Claudine misses two days of school and Maya is forced to acknowledge Claudine's role in her life [Doujinshi Oneshot].  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight.

title: Lovely Everywhere
description: Tong Danwei is a high school freshman with romantic dreams about the boy she is fated to meet. While on the way home from picking up groceries, she runs into a pretty boy, and that’s where our story begins. Will she find love in high school? And more importantly, will any boy be able to overlook the fact that although she is in high school, she still looks like an elementary student?? Follow along on Tong Danwei’s adventure of love and high school angst, with plenty of comedy thrown in to the mix.

title: Uma Musume Pretty Derby - KitaSwee manga when they fought (Doujinshi)
Otouto wo Kareshi ni Suru Houhou
description: Her crush is her new brother? Despite with their new status, she's determined to make him hers. She'll do anything (comically)…

title: Kimi no Tonari de Seishunchuu
description: Miu is living with her dad since her mom left them some years ago. While taking care of the house, Miu has missed the breaking news about the new transfer student. When she meets Keita at school, he seems to know her quite well, but she doesn't recognize him at all. Who is Keita and why is he approaching Miu so openly?

title: Osanajimi Ja Dame Desu Ka?
description: An omnibus collection of childhood friends oneshots by Chiba Kozue, Watanabe Shiho, Shiraishi  Yuki, and other shoujo authors.

title: Full House Kiss
description:
Suzuhara Mugi is a fifteen-year-old on a mission. She is determined to somehow get onto the campus of Shoukei High School, one of those super super elite high schools. This school is huge and private and has tight security. Mugi is searching for her missing sister–her only remaining family–and she has been led to believe that someone or something on the campus of that school will help her in her search. Unfortunately, that strict school security is preventing her from getting onto the school grounds. However, her luck changes when she literally runs into Midou-kun, the son of an insanely rich mega-corporation president, and elite person at the school.  
Midou is not impressed with Mugi’s sob story about needing to get into the school. He is a very smug and arrogant rich guy. But he can be reasonable, and he eventually strikes up a deal with Mugi–he will get her onto the school grounds in exchange for some labor on her part. She must come to his house and work as a maid! Yeah, this is o

title: Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete
description:
"I'll see you again tomorrow..."

Uchihama Academy is at its most exciting during its last cultural festival in the old school building, which has been decided to close. Kanade Akiyama, a member of the astronomical society, works hard to maintain public order within the school, and one day he meets Yui Furukawa, a beautiful girl with amnesia.

title: Love is too Early for us
description: "Kisa fall in love for the first time with the philanthropist Ichikawa-kun! He's nice and cool, but the reason why no one want to get near is a mystery. For the sake of confession, Kisa went to the student council room, and found out the reason why! Now, how will Kisa's fate be…? Swinging, school love comedy about boys and girls!"

title: Kuse ni Narisou ♡
description: ☆ I'm Shiratori Nagisa, an idol! Tossing people around is a hobby of mine. Is there a strong and cool boy out there somewhere? Finally, a super hilarious romantic comedy! Includes 2 other stories.

title: the Wizard of Pink Magic
description: A boy picks up a magic book in the library and the funny situations happen …

title: Manatsu ni Eakon Kowareta Watashi desu ga, Shiawase ni Narimashita
Quick Transmigration: Addictive Relationship
description: Ling Qi, a mischievous rabbit spirit, stole the Celestial Emperor's prized carrots and was punished with trials across three thousand lesser realms. In each realm, he diligently cosplays various roles, from pervert to villain, with one goal: sabotage the central couple! However, despite his intentions not to seduce anyone, his attempts often fail. As the trials progress, Ling Qi realizes that everything was manipulated by the Celestial Emperor…

title: Boku wa Kimi no Iinari
description: "I'm the only one who gets to see you so filthy, when you're usually so serious." Danno realizes he's gay in junior high school and professes his love to his crush, but is deeply hurt by rejection. Still disgusted by himself in his second year of high school, he ends up falling for another guy that spring. He tries to keep from being found out and to stop his feelings developing any further by pushing away the object of his affections, first-year student Tsukasa. One day, Tsukasa finds Danno jerking off in the nurse's office. "Does it turn you on? Being watched by your crush?" Tsukasa's torturing and teasing makes Danno dizzy with pleasure, robbing him of coherent thought!

title: Sumire Syrup
description: Sumire is habitually indecisive. Kei is brutally straightforward. And so begins a sweet, high school love story.

title: Koi wa Kaisatsu no soto ni Gozaimasu
description: A eloquent high school boy falls in love with a tongue-tied high school girl working part-time at the train station.

title: Boy Meets Girl
description: Though he's handsome, Minami-kun isn't very good with girls. This is a comfortable love comedy about Minami and his friends.

title: Funatsu Kazuki Tanpenshuu: PIATTO UNICO
description:
**Contents:**
1. Youkai Shoujo ―Monsuga― Jump SQ. Shucchouban! (妖怪少女―モンスガ― ジャンプSQ.出張版!)
2. Ore to Nanoka no Yukanda Ren'ai (オレとなのかのゆがんだ恋愛)
3. AGEHA DESTROY: You (AGEHA DESTROY: You)
4. AGEHA DESTROY: May (AGEHA DESTROY: May)
5. AGEHA DESTROY: Sara (AGEHA DESTROY: Sara)
6. Momomoke mini (もももけ mini)
7. Momomoke mini no 2 (もももけ miniの2)
8. Momomoke SUPER (もももけ SUPER)
9. Minna Agechau♥: Sequel (みんなあげちゃう♥～sequel～)

title: Kimi ga Suki Toka Arienai
description: Kana, who has zero experience with love and can't even talk to a boy, loves to read about it in her favorite manga, which according to her friends is completely unrealistic. Annoyed by their cynicism, Kana declares that she will finally get herself a boyfriend and prove them wrong. Suddenly, a handsome transfer student arrives. Is this love at first sight? Does she have a chance with this popular boy? Why does he seem to know so much about her?

title: Rizelmine
description:
The government has been conducting experiments to genetically engineer a human. Its first creation is a girl named Rizel, and the experiment is a success–sort of.

While healthy and cheerful, 12-year-old Rizel also possesses the uncanny need for love to further her development. Saddened by this emptiness in her life, she sheds tears that can end up destroying a city block.

So what's a girl to do … except get married! Enter Iwaki Tomonori, your average 15-year-old boy. His world is turned upside-down the day he arrives home to find that the government has just announced that he's a married man!

title: Houkago Orange
description: The track & field team Sakurai Natsumi joined is an uncommon team, who instead of training, play basketball and soccer everyday. The captain of Tokiwa Middle School's track and field team is Yoku-sempai, a second year student, who despite his small height of just 151 cm, is good at every sport he plays. Even though it was Natsumi’s brother Ryo who made Yoku the captain, she criticizes Yoku-sempai for being a bad captain. But soon she understands why her brother made that decision just by seeing Yoku's high jump. His beautiful jump makes her fall in love with him on a day where the sport’s ground was colored in orange by the setting sun, a day she will never forget.

title: Issho ni Ofuro
description:
A collection of oneshots.  
  
1. Kandagawa Rhapsody  
The bathroom at home is broken, so I'm going to the public bath-house. But what I kind of look forward to is that boy that I meet after getting out of the bath. Will I get to meet him again tomorrow? After knowing for sure that this is "love," I will say it to him.  
  
2. Dance of Glittering Stars  
  
3. Santa's Kiss  
  
4. Orange Road

title: Taka to Tonbi to Aburaage
description: Hanajima is the most popular and sought-after guy in school. But he has a secret: a hidden self, who is unbearably egoistical in both words and thoughts! The only one who knows that is a fellow schoolmate, Nodate!

title: Shiho Hayashi Collection: Love in the Bottom of the 9th Inning
description:
As a manager, having a “favorite” is improper. And yet, Honda can't seem to shake off the feelings she's caught for Yazaki……?

Featuring the title story depicting a scorching summer romance, plus three other fresh, youthful one-shot stories.

title: Giri Koi
description: Mao has just graduated middle school, and due to where she lives, she has to go to a different school from all her friends. While trying to find her new classroom, Mao stumbles upon a boy being bullied. She gets the bullies to go away, only to find that the boy, Riku, wasn't being bullied at all. Nonetheless, Riku respects her now, and refers to her as "Prince," for saving him. How will their relationship continue…?

title: Spring Storm
description: Being a teenage girl is not easy. Mari, a high school girl, struggles to find her place amongst the common sociological beliefs. Stigma, prejudice, and discrimination has seeded doubt and stress in Mari as her identity is being challenged.This story is created in support of LGBT teens who face social challenges and negative attitudes from society, the innate struggles of adolescence are further complicated leading to the potential development of mental health concerns. Now - Mari is trying to overcome the stigma.

title: Half of Me
description:
From 7 AM to 7 PM, 
I have to live in someone else’s body for 12 hours…?!

Due to a car accident, Taekin, a teenager in high school, and Heechan have switched souls.
Due to this, Heechan’s vegetable business, to which he’s dedicated his entire life is in trouble!
In order to recover his body, Heechan heads to Taekin’s school…

‘That gym teacher, why is he here…?’

He sees his old classmate, ‘The ultimate nice guy’, working as the school’s gym teacher.
Heechan excitedly tries to ask for help but…
‘Kim Taekin, bend over.’

This… This isn’t it…?!
Will Heechan be able to recover his body through this difficult journey?

title: Black Coffee
description: How does a girl declared by her childhood friend to be gloomy and anti-social transform into a cutie “as sweet as sugar” and every boy’s dream? And does every boy really dream of girls “as sweet as sugar”? Or is the rich and deep taste of coffee better than sugary glitter? The story of a girl who may not be sweet, but sure is as addictive as black coffee!

title: Nigireba Kobushi Hirakeba Tenohira
description: *Debuted on equal Vol.8*

title: Suki, Tokoro ni yori Arashi.
description:
1) *Love in the Middle of a Storm*  
Watase Touko is a bit sad, since it's her last day before transferring. It isn't only that she's lonely about being separated from her friends, but also that she wants to spend time with her crush, the transfer student, Yoshi-kun. Both of them attended school that day without realising that it was closed due to a typhoon, so they walk around the school enjoying each other's company. She only wants to spend more time with him, but…?  
  
2) *Love's Sonnet*  
Arai Kanade has been recently bullied for her diminutive height; she just considers a recent trend and neither minds nor asks for help. While having trouble retrieving her bag, she's encouraged by some beautiful piano music and then checks the source. To her surprise, the tall, constantly bruised, and lion-like Honda is playing. Not that she was going to talk about it anyway, she agrees to keep it a secret, but that is not the end of their interactions.  
  
3) *Love x Kiss x Mark*  
High-school

title: RULE ~ Criminal Boy
description: Common sense of the world, rules. Is there a meaning in days I am tied up? A story of a boy who feels uncomfortable about his present self.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica - Coffee God and Cigarettes (Doujinshi)
description:
What if Madoka caught Homura smoking?
The first half takes place early in the time loops while the second half takes place during the Wraith arc.
Coffee, God, and Cigarettes is a fan-made manga exploring Akemi Homura's traumas, and a take on the idea of "what if rebellion didn't happen".
The doujin is 118 pages long and will be published for free on Dynasty Scans, and there will be a small print run release as well.

title: Kimi no Inmou ga Mitai!!!
description: Won honorable mention at the 5th Young Jump Rookie Manga Award.

title: Guru Guru Pon-chan
description:
Ponta is a Labrador retriever puppy, the Koizumi family's pet. She's full of energy and usually up to some kind of mischief. But when Grandpa Koizumi, an amateur inventor, creates the Guru Guru Bone, Ponta's curiosity causes trouble. She nibbles the bone - and turns into a human girl! Now Ponta lives two lives: one canine and one human!  
  
Winner of the Kodansha Manga Award for Shoujo 2000.

title: God's Music Box
description: Yumi is a college sophomore. She's going out with Kouta, who's in her same circle. Just when she's been taken in by Kouta's boyish manner… she gets pregnant. What will become of Yumi and Kouta, who worry that they can't have this child…?

title: Love! Love! Love!
description:
“I have to keep moving forward!”  
  
Nonomiya Akane, 17 years old, second year in high school and the eldest daughter of the owner of Yaohachi Greengrocer, lives her life according to that motto. So when her crush of seven years, Nakai Sachio (Sacchin), announces that he was going out with childhood friend, Nishii Kayomi (Kayo-chan), Akane decides to just forget and move forward. Whether she fights with Yamato, her childhood friend, or suffers a heartbreak, she doesn’t falter and keeps working hard to achieve her dreams. So what kind of miracles will Akane be given?

title: Prince Cinderella
description:
From Lezhin: Outgoing and athletic, Darim’s always surrounded by friends. But back in elementary school, she used to be a social outcast—she only started making friends when Taehoo brought her into the fold. Now in high school, the two have drifted apart, but Darim is waiting for a chance to reunite with her icy Prince Charming. There’s just one issue: Darim’s body transforms into a boy’s at noon every day, only to turn back at midnight! Well, if she can’t get close to Taehoo as a girl… Why not try as a boy?!  
  
Principe Cenicienta.   
  
Extrovertida y atlética, Darim siempre está rodeada de amigos. Pero en la escuela primaria, solía ser una anti social; solo comenzó a hacer amigos cuando Taehoo la incorporó al grupo. Ahora en la escuela secundaria, los dos se han distanciado, pero Darim está esperando la oportunidad de reunirse con príncipe azul de hielo. Solo hay un problema: el cuerpo de Darim se transforma en el de un chico al mediodía ¡Todos los días! ¡solo para regresar al suy

title: Fly High!
description: Meru Tachibana, 12 years old. She’s just returned back to Tokyo after 12 years of training with her father, who thought she was a boy! Now Meru is stronger than most guys, and she’s doing her best to make sure that people don’t find out, or else her chances of making friends is ruined! However, a group of eighth graders seem insistent on making that impossible, as they break the rules and pick on the weak. Will Meru be able to stop them as the new student council president without appearing to be a “Monster Melt King” as her mother has warned?

title: Christmas Romance
description: Ito's favorite author has been right around her corner all this time. But, he wasn't quite how she imagined he'd be. So, will romance still ultimately bloom between these two?

title: Crab Kiss
description: Although Hye-Bin was smart enough to get into a prestigious private academy, her life has been marred by the fact that her mother used to be a famous porno actress. Having led a difficult life so far, Hye-Bin refuses to just sit there and take it, and no one who knows the secret about her now-legitimate-actress mother dare say anything about it. But Hye-Bin's one true purpose of coming to this academy was to find her childhood friend and love, Ryul, who had given her first kiss when they were little. Having seen Ryul declare on TV shows after becoming a child star that he was still waiting for Hye-Bin, she had been dreaming for this reunion ever since. But something is wrong with Ryul. The warm, friendly kid she remembers had been replaced by a cold, indifferent boy who is seemingly obsessed with the beautiful president of the art club.
