- [Original Webtoon <Mr.Blue>](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000047504)

- [Original Webtoon <Lezhin>](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/unrequited_love_club)

- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=54202151)

- [Original Webtoon <Naver>](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5107969)

title: Nekomori-kun no Himitsu no Tobira
description:
"…I can see…the doors to people's hearts."  
  
Ai Nekomori can see the "doors" to people's hearts. He hears the thoughts of everyone around him and has learned that what people think and what they actually say are often very different. Therefore, he doesn't trust anyone and never opens his heart to others. Then he meets the upbeat, tomboy Ritsu Sengoku, who honestly says whatever she's thinking. Can she open Nekomori's heart?

title: Her Weird Hobby
description:
They say, guys are too overconfident if there is a girl trying to get closer. I want to prove it! But… Why can't I stop it?!  
  
———-  
  
Yuna known as a pretty and sweet girl. Little did they know, she has this weird hobby! What would she do when she has been found out by two hottest guy in school?

title: Linden Hall no Aria
description: Kohinata Kanade is a second year violin student at Seiso Academy's Music Division. She lives together at the school dorm called Linden Hall with her childhood friends, brothers Kisaragi Ritsu and Kyouya. They practice intensively day after day at their orchestra club, aiming for victory at the nationwide music concours. However, one day Kanade is told by a boy she doesn't know "Your performance has no flower"?!

title: SPY×FAMILY: The Official Guide—Eyes Only
description:
The intimate secrets of the Forger family are revealed in this ultimate behind-the-scenes guide! Packed with character details, never-before-seen illustrations, in-depth interviews with creator Tatsuya Endo, and much more, this is a must-have for fans and collectors alike.

Includes behind-the-scenes details covering the first nine volumes of the hit manga, as well as tribute illustrations from 16 artists, including Hajime Isayama (Attack on Titan), Yuji Kaku (Hell’s Paradise: Jigokuraku), and Kazue Kato (Blue Exorcist)!

title: Boku no Tsukuru Sekai
description:
This isn't an ordinary high school—these kids have magical powers! Having the ability to cast a four-dimensional image can bring you fame and fortune, but you've got to be good at it. And that's what goes on every day in this school for "Projectionists." Some, of course, have an easier time at it than others. And sometimes having magical powers just gets in the way of the usual concerns that complicate a teenager's life. This complete in one-volume collection features stories that focus on different members of the student body. Step into this multi-dimensional world with these magical kids and see how each student deals with his or her special gifts! —CMX  
  
Contents:  
* The Sky That Enchants You
* Last Platonic Blue
* Little Girl's Close Game
* The World I Create
* Summer Vacation (Bonus Manga)

title: Ua So Lovely
description: Suh Ua, a high school girl that has no interest in her surroundings. Han Suon, a honor student that smokes. Shin Narim, she seems like a punk, but she cares deeply for her friend Ua. A story about the love and development of these people.

At first glance Moolchi is just another shy, unassuming boy whose greatest talents are running away from bullies and binging on vitamin supplements. Then one day, Moolchi's absentee father sends him a most unusual gift–a stunningly-proportioned automaton. She calls herself "Six" and mumbles about having a "prime directive." This strange and exquisite creature quickly turns the boy's life upside-down, violently disposing of high school hooligans and anybody else who gets in his or her way. The word "oblivious" barely does him justice as Moolchi remains blissfully unaware of his father's dangerous double-life, or the cute hall monitor who harbors a crush on him, or the intentions of this mysterious femme fatale who insists on bathing with him. Meanwhile, ominous storm clouds gather on the horizon, and one lingering question looms above the others "who is this so-called "Zero" that everybody is looking for?

title: Meine Liebe: Eien naru Träumerei
description: Erika Klause was separated from her brother when she was little. Determined to meet him, she decides to enroll at Rosenstolz Academy, where she is sure that she will find him. But, on the first day of school, she accidentally meets the five Strahl candidates. Since assistants of the Strahl candidates gain access to the boys' dormitories, Erika becomes determined to become an assistant in order to find her long lost brother. What awaits Erika at Rosenstolz Academy?

title: GuruGuru Meguru
description: From today, Meguru Kinosaki is a freshman in high school. But it's not only that she hasn't had a first love yet; she's in fact a clean girl who's never been in contact with any guy apart from her older brother Toshiya. With this pure Meguru, her classmate Yuuma falls in love at first sight. He starts a determined attack, but the over-protective big brother blocks his way! Now Meguru's days start to turn around between a big brother with a sister complex and a pushy boy…!?

title: Inu to Tsubame
description: Kaede is still mourning the loss of his brother when he is suddenly reunited with his childhood friend, Noro. As they get closer, Kaede shares his suspicion that he may have caused his brother’s death. After hearing this, Noro recommends animal therapy and lets Kaede use him as a pet dog. But one day, the dog suddenly kisses his owner…?

title: Chotto Edo Made
description: What if the Meiji Restoration never happened? Bakufu still holds sway, the class system has never been abolished, and there is no westernization. The story is set in modern-era Edo, which had never been renamed to Tokyo, where people go to Kabuki for entertainment and hang out at pancake house. It centers around Sobi, the sister of an Edo magistrate who goes to school with Michisato, who prefers to be called Michelle, the eccentric son of the ruling Tokugawa clan's Mito family.

title: Kouya no Koi
description:
Yamanouchi Kouya, the daughter of a famous author, is a shy young girl just starting middle school. She is named class representative along with Kannazuki Yuuya, a boy she met on her way to school who frightens her a little bit. They are trying to work together, but he always seems mad at her and she is painfully shy. The thing is, Yuuya knows something that Kouya doesn't know yet—that her famous father is going to marry his mother!   
(From: Dazzling Scans)

title: Osananajimi Kara no Amasugiru Kyuukon ga Tomarimasen
description: The day before her 18th birthday, high school senior Nino is proposed to by her extremely popular childhood friend Ichi, whose face is a national treasure. When she refuses to believe Ichi's feelings for her, who has grown up with her like a brother and sister, he says, "Let's experiment to see if we can become a love object"...? Since then, he has been hugging and pampering her everywhere, and scheming to make Nino his sole slave...? The drowning (love attack) and playing lover that is accelerating more and more, Nino is at the mercy of...?!

title: Haruiro Astronaut
description: Mami and Tomoki have always shared everything in life, they are identical twins, yet so different in character and personality: Mami tender and helpless, courted by boys to whom she doesn't never "no" for excessive kindness, Tomoki with a strong sense of duty and a great spirit of sacrifice, would do anything to see her sister happy. But comes a time, however, when one realizes there are things cannot be shared, especially when it is something extremely rare and unique …. just like an alien?!

title: Delete
description: Life is all about filling in the gaps.

title: Deban desu yo? Kondou-san!
description: Everything was supposed to change for Kondou Isami in high school. She was known for her impulsive and masculine personality in middle school due to her life being centered around kendo. As the national champion for two years in a row, she was the best, but, as a consequence of that lifestyle, she was no longer attractive to the boys. Vowing to become more girly and refined when she starts attending Seishinkan High School, fate seems to fight against her will until she joins the idol club at school.

title: ugly complex
description:
Ajin, who's only interested in baking, is a loyal girl who thinks "the Friendship is the best!"
When the super handsome Junwoo approaches her, an ordinary girl with glasses and braces,
her daily life begins to go awry…
"Why are you so mean to me?"
"Because I like you."
A truly heart-fluttering school romance between the straightforward Junwoo and the innocent Ajin!

title: To the Sky of Monaco - We Never Stop Boxing
description: Monako Saotome is a tall, long-legged, cheerful 16-year-old. However, ever since Sora Okita, a small, cocky, and slightly mysterious transfer student, shows up, Monako's condition continues to go crazy!! To make matters worse, Sora joins the small boxing gym run by her father, and immediately falls in love with the members of the boxing club. Will you be noticed by someone?

title: Nikoben!
description:
Norimichi is in his first year in high school, and his daily life is full of being bullied. However, there is one thing in his life that he enjoys–spending his evenings making elaborate lunch boxes. The only one in his family who needs a lunch box is his father, though. One day, his father finally refuses his decorative lunch; he says that it's embarrassing to have such a cute lunch made by his son, and he thinks Norimichi needs to learn to stop doing 'girly' stuff like that.   
  
Norimichi is devastated that his one happiness has been taken away, but the events of the day lead to him giving his rejected lunchbox to an unsociable girl at school, Umemiya. She is delighted by his adorable lunch box, and he is thrilled to be able to make her smile. Now he has an exciting new target for his creative lunchboxes, and maybe this first step can lead to something more!

title: Class no Inkya ni Kareshi no Sainou ga Ari Sugiru
description:
"Your smile is definitely the cutest."

Heartbroken after being dumped by her boyfriend, Kokoha discovers that Mizuma, a plain-looking, bespectacled boy in her class, is actually incredibly handsome! To get revenge on her awful ex, Kokoha asks Mizuma to pretend to be her boyfriend, but Mizuma's unconscious boyfriend-like behavior in the classroom is incredibly powerful…!??

title: Sweet Bitter Candy
description:
1-3) Sweet Bitter Candy  
Kawaguchi spent his entire life in high school as the short chubby kid, "Chidebu". His one secret was his admiration of the rebellious, openly gay Kanaya. Five years have passed and now that Kawaguchi has lost the weight (but is still short), does he have a chance of catching Kanaya's attention?   
  
4-5) Wait a Little Longer  
Student council president Tone is used to being a slave driver, and he's sure being stuck with overly persistent kouhai Ninomiya is just another cross for him to bear. After all, Ninomiya already confessed to him and he's only joining the student council to be close to Tone. But even though Ninomiya turns out to be a great worker, Tone relax around him…  
  
6) Just as God Said  
Two long-time lovers face a heart-wrenching breakup when one of them decides to get married.  
  
7) Sasoku  
A mangaka doesn't want his new assistant to fall for his secret lover.

title: Beyond the White Window
description:
I’m Seiko. I’m childhood friends with Yoshi-kun, and we always hang out together. But these strange new feelings I have for him leave me stumped…  
I’m Yoshito. Is Sei-chan just my childhood friend, or…?  
This is the first volume of Shiroi Mado no Mukougawa, a story of a budding romance between Seiko and Yoshito, of their fluttering hearts, and of their hearts brought together.

title: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. GX Comic Anthology
description: A collection of Oregairu comics by a star-studded lineup of artists is now on sale! A comic anthology for "My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU," which will begin airing its third anime season in July, is now available from the Sunday GX editorial department! In addition to the renowned artists of GX, it includes illustrations and comics by guest artists! A must-see collection of "Oregairu" episodes that can only be found here!

title: Kusatte mo, Hatsukoi.
description:
The main character, Yukari Murasaki, has developed a fugo-girl heart.
She can't stop wanting to be close to these two handsome guys, so she dresses up as a boy and transfers to the boys' school they attend!
Murasaki wants to bring them closer somehow (or at the very least, have them go out with her), but...?

title: Pimallineun Gwadaesaenghwal
description: My life of comparing myself to my perfect older sister is over. Now I'm going to live as the main character! Shin Seon-ha, a freshman who entered college with big dreams. However, I thought there was something strange in that department, but I never thought they were all vampires!!... Sunha's bloody college life with her fellow vampires begins.

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - Rewrite Stars (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: You x Riko

title: Shitteru Kimochi, Shiranai Karada
description: Hina strives to have the perfect girl image, but in reality, she's just a average delusioner. When she was having yet, another daydream, a boy ask her out and she, in a daze said yes? Little did she know she said yes to the school's most popular boy- Taiga, and on top of that, he found out her true nature! What will our Hina do?

title: Mawaru Sekai no Kimi to Boku
description:
1. Mawaru Sekai no Kimi to Boku  
When they were very young, Keito and Tomoya made a promise to be together forever, but after Tomoya disappeared one morning, Keito lost his faith in people. Years later in high school, Tomoya makes a sudden return, but now Keito's no longer a cute little kid Tomoya seems to have forgotten who he is!  
  
2. Masaka no Futari  
High-school student Akito is too cute! So cute that he's been traumatized by attackers both male and female. When Akito's mother convinces laid back college student Kunugi to tutor him, is Akito destined to be attacked again? Or is Kunugi really just a nice guy?  
  
3. Lucky Item  
Yazawa Shizuma, receives a visit one night from a middle school classmate, Hanai. Hanai is running from debt collectors and needs someone to take care of his son, Hanai Souta. What will happen between these two? Maizuru from Yubisaki no Koi makes a guest appearance in this story.  
  
4. Hitomi no Ori  
When he was small, Ran was found at the brink of

title: Cutie Boy
description: Lee Han-Ah used to be bullied in 2nd grade for having a “wide and flat” butt by a boy in her primary school and has hated him ever since. Now, in high school she is the celebrated, legendary captain of Il-Hwa Girls High School and she is seeking out a pretty boyfriend. Then she meets the mellow and seemingly perfect boy, Yoo-Min.

title: Mizukano: Water Girls in Sparkle
description: Ryōji Ara suspects that the bruises on the leg of his sleepy classmate, Kotori Mizuno, are signs of abuse. Eager to find out the truth about her situation, he sees her being taken away in a car! He pursues her and finds her at the Kito Artistic Swimming Club. As he talked with the club's coach, Aya Kitō, Ryōji realizes that Kotori is just very uncomfortable with the way people look at her. The bruises are also the result of a failed performance! Ryōji attempts to leave quietly, but Kitō takes notice of him and plans to use his personality to solve Kotori's problems!

title: Suki: A Like Story
description: Hinata Asahi is a high school student who lives alone with only her teddy bears to keep her company. Her life becomes much more exciting when the handsome Shirou Asou, moves in next door – not only is he really cute (even if much older), but he’s also her new teacher! Hina has a bit of a crush on Asou-sensei, but when the older man seems to take an interest in her as well, is it a forbidden love or something else?

title: Caramel Milk Tea
description:
A volume of cute and romantic short stories:  
  
- Caramel Milk Tea  
Nozomi, a high school student, did not believe in love at first sight. But it happens that she is in love with a cafe clerk. Immediately she declares love to him. But because he gives her the cold shoulder, she is disappointed in love. Now she begins to work part-time for the cafe where he is working.  
  
- Futari no Jikan (Two People's Time)  
Eri hangs out with her childhood friend, who she hasn't seen in four years. They've changed over the years, but certain feeling have stayed the same.  
  
- Kirakira no Kimochi (A Sparkling Mood)  
Narumi tries to make the most of her time before she moves on Christmas Day, but falls unexpectedly in love.  
  
- No. 1 Girl  
Saiko must choose between her career or her love.  
  
Orange Kiss contains Happy Words, a prequel of No. 1 Girl.

title: Kono Bushitsu wa Kitaku Shinai Bu ga Senkyo Shimashita.
description: 人畜無害な普通の高校生・柊木夕也。彼は教室に置き忘れた携帯電話を取りに夜の学校へと忍び込む。そこで出会ったのはふたりの美少女だった!?　ひとりは幼馴染の木滝恋子、もうひとりは転校生の桜江ゆすら。事情を聞くとどうやらふたりは学校で寝泊りしているらしい。流されるがままに夕也も学校に泊まることになり…？

title: Vampire no Okurimono
description: Himari was saved by a vampire as a child. Now a high school student, she lives wanting to meet that vampire again.

title: 7 Genme wa Himitsu
description:
1-3) 7 Genme wa Himitsu  
Shun is a girl who used to be shy and gloomy. Wanting to change, she transforms herself into a bright girl when her family transfers into a new place. Hoping to fit in, she laughs and smile at everything agreeing with everyone. She starts to fear that her young teacher is seeing right through her. Is she just imagining, or is it true—?  
  
4) Puberty BABY  
To Eri, Kaoru is like a troublesome little brother or a cute puppy. She's been taking care of him for fifteen years since they live in the same apartment. She thought he had no interest in girls but that changes when she catches him with a group of girls and flirting!  
(Also included in Houkago, Kimi to Koi o Shite.)  
  
5) Your Kotonoha (Your Words)  
Yuki's childhood friend, Rio, suddenly moves back. Two years ago, she confessed to Rio through a letter; but Rio read it out loud to everyone and made fun of her. Rio still has the letter and threatens to recite it unless Yuki does what he says.

title: Moon Shark: Sangeo ga Star-seong eul Tagonam
description:
Princess Sid of the Underwater Kingdom is destined to inherit the throne of the sea. However, she becomes a fan of the land idol 'Raon', and she becomes eager to see her favourite star, so she runs away to the surface.
While leading a satisfying life as an ordinary fan, Sid's world is suddenly turned upside down when she meets the famous actor 'Jihan'. Unintentionally, the two keep getting entangled with each other, and Sid unexpectedly becomes an SNS star overnight…!!
This story captures Sid's journey of growth and love as she navigates her new life on land, discovering herself between the two worlds of the underwater kingdom and the human world.

---
Sid, who is a Shark Princess of the underwater kingdom, falls in love with Raun, a member of the boy band BUB, and runs away to the surface to see him. Things are going great until the famous teen actor, Jihan Kang, steps into her life unexpectedly and they keep crossing paths. Will Sid be able to keep her secret and get what she came up

title: Genshoku Tsundere Danshi Semekare
description:
Kimi ga Suki Plus Pink Passion Version by Watanabe Ayu  
After going out for only a year, their relationship is already in trouble?  
  
  
Boikore Boys’ Collection S Seitokaichou by Aikawa Hiro  
I’ve become a toy for a super S senpai, but I can’t defy him…  
  
Anata Nante, Kirai by Yoshioka Ririko  
He’s such a frivolous person. Even so, he’s still the one I care about~?!  
  
Shitsuji-sama to Himegoto ~Otona no Tame ni Atsui Chocolate~ by Aoi Saki  
Eri wants to give the butler a Valentine’s chocolate that he will like, but…?!  
  
Akai High Heeru by Ishiko  
A good looking shop manager with spectacles… Just looking at his serious facial expressions turns me on.  
  
This is one of 8 (as of 8/31/10) Genshoku Tsundere Danshi Anthology books.

title: 1/3 Romantica
description:
Hana started going out with Tokumoto-kun, who's popular with both the class and the girls. She's being played around with by the guy's pace. Hana falls in love more and more with his kindness and his sense of humor. But, then she finds out about his ex-girlfriend, who is a teacher…!  
  
Also includes two other stories:  
- Cm na Futari  
This is a love story between childhood friends.  
They’ve always been together so it’s hard to go from childhood friends to lovers, right? Michika thinks that people who try to trick her are bastards, but Yuki saved her. She thought he was so cool that she fell in love.  
  
- My Life My Melody  
Aoi met Kei, the street guitarist after running away from home one day. Aoi’s life is not at all perfect as her family kept ignoring and not realizing her existence. Can Kei help Aoi to go through with her life?

title: Lemon Roman
description: Why don't you become an idol at a former boys' school (this school)? A female student finally enters a former all-boys school. Although the school was boiling, the one who entered the school was an intimidating Han girl, Lemon. The students were depressed, but Miki Haremon, a cute boy like a girl, made a certain proposal...? One girl in a former boys' school. But a reverse harem doesn't work!?

title: Mucha Kucha Daisuki
description:
Katagiri Aoi lives in the countryside, and likes it just fine there. Yet, to her dismay, her parents are moving to Tokyo, and she has to come along. Just before leaving her home town, however, she has a chance encounter with a visiting Tokyoite, Sugita Tsuyoshi, a city-born playboy type. On impulse, he kisses her–only to realize that this kiss, unlike all the others, carries unexpected meaning for them both.  
  
Extra stories:  
vol1: Love  
vol1: The River Person  
vol3: Psycho Love  
vol4: Wait For a Night When Snow Falls  
vol4: Your and My Rendezvous (Rendebu)  
vol4: A Tearful Tale of Love

title: Yowai 200-nen no Norowareta Seirei wa Koi no Mannouyaku wo Hossuru
description: Riko, who will be a high school student starting this spring, has a problem. That is, she "grows a little faster" than others. When she was little, she was sickly, but from a certain point on, she became the epitome of health, and her body and height started to grow quickly. Although she is happy, she has mixed feelings about it all...

title: Kimi ga Suki PLUS
description:
Collection of short story sequels to [Kimi ga Suki](https://mangadex.com/manga/3352).  
  
- Story 1: St.Xmas Version - Aki wants to go on a trip with Mase, but they have no money for it so they decide to get a part time job. Unfortunately, not many are ok to hire high-school kids. Aki gets a job at a bar owned by Mase's brother, that doesn't think she is worthy of being the girlfriend of his little brother. She is determinate to prove him wrong and spend the best Christmas with her boyfriend.  
- Story 2: Passion Pink Version  
Also released in [Genshoku Tsundere Danshi Semekare](https://mangadex.com/manga/4537).  
- Story 3: Koibana Confession

title: Murasame-kun no Tawagoto
description: Chika has always seen Murasame-kun as a rival who manages to constantly piss her off. While wondering out loud to herself, her sister whom overhears Chika, gives her a perfume necklace which supposedly able to capture a guy's heart. The next day, Chika bumps into Murasame-kun and spills all the perfume. As she begins to apologize, he suddenly asks her out?!

title: Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaetemo Omaera ga Warui! - Living Together (Doujinshi)
description: Tomoko y Uchi viviendo juntas.

title: Hachimaki Love Letter
description: She asks a bold question to her crush… What will he answer?

title: Flowers Falling Together
description:
A young female student is willing to confess to the boy she likes, but only after CSAT is over!  


---

How many stages should one experience to be intimate with others? Saying hello, getting along well, making friends, dating and being in a relationship and more…l love him", she's been practising this sentence in her mind over and over again, waiting a "correct" time to confess her love with him, one of her best friends. Thinking it is fate to see him afar, she's just about to say "what a coincidence" when she only found herself being in an awkward distress…

title: Sekigae Game
description:
Tamami is shy, clumsy and slow at everything. Everybody around her and Tamami herself think that she is good for nothing. That’s why Tamami can’t believe that Mitsui-kun, cool and good-looking guy from her class, likes her. It must be some kind of misunderstanding. Or is it not?  
  
1. Sekigae Game  
Tamami is shy, clumsy and slow at everything. Everybody around her and Tamami herself think that she is good for nothing. That’s why Tamami can’t believe that Mitsui-kun, cool and good-looking guy from her class, likes her. It must be some kind of misunderstanding. Or is it not?  
  
2. Goshujin-sama no Inu  
  
3. Hazukashigariya na Kare no Koto  
Mami was confessed to by a delinquent, Masamune. At first she thought he was a scary guy but found his reactions quite cute. How can she get this bad boy to become more lovey-dovey?? (From Intercross)  
  
4. Yasahii Akuma  
  
5. Hana, Hiraku.

title: Kira Kira☆Labyrinth
description:
When Asano Arisu was little she was badly bullied by the local boys. Now a high school student, she's famous for her vehement hatred of men and boards at an all girls school.  
  
When stunning Fujimi Kira enters and becomes her dorm-mate, proclaiming that she also hates men, Arisu thinks that it must be a fated meeting. However, they both have secrets that they need to keep from the Dorm Head, strict Kamitani-Sensei: Arisu for keeping a pet ferret in the dorm, and Kira the fact that she's actually a BOY–much to Arisu's horror! It appears that he's at the school to uncover the mystery of his older half-sister's supposed suicide 2 years before.  
  
Will Arisu be able to cope with having to share a room with a boy, let alone help him with his investigations? And just how dangerous will it be to solve the mystery?

title: Toretate Crazy!
description: An encounter in the spring, the budding of spring. What do you think of an agricultural otaku? The comedy between beauty VS agricultural otaku will now start!

title: Aitsura, Zettai Yatta Desho
description: Today, for the second time, we were trapped again and he kissed me hard and deep while we couldn’t escape. But, if someone sees us, rumors will spread again…!

title: Oshi to Seishun Shichatte Ii desu ka!?
description: Fujita Moka was a super otaku girl in middle school. After her crush told her that she "hates otaku," she decided to graduate from being an otaku and started the new semester of her first year of high school. But then, a boy appeared in front of her, dressed as Mary-chan, her favorite character from her favorite late-night anime, "Necromancer Mary"...?!?! The two share the same bias, but are complete opposites, and their happy, full-throttle youthful days begin.

title: Dog Style
description:
Miki Terayama saved Teru from getting roughed up by some punks. They're both in love with other guys… but one thing leads to another, and they're fooling around. Teru acts like a stray dog that hasn't been fed in ten days. He consumes Miki's love quick and rough and that can be quite a pain in the butt!  
  
—  
  
An entertaining romp from Modoru who has once again veered away from her dark side and visited the side of her humorous stories. Of course it's still rather twisted.   
  
A couple of high school delinquents (Teru and Miki) discover that despite being from opposing sides, they have no objection to a bit of a sheet tumble with one another. Doggie-style refers more to how one of them is referred to as a dog by the other.   
  
After their fourth time together, Teru and Miki finally have sex good enough to melt them both. However, they're still stuck in a weird place… more than friends with benefits, but not quite lovers. But now Miki's friend Kashiwa is demanding a meeting. Wh

title: Kuze-kun Waruikoto Shicha Dame
description:
From Chibi Manga:
Natsu wishes to lead a peaceful high school life. However, in an unexpected turn of events, she became the girlfriend of Kuze Reito, who is rumored to be the strongest in a fight and the number one ikemen of the school. And ignoring the flustered Natsu, he declared in front of the whole class that they were 'going out'...!? What will happen to Natsu's peaceful school life...!? An enthralling school love story with a wild Kuze-kun's sweet teasing!

title: Yugawara-kun wa Ooyamada Danshi Koukou de Moteru Houhou o Kangaeteita ga
description: "I've liked you for a long time. Please go out with me!" These were the words second-year high-school Kazuki Yugawara heard when one day out of the blue, someone confesses their feelings for him! But, wait just a minute… I go to an all-boys school. And the one who confessed to me was Sakurada-kun, who… is also a boy! I’m happy someone told me they liked me, but there's no way I could ever go out with a guy! But this guy Sakurada looks like a girl. What to do?

title: 8-Man
description: The Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Investigation Division has 49 members, with 7 squads of 7 members. 8 Man, however, is part of an 8th squad, with no other members. In reality,  8 Man is a robot who assumes the identity of Azuma, a detective who works with the Metropolitan Police. 8 Man has abilities such as super speed, and the ability to shift his appearance. Only a select few know this secret - not even Ichiro or Sachiko, the two younger companions of Azuma, know this fact. 8 Man deals with all sorts of scoundrels and criminals from all over the world - both as the detective Azuma, and the robot 8 Man!

title: Close Your Eyes
description: Two childhood friends and neighbours suddenly stopped talking to each other after summer break. What could have happened between these best friends who used to be joined at the hip?

title: The Doorway to Summer
description: Marion is a young schoolboy who prides himself on his adherence to a philosophy he calls "realism". Because of his distain for emotional display, he ignores anything remotely akin to affection. But when Marion is entangled in a romantic affair with an older courtesan, his rationalism is revealed to be little more than a cover for his own emotional immaturity. Learning to love, Marion blossoms under his older lover's care but unfortunately, Marion has yet to learn the true price of the affair.

title: Douyara Kore ga Koirashii
description:
Mika Uesaka, a girl with glasses, is the girlfriend of Aoi Tachibana, the most famous boy in school.
Although they are in different grades, Mika loves Aoi, who is always kind to her!
One day, one of his friends blackmails her, "There are many girls who want to get Aoi," and "If you are him girlfriend, you need to be more critical!" Mika decides to become pretty for her senpai...!
The reaction of her senpai was unexpected when he saw Mika, who took off her glasses, put on make-up, and became extremely pretty...!

title: Tsukumo-kun no Ai wa Machigatte Iru
description: It's about a top student taking care of her younger brother after her parents get into an accident. She attends a prestigious high school with her hard work, but finds out an exchange student tops her exam score. When she meets him at the ceremony he has a surprising proposal.

title: Grand Dolls
description: On his way home from school, the shy young boy Tecchin finds the body of a young girl lying in the street. He alerts the police, only to come back to find she has been replaced with a life-sized doll. Tecchin takes the doll home and repairs it. She comes to life and tells him that they are both Grand Dolls, alien beings bent on world domination.

title: Kuji no Hito
description: This handsome man always shows up at my store at 9 p.m. and I have the impression that I know him from somewhere ...

title: Kiss Fure Kiss Shiterukedo Koibito Janai
description: Hime était dans le pétrin quand un couple de touristes est venu lui demander son chemin … dans une langue étrangère. Un inconnu l'a aidée à s'en sortir, mais en échange, il lui a volé un baiser. "Est-ce qu'il … est tombé amoureux de moi!?" Le lendemain à l'école, Akane, le garçon qui l'a embrassée, se présente dans sa classe en tant que nouvelle élève. Son cœur bat la chamade, elle lui parle, mais tout ce qu'il dit, c'est : "Embrasser, c'est comme dire bonjour." Il commence alors à la poursuivre en disant qu'ils pourraient faire plus, et …!

title: Kare ga Kanojo O Tsukuranai Riyuu
description:
Collection of oneshots:  
  
1. Why He Doesn't Have a Girlfriend (Kare ga Kanojo wo Tsukuranai Ryuu)  
  
2. I, My, Me (Part 1)
3. I, My, Me (Part 2)
What will happen when a woman-hater and a girl wanting friends clash?  
  
4. Border Line  
  
5. Uten Kekkou  
  
6. Far Away

title: Bye Bye Regret
description: Saaya has always been in love with Yuuki since high school, but she has never dared to tell him this, and when she tried to do it, she found herself doing something that she will regret for several years. One day, when she visited her grandfather, he gives her a small box of music with certain powers … Will she be able to make amends for his mistake or will her love for Yuuki lead her to make more nonsense?

title: Ooki-Sensei to Kosame-san
description: Неопытный и молодой учитель Ооки, которого никто не воспринимает всерьёз. И головная боль всей школы – девочка по имени Косамэ. У этих двоих нет ничего общего. Но однажды они поменялись телами?..

title: Magician in July
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- **Magician in July** (7月の魔法使い, 7-gatsu no Mahoutsukai)  
A love story between a magician and his princess!  
  
- **The Prince Melancholy in November** (王子様11月のユウウツ, Oujisama 11-gatsu no Yuutsu)  
  
- **Queen and Me in October** (10-gatsu no Oujo to Boku)  
  
- **Forest in the Morning** (Gozen no Mori)

title: Anesan Countdown!
description: High school student Ritsuko Umekita does her best to stay under the radar of the scariest boy in her class, Saruwada-kun. Being from a long line of Yakuza, no one dares mess with him. Then one day her life is turned upside down by him. She is dragged home with him, only to find that…What's this? She has to marry him?! How will poor Ritsuko manage to escape the wolf's clutches?

title: Senpai, ano ne.
description: I like you, the one who is kind and a little bit of a liar.

title: Kubisuji ni Amai Kisu
description: A shy schoolgirl makes a deal with a handsome young vampire. In return for helping to make her popular, she will let him drink her blood.

title: Mikami-kun no Himitsu
description: Mikami's scary, I'm telling you! But wait, what's this secret of his?

title: Kitsune to Atori
description:
1) Kitsune to Atori  
This is a tale of human and fox, of Atori, who hates lies, and of her sister, who lost one eye because of a fox.  
  
2) The Doll's Girl  
Minori is a reserved girl who would rather be left alone to make clothing for her dolls. Kanae is a flashy, spur-of-the-moment type of girl who's always enthusiastic. When the two end up in the same hospital room, they become fast friends. But when a fight tears them apart, it'll take a lot to get them back together. Can a friendship truly be eternal?  
  
3) Extra story for Yaeka no Karte

title: Ask Dr. Rin!
description:
From Starlight Scans:  
  
Meirin, a junior high schooler, is the real identity of the famous "Dr. Rin" who heads a very popular feng sui website. She is in love with her best friend Asuka, a member of the soccer team. "Dr. Rin"'s advice has granted success for many, yet Meirin's own love life doesn't seem to be going too smoothly?

title: Kiss mo Shiranai Kuse ni
description: Fujisawa Satou, a high school freshman, was molested while boarding the train one morning. However, that was only a misunderstanding on his part. He eventually found out that it was only a racket. The one who informed him of this was Ayase Chihiro, the transfer student who started school a month late. It was awkward between the two of them at first, but they gradually became closer.

title: The Maiden of the Rose Mansion
description:
Ikeda's manga debut.
  
In front of a mansion where roses blossom, Tomoko and her brother Kenichiro meet a mysterious girl. She looks interested in them but vanish each time they see her.

title: I Love Her
description:
Hana, a 16 year old who's a bit of a tomboy, is dumped by her boyfriend when she moves to Sapporo after her parent's divorce. On her first night there, she comes across a young guy who is seemingly too ill to walk. He ends up collapsing on her and is quickly rushed to the hospital. As it turns out, he's Hiroto, her next door neighbor.  
  
The next day, when she goes to her new school for the first time, she finds out that he's actually a teacher and that he's the teacher of her class! With his out-going personality and friendly demeanor, he gets along with everyone, but she notices there's something a little different going on between him and Nishiwaki, a classmate of hers who the others write off as a "cold-hearted beauty."  
  
Hana always runs into him on her way to school, and as she gets to know him more, she finds herself falling for him! Things get even more messy when her boyfriend who broke up with her comes to Sapporo saying that he wants to give their relationship another s

title: Myakunashi
description:
A ghost girl has lost her memories.

**Notes:**
- Originally published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2020 No. 38.
- Compiled in [Red Hood](https://mangadex.org/title/7ce4a6a6-6e57-41fa-a8b2-d54f901dc6a6) Volume 2.

title: Unattainable Two: A Master & Servant School Love Story
description: "I will serve you, my lady." A kiss on the back of her hand is the mark of his servitude. These two dreamboats would make anyone envious. A heart-pounding master/student love story begins at the academy!

title: 30-sai Moonna, Heisei Gyaru ni naru.
description: Aya, an unpopular 30-year-old office lady, has been regretting that her life would have been more enjoyable if she had debuted as a gyaru when she was a high school student... Aya, however, is able to go back in time to the year 200X and live again as a Heisei-era gyaru in high school!

title: Shiba Inu - Masanori Morita Sketchbook
description:
Consists of 6 short stories spanning 14 years of Masanori's career.  
  
Contents:  
1. A MESSAGE TO YOU, RUDY  
2. ALL THE WAY DOWN  
3.-4. Shiba Inu  
5. Gang Age  
6. Sand - SABAKU - Desert  
7. Hitmen Laugh Too

title: Honey Holic
description:
Sakou Watari-sensei of "Cosplay Animal" fame presents this omnibus of love stories about five boys.  
  
First Story (ch 1):  
Kyousuke is stdying to get to medical school and is desperate for money, so he used someone else's identity to become a tutor. Who would have thought that the girl he's tutoring happens to be girl he met Suzuri. On top of that he is falling for her. How long can he keep up his lie before she finds out his true identity?  
  
Second Story (ch 2-?):  
Kaichi is a student in South High's soccer team, who is determine to be the best player around. Coincidentally South High's rival team, the North High happens to be staying in the same place for their training, and there he meets one of North High's female managers Ejiri. Despite of their school rivalry, those two had become closer…

title: Shoujo Kageki ☆ Revue Starlight - Jealousy (Doujinshi)
description:
Maya is taking a look at a recent photoshoot picture she and Claudine took part in. She starts to feel a bit miffed at seeing how Claudine throws a seductive look at the camera… or whoever might be behind it.   
  
Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki ☆ Revue Starlight

title: Kimi to Watashii no Taiiku no Jikan
description:
"Even though he should be an impertinent, irritating and hateful junior…"   
An encounter with an impolite and rude junior in a P.E. class full of boys!??

title: Tobenai Tori
description: Aoi was abused by her teacher in middle school, a trauma she is still unable to overcome. One day, because of a family vacation, she is reunited with her first love, Kaoru: even though she has never forgotten him, she definitely doesn't want him to see how much she's changed…!

title: Pixie Pop: Gokkun Pucho
description: Mayu, the daughter of a café owner, is unlucky in love until she meets “Puchou,” the magical fairy of beverages. Now, whenever Mayu drinks something, she transforms accordingly! Milk makes her grow large, water makes her invisible, pork soup turns her into a cute little piglet. But what will help her win the man of her dreams?

title: Sensei no Iinari
description:
c.1-4) Sensei no Iinari.  
  
c.5) Zenbu Omae no Sei da  
  
c.6) Ono-sensei no Iinari.

title: LovePlus - Nene Days
description: 人気恋愛コミュニケーションゲームを珠玉のコミック化。ひとつ年上のカノジョ・姉ヶ崎寧々（あねがさきねね）さんから告白され、戸惑う僕。初々しい２人の　物語は１話ごと、月が進み──。その都度、変化するカノジョの髪型・服装、そして僕との距離。

title: Lemon
description: A kind-hearted girl, Ning Meng, who was never able to reject others, began to isolate herself as she was not good at handling her interpersonal relationships. However, during the new school term in high school, she met many new friends who were willing to help her. They influenced each other and became people worthy to be engraved in each other's memory.

title: Monday, Wednesday and Friday is Swimming
description: Chiba Osamu and Arikawa Madoka are in the same middle school class and in the same swimming school on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. Although they have many opportunities to talk to each other, they never have for years now. They barely acknowledge each other, even though they have met hundreds of times. But when Osamu learns that Madoka is going to quit swimming school when she starts high school, something emotional starts to grow inside of Osamu. First, it began with nothing more than curiosity, but soon it blossomed into something more real. He has to tell Madoka what he is feeling before he never sees her again.

title: Chulso and Younghui's Story
description: "What is your identity?" One day, his partner Woo Younghi suddenly appeared. I don’t think she’s human…? Younghui, a robot who comes to school to learn about emotions, and Chulso, a robot who helps Younghi and express her emotions. But… The more time he spends with Younghi, the more he develops feelings for Chulso? The story of the two of us in a world that no one can enter!

title: The Girl Who Could Control the Weather
description:
The story of Mikage, a girl who gained the ability to control the weather (sort of), and her childhood friend Ookami-kun.

Creator-approved translation by [TheElusiveTaco.](https://twitter.com/elusive_taco)

title: Sublime Trilemma
description: Ayami and Sumire are best friends. Starting high school, a boy named Yuu catches the attention of both in different ways. Where Ayami sees a charming and popular boy, Sumire sees someone who’s struggling. As their relationships with Yuu develop, they start to see each other in a different light too… The focus of this webtoon is and will always be GL, but other types of relationships will be featured on the side too.

title: Space Patrol Luluco
description:
The story takes place in Ogikubo, which is the name of the specially designated area in space in the Milky Way where Earthlings and aliens can live together. Luluco is a female middle school student who lives with her father, and no matter where she is, Luluco is a common, "super normal" girl. As she is living her normal life, one day the mysterious transfer student ΑΩ Nova abruptly appears before her. That meeting will change Luluco's fate.  


---

title: Shoujo Kageki ☆ Revue Starlight - Study Abroad (Doujinshi)
description:
Saijou Claudine finds out that Tendou Maya, her dance partner and object of respect and admiration, will be leaving Seisho Music Academy to go study abroad. She has a hard time sorting out how she feels about this news.   
  
Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki ☆ Revue Starlight

title: Tokyo Rock Boy
description: Mai dreams of being a rock star, but her band suddenly breaks up. Then, in front of Mai who's on the brink of losing hope, appears an unfashionable guy who says he likes her voice. With the help of this dull-looking guy, Mai gains some popularity, but wait, that guy is actually…!?

title: Taming the Cat Master
description:
A cat went in the hot-tempered KANG Jae-Young's villa.   
Forbid approach to my room and my library.   
Things must be always in place.   
I hate messy things and clamor.   
Just follow the rules!   
Darn! >v<   
I won't be daunted.   
It's not like that I want to live passively and say no other words but "meow meow".   
Seems to be acting modestly, and all of a sudden extrudes the claws while sounding "Grr.." like a wild cat.   
Kya~!   
Now can love be formed?!!   
Let's wait and see.   
The vicissitudinous cohabitation diary~

title: Love Through the Fence
description:
**Links:**  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=14807885)
