title: Kon'yakusha-sama Sashiagemasu
description:
After being blown away by a truck, you wake up and find yourself reincarnated as a villainous young lady?! To change your terrible fate, you decide to quickly break off your engagement!
___
Asakura Yuri thought her short life had come to an abrupt end when she was sent flying by a truck… or so she thought.

But when she opens her eyes, she realizes she’s been reincarnated as the villainess of a certain otome game! Worse yet, her engagement to the prince has just been finalized, and there’s no escaping the grueling training required to become a future queen. If things continue according to the game’s plot, Yuri is destined to become the final boss and ultimately face execution!

Determined to change her terrible fate and avoid becoming queen at all costs, Yuri comes to a simple conclusion. She’ll get this engagement broken, and fast!

Thus begins a frantic villainess romcom about dodging death flags and escaping an unwanted royal future!
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.co

title: Exciting Love
description: Childhood friends Chihiro and Keigo are living together under one roof. They're lovers, but they've only ever kissed once. To Chihiro, it hardly even feels like they're going out, and he's getting impatient! And on top of that, he suddenly has a rival!? It's ever-loyal Keigo and headstrong Chihiro's heart-pounding, heart-breaking love story.

title: Wabi-Sabi - Auri Hirao's Works
description:
Collected short stories by Hirao Auri.  
  
1. Wabi-sabi (わびさび)  
3. Miyabi-chan Down from the Moon (月の下の雅ちゃん)

title: To Heart
description: Akari, Multi, and Hiroyuki all go to Miss Kurusugawa's guest house. That night, Akari gets scared after a round of ghost stories, and she gets Hiroyuki to hold her hand! Later, they all strut their stuff at the school festival. Remy's waitress outfit gets the students gaggling, while Akari puts on a bear suit for the student play! Even Aoi gets in on the action, starting up her own club called Extreme for fighting fans. Finally, Hiroyuki runs (literally) into Kotone Himekawa, a sophomore whose telekinetic abilities are starting to get out of control. Hiroyuki works closely with her to help her master her powers… but are they getting a little too close?

title: After Prom
description: Esther has one wish before high school ends: to attend Prom with a date. But who would ever want to go with a girl like her? And what happens when prom…isn’t all what it’s cracked up to be? SLOW BURN ROMANCE, DEPRESSED FEMALE LEAD, SOCIAL ANXIETY, LOW SELF ESTEEM, SCHOOL DRAMA, EMOTIONAL, PLOT TWISTS, HEARTWARMING, COMING OF AGE STORY.

title: Houkago Blue Moment
description: Suzu Mizuochi enters Hoshigaoka High School, a prestigious preparatory school she had longed to attend, but she becomes depressed because she can't keep up with the high level of the students around her. Despite her earnest efforts to study hard, she ranks 238th out of 239 students in the final exam. At that time, she befriends Kiyoto Ihara, the lowest-ranked student whom she meets during a remedial class. Suzu, who is conservative in everything, is attracted to Kiyoto's freedom...

title: Saboten no Hana
description: Natsumi has a complex about her younger sister Haruna, who is cute and loved by everyone. She finally gets together with Yusuke, whom she has had a crush on for a long time, but she is reluctant to go out with him because she doesn't want him to hate her this time. Takuma, a junior colleague, expresses his love to Natsumi in a straightforward manner. A sweet love story with a single-minded and aggressive younger man that gradually heals the sore in her heart.

title: Karada Meate de Warui ka
description:
"As long as Kakuno's willing to look at me, it's okay."  
  
Hazumi was helped by his classmate, Kakuno, who saw him being harassed by some upperclassmen. His heart stolen by Kakuno's strong and beautiful body, Hazumi told Kakuno that he wanted to see it all. Kakuno obliged, but as time passed their relationship became no clearer.  
  
They started out as strangers; neither lovers nor friends.  
  
Which would it be, if any?

title: Lacuna Overture, For You Who Are Moving Forward
description:
Collection of short stories about high school girls who attend the same institute. Each one of them, during their daily lives, asks their own questions: about her future, about life, about love, etc... But none of them will give up... Because they must always move forward. With her unique look, Akane Torikai paints (literally) the portrait of contemporary girls.
Also includes the oneshot "The Demon"

title: A Diary of Troublesome Adventures
description: "If you become my wife, I'll grant any wish…" Maybe it wouldn't sound half as crazy if Saeju wasn't told this by a cat (who may or may not be some kind of prince.) But she's desperate for some payback, particularly when her longtime crush blows her off, ice-cold style. But what happens when you invite someone downright… unearthly… into your life? Saeju's about to find out- particularly when one strange cat becomes one strange "brother" she didn't ask for!

title: Yakkai na Hatsukoi wa... Senpai to
description:
Why not 'fall in love' with a slightly troublesome senior?

Yagisawa Senpai appears in front of Hikari, who is known for her seriousness. He was rumoured to be a 'cool but troublesome' senior, but his true face is a surprise to Hikari... His growing feelings for his senpai can't stop! A 200% heart-throbbing first love story!
Includes:Troublesome first love... with a senior / Prince, I give up already!

Recommended information from the editor.
A "troublesome" love story filled with all the confusion, excitement and thrill of first love. Please support the love between clumsy Kouri and Yagisawa-senpai!

title: Haksik ui Kkum
description: Yejin, a smart girl from a poor family who gets into a top university, has zero dating experience. Now that she's in college, she wants to find love, so she puts herself out there, but... Enter Hyeon, an elite Taekwondo athlete, her only guy friend from childhood, who masquerades as her "bestie," but is he really? Yejin is determined to support her family through academic achievement, but she also wants love. Can she have both? How will Yejin navigate the journey of having it all?

title: Kizuna
description: Three's a crowd. Ranmaru and Kei have a strong and passionate relationship built on years of trust, sacrifice and love. When the mysterious son of a Yakuza boss starts to have designs on Ranmaru's affection, tempers flare, and hidden emotions rise to the surface. Will Ranmaru and Kei's love for each other be able to survive this difficult test, or will the emotional conflict finally come to a head?

title: Hito no Yomei de Seishun suru na
description:
The students in the entertainment major at Futakotamagawa High School are adolescent amateurs who aren't interested in normal school life. When Noyori goes for an audition, along with her classmate Otoshi, both total unknowns, they're told that they lack sufficient life experience—?

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title: Yamaoka-kun no Himitsu no Koibana
description:
A collection of oneshots:  
  
1. Yamaoka-kun no Himitsu no Koibana; Deluxe Betsucomi 2014-02  
2. Kanojo ga Bijin ni Natta Wake (カノジョが美人になった理由〈ワケ〉); Deluxe Betsucomi 2014-04  
3. Warui Onna no Susume (悪いオンナのススメ); Deluxe Betsucomi 2014-10  
  
4. You’re the Worst, But I Won’t Forget You (Saitee no Kimi wo Wasurenai, サイテーのきみを忘れない); Betsucomi 2014-05  
Yuuki and Michi—two childhood friends who drifted apart are reunited inside a mysterious train.  
  
5. Kimi ni Nokoru Koe (きみに残る声); Deluxe Betsucomi 2012-06

title: Hatsukoi Asterism
description:
Minako entered the same high school as her friend Shuu. And then she fell in love with one of her classmates, a guy named Takuma. Now, she will have to make a choice between love and friendship…  
  
Volume 2 includes a oneshot called Sakura no Kioku, which is included in the Pure Love Seasons 1: Haru - Hajimete anthology.

title: Haikyu!! - Heat Up, Cool Down (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata  
  
Kageyama gets mild heat stroke during practice, and Hinata helps see him home safely… and then into bed.

title: Love Zipper
description: My name is Airi. I'm a high school student working at Rose Fan Fan. With what I learn at RFF, I will help solve everyone's problems!

title: Tokyo Kareshi
description:
"Yu-chan I’ve been wanting to see you this whole time, I’m presently going to Tokyo…"  
  
Mugiko is a very energetic girl that was raised in a rural agricultural village within the mountain area. In order for her to see Yu-chan, who she was extremely close with when they were children, she transfers to a school in Tokyo. It has been three years since Mugiko has seen Yu-chan, but when they meet each other again he treats her coldly. Mugiko is shocked by this, but a very kind prince type boy appears…?!  
  
Also includes the following:  
  
Countryside Girlfriend  
A continuation of Toukyou Kareshi told from Reigi's point of view.  
  
Tatami 4.5 Mats Lovers  
Ume indirectly saves a guy from being beaten. The guy turns out to be Ninomiya Hikaru, a rich guy who later transfers to her school. He tries to get Ume to fall in love with him, but Ume wants nothing to do with him.

title: Lady!!
description: The story starts with a 5-year-old Lynn travelling with her Japanese mother to England to meet her father. On their way there Lynn and her mother get into a tragic car accident in which Lynn's mother dies. After getting out of the hospital Lynn moves to live in a manor owned by her father who is an English nobleman. The motherless little girl tries to adjust to high society life and get the approval of her elder step sister, Sara, whose mother has also passed away. At first Sara seems cold and distant towards her new younger sister, because she fears that Lynn's open and cheerful personality will win over the attention of their father as well as the handsome young man who lives nearby, but…

title: Shiro no Eden
description:
Mashiro was always alone, whether at high school, cram school, and home. Until one day, Mashiro met a youngster with a strange atmosphere. Holding the thought of “I want to change”, she took a big first step forward–even though her legs are small–seeking the path of Eden.  
  
A Pure Love Story.

title: Birthday of Love.
description: A short and sweet one shot celebrating the birth of love between this girl and her crush.

title: Kimi ni wa Fureru to Naru Toko ga Atte
description: Touji is an average high school student who is terrible at dealing with people and struggles with physical contact. On one rainy day, all of Touji's struggles come to a head when he encounters Itsuki Yato, a fellow classmate who touches him casually even when they first meet. Even though Touji isn't great at socializing, Itsuki goes out of his way to talk to him and spend time with him. Gradually, Touji starts to want to learn more about Itsuki…

title: Amasugite Zurui Kimi no Dekiai
description:
"You look so sweet, I could eat you up."When Chiko returns to her classroom to pick up the notebook she left behind, she notices a sweet smell. Following the scent to a seemingly empty room, she comes across the handsome, but aloof Mikoto Yukino, asleep. When he wakes up and catches her staring, Chiko finds herself on the receiving end of some very affectionate advances, and becomes completely overwhelmed, yielding to his rhythm. As Chiko and the chocolatey-sweet Mikoto continue meeting at this new secret spot of theirs, a cavity-inducing story of high school love slowly begins to unwrap!

source: mangaupdates

title: Far Away From Cold
description: This is a story of Little Princess Luo trying to make a friend. Luo Linyuan is born with a silver spoon in his mouth and a pretty face. Yu Han is "straight", and he sleeps only three hours a day. Yu Han doesn't want Luo Linyuan to get close to him, but Luo Linyuan wants otherwise.

title: Sprout
description:
Reality isn't a shoujo manga, and Miku Ikenouchi's friends know that perfectly well. But then again, they are not Miku-chan. The reason for this is that Miku-chan has a boyfriend, a third year, and is content with what she has. But then a chain of events occurs - one which leaves Miku-chan with a rival (for cuteness), her father quitting his job… and a new roommate?  
  
((Español))  
Narra la historia de Miku, fan de los mangas shoujo, que desea exprimentar un romance como los que lee cada d� a y convertirse en una chica mona. Un dia sus padres deciden que su casa se convertirá en un hospedaje, casa de alquiler, y es ahi donde la vida de Miyu cambia radicalmente, puesto que nuevas personas entran en su vida. Cómo afectará esto el noviazgo de Miyu? el manga shoujo podr� a volverse realidad?.

title: Garnet Cradle - Gekkou no Aria
description: Amahashi Miku is a first year student at the elite Mifuta Academy and its a perfect one. Suddenly her life changes when she is chosen to play a role on the academy play. Soon a lot of events happen, including supernatural ones...and she even starts to have strange dreams with a unique black cat...

title: Tsuugaku Densha - Kimi to Boku no Heya
description: Morishita Haruna is a high schooler who has a crush on a guy, called "Haru" (by his friends), whom she always see at the train she rides on. One day, waking up, Haruna was shocked seeing "Haru" sleeping in her bed! Neither one of them knows why is "Haru" there. After introducing to each other, Haruna knew that "Haru" is actually his surname and his full name is Harukawa Kanata. Kanata was just about to leave but an invisible wall on the door prevents him from getting out of Haruna's room. Him being unable to leave, Haruna has no choice but to go to school while Kanata stayed in her room. At the train station, an old man tried to molest Haruna but Kanata saved her?! But this Kanata doesn't know Haruna!! Rushing back home, she saw the Kanata who slept in her room still there! What happened to Kanata's body?

title: Miryou Mahou wo Bouhatsu Sasetara Haja Guzzu wo Jarajarasaseta Outaishi ni Sukuwaremashita
description:
Claudia, the daughter of a wealthy baroness, has always fascinated people just by being there. One day, she was summoned by a letter to the back of the second school building,
There, she finds Prince Albert waiting for her, fluttering a dazzling array of evil goods.

He told me, "Your enchantment magic is preventing me from making any progress in my search for a wife!"
What does that mean?

The days of secret training with the prince, who is a jerky and selfish man, begin.....!

title: Seito Kaishitsu Kare ga Doku o Haku Riyuu Megane no Uso
Watashi no Yankee
description: Twitter oneshot by Tobo @tobo_o3o

title: Nisekoi - Chances (Doujinshi)
description: A Japanese dubbing project turned one-shot featuring characters from the Nisekoi series.

title: Fushigi no Maria-kun
description:
Abe Maria, an ordinary high-school girl and Nanami Tokuko’s childhood friend, is the world’s last pureblood vampire!! For 10 years, Tokuko has been encouraging him to become a part of human society, and since then, Maria has come to love humans. As such, Tokuko happily watches over Maria. This couple's story is the world’s most gentle vampire comedy.  
  
*Includes an extra story called Manshinsoui no Futari (The Wounds that Cover Us) in vol. 1 detailing a high-school romance between a boy who is suffering mentally and an extremely clumsy girl.

title: Koishii Akuma
description: Despite his best efforts, Akiyoshi Tooru has fallen for the very beautiful but sadistic and perverted demon, Naruse Fuuta. Not only do they attend the same university, they’re now living together! Though Akiyoshi has always tried to be careful about their night life, he never expected Naruse to stop touching him altogether, and then all of a sudden, Naruse is in an accident and reverts to his adolescent self!

title: Zenbu, Hajimete.
description:
Zenbu, Hajimete  
Because of a job transfer, Ookawa transfers to Shirakiran academy for girls. At this Academy she runs into a university student who used to live in her neighborhood 4 years ago, and is now a teacher at her school. A sweet teacher-student love story ensues.  
  
Contains two extra stories:  
  
・Sakura Yuki  
  
・Baby Magic

title: Don't you want to know the Future?
description:
Well, meet Nekoyanagi Kennosuke, a mysterious man who claims to make his living as a miraiya - one who "deals with the future”  
  
Just when Yamamura Fuuta is looking forward to his last summer vacation as a grade-schooler, the self-proclaimed miraiya barges into his life and turns what should have been an idyllic vacation into a series of events shrouded in mystery and filled with spine-tingling encounters. Strange things begin to surface all around the skeptical and unwilling Fuuta.  
  
This is a manga adaptation of Hayamine Kaoru’s novel of the same name. Squeal, gasp, cringe, tremble, but don’t forget to peek between your fingers from time to time as mangaka Takemoto Itoe adroitly transports you to the quiet, fictitious, rural town of Kamikushichou, where the woods are brimming with life in the vibrant Japanese summer.

title: Full Moon Joker
description: Yukihara Mutsuki is a first year of Mitsuki Gakuen high school. She has a somewhat strange [self-ability], the ability to understand people's feelings. However, usually she acts like a normal girl who is looking for love. One day, Mutsuki meets a boy who had sat beside her in a train by chance. Can this be…. the destined meeting?? Mutsuki, who thinks like that, is…

title: Danshi Toilet de Machiawase
description:
1. Danshi Toilet de Machiawase
2. Immote
3. Sekai no Owari no Kyoushitsu
4. Kimi to Rumba wo Odoritai
5. Kimi tte Donna Nioi nano? (What do you smell like?)
6. Denki-gai no Honya-san Bangai-hen: Mikan Books no Hitobito

title: Daydream Illustration
description: A tom-boy girl who is incapable of love. One day she got her hands on a game that can customize a man for herself. With her saying that she doesn't want to be in love, will she enter the game? With her normal qualifications will she be able to pass the layer-by-layer test of the game? Who is the hidden man card?

title: Otodokemono Desu!
description:
1) Otodokemono Desu! (Delivery!)  
Competent president Kurokawa is hard to approach because of his fearsome demeanor. But the home delivery worker who brings parcels, Sawada-kun, with his angelic smile, is a soothing existence – he greets Kurokawa with a fearless "Hi there!" Thinking that he wants to somehow get closer to Sawada-kun, what does the president courageously resolve to do!?  
  
A hopeless, wild idea, with a sharp glint in his eye …  
  
2) Amagarai Unmei (Salty-Sweet Destiny)  
What will happen to this poor man who's about to turn 30 when he finds out he was born without the Red String of Fate.  
  
3) Rookie  
Sugou always had things easy in life until he meet his co-worker Atou.  
  
4) Futari no Kyoukai-sen no Iro (The Color that Divides Two People)  
  
5) Shiawase no Yakusoku (Promise of Happiness)  
  
6) Kuse ni Narisou na (It Might Become Habit)  
  
Extra) Otodokemono Uketorimashita! (Delivery Received!)  
  
Six works total with the title work included, plus an i

title: Kijou Senshi Mokuba-san
description:
幼き頃に公園でウマの遊具に乗った思い出はありませんか？

この物語は子供の頃に自分に乗ってくれた男の子に恋した遊具・モクバが、その想いを成就する為に人の姿になる、現代版人魚姫です！！………もちろん鬼才・太陽まりい先生（前作では酔拳使いの美少女ヒロインが尿意と戦いながら悪と戦う漫画を描いています）が描くのだからそれだけで終わるはずも無く、少年に乗られて恍惚の表情を浮かべる遊具はどう見ても変態ッ！！出てくるキャラもほとんど変態ッ！！

title: Rui wa Koi o Yobu
description: From Ikemen Guys: Nanami who is not good with boys attends a girls' high school while she longs for a Shoujo Manga like love . But all of a sudden her school changed to co-ed and she now has to practice love with newly transferred guy Rui. A test of love with an elite but a bully .

title: Isso Mou, Kudokitai!
description: Ayukawa has had nothing but trouble with women, from his first crush to the last girl that dumped him, so he's given up on getting a girlfriend. Now he's teaching at an all boys school and his cute student Hino is very friendly. Is a boyfriend the answer to Ayukawa's love troubles?

title: Would You Marry Me for Baseball?
description: Tomoya, a university student and baseball pitcher, chose his childhood friend Sora as his catcher. A love (?) comedy manga.

title: Sumikomi Saki wa Osumitsuki - Wakagashira ni Kawaretemasu
description: Mugi Kogure, a JK who lives alone, is stranded in a garbage dump when a stranger, Toyohi Yada (Yutaka), picks her up. In order to pay for the 3 million yen in vomit-stained clothes and shoes, she ends up living in the man's house and doing housework... but the man is actually a young yakuza boss!

title: Hot Milk
description: Waiting 300 years for a fateful meeting, living positively with crazy delusions, striving for many lovers, and drinking milk every day to get bigger breasts…Girls do all of this for boys! A collection of four stories to help out with your love.

title: Chou Kuse ni Narisou ♡
description: ☆ I, Shiratori Nagisa, have a secret that I can't tell anyone. That is, pretending to be a boy and going to a normal junior high school ♡ The popular "I'll Make A Habit Of It ♡" reappears with even more power!!

title: A Pudgy Girl's Love
description: Li Mei is a chubby girl who can’t hold back from eating junk food. One day, her mother gets her a home tutor, a boy called Jiu Teng Zou, who happens to be a senpai she's long admired. At first he seems cold, but what will happen when they start to get to know each other?

title: Two Steps Away
description: Hosu is an average, carefree high school student who isn’t particularly special in any kind of way. Danwoo is the attractive, untouchable top student of the class. There shouldn’t really be any reason for them to interact at all. But one day, Danwoo announces that he wants Hosu to sit next to him in class. In fact, he wants to be within her presence as much as possible, and he’s willing to do whatever it takes to stay by her side. Not too close, but not too far. Just two steps away is enough. However, will they be able to maintain that distance? Come take a closer look, from just a couple steps away…

title: Henai Osananajimi wa, Motto Nakasete Aishitai
description: "I'm going to make you cry a lot - are you ready for that?" Sae is blessed with a boyfriend and friends, and leads an ordinary but fulfilling high school life. However, one day, Sae's life changes drastically when she catches the eye of a handsome transfer student, Hazuki Takahashi! She discovers that her boyfriend is cheating on her, and Hazuki kisses her... Hazuki also tells Sae that he's here to take revenge...?

title: Leading Girl
description: Yukiko, a former yankee who was a little disappointed, enrolls in a prestigious school at the temptation of her younger brother Aikawa. However, it is a school where each class is graded...!? Tsundere yankee girl x Glasses boy's downhill romantic comedy!

title: The Three Eyed One
description:
To learn about his roots, Sharaku must investigate the mysterious ruins that a long-lost civilization called the Three-Eyed Ones bequeathed to him. In his worldwide search, which takes both him and Chiyoko Wato to locations like Arizona, Easter Island, and Mexico, Sharaku deciphers ancient scriptures and uses gadgets he invents to help solve (or start) problems and mysteries.  
  
Sharaku is frequently bullied for his childishness, and as such the story is also about how he fights back when the x-shaped bandage that covers his third eye is removed. Behind the bandage is hidden Sharaku's malicious third eye, and the boy's hidden evil genius emerges when it can see. Sharaku's rivalries with teachers or students are occasionally developed into major plot points.  
  
---
- **Won the 1st Kodansha Manga Award for Shonen in 1977, which it shared with Tezuka's other serial, Black Jack**

---
**Volumes 101-113 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Hello My Seven Uncle
description: Seven Uncle is an ultra handsome Ancient God? A normal University freshman is forced to join the Committee of Monitoring Gods, and other than having to serve the arrogant and picky Seven, he also has to fight with every wit and strength against other eccentric Gods. God VS Human, Ancient God VS New God, the door to a new world is about to be opened…

title: 30 Days 'til the World Ends
description: On a peaceful day, a text message announces the countdown until the end of the world. Soo Ah, a cheerful high school girl, sees how all of her loved ones gradually disappear and panics. She decides that the last thing she can try to do is save Sun Woo, her dear friend and crush

title: Kareshi Toshishitakei.
description:
- Kareshi Toshishitakei  
Her childhood friend, Sou, returns from America for the first time in 5 years. Ai is really happy to see that he has become very angelic looking in the time that they've been apart. However, one day he says, "I will definitely make Ai mine", and forcibly kisses her! To get treated like that by someone three years younger than her and who she's always treated as a younger brother takes Ai by surprise. It would definitely make Ai's heart skip a beat, wouldn't it?!  
  
Also included:  
  
- Gyakuten Valentine  
  
- Kimi ga Hajimete  
Inoue never tells anyone about her job as a voice actor since no one ever believes her. She now keeps it as a secret from everyone around her, but one day she’s discovered by Mukoujima, the womanizer of her class! Why does he keep on visiting her every day afterward?

title: Yankee ni Koi to Ikuji wa Muzu sugiru
description:
Natsune Aoki became a father at the age of 16. Natsune, a high-school student, was entrusted with raising the child of his deceased brother, Kotori.

I used to think raising a child was a chore, but as I let myself be pushed around by the innocent and cheeky Kotori, I started to smile... !

title: Nextworld
description:
As Mustachio and Kenichi make their way through the hustle and bustle of Tokyo, they overhear a muffled scream from a parcel carried by an old man. Ever the curious type, Private Detective Mustachio follows the old man to his home, finding out that he is a scientist, Professor Yamadano.

When confronting Yamadano over the package and his intentions, Yamadano breaks his silence and reveals the discovery he made during a visit to Horseshoe Island. A discovery that has very grim implications...

The final installment in Tezuka's SF "World Trilogy" filled with Conspiracy, Political Turmoil, and Hardship.

---
**Volumes 45 and 46 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Remembering You
description:
After a car accident, Yeowool loses fragments of his memories, especially Soohyun. After recovering, Seungho appears before him claiming to be his boyfriend. Soohyun, distraught and guilty from what happened to Yeowool, carefully watches the relationship budding between Yeowool and Seungho. Will Soohyun be able to get over his guilt? Will Yeowool remember what he has lost? Stay tuned as their story unfolds . . .  
  
[Project is dropped]  
  
Please support the author through the official licensed version of this manhwa:  
  
<https://www.wutopiacomics.com/#/computer/detail-cartoon/103>

title: Ninja Scrolls Love ~Hidden Love Snowstorm~
description:
A person born as a ninja must always honor the rule to keep hidden.  
But one day while training, Ishibashi from the same high school sees her…!?  
  
Pt/Br:  
Uma pessoa nascida como ninja deve sempre respeitar a regra de se manter escondida.  
Mas um dia, enquanto treinava, Ishibashi, da sua escola, a viu…?!

title: Natural Pearl Pink
description: We follow the bumpy and funny romance between bubbly Tamoko and the serious Kanji. With Kanji's father running an idol agency, and Tamoko being the daughter of their top-selling idol, Shinju, things get complicated. Tamako must hide the fact she is Shinju's daughter to save public face, and at the same time, she is determined to be Kanji's ideal wife (as was promised when they were little kids). It doesn't help that Tamako's pretty clumsy and poor of domestic chores, but no matter what comes down the road, she's not about to give up!

title: Kimi ni Hana o
description: Who cut my daisies?!

title: Lever Gacha Archive
description: The story is set in the 1990s, and follows an ordinary middle school boy named Yasutaka Etō, who plays games and is bad with girls. One day his female classmate Kaori Kashiwame consults him out of the blue about Neo Geo and SNK games because, as it turns out, the person she has an unrequited crush on is a fan.

title: 5-tsu no Hajimete - Ubawarete mo Ii, Kimi ni Nara
description: The often-ill and unskilled-in-love Akane Is teaching a demon-like boy about love!?

title: Hana × Hana
description: **Character Designer:** [Ryohka](https://mangadex.org/author/9713d223-4ed6-4a1b-9f6c-867e2f2e095f)

title: Majimoji Rurumo - Houkago no Mahou Chuugakusei
Koi Nanka Hajimaranai
description:
"I absolutely won't fall for this brat!"  
  
Due to job transfers, Makoto has no choice but to stay at the home of her father's friend for the time being. But there lives a boy who makes her boiling mad!? Turns out he's the king of popularity at school, but he's a prankster who likes to mess with Makoto, and even recently dumped one of Makoto's good friends! How is Makoto supposed to handle this obnoxious brat!?

title: Daruma no Kokoro
description: I’ve always thought that if I were to fall in love, then I’d want to love someone who is kind and praises me!

title: Yuka-chan no Aijou Hyougen
description:
Beneath the surface of ordinary school life lurks a punk-rock reality.
Kashiwabara's expressions of love for Komori are intense and unconventional.
Will her rockin' yet bittersweet affection ever reach Komori's heart...?!

Source: MangaPlus

title: Xu Ge Yuan Ba! Da Xi
description: Gao Da Xi is a notorious delinquent youth; only Teacher Dai dares to challenge him. When Teacher Dai has to go and take care of his hospitalized daughter, he has no choice but to bring Da Xi along; this is the first time Da Xi and Tian Le meet… After this, Da Xi meets another boy who claims to be called "Angel" at the hospital. Angel says that as long as Da Xi promises him one condition, Da Xi will be granted one wish. What would his wish be…? Just like poems during spring softly capturing your ears or the warm currents in winter cleansing your eyes, after completing "Lovely Everywhere", Ke Li brings to you again a touching love story close to your heart!

title: otona♥pink
description:
Sensei, please teach me about love.  
Senou Miku is a normal high school girl. On the day that she had her first boyfriend, her mother had a job transfer. And then, her guardian, who came to live with her, turned out to be her homeroom teacher, Nishizono-sensei…

title: Gakkou no Ojikan
description:
Normal high school student Riku comes back home one day to find… she is now the school chairman of a famous elite school?! It seems her grandfather left her the post after his death and, although Riku is not really enthusiastic about the idea, there happen to be two really interesting guys that attend that same school…  
Also contains a side story called Kimi no Te to Hitomi to (Your Hands, Your Eyes) in volume 5.  
  
((ot@kus))  
Riku es una estudiante normal de instituto, un dia vuelve a casa para encontrarse con que… ¡¿ella es ahora la presidenta de una famosa escuela de élite?! Parece ser que su abuelo le dejó una nota antes de morir y aunque Riku no esta muy emocionada con la idea, hay dos chicos interesantes que van a esa misma escuela…

title: Kimi ga Hikari
description: Shinohara Sumi is stuck taking supplementary lessons in the heat of summer. Her situation immediately changes when a mysterious boy named Yoshino Mitsuru jumps into the classroom through the second story window. He spends each day helping her with her lessons, and her feelings for him begin to grow. But things may not be all that they seem as she begins seeking the reasons for the loneliness in his eyes…

title: Butsumetsu Sentimental
description: This side story from the manga "Queen's Quality" tells you about a girl named Houshou Mikako who couldn't inherit the power of purifying evil spirits from her family. She had to cooperate with the delinquent Kagura Shinobu to save her friend, Yamada Toranosuke, from being eaten by an ugly monster. Will she be able to prove that she doesn't need superpowers to help those she cares about?

title: Dramatic Maestro
description: All three of Mao's high school girlfriends have been taken away by the gorgeous-looking Yuu. But in retaliation to the slap that he gave this popular guy, a confused Mao gets a kiss..!? Soon he's dragged into the world of the school's "celebrities," who all have special talents, which range from "entertainment" to cosplay, and even pleasure!

title: Navy Blue no Hoshizora
description: Ichika had always tried to fit in, as she strives to have friends, unlike her time at elementary and middle school. She still does have certain nerdy and carefree childhood friend "Doc" that she secretly sees. Hanging out with him makes her realise that maybe she can change…

title: Katakoi Densha
description: She's always taking the same train when she goes to school and in that train there's a boy with such a beautiful smile. She doesn't know in what school he goes but she's so attracted by his smile. And one day, the train suddenly stopped. That's the start of their love. You will see the first steps of a love between adolescents.

title: Shutter Chance
description: A cute story about a Photography Club and people's secret crush.

title: Oujisama, Dochirasama?
description: One day, Mizuki gets rejected by school prince and student body president Seima Takajo. While sobbing his eyes out behind the school, he meets Fuji, a fierce-looking upperclassman who wears a surgical mask. The older boy is awkward, yet kind as he desperately tries to comfort Mizuki. "I want to tell Seima how I feel, so help me!" Mizuki says, demanding Fuji's cooperation. Despite his appearance, Fuji's actually pretty soft, and he even thinks the sharp-tongued, mischievous Mizuki is cute. At some point, Mizuki starts losing track of his goals… Fierce, weak, and sickly, can a prince with a triple handicap find happiness with a mischievous "princess" of a boy!?

title: Cherry na Bokura
description: A 17-year-old girl, who has no experience with guys, one day sees a classmate drop something and without realizing what it is, she returns it to the guy. But soon she finds out that what she picked up was actually a condom! After school, she coincidentally meets the guy in the hallway and she's excited to be so close to a guy for the first time! But when she sees him flirting with other girls, she realizes that he's just a player…? What will happen between them?!

title: Kirihara Mika no Yuuutsu
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
1. Kirihara Mika no Yuuutsu  
Mika's love life is not easy at all! Due to her overprotective and wild brothers every boy she likes run away from her. But is it going to be the same as always even with this girlish boy who really wants to stay by Mika's side!?  
  
2. Shuugaku Ryoko Naisho no Koi  
Megumi finds it discomforting being around boys yet on their class trip, she's assigned to sit next to Taketo-kun. After a small incident, they become friends, will romance bloom next?  
  
3. Hajimari no, Kiss.  
4. Hatsumei Princess Shizuka-chan!!  
5. Nee, Boku ni Shina yo

title: Hitsuji no Namida
description: High school student Hasumi Kei has only one goal in life–that is to visit her classmate Kanzaki Kyosuke's apartment! Seeing how the two do not know each other, Kyosuke refuses to allow her to be anywhere near his apartment… But Kei is relentless, demanding to get her way… but why?

title: Adulthood
description: Best friends Alex, Mickey and Joe are up for a very eventful freshman year.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club - Zenryoku Horegusuri Move (Doujinshi)
description: A Shizuku x Kasumi doujinshi in which Shizuku teams up with Kanata and Rina to have some payback for Kasumi's pranks.

title: Houkago S to M
description: A warped romantic comedy between a bully high school girl and a bullied high school boy.

title: Amano Kozue Tanpenshuu
description:
Volume 1. Mukuukai: (夢空界, Yume Sora Kai/Mukūkai, World of Dreams); released on June 1996.
Zenyasai (前夜祭, Night Before Festival)
A student encounters some mysterious girls the eve of the school festival. Are they... ghosts?

Ichigo-chan Panic (いちごちゃんパニック, Strawberry Panic)
A young boy, Vanilla, transfers to a new school. Thanks to Ichigo, a girl who can transform her bubblegum into anything, he has an action-packed first day.

Setsuna no Natsu (刹那の夏, A Summer's Moment)
A boy goes to school during summer break to pick up a notebook. He encounters a ghostly girl, dressed entirely in white...

Chiisana Seiya (小さな聖夜)
Abandoned cats try to survive another Christmas Eve. Have they truly been forgotten by their owners?

Mukuukai: Hiraku Yume no Tobira (夢空界〜開く夢の扉〜)
The drama club is preparing a play for the school festival. The leading roles are given to Harumu, an outgoing boy, and Kanon, a girl who has been absent from the club for some time. Will Harumu remember how he and Kanon met, and the

title: Inugami-kun wa Tsun dakedo Bareteru
description:
Inugami is the kind of tsundere, cool type of boy...despite that, his true feelings are always too obvious! He's from a traditional family which worships the old dog god, and he was born with dog ears and a tail which both expose his emotions.

And so begins a romance comedy about a high school girl who's bad at dealing with dogs and Inugami!

title: Linda the Shared House
description: Akane and her elder brother Akira have been close ever since they were children, despite their age gap - Akane is now in high school, while Akira has given up his career as a police officer to pursue his dreams in music while living in a shared house with his friends.  When Akira fails to turn up to see Akane, a visit to his shared house reveals that he has gone missing - and while the police refuse to investigate, Akane discovers a note from Akira hidden in his room that tells her to get out of the house as soon as possible - his four mysterious house mates are dangerous, and if she stays any longer, she'll end up dead...

title: Sugar Princess
description: When Maya Kurinoki takes her little brother to the local ice-skating rink for the first time, she's got her hands full just trying to get him to let go of the bar. To inspire a bit of bravery in him, she attempts a double axel–and lands it! Maya never imagined that this jump would change her life…or that a coach named Eishi Todo would vow to make her a figure skating "princess"! Now all Maya has to do is convince famous skater Shun Kano to become her partner. Too bad Shun doesn't want to have anything to do with her!

title: Peter Pan♠Syndrome
description: Twelve-year-old junior high school girl Hasumi Kohaku moved into town in search of her mother. She is gifted with ESP and the ability to fly– well, only when the sun is down. Otherwise the sun could make her power fade away. Kohaku soon uses her powers in front of her classmates, in order to save her friend Yuuro from falling out a window… but during the day!

title: Hatsuiro Focus
description:
Sakurai Chisaki is a soft-spoken high school girl who longs to be the protagonist of a girl's novel.
Chisaki has been hiding behind her best friend Himari Kusunoki, who is always cheerful and cheerful like a hero.
One day, a photo of Chisaki that was taken secretly became a buzz on social networking sites.

I thought I was only a supporting character in this world.
Chisaki's own love story.

title: Inu Jikan
description:
1-3) Inu Jikan  
Riku is a girl who would choose dogs over a boyfriend and food. And it just so happens that the most popular boy in school not only has the word "dog" in his name but owns three large dogs too! Will love bloom?  
  
4) Amakuchi Kigokoro  
  
5) Himitsu no Chikara

title: My Secret Boyfriend
description: Black and Molly are now a couple, but their relationship spells trouble for Black Storm. In an attempt to avert anything untoward, Benjamin decides to take matters into his own hands. Is Benjamin really acting out of loyalty to Black Storm? Or are his intentions selfish in nature? An action-packed romance begins...

title: Ai to Mogumogu
description:
Fuku lives alone with her brother; however, due to her brother's business trip, he cannot make dinner for her. Despite her attempts of taking this chance to become independent, her dietary life becomes a mess… One day, she meets her neighbour, Souta, who made her the most delicious meal she's ever had. This is a heartfelt story filled with nutritious and romantic goodness!  
  
Fuku vive solo con su hermano; sin embargo, debido al viaje de negocios de su hermano, no puede preparar la cena para ella. A pesar de sus intentos de aprovechar esta oportunidad para independizarse, su vida dietética se convierte en un desastre … Un día, se encuentra con su vecina, Souta, quien le hizo la comida más deliciosa que haya tenido alguna vez. ¡Esta es una historia sentida llena de bondad nutritiva y romántica!

title: Harlem Beat wa Yoake Made
description: Meet Kujou Yamato, who on the outside is your average high school kid pursuing love and happiness. Except in truth he's the prince of hell, escaped to the human world to avoid a marriage he wants no part of. But hell wants him back, and picked a trio of their finest (?) to rope in him! Not to mention, his fiance isn't going to just wait around forever…

title: Demonic Hallelujah
description: Dear God, there’s a super perverted and devilish guy in this sacred academy…! And yet for some reason, I can’t keep my heart from racing for him…Oh dear God, would you forgive me for falling in love with such an outrageous priest…?

title: Koi Shitagari no Blue
description:
“Won’t you become my girlfriend?”  
On the day of her high school entrance ceremony, Ao got asked that by Riku, a guy that she has only just met. But by that, he meant to ask her to become his fake girlfriend, just to pretend. Ao was surprised by the sudden request, but after knowing Riku’s true feeling, she decided to agree to become his fake girlfriend…?

title: If It's Not You
description: Hisami is a highschool girl whom has never had a boyfriend in her 17 years of life. Although she developed a crush on her classmate Haru-kun at a school festival event, due to a misunderstanding she ended up dating his friend, Narushi-kun. On top of that, Haru-kun started dating Hisami’s best friend, Izumi. In this situation, one day Izumi suggests “swapping lovers for just 1 day.” Even if it’s just for today, Hisami can date Haru-kun! Hisami is extremely excited, but she was suddenly brought to a love hotel by Haru-kun!? *** At last, 4 of the early works of “national treasure in the field of Love Comedy,” Yoshihara Yuki, published as a volume!

title: Harete Bokutachi wa
description:
High-school student Chihiro is small and cute, and gets molested by middle-aged men on the train. But it wasn't always this way – up through elementary. Chihiro was bigger than all the other boys and he defended his friend, smaller and gentler Keigo, from the bullies. That is, until Keigo was transferred to Vienna!  
  
Despite promising to write, Chihiro had long ago left behind the memories of Keigo. Now, Keigo is coming back to Japan – and what's more, they'll be living under one roof! Will Chihiro accept the confession from Keigo, who has become like a stranger to Chihiro?

title: Hatsukoi Hajimemashita.
description:
A love story between an athletic boy and a serious girl who is inexperienced in love.  
  
Makino Himeko is a second year girl who belongs to the lower level of the social pyramid, is not interested in love or being the center of attention. That is, until popular student Kohai Haruki asks if he can fall in love with her.

title: Houkago no Aurora
description:
Manaka Saki, a popular high school student, falls in love at first sight with her Chemistry teacher, Tsuge Kousuke, after being saved from insistent upperclassmen suitors. Tsuke-sensei is popular amongst the students as a teacher and a handsome man. Manaka starts pursuing Tsusge-sensei until she finally becomes his secret girlfriend. There is only one condition: both of them have promised not to touch each other until she graduates.
Will they be able to keep their promise?
This story is included in the "Pinkscrap" volume.

title: Watashi no + Okusuri
description: Inori is an honor student in a witches' school. In order to pass her final exam to graduate, she has to make a "love potion." In order to make that "love potion," Inori lives in the same house with Aoi, in hopes to get him to fall in love with her (required for the "love potion.") The only problem is they don't get along at all! So how will Inori get Aoi to love her when he's always picking on her?!

title: Hanpirei no Kyori-kan
description: Akhir-akhir ini, perilaku Yuta, teman sekelas dan teman masa kecilnya Hina, terasa aneh. Itulah masalah terbesar Hina saat ini. Mata mereka tidak bertemu, dan mereka tidak bisa berbicara seperti dulu. Dulu, Yuta begitu kecil dan lucu seperti adik, tapi mengapa sekarang? Apakah aku melakukan sesuatu? Apa perasaan gelisah ini? Di sisi lain, Yuta memiliki rahasia yang tidak bisa dia katakan pada Hina? Dua pemula dalam cinta yang kikuk, menjauh dan mendekat!? Cinta muda yang penuh dengan kejutan dan kesedihan!

title: Symbiotism
description: Shimizu Hikari is the last surviving carrier of the deadly EXT-Virus. A disease stemming from the event known as; "First contact". With the constant threat of being sent back to the test-lab she was born in, join her as she attempts to find a life among us…

title: Haru wa Mijikashi Koiseyo Danshi.
description: The manga follows the lives and romantic pursuits of four high school boys, who all have no experience with romance.

title: Kindan no Koibito
description:
From Midnight Scans:  
  
1) Simple Kiss by WATANABE Ayu  
Once in a while, we kiss in secret. We are not lovers. We’re just “friends who kiss”. This was supposed to be a simple relationship, but…  
  
2) Guruguru Pon-chan Okawari by IKEZAWA Satomi  
With a miraculous invention, a small dog (male chihuahua) turns into a human! This is the interesting story of Sakura (human female) and a chihuahua living together!  
  
3) Akarui Mirai by MIYOSHI Maki  
To Sensei, I’m just a “student”, but to me, he’s a “man”. Although it’s not a love that is permitted, will this feeling of love that I have for Sensei ever reach him?  
  
4) Goodbye, Friend by KUMAOKA Fuyu  
Kyoko was confessed to by the guy her best friend likes. Although her friend is very important to her, and she definitely doesn’t want to lose her friendship with her, she can’t bring herself to break up with him…  
  
5) Kimi ni Tsugu Ishiko  
July 7th. I dye my hair and turn into my dead twin brother. Both my twin brother and I lov

title: Ice Cream Line
description: Kouta Natsumi had devoted himself to surfing, and after quitting he finds his days have become enjoyable but unexciting. Then, one day, he receives a gift from Michiru Oguri, the school’s honour student. Kouta becomes more aware of Michiru, but he can’t figure out Michiru’s feelings. With each summer, they close the distance between them, and before they know it, they find the other becoming special to them…

title: Love or Die
description:
If you want to live again, show me true love between two men?! Two guys that hate each other because of a car accident, must prove their worth with true love. They start a relationship to live again, but can they succeed in filling the angels criteria?

title: Hǎixiàn Diànchē
description: In our youth, we’ve had that moment where our hearts fluttered. If there is one person, who once shone so brightly in your life, who would be the first person you think of?

title: Sonomiya-san no Mukojijou
description:
Sonomiya Junrei, the student council president of a super-celebrity school, hates men. One day, Junrei was involved with a delinquent when she was attacked by a boy from another school, Koukou. She is saved by Chika Takase, a high school boy from another school. The dramatic encounter made her feel
Junrei almost felt a flash of excitement, but...

What kind of distance is he going to put between you and me when we first meet?

title: Nagai Gou no Vintage Mangakan
description: a Manga Autobiography about Go's Mangas.

title: Sorairo Koiiro
description:
1-3. Sorairo Koiiro  
Sora somehow ended up in a science class with all boys. Now, she's going to pitch in and help them enjoy school life by showing them her Girl Spirit!!  
  
4. Sakurairo Koiiro  
  
5. Sore demo Yappari Kimi ga Suki  
The energetic and cute Rin is actually an otaku! Unexpectedly, she meets a 3-dimensional boy with the same looks as her beloved, Chris-sama! Otaku love in full bloom.

title: Kyuujou no Charlotte
description: My step-sister, a foreign girl named Charlotte, suddenly arrived. She may seem shy at first glance, but her hobby is... watching baseball!? Let's go to a baseball game with my step-sister Charlotte, who is very pushy when it comes to baseball!

title: My First Love
description: Kang Bin, is a teacher who has never been in a relationship, but misses the opportunity and is transferred to his alma mater in his hometown. After an accident, he realizes that the place he wakes up to is his alma mater 15 years ago, and there he meets himself and his friends 15 years ago... and his first love. At first, he thought of this unbelievable situation as a dream, but he thinks it was a reality and an opportunity given by heaven. Unimaginable fantasy mystery romance!

title: Mizuiro Idea
description:
A light hearted comedy which revolves around the hearty efforts of Wakaba to make her dream come true. She becomes friends with Hidaga in the hopes that they can join the school's manga club. However, the manga club has not been active lately due to something that happened in the past and Hidaga seems to be hiding something too. Wakaba has plans for the manga club to ultimately achieve her dream. 

Note: Publication of the second volume was cancelled by the publisher. Chapters that could comprise the second volume are still available at Comic Walker website.

title: Mamotte! Lollipop
description: Junior high schooler Nina is ready to fall in love. She's looking for a boy who's cute and sweet and strong enough to support her when the chips are down. But what happens when Nina's dream comes truetwice? One day, two cute boys literally fall from the sky: they're both wizards and they've come to the Human World to take the Magic Exam. Their success on this test depends on protecting Nina from evil, so now Nina has a pair of cute magical boys chasing her everywhere she goes! One of these wizards just might be the boy of her dreamsbut which one?

title: Ouji Romantica
description:
1. Junjou Erotica (Pure Erotica)  
Heartbroken by her first love, senior high year 2 student Rika develops a fear of romance. One day, she finds out her first love's weak point! From then on, she starts her revenge…  
  
1.5. Passionate Erotica (not scanlated)  
  
2. Renai Teppen Shugi (Romance Summit Principle)  
The two most popular people in school, Rinko and Shirou, are pretending to be a couple to keep people from confessing to them. Rinko is slowly falling in love with Shirou, so what happens when someone finds out about their fake relationship?  
  
3. Romeo na Kanojo (My Girlfriend Is Romeo)  
Seiya was the prince of his school until a new girl, Ryou, transferred in. "If I can't win against her, my only other option is to make her fall for me!"  
  
4. Ouji to Kiss to Nemurihime (Prince & Kiss & Sleeping Beauty)  
Shiya has a phobia with boys. What can she do, but ask the almighty ?prince? of the school for help? The prince is shocked that this girl doesn?t like him, and decid

title: W.I.T.C.H
description:
Will has just moved to a new town and still feels insecure, but immediately makes friends with Taranee, Hay Lin, Cornelia, Irma and Elyon. However, this encounter changes everything.  
 Now that the order of the Infinite Kingdom of Kandrakar is disturbed and crisis is approaching, the adventure of the five chosen girls begin.

title: Sorairo Ageha
description:
When Ageha was younger, she watched a tennis game and was affected by a passionate young tennis player. Years later she was determined to become the number one tennis player and to join the tennis club in her new high school.  
Unexpectedly, on her first day of school, the person who sit next to her is none other than "the passionate young tennis player" Takeru. But this Takeru quit tennis long ago, and Ageha is determined to make him play again and establish the Tennis Club in their school and be the number one tennis player that will defeat the prodigy Takeru.  
Is her eager intention is enough to sway his decission? Will the Tennis Club in their school be ever establish? Is this the start of a new love on the tennis field?

title: Persona 4 - 100% Lovers
description: A doujin focusing on the relationship between the Persona 4 Hero and Chie Satonaka

title: Complex Tastes
description:
"You're the only one who can fix my complex!"

Su-jeong, a handsome boy who gains popularity with his mysterious atmosphere, suddenly visits the main character, Ma Eun-ha, and asks him to fix his huge xxx complex.

"Why must it be me?!" Eun-ha finally accepts the request because of Su-jeong's persistent attack, but this guy is crazy!! What is this awesome XXX?!
