title: Oyasumi Mae no Lemonade
description:
─…私立花ノ宮女学院。この学院には、”女の子の王子”と”姫”がいる。
”みんなの王子様”である真希と”高嶺の姫”ひまりの、不器用な恋のお話。

title: Shounen x Shoujo Shousetsuka: Danshi Koukousei no Kakushigoto
description: Yukihisa considers himself to be a normal high school student, but he has a secret in which he doesn't want anyone to know of or else he will be embarrassed to face his friends! He's actually a shoujo novelist!

title: Change! Sabu
description:
The two protagonists, the tomboy Chenji Yuri and Henmi Saburo, a wimp, crash into each other in the school showers, swapping each other's bodies. What will this newfound blessing bring?
Contains 2 bonus chapters for the manga "Hamaguri Dosse~!!"

title: Tomorrow's Blue Sky
description: Don’t mess with Ayu – she’s one of the top-ranked Karate club members in the region, although she does have one weakness; snakes. After one fight where she is unconscious because her opponent knows her weakness, and old friend shows up, a young man named Shunpei. He used to be a weakling, but now he may be even stronger than Ayu!

title: Akujiki's Meal
description: A weekly CoroCoro original series! Kyuuji-kun is a boy who is obsessed with cooking. Lately, a cute girl with a big appetite named Akujiki-san has caught his eye. But, could it be that Akujiki-san is hiding something...?

title: Vitamin C Vitamin D
description:
A complicated relationship sparks as a new transfer student, Dylan, meets Corey, a girl who's always mistaken as a guy. --- - [Original Webtoon ](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=56548270) --- - [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://toomics.com/tc/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://toomics.com/sc/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official Spanish Translation](https://toomics.com/mx/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official Portuguese Translation](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official Portuguese
Translation](https://toomics.com/br/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official Spanish Translation](https://toomics.com/es/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official German Translation](https://toomics.com/de/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official French Translation](https://toomics.com/fr/webtoon/episode/toon/5161) - [Official Italian Translation](https://toomics.com/it/webtoon/episode

title: 99% Cacao
description:
Sayu, a newbie when it comes to love, fell in love with the number one cold-hearted prince in school, Kanna…?!  
  
This is a compilation of three chapters of the popular series "99% Cacao" and "Yellow-eyed Fish," based on the original work by Satou Takako.  
  
Chocolate and tests are best when sweet! Also, if possible, love, too…

title: Gestalt
description: Akitsugu has been been in unrequited love with Kei, who only looks at Maya. After Akitsugu returns home from a party, he finds Kei in his room – but this "Kei" isn't the real Kei?! What will happen to both of them?

title: Nakigao ni Kiss
description:
I'm Narazaki Eori who is famous as a crybaby. I'm 17. This is the first time I fall in love and I'm being stuck with it. When I look at my beloved Yusuke, sometimes I daydream (?!) cry and smile.  
Eori is too busy for love. Lovey-dovey but in this love which is full of unpredictable things, you have risked your life, Eori!

title: Dare Nimo Naisho
description: Yui has a complex about being so short, and it doesn't help that the guy she likes, Keiji, likes to poke fun at her for it. If that's not bad enough, why is the beautiful model, Rena, doing in Keiji's house?!

title: Crescent Love
description:
The moon and the earth are linked by a single contact point, "Mitsuru ga Sakichau Ouren Rakuniushi" where Tatsuya lives under the supervision of the Sphere Kingdom (Moon Kingdom)'s Princess Feena Fam Earthlight who is coming to stay at his home.  
  
~There is also a 12 Episode Anime made of this~

title: Tottemo Love Voice
description: Everyday, Haruya looks forward to the announcement made by the school's library. He can't help but fall for the beautiful voice that comes from the intercom. Lone and behold he meets the voice's owner one day at the library. It belongs to a student in the same year called Takashina who is labeled as unapproachable and cold by other students. But that is not what Haruya sees when he first met Takashina. In fact, he wants to get know the person behind the voice even more.

title: Much Ado About Nothing
description:
Kawahara-sensei will start the short-term serialization "Much Ado About Nothing" in the January 2021 issue of Bessatsu Margaret, released on December 11th. It has also been announced that the series is a love story based on William Shakespeare's comedy.  
(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

title: Venus in Love
description:
It's spring!  
  
And for Suzuna, it's a new life that begins! She is officially a college student and finally has her own apartment!  
  
Right from the first day, it's love at first sight when she meets Fukami, one of the tennis club's members and best friend of her new neighbor, Eichi. In order to become closer to Fukami, she doesn't hesitate and signs up as well, but she finds herself with quite an unexpected rival!

title: Takane to Oni wa Kakushitai
description: A powerful romantic comedy about a former-delinquent girl who just wants to make friends and a tough-looking boy who gets misunderstood because of his appearance. This is the story of the two who are complete opposites as they make their high school debut.

title: Modotte! Mamotte! Lollipop
description:
Nina, Zero, and Ichii are back! This time for the Advanced Magic test! The object of the test is–yet again–a crystal drop that looks like candy! When Nina accidentally swallows it (again!), it's up to Zero and Ichii to protect her until it comes out. The only trouble is, all the past participants are back, and only little fragments of the crystal drop will come out of Nina at a time!  
  
Oneshot included: Milcute vs Lollipop

title: Tea Cup Toy Boy
description: 17-year-old Kento Toi awakes one morning to find he's shrunk down to the size of a doll, but his doctor says he's in perfect health… Except for one thing: Kento's love for an older boy at school has made his heart grow bigger, which could be perilous! Now, he's got to either get a boyfriend or get shot down, or the swelling could be his doom! Talk about an awkward first crush! Not to mention, his childhood friend Yuki seems to have something in mind for Kento as well…

title: K-ON! - Valentine (Doujinshi)
description: Azusa x Yui

title: Teasing Master Takagi-san (Continue)-Fan Manga (Doujinshi)
description:
A fan-translated ver of a fan-made doujinshi of “Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san” by A Chinese Takagi-san Fan/Artist.

*In this fan series, Takagi and Nishikata are lover.
---

Original work Desc:

***If you blush, you lose!***

Living by this principle, the middle schooler Nishikata gets constantly made fun of by his seat neighbor Takagi-san. With his pride shattered to pieces, he vows to turn the tables and get back at her some day.

And so, he attempts to tease her day after day, only to find himself victim to Takagi-san's ridicule again sooner than later. Will he be able to make Takagi-san blush from embarrassment even once in the end?

title: Asahi Ojo-sama and Kashima-kun
description: One day, Kashima yu, a poor student who is one step closer to repeating a grade, is asked by Asoya Asahi, a super-rich lady living in the neighboring town, for support to cure her Androphobia . he was blinded by the money and decided to work in her place of residence, but he received unreasonable demands from the naive Asahi. The first romantic comedy about the gap between a poor student and a young lady drawn by a super beautiful artist

title: Nurse Angel Ririka SOS
description: Ririka is an average student that can, in fact, transform into "Nurse Angel" by using a special nurse-like hat given to her by her senpai Kanou (who is, in fact, from another dimension/world connected to this one). Ririka's fellow classmate and neighbor is Seiya, who follows her and helps her as much as he can.

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - You Are Mine (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine have finally entered into a relationship after three years of maintaining a friendly rivalry at Seisho Academy. As they're about to cross the line into more intimate territory, Maya is startled by Claudine's sudden tears and worries that she might have overstepped.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Karin to.
description: Oosawa Junpei is what people considered a loser–an astronomy geek with bad grades, and he's also terrible at sports. Although it seems impossible, he is working around trying to get together with Kido Karin, his longtime crush. Unfortunately for him, Karin has a perfect twin brother, who is a skilled player in the Junior Japanese soccer league, a top student, and of course, he's also good looking. Out of nowhere, Karin asks Junpei to go to the planetarium with her, and Junpei is caught peeping into Karin's change room with the telescope by Karin's twin brother. He is then brought up to the roof where there is an alchemy circle drawn…

title: Tough Mate
description:
Kihyun ends up in the school dorms after his family loses all their money. But his dream of being successful studying silently is destroyed by Go Seungjo, who always leads a group of journalists. Go Seungjo is the son of the president and the little brother of a celebrity. Due to Seungjo's uniqueness and superiority, Kihyun faces all kinds of suffering, shame, insults and problems...

---
- [Original Webtoon <Lezhin>](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/sapo_roommate)

- [Original Webtoon <Naver>](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6039486)

- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=51187746)

- [Original Webtoon <BookCube>](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=180214)

- [Original Webtoon <Bomtoon>](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/tough_mate)

- [Original Webtoon <Comico>](https://www.comico.kr/comic/3109)

title: Ano Ko to Boku no Ie
description:
A collection of oneshots stories.  
  
I am a dog and my name is Kai. I love a 2nd-year, but I don't know what she thinks of me. Humans do not always say what they think. Only a few words could change the whole matter. If I could speak a word, I would confess my love to her.  
  
[PL] Zbiór 4 historii o miłości. Nie są one takie zwykłe, ponieważ pokazują ludzkie związki z punktu widzenia psa.

title: Kanata Kakeru
description: 6th grader Haruto Nagino is the son of an inn owner in Hakone, a town that is famous for hosting the annual [Hakone Ekiden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hakone_Ekiden). His daily mundane life suddenly changes after the arrival of a transfer student named Kanata Sakuraba. She is a weird girl that likes to "chase people's back" and somehow Haruto can't take his eyes off her.

title: Valentine's Day for the New Couple
Sakura no Himegoto
description: Narinomiya Aoi, the daughter of a distinguished family, has a secret. Thanks to her grandfather's debts, she's now the "pet" of Katsuragi Kei, a rebellious new student at their prestigious academy. How will she escape the burden of the debts and what exactly is Kei actually after?

title: Sensei wa Warui Ko
description: The kind and popular homeroom teacher, Yoshino-sensei (more popularly known as Yoshino-kun) is actually a mean, black hearted sensei! Minami accidentally finds out how he's really like and are now subjected to his mercy and thus begins a sadistic romance!

title: Kuchibiru ni Uta o: 15-nengo no kimi e
description:
Nazuna has an immense dislike for men because her father left due to an affair. She starts to believe that all boys like hot teachers. The relationship between her and childhood friend Keisuke goes south when he says something about their hot chorus teacher!   
  
Can they fix their relationship between themselves? Find out in this oneshot by Chiba-sensei!

title: Katakoi Drops
description:
Sanae, positive minded and super beautiful, always popular among men, and Taishi who is the ace of Track&Field casually gentle with girls and popular among girls. Ordinary girl Yui, is proud to be both of their childhood friend. Yui had feelings for Taishi since a while back but kept to her heart since she didn't want to break the relationship that the 3 had. One day, Sanae told Yui "I love Taishi" Yui promise's Sanae that she will cheer them on and….?!  
  
Includes one-shots:  
  
Suki dake ja Wakaranai  
Fujisaki fell in love at first sight with Nakamura-kun after he helped her out of an embarrassing situation. Fujisaki wants to be more lovey-dovey with Nakamura-kun however he is known for being the ‘antisocial king’!!!  
  
Darling I Love You  
Chiho has always loved Ryouhei but Ryouhei has never even shown a hint of liking her back. What does Chiho have to do to make him turn her way, even if it’s just a little…

title: Koi, Hirari
description:
The food loving and pure-hearted Sumire Misaki´s family is moving to the same town where her mother and father met and fell in love. Sumire´s mother tells her that its a town where she will fall in love, and she meets her first love in a very unexpected way: the good-looking Kazuki Miyamoto, as he tries to escape from his home. Through an unfortunate set of events, the wheels of fate have begun to turn for Sumire, as Kazuki is more than he appears to be.  
  
In fact, he is a traditional dancer. Will Sumire´s first love be a happy one? Or does a bumpy road await her?

title: Gyutto Shite Chuu
description: Mai Kojima is a slightly ditzy sixteen-year-old, but she’s gotten her first boyfriend! They’ve been dating for three months. Even though they should be at their most lovey-dovey, they haven’t been able to make out at all… That’s because her boyfriend Yu-kun is a super exam-taking student aiming for Tokyo University. Every day is an uneasy one, without much hugging or kissing.

title: Devil's Bride
description:
Jeong-Hwan received a letter from his sister Ji-Yeong that said, "Please rescue me, the devil is here!"  
  
His sister goes to an all-girls school and in order to rescue her, he must disguise himself as a female student. In this school, all students are candidates to become "the bride of the devil."

title: Kagehinata
description: This is a story about a pair of twins who're, undeniably very different from one another. Big brother Shuuya and little brother Yuuta are basically light and shadow…

title: Koi no Dracula
description: Natsuo recently got a hot private tutor for his upcoming entrance exams. But there's something funny about Miss Hibiya that he just can't put his finger on. Miss Hibiya helps Natsuo on both his exam and his love life at school.

title: The Mermaid's Head
description:
A collection of mermaid themed horror stories

1- 人魚の首 (The Mermaid's Head): Maki is shy and quiet, and after having her secret crush stolen by her friend, Rumi, Maki started holding a grudge and in her dreams, a mermaid constantly whispers to her, "Maki, eat me... And you'll become beautiful…"!
2- セイレーン ~人魚の歌声~ (Siren ~The Mermaid's Singing Voice~)
3- 人魚のいる海 (The Sea where Mermaids Live)
4- 花の名前 (The Flower's Name)
5- 夢のつづき (The Dream Continues)

title: Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana
description:
1-4) Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana  
Yuuri has always been attached to his childhood friend and neighborhood Onii-san; Aki. With a certain fondness for his friend, he enrolls in the same college where Aki is working as a lecturer. Yuuri immediately falls into the position of Aki's personal caretaker and not before long, he comes to realize that there is more to their relationship than he understands. Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana is a story of the delicate balance between friendship and love.  
  
5) Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana Extra  
Aki and Yuuri are trying to come to terms with their relationship and where to draw their lines.  
  
6) Shake  
Continuation of chapter 5 of Koi no Shizuku.  
  
7) One-pager  
The academics go on an onsen trip.

title: Silver
description:
Geraldine Francis is the innocent daughter of a wealthy aristocrat. Being sheltered all her life, she is oblivious to her cousin Charles' true intentions when he lures her in and makes her fall hopelessly in love with him. It is only after the murder of her father that she realizes his love was nothing but love for the money and the land that came with her name. She vows revenge, and she throws away her past in order to become "Silver," the perfect woman. With a new face, and a new lease on life, she will turn the tables on the man whom she once loved so that this time, it is he who will be left with nothing.  
  
Adaptation of English fiction Silver by Penny Jordan.

title: Kimi ni Chiisana Uso Hitotsu
description:
Chise and Akari are twins. They are so identical in appearance that people around them cannot tell them apart except for their parents and their childhood friend, Mayuki. The two sisters however, have their own personalities. Chise is shy and timid, making her unapproachable; Akari in contrast, is energetic and expressive, making her popular amongst boys in their school. But since they are so identical, boys often confess to Chise by mistaking her as Akari.  
  
  
Akari doesn't show interest in the boys who intend to confess to her and Chise got used to it—being mistaken as her sister. There is just one thing that shakes their two small worlds though—Mayuki's attention. Deep inside a voice whispers to a heart "Why did there have to be two of us? God is so cruel…"

title: The Witch of 2-A
description: Fuka Nanase, a 14-year-old in the 8th grade, falls in love for the first time. But when her heart beats, she becomes a witch!?

title: Sikeum Saekeum
description:
"It's a blessing that there is a person who listens to my story."  
Not an ordinary, but an ordinary romance comic.

title: Joou-sama no Tamago
description: Mia is a princess of the country where people are either masochistic (M) or sadistic (S), but generally only royalty is (S). Her daily duties consist of insulting, stepping on and generally bullying her people, and they're all happy about it! But the day comes when Mia has to transfer to a foreign country for a year to study there. The only problem is…. people there are normal. When Mia changes schools the (S) and (M) hilarity begins!

title: Sweet Sweet Revenge
description: Hikari Minamoto is here for one reason: Revenge. She's after five most popular guys in school...who have given her every reason to take them down. Never mind that they're handsome and accomplished. Will she succeed, or will even the cool-hearted queen of revenge be compromised...?!

title: Ojou-sama no Gohoubi
description:
1-3. Ojousama no Gohoubi  
Rika is pretty, intelligent, and attracts the attention of all students. As her house was collapsed, she came to live with Mitsuru's family. Mitsuru, who is a babe in the woods, tries to approach Rika repeatedly, but she regards him as a fool. Love is unpredictable, however. Rika finds it difficult to keep her virtue.  
  
4. Kimi no Te  
Kanzaki Aoi is a third year at junior high, whom is a vice president at judo club. She is popular with many girls due to her manliness and no one can beat her in judo, except for the president himself, Takamiya Yuu, who is a big flirt! An incident with a bra had suddenly made them closer, making Aoi fall for him?  
  
5. I Want to Be with You  
  
6. Don't Look!

title: Marvelous Melmo
description:
A fantasy story for kids featuring a girl named Melmo, who can change her age as she wishes by eating special candies.  
  
Melmo's mother dies in a traffic accident, leaving young Melmo and her younger brother Totoo. Anxious, Melmo's mother in heaven asks God to prepare some magical candies, and hands them to Melmo.  
There are two kinds: Melmo can grow 10 years older to become any sort of adult she wishes by eating a blue candy. By eating a red one, she can become 10 years younger.  
  
Using these miracle candies, Melmo disguises herself as a nurse, schoolteacher, policewoman, and overcomes troubles together with her brother, Totoo.

---
**Volume 280 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Konna Hatsukoi
description:
A collestion of short stories.  
  
1-3. Konna Hatsukoi  
The super shy Kashiwagi Makoto from the student council has never been in love before. Although she thinks the popular new student Yanase Yutaka-kun is quite unapproachable, she comes in direct contact with him one day as a part of her student council duties?  
  
4. Kirai Uta  
Riko has always liked her friend Mori Yuuma, but whenever they're around each other they just argue and bicker. Will she be able to tell him how she feels before graduation?  
  
5. Kimi Daruma.  
It’s almost Christmas, and Yukine wants to show Touma how thankful she is for having a boyfriend like him. She decides to plan their Christmas date and the both of them are expecting it to be a wonderful time!  
  
6. Ano Okata no Tansho  
  
7. Kimi wo Mamoru Hana  
  
8. Omikuji no Usotsuki

title: Teasing Master Takagi-san - Wedding - Fan Manga (Doujinshi)
description:
A fan-translated ver of a fan-made one-shot doujinshi of “Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san” by A Chinese Takagi-san Fan/Artist.

---

Original work Desc:

***If you blush, you lose!***

Living by this principle, the middle schooler Nishikata gets constantly made fun of by his seat neighbor Takagi-san. With his pride shattered to pieces, he vows to turn the tables and get back at her some day.

And so, he attempts to tease her day after day, only to find himself victim to Takagi-san's ridicule again sooner than later. Will he be able to make Takagi-san blush from embarrassment even once in the end?

---

*User @AuroainicQ and group "TKGstar" have obtained permission from the author to release Chinese Raw.

title: Kocchi Muite! Miiko
description:
The very funny and cute stories of elementary school girl Miko will bring readers back to the beautiful and sweet childhood years.

---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by m&c! Comics as **Hai, Miiko!** (2003)

title: Aqua Age
description:
We follow the life of Kawai Yuuko beginning in junior high. Throughout the passing years, we see her grow up and sort out her life with her friends, her parents and her love.



---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **The Aqua Age** (1998)

title: The Aesthetic of Good Looking
description:
“Hyung is pretty.” Even after being warned not to, Hong Seowoo, overdoes it and gets drunk at his club’s welcoming party. The next day, he wakes up in the clubroom and realizes that not only did he miss his morning class, but while he was asleep…he’s been holding hands with a stranger, who also happens to be a man — one of the club’s new recruits and Seowoo’s junior, Baek Dohyeon. Drawn into joining the club after seeing him, Dohyeon plans on gaining Seowoo’s affections, even if it is proving to be quite the challenge.   
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

title: Idejuu!
description: Hayashida is a first year student in Ide high school. He joins a judo club, only to find out that it has no second year members and is on the verge of being closed down. After becoming the new captain, he decides to bring the once famous club back to it's glory. The task may be a tough one, taking into consideration the remaining club members - ecchi king Kawamura, bigsized Miura and obscene Fujiwara.

title: Ume ni Uguisu
description: Ume-chan harbours a huge crush on Isezaki-kun, a boy in her class. She spends a lot of her time writing about him in her notebook, and is content with her unrequited love… since Isezaki already has a kind and pretty girlfriend. One day, however, Isezaki asks Ume-chan if he can borrow her notes. To her horror, she realizes belatedly that she’s given him the wrong book! By the time she finds him, he is already reading the contents of her secret notebook. However, not only is Isezaki extremely nice about it, he even offers to be friends. But when the news that Isezaki has broken up with his girlfriend comes around, Ume-chan begins to think that this could be her big chance.

title: Kaname Étoile
description:
Will Kaname's destiny as ballerina change?  
  
Because she wished to become a great ballerina, Kaname followed Miki-sama and entered in the prestigious ballet of her school. Kaname will secretly develop her talent as ballerina there.  
  
The volume contains 2 additional stories:  
- Futari, Kataomoi  
- Kimi ni Zettai Koufuku

title: Kataomoi no Mukougawa
description:
- Kataomoi no Mukougawa  
Azusa knew the boy in the library was already in love… So what can she do when she starts to fall for him?  
- Which Scanlations  
  
- Ano Kado o Magareba  
It’s summertime, and Kako is sick of the heat. She is feeling restless, and she wants to find a guy to fall in love with. Kako is actually desperate enough that she tells herself that she will try to fall for the next guy to walk through a nearby doorway. Fortunately, the guy who appears is really cute! Kako doesn’t know him. Can she fall for this guy? But already, her heart is pounding…  
  
- Tenshi ga Kuretamono  
Miyuki is working at a convenience store. One day, on Christmas Eve, an interesting guy comes in and asks for job at the store. They do, but the hours are really bad (evening shift). That-disappointed-guy then talks to Miyuki and knows she's single. The guy suddenly asks her to go out with him! She feels she can't go out with a stranger, no matter how cute he is, and no matter how persistent

title: Sagesumareta Reijou wa, Daini no Jinsei de Akogare no Renkinjutsushi no Michi wo Erabu ~Yume wo Kanaeta Minarai Renkinjutsushi no Dai Ippo~
description:
Meer, who works at the guild reception desk, witnesses her fiancé cheating on her just before retiring. After breaking off her engagement, she receives an unexpected offer to become the "court alchemist's assistant"!?

*Source: Kadokawa, translated*

title: Shoujo no Melancholy
description:
"I want to become her friend."  
"I want to see that person again."  
"I don't want to grow up yet."  
"If it was me, I wouldn't make her cry."  
Our every day is full of pure and sparkling feelings…

title: Overnourished
description: Zhong Yi came across a young man eating in the restroom, his name is Rong Mian, and he's another male lead in his upcoming new drama. Rong Mian is a cool black-haired beautiful boy. But now he's holding a spoon and eating cat canned food? A story about a narcissistic but reliable person and a cat shapeshifter, who enjoys eating cat canned food.

title: Kimikoi - Gakusei-hen (Anthology)
description:
1: Kinoshita Keiko 『恋とは不思議なものだから』  
2: Kojima Lalako 『ハレルヤ ベイビー』  
3: Nekono Mariko 『消しゴム彼氏』  
4: Tsukahara Saki 『君に想ふ、碧』  
5: Takagi Yuna 『THE 普通の恋人』  
6: Maria 『思惑いろは』  
7: Tagura Tohru 『のみ×しば』  
8: Kurito Natsu 『囚われ少年』  
9: Kisaragi Ai 『ワンダフル☆アニキ』
An anthology ran alongside with [Kimikoi - Shakaijin-hen](https://mangadex.org/title/33ff16cb-3fb1-4bed-b621-63e729044499/kimikoi-shakaijin-hen)

title: Lingerie Logic
description: Yuzu has always been a tomboy so she is worried that other girls will make fun of her underwear during the class trip. Without a second thought she asks her male friend, Ken, to help her chose better lingerie. However, right after this, Yuzu can't understand why she can't act like usual around him anymore.

title: Beyond Memory
description: Won Jun can read people's feelings if touching them. Ku Han, a colleague in the same program, tries to ignore Won Jun, which makes him suspicious. Won Jun try to read the feeling, but fails. What will happen between those two?

title: Futsu Hyakkei
description:
In these super ordinary days something unexpected happened?  
  
Mirutsuki is shocked when Fujiyama suddenly approaches her with an unusual request: The smartest, most popular guy wants to observe her, the most average girl? What could be the reason for his strange behavior?

title: Suki Nante Ienai
description:
She was in her last year of middle school, he was in the 1st year of high school.  
She met him at the basketball match for the first time. He was so amazing, she fell in love at first sight and decided to enter the same high school he's going to.  
After she managed to get into Shuuei Institute, she expects her happy love life to begin but… what if the guy she liked was held back a year?! And what if he told her to "never come near him again"?! No worries, Tachibana Riri will not give up!

title: Hapi Kisu
description:
Kurata Mugi is unlucky, even on her supposedly lucky day she manages to attract a lot of unfortunate situations. One of them is lending her umbrella to a perfect stranger and catching a cold herself. Turns out this stranger is a school mate of hers who tells her that there is no use in waiting around to get lucky - rather luck is something you actively take for yourself. Now, what will Mugi make of that?   
  
Trama: Mugi è una ragazza perseguitata dalla sfortuna. Hinata invece ha successo in tutto quello che fa… A cosa portera' il loro improvviso incontro?!

title: Ojousama no Himitsu
description:
From Intercross:  
  
After transfering from an elite girls school, Haru, by her expression and manner, is seen by many as an 'Ojou-sama'. But in truth Haru really is a countryside chick with a fierce attitude! Though she tries not be discovered, she is seen in an unlikely situation by none other but a classmate, Nagase! Thinking she is done for she tries to ‘beat’ her way out of the situation but instead Nagase…?!  
  
Includes 3 extra stories:  
  
- Ultimate Boyfriend and Addicted Girlfriend  
Chisako is dating Akiomi, the public morals committee's leader. Due to his strict nature, Chisako hides the fact that she was a former yankee. Will their relationship work?  
  
- Top Secret Boyfriend and Jealous Girlfriend  
A continuation of Chisako and Akiomi's story.  
  
- Pure Strange

title: Wakusei Honey
description: Nagahara Kisara can read thoughts. Miura-kun is a popular guy, apparently normal, but with unknown feelings for all... Do Kisara unveil?

title: Kenja no Gotoku
description: Solitude nurtures talent… Sadaharu, a high school student, lived a cautious academic life, admiring and aspiring to become like the great historical figures. But then, someone appears who threatens to disrupt his carefully ordered world…?! (MANGA Plus)

title: Sok-ajugo Sipeo
description: Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

title: Magi-Cu 4-koma: Corpse Party
description: A collection of romantic comedy-themed four-paneled comic strips involving the cast of characters from the Corpse Party series.

title: Lies Lies Lies
description: Kim Nam-joo decides to live a normal life in high school, leaving behind the dark history of the heavy 2nd disease. However, from the first day of the new semester, unbelievable things unfolded without his determination! Yesung, a high school goddess who turns into a child when her original personality comes out, Joo-Hyeon, a crushed love and a high school goddess with a high affinity, and Senior Yunha, who seduces her from her first encounter with an infinite offensive of affection. Each of the three high school girls surrounding Kim Nam-ju had a'witch's curse'? Breathtaking ♥ High school comedy, start!

title: Risou no Koibito
description:
In the Risou no Koibito series:  
  
V.1 - Risou no Koibito (Ideal Lover)  
  
Riku suffered a traumatizing experience after coming out and has since chosen to avoid love. That is until the super-confident and dominating pretty-boy, Yoshimi, walks into his life. He deliberately targets Riku's weaknesses, but what are his true intentions?  
  
This is a story of discipline, guidance and affection that fills both the heart and body of the handsome and brutish Yoshimi and the naturally timid Riku.  
  
6. Furueru Te no Saki (Before Trembling Hands)  
They were friends in high school. Now that they are university students, Kou and Ichi have become a pair of rather dysfunctional lovers. Kou enjoys making Ichi jealous and often keeps him at arm's length. But what will Kou do now that a new kid has captured Ichi's gaze?  
  
V.2 - Risou no Yuuwaku (Temptation of an Ideal)

title: The Prince Can't Do It Alone
description: "Even women... Need to unwind, right?" The sweet voice echoing in my ears, the boy next to me with a raised body temperature... When adolescent men and women watch porn together, you shouldn't expect it to end without incident!

title: Tonari no Megane Ouji to Yankee to!
description: After getting away from her hometown - and her delinquent brother who basically ran the place - Yui is living it up at university. There, she falls for a cool, handsome (same difference!) Prince Charming in glasses who is the total opposite of her idiot brother, but unexpectedly her prince’s friend is a delinquent!? On top of that, he’s always getting in her way!! Just as she thinks it’s all over for her, in more ways than one, she discovers that her prince in glasses lives in the apartment next door!?

title: Hitai ni Mikazuki
description: Ten years ago, Yutaka followed Azusa but ended up falling from a tree. Because of that, she has a moon shaped scar on her forehead. Then the two separated, but when he came back, he was a shinobi!

title: Renai Junkie
description:
Renai Junkie  
Haruki was betrayed by his girlfriend Kiyuka and his best friend Ikeda. After retreating from them, he starts to become friends with Atsushi, one of the most popular guys in school. After a conversation with Atsushi, he realizes the mistakes he made. He reconciles with Ikeda and accepts his relationship with Kiyuka. Atsushi who eavesdropped on their conversation offers to take care of Haruki. They become very close and Haruki realizes that he's fallen in love with Atsushi. How will their relationship develop?  
  
Shadow  
Arata and Yoshiki are childhood friends. Yoshiki had an accident when he was still a kid, his genitalia did not develop after that and he cannot get an erection or ejaculate. The two friends have feelings for each other but things get messy when they start to explore them…

title: Came the Mirror - Rumiko Takahashi Short Story Collection
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Another Side of the Rumic World unlike "RINNE" or "Rumic Theater"!　

Black, pure, mysterious, and humorous! Works made from 1999 to 2014 are almost all included in the tankobon for the first time! 
Included works: 
- **Came the Mirror** (鏡が来た, Kagami ga Kita) 
- **Revenge Doll** (リベンジドール)
- **The Star with 1000 Faces** (星は千の顔, Hoshi ha Sen no Hao)
- **Lovely Flower** (可愛い花, Kawaii Hana, ALT. ENG. - Cute Flower)
- **with CAT** 
- **My Sweet Sunday** (マイスイートサンデー) - Collaboration with Mitsuru Adachi

title: Nine Puzzle
description:
Mika is a regular girl who just goes day to day without any concrete dreams for her future. Until one day, when she sees her classmate Kaede playing pool in a billiards lounge. Kaede is a boy who hides many secrets… whose personality seems to change when he plays billiards. Entranced by the smile Kaede wears when he plays, Mika soon finds herself immersed in the game…!  
  
Also contains the following short stories:  
  
- Platinum in vol. 1  
- Ichigo Namida (Strawberry Tears) in vol.2  
- Wakasama no Jijou (The Youth's Circumstance) in vol. 2

title: Heart no Diamond
description: Himeno's chest hurts if any boy touches her because her heart is a diamond. However, when she was young, she befriended two boys: gentle Mamoru and blunt Keigo, who could touch her without harming her. Without knowing about her diamond, both Mamoru and Keigo promised to protect Himeno. When some people threaten to take Himeno's heart, who else will protect her but her knights?

title: Inukano
description: Inukai is a girl who is like a dog: she's affable, lively and straightforward. Nekoi is an attractive boy who is like a cat: shy, quiet and dedicated to his hobbies. This is their love story.

title: Irodzuichau Futari
description: A shy expression... It's sometimes sexy and shoots through the hearts of men. But that feeling is the same for women! Moko Umekan's first serialized work, which depicts a girl who is at the mercy of such a blushing boy, is about to begin!

title: Spring up, spring breeze
description:
Mei is often compared to her talented older brother and sister wherever she goes, and in middle school she wants to find something uniquely her own. Meanwhile, when she goes to observe the volleyball club, she meets Akatsuki, a senior who sees her for the first time...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Otherworld Barbara
description:
(from ebookjapan):

The year is 2052. Tokio Watarai, a "dream guide" who can enter other people's dreams, takes on the job of searching the dreams of Aoba Jujo, a girl who has been asleep for seven years since a certain incident. 

And with the name of the island where Aoba lives happily in her dream, "Barbara", unexpected facts begin to appear one after another...?

[Official English](https://www.fantagraphics.com/products/otherworld-barbara-vol-1)

---
- **Won the Japan SF Taisho Grand Prize in 2006**

title: Look at Me
description: Silent manga about a good looking girl and the guy that never looks at her.

title: Kira Kira 100%
description: Miku is an ordinary girl, who has a crush on her classmate Shibutani-kun. Miku doesn't have confidence in herself, and holds her feelings inside. But one day, after a makeover with the help of her guy friend Yuutenji, she ends up confessing her love to Shibutani-kun!

title: Kara no Shounen
description:
1) Sunny Spots Typhoon  
Kusakabe Kaoru is the prince of the school that all the girls want. But he has a secret that he doesn't want any one to know: Since his mom's death, he's been house-bound taking care of his three younger siblings and father.  
  
2) Dawn in Eden  
During the summer, Hibiya Madoka, Azuma Tatsuki, Mizuse Miwa and Nakayama Kotaro must go to cram school. Knowing that Miwa and Tatsuki both have mutual love, Madoka liking Tatsuki (but they are only partners) and Madoka and Tatsuki both hating Kotarou. How will they manage to survive on an inhabited island that they just have been stranded on?  
  
3) Empty Boy  
A boy called Ao, who hates humans, has one secret. When he touches someone’s naked skin, he can wipe out all memories of himself. But then he becomes close with his classmate Akane and gradually starts to want to touch her…?!  
  
4) Pinocchio Dreams  
Fubuki's dog, Chloe, gets hit by a car. Kio spots her and tells her to come with him to save Chloe. After To

title: Shijou Yamato no First Lady
description: Junka Sato is a high school girl who works as a maid for the Shijo family, a prominent family that has produced politicians for generations. Junko meets the Shijo family's unique sons, including Yamato, who is rumored to be a "useless eldest son," as well as the sons of the incumbent minister.

title: Ai no Kotoba mo Shiranaide
description:
1-3: What Is Love?  
Kojima, the student body vice president, always strives to be number one at everything in school. He normally gets along with the carefree Kurata… until one day Kojima snaps and forces Kurata to have sex with him. So starts their S&M relationship – or is it love…?  
  
4-6: You Are The Worst  
Hiroto and Kota's parents suddenly get married and the pair are forced to play nice and be the perfect brothers, but will it really work?

title: Night Walk Faraway
description: A young girl answers the door late at night and looks up to see a very, very tall man standing before her.

title: Riso no Seito Kaicho!?
description: Sakiho is an ordinary first-year high schooler who is designated as a member of the student council by the charismatic Itsuki Yagami, head of the said council, which is full with ikemen such as Ogihara, the leader of the Ballet Club, or Ishuuin, the successor of a tea ceremony school. Her life at school is about to be turned upside down! What’s more, she gets a glimpse at the real face of the seemingly always calm and cool Yagami… and thus a love story begins!

title: Kono Mama ja Dame Mitai desu
description: Kouga Nagahisa never tries his hardest in life and he's in love with the prettiest girl Hananoi Mizuki. Mizuki has her childhood friend Kusakabe Riki who is the star of the basketball team. When Nagahisa gets home after school, he's in for a surprise.

title: Genius House
description: “Private Shiratori Academy is a very prestigious school that strongly encourages its students to develop their own capabilities.” And the best students, four teen geniuses, live in the Meisen Dorm. But their sickly dorm manager is replaced by her granddaughter–a first-year high-school student. Kamiya Makota is dismayed by the boys’ imperious demands, and the jealousy of her classmates. Can Kamiya trust these brainy hooligans? And can she even trust herself to do the job?

title: Kawaii Hito.
description: Manaka feels awkward being with Sasaki, as he seems to avoid her. When their hands accidentally touched, Manaka sees a completely different face of Sasaki.

title: Futari Pocchi: Together Alone
description:
Kaoru Matsubara, a common girl, and Reiko Higaki, a girl from a zaibatsu family, are two girls who attend the prestigious Aisei Girls College. They are complete opposites in their upbringing and personalities, and can hardly stand each other. However, when their parents remarry, they become sisters! The two clash and quarrel, but gradually come to an understanding, and many complicated feelings begin to emerge as they develop a bond... Riyoko Ikeda delicately depicts the emotional turmoil of adolescent girls as they face the absurdities of the world on a journey that can only be embarked by the two of them alone!

Note: Also contains the one-shot Gomennasai: Ryoko Hagiwara, an elementary school girl, decides to stand up for Yasue Yamada, an impoverished girl in her class. Little did she know the harsh reality awaiting her... A work that frankly depicts class divide and privilege, and how children emulate the practices and discrimination of adults.

title: Hensachi 30 Gal to Gariben Inkya na Ore.
description: Eiji has been studying by himself, telling himself that. One day, a gal named Aoi appears in front of him and asks him to "Teach me how to study!" Eiji tries to refuse, but he finds that his family is not interested in his studies. Eiji tries to refuse, but he is taken to a family restaurant where Aoi teaches him how to study.

title: Hey! Be More Confident
description: Gu Ge just returned home to meet the girl that’s always on his mind, Bai Yu, who’s unable to recognize him due to her suffering from face recognition loss. After a few days of getting along, Gu Ge found that she is no longer as cheerful and lively as before. Why did she lose her light, and what has she experienced over the years? The girl who suffers from prosopagnosia and the boy who sets his mind to heal it. When we were young, it was you who taught me about self-confidence. Now, it’s time for me to teach you. Hey! Be more confident. A redemption story is about to unfold.

title: Aria at Dawn
description:
Tokyo, Taisho era (1912-1926). 
Aria Kaibara, who wishes to become a pianist, takes the exams to become a preparatory student at the Tokyo Music School. 
The passion in her playing overwhelms her surroundings, like a ripple on the surface of water. 
It is then that Aria has an encounter with the son of the Nishimikado noble family, Natsuo, and learns a shocking truth… 
The youth of a maiden blessed by the god of music in this stream of musical romance!

title: Oshipi Shoukougun
description: Ria is a big fan of "Uyu-sama" immediately after Uyu suddenly announced that he was going on hiatus, a new student, Yutaka, arrives...and it turns out to be Uyu himself! Ria is shocked to see that he is a different person from the one she saw in the video, but she can't help but hate him because she is in love with him for the first time. Seeing her, Uyu somehow recruits Ria to be his manager...?

title: Futorase JK Kohane chan
description: 美少女として話題になっている転校生・雪平こはねに呼び出された男子・前田遥稀は教室に軟禁され、大量の料理を食べ切るまでは解放しないと脅される。何が目的かわからず動揺する遥稀に犯人・こはねは、太っている人が好きという性癖を告白。こはねに弱みを握られてしまった遥稀は、彼女に「全人類太らせ計画」への協力を強要される。

title: Kore kara Hajimaru Koi o Oshiete
description:
The story is a bit the usual: childhood friends, forced marriage, teacher-student but they are in college, and living together but kept it a secret.  
  
"There are a lot of things that I don’t know, whether it is about myself or about yours. Even love is no exception, so please can you teach me everything?"  
  
(Source: tatsukida.blogspot)  
  
Included one-shots:  
Volume 2: Ame dake ga Shitteiru  
Volume 4: Watashi no Unmei 7-kakan

title: Dice
description: 2nd year Junior High schooler, Misaki is in love with Mutou-kun in her class. But somehow, the one he likes is the class idol, Kuririn. However, Misaki doesn't need to be depressed. She's got other options…!?

title: Oshikare Shimazaki-kun
description:
Kuchinashi Kouko has set up a solo activity club to enjoy her alone time. The club's activities include gazing at her favorite person.
Just when she thinks she has gotten the club room she has longed for, she is somehow accompanied by her favorite, Shimazaki-kun!

title: Noisy Girl
description: Matsuka Ryou is a school girl who doesn't seem to take life seriously. She dreams of growing up and becoming a wanderer or a minstrel. She's the adviser and sole member of the light music club (although it's not really a club). However when she picks up a key that a teacher drops, a whole new world is opened up to her…

title: Suki na Ko ga Megane wo Wasureta (Fan Colored)
description: Una historia simple pero agradable... Los días normales de Komura-kun, quien ayuda a su compañera Mie-san, la cual tiene que usar lentes y siempre termina olvidándolos o hay algún suceso que evita su visibilidad... Estos sucesos los llevarán a entablar una amistad y también podría llegar a ser... ¿Amor?

title: A Fairy Tale For You
description:
- Otogibanashi wo Anata ni (A Fairy Tale for You)  
Once upon a time, there was an incredibly strong-willed and beautiful princess, and an egotistical young man who burned with the desire to make something of himself. The young man's heart was stolen in an instant by the beauty of the princess, and he fell in love… but!?  
  
- Otogibanashi wo Anata ni 2 - Houseki Hime (A Fairy Tale for You 2 - The Jewel Princess)  
Starring the younger princess, Lucy, and her new love after the war.  
  
- Kimagure na Maria (Carefree Maria)  
Nonoka-chan watches over the hot-blooded Atsushi like a mother, but is that really all there is to it…?

title: The Day She Jumped
description:
“Recruiting those who want to finish it and die, but feel sad doing it alone…”  
Fed up with everything, Mie posted a notice on an Internet Bulletin Board and found suicide-partners. Four boys and girls were gathered together because of their ties to death. And then…?!   
  
A collection of oneshots dealing with psychological themes like death, suicide and bullying.

title: Skill ga Mieta Nidome no Jinsei ga Chou Yoyuu, Hatsukoi no Hito to Taonoshiku Sugoshiteimasu
description:
After dying from brutal overwork in a corporate hell, Yasushi Satou awakens in his middle school years—with a shocking new ability: he can see people’s skills and stats like a game interface! Determined to rewrite his tragic fate, Yasushi grinds his newfound powers… only to accidentally unlock superhuman physical abilities far beyond ordinary limits.

But that’s not all. His middle school crush, Ichika Kobayashi—the girl who once occupied his daydreams—suddenly starts getting very close to him. Is it fate, or does she sense his cheat-like potential?

Armed with game-breaking skills and a second chance at youth, Yasushi vows to flip the script on his unlucky past. But between training obsessively, dodging Ichika’s advances, and navigating teenage life, will this "stress-free" do-over turn into chaos?

Award-Winning Fantasy Rom-Com!
Winner of Dual Category Prizes at the 6th Kakuyomu Web Novel Contest
Now finally adapted into manga form!

title: Bishounen no Oheya
description: Koyuki's family is poor, so her dream has always been to marry a rich man. What better way to try and achieve that dream than to put on a sexy maid outfit and take on a job as a maid in a mansion? Unfortunately, the master of the house is a spoiled brat!

title: 7 Centi!
description:
From Shoujo Crusade:  
  
One day, while in search for more food, our heroine stumbles upon a jar of what looked like umeboshi; little did she know that it would bring her more than just a full stomach. The mysterious snack somehow makes her shrink and she can only grow back when she eats something (which is a bit of a chore if you're THAT tiny). And if that's not troublesome enough, she's also dealing with her crush who seems to like her best friend!?

title: I’m Looking for the Princess
description:
The one “who operated a Hong Sin Seo for 10 years”, who shudders at the monthly rent, Na Baek Su, dives a 1 million dollar project, The Search for a Princess!!  
For money, she’ll do anything!! she who says that money, money, and more money is the best, Suh Jan Di.  
To help her uncle, Na Baek Su, she joined the Search for a Princess…  
Her princess candidates list shows a couple of people…  
Cold, charismatic, the one who’ll go down in the history of the fashion world, Yu Jin.  
The one who’d even sell the Sameun group for the money-crazed girl, Eun hyuk.  
A wingless angel’s infinite love, our eternal goddess, fashion model Eh Eun.  
A love story that outrageously intertwines the princess candidates and Suh Jan Di, with lots of trouble and excitement!

title: Boku wa Sakana
description: A short 16-page oneshot about the relationship between two high school boys who are incapable of admitting their feelings to each other and the girl who perpetuates their anxiety.

title: Koi o Shita Sora no Majika
description:
They loved each other, but they couldn’t tell anyone until graduation...!

As a homeroom teacher, Yahaba was worried about Yumino, his beautiful student who couldn’t make friends. When he visited his dorm and tried to help with his problem, he felt that he could no longer stop.

“I can’t say it now, but I won’t let anyone have you.”

A love story between a popular teacher who was trying his best to conceal his feelings, and a determined, tsundere student~♥

title: Kirakira Boshi to Koi no Ballad
description: A love story about a girl who loves K-pop idols and a transfer student from Korea.

title: We Will Always Find Each Other
description:
In their previous lives, Ivan and Lewis met each other in extraordinary circumstances, with a terminal disease getting in the way, their story ended before it could begin.  
  
Now that they have met again at the university, without a terminal disease and lovers hindering, could they be able to write their own story?  
  
Sometimes destiny can be very capricious…

title: Kare wa Chameleon
description: Hayama's hair and eye color change with just a glance or touch, earning him the nickname 'Chameleon'. Fascinated by those unique characteristics, Seto gradually closes the distance between them. As their feelings deepen, one day, Seto can't help but let slip an unexpected "I like you"...

title: Haejin's First Love
description:
The characteristics of "First Love" Disease are:
1. The majority of the patients are in their teens,
2. Those patients are in love with someone,
3. There formed a heart-shaped scar on the patient's body.

Haejin Jeong never caught the disease, even though all of her friends had. But when she hit 24 years old, two men miraculously appeared in her life as if it were fate. The question is, which one is her first love?
