- [Original Webtoon <Lezhin>](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/jeonghaejin_firstlove)

- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=54864058)

- [Original Webtoon <Naver>](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5008117)

title: Ore no Hatsukoi no Hito ga Ani to Flag wo Tate Makutte Tsurai
description: He fell in love with the love of his life. But there was something wrong with the beautiful girl he was dating. She approaches me with all her might, using strange words like "moe" and "precious". And not to me, but to my brother!　This is the start of an all-out love comedy  but full of muscles, and a lot of foolishness and a lot of fun!

title: The Evening Sun Rises!!
description:
Yuko Sawaki wishes for her prince from the sunset and he arrives from the ocean. Kenichi Katsuragi, prince charming, is as close to perfect as you can come with one major flaw.  
  
The second tankobon in the original edition also contains a short story entitled: "The Song of Good Friends"

title: Sono Hakui wo Nuide
description:
- Box Prince  
Finally, she has permission to live on her own but before she has a taste of freedom, her father sends her a supervising robot.  
  
- Taking Off Your White Coat  
Afraid of getting close to the "white jacket" chemistry teacher, she will become out of breath just by merely passing him! But when she has to stay in the same room as him for supplementary classes, what is she to do?  
  
- Partner In Crime  
Nao witnesses the student council president removing a valuable object from the church when she accidentaly causes one of the church windows to break. He blackmails her into silence by threatening to tell people she broke the window on purpose… What is the student council president really hiding…?  
  
- Spirit In The Rain  
Every rainy day Azuzas dead mother's stepbrother comes to spend time with her. Is he only feeling sorry for his niece…?  
  
- ABDUCTION  
Hisano watches his classmate Mikoto as she waits on her roof to be abducted by aliens. But who is Mikoto really

title: Kayowai Chounouryokusha no Bojou
description:
The psychic powers I struggled to obtain turned out to be rather weak. But then I met someone who saw value in these modest abilities…

A 54-page supernatural love story by a rising star artist.

title: One Summer's Kids Game
description:
Hito Natsu no Kids Game (ひと夏のKIDSゲーム Hito Natsu no KIDS Gēmu) is a short, debut manga work by Ken Akamatsu, the creator of Love Hina. The manga was published on September issue of Kodansha’s Magazine Fresh on September 10, 1993. Ken Akamatsu later received Kodansha’s "Freshman Manga Award" (Japanese: 新人漫画賞/少年マガジン新人賞) and Special Jury Award (Japanese: 審査員特別賞) for this work.The manga was re-published on 20 May 2001.  
  
(Description taken from Wikipedia)

title: Kanchigai ja Arimasen
description: ちゃんと理解できていない男。 彼は一体どこに着地するのか～!?（別冊少年チャンピオン2018年5月号）

title: Kimi no Uta de Nemuritai
description: Haruki, a family-oriented high school girl, was working hard at an early morning job to babysit. One day, she succeeded in putting the president, who was having trouble sleeping, to sleep, and she became the president's exclusive "sleep-walker!　But the president has a mountain of reasons for not being able to sleep, including family problems and sibling relationships...!

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - School Days Extra (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine are actresses-in-training at the prestigious Seisho Music Academy. On a certain day, Claudine notices that Maya is not performing at her peak, and becomes a little worried.

Sequel to "Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - School Days (Doujinshi)".

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Wish Upon a Glass
description:
There's a rural legend that says that if you find a red sea glass, your love will come true.  
  
A simple, slice-of-life romance in a small town.

title: Houkago Kiss
description:
1) After School Kiss  
All the guys think Fuyu Yamashita is the stupidest girl in school and dare the guy who does the worst on the next test to go out with her. That guy turns out to be Minato Sakurai, the scariest guy in school. Poor Fuyu?  
  
2-3) Making an Angel  
Sayaka Sunohara a highschool student and a talent scout find a cuteish boy playing with a cat. Thinking that he would make a perfect image of an Angel she brings him to her mother's agency. After the makeover, he fits the image perfectly. When Sayaka asks him "what would you like to eat?" as a treat for his successful photo shoot. He say "I would rather have you instead…". what would Sayaka to do with this Cute Angel or rather a Bratty Devil?  
  
4) Young Nobleman Lock On!!  
Iori Seto known as the "Stupidity Queen" has a crush on Motochika Ishida who happens to be a school elite, a cold student body president plus the chairman's son. Just to stay close to him she decides to join student body. But all she does is cause

title: Anta Nante Okotowari!
description:
Yui has a deep love for her "older brother" (they're not actually siblings, but are related), and she is devastated when he gets married. While at the wedding, Yui meets a sobbing boy, Kaoru. It turns out that his cousin (that he was in love with) is the one Yui's brother is marrying.  
  
When Yui moves into a boy's dorm so she can seek out new love, she finds that the head of the dorm is none other than Kaoru!

title: She Is Mine
description: The story's about the blond-haired Haru and the dark-haired Ryotaro who are the best of friends. A girl suddenly steps into their life and caught their attention, and thus romance blossoms! The thing is that she is experienced in the field of love, but on the other hand, they have zero love experience?!

title: Otonari-san wa Kiss yori Amai
description: Nao, a high school student, spends her days in class trying to keep a low profile by suppressing her true "likes". Then one day, who recognized Nao's "like" in junior high school, moves into the apartment next to hers! But he has turned into a super cool boy!

title: Musunde, Hodoite, Kiss
description: Kanade-kun and I broke up at graduation. that's what I thought, but we met again in high school…? Are we going to keep this a secret still?

title: Akuma no Riddle - Sekai wa Koi ni Michite Iru (Doujinshi)
description:
Tokaku x Haru  
Haru treats Tokaku's wound, which she incurred by protecting Haru. Haru feels certain that Tokaku will eventually return the favor.   
In the middle of the Doujinshi you find also two short storys about other pairings.  
  
Link:  
[The Doujinshi & Manga Lexicon](https://www.doujinshi.org/book/708348/)

title: The Governor's Migraine
description: The seven-stream killer was reborn in the 21st century. Ye Ban Xia, an ambitious woman with a happy and peaceful life, realized a bitter truth on the first day of her freshman year. What? That handsome student is, in fact, the governor who tormented me in my past life?! I will never be his slave in this life ever again!

title: Yaneura no Majo
description:
A collection of interlinked oneshot stories, Yaneura no Majou tells the story of students from Sannosan High School as they are preparing for the Culture Festival.   
  
- Lilith  
Asumi is responsible for writing the play that will be performed this year, but struggles to relate to her own characters—especially that of Lilith the Witch—until she reflects on her relationship between her childhood friend Asami.   
  
- Ground Woodpecker  
Michi loves fortune telling, but when she helps her childhood friend Satoshi with his crush on fellow classmate Mikako by performing a magic trick, something seems strange. Her magic actually works! Satoshi begins to change and even gets the girl; however, Michi becomes obsessed with the bird that she saw while performing the trick… and she joins the bird watching club in order to find it again.   
  
- Eve  
Suzuki Mie is the president of the bird watching club and is assigned to put the yearbook together with committee member and star of this year's

title: Sokkuri Mate
description:
"They say in this world there are three people with the same face, but I never imagined one of them would be a boy in my class…"  
  
[PL] Mówią, że na świecie istnieją trzy osoby o takiej samej twarzy, ale… Nigdy bym nie pomyślała, że jedną z nich będzie chłopak w mojej klasie!

title: Tada, Kimi wo aishiteru
description:
From Shoujo Manga Maniac:  
Amateur photographer Makoto and the homely but endearing Shizuru meet during university orientation and become instant friends. Shy by nature, Makoto finds himself opening up around Shizuru, and the two often go to a forest together to take photographs. Shizuru secretly likes Makoto, but he only has eyes for classmate Miyuki.

title: Choco Yori Amai First Kiss
description: A 9-page manga about a gentle schoolgirl and a handsome athlete's first kiss.

title: Delinquent Cinderella
description:
Nan Hui was sent off to the city to live with her mother and her nasty grandmother when she was caught smoking at her country school again. There she rescued the drunk and ungrateful, Gong Myeong from the beatings of five boys. Angry that he did not appreciate her help, she stomped on his arm and ran off…not expecting to meet him again.  
  
Gong Myeong devised a plan with Nan Hui after being heartbroken over losing a girl he loves to his half-brother, Baek Jae Ha.  
  
"We’re not going to really love each other. We’ll be a contract couple to get what we both want.”  
The handsome bad boy, Cha Gong Myeong & bad girl, Lee Nan Hui are declared a couple of horror!  
  
What will happen when Nan Hui’s best friend, who is in love with her, comes to Seoul? Things get even more complicated when Gong Myeong’s half-brother falls for Nan Hui.  
  
Can this bad prince give this bad Cinderella her glass slipper? Will love blossom between these two bad personalities?

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - School Days (Doujinshi)
description:
Saijou Claudine considers Tendou Maya to be her most formidable rival at Seisho Music Academy for actresses-in-training. She believes that she keeps her friends close, and her enemy even closer. From her friends' perspective, though, Claudine appears to just genuinely enjoy Maya's company. A story of a day in the life of this cute pair.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Lucky Spider
description:
An extra chapter added to the end of the first volume of "Ookumo-chan Flashback"

Depicts Suzuki Minoru's father and his first encounter with Ookumo Aya.

You can find it as chapter 4.5 in Ookumo-Chan Flashback

title: His Women’s University
description: Good.

title: Asa no Shihaisha
description:
Nitori Akari is an early riser. As a 1st-year high school student, she had a secret—something she carried out alone in the empty classroom about 30 minutes before school started. The secret, burdened with the girl's modest feeling of control and feeling of guilty pleasure, was supposed to remain undisturbed by anyone…

Released as a part of Manga One's 10th anniversary celebration.

title: I've Loved You All My Life!
description:
Keiko and Mako have known each other since primary school. Only two months after we entered high school, Mako, who I've always loved, already has a lover! The girl she likes is a cute, fluffy, beautiful girl. What's more, she wants the three of us to go out together…  
  
A girls love comedy that starts with a broken heart!

title: Houkago Hachimitsu
description: Why am I in a place like this…… kissing HIM……?'' Awkward class loner Mitsuo Hanaori has a pet peeve - the handsome and popular Hachiya, who's always at the center of the class. He has soft hair and clear skin, everything comes easy to him, and his voice is easy on the ears - it's all just so irritating…… But Mitsuo can't take his eyes off Hachiya, who scores perfect shots in basketball class, and he twists his ankle as a result. After helping walk Mitsuo to the nurse's office, for some reason Hachiya suddenly brings his face close as if to kiss him!! Mitsuo's freaking out and his heart's pounding like crazy, and to his mortification, his JUNK is responding……! To make things worse, ever since that day, Hachiya's started coming onto him on a daily basis…… Just what the hell is going on!?

title: You Are My Catnip
description:
Wu Yue is a 'catnip' descendant- one who carries the fragrance of catnip on her body. Not knowing better, she enrolled in a school that is filled with cat descendants, causing a commotion and to be chased around by them. In the process of escaping, Wu Yue accidentally kissed Li Zechu, a descendant of the jaguar, and unexpectedly discovered that Li Zechu's kiss could somehow camouflage her unique fragrance.  
Thus, in order to quell the commotion she had caused and survive in school, Wu Yue had to become Li Zechu’s pet. She would have to endure all sorts of harassment, just for a kiss from Li Zechu…  
It is an impossible kind of development. Wu Yue vows to find another solution to this problem and be rid of the control of the demon Li Zechu!

title: Ai Dake ni.
description: This particular high school boy has 13 half-siblings from different mothers! Incest, homosexuality, romance with a huge age gap and etc... These are the various secret and twisted love affairs of this family's members.

title: Who Is He
description: The cheerful and optimistic brother died suddenly. Mu Siyang lurked into the school to investigate the cause of his brother's death. The scares followed: his roommate was a friend; his brother's rumored boyfriend wanted to kill him; all the guests of his brother's work station wanted him... What did my brother go through before he died?

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen (Fan Colored)
description:
All’s fair when love is war!

Two geniuses. Two brains. Two hearts. One battle. Who will confess their love first…?!

Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane are two geniuses who stand atop their prestigious academy’s student council, making them the elite among elite. But it’s lonely at the top and each has fallen for the other. There’s just one huge problem standing in the way of lovey-dovey bliss—they’re both too prideful to be the first to confess their romantic feelings and thus become the “loser” in the competition of love! And so begins their daily schemes to force the other to confess first!

title: Cheol i Eopseoseo Geurae
description: Yoo Hajin, who works as a private tutor for extra income, has a student: Im Ildo, a wealthy student preparing to retake his college entrance exams. However, one day, she hears shocking news from her younger sister. "Sis, Ildo is... my junior at university!" It turns out that Ildo, whom she thought was a struggling repeat student, had already been accepted into National University. From the day his true identity is revealed, Ildo’s meticulous schemes and terrifying obsession begin to slowly tighten their grip on Hajin's life.

title: Kanshakudama no Yuuutsu
description:
- Short-Tempered Melancholic   
Kajika Yamano is a female ninja whose job is to protect her family's legendary weapon. But when a boy she has a crush on tells her she should be more ladylike, she vows to give up all ninja related deeds.  
  
- This Love is Nonfiction   
Yuri sends her pen pal Ryo a picture of herself–but it's really of her best friend Karin, who is prettier than she is. Now Ryo wants to meet her, so she has no choice but to send Karin instead!  
  
- Romance in the Afternoon Rain   
Minori falls in love with Takato, a boy who shared his umbrella with her one rainy afternoon. Now she "forgets" her umbrella every time it rains in hopes of becoming closer to him.  
  
- Second Time in Love   
Mana secretly likes her friend's boyfriend, but Nakamura, a younger boy, is determined to win Mana's heart.

title: Image Change Manual - Love Version (Anthology)
description:
ShoComi Summer Special 2008  
  
New!! Three Stories about complete new makeovers - love version!  
  
1) Himegimi ni Koi no Hanataba o by MITSUKI Miko  
“Mikity” Yuzuhara is the ultimate tomboy: she wears sweatpants under her school uniform and beats up pervy guys (when they well deserve it, of course). But what happens when Ayakawa, a pretty-boy with makeup skills, decides to make her his princess…?!

title: Okitsune-chan ni wa Seishun ga Tarinai
Kokuhaku Suru Aite o Machigaemashita
description: Ever since Naho first laid eyes on Teppei Nose, a fiery red-haired boy who takes the opposite train from her to school every day, she's had a crush on him. She finally musters up the courage to ask out her first love, but when he turns around, it turns out to be a different red-haired guy instead... and he looks kind of scary, too!! She can't tell him the truth now! What will her mistaken outburst lead to...!?

title: Kowairo Henge
description: Torigoe can imitate anyones "tone of voice." He, along with his accomplice Madara, accepted a request made by a woman. She wants them to imitate the voice that she hears every morning from the second floor of her house. A hidden secret and a faint memory awaits them. What could they be?"

title: POPS
description: Kusuko has a secret crush on the resident class playboy, Mishima. But with his constant rotation of ever changing girls on his arm, she keeps a safe distance. Mishima takes her stand-off-ish attitude for coldness and confronts her about it; however, they manage to overcome the misunderstandings and even begin dating! The more she gets to know him, the harder she finds herself falling, but one day, she overhears him talking to another girl on the phone…

title: Manbou-chan to Lion-kun
description: Makebe is a shy girl with a habit of falling down whenever she is startled or embarrassed. Riou Taira is a popular boy in class with a love for shoujo manga, which he keeps a secret from everyone until Makebe catches him in a bookstore. When a teacher asks Taira to look after her and make sure she gets along with her classmates, how will the relationship between them develop?

title: Gone with the Wind
description:
Gone with the Wind is a music band romance that revolves around the meteoric rise and eventual fallout of the vocalist-guitarist duo of an underground rock band — *West Wind*.

> "I was the one who made a mistake, and you're the one punishing me." 

The chuunibyo king and the guitarist whom he once betrayed. 

Set during and after *Dr.Solo's Soul Vibration*, it's part of the **Solo Universe** danmei series by Dr. Solo

Vocal x Guitar
Sui Qingchi x Fu Cuo

title: Zenbu Kimi no Mono
description: Yanagisawa Aiku is the president of the flower-arranging club. In order to save her club from being closed down, she agrees to go out with Hosaka Ryousei, the extremely handsome president of the student council. However, the only problem is that Ryousei is always in love with one girl after another. Aiku is just another girl to him… or is she?

title: When She Touches Me
description: "When She Touches Me," by Amaguri Tarou, is a teacher-student story.

title: Ai wa Utsukushi Koiseyo Otome
description: The beautiful painting that high school girl Kotoha saw every morning on her way to school. Her encounter with Ran, the art student who painted it, changes Kotoha's life! The opening of a super beautiful youth graffiti between a shy high school girl and a free-spirited college student!

title: Hanjuku Hime
description:
- Hanjuku Hime (Rookie Princess)!  
  
- Oresama, Kaimasen ka?!  
  
- Kiss Friend  
Emimi had had several boyfriends. However, she disliked any intimate contact with them. Whether kissing or even holding hands, she got disgusted and simply breaks away. One day, she realized that her long time friend, Shinji, did not gross her out and asked him to kiss her. That, of course, is the beginning of a romance.  
  
- Imakoi  
  
- Kaori-chan Himitsu Nikki  
Kaori has quite the imagination when it comes to romance. In particular, she daydreams about cliche school romance scenes between herself and the boy she likes, Ryuu. One day she drops her diary and it’s picked up by the difficult and hard-to-approach Mayuki. Is this the beginning of a beautiful friendship, or fandom?

title: NAN&BEI
description: A muddle-headed father mixes up the paperwork of his fraternal twins. The brothers, living in the north and south respectively, are forced to change cities because of school and learn just how different things are. The new environments present all kinds of unusual problems. See which brother is your favorite in this hilarious manga about everyday life.

title: To You Who Protects
description: Born as a spirit medium, Tae-nam has lived and escaped ghosts. She lived a limited life under the protection of her grandmother, a shaman, but she finally found her freedom when she went to a university! In addition, the guardian spirit of a person, whom she met at the entrance ceremony, is a god with general-level ability to exorcise the surrounding ghosts, and will Tae-nam enjoy the freedom of college life with their help?

title: Tokyo Ravens - Sword of Song
description: Spin-off of Tokyo Ravens.

title: Stand Up!!!!
description:
The protagonists, Hinako, Makoto, Yoshi and Yuki, are standing up!!  
One day, the four are called to the principal's office and shown some scary graffiti that had been put up on the school wall. One reads, "I'll kill Shinozuka Makoto". It's their job to find out who did this, and who's after Makoto. Near-death experiences and mystery await!

title: Oikaketemo Chikazuitemo
description:
Collection of oneshots   
  
1) Oikaketemo Chikazuitemo  
When she was small, Uiko exchanged a promise with childish Mako that when they are high school students, if they become a couple, they will kiss. All this time, she hasn't been able to forget that promise. But now that they've become high school students, Mako is a popular guy in her class, and Uiko is a plain girl without any redeeming points. No matter what she does, she can't be honest to Mako, who already belonged to a different world before anyone knows, but…?  
  
2) Santa Clause wo Dakishimete  
  
3) 1000% Aisuru Kimochi  
  
4) Suki Sugi Chatte Gomen ne  
Chikage has been dating Manato for 3 months, they've held hands, and kissed too and now finally Manato has asked Chikage over. Even though Chikage has mentally perpared herself, can she really take that important next step?  
  
5) Aishi Kimi wo Dakishimete

title: Sayonara demo Aishiteru
description:
From Midnight Scans:  
  
Story 1: Sayonara Demo Aishiteru - Yutaka's version  
Yutaka has decided to confess to Mariya, the girl who saved him during the entrance examination. Being an average girl, Mariya was bewildered by the confession of the charming Yutaka. Even though there are strains in their relationship, the distance between the two slowly shortens. However, Mariya has suddenly asked for a breakup!  
  
Story 2: Sayonara Demo Aishiteru - Mariya's version  
  
Story 3: 1% No Kiseki  
Nana falls for her rumored cold teacher.  
  
Story 4: Sumetaku, Amaku, Koi O Shite  
Rinka has always been perceived as a cold girl and is popular with the freshman boys, until that is they found out about her true personality. There is yet another freshman that proclaims that he fallen in love with her at first sight, but she gave him a blunt reply as she have given many others. However it seems that he has not been shaken by her reply, how will Rinka react?

title: Paradise Academy
description: Paradise Gakuen's annual competition Miss Paradise is coming soon! But a major incident occured: one of the girls hoped to be a contestant, Chihiro, had her precious part seen by a boy! Chihiro who holds a principle that she won't let anyone other than her husband to see her naked, wants to become Shiba's wife. Because the latter didn't believe her intention, she decides to prove it, by entering the annual competition!

title: Heartbeat
description: A girl pressured into good behavior and a boy who has no ambitions, these two connected by a misunderstanding from a diary, leading to an interesting and stimulating game of decryption… As the emotions of adolescence germinate in this game of misunderstanding, the distance between the both of them gradually shortens, with them finding out that two completely different people are facing the same problems…

title: Silent Manga Audition: Sekai kara Todoita Japanese Manga
description:
Works submission period for Silent Manga Audition first round: June 2012 - 31st March 2013.

### Grand Prix:
1. Sky Sky by Prema-Ja (Thailand)
A silent story about a young girl and her very own way to cope with her old pet dog's death.

2. Excuse Me by Alex Irzaqi (Indonesia)
One day, a school girl finds a love letter in her desk. Unfortunately, she's still in the middle of a lesson, and her seat is in the front row. Will the girl find a way to escape the teacher's watchful eyes?

### Semi-Grand Prix:
3. A Pure Love by dee Juusan (Jordan)
A semi-autobiographical story about a mangaka and her pet.

4. Beginning and Farewell by Vincent Lange (Germany)

5. Roach Story by Erwin Prasetya (Indonesia)
A dialogue-less story about a roach being in love with a girl and the boy she has a crush on.

### Award of Excellence:

6. To Give by RED (Vietnam)
A dialogue-less story about a homeless man and a little girl.

7. A Better Tomorrow by Miyuli (Germany)

8. Heart by Ink-pop (Germany)

9. Postman

title: Puchi Puri
description: "Please don't cry! I promise, one day, I'll become a strong person, all for your sake!" These were the words of a cute, pure-hearted prince. However, Atsushi is nothing more than an elementary school student! For Yuuji to have his first kiss stolen by this kid, after the horrible experience of being rejected by the guy he confessed to…

title: Otogibanashi de Himitsu no Kiss
description:
The moment that Rio opens a book that she found by chance, she gets sucked into another world. There she meets a guy that she sees in her dream every night. His name is Tsukishiro. He's a magician who controls the story world, and his mission is to take a "princess" from the outside world there. He asks Rio to be act as the princess and complete the tale "Cinderella", however…  
  
Also contains:  
- Burning Heat On My Lips (Kuchibiru ni Tomoru Netsu)  
Weak bodied Naruse Momo gets entangled with the reknowned playboy, Toomine Hazuki, at the infirmary.  
  
- In Love with the Wolf (Ouji Tokidoki Ookami)  
The theater club will be remaking "Little Red Riding Hood" for the school festival and Enomoto Aria is in charge of the script…  
  
- What Resounds in My Heart Is Your Sound (Mune ni Hibiku wa Kimi no Oto)  
That boy keeps playing the song she hates and he won't stop playing it until she can remember the title.

title: Tonkaradani Monogatari
description:
Story about the history of a valley and the animals that lived there.  
  
- **Tonkaradani Monogatari** (とんから谷物語, The Tale of Tonkara Valley)
Story about the history of a valley and the animals that lived there.  
 - **Sing Penny** (Utae Penny yo) 
- **Silk Hat Story** (Slik Hat Monogatari)
- **Princess Knight: Tink and the Golden Egg** (Ribon no Kishi: Tink to Kin no Tamago, ALT ENG. - Ribbon Knight - Tink and the Golden Egg) -
*(Gaiden to Princess Knight 1953)*
- **Duckling with the White Neck** (Shiroi Kubi no Kogamo)
- **The Golden Scale** (Kin no Uroko) -
One day, a young boy heads out to catch a haul of fish, so that he can afford to get good bread for his mother. While there he finds a golden fish who, in exchange for not killing it, offers him a golden scale which will grant any wish. Choosing delicious bread as his prize, the boy returns home successful. If he could get bread from one scale, what would he get with another?  
 -  **Why Mother Lost Her Leg** (Okaasan no Ashi) 
-

title: You are Bun-chan's Love
description: I fell in love with all my heart, so much that I would break myself. Natsuji Miyazaki, who gently snuggles up to loneliness and continues to draw delicate emotions that cannot be expressed in words, draws "Ultimate Unrequited Love" in his latest work. Please watch over Bun-chan's heartbreaking love, which you can never think of as someone else's affair.

title: Kirai no Prince wa, Jimiko Dake wo Henai shitai
description:
High school senior Sakura Momoi is a plain girl with glasses at school, but she's really a very pretty girl who uses them to protect herself from her phobia of men. But when her mother remarries, she suddenly finds herself living with three handsome brothers.
Among them, the second son, Banri, is Sakura's classmate and is famous at school for being a misogynist. ・・・・・・
Sakura is left bewildered by her new life, which has so many hurdles, but Banri is so kind to her that she can hardly believe he hates women...?

title: Futari no Zero Jiba
description: 真実と俺は超能力を使えた──。３年ぶりだった。14歳のあの日、目の前で“消失”した真実が戻ってきた。戻ってきてくれた。“次元”を超えて。だから俺は思った。もう放さない。もう誰も二人を引き離せない。永久磁石のNとSのように。そして思いもしなかった。３年後の美しく大人びた17歳の真実が“変わった”ことを。そこに誰も知らない“真実”が潜むことを……。

title: A Confucian Scholar Has Appeared!
description:
"I don't think I'm from this time period...!"

On the day of the traditional freshman orientation, where everyone wears scholar robes, Chaewon notices a young male student who was downright fully committed to acting like a scholar of Confucianism era—from his clothing to his manner of speech.

Chaewon ended up receiving help from this peculiar student, yet it wasn't simply him being devoted to the act—he was actually a scholar of Joseon who actually traveled time?! 

Here lies a comedic tale staring the modern university freshman Chaewon, and Hajin, a Confucian scholar from the Joseon dynasty!

title: Hard Luck Woman
description: Hidaka Hikaru is a first-year high schooler who, in front of one she loves, becomes beyond clumsy. Let´s follow her struggles to love.

title: Tenderness of Winter
description: The male author of a BL manhua meets one of the men who he used as inspiration when he was finding subjects to draw for a college manhua. This particular subject was tall and handsome, which caused him to fall in love.

title: Dekiai Itokon!
description: Touji's daily routine consists of cooking, doing laundry, and cleaning… Before he knew it, he had become like a househusband, taking care of his extended family, the Udagawas. One day, Touji's cousin Yuuto joins the family and Touji cannot take his eyes off the innocent Yuuto. He even has erotic thoughts about Yuuto. With his feelings spinning out of control, what will happen to this Itokon?!

title: Naruto - You, Like a Sunflower (Doujinshi)
description: A high school AU romantic drama tongren (Chinese doujinshi) of the manga Naruto. End game pairing is NaruSaku, there are also love triangle elements as well as a side story of Sasuke's difficult relationship with his brother. This was translated from Chinese with the permission of the artist; the original Chinese version is available free on the artist's blog. Please read panels and speech bubbles left to right, not right to left.

title: Asuka@Future.Come
description:
(from ebookjapan):

One day, a transfer student named Asuka Daimon arrived in Aika Kamishiro's class. At first glance, he looks handsome, but when he introduces himself, the class is stunned when he suddenly says he is from the future. Nagagabe, a male student in the class, even says to Asuka, "What's with that setup?"...

title: Mi wo Kogasu Hodo no Ai wo Shire
description:
Miu has a crush on her older childhood friend and next-door neighbor, Ran. On the other hand, Ran's younger brother, Ren, is flashy, a huge flirt, and totally not boyfriend material—at least, that's what Miu thought. But lately, he's been showing up when she's in trouble, saying things that make her heart race, and throwing her feelings into chaos. Why is he affecting her so much now!?

However, Ren's true nature is... way darker than she imagined—he’s the type who’ll use anything to make Miu his. A twisted love story with a dark party boy childhood friend!

(Source: Betsufure, translated)

title: Toriko no Toriko
description: Financial conglomerate Asahi, which is worth 8 trillion yen, has Hinaka as the only daughter of the head of the family, who is on the verge of death. Hinaka keeps fighting off all the looming assassins, but what will happen when she's confronted with the "strongest professional hitman," Kyouma?

title: Love Riot
description: Joey thought he can avoid fights by transferring to another school. But what he doesn't know is that by meeting Elaine for the first time, he'll experience what it's like to be in love with his enemy.

title: 9 - Kimi ga Iru Machi de Koi o Shita
description: Kouki was the ace of the baseball club. But for some reason, he became unable to play and then return to his hometown. Over there he'll meet his destiny and love…

title: Otouto wa, Ookami.
description:
1-3. Otouto wa, Ookami.  
Misako's father remarried a week ago and her step brother turns out to be the school's most popular guy, Aizawa Hiroki. Giving the appearance of a gentleman it turns out he's a huge playboy, trying to "capture" her to prove they can't be a family!?  
  
4. Kimi Fechi  
  
5. Kanzen Date Manual

title: Koisuru Sha Girl
description: When first year Rikako stumbles upon a senpai in the school's archery range, she finds herself entranced. She decides, on the spot, to join the archery club in order to chase that feeling and meet him again. Except, as it turns out, she's not the only first-year girl with that idea… Can Rikako win him over with her earnestness, or will her ulterior motive be discovered?

title: Summer's Lie
description: 暑假的炎热夏天，李木子和宋若依相遇在一个海边。在双重谎言下，两人有了一段美好的夏日之恋……

title: S.P.Y
description: In search of her mother, Nagi, a girl from a desolate country village, comes to a big city and enters Swimming Suieikyou High School. Shortly after joining the swimming club, Nagi finds out that the pool is actually completely dominated by boys! But in this never-practicing so-called swimming club Nagi finds something…

title: Tiger Books
description:
This is a collection of loosely interconnected stories where the main characters are all animals, especially the tiger who is the hero of the first book.

Stories collected:
Volume 1
- 
- Tigerland タイガーランド

Volume 2
-
- Akuemon 悪右衛門
- Genjin ishi no monogatari 原人イシの物語
- Teizoku tenshi 低俗天使

Volume 3
-
- Korosuke no hashi ころすけの橋
- Canon カノン
- Amefuri kozo 雨ふり小僧

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Position Left 2 (Doujinshi)
description:
[Sequel to "Position Left" doujinshi by the same author]

Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine are the top two actresses-in-training at the prestigious Seisho Music Academy, with Maya as the Top Student and Claudine as the Second-Ranked Student. They are also secretly dating. Following the events of Position Left,  Claudine continues to work hard to take the "Top" position from Maya. 

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Kuraku naru Made Matte
description: Ushio just transferred from a prestigious high school. While running an errand after school, she collides with Mitsunashi, who's known as a studious robot, and breaks his glasses. Afterward, Mitsunashi invites Ushio to join the Astronomy Club. Will love blossom under the stars?

title: Highteen Spoiler
description:
After giving up Taekwondo for over 10 years, Sohee, who lives like a hanryang, has only one interest... k-teen romance! She dreams of a future where she becomes Soo-hyeon's girlfriend, who is going well. 

But... one day, photos seemingly from the future sync to Sohee’s phone, and the guy in them who’s become her boyfriend is... her annoying classmate and desk partner, Lee Ando!

Unbelievable! This romance makes no sense! As more and more future photos keep pouring in, Sohee grows increasingly confused... Will things really unfold exactly as spoiled by the ending?

title: Zettai x Roman
description:
A collection of one-shots  
  
- The One Adabana in the World: A fantasy story about smoke creatures that take on human form.  
- The P.E. Storage Room Romance (can be found within [ES - Eternal Sisters](https://mangadex.com/manga/4879))  
- One Room Romance  
- Song Song Romance  
- Love Story  
- I'm With You  
- I'm With You 2

title: Tonari no Inuyama-kun
description: Kokoro was involved in a traffic accident when she was small, and there was a hero who risked his life to save her. She can’t remember anything about him, except for his back, which was scarred from saving her. Now a high school student, she still can’t forget the guy from her memories. Suddenly, she was assigned to take care of the new transfer student, Inuyama Kei, who’s always quiet and somewhat of a weirdo. He reminds her of her childhood hero, but she wishes her hero was Shun-senpai, the idol of all the girls in school, and who’s been very nice to her lately…

title: Koi wa Keiyaku no Atode
description:
Consists of a collection of oneshots.  
  
1) Love After Contract I (Koi wa Keiyaku no Atode)  
Kazuto wakes up with a hangover and finds himself lying in bed with a stranger. The stranger, Takasugi, is a young CEO and he announces to him that he bought Kazuto in exchange for one million yen for a month before his arranged marriage.  
  
2) Love After Contract II  
Kazuto continues the contract with Akihiko… Nothing has happened after the last time when they are in the bed together… Kazuto is actually expecting something more than just a dating…but it seems no responds from Akihiko besides kissing… What should Kazuto do…?  
  
3) Kiss Prescription I  
Mutsuki Yuasa, a very dependable & diligent student council vice-president has loved Gaku Tougou, his very soppy friend, since they were childhood neighbours. But now Gaku is taller than him, very popular among girls and bosses about Mutsuki.  
  
4) Kiss Prescription II  
Mutsuki & Gaku's relationship is getting closer but not yet stable

title: Anne of Avonlea
description:
Adaptation of novel Anne of Avonlea (1909) by Canadian writer Lucy Maud Montgomery and it's a sequel to novel Anne of Green Gables (1908). It follows Anne from the age of 16 to 18, during the two years that she teaches at Avonlea school. Anne discovers the delights and troubles of being a teacher, takes part in the raising of the twins Davy and Dora and organizes the A.V.I.S. (Avonlea Village Improvement Society), which tries to bring improvements to Avonlea with questionable results.


Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media Komputindo as **Red Haired Anne Vol 4: Anne of Avonlea** (2011)

title: Kill Me Kiss Me
description: When Tae Yeon Im finds out that the idol star that she's adored for ages is currently attending the same school as her identical cousin, Jung-Woo Im. She convinces her cousin to exploit their similitude and switch places, or maybe he just likes wearing a skirt? So, she will dress as him, attend his school, and try to get close to her lover boy. Meanwhile, he will dress as her, attend her school, and revel in its sea of babes. The plan seems flawless until Tae learns of a bully named Ga-Wun Kim who likes to beat up on poor Jung-Woo. While Jung-Woo finds that being a woman might not be as thrilling as perceived.

title: Shāshǒu Shèchù Liàn'ài Shǒucè
description: One night, an assassin disguised as a high schooler runs into his drunk neighbor, who plants an unexpected kiss on him. From that moment on, he must keep his secret identity hidden while figuring out how to deal with the “mister” living upstairs.

title: B.B.
description:
(from ebookjapan):

High school student Ryo Takagi, known as Yokosuka's "B.B." is an amazing man whose red blood burns bright and has created many legends. 

Ryo shows outstanding aptitude in sports and music, but his soul is not satisfied, and he is searching for something he can seriously tackle. Then, Ryo and his best friend, Soryo, are confronted by the "Kitsunohi" a bosozoku gang in Yokohama that is notorious for its brutality...! 

An inspiring drama about young men who fight hard whilst being swept away by a harsh fate!

A work with 3 parts.

title: Between Jaeyoung and Jaeyoung
description: The "Ha Jaeyoung" whom Seou had a crush on in high school has died. Seou meets the deceased Ha Jaeyoung in a dream, and as the past is reenacted in the dream, Seou tries to change it to save him. Meanwhile, the death of another Ha Jaeyoung gets entangled, complicating the present. Before this dream that transcends time ends, can Seou save both Ha Jaeyoungs?

title: Omoshire-Onna wa Tokimekanai
description:
Masao Yumeji has never been in love and has never had a girlfriend in his life.
He tries to reform himself in order to get the girl he loves to look at him, but what he finds as a reference is a "dream novel"...!

title: Heptagon
description: Nana, an apathetic 24-year-old with nothing much in her life, suffers a car accident and wakes up in her 14-year-old junior high body. As she lives through each day, she starts to remember things she buried deep in her memory, and she can now not remember being involved with her older sister, whom she deeply admires, and her sister's first love, a senior at her school.

title: Koi x Kagi
description: Hinako Midou's parents died several years ago, leaving her alone. Since then she has been passed from relative to another. Now she finds herself about to move to another new home, with a child her own age called Hayami Subaru-chan.

title: Omowaseburi na Kimi no Tonari
description: Through his friend's introduction, friendly and cheerful Nishino became roommates with Maki, his kouhai in university. Living with the unsociable Maki, whose personality is the opposite of his, makes him feel troubled all the time. But after realizing Maki's kindness and consideration, he gradually felt comfortable being with him. However, at that moment Maki told him: "I like senpai, so I can't stay with you anymore". He can't respond to his feelings but he wants to be with him. Nishino flatly rejected Maki's confession by saying "It's just your delusion" and continued living with him, but…

title: Hug Kiss Akushu
description: At his older brother's behest, Kazuyuki started teaching English to the art teacher Kamisuwa-sensei. Somehow, it seemed that sensei was in love with his older brother… What was this gloomy feeling? To begin with, what is love? Do words come first, and then the physical part comes after?

title: I'm the Boss of After-School
description:
Enter our hero Wakadaishou! He doesn't have much interest in school; he saves his energy for all the excitement he can stir up after school. This is an early Adachi Mitsuru 'youth manga', filled with engaging characters, comic scenes, and a young hero with a zest for life.  
  
Volume 1 includes the oneshot Isourou wa Tsurai yo, and volume 2 includes Kimagure Punch.

Volume 2 of the Mitsuru Adachi Early Complete Works.

title: Tokyo University Story
description: Murakami Naoki is the most intelligent student at his high school, but he can't stop obsessing over a girl named Mizuno Haruka. He finally asks her out, and to his surprise, she accepts. After several months of a loving yet obviously doomed romance, it comes time for them to take the entrance exams for Tokyo University. What will happen to their relationship if only one of them is accepted?

title: Jiujiu
description: The Hachiouji family hunts demons in the darkness. The heiress of the Hachiouji family, Takamichi, lost her older brother at a very young age. She isolates herself, but, one evening, two werewolf pups are given to her. After just a few years, they have grown quickly, and they even go to the same senior high school that she does!

title: Koi wa Nintai
description: 東京の北の端。都内屈指の男子校、英凜（えいりん）高校が共学化した。記念すべき初年度の女子入学数は“5名”だけ…。女子や恋愛をワカった気でいる男子たちの掃き溜めに　突如現れた女子入学者・一渡瀬七日（ひととせ なのか）。彼女にくぎ付けの男子たちはあの手この手でお近づきになろうとするが…。「失礼じゃないですか？」

title: Falling For You
description: Gao Miaomiao is finally meeting her online close friend whom she knew for more than a year. To her surprise, Pu Xu, who was holding the same token as her, is completely different from the gentle and easy-going personality he has on the Internet. Facing the coldness and alienation of Pu Xu, she originally wanted to run away. But after being assigned to the same group as him for a project, she slowly uncovered what a shiny treasure he is, and the knot they had hidden within their hearts gradually opened up...

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - Himitsu Shite ne? (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: You x Riko

title: Megane x Parfait!
description: A girl joins the 'White Labcoat and Glasses' club to get closer to the upperclassman she's fallen for. She's then coerced into conducting an experiment in love with said upperclassman's younger brother…

title: Take Over Zone
description: Welcome to the lives and tangled loves of the track and field team: stern coach Wada; dedicated and enthusiastic runner Ogasawara; kind and gentle captain Takashima; playful, teasing second year Yamauchi; stoic and bad-tempered Konno; talented former runner Hashimoto Mizuki, who must overcome the past if he wants to run again.

title: Sweet vs. Home
description: Living with a whimsical mother is hard enough for Tatsuya, but he is soon faced with an even bigger challenge: he finds out that his mother has married his teacher, and that right after marriage she suddenly disappeared. The kind hearted Takaoka, her husband, now has the burden of taking care of Tatsuya. They live together and get along fine, but as their bond tightens Tatsuya soon starts having ulterior motives…

title: Air Love
description:
1-3) Air Koi  
Nina has one sided feelings for Hayashino Senpai. Nina is unable to see Senpai until she clears the game that Senpai provided. That it's find and take the exact pictures that were e-mailed to her. But Taro from the same class was assisting her And realized how odd this game is and…?!  
A Painful dramatic love story!  
  
4) Lost in a First Love  
  
5) Love Materializes

title: Ani no Yuujin
description:
The person I like belongs to my deceased brother…   
  
The growing love of the ones left behind.

title: Kyou mo Futari wa Nakayoshi desu
description:
1-3. Kyou mo Futari wa Nakayoshi desu. (今日も2人は仲良しです。); Comic REX 2015-02, 03, kakioroshi
4. Sailor Fuku wo Matotta Kyouso-sama (セーラー服を纏った教祖様); Shounen Sunday 2012-10
5. Meido kara. (冥途から。); Shounen Sunday S 2009-09
6. Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san (犬神さんと猫山さん); Manga Life Zoukan Munko S 2009
7. Smile (Smile); Manga Life MOMO 2010-11
8. Souseki-san to Issho (漱石さんといっしょ); Comic Alive 2014-04
9. Uchi no Tenshi no Seizensetsu (うちの天使の性善説); Young Animal 2014 #19

title: Zuìhǎo de Wǒmen
description:
You always said that youth would never last forever, and the us of that time– was the best of us.  
  
This time, we will bid farewell to our whole youth.  
  
Do you still remember your high school deskmate? That boy with the world’s brightest smile, that girl with the world’s most beautiful silhouette?  
  
In the three years of high school, the shadows of two people intertwine with the chalk, black and white both distinct, drifting around within the memories.  
  
With You paints a reminiscence of the story of the female lead, Geng Geng, and the male lead, Yu Huai, during their three years as deskmates. Taking troubles to heart,* the small moments of their growth throughout the entire story touch the heart and bring nostalgia and memories to their peak.  
  
**(Geng Geng Yu Huai, put together, form a homonym of the idiom “to take troubles to heart.”)*

title: 2 Kaime no Hajimete no Koi
description: Five years ago, Shin was Yumika's private tutor. Now this Shin-kun comes to Yumika's high school as a teacher trainee! But their love from five years ago will most probably start to bloom again?!

title: Nitamonodoushina Bokura no Iibun
description: Touma is long time friends with brothers, Yuuto and Akito. A year younger, Akito finally enters the same school as Touma and Yuuto, however, he has been watching Touma from afar... Is Touma being stalked by Akito?!  Akito sulks telling him, "You never pay attention to me," leading their tight friendship towards a closeness they aren't even aware of...

title: Girls und Panzer - Daikirai na Aitsu to Hatsutaiken ♥ (Doujinshi)
description: Andō despierta con un problemita al descubrir que ahora tiene un pene, Oshida terminará descubriendo eso y la ayudará a solucionar sus problemas de erecciones.

title: Change the World
description: A tomboyish girl finally meets a boy who tells her to be what she wants to be, not what others see her as.

title: Dancing Baby Karin
description:
Karin is a student of an institute that's very strict, but then leaves class to be dedicated to street dance in a club called "Free Square," that is in fact, one of the best. One day while dancing with her friends a group of boys who play basketball arrive and Karin falls in love at first sight with their leader, Yuuma Seta. Some thugs want to be in the club and Yuuma challenges them to a game of basketball, but the thugs are cheating...
___
Included one-shots:
* Volume 1: Pop'n Eight Beat
* Volume 2:
  * Bokura no Kokoro
  * Hug!: Haruka has a dog... A dog she ABSOLUTELY loves! Every single day, she gives him hugs and kisses~! Upon entering high school, she suddenly meets a boy... with the same name as her dog... looks like her dog... and acts like her dog in every way possible! Can Haruka resist the temptation of wanting to hug and kiss him like she does to her dog?

title: Kawaii Anata ni Amai Wana
description:
In the Keisei High School infirmary, the school's doctor is regularly visited by Atsuki, the frail and handsome school prince.   
  
They grow closer over tea and biscuits, but could Atsuki's feelings be real or are they merely being used to escape the loneliness caused by the death of his parents?  
  
Can love bloom successfully between a teacher and their student?

title: MAX Lovely!
description: Best friends Tokieda Airi and Sahara Taki have had a happy junior high school life, but the mysterious group “F” begins to target them because they attract too much attention! “F” has already hurt many attention-grabbing students, and they begin their attacks on Airi and Taki by trying to split the best friends apart. When this method doesn’t work, they sink even lower: they target Airi’s sister Nako! Airi and Taki’s beautiful school life has been ruined, and now they must race to reveal the culprits of “F”…

title: Kigurumi Planet
description: One day, university student Narumi Daisuke meets a pink kigurumi rabbit in the street. This kigurumi, named Arita, falls in love at first sight Daisuke! But, no matter where the two meet, it seems that Arita won't take off his bodysuit. To Daisuke, who finds this strange, Arita makes a shocking confession! If he takes off his costume, he will die… "The truth is, I'm an Undergrounder!" Is he for real?!

title: Haunted Campus
description: The story follows Mototsu Yagami, a college student who can see ghosts but doesn't want to. In college, he meets Koyomi Nada, who was his junior in high school. Out of unrequited love for her, he follows her into the "occult research society," which is full of eccentrics who fill their campus life with the occult.

title: Ninki Seiyuu Oshi sugi Gachizei ga Housoubu wo Yattemita
description: 色葉桃音は高校1年生。中学と同じく高校でも放送部に入部しようと部室にいくと、そこには聞き覚えのある声の男の子がいて・・・

title: Leave Me Alone!
description:
You don't know me. Got it?
After a rough three years in middle school, Doeun decides to return to her hometown and attend high school there for some peace and quiet. But with her old besties now the hottest, most popular guys in school, that might be harder than she thought. Why can't everyone just leave her alone?!

---
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/dont-pretend-to-know-me/list?title_no=2787)

title: You are Beautiful
description: College is expensive. After his big brother sacrificed their life savings to pay for his tuition, the last thing Sujin wanted was to burden his new roommate. Little did he know, she was a beautiful older woman?! Minuk, famous writer, ex best friend of Sujin’s brother, and also very gay. She’s letting Sujin stay on one condition: don’t fall in love. More specific: with her. Can he do it? What is her past with his older brother? And why was Sujin chased out of the last college he entered…

title: Nidome no Koi wa, Hayami-kun to
description:
The manga is about a girl who confesses to a guy she likes, right after starting school, but gets instantly rejected. To make the failed confession more heartbreaking, the school's cool guy witnesses the whole scene.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Shoukan Kemonoshi no Gakkou
description: Long, long ago, there once was a country inhabited by summoned beasts. However, that country is no more and they now live scattered through various parts of the world. It has been 100 years since a school was created where summoned beasts are taken in and used to help foster a child's growth. Cora was born and raised in a town that discriminates against those beasts. However, one day, she befriends a boy named Kilian who is confined in a dungeon. Escaping the town where summoned beasts are oppressed, she leaves home and heads towards a school for summoners.

title: Koi no Shizuku
description:
1-2) Dripping of Love  
Maya and Narusawa, college students at the same university, start sleeping together in what was supposed to be a purely physical relationship. Maya, however, starts to fall deeper into the relationship and has started to want more. Will real love mess up the relationship they have now? The bittersweet story of two people troubled by love.  
  
3) The Distance That Your Voice Touches  
Miyakawa's upstairs neighbor Tsukasa is always dropping things onto his balcony, and of course Miyakawa has to return them, only to be fed dinner and sexually harassed! It's getting to be too much for the poor college student.  
  
4) I Want to Embrace  
High school student Takase is unwittingly drawn to cheerful energetic Sora. But as his interest and naturally protective feelings toward his friend become something deeper and more dangerous, Takase begins to pull away from Sora.  
  
5) Shake  
Kikusui is a waiter in a cafe with primarily female clientele, but lately a handsome ma

title: Yuānjiā Yí Jié Bù Yí Jiě
description: The male and female lead's first encounter was a heavily remembered thing! They hated each other, but just out of luck, they became classmates! Not only were they classmates, but also seatmates! These two, like enemies that fought and battled! They both despise each other and tortured each other. But what will this continuous torture and bothering result in...

title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
description:
Kazuko is a high school senior who has no idea what she wants to do in the future. Alone one day after school, she discovers a broken beaker in the science lab. She smells something sweet in the air, passes out, and finds herself transported back to her own past! Will Kazuko use her ability to travel through time wisely or selfishly?

Based on the 1965 novel.

title: Christmas ni Omoi o Nosete
description: Setsuna and Hijiri are always found to be at loggerheads. Setsuna bakes some cookies for Hijiri before Christmas to make her feelings reach him. But Hijiri doesn't seem to like the idea of Setsuna making cute cookies and retorts rudely. How will their story progress?

title: Strawberry And Milk Tea
description:
From Lezhin:  
The emotions between these two are fresh like a strawberry and sweet like a cup of milk tea. Love is blossoming all over this campus!

title: Twinkle Twinkle Little...
description: An 18 year old girl that is in love with her step brother who is same age as her and goes to the same school. She leaps through time and finds herself all grown up… what will happen on this crazy adventure to find true love? Stay tuned to see an amazing story of a high school girl's first love that will be a thriller to read.

title: Spring One Year Later
description:
Yuuko wants her best friend to be happy, so she supports her friend's crush, a senpai. However, there is another energetic senpai that is aiming for Yuuko…  
  
(Source: MU)

title: Ouchi he Kaerou
description:
The calm composed honor-student, Satomi has always stated his dislikes about Keiko but meeting accidentally at a preschool, Keiko makes an unexpected connection that is found between having to look after her younger brother as Satomi does with his younger sister. This leading to Keiko being able to speak with Satomi normally, to coming to the point of helping Satomi who is poor with housekeeping…?!  
  
Includes two extra stories:  
Ore-Sama Housekeeper  
Digital Honey

title: In My Rain
description: Ella, de una escuela prestigiosa… Él, de una escuela conocida por sus pandilleros… Ellos, se encuentran sólo los días de lluvia… ¿Podrán experimentar el amor por primera vez?

title: Kare wa Ima, Koi o Shite Iru.
description:
"Now, he is in love". Collected short stories from the male point of view.  
  
1. Mizuiro Hanabi  
2. Kokuhaku  
3. Ato Hitotsu  
4. Bokura no Seiza

title: Tonari ni Iru no ni, Tooi
description: Nagisa's good friend, Igarashi Taiga, is the popular guy at their university. After being compared to Taiga, Nagisa keeps wondering who would in fact make a better lover. He questions Taiga, who demonstrates his skills with a hot kiss… What will come after that?

title: Tribology
description: A humorous story centered around the life of a girl named Hinatsu Nose, an undergraduate student in the Department of Engineering. Just as she is entering her senior year of college and is applying to join a research lab, her friends start talking to her more about love and she becomes curious about having relationships with guys. Since Hinatsu is a material science nerd who has an unhealthy obsession with melting and molding metal, it surprises everyone when she suddenly takes interest in a guy she meets in a lab. Will love continue to be a side thought for Hinatsu??

title: She's Scary
description:
A beauty at first glance,  
the opposite of organized,  
Swearing as part of her daily routine,  
The so~ hot girl, Jin Eun Jung  
  
Considered a hunk by everyone,  
A textbook example of a good student,  
The king of organization,  
The student council president,  
The so~ hot guy, Moon Seo Young  
  
Suddenly one day,  
these completely different people  
start living under the same roof  
and something starts to change!  
In a bittersweet way ♥

title: Honnou Level Itoshiteru
description: Chiho, a second-year high school student, is childhood friends with a handsome, slightly overprotective Shion. Shion has a special constitution called "alpha" and is a super-perfect person from birth. On the other hand, Chiho is an ordinary person called "beta," but a certain change appears on her birthday--?!

title: Party! - Hana - Higashi Nihon Daishinsai Charity Mangabon
description:
A collection of extras from creators in Shueisha's Margaret shōjo manga magazine to raise funds for the victims of the Great Eastern Japan Earthquake disaster.

title: Kaeshite Kudasai. Mari-senpai
description: **Award:** Won an Excellent Work in the 20th Monthly Shounen Magazine Comic Grand Awards Debut!.

title: Nanda Koitsu!
description: Học sinh lớp 10 Kato, vì không giỏi ăn nói cùng cặp mắt dữ dằn nên cậu bị cô lập trong lớp.Một ngày nọ, lúc cậu đang chán nản vì những tin đồn thất thiệt thì thấy đàn anh lớp trên Usaki gặp rắc rối với đám du cônUsaki rất có hảo cảm với Kato vì đã giúp mình. Anh đã mời Kato vào câu lạc bộ, theo dõi, thậm chí là bắn tên vào Kato để thu hút sự chú ý!?Tình yêu trong sáng giữa cậu nhóc trông đáng sợ nhưng vụng về cùng anh chàng xinh đẹp kì quái.

title: Hidden Persona
description: Chen Cheng had an unexpected encounter in Nandu University. She discovered the secret of Wen Jiaqin, a popular actor. It turns out that his persona of a "good little brother" was fake! He is simply a naive and childish person! But, does she now know too much? Is she going to be silenced?

title: How I met your father
description: Just a small comic, it's about how " mommy " and " daddy " have fallen in love ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Various, Various MayaKuro (Doujinshi)
description:
Seisho Music Academy's top two actresses-in-training, Maya Tendou and Claudine Saijou, and their relationship across different timelines and universes.

{The Last Story is a Sequel to the "SeeSaw Game" MayaKuro Doujinshi OneShot}

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: The Poem of Aster and Hana
description:
High schooler Hana Kim channels her pain and angst by leading a secret life as Sparrow, the live streamer! In her vids, she shares her love of poetry yet never her own face, because — let’s be honest — people are the worst, especially on the internet. Her cherished anonymity is broken when her classmate Aster discovers her private life and wants to get closer to her. Will she keep her distance from him? Or will she let down the walls she built to protect her heart from life’s cruel realities?

title: Smartphone ni Kimi ga Iru Kiseki
A Suspicious Confession
description: "We are getting married!" . Soon after returning from an overseas trip ;  Minhae feels troubled when she hears at the airport that her best friend , Yoona and her long time crush , Kanghyun are going to get married." I didn't even know that they were dating but marriage ?! " Yoona knew that the person Minhae liked was Kanghyun .  " I lived diligently  , only clinging to work , with the determination to succeed but the result was betrayal from my best friend and broken heart. One-day, on her way back home from work , Minhae stumbles upon her cat , Marie and runs into the driveway to save the cat and meets with an accident. " Right after the accident what I remember is the flashing headlights and the floating sensation . When I opened my eyes , I thought " Am I going to die like this.?! " I returned to a year and a half before the car accident . I will live differently this time. I'll balance my work life and confess before it's too late. Manager Kwon Joohyuk , who had nothing to do with

title: Dansou no Hametsu Seijonanoni Kyuukoku Kishi ga Amayakashite kuru
description:
Akurei—better known as Akira—was born as the only being possessing the holy power of the Saintess.
Fearing that, just like in past wars, a Saintess might once again become the spark of conflict, Akira’s parents raised her to live as a boy.

Now at eighteen, Akira sets off to study abroad in a neighboring country.
She wishes only for a calm, peaceful, and uneventful school life… but before long, she somehow catches the attention of three captains of the Holy Knight Order—

“We want you to join our knight order.”

title: Elite-sama Koi Shiyou
description:
Yukio is a cold girl with a poker face, not to mention that she is cute, and works like president of student council with the most popular two guys on school. But under all that seriousness is her throbbing heart desperate to be loved by someone.

Even so, why cant she tell him?

Extras:  
+ Love Progression of an Honour Student extra
+ Cute Prince
+ The Idol and the Jealous Girl

title: Sweety
description:
How do you distinguish between the love from a cute neighborhood girl (who’s like a little sister to you), and the love from the hottest, yet quirky, girl in school? This is exactly the question Myung-Ho has to ponder when both his neighbor’s cute little daughter, Ji-Hae, and his school’s most popular diva, Yu-Ri, make him their valentines. Of course he cares for Ji-Hae, because the poor girl’s already been through so much for someone her age, but still, she’s only just a kid. Then there’s Yu-Ri, the girl of his dreams…or rather, she would be if she wasn’t a fortune-telling voodoo witch doctor. Oh and yes, it would also help if her father, the local gangster boss, wasn’t out to kill him.  
  
When you’re as lucky as Myung-Ho is(?) choices are very hard to make. On one hand, he could go out with Yu-Ri by turning down Ji-Hae, breaking the heart of a child who’s been depending on him ever since she moved in next door. Or, he could choose Ji-Hae by turning down the only chance at romance w

title: Love Survival
description: Seri is in love with her childhood friend Kou. But he's more interested in her sister! To make things more complicated, Seri's classmate Ikushi is always getting on her nerves… because he likes her sister, too!!

title: Marilyn wa, Inaku Natta
description:
Kyoko Marihara, a 24-year-old teacher in Japan, has lost her memory of the past seven years due to a blow to the head, and is now a 17-year-old. 24-year-old Kyoko looks and acts like a different person from the serious, happy-go-lucky Kyoko of her 17-year-old days. She is shocked to find out that she has become the teacher she had always wanted to be, but her students are cheating on her, and she is separated from her parents, whom she loved very much.

(from mangaupdates)

title: Ouji-sama ni Nemuri Hime no Kiss wo
description: Tsukiko loves to sleep and spends every opportunity to do so. As a usual activity, she has slept at the school roof, however she finds a guy sleeping next to her! This same guy, also have asked her to sleep next to him in order to help him with his sleeping problems. This guy (dun dun dun) happens to also be that very popular guy that is the prince of the school. As they spend more time together, it's harder and harder for Tsukiko to get the sleep that she usually gets…

title: Heikou Sekai no Kimi Kimi Boku Boku
description:
Makise likes Sakai, a lively girl in his class, but he has a hard time telling her how he really feels about her.  One morning, Makise woke up and found himself in a "parallel world".
The differences from the original world are that the school uniform is the school run and the classes move slowly, and Sakai is my girlfriend.

This is a coming-of-age love story of junior high school students who move back and forth between two worlds!

title: Utatane Hime
description: Collection of stories published in Harta and Fellows.

title: Lucky-La-Kiss
description: Luck that gets replaced with a kiss? Tamao Mirika has been super lucky from the moment she was born, and when she kissed the 'Not-so-lucky' handsome Ichinose, her luck got replaced?! A destined love that starts with a kiss.

title: Kimi Dake ni Ai wo.
description:
Won't this love ever reach you, no matter how much I think about you…?  
1) I Love Only You. (Kimi Dake ni Ai wo.)  
Sayumi finally got the courage to ask the guy she likes out, Yui-kun. Everyday her feelings grow more and more for him, but she also notices he keeps looking at another girl, Momoko. No matter what she does she feels he's not looking at her…Will he ever look at her only?  
  
2) Simple Missile (Tenen Missile)  
Hanako attends the girls only school St. Silvias for young ladies. She has fallen in love with a guy from Koudan High School which is looked down upon by St. Silvias. She overhears the guy she likes mention to his friends that he doesn't like spoiled girls and would never go out with someone from that school…what will she do?  
  
3) Simple Kiss  
Arisa is the senior to Yuuta in basketball at school. One-day after seeing a couple outside kissing they tried it too. They are now kissing friends! Arisa doesn't seem to notice that Yuuta wants to be something more than

title: No Love, Zettai
description: Ayaya Kizaki was said to be a child prodigy when he was young, but before he knew it, he was living a very average student life, one step away from failing. Then Ayaya receives a letter of admission information, and it is from an elite and prestigious school... Get a girlfriend before graduation!? At a school that encourages "heterosexual intercourse," a troubled youth begins with heroines who have their own reasons!

title: Mayokohama Ramen Sanshimai
description: A Ramen shop run by three sisters that's about to go out of business. Can Tonko's childhood friend Shiina save the Ramen Shop?

title: The Time Traveler's Daughter
description:
What if the dead could travel through time and space? A rebellious girl meets her long-dead father, and the two become classmates.

Life is about to turn upside down!

title: Mako and Rumi and Chii
description:
This Manga deals with parenting, depicting the daily lives of mangaka Ohsamu Tetsuro, who strongly resembles Tezuka Osamu himself, and his family.  
  
The story begins with the birth of his first son. The son is named Makoto (nicknamed Mako) and grows to be a healthy 2 year-old, basking in the love of his orderly mother and careless father. The son is followed by two daughters named Rumiko (nicknamed Rumi) and Chiiko (nicknamed Chii). This story focuses on the increasing hustle and bustle inside the Ohsamu family.

Also includes the 4-koma work "Sorry, Mama": The lively day-to-day family life of the young boy Yabo Onishi, his mother, and his father. Frequently, they are tempted by their desires (represented as their other selves, with devil horns and tails), and sometimes, against their better judgment, they may fall to them. But above all, they value family the most.

---
**Volume 273 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Alliance of Unrequited Love
description: Yu-han and Tae-yun form a one-sided love alliance as they enter High School. Yu-han, who falls in love quickly, immediately falls in love. Tae-yun, who always viewed Yu-han as pitiful, soon also develops a crush. And both slowly became more aware of each other.

title: Hieshou Danshi Kouryakubou
description: She can not stand the hot weather and does not want to live in Hokkaido. He, the ice man who loves the high temperatures and wants to live in Okinawa. They are a harmonious pair but this does not prevent them to have different for the good of another?

title: Bokura no Jam wa Amakunai
description: Sawa Mizuno is a first-year high school student who is quiet and doesn't stand out. At the high school she attends, a band called "Blue Burst" which is made up of four members is very popular! Seems like Sawa and the band members have nothing to do with each other. But in fact, one of them is Sawa's twin sibling! Afraid of repeating a year and because it conflicts with his work , he convinces Sawa to attend his make-up classes - that means she has to pretend to be his brother?

title: Kiss Me Baby
description:
A girl gets impatient when she and her boyfriend haven't kissed yet, even though they've been dating for awhile, so she tries to take matters into her own hands.  
  
Also, there's a oneshot after this about a girl with a similar problem as in the first story with her dating the most popular guy at school who hasn't made any moves on her.  
  
A sequel chapter can be found in the Pink no Idenshi anthology.

title: Tomboy Banzai
description:
A shojo one-shot compilation that chiefly features one-shots from the 1960's and ones published in Kodansha shojo magazines, with a theme of celebrating girlhood and girls from all walks of life.

- **Tomboy Banzai** (おてんばバンザイ, Otenba Banzai): A gag one-shot in three parts about a thrill-seeking tomboy and her encounters with a group of petty yakuza.
- **Clattery Classroom**
- **The Silver Eyes**: Horror manga is all the rage at Sumi's school. One day, her teacher asks her to check up on her friend, who has been absent from school for some time. Before she knows it, Sumi ends up in a horror manga of her own!
- **Will You Listen to Swan Lake With Me?**: Ishinomori's whimsical take on Swan Lake.
- **Manga School**
- **Little Red Riding Hood**
- **New Masterpiece Fairytale Little Red Riding Hood**
- **The Modern Girl's Mentality**: A whimsical commentary on all the hottest trends and pastimes of modern girls.
- **Summer Break! Operation Cupid**: A boy gets asked by his friend to set him u

title: You're No Good
description:
Why does Alfred insist on living as an outcast?  
And why does Hollie try so hard to keep him company?  
Is there something going on between the two?

title: How to Train a Carnivore (Persona 3)
description: A doujinshi about the popular ship between Shinjiro Aragaki and the female protagonist in Persona 3. It takes place after they start dating in the game

title: Forget About Love
description: Saerim Lee gets into an accident and loses her memory as a result. When she goes to school, she realizes that everyone is afraid of her, even her two best friends, who tell her that she was a very mean girl who blackmailed people, using their secrets against them. But she realizes that she can order people around because she supposedly knows these secrets, all of which were forgotten in the car crash. She only has one connection to the person she was in the past, and that is her diary. In it, she wrote of the person she was in love with, but never his name. She will stop at nothing to discover his identity!

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Violets (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine, both of whom are young actresses-in-training at the renowned Seisho Music Academy, spend some time together outdoors in the academy grounds.

[Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Oui Oui Days
description: It’s about school life and there are three girls and three guys but only the first guy and girl are introduced in the first chapter. The girl, Taeko, even forgets her own friends’ names, and the guy, Ushio, is also an airhead. They make a cute couple.

title: Gokujou Twins
description:
- **1 - Gokujou Twins**  
Morinaga Sara, 16 years old, is a cool, yet calm girl… But in reality, she has this incredibly ugly smile. Because of the trauma she experienced, she became expressionless. However, the source of her trauma, the twins, who apparently became really good-looking, suddenly appears right in front of her!  
  
- **2 - Chocolate Sensou**  
Konishi has made Valentine chocolate for her secret crush Nakata-senpai but amidst giving senpai the chocolate, they accidently get handed to Makino Shinichirou. As Konishi says its not for him and hurting Makino's pride in the process, it becomes a game of trying to get her Valentine chocolate back from Makino before the end of the day.  
  
- **3 - Itazura Ouji**  
Mayuri was asked to be in charge of educating a selfish rich young boy. What will happen to her…?!  
  
- **4 - Katekyo to Obenkyou**  
Nina has a home tutor who is extremely mean. She considers him the devil. But her feelings get confused when she sees his nice side…

title: Chicken Cutlet Princess
description:
A playboy who has gone through countless girls; a pure, lovely girl whose only love is chicken cutlets; a super gifted student who spouts poetry and songs about fried chicken cutlets; a blond hyperactive boy who chases after girls with chicken cutlet deliveries three times a day; the student council president Wei Luo Li who moves people's hearts everywhere, and also the truth of the BL headline story published in the school newspaper…  
  
The legendary stories happening at Rembrandt High School are just that unbelievable!  
  
Includes a side story to "Proud Dragon Showy Phoenix", which was published in Butterfly Likes to Read (<https://mangadex.com/manga/4508>).

title: Shan Cat
description:
Short manga serial of Hideo Azuma that features the first Neko-Mimi (cat-ears) in history, Sham Cat. (further details in the rest of the desc.)

Serialized in Weekly Shonen Champion.

Descriptions for each chapter:

- Chapter 1 - **Sham Appears**
An odd cat who can speak human language comes running into
the apartment of a ronin student boy. The cat also turns into a bishojo!

- Chapter 2 - **Cutting a Tail, and a Great Transformation...!?**
Ban (The last name of this ronin student) goes to his part-time job, but Sham, wanting attention, follows him around after.

- Chapter 3 - **Dig Up Shadows, Nyan Nyan!!**
All living things have a great weakness. You'll know right away when you dig up their shadow...
Sham displays her mysterious ESP, and an enemy bearing an existential crisis draws near.

- Chapter 4 - **When You Want to be Popular, This Scent...**
Ban falls in love with Ranko, the idol of Ajima Prep. He tearfully wishes,
"I want to be popular for once!!" Sham easily succeeds in gra

title: Seigi no Mikata!
description: Quick tempered, dirt poor brawler Kotarou Mikata can’t hold down a job because he always ends up beating the crap out of some errant customer. Just when he’s at wit’s end, “S” offers Mikata a job as a “hero”. But what exactly does it mean to be a hero? Join Mikata on his WTF journey from brawler to hero in the action romantic comedy “Seigi no Mikata”!

title: Boy's Abyss (Fan Colored)
description:
In a town with nothing, in the middle of a daily life with seemingly no signs of change,  high schooler Reiji Kurose was "just" living.  Family, dreams for the future, childhood friends were all binding him down to that city.  He thought he would "just" keep on living like that. 

Until he met her. 

Is there hope in living? Is there light waiting ahead? 

It's the start of a boy meets girl series which reflects the "now."

title: Oretachi ni Ai wa Nai
description: Mikoto Inui lives with her rich grandfather. Her parents are dead, so he's all that she has. Her grandfather is worried about what will happen to her when he's not there anymore, so he wants her to attend an omiai [an arranged marriage meeting], while she'd prefer to go live on her own. He pushes her to attend them anyway, but at her next omiai, she meets Saruno Itaru, whom she likes right away. They decide to get engaged but… things aren't what they seem to be?

title: What to Do if My Cotenant Is My Love-Rival?
description: Because of his cousin's "mistake", the good boy Song Shuzhi lives in a shared apartment with his rival, Zhou Xu. Zhou Xu is a cynical playboy, and Song Shuzhi disregards him. The lives of the two are also chaotic. But later, an inexplicable feeling filled the two of them...

title: Yuki-doke no Netsu
description: Takaharu has fallen in love at first sight with a girl named Mifuyu, who has named herself a "snow maiden" who can't fall in love. What will it take for Takaharu to melt her frozen heart?

title: Tenjou no Kajitsu
description: Tomita Yuri has hated boys since she was little, seeing them as the devils who taunt and tease her. So when her all-girl school Kinka academy decides to merge with the Ginka academy for boys, her ‘heaven’ is once again threatened by the devils from hell = men. Not only that, but being a member of the student council, she now has to work alongside the male student council of Ginka academy. Will Yuri’s ‘heaven’ be overrun by the male devils from hell?

title: Shoujo Shuutome no Yuuutsu
description: A perfectionist girl and a slob of a boy! What could possibly go right?

title: Danshi ing Girl!
description: Karin HATES guys. She can't stand the sight of them, let alone be near them. But after a near death experience she finds herself waking up to a guy she doesn't know, within a guy school and in a guy's body!!?!

title: Coincidental Contact
description:
"우리, 어디서 만난 적 있지 않아요?"

서로를 알기 전, 이미 몇 번의 만남이 있었던 우연과 예하.
둘은 우연의 퍼즐을 모아 관계를 완성할 수 있을까?
평생 엇갈릴 것만 같았던 둘이 세 번째 접점을 계기로 시작하게 되는 캠퍼스 로맨스.

title: Alexandrite
