description: This story is a spinoff from Narita Minako's own series *Cipher* where Siva's friend Alex Levine is now the main character. Ever since Alex was young, he has harbored a complex about his extremely pretty face. People are always comparing him to a girl, so to combat this image, he has thrown himself into practicing martial arts. One day, though, he is scouted by someone to become a fashion model and thus begins Alex's tale of growth and romance!

title: Yousuke no Kimyou na Sekai
description: 20-volume anthology of short stories, from surrealism to horror, featuring Yousuke's lovely art style.

title: Yoru no Gakkou e Oide yo!
description: Hayasaka Yoru lost her parents, and was taken in by her relative, Enomoto, who's a junior high school teacher. Her house is called "School House", which is on the premise of the school. The students would gather there and have fun every day, but when they go back, it's very quiet and lonely. One day, at school at night, she found an unexpected side of her classmate Yamane. Gradually, she becomes attracted to him…?!

title: Haikyuu!! - Caramel Panic (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Hinata and Kageyama are dating, and while Kageyama can be a little cold and aloof, Hinata is enjoying every aspect of their relationship otherwise–until he learns that in middle school, Kageyama was quick to dump a girlfriend whenever she became too annoying, so Hinata starts planning on how to make sure Kageyama never tires of him.

title: Aoharu Nante Kimi no Sei
description: Ena, a high school girl, is working part-time as a housekeeper. Her landlord, Mikanagi-san, is a manga artist. Mikanagi, who is cool and unapproachable, asks Ena to "teach JK" to help her create manga. As part-timers, they take purikura pictures and go to the beach together, but their relationship seems to be a little too close. "Is this an extension of a part-time job? I'm so nervous!"

title: Lunatic Japan
description:
Ichiro Kitamura ("Icchi") is a young man who, due to a near-death experience he had when he was little, has to attend night school. On his way back from school one night, Ichiro encounters something truly out of this world - a procession of ghosts! A conversation with a reporter in the city reveals that Ichiro is not the only one to have come across paranormal encounters as of late. Then, Ichiro happens to see a girl at the train station, but she, too, has ties to the ghosts...

---
**Volume 247 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Only☆You: Anata to Watashi no Futari Bocchi Keikaku
Atsui Hibi
description:
A collection of oneshots:  
  
1) Atsui Hibi  
When Kuniyoshi was on his way home, he saw honour student, Ikeda, in the river looking for his notebook. Then, the girl who picked up the notebook, Murozono appears and she has come to know about the ‘murder-plans’ written in it…  
  
2) Flower's marking  
Who draws the beautiful flowers on Kikuchu's desk? And why were they erased when she added one of her own next to them?  
  
3) Cold days like before  
Can the warm feelings of Tooyama thaw Ikeda senpai's heart.  
  
4) Nameless Guest  
Four people are held hostages under the threat that those who remain will be killed if anyone tries to escape. Then a professional hostage rescuer sneaks into the room looking for Tateishi Hideyo only…

title: Kuzu no Kanojo ~Demo Daisuki Nanda Mon~
description: There's no way I will fall in love with my really brutal childhood friend after XXX!?

title: Ore ni Horeta to Ittekure!
description:
A love fight between a crazy, devoted Yankee and a high school girl working part-time at a pharmacy!

Yankee Shishio is challenged to a fight and (even though he wins) is injured to the point of bleeding from his head. While stopping by a drugstore, he falls in love at first sight with Maya, a part-time worker who talks to him without any fear and even worries about his wounds, and he can't help but confess his feelings! But she rejects him, saying, "Yankees are a bit..."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Because I Like it! Taste the Strange Fruit!
description: Amasaki Asuka has finally gotten into the school she wants, a school where Togo Hiroshi, the man who rescued her from a subway groper, works as a teacher. She has a big, intensely sexual crush on him, but he seems to not remember her. When Asuka arrives at the school dorm, the dorm leader, Shiga Kahori, shows her around. Asuka is shocked to realize that she has the same sexual feelings for Kahori! Will Kahori return her feelings?

title: My Last Love Scenario
description: College is a time of freedom, learning, and, let's be honest, sex. Juhyun and Jigoo spent most of their high school years studying and keeping their relationship a secret from everyone in their lives. But now, they've moved out which means no curfew, no rules, and no roommates. But they're about to learn that taking their relationship to the next level means taking on some new challenges, too.

title: Amai Doku Osananajimi
description: I feel him catch me, I feel he paralyzes me and then devours me. My childhood friend is the heir to a millionaire family and since childhood I have been at your mercy … but … Do you just for fun? Because my heart and my body no longer resist it …

title: Living in a Happy World
description:
Kanae, who's just been through terrible heartbreak, decides to take a vacation to the mountains, hoping to take her mind off of things. Her skiing instructor turns out to be more of a comfort to Kanae then anything, and she finds herself slowly opening up to him. Unfortunately, before long, it's time to say goodbye… But this isn't even close to the end of their story!  
  
[PL] Kanae, której właśnie złamano serce, postanowiła, że pojedzie w góry. Jej narciarski instruktor pociesza ją, a Kanae zaczyna się przy nim otwierać. Niestety, niedługo nadejdzie czas pożegnania, ale… To nie koniec historii!

title: Tetsuya Chiba Short Stories - Shojo Manga
description:
A collection of two shojo short-serials and a one-shot from Tetsuya Chiba. Part of a three-volume short stories series, alongside a volume of his shonen work and his essay manga.

- **Papa's Bride** (パパのお嫁さん, Papa no Oyomesan) - Ekko (Etsuko) Nakajima is a feisty little girl who lives alone with her father. One day, after many struggles, one of her father's musical compositions get selected by the Japan Music Association. From there, many joys and sorrows present themselves before them as Ekko's father ascends in the world of music.
- **Jambo Riko** (ジャンボ・リコ) - Riko (Ritsuko) is the daughter of the head of a hospital situated in South Africa. When Riko's parents do not return from their search of crucial medicine, it's up to her and a colorful crew from around the world to search for them.
- **Like the Wind** (風のように, Kaze no You ni) - Chiba's last major shojo work, this recounts the story of a rambunctious boy from an beekeeping family, and the impact he makes on a rural mountain villa

title: Suki Kirai Suki
description: He hates to lose and is a little shorter than other boys. A little cheeky, but when he smiles, he's really cute. This is the Miyamoto that Hitomi loves so much. Just before the entrance exam for high school, she has two chances to make a confession. But she is dazzled and doesn't really have to courage to do it, so she decides to leave it for after the exam. Or at least that's what she thought…

title: Konna Otoko wa Aisareru
description:
Sonekawa Retsu, the high school karate club captain, has been in love with the student body president, Kaji Shogo, since junior high. He even went as far as volunteering for the position of student body secretary in order to be close to him.  
  
Retsu has never thought of confessing his feelings, but his constant heated stares don't leave Kaji unaware of the situation. However, this bashful late bloomer needs serious help…  
  
Would love finally blossom between these two men from different worlds?

title: Our Beloved Summer
description:
At Midsummer High, Yeon-Su Guk is at the top of her class, while Wung Choi is ranked dead-last. And it’s not just their grades -- their personalities couldn’t be more different, as Yeon-Su is a no-nonsense stickler and Wung is a care-free slacker. When a filmmaker comes to make a documentary about their school life over the course of a month, they’re not exactly thrilled to be spending so much time together. However, as the month goes on, they begin to discover each other’s hidden depths. At least one thing’s for certain - they’ll never forget this summer!

Note:

This webtoon is a prequel to the Kdrama, Our Beloved Summer, the webtoon will focus on Choi Wung and Guk Yeonsu in their high school days.

title: Shite, Okeba Yokatta Koukai
description:
1) I should have…  
En Asakura often has the same dream lately. She dreams of a boy asking her to kiss him. Her dream is connected to a painful memory from her high-school life, when she felt in love with a boy named Maru. When he asked her to kiss him, she refused, and now she's regretting it. Not to mention that the boy started to date another girl after that incident.   
  
En is now in university and is trying to find her life partner through goukon: blind group dates. What will she do when a boy with the same name as her past crush asks for her number? Will she refuse and regret it again?  
  
2) The Realization Of Happiness  
Continuation of the preview chapter.  
  
3) After School Kiss  
  
4) Tell Me You Love Me  
  
5-6) My Friend's Boyfriend

title: I Like You, I Like You, I Like You
description:
Why do I have to love only one person?
Half of the world's 7.3 billion people are men, but it is a perfect X-year that cannot be understood that only one person should be loved. And a full-fledged romantic comedy unfolded by three attractive men who fell in love with it.

title: Prism Spectrum
description:
From Attractive Fascinante:  
  
Oomura Yuu's first kiss was stolen by the beautiful Student Council president, Takamura Mitsuya. He later became his executive secretary and his duty was to do whatever Takamura wanted. Both loved cats and were slowly drawn towards each other. As much as Yuu wanted to acknowledge his own feelings, he realised that he might not really knew about Takamura at all. In the end, Yuu decided to follow his heart and reach out to Takamura.

title: Scarlet
description:
1-2) Scarlet   
College student Akio is dating his beautiful classmate, Ryou. Unable to stand the slightest loneliness, Ryou accepts any girl who approaches him. One day, Ryou introduces Akio to a girl he is thinking of marrying which makes Akio decide to completely break it off with Ryou. Instead, a heart wrenching love story takes stage!  
  
3-4) One Night Stand  
During the day Harumi is just a normal businessman but when night comes he changes into a different person.  
  
5) My Lover  
Keito wonders why he is still in a relationship with the overly depressive Naoki

title: Asa mo, Hiru mo, Yoru mo
description: Shinobu is a typical high school girl…with an atypical hatred of boys. Long ago, she was horribly abused by one and hasn't been able to tolerate being near them since. Now Yokomizo has appeared before her–a boy who looks exactly like the one who tormented her in the past. He's the last guy she wants to have around, but then he confesses his love to her!?

title: Apple Dynamite
description: The fathers of the Go and Do families promised each other when they were young that they would raise their families side by side and they did just so. Years later, their kids are now teenagers/young adult who have been with each other most of their lives and are childhood friends. This is the story of the kids, their friends, and the relationships that weave them together yet just might be changing too.

title: Say Love
description:
A high school boy and a female student spend the night in a hotel after drinking a little much…  
… without being able to remember what may have happened between the two of them!  
  
Three months later, the female student comes back to the young man telling him she might be…pregnant…?!

title: Love and Sin of Hotaru
description:
"What did we do wrong?" 

17-year-old Hotaru Morikawa has fallen in love with a teacher, Sakuya Kagetsu. Hotaru tries to get close to him out of a faint infatuation, but Kagetsu has a hidden, horrific past. Hotaru gets caught up in the whirlpool of crimes surrounding him. A shocking pure love suspense!

title: Kara Kara
description:
Matsumoto Hinako is a girl who's not good at expressing her feelings. After being dumped for that exact reason, she accidentally sees Uchida, a classmate, breaking up with his girlfriend. "What a noisy guy…" she thinks and then he saves her with a bicycle…  
  
[PL] ||Matsumoto Hinako to dziewczyna, która nie jest dobra w wyrażaniu własnych emocji. Po byciu odrzuconą z tego powodu przez przypadek zauważa Uchidę, kolegę z klasy, który zrywa ze swoją dziewczyną. Myśli: „Co za facet…”, a później ratuje on ją na swoim rowerze.||

title: Namae mo Shiranai
description: Kobayashi Hina has always had one single goal: to study hard and get into a good university. During her breaks while studying at the library she notices a short football player in the courtyard and gazing at him is starting to become a habit for her. She doesn’t know who he is, but his constant presence near the place she’s studying is starting to become a distraction. Does finding love means giving up on studying?

title: Mou Shoujo Manga Nante
description:
A collection of stories:  
  
1. Mou Shoujo Manga Nante (I Don't Want To Make Girl's Comic Again)  
I made my début as mangaka at 14 and we called me the new genius. However I don't want to just draw manga for the rest of my life! I thought that I needed a goal but…One of my classmate, Mamiya, asked me to take him as my assistant…?!  
  
2. Heroine Blue  
  
3. Michikusa Shounen Shoujo  
  
4. Usotsuki House  
  
5. Time Machine wa Uso o Tsuku (Lying Time Machine)  
I wish I could use a time machine… Mizutani has found her crush's phone! Instead of directly giving it back to him, she begged him to be her email friend with an alias. Will he ever find out?

title: Ama Iro Omoi
description: Aiko falls in love at first sight with a guy who lends her an umbrella on a rainy day. Later, she meets him again on the train to school, but no matter how hard she tries, she still can’t confess her love to him. Will Aiko be able to convey her feelings to this guy, whose name she doesn’t even know, or will everything remain simply a beautiful memory of a rainy day?

title: The Unfitting Puzzle Piece
description: Lisa is a school girl who wants to know the secret behind Eva’s perfect life, and she will soon, but what she finds is not what she was expecting from her flawless classmate…

title: Okatai Ouji no Tsuyagoto
description:
Mei Hanamaki, a second-year high school student who has transferred to another school for some reason. It was Iku Hinosaka, a handsome sergeant who is the most popular girl in the school, who showed her natural nature and took the seat next to her, who seemed to be floating from the first day of transfer.  
The cool Iku's de S is mercilessly poured on Mei, and each other's first impression is the worst.  
However, the relationship between the two began to change as a result of something …!? The super popular school romantic comedy, which won first place in the magical i Land novel overall ranking, has become a long-awaited comic!

title: Watashi no Umbrella Boy
description: Of course it rains on school events and play dates. Water trouble is a common occurrence once a day. Ayaha Umemoto, a high school girl with a 100% chance of encountering a water accident, is asked by Azuma, a science-oriented boy in her class, to help him prove his case so that he can save Umemoto...? A handsome observational romantic comedy in which you can't help but fall in love with a watery, cutthroat science-oriented boy.

title: Blue Screen
description:
Can Kai become the greatest programmer? Find out in this school life + sports shonen manga!

Support Blu-kun: https://www.patreon.com/TEKNOmanga
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bluescreen_off/ 
Official Site: http://bluescreenoff.com/ 
Watch the Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kdrLIfT6qck 
All Links: https://linktr.ee/bluescreen_off

title: Dynamite Star
description: Sena and Hoshino had been friends ever since the day Hoshino was assigned to the seat in front of hers. When Hoshino suddenly confesses to her, Sena begins to face the difficulties of love as she tries to understand her feelings as well as his. What will Sena say in response to his confession?

title: Basketball Monster
description: Wu Wei is a 16-year-old boy who loves basketball but he was dissed due to his short height. It was impossible for him to survive in the basketball world where everyone who gathered is a giant with great skills. He became an official basketball player of Lan Ting High School by chance with his unbelievable jumping power and superhuman-like speed. Along with his buddies with different personalities together in this fight, he became the outstanding one with his quick learning ability in the basketball league where height is everything, and gradually became a basketball monster.

title: Kanchigai Musume to Buchigire Ouji
description:
1) Kanchigai Musume to Buchigire Ouji  
Kouga-kun is always looking at me, I think he likes me… Full of self confidence Keiko confesses her feelings to him. And as a result she had misunderstood and had a honorable defeat! After finding out that Kouga has someone else that he likes, she begins to give her support for him, but somehow her heart is full of pain. And then, Kouga can’t let that Keiko alone. The love of these two are full of misunderstandings, what will happen between these two!?  
  
2) Haru Fuwari Koi Hirari  
One day, Asumi's heart gets broken when her crush gets a girlfriend and she can't stop crying in class. But her tears are hidden by a guy name Yukiya and protects her from letting others see her cry. She then starts feeling for him and when a new semester starts, she finds him again and confesses right on the spot. He doesn't say yes, but gives her 3 days to kiss him. And if she does, he'll make her his girlfriend. How will shy Asumi be able to kiss this hottie?

title: Senpai wa Cool dakedo, Watashi ni Dake wa Amasugiru.
description: "I like you. I want you to go out with me." Komori Riko, a high school girl who has never known love, is suddenly confessed by Sena Minato, the handsome but famous student council president.

title: Taiyou ga Miteiru (Kamoshirenai Kara)
description: The story follows the daily life of Misaki Miyama, a freshman in high school and her two friends: the rich boy who used to get bullied in the past, Nire Hirose, whom she met in junior high; and the beautiful Kazuho Ida whom she got to know in high school. but it seems that Nire and Kazuho already know each other…

title: Olhae ui Beotkkot do Hamkke
description: When the cherry blossom petals blow in the spring wind, he remembers her again and his heart starts to beat faster. One year ago, he couldn't say those words to the girl he loved.

title: Suki, Kirai… demo Suki
description:
Stupid, poor and tease but I really love that guy…  
A compilation of six pure love awakening stories!!  
  
Isourou Otokowari – Anri Yuuka  
A NEET (not in education, employment or training) stumbled in a poor cafetaria and has been living there ever since. Poor and good for nothing… but somehow, what is this feeling…?  
  
Number girl No.2 Sister – Sakurai Machiko  
A younger sister who learns by looking at her brother’s back. What if she happens to fall in love…?  
  
Yubikiri no Binetsu – Kitagawa Yuka  
I started to fall in love with the dull and indifferent art teacher.  
  
Yasashikutte, Sugoku baka – Shinjou Maki  
A king was broken hearted from a childhood friend, and came today to heal it to my public bath. (He doesn’t know what one feels!)  
  
Suiyoubi wa himitsu – Ootomo Nana  
There’s a secret class on Wednesday nights, something one can’t say at all. A secret unfaithfulness… “A lesson on how to kiss…”  
  
I just love you – Ichinose Ruka  
To hide behind pure poems, it w

title: Akane-kun no Kokoro
description: This is about a boy that can hear people's mind. He never talks in the school and never smiles so people try to make fun of him cause they want to hear his voice. One of the girl made him speak say she knew about his ability.what happens then?…

title: Para Paru
description: Meet Ikeno Komaki –an ordinary girl with an ordinary life. Everyday is pretty much the same as the last, until today. Today she awoke from a strange dream hearing voices and has unexpectedly received an extraordinary new talent.

title: First Love
description: Haruka Mizuta is shocked when she gets confessed to by Naoto Konno a month after entering high school. He used to bully her in the second grade, but it seems he doesn't remember?!

title: First Love Confirmed!
description: As the eldest sister, Ayano must look after her three younger siblings. She has no time for love. But when Kaede asks her out, can she juggle her responsibilities and her blooming love for Kaede?!

title: Hanazakari no Kimitachi e: After School
description: A collection of HanaKimi side stories and an epilogue.

title: Kanbinaru Okurimono
description: The fight-loving Mitsuru has two dreams. One: to inherit his mother's cake shop, and two: to make his childhood friend Shiota his. After making a satisfactory cake, his plan is to confess to Shiota, however, Shiota intends to attend a college far away?! This the sweet love story between a sadistic class president and a pure delinquent!

title: Gokuraku Doumei
description: With her father having disappeared and her mother lying in a coma at the hospital, Homare inherits the responsibilities of the family hot springs inn. But where did all these guys come from to help out? And what will happen to the firm rule of no love?!

title: Sensei, Kiite yo
description:
Story 1 - Sensei, Kiite yo (Chapters 1-3)  
Uta thought that her homeroom teacher was a geek, but she saw him when he was dressed differently. Sensei was actually a handsome rock-n-roll singer!? Since Uta had always wanted to have a boyfriend, she threatened him to "go out with her" and she wouldn't tell anyone his secret! but she ends up really falling in love with her teacher..!?  
  
Story 2 - Natsu wa Ginga no Ame ga Furu (Chapter 4)  
Summer Holidays. She didn't want to go live with her grandmother, who she is on bad terms with, so she spends her life alone like she wanted. (Only for watching the house though!) And the person who appears in front of Akari is…!?

title: Girlfriends (SEASON 3)
description: High school is shaping up to be much different than what Young had imagined. First of all, the girls and boys are in separate buildings, which means Young’s got zero chance of casually running into her handsome, dreamy, kind, sexy, gorgeous crush, Bitna. Second, there’s a psycho chick in Young’s class…that no one else knows about! And to make things worse, she is Bitna’s dream girl. Young must find a way to get back at psycho chick and win Bitna’s heart…but luck is not on her side and things quickly spiral out of control.

title: Flying Bunny
description: When Aida Minami was little, she fell in love with the long-distance runner Manabe Keiichi. He was in the club that her school teacher mother supervised. But all her hopes were dashed when Manabe confessed to her that he was in love with her mother! Worse yet, he promised to take care of both her mother and her! Talk about instant love defeat! But it seems that the worse is not over yet because after a few years, Minami finds out that Manabe is now a teacher at her high school and the supervisor of the track and field club in which she belongs! Will her heart have a chance this time?

title: Shin☆Daa! Daa! Daa!
description: After Daa! Daa! Daa!, Ruu is now a cheerful youth living in his home, Planet Otto. Then, a confused girl named Miu arrives through a wormhole from Earth. Ruu joins up with her and promises to take her home. Unknown to Ruu, Miu is the daughter of the same people who took good care of him in his stay on Earth.

title: Aikatsu! Secret Story
description: The story takes place right after Aikatsu! Season 1. Ichigo Hoshimiya, now a top idol, moves to America to train and take part in concerts. Here she meets Marie, a Japanese-American 14-year-old girl who is getting to know Aikatsu and idols. Despite her mother's opposition, Marie decides to become an idol and starts training with Ichigo.

title: Haikyuu!! - Kimi no Tonari ni Itai na (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama and Hinata are now college students. This series looks at the development of their relationship as they grow closer.

title: Seduction More Beautiful Than Love
description: A new teacher, Miss Jung has a student she particularly worries about. Ryu Min is the top student in the school, he's tall, smart, and handsome. He shocks her by telling her, he wonders what it would feel like to kiss her. What is she to do about him?

title: You Benshi Ni Zai Xiong Yige?
description: The school tyrant Shen YiChen is looking for trouble with the genius student Ji YuMing?! The lives of two campus figures who originally wouldn’t have crossed each other’s paths in this lifetime, become entangled because of a particular “diary”. As Shen YiChen continues to pick fights with Ji YuMing, he realizes that this model student doesn’t seem like the type who’d “do such things to his younger cousin brother”. At the same time, looking at the easily ruffled wild school tyrant in front of him, Ji YuMing gradually gets the hang of smoothing out his ruffled feathers...

title: Virgin Tyrant
description: High school student Yoshiya Robu has to deal with the return of his childhood friend, Rumiko Udo, who used to take advantage of him when they were kids. As a beautiful and multi-talented girl--as well as having a no-nonsense attitude from sutdents who hit on her--Rumiko becomes the school idol. But how will Yoshiya react when he finds out she still holds feelings for him?

title: Uchi no Ouji Irimasen ka
description: Haruka was always weak as a child, unable to normally attend school. Nevertheless, he dreamed of going to school as a regular person, and his wish finally came true. As a result, he is a rare specimen, innocent in the ways of the world, giving him the nickname of "Prince". Follow him in his new school life as he makes friends and befriends one friend, Ryouhei, a little more specially. This is a cute, innocent story.

title: Chocolate
description: Chii-chan is an elementary school student who is really inexperienced in love. When the new transfer student Rei-kun arrives at her school, her life changes in a major way. Is he the one she has been searching for all these years…?

title: Hana wa Docchida
description:
Hana Kisugi is a somewhat apathetic 28-year-old office worker with no luck at work or with men. One day, she missed a step on a staircase, and... when she woke up, she was in the body of a 17-year-old high school student named Hana Yamada. At a loss, she ends up living the life of a high school girl at the boarding house Hana Yamada lived at, Ikuta House. She's surrounded by the responsible adult Haruki and the high school boy Haruchika.

She's having trouble not falling for all the guys around her, but she can't fall in love with someone else's body, can she? While she's worried about that, someone tells her HE'S in love with HER! Will this Hana be able to return to her former body?!

title: Coherence
description: It tells the fantasy love story of Si Ma Lan, a young witch hunter in Hua Du, since she entered Sheng Fang Academy, and the descendants of the demon clansmen who have secrets around her. Conspiracy is an enemy or a friend. Can she, a cowardly and timid girl, eventually grow into an outstanding witch hunter? So many beautiful young men, who would be her Mr. Right?

title: Karasuma Suite
description:
The class idol—Chitose Chima has been chosen to be the accompanist for the school's orchestra contest. She is a perfect girl acknowledged by her class, thus bearing their high expectations.   
  
Will she be able to excel as the perfect girl, once again?

title: Bullshit Love Stories at School
description: There are those that date publicly, those that love each other but are too dense to realize and those who date in secret. These are the bullshit love stories at school.

title: Bokura no Kiseki Guidebook: La trace
Mahoutsukai no Koi
description: Without worries about girls or money, halfheartedly living Nishizaki meets the love of his life on campus. A lover who bites his lips when happy… Araya is always troublesome, gloomy, and without desire. Thinking of him, Nishizaki’s teeth always hurt…

title: Lick
description: Truyện kể về Murao, một cậu bạn thích người bạn cùng lớp -Adachi- của mình đến mức muốn liếm lông mi, mắt, môi, màu tóc và cả da của Adachi. Một ngày nọ, Murao bị thương khi đang học thể dục, Adachi đã bất ngờ hôn cậu và nói cậu muốn được Murao thích nhiều thứ khác của cậu hơn chứ không chỉ là khuôn mặt!?

title: Celeste Blue
description: Eishi is one of those popular guys who is smart, good looking, and great at sports. However, he thinks people and "love" are bothersome and would rather not deal with either of them. When his teacher tells him to help a girl, Uta, to study, he dreads the idea of having to deal with such an annoying girl…

title: Yes, My Queen!
description: Welcome to William's Castle, a mysterious top aristocrat school! Here, the light and darkness are like fire and water. The light prince Yi Liuchuan and dark prince Yi Liuying rule the school! What will happen when they meet Miki, a mysterious girl with a fiery temper? How will fate prevail?

title: Koi. - Itoshii Itoshii to Iu Kokoro
description: During the entrance ceremony of high school, while looking at the rainbow after the rain, the main character Haru met, an unusual girl with an aura of 「air」-?

title: Otokonoko wa Hachimitsu
description:
1) Honey Prince  
Minoko accidentally witnessed the secret of her junior, Akane, whom she has been hitting it off with. This Akane is much different from usual, and Minoko involuntarily…?!  
  
2) Magic Red Thread  
Tamaki and Hikari are childhood friends, and Hikari has always loved being taken care of by the gentle Tamaki. But when she is suddenly confessed to by someone else, Tamaki reveals his own romantic feelings toward her. Can she see him as man and love interest, or is Hikari only interested in his friendship?  
  
3) If I Disappear  
School nurse Sakura confesses to slacker student Kaede and the two start secretly dating. But their exchanges are tinged with sorrow, as Sakura knows that this relationship can't last…  
  
4) Trembling Honey Taste  
Teruyama Shikao is used to people mocking his name, and is always getting into fights because of it. Asakura Shizuka is different from everyone else, she has no trouble talking to a scary delinquent like Shikao and even seeks him out

title: Boys' Kingdom
description: Himeno transferred to a former boys' school, Hallelujah. The president of the students association, Gao is an extreme misogynist, and the relationship between the two becomes intense.

title: Crown Craze
description:
In a room lie the two real brothers, the 17-year-old Kuruto and the 15 year old Enishi. —This is the good night kiss— They have been together since they were small. It was a natural thing for them to spend time together but that is slowly starting to change.  
  
The day the relationship between the two of them becomes awkward is when Kuruto returns home after a long time. The brothers attitude towards each other are so different and suddenly Kuruto tells the younger brother “Don’t think of saying you love me again”…?

title: Honey Bunny!
description: A story of unrequited love and alien possession! Chiyo, a homely high school girl, hates the handsome Tsubaki for his cruel ways, but she can't help but have a crush on him at the same time. Pushed to the breaking point, she prays for him to go away, and that's just what happens. But where does alien possession fit into all of this? Read and find out. This is a shoujo manga like no other!

title: Sweet Taboo
description: Siblings, unrelated by blood and acquainted in the face of animosity, are about to embark into one hell of a forbidden romance.

title: Running A Love Hotel With My Math Teacher
description: "That's just the kind of hotel this is, you know?" My teacher has got me pinned down in the S&M room at a love hotel...! What should I do? I can't run away...!! My name is Kana; I'm a high school girl by day and a love hotel owner by night. Of course, it's a secret to everybody at school. My grades have dropped due to the stress from my busy life, but I'm kind of happy that it gives me an excuse to receive extra lessons from Mr. Saitou, the teacher I admire. One day, however, a guest at my hotel catches my eye... What!? It's Mr. Saitou!? And the room he chooses to stay in is the hotel's most popular room, the S&M room!! Really!? That kind and gentle teacher...!? Flustered and shocked, I'm forced to go into his room! What will become of me...!?

title: I'm a Level D Student
description:
In a world where powerful beings are ranked by abilities, Key Academy is a battleground for the elite. Jelack, a mysterious new student, comes in as a bottom-tier Level D student. 

As students regularly spar to flaunt their powers, keeping her low rank a secret becomes increasingly difficult. Jelack trains in the shadows, aiming to rise above her D status. With unknown reasons for her transfer and her past shrouded in secrecy, she must uncover her true potential to survive the fierce hierarchy of the academy.

Every day is a fight for recognition and respect, and Jelack is determined to prove her worth.

title: Koori no Kiss de Toroketai
description:
Sugimura Nozomi made a pact with her childhood friend Hyoudo Rei who both have a passion for ice-skating that when they grow up, they will both pair up to get into the Olympics. But then Rei moves away.  
  
Years later, Nozomi transfers to a school famous for its students' emphasis on ice skating. There she unexpectantly meets up with Rei only to find him indifferent to ice skating. But Nozomi will not give up on her dream even if Rei has and she's determined to make it to the school ice-skating club and bring Rei with her as her partner.  
  
Includes two oneshots, Red Lips' Trap and Super Prince.

title: Koiseyo Moyashi - Timid Boy Blues
description: A smart weak boy in the wrong school wonders why students waste their time on sports.

title: Sagashimono
description: It all started with a small, gentle whisper… The precious necklace that Papa bought for me is gone! While I was searching for it desperately, a boy picks up the necklace! With a whisper of “It’ll get stepped on”, he departed. I can’t get him out of my head…

title: Lovestuck
description: Siga casualmente estes colegas estranhos, melhores amigos, e antigos amantes até à faculdade! Sim, risos e borboletas no estômago são providenciados.

title: Glasses Apartment
description: Haruse Yui ends up becoming the new landlord for her grandfather's apartment. But it's no ordinary apartment because all the tenants wear glasses and thus it has been dubbed the glasses apartment! Not only that, the tenants aren't what they seem?

title: Kizuna: A True Story that will Make you Cry
description:
6 stories by different authors about human bonding.

Chapters:
1. **Kizuna - prologue** (キズナ prologue) by Yamada Daisy
2. **Tsunagaru Omoi** (つながる思い) by Seta Haruhi
3. **Kiite, Otousan!** (聞いて、お父さん！) by Itou Mingo
4. **Kimi ga Iru kara** (キミがいるから) by Miura Mizuki
5. **Arigatou, Ricchi** (ありがとう、リッチ) by Sakyou
6. **Watashitachi no Harmony** (わたしたちのハーモニー) by Shirasawa Marimo
7. **Kizuna - epilogue** (キズナ epilogue) by Yamada Daisy

title: Tensei Shitara, Kareshi Nannin Dekiru Kana?
description:
Haruna Hinata is an unpopular high school girl who has not even once had a boyfriend. While she secretly has feelings for her childhood friend, Ikuya, she, being the late bloomer that she is, has still not been able to confess.

Then one day, she met with an accident and was reincarnated! In the new world she's in, women can have multiple husbands and even in high school, it's obligatory for girls to submit dating applications with several boys?

This is a romantic comedy about an unpopular high school girl who was reincarnated and her reverse harem!

title: Sureta Hoshi to Raspberry
description: A guy who's believed to be all face and a girl that's into gravure magazines. What will happen?

title: MISS
description: Falling in love with him was her biggest mistake… After being badly bullied in junior high, Kazu's sworn off getting deeply involved with other people. One day though, the resident class playboy, Kirishima, comes and tears down the walls she's built around her heart. She finds herself falling quick and hard…but is she only setting herself up for heartbreak?!

title: The Courage to be Disliked
description: The story of a boy who always worries about pleasing others on campus, Yu Gan Yi, often feels that his future is not bright, until he meets Cai Peixi, a boy who is the complete opposite of him…

title: Honggane
description:
Nanhee Hong is the second child in the Hong family. She has an older brother, who is the jjang (boss) of his school, and a younger brother, who is a member of the rival school's gang. When Nanhee meets a mysterious student, things begin to get complicated. What will Nanhee do?  
  
[PL] Nanhee Hong jest drugim dzieckiem w rodzinie Hong. Ma starszego brata, który jest jjang (szefem) swojej szkoły, oraz młodszego brata, który jest członkiem gangu z rywalizującą szkołą. Kiedy Nanhee spotyka tajemniczego ucznia, wszystko się komplikuje. Co Nanhee zrobi?

title: Tensei
description:
A collection of one-shots:  
  
1. Tensei:  
The day Shinohara Chiaki met Gotou-kun was in April during her second year of high school. The new class lists had just been posted and she was nervous that she would not know anyone. Gotou, the school judo star, instantly introduced her to lots of people and made her feel at ease. To Chiaki, Gotou-kun was like a impressively bright blue sky. But one day, during one of his judo matches…  
  
2. One and Only:  
Matsumoto Rika was on her way to her part-time job as a waitress at a restaurant when in her rush, she yanked open a door right into a guy's face. The guy glared at her in pain and in surprise and embarrassment, she ran away while barely apologizing. She hoped she would not ever have to see him again, but when she arrived at work…  
  
3. Aishitekurenai:  
Fukazawa Akira is dating Yasuda Tatsurou, but Akira is worried that Yasuda doesn't actually like her all that much. It's been a few weeks now since she asked him out, but nothing rom

title: Shiritsu! Bijinzaka Joshi Koukou
description: Nonomiya En, previously expelled from her old school following three suspensions, is forced by her father to enter Bijinzaka, a prestigious all-girls' high school where they train girls to become young, well-mannered ladies. Upon her arrival, En realizes that this school is definitely not for her and sneaks out. On her way out, she meets Narushima Chihiro, first year student at Jouyama Boys' High, on the other side of the hill.

title: Sora Oto
description: "Heaven" is a company. The job of the "Messenger of Death" is to deliver the souls of the dead to heaven. The Messengers of Death are ranked according to ability. Uka, a "Rank C" dropout, is normally an average, easy-going high school girl. One day, she is teamed up with Tsumugi, one of the "Rank A" arrogant elite!

title: Sounds of the Summer at 17
description:
It is a story of love and separation between a piano-loving high school boy and girl who live in a world where they know their own lifespan.
Akihiko chooses piano in the curriculum prepared for students with short life spans, and Nao makes the same choice to follow her one-sided love, but what will happen to their relationship in the little time they have left?

title: Kokuminteki Idol ga Otouto ni Nattara
description: Omori Suzuka is a high school girl who is crazy about Kamiya Hinase a member of the popular idol group Shine. She was happy just watching him on TV, but when her parents remarry, she and her favorite Hinase become a family! She is so happy to be under the same roof with her favorite idol, but Hinase is a scumbag who calls his fans "stupid women who are fooled by superficiality"... The hardship of a idol-otaku girl being pushed around by a cat-like idol has just begun!

title: Spring Summer Festival
description:
"I wanted to create a summery, sparkling youth." - And so the theme is "yosakoi*"!!  
  
For the sake of her younger sister's medical treatment, Natsume moves from her home in Tokyo to Shikoku. In a place where no one knows her, she decides to make her high school debut as a "cool beauty"! …This determined Natsume is approached by the wild child-like Yudai saying, "Join my team"??  
  
Eeh!!? What do you mean by team!!?

title: Tobaku-senpai Nani Kakeru?
description: The "gambling and love" comedy follows a high school girl who loves to make bets and a high school boy who hates making bets.

title: Haikei, Nanashi-sama
description: Terao Chigusa has always loved a certain book called "Dear, Mr. Nameless." Plus, she has a very timid personality, so much so that she gets REALLY scared when confronted by Takaya Tooru. However, one day, she ends up living the same situation as her beloved book!? How will she react!?

title: Mamotte Banken-kun
description: “Masa chó dại”, một gã trùm trường sừng sỏ của trường cấp 3, lại từng có quá khứ là một cậu nhóc yếu đuối và mít ướt, luôn ám ảnh vì bị “tình đầu” từ chối. Masa tình cờ gặp Sora – một cậu ấm có khuôn mặt giống với cô gái tình đầu đã từ chối mình lúc nhỏ, và được yêu cầu trở thành “chó canh” – bảo vệ cho Sora. Những rung động chớm nở bắt đầu từ đây, liệu chuyện tình của họ có suôn sẻ?!

title: Daikyou Enmusubi
description: Average high-school student Takahashi wants good luck for the new year so she can get closer to her popular classmate Yoshizawa, but instead her fortune reads "Terrible Luck". What's a poor unlucky girl like her to do?

title: Ojisan to Miiko - Doukyuusei to Koi no Hanashi
description:
*"Cô bạn cùng lớp - người tôi đem lòng yêu - lại dành tình cảm cho một người khác.
Nhưng, người đó lại chính là..."*

Một cuộc gặp gỡ bất ngờ đã khiến chàng trai rung động trước cô bạn cùng lớp. Dù nhận ra tình cảm của mình nhưng cậu không đủ can đảm để thổ lộ. Cho đến một ngày, cậu vô tình chứng kiến cảnh cô ấy bên cạnh một người đàn ông hơn tuổi...

Đây **KHÔNG** phải romcom :D

Hãy đọc Ojisan to Miiko trước nếu có thể :D

title: Awo no Idokoro
description:
Nagi wanted to enjoy her youth to the fullest, so she ran for student council president, but her position was taken by a handsome boy named Hairi. Frustrated at losing to a man who only had looks, Nagi decided to see what he could do as vice president. But then she saw a completely different side of him...!?

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

title: Thank You for Being a Part of My Youth
description: A short dedicated to unrequited love in youth.

title: Luminous
description: Magic, miracles, Alissa doesn’t have time for that superficial nonsense. An honor roll student and serial high school heartbreaker, Alissa learned from her family that if it’s not logical it has no place in her life. When she meets an eccentric boy named Matt who performs magic tricks that might be real, she questions everything including her heart.

title: Boku no Jealousy Monogatari
description:
From KCG Scans:  
Haru, a girl that is scared of boys, encountered a beautiful girl that took her breath away. Who would have thought that she would meet her again in her new high school. But she is… a boy? What will Haru do when he confesses to her?  
  
Haru, a quien le asustan los chicos… se encuentra con una hermosa niña que le quita el aliento. Feliz por su nueva amiga, pensó que la vería de nuevo en su nueva escuela; pero… resulta que ¿Ella en realidad es Él? ¿Qué hará Haru cuando este chico se le confiese?

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club - Hazzzzzzzu!!! (Doujinshi)
description: A Shizuku x Kasumi doujinshi set after the events of episode 8 of the 1st season.

title: Atashi wa Bambi
description: Mai was constantly picked on in Junior High because of the way she looked. To change all that, she walks into High School with a new look and a new attitude. As she was getting used to school, she falls for her classmate, Sen. But Sen's best friend, Yaezou, tells her to back off because Sen was his! But, knowing Mai, this doesn't stop her.

title: Oishii Kimi List
description: Kaoru loves delicious food and will do anything for it… including trying to find things out about Igarashi-kun - a violent yet handsome guy.

title: A Killer Husband
description: An amazing secret that has influenced the structure of the world's Yakuza brought together the main female and male leads who had been separated for 15 years. As of current, one has become a trump female agent, and the other has become a powerful Yakuza. After 15 years of searching and waiting, what sparks will be produced when they meet again? Those two were caught in various extreme forces of the infighting and intrigue. How will their feelings develop?

title: Kawaiitte Itteyo
description:
A collection of short stories:  
  
1. Pink Colored Love  
To say you're going out isn't the end of love, but merely the beginning. How far and fast must you run towards one another in order to make things work out?  
  
2. Say I'm Cute  
Needless to say, the cute one always wins… right? Or could it be something more than that? A story about love from the heart, rather than from makeup.  
  
3. So Close, I Feel the Warmth of Your Body  
When the culture fest comes around, it seems that Maki and Ken can finally make a first memory for the both of them after three months of dating. But then something comes between them that threatens this first precious memory?  
  
4. The Winter Sun  
Itsuki has always dreamt of being a part of baseball, but when something causes him to lose sight of his dream, he realizes that some one's been there, encouraging his dream from the very beginning…

title: The Starry Heavens and the Blue Sky
description: The manga's story centers on Shingo Nakazawa, a high school boy who remains emotionless, even as the rest of humanity is coming to grips with the possibility of extinction due to the approach of a world-ending meteor. In the beginning of the story, Japan thinks itself saved from disaster, only to face another one.

title: Kimi to Aoi Yane to Shita
description:
Maekawa-san, who grew up in a single-father household, is a perfect girl who is serious and reliable. However, she doesn't attend class enough and after meeting her upperclassman, Hinata Nagao, who always gets failing grades, an unexpected world opens up before her...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Akuma no Kuchizuke
description:
Sara is a member of the Heaven Expedition Team, and her job is to hunt Devils, but she hasn't caught even one devil yet and if she doesn't catch one she will be expelled!  
  
She decides to summon a devil so she can catch him, but what will happen when she meets the charming devil Rembrandt?  
  
Also contains:  
Midnight  
Blooming Love  
  
Following each chapter is a small side story. The fourth side story remains untranslated.

title: Triple Kiss
description:
On the way to school, Yukino stumbles into a handsome boy, and is surprised to find out that he is Sasegawa, a transfer student joining her class. However, when he enters the classroom, nobody can see his beautiful face hidden beneath his thick bangs.  
  
At first Yukino is confused as to why he hides his good looks from the class, but as she develops feelings for him, she starts hoping that nobody will see his real face, for fear that the rest of the girls in class will fall in love with him as well. How will Yukino and Sasegawa's relationship turn out in the end? And who is the mysterious man who claims to 'own' Sasegawa?

title: Trompe-l'œil no Yubisaki
description:
1) *Dazzling*  
College student Keisuke often picks up his younger brother from elementary school, and talks with handsome Murakami-sensei. As they gradually become closer Keisuke finds himself thinking about Murakami in more than friendly terms.  
  
2) *The Flow of String*  
Yamazaki sensei finds himself paying special attention to archery club student Yagi. At first Yagi is just his cute student, but as his body matures Yamazaki's feelings for the boy begin to change as well.  
  
3) *A Cracked Pot with a Battered Lip*  
Super-pervert Haruto started his relationship with Masumi by asking him weird questions, and later graduated to kinky sex play. But suddenly Haruto starts asking other people his questions, is Masumi going to be dumped?  
  
4) *The Shadows Under the Tree*  
When Takuma's father remarried he acquired an older brother as well. But three years later his stepmother has passed away and Takuma is well on his way to becoming a deliquent. Something dark and disturbing is h

title: Classroom 101
description:
Reginald Guevarra, a 4th year college student felt like his life is stuck on repeat.
Every day is the same schoolwork, research, thesis, exams, and more. He misses the fun and excitement of his senior high school days, where everything felt exciting for him.

One day, he gets a strange text with a QR code and a location. Curious, he decides to go  and on the way, he meets a familiar face from the past. But what waits at the end of the road is more than just a reunion.

All his old classmates are there, and they’ve been forced in a massive game venue. To escape, they’ll have to play  and win.

Friendships will be tested, memories would be a weapon, secrets will be revealed, and there’s no guarantee everyone will make it out.

title: Dakara Boku wa Kimi Osarau
description: A young musician with a painful past, Mitsusei Morio (Molio Kosei) lived peacefully. One day, a star meets a girl in a cemetery at night. The secret of the girl and her past. The star is swept away by the vent of fate and commits a crime to protect his loved ones. A pure love mystery that makes me want to fall in love with someone after reading it.

title: Anta Nanka Daikirai
description:
Contains 4 stories.  
  
Story 01: I Can’t Stand You: Although Rena-chan likes Miyake, she doesn’t do anything about it, because Mariko has turned her feminine charm to full throttle! However, in no time at all, Mariko finds out about her rival in love, Rena!   
  
Story 02: Caught on You: Relationships haven’t gone too well for Maho throughout her life. Why is that? It all started with her first love, Shiki. What happened between these two? Will Maho be able to get over the past and find a new love? Or will one of her past loves be able to bloom once again?  
  
Story 03: Something’s Wrong: Misono, who doesn't look very feminine, begins to have feelings for her childhood friend and neighbor, Yuuta. Will she be able to catch his eye by dressing in a more feminine way, especially when his attention seems to have been stolen by the pretty and stylish Sugisaki?  
  
Story 04: See You Tomorrow: Akemi’s in high school, and she doesn’t really care about grades. Or rather, she didn’t care unt

title: Jijou o Shiranai Tenkousei ga Guigui Kuru: Yuki no Shita de Nemuru
description:
For a while now, Sumire Kasahara has been having a crush on Taiyou Takada, her classmate. Although she knows Taiyou likes another girl, one day Kasahara-san decides to make a move... 

Story based upon "My Clueless First Friend" (created by Kawamura Taku)

title: Boku no Itoshii Kairiki Hime
description:
"I'm gonna propose to you in a month!"
"...... Huh?"

Akane Kongoji, a high school girl who was born with more power than others, is a celebrity in this town.
Because of her power, when she was a child, others did not have a good impression of her, and she naturally kept others away from her.
One day, Akane saw a car parked in front of her favorite store, and she used her powers to help the owner of the car, but the owner took notice of her.
When she was at a loss as to what to do, the person who helped her was another famous person in town.
He is Kazuma Kujo, the sergeant of Kujo Corporation...?

title: Doukyo shita Osananajimi wa, Dekiai o Gaman Dekinai.
description: "Do you want to be kissed?" In order to avoid having to move abroad, Koi and her younger childhood friend Shuri, who she has not seen in two years, have decided to move in together. Koi thought he was like a cute little brother, but when they start living together, Shuri changes drastically! He spoils her like a lover, whispers to her in a sweet voice, and pushes her down... He seems to be up to something, but he can't stop doting on her too dangerously...! Drowning in the sweet tricks of a younger childhood friend.

title: Hoshigarimasen! Katsumade wa
description: Beautiful and popular Nakatani Hiyori has fallen in love with his dormitory roommate and underclassman, Amano Kasumi. But being in the same room with the one you love day in and day out is a strain. From here, there is only one way to advance.

title: Dame Koi Mihonchou
description: I just want to have a nice romance... but... why? why?! Where did you make a mistake?! Nako who is always a bad guy and a bad romance. "I'm here! Such a man!" "There is! This kind of thing!" It's a love story with a real degree of 120% that is a little salty and sometimes sweet!

title: 1-Senchi yori mo Chikaku
description:
From *Chibi Manga*:  
Kanata is cheerful and friendly. kasumi who can only look at the senpai she love from afar, is very inexperienced in love and her heart thumped unstopably by kanata closeness …!? Friendly boy and inexperienced in love girl, a refreshing heart thumping love!

title: Hana Sakasu Te, Tsubomi no Kimi
description: Chihiro loves fixing up girls’ hairstyles. So, when he sees Akahoshi Miri’s bedhead, he can’t resist playing with it too.

title: Tonari no Danshi ga Oshida Nante Kiitemasen!
description:
Yoi discovers the idol she devotes herself to, Hikaru, is actually Akari, the black-haired, glasses-wearing boy sitting next to her, after Akari asks her to teach him how to study. From then on, they meet regularly after school, just the two of them.

Akari usually has no aura of an idol, but the "real" expression she shows in a moment is very cute...

Little by little, Yoi finds herself drawn not to the idol Hikaru, but to the high school boy Akari.

A secret after-school lesson with her "favorite" idol!
A royal roadside love comedy that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

title: Miagareba, Koi
description: Hi! My name is Nagi and I'm in my first year of high school! Both my parents are busy with work and my brother who's in uni is rarely home. So, I'm usually alone. For birthdays, it is the family custom to have karaage but on the night of my 16th birthday, not only did I make the karaage by myself, but I also ate it alone. That's when my brother's friend Shuu-san brought my drunken brother home. He's not only a gentleman, but he was also even worried about me having to be alone at home!

title: H³ School!
description:
What happens when an all-girls' high school reigning tomboy finds out her school is about to be filled with boys!?  
  
Hanabi Oozora is a rambunctious sixteen-year-old tomboy who comes to the rescue of her less assertive friends–sometimes in exchange for food. So what does she do when, all of a sudden, her all-girls' school is about to be integrated with an all-boys' school?!  
  
She meets and falls in love–naturally–with one of the three most popular and handsome boys in the Student Council, Yasuaki Garaku! Unfortunately, Yasuaki doesn't care for girls… and when the girls' Student Council clashes head-on with the boys' Student Council, Hanabi steps in to become a member - hoping she'll change Yasuaki's mind!

title: GALS!!
description: The sequel to Gals!

title: Kimi no Kachi
description:
A collection of oneshot stories.  
  
1. You Win  
I hate him–Ayu's classmate, Kataoka, is popular among girls. But Ayu doesn't like him that much, because she thinks that he isn't a nice person. But…!? Depicting the feelings every girl should feel when in love, vividly and sensitively, it's the best school love story.  
  
2. His Back, His Heart  
Nariko is in love with a popular boy from her school. However, she can only watch him from behind as he is not in her class and has no idea who she is. By watching his back from afar, can she truly win his heart?  
  
3. Spring Fever  
Marina and her friend go to an all girls school and take the same bus home everyday. This same bus passes by Kita High, where a few boys always get on. Marina has slowly fallen in love with one of the boys – can she work up the courage to speak with him?  
  
4. Constellation in July  
Niro and Chise have been childhood friends since Niro planted the willow branch in their backyard, and a willow tree grew from

title: Hatsukoi Kaoru
description: When the quiet Ishida finds herself in trouble on the first day of school, a sparkling Egami-kun is there to help her. They have to work together after school for a week, but his fragrance seems to linger and doesn’t go away. What will happen after one week?

title: Gekkou Teien
description: Yuuki is a girl who lies about her gender to enroll in the theatre department of Getsuryou academy, an all boys' school where all the students are required to stay in the dorm. While hiding the fact that she's a girl, she tries hard to study acting, a subject that she loves very much. One day, an upperclassman, Riku, finds out about her secret, causing Yuuki to be very worried, but she gradually becomes attracted to him. At the same time, she comes to know the real reason why she was brought up as a boy.

title: Kimi wa Tomodachi
description: He was always by my side. … So, I thought that I certainly won't fall in love with him

title: Kimi no Bitch
description:
High school girls × secret affair × dog!
A forbidden feeling, and resistance to falling into depravity…
A refreshing lily story.

**Awards:** Won an Excellent Work and a Judge Special Prize in the 10th YG Manga Grand Awards. (2019)

title: Mukuchi na Nashimoto-kun no Kokoro no Koe ga Amasugiru
description:
Koharu has a secret she can't tell anyone: she can hear the thoughts of everyone around her. It's made her overly conscious of the people around her, too. One day, she accidentally hears the true thoughts of the supposedly scary delinquent, Nashimoto. "She's seriously an angel!! Her smile is so cute that I can't look directly at her!" As it turns out, Nashimoto is completely in love with her to the point of worshiping her every move?! Koharu also soon realizes that whenever she touches Nashimoto, she can't hear his thoughts anymore...?

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Osana Fumi-chan
description: Osanajimi-chan is cute. A coming-of-age romantic comedy story begins.

title: Living In The Moment
description: Hayato Tetsuya é um adolescente "normal", que foi transferido para uma escola no meio do bimestre, mas o que deveria ser uma simples transferência, parece esconder muitas coisas por trás, forçando Hayato a escolher ser um aluno invisível aos demais, mas será que isso dará certo?

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - The Dispute (Doujinshi)
description:
[DOUBLE ONE-SHOT]

Story 1: Claudine is frustrated because Maya doesn't allow herself to be spoiled by her.

Story 2: At the end of their school days, Maya and Claudine wonder about what the future has in store for them, both as a couple and as separate individuals.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) Double One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Don't confess to that boy
description:
Lee Da-jung is a timid high school ghost.
She's possessed Chae Rim, who has everything: beauty, money, and popularity!
She tries her best to imitate Chae Rim... but her identity is discovered by one person.
Baek Isaac, Chae Rim's best friend.

"I'll help you pretend to be Chae Rim."
Can I trust this friendly but suspicious boy?
What is the secret of my death?
A breathtaking occult comic! ♥︎

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - I Will Steal You Away (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine are friends and rivals at Seisho Music Academy. While rehearsing a romantic improv scene, Maya gives Claudine a real kiss instead of a staged kiss, and Claudine is left flustered and confused as to Maya's sudden action. And what's worse is that, after the kiss, Maya acts as if nothing happened between them!? 

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Shishunki Kyoudai
description:
What is "me"?

Yosuke Hino is thinking about when to change his name from "me" to "I". His latest problem is that he can't beat his twin sister Mikage. Whether it is his height, studies, or athletics... Mikage outranks him in every aspect, and this has caused Yosuke to have a hard time with girls. Now that he is in his second year of junior high school, he wants to make many changes--but...?!

title: Yumeyume, Koisuru Koto Nakare
description:
Since she was little, Nadeko has been having "prophetic dreams" in which things she experienced in her dreams come true, but there is one thing that has yet to happen to her - in her dreams, she meets the "prince of her dreams" who always whispers sweet and gentle words to her! I wonder when I will meet him. One day, while she was filled with anticipation, wondering when she would meet him, Koga-kun, who had transferred to her class, turned out to be the very prince she had dreamed of! However, he is a famous delinquent in the area and....? 

A love story of a prince who doesn't turn out as predicted in a dream and a girl who is a runaway dreamer!

title: Looking For a Better Boyfriend!
description: "If i were to become a guy, then i would never make a girl cry!" Said Jun, who just had a break up with her boyfriend. "Then why not become one?" An old woman told Jun… which startled her

title: Ai wo Kudasai
description:
"Even though you are a playboy, kissing so clumsily breaks the rules!"  
  
Uncommitted playboy teacher Kurosawa does not refuse anyone who comes to him. His serious student Mamoru hates playboys and is appalled by his teacher's behavior. After accidentally witnessing Kurosawa and his girlfriend fighting, Mamoru instinctively scolds him. But Kurosawa suddenly says "I like guys like you," and gently hugs him.

title: Katsute no Ore ga Suki na Kimi he
description: After being rejected by the girl he liked at age 11, Yanagiya Riku decides to change his shy and pathetic self and become a cool guy. Now at 17, a girl confesses that she liked her old self, and Yanagiya-kun will do anything to make her take it back.

title: World No. 0, Please Stop!
description:
[Welcome to the Possession of Lee Joo Eun! ^0^]

Out of nowhere, a status window appeared, and I found myself possessed. In an internet novel where the top-ranked female lead in the world pretends to be an outcast at school! And in this story...

“Hey, are you ignoring me right now? Do you think we’re a joke?”

I’m playing the role of one of the henchmen for the villainess who bullies the heroine.

Before I get beaten up by the female lead, who reveals her true identity, and end up with eight weeks of recovery,
there’s only one way to escape this absurd world and role.

[If you create a happy ending, I’ll grant you a wish! >ㅁ<]

I need to bring happiness to all the characters in this story and make a wish. But...

“Are you the leader of this school? Heh, our focus wants to have a word with you.”
“What if I refuse?”
“Eek! Oh my gosh, are we really going to fight Haeseong High today?!”

...Can I really bring happiness to these characters? This place truly is an era of madness.

title: Goshimei Arigatou Gozaimasu!
description: Mizuki Hina is a girl who never liked learning, and her test scores are naturally at the bottom of the class. Even most of the tutors don’t really know what to do with her. One day a young handsome tutor named Sakuya Ichijo came. His ways of teaching are different; When Hina is learning from him, learning felt just like talking to a friend. Hina also had developed a secret love for Ichijo that she is trying her best to hide. Could Ichijo possibly have the power to change her test scores?

title: Omae de Nakya Dame Mitai
description: For Suwa, a hunk like himself needs a pretty girl by his side. Theoretically. But in fact, he's going out with four-eyed, average looking Fujisaki. It's just a temporary relationship for Suwa – only until he finds a girlfriend… But then, why does he feel so guilty when he takes an interest in someone else?

title: Neverland no Shirakawa-san
description:
Shirakawa, is a high school girl whose mature appearance and behavior make her the object of admiration. However, the real Shirakawa is not the person she is rumored to be, but a hardcore "fighting shape-shifting girl" otaku. The only one who understands her is Tateishi, a cool and handsome guy who is also a member of the Kyudo club. Like Shirakawa, Tateishi attracts the eyes of many people from afar, but in fact, he is also a "Sentai" otaku. 

A love comedy unfolds between the two who share a secret hobby: Sunday morning children's hero shows.

title: Momoiro Shoukougun
description:
Collection of stories:  
  
1) Big Brother is my classmate  
Hikari became brothers with his classmate Hyuuga through their parent's remarriage. Although he never had much contact with Hyuuga up till then, after they started living together, Hikari sees a side of Hyuuga beyond his imagination. Including his surprising weakness to skinship! After that, Hikari begins to make fun of Hyuuga, but…  
2) Pink Syndrome  
3) Teasing Suggestion  
4) VS the pastry shop across the street  
5) The cute rude person  
6) Cleanness library  
7) Cowardly warmth

title: Senpai Kirai
description:
Why are guys so useless!?  
Nene is a high school student who is sick and tired of her male classmates constantly acting like children.  
Still, she hopes that she might one day fall in love like everyone else. It's when these thoughts are going through her mind that she bumps into Yusuke; a good-looking and popular senior…  
A love story between a senior who's a little short in the sensitivity department and a girl who likes things crystal clear.

title: Kyou mo Senpai to Katakoichuu.
description: Hoping to find love in high school, Akari finds herself invited to join the communications club. She finds herself more and more attracted to her senpai, but he himself currently has an unrequited love. Will Akari find a way into his heart?

title: Shounenshoujo Romance
description: Ran's dream is to meet a prince, one of those you see in fairy tales. After several years Ukyo is back… to become her prince? With Ran living in her own fairy tale world and Ukyo not able to express his feelings and thus bullying her, how will this couple work?

title: Osuteki Daarin
description: Serika is your typical high school girl. She loves reading books, likes romance, and has the ability to knock a guy flat out with her fist. She imagines herself as one of those heroines she reads in books, a shining maiden waiting for her prince. But what happens to her dream when the prince she has been waiting for is not only younger than her, but also smaller? Will the princess accept the chibi prince?

title: Doko Dere?
description: A lonely young boy finds his solitude disrupted in a way he hadn't hoped. But perhaps he can make the best of it...

title: Yasashii Karada
description: わずかに響きあう登場人物。そっと手渡されていく物語。柔らかで強靱な感性が創り出す、切なく遠い青春ストーリー！　業界が熱く注目する期待の新鋭、ファン切望の初単行本!

title: Meng Never Falls in Love
description: This is the bitter story of Meng and his unsuccessful love life. He obviously wants to fall in love but it almost always doesn't go as planned.

title: Obake Life
description: A girl who can see spirits opened up a manga and read "Those who read to this point in my manga will die without fail on the same day". Terrified, she tries to break her curse, with a jumpy spirit who wants to marry her…?

title: Red Temptation
description:
People call me a teacher, but I'm really just a 22-year old girl.   
  
But, I'm a teacher. And teachers can't fall in love with their students.   
  
Hitomi teaches Japanese. But from their first encounter, she hasn't been able to look Sakou-kun, her student and school prince, in the eye…

title: Amari ni Kaichou ga Are Nanode.
description: Nana, who thinks that love is a nuisance decides that it does not need it, but suddenly appears in his house the President of the Student Council, saying that he will do that you love him can win the heart of Nana?

title: Atom Cat
description:
Reading the “Astro Boy” manga with his dad is Tsugio's one refuge from the bullies at his school. One day he finds an abandoned kitten, and names it after the robot hero to convince his family to keep it. But after a strange encounter with aliens honeymooning on Earth, Tsugio's shocked to find his cat can speak ― and has all of Astro Boy's powers! Sworn to secrecy, Tsugio and Earth's tiniest hero together fight raging fires, awakened mummies, and more!

[Official English](https://emanga.com/collections/osamu-tezuka/products/atomcat?variant=32122286790)

---
**Volume 309 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Paris~Tokyo
description:
(from ebookjapan):

An undiscovered gem, quietly left behind by a master of maiden drawings in Osaka's Hinomaru Bunko, the birthplace of gekiga! 
Flower-selling girls longing for Paris and the "golden rule of girls' manga" (Yoraba Takemoto), essential to every girl's dream! 

The e-book version does not include "Sakura Namiki" (a separate volume of interviews, commentaries, and conversations).

title: Akahime Ranshin
description: Akagi Erika is a classical literature teacher at a high school. One day, she scolds a male student, Usami Rento, for wearing perfume to school. However, she later finds out that the sweet scent isn’t from perfume but from incense that’s soaked into the kimono he wears, for Usami Rento is actually a famous kabuki actor playing female roles. Erika watches a performance of Usami’s out of curiosity, and finds herself gradually drawn to this strange student…

title: Paper Fortress
description:
A collection of one-shots done during the 1970s, all regarding some aspect of Tezuka's early life. Includes a reflection of his time at the famous Tokiwa-so.

- **Record of the Life of Gachaboy** (がちゃぼい一代記, Gachaboy Ichidaiki, ALT. ENG. - The God of Manga): A reflection on Tezuka's career up to that point. Tezuka  encounters the God of Manga right after the war, who nicknames Tezuka "Gachaboy". He is determined to see Tezuka become a great mangaka, no matter what - and restore manga's presence in Japan.
- **Paper Fortress** (紙の砦, Kami no Toride):  Right at the end of the war, Tezuka is doing manga in private in high school. He meets a girl who fully understands his situation, and they get along well. In a society where manga, dancing, and even informal relationships are forbidden, how will Tezuka, crazy about manga, keep on?
- **Hungry Blues** (すきっ腹のブルース, Sukippara no Blues): Directly following *Paper Fortress*, Tezuka is now a hungry, desperate student with little luck on his path in

title: Itoshi Kingyo
description: The volume consists of five separate storylines plus a sidestory.

title: Yubisaki wa Koi no Aji
description:
1-5) Fingertips' Love  
Hajime and Eiji, who were childhood friends, have been reunited at an all-boy's high school (oh, the possibilities). Their friendship is still as strong, but it seems as Eiji is ready to confess. Will Hajime accept the confession? How many other boys in this school will be joining the boi love craze? And will anyone ever call Uncle Kai-Sensei?  
  
6) Playing with Fire  
Masao, who was dumped, decided to flee home to the countryside to get over his heartbreak.  
  
7) Extras

title: Himawari
description:
"What do you think about me...?" 

"I see you as my friend, forever." I still regret the lie I told at that time. 

When Momo was in elementary school, her first love was Haruo, who had a smile like a sunflower. However, in the spring of their fifth year at elementary school, he disappeared.

Four years later, when Momo becomes a high school student, she is accidentally reunited with a classmate who looks exactly like Haruo, and her heart pounded violently. 

"Hey, you're not Haru-chan are you...?" A pure love story of a girl who keeps thinking of a boy from her past.

title: Otokogumi
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A boy, Jiro Ryuzen, is imprisoned in Kanto Juvenile Prison for the crime of "killing his father. He was sent to Seiun Gakuen, a prestigious private school, in handcuffs, which was ruled by the immensely powerful Goji Shinryu...

Together with five members of the Gokehoren, his allies in the juvenile prison, Nagare's fierce battle has begun!

title: Next Door Boyfriend
description: Yoona is suddenly introduced to a suspicious secret part-time job, asked to befriend the employer's son while monitoring him. But turns out he's the guy next door?! A complicated campus life with the cold and picky neighbor begins.

title: Shinshikyoutei wo Musubou!
description: Upon entering Takamanohara Academy, Waka meets Moriya, a strange boy who seems to know him, though the feeling isn't mutual. Despite not knowing who Moriya is, Waka feels a strange pull to him. When he gets an invitation to the mysterious "Gentleman's Meeting", Waka can't help but be fascinated and a little worried all in one. Upon entering the Shrine's archways, Waka's future becomes increasingly unclear.

title: I’ll Get My Deskmate to Hit You
description:
The poor little top-scorer was bullied, so he transferred from a high-ranked high school to an ordinary one.

Class teacher: Zhan Ming, look at the score you got!
Zhan Ming: I'll ask my deskmate to teach me.
Former classmate: Gu Qinan, don't think we can't find you just because you transferred.
Gu Qinan: I'll tell get my deskmate to hit you.

title: Tsumi Koi
description:
Compilation of short stories:  
  
- Tsumi Koi / Sinful Love  
“If you want me to stay quiet, then have an affair with me too”  
Yashiro witnessed her classmate Maki, who is extremely popular with the girls, with a girl who wasn’t his girlfriend. Tired of her uninspiring days Yashino suggested that she become Maki’s “lover”, but because of these circumstances she finds herself being charmed by him and she can’t stop herself from falling in love with him…!?  
  
- Until I Fall in Love  
About twin sisters, Tae is the older twin and Rie is the younger. One day, Rie begs Tae to switch places with her. Rie has a crush on a boy who sits next to Tae. Finally Tae agrees. In Rie's class, Tae is surprised to discover that Rie sits next to a cute guy, the one on the soccer team that she saw after school a few days ago. Then, Tae has a good time sitting with the boy. He's funny and nice.  
When he invites Tae to watch him play soccer, Tae agrees, but then she realizes that he invites her as Rie..

title: Cheat Nouryoku wa Koi ni Tsukaemasu ka?
description:
Asuka Shirayama has a crush on her childhood friend and new teacher at her high school. She's always liked him, but just when she was about to give up, thinking that love between a teacher and a student can't come to fruition, she begins to hear his inner voice!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Sentimental Letter
description:
It's been three years since Amo's first love passed away. But they still have the feeling that everything that happened was a dream, even more when a transfer student with the same name and very similar to him suddenly arrives in his class. Who is he exactly? Can she put aside her first love to experience a new one?  
  
ITALIANO:  
Sono passati 3 anni da quando il primo amore di Amo è morto. Eppure lei ha ancora la sensazione che si sia trattato solo di un sogno, soprattutto quando spunta all'improvviso nella sua classe uno studente trasferito con lo stesso nome e molto simile a lui. Chi è questa persona davvero? Riuscir� a mettere da parte il suo primo amore ed a sperimentarne uno nuovo?

title: Sarusuberi Danshi Koutou Gakkou!!
description:
From Chibi Manga:  
"I'm going to be a boy starting today" It's so much fun after quitting being a girl!!  
A girl inside a boys' high school! A monkey girl is passing by!!

title: Dolly Kanon
description:
Shinon, who enjoys writing lyrics and composing music, sings a song to Kanade Shishi, an idol boy at her school, dressed as a woman, and the video becomes a big hit on a posting site! Moreover, Remi, a singer-songwriter he admires, responds to the video on live TV. In response, Shinon and Kanadeh responded and decided to collaborate to write more songs together...

(google translated)

title: Deatte 10-Byou No koibito
description:
"Hey, does that mean you really love me?" …Aki and Haruto instantly become a couple ten seconds after they first meet. From these two comes an awkward love story. Aki is a girl whose motto is, "If you love them, tell them right away!" On the other hand, Haruto thinks that there are times when you can't just confess your feelings.What if these two, with their opposing philosophies on love, were to suddenly become a couple one day? Haruto makes a surprise attack and steals another kiss from Aki, after which he invites her to his room… Because of a certain secret of Haruto's, their relationship proceeds in an unusual way, and at an unnaturally fast pace. Can these two, awkward in their purity, each find their own way to express "true love"…?

---

Official: [Renta!](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/114402), [Coolmic](https://coolmic.me/titles/143), [Pocket Comics](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Onna no Ko wa Yoyuu!
description:
From Stage Storm:  
Tomomi is secretly in love with her classmate Sawada. But her love couldn't be fulfilled as Sawada is in love with another girl. Meanwhile, Ojika, the head of the broadcast club, is trying to win Tomomi's heart with his handsome voice. Finally Tomomi's gloom is driven away. She starts to see the hidden beauty of the things around her which she has never noticed before.

title: Reverse!?
description: A math teacher unwittingly formulates a love triangle with two diabolical variables divided over him. Unhappy teaching at an all boys school, the heterosexual Amamiya entertains his bitterness by toying with an adoring student. The surprising interference of the boy's fierce former friend, however, places Amamiya at the center of a wildly twisted tug-of-war. Teacher and student: a taboo love affair gone… comedy?

title: Kaze no Yukue
description:
Kento and Akira's sweet romance continues… Miraculously, it's been a whole year since the ultra-conservative Kento and the ridiculously flamboyant playboy, Akira, started dating. Though Kento's grandparents have, so far, managed to survive their grandson's gay relationship, Akira still has some secrets that just might send them to their early graves. Should Kento be more concerned about his family's opinion of him, or his high-maintenance lover's extreme complexes?
