Sweet and funny, this is the story of two people who couldn't be more different, or more perfect for each other.s opinion of him, or his high-maitanance lover's deep-seated social inferiority complex?  
  
An extremely sweet (and funny) story of two people who couldn't be more different, or more perfect for each other.

title: Sensei to Iwareru hodo Baka de Nashi
description: Siempre ha admirado la carrera de un Maestro, pero en cuanto crecía la realidad de cómo pueden ser realmente la golpeó. Así que, cuando este nuevo Sensei estuvo frente a ella… ¿Lo juzgó muy fuerte? 9 años después, ellos se vuelven a encontrar.

title: Shinikaeri
description: A young man whose motto is "Never commit suicide" happens to meet a boy with a cut mark on his wrist and follows him out of curiosity. However, the boy's path leads him to a world of "death" that he has never seen before−−. A battle of different abilities by suicides who have come back to life.

title: Ore no Mono ni Natte, Senpai.
description: The first time you see her, you'll know that she's a very popular girl in your class, but you can't seem to make a move. However, one day, Ryo's younger brother, Rai, asks her, "Do you want me to help you with Ryo? Ryo's brother, Rai, asked her if she would like to help him with Ryo. Rai says that he knows Ryo's personality, what type of girl Ryo likes, and everything so he can make Hana into the kind of girl Ryo likes! Why would Rai cooperate with her when there is no merit to it? Hana wonders why Ryo is cooperating with her, even though there is no merit to it. Then, Ryo and Hana begin to get closer and closer...!

title: From the moon to the stars
description: Kim Jonghyun is a freshman student who just started questioning his feelings for his best friend, Ren. As the story progresses, both of them will or will not realize how they really feel, you'll have to read to discover!

title: Joshi Mousou Shoukougun
description: Hatori is a tall girl who's easily mistaken for a boy, and she's in love with her childhood friend, Keishi. Even though he's a boy, Keishi is so cute that Hatori just wants to push him down and make him her own. Hatori has countless delusions and hallucinations (unbefitting a young lady) running wildly through her head every day – and they're all about Keishi. They set her heart pounding and her nose bleeding!

title: Pisu no Oshigoto
description:
No matter how you look at it, Kamijou is an average guy. On the other hand, his ex-childhood friend, Aikawa Itasu, is a popular and intelligent girl. Believing his childhood friend to be in a whole other world than himself, he starts putting distance between them…  
Until one day, Kamijou’s cat, Peace, sneaks off and visits Aikawa. The two of them starts talking again. What's Aikawa's motive for feeding Peace? And… will they end up reconnecting?

title: Chou ni Naru Hi
description:
1) The Day I Become a Butterfly  
There is a rumor going around school that Mikami can “hear” when one’s death is near. Uka has just turned fifteen, but doesn’t know how much longer he’ll live… Will the budding love between Mikami and Uka have a happy ending?  
  
2) You At the End (Hate Ni Aru Kimi)  
A short story about a guy sick of this world and the silent, unlikely boy who anchors him to it.  
  
3) The Lonely War  
Can men and women have platonic friendships? Suzu is determined to try.  
  
4) Blue Cat's Tunnel  
A story about one girl's hope to find a way out of her life…  
  
5) Tokyo Alien Yulala  
A young student's trouble understanding his classmate makes him think the boy may be an alien.  
  
6) Planet Yours  
An abused boy has trouble relying on his friends.

title: Binan Zaibatsu
description:
Nanako Fujiwara, a socially isolated high school girl, remains an outcast even after transferring schools—until one day, her life takes a dramatic turn!

She’s unexpectedly tasked with a crucial mission: selecting the next heir of a powerful conglomerate (zaibatsu). To "accurately evaluate the candidates’ leadership qualities," she must live with four dazzlingly handsome brothers competing for the title:

Yamato Mitsurugi (Eldest):

Flawless Student Council President

Vibe: "Excellence isn’t my goal—it’s my default."

Shizumaru Tenhou (Second):

Undefeated Street Fighter

Vibe: "Try saying no. I’ll make you regret it."

Hikaru Sennen-zaka (Third):

Illegally Adorable Mascot

Vibe: "Nee-chan, let’s bake cookies!" (…Why is his stock portfolio outperforming Wall Street?)

Ukyou Sumeragi (Youngest):

Mysterious Beauty Incarnate

Vibe: "You keep staring… Do I haunt your dreams?"

The Catch: Each brother deploys every tactic imaginable—from sweet persuasion to corporate sabotage—to win Nanak

title: Sensei to, Watashi to, Hajimete.
description:
Sensei, the person whom I long for, whom I wait for, whom I love, and whom I want to be with. At night, I always think about you, Sensei. You are similar to me, but you have a completely different personality. The moment I fell in love with him, school has become a different kind of place because of him. The love between me and Sensei has begun to grow.  
  
Includes the oneshot, Fake Letter.

title: His Feelings
description:
“I don’t want to fall in love with anyone.” That’s what Wataru told himself, not expecting his encounter with Satago, a tall, blond and thug-looking guy, who speaks his mind a little too bluntly and seems particularly interested in his schoolmate’s lack of expressiveness.   
Chapter deleted due to the demands of the author.

title: Love All!
description:
Kimari Haneno, 15-years-old. This spring, she enrolled at Shikano Academy's Special Communication department. But on the day of the entrance ceremony, this Communication Department is sentenced to getting abolished. Kimari however, who followed the footsteps of her deceased brother, doesn't want this department to vanish! And so, she starts to act out of character! But what should she do!? Only the president of the all male Normal Department student council holds out a helping hand to her. And he has secret plans to capture the headmaster?!  
  
Pt-Br:  
Kimari Hano tem 15 anos. Nessa primavera ela entrou para o Curso Especial da Academia Shikanomori. Mas no dia da cerimônia de entrada, o Curso Especial faz um comunicado dizendo que terão que encerrar as atividades. No entanto, Kimari que sempre seguiu os passos do seu irmão, não quer que isso aconteça. Então ela começa a agir sozinha! Mas o que ela fará? Apenas o presidente do conselho estudantil é quem pode ajudar ela.

title: Pseudo Love
description: Baek Ga-in is a university student doing multiple jobs, living a double life as a demon worship concept streamer 'Lucia.' She has been carrying past scars of being entangled within a cult but suddenly her stream attracts a real demon, an 'incubus'?! A demon, human and... an angel?! This is not a 'cult' it is that campus fantasy romance!!

title: Ordinary School
description: Nareh and Tareh are fraternal twins, Nareh the elder sister and Tareh the younger brother. When Nareh learns that Tareh has been accepted into the all-boys Ordinary School for the purpose of achieving his crazy dream, she is shocked, and prepares to stop him at all costs…

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Ma Maya (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine are the top two actresses-in-training at the prestigious Seisho Music Academy. One fateful day, Claudine catches Maya speaking on the phone about her desire to get married following graduation. Claudine finds herself distraught at the news, and questions just what Maya really means to her.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Kanojotachi no X-Day
description:
It's senior year, and Rica is seriously stressed out. She's got more homework, exams, and papers than she can handle, and was recently dumped by her boyfriend. In other words: Life sucks! One day, she's chatting online when she meets three classmates who hate school as much as she does. Together, they hatch a plan to blow up the school when no one is present. The countdown is on for X-Day …  
  
Side story: The Last Supper  
In the future cows have died out and are now made using human DNA. The can speak and look similar to humans, but people still eat them and treat them as cows. After her father was eaten, Lamda the cow decides to run away. Unfortunately he is caught, but before that he helps a little boy, Mitsuhiko. The boy then insists Lamda become his servant instead of being eaten. When the Black Plague hits Mitsuhiko he is in danger of dying because the only cure is cow's meat and every cow except Lamda is gone….

title: Ane-Mone Seikaten
description:
Story 1: Aneâ˜†Mone Seikaten  
A cute and funny little story about a baby-faced high school girl Mone Saeki who inadvertently falls in love with a grade schooler Ren Anesaki!  
  
Story 2: Everyday Treasures / Every Day is a Treasure  
Momo is a scaredy cat and always bullied by Kanazawa, but what happens if the two find themselves on a treasure hunt in an abandoned amusement park.  
  
Story 3: Batsu-san  
Hanada has been living in the country and was the only student in her school. Can she work together with Fujino to fulfill her dream of doing a big event?  
  
Story 4: Daydream Believer  
Minato has given up on her dream, will something change when she saves a boy that jumps into a river.

title: Jyoshikousei wa Ohayoutte Iu
description: An all boys school is combined with an all girl school, a whole new adventure confronting the unknown starts for a couple of school boys.

title: Renai Catalog
description: Hanamoto Mika is a shy, self-conscious 17-year-old-girl who wants very much to love and be loved. Hopelessly superstitious and unhappy with her current self, Mika tries to find answers and guidance to her life through fortune-telling and romance magazines. She decides to go on a group date with her friends and meets Takada. It’s love at first sight; at least on her end. Soon after, she encounters Takada coincidentally on the subway, but Mika trips and falls at his feet, then runs away in mortification before he could say a word. They meet again on a second group date, but to Mika’s humiliation, he has no recollection of her from the first date! But he does remember her embarrassing moment on the train. He apologizes for not remembering her and then explains that he had lost his contacts and couldn’t see clearly on that first date. Emboldened by his confession, she shocks him and herself by asking him out on a date! This is the story of unlikely relationships, and the trials and tribula

title: Dramatic Love Album
description: Manabe is a an ex-model who feels insecure about herself. She wants to live a life unnoticed by others, so at school, she's called "corner girl." She's always by herself, and doesn't associate with anyone. Its all about change when she accidentally meets her teacher, who also happens to be a photographer.

title: Bye-Bye, Little
description:
A collection of oneshots:  
  
1. Bye-Bye, Little.  
Ai is a first year high-school student whose father passed away when she was still in elementary school. Her immature younger brother is a pain, she has to do all the housework and it's awkward being around her own friends. But Takahashi-kun is secretly supporting her in the shadows… a story about growing up.  
  
2. Love, Stupid, Me  
Chie wishes that her boyfriend Satoshi would show her more affection, but she knows he doesn't like the clingy type. The fact that she's hated by Satoshi's friend Sugiyama Sei doesn't help. However, it turns out that he doesn't hate her after all…  
  
3. Doki-Doki  
Miyuki's in love with Shuntaro, but she won't confess because she's afraid of ruining their relationship. But when another girl confesses to Shuntaro, something begins to change…  
  
4. Too Young  
Mika's mom doesn't approve of her relationship with Yoshiyuki, her boyfriend. In fact, she doesn't approve of anything Mika does, whether it b

title: Kiss Kara Hajimaru
description: A girl takes a pencil left by the senpai who she has a crush on, but she was unknowingly being watched by another boy while taking it. In order to keep her secret, he demands… that… she… kisses… him!

title: Darkness Gathers
description: Six lost souls gather in a candle-lit room with a mysterious host. None of them know exactly how they came to be there, but there's only one way out. Each of us follows a path preordained by destiny. If the souls are judged to have lost their path by mistake they will be returned to it. But if destiny says their time is up: they have to move on.

title: Bye Bye Brother
description: Kotono has always lived in the shadow of her brother, what will happened when he suddenly comes back home after living abroad for many years?!

title: I Want a Painting Brush
description: Despite his family’s opposition, Cheng Qian runs away to attend a Fine Arts Academy. Penniless, he must work while also attending classes, pushing his mind and body beyond exhaustion. At that moment, he meets Xu Qiujin, who is the complete opposite of him. His art, and everything about him, is enviable. One single life-changing moment causes them to become tangled up in each other's lives...

title: Kiss and Hungry - Love Like Sweets
description: An older girl looking for love. A younger guy comes into the picture?!

title: Sakashima
description: Two high-school students who have been friends since childhood have a complicated relationship.

title: Ningyo Hime to Ouji-sama
description: School life becomes too much for Sonohara Kokone when Sei-kun, who is as popular as a real prince at school, suddenly asks her out. They barely know each other due to her doll-like but expressionless features. So, why is he minding her so much!?

title: Anata no Uta ni Koishite Mita
description: High-school girl Takamiya Maki is a big fan of the musician 'Shou,' so much that she still hasn't found her 'first love.' So what will happen when she meets the handsome Saitou-kun…?

title: Kimi ni Moete Ii Desu ka
description: Kyoko isn’t interested in men, well, not real men that is. Her only love is “Haruki”, an anime character but what happens when Aki, her flashy classmate kisses her unexpectedly and asks her to date him?

title: Whatever You Say, I Won't!
description:
What fell from the ceiling, was a tiny girl that looked like a 10 year old.

---

- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.toptoon.net/comic/epList/80473)

title: D.C.S.G. ~Da Capo - Second Graduation~
description:
Nemu is back home.  
What's gonna happen with Junichi's life after this reunion with his sister?  
"Da Capo" in Italian means "From the beginning"… then will we see the end to this romance?

title: Chocolate Junkie
description: A story about an ugly girl named Chiyoko, who has always been bullied for her looks. When a good-looking new transfer student named Aoi arrives, he decides to rule over her and announces that he's the only one who can pick on her. From then on, no one but he bullies her - she's unable to escape from him until college, where she lied and said she was going to the same school but didn't. Now, 8 years later he finally caught up with her…what oh what will he do to her now!?

title: Kanojo, Okarishimasu (Fan Colored)
description: In today's Japan, "rental" services can deliver an afternoon with a "friend," a "parent," even a fake girlfriend! After a staggering betrayal by his girlfriend, hapless freshman Kazuya gets just desperate enough to give it a try. But he quickly discovers how complicated it can be to "rent" an emotional connection, and his new "girlfriend," who's trying to keep her side hustle secret, will panic when she finds out her real life and Kazuya's are intertwined in surprising ways! Family, school, and life all start to go wrong, too...

title: My Underworld Boyfriend
description: Kissed by a rogue on one night, and then I was kidnapped by a handsome guy to a strange place... what a bad luck! What is more unfortunate, I was arranged to study in a noble while violent school by that guy, who is the biggest leader of the underworld...

title: Maou wa Senkyou Gakuen de Koi o Suru
The White Shadow
description:
Main Story: The White Shadow - Shiroi Kageboshi - 白い影法師  
Suzuko Hasebe, a grade 11 student, has been on a consistent transfer from one school to another (due to her father's work) before transferring to a private school. When she arrived, she saw an empty desk sitting by the window of the classroom and was given permission to sit there. No one has sat at that desk for 5 years, and strange things are about to occur.   
  
Side Story: Melody for Two - Futari no Melody - ふたりのメ� ディ  
Sawai is handsome, cultured, and a talented violinist who is searching for his soul-mate. Karumi is a boisterous and energetic girl whose greatest desire is to play the drum during the local festival. When Sawai's grandmother has heart trouble, Karumi impresses Sawai with her energy–and wrestling ability! But the gap between their worlds may be too great even for a duet with violin and drum, for Sawai's mother has returned to Japan–and declares Sawai must go to Austria. The only way he can stay is for rough K

title: Jakushou Soshage-bu no Bokura ga Kamige wo Tsukuru Made
description:
Past trauma leads Kai Shiraseki to abandon the world of social game development, so he transfers to Maikun High School to start a new life. But on his first day he meets Nanaka Aoi, the president of a low-tier social game club, and finds out that the club is on the brink of disbanding—and is also populated by total weirdos! The programmer, Aya Oushima, is a crazed gacha addict, and the illustrator, Eru Kuroba, faints from the cuteness of her own drawings?!

Kai joins the club, which gives them enough members to continue... or so they thought. The student council hands down an ultimatum: "Win a competition against another school or disband!" Now their management talents will really be put to the test. With the skills that he's nurtured and his new set of friends, can Kai face his fears to create the ultimate social game?!

title: Pig Bride
description: Lost in the mountains on a trip to summer camp, eight-year-old Si-Joon fears he’ll never make it out alive. When a strange girl in a pig mask appears before him, he follows her to a house deep in the woods, where he is told that he must marry the pig-faced girl to atone for the sins of their ancestors. Si-Joon’s not too keen on getting married, but that wedding feast looks so delicious! It’s only afterward that he realizes what he’s done and…wakes up. Now in high school, Si-Joon Lee has been dreaming about the pig bride for as long as he can remember. But it’s all just a dream, right?

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - Mattete Koigokoro  (Doujinshi)
description:
ship: You x Riko  


---

 Links  
- [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/467636)  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/nobi209)

title: Orange Kiss
description:
Consists of 4 short stories.  
  
1. Orange Kiss  
Kijima Aka had a dream. In the dream, she and an orange haired boy kissed under the setting sun. And that boy just so happens to be the guy who's in the same class as her, Shimizu! She always thought Shimizu had some kind of grudge against her because he seems to hate her. Will Aka's dream become reality?  
  
2. Happy Words  
The story of the past of the main characters, Saiko and Ichi, from "No. 1 Girl" in the tankubon Caramel Milk Tea.  
  
3. Last Train Under the Night Sky  
  
4. More Orange Kiss  
  
Includes "Another Usami's Biography."

title: Plume Ruri Magic School
description: A mysterious white-haired girl named Kami Night enters Plume Ruri Magic School, the magic school of highest reputation on the Mansonsno continent. As a mage who can conjure several kinds of magic, she is the alien in the eyes of the classmates. what is the secret behind her?

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club - Kaichou Kao Akai desu yo! (Doujinshi)
description: Nana yang harus melindungi identias Idolnya dari Wakil Ketua OSIS yang ternyata sangat mencintai sosok Setsuna-chan.

title: Harmony of the Stars
description:
This manga includes two different stories.  
  
1) Harmony of the Stars (2 chapters) : The first one is about a girl, Yukiko, who is always doing what others tell her to do and a boy, Wada, who can't stand how his classmates always taking advantage of her naivety and kindness and tries to knock some sense into her.  
  
2) (4 chapters) Mayuko and Sugikake's story : Mayuko had an unrequited love with her cousin and promised herself to not fall in love again but everything changes when Sugikake, her sempai in the volley club, starts picking on her.

title: 6-banme no Megane
description: Chuunri's in a predictament - he's newest boyfriend doesn't seem to be interested in being intimate, so he goes to his previous boyfriend for advice. Of course, a little jealousy never hurts to get some action going.

title: Doubt!!
description:
Ai has been a jimmies (*slang: girl who is plain and behind in fashion*) all her life, and she's never had a boy as a friend, and much less a boyfriend. She's always lived in the shadows, and blamed others for her misfortune.  
  
One day she becomes the laughing stock in front of her whole class, including the boy that she likes, because of her Cutey Bunny panties. That is the turning point for Ai, and she decides to become a fine woman and start over in a high school where no one knows her.  
  
Thus begins Ai's search for love.  
  
*Includes a oneshot entitled The Day of Finals.*

title: Otomentaru
description:
Otome is searching for love now that she has entered high school. But of course, finding love isn't going to be easy, especially if you have three delinquent boys who are your childhood friends. Otome explains to the boys that since they are in high school now, she wants to find love and fall deeply in love, but Tokio (one of her childhood friends) insist that she be part of his plan. He dreams of taking over the school and becoming a grand gang leader; he'll even let her join as the sub-leader. What is she going to do? As she sneaks away from the boys, she catches a couple of girls watching the most popular boy, Touyou, being confessed to!? Is this love at first sight? She decides to spy/stalk him… what will she find out?  
  
Extra 1 - The Boy Next Door (Tonari no Danshi)  
  
Extra 2 - System vs Freedom

title: Natsume to Natsume - More Perfume
description:
"I want to be her hero."

Shiranui Natsume, a third-year high school student. His lover is his childhood friend, Minazuki Natsume. Whenever he's in a pinch, she rushes to his side. Whenever he loses his way, she shows him the path. He wants to catch up to her—his girlfriend, who is always dignified, cool, and just like a hero.

title: Aoi Futari
description:
Collection of three one-shot stories by Shiina Karuho.  
  
Aoi Futari:  
A funny, sweet, touching story about a girl and a guy who have just begun dating. They each pretend to be calm and in control, but what are they really thinking?  
  
Hana to Thief:  
Miyata Azumi met Ooki in grade school. Azumi was grabbing a flower from Ooki's yard when Ooki caught her red-handed. Ever since then, she's avoided him out of embarrassment. Now in high school, will things change?  
  
Katakoi Juliet:  
Jurie and Romio have a lot in common. Both their parents own rival stores in town, both have silly names from Shakespeare's play, and both have trouble getting along with each other. Are they as ill-fated as their namesakes?s.

title: Bara to Zirconia
description: School teacher Satomi-sensei was coming home drunk one day when he sees a girl sleeping among the roses in the park. In his drunken state, he believes the girl is his first love back in middle school. He wakes up the next morning with the girl beside him with the exactly the same face as his first love! Is he still drunk? Or it this some cruel twist of fate?

title: Tony Takezaki's Neon Genesis Evangelion
description: You saw his work in *Neon Genesis Evangelion: Comic Tribute*... depicting the truth about Rei with great sensitivity... Wait, that’s not the right word. What’s the opposite of “great sensitivity”? Well, whatever it is, Tony Takezaki’s got it, in this collection of all-new stories satirizing the *Evangelion* you saw on TV, as well as some scenes that apparently were never aired! SEE! *Eva* as a 1960s TV show! SEE! Kaworu and Shinji’s standup comedy career! SEE! Ritsuko’s days as Gendo’s student intern! SEE! Eva Units, flinging dookie! You’ll see all that and more, because this is *Tony Takezaki’s Neon Genesis Evangelion*! [Dark Horse]

title: Yume wo Miru Hima mo Nai
description: Kawamura Kazuya had dreamt of being a pilot as a child. Thus, when he heard of an aviation school five hours from where he stayed, Kawamura enrolled without giving it much thought. He was assigned a room with his two new roommates. One of them, Itou, dropped out when he couldn't stand the tough life. This left Kawamura with Yoshitake, a tall, quiet and non-responsive guy.

title: My Sweet Dragon
description: Chihaya, a 3rd year junior high student, is the only daughter of the priest who tends the small shrine dedicated to the Ryujin. One day, while cleaning the shrine, she finds a sleeping boy who is actually the transformed Ryujin.

title: Sayonara Usotsuki Ningyo Hime
description:
Ayase Suigetsu, who always smiles and tells lies, was the one person in her class who stood out from the rest.
Seated in front of her is Sou Hazumi, a loner weirdo who doesn't get on with anyone.
The two, who have no place to belong, begin to spend time together after one thing happens...

'If we're together, surely we won't be afraid.'

Facing the worries and loneliness of a 17-year-old.

title: Our Date Plan
description: 「ヤングジャンプラブ」に「僕らのデートプラン」っていう読み切りを載せてもらってます！

title: Kataomoi Mistake!: Suki nante dame dakara
Koi Gokoro Gekokujou
description: Minori's childhood friend, Shin, has always been a crybaby and even though he's considered the charming prince of the school, Shin is still a crybaby in disguise! Minori consider him no more than a little brother, but is Shin's crybaby character his real character?

title: Senior, Don't Run Away
description:
A junior in university, Yu Sheng's, daily priority is to make herself a person with no presence, friends, or love, insisting on refusing any social interaction. She only knows how to bury her head into creating horror novels. Until... her new neighbor, a freshman in her school's physical education faculty, moves in next door. Her junior brother Lu Haoming keeps chasing after her every day, sweetly calling her "Senior Sister", which makes her life change drastically! 
Senior sister: Do... Don't come over here! 
Junior brother: QAQ, am I not your cute junior brother anymore?

title: Engi Daketoka Gachi Tannai!
description:
A youthful love story between a gyaru and a theater student that can't be escaped!

Chiharu, a gyaru, is pushed aside by Makoto, a good looking but stupid theater student, and ends up helping out at a theater circle! Her youth and talent, which she had given up on, blossom!

title: M.A.X
description: A school where the students make their own riches. From Models to Computer Geniuses, These students get rich on their own. Namu goes to a school where all the elite get idolized by the non-elite. Never making it easy to get to school on time, Namu is soon helped by a new transfer student. Who gets categorized as an elite almost immediately?

title: Yumenara Samenaide
description:
1. Sachika got involved in a traffic accident, and she fell into a coma. The moment she awoke from it, the one waiting for her wasn't a family member or her boyfriend Tetsuo, but a man she didn't know. He introduced himself as Kohara, one of her relatives, and he took her to his house. Sachika gradually felt that something was wrong, and she came to know of a shocking fact…  
  
2. A girl meets her prince charming - just to find out things aren't what they seem like soon after. Dejected, she tries to make the best of her current situation, but then the past life mixes with the present life…  
  
3. Comedy about a tomboy and her unmanly childhood friend.

title: Inviolable Area
description: The main character is a hidden fan of the idol 'Leon'. At school, while acting as a model student and continuing his hidden virtues to meet his parents' expectations, 'Kang Seo-seo', who looks precisely like her favorite, comes to her school. Arthur starts to scratch the nerves of the main character by consistently mimicking 'Leon'... The story of their immature growth as they start to invade each other's inviolable territory.

title: Houkago no Binetsu
description:
The boy who rescued me went to school at night. It was a nice thing to admire from my ordinary life, however I could not face reality. Amidst this problem, suddenly I smell tabako and a young boy appears!  
  
Spanish:  
||  
El chico que me rescató fue a la escuela por la noche. Era algo agradable de admirar de mi vida ordinaria, sin embargo, no podía enfrentar la realidad. ¡En medio de este problema, de repente huelo tabaco y aparece un niño!  
||

title: Nagi no Asukara Official Comic Anthology
description: A cute and laid-back story anthology is here♪ A story anthology of the Dengeki Daioh x P.A.WORKS original animation "Nagi no Asukara" is here! 　It's full of cute and laid-back episodes by a stellar team of writers that are a little different from the usual "Nagi Asu"!

title: Anata ga Megane wo Hazushitara
description:
Collection of short stories:  
- Anata ga Megane wo Hazushitara  
- Hitorijime: The playboy Haruya’s rule is to not decide on one girlfriend. I don’t like crowds so I can monopolize Haruya…!?  
- Goshujinsama to Yonde  
- Delicious!! – Renjou Host Boy  
- Houkago Engage – Houkago Host Club Final

title: Hizamazuite Ai wo Chikae
description:
A cute collection of short stories, packed full of love!  
  
- **Hizamazuite Ai wo Chikae (Swear Love On Your Knees)**  
Arisa is in love with Naoe, her bodyguard, but he'll never see her as anything more than a job!  
  
- **Omae no Karada ni Kiitemiro (Try Asking Your Body)**  
"How does everyone choose only one person among so many people in this world?" That is the question that Yuasa Jun wants to find the answer for, and he just might find the answer with the help of Igarashi Misao. The girl who just beat him up for hurting her friend!  
  
- **Yokubou Star**  
A famous high school novelist and his assistant… what shape will this love-story take?  
  
- **Koibito. Zenyasai (Lover. The Eye)**  
"Culture festival is coming soon… For the costume parade, out class has decided on the theme 'Cinderella'. I, Mamiya Ena, am the Cinderella!" Yet, Ena's boyfriend, Mikio, refuses to play the role of the prince…  
  
- **Tennen Ecstasy (Natural Ecstasy)**  
She's finally released from hospit

title: Shakaijin Kareshi to Daigakusei Kanojo (Fan Colored)
Takane no Hana Senpai
description: My childhood friend is the pheromone Prince.

title: Boku no Ie ni Oide Wedding
description:
From Endless Journey:  
  
Mirei, an 18 years old studying as a specialized student in design, was proposed to by Mano during her high school graduation. Now preparing for her wedding in the summer with a handsome high-class man, this marriage seems like a dream. In reality, these two haven’t even taken their relationship into adulthood yet! How will the naive Mirei handle their newlywed life?

title: Kuyashiikurai, Suki.
description:
Spanish:  
Esta historia gira en torno a dos estudiantes que se conocen desde la primaria; Kojima Arata, un jugador de basquetbol, y Lena, una chica arisca que no entiende mucho del amor. ¿Pero qué pasará cuando Lena descubra nuevos sentimientos hacia el chico que ha conocido por tantos años?  
  
English, From Chibi Manga:  
You're making my heart beat all alone stupid. The unfriendly girl, Reina is a first year in high school. Because of her childhood friend, Kojima Shin, she became the boy's basketball manager. He was like a small brat when they were in elementary school, but not he's gentle and so cool. But there's a Senpai who he looks up to. But I can't seem to stop falling in love with him…!?

title: Cinderella Syndrome
description:
"A prince and such, how idiotic!!!"  
"That's what I thought, but…"  
When Ruri saw the school's most popular prince unexpected side…!?

title: Aishite Ii no wa Ore Dake - Osananajimi kara no Ai ga Fuka sugiru
description: Mugi, a senior in high school, has a crush on her handsome childhood friend, Nagisa. Although she can't help hoping that Nagisa will smile only at her, she refuses to be touched by him. The reason for this is that Mugi has a special constitution... On the other hand, Nagisa is also harboring a very heavy emotion that she can't tell Mugi about...? A handsome, sweet, and lusty love story that explodes with secrets that can't be hidden!

title: Yumeiro Button
description: She dreamt about confessing to her childhood friend at the graduation ceremony but…

title: The Hatsukoi Chronicle
description: Mustuki Yoneya, a high schooler, feels insecure and jealous because her constant companion and best friend, Nishio Kyuteki is starting to pay attention to a beautiful upperclassman. Seeing the senpai's attractiveness as a threat to her wish to remain at her best friend's side forever, she tries out several attempts as she strives to become the main object of Kyuteki's attention.

title: Sekai wa Temee de Mawatteru
description: As a transfer student to a rough, run-down school populated by delinquents, Shindou tries his best to make friends. When he meets the ill-mannered Yousuke, heartbeats and tempers start to fly! It seems Yousuke is a "tsundere" – his gruff exterior hides a shy, sensitive side – and Shindou immediately finds himself dizzy over his combative new crush. Can Yousuke accept a relationship that goes against his tough-guy image? Or will his tendency to lash out at everyone around him drive even the earnest Shindou away for good?

title: Suki ni Narazu ni Irarenai
description: Sakae Shuku tiene 15 años y por primera vez en su vida va a una cita en grupo, pero debido a su muy extrovertida personalidad las cosas no resultan como esperaba, cuando la cita seguía siendo un tremendo fracaso un camarero del lugar la animó… Musubu Aoto, quien, todo lo contrario a ella… es extremadamente tímido. ¿Será este el inicio de un peculiar primer amor?

title: Classmate no Ikemen ga Uchi no Kasei Otto ni narimashita
description:
Honoka Oshita, a lazy girl who is not good at housework, but lives her high school life as an outwardly perfect character, has to start living alone for a limited period of time due to her mother's business trip abroad. Her mother asks Akira Katsuragi, the most handsome boy in her class, to be her housekeeper. When he sees Honoka's disheveled appearance, he says, "Won't you be my girlfriend?" 

The two end up living together and signing a lover's contract!

title: There Is or Isn't
description:
어느 날 부ㄹ친구가 부ㄹ 떼고 나타났다면?! 가능?

___
Alternate Raws: [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/there_is_or_isnt), [Naver Series](https://m.series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5514900), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/5577)

title: Yuusetsu Taion
description: A cute love story starts with a pair of broken eye glasses.

title: Anti-Gravity Boy
description:
Aka Mujuuryoku Shounen   
  
Fuuko is a normal high school student who went after a boy whom she thought had something "special" about him. Turns out that the guy had a "super" power that lets him control how gravity affects him. However…it seems that it can also affect other people!  
Last volume includes a sidestory called H²Love.  
**********************  
ITALIAN/ITALIANO  
Questa è un' opera molto carina che comprende 3 bellissime storie: Mujuuryoku Shounen, Moon light boy e H2 Love  
  
Mujuuryoku Shounen è la storia di Konami Fuuko,una normale studentessa del primo anno di scuola superiore.Tra i ragazzi che ci sono nel suo istituto,solo uno attira la sua attenzione:Funakoshi Ruka,un ragazzo molto attraente anche se arriva spesso in ritardo alle lezioni, non è molto socievole,mantiene le distanze dagli altri ragazzi e ha un secreto che lo riguarda…ma Fuuko è decisa a fare amicizia con lui. Ma ultimamente tutti gli studenti sono molto spaventati, perchè girano voci riguardanti un

title: BRIGADOON: marin & μελαν
description:
Imagine waking up one day to find that the sky around has been engulfed by an unidentifiable mechanical presence. Imagine that this new sky opens up and releases a Monomakia, a living weapon, whose sole purpose is to end your life. That's exactly what happens to 13-year-old Marin Asagi, an orphaned girl living in an alternate version of Tokyo in the 1970's. Young Marin's only chance to survive rests with Melan Blue, the Gun-Swordsman, who is destined to protect her. With arms made of weapons, the power of flight, and retractable body armor, Melan is a powerful bodyguard indeed.   
Who is sending the Monamakia? Why do they want Marin dead? Who sent Melan to protect her? What is the secret of Brigadoon? With her new protector by her side Marin sets out across two worlds to discover the answers.

title: Kiss wa, Kokuhaku no Mae ni
description: Ichika and Rio "accidentally" kissed, and he wants compensation by making her go out with him. She dislikes him and refuses, but Rio does not take no for an answer. What will Ichika do?

title: Thirsty for Love
description: Orie Nakano's girlfriend is cheating on him with two other men! One is the mysteriously untouchable Tatsumi, and the other is the basketball-playing upperclassman that Orie idolizes. But things are far from being as simple as they seem, and now the three men are inevitably pulled towards each other and bond together by their love for Yuka, which extends much farther than just the girl herself. Love, admiration and lust intermingle around them in an inescapble spiral in this coming of age sexy romance.

title: Anoko ha Ahiru no Ko
description:
When deciding on the roles for their school's original play to be held at the school festival, Umino-kun, who is in charge of the script, suddenly selects Mashiro as the heroine...!?

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title: Konomini - This Ugly yet Beautiful World
description:
Takemoto Takeru, an ordinary high school student, encounters a strange light during a bike delivery for his part time job.  
  
When he stops and searches the surroundings, he notices a cute girl named Hikari climbing out of a sparkling cocoon in the forest.  
  
Takeru instantly falls for her at first sight, but was interrupted when suddenly a monster appears at the same spot and attacks the girl.  
  
This is the beginning of adventurous and exciting days for Takeru, the mysterious girls, Hikari and Akari, his childhood friend Nishino, Mari, and his classmates.

title: Walking Between Twinkling Stars
description:
Chance meeting planet ★ romance.

By touching you, the world takes on new colors.

Published in the LaLa DX January 2012 Issue.

title: Make Sweet
description:
Bittersweet stories that make your heart race in a painful but happy way. A compilation of stories about one-sided love that will have your 100% sympathy.  
  
Contains 5 short stories:  
- Make Sweet  
- Sugar Baby Love  
- Meganegoshi no Kimi  
- Haru, Urara  
- Make Sweet - Valentine Special

title: Ani-Com
description: Maachi is a 15 year-old girl who loves her brother Riichi. Actually, the two of them are not related by blood, but due to their parents work situation they are forced to live alone together. Riichi, whose looks, personality, and grades are top-class, is the idol around school. But he has a huge secret that only Maachi knows about. Riichi is actually an otaku!

title: Trouble Love Candy
description: The experienced Inspector Kazuhiko and the pre-graduate Michihisa are a loving homosexual couple. But Kazuhiko is always busy and seems to constantly find himself in trouble while Michihisa gets into just as much trouble himself! Frustrated with the little time they have together, Kazuhiko seeks help from Michihisa but the latter, not wanting to bother the already work-overloaded Kazuhiko, continually attempts to solve these problems on his own…

title: Kare wa Tsumetai Furi o Shite
description:
Story 1 - Kare wa Tsumetai Furi o Shite (He Who Pretends to be Cold) - Chapters 1-3  
Wishing to become a shining girl and be in a romantic love. Kaho starts a part time job in a family restaurant to save up her allowance. Due to the tension from a new job, she accidentally injures her co-worker Arata, a handsome college student. To this result, the two are teamed up on the same shifts. Kaho is timid towards Arata's cold attitude, but realizes he has some soft sides and…?!  
  
Sweet & Painful first love story.  
  
Story 2 - Sawacha Dame! (Don't Touch Me!) - Chapter 4  
Momo hates boys, the idea of being touched by them disgusts her. One day, the reason for her hatred and trauma returns.  
  
Story 3 - 17cm Saki no Kata Omoi (The Unrequited Love Beyond 17cm) - Chapter 5  
Sarishima has always loved Sho, despite the fact that Sho is always being mocked for being short.  
  
Story 4 - Tsumetaku Shinai De (Don't Be Cold) - Chapter 6  
Maki Kurumi wants to grow up catch up to her childhoo

title: Haikyu!! - Koisuru Wakusei (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama is being harangued by girls confessing to him–so Sugawara offers him a helpful suggestion: find someone to pretend to be dating to throw them off.

title: Chouchou Kumo
description:
1) Butterfly Cloud  
Best friends Kiyo, Kanta, and Goma live in a small, depopulated island in the Seto Inland Sea. One day, a transfer student from Tokyo arrives. Before long Ritsuka, a cute and fair-skinned girl, started hanging out with the three best friends, but what happens after?  
This story was released as a oneshot in the Bitter - Nakechau Koi Monogatari anthology volume.  
  
2) Middle School First Year - Less Than Love  
Koizumi Kana is in love. And her love for Fujimoto made her imagine him as a total different person and do all sort of silly things, even as far as to steal a pencil lead. What will happen when suddenly Fujimoto asks her out and she finds out that he is not the person she imagined?  
  
3) Middle School Second Year - Man Hater  
Mitsuki Abe is always being sexually harassed which lead to her aversion for men. Torii after being falsely accused for groping Abe decides to catch the real culprit. What will happen when Torii betrays her by accidently kissing her

title: Dāng Bùliáng Lǎodà de Nánrén
description: Because of his involvement in a fight, the school's star student, Xu QingSong, becomes acquainted with the young delinquent, Zhu Chen, and falls in love with him at first sight. Then, for various reason, Xu QingSong becomes the boss of a gang. He launches an offensive against Zhu Chen, who is now his second-in-command, and leads the Sea Flower Gang on a rampage to… er… to rectify the town of Taifang.

title: Milky Way
description:
Sayo is a high school freshman. She and Nao are neighbors and childhood friends. Nao is a year older than her, and they have been together forever. They ride the train to school every day. Nao is a very caring friend and treats Sayo as his little sister; however, Sayo is in love with him, but is afraid of confessing because he might turn cold towards her.  
  
Also contains oneshot Cosmic Wonder - Fate's Twin.

title: Kocchi no Mizu wa Amai no da
description: Even though I just wanted to join the biology club…!? A reunion is born, a story about water, fish, and love

title: Invincible Yeonbyeongeol
description: After losing her entire family to a mysterious fire, Soon-Doong refuses to wallow in sadness and decides to move to South Korea from her native Yanbian to find herself a new and better life. Holding nothing but a plane ticket to Korea, a small package of clothes, and a half-burnt letter between her grandfather and a "textile factory owner" in Seoul (who were good friends), she resolves to find a job at the factory and make a decent, honest living. Only, the "textile factory owner" just happens to be the CEO of the biggest clothing brand in the country, and her grandfather wasn't just a good friend with the "textile factory owner" - he had saved the CEO's life and lent him the money to start the business that he has today! And so begins Soon-Doong's life in Korea, as she shatters everyone's bigoted prejudice against ethnic Koreans who came from Yanbian and makes everyone rethink about their own values and lifestyles.

title: Fall
description: Everyone at Yangming High School knows that Zhou Wan is introverted and silent, while Lu Xixiao is flamboyant and unruly. The two are worlds apart, having nothing to do with each other. No one expected that one day these two would stand together. "Some people will love you when you're in full bloom, and still love you when you're covered in mud." A roguishly handsome and flirtatious second-generation rich kid x a well-behaved and studious girl.

title: Datte Aishiteru
description: The high-school second grader Nao secretly likes Rin, who is in the same basketball club. She didn't want to destroy the "friend" relation, and couldn't convey her feelings; but, one day, Rin falls in love at first sight?! Moreover, the person is a beautiful senior, Michiyo. And a junior, Kouta, is approaching Nao–?!

title: Waraenai Riyuu
description: Kanako is the resident class outsider. She has no friends, and her classmates talk about her behind her back calling her a "downer." However, she wasn't always like this. Back in elementary school, she was a cheerful, outgoing girl who loved to smile. This all came to an end one day when Eiji, the younger brother of her school tutor and a classmate of hers, told her that she looked ugly when she smiled. Even though he moved away soon after, she took his insult to heart and it's been two years since anyone's seen her smile. Now that Eiji's back in town, what will become of her?!

title: Gakuen Baby
description:
Even though Komachi was born into a doctor's family, she's extremely shy, has a phobia of blood and is extremely bad in sports. Studying is the only thing that she can do well, but she totally failed her high school entrance test! Instead of entering her first choice "ELITE class," she entered the "SPECIALITY class," where people who want to specialize in sports and the arts are.  
  
Macho with dreadlocks, bearded lolita… Being surrounded by these people is already very terrible! But on top of that, the famously talented sprinter, Oosaki Hiro, has zeroed in on her and has his eye on her…

title: Tadashi Koi ni Kagiru.
description:
A new life of excessive excitement in a school dormitory where love is mandatory!
The romance-incompetent Chiyori is approached by two top handsome men...!

title: Heh, I'm in Trouble
description: Upon transmigrating into a strange cultivation world, Luo Lanlan believed she would remain there and become a star. Later, she found herself in front of the entrance of a high school whilst inhabiting the body of a 16-year-old, and realized she was going to become the CEO's future wife! With nowhere to run, the CEO began approaching her. "Don't come over here!".

title: Mitsuru Adachi's Early Complete Works
description:
Collections of short stories:  
Volume #1:  
Gamushara
  
Volume #2:  
I'm the Boss of After-School
  
Volume #3:  
-Ace of hearts  
-Teens  
-Wind and Leaves  
-Hirahira's stories

title: Oshi ni Muchūna Hazunanoni
description: A girl completely devoted to her oshi/idol day after day… until an unexpected rival appears!

title: Delinquent Lesson
description:
From Esthétique:  
  
A teacher's pet and a model student, Young-Won Lee, at this important time right before the college entrance exam, feels her heart beating faster toward a delinquent… When she can't get a reasonable answer from books, she follows the philosophy that after being lovers for 3 months, the love hormone that confuses the lover disappears. Thus, she decides to show her interest to the delinquent-!! What did you say? You hate nerds like me? Just wait, Haru Kang! I'll become a hot, flashy babe and make you fall for me!

title: Soshite Boku wa Koi wo Suru
description:
1, 5 - Catamountain  
Even though the President of the Student Council, Aoyagi, isn’t much of a fighter, he's still determined to bust any troublemakers in school. It’s a good thing that he can always rely on his strong and dependable kouhai, Hayami, the Treasury of the Student Council, to watch his back. Until one day, Hayami drew him close and demanded, “I want to embrace you”…!?  
  
2, 3 - Moe Love  
Riku is in love with Chisato, a bishoujo anime otaku, that doesn't see anything other than his moe figurines. Will Riku be able to win his love?  

4 - One More Kiss  
Taiga comes home one day to find a stranger in his house, eating his cup nuddles. The stranger, Higuchi, is a very talented illustrator, and his style is very similar to someone Taiga knew when he was in high school. Someone Taiga had forced himself upon…

title: Kuusou Spin Flower
description:
Let us search for fellow youthful club members for our mysterious club activities!  
Because of her father's adventures, Miku is entering school 3 months late. As such, she's petrified of being excluded and not having friends. He, the school special's extracurricular "finder", gave Miku an opportunity to make friends. And thus, somehow, Miku managed to join a club…

title: A Can of Happiness
description:
Five short stories:  
- A Can of Happiness  
- Boys Just Don't Understand  
- A Million Words  
- The Opposite of Love is Hate  
- I'll Always Be Here

title: Switch
description: Kei is a quiet student who doesn't really like adults or teachers too much. However, after getting to know her English teacher, she begins to fall for him.

title: Geureohgo Geureon Baram e
description: Rumor has it that Baram Oh had an affair with her married art school professor. It’s been four years since that debacle, and now she’s back at campus to try and enjoy her college life. But she’s not the only thing who’s returned: there’s rumors of a water ghost roaming the halls, and it just might be following her around.

title: Fuudanjuku Monogatari
description: Nakano Fudanshi Gakuen is a school renowned for its sports program, yet only has an average school rating of 50! Within the school, there is a club on the verge of losing its official status called "Fudanjuku". The club's theme is, to put it simply, "anything-goes". This story is a slapstick school comedy revolving around the unique seven members and their various troubles.

title: TOKYO Yamanote BOYS
description:
Tokyo Yamanote Boys is a confession tournament held in Tokyo. This year Chihiro is chosen to be the princess, which means that she gets to spend a fateful dreamlike week with the boys.  
  
Based on an otome game.

title: Tabetai Hito
description:
Compilation of short stories:  
  
- Tabetai Hito  
Yuu carries the torch for her childhood friend Kyoshi; but he is a handsome player that always treats her as a child…  
  
- Mitsuiro no Houkago  
The shy class representative Saetsuki watches the popular Koyano from afar. One day the teacher asks Saetsuki to help him with his studies, and when they are alone in the classroom he suddenly kisses her. What are his intentions?  
  
- Hazushite yo  
Kinoshita has long admired Yamashita, especially his smile when he sees his girlfriend. Now she overhears Yamashita's girlfriend breaking up with him. The next day she is close by Yamashita when he meets his old girlfriend with her new boyfriend. To hide his embarrassment, Yamashita grabs hold of Kinoshita and kisses her. What will happen next?  
  
- Mado Goshi ni, Koi Shita / Mado Goshi no Ichimoku Hore no Koi [Scanlated by Midnight Scans; Re-hosting not allowed]  
The very shy Fumiko from the normal classes sees the cool Mibu from the advan

title: Ann no Magomago Tosho Land
description:
The story begins when a suspicious cult called the "Confusion Cult" enter the town. The god they worship is in fact a baby. The red-haired protagonist of the manga named Anne attends the school that the cult founded, and even though she is not popular, she is still loved by her friends. As she continues to rebel against the cult, the door to a mysterious world opens.  
(Anime News Network)  
  
Note: It is unknown if this was cancelled or not.

title: Sakiyomi!
description: 如月美羽の誰にも言えない秘密…それは、人の顔を見てしまうと良くない未来『サキヨミ』が見えてしまうことがあること――。その力を恐れて高校入学後も友達を作れずにいたけれど、同級生の瀧島君に「運命は変えられる」と言われて…！？秘密の力を持つ二人で未来を変える！！

title: El Romance de una Chica Gorda
description: Una chica con algunos complejos necesita encontrar la solución pronto para conseguir al chico de sus sueños. ¿Logrará su objetivo?

title: Akuma na Kare to Ikenie Tenshi
description:
1) The Lover of the Devil  
The main girl gets entangled with a guy well-known as, "The Devil". After he saves her from the grasp of some guys she got into trouble with, a contract is made. As part of the contract, she belongs to the "Devil." What will become of this poor girl? Dinner for the devil himself? Or will she find something else?  
  
2) TRANCE KISS  
  
3) TROUBLE KISS  
  
4) JOKER MAGIC  
Tsubasa has gotten tickets to Daita's magic show… but she's lost them! She desperately wants to see the Prince of Magic, so she sneaks in backstage to attend it! However, things don't always work out, she runs into Daita, the magician himself catches her, and to keep her quiet, she agrees to be his assistant for the time being

title: Kimi wa Riaru Hero
description:
*I want to be the main character in a story. I would meet my ideal hero… And have a dramatic love scene like in novels and manga!!…… I wish~*  
  
Or so Reiko Sengoku thought until a chance encounter with classmate Kanata Hyuuga.

title: Guardian Hearts
description: Hina, otherwise known as Guardian Hearts, is sent to Earth on a mission to protect the peace… and with strict orders not to let anyone find out her identity. So when Kazuya accidentally sees Hina transform just when she comes to Earth, he is forced to take her home with him. Because it’s ok to know about a secret identity if you’re family, right? At least that’s what Hina believes! But as if living with Guardian Hearts isn’t troublesome enough, magic girls now seem to be appearing everywhere and revealing themselves to Kazuya! Can Kazuya survive the attentions – and jealousies – of so many girls? One thing is for sure, Kazuya’s days will be anything but dull!

title: Esoragoto.
description: Kotoko is a first year high school student. She never gave love much of a thought until she meets a boy on the train. She falls in love with him, but he seems to have a girlfriend...!?

title: Sasuga ni Muri da yo Amon-kun
description: Ai, a high school sophomore who loves older boys, meets Amon, a handsome college student who is exactly what she wants, at her sister's wedding. He confesses his love for her and she says yes, but it turns out to be a first-year junior high school boy who has just graduated from elementary school!　I can't be four years younger than him!　But Amon is just too cool for him!　This is a romantic comedy with a reverse age difference that will make you laugh and make you feel a little bit happy!

title: Itazura ni Sayonara
description:
A coming-of-age romantic comedy between a righteous heroine and a former bully!
Shiorina enters high school and is unexpectedly reunited with a bully from the same elementary school, Ryo Kiba!
She dreamed of a peaceful high school life, but she is constantly being pushed around by the bullies...?

title: Majestic Prince
description: In the latter half of 21st century, humans leave the Earth and begin to live in space. In order to adapt to the environment in space and deal with the hostile aliens in Jupiter, genetically engineered children called "Princes" are artificially raised and trained to be pilots of armed robots "AHSMB (Advanced High Standard Multipurpose Battle Device). This is a story about one of the teenage "Princes," Hitachi Izuru, who studies in an academic city Grandzehle.

title: Traumerei Lies
description:
"Just two and a half months. Go out with me."
Nanami Osaka, a high school student in Kamakura, has a secret she can't tell anyone. That is, sneaking into the "no trespassing" third music room and playing the piano after school. It was a precious time for Nanami, who has been unable to play the piano in front of others since a certain past, but one day he is found by a strange male student. Calling himself Yui, he presses for an exchange condition, "In exchange for keeping the secret"--? Kamakura, dusk, music room. A boy and girl with a secret, a special time for just the two of them begins.

title: K-ON! - The Mio Mio Mio Mio Mio x Ritsu Book (Doujinshi)
Ongaku no Jikan
description: Kanamu's favourite time of day is after school, when she meets to practice with her three-person band, "Chocolat no Yell." She may be inexperienced, but she's determined to do well. If only Rito, her senpai in the light music club, weren't always showing up to pick on her. With the band's first live performance coming up, will everything go off without a hitch? And what exactly is Rito's problem, anyway?

title: Marionette ja Koi dekinai!
description: The promise we made when we were young..."If you like me, will you be my friend?" We enrolled in the same high school. However, Kanata has completely changed... One day, Hina picks up the character in a VR game that Kanata dropped and immediately goes to the VR space, where she becomes Kanata's long-awaited friend. What will happen between the two of them?!

title: Otonari no Senpai wa, Zurui Kurai ni Aishitagari.
description: When she starts high school, she begins to live on her own, but gets lost on campus and is almost late for the entrance ceremony. She is saved by a handsome senior who was sleeping in the garden, but she makes a promise to do whatever he says... Moreover, the senior student is Haruse Akio, the most popular boy in school, and to her surprise he is the neighbour of Kiruwa's room! For some reason, she is taken in by the careless and indifferent Akio, but she is thrilled to be pampered by him both at home and at school...?

title: Love SOS
description:
The main character is Dan-bi, the daughter of a Yakuza boss. One night, the father she loves more than anything is killed before her eyes. The killers blind her, making her father's death the last thing she sees with her own eyes. Her mother sends the wounded Dan-bi to Korea, where she has an eye transplant. From then on, Dan- bi is to be a good girl, live with her aunt, and stay out of trouble.  
  
Dan-bi does her best, maneuvering between her aunt’s boy-crazy daughter and son, the Jjang. Things get complicated when her aunt's adopted son turns out to be connected to the mysterious boy who looked in on Dan-bi when she was in the hospital. This boy always looks so sad, and once he even asked for permission to kiss Dan-bi's eyes…

title: My school desk - The demon!
description: Setoshi Ishihara is an ambitious first-year high school student. His eyes are burning, he is making huge plans for the future! But, it seems that his goals and dreams will not come true, because he has a new acquaintance, or better to say, a new demon!

title: Love Like Crazy
description: Han Se In finds street fighter Moon Ji Soo on the street. When she tries to help him, he tells her to go away. Se In wants an apology but Ji Soo won't give one. She then slaps him and runs. Moon Ji Soo wants revenge…

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica - Cardinal Crimson
description:
In a place called Polyphonica, humans and spirits live side by side. Young musicians create magical sounds with their music, which bind the spirits to them.  
  
A struggling student named Phoron accidentally summons a spirit he met in childhood but later forgot about. Phoron could use all the help he can get, but this feisty spirit may prove to be more than he can handle!

title: SSSS.Gridman Doujinshi - Utsumi x Hassu
description: Short heart-warming stories about SSSS Gridman characters.

title: Yui-chan's Love Knot
description: Yuzuki, a high school girl is in love with Koutarou—a cram school teacher who has moved in next door. Yuzuki struggles to figure out how to approach Koutarou but her younger sister, Yui, also seems to have noticed her sister's love for him...? Leave it to Yui! The cupid of love is the 5-year-old sister! A heartwarming sisters' love comedy begins!

title: Meguriau yo Baby
description: Yoshizawa Kuuya, a high-schooler, grew up in a single-parent family. Because his mother was an unpopular actress, he had to work part-time as a pizza delivery boy. While making his deliveries one day, he accidentally met a gay couple arguing and one of them was his sensei, Kakei Yuuichi. After that, they started to get closer. Was it a coincidence or destiny?

title: Maybe Friday
description:
On a rainy Friday, Yayoi makes an effort to go to the store to get a new pair of glasses. With her poor eye sight she ends up bumping into a guy who is soaking wet and this guy ends up helping her get to the store. He runs off quickly and Yayoi is unable to thank him. From that day onwards she labels him as Mr. Friday and has him constantly on her mind. Now her life is filled with wonder and questions as she fumbles to try and find the truth about who Mr. Friday might really be. Can it really be someone from her school?  
  
Also includes a short story, P.M. Dream, about a teenage girl who is considered to be very much like a cool guy. She is the daughter of the owner of a boarding house, in which the bearded Kuma-san boards.

title: Oneesan to Joshikousei
description:
"Please don't tell anyone about me!"
Akira Takanashi, a dry girl, has discovered a secret.
The cool and beautiful prince of the school, Yoichi Oribe, is a "onee" (onee).

He is good at making sweets, is always on high spirits, and loves girls...?
This is a love comedy between a tsundere onee boy and a fast-paced girl!

title: Shirobara-sama no Iu toori.
description: Super commoner Ayame just entered Shirohara Academy, an elite school. Suddenly, she's pushed around by the super sadistic student council president…!?

title: Nanaka 6/17
description: Seventeen-year-old Nanaka Kirisato is a high school student serious about her studies and goals in life. She frequently criticizes her best friend, Nenji Nagihara, for being a childish delinquent who spends his time fighting other boys. Then one day, after a heated argument with Nenji, she falls off a flight of stairs and suffers a brain injury, resulting in her mind reverting to that of a six-year-old. With this in mind, Nanaka's father and Nenji must keep her injury a secret as she struggles to live a normal life and grow up all over again.

title: Orange Planet
description: Orange Planet is about a girl named Rui, a high school student in love. One day, while delivering a love letter, Rui finds herself caught in a fire! Eisuke, the owner of the apartment that caught fire, says that since he saved Rui from the fire, that he should live in her home! This will be a problem for Rui, because her childhood friend, Tarou, lives next door and often comes into Rui's house unexpexctedly. Will Rui be able to put up with Eisuke living in her home without being caught?

title: Hachi x Ritsu
description:
Hachi & Ritsu were childhood friends who grew up in the countryside doing everything together despite their vastly different backgrounds. Hachi begins viewing Ritsu in a different light and, plagued by thoughts he deems impure, runs away from his beloved Ritsu.

Can Ritsu confront his friend and learn the real reason why he ran away all those years ago?

title: Hime-chan no Ribbon Colorful
description:
Tomboyish Himeko loves sports and playing with the boys, but longs to be a feminine, gentle girl like her name implies. When it looks like all is lost, suddenly a familiar face gives her a magical hair ribbon that grants Himeko the ability to appear like anyone in the human world in return for being a magical observation subject.  
  
This is a remake of the classic shoujo manga and anime of the early 90's by Mizusawa Megumi.

title: World! Bring It on!
description: Hyo Yi is a poor girl with a scholarship to one of the most exclusive private schools, attended only by kids from the richest families. Strong and resilient, Hyo Yi fights to protect her mentally handicapped brother whose illness makes him a target for bullies and beatings. Then she meets Min Ha, who unexpectedly winds up making an agreement to protect the siblings. Bound together by their unusual arrangement, Hyo Yi and Min Ha gradually learn what it means to love, one step at a time….

title: Eikaiwa School Wars
description: Arisugawa Kiku (aka Arisu) is a Japanese high-school girl who gets really nervous around foreigners. Arisu's father is getting transferred to New York for his job, so her mother pressures her to sign up for conversational English lessons. Arisu reluctantly goes to class only to discover that she's already met Ish, one of her new instructors! The two had fought over the last can of mackerel at the 100 yen shop the day before. Despite being a rude and sarcastic guy, Ish is actually very popular… Why is it that guys with glasses are just so SEXY?!

title: Really?!
description: MiRyu has a gorgeous mother who's quite childish for a woman. But asides from being just gorgeous, MiRyu's mother is also getting remarried to a rich man. Worst case scenario for MiRyu herself is that this isn't the first time that this has happened: her mother married multiple times in the past to pay off a debt. Now because of her mother's new husband, not only is the debt that MiRyu's mother had is paid off, but MiRyu also now gains a stepfather who has a daughter and a pair of extremely handsome twin sons. And MiRyu thinks that she just may be falling in love with either one or both of the twins. One just happens to be sweeter than the other, and the not-so-sweet one is always so stubborn. Her stepsister also happens to be her class's Vice President. Just when MiRyu thinks that her life can't get any worse, it always seems as though she's proven wrong. Really?!

title: Cheese! Best Selection
description:
Collection of oneshots:  
  
1) Real Kiss by MIYASAKA Kaho  
School Festival is coming. Haruna, who is dating Fujikawa, have mixed feelings after the day she fails to have sex with him.To all her frustration, she ask her sempai to help her out…  
  
2) Mikansei no Futari by WATANABE Shiho  
  
3) Hana, hiraku. by YUMACHI Shin  
Ichika is called a brutality for a girl by her friend Tashiro. That's why she decides to take revenge by taking classes to learn flower arrangement to be more lady-like. A meeting with the son of her mother's friend changed and opened something she didn't expect….  
  
4) Boku no Kanojo ha Erokawa desu. by TSUZUKI Moe  
  
5) Koisuru Honnou by MOMOTA Sayo  
  
6) Yokujō Otome by MOTO Haruka

title: Oshi ni Kawareteimasu
description: Natsukawa Runa, a college student, is shocked by the disbandment of a popular idol group which she loves. One day, while caring for a drunken guy at a college drinking party, she discovers he is Subaru, her bias, who has gone MIA after the announcement. When Subaru realizes that he has been exposed, he threatens her by taking her picture, saying: "Should I expose you so you can't go against me?” What’ll happen to Runa now that she finds out the true nature of her bias?!

title: Don't Believe Her
description:
Hae Na a young pretty famous model who made it to the top within a short period of time. There’s more to this girl that seems pretty mysterious. Her whereabouts are unknown. Except nobody knows her secret, behind those thick glasses Kang Hae Na, a seventeen year old orphan girl is really Hae Na. With her determination to have a peaceful school life, she was allowed to go to school if she can hide her true identity.  
  
Find out if she can hide her identity behind those glasses or will her efforts be futile?

title: Haikyu!! - Do You Know Anything About TPO, Kageyama-kun?! (Doujinshi)
description: Kageyama has an annoying habit of kissing Hinata where all and sundry can see, and Hinata needs him to learn a thing about appropriateness regarding TPO–time, place, and occasion.

title: Here is Greenwood
description: It seems like 15-year-old Kazuya Hasukawa's life can't get much worse. Not only did his older brother marry Kazuya's first love, he brought his bride home to live with the family! Leaving his own home, Kazuya enters an exclusive all-male boarding school, Ryokuto Academy. Unfortunately, a prestigious education is little compensation for getting stuck with the cross-dressing roommate from Hell…

title: Kiss x Miss
description: Yuuka has always had the hots for her classmate, Suzuki-kun, and tried to kiss him to show how she feels about him. However, when the chance came, she kissed the arrogant Makita-kun instead! She has always hated Makita, and they quarrel a lot. What will happen now that Makita thinks she liked him?!

title: A Talking Timetable
description: Oshaberi na Jikanwari is based on Mizusawa Megumi-sensei's own love story. It is the story of how she had a crush on a boy since primary school and the events that took place while she goes from primary school through junior high to senior high.

title: Shouten
description:
A 6-book dojinshi mook series by CLAMP. Each book consists of manga and text Short stories.

List of stories:
Shoten  1:
1. となりのいんど人 (Apapa Mokona, 17p)
2. 302号室の変人 (Mick Nekoi, 4p)

10. PASSENGER! (Soshi Hisagi, 8p)
