1. 妹之山家の一族 NG (CLAMP 42 Nen Gumi, 2p)
1. SECRECY (CLAMP 42 Nen Gumi, 6p)

Sho

title: Fujiko Fujio's Shonen SF Short Story Collection
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Enjoy the real thrill of the mysterious universe to the fullest!　

All of the works depicting the SF world with exquisite development are well worth reading. Includes works published in magazines such as "Manga Shonen," "Kodomo no Hikari," "Starlog," "Shogakusei Shonen," "Shogakusei Gosei," "Bessatsu Korokoro Comic," and "Shoujo Comic. In particular, "Extinction Island" (first published in "Starlog" silent issue) is included in both editions so that readers can compare them with the final edition with dialogue, which was revised when it was collected into tankobon. 

We hope you will enjoy reading and comparing the two works.

Vol 1:  
||  
1. Solitary Space War: A boy is picked as Earth's champion to fight in a proxy war, with the fate of his planet at stake.  
2. Commerce Monkey  
3. The Good-Natured Ghost  
4. Future Thief: Dissatisfied with his current life, a boy agree to exchange his youth for a large fortune.  
5. Miraculous Belief: Lost in his own world, a b

title: Uirabu. - Uiuishii Love no Ohanashi
description: I'm not very good with love. it's a trendy stuff but i don't really get it. i don't even believe in it! but is it okay for me to fall in love as i'm like this….?

title: Oh! my Prince
description: Siffle Brown is an exchange student who suddenly appeared in front of Hina. He seems very arrogant and forceful, but he's also very handsome and (probably) kind. And he turns out to be a real prince?!

title: Girl Versus Girl!
description:
An all-girls school infiltration love comedy.  
  
Yōta took the place of his sister and dressed as a girl to enter an all-girls high school. What will happen to him? [ANN]

title: Shinai Mijikashi Koiseyo Otome
description: Sakura Toyama, a girl who uses short swordsmanship and is nicknamed "Prancing Horse," decides to live under the same roof and undergo special training with Ryunosuke Sakaki, the successor of her enemy, the invisible magic sword "Kumyo"...This is it! Gachinko!? Authentic beautiful girl swordsmanship manga!

title: Iroha ni Ai wo
description: The person who discovered all the sides to the modest and sharp-tongued Iroha is actually a crybaby!

title: Ore no Yome wo Shoukai shimasu
description:
1 ) Ore no Yome wo Shoukai shimasu  
2 ) Ore no Yome ni Narimasen ka?  
3 ) Stalker, Hajimemashita.  
4 ) Kimi no Tonari ni Iru no wa Itsumo Watashi de  
5 ) 366-maime no Love Letter  
6 ) Zettai, Kimi to Kekkon Sengen

title: 8-banme no Tsumi
description:
Souko and Yuki are childhood friends. Despite their youth, the love between them develops into a serious relationship. But the terrible secret Souko hides prompts her into later abandoning Yuki.  
  
Now living in a new town, Souko meets Hiroto whose friendship and gentleness coax Souko into once more reaching for happiness.  
  
Past wounds, the promise of future love, overwhelming passion and two men vying for the same woman. What will become of them?

title: Dear Waltz
description: After her mother's death, high schooler Mi-Hyang packs up her belongings and enters the household of her mother's formal manager. Even though she was a daughter of a rich man, with her father and other family members still alive and well, she apparently has good reasons for doing this… So the life of smiling 24/7 Mi-Hyang and the two good-looking sons of her mother's formal manager – with their own set of unique personalities – begins!!

title: Sekai wa, Kimi no Toumei
description:
During the spring of his senior year in high school, Keito tours a nearby college campus and has his heart stolen by the acting performance of Yukichika when his film club's shooting a scene in the middle of falling cherry tree petals...

Yukichika was in the middle of acting out the scene, but since Keito walked right into it, they stopped filming and started searching for a different location.
When Keito asks who he is, he says, "I'm just a creator."

It turns out this chance encounter is what changes Keito's destiny and begins a "love story" in the "world" he lives in...

title: 18-Sai no Himitsu
description: 18 year old Sako is tired of her loveless high school life. Her only comfort is her sensei whom she frequently visits for love advice. Now that her graduation is coming up, will she be able to seize the love that she has always wanted?

title: Karekano, Hajimemashita.
description: Hanamori has had a crush on Ryoutarou for ages and is over the moon when he asks her to be his girlfriend. It's the first few days of a first love…

title: Mukai-kun wa Sugoi!
description: High school student Yuki Mukai is gay and out of the closet. His classmate Makoto Moriya can't stop thinking about him. Why? Because the two of them are "the same". A series depicting the lives of authentic youths in modern-day Japan.

title: Kimi wa Kawaii Hito
description: Migita, a handsome and popular student always uses the word 'cute' to describe everything. He thinks that the word 'cute' is simply that - a word. Sanai confronts him about this and their journey starts from there.

title: Gom gateun Yeou Neukdae reul Mannada
description: Misunderstood in the dark, Na Na "saved" a girl from a "pervert." Now he has his eyes on her. He brought her many troubles continuously at school because he is a "hot boy" many likes. Now, Na Na is determined to get revenge, but maybe she met her match…

title: Yankee JK Kuzuhana-chan
description: やんちゃなギャルだらけの高校に入った早乙女君は、クールなヤンキー系女子•九頭華子ちゃんと出会って…!?（週刊少年チャンピオン2019年48号）

title: Jigoku Sensei Nuubee S
description:
Meisuke Nueno, also known as “Nuubee”, is an elementary school teacher at Doumori Elementary, where youkai, spirits, and bizarre phenomena frequently occur. He's usually clumsy, poor, and unpopular, but once his beloved students are in trouble, he'll fight for his life with his invincible weapon, the Demon's Hand! See you, the strongest psychic teacher!
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/nube_off)

title: Kare to Kanojo ga Uso o Tsuku Hi
description: Yui secretely admires the smart Shinohara-kun and puts all her effort into studying to be a good match for him. Then one day she overhears him talking to his friends saying that he would only want a girlfriend who is more stupid than himself. Arima-kun sees her crying and helps her and feelings arise. but when Yui's mother finds out, she tells Yui that she must stay away from Arima-kun.

title: Attack No.1
description:
The story is about Kozue Ayuhara, the new girl who transferred to Fujimi College, who tried out for the school volleyball team. Her friendship with Midori would develop, and her talents would impress coach Honga more and more each day. Though she showcased extraordinary volleyball skills, she would make enemies with Yoshimura, the star of the current team. Kozue would discover that being at the top would bring stress, incompatibilities and other dilemmas into her life. Her high expectations of becoming the best volleyball player in the school, Japan and eventually the world, would set the tone for the drama to follow.  
  
AnimeNewsNetwork Links:  
[Anime](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=1186)  
[Live-action TV Drama](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6305)

title: Keppeki Shounen Kanzen Soubi
description:
Because of a frightening experience three years ago, schoolboy Sata Senda has become a compulsive cleanliness freak. As he carries anti-bacterial spray and a mask as standard equipment, and doesn’t allow any form of close contact, he has no friends.  
  
Now, in the summer of sixth grade, Sata has been forced to participate in the school trip. And so, he arrives at the departure point… completely covered in a protective suit?!

title: Mayonaka ni Kiss
description:
Natori Nono is a very tough schoolgirl. She lives with her widowed mother Ayame and her younger brother Takumi in a very small apartment, where she does all the chores. Her boyfriend wants money from her, because he's really poor, too. But one day, Nono discovers that her mother remarried! She married Ichijou Hayato, the owner of the 'Ichijou Group'. Now, Nono lives there (in unaccustomed riches) with her mother, her brother, her stepfather AND her new stepbrother: Ichijou Kasuomi (his father calls him Omi-kun)!!! At first, Nono thinks Kasuomi is not nice. But what will happen next?  
  
Included in this manga are two short stories called Sayonara Marigold and 130 cm Kara Merry Christmas.

title: AntiSTALKER
description:
At this school usual students study with vampires from wealthy families. She is a representative from disciplinary committee, he is a guy who breaks school rules. She is a hunter, he is a target. He is her stalker, she is his target.

---
Previously available under [WebToon Canvas](https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/antistalker/list?title_no=293641).

title: TakiRāna
description: Collection of posts centred on Taki x Raana from BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!

title: Let's Be Perverts
description: Perverto is just a regular 17-year-old…with the unavoidable nickname, "pervert." Unlike his namesake, he's actually quite naïve when it comes to sexual matters; his first and only youthful romance having ended terribly. To escape his bad reputation, he transfers to a new school for a fresh start. But on his first day there, he's falsely accused of groping a girl named Hongdan on the subway. To make matters worse, she happens to be another new student who has just transferred to his new school, to his very class.

title: Mizukoshi-kun wa Futtou Shitakunai no ni
description: クールな水の亜人「水越くん」は最近できた彼女「熱海さん」の可愛さにいつもドキドキ・・・。でもドキドキすると沸騰しちゃって彼女が火傷してしまう！？彼女を守るためクールなふりを続ける水越くんは、平静を保ち続けることができるのか！？

title: Rifle Shoujo
description:
A collection of short stories including:  
- Rifle Shoujo  
- Rifle Shounen  
- Obakemura e Youkoso

title: Good Luck
description: Shi-Hyun is a girl who has nothing but bad luck - at least, that's what everyone believes. In some ways, Shi-Hyun herself believes this and tries to stay away from the people she loves the most. As a result, she has developed an outer shell, making her look tough and indifferent even with the constantly bullying. But when she transfers to a different high school, a fresh start brings unfamiliar characters - and new challenges - into her life.

title: Kare Made Love ♥ km
description: Miyuu Nanahara is just your average ordinary girl: she has school, friends, and love troubles. Especially love. She loves the most popular guy in school. Secretly, he loves her too! What's keeping these two from getting together?

title: Sweet 16
description:
Collection of oneshots  
  
- Sweet 16  
Kataoka Nanami had made a promise with her childhood friend Eiji that once she celebrates her sweet sixteen, they are to marry. However, nowadays Eiji only seems to be interested in surfing and has forgotten all about the promise. Will Nanami be able to revive her childhood promise?  
  
- Kira Kira Frozen  
Nakazato An has always loved ice skating since she was young and dreams about becoming a professional. But when it comes to being accepted into a school in America and leaving her boyfriend Ya-chan behind, how will An be able to handle this situation?  
  
- Harumachi Platform  
It's spring, which means a new school, new semester, and new challenges for high school student Riko Kurosawa, who is not looking forward to this troublesome period of time. That is, until one day, a boy hands her a "magical" train ticket, and suddenly, Riko's mornings are a lot brighter. And at the center of it all is the boy who shares her train rides…  
  
- Itosh

title: Secret Base
description:
Contains four one-shots:
  
Boyfriend's Secret  
High school year one, Kana has recently started looking for a boyfriend. She is head over heels for this mature guy whom she always thought was a 20 year old college student. However, he’s actually…!? Love + Secret = Something big to look forward to!  
  
My Own Secret  
A tough, tomboyish girl named Haruka that's often mistaken to be a boy meets a strange guy, Kotake. After helping him out, she realizes that Kotake is even more like a girl than she is!  
  
Girlfriend's Secret  
Seiji fell in love with his friend's girlfriend, Eri, without knowing she already had someone else, but it turns out that Eri-chan has a secret as well.  
  
My Secret  
Emi is the son of a very unpopular, but experienced Kansai comedian, and he doesn't quite seem like he wants to be.  
  
(Source: MU)

title: Love Story ~Aiwa~
description: A girl watches her friend get her first "boyfriend".

title: Tomadoi Choco no Yukue
description: I’ts hard to tell your real feelings especially, in front of him♥

title: Mahochu!
description: Airu is a clumsy and scatterbrained girl. She was looking forward to a flowery middle school life, but due to her being from a 'family of witches'?, she was admitted instead to Mahoraba Academy. In a strange school without any friends, the lonely Airu encounters strange people who use a special power called Maho…!? A magical school life begins!

title: Happy Tomorrow
description:
Contains four short, sweet stories by Suenobu Keiko.  
  
- Happy Tomorrow

Kunieda, who recently entered SMP High School, was immediately antagonized by her classmates and bullied by them every day. Trash was piled on her desk, and her pencil case was filled with thumbtacks. Kunieda even has to eat lunch in the girls' bathroom to avoid being harassed. Among the classmates who didn't bully or mock her, there is one guy who cares a lot about her. He helps her through the crisis, and invites her to eat at his usual table.

- Doki-Doki

The day of the last school trip Nao openly confesses to her good friend Yoshioka, who sits next to her in class. He agrees to date her, and then their story starts. What fate awaits these two on the last class trip?

- Wish on the Stars

One night, Yuki was asking the stars what kind of Christmas awaited her when a guy bumped into her, knocking her bag down. He complimented her bag's star-shaped charm and left. Months later, she joins the Christmas tree de

title: Otona no Shoumei
description:
Tsubaki always appears experienced, but actually, she has never had a boyfriend even though she's already 16, and she's a real baby. She wants to quickly increase her love experiences, and become an adult! One day, she got called out by her math teacher, Shiina-sensei, and she was told that she'll have to take supplementary lessons. All alone in the math room with her sensei after school, Tsubaki's heart beat like crazy when she saw Shiina-sensei's facial expressions that were different from usual…?  
  
2. The Imprisoned Princess  
  
3. The Prince's Mantle  
  
4. The Upside Down Message

title: Ousama no Ura Shigoto
description:
The master whom I serve is in love with me?! This love, is it okay to trust it?  
  
Miyuu is shocked to discover that the author of her very favorite shoujo manga is none other than her rich and arrogant classmate, Shiina-kun! The one who she despises the most and what make things worse she totally in love with Yuuji, the hero of her favorite shoujo manga.  
  
[PL] Miyuu była pod wielkim szokiem, kiedy dowiedziała się, że jej arogancki, bogaty kolega z klasy, Shiina-kun, jest twórcą jej ulubionej mangi! Czy Miyuu będzie dalej darzyła uczuciem jej ulubionego bohatera mang – Yuuji, czy przeniesie swoją miłość na jego twórcę? Przekonajcie się sami!

title: "Suki" to Ienai.
description: Shiina has 2 secrets. She loves her brother Kiri a lot, and Kiri doesn't know that they are not blood related. She doesn't know what to do, she's been hiding it for a long time, and no one knows she loves him. "This love is secret. Secret to anybody. However, my heart is trembling. —Hey, I've become aware of these feelings. Please don't notice.—"

title: Nanji, Chikai no Kuchizuke wo...
description: No one knows that 1st year Rena (16) and upperclassman Kyouta (18) are in fact married. This manga follows them in their lives to discover more about each other and keep the fact they are married a secret from everyone at school. They'll be tested in Jealousy, love confessions, exams, love, mother in laws, embarrassing situations, noisy neighbors and teachers.

title: H2O
description: Menga is simply known as the vice rep and is bullied. Hanako has moved to Korea but was robbed the first day and has nothing. Na Hong Soo is known as a troublemaker and is in constant trouble. And Eechan is the student body president, very popular and known as Bacchus. It seems they have nothing in common, but this will change soon.

title: Hitotsu no Shigusa mo
description:
His name is Itou Hiroyuki, nickname: Hiro-kun. He's a math teacher at the private Taihei Academy, as well as the homeroom teacher of class 3-3. He's young, cool, and tall, and yet, when he's with the male students, it's impossible to tell who are the students. He's the person I love.  
  
This is a sad and gentle story about the 15th winter of a girl who fell in love with her homeroom teacher.

title: Daniman: Everyday Life in Manga Club
description: Akashi Kento enrolls in the school of his dreams, which is said to have a "legendary manga club". The manga club he had expected was different from what he had imagined.

title: Mellow Mellow
description:
Ichika Kinohara enters high school still pining for her childhood crush. She remembers that boy Yuito as a cute innocent kid. But when Ichika found out that Yuito has returned to attend the same high school, she discovered that he's become a super handsome young man!?

A sweet love story about girl meets boy, again.

title: Nise Moteo ni Renai Shinan wa Nigaomoi
description:
"Master, please make me a man."

Yuma Hotaka has been changing schools all the time and has little connection with his friends. Not wanting to be forgotten after transferring schools, he came up with the idea of creating a strong character to live his school life.
He now plays the role of a popular guy who has girlfriends all over the place, and together with his prince-like appearance, he has succeeded in becoming a popular guy.
In reality, however, he is a pure-hearted boy who has never been in a relationship, let alone kissed anyone.
Then, a real popular guy, Tadashi Someya, transfers to Hotaka's class!
Hotaka is impatient with Someya's attention-grabbing presence, but Someya begs him to teach him a technique to make the guy he likes fall in love with him.
He asks Hotaka to teach him some techniques to make the guy he likes fall for him. The contents of the lesson are all practical exercises such as kissing and licking his chest...?

title: Fourth Bridegroom
description: Men of Japan can get pregnant thanks to technology and science! Third-year high school girl Touko Yatsurugi is part of the Yatsurugi group, which is lacking a leader, and that’s why she is looking for a husband to give birth to a child.

title: Ah! Koshien of Youth
description: Combining some of the early works of Adachi Mitsuru, these books include the two stories Hatsukoi Koshien and Nakimushi Koushien, respectively covering 2 and 4 volumes. Both are focused on baseball youth and the desire to reach Koushien, the famous stage of the high school baseball national championships. Volume 7 and the end of Volume 6 contain a selection of short stories.

title: Wasurene no Language
description: Futaba, whose father is an oceanographer, has transferred schools 8 times because of his work. Afraid of eventually being forgotten, she tries not to make any new friends at her new school.

title: Haikyu!! - Sweet Happy Sweet (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama tricks Hinata into being his boyfriend. What follows is a series of cute moments between the two once Hinata realizes their feelings are actually mutual!

title: Fetish
description:
* Fetish  
"I've been watching you from my seat at the back of the classroom. I really want to touch your hair no matter what-!"  
  
* Beautiful Days  
Reo is an average, hardworking salary-man. He shares an apartment with his boyfriend, Shinri, whose life couldn't be more different than his own. Reo is sick of Shinri's attitude. He is a lazy, demanding man who speaks of little but the filth of the world and the importance of beauty. When two men on different paths find themselves in a relationship which is more straining than nurturing, can it last?  
  
* Photograph  
The story begins where we left Reo and Shinri from Beautiful Days - each deeply absorbed by their contradictive relationship. Shinri's strong attachment to Reo is unveiled, but is it too late to save their troubled love?

title: The Boy From the West
description: Benjamin Herrmann is a cynical loner, cold and close-minded. However, that won't help him as his mother secretly signs him up for a student exchange program. Now he must spend a year in Japan, at the Tatsuya High School finishing a checklist that needs him to be the exact opposite of himself. On arrival he meets his assisting student: Mizuho Sakiyurai. She makes it their mission to finish the list by the end of the year and tries to break down the walls around her new friend from the west.

title: Manabiya Ouji
description: Lina is an honor student on a mission to be perfect, and all's going well… until the free-spirited Prince Gigi transfers into her class.

title: Second Button of March
description:
4 works that were published over span of 10 years.  
  
1. 1 Gatsu no Merry-Go-Round  
A high school girl has a crush on a boy two years younger, but she has always insisted she could never date a younger guy.  
  
2. 3 Gatsu no Dai 2 Button  
A girl realises that she likes her childhood friend whom she's always joked around with but never thought she thought of that way.  
  
3-5. Onna no Ko wa Genki!!  
About three fifth-grade girls (Chisa, Nanami, Yuula) who are best friends.  
  
6. Basket Girl!!  
About a girl who practices hard so she can be a starter for her basketball team's last match of the year.

title: Hatsu koi, Yoru ni Tokeru
description: Rin and Hiro are childhood friends. The truth about Hiro’s love that he can’t confess is…?

title: Kimi no Ai wa Mienikui
description:
1) Your Love Cannot Be Easily Visible
Inori always goes to his friend Senou with his love troubles, because Senou always listens patiently. But lately Inori has been thinking about Senou in a different way...

2) Impossible Boyfriend
Continuing story of Inori and Senou's relationship in chapter 1. Story will also continue in [Kimi to Iru Asu](https://mangadex.org/title/5686ad04-5fa2-4f55-855d-2667dd52a25f/kimi-to-iru-asu).

3) Please Don't Let Go of This Hand
Jinryou Aki just started at the clothing store where Goichi works, and Goichi can't help liking his cute new coworker. But Jinryou has a troubled past. 

4) Good Luck Sleeping
Eight years after graduation Hoshizono runs into his high school crush, Kure. In school Hoshizono was always considered a brainy kid, while Kure was a jock. Now Hoshizono works at a gay host club, and Kure is a successful businessman. Can these two reconnect?

5) Love Without Boundaries
Shouji, an established curator, and Shimizawa, an up and coming advertis

title: Ookami Shounen
description: Chisato loves strong, dangerous and cool guys. That’s why Ikehara, who hates dogs and confesses to her, is no good! But then, Ikehara tells Chisato his secret…?!

title: D.C. II ~Da Capo II - Imaginary Future~
description:
Takes place approximately 50 years after the original D.C. - Da Capo series.  
  
The story revolves around Sakurai Yoshiyuki and Otome & Yume, the two granddaughters of the original D.C. - Da Capo protagonists Junichi and Nemu.  
  
This is actually the second manga based on Da Capo II in active serialization. The other manga, running in Kadokawa’s Comptiq magazine, is considered to be the “canon” adaptation of the story (i.e. it’s based directly on the game). As the title “Imaginary Future” suggests, this manga proposes an alternate deviation from the game’s premise, where fan-favourite Nanaka Shirakawa (speculated to be a descendant of the famous Kotori Shirakawa) is the story’s main heroine.

title: Onee-chan Dorobou
description: For Yui, she has no "freedom" whatsoever. Every single day, she's always been ordered around by her childhood friend, Aya, and her little sister, Chika, and she can't help but to obey them. Though, one day, she receives a love letter from a classmate! For some reason…Aya seems very annoyed by this.

title: Sanrio Danshi - Oretachi, Koi, Hajimemashita
description:
Rio, the transfer student, will have a destined meeting with one of the Sanrio guys but..!?

(from mangaupdates)

title: The Invisible Star (Pre-Serialization)
description:
Can stars grant wishes? Tongan understandably wished to get together with her senior, but she never thought that her wish would take form in an unexpected way... Eh? Something's not quite right!

[Author weibo](https://weibo.com/u/5684626696)
[Author BCY](https://bcy.net/u/104932646926)
[Original Webcomic](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/12722)

title: Romance Revenge
description:
오해가 불러온 달콤한 복수가 시작된다!

수강신청을 폭망하고 들어선 낯선 강의실에서
유나는 베프 지수의 바람둥이 전남친과 똑 닮은 
정우와 부딪히고 예기치 못한 사고로 키스하게 된다.

그동안의 경험치(?)로 유나의 행동을 오해한
정우의 “사귀어주겠다”라는 말에 유나는
‘유혹하고 차버린다’라는 원대한 복수를 계획하는데…

title: Anata wo Mamoritakute
description: A short story about a student-teacher relationship. The teacher breaks it off and after 6 years pass, the student is now a teacher also and they find that their feelings are still the same.

title: My True Story
description: An essay manga about the mangaka's experiences growing up gay.

title: Don't Be So Harsh, Master!
description: Lin Mubai life is the most fortunate and the most unfortunate thing: accidentally peeping Song Qingxiao, that he was most likely to see the secret light. Since then, he chased her, and she fled … … he suppressed, she resisted … … he fell, she began the road against the reverse, the ultimate back pressure success! Fame, Lin bai to give their love made a summary: the most blood of the encounter, the most twists and turns of the process, the most perfect ending!

title: The Kidnapping of Minja Jo's Boyfriend
description: Two high school girls are complete enemies, and they both are in their own gangs. They fight each other all the time, and to get even with the other, one girl tries to kidnap the other's boyfriend. But the information her right-hand girl gives her is wrong, and they kidnap some really good-looking guy who is NOT the boyfriend of the other girl. You know what happens. They fall in love.

title: Prince Bubble
description:
Wi-Lan is a girl born into a poor fisherman's family. She yearns to go to a particular, high-standard private high school. She is overjoyed when she receives her acceptance letter, but her happiness quickly turns to dismay when she gets teased and pranked, and becomes the laughter of the whole school for being the poorest kid there.  
  
However, the arrival of a new transfer student, San-Yue, soon brightens her days. He's so handsome that, along with all the other girls, Wi-Lan can't help but fall for him. But then, when she gathers up her courage and confesses to him, he runs off without saying anything…?! Apparently, he and his family are hiding a dark secret…

title: Motenai Riyuu ga Oosugiru!!!!!
description: Hina is able to become friends with anyone. Girls are jealous of her because she's always with guys. However, she's forever in the friend zone. Will her luck change? Will she be able to be someone's girlfriend?

title: Ginjiro the Tough Kid
description: Ginjiro Yamazaki, a third year student at Tencha Junior High School, is a hard man who hates women! Carrying the baby Mamoru on his back, he spends all his time fighting today. Then a beautiful woman with an outstanding figure, Takako Ozawa, transfers to his school...

title: Maya - Midnight Girl
description: A young, beautiful girl attempts to escape a nightmarish existence: Every time she sleeps she sees a new murder. She MUST solve these murders so she doesn't have to experience the agony all over again in miserable desperation.

title: Anta wo Zutto Karakaitai
description:
During the men's volleyball club match, Kano's attention is drawn to the good-looking ace attacker of the club, Yosho-senpai. Kano is attracted to Yosho, but he is a mean senpai who is famous for his headstrong personality! 

The start of a romantic comedy of a nasty senior x junior girl who is good at teasing!

title: Blossom With Love
description: Nous sommes tous passés par là, ou devons y faire face, de quelle couleur sont vos souvenirs d'adolescence ?

title: Kataomoi Couple
description: I'm finally dating my beloved Aso-kun. But he keeps teasing me! Is our relationship the same as before?

title: Renai Library
description:
From Divine Sanctuary:  
Minami is a shy girl who is respected by her friends. When she meets a good looking guy at her school, she falls for him at first sight. Does she have a chance to become his girlfriend? Or is there maybe another problem which makes everything problematic?

title: Nadeshiko Club
description:
Reo-chan, a first year girl, gets dumped by her boyfriend because she's not skilled in the home economic traits he believes women should have. Her ex tells her that she must apply to a "housework" club before he will reconsider going out with her. Therefore Reo-chan has little choice but to join.  
  
Here's the catch: the only members are four gorgeous bishies. The other first year in the club, Irinaka, competes with her a lot. As the story progresses Reo and Irinaka get forced into a lot of interesting situations together and in the meantime become closer and closer.

title: Chocolate BF
description: Ichinose Fujiko. 15 years old. Lives in a flat. Bath house poster girl. "Love" is not a word in her dictionary; not since her first love when she was 6. But this guy who helped her younger brother in a traffic accident is making her curious. Could this be…?!

title: Galactic Romance
description: The story of a boy who dreams to be the last scholar of the 21st century.

title: Pure Mission
description:
My first boyfriend is super hi-spec but…?  
  
(Source: Café Scanlation)

title: You Are A Shining Star
description: The boy who had labeled himself as a "bad student" is actually at the top of his grade? A hardworking girl vs. a fake school bully. You and I are like shining stars in this universe, each with our own unique, romantic colors.

title: This Love Is a Bit Difficult
Beautiful Days
description:
1) Beautiful Days  
Asahi was taken under the care of Natsume when he was nine after his mother left him. Natsume has a penchant for taking in abandoned pets, and bringing lovers home as well. Asahi finds his feelings for Natsume growing by day, but his love appears to linger on a one-way street, unanswered.   
  
2) Beautiful Sunday  
  
3-4) Beautiful Life  
  
5) Another Life  
  
6) Kyou Anata ni Wakare wo Tsugemasu  
In this tale of broken hearts and deception, three young men are caught in the protagonist's web of revenge. Will the unknowing victims be consumed or is it the weaver of the web who will face the final retribution?  
  
7) Ashita Kimi ni Ai wo Sasayaku  
Years after a personal tragedy struck his life, Mei struggles to deal with its implications as an innocent bystander is sucked into his tangled web. Told from Mei's point of view, this story falls some time before the conclusion of its prequel, Kyou Anata ni Wakare wo Tsugemasu.  
  
8) Yesterday We Will Embrace Our

title: 2024 Rookie Short Story Collection
description: A selection of Hell Camp short stories produced directly by legendary writers Lee Hyun-se and Lee Du-ho! Introducing the strongest rookies of 2024!

title: Osananajimi ga Yatara Guigui Kimasu
description: A story about girl named Mana-chan and her adventures with her childhood friend, Shou-kun.

title: Puri*Puri
description: He's giving headaches to the serious student council president. But they are strangely in tune with each other…!?

title: Hinata no Koishita Kageyama-kun
description:
Kageyama is a high school model who hates people and is most afraid of getting a sunburn. One day, his older sister came home drunk and was taken care of by a girl named Haruhi Hidaka, a mood-maker in the same class. I thought I was in a different dimension from her and would never get involved with her. But after that day, Hidaka and Kageyama quickly grow closer... 

A sweet and sour coming-of-age love story of two opposites begins.

title: Danshi Kinshitsu!!
description: For all of Mao's life, she has longed to be girly and have tea parties with beautiful girlfriends. And finally, she has that dream right in her reach, until she walks in on three boys changing at her private all girls school… What's a girl to do when another girl she admired turns out to be a guy?!

title: Immature EARTHling Friend
description: A boy from an alien planet learns that he is not of that planet. He moves to Earth because of an “immigration project” and now must learn to live among the humans in the scariest place on Earth, Seoul Korea.

title: Retribution
description:
What is the reason of Nemesis' doing...?

YandereDev always wanted a short Manga, an artist named "Vandelover" contacted him and made that dream come true. This is the result.

As of the 19th of May, **Retribution** received a second chapter with another artist, named "J. Namthorn".

Chapter 1 Art: Vandelover
Chapter 2 Art: J. Namthorn

title: R-Chuugakusei
description: R-Chuugakusei talks about three teenager's daily and sexual life.

title: Boku no Hero Academia - KamiJirou Only (Doujinshi)
description: Short comic about Kaminari and Jirou fluff stuff

title: Shounen Chuudoku
description:
1) Boy’s Lips  
Narina accidentally kissed a sleeping boy in their school clinic and now she can't get him out of her mind. She later learns that his name is Yasuda and sees him roughed up. When they meet again, Narina is startled by Yasuda's kindness. But before she can figure out her feelings for him, Narina sees her teacher, Sugiyama, warning Yasuda off her. How will she be able to handle the situation, especially now that she knows that her teacher has special feelings for her?  
  
2) Boy Poisoning  
Harada Sayaka bought a potion from the neighboring boys school's chemistry club, which they no long make. Unfortunately for her she has become addicted to it. Leaving her to chase after one of the members, Fujikawa Shuujei, to get him to produce the main ingredient… his tears. Which, obviously, he is not too keen on doing.  
  
3) Electrocuting September  
Kayama is the last of the class to experience Koba's exciting talent, and the class is taking bets to see how long she can resist

title: Uwasa no Kanojo to Sono Kareshi
description: An indecent photo goes viral and Ai finds herself to be the centre of a weird rumour in school. Will the guy she likes trust her?

title: Haikyuu!! - Kagehi Biyori (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata  
  
Kageyama Tobio/Hinata Shouyou anthology.

title: How to Get a Guy: Sorted by Blood Type
description:
A collection of oneshots on how to get a guy with a certain blood type! ♥  
  
1) Blood Type A  
Sawaruna Kiken! by Kayoru  
Megumi-kun is a hygiene freak, but it doesn’t stop Naho from admiring him. She even volunteered herself to help Megumi-kun overcome his flaw since he has to meet his future fiancee within two weeks time. Will everything be okay for the two of them?!  
  
2) Blood Type AB  
Kare no Iinari by MAMURA Mio  
Rika is known to be a cheerful girl, but is that her real self?  
  
3) Blood Type O  
XXX - My Little Honey by YAGAMI Rina  
  
4) Blood Type B  
Life+B by ICHIKAWA Shou  
Sonoda Mio has always been such a tomboy at school but when at home, she works in her family's flower shop. Her family's VERY GIRLY flower shop. Mio doesn't want anyone at school to see her all girly, so when someone walks in, wearing the school uniform, she goes and hunts him down the next day. But when she tells him not to tell anyone, he….!!?!  
  
5) Special Story  
Mitsu Aji Blood by MITSU

title: Nanako SOS
description: An alien girl crashes on Earth and loses her memory, but her special powers still work. What will happen to her? Nana encounters a variety of dangerous missions and mysterious events, but her natural sunny disposition helps her through all the incidents as she solves each mystery, one after the other.

title: Kare wa, Ano Ko no Mono
description:
A collection of short stories.  
  
1. Kare wa, Ano Ko no Mono  
Sanae is volunteering at the hospital. While there she becomes close friends with Mika and throws her a leaving hospital celebration party…  
And because of that Mika gets a boyfriend! That person is Takuya who is in the Soccer Club. Sanae has been in love with him.  
Seeing how happy Mika is, Sanae tries to destroy their relationship but!?  
  
2. Sawaruna Kiken!  
Megumi-kun is a hygiene freak, but it doesn’t stop Naho from admiring him. She even volunteered herself to help Megumi-kun overcome his flaw since he has to meet his future fiancee within two weeks time. Will everything be okay for the two of them?!   
  
3. I'll Give You a Reward  
  
4. Summer Love Fireworks  
  
5. A Lady's Love Trouble

title: Ousama to Fushigi no Shiro
description: A desperate and clumsy girl enters a famous high school in order to be close to her "Prince." But while Hiroto may be a prince, he is also egotistical and arrogant! Even so, Mitsu is still in love with him. Will Mitsu will be able to capture the heart of the boy who thinks she’s just a “parasite”?

title: Mou Speed de Karera wa
description: Friendship blossoming to love between a high school girl who tries extra hard to make up for her lack of height and a middle school boy who just looks too tall to be his real age.

title: Tokyo Casanova
description:
Tamiko lives with her two brothers, her mother and her grandmother. It's your typical family, or so she naively thought. 
Yet one day she finds out Akira, her older brother, is not her brother at all but the illegitimate child of the famous actress Hanyuu Kaori. 
To make things even more confusing, Akira's feelings towards her aren't exactly of the sibling kind and because of his persistence 
she starts feeling love for him as well. The plot becomes even more complicated when Tamiko's classmate Yukari falls for Akira. 
Yukari though has a connection with Akira that shocks everyone, including herself…

title: Gaba Kawa
description: Rara, a girl from the demon world, came to earth with only one goal in mind: To wreak havoc, as much as possible. Sounds easy, doesn’t it? It doesn’t sound as easy as it seems when Rara starts to develop feeling for a certain someone that she shouldn’t have.

title: Attack!!
description: Harutaka Kato, 1st grade students in Kakegawa high school with the extraordinary ability to jump. After look at his ability, Maiko the volleyball club manager's kept urging him to join as. Finally, Harutaka persuaded to enter the club. However, volleyball club had another star, Yuta Kaneko! Harutaka upset and trying to show off. But, all of his smash managed to block by Yuta!! So, what will Harutaka do!?

title: Arcana 15 - School / Uniform
description:
Volume 15 : School Uniform  
  
  
1. Boku no Gakkou wa (My School Is) by Fujimura Ayumi  
  
2. +1 by Aoto Takane  
  
3. Bukiyou na Sahou (Clumsy Manners) by D. Kissan

title: 100 Ways of an Exorcist
description:
Soon after transferring to a new school, Mayu Kodabutsu recieves a love letter from a cute girl named Yuuko Hai… Expecting the envy of his classmates, Mayu is surprised to recieve condolences instead. You see, Yuuko Hai is no ordinary 5th grader… She's an exorcist. And Mayu is destined to experience her 100 terrifying ways.


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **100 Kutukan Yukochan** (2006)

title: Hoshi ni Negattari Nanka Shinai
description: The cool and pushy astronomy club member, Takayanagi, always begs the hardworking student council officer, Kamijou, to "give them more funds for the cultural festival", but always receives the answer: "absolutely impossible!" Like cats and dogs, Takayanagi goes to pick a fight with him every day because the adorable sight of Kamijou turning red with anger makes his heart race… A cultural festival romance featuring the pushy astronomy club member vs. the tsundere student council officer!

title: Breakfast Club
description:
Yaoi series of stories about life in a boy's dorm at a high school. The main couple in the first volume is Masamoto and Izuka, who are roommates. Masamoto saves Izuka from prostitution. There is also Hiroki who is sleeping with his teacher, the dorm manager.  
  
Vol. 1 Breakfast Club  
Vol. 2 Room Mate  
Vol. 3 Bed Time  
Vol. 4 Pillow Talk  
Vol. 5 Door to Door

title: Beauty!!
description: Makoto, a first year high school student, was forced into joining the Beauty Research Club by upperclassman Bidou Yoh. The only problem is that she always feels like throwing up when faced with beautiful men! Yoh's younger brother Mucchi and Makoto start to have feelings for each other and it grows into something more, but then they find out that Yoh is Makoto's half-sibling and now the young couple must overcome different life hurdles.

title: Metropolitan Magic Academy
description:
Hoshino's first long serialization.  
  
Comical romance between a student of magic school and his familiar spirit.

title: Princess's Cradle
description: After her father passes away, outspoken Chizu is dragged from her home in Las Vegas to live with family in Japan. Will she adjust?

title: Kokyuu no Aida ni Koi ni Naru
description: How is Naoya supposed to respond when his friend, Kei, nonchalantly propositions them to be more than just friends?

title: Schoolboy vs The World
description:
A girl at my new school asked me out. She's the school's strongest, Yi-Na Kim. Is this an elaborate scheme to punish me?

"Can the next challenger wait until tomorrow?"

Only the strongest girl can take me! Wait, do I not have a say in this?

title: To Attract a Junior
description: Jung Jae Ih, 19 years old, is the Jiang of Sao Sung High. She is strange and very interesting, and of course her love life is not a boring one either…

title: Maboroshi Mata ne
description:
"I have to stop this. I can't let my friend be killed...!"

Meiko Yashiro is in her second year of junior high. She's barely spoken to her childhood friend Hozumi Togawa ever since a certain incident drove them apart. However, one day Meiko has a supernatural encounter that could change everything... "I can't let his life end at 14 years."

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Ibitsu na Hoshi no Katachi
description:
A collection of 3 one-shots by author Shiina Karuho.  
  
- **Ibitsu na Hoshi no Katachi:**  
Makoto and Aya are opposites but best friends. Makoto is mature and has had many relationships. Aya is naive and has never liked a boy. Yet, nothing has ever come between them until Makoto discovers Aya's secret…  
  
- **Mou Iikai.:**  
Kanna is a tomboy who is used to being treated as "just a friend" by other guys, but being used to it doesn't mean that she likes it. Do things finally change when she meets Motonari-kun or is he just like the rest?  
  
- **Seishun Rhapsody:**  
Kusano Hiro always seems to have the worst luck. She gets blamed for things she didn't do and is constantly in trouble over misunderstandings. Usami, her classmate, is the exact opposite, so no wonder they don't get along…

title: VS"
description: Van, Yai e Yht son tres tontos cuya amistad pende de un hilo: Van les juega una broma pretendiendo arrebatarles la oportunidad de estar con las chicas que les gustan. Yai e Yht harán de todo para impedir que Van juegue con los sentimientos de sus amadas, están dispuestos incluso a jugar con magia.

title: My Secret Buddy
description: Black’s father’s refusal to accept Black and Molly’s relationship is causing a rift within the gang! Black is determined to be with Molly forever and even threatens to leave Black Storm. Horrified at the thought of losing Black, Francis and Mic do all they can to keep their friendship intact. A touching yet funny story of friendship and loyalty!

title: Okujou ni Saku Hana - Mizu Asa to Tan Henshuu
description:
1. Okujou ni Saku Hana
2. Sasareta Hito
3. Sotsugyou Moratorium
4. Futari dake no Kyoushitsu
5. Saigo no Hanabi ga Owattara
6. Denki-gai no Honya-san Bangai-hen: Unimate no Ouji-sama

title: Jujutsu Kaisen - Baby Ore Wo Shikatte Kure! (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Gojo Satoru x Itadori Yuuji

Higschool AU.
With no humanity in sight, it's Gojo's personal war... In order to get Yuuji's scolding!

title: Sora ni Haeru
description: One day Mitsuya Aiji sees the door to the rooftop is unusually open. As a painter, he's attracted to the blue color of the sky. A person showed up all of a sudden and falls on Mitsuya. Who is this girl? Why does she have rumors circulating around her? See how Mitsuya and her get closer in this short romantic oneshot.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion - GirlHood + (Doujinshi)
description: Asuka's quest for maturity, but with a major obstacle from her insecurity due to lack of experience.

title: Muneatsu
description: 舞台は山口県岩国市。弱小柔道部キャプテン・正宗淳は柔道ライフを満喫中。そんな彼は同級生、藍川小春に密かに思いを寄せていたが、ある日東京から転校して来たイケメン・秀才・運動神経抜群のパーフェクト男、桐島篤が小春と急接近してしまう。「もう俺には柔道しかない！」と意気込む正宗の元へ、桐島が柔道部に入部したい、と小春を連れてやってきて……！？ 不器用で暑苦しい男が走り、もがき、立ち上がる！ 涙と汗、友情と恋、挫折と再起、情熱と達成がすべて１冊に凝縮された青春柔道狂詩曲。ぶち燃える。

title: Horror Newspaper
description:
(from MangaUpdates): 
There exists a horrific newspaper called the Horror Newspaper that foretells of people’s extreme misfortunes.

title: OATH
description: Akira Yamazaki is a young heir of the oldest arms suppliers family. He is looking for a fiancee in his new school. His future wife has to be strong and confident. Mizushima Rina looks like absolutely opposite person, but Akira chooses her for some reason…

title: Yuri Iro no Koibito
description: A useless guy is hopelessly in love with his friend… so he attempts to change himself.

title: Love Live! - Shashin ni mo Torenai Hodo no Chikasa de (Doujinshi)
description:
Maki is assigned to take pictures of μ's activities. When she checks the photos, she realizes that she has only taken pictures of Rin.

She secretly cuts out a picture of herself and Rin from a live performance and crafts it into a fake wedding photo.

Unfortunately for Maki, Rin discovers it.

Rin suggests that they have another photo session with only the first-years. Maki and Rin arrive to the clubroom before Hanayo, and tension begins to build between the two...!

A cute doujinshi where Maki becomes aware of her feelings towards Rin!

title: Kyuuketsuki wa Kamitsuku Dake ja Aishitarinai ~Kiss yori Amai Dekiai Keiyaku~
description: When she is asked to do something by Ondeki, Mashiro forgives anything. She is scolded by her teacher for being anaemic all the time, and she feels sorry for herself, but she thinks that it would be nice if she were special to Ondeki...?

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - METEOROID (Doujinshi)
description:
A Compilation of 2 Stories depicting different aspects of Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine's everyday life at Seisho Music Academy, as actresses-in-training.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: Tonari ni Koakuma-chan
description: Kase, a boy in the shadows, is pushed around by Furuhashi-san, a devilish girl.

title: Awasete Ippon!
description: Asuka is a typical high school girl with two big loves in her life; Judo, and Kujyo-senpai. One day, Asuka finally gathers up her nerve to confess her feelings to Kujyo-senpai. But before she can do so, a boy from her past transfers to her school and challenges Asuka to a judo match â€“ if he wins, Asuka will have to be his girlfriend for three months. Who is this boy? Will Asuka ever get a chance to confess to Kujyo-senpai? Who will win this match?

title: Nakasone kun ga Mae wo Mukanai
description: "Yankee from Okinawa × Timid High School Girl from the City" Saaya (15), who moved from the suffocating Tokyo to Okinawa and enrolled in a night school, struggles to fit in. Her classmate, Nakasone-kun (17), though intimidating in appearance, always casually talks to her. Saaya is good at studying but struggles with group activities, always being alone. Nakasone declares, "I'll be your first buddy." As they both deal with their own circumstances, their distance gradually closes in. A refreshing pure love story set in an Okinawan night school!

title: Yuuto no Shinro Kibou
description:
I was born to be a hero, to be the one to defeat the Demon Lord, but…  
  
Entry no. 43 in the 3rd Club Sunday Cup.

title: The Honey-blood Beauty & Her Vampire
description: Kagari Tojyo is smart and beautiful...but what really draws a crowd is her rare "honey blood"—a crowd of vampires, that is! Enter Ryotaro, her bodyguard and a vampire himself...with quite the perverted, sadistic streak! What's Kagari got to do to have a "normal" life?

title: Kimi no Kokuhaku wa Modokashii!
description:
"What am I going to do now that he's confessed?" 

Shotaro is Riku's male friend. They are always having a good time together, but then Shoutarou suddenly confesses his feelings for Riku!　Riku becomes strangely conscious of him and her heart jumps just by touching his hand. She tries to play a prank on Shotaro, who is lying down in the schoolyard, as usual, but fails because he is too nervous. How did I always do it...?

A school omnibus series that begins with a sudden confession!

title: Hina to Sensei no Kage
description:
Usuka works as a high school teacher while hiding the fact that he is a vampire. Although he has been able to live his life without being exposed as a vampire, he still spends his days fearing his deepest instincts. Then suddenly, Hinata, who claims to be "a daughter raised to be a vampire," enters the school! This is a love story about two people who want to be "normal" but can't.

(google translated)

title: My Rei of Light
description:
“Tôi muốn cậu trở thành nguồn cảm hứng của tôi!”

Hai con người với những đam mê cháy bỏng nhưng lạc lối trong chính câu chuyện của riêng mình. Một cách tình cờ, họ đã gặp được nhau.

Ở cạnh nhau, Yuji và Masa, hai con người yêu cái đẹp, được sống là chính mình. Cùng niềm đam mê quá đỗi đặc biệt họ dần khám phá ra những cảm xúc chôn giấu và điều sẽ thay đổi cuộc đời của họ mãi mãi.

title: Boku ga Utau to Kimi wa Warau kara
description:
1) Because You Smile When I Sing  
The pop band vocalist, Atsushi, has always been thought of by others as a "scary person" because of the facial expression he was born with and his disinclination to speak. For Atsushi, Anzu is the only one who ever smiled wholeheartedly upon meeting him, but now that they have met again in high school, Anzu has changed completely. Why doesn't she smile? What can a boy–a singer–with a frightful expression and no speech do to bring her beautiful smile back…?  
  
2) Ding Dong  
Happiness resounds, ding dong. Though the sound of it may be short-lived, the echo only dies if we allow it to. Chisato wonders if her father ever loved her. He died in a car accident, leaving Chisato behind with her stepmother. He never gave her anything–no gifts on holidays, and he didn't even have the decency to go on living for her. It might be the case that even Chisato's stepmother feels no love for her and will leave. But one question from Chisato's childhood friend, Takah

title: Onii-chan Lab.
description:
Ikezawa Sumire's three elder brothers, Asagi, Ai, Kon are so beautiful even friends get jealous! Sumire too loves Asagi and Ai, but for some reason she just can't like Kon. That reason is…!?   
  
Adoptive siblings love.

title: Tanukida-senpai no Seishun ni Naritai
description: When she was in junior high school, Nanoka fell in love with Tanukida a popular Koshien baseball player who is rumored to be “the genius of the century." In order to fulfill her dream of being the closest person to cheer for her senior (and possibly go out with him), she enrolls in the same high school as him and becomes the manager of the baseball team! However, Tanukida has a secret of his own!

title: Hadashi no Aitsu
description: This is the story of Hamada Akari, a sixteen-year-old girl whose father has problems with money. To pay off one of his debts, her dad sends her as a servant to the Otomo family. She is forced to live with them and attend a private school where only the richest and snobbiest kids enroll. The son of the Otomo family fights constantly with her and the tension between the two never seems to disappear.

title: Nevermore
description: James Jung is the top student at Ozoh Academy, home of the gifted and mega rich. He is also an undercover agent protecting the principal from a dangerous assassin. His name? Samuel Gyo, codename black mamba and now James’ homeroom teacher. In order to fight, they must abide by three rules. First, they cannot have their identities exposed to the other students. Second, they cannot harm the students. Third and most importantly, no explosives or firearms. Poison and tranquilizers are fine. Fighting to the death, no one ever briefed them for the fourth and final rule: you must not fall in love. Will they break it?

title: Yaya
description: The main character of this story is a girl with obsessive compulsive disorder. On a visit to her new school, she meets a fellow student, a "bad boy," and a handsome teacher. Things start to heat up later on, but who will she end up with?!

title: Love Graduation
description: Fujisaki Asuka has had a crush on Urabe Jun for three years. Days before graduation, to her surprise, he asks her to be his girlfriend. But there's a catch, he actually wants her to pretend so other girls won't swarm around him. Asuka is disappointed, but for her, just being around him is enough. She decides to enjoy spending time with him while she can, but jealous girls aren't happy with the new "couple".

title: Everybody Loves Somebody
description: Megu is a shy girl and not really experienced when it comes to love, but when she hears Takeda talking about her and saying that she’s cute, she starts to get some hopes for her love life. Thanks to her friend, Akane-chan, she is able to ask him out and he agrees right away, but in the end it seems that Takeda is getting along better with her friend than with her. And Takeda’s friend seems to have his eyes on her. How will Megu decide to settle this love triangle?

title: The Girlfriend Project
description: When Julia’s scholarship is cut, she’s out of options. A surprise rescue comes when her project partner Ryn offers to pay Julia to pretend to be her girlfriend for the holidays. One problem: Ryn is quite possibly the weirdest person Julia knows. On top of that, Ryn’s filthy rich family snubs black sheep like Ryn and working-class people like Julia. As Julia works to win the hearts of Ryn’s family, she realizes it could be more than her pride on the line: Her own heart may be in jeopardy, too.

title: Shiro Neko
description:
Collection of oneshots:  
  
1) Shiro Neko (The Cat Shiro)  
Sensei is a veterinarian who works hard and always sleep in the last train. One day, a boy wake him up and all that he thinks is "Kind childen really do exist"… But is that little kid really kind? Or is he like a stray cat?  
  
2) Sweet Days  
Asai and Yoh were childhood friends, but Asai had to move out, so he leaves a lesson to Yoh: "You should get stronger". Years later, Asai is a new student and, whoa, Yoh studies there too, but… He became a deliquent?!  
  
3) And Sheep  
"It's impossible to talk to animals", that what Lin said when he was visiting Kuranosuke, a genius that knows everything about quantum physics, fundamental chemistry and medicine. After eating with him, Lin goes home and sleeps. On the next he wake up a little… Animal?!  
  
4) Himitsu no Hanashi (What We Keep Silent About)  
Yori has a homossexual brother and he just can't stand that. But, to be more complicated, Kawamori, a close friend, likes him. Y

title: Choro na to Senpai
description: She has been rejected 19 times. One day, she falls in love at first sight with a handsome guy named Ichinose Senpai, who is not very good at love. She tries her best to make a move on him, but Ichinose declares that he is not interested in a serious relationship and does not take her seriously at all!　A heartwarming romance between an overly good-natured and carefree girl and a lazy guy is about to begin!

title: Haikyuu!! - Aiming for a Happy Marriage (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

What’s the next step after a secure, loving relationship? Kageyama and Hinata are both dancing around the question, but how will they take their first steps of the rest of their lives together?

title: Kingyo Used Books
description:
A businessman discovers how his childhood memories can brighten his day. An art student finds inspiration. An archer hits a surprising bull's eye. A housewife rediscovers romance. A teenager discovers his true self in the pages of a manga magazine. Welcome to Kingyo Used Books, a place where people find their dreams in manga…

[Official English*](https://www.viz.com/read/manga/kingyo-used-books/all)

 ***Discontinued past Volume 4**

title: Mizutama Fabric
description:
Collection of short stories:  
1.Polka Dot Fabric  
She might be tall, but high-schooler Fukagawa Yori likes pretty dresses. BUT, the guy that she likes says, "They don't suit you." What a trauma for our poor Yori! One day, our Yori ends up modeling for a fashion show…  
  
2.The Love Affairs at the Somagi's  
Umino Kujira answers an ad for a live-in housekeeper at the home of two brothers named Somagi Takumi and Arata. She's given a trial period of one week for the job.  
  
3.Michibiki no Tsue (The Staff of Guidance)  
Hotaru is training to be a "staff" - someone who guides spirits wandering between life and death. Her first case is Koizumi Otoha, a girl who loves piano, but cannot choose between staying and going from the world.  
  
4.Wish Upon the Stars  
The planetarium in Konno Momiji's town is closing, so it's offering free performances for a week. Momiji goes and meets one of her old middle school classmates, Hiiragi Kiwa, who is working part-time as a commentator at the plane

title: Koi to Natsu Tsubaki
description: Rinne, a huge fan of Buddhism, was searching for a "monk-type," a boy as calm, intelligent and diligent as Lord Buddha himself, when she set her sights on a young, handsome monk-in-training, Yuuryou. She soon learns that this kid, out of his robes, is not her dream boy, but a shallow, irresponsible lady killer who goes by Yura. Is Rinne going to give up on her fantasy, or is there more to Yura than meets the eye?

title: Mebuki Kimidori
description:
Towa always had the gift of sensing danger.
One day, she gets a bad premonition about a boy.
She, along with her friend Ririko, tries hard to prevent it from happening.

**What will happen next?**

title: The Euphrates Tree
description:
This is the story of three high school students who discover a tree of knowledge on a small island in the Sea of Japan, who eat the fruit of the tree and then return to the mainland and attempt to return to their lives!

---
**Volume 255 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Shishunki Miman Okotowari - Kanketsu Hen
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
1. Shishunki Miman Okotowari Ending  
As final chapter of the Shinshunki Miman Okotowari series, Manato returns from America, but he doesn't come with the best news for Asuka. This might be the last time he returns to Japan.  
  
2. Couple  
Inaho has fallen in love with Takumi, the lead guitarist of a high-school band. With hand-made gifts and her strange personality, she gets Takumi to ask her out. But only with a special biwa (a Japanese lute) can their relationship last.  
  
3. Chikyu no Arukikata  
Ayuki just got dumped. On the same day, she hurt her ankle during track practice. Later, Ayuki gets trapped on the wrong train to the coast. On this train, she meets Hiroto, a guy who has quit school in search of himself. Ayuki wonders if she should do the same.

title: His Temperature
description: Ito, a girl who is physically abused by her father, nonetheless hides it from the people around her. But when things spiral out of control only Ibuki is willing to reach out his hand to try and save her. As the two are drawn together, however, he is simultaneously tied down by obligations difficult to break away from no matter where his heart lays.

title: The Cross Triangle
description: It was her 16th birthday when Kurusu was told by her classmate, Ogami, a confession, she’s delighted, but also feels very uncomfortable in relation to her friend Kiraha whom she knows that she got a soft spot for this guy. Kurusu doesn’t have time to rejoice because the mysterious evil creatures appear suddenly and attack her!! Kurusu must face her destiny along with Ogami whose role is to protect her. However, Kiraha can’t see this situation.

title: Himitsu de, Hanazono.
description:
A normal high-school student, Ryou falls in love with the angelic young master, Minato.  
  
But the three butlers living with Minato are much too overprotective of him, when Ryou wants to get intimate with Minato for a moment, he's always interrupted by the three; with three *light bulbs forcing themselves between the pair of lovers, what is to be done?  
  
Two untranslated chapters are called, Butterfly Part 1 & 2  
  
Other story:  
  
- Vampire Kiss  
Shuichi comes back after a long absence from school to find his old friend Kura. No one else remembers Kura though. After searching Shuichi ends up at an old western style house where he finds Kura in the basement, in a coffin!?  
  
Note: *light bulbs are something like a third wheel; an extra person who intrudes on a couple spending time together.

description:
What if one day a stranger suddenly kissed you like in a movie?  
And furthermore, that person was handsome like a movie star?  
  
A heavy eater and simple minded,  
A slow witted girl with no sense at all.

When she saves a person on the brink of death,  
he shows his gratitude with a sweet and sensual kiss.  
The weird transfer student Kang Uh yuk (Oh yuk?).

Love... 

Almost everyone experiences it... 

Some say it makes them feel uneasy, 
While some say it makes them feel joyful.

title: Manekoi
description: Sonoda Haru is a 16 year old teenager who has a crush on his classmate Honda Chikako, who is not only popular but athletic, smart and incredibly hot whereas Haru is just an average joe. He has been dealing with this feeling for months without making any progress until one day he is forced to purchase a [welcoming cat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maneki-neko) off of a random person on the street. It turns out that as the 10,000th user of the welcoming cat, a real life walking, talking, and breathing welcoming cat named Maneki Nekotaro appears from his world. Nekotaro has come into Haru’s life to grant him any wish and the only thing he has in mind is being with Chikako. But Nekotaro’s expertise is in financial related issues and has no experience in romantic problems so he has to make it up as they go. Will Haru ever be able to be with Chikako?

Accidentally voted Student Council President on her first day, Aria's attempts to just fit in are ruined by her nosy new classmates. Since she can't beat the use of her mocking former nickname, "The Lovemaster" she decides to go with it and turn the Student Council into a dating service! If she recommends a book to you, please do not reject her, because it is a love story that belongs solely to you—The female protagonist, Xiao Deah*, received a wordless book. This book caused a misunderstanding and now Deah is the pretend girlfriend of school idol and soccer captain, Hu Ke Jun?! Will Deah and Hu Ke Jun become a true couple?

It was Uehara, his senpai from college, the guy he used to sleep with. Each word he spoke brought back memories from that time… A story of an ended love and sensitive romance suddenly revived.

Kurai Karen is a rich ojou-sama with many suitors. She's in love with her butler, Ishibashi Megumi. Long ago, the two of them made a promise to be together forever. Now that they've grown up, Megumi seems to have forgotten, but Karen hasn't. A forbidden love between master and servant, what will happen to them?!  
  
Extra story Sweet Guardian:  
Kasuga Yuuki had always been in love with Himuro Makoto. One day she decided to confess to him and ended up rejected. On the same day she fell asleep on a supplementary class and ended up staying late at school. To her happiness, she found out that Himuro-kun was also still at school, but somehow he had a gun?! Moreover he tried to kill their school Chairman and admitted he is a hitman?! And later she ended up going out with him!? Is this all a dream?!

All of them have strong habits, but Fujiwara Ryukan is a little different.

I gave up on youth and started living in a dormitory, but both youth and love came along with it!

description:
I was reborn as the heroine of a shoujo manga I had read in my previous life. Yay! That’s not it! Out of everyone, I was reborn as the heroine that I hated. I don’t want to be that girl, I don’t want to stick to men that like such a girl either!

In preparation for the high school entrance ceremony, I decided. I will completely avoid the hero and make the rival character and the hero stick together. Since the high school entrance ceremony, I stealthily watched over the hero and the rival character from the shadows and saw them grinning and getting along with each other. Even though I was just gazing at them, I somehow became acquaintances with the rival character and am having tea with them right now.

Dragon Quest 4koma Manga Theater is a collection of parody gag manga from multiple artists covering Dragon Quest 1-6. The collection spans 20 volumes starting publication April of 1990 and finally ending in April of 2000.

Kaoru is the type of girl who always has men fawning over her. She's pretty, bright, and has that sparkling personality that all men love. Then she met her new home tutor Katagiri… how will he fare against her wiles?

4) Katakoi Yozora (Unrequited Love's Night Sky)
