title: Paper Planes
description: When they first met, 5 year old Tang Jun He saw 6 year old Yang Xuan as his hero, and willingly became his ‘lackey’. Yang Xuan: “There are 12 ways to fold a paper plane, don’t you know? Let me teach you." Ten years later, 17 year old Tang Jun He started living in Yang Xuan’s house as his younger brother. The grievance from the previous generation had not yet disappeared. These two youngsters fought and contended against each other. "The one who falls first is the one who loses. I knew that since long ago, but I’m willing to.” In a blink of an eye 10 years passed by, a 28 year old Tang Jun He and 29 year old Yang Xuan met again. Things remained the same but the people were no longer the same. Two people who remained in the darkness can never be each other’s light. Then let’s walk together, and find the light.

title: Haunted Campus
description: The story follows Mototsu Yagami, a college student who can see ghosts but doesn't want to. In college, he meets Koyomi Nada, who was his junior in high school. Out of unrequited love for her, he follows her into the "occult research society," which is full of eccentrics who fill their campus life with the occult.

title: Muteki no Mirai Daisakusen
description:
"Who wants to get holy marriage!"

It is a new form of marriage to counter the declining birthrate. A new system that allows selected saints (*super rich) to create polyandry and polygamy families!! Akira Eiko starting to get interested in school prince Iida-kun for life but?.. Aiming for a holy marriage, a school romantic comedy in search of life!

title: It's your Fault that I'm Blushing
description:
1. Iwasaki-san wa Keisandakai  
2. Kawaiitte Iwanaide  
3. Kiss mo Madana Watashi desu.  
4. Akaku Naru no wa Kiminosei

title: Hey, Don't Touch My Cheese
description: Xie SiZhe was once everything for Bai Xi, she could do anything for him. However, his betrayal ruined her whole family… Time-traveling to the past, how can she rewrite her life and take revenge? And is the little fatty who always pays for her silently her true love?

title: Cross Line
description:
Tsukiko, a somewhat cold-hearted college student who can't really like people, is confessed to by Touma, a senior in the same circle, and they start dating. Tsukiko gradually becomes attracted to him who is pure. However, Hiiragi's ex-girlfriend appears in front of them...
Presented by the overwhelmingly popular Yoyoi Sou on the web, this modern love story crosses each other's feelings.

(Google translate)

title: Mama
description:
A boarding school where only those chosen by God attend. The ones who possess the true ability are said to be granted great honor as well as death… What awaits these children is jealous rivals, arguments with their mothers, forbidden love, and both confidence and confusion over their own abilities. The story of the unfolding powers of the boys who have the voices of angels.
-MangaUpdates

title: Tsumari wa Kimi ga Itoshii no Desu
description:
A collection of short stories:  
Miu's grandmother is hospitalised. When she visits her, she occasionally sees her classmate, Moriya Shun, coming in and out of the hospital. "Maybe he's visiting someone?" she thinks. "Or maybe, he's actually…"

title: Gakkou ja Dekinai Koto
description: ある日、僕は教え子と一線を越えてしまった…。小悪魔美少女な女子高生に振り回されるヘタレ眼鏡教師の話。教師×生徒の不健全な漫画です。

title: Kirai ni wa Narenai
description:
"I should give up on a love that can't be returned."  
  
Shinohara is averagely popular with girls, but he has never been able to get serious with anyone. One day, he finds out that his student council mate Okui has someone he likes, but that person has a lover. Shinohara feels frustrated on his friend's behalf… could this be love?

title: Bijo Juku
description: Hanazono Eve is a woman in search for the perfect suitor. However, because of her family's influence, she believes that only rich men are worth marrying. But, what will happen when she enters the school that just became co-ed recently?

title: Good Father
description: Nakamura Sano feels great stress when his girlfriend asks him to meet her father. When he gets the courage to come visit, he discovers that her father is actually a first class DJ who doesn't want his daughter to date Sano. As a result, Sano throws himself into the DJ world and enters the DJ preliminary match to prove himself worthy for his daughter!

title: Sensei wa Egoist
description:
Beautiful teachers and secretive extra-curriculum lessons!  
White suits, sports, spectacles, and extremely attractive teachers!  
If it were you, which teacher would you choose to go to for a “not allowed” lesson?!  
Ikemen Teacher and Ikenai, a personal lesson after school?!  
Extremely charming English teacher, Sanada Kyoichi, is as charming as a prince.  
However, the truth is that he is a sadist that has made Yume turn into a person with a slavery-characteristic!  
He appeared in front of Yume, when she was a high school student, and he ordered her around with “order” and “praises” at a grade higher than his pervious commands, but…?!  
Another white suit devil?!  
  
A sadistic chemistry teacher and a killer-smile, spectacled history teacher. A total of three new sensational teacher love stories drawn by Nana-chan.  
  
Includes:  
- Sensei wa Egoist  
- Sensei no Koibito  
- Sensei no Kai Neko  
- Sensei wa Egoist in Natsuyasumi

title: Himitsu no Yubisaki - Katakoi Doukei Tanpenshuu 2
description:
The second volume of Soyoko Inogari's highly acclaimed early short stories!


Yura is a girl in her third year of high school. She secretly has a crush on Maya, who is in the same class with her, but when her parents remarry, she and Maya suddenly become sister and brother in law...!
(Published in the August 1, 2011 issue of Hanato Yume)

How to Start a Natsukare:
Yuki is on her first summer vacation as a university student. While all her friends are getting boyfriends, she's worried that nothing is happening to her. One day, a childhood friend, Chihiro, suggests, "Shall I pretend to be your boyfriend?
(Published in the September 1, 2014 issue of Hanato Yume)

Red Lantern Moon:
Rentaro has a crush on Benihime, a senior who loves books more than anything else. However, it is Rentaro's older brother, Mr. Noyo, who has a crush on Benihime. As their unfulfilled love grows, the last cultural festival for both of them is approaching--!
(Published in the October 1, 2010 issue of "The Flower a

title: Hiatus Feelings
description: Satoshi comes home from America after his treatment. What awaits him is not welcoming arms but discouragement from his non-related sister. But he still hasn't given up, and tries his best to make up for what he's done.

title: Mask
description:
When the clock strikes midnight, the door opens. This is when the phantom awakens, wandering, looking for the most beautiful dancer.  
Loosely based on "The Phantom of the Opera."

title: Where the Sea Meets the Sky
description:
"A mermaid will fall in love with the first human she sees."  
  
Shiina is your average grade 8 girl -that is, except for her height, which makes her tower over the other people in her class. 
She's never met anyone SHE had or wanted to look up to… until a young male teacher begins teaching at her school. 
Yet because of his good looks and easy demeanor the other girls in her grade have turned him into the resident school idol, 
and there's little chance of him ever noticing her.  
  
That all changes one day when they end up in the same train during rush hour. 
She's surprised to find that he not only recognizes her but he remembers her name! What could this mean?

title: Slow-Healing Heart
description:
Why does he look like my ex...? 

After a traumatic first love, Mijung is determined to put her past behind her and start fresh in college. But when Mi-Jeong enters school, she meets an upperclassman with the exact same face as her first love! Will she be able to heal her past scars and learn to love again?

title: Angel Time
description: Four cute school romance stories, all having some sort of time theme. In the first story, a girl discovers she can freeze time. In story 2, a girl discovers she can communicate with a boy living 6 years in the past through notes written on her desk. In Story 3, a girl finds herself living the same day over and over again (like the movie Groundhog Day) and finally, a girl who has a crush on a boy 3 years her junior discovers what the world would be like if he were the one who was 3 years older instead.

title: Chinko no Tsubuyaki - Chintsubu (Doujinshi)
description:
Volume 1: Chintsubu A  
Part 1 – Iwabuchi starts hanging out with girls from his cram school, and Kamiya-chinko freaks out. What is he up to?  
Part 2 – Toride's soul moves up to Ayase's nipple.  
  
Volume 2: Chintsubu B  
When Iwabuchi engages in more chinko cosplay, Kamiya is upset and they get into another fight. The cosplay chinkos are not to be missed in this!  
  
Volume 3: Chintsubu C  
Part 1 – The chinkos are having a big discussion over what to do when they want to get off and their "bodies" don't.  
Part 2 – Gives us the backstory on Iwabuchi's first impressions of Kamiya, when they first met long before the accident.   
  
Volume 4: Chintsubu D  
Kamiya injures his hand and can't engage in mutual jerking off with Iwabuchi, leading to a REALLY big fight.  
  
Volume 5: Chintsubu E  
It's summer and the chinko alliance head to the pool for some swimming fun, but can chinkos even swim?  
  
Volume 6: Chintsubu F  
When Toride-chinko disappears one night, Ayase panics. The nex

title: Seijo Sama Ni Naritainoni Kogeki Maho Shika Tsukaenai Ndesukedo!? THE COMIC
description:
In this world, men and women are already divided by nature, but there exists one more boundary between them– men can wield only offensive magic, while women can use only healing magic.

Born a girl, Yuffie Abishas has always admired the Saintess, a miraculous figure beloved by all for her power to heal. If she could become a Saintess too, maybe she could finally make some friends… or so she thought.

Having never had a single friend in her life, Yuffie eagerly tries magic for the first time only to unleash a power beyond imagination. Without realizing it, she’s just set the stage for the birth of a new legend: that of the world’s most overpowered (and most socially awkward) girl!

Zero friends! 0% self-esteem!! A clumsy girl with nothing but offensive magic charges into her academy life—

Can she really make hundred friends along the way?!

title: Gomen Asobase!
description:
Yuu  Watase Masterpiece Collection #1

1. Gomen Asobase! (ごめん遊ばせ！)
Miyagawa Hao has just come to Tokyo from Osaka. To relieve her of a headache, a passing bishounen offers her a packet, which was suppose to have a pill inside. By mistake, the guy gives Miyagawa a very important button. Miyagawa finds out he goes to her same school, which divides the boys and girls with a very large wall.

2. Pajama de Ojama (パジャマでおじゃま)
Legend has it that if you wear the same pajamas as the one you love, you will be transported to him for a short period of time. Misaki Aguri decides to try this out with the person she has a crush on, Isozaki. She never quite gets where she wants to be.
3. Pajama de Labyrinth (パジャマで迷路〈ラビリンス〉)
Sequal.


4. Koori Musume wa Otoshigoro (氷娘はお年頃)
Kahyouzan Koori runs into Kazama Shuuhen at the beach (quite literally) and falls in love with him. Her grandmother does not approve of this relationship, and makes a deal with the couple. If she can break a string tied around their f

title: Danshi Ryou de Himitsu no Kiss
description: Hikawa Tooru. Female. Freshman. And for some reason… she has to stay in the boys' dorm.

title: Anata no Sekai de Owaritai
description:
1. Goodbye My God
2. Bokura no Hahen
3. Mr. Wonderland
4. Anata no Sekai de Owaritai

title: He's My First Lover
description: Five years ago, Ruan Zhi and Qi Zhan broke up unhappily. Now five years later, an unexpected reunion disrupted her life. That male god, did he not study architecture? How did he become the boss of her dubbing company? What? The hidden idol CV God is also you?! Ruan Zhi, who was being devoured to death by Qi Zhan, couldn't help but wonder secretly. It turns out that the male god can have such a deep routine.

title: Hayato-kun's Overprotective Bias is too Much
description: 'Would it bother you if I kissed you?' One day, an extremely handsome older man, SATO, arrives at the café where Yukino, an ordinary high school girl, works. Yukino's heart is on the verge of exploding every time she meets him! Yukino is becoming more and more attracted to him, but in fact, he's someone everyone knows...? A sweet-cyan love story with lots of love from the grown-up boys!

title: Wild Damon
description: A girl's life is going to change because of her father who is an explorer. He found a boy living in a jungle and took him home. Now she has to take care of him and guide him as he tries to adapt to the city life.

title: Hetare Venus
description:
Her classmates were always intimidated by her height, hence she received the nickname of “Big Sister” for sixteen years. But this is far from the truth! She not only is a coward who doesn’t dare to say what’s on her mind, she’s also super scared of horror movies! Like every girl in love, for the sake of the guy she likes, she volunteered to be on the committee of the school’s cultural festival.   
Unfortunately, her class then chose “haunted house” as their theme; how will she get through this now?  
  
Contents:  
- Hetare Venus (Clumsy Goddess)  
- 1 Day, 1 Kiss   
- Tsuki ni Todokutou (Tower That Reaches the Moon)   
- Yami e Hakobu Elevator (The Elevator that Takes you Into Darkness)  
"There's something coming from the other side of the darkness…"  
A teenage girl is recommended by her friend to take the test of courage at an unused hospital, but something sinister is going on there…  
- Watashi no Sweet Love Taiken (My Sweet Love Experience)

title: Netsu Shisen
description:
Yanase Touko is a high school student and photographer. She is asked to take a photo of Setsuna, a very popular fashion model. She tries to consider it to be just another job, but finds herself responding to his suggestive gaze.  
  
Includes oneshot Pika Pika Scandal which is about a girl who loves bishounen and thus scouts them to be actors.

title: Ibara no Koi
description: When I was younger, I was the cutest and one of the most popular girls around. I even fell in love with a certain boy. All that changed after that one incident. Now in high school, I am far from cute and I am scared of touching people, but I still have feelings for that boy…

title: Nine
description:
Time travel that messed everything up
After discovering a mystery incense stick, Sela finds out that she can travel back in time by lighting the incense stick. With her new ability, Sela saves her mother and thinks she's finally found her happy ending. However, she realizes that her time-traveling ability comes with a price when she finds out that her first love Yijoon is now dating her best friend...

---

- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/nine/list?title_no=3075)

- [Official French Translation](https://www.verytoon.com/serie/nine)

- [Official Thai Translation](https://www.comico.in.th/titles/2469)

title: Kyouken Breeder
description:
1) Atelier  
Art student Ritsu takes on Tagami, a teacher with a bad attitude.  
  
2) Mad Dog Breeder  
Kusugawa wants to discover what his coworker Oka means when he says he get "desperate" when he drinks.  
  
3) Longing for the House Guest  
Haruka and Jun are roommates and novelists. After Jun's sloppy housekeeping causes Haruka to injure his hands, guilty Jun needs to help Haruka any way he can.  
  
4) White Snow, Black Wings  
Ex-prostitute Mizuki and mafia assassin Katsuhiko are on the run from their former bosses, but Katsuhiko is sick.  
  
5) Milk  
A young man has a guy who wanders in and out of his life like a cat.  
  
6) Twilight Amusement Park  
Teacher is dating his student, Yoshii, who wants to quit school and work in an amusement park, but Yoshii's family wants him to study abroad.   
  
7) Haruhi  
His young patient dying of a mysterious illness, a doctor takes him on a trip to the sea.

title: Jibun no Mune ni Kiitemina
description: Tsubaragi, who is a kind and a thoughtful guy, is dating five girls at the same time. The reason is that he doesn't want to see girls being sad because of rejection. But is this situation sustainable in the long run?

title: Orera Kourin! Ai toka Koi toka Sekai toka
description:
The everyday misfortunes that occur are from her prayers to God. She believed that her parents and the sister that she loved so much died because of her unhappy predisposition. She can’t even make friends, but all she does is just continue to pray everyday…  
  
And then one day, she met Koini who is invincible at fighting and Kinzou who is invincible against love and was told “we will protect you”!?  
  
This is a high tension love comedy.

title: Kikenchitai Danshi - Kedamono Black & White
description:
Satsuki-chan attends a girls' school that is located near two other high schools. These are boys' schools, notorious for their gang leaders, the Black King and the White King.  
  
One day after visiting the market, Satsuki-chan takes a short cut by jumping over a wall. Unfortunately, she jumps right into the middle of a fight between Blacks and Whites. Of course, being a girl, she makes quite an impact on them! Then Kuroki-kun, the Blacks' leader shows up. Will something develop between these two?  
  
But unknown to all, the White King has watched everything from behind the scenes, and a new game has started: Satsuki-chan is the new target!

title: Sword of Musashi
description:
Musashi Natsuki was born to kendoist parents, and was a born kendo boy. His parents named him Musashi Rokusanushi in the hope that he would become a modern-day kendo master. 

He spends his days doing kendo in Morioka, a town watched over by Mount Iwate, where he spends his days practicing kendo. A super passionate kendo story!

---
  
- **Sword of Musashi received the 1984 Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen manga.**

title: Onii-chan, Gacha
description: A story about an elementary school girl who finds an older brother in Gashapon machine (toy vending machine.)

title: Egg of My Youth
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- **Spring Egg** (青春のたまご, Seishun no Tamago):
Chika’s house was actually just an old lodging house, but due to the location, her parents decided to turn it into a student dorm for the college students. One day, she meets her first love, Fujimori Tomohiro, a college student who will be living at her house! But, Chika’s mother had made him signed an agreement that he can’t go after Chika-chan?! How would their love bloom?!  
  
- **Sunflower Girl** (ひまわり娘, Himawari Musume): 
Misaki likes Kenji but she doesn't have the courage to confess. Now that summer break is close, she plans to give him a love letter, but…  
  
- **Happiness Faces South!** (しあわせ南向き！, Shiawase Minami-muki!):
Sakura used to like her sensei, but now that he has a girlfriend she decides not to like anyone else. Bon, a college student sees her playing softball and falls for her. Will Sakura be able to fall for him too??  
  
- **The Prince and I** (王子様とわたし, Oji-sama to Watashi):
Mari has

title: Kare no 1-Ban ni Naru Houhou
description: Chiaki had to suddenly transfer from Tokyo to a secluded village in the countryside, because of her father's job transfer. Though longing to go back to Tokyo, in her new school she met Miya, whom she initially hated, but as time went by the feelings of hate changed to love. Now, while using her own skills, and competing with the other girls that stick to Miya, she will try to win his love. "I want to be his No.1."

title: Shitsuji Kyoushi no Renai Jugyou
description:
1-2) Butler Teaches Lesson of Love  
"I've saved myself for you because you're my only master for life!"  
  
Sera was acting out his rebellion against his parents, when Makieda, a former butler, came into the picture as a substitute teacher.  
  
Under Makieda's guidance, Sera learned more than just becoming a gentleman. He also fell in love with this butler-turned-instructor. However, will Makieda choose duty to serve his former master over love? See how these two struggle to master the lesson of love.  
  
3-5) Social Dance for Men  
Thanks to an unfortunate accident the President of the Social Dance Club is now allergic to women, but that's not going to stop him from finding the perfect dancing partner.  
  
Extra) The Butler Becomes Jealous at Night

title: Minors
description:
A collection of short stories by depicting the emotions of young people living momentarily but passionately in a rural town in the Tohoku region.
___
**Additional Links:**
- Collector's Edition Page: [Shougakukan](https://csbs.shogakukan.co.jp/book?book_group_id=14612)

title: Hatsukoi no Tsuzuki
description:
1) Hatsukoi no Tsuzuki  
After reaching a dead end in a relationship that never really started, Ogu and Kyoka meet again 4 years later. Will things unfold differently this time around?  
  
2) Clumsy  
  
3) age22  
Nene made a promise with her 'childish childhood' friend. But will he remember these years later?  
4) Suki na Kuseni  
  
———————-  
  
Ogu y Kyoka eran amigos en primaria y sin embargo llegarón a ser algo más que amigos pero aun que estaban juntos eran muy timidos para darce la mano y menos darce un beso, un día ella quizo entrar en la misma secundaria que Ogu el cual a este lo puso muy feliz no obstante ella no quedo en la secundaria que Ogu por lo que se tubierón que separar…. 4 años después ellos se vuelven a encontrar estando en la Universidad… sin embargo al pasar los años ellos estubierón con otras personas ¿Comó afectara esto a ellos dos?

title: Seiten Taisei
description:
Ako Doumoto's an everyday gal, or gyaru; she likes shopping and has no big aspirations since her exams are a ways away. That all changes when she meets Katayose-sensei, a teacher and coach of the boys basketball team at Ako's school. Head over heels, she chops off her hair and decides to become the manager of the basketball club in order to win his heart.  
  
Will he open to her will or is her close friend Taiji more for her?  
  
**Included one-shots:**  
Volume 5: Kanojo wa Delicate  
Volume 6:  
- Renai Dungeon  
- Kimi to Eve Shitai

title: Loose Leaf
description: Yuki Anno just turned into a high school student, she's very nervous and what's worse, she is in a different class from her best friend Jiu. But she resolves to make new friends. Upon meeting Jiu's cousin, Yuki, who has the same name as her, will she be able to open up and show people who she really is?

title: 99% Love
description: Ria has been going out with her boyfriend, Jiro, for almost half a year now, but they haven't "done anything" yet. Jiro loves to dance…but it seems like he cares more about dancing than Ria…?! Who knows if they could gain their last 1% to their relationship..

title: Signal To Love
description: Zhong Xinhuai, who never believes in fate, helps his cousin teach a lesson to a scumbag who askes for a "Fated Mate" and broke up mercilessly. Only to find out he's the scumbag's real "Fated Mate"?! Since then, the cool senior has been entangled by the fate-believing "scumbag". But, he's also the new student in the same major he's a Teaching Assistant. He runs away... He chases... Can they get rid of this entanglement of fate...

title: Bitansan Renai
description:
There's a guy that's been on my mind – Michinaga. One day, he told me, "Taka, I have a crush on our teacher." But it hurts me to see his pained expression. Forget about that teacher. Forget about this love that'll never bloom. Choose me instead…  
  
Taka and Michi, Michi and his teacher, the teacher and Taka's older brother… Where will all their one-sided feelings take them?

title: My Cinderella
description:
From Aerandria Scans:  
  
Princess Tsubaki, who loves romantic stories, is told by her father, the king, to choose a guy to date at her 16th birthday party at all costs. Troubled by this, princess Tsubaki asked a favor of Aoi, a boy who’s treated like a Cinderella…?!  
  
Also includes the following stories:  
  
Funny Work After School  
Maki loves decorating things and lets out her passion in the Handicraft Club. However, in class, she's passive in order to hide her over-enthusiastic personality. When a boy she knows from her childhood joins the Handicraft Club, will her true personality be exposed?  
  
Star Falling Gift  
Although Miri is rich and can't do anything, she hates being treated like a kid. She will only eat her housekeeper's gruel for breakfast. So when the housekeeper leaves for a trip, she has her "granddaughter" who can make the same gruel substitute for her…  
  
Quartet Carta  
Nishihara Miyo was one out of four chosen to represent her class in karuta (cards of on

title: Short Sunzen!
description: Meet Satsuki, a rather rough and tumble girl who acts more like a yakuza member than a sweet young lady! She's too busy teaching people lessons to see that her handsome and cool classmate, Aya, secretly pines for her. Unfortunately, she just wants to be friends – ouch! But as they spend more time together, their relationship builds and strengthens. Will they ever be more than friends?! Find out in this sweet and sexy romance!

title: iShoujo (Official Colored)
description:
This manga follows an omnibus format, in that the characters the story focuses on changes every so often. The first characters, Tetta and Ginko's story ends at chapter 3, but all the characters are recurring, and sometimes, show up again in the future chapters.  
  
There is a magic love app that supposedly helps people's dreams of love come true. The first story of this love app follows Tetta and Ginko, friends who have bickered since grade school. Tetta looks up the magic app on a whim, and ends up with an application that is connected to Ginko. When he manipulates the "Ginko" on the app, it affects the real girl. He's embarrassed to have it in the first place, but he can't uninstall it without inputting Ginko's measurements. Whether he actually likes Ginko romantically or not, it seems that this app could only make the situation worse!

title: Freesia's Morning
description:
A collection of early oneshots from Riyoko Ikeda. Includes:

1. **Freesia's Morning** (フリージアの朝, Freesia no Asa)
2. **4:50 at Ueno Station** (上野駅４時50分, Ueno Eki 4 Ji 50 Bun): A girl waiting at Ueno Station observes others who also wait at the station, and their troubles.
3. **A Summer in Canterbury** (カンタベリーの夏, Canterbury no Natsu)
4. **The Harmony of Friendship** (友情のハーモニー, Yuujou no Harmony)
5. **Laura's First Love** (ローラの初恋, Laura no Hatsukoi)
6. **Under This Sky** (この空の下に, Kono Sora no Shita ni)
7. Bonus oneshot by Mieko Takahashi, Ikeda's first assistant: **The Love of Auntie Reiko** (レイコおばちゃまの恋, Reiko-obachama no Koi)

title: Ii Kankei de Komatteru
description:
1: Coworkers in an easygoing relationship.  
2-3: Childhood friends go to a planetarium.  
4: A responsible salaryman enjoys the unconventional attitude of a new intern.  
5-8: A school librarian is tempted by a determined student.

title: Sweet Chapel
description: Haruma Shinohara has always been looked at as someone who is frightening and cold. With his attitude, no one would have figured out that a first year, Tetsubei, had crumpled that exterior by stumbling upon Haruma's weakness.

title: Cat & Dogs!
description: Shiba is in love with his kendo senpai, but when he enters university he doesn't want to be in the kendo club anymore. How can Shiba convince him to join the club again? And why does the annoying Akito-senpai have to be in the club instead?

title: Amagami: Precious Diary (Official Colored)
description:
Based on the dating simulation game, Amagami (Gentle Bite).  
This adaptation focus on each heroine based on the Amagami visual novel.  
V.1-2 - Ayatsuji  
V.3-4 - Kaoru  
V.5 - collection of short stories

title: Kotonoha
description:
This is a series of 4 one-shots by Asou Mikoto that all have a common theme of words and language.

- Chapter 1: **Kotonoha ~Usuyou no Tsukebumi~**
Maeda Kotoha joined the calligraphy club at her highschool because she was impressed by the club president Fujisaki's demonstration. Unable to gather up her courage to confess her feelings, he graduates. Feeling regret, Kotoha decides to write him a letter using a brush and traditional paper...
- Chapter 2: **Kotonoha ~Ningyohime no Kowairo~**
Manabe, a cool ice queen type of girl, in Fukazawa Tatsuhiro's class joins the swim team even though she can't swim. Intrigued, Fukazawa decides to teach her, but wonders why she wants to learn so badly...
- Chapter 3: **Kotonoha ~Tenjousajiki no Naishobanashi~**
Mihara Ritsu is a playwright for her school's drama club. Nakajima is an underclassmen who joins the club because he was moved by the lead actress Seto Miyabi's words in the final scene of last year's production. This year, Ritsu must write a

title: Koikokoro Koushinchuu
description:
Ritsuka, a Ryousei student, believes that she’ll find a wonderful boyfriend by following the love legends. After all, her older sister, Aya, followed them, and she got married! Yet every time Ritsuka carries out a legend superstition, Kuze-kun gets in her way…  
  
Although they fight all the time, Kuze-kun is always there for her when she’s feeling scared or anxious. While his words are ill-natured, he is kind to her, so Ritsuka feels happy even when she’s mad at him…  
  
Ritsuka falls in love with Kuze-kun. After four of the legendary superstitions were completed, Ritsuka and Kuze-kun fell in love with each other, but…?!

title: Ao ni Rakurai
description: Aozora is a high school student in her second year who is not good with boys. But the all-girls high school she attends is merging with a neighboring boys' school! On the day of the opening ceremony, she meets Raikawa, a free-spirited problem child, on the rooftop...?

title: Hoshi to Kakumei to Sakaguchi Kyoko
description:
少女は大人になれないまま、時が止まった世界を生きるのか!?　坂口杏子は同じクラスに潜んでいる謎の男・星愼一朗に出会うことによって、自分の運命が大きく変わる！

ある日、同じクラスにまったく見覚えのない男・星愼一朗が潜入していることに気づいた坂口杏子。 友達たちに確認するが、ずっと最初からいると言われ、混乱する。 また人によって、身体にある模様が出ていることに彼女は気づく。 地球は侵略されているのか!? 杏子と星の戦いとジュブナイル（思春期）が始まる!!

title: Kono Koi Level Takasuginai!?
description: Ichinose Mei is a hardcore gamer who keeps her hobby a secret from her friends. Although she usually presents herself as a typical high school girl who gets excited over desserts and hot guys, she actually enjoys her nightly online gaming the most. And while playing her online game, Mei, who has zero romantic experience, somehow became acquainted with the wildly popular and handsome actor, Hikari!

title: The Scarlet Vow
description: Hao Hao who grew up in an orphanage, welcomed great changes in her life on her 15th birthday. From a mysterious elite private school, to a random fiance, all this took Hao Hao's confused heart by suprise, and signaled the beginning of a battle to escape her fate.

title: Momotan
description:
1) Usotsuki Ookami  
Satsuki is a counselor at a prestigious boys' high school. In fact, she is an ordinary high school student. Though she wishes that it will not be revealed, Tsuburaya, a problem student of the school, hangs around her…?!  
  
2) Miscalculation of the Little Demon  
His Family is about reach as mine, but he is 9 years older and already turned me down. then why is he here again?  
  
3) Together with Doggie  
They are interested in me because of my face. I'm tired of younger boy's confessions but this dog like boy won't leave me alone …  
  
4) Deli Bunny Girl  
Working in a cosplay cafe for bunny ear maniacs when I'm just a high schooler! He find outs, what should I do now?  
  
5) Non-sugar Darling  
We've been dating for 1 year now, but it looks like there is no love anymore.

title: Miss Rain
description:
A rumored girl seems that she can't graduate unless she takes extra classes and also pass the examination test with a 60. She thinks that there's nothing to do in the school, but while studying….she finds….  
  
This is extra story can be also be found in the manga, Chocolate Christmas.

title: Pink Innocent
description: Cocona is a rich girl who doesn't seem to have a firm grasp of reality. She's in love with someone–but he happens to have a bigger interest in his laptop than in girls.

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai - Rogobo's IshiMiko Shorts (Doujinshi)
Ame Nochi Balloon
description: Miko believes that flying red balloons can help grant your wishes… *I wish that I could meet him just one more time.*

title: The Guy Who Will Give a Kiss for ₩ 5000
description: 'Recently, the social evils have not disappeared yet and they are even contagious into the school' is what Soo Yung believes, little does she know that the 'accidental' first kiss on the school roof leaves her running/craving for more!

title: Stitch by Stitch
description: Joo-won comes from a high-class background but spends his time in an old embroidery room. In embroidering, he hopes to finally find Gwangmyeong, as was told to him by a famous fortune teller. The man works stitch by stitch in a shabby neighborhood as he tries to find the light to his life

title: Attention All Students!
description:
Seito Shokun follows the life of Kitashiro Naoko, nicknamed Nakki, as she plows through life with her friends and family. Faced with hardships and struggle, happiness, sadness, love and tragedy… Nakki paces forth! A manga classic!  
  
---
- **Won the 2nd Kodansha Manga Award for Shojo in 1978**

Note: Numbering based on Bunkobon

title: Namida Usagi ~Seifuku no Kataomoi~ Momoka ni Manabu Ai Sareryoku
Ai no Kotoba
description: Hitomi Kosaka, who wants to be a novelist, admires Takeru Murasaki, a genius writer and high-school student. She dreams that he would help her make her debut, and enters the same high school that he attends. However, being opposite of the image, Takeru is dirty-minded and sadistic in reality. What is worse, he says to her, "I'll make love to you."

title: Oh My Ghost Manga
description: Follow the Supernatural Adventures of Loi the Humand and Maya the ghost~

title: Shounen Butterfly
description:
A collection of oneshots.  
  
1) Shounen Butterfly  
He is nice, yet he is mean. An underclassman, who is quite highhanded. What are Nakazawa-kun's true intentions under his mixed reactions towards Okano.  
  
2) Ikemen Kanojo  
She looks so much like a guy, a bishounen but still!! Once, she wore a hairpin, but the guys made fun of her, saying it didn't suit her. She is still 100% girl, and what happens when she wants to joins an accessory making class, meeting the owner of a quiet accessory store?  
  
3) Nostalgic Complex  
  
4) Ao no Hitoiro  
At first, Sakurai thinks Aoi-kun is kinda scary, but when he speaks up against a group of girls that are making fun of Sakurai's inexperience, she slowly grows more fond of him.  
  
5) Akai Koi no Territory  
I love cats! But cats seem to hate me… At that time I met a cat-tamer, Kai-kun?!

title: Haru ni Tomoru
description: Kasuga, now a high school student, had one regret from his junior high school days: he had to get a girlfriend. However, as soon as he entered school, he was involved in a traffic accident and had to come to school late.... When he goes to school for the first time in a while, he happens to see Mr. Morikawa, who is in the same grade as him, in the hallway and falls in love with him at first sight! The good-natured Kasuga changes his character to a "cool person," which Mr. Morikawa says is his type, and takes on the challenge of confessing his feelings to her..! This is a cute love story about two freshmen!

title: Boku wa Konomama Kaeranai
description: Upbeat Ritsuro and downbeat Ken have been longtime friends. Although Ken leads a dark life of prostitution after dropping out of high school, Ritsuro still cares about him. When Ritsuro realizes that what Ken wants is something more than friendship he vacillates between Ken and his girlfriend Moeko, setting the stage for a bizarre love triangle.

title: Yatteranneeze!
description:
Fujimoto Hiroya is at the top of his class. He's the Student Council Vice President, spends all his time studying, and is the idol of all the "good girls". But the truth is, he'd trade it all just for the chance to be someone else… someone popular, outgoing and carefree… Someone like Masaki.  
  
Masaki's what Fujimoto's friends would call an "idiot". He'd rather play soccer than study, almost never cracks a book, and is popular with all the "normal" kids. He's got flashy clothes, bleached hair and a reputation just as lousy as Fujimoto's is good.  
  
In the summer of Fujimoto's freshman year of high school, he resolves to change his image and his life… all to make friends with Masaki. But can dyed hair, new clothes and a piercing really change a person inside?

title: Million no Spell
description:
Eye Yuki, the hero of this story, was an ordinary junior high school sophomore that anywhere he went, he called the Million from the possessions of his grandfather who had died. Yamada, would have to live in the quick guide to the top doll in favor of his classmate by some freak coincidence, and will learn the magic to undo her.  
At the School of Kurisuesu, Eye Yuki will become undisputed in the top class for using the magic of the Million.  
Such as the heart of the story or unaware of cheer, he is doing the game and are not described purposely, to show a poor ability to understand surface.  
Yamada was likely the result has been a runaway, etc. Some of my classmates and she associates with Yamada.  
Interest to the news is thin, and I did not notice the magic cult kidnapping grace to be pointed out to us.

title: Linden Tree
description: 10 years ago, Nakahara Asami's parents died in a car accident, leaving her an orphan. Ever since then, a mysterious guardian named "Ashinaga Ojisan" ("Daddy Long-Legs") has taken care of her education and finances on the condition that she work hard at school to become a doctor like her parents and that she never ask about his identity. This year, she is starting her first year at medical school. While adjusting to her new and separate life from her boyfriend Katsumi, she meets classmate Moritsugu Shun and a handsome new professor named Hayasaka Tasuku, who both seem to have secrets of their own. What experiences await her and will she ever find out who her Ashinaga Ojisan is?

title: The Season of Love
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
1) Crescendo  
Kazune, Yuzuru and Yanna loved the band "Crescent" and were inseperable. Then Yanna reveals she loves Yuzuru and Kazune cheers her on. Kazune discovers her family is moving away. And Yuzuru calls Kazune to ask if she'd like to go with him to a "Crescent" concert…  
  
2) Mousou Reijou  
Nene has inhired a special gift to turn the "beautiful" scenes in her head into reality. Only the one she loves with all her heart can help her control it. One day she gets dropped in front of Tatsumis house, the boy she loves. He has to take care of her from now on…  
  
3) Kokoro Prism  
Haircut, makeup and contact lenses. The new me. Nahi uses her day off from cram school to go to the beach as a different person. Her classmates don't recognize her. Beach bums try to pick her up. She's saved by a mysterious boy named Yoh who says, "Don't I know you from somewhere…?"  
  
4) Link - Kimi no Tenohira  
Miyuu was devastated when she saw her boyfriend kiss a

title: Bùkěnéng de Shì
description: A complicated web of relationships between two sets of childhood friends. How can all of them reach their happily ever after?

title: Yuki, Tokidoki Suki
description: High schooler Mao is excited for her first Christmas with her classmate and boyfriend Takeuchi. They have been dating since summer. And according to her friends Christmas is an event for first kisses…?!

title: Onaji Sora wo Miteiru
description:
1. Onaji Sora wo Miteiru (I'm looking at the same sky)  
Rin is always sending messages with her phone and doesn't speak to anyone. Even though she's like that, Taka got interested in her and keeps on following her. But why doesn't she want to look at him…? And who is this mysterious person with whom she always exchanges messages with…?  
  
2. Natsu ni Ochiru  
  
3. Bokura no Renai Hierarchy  
  
4. Samishii Yoru wa

title: Enren Lover
description: When Tousaka-kun helps Hiyori out of a troublesome situation, it left an impression on her so much she wants to always be with him. But when she hears that he is transferring, can Hiyori handle the distance that's slowly growing between them?

title: Keppeki Danshi Kouryaku-hou
description: Takumi is a neat freak who shies away from touching others, while Sakura is a goofball who tends to overstep personal boundaries. Even though it pains him to do so, smart and successful Takumi finds himself tutoring Sakura on a regular basis. Over the course of their study sessions, they finally start to break the ice. But then, Takumi discovers that Sakura is actually a...The love story of a guy with no sense of personal space and a stoic student council member trying to overcome germaphobia.

title: Honey Vanilla Latte Please!!
description:
what is the taste of love? is it extraordinary sweet? Or….  
is love really sweet? Or does it become sweet because of many many fights?  
  
Yuna never wanted to talk to the handsome boys of the neighbor high school. And then she was confessed by the most beautiful of them, she can't believe it. does he just tease her…? Can she believe in this love…??

title: Her Twin Brothers!
description: When a love story is hindered by the existence of two troubling twin brothers who always terrorizes their love story.

title: Cash Girl
description: Nohae has been crushing on Dona, his neighbor, since they were younger. Dona is a girl who was obsessed with money as a child and would make her childhood friend Nohae actually pay her. Time has passed and now she's a teen, broke and living on the streets with her dad. Her dad meets Nohae and arranges for Dona to live with him. But Dona's not your typical heroine. She's one of those fake people, maintaining a perfect image at school but in front of her parents she's self-absorbed, a glutton, and is quick to nab a meal or swindle money. She's quick to anger and has a grudge against Nohae, but he likes her so much he's completely unaware.

title: Love Knife
description:
1-3. **Love Knife**: Afraid of being alienated, Asahi doesn’t say what she really thinks. Sou, who is always true to himself, has Asahi’s admiration. She is about to go to a love hotel with her boyfriend that she doesn’t even like, Youhei, and gets saved by Sou… The admiration for Sou starts turning into love. Even if she turns everyone around her into an enemy, she chooses Sou but…!?  
  
4. **Antique Girl**  
  
5.  **Tea Time wa Mayonaka ni**

title: Kiss, Zekkou, Kiss Bokura no Baai
description:
Continuation of Kiss, Zekkou, Kiss, a shoujo manga following the relationship between Sakisaka and Hatori–the ups and downs, misunderstandings, the tears and the laughter.  
  
A unique thing about this series is that each story/situation is told twice–once from the girl's perspective, and once from the guy's perspective! The reader ends up learning what each side was thinking.

title: Taiikukan no Ura no Ura
description:
What is the strange event that a high school boy encounters after chasing a JK who confessed? An amazing 8P romantic comedy!!!

Published in Weekly Young Magazine 2020 Issue 27.

title: Yankee to Matsuge Egaki Oroshi Doujinshi
description: * Alternative Official Raw - [CMOA](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/211618/)

title: A Single Snowflake of Love Falls: Forecast of Changing Colors
description:
There's a jinx at Haruru's school - if a couple sees the blue train at 6 am together, they'll be together forever! But if a couple sees the blue train at 10 pm together, they'll break up!  
Haruru is going out with Nagi, a boy who goes to another school, and their love is just starting to blossom. But what happens when Haruru happens to see the 6 am blue train with someone else?! (From: Nagareboshi Manga)

title: A Dream Forgotten
description: Life is a continuous cycle of endless dreaming and countless choices. Lucky are those who discovered their dreams early in life, but it is never too late for those who still haven’t. Kaden dreams of being a singer; Layza is still finding hers. When two people in pursuit of their place in this world grow closer together, what will happen when life is hell-bent on keeping them farther apart from one another? One thing is for sure: no one gets out unscathed.

title: Katakoi × Alliance
description: Akito fell in love the moment he saw Kiriya, a part-time math instructor, while on the school's rooftop. Even though they have never talked, Akito looks forward to every time he can spy on Kiriya from the rooftop. One day when Akito sees Kiriya, Akito rushes in to see why this math teacher is crying alone. In a panic, Akito asks Kiriya to teach him math. As they spend more time together, Akito realizes Kiriya is in love with another teacher at their school. Akito refuses to give up on Kiriya, though, and proposes they enter a One-sided Love x Alliance!

title: Kimi wa Itoshi no Yuutousei
description:
Horikawa Kunihiro x Kashuu Kiyomitsu

High school AU (not reincarnation). A romantic comedy about Kashuu-kun, at the request of his homeroom teacher, becoming friends with Horikawa-kun, a top-performing honor student yet has a habit of cutting class.

title: Konyaku 0-Nichi Kon wa Dou desu ka?
description: High school student Yayoi and her childhood sweetheart Hayato, are married! Yayoi is very thrilled to be married to him, but she currently has a problem. Even though they live together, they never once had a lovey-dovey time together, let alone a kiss. Yayoi feels insecure and starts to doubt him. Could it be all in her head?

title: Yasashiku nai Kimi ga Suki
description: Chico sádico y poco honesto + Chica soñadora amante de los mangas ¿Es el inicio de un inocente amor?

title: Flower
description: 14-year-old Aoi is an upbeat girl who has big dreams for her future, though her main one at the moment is getting into N High. Aoi is both popular and pretty, and has even been voted Pure Teen Magazine's reader-model. Accompanying her is her childhood sweetheart Ryuuta, the number one slacker in the school. Though the two bicker often, mostly about Ryuuta's consistently low scores and lack of studying, it is apparent that they both harbor feelings for one another. Unfortunately, Aoi's dreams and love are tested when an accident renders her handicapped. Aoi and Ryuuta must now find a way to cope and see if their love endures the many trials ahead.

title: The Paradise of Wolves
description:
Story 1: Ookamitachi no Tengoku (The Paradise of Wolves)  
"Be careful of the student council." Although she heard of that rumor, Mizuki, who has just transferred, starts a fight with a member of student council. Of course they start picking on her and they force her to enter the dangerous "Tagging Contest" that's sponsored by the student council…?! But why can't anyone help her…?  
  
Story 2: Handsome Girl is Yours!  
Kiyomi is a Boy?! Well don't be tricked!!  
Sakura kiyomi is in love with her best friend Haruhito whom she always protected and cared since kids, but this sick love its just one-sided. So, In order to prevent him from having a stable girlfriend, she interferes by cross-dressing as a Handsome Boy who always snaps away his girlfriends!! But, what will happen when a super-high-level-rival appears?? Will she be able to make this rival fall in love with her BOY-SIDE, and leave Haruhito alone?? Or will He…  
  
Story 3: A Phobia For the Opposite Sex

title: So Bad!
description:
Because Yukino's mom is a housekeeper for the Renjo familiy, she has to suffer the pain of hearing her mom praise the family she takes care of. And this is why Yukino has been trying to beat Renjo Tamaki for most of her life, so her mom would care more about her than the Renjo family. But when her mom gets sick, and she has to take care of the Renjo family instead, her goals change a little.  
  
Also contains the side story "Kira Kira Suruhimade" in the final volume.

title: Natsuzora Lemon Biscuit
description: There’s a reason why I help clean the school swimming pool. And the reason is a bit sentimental.

title: Kare ga Megane wo Hazusutoki
description: "Could I take the place of my brother?" When Tomoe's best friend, Ichita develops an interest in the new transfer student, it affects Tomoe. Not knowing the reason for this, a corner of his heart slows. In the wake of all that, he becomes close with Ichita's younger brother, Kenji. The two of them meet, but one day, on top of pointing out Tomoe's feelings for Ichita, Kenji also confesses his own feelings. It's a story full of waves and waves of emotions and angst youth.

title: Love Fighter!
description: Nami has passed the super difficult high school exam in order to meet the generous person who had helped her in the haunted house in the past. However, it turned out that he was the infamous almighty cold-blooded king, Haruka Sakuragi. On top of that, even before Nami had the chance to confess her feelings, she became the 100th girl to be rejected by him! But she’s prepared to put up a fight. A war over love is about to begin!

title: Doushiyou mo nai Kimi
description: Saki, a first-year high school student, has been having trouble keeping up with her friends' love stories lately. One day, she runs into Kyo, a boy who is popular on a different level with his beautiful face and kind, gentlemanly personality, and ends up kissing him...?

title: Innocent World
description: In our classroom, everyone has worries behind their smiles. Parents divorcing, complexes, kissing… The main characters in these stories are living with pain or anxiety, but they are still shining brilliantly.

title: Frogman (Oneshot)
description:
Pilot chapter of the Frogman manga series. Published in the Young Animal magazine in 2008.

Michiru is a high school boy who isn't really good at anything, including sports and socializing. He likes watching one of his classmates, Haruka, as she practices swimming. Haruka happens to be the only member of the swimming club associated with his school. As she and the coach search for members, she notices him and innocently believes he's been watching her because he really wants to swim. Michiru is unable to say no to her invitation to the club, even though he's never swam before and has no idea how it's done. Michiru finds his life changing as Haruka patiently teaches him how to swim.

title: After Friend
description: How long can a 'childhood friendship' last? This is the story of those two who are close yet distant.

title: Real Heroine
description: In the new semester of my second year of high school, Beni-chan, the girl sitting next to me, was the only one who could get a kick out of my sloppy self-introduction. She is the center of the class and has an older boyfriend, but she seems to be interested in Chika-kun, who is also in the same class.......you may think it is a royal school girls' manga, but something is different⁉ This is a love story with 200% sympathy, depicting the love of high school students in their own size.

title: Die for me
description: Su Keke, a super schoolmaster who only wants to learn, she then accidentally encounters a magic stick on the way home, turning her into a charming physique. Since then, life has undergone earth-shaking changes. Faced with all kinds of confession and pursuits every day, Su Keke just wants to scream and die! Die, everyone who loves me just die!

title: Kanoko Momogumi!
description: Momoki Kanoko hides her gift for combat so those around her will accept her, and learns to show her true colors.

title: Secret Princess
description: When Kana was 6 years old, her best friend Kouki moved away to Hokkaido. But before he left, they promised to meet again and get married. For seven years, Kana has kept true to this promise, but when Kouki finally returns, things are not as she had hoped them to be…

title: Asa no Jumyou
description: A boy and a girl set out to determine the lifespan of morning.

title: Mega Giga Panic Shiritsu Renshuu Gakuen
Dynamite Beauty!!
description: A local high school is thrown into chaos when Wakaba Sakurada, a gorgeous 21-year-old teacher-in-training, joins the faculty. Wakaba goes to incredible lengths in her attempt to become the best art teacher she can be, including modelling nude for her students!

title: Sensei no Kanojo
description:
"I'd never met a teacher like him!"  
  
Her breath stopped, and so did the air around her. She wanted to show him how she felt. Her heart was shaking. She'd never seen someone as beautiful as a painting before. She fell in love for the first time with her teacher. In an attempt at getting closer to him, she attended a goukon as an older student named "Mika." They had a lot of fun but at the end of the night he told her that he would never go out with one of his students!  
  
Even so, she decided to meet him again as "Mika." She wanted to be close to him more than anything, and she continued to lie to him.

title: Kanojo to 2P
description:
[Junior high school couple's blushing punishment game!]

One day, junior high school boy Tendo Jin (13) beat Yuko Sega, the cutest girl in his class, at a game of rock-paper-scissors, and she confessed to him and decided to go out with him. [Romantic comedy for two players] with a bit of a naughty punishment game opens!! Youthful graffiti with retro and warm patterns that won't stop you from grinning!!

title: Love Live! - High school days (Doujinshi)
description: Maki x Rin

title: Persona 3 - Girl Meets Boy (Doujinshi)
description: Akihiko catches the FeMC wearing a rather unfamiliar attire. He does not take it well, and a series of awkward situations ensue as a result of that.

title: Sentimental Honey
description: A cute short story about a girl who's a tomboy, but whenever she's around him, she seems to turn girly.

title: Sumire Reborn.com
description:
"The corner suits me. Or that is how it should be…"  
  
Sumire, a very low self-esteemed, gloomy girl had accidentally stained a school idol's shirt. He demands to pay him back by a date?

title: Wakari Nikuine Sano-kun Wa
description:
Two classmates sit next to each other every day, but they've never spoken even once. One day, after a haircut mishap, one of them finally gathers the courage to start a conversation...!? A heart-fluttering love story between two innocent souls!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Princess and a Bum
description: Who am I? I”m Gi-ryum, a tall, handsome bachelor, and the coolest guy in the country who even makes O△ sama (Reference to “Yon-sama”: Bae, Yon-Jun from Winter Sonata) cry at my beauty. One day, I received classified info of the princess enrolling in a regular high school.Huhuhu. Can I snag the princess with my irresistible beauty?!I will be the king”s new son-in-law! (Chuckles)

title: Gakuen Heaven - Double Scramble
description: Asahina Yuki, a young man with no special skills save for good luck, was invited to attend Bell Liberty, a legendary high school for elite students. Immediately after arriving, he was given an armband by a mysterious ninja who begged him to protect the school. That armband is the proof of being the Ace of the school - the student council president!

title: Gokusen (Official Colored)
description: Fresh out of college, Kumiko "Yankumi" Yamaguchi becomes a math teacher at an all-boys high school. Unfortunately for her, she's assigned by the school board as the homeroom teacher for class 3-D, which happens to be the class of delinquent students. When the class attempts to make a living hell out of Yankumi's career, they fail as her persistence and aggression gain her respect. However, little does anyone in the school know that Yankumi is actually heir to the Kuroda Ikka—one of Tokyo's most powerful yakuza clans.

title: Kokuchou
description:
*Unrelated to the film starring Natalie Portman, Yamagishi's Black Swan predates the Hollywood movie by 16 years*

One-shot compilation of Yamagishi focusing on the psychology and turmoil of ballet dancers. Includes the following:

- **Black Swan** (黒鳥-ブラックスワン-, Kokucho - Black Swan) -
The real-life choreographic genius George Balanchine took five wives during his lifetime, all of whom were his "muse," but none of them lasted long. 
The work depicts their anguish in the form of a monologue by his fourth wife, Maria Tallchief, a real-life ballet dancer also known for her Native American ancestry. 
In addition to Tallchief, Vera Zorina, his third wife, and Tanaquil Le Clercq, his fifth and last wife, also appear in the work. (description from wikipedia.ja)
- **Kifune's Road** (貴船の道, Kifune no Michi)
- **Depths of Silence** (緘黙の底, Kanmoku no Soko)
- **Hariti** (鬼子母神 収録, Kishibonjin)

title: Ike Ike! Nounai Pink-chan
description:
So love is inspiring these dangerous thoughts!? Such is the heart of this delusional love comedy!

Comico.jp page:

title: Bitter Suger
description: On the day of her class change, Yona, now a senior in high school, comes across the scene where Shin, who has outstanding looks, is confessing his love to her. She is told, "Give it up. There is no hope for you." Yona is shocked to hear his blunt refusal. Being an introvert and not very good at expressing her feelings in words, she could not understand why he would go to such lengths to say such hurtful words. However, when Yona is approached by Riko, a "friend" of Arata's, Yona is asked to join her...? This is a coming-of-age love story in which Yona discovers "sweet and sad love" for the first time.

title: Cool, na no ni Yoru wa Amakute. - Doukyou Hito wa Dekiai Chuudoku
description: Hanazumi, a high school senior who hates men due to a trauma in her past, has to live with the cool and mysterious prince Sunaga Kiyo at the same school due to family circumstances! Hanazumi is confused by Kiyo's closeness to her despite her declaration that she hates men. At first, Hanazumi is repulsed by Kiyo, but then Kiyo asks Hanazumi to help her cure her man-hatred...?

title: Boku no Ichiban Kowai Hito
description: Yumemi You is a 16-year-old boy who grew up with the idea of a perfect romantic school life; however, things turned out very differently from what he expected. With the help of his childhood friend Kamio Souta, they both hang a tanzaku with their wishes. You wishes to have a girlfriend, and Kamio wishes for his friend's wish to come true. To You's surprise, the next day he is visited by a mysterious girl.

title: Dear Us
description: In the year 2110, universes and worlds are united. Two kids transfer into Tsuyo's (Omega) school, one is an Alpha, and one is a Degen.

title: Study!
description: Misora had amazingly managed to get into a prestigious school which has 80% of its students managing to get into Tokyo University. However, because of that, everyday ever since school started, she’s always been forced by her grandfather who runs a tuition centre to just study, study, study…

title: Doukyochuu no Osananajimi wa Aishitakute, Modokashii
description: Hana's parents have arranged for her to live with her childhood friend Kiouha. Kouou is handsome, perfectly behaved and popular, but in front of Hana, he is black-hearted and has a poisonous tongue. Hana has nothing but anxiety about living with such a Kouou, but in fact, Kouou has always doted on Hana...? Kiouha, who loves her childhood friend Hana so much that she can't be honest with her, is frustrated, but she will stop at nothing for Hana's sake! A sweet childhood friendship and cohabitation love!

title: Miki-san to Sugoshita Koukou Jidai
description: It all started with a trivial matter. Tsujimoto, a dull and plain boy, and Miki, a gal with a bad reputation. In their third year of high school, they were in the same class for the first time and became friends. They studied for tests together, worried about their future paths, had lovers, and broke up. It's nothing special, but it's something they will never forget. This is a story of the spring, summer, fall, and winter of these two uneven people.

title: Sakuranbou ★ Rabu Inosento
description: Spin-off cặp phụ của Công cuộc khủng bố tình yêu

title: Hand's
description: Daigo wants to be a hero, but his father, who was once the ace of the Japanese handball team, is now a bum who loses all of their money in gambling. His father visits a coach and asks him to take care of Daigo, because he got into debt and is running from the yakuza. The coach thinks Daigo's an outstanding talent and is thrilled at the prospect of coaching him, and sends his daughter to go pick him up. Daigo then ends up living with the coach and his daughter. What will happen now?

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - I Want To Shine By Your Side (Doujinshi)
description:
Tendou Maya and Hanayagi Kaoruko, both classmates and actresses-in-training at the prestigious Seisho Music Academy, notice that their respective dance partners, Saijou Claudine and Isurugi Futaba, are spending a little too much time together lately. In their jealousy and disgruntlement, Kaoruko and Maya devise a plan to put on a performance that'll remind their dance partners exactly whose side they should be standing by.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

title: They, Too, Love
description: Jung Euimoon and Eun Myroyung are both members of the second Biology Club, which has been downgraded to the oldest facilities in the school to make room for the new Biology Club. Jung Euimoon uses Bunsen burners to cook his breakfast and routinely camps out at the Biology Club room to get away from his numerous siblings. Eun is a loner and reads tarot cards–which always foretell unhappy auguries–to amuse herself. They each think the other is strange. These two seem to be opposites, but they have more in common than they think. Who knows what the future holds in store for them.

title: Sensei, Sotsugyou
description:
Collection of oneshots:  
  
- Sensei, Sotsugyou  
Soudo sensei has been confessed by a popular third year student. But they're student and teacher, such romance is forbidden, even after he graduates…  
  
- Sensei to Atashi to Kento-kun (Sensei, me and Kento-kun)  
Kato Ichika is in love- with Takatsuki sensei! She is so "in love" to the point she made an alias in order to "befriend" him on twitter, but she has no face to face connection with him. When she foolishly ran into a door, she bumped into a certain kouhai called Kento-kun. From him, she finally has a link to her sensei. Will Ichika be able to successfully capture sense's heart, or will her heart belong to someone else?  
  
- Koi ni Ochita Sagishi-kun (Imposter That Fell in Love)  
Haruto thinks all women are easy. All you have to do is say a few sweet words to them, and they'll adore you, especially if you're handsome. That is why is he a marriage swindler, currently aiming for a certain nurse. Whilst he was meeting her, he

title: My Wonderful Sweets
description: Mizuki is a regular high school girl that loves sweets and pink things. One day, she is suddenly confessed to by Akiyoshi Kazuma, one of the most rumoured delinquents in school. At first, she gets scared and wants to break up with him already, but as she hangs out with him more, her feelings start to change.

title: His Secret Hobby
description:
Kang Yeon-woo, a physical education student with a strong physique has a secret and that is, he likes pretty and cute things. His hobby is decorating diaries! Famous as "Strawberry Fairy" on SNS, he goes to the stationery festival himself after hearing that his favorite artist's new sticker will be released. But due to a turn of events, Kang Yeon-woo's identity as Strawberry Fairy is revealed! How will his favorite artist react now that she knows the face behind the famous cute user Strawberry Fairy?

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/zuoshouzhangdenanren/list?title_no=1848)

title: Space Street
description:
A gag manga* that takes place after *Horizon of the East, Eternity of the West*, focusing on Tada and Frol's misadventures at the Cosmo Academy.

**NOTE: Included in most editions of They Were Eleven! alongside the sequel. Absent from both official English releases.*

title: 16-sai nanode Kekkon Shimasu!!
description: Chiyuri is a teenage girl who desperately wants to get married to her childhood friend, Daisuke.

title: Tsuyogari
description: Kikuchi Ima”s first love was her sister”s boyfriend, who is 11 years her senior. Nine years later, she meets him again … and this time, he is her homeroom teacher. What will become of this one-sided love?

title: Fiance-sama kara Nigerarenai
description: Natsuki is told by her father that she has a marriage on her 16th birthday!! What a partner… Rui, the successor to the Rensui Group, one of Japan's leading conglomerates!! He is very popular at school as a prince, and he has a secret that no one knows..?!!

title: Candy Flower
description:
A collection of short stories on love and romance by author Yamada Daisy.

Chapters:
1. **Candy Flower** (キャンディ・フラワー)
Kobayakawa loves to tend the Garden Club plot behind the school and dream about handsome Yagi. Mizuki Aihara loves to sleep away the day on the garden bench and mooch her candies. But Aihara proves to be a good source of advice on how to catch Yagi's interest. Soon Kobayakawa basks in the glow of Yagi and friends attention. But she's pressured to leave her beloved garden…  
2. **Love Has Begun.** (Koi ga, Hajimaru., 恋が，はじまる。)
3. *Tomato to 14-sai* (トマトと14歳)
4. *Yuuki no Hana* (ゆきのはな)
5. *Masshiro* (まっしろ)
6. *Petit Tomato to 15-sai* (プチトマトと15歳)

title: Love Burial
description: A collection of short stories by Kusunoki Kei.

title: Ouji-sama Sama no Jijou.
description: Popular boy Kagami is horrified when his secret is sniffed out by the infamous anime club President, Tsukishima. Tsukishima agrees to keep his secret, as long as he submits to her terms…

title: Suki de Shikatanai
description:
1. Can't Stop My Love  
"You like me. So I'm holding you now." Shiratsuka sensei held Isoyama after saying that. Holding each other without love, bodily contact without feelings… Even after sensei made Isoyama cry, the feeling Isoyama has just refused to back down. What does sensei really think of Isoyama?  
  
2. My Love Overflows  
Momozono was heart broken when Isoyama expressed his love for sensei. When Kuwana stumbled into his life, Momo started to get confused. Why is he thinking about Kuwana all the time? Is he not that into Isoyama after all?  
  
3. I Don't Come To Like You  
After Momo moved out, Yone got a new roommate, Kei. The only problem is, he ran away from Kei three years ago. Did Kei follow him here?  
  
4. My Love Overflows (Extra)  
Momo comes home sick… how will Kuwana help him get rid of the fever?

title: You're Mine
description: A rich young master and an abandoned son in an orphanage. Two people with different identities and positions, yet became good brothers for ten years.

title: Bokura ga Haru wo Tsugeru Koro
description:
Genial, handsome, and popular, Ebisu Shugo is the "perfect" boy who has always lived up to everyone's expectations ever since childhood, being "everyone's Ebisu-kun."However, when he entered high school, he lost his position as the most popular guy in school to Meguro Saku, who was on the basketball team.

Ebisu is determined to beat Meguro and regain his "number one spot," but when he meets a girl, Shinsaku Kayaba, his world starts to turn towards a different direction—!?

(Source: Nakayoshi, translated)

title: Koi Suta
description: Shizuku has a unrequited love for Ichinomiya-sensei. But since Ichinomiya-sensei is her sister’s boyfriend, it’s a love that definitely won’t come true… She's trying hard to quickly find a new love, and she's been rushing to search for her soul mate within 10 years! When she went out searching for that fated person, she had a horrible meeting with Hatori from the tennis club.

title: Haikyu!! - Lolicon no Shinyuu ga Gouhou Loli ni Koi o Shita!! (Doujinshi)
description: Tiêu đề nói lên tất cả. Tsukishima Kei x Fem!Hinata Shoyo.

title: Ricochet to the future
description:
Kaon Aki (18) is her high school academy's biggest delinquent.   
  
She has a problem and that's her temper issues. She is a failed experiment of her father whom is a mad scientist.   
Her normal life changed drastically since then. She became something and someone she never thought she'd become.  
  
Whenever she gets really furious, her body and subconscious time skips 10 years to the future and returns back to the present randomly. Most of the time it's for her to calm down and then she reverts back to the normal time.  
  
One day she reverts 10 years into the future but this time she manages to clash with a girl from the future…

title: Karekano Gokko
description: Mizuki is the most beautiful girl in the school. Even though she met a boy who's as beautiful as her?!

title: First Love Malisa
description: The sweet and the sour of a first love! Boy or girl, everyone is looking forward to that first encounter. No words can describe the nervousness and excitement felt at that destined moment! Perhaps the story of your first love, too, is collected in the First Love MALISA series. Malisa Lin's new work is filled with delicate artwork, elaborate drama, rich laugh-out-loud moments, and perfect endings. This series tells stories of "falling in love"…

title: Ohana Moyou no One-Piece
description: Tomboyish Ayuka is in love with her childhood friend Sakamoto. At the start of her third year of middle school she meets a new friend Sally-chan. Sally-chan also seems to have feelings for Sakamoto. Will Ayuka have the courage to confess her feelings or will Sally-chan beat her to it?

title: Doki Doki Literature Club - Your reality (Doujinshi)
description: A DDLC fan manga where everything is same but at the same time isn't. The story follows a young boy called Michael and his friends in the literature club. One day they got an emergency and Michael with Monika will go fix it. Little did they know it was a trap.

title: Nakanu Hotaru no Nemuru Basho
description:
Teru, who lost her sister at a young age, decides to enjoy his youth to the fullest for her sister. Then he meets the man of her destiny, Soutarou. But he claims that he was the one who killed Teru's sister, Hotaru!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yes! High Step Jun! (Nakayoshi DX)
description:
Jun is an intelligent and resourceful girl who spends her time creating all kinds of inventions. She creates a robot, Kichinosuke, who follows her everywhere and becomes her close friend.   
  
She falls in love with Zero, a motorcycle enthusiast who prefers to travel the roads rather than study. Their mutual love of mechanical objects brings them closer together and Jun is determined to have Zero as her boyfriend.  
  
Unfortunately for Jun, he doesn’t even seem to notice her feelings!

title: Shuko's Snack
description: Kenji Yashima has been receiving hand-made snacks from his neighbour, Shuko Kojima, who moved in when he was seven. Shuko was good at everything, and what he doesn't understand is why she would bother with a guy like him.

title: Girl Queen
description: Class rivals June and Lucia vie for the honor of being named the Queen of Light, entrusted with protecting the people from the King of Darkness. June is an attractive girl whose feisty, hot temper and general laziness may prevent her from receiving the crown. Lucia has a more regal quality and a strong desire to match, but she is always overshadowed by June. Will petty jealousies, love triangles, and one cute boy interfere with the Queen's royal duty?!

title: Boku no Hane wa Kimi
description: All this time, Aki has harbored a one-sided crush for a boy she saw jumping higher than anyone else. During the spring when she's in grade 9, Okumura transfered to her class. After seeing his jump, she has the feeling that he's the boy she once saw, and she started to notice him more. And then, she heard an unbelievable rumor about him…

title: Brothers Conflict Anthology - Beloved Blue
description:
Various mangaka take part in this second anthology of short stories involving the brothers in *Brothers Conflict* (see also "Perfect Pink" Anthology). Characters featured in "Beloved Blue" include Iori, Futo, Masaomi, Azusa, Yusuke, Ukyo, and Juli.  
  
- Side Masaomi: Mero  
- Side Ukyo : MORINO Mizu  
- Side Azusa : SAKAMOTO Sayo  
- Side Iori : HIDOH Ren  
  
- Side Yusuke : SOUKA Haruhi  
Yusuke manages to invite Ema on a date. Will his fantasies come true?  
  
- Side Futo : NOGAKI Suzume  
- Side Juli : AOI Mito  
- All Brothers : COTORINO Deathco  
- Editorial  
  
N.B. Not to be confused with *Brothers Conflict* "Brilliant Blue".  
Based on the light novel series *Brothers Conflict* and its otome game (visual novel) and anime adaptations.

title: 18 diary
description:
A collection of one-shots:  
  
1. 18 Diary – Uchiyama Ayako has had a one-sided crush on classmate and good friend Kitamura Tooru since they started high school, but his sights are set on another girl. During their last summer together as classmates, she agrees to teach him to swim, but his sole motivation seems to be to impress that girl…  
  
2. 17's Seisho – Mizutani, depressed that her parents are filing for divorce, drinks alone at a bar when Sakuma her playboy classmate finds her and hits on her. They end up having a one night stand, but that's when all the trouble begins…  
  
3. Tadashii Hoshi no Miagekata – Kurahashi has been taking care of her little brother Takumu since her mother died. She has her reservations, however, since she can never seem to get the inward Takumu to open up to her. One day, however, Takumu shows signs of emotion when he sees her classmate Hokuto dance at the park…

**Note:**  The following alternative titles do not have their country flags listed:
*

title: Kono Ie de Kimi to
description:
Tachibana Itsuka has always planned to live on her own once she became a high school student. On the day she's supposed to move into an apartment building, she finds it burnt and unfit for living. She's forced to live in the house of the landlady's son, along with two other women, and starting from day one, none of them gets along at all.  
  
Includes oneshot:  
Pure Heart Broken - To Rise to the House's Drama

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai - Moto Daikirai na Koibito
My Kuudere Boyfriend
description: Hina Fujimoto, a high school student who has lived her days without falling in love, is suddenly shot by a classmate named Kazuya. Will a despicable love story begin to blossom?

title: Yu Ai
description: Yusuke falls in love at first sight with Ai Aizawa, with whom he exchanged greetings as soon as he entered high school. Yusuke wants to talk to her, but he can't get the ball rolling and ends up following her. Yusuke's friend Hiroki accuses him of being a stalker, but Yusuke doesn't realize it. Then Ai, who knows that Yusuke has been following her, directly asks her why she has been following him…

title: Bara to Sumire to
description: Izumozaki Sumire was accepted into Ojika High School. Her older brother Satoshi was strangely against her entering that school. But she wanted to experience high school life at the same school he attended no matter what. Subsequently the truth about her older brother’s real identity comes to light…!

title: Dear Diary
description: Hyobi is a famous teen star on TV who has lived her whole life as her mama’s doll. Suddenly, Hyobi’s mother decides to send her back to high school on a whim. Hyobi feels lost in all this and she doesn’t have a single friend at school. Then she meets a girl named Soyule, an outcast of the class, and Soyule's childhood friend Chanbi. Now, Hyobi feels drawn to Soyule and Chanbi, for they don’t know who Hyobi is outside of school…

title: Guuzen ka Unmei ka
description:
- Guuzen ka Unmei ka  
Ren-chan has a problem: Whenever the girl he confesses to begins to like him back, he gets tired of the relationship. This time, the person he likes is his friend, Ari. Ari agrees to go out with him, thinking that he'll get tired of it if she does, and they'll go back to being friends. But will it really turn out that way…?  
  
- I Miss  
After one of Ninomiya Majyu's girl friend declines to go to a live concert with her due to certain circumstances,  
Makyu's new guy friend Aoi Kou asks if he can go with Majyu instead. Assuming this to be just a simple friends get together, Majyu accepts, but is latter shocked to discover from her girl friends that Kou might actually have feelings for her?  
Contemplating what she should do next, Majyu runs into a beautiful girl who also has the surname of Aoi, and is amazed to discover that the weak-bodied girl called Mai is in fact Kou's sister (although not blood related.) But what's this? Mai might have more then just siste

title: Nanatsuiro Drops
description:
Based on the Eroge by UNiSONSHIFT.  
  
We've got our main character, Tsuwabaki, a normal student, but one day he bumps into a weird guy with "not cosplay ears" who gives him a drink. It transforms Tsuwabaki into a chibi lamb! The teacher explains everything, and the teacher tells him the only way he can get back to normal is to find a chosen girl and have her catch the 7 Stardrops. The only thing is, is he can't reveal his true identity.

title: Hakkou Seinen
description: Reiji Kubo is an undercover fudanshi who one day meets Yuya Yagasaki, a bookseller who is secretly in love with him. The story focuses on how Yagasaki starts, follows and finally reaches the depths of Kubo.

title: ...no Onna
description:
This is a "Girl's Diary" of four very different girls' lives recorded in four short stories.  
  
1. The O Girl:  
She tells him that they'll start as "just friends" but he seems to feel differently, telling her that she can't cheat on him?!  
  
2. The S Girl:  
Always acting as the servant of the guy she likes, Rei-chan is starting to get fed up with this lifestyle.  
  
3. The Girl in the Legend:  
Just as Tanoko has decided her fate as being only remembered for dying at her school, she meets the most popular guy, who seems to have a problem with being alone…  
  
4. The Negative Girl:  
All the guys Hinako has dated have ended up in accidents, their lives being almost completely ruined while being with her. Hinako believes that her so-called "negative aura" isn't just coincidence.

title: Aoyama-kun no Amasugiru Okaeshi
description:
University student, Ina, who is always devoted to the person she loves, always ends up being a convenient woman.

One day, she lends a handkerchief to Aoyama-kun, who is famous for his saltiness, and receives an over-the-top gift in return!
"No, this doesn't balance out, so I have to thank him..."
The loop of repayment doesn't stop because of her devoted nature, and the two gradually become friends...?

title: Fuichin Goodbye!
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Mangaka Toshiko Ueda, born in 1917 (Taisho 6) and died in 2008 (Heisei 20). This is a story about a real tough woman 
who paved the way for female mangaka, a path that no one had yet taken. 

It can be said that the "history of women manga" in Japan began before the war, when a crazy girl named Toshiko Ueda
