made an imaginary picture in the high and wide sky of Harbin, Manchuria. 
Motoka Murakami puts his all into this book, the Blue Spring of manga. 

The long-awaited first volume in tankoban form!

title: Haru wa Kumo no Ue
description:
Fifteen-year-old Souta Tanaka is the kind of boy who quietly blends into the background, to the point that even his classmates struggle to remember his name. Still, hidden behind his ordinary days is a secret crush on Karen Kozakura, a famous influencer with over 100,000 followers on social media. Souta never thought someone like Karen would ever cross paths with him in any meaningful way. But after a chance encounter brings them together, he ends up listening to her worries about love...

A romantic comedy centered around a background character unfolds in the kindest way imaginable!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Koi, Koinegau
description: At a festival, Natsuno Miyata saw his classmate Nase shed tears for a dead goldfish. Ever since then he longs for her tears. But how can he make the confident and composed girl cry for someone like him?

title: Ouji-sama to Inu
description: Yuuri is an average girl who hopes to get good grades and go to a good college as a token of her appreciation for all the hard work her mother has done to raise her single-handedly. However, fate has different plans for her when she gets involved with raising star Haduki. While Haduki puts on a charming smile in front of his fans, beneath those pearly whites lurks a little demon. After Yuuri tackles him, thinking him a pervert (who is to blame her when he’s hiding in the bushes with a face mask and sunglasses on, he blackmails her into being his gopher…or more specifically, his dog!

title: Ogawa to Yukai na Saitoutachi
description:
Ogawa is a total pushover. So much that she's been voted the "most apologetic" and "most bossed around" girl in the school! So what happens when she gets dared to kick the "Three Feared Saitou" - the infamous boys who have bad reputations - behind the knees? They end up teaming up with her of course! The Saitous decide to protect pathetic Ogawa from being bullied–hilarity ensues!

[Wikipedia](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%B0%8F%E5%B7%9D%E3%81%A8%E3%82%86%E3%81%8B%E3%81%84%E3%81%AA%E6%96%8E%E8%97%A4%E3%81%9F%E3%81%A1)

title: Please Cure My Illness
description: Yu Zitian, a university student and music arranger was always questioned by record companies for being unemotional and being unable to write love songs. As someone who has been single since birth and has no interest in falling in love, Yu Zitian decided to ship his roommate and a junior to discover what love feels like! With Yu Zitian's unreliable assistance, how will the chemistry grow between this pair?

title: Bleak
description:
Bleak is a coming of age story, a mix of slice-of-life, lucid dreaming and fantasy.

AF is teenager in his second year of highschool, depressed with his life and disappointed with the world.
The thing is, when he gets depressed he sees three little things floating around him, this happens to him since his 10 years of age. Now 15(almost 16) his life gets a bit crazier, when he meets a transfer student in his class, Sane; and an old man in the underground train who he talks about dreams and lucid dreaming.
Suddenly he begins experiencing really strange dreams. Even making him unsure whats real and what´s not anymore.


I update the chapters first on my website every Friday night (GTM+0):


Follow me on facebook for more info and updates:


Thanks,
AI

title: Meru Meru Mail
description: Meiru Inamori is a mailing obsessed 16-year-old whom attends an all girls high school. One day she finds out that all of her friends have boyfriends, and finds herself wanting one as well; the only thing is that Meiru freezes up whenever a guy comes close to her. Will there ever be a guy able to free Meiru from her boy phobia?

title: Darling
description: Rio was living a perfectly normal high school life when cool and suave transfer student Tomo-chan entered his school. Rio admires his style, and watches as Tomo easily grabs the attention of the female student body – and of some teachers too. It's not until Tomo picks up Rio's dropped planner with a photo of his beloved idol, a male teacher, that they interact. Suspecting that Rio is gay, homophobic Tomo tells Rio he's going to 'cure' him by designing a special "Homo Fixing Training Regimen".

title: many
description:
Kikuyo is really popular in school and is confessed to by a lot of boys, but she is unable of rejecting them clearly, so Ryuu, her childhood friend always prepared to protect her, make then got away. What would happen when Kikuyo decide to go out with one of them? Which are the real feelings of Ryuu?  
(The main story is finished, three separated oneshot are left)

title: She’s The Mom Candidate
description: Xia is a girl that came from the future to prevent her mother from getting a disease. Her future father is about to meet her mother in school, so she sets out to find who her mother is. A girl that came from the future bringing many issues to the present in a story filled with antics

title: Kare wa, Watashi no Koto ga Suki Mitai Desu.
description: Midorikawa is indifferent in love, but yet she is dating Nonomiya. As she starts dating him, she may, or may not fall in love…

title: K-ON! - A Standard of Graduation Ceremonies (Doujinshi)
Seitoshidoushitsu no Ouji-sama
description: Kanbara Rinko is a half-Japanese, half-British girl, so she has blonde hair and blue eyes. However, the vice president of the public moral committee at her school, Kotoshiba, thinks that she dyed her hair and uses contact lenses, so he constantly gives her troubles. And with her attitude, everyone in her class thinks that she’s a delinquent, so she doesn’t have any friends. Her only joy in coming to school is to see Hachiouji-senpai, the gentle and handsome president of the public moral committee. She thinks he’s her ideal prince, but is he really?

title: Dear My Mister
description: Unable to speak English, even though half of his lineage is from an English speaking country, Noah starts to learn from his sensei, Takamasa. Through the process of learning the language, will some feelings start to develop!?

title: Like A Hero
description: Keiichi and Kaname used to be cousins, but they became brothers when Kaname was adopted into Keichi’s family after his parents died in a car accident. The two of them have always gotten along well, but lately Kaname is acting strangely. He has become so cold and distant that Keiichi begins to wonder if his adopted brother hates him for some reason.

title: Shounen Maharaja
description: 世界一煌びやかな超絶ノーブル主人公クリシュナ、カレーに降臨!! 千花はありえない額の借金をチャラにするため、とある少年王族の暗殺を引き受けることになったが…この王族【マハラジャ】だった!?全てがマハラジャ仕様の豪華絢爛、ノブレスオブリージュを地でいくクリシュナに対し、千花はツッコミマシーンとなっていく――…上月ヲサムが描くカレーなる王族ギャグコメディ登場!!

title: Kanjou wo Korosu no wo Yameta Moto Koushaku Reijou wa, Minna ni Dekiaisareteimasu!
description:
The entrance ceremony at a noble academy. The girl who had not smiled for more than ten years had a big smile on her face. Brenda's engagement was broken off and she was disowned by her father, who told her to suppress her emotions, and she became a commoner. She is at rock bottom, and her goal is to find a secure job in research. It was supposed to be a lonely school life filled with studying, but there was no way the people around her would leave her in the dark about the changes she was going through!

A handsome, misanthropic senior recognizes her as a cute junior. A childhood friend proposes to her. Her former fiancé, Prince Charming, asks her to dance with him. She is thrown into the middle of a love triangle...? The story is about a young man who is in love with his former daughter, who has been a waitress for a long time. How will the former daughter, who had been a quiet person, turn out to be?

title: Mousou Samurai Kareshi
description: Hiro loves Yuu, but the love is unrequited and he won't pay any attention to her. One day Hiro follows him and discovers he works at the "Sengoku Cafe".

title: Tokumei Egaogakari
description: When Kashiwagi transfers to Chiemi's school, sensei asks Chiemi to watch over him but even after a month since his transfer, Kashiwagi still doesn't get involved with anyone. Chiemi thinks it might be useless and annoying to keep trying to get close to him but continues trying to be friends with him anyways. But is it really as useless as she first thought it'd be…?

title: Gakuen Joou
description: Higashisanjou Ayako is called the queen of Hibarigaoka Academy – she’s smart, beautiful, cool, and practically perfect at everything she does. However, little does everyone know that she has another side to her. One day, Yuzuki Haruka, who everyone calls the king of the academy, finds out Ayako’s secret. Will our queen have a peaceful and perfect life again with her secret in the hands of this little sadistic king?

title: Kimi ga Tonari ni Iru Nante
description: Saya is shy around boys, so one of her classmates decides to exchange notes with her. Short but sweet, something else could be born.

title: Ubawareta Kiss
description: Riku likes her sensei but a mysterious young boy of her age who looks strikingly similar to him steals a kiss from her, how will the story of the "Ubawareta Kiss" unfold?

title: Seishun Lover's Festival
description:
A guy who appears to be very laid-back, but is actually an amoral, idiotic, pervert! The president and vice-president team up to unmask the secret of the biggest event in a student's life! All sorts of embarrassing things can happen during the preparations for the Culture Festival!  
  
(Source: Otakumole)

title: Renai Mentalism
description: A girl who was suffering from an unrequited love received a "mentalism comic"! The mentalist Daigo is popular and can be seen on TV and in magazines. He can read people's heart thank to mentalism and he can also find people to love!!

title: Anata e no Crescendo
description:
From *Intercross*:  
  
1-3) *Anata e no Crescendo*  
First love. Reunion. Misunderstanding. Passing by each other. And…a teary happy ending.  
**"When you can play this tune, play it for me"**…Suzuno has always been searching for the boy who told her that, whom she met at a piano recital when she was small. After entering high school, she was chosen to play the piano to accompany a chorus competition. Suzuno started practicing with Aiba-kun and Fujisawa-kun from her class, but Fujisawa-kun told her that they used to meet when they were small…!?  
  
4) *Invincible Love Mission*  
Ten years ago Hina, without a single relative, was taken into the Ichijou family as the bodyguard for their eldest son, Reo. *However…*  
  
5) *God's Love Theorem*  
**"Please let me have a boyfriend this year"** Mizutani Yuzu, 16 years old, has up until now, never visited the shrine on New Years but she has a wish to be granted no matter what. When She throws her money offering hers gets hit by another and

title: Green Peace
description: Kosakabe Chihiro is enrolled as a first year in an agricultural high school. In this all boys school, Kosakabe treats his admirer, Kawana Ginji, like a slave. One day, Kawana suddenly steals Kosakabe's first kiss! From then on, Kosakabe decides to skip morning duties. With a pale face, Kawana throws him into the storage room and then…! The real Kawana is actually…?

title: Order wa Tantei ni
description: Miku Onodera, a college student looking for a job, wanders into a mysterious café called “Emerald.” It was a café run by her eccentric older brother, Mahiro, and her younger brother, Yuki, who was so handsome he could be mistaken for a prince. Mikuni, who was accidentally saved by Yuki, finds herself drawn to him, but he's a high school student, has a sharp tongue, is a sadist, and to top it all off, he's a “detective”…!?

title: The Takamiya Family and the False Fiancée
description:
With the proposal, “Let’s make a baby”.

High school student Kotori is roped up into a fake relationship with Sei, the head of the wealthy Takamiya family. Even though Kotori’s traumatic past makes her uneasy with other people, she can’t escape this situation, but Kotori isn’t the only one with secrets. Being forced to visit Sei every day, actually shows he’s keeping some of his own!

As the Takamiya family aims to continue its lineage, Kotori's gradually getting caught up in their schemes. Clumsy, but also straightforward, this story follows a lonely girl and a troubled nobleman’s son’s love story.

title: His First Love is Me
description: A few years ago, Xia Ke had a big fight with his family and heard a song. The gentle melody comforted his frustrated soul. From then on, he focused a lot on a music streamer. Who knew that the streamer he followed would be his classmate! "I want to be friends!" Aside from the college entrance exam, Xia Ke's life as a senior in university got one more goal. The daily school life of a music host and a fanboy.

title: Yesterday You Forgot, Tomorrow I'll Remember
description:
A woman who forgets her memories every day, and a man who can't.

___
[Mangaupdates](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/flmfvxd)

title: The Main Character Is Chie!
description: Persona 4 oneshot for Yu x Chie

title: Otona wa Wakatte kurenai
description: The manga centers on a girl named Tsumugi who enters a private school for high-class families, and has a fated encounter that will change her life.

title: Sakuragaoka Angels
description:
Haru, an energetic, honest, and sweet young girl, meets the popular grade schooler Yashima at a bowling rally, and she unintentionally develops a strange interest in him. He's very forward about wanting to date Haru. However, Haru is in love with her childhood friend, Yuusaku, who thinks of Haru like family and rejected her love confession before he left for America one year ago. But now Yuusaku is back! How will both boys respond to learning that they have competition for the role of most important man in Haru's life?  
  
First volume includes a yomikiri, Let's Go Youth Heaven.  
  
[PL] Haru, energetyczna, szczera i słodka dziewczyna zaczyna interesować się Yashimą dzięki zawodach w kręgle. Yashima bardzo chętnie poszedłby z nią na randkę, ale… Haru jest zakochana w swoim przyjacielu z dzieciństwa, Yuusaku, dla którego Haru jest jak rodzina. Odrzucił ją rok temu, przed swoim wyjazdem do Ameryki. Ale Yuusaku wrócił! Kto teraz zajmie miejsce najważniejszego chłopaka w życiu Haru?

title: Shigatsu no Hina
description: The guy who's always been by my side… the distance between us changes…

title: Could the Boy Next Door Be a Vampire?
description: Navigating the uncertainty of early adulthood is no easy feat, as Hong Wooree is realizing on his year off from college. Not only is he trying to make it as a published author, but he also thinks that his best friend, Gong Minnee, is a vampire! After making some flawed assumptions, Wooree believes that Minnee's secretive behavior comes from hiding his "true" identity—he's completely unaware that Minnee isn't actually a vampire, and just has a huge crush on him. While Wooree struggles to get his writing published and protect Minnee's "secret," Minnee must find a way to confess his feelings for the oblivious Wooree. Will these two be able to reconcile their misunderstandings and allow for a real relationship to blossom?

title: Koisuru Heart ga No to Iu
description:
- Koisuru Heart ga No to lu  
Sawa is a representative of the student council and the valedictorian of her grade. A teacher had asked Sawa to persuade Tatsuki who has been ditching school and have not been attending his classes. But when she goes to the Educational Guidance Room to speak with him she sees him fooling around with a girl. She decides to go to his house to talk to him, but he takes her out with him and tells her, “If you want me to attend school, all you have to do is kiss me once” but… At that time she thinks, I will really kiss you?!  
  
- Sonna Koi no Hanashi  
The popular Saho asks Takita-kun to pretend to be her boyfriend for a month to avoid the soon-to-graduate third year seniors from confessing to her. He agrees on the condition that Saho must not fall in love with him…  
  
- Doruchu  
Fujishima worries about her future when she hears the sweet sound of a piano playing. It is the annoying Tomonori that is playing…  
  
- Seiya no Kiss - The Kiss on Christmas Eve

title: Shuu7
description:
A collection of 4 stories

1) **Shuu7 (7 Days a Week)**
Kae likes Seto from her summer job, but when she's about to confess, she accidentally sees Seto confessing to another woman who turns out to be married. After Kae sees Seto turned down and heartbroken, she bids him farewell, and they meet again in school. Will Kae finally confess to Seto? Will Seto, whose field of vision is narrow, recognise Kae?
  
2) **LoveChuu (In Love)**
Saya is an energetic girl who loves high places but is always teased by Ryou Natsume. Although Saya considers him a "Black Devil King," she loves him all the same but is afraid to confess in fear of being ridiculed and teased by him.
  
3) **Koi no Kajitsu (Fruit of Love)**
Yuzuhara had to quit the track and field team due to an injury and is down because of that…then one day Tooda Shuuhei pops in at the window where she sits and asks her to date him…although shocked Yuzuhara agrees him to see at her window seat for a month until her seat changes…but on the la

title: F no Meikyuu
description:
Having same face with a killed girl by her brother what would bring to her life. Mochizuki Remi experience it with her brother, a detective and her acquaintance who had magical ability.  
  
The initial oneshot both had a follow-up and was later serialized into a one volume series.

title: Vampire Kisses: Graveyard Games
description: Things might finally be back to normal for Raven and Alexander— as normal as they can be for a goth teen in a small town and her dreamy vampire boyfriend. But the secretive couple soon discovers that Alexander’s now full-blooded vampire cousin Claude and his friends are still lingering in Dullsville. And when they all become involved in the same local production of Cinderella that Raven is pushed into costume designing, and once again their worlds collide. Raven suspects Claude and his dubious crew must be up to something, especially when Claude shows interest in the play’s leading lady. Can Raven and Alexander keep a close watch on the gang and still make sure the curtain rises on opening night?

title: Ningyou Saisei Koujou
description: A mysterious doll maker grants "Plain Jane" Seika Hosokawa a new life as a pretty girl. Her new found beauty gives Seika the courage to ask her crush, Asai, out to the school 's cultural festival. However, Asai has an unstable childhood friend who will do anything to keep Asai all to herself.

title: Junai Twitter
description:
1) Jun'ai Twitter
Reona gets into Twitter. Today, she looks at her beloved Tokuda-senpai again, while Mori-senpai worries as usual...
At that time, her followers increase and... and that, no way, that's Tokuda-senpai!?
And when she thinks she can now get all ...♥ with Tokuda-senpai without any hindrances, Mori-senpai is unusually nice. And Reona, who Mori-senpai is worrying about...!?

2) Onna no ko wa mainichi tatakatteiru

3) Nigai atashi to amai kimi

4) Ashita, Kimi to koi shiteru

title: Mysterious Alice
description:
The story centers on Arisu, who just started high school. Her first day of school, which also happened to fall on her 16th birthday, was rather catastrophic. Arisu was absolutely devastated, and when she came home, she overheard her parents arguing.  
  
She discovered her parents are actually a devil and an angel! Her mother, the angel, explained that she and her father, the devil, fell in love and got married. Arisu is actually half demon and half angel. She cannot control her powers because of this and needs to find her true love. According to her mother, she can track him down by following the red threads tying them together–but Arisu discovers her threads have been cut, and she must find him using the old fashioned way!

title: Touhou - Coming Out and Seven Days (Doujinshi)
Haraguro Kareshi wa Dekiai wo Kojiraseru
description: No matter what happens, I'll only look at you, Nonoka and Kyoichi, who have had a one-sided love affair, are now boyfriend and girlfriend! At home, at school and on dates, Kyoichi is sweetly pressing her in every way he can, and Nonoka is thrilled to no end. Nodoka wants to respond to Kyoichi's feelings and "wants" to do it herself, but when Kanzaki, a woman claiming to be Kyoichi's fiancée, appears, a dark cloud hangs over the relationship between the two - ?

title: Murai no Koi Gaiden: Great Twin Busters
description: High school freshman Taiga Shibaki is a solitary delinquent who loves playing piano. If someone picks a fight with him, he always takes the bait and is in and out of the hospital repeatedly due to injuries. So of course, his childhood friend and first love, Nene Satou, worries about him. When Taiga is troubled by this clumsy love affair, Murai, a third-year student at Tatebe Academy, appears before him!?

title: Kiss Tokidoki Kiss Tokoro ni Yori Kiss
description: A kiss is shared with her kouhai, Hasumi-kun, through a game of Kings?! What will result from the throbbing of hearts that they experience together?

title: Ko no Ren ni Namidasuru!
description:
A collection of one shots by various shoujo authors. Includes:  
  
1. Vanilla (Shimotsuki Kayoko)  
Sachi and Yamada have been friends since freshman year, but now that their classes have changed and Yamada is busy with his girlfriend, their only chance to meet is in music class where Sachi is plagued by the smell of Yamada’s vanilla-scented cologne. Confused by the way Yamada treats her, Sachi begins to distance herself from him. Will they ever be able to bridge the gap between them and reconcile or will this be the end of their relationship?  
  
2. 17-sai (Mikimoto Rin)  
In her 3rd year of middle school, she caught her boyfriend in bed with another girl. Now Nakura Yuu in high school and rejects any boy who even says the word "love". One day, Yuu her best boy friend Kashiwada got drunk and did "it" in the bathroom. The next day Kashiwada told her to forget what happened. To Yuu, that day was special for her since she liked Kashiwada. But for him it must have been just any old day…

title: The Astrometry
description:
From [Loyal Kiss](https://mangadex.org/group/1279/loyal-kiss):  
  
Student Quibenyi (aka “Master Qui") has two things people like to talk about: his “light hair” and his “poison tongue”. Anyway, girls at school fall for him and his friend, Shegu, all the time. Our female main character, Xindu, plans on confessing Shegu, the guy she likes. But something goes wrong…  
  
(So far only half of the oneshot has been translated.)

title: Please Be a Hero!
description:
내가 꿈꾼 복학은 이런 게 아니라고! 
제대하자마자 본의 아니게 정의의 용사가 되어 위기에 처한 사람들을 구하게 된 사현. 
하지만 빨간 쫄쫄이를 입고 올백 머리를 한 그 모습을 짝사랑 상대인 초윤에게만은 절대로 들키고 싶지 않다. 
쉴 새 없이 나타나는 방해꾼들, 몰아치는 위기 속에서 과연 사현은 정의의 용사를 그만두고 초윤과 맺어질 수 있을 것인가?

title: Amai Suppai Horonigai
description: This gem omnibus contains first-love stories. "Being with you, my heart throbs." "There are a lot of people, but only you shine." "I went around together with many boys, but I just don't know how I should do with you." How is the flavor of the first love that one experiences only once?

title: Lemon Angel
description: Medaka is a high school girl full of energy and curiosity about sex. Today, she watches adult videos with her female friends and learns about the experiences of her older female college student sister, and at night, she uses her imagination to indulge in solo sex. However, although her knowledge of sex is increasing, she still seems to have resistance to real men, and even when her childhood friend Keisuke or the handsome Mr. Mitamura come onto her, she manages to dodge them at the last moment... Will the day ever come when she has her ideal first sexual experience!? This hit series, which depicts the daily life of a high school girl full of curiosity about sex and has been developed into a media mix including comics, anime, and an idol group, is now available in a complete edition combining series 1 and 2!

title: I've Been Looking for a Thousand Years
description: Yuhan-byeol, a housewife, is punished for failing to sacrifice the liver of a rabbit to the dragon king and is reincarnated with memories of her previous life. In order to break free from the cycle of endless reincarnation, you have to complete unfinished missions... A modern version of Beejubujeon that takes away the rabbit's liver, not just the heart!

title: Tora to Hana (Spin-Off)
description:
Rinka is the daughter of a host club owner.
She loves her parents and everyone at the club, but she is hurt that people speak ill of her just because she is in a host club.
Then one day, she meets Aya, a young man who will soon become a legend in Kabukicho.
Rinka finds herself opening up to him, but...?

title: Hito Seijin.
description:
Satou knows that his childhood friend Ninomiya is being bullied by his classmates, but he is unable to act. Then, Ninomiya expresses his feelings to him…
Friendship, sympathy, love. Pure and refracted emotions run through this true-to-life drama about boys.
___
[Alt Official Raw (Young Jump)](https://ynjn.jp/title/15101)

title: Indigo Blue Legend
description:
Divided into four chapters entitled respectively 1970, 1974, 1976 and 1980, the story focuses on a young couple, Keiko and Kosuke.  
They meet during high school and soon become friends. Koisuke aspires to become a famous movie director and Keiko helps him with his project in a competition. The outcome is brilliant but not much later Keiko sees him kissing another girl. During the next years they will meet again, but will they be able to overcome their misunderstandings?   
  
(from MU)

title: Yume Miru Happa
description:
The first collection of volumized short stories by the author of "For You in Full Blossom" / 『花ざかりの君たちへ』 ("Hanazakari no Kimitachi e").   
  
1) The Dreaming Leaf (Yume Miru Happa) -   
Futaba (=Two Leaves) departs for Tokyo to attend high school there. In order to relieve the financial burden slightly and achieve independence, she finds a live-in work situation at an old mansion. She becomes (fighting) friends with one of three good-looking fortune-telling employees there, Masato, who attends her same high school and is even in her same class. But then one day, Futaba discovers the secret of the old mansion… which is–!?   
  
2) 17 Romance (17 [Juunana] Romansu) -   
Natsume, now in high school, was raised like the son her father never had, and so she's determined never to lose out to any man. Homare Misono has been her guy friend for 17 years. Despite their closeness, Natsume always feels the disadvantage her gender places her at. Homare is stronger and better than her at a lot of th

title: Koi no Uta
description:
Love song – those are the three love stories of three young girls who find their own feelings reflected in beautiful songs. The scribbles on a bench, memories of childish days, feelings echoing in the classroom but cannot reach that person…  
  
This is a wonderful collaboration between poet Homura Hiroshi and the queen of shoujo manga, Akira-sensei – a touching anthology of various love songs that will deeply soak through your hearts! Contains 4 cute and romantic oneshots:  
  
- Shuubasu (Last Bus)  
- Kataomoi no hime (Unrequited Love Princess)  
- Before Kiss  
- Haruno shirushi (Spring mark – an older work)

title: Confession Game
description:
Iri and Yukimi have been best friends for two years, and they have something in common–both of them have crushes on two of the coolest guys in school! But they both decide to change that. Iri talks Yukimi into making a game out of it. They'll both do their best to confess their feelings to their crushes and see what happens. But then, Iri begins to make more progress than Yukimi…?

title: Crazy Love Game
description:
Not every girl has the misfortune to see the boy she likes confess to the most beautiful girl on the tennis team–or the luck to see him get rejected! Unfortunately for Kazusa, her beloved Kurosaki has absolutely no interest in dating her even after he's been turned down, and a confession from another upperclassmen only serves to make this "love game" even crazier.  
  
Includes the one-shots Tsukinami Rose and Princess Ship.

title: Koibito wa Doukyonin
description:
When Yui's mother remarries, she gains five hot stepbrothers! Although she likes the cool Masaki, she feels insecure. How does he really feel about her…?

(An adaptation of the VN of same name for mobile)

title: Me ha Kuchi Hodo ni Ai wo Iu
description: Why does he keep glaring at me? Is it out of hate, or…

title: My Platinum Lady
description:
The super-expensive Joka Gakuen has a policy where the valedictorian, platinum student (PS), is exempt from school fees. Ai supports her large family in place of her parents, so she has little money. She takes Joka Gakuen's entrance exam because she wants to become the PS. Her dream comes true when she gets the top mark, but…

title: Ai no Kotodama
description: After graduating from high school, Tachibana and Otani have finally confessed their love for each and are not living together. However, their life as "newlyweds" is rudely interrupted when they run into an old, high school classmate, Yuki. Otani has always been suspicious of the close friendship between Yuki and Tachibana; and honestly, his suspicions may not be that far off… Are the feelings between Yuki and Tachibana simply an ordinary crush, or could they be more?

title: Tabidachi no Hi
description: They were always together. But soon, they will leave this school and go their separate ways.

title: Dekiai Royale
description: Kagura Itsuki is the demon king's daughter. She spends every day having fun with her three childhood friends: a werewolf, vampire, and oni. On her 14th birthday, the princess receives a surprising present...

title: Majiriau Bokura
description:
Yoshiya thinks it's fate when he's reunited with his first love; however, he learns they can never be together… For middle-aged scriptwriter Makoto and beautiful actor-in-the-making Yuu, it's a chance meeting in which admiration turns to love, and love turns to doubt…?! A young and heartrending adolescent love story and a bittersweet mature romance.  
The stories of a group of men who mingle, intertwine, and change.

title: Miyuki no Ori
description: Minami is cursed. Every time a guy she likes gets close to her she starts to feel bad and sometimes even throws up. She knows that she is cursed because of a nightmare that she keeps on having about a girl who’s asking her to “give him back.” “Give who back?” Minami asks herself. In the end, her only lead brings her to Kouki, her ex-boyfriend. The nightmares have started after they broke up.

title: Akuyaku Reijou, Juukai Shindara Nanka Kowareta.
description:
「お姉さん、大好き！」「私、今世はこの美少年と添い遂げます！」

何度も裏切られ、何度も死んだせいか、出会いも別れも、もはやどうでもいいと思っていたのに…!? 17歳にして「煉獄の魔女」と呼ばれ、人々から恐れられているフィオラ（ただし、聖女メセラは除く）。今世もどうせ同じよ・・・と、ひとりでさっさと魔王を倒しに出かけてみたら、出会ってしまった!! 魔王レペテラ君に!!!　ハイ、決めました。私、今世はこの美少年と添い遂げます！

title: Aspiration
description: Aoi nuestra protagonista conf� a plenamente en el "Protocolo del amor" pero todas sus creencias se ven revocadas cuando Sumiyoshi-kun, un chico de su clase con el que pocas veces ha hablado, confiesa su amor hacia ella repentinamente.

title: Buried In Flowers
description: Sanae is a sweet and kind young schoolboy, although he gives the impression of being a troublemaker which leads to many problems. This side of Sanae causes the school doctor to worry about him. With his support, Sanae is slowly able to communicate well with the people around him. Without realizing, Sanae develops feelings for the school doctor, who is getting married soon..... It's a student's monomaniacal fantasy.

title: Okasa no Hime! - Tsukare-kei Joshi no Occult Nisshi
description: Airi is a shy girl who is suddenly told by a handsome stranger at her university that she will die if she doesn't do something. She visits an occassionist to have him solve the bizarre phenomena that occur around her, but...

title: Copernicus tenkitenkai no Seishun-teki ôyô
description: Itsuki, is a girl a bit strange, although she looks like a normal girl, apart from her appearance is hidden a true lover of cinema, especially classic and old movies. This hobby leads her to meet one of the most beautiful boys in the school, Shima, who loves cinema just like her.

title: Eguchi-san wa Game Nou
description: 成人向けゲームが大好きな女子高生・江口真子（通称：まー子）は、何をやらせても完璧な幼馴染の王子 翔（通称：ショウちゃん）に想いを寄せていた。ある日、そんなショウちゃんから、校舎裏への呼び出しが！これは…幼馴染からの告白！？期待に胸を膨らませるまー子だったが、ショウちゃんとの間にはまるでエ●ゲのようなフラグが次々と立ち始め――！！

title: Osusume Boyfriend
description:
At the start of high school, Takae fell in love with Araki. However, Araki just happens to be indifferent to love. Against her better judgement, she begins dating someone else, but that relationship turned out to be a big mistake…What will become of Takae's love!?  
  
Includes an extra story:   
"Yori-chan has a Love That'll Never be Requited" 
(Sequel to "Like Snow Falling on Harbor" from [A Rose-Colored Tomorrow](https://mangadex.org/title/6382e96a-2416-499c-8c05-48e123531afb/barairo-no-ashita) )
  
It's been over five years since Yori watched the car that his best friend and Kurita, the girl he was in love with, were riding crash into another car, leaving Kurita in a coma that she hasn't come out of since. His best friend, who had also been in love with Kurita then, has already moved on and found himself a new girlfriend.   
  
For Yori though, time stopped that horrific day many years ago. Can his distant cousin, a spunky teenage girl who harbors a huge crush towards him, make him

title: It Is Not Love!
description:
Because of a strong trauma in the past, Nanno is a coward when it comes to love. When she was in her sixth year of elementary school, the boy she loved threw away her love letter. As a result, Nanno thinks she can't love anymore. But she finds she is interested in the boy who joined the same committee as her…  
However, what will she do when she finds out he is Tsuzuki, the one who caused her trauma!?

title: Birth!
description:
Contains three stories:

- **Birth!** (誕生！, Tanjou!)
When strictly raised teenage girl Asami becomes pregnant, she and her boyfriend decide to keep the child despite the disapproval of their parents. Meanwhile, Asami's best friend Rei discovers some secrets concerning her own background that make her feel especially connected to Asami's situation.

This manga caused controversy in its day since it dealt with the pregnancy of a high school girl.

- **Utako to Yonde Mou Ichido** (詩子とよんでもういちど)
The story of a young leukemia patient and her fiancé.

- **Danshi Shikkaku** (男性失格)
After surviving a strange accident, a young man starts gradually turning into a woman

title: Pretty Haru
description:
As children, Lee Haru and Yun Dong-Ha made a promise, one to become a famous baseball player, the other a ballerina. When Lee Haru departs for Russia, they both decide that when they meet again they'll become a couple.  
  
Fast-foward several years, and Dong-Ha, now a feared deliquent, is excited to find out Lee-Haru is returning to his school. Expecting to meet a gorgeous, skinny ballerina, he is rather dismayed to find out Haru hasn't exactly turned out the way he expected.

title: Winter Carnival
description:
A new employee, Myeongjin, will enter the mountaineering department where the manager died in an accident on a mountain climbing and the lungs were decided.

With that opportunity, the darkness of the mountaineering department, which was scheduled to be buried deep, appears, Myungjin will also be caught up in it...

title: Natsu no Nioi, Fuwari
description: The guy I like is always alone after the swimming class. That faint fragrance is the scent of love!?

title: Yochui Kanojo Yumemi-chan
description: は、かわいい彼女から逃れたい男子を描いた“病みかわサイコスリラー”。主人公・根倉千秋は理由あって、親友が思いを寄せているクラスのマドンナ・夢見叶の彼氏になってしまう。容姿端麗、スポーツ万能で性格もいい完璧人間と思われていた夢見さん。しかし彼氏になってから、根倉は彼女が普通でないことに気がつく。

title: It only takes 0.36 seconds to fall in love with one another
description: That day in autumn lied the unpredictable path towards love.  The youthful breeze silently arrived by their side. After touching it by accident, the feeling of love, like poison, intruded from all directions like a raging wave. After realizing it, it was already too late to escape.  This is a story about two outstanding, independent individuals that are not well-versed with the affairs of life, trying their very best to resist the poison of love.'I will not date anyone, don't come near me!'

title: Reflection
description: This story is about Thien Thanh, a girl who is quite superstitious and believes in the Doppelganger phenomenon. With positive thinking she believes that she also has a copy in the world, and that the "copy" must be in a position like her. A copy in which there are two parents; one that lives happily and is loved by everyone. Every day she looked in the mirror and thought of that. One day, Thanh found a girl with the same face as her, born on the same day of the same month. She is Giang Lam. But then, along the way, she starts to learn more and more that her "copy" is not as great as she thought, and the complete opposite of her, from morality to lifestyle.

title: Do You Want to Try?
description: When the hot-tempered Han Hye Won accidently insults the handsome jjang of Han Hwa Go, Sunwoo Bin decides to pay her a visit… with his entire motorcycle gang, ready to see some blood. So how does that lead up to a kiss and the infamous captain begging for a date? Do you want to try?

title: Gekkou no Rankan ni Kuchinashi no Nioi
description:
Saikawa is a teacher at a fine-arts prep school. His colleague, Nashimoto, is a great guy and always stays by his side for him. Looking at Saikawa so depressed after holding his wedding yet breaking up even before submitting the marriage registration, Nasimoto instinctively gives him a kiss. Nashimoto who realized his feelings for Saikawa…!?  
  
Hasumi from From Yesterday makes a cameo appearance as Saikawa's friend.  
  
Included Oneshot "And the Rose Coloured Days"

title: Innocent Blue
description: Mizuhara Kana is staying together with his cousin, Shuuya. Kana has a weak heart and Shuuya has been taking care of him. Somehow, Kana felt like a bird locked in a cage and hoped to have some breathing space. A coincidental meeting with the transfer student, Aoi Rin, changed Kana’s life. He fell head over heels into this first love. The mysterious Aoi taught him about the freedom outside the cage, but the risk that came along with this freedom could cost Kana’s life. The love story of a bird flying out of the cage during the summer, will Shuuya rescue Kana in time?

title: Banken Tokidoki Ookami
description: A lamb surrounded by wolves gets a guard dog. But is the guard dog the most dangerous wolf of them all?!

title: Renai Kaizou no Susume
description: In order to present a report for his class, college student Niwa Kyouichi had to pair up with Sakashita Hitomi, a taciturn guy who lets his hair and beard grow wild, wears unattractive clothing, and is difficult to understand. At first, Kyouichi thought it would be hard dealing with Hitomi, but as they spent more time together, Kyouichi discovered the appealing aspects of Hitomi’s personality. Wanting others to know about this side of Hitomi, Kyouichi started thinking about a plan for Hitomi’s makeover…!?

title: Sumire wa Blue
description: Kinoshita Sumire… Does not participate in any co-curriculum activity and does not even like her own name. She first saw Makimura Daichi in the library. For some reason, she was very attracted to the way he twirls his pencil, and from then on, she started taking interest in him. Makimura Daichi… Part of a famous ice hockey team and is secretly in love with his childhood friend, Shouji… These two people have nothing in common at all, yet they are slowly getting closer to each other…!

title: Dream Away
description: Gehan is a college student with special ability: he can see the future through his dreams. One day, he wakes up from a dream about a man colliding with a car accident. Jehan feels it is his responsibility to help this person, but he couldn't see his face. Try to get rid of his frustration by drinking coffee in the café near the campus, only to realize that the barista is the man of his dream. Will Jehan be able to save him?

title: Love Me Baby
description: Despite his endless enthusiasm and flashy style, Koshiro just can't seem to get a girlfriend or even a date. To make things worse, the cute girls that ignore him all go flocking to aloof Kirihara who glides through life effortlessly and unaffected. In fact, the only thing that Kirihara seems to take enjoyment in is watching Koshiro's failures. Why do these opposites keep getting thrown together or is it more than just coincidence…

title: Hannune Banhada! Season 1
description:
Kang Han-Se and Ban Ha-Da have known each other ever since childhood. They are close enough to sleep in the same room together at their current age.  
  
"Three men for you," Kang Han-Se's mother tells Ban Ha-Da, on the day of graduation. As soon as Ban Ha-Da's life as a high school student starts, her love life begins as well.

title: Honor Student's Little Wildcat is Too Titillating
description: School bully Xie Gu — the person I hate most is my deskmate, Fandu, who’s only good at studying and nothing else! Honor student Fandu — what I hate most is my deskmate, Xie Gu, this person is nothing but a cat-shaped sucker! It is said that since ancient times, the "enemy" had true love, and the two were unhappy with each other. After "injuring" each other 300 times, they found out that the other party was quite cute…

title: Himekoi
description: Yoshikuni and Okada were classmates, but Okada changed schools and they parted ways. Years later they meet again at school; Okada does not recognize Yoshikuni, but notices that he treats him differently. From then on, Okada begins to realize his true feelings for Yoshikuni.

title: Daughter of the General
description: After witnessing her father dragged off by a loan shark and found dead, Da Ra Ji is determined to do justice to those people who killed her father.

title: Look at Me When You Want to Cry
description:
It was a usual day for Yu Hui-Ne, a color blind girl.  
  
A usual black & white day.  
  
But now, she can see colors for the first time.  
  
Note: This webcomic is likely discontinued. Although the author completed Season 1, Season 2 was never started, even after three years.  
  
  
Résumé en français :   
C'était un jour habituel pour Yu Hui-Ne, une daltonienne. Un jour noir et blanc habituel. Mais maintenant, elle peut voir les couleurs pour la première fois.

Mei and Takeru are twins who have a very close, if slightly flirty, relationship, and are quite popular within the school. Their relationship is both a source of amusement and dismay to both the male and female school population, especially with Mei, whose massive brother complex keeps her oblivious to serious confessions from other males. Their relationship becomes even more complicated, however, when the two of them learn that they are not related by blood.

title: Mischievous Pestering Fox
description: This is a FORK & CAKE setting. People with FORK trait, although possessing unusual abilities, have lost all their sense of taste. While people with CAKE trait, are like a walking dessert in the eyes of people with FORK trait. CAKE trait people's saliva, sweat, skin, etc. are rich in sweet taste... And our protagonist, a soft moe FORK fox god, is dead set on chasing after the bride he has identify, a strong CAKE who can 1V5.

title: Honey na Koto
description: Tamako, a high school girl, comes to play at the beach with her friends. She gets drunk, and when she awakes next morning, she sees Tomio lying beside her. Now she's in a panic.

title: Shiawase Ikura De Kaemasu Ka?
description: When she was young, her parents died in a car accident. Her only relative, her grandma, has also passed way. As such, Kiri is now alone and without support. On the day of her grandma?s funeral, an unknown young man named "Shiina" appeared before her. The truth was, her grandma had been funding this violinist…?

title: Pet X Magician
description:
Zama, a timid boy, is plagued with strange dreams. 
Him and his eccentric crush, Nung work together 
to get rid of them.

title: Hatsukoi Ryuuseigun
description: He didn't treat her as a woman but then, at the school camp night, something will happen…

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha - Time of Love (Doujinshi)
description: This is a 20 odd page long story featuring Nanoha and Fate in their high school days with their friends.

title: Sankaku-teki Rennai no Kyouen
description: 中学2年生の響は、学年最高の美少女ともてはやされる高嶺の花的存在。そんな彼女が愛しているのは、義理の兄である亮。亮を振り向かせるためなら手段を選ばない。響は亮の気を惹くため“当て馬”的彼氏を作るが――。

title: Hannune Banhada! Season 2
description:
Kang Han-Se and Ban Ha-Da have known each other ever since childhood. They are close enough to sleep in the same room together, even at their current age.  
  
"Three men for you," Kang Han-Se's mother tells Ban Ha-Da, on the day of graduation. As soon as Ban Ha-Da's life as a high-school student starts, her love life begins as well.

title: The Shimamoto
description:
One-shot compilation of Shimamoto's earlier works for Shogakukan:
- **Blazing Transfer Student - Kaiju Battle!** (炎の転校生・怪獣戦闘!, Honoo no Tenkousei - Kaijuu Sentou!): Noboru Takizawa and crew are back for another chaotic event, this time dealing with an alien invasion. A bonus story done half a year after serialization finished.
- **Warrior of the Sun Wind Breaker X** (太陽の戦士ウインドブレーカーX, Taiyou no Senshi Wind Breaker X): In a school without a dress code, leagues of students fight to force others to wear what they want. One young man stands up to protect the girl he loves from being forced to wear anything but her beloved uniform.
- **Hardly a Hero** (ほとんどヒーロー, Hotondo Hero): A short serial of 5 chapters, about a seemingly good-for-nothing boy with a penchant for sleeping finding himself part of his school's baseball team.
-- Chapter 1: **A Full-Powered Morning Sprint**: Shingaku High School's baseball club is in a dire state. Should it lose again, the club will disband. Sakata, the captain

title: Girls und Panzer - La Vie en Rose (Doujinshi)
description: Oshida y Andō comienza una relación romántica, pero al parecer terminan teniendo algunos problemas en esta.

title: Boys Over Flowers (Official Colored)
description:
Eitoku Academy is a school that caters to children and from rich, high-society families. Hence, Makino, who comes from a poor family, is considered by others as the "weed" of the school. The school is ruled by the "Flower Four" group, more commonly known as the F4. The F4 leader, and son of the wealthiest, most powerful family in Japan, Domyouji Tsukasa, takes an interest in Tsukushi because she is the only girl at Eitoku who does not fawn over him. However, his hot-headed nature and bullying ways are originally a major turn-off for Tsukushi, who has her sights set on Rui Hanazawa.  
  
Volume 37 is comprised of three short stories that happen after the ending

title: My Secret Bodyguard
description: Molly, a cute 13-year-old girl, has been bullied by ruffians ever since she was little. Determined never to be harassed again, she gets herself into an elite school – a place free from hooligans and gangsters, or so she thinks! It isn't long before she finds herself the lackey of a mysterious boy in black – a gangster belonging to a pre-eminent gang in the underworld! An action-packed tale peppered with budding romance...

title: Gal ga Rakugoka ni Koi shitara
Hush
description:
Although Gyu Hwa Lee might look like a guy, she has feelings like any other girl. In fact, she's currently in love with Korean pop idol Kang Un Ryu. As luck would have it, Kang Un ends up transferring to Gyu Hwa's high school. The only problem is he has to keep his identity a secret so he's cross-dressing as a girl!  
  
What happens when Gyu Hwa discovers Kang Un's secret? Will she ever be able to win over his heart? Or will she always be nothing more than just a friend?

title: Hoshii Kiss, Shitai Kiss.
description:
The first kiss at the home of a boy you've known since childhood, the secret kiss in a classroom alone with a popular younger boyfriend....The best kiss of your life, with your favorite boy - An collection of four stories about "kisses."

*Content list:*
- Me wo Tsumutte, Mata Ashita. (目をつむって、また明日。)
- Atsukute Atsukute, Torokesou (暑くて熱くて、蕩けそう)
- Kiss no Kotae Awase (キスの答え合わせ)
- Kore kara mo Shitai Kiss (これからもしたいキス)

title: Gomix
description: The extreme introverted Tao, a first-year high school girl, has no friends. She has a childhood trauma from being abandoned by her mother (she lives with her grandfather) and often feels that no one will listen to her voice and opinions. In his school there is a class called "Gomi Kurasu" = junk class, where a group of rioters and extravagant characters meet. She ends up getting involved with them and that's where the story begins!

title: 24 Jikan Kiss Dekinai
description:
1-2) Can't Kiss for 24 Hours  
A math teacher who has an intense relationship with the problem student, Kikusui Kiyoya. Even though they were a couple in love, one day, Sensei suddenly wants to break up…?  
  
3) If I Didn't Have You  
Fujisawa Yuu just moved to a new town. On the first day of school he's warned to stay away from Nanatsuki Haruki. The word around school is that Nanatsuki who is actually 20 years old will sleep with anyone, but only at school. The mystery is why he only sleeps with people at school and why hasn't he graduated yet?

title: Ramune Bannouyaku
description:
A Matsuzuki Kou anthology, containing four one-shots:  
  
1) Omnipotent Medicine (Ramune Bannouyaku)  
2) Ahiru Revolution (Ahiru Kakumei)  
3) Under the Scarlet Sky (Ake no Sora no Shita de)  
4) The Orange Angel (Orenji Tenshi)

title: Sakura Ryou March
description: After the death of her father, Sakura decides to follow her father's last wishes and move into Sakura Dormitory and attend Sakura High. However, on her way there, she's approached by a stranger who mistakens her for someone else and steals her first kiss!

title: My Days With You
description: Suyin es una universitaria que esta interesada en la chica que se sienta junto a ella en clases, sin embargo jamás han conversado, pero eso cambiará pronto.

title: Mari and Shingo - Wättemberg Bankarangen
description:
A coming-of-age tale of boys who lived in the good old days. This is a story of friendship between Mari Takato, a half-German, half-Japanese boy, his best friend Shingo Innami, and their schoolmates at Jidoin, a prestigious old high school. A representative work of Toshie Kihara, this is a story of the boys' dreams, tears, and friendship!

Note: Has a extra volume, [Yunta Muari,](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/bayrgx8/yunta-muari) that is included in the later bunko and kanzenban releases. (Yunta Muari is the Chinese reading of Mari Takato.)

title: Prince to Yobanaide
description: Cool, smart, athletic Hoshino Toma enjoys being the school prince, but she's all-girl at heart. She has to decide which is more important–her image, or the boy she likes.

title: He Loves You
description:
Collection of oneshots.  
1) Lifeless Life by KOMURA Ayumi  
2) Fake x Fake by AIDA Natsumi  
3) Kimi to Watashi no Kyoukaisen by SAKURANO Mika  
4) Hadashi no Cinderella by HAZUKI Megumi  
5) Kimi no Te to Hitomi to by TAJIMA Mimi  
6) Hanbun wa Ai de Dekitemasu by SATO Zakuri  
Himari Wataya is maybe dating her senpai, Atari Hoshikawa. Hoshikawa is the top student of their school but he's also well-known among the students as the the Super S (Sadist) Prince of Disdain. What is she supposed to do when he teases her mercilessly and he's always angry with her? When she's pushed to the edge, Himari finds out that she might not be as submissive of an M (Masochist) as everyone assumes!

title: Kare no Aijou no Hakari
description:
Arishige Ritsu is the most popular boy in Nagao Mioko's high school – admired by the boys and adored by the girls. His smile has the power to charm many, but Mioko has a strange feeling about it. When the whole school discovers Arishige's secret, Mioko must decide what role she wishes to play in the life of the boy whose honest and patient personality she has grown to love…  
  
The manga also contains two unrelated oneshots.

title: Ultramarine
description: Xiao Yuman who had been away from her hometown for a year is finally back to her beloved city. She released a luminous fish on her 13th birthday, because of that, she unintentionally embarks on a romantic yet dangerous journey. Once she meets the folktale being, is it just a lucky coincidence or is it fate?

title: Ore To Kanojo No Zettai Ryouiki
description: 高校入学直後にオレが一目惚れした黒髪の少女――観田明日香先輩は、『絶対不可避の不吉を告げる魔女』として全校から恐れられる存在だった。自分が視た悪夢が100％現実化してしまう先輩の悩みを知ったオレは、従姉で生徒会長のサヤ姉の制止を振り切り、先輩の未来を変えるべく行動を開始！ だが数々の偶然がそれを阻んできて……どうなるオレと先輩の運命!?

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - YouRiko Compilation (Doujinshi)
description: You x Riko

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai - Demi's IshiMiko Shorts (Doujinshi)
Osamu Tezuka's How to Draw Manga
description:
Tezuka's very own guide on how to draw manga, from the 1970's. Learn tips on character design, manga materials, perspective, expressions, paneling and composition, titling, narrative, and more from the master himself!

---
**Volume 17 of the Osamu Tezuka Essay Collection and Volume 399 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Unbalance ni Koishite
description: A girl being anxious of her relationship with her boyfriend since there is still no progress.

title: Chuuken Kunshu
description: Katou is a member of the high school swim club. Matsuoka has come to bring him lunch and once again to use Katou as his stress relief punching bag. To the sympathy of his clubmates, the impulsive Katou totally falls for Matsuoka, calling him cute with a shy smile. Even as Katou treats Matsuoka kindly and tells him that he loves him, Matsuoka remains a total tsundere, leaving doubts to linger in his heart!

title: PARTY!~SORA~Great East Japan Earthquake Charity Comic Book
description: A collection of extras from creators in Shueisha's Margaret shōjo manga magazine to raise funds for the victims of the Great Eastern Japan Earthquake disaster.

title: Kindan Konyaku
description:
Snatching me, the world most dangerous man!  
  
The boyfriend of the metropolitan police chief commissioner's daughter, Kaede, is Mikura-san, the young leader of Aketo, the biggest yakuza group in the Kanto region.

title: Flower of Life
description:
Forced to enroll in school one month late after recovering from a serious illness, Harutaro is doing his best to remain optimistic about the entire situation. The other students are working hard to make Haru feel welcome–especially his chubby, loveable pal, Shota. However, Kai Majima, president of the Manga Club and all-around hard case, seems to be the one person intent on making Harutaro’s school life a living nightmare.  
  
Note: Was nominated for the first Manga Taishō award in 2008.

title: Dive!!
description:
From Yen Press:
Tomoki has long been passionate about the blink-of-an-eye performances that take place on the platform of the 10m dive. But as a member of the Mizuki Diving Club, he'll need more than passion when his team's lackluster record leaves them on the outs with their sponsors! Given an ultimatum to qualify for the Olympics in one short year and a new coach to train under, Tomoki and his teammates compete for glory with the fate of their diving club riding on their shoulders!

• Official English: [Yen Press(publisher)](https://yenpress.com/9781975328580/dive-vol-1/), [Amazon](http://www.amazon.com/s/?index=books&keywords=9781975328580), [BookWalker](https://global.bookwalker.jp/search/?word=9781975328580&adpcnt=zro2xwum), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/search?c=books&q=9781975328580)

title: IZUMINO
description: Izumi Momoko is one of the most popular girls in school, but she has difficulty getting good grades, so her mother decides to hire a private tutor, Izumi's mother receives a recommendation from a friend and hires that friend's son, Minoru Yoshi is Izumi's private tutor on the weekends, but Minoru and Izumi don't know this, the problem is that the two are classmates, how will these adventures be?

title: Senpai no Pocket
description: When boys put their hands in their pockets, it means they're hiding their feelings!" Chiharu has a boyfriend that is very, VERY quiet. At first, she didn't mind at all that he rarely spoke because she believed that she was fine as long as their feelings could be conveyed. Soon, though, she comes to realize certain things that makes her feel extremely anxious towards him… Why does he always keep his hands in his pocket?

title: Love Story Collection of Yoko Maki
description: A collection of short love stories, several of which were previously released in 14R.

title: Nijinohara de Koi wa Dekinai
description: Nanazaki Ichigo enrolls in his dream school, Nijinohara High School, and ends up living in the "Nijinohara Dormitory," a dormitory for boys run by his grandparents near the school. In the boys' dormitory full of peculiar characters, Ichigo's tumultuous new life begins!

title: Kanojotachi
description: On her first date with her boyfriend Hasegawa, Misono, a sophomore in high school, meets Ryuiko, a beautiful young woman with good looks. Hasegawa takes her to a fashion show, where Ryuiko is on stage as a model. She is a friend of her brother's, a lesbian who is dating Susan, another woman. Misono becomes interested in Ryuiko, and Ryuiko is also attracted to Misono's purity...

title: Ame Tokidoki Koi Moyou
description: Under the umbrella, my feelings pour down like the rain… (Cover text, TL by Shoujo Sense)

title: Tennenkei Ouji
description:
From Serenus Dreamers:  
Aoi - a girl who lives in a household of seven. Her current status? Poor. Masafumi, dubbed the Prince of School, lives in a mansion with a household of mostly servants and his grandparents. His current status? Rich. When Masafumi decides to throw away 40 cents which Aoi could have used, she's enraged at his action of discarding the valuable amount, and vows to never forgive him! But, what happens when fate brings Aoi to the Prince's door, in place of her mother, who is injured? Revenge? Schooling in the antics of the poor?  
  
Extra:  
That is Why we Dream - Nakahara has a habit of setting things on fire, she coops herself up in the art room and never smiles..she is also a young and famous artist. While setting fire to another object, she meets a boy, who is a young and famous basketball player…why does he give her so much attention when everyone else shuns her? and why does she seem so sad while painting?

title: The Best Of Miyasaka Kaho
description:
1) Houkago wa Koi no Yokan  
Sarara has been going out with her first boyfriend for over a week but they haven't progressed past going home from school together. Kawatori is a year younger, tall and cute, a little weird and quiet, but she knows that he's a very kind person, and loves his sweet smell. She adores sweets and cakes, and regularly visits her favourite cake shop, however Kawatori says that he doesn't even like cakes! With Christmas approaching and Kawatori saying that he's too busy to see her, is Sarara right in thinking that he's not really interested in her and is already cheating? What's he being so secretive about? Will they ever be able to have the sweet Christmas together of her dreams?  
  
2) Yuuwaku Danjon  
Natsumi has been by Ryo-kun's side for years and still hasn't confess her feellings. He's a year younger then her and tries to get in to Keisou University. When she brags about him to her friends everything goes wrong. Will they ever be together?  
  
3) Yozora

title: Your Obedient VTuber!
description:
Higashi — full name Higashitōge Kōichi — has one dream: marry his favorite VTuber, Yumeno Riaru. His plan? Become a female VTuber himself. The problem? He's absolutely terrible at it. Enter 〈Sata Nonoka〉, who's been watching this trainwreck from the sidelines. Turns out she's just as big a Riaru fan — and she sees something in Higashi that just might work. So she makes him an offer.

Nonoka's only doing this to get closer to Riaru-chan. But somewhere between taking commands from her "Master" (a.k.a. the viewers), she starts to actually enjoy it—

"Keep the orders coming… h-hang on, what am I saying!?"

One girl who can't say no to anything. One guy who won't stop for anything. Together, can these two total opposites actually pull it off and meet the VTuber they both adore?

A chaotic youth VTuber comedy — now live!

title: 3 and 1/2
description:
Choi Yul and I like Han Taekyung as 'us.'

Joonhee has a crush on his childhood friend Taekyung.
By chance, he realizes that his classmate Choi Yul also likes Taekyung...
"I... need someone to like Han Taekyung with!"
"Okay, then let's like him together."
But Joonhee is increasingly bothered by Yul.
The fresh, bittersweet story of Yeon Joonhee’s unrequited love.

title: Shirayuki Pop
description: Mashiro is a fangirl of a model named Yuuki. One day, Yuuki transfers to her school and the very first thing she says to him is "I LOVE YOU!" He ignores it as if it is was something normal, and Mashiro repeats it every single day, saying that it isn't enough even to say it everyday. They act like they're a couple although they're not. But will Yuuki's feelings towards Mashiro change?

title: Love Diver
description:
A master chef and the owner of the bar where he is about to begin working at, are actually high-school classmates. In the past, they had shared a kiss, the scent of flowers still clings onto the owner's body… The master chef who thinks about the past, is carrying complex feeling everyday?  
Also, the owner is someone with his pheromones on high, and super popular with other men that one night, he was attacked by an unknown stalker! Decadent wine and love stories between adults…

title: Peach on Ice
description:
Lee Kyun, the Shepherd, is at the top of the pyramid of the Carnivore Class. Everything was perfect - other than the fact that he has a crush on his best friend, Choi Hae Beom, the Leopard. Too scared to confess, he thought he would be satisfied with just the title of "Best Friend," when a bottom-of-the-food-chain, zero-attack-power Golden Hamster appears and starts to show interest in Hae Beom. Between the two of them, who will manage to capture the Leopard's heart?!

#BL #ShortSeries #Cute #Sweet #SchoolSetting #Hybrids #UnrequitedLove #LoveTriangle #NiceTop #CuteBottom

title: Karenai Hana
description: Hikita was hit on by Imai, an older member of his baseball team who he's always respected and looked up to. After practice, they start kissing each other, deepening their love, but then…

title: Kazekanata
description:
Do you have a song that has left an impact on your heart?  
Do you have a secret you can't tell anyone?  
A slightly heartrending love story.

title: Lemon no Himegoto
description:
How does love go to your side? Is it like sunlight shining, is it like petals falling, or is it a reply to my prayer– Love. While Happiness shines rays of light, it slowly leaves the sky, picking up huge feathers, shrouding the souls of my blossoming flowers.  
  
Story 1 - Hana always watches the boy at the library and has always wanted to speak to him, until  
one day they are alone in the library together…  
Story 2 - A new boy enters school and is instantly paying a certain girl extra attention.  
Story 3 - ''He is my neighbor, you could call us childhood friends''  
Story 4 - A girl dumps her boyfriend because she is too shy and inexperienced, but he keeps on pur  
suing her, what should she do?!  
Story 5 - sequel to Story 1, Hana catches her new boyfriend talking in his sleep, he mumbles her na  
me…

title: KAU + AKU ≠ KITA
description: WEBTOON is back with another heart-breaking Valentine's compilation! They say it's normal to love, but what if all you get is heartache? Can we still face tomorrow with a broken heart?

title: Challenge Up!
description: Miyu's dream is to go to Wimbledon and become a professional tennis player! But the reality is harsh…

title: Boarding House of Hunks
description: Boy-crazy Jae Yoo is willing to go through any underhanded means if it means living in the boarding house full of hot guys… Even if it’s going out on a blind date with the dorkiest boy in the school. When she dumps the guy immediately after, she pisses off his handsome best friend Ji Hu and from that point on, the two are constantly going at each other’s throats like cats and dogs. When Jae Yoo finally accomplishes her dream of entering the “boarding house of hunks,” she thinks that nothing could go wrong. An amazing house, a kind landlady, and even a cute guy who seems to be interested in her… What’s this?! Ji Hu is the landlady’s son?! And how is it that he knows about Jae Yoo’s most embarrassing moment in life? What kind of life will the two lead under the same roof? Will they be able to live together at all?!

title: Fortunate Son
description:
High school delinquent Mura must put up with the annoying presence of new stepbrother Subaru when his mother goes away on honeymoon. Dealing with gossip at school is bad enough, but Mura's life is turned upside down by a forbidden locker-room kiss and the publication of an incriminating photo snapped by BL fangirls.  
  
Takaguchi Satosumi's first BL work.

title: Mirai no Koibitotachi
description:
6 - My Little World  
Nakayama Saori reunites with her old classmate, Tokito, and they reminisce about the past and a girl named Tasaki Mina.

title: Karenai Onnanoko
description: Ishigami-kun se siente atraído por Sakamoto-san, una compañera que parece vivir en un mundo de fantasía. Sin embargo, cuando los rumores sobre sus mentiras y su familia comienzan a circular, Ishigami-kun debe decidir si cree en la realidad o en la "verdad" de Sakamoto, aprendiendo que la falsedad puede esconder una verdad más profunda de lo que parece.

title: Usotsuki na Kanojo
description: Marie always puts herself back, lies to her friends that she's a love master. Manami, Marie's bestfriend, trusts her and asks her and her boyfriend to go to a double date. Marie who doesn't have any boyfriend gets panicked and at the end she asks for Yamato's help. Yamato is willing to help her, but… with payback!

title: Ikemen Oukyuu Another Side - Houkago no Cinderella
description: In this school, Mari is chosen to be "the princess!?"

title: Let's Fall in Love Naked
description: "Will you buy my silence with a kiss?" He sees her naked and asks her for a kiss in return for not telling anyone about it! She doesn't want to... so why's her heart beating so fast?

title: Hatsukoi Limited. (Official Colored)
description: Being an adolescent girl is just one problem after another. Middle-schooler Arihara Ayumi receives a note from a high-schooler, a very large and intimidating boy, Zaitsu Misao, asking her out. Frightened and intrigued, she doesn't know what to do!

title: Love Live! - Koi o Utatte (Doujinshi)
description:
In which Umi and Maki go on a date to get inspiration for lyrics but end up with something better.  
  
{ Umi X Maki }  
  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oiVINmy.png) Artist’s Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/161077)  
[![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/nekonso)

title: Daichi-senpai is so Unfair!
description: Shiina is a young girl who has just started high school and has never fallen in love. Seeing all the senpais she has, she thinks that maybe love will be possible. But, a friend of hers points out to her that these people live in a different world than theirs. However, Shiina is still determined to get an older boyfriend!

title: Koisuru Minimum Moon
description: A teenage girl just can't hit it off with her classmates but as the school year is about to end when suddenly a cheerful boy from her class approaches her!

title: Shoujo Mangaka no Koi
description:
1-2) Shoujo Mangaka no Koi (Love of a Shoujo Mangaka)  
(Adapted from the original oneshot)  
“If I could be of any help, would you want to try it?”  
To help incorporate boy’s love elements into his work, the unpopular shoujo mangaka Akimoto Yuu and his editor, Kurata, decide to carry out their own experiment.  
  
The story of an awakening love that is embarrassing but warm.  
  
3) Shoujo Mangaka no Koi Omake  
  
4) Seppun Shuugyou (Kissing Lessons)  
Seiji still thinks about the time he walked in on his childhood friend Daigo masturbating. Now Seiji can't help but do the same when he remembers it and it seems Daigo can't either; so what will our frustrated couple do when a co-worker takes a sudden romantic interest in Seiji?  
  
5) Natsu wa Hagakure (Shadowed by the Leaves of Summer)  
  
6) Hug Me, Hold Me  
  
7) Tokyo Hotel  
  
8) Passionate Pen Pals  
  
9) Afterword

title: Hatsukoi Dandelion
description:
Clumsy and ordinary mao, thanks to a pet dog, she get to know about her handsome classmate's life after school…!?  
  
French :  
Mao est une fille simple et enjouée et est la voisine de classe du garçon le plus populaire du lycée, Kanade, et se fait même harcelée par ses fans à cause de ça.  
Mais elle est la seule à connaître le secret de Kanade : il est amoureux de leur professeure de littérature…  
Une histoire d'amour sur fond de pissenlits…

title: Ohoshi-sama ni Onegai!
description: As a child, Sasahara Tomo has always been "one of the guys," hanging out and rough-housing. Even though, she secretly wished to be a girl instead when she enters elementary school, she keeps her facade, too embarrassed to admit it. But when her love confession was later rejected because she didn't seem like a girl, Tomo was ready for a new start. And how lucky that she's about to enter high school. She's excited. A whole school where nobody knew her! But not quite. There's Shimazaki Akira, who had been her next-door neighbor until 5 years ago.. and it seems as if their "sibling" regard for each other is growing into something more.. But there are problems aboard.. because this is a forbidden love.. because he is her 23-year-old class advisor.

title: Kiken na Kiss wa Mitsu no Aji
description:
1-3) Kiken na Kiss wa Mitsu no Aji  
She started to date her childhood friend, the boy who always stayed with her. One year later, her first love came back and confessed his feelings for her…  
  
4) 22-ji niwa Kiss o Shite  
  
5) Kocchi o Muite Dekishimete  
  
6) 22-ji niwa Kiss o Shite - Extra

title: Yotteke! Otokomura
description: Otome Arisugawa has always hated boys. Her life is made worse when her father suddenly takes her away to Otoko Mura, a village with a 98% male population! If that wasn't enough, she's supposed to pick one of the residents to be her fiancé?!

title: Kiss Yori mo Ijiwaru
description:
1-3. Kiss Yori mo Ijiwaru  
Miku is admitted to enter an extremely prestigious school, where only elite students are studying, as a transfer student. Her only good point is that she's cheerful and enthusiastic. She's pleased to enter the school because it is a boarding school and the tuition is free. However, Omi, an elite but spiteful student, tells her to quit school. Miku is put in a tricky position, and accepts his challenge to a fight.  
  
4. Sensei, Onna no Ko ni Shite (Teacher, Please Turn Me into a Girl!)  
  
5. Scandal Nante Iwasenai (Not a Scandal)  
Yuuri is a total fan of the top idol Shibuki. Then during his concert, she gets an unique chance that any fan would dream of.  
  
6. Yubisaki kara Hajimaru Furachi (The Evil Prince)  
Keita, a hairstylist and a former gangster, suddenly asks Arimori Tsukasa to be his model after seeing her beautiful hair, but a street flirt comes and Keita saves her. They gradually become friends, but will there be something more?

title: I Want To Keep Gazing At You
description:
Machiko should be floating on cloud nine. She's snagged the most popular guy in her grade and she's finally been able to form a close friendship with someone in her class for the first time in her life. But things aren't so simple - the other girls in the class are quick to accuse her of not being serious about her new boyfriend, and bad rumors are starting to spread around the school about her.  
  
So when she meets Takaya, a rebellious teenager who's in the same grade as her younger sister, she can't help but be drawn to him, and he seems equally attracted to her. Who will she choose?

title: Diamond Beat
description: She was born into a family of classical musicians, but Satsuki is the one misfit. She thought that she hated music; but, then, a prince with a guitar appears…?! “You are a genius DIVA!” That’s a lie, right–?!

title: Taiyou-kun to Itsuwari Account-chan
description:
Hikage Chigusa is a dull high school girl with a secret... She has three social media accounts where she pretends to be a bright and happening girl. Ever since she fell in love with Taiyou, the popular guy in her class, the clash between her fiery feelings and her ideals have made her lose control!

In one account, she pretends to be in a relationship with Taiyou. In another, she pretends to be a charismatic girl with perfect make up who other high school girls even look up to and the third account is where she dances her heart out...

In between reality and her fake accounts, will Chigusa's love ever bear fruit?

title: Wait! Wolf
description:
Princess of romance, Hwi-Kyung. The handsome, wolf-like, Three Musketeer guys who run to Hwi-Kyung wherever she is.  
They make a secret promise without Hwi-Kyung knowing. If one of them starts to love Hwi-Kyung, their friendship will shatter.  
A no-love oath.  
The prince of confidence, Yoon Suh-Rin's, charm!  
Te-Ri, who became a two-timer because he loved Hwi-Kyung!  
And the one who hid his love for Hwi-Kyung's happiness, the charismatic Jo Hwan-Sung's sad love story!

title: W Pinch!!
description: Kawai Arisa is a timid girl with a split personality. She used to be a super bully and commands her army of "servants" to do things for her. Due to a freak accident, she has forgotten all her memories and turned into a crybaby who never sticks up for herself. Then, a new student shows up to seek revenge against her, which makes Arisa revert to her former self.

title: Boku no Hero Academia - Behind You (Doujinshi)
description:
Kirishima Eijirou/Ashido Mina
This story fills in the gaps after Kamino and Kirishima's inner conflicts regarding becoming a hero and being a true man.

title: Prince from the Sun
description: Noriko has led a sheltered, overprotected life since she was little, not being allowed to play outside or take part in normal childhood activities due to her affluent background. Then, during a school trip to Osaka, she meets Taiyou, who shows her that beyond the gilded birdcage she was raised in, there exists a dazzling world that shines as bright as the sun. But, faced with overwhelming opposition, can Noriko somehow find the courage she needs to break free of the chains that bind her?

title: Kono Atatakai Hizashi no Naka de
description: Kamiyoshi Hina is a new transfer student. She was looking forward to spending her school days with peace and ease. Unfortunately, that thought flew out the window when she was appointed class representative and seated next to the school’s infamous delinquent, Mikuni Satoshi. According to rumors, Mikuni Satoshi gets into fights and spends the nights working as a gigolo. Are there any truths to the rumors? What will happen when the two meet? Is there more to Kamiyoshi Hina’s cheerful demeanor and Mikuni Satoshi’s delinquent behavior? Read to find out!

title: Otoko Oidon
description:
A story about a ronin student named Oyama, living in a small apartment, trying to survive. This series made Matsumoto famous.

(from ebookjapan):

Shota Oyama, aka "Oidon," a Kyushu boy, lives in a four-and-a-half-tatami-mat room. He has a pile of underpants in his closet, and a strange mushroom called sarmatake grows in the closet. However, even these mushrooms are valuable food in his extremely poor life. 

He works part-time at a factory during the day and attends a night high school, but his failures lead to his being fired, dropping out of school, and heartbreak. Then Reiko Nishio comes to live across the hall from him. Oidon is attracted to her, but she is not the only one...

title: Brothers Conflict 13 Bros. Collection
description:
Manga adaptation of various drama CD tracks.  (From: Agent of Change Translations)  
  
Based on the light novel series *Brothers Conflict* and its otome game (visual novel) and anime adaptations.

title: My Okita
description: Souichi Okita is a second year student at Haramachida University. Since entering school, he has been dumped by a girl who attacked him eight times. He wasn't popular at all, but when a girl moved into the room next door, his life changed completely. Her neighbor is Koto Sawamura, her childhood friend. It was the first reunion since junior high school graduation. Two people who grew up to be 20-year-old men and women. How will the childhood friendship develop...!?

title: Theatrical Anime Seven Days War
description:
The stage is 2020. Mamoru, a second-year high school student who likes indoors,
has feelings for Aya, a pretty girl who lives next door.
However, Aya decides to move her out due to adult reasons, and
Mamoru, who doesn't want to leave her, summons up her courage and proposes a plan to run away from home with her.


The best-selling novel "Our Seven Days War" transcends time and
sparks a new adventure.
Theatrical version animation "Bokura no 7 Days War" comicalized!!

title: City of Dreams
description: I'm there again. That town in my dreams. There is a boy here that I know, that I've met in that town in my dreams.

title: Touhikou Days
description:
It was the first time she skipped school.

Suddenly, she finds someone from the neighboring class skipping too. It was strange how he shared the same feeling as her.. how they were both struggling with a decision in their lives.

Their stories are revealed.

title: Yoakemae
description:
Recently, An's boyfriend, Kurosawa, has been acting strangely. Did he just cancel their date for Sunday? It turns out that he's helping his best friend, Kouta, who is in love with this other girl. But does he have to do this in spite of An's feelings!?  
  
Includes other short stories: Onaji Sora no Shita, Niji no Ame, Scratch Go-go

title: The Gutsy Frog
description:
While frog Pyonkichi is hopping in an empty lot in Nerima, Tokyo's Shakujii Park, middle schooler Hiroshi trips over a rock and squashes him. However, Pyonkichi is reborn as an imprint on the front of Hiroshi's shirt and now gives him advice and commentary on his life.

An early popular work of Weekly Shonen Jump.

title: Saikyou HELPxxx
description:
Tsubaki comes from a really rich family. Since her parents lets her do what she wants to do she parties everyday. She has many friends and guys, and it should have been a fun high school life but, because of one guy she changed!?
