title: Anata ni Muchuu
description: Takami has an 'eye power' that causes guys to fall in love with him by looking them in the eye and Ninomiya has a 'pheromone power' that gets both men and women fall in love with him. What happens when these two characters clash together?

title: Tadaima Otori Komichuu desu
description:
Watanuki-kun is a problem child who is always late. Wano-san, the student council president, is a serious girl who takes care of all the trouble in the class. The two of them don't have much in common, but Watanuki-kun finds out that Wano-san has a crush on their teacher Tsuji!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Suki na Mono wa Suki Dakara Shouganai!!
description: Sunao and I are childhood friends and also college roommates. Due to the Culture Festival, our class decided that we were going to perform "Swan Lake" and made me play the part of the "prince". Sunao, being so slender and delicate to the point that he could be mistaken for a girl, was, of course, chosen to play the role of the "princess". But since he hates to deal with people, he didn't like that idea too much…

title: Anchoko!
description:
Four short storys about love and chocolat  
  
1. Anchoko! Anti-Chocolate:  
Even though she was born on Valentine’s Day, Kagami hates eating chocolate and resents having it constantly associated with her day of birth. Like any girl, she dreams of one day finding a prince. That moment came much sooner than she anticipated. Unfortunately, his two older sisters are constantly getting in the way. On top of that, her perfect guy actually likes chocolate. It's enough to make anyone's head spin! Will Kagami be able to keep her newfound relationship strong?  
  
2. Looking at You Only  
Tsuyoku Hamuro is an aspiring art student who aims to get her painting recognized in the upcoming school festival. It's almost a dream come true that she happens to have the kind, popular, and attractive school idol, Tomotsugu Nagayama, as a boyfriend. Nagayama is straightfoward with his affections for Tsuyoku. Truthfullly, Tsuyoku has admired Nagayama since freshman year, but the interally shy artist cannot e

title: Say Say Say
description:
No matter where you are I can recognize you at one glance whether you are disguised or far away.  
Because it's our fate and destiny.  
  
There is no other enemy like you!!  
You tackle and bother me on everything I do.  
Say and Yong-won are like enemies ready to attack-!!  
  
Messed up and tangled Say’s and Yong-won’s sad but beautiful love story~

title: Underground Kids -Gakuen Onmitsu Torimonochou-
description:
1-3) Underground Kids  
Everyday Kimi's belongings were searched and destroyed, and she always felt that someone was watching her. They said that the school’s secret organization solves all the problems within the school’s ground thus she gathered up her courage, and went to them for help. Little did she know, this organization actually consisted of 3 “Money-loving” people… can they solve her problem safely?  
  
4) Fake  
Miki rolls her eyes just by looking at the girls who are squealing over the beautiful guys of the Disciplinary Committee. She's got the braids, the glasses, the uniform, and the textbook to AVOID having contact with the Committee. No tardies, violations, or absences; now, because of that, she's part of the Disciplinary Committee!  
  
5) Summer Love Paradise  
Ichiha's friends take her to the beach with them, hoping she'll get over her troubles with her past four boyfriends. She unexpectedly meets the unpleasant lifeguard, Kouta, though.

title: Kimi Ochi
description: Misuzu and Yuu are childhood friends for 7 years now, and even thought they get along very well with each other, they never thought of having any romantic relationship between them. That is, of course, until Misuzu decides to use Yuu as a model for one of her paintings and she realizes that the passion she feels while drawing it is not only art related.

title: Involuntary Romance
description:
Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

**Original Webtoon:** [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/involuntary_romance), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/involuntary_romance_)

**Official Translations:** [English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/inv

title: Land Escape
description:
We have been together since childhood, and even now we are still close friends. I have always loved you but now that you are leaving me behind, what do I do?   
  
————————————  
Spanish/Español:  
ESP - Hemos estado juntos desde la infancia, y todav� a ahora somos amigos cercanos. Siempre te he querido pero ahora que me estás dejando atrás, ¿qué hago?

title: M.T. Pass
description: “You shall meet your true love today…” This was the fortune that Magic Tower’s top fortune-teller (and not to mention hottest), Aki, predicted. The girl he met that day was Saya, part of Aki’s brother’s fortune-telling club. Saya simply cannot believe it, but Aki tells her fortune and it’s the same! Could this fortune really come true? If you do not tell one fortune right, you are forced to leave your position at MT…

title: Trill on Eden
description: Admitting herself as super unlucky person, Ritsu, freshman in high school, tries to get out of unluckiness and disasters by living in the school dorms and starting fresh. However, with her destined meeting with school's famous genius as well as problematic student Eiri, Ritsu starts to get unluckier everyday….!?

title: BxB Brothers
description: Iizuka Sono just transferred to a new school where the reigning oddballs have their own club called "BxB Brothers" ("B" for "Baka" = "Idiot"). According to them, you make your life meaningful by doing things out of the ordinary. While Kazuhisa and Kei aren't too selective about membership, Katsumi is – so it's just the three of them… Until Sono strikes Katsumi as an admirably unusual person, and he coerces her into becoming a Brother! The more Sono learns about the Brothership and Katsumi, the more pride she takes in being a Brother, but being the only BxB Sister has its problems. Caught between the open affection of Kazuhisa and the reserved admiration of Katsumi (with Kei taking school-wide bets on the side), all while struggling to register the club officially, it's a BxB Triangle that constantly takes on new angles!

title: Princess Army
description:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl. One day she played a trick on a drunk and made him angry. The drunk was going to hurt her, until a boy appeared and saved her. It's been eleven years since that incident, but Nonoka is still looking for the "prince" who saved her.  
This manga's got a love triangle and lots of judo!

title: Dokuhebi-san ni go-chuui wo
description: There’s a deadly poisonous snake. Though, as long as you don’t touch it, you wouldn’t have to worry. No matter how deadly its poison is, as long as you don’t get involved with it, there shouldn’t be a problem.

title: Christmas ni Kagayaku
description: Runa has always had a fear of boys. When she's confronted by a confession from the school's most popular guy, Kizuna, she just burst out in tears. However, she calms down when Kizuna says he wants to start out as being friends.

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai - Chikaya's IshiMiko Shorts (Doujinshi)
SWOT (Oneshot)
description: Pilot chapter of the SWOT manga series. It was published in the 52th issue of Weekly Shonen Jump in 2009.

title: Kokuhaku Mamire
description: Ichijou is asked to say "I like you" to Hankai, even if it's a lie, just because he wants to know how it feels like! But, is Ichijou really lying when she said that…? Cute 17 page oneshot!

title: Aniki wa Tsunayoshi!
description:
Tsunayoshi is Misao's big brother, though they're not related by blood. He used to be a juvenile delinquent, and his love for his little sister is constantly embarrassing Misao. Yet he's a good guy who will do anything to protect his little sister.  
A powerful and dangerous brother x sister love battle begins!

title: เปลี่ยนยัยห้าวเป็นสาวแบ๊ว
description:
PaoPao es la hija del dueño de una granja y también de un campo de boxeo, su sueño es ser diseñadora a escala mundial!, sin embargo sus padres quieren que ella herede la granja.  
¡Esta es la historia de una chica que quiere ser diseñadora a escala mundial!, y de paso en el camino ¿quizás ella encuentre el amor de su vida?, averígualo ya!

title: Cute and Flirty... and a Man!
description: A cute and flirty guy x a naïve high school girl who's worried about her appearance!? Their appearances mismatch their personalities, and when these two intertwine, the whereabouts of love are...?

title: Captain Ken
description:
Technology has finally allowed humans to colonize Mars.

People from all over the Earth have migrated to Mars and now several generations of human residents have been born and raised on the red planet.

Though, it is not without stipulation.  

Despite such a monumental achievement, humanity's follies emerge to bring about suffering. 

Mars is lawless, much like the Wild West of old and despite efforts to stabilize, corruption and crime are prevalent.

An ever present reminder of humanity's cruelty, Martians of what is known as "The Moro Tribe" periodically attack and kill any humans they come in contact with as revenge for the genocide committed against their people years ago. 

The Story begins In Hedes Town, where Mamoru(played by Rock Holmes) goes off to meet the child of a family friend Kenn who just arrived from Earth.

Despite the warnings against leaving during a storm, Mamoru heads off stubbornly. On his way, Mamoru gets ambushed by the Moro Tribe before being rescued by a boy

title: Storm Lover
description:
Original version:  
Lots of bishies with one girl. Seems to have something to do with the Chinese zodiac at an elite school.  
  
Serious version:  
Igarashi Yuna is a transfer student in St. Louis High. Based on an otome game of the same name. This manga covers each of the guy's routes in each chapter.  
  
In the series:  
  
V.1 - Storm Lover  
  
V.2 - Natsukoi!!

title: Atashi o mamotte mi nasai!!
description: Chinatsu Ayanokoji is the only daughter of the president of a major financial group. Tired of studying at a school for young ladies, is changed to a public school, without the permission of his father. With three bodyguards around her you can not even have a loving relationship, even if the person you like is Shun, the smallest of Kaga. Will Get Chinatsu Shun treat her as a girl and stop thinking only at work?

title: Gareki's Flight
description:
(from mangapedia):

When Gareki Sho arrives at a new school, he hands out garage kits of bishojo characters as a greeting to his classmates. However, his classmate Rei Shuga throws away the garage kits, calling them "disgusting," and Sho clashes with her. 

Sho goes to the club room to join the art club, and after a Q&A session with Mizuki, they end up having a sculpture vs. garage kit competition.

The one who came forward as a model for the "same motif," which was a condition of the competition, was Rei, who did not think well of Sho.

title: Fake na Junjou
description: Sweet and pretty high school student Keita is aggressively courting his remedial class teacher, Soga. Soga, however, thinks it's just a childish joke, and that there is no real love… From the beginning of courtship between sensei and student to their first time together, and other romantic stories! In another pairing, an ex-student meets his tutor. Adult love relationships are compiled here. Pure love and romantic love stories of innocent teens and adults who are toyed with by them.

title: The Eccentric School Idol
description: Soren Shen is a high school student. He’s always a well-behaved student to his teachers and takes Sharon Li as his good example, who is the school idol. But one day… Soren accidentally found the secrets of his idol!?

title: Summer Basketball
description: The basketball event that happened that summer…

title: Distance Between You and Me
description: I love you- I wonder if you like me back? And if you don't, well, I will slowly work to forget you…

title: Ten yori mo, Hoshi yori mo
description: Mio Mizumori's parents die, and she goes to live with her cousin, Tadaomi Shijou. Her only salvation is Rei Narumiya, the Golden Girl of her school. Simultaneously, Mio discovers that they have powers over the elements of nature… and a destiny to fulfill.

title: Ren Ai Cupid
description: Yoshikawa Hiyo have waited years to finally confess her feelings to her crush. Now that she’s in the same school as him, she decided to bring up the courage to confess. But just as she was building up her nerve, she almost gets hit by an arrow directed at her! With the arrow came a note of invitation to a room of the school. When she got to the room, she was greeted by two gorgeous brothers who introduced their club as the Love Cupid club whose purpose is to help those who have love problems. As the brothers try to help Hiyo to confess, they are besieged with another problem. Whenever Hiyo faces her crush, she becomes extremely clumsy and accidentally hurts people around her, even her crush! Will Hiyo ever be able to confess her feelings?

title: The Life of Genius Professor Yanagizawa
description:
Won the Kodansha Manga Award for general manga in 2003.  
  
Yoshinori Yanagisawa, professor of economics at University of Y. Walks to the right of the road and does not cross it except for at crosswalks.  
  
This story is a clear and pleasant record of a scholar who adheres to the Road Traffic Law and is faithful to the laws of the free economy.

title: Kitamachi-san wa "Tada no" Tomodachi
description:
「これでトモダチだね」

憧れの北町さんの席で、放課後こっそりひとりエッチをしていた南屋くん。それをあろうことか北町さん本人に見つかってしまった！完全に終わった……と絶望する南屋くんだが、北町さんは南屋くんの手を取り口元に……？友達なのに？トモダチだから？

title: The Loser
description: To reward Meng Fan for his good deeds before his death, the Universe awarded him with a System, and returned him to three months before. He received missions, and if he completed the missions, he earned achievements that gave him traits. The story begins as he received this mission: confess to and be rejected by 100 people...

title: Kozue-chan no Koukan Nikki
description: Hayami Chiho, after a bad experience six months ago, is having an aversion to text messaging. She worries so much about her replies, that it takes her forever to revise and edit them—causing misunderstandings and hurt feelings. Her classmate, Kozue-kun, suggests using an exchange diary as practice… will Chiho be able to overcome her anxieties?

title: Kodomo x Otona no Houteishiki
description: Nanjou is a divorced father with a child, Chiharu. Chiharu's teacher from the childcare center, Aiba, ends up staying at the Nanjou family's place to take care of Chiharu as his 'mom.' How does the relationship between Nanjou and Aiba progress?

title: Kami ka Akuma ka
description:
A girl who dreams of fated meetings - Kizuna. The one she met in a suspicious western-style house, the "Yuurei Library", was a good-looking but demon-like young man - Ruu. On top of that, Ruu has an unbelievable secret…! A cursed love hidden in the masterpiece "Romeo and Juliet". Searching for a new ending, the gears of fate have started to move–!?  
  
Pt-Br:  
Kizuna sonha em ter um "partner fated"(predestinado ou futuro parceiro). Em um sonho em uma biblioteca antiga, conhecida como "biblioteca fantasma", Kizuna reencontra Ruu, um jovem garoto misterioso que guarda um grande segredo e que aparece em seus sonhos frequentemente. Em cima disso um amor maldito escondido na obra "Romeu e Julieta" a procura de um novo final. As engrenadas do destino começaram a se mover. O que acontecerá com Kizuna??

title: Himitsu no Oshikake Kyuuketsuki
description:
Nagisa Dojoji, who entered a prestigious school to become a first-class violinist, is a young lady of a large company that everyone recognizes.
She was supposed to be well behaved, talented, and admired by everyone, but in reality, she is a self-indulgent girl who loves junk food and has no self-supporting skills!
She was enjoying the life of her dreams when a vampire suddenly appeared in front of her.

The vampire, who calls himself “Rudy,” offers to become Nagisai's “housekeeper” for the sake of her special blood, “Mawaku no Mitsu,” which flows through her veins.

This is a high-tension cohabitation romantic comedy that will keep you in a dizzying daze!

title: C♥C♥C
description:
From Shoujo Manga Maniac:  
  
Kojima Mitsu (a.k.a. Honey) is in middle school (She's 12 years old) but she's so small that she looks like she's in elementary school! One day while she is is changing into a maid uniform for a school event (with not much success…the uniform is too big for her), she find a little bat blocked by the window and helps it. Suddenly an awesome guy appears in front of her! He is a vampire and as thanks for saving his "toy," he helps turn her into an adult (with a kiss)…

title: Renjou Sparkle
description: Sawara Yume has been playing the violin for over 10 years now. She's not particularly good at it but she likes to play. Right before her debut in a violin duet, a student from her school tells her that she plays bad and that she should just give up. This doesn't stop Yume, actually, now she is even more determined to do good at the school's violin duet concert. Her plans don't go so well as she ends up playing the duet with Seima, the boy that insulted her violin skills earlier. Despite their differences, the performance goes really well, but what will Yume do after Seima kisses her in front of everyone after the concert?

title: Let's Stay Together Forever
description:
From CPM:
From the 80's comes big hair, heavy metal and romance. High school throws everyone together, from shy and geeky bookworms to bawdy outrageous metalheads. These cliques can get very exclusive and people will seldom cross the lines, but when they do…everyone is watching! Will Leo the metalhead and Ayami the shy quiet girl ever realize that they were made for each other or will they remain glued to their little cliques?

title: Koiiro Omoi
description:
I've always, always longed for this. Fancy gossip with friends. And my first love. The girl who thinks this, Ayumu, met the sparkling boy Kanata. When she sees him, her heart beats fast and her chest feels tight. These feelings… is that love?  
  
Also includes two other stories:  
  
- Love Ego  
  
- Katakoi Iro

title: Jippu Jippu Byuun!
description: Naho Yoshihara just wants to be an oridinary first year, but Kouki, her brother, won't stop pressuring her to join his band, ZIP! At a young age, her brother had convinced Naho that she had super human guitar playing powers, but now she's no longer convinced. How will her brother and his bandmates trick Naho into playing with them at their school's festival?

title: First Love - Anata ga Watashi o Sabishiku Saseru
description: Azayoshi lives in an empty world, there is no hope or happiness, all she wants is a person who will never leave her side. Suddenly Ai steps into her dark world. To her he was her love. But what will happen when he discovers Azayoshi's past? Why is she keeping secrets from Ai?

title: My Hero Academia - Meisekimu ni wa Hodotooi (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Gikyoudai
description:
"A classmate suddenly became my 'older brother'…?"  
High-school student Shinozaki Aya can't help but take care of others. The only one to relieve her burden is her classmate and close friend Haruki. But what will happen when they learn about their parents' remarriage to one another? Will they really be able to become siblings?

title: Taiyou wa Kimi ni Kagayaku
description:
“I must get into that school!”  
  
That was the sudden thought Chinatsu had during the summer of her third year in middle school. Chinatsu never really thought about her goals and dreams in life, but after seeing a match in the Japan National High School Baseball Tournament (or Koushien), she suddenly had a goal to achieve! She worked extra hard, and finally got into the school, but on the first day, she meets a fierce looking senpai who is actually the baseball team’s ace player! Once again, Chinatsu did her best and managed to be the baseball team’s manager, yet the most important player is…?!

title: Please Don’t Be So Conceited
description: Male polytechnic honor student He Zhizhou and airheaded yet lovable female idiot Shen Xi had their bodies swapped in an accident. From the ever-present issues of misplaced youth to the supernatural chance encounters, the two of their lives have changed a lot from their past. He Zhizhou was forced to live in the female dorms, and Shen Xi had no choice but to adapt to the life of a man… This fresh new take on the school-life slice-of-life romcom is about to begin!

title: Zettai Donkan
description: Taki Kanon and Nakamori Ryou met through a piano in their first year of high school. Nakamori played video game songs beautifully, while Taki's talent lay in piano tuning. They were in the same class, and they spent a lot of time together at a piano. But shyness and misunderstanding plagued the formation of a more serious relationship. Over the years, will they be able to find a way to make the paths of their lives finally converge?

title: Nobles' Love Company
description: Lang Lang, a 15-year-old Korean girl, got adopted by the Freeman family in England, when she was three years old. With a big donation from the Freeman family, Lang Lang got accepted into the prestigious 'IDOL' high school. The school is very famous for its smart, famous, and rich students. Lang Lang's step-brother, Ian Freeman, has never accepted Lang Lang as his sister, and even though he's the school body's president and the head idol, as he excels in everything he does, he decides not to help out when his biggest rival, Choe Jang Gun, targets Lang Lang.

title: Birikketsu no Mahou
description:
1-3: Imperfect Love Spell  
First year Ueda isn't interested in joining any of the clubs until Momotani Yuushi, crybaby vice-president of the supernatural club, runs into him. Unable to leave his pathetic and adorable senpai alone, Ueda finds himself drawn into the increasingly odd life of the supernatural club.  
  
4: Yowareru Karada  
A swimming lesson reveals ulterior motives between a senpai and his cute kouhai.  
  
5: Doukashite Iru!  
Manager Muroi is regarded as attractive, clumsy and hopeless as marriage material by the girls in the office. Good thing there's the adorable and sincere Ogawa and the stoic Taki to take his mind off his hopeless love life.  
  
6: Power Of Pants  
Computer geek and general otaku Takahashi considers himself undersized, but he only has porn to compare himself to. Takahashi's recently struck up an unlikely friendship with jock Miyamoto. Maybe this could be his chance to compare sizes…  
  
7: You're Still Standing In The Same Place, Looking At The S

title: The End of Summer
description: Maeda and Sakuma catch each others eyes every now and then. At the last day of school before summer break, they say 'see you later' but it doesn't really end up that way.

title: Gakuen Tengoku
description: Koizumi Momo has just moved to a new school, and is quickly discovering that her new classmates are...oddballs, to say the least. Little does she know that she's in for an adventure full of nothing but chaos!

title: Beatlyfe
description: Beatlyfe is a place where game freaks, music nerds, and adrenaline junkies intersect: a rhythm arcade. Join our heroes (read: rhythm gamers) as they work tirelessly to top their high scores, find the best late-night noodles, and support each other through life — arcade culture at its finest.

title: 37°C Kiss
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- 37℃ Kissu  
Naoki was a very cool and good looking guy, but somehow after meeting Fumika-chan, he's not cool at all, but very cute?!  
  
- Himitsu no Namida (Secret Tears)  
He saved his second button for her, but on their last day, she handed him a love letter to give to his best friend. Instead of delivering that letter, he kept it himself, and asked her to go out with him instead…?  
  
- Caramel Kiss  
Atsushi-sensei is Kawahara's first love, will he be able to accept her affections?  
  
- Shounen Knife  
Until Riki moved in, the house next door to Mimi's was always vacant. Riki saved Mimi's cat, but it seems that he isn't as well mannered as she first thought?  
  
- Kiss, Zekkou, Kiss (Bokura no Baai Extra)

title: Tenshi Kouryaku Manual
description: Tenko, a girl who always went to an all-girl school, after making friend with a stuffed dinosaur who also speaks, decides to try the entrance exam of a mixed school, previously an all boy school, because she fell in love at the first sight with one of their students : Madoka. A cute and lovely story about a first love!!

title: Fugitto Amor
description: Two souls are linked by a heirloom rose garden.

title: Amayakasanaide Maid-kun!
description: Mitsu Hachinomiya, the daughter of the infamous Hachinomiya family, was banished from her prestigious school and transferred to Ohanabatake High School, where her grandmother's family attended, in order to start her youth over in a place where no one knows her. However, it is a place of delinquents, and the most dangerous-looking boy named Sumire Kitamura, who saved Mitsu from getting into trouble as early as the transfer, comes on to her and says, “I'm your maid”!

title: Koishite Nanbo!
description: Anri is a very active girl, pursuing love. One day when she is trying to conquer Morio-kun, think and stumbles Kiriya, the student council president, who has a hobby. But by chance, discovers that he likes her best friend, Sayuri-san. What will Anri do now? Will she help him or blackmail him?

title: Soushoku Danshi Okotowari!?
description: I love Takai-kun in one of my favourite books that I'm reading, but Fukai-san disagrees with his character. To settle our differences, I challenged him, a push-over to act as a dominant Takai-kun, while I, as the meek heroine in a fake date. I seems I get more than a bargained for in that day…

title: Tongari Root
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- Tongari Root  
Ruu is a high school student who studies seriously everyday, aiming to become like her genius brother, Shikyu. At this time, at Ruu's side, comes Jijyou, Shikyu's friend, who become's Ruu's teacher at home. Although Ruu's life has been messed up by the daring Jijyou, she has started to have feelings for him…  
  
- Monochrome Candy  
It can't be cast off, it's fascinating, that silver wrapped candy.  
  
- Bye-bye Babe  
Flowers will bloom upon the earth.  
  
- Love Fight  
So Beautiful! With this thought, my body just moves by itself. I really want them to see him now.

title: Hebigami-kun wa Samui to Henshin Shichau kara
description:
The transfer student, Hebigami-kun, has a peculiar trait: when he gets cold, he turns into a snake.

Mysterious and feared by everyone, only his seatmate Haruna knows that he's actually kind-hearted. Unless his body temperature rises, Hebigami-kun can’t return to his human form. Haruna starts to worry about him and tries to keep him warm.

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title: Doctor Zelos
description: Former professional baseball player Nonami retired at a young age due to an injury. Being "not enough" for him, he goes through the path of a sports doctor...!?

title: Haikyuu! - Zettaiteki! Fukashin Ryouiki (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Sawamura Daichi x Sugawara Koushi

title: Back in Time to You
description: Accidentally stumbling across a hidden attic after moving back to a house in his hometown, Yeoh-Ho finds a 10-year-old diary which makes him recall the memory he most wanted to erase: the day his friend Jae-Ha died!

title: Kyou, Sekai Ichi no Kokuhaku wo.
description:
From Batoto Scans :
A ‘confession’ is that moment when you become special to the person you love...

“It’s not a Special Confession” - Valentine's Day with a classmate.
“Deciding not to Confess” - I decided not to confess because I want to be with you.
“The End of Summer and the Missing Confession” - Reuniting with the person who confessed to me a long time ago.
“The Confession was made after a Happy Ending” - I confessed my feelings for the third time, and we ended up going out, but...

A collection of 4 short stories about pure confessions from each season!

Note: The series was first published under the title "Kimi ga Suki tte Iitai" in Dessert Pink.

title: Koe ga Kikitai Kodaira-kun
description:
"I really liked that voice—"

On the day of the school entrance ceremony, Teppei Kodaira got absolutely charmed by the voice of Tsugumi Kuritani, who delivered a speech as the representative of the incoming freshman students. By complete coincidence, Teppei's seat in class was also right next to the owner of "that voice", Kuritani-san. But just when he thinks they'll gradually become closer... Kuritani-san sends him a message: "Teppei, it's embarrassing to let you hear my voice just for the sake of your reactions!" Kodaira-kun wants to hear her voice, and Kuritani-san doesn't want to be heard by him.
___
Additional Links:
* [Comipo](https://comipo.app/series/web/34749/) (Publisher)

title: Hitosaki no Hana
description:
A collection of short stories:  
  
1) Kobore Mono (Things That Drip)  
2) Kimochi Kurabe: Natsu (A Measure of Feelings: Summer)  
3-5) Hitosaki no Hana (A Single Bloom)  
- Oohime  
- Yoshitaka  
- Sakura Shibe Furu (Falling Sakura Pistils)

title: Kurohyou-kun wa Tabechaitai.
description: Yuno, the daughter of a lunch box shop owner, is interested in an eccentric and pierced weirdo named Hyou-chan. But is Leopard-chan someone Yuno should not fall for...?

title: Fatal Choices X
description: After a lot of traumatic events Strive receives an app on his phone that will give him three choices at random times that will change his life and those around him. Little does he know that all 5 app users will soon decide the fate of the world.

title: Ore wa Warukunai
description: Makoto has always looked up to his cool older cousin, Toshi. After all, it was the movie-obsessed Toshi that told him to never settle for being a boring adult. But now that Makoto's a teenager, he senses a big change in Toshi's outlook. Could it be that his freedom-loving cousin has given up on his dream of making movies? Only a look back into the highs and lows of Toshi's wild days with his school's Film Club can part the curtains on this made-for-the-big-screen mystery!

title: Kemono Renairon
description:
1. Kemono Renairon  
  
2. Karakuchi Kakumei  
Natsui has always liked the chairman of the student council, Kazuki Oda. But ever since a long time ago, she's been bad at dealing with people. She easily gets nervous, and, to hide her embarrassment, always puts on a hard face. So how will she be able to make her feelings reach her admired Oda-kun?!  
  
3. Sore wa, Nigai, Chocolate.  
Yuri hates to be alone, so she'll spend time with any guy who comes along. Chiyo Kyosuke, a teacher at her school, finds this behavior repulsive, but Yuri seems to have fallen in love with him all the same.  
  
4. Eien no "Suki" ga Hajimaru Hi

title: LovePlus: Girls Talk
description:
Based on DS Dating Sim "Love Plus".
Following the three girls as they live under one roof.

title: Secret!
description:
Shuuji is a new teacher, but most of his worries don't stem from the stress at being in a new situation, but from the nightly visits of his lover Yuu – a student at the same school. And Yuu has … issues.  
  
The new teacher, Shuuji, has a little something to worry about… His beautiful lover comes sneaking into his room night after night. The mornings can be harsh when you've been forced to have sex with your lover every night. But… That's not what's worrying him. See, his lover is actually one of his students, Yuu! As a teacher and pupil, their relationship is of course kept a secret from those around them, but what's even more dangerous is Yuu's rather odd hobby. What will be in store for them…!?

title: Kimi no Torso o Tsukuritai
description:
Rito is a shy girl who dreams of a typical high school romance. Her complex is her large breasts.
By chance, she meets an art boy named Shibata, who says to her, "Let me create that body," and her youth is set in motion.

**The pure "sculpture-making" romantic comedy begins!**

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Yu Narukami Fell In Love With Chie
description: Persona 4 oneshot for Yu x Chie

title: Haru Iro Koi Gokoro
description: Yukari had finally saw the true face of her senpai she has a crush on, and it was not that great. When she comes again to his Japanese sweet shop to buy some sweets, she also finds a nicer side to him. Cherishing her alone time with him, she starts to fall for his true self. What will happen when other girls also find that nice side to him?

title: Naruto - JieYingKUN's Previous drawings (Doujinshi)
description: It's Sakura and Sasuke in an alternate world's school life setting.

title: Suisai
description:
"In an orchestra, no one 'runs' alone…"  
In middle school Sano Urara was the ace of the track-and-field club. Now in high school she desires to try new things. While being chased around by those who want her to return to the sport, Urara bumps into a boy part of the music club who invites her to come listen.

title: Kare no Iinari
description:
Rika is known to be a cheerful girl, but is that her real self?  
  
Rika es una chica divertida y popular, pero como es en realidad?

title: Haikyu!! - Lemon Taste (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

From September Scanlations:

Kageyama and Hinata share their first kiss–and Kageyama is on cloud 9, until he overhears Hinata mention that he had his first kiss a year earlier.

title: Violence na Kimi ga Suki
description: A stupid and tall student, Myouenji, loves a small but delinquent student, Kuroda. Myouenji keeps stalking Kuroda though he knows Kuroda adores Masaki, a very cool guy. But soon after, Kuroda kisses Myouenji by mistake instead of Masaki…

title: Airyouran Gakuen
description:
From Fantasyshrine:  
  
In the all-boys school, Blooming Love Academy, there's a super-elite group where gorgeous guys flock in unrestrained abundance, the GLG (Gorgeous-Looking Guys). Even the people off-campus have heard of them. One fateful day during the preparation of the school's Christmas party, Echizen Makoto encounters the tall, handsome Fujimiya. Will the ordinary-looking Makoto ever have a chance to make his wish come true!?

title: Girl Crazy
description:
Miku is on the same tennis team as her childhood crush, Tomo-nii.  
Not only can this guy kick ass in tennis, he's also good-looking and super nice! The only thing that Miku doesn't like about him is his brother, Natsume. Completely opposite from his older brother, Natsume is known to play girls, and be a basic cocky pain in the neck.  
But one day, Miku finds out something about him that ends up shocking her to no end…!!

title: Haru Kurari
description: Second-year high school student Kuraki quietly draws manga in his free time, but although he wants to draw a bright and bubbly main character, his own more subdued personality means that his main characters always turn out gloomy like him. Then he meets Urara Haruno, a dazzling girl who sparkles like spring sunshine and attends a private school for young ladies from wealthy families. Kuraki is so inspired that he draws a new manga chapter all in one sitting, using Haruno as the model for the main character, but how will she react when she reads the manga herself?! This is a school love story of an artist, his muse, and their budding relationship!

title: Love & Noise!
description:
Sweet Skulls' energetic Kuroko thinks of the popular band 'Nitro Pop' as her enemy because there was once when she was ignored by their unsociable vocalist scum guitarist, Niko. However, their songs and performances are so captivating that it's hard not to be mesmerised by them… Turns out there's a plan for them to perform at the same live event…?! With pure funk beat that's guaranteed to capture your heart, the emotional rock romance makes its grand appearance!  
  
Also includes:  
  
- Renai Misui  
  
- Ero Pure

title: Incident at Honnoji Temple
description: Natsuneko's "Incident at Honnoji Temple" is a short teacher-student story.

title: Crush on You
description: Minhee lost her parents in a car accident at the age of 12. After the accident, Minhee is raised by the family of her male friend, Pilho, but suffers torment and discrimination. It's almost as if at this point, Pilho is like her real family. However, for Pilho, Minhee is not family. Little by little, he starts to see her as more than just a friend, but what happens when the new next door neighbor, an older guy, catches Minhee's eye? What if this guy, Kang Muyeol, is actually the new teacher at Minhee's school?!

title: Kokoro Note
description: She has a secret little notebook filled with her goals and thoughts of him..?

title: Kirakira to Yoru ni Furu
description:
A girl who was bullied and ready to give up everything.  
A boy who never knew fun because of his circumstances. Until the night of the first snow.  
Somehow they met again in a night-time school.  
"The day you taught me that I'm not alone, I decided I'd face forward and live on."

title: Sugar Ball Diary
description: Heart-throbbing first love story of a baseball club's hard-working manager Aoi and its ace Kanzaki!

title: Brothers Conflict Gimme the Love!!
description:
SAKAMOTO Sayo brings 5 short extra stories about events in the daily life of the Asahina brothers. All stories are original and four of them are from the unique perspective of mob characters!  
  
- It's tough for a fellow high school student living in the same building as the Asahina family.  
- The day Futo tells his manager he wants to take the entrance exam for a certain high school.  
- Natsumi has a crush on her schoolmate Yusuke. She's working hard to achieve her love no matter how hopeless he seems.  
- Subaru's basketball team.  
- The Asahina family on the day Wataru, the youngest son, is born!  
  
Based on the light novel series *Brothers Conflict* and its otome game (visual novel) and anime adaptations.

title: Socrates in Love
description:
In a small regional town in 1980s southern Japan, Sakutaro "Saku" Matsumoto and Aki Hirose, who were classmates all through junior high school, become high school students and then fall in love with one another. They share audio diaries, go on excursions together, and enjoy summer vacation.  
  
However, Aki soon finds herself suffering from Leukemia and begins to weaken day by day, rendering her unable to see Saku or go outside…

title: C-Kei Otome Renmei
description: Contains 3 stories and unrelated stories.

title: Kaede Ninpouchou
description: After an old family friend shows up to throw Kaede and her ninja family out of their secluded mountain home, the three of them must brave a new world - Tokyo - and fight off malicious goons to stay safe.

title: Teacher's Doll
description:
Sumika is a high school girl without a family. She is taken in by Shoumei, who is a teacher at a prestigious all-girls school. He declares to her, "I'll be the one to teach you."

---

• [Official Twitter](https://twitter.com/sensei_oningyo)

title: Cat Couple
description: The full title of this webtoon is A Common Couple Who Met Through a Cat. The author shortened it to "Cat Couple." This is a cute, comical and bitter story of a cat.

title: Yume Kui Annainin
description: Marin, a caretaker from the Dream Management Bureau, works with Bakuo, a Dream Tapir, to turn young girls' nightmares into sweet dreams. Perhaps they'll come to visit you at your pillow tonight...? A heartwarming dreamy fantasy!

title: Young Lovers
description:
We have this girl Kokoro, and a guy that looks like her favorite model, Reiji. Could this be…destiny?  
  
Note: The series went on hiatus after the author began to feel fatigued from cancer. Even though she has since written 5 volumes of another series, this one remains thus far as unfinished.

title: Hidan no Aria - Shiden no Majo
description: 平穏な日常を過ごすキンジに、ジャンヌから一通の手紙が届く。指定場所に向かうと、そこには異形の集団が待ち構えていた。 キンジの日常は再び崩れ去る…。

title: Boys'n Girl
description: Aria Hoshina transfers to the prestigious school, Saiko Garden, to be with her father, who told her he supervises a girl's dorm. When she arrives there she finds the 222 BOYS that live there to be troublesome.

title: Houkago Shinjuu
description: After school Lover's Suicide. Is there a terminal station ahead?

title: Rumor Has It
description: A toxic and rumored life doesn't make Agatha Bellen, a thriller writer give up on living her life. Oh… Rumor Has It, She's not the protagonist in this story.

title: Ai no Chikara de Koi wo Surunoda
description: When rich, gorgeous and heartbroken Keiichiro Kuroda's ex-lover asks for a loan, he makes a bet with the man: he'll leave 5 million yen in a park with a sign that reads "Please Use Freely," and if it gets turned into the police, his ex can borrow the money; if someone takes the money, Keiichiro can finally turn away the man who broke his heart. But when the first person to spot the money ends up being a handsome young man in trouble, can Keiichiro give up on his quest for revenge and fall in love once more?

title: Boku no Hero Academia -  Kiss Made Tooi Manga (Doujinshi)
description:
Bakugou Katsuki/Todoroki Shouto
This is the story of the ordeals that two inexperienced, young lovers must go through to achieve their First Kiss.

title: Snow Drop
description:
"People become unhappy because they only think about the past and the future… not the present.."  
So-Na, unable to remember a painful event in her past, is living only for her mother's nursery, "The Snowdrop". When she meets Hae-Gi, the intentionally isolated and beautiful model, they instantly click and fall in love. However, a dark secret that connects them, threatens to tear them apart. Like a modern-day Romeo and Juliet, Snowdrop is about two star-crossed teens who fall madly in love.  
  
Also included in this manga is a short story called 'What Is Fate…?' in volume five.  
  
Yu He-Min has traveled back in time and is on a mission: to stop her parents from marrying!

title: Pure Gold Aristocrat
description:
A super prestigous school that will make you jealous! A complicated student life is about to begin!  
  
Cai Ying is ending her study tour in England with her good friend Gong Liang Hui, taking Elizabeth High's ocean liner back to school. As she is ready to board the ship at the harbor, she bumps into a mysterious handsome man who is being chased–?!

title: Hana to Watashi ni Ongaku wo
description: I’ll sing this song for you in the garden… so come and listen to the song while gazing at flowers.

title: Roke Mani
description: Sugawa Raika is a pretty normal second year in high school… except for her unhealthy obsession with good-looking boys. When she meets Tamaki Jun, a boy at her school, she is just as determined and boy-crazy as she's ever been. But Raika has met her match in Jun; he smiles sweetly at her advances, telling her nicely that he is, in fact, not from planet earth!

title: Sawaru no Kinshi!! Ore no Mono.
description:
For a long time Akagi Ayane has been suffering from Hyper-Sensitivity. But she has to keep that fact hidden, especially in high school! Unfortunately for her, someone from her school, Aizawa, discovers her secret.

***Included one-shots:***
1. Kawaii Otoko no Ko no Kaikata
2. [16-sai nanode Kekkon shimasu!!](https://mangadex.org/title/060f34d5-adb3-4242-b39f-e67e15a7e3a8/) (I'm only 16, but I'll get married!! , 16歳なので結婚します！！)
3. Anata wa Ouji-sama desu ka!?

title: Suki ni Natte mo Ii no?
description: When Yuuki first meets Akihisa she is less than impressed. Not only is he stalking her, but he also tries to seduce her knowing full well she's a high school student who already has a boyfriend. She can't stand him at all so why is she so drawn to him? On the surface Akihisa seems like the worst kind of man… Is he just toying with Yuuki or does he really care about her?

title: Kuchibiru Kudasai
description: My dream of a fairy tale kiss, dashed.

title: Green Apple Romance
description:
This collection of five short stories illustrate how the author's drawings have changed through the years:  
  
1) Akuma no Kuchibiru  
Eri was being harrassed on the streets by her ex-boyfriend Yuji. Out of nowhere, Kei came to her rescue but then he suddenly forced her to kiss him!! Ever since that day, Eri has not been able to forget that passionate kiss. One day, Eri met Kei again at her workplace. Unknowingly, Eri fell in love with him…!!  
  
2) Green Apple Romance  
She knew him in middle school, and finally transferred to his high school to an unfriendly welcoming.  
  
3) Bad Kozo Doki  
Friends, Delinquents, Schemers, Lovers.  
  
4) Mitsumete Bike Boy  
Senya decides to confess to her sempai on his graduation day.  
  
5) Jungle Boy  
As Nao is late to school, she's taken along for a ride on a rope with Aso, almost smashing into a window!

title: Dakara Koi to Yobanaide
description: At the end of the second semester, a teacher came. Everybody in class quickly opened their hearts for the childlike adult, Jiro-chan. Kokoro knew that Sensei loved her because he asked her for help. However, Fuwa-kun, the one I love, hated Sensei.

title: Royal Straight
description:
1-3) Royal Straight  
Karen is a "half", born of a Japanese father and German mother. Having always lived in Germany until now, as a present for her 16th birthday, she goes to Japan which she admired so much. Hoping to find her soulmate but…!?  
  
4) Anata ni Koishite Watashi wa  
  
5) Osatoudzuke no Misu Hanii -  
Lily Amemiya has the perfect boyfriend–Yoh Tsuruta. Unfortunately, lots of other girls think so, too. How will poor Lily deal with all the attention her boyfriend gets!?  
  
Italian:  
5) Osatoudzuke no Misu Hanii -  
Lily Amemiya ha il fidanzato perfetto, Yoh Tsuruta. Purtroppo un sacco di ragazze pensano a lui. Come farà la povera Lily ad avere tutta l'attenzione del fidanzato tutta per lei?

title: Okujou de Kimi to Yume Miru
NG × Baby
description: Takatou Mitsuki luckily passed the exam for Honmaru, an elite high school, and now she finds herself struggling to catch up with all the smart students here. To make matters worse, Mitsuki was chosen as her class’ representative in the Survival game at school. Amidst the chaos, she finds out that Honmaru has a system where scholarship students are expected to take care of students with poor academic ability like her. And thus, Mitsuki is stuck with this handsome guy called Aoi Kousuke, who’s only helping her because of the money he gets from the school. But somehow, Mitsuki has the feeling she has seen Aoi somewhere before…

title: The Princesses of the Boys' School
description:
In the Reiwa era, not long ago, there were two "princesses" at an all-boys school called Otogi High School.
Every day is happy and easy at school, but something feels lacking, and the two princesses fall in love at first sight!?
What will become of the secrets and love that these "princesses" who are more than just cute hold?

title: Handsome Ace: Triple String of Love
description: Sharon's parents died in an accident. They left her in the care of their close friend, Mrs Mu. Sharon entered the noble academy as the basketball star Minz's younger sister…

title: Guide to Unpopularity
description: One day, the female lead suddenly grows a halo on top of her head. It was also on this day that her parents won the lottery and got promoted. This lucky day opened a path for her and her older brother to be transferred to a prestigious high school. However, that night, she dreamt of looking through a mysterious manga panel, and saw a mangaka and his editor deep in discussion. She realized quickly that she was the female lead of a shojo manga, and the tragic fate that awaits her. The truth came to be that she will later be pursued by many hotties, and that isn’t necessarily a good thing!?

title: Mask Catharsis
description: Behind Student Council Vice President Yuuko's cool facade lies a secret that she is desperate to keep from flamboyant President Hasumi. But how long can she go before her mask cracks on Christmas Eve and she's exposed?

title: Love Me Pom Poko
description:
The manga will center on a heroine who is also a tanuki, who lives together with handsome twins.

(from mangaupdates)

title: Dear Gentle Papa
description: Haruhiko has just been confided by his friend, Kyotarou, that he is seeing someone. That "significant other" turns out to be Nao, a young elementary school boy. Nao's mother died when he was younger and the only person taking care of him is his dad, Hirofumi. Scared that Hirofumi might find out about their relationship, Kyotarou asks Haruhiko to tag along on their outings in order to conceal the relationship from Hirofumi. Haruhiko reluctantly agrees but what he hadn't expected was to develop feelings for Nao's father.

title: Magamono Renai
description:
Hitoko, a member of the photography club, likes Aki, a flirtatious guy in the newspaper club, but she can't confess her love to him, so she takes his pictures as he orders. Hitoko's junior, Kodai, can't bear to see her like this and makes her a proposal: "If you tell Aki that you were confessed to by me, she might become interested in you." Hitoko is shaken by the joy of being a fake lover and the guilt of pretending to be one. She tells Aki everything and tries to stop, but Kodai changes her mind! The three of them have their own "love" for each other, and their thoughts and feelings intersect in this heartbreaking but bitter love triangle.

(google translated)

title: Homemade Home
description:
From MegKF:  
  
The daughter of a washed out actress is given the chance to see what it's like to be in a real family.  
  
Itsumi's mother, Kei, is a washed-up actress. One day, Itsumi meets a lady with a severe heart condition and receives an invitation to her house. The house, which Itsumi thinks of as the ideal family home, was just a performance arranged for the lady. Among the family members, Itsumi meets Shuu, a very polite boy, and is persuaded to play in a theatre… ?!

title: Shanguri Rabu
description:
Contains four short stories:  
  
シャングリラブ (Shangri Love)  
ベイビースター (Baby Star)  
恋ゴコロ (Koigokoro)  
花のなまえ (Hana no Namae)

title: Odeko no Mahou
description: One day during soccer practice, Eiko gets hit on the forehead by a ball kicked by Shigeru. The next day, a strange word appears at the very spot, and it changes to reflect her emotions. What happened to her forehead, and what is it supposed to mean?

title: Persona 5 - Ashita, Anata wa Koko ni Inai
description: Collection of short stories centered on the protagonist (named Akira Kurusu) and Makoto Niijima. This doujinshi is composed of older works published online and new works created for the collection.

title: Ano Kado wo Magatta Tokoro
description: Yuuya, a high school student, unexpectedly bumps into Kiriya-san while walking down the street and ends up saving the older man's life. The two are "neither friends nor lovers," but form a companionship in order to listen to each other's troubles. Will this bond turn into love?

title: Love Blind Spot
description:
Hojun possesses a unique ability to see a sign above people's heads - those that he is attracted to!  
  
When Hojun saw the sign above the famous Woosung head, he feels the need to save this person.  
Romance between the two unlikely classmates blooms as they begin to get to know more about the other.

title: Strażnicy Servamp
description:
Agencja Egao - nikt nie wie skąd się wzięła i kto właściwie ją założył. Pracują w niej ludzie, jak i magiczne osobniki, których zadaniem jest dbanie, by zwykli ziemianinie nie zobaczyli nikogo spoza ich rasy. Raimei oraz reszta Servamp'ów, oprócz uganiania się za magicznymi stworami, musi dbać o portal między wymiarami, by przypadkiem ktoś przez niego nie przeszedł i nie zniszczył czasoprzestrzeni.  
   
   
   
 Siedmioro wampirów, właściwie przez dwadzieścia cztery godziny musi dbać o portal, przerzucający do innego wymiaru, jednak pewnego dnia dwoje z nich postanawia się zbuntować przeciwko porządkowi panującemu na tym świecie, chcą doprowadzić do prawdziwego Ragnaroku, a w tym samym momencie wampir Lenistwa świętuje urodziny ostatniego narodzonego wampira - Chciwości."

title: Furenai de, Seibo-sama
description: Himari, known as the 'Holy Mother' of the school, is heartbroken when her childhood friend Daiya, whom she has had a crush on for years, gets a girlfriend. In the midst of her heartbreak, a junior boy, Itsuki, confesses to her, "I've always loved you"...? She still loves him, but she can't resist Itsuki, who ignores her rule of 'not touching the Holy Mother'...?

title: Houkago, Sena-sensei no Dekiai ga Amasugiru
description: Tsumugi just entered high school and met a handsome teacher, Mr. Sena. He is light, flirtatious, and honestly not the type of teacher she likes, but before she knows it, Tsumugi can't stop the crush she has on him...!

title: Joyful Days?
description: Keigo Satou has a crush on his classmate/friend, Arai, who is always cheerful. He tries to make her fall in love with him even though she doesn't notice him.

title: Urino Kiko Works Collection
description:
## Volume 1: Bara Datte Kakeru yo
1. Bara Datte Kakeru yo
2. Origin of My Love '98
3. Nichiyoubi ni Jisatsu
4. Origin of My Love '09
5. Tooi Hi no Boy
6. Origin of My Love
7. Haruta no Hankou

## Volume 2: Dousousei Daikou
1. Dousousei Daikou
2. Houmonsha
3. Paradise Zen'ya
4. Motto Motto Yoku Mite
5. Mimei no Girl / Predawn Girls
Captures a few moments in the early hours of the morning.
6. Motto Motto Motto Yoku Mite
7. Last Circus
8. Ai no Kemono ni Shitagainasai

## Volume 3: Shiawase ni Naritai (I Want to Be Happy)
1. Kitanai Otona ni Naru Mae ni
2. Fuantei Datta Koro no Kimi ga Suki
3. Akebono-kun to Akebono-san
4. Yumemi ga Machi Pajama Party
5. Honeymoon
6. Shiawase ni Naritai 1
7. Shiawase ni Naritai 2
8. Sonna ni Minaide

title: Love Equation (KODAKA Kazuma)
description: The one-year-younger cry-baby and childhood friend, Kanade, suddenly took Meguru’s first kiss! Though he's grown taller a bit recently, and the girls made a big fuss and called him “the piano prince”, I will not be tricked. He’s a pervert who steals another guy’s lips! With additional pages, the perfect version is now on sale. ♥

title: Junjou x Mousou Honey
description: Yuri, who’s writing a novel on her beloved Mitsuki-kun. Became super popular, but she has to keep it a secret from Mitsuki-kun no matter what…

title: Kataomoi no Kakudo
description: I sit next to him. I’m curious about him everyday!! But why isn’t it me? A story about the four people around him starts!!

title: Shibararetai
description:
During the Edo era, as the successor of a famous store, Seijirou was publically considered as a total playboy; but secretly, he's keeping an eye on the school's teacher, Toshinoshin. Under the pressure of his family and a forced omiai, he confesses to Toshinoshin- but he never expected that Toshinoshin was actually a wolf in sheep's clothes!  
  
Chapter 1: Shibararetai  
Chapter 2: Iroasobikoi no Hajimari  
Chapter 3: Time after school  
Chapter 4: Sweet Life  
Chapter 5: You&Me, started in summer  
Chapter 6: You&Me, looking at each other in winter  
Extra: You&Me, smiling in spring

title: Ikutsu Mo No Kisetsu O, Kun To
Mikage-kun wa Oshi ga Tsuyoi
description: Matsumoto Hinata, a lonely otaku, finds her only daily joy in watching streams of the VTuber Amami You–sama. On her first day at a new school, the person sitting next to her is Mikage Touma, a boy feared by everyone after suddenly causing a violent incident during the entrance ceremony. Now, a love story begins between a fangirl devoted to her “idol” and a yakuza boy harboring a massive secret──.

title: Easy Chocolate
description:
1) "Easy Chocolate" is about a guy who thinks women are annoying, but there's a particularly persistent one! Will she succeed in winning his heart?  
  
2) "Heavy Clouds, No Rain" is about a young couple that suddenly gets a visit from a stranger who demands consolation money!  
  
3) "Broach" is basically a story revolving around a cat that a couple picked up once.  
  
4) "From the Cabbage Kingdom '03: Hesitation" is about a reluctant but budding teenage love between an unlikely pair.

title: Yano Junkyouju no Risei to Yokujou
Double Sentiment
description:
1. Double Sentiment  
Emi and Atsushi have been dating for one month now, and to be able to become one with the person you like is like a miracle. The feeling of happiness is overwhelming, but apparently, there is an unforgettable person for Atsushi. What should a person do in order to make his attention turn to one's self? An earnest love graffiti.  
  
2. Shin Sekai  
  
3. Iroha ni Hoheto.  
  
4. Omoware, Omou

title: Ugly Duckling
description:
From Pocket Comics:  
An ugly duckling?!  
Jouka Sourin Academy is a school for the sons and daughters of elite families, but the impoverished main character, Ug-Fatty Saotome, has been bullied there for six years. She's forced to face the leaders of the two bullying groups in the school, but luckily she has strong mental fortitude! Will she be able to survive the game her enemies have set up and graduate?  
A romantic comedy featuring an Ug-fatty who fights back!  


---

[Official Taiwanese Translation](https://www.comico.com.tw/3769/)  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Seifuku no Tame no Love Song
My Dead Brother Who Loves You
description: Song Tae-han, lost his twin brother in a car accident. But when he returned home, his dead brother returned as a ghost. Knowing that he can possess him, he decides to 'share' his body with his older brother, but he suddenly falls in love with his transfer student at first sight...

title: Yuzuki wa Neko ni Naru
description: 早起きも電車通学もウンザリ。クラスにはまだ馴染めないし…。そんな高校1年生、三毛遊月（みやけゆづき）はある日、昼休みに独りでお弁当を食べている時に、突然自分が猫になってしまい…⁉︎

title: Seishun Walker
description:
Being a tomboy who loves to get into fights, Ouka's had zero-luck in the love department. The motto she lives by leans more towards "Be Yourself" than "Be Ladylike," and she follows that to a T. But lately, her long time friend Mashima's been on her case about how she should act "more like a girl"…  
  
Includes extra stories Appare! and Red-Green

title: 1-2000 Byou no Koi ~Watashi Dake ni Misete~
description: Mika loves taking photos and to make money, she sells secret photos of the popular Yuuki. Annoyed, Yuuki confronts her, but Mika gets her way and decides she will take full coverage photos of him (ie. follow him). Will Mika get the shots that she wanted, or more?

title: Strange Orange
description:
"I want to get a boyfriend in high school"   
  
Born on the same day at the same hospital. Asuka and Tomaru were always together just like real twins but Asuka's desire for Independence will lead to separation between their twin like relationship. What will Tomaru do?

title: 17-sai, Hajimete - Hatsunetsu -
description:
Collection of 9 one-shots:
1) "Ouji-sama wa Midara ni Midareru" by Kayoru: Hadzuki is in love with her childhood friend Yuki, but now he is very cold with her. What secret will Yuki keep?
2) "Yumeiro Button" by HOSHIMORI Yukimo.
3) "Waru no Kuchizuke" by KOKORO Ayumi.
4) "Konna Abunai Kyori" by CHIBA Kozue.
5) "Amai Tameiki, Binetsu Jikan" by SHIRAISHI Yuki.
6) "Sensei to Naisho no Gohoubi Kisu" by OOGI Sae.
7) "Horeta Mon Makke ~!" by HANAMOTO Asami.
8) "Nande Watashi or Kisu shita no?" by FUJINAKA Chise.
9) "Mofu * Mofu" by KITAMURA Satoko.

title: I Want You
description: Che Ja Nok, 16 years old, has a disease in which her hair grows 20 cm every night. She lives with her aunt. One day at school, she gets a call: Her aunt passed away. Now her life is turned upside down, what should she do?

title: The Student Guardians Are Obsessed With Me
description:
Eleanor died from overworking as a teacher in her past life, so now she's determined not to work! She teaches her brother to be the prince's aide so he can be the breadwinner instead. 

When he reveals his sister is the true genius, she is asked to tutor the siblings of the most influential men in the land: her best friend, a handsome duke, and the crown prince. 

How can she refuse?! 

But is a good education all they want from her? Maybe this time, her job won't ruin her life but lead her to love…

title: Saikou no Kimi
description:
1) Saikou no Kimi  
All begins when Soga Naoaki went to complain to the president of the student counsil, Yoshizumi Sekai, about the reducing of his volleyball team's bookings. By coincidence, Naoaki becomes the vice-president of the student counsil because of the health of the current one. He and Sekai don't get along, but what happens when they have to organise the school festival? Also found in Koibito no Namae  
  
2) Kimi to Boku no Itsu Pobun  
Oneshot also found in [Renai Jikaku Shoujou](https://mangadex.org/title/55805/renai-jikaku-shoujou).  
  
3)Kimi ni Ai ni  
Oneshot also found in [Takaramono](https://mangadex.org/title/27658/takaramono).

title: Calling (Hori Mai)
description:
Akari has always lived in the shadow of Yuka, her older sister: less athletic, less smart, less beautiful. When she gets a call from a popular boy in her high school confessing his feelings to her sister, she goes along with the ruse of pretending to be Yuka because she feels bad about turning him down.

(Source: Damn Feels!)

title: Kiss of a Sixteen-Year-Old
description:
A collection of oneshots.  
  
1. Yozora ni Kiss (夜空にKISS, Night Sky Kiss) by Miyasaka Kaho  
Hitomi is about to change schools, and before she does, she wants to go out with a bang at the cultural festival. Will committee chair Matsunaga-kun help?  
  
2. Powder Snow ni KISS (粉雪にKISS) by Miyasaka Kaho  
Continuation of the first story.  
  
3. Shinai (深愛) by Nakamura Sayumi  
  
4. Dakara, zutto… (だから、ずっと・・・) by Haga Yuina  
  
5. Koi to Iu Shiromono (恋というシロモノ) by Fukami Sakana  
  
6. Dream by Ibuki Kaede  
  
7. Dakkai Letter Sakusou Love (奪回Letter 錯綜Love) by Minami Kanan  
  
8. Wild Cinderella (ワイルド・シンデレラ) by Satsuki Mikiko

title: Estrous Pure Heart Fairy Tale
description:
The 'starved wolf' man and 'little red riding hood' Shouji loved each other?

Also included in this compilation:

• Akuma na Cupid
Ashiwara Iroha has a crush on Suzuki-san. In order to make him like her, she climbs up a tree to try to touch the "legendary mark" at their school. He is supposed to fall in love with her if she does, but instead of touching the mark, she falls from the tree and into Shindou Kaname's arms. He tells her "leave Suzuki to me" and becomes her devilish cupid...

title: Doushite Namida ga Derunokana
description: Junior high student Izumiya is surprised by a sudden kiss from his handsome classmate Hayakawa. Leaving him completely confused, Hayakawa suddenly leaves town, but the two reunite again in high school. As the two continue to part and reunite, Izumiya's feelings begin to stir…

title: Kanojo to Kanojo no Renai
description:
A collection of short stories.  
  
“17 years old. We’re not children, yet we’re not adults. But every serious matter is worthy of attention.” Bored with everyday life, Haruka was feeling that she wanted something hot. And then one day, did you know of the hot Miki who has no female friends’ “unexpected face without makeup”…?

title: Even in Your Absence, He Continues to Shine
description: Namiki is a high school student leading a frantic day-to-day existence. Eternally in his heart is “Golden Yukiko”. Yukiko’s identity…

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - The Goddess and The Unrequited Love (Doujinshi)
description:
ship: You x Riko  


---

Links  
- [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/132763)  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/mizuno_yun)

title: Second Kiss
description: A new teacher enters are the girls basketball coach and Miho can't help but look at him other than a teacher. Fate however has a different idea.

title: Idol wo Sagase: Bangaihen
description: Chikako Fujitani’s first kiss at 14 made her heart flutter. Megumi Kanroji fell in love with the idea of love at 17. Special extra chapters showing the young days of the “Find an idol” cast, depicting their pure, delicate feelings! Includes the extra oneshot of “Tsuki ni hoero onnatachi!”

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai - Sawanari's IshiMiko Shorts (Doujinshi)
Hidamari no Tsuki
description:
The Story is about a high school girl namend Hina and her classmate Gen.  
Their parents get married and now Hina and Gen are stepbrother and stepsister.  
  
Gen is an Mangaka and really cold to Hina and the other family members, but Hina wants to befriend with Gen…

title: Mukashi no Hanashi
description:
A young woman makes some preparations to move. While emptying a drawer she finds a well-hidden damaged cup. What is the story behind the carefully stored dish?  
  
Entry for the Silent Manga Audition.

title: Sora Sora
description:
Sorako and Sorao met in the school office when they both had transferred to a new school. They became friends really fast, but a short bubbly girl comes and claims she likes Sorao. What will Sorako do?  
A really nice love story.

title: Yes! Pretty Cure 5 GoGo!
description: The Cure Rose Garden has always been concealed from human eye. Flora, the area's guardian, watches over it and ensures that the path to the secret area doesn't appear. However Eternal, an art organization known for amassing treasure and artwork from many worlds, is trying to get to the garden. Flora senses the danger and sends a letter to Nozomi and the Pretty Cure, who regain their ability to transform and fight alongside a new warrior, Milky Rose.

title: Kareki ni Koi o Sakasemasu
description:
1) Kareki ni Koi wo Sakasemasu  
Ritsu is a normal high school girl, who everyone thinks is cold. One day, she met a weird looking guy by chance, who turns out to be the new transfer student…but for what reason is he there? And why is it that she can't help but care for him?  
  
2) Heavy Crash!!  
Two girls who are always tagged as a problem child, even though they aren't. Still, they don't care, their friendship is the best. But…what if one of them falls over heels in love?  
  
3) The Juicy Game  
After too many unrequited loves, Natsuko finally gets herself a boyfriend. But…not everything is pink and flowers, her thick-headed brother won't let this go easily…  
  
4) Love Service!  
Miku is a girl with no interest in school, who is always out of it. Then, on the streets a guy suddenly saves her from being tossed by a car, but…breaks her phone?!! Who is this guy?!

title: Daini Button Kudasai
description: At a judo tournament, Akutsu falls in love with Murakami. While jogging, they crashed into each other and Akutsu got hurt (not really, he had a nosebleed due to dirty thoughts). In order to tend to his "wounds", Murakami took him home…

title: Komata-kun to Komata-chan
description:
Two short one shots about school boys in love~  
  
1. Haruda has started dating the quiet, shy Shiba. Nurturing their relationship like a small, budding plant, Haruda promises he will never make Shiba cry. And on a hot summer afternoon, Shiba quietly pulls Haruda to the next step.  
  
2. Hoshino is confessed to by Oda, an adorable boy in glasses. They start dating, but Hoshino wonders why Oda chose him… since he started dating Oda, Hoshino feels like his world has expanded, but since he's not a star*, why would Oda like him?  
*Hoshino means "star" but he thinks of himself as gloomy.

title: Haru yo Koi
description:
1. Spring and Love Come Early?  
Ichio Tomochika, the archery club president, likes the calligraphy club member, Komada Aoba. With black hair and black eyeballs, Komada is just like a stubborn black cat. Looking at such an adorable cat everyday, Ichio hopes Komada can sense his feelings he has for him. After an unexpected kiss from Ichio, will Komada return his feelings?  
  
2. The Trap of Love  
Iwami Seiichirou is in love with his beautiful classmate Yuuzaki Midori… unfortunately, Midori is what you call a bubble brain - and really popular in their all-boys school. Iwami has known Midori since middle school, but is just friends enough now?  
  
3. I Want A Bit More Love  
Takanori was Rokuta's classmate in highschool. After meeting each other coincidentally, Rokuta has been eating at Takanori's Italian restaurant every night. When a female editor ends up tagging along with Rokuta one night, complicated feelings arise.  
  
4. Youth Melancholic  
Nikaidou is always second to Hirahata

title: 1 Meter Kara Hajimaru Koi
description: Mei Ishizawa is a really shy girl that gets extremely nervous around popular people, particularly her desk neighbor Sasahara-kun, where she trembles at his presence. Can Mei face her fears and get close to Sasahara-kun?

title: Suki nara Sukitte Ie yo!
description:
1. Suki nara Sukitte Ie yo!  
New male teacher Himeno at an all-girls school is confronted by class chairman Asuka, will hearts collide as well as tempers?  
  
2. Uso Toki Doki Honto  
Himeno and Asuka are in somewhat bliss, but what will happen when their relationship my leak out and doubts creep in.  
  
3. Love ver. 5  
When ruff-and-tumble Hokuto is looked upon kindly by a Miharu, what will he think when he goes to her house and finds her four beautiful male roommates?  
  
4. Hard Bread Morning  
When Yuki meets Tooru she's taken on a whirlwind 'date' and ends up working at the bread place with him. What's under his mean demeanor and passion for making bread?

title: Happy Ice Cream!
description: Misaki Sakurako is a thirteen-year-old girl who loves ice cream and cherry blossoms. Living alone, she had a weird dream that told her she is the only savior to three young child boys… Strangely enough, she woke up to three handsome strangers who asked her to resolve their dear curse–their bodies will transform if they see any slightly "perverted" materials (posters, pictures, etc). The only way to prevent them from transforming would be…?

title: Cream Caramel
description:
Cream Caramel  
Because her parents are transferred away due to their jobs, Mikoto, a grade 11 student, starts living alone on 100,000 yen per month. But the place she lives at is a horribly old apartment… And the one living in the room next to hers is a super cool boy…?!  
  
White Summer  
Mana and Shou have to go their separate ways after graduation, will they be able to stay together when they're hours apart?  
  
There Are Days Like That, Too  
Sonomi has been in love with Ikuta-san since she was in the seventh grade, four years before this story takes place. Ikuta-san suddenly starts working at her uncle's cafe, and it seems like Sonomi might have a chance to be his little sister, since he's been going out with another girl for those same four years that she's loved him.

title: Kurenai Hanafubuki
description: Sanada Beni is 13 years old now and she is part of a ninja family. She is finally a Red ninja after 13 years of age. She takes an oath of loyalty to fulfill all her missions as family's "red ninja" descendant. But the problem is she is still a ninja in training. Four years ago she accidentally met a boy named Kiyoshi Makoto. Now she is set off to his school to protect him. Now what will would happen as Makoto continues to protect the entrance ceremony and Beni protects him?

title: Kiss Me on the Apple of My Eye
description: Ibuki Morisato dreamed of kissing a prince turned into reality when her dream prince appeared as the new transfer student?!

title: 0x0 Memories
description: Due to an accident, Tsuda Rei has lost all of her memories. She can't remember her favorite foods, her parents, or even her childhood best friend, Ichi. Ichi drags Rei to the place where she lost her memories, but says he won't tell her anything. Then along comes the handsome upperclassman, Kujou Manabu, who tells Rei that is it okay if she doesn't remember anything…

title: Mirarecha Ikenai Umitora-kun
description: Yamasugi enrolls in an elite swimming school dreaming of one day joining a water rescue team. But there’s one big problem—she’s such a muscle fanatic that she can’t focus on practice at all! Then one day, she accidentally discovers the embarrassing secret of Kaiko-kun, the swim team’s ace who always wears a rash guard and never lets anyone see his skin…!? A heart-racing school rom-com of muscles, secrets, and first love begins!

title: more than red
description: Flirty, handsome high school student Daiki has one defining trait: his self-professed sister complex. In Daiki's eyes, his beloved big sister Futaba will always be number one and deserves nothing but the very best - so who is this Kamiya guy, and why is he hanging around with her!? Thinking that no way in hell is his sis hooking up with this gloomy dude on his watch, Daiki sneaks into her college and confronts Kamiya. It turns out that Kamiya isn't Futaba's boyfriend, but one thing leads to another, and he becomes Daiki's friend. The more they hang out, the closer they get until Daiki realizes his heart skips a beat whenever Kamiya flushes red.

title: Tsuihou Sareta Saikyou Reijou wa, Arata na Jinsei wo Jiyuu ni Ikiru
description: Alexia, the successor to the Marquis family, has devoted all her time to her own training. Thanks to this, she has been trusted by those around her as the “perfect and ideal successor,” but one day, she is suddenly banished from the Marquis family along with her servant, Will. This is a fantasy story depicting the new life of the strongest young lady, who is intelligent and has excellent fighting skills.

title: Horda Dourada Não Me Atrapalhe, Eu Preciso Me Declarar!
description: Aventuras sobre a vida romântica de uma guria tapada que é auxiliada pelos poderosos guerreiros das estepes.

title: Girl in Heels
description: Suppose you were so beautiful that people mistook you for a superstar, a model. So beautiful that strangers went out of their way to catch a glimpse of you and shopkeepers offered you things freely. Kyung-hee Goh is that girl. Trapped by the feelings she evokes in other people, she steers through life alone. Boys are either too intimidated to approach her or think she should reward their compliments with her attention. Then she catches the attention of the baddest boy in the school. And that's when the battle really starts…

title: Hi ga Kuretemo Aruiteru
description:
Kyoko had planned to confess to Kenta, only to hear from him about his crush on a close friend. To stay by his side, Kyoko can only hide her feelings and act as Kenta's love advisor…  
  
Also includes 2 other short stories.

title: Grape Pine
description: Lose a game of jan-ken-pon and you have to confess to the person you love?! From that game on starts the pain, smiles, and tears of confession in this omnibus series!

title: Ginchou Kidan
description: The Heavenly Jade Pavillion houses many beautiful hustlers and their protectors. Patrons come in nightly to take advantage of the culture and beauty of these hustlers. These men share their love nightly, but are they allowed to fall in love?

title: Netsuppoi Desu yo?
description: Yada zaczyna właśnie nową pracę jako matematyk i pechowo się składa, że od razu łapie przeziębienie. Próbując temu zaradzić, udaje się do gabinetu szkolnego lekarza, gdzie jest świadkiem pocałunku między lekarzem Sakaigawą i jednym z uczniów. Aby zmusić Yadę do zachowania milczenia na ten temat, Sakaigawa robi mu zdjęcie w nader krępującej sytuacji i od tego momentu matematyk musi się mieć stale na baczności, by nie paść ofiarą molestowania seksualnego ze strony zboczonego doktorka. Jednakże wkrótce wychodzi na jaw, że szkolny lekarz jest kimś więcej, niż mogłoby się zdawać i przede wszystkim zależy mu na dobru uczniów.

title: Hakoiri Ouji to Shitsuji Hime
description:
My butler is usually very serious and strict. But there are moments when he seems… kinda cute!?

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title: Shingeki no Kyojin - In The Soup (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Levi x Eren AU  
  
Slice-of-life/school series, about romantic relationship between teacher Levi and student Eren.

title: Can't Win With You!
description: Yuuhi-kun planned to build a soccer field on the piece of mountain land that was his inheritance, but when his brother's elite Shuuiku Academy needed a new campus, Yuuhi was forced to reconsider. Now he finds himself both the landlord, and a student at the school! Needless to say, the other students are none too happy about being shipped out to the boonies, so Yuuhi – AKA “chicken-head” – has become the object of their collective ire. But there's something about the country bumpkin that has many students eyeing Yuuhi in a different way… a way that makes him very uncomfortable. Seems there's a lot more than “book-learnin’” going on at this school, and Yuuhi's about to get a whole 'nuther kind of education!

title: Lily no Subete
description:
“The course of true Love never did run smooth.”
by William Shakespeare

Amano Kiyotaka lives a tough high school life with the motto of excellence in both academics and sports. There is someone he has feelings for, but he is unable to confess his feelings due to his overly serious personality. Then Kiyotaka learns of the rumor that there's a magic mirror fairy at his school that can grant wishes…

title: My Girl Academia
description:
A girl struggling in chaos in an unknown world…
Having been secluded and rebuked harshly for her lack of power and existence, Tashita Hitomi still wishes to become a hero. Even in this crazy place there is something she still wishes to protect… and fight with… or do something else. More than what they’d expect of her, she’ll do it-her way!

title: Our Eunha
description: Harem manhwa otaku ‘Na Eunha’ is one day transferred into a school filled with beautiful girls and boys with the help of God. Everyone likes me! Harem life is the best! But after ‘Lee Woojoo’ transferred, weird things started happening… ‘I’m not the main character of this harem…?’ Eunha’s harem conquering1

title: Ming Gi Nyu
description: To an outcast like Yeon Wu, her first crush was a mysterious man named Ming Gi Nyu who emotionally supported her when she was at her lowest. However, as Yeon Wu enters college, she wants to forget all about him. The only problem is Ming Gi Nyu is not ready to let her go…

title: Boku no Sorciere
description:
Uesaka Kazuhi usually visited his grandfather in the summer with his family when he was small. He once visited the shrine next to his grandfather's house. There, he met a pair of mysterious twins, and since then, he's gone to the shrine multiple times in hopes of meeting them again, but he never did.
