Six years later, Kazuhi visited the shrine again for the first time in a while, and there he once again met the twins, who were loitering around just like they did back then.

The two seemed to not have changed at all, as Haruka still had her beaming smile and Ryou was just as mature. but...!

title: Last Kiss
description: Ever since she was 10 years old Eun Song has been an orphan! Money is the best! If it's for money she would do anything (except for kissing). Stubborn rich guy Jae Gal Won who acts like a gentleman in front of others. But when he sees maid Eun Song he becomes greedy and playful… Is this love?

title: Deru Toko Demasho!
description: High school girl Shizuka Kamei was once a young lady. However, her father Tomoharu's company went bankrupt. Her life changes and she is forced to live in poverty. In order to earn a living, she rushes into the Nonaka Law Office run by Hiromu Nonaka, a lawyer she met by chance, and is hired as a part-time worker, but she is surrounded by people with their own quirks, including her employer who has a uniform fetish. It was a series of hardships. However, the optimistic Shizuka works cheerfully every day and solves cases even though she causes trouble.

title: Kana, Kamo.
description: In middle school, Yuna is constantly being bullied. The only person she can confide in is her cousin, Yuya. One day, a pair of strange brothers who have just transferred came up to Yuna and wanted to be her friend! Will she find some female friends in high school?

title: Megane no Koiwazurai
description:
Megane no Koiwazurai  
Despite being in the same class as Takigawa-san, we only started talking after two weeks. And just as I thought, "Takigawa-san" is the glasses-wearing genius who graduated from the same junior high as me. He's Daisuke, whom I loved so much. Even though I called him by his first name before, now I call him by his surname. Then one day, the homeroom teacher ordered me to have Daisuke tutor me…?!  
  
Kimi ni atsui kisu  
The popular Hongou-kun always calls Sayaka Class Rep and does not see her as a girl at all. When he is in risk of failing his exams, he pleads with Sayaka to help him study. Will the two of them studying alone in a room change Hongou-kun's impression of Sayaka?  
  
Hazukashii hodo, kimi to  
The timid class rep Sakou Riko becomes a cover magazine girl to catch Ryou-kun's eyes. But will she ever be able to let him know that she is really the idol Kokoro that Ryou-kun loves?  
  
Juuyoku egotism  
Hagane and Suzu have been dating since middle school

title: Jiekusu: Sonzai Bangō 002
description:
In a world where unseen beings known as Jiex (Has Physical Form) secretly coexist with humanity, a hidden war rages beneath the surface. These entities form contracts with humans through emotional resonance, allowing them to survive undetected while influencing the human world from within.

Kuroihana Shinchiro, a former delinquent burdened by a life of constant misfortune and violence, seeks nothing more than peace. But after reaching his breaking point, a near-fatal incident triggers an abnormal contract with a high-ranking Jiex known as a Daijiex—Kyoha.

Unlike ordinary contracts, their bond defies the natural order. They exist as equals, sharing power while maintaining separate bodies, bound by a connection neither fully understands. As Shinchiro begins to awaken to his own transformation into a Daijiex, he becomes a target of both humanity’s Jiex Elimination Force and the Jiex themselves.

Branded as “Akuma” (Taken from The name of his Daijiex Full Transformation armour)— a devil f

title: Dekiai Shitekuru Gitei to Yamashii Doukyochuu
description:
Alice is a perfect young lady who goes to a prestigious school, but in reality, she is a commoner who loves wearing jerseys. Her parents remarry and her school's most handsome boy becomes her step-brother! At first, Alice is confused as they have to live together, but she is very satisfied with her life with Rio who is a good cook and witty! But Rio, on the other hand, can't stop loving Alice!

This is a sweet and complicated love story about two people who share a dirty secret!

title: Gakuran no Naka Made Sawatte Hoshii: Sono Saki
description:
Niimi and Sawane, who became acquainted with the student council of the boys' school and became lovers.
After graduating from high school, the two high school boys chose another course, but they had a summer vacation without having to meet them easily ...! ?
I will draw plenty of erotic depictions of the university and vocational school after the graduation of the two, and the working adults who have started cohabitation!

title: Yuusei no Fool
description: The story follows Sena, a girl who enrolled in a training school to become the queen as a substitute for her missing twin sister.

title: Donmai Princess
description: What does a high school boy have to do in order to make the love of his life remember you in *this* lifetime? Cosplay? Host a "this is your previous life" audition? Show her all your good points? Just because she is a manga otaku in love with Blue-Sama. It's not like falling in love with manga characters is based on real life?

title: Koi Wakaba
description: What does it mean to be in love? Inoue Fuuko has a huge crush on the handsome Takamiya-senpai but due to her over the top delusions, she's mistaken as a stalker. Even though Fuuko really likes her senpai, she just doesn't know how to approach him without her delusions being triggered! Find out what this total amateur in love will do to get her beloved's attention!

title: From Yesterday
description:
1-3, 9) Say You Love Me  
Akane Ryuuichi loves professor Hasumi Akira's artwork, that's why he became his assistant. But he also loves Professor Hasumi.   
  
4) That's a Blue and Transparent Surprise  
Hikari's body produces electricity, so he can't touch anything metal. His childhood friend, Ten, is always taking care of him.   
  
5, 8) Welcome to the Clinic Room  
Asashi Keiichi is a middle school doctor. Ichikawa Yuu is his cute and innocent student who has designs on his sensei. Chapter 8 takes place 10 years later when Ichikawa is all grown up.  
  
6) Home  
Touri's lover Seiji has been living with him for two years, but sometimes he just takes off for a month at a time.   
  
7) Listen to the Sound of Rain  
One rainy day, bookstore owner Yamamoto Fuku shares his umbrella with beautiful high school student Toya Kairi.

title: Kare ga Cafe ni Iru no nara
description:
Aiko always dreams she could have a sweet love story. But all boys around her are like kids, so far from Aiko's ideal boy. To get a mature ideal man, Aiko is working part-time in a cafe which popular for handsome and cute guys!  
  
Including two other stories:  
♡ You Are My Vitamin  
♡ Shooting Star on the Café

title: Oujisama no Kanojo
description: Michiru's dream is to have a real prince propose to her. Now, three princes from an Arabian royal family come to study at her school and her friend, Tanguchi seems to be…?! What will happen next?

title: The Three Times
description:
Hina, a Japanese foreign student. Junho, sufferer of Elite OCD. Won, a girl with her own way of seeing the world. A campus life story of these three people. Deals with the issues of Japanese, Korean and global society.  
  
The author, Yellow Goo Mi, was born in Japan, but since her parents are Korean, the Japanese government will not give her a Japanese citizenship (which is considered a problem in some aspects; these people are slightly alienated by the 'real' Japanese people in society, despite their extremely Japanese upbringing). As a person with a Japanese and Korean heritage, she writes about the problems in modern Japanese and Korean society, plus the global society in more recent chapters.  
  
The first part of the webtoon focuses on Hina and the Japanese society, an example being the more increasing problems with Japanese bullying (ijimae).  
The second part of the webtoon focuses on Jun Ho and the Korean society, an example being the flaws of Korean education system. Curren

title: Hitotsubana
description:
"I want to make you mine at any cost."   
  
Experience the thrilling high school drama about a student obsessed with getting what he wants. That first love with an older student you secretly have a crush on - even if it never comes true, it usually turns into a bittersweet memory. Usually. But if it leads to morbid thoughts, this perverted love makes a jet-black "flower" blossom in the heart of the young man, which transforms the fleeting feeling of infatuation into something completely different. . . Where will this love-hate relationship lead those with whom it plays its game?


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Akasha as **Hitotsubana: The Cursed Flower** (2019)

title: Go Shido Sareta Gari No Dahlia-san
description:
成績優秀、容姿端麗、絶対零度の完璧令嬢がボクの心をかき乱す――。

ラ・トゥール魔法学校。優秀な魔法使いを養成することを目的とした施設で、学年成績万年2位のガリ勉男子・オリバースミスにはある悩みがあった。
それは文武両道・才色兼備にして、学年成績万年1位の令嬢・ダリアに成績で勝てないこと!!!!
そんな悩みを抱えながらある日、オリバーはダリアに実技を教えて欲しいと言われ、一緒に訓練をすることに。しかし彼女、やたら体をくっついたりとこちらをからかってきて……!!?

クソ真面目なスミスは彼女のからかいに耐えることはできるのか!!!!

title: Let's Talk Love
description: Subaru is enrolled as an art major in the department of education at university. She's energetic and good-natured. There, she meets a rather ill-natured honor student who is enrolled in the same department as her. What's most surprising though, is that it turns out that this disagreeable boy is her next-door neighbor at her new apartment! Just what lies in store for Subaru's daily life now?

title: Archive of Lovesickness
description:
IKE's first book.  
  
Collection of short stories  
  
1) Koiyami Archive  
A cool college student whose personality is bad loves a high-achieving student who dresses like a nerd. The cool one is kind to the nerd one but he turns cold as soon as the nerd confesses his love to him…  
  
2) Ater School Special Plan  
The hero's best friend suddenly annouces his family will move, kisses him and waits for his answer. The hero intends to refuse but…  
  
3) Love Prisoner battle Line  
Twin brothers. The elder one has guarded the youngest in their childhood, so he becomes strong to repay him, but now the elder one fears him. Add to the mix the elder's homosexual friend  
  
4) Love Prisoner battle Line - Odd Situation  
Sequel of the above. The elder one comes to fondle his twin. But the friend aims at him too…  
  
5) Radical Report  
A journalist interviews a young CEO of high-tech company. Before the interview, he entertained antipathy toward the CEO but after actually meeting him, he fi

title: The Witch Medea
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Lily has had the same dream over and over since her mother died when she was six years old. 

Now 17 years old and she still has the same dream, but on a trip, the huge tower in the fog that she saw in her dream appears in reality.

title: WA!
description: He Ra has a dream of becoming a scenario writer for her super idol Pil Lip Lee. Her chance to become one, arrived when her idol saved her from the bullies and 'unexpectedly' introduced her to the famous teenage scenario writer Ye Myeon. But can He Ra handle Ye Myeong stubborn attitude and become his student? and what will happen to her if Pil Lip Lee doesn't even remember her right after they kissed? WA! Will love blossom out of these three?

title: Orange Revolution
description:
Our always bright and cheerful heroine, Nat-chan, finds herself faced with a serious problem! She's crushing on a guy who already has a girlfriend! Oh, what's a girl supposed to do? Well, join the Sports Day Committee in order to be close to him of course. But things don't turn out the way she expects as she runs into a few problems, one of them namely Sakaguchi Touya. He doesn't just bother her by confessing his love for her everyday, even worse, he steals her dessert every lunch hour!  
  
Includes another short story called Sunflower Carnival.

title: Tenka Ichi
description:
It's her high-school debut, yet Tora Takei can't seem to fit in.

Then somehow, she ends up time-slipping into the Warring States period!

In order to return to the present, she has no choice but to change history. Disguising herself as a man, Tora gets caught up with Mori Ranmaru, the handsomely beautiful, yet deadly guard of Oda Nobunaga. Slowly, she discovers the kind and honest nature of this strongest and most beautiful of warriors. Falling in love with Ranmaru, the story of Tora's time-slip into the Warring States period begins!

title: Gal Samurai
description: High school girl Kirishima Ran is in the middle of her youth!! She enjoys shopping in Shibuya with her friends, dreams of becoming a fashion designer, and has feelings for her longing, Fujii Senpai---A seemingly ordinary girl. However, her other side is that she is the successor to her son-in-law, Shuwashi-ryu martial arts. Because of her Bushido spirit, she can't forgive any crookedness, and she cuts down molesters, voyeurs, and bullies one after another!!

title: Doukyuusei!! ~Zutto Kimi ga Suki datta~
description: Today is Azumi's wedding day. Among the friends who came to give her blessings, there was one in particular who Azumi awaited the arrival of. She first met that person 12 years ago, in sixth grade. At that time, Azumi was in the same class as gentle Minato and brusque Yūhi. At that time, a girl and a prince fell in love.

title: Tumbling
description: Yuuta Takenata has dreamed of being a gymnast ever since he was a little kid, so when he gets into high school he starts up the "Boys Rhythmic Gymnastics" team. He works hard and gets enough members to compete, but then the club adviser forces them to take the delinquent Azuma Wataru into their club. He's loud, whiny and has absolutely no interest in gymnastics. Yuuta just gives up on him, telling to stop coming to the practices. But when he accidentally causes one of the members to break his arm, Azuma has to start training so as to take his part in the competition.

title: Sugu ni Te ga Deru Bokutachi wa
description: Speaking of passionate love, Ginkawa who swings at foul balls. The serious, bespectacled Haguri who typically responds to that idiocy by ignoring him, yelling at him or quickly striking out at him every day (swinging at fouls). He is angry, surprised, and irritated that Ginkawa is not discouraged… However, sometimes, silly men are controlled by their hearts, and there are moments where they can't swing at that foul…

title: Crushing on My Rental Boyfriend
description:
"Better think twice 'bout messin' with my girl."

A fake kiss with a guy from Osaka quickly escalates into a major crush! A "rental boyfriend" just doesn't cut it; I want the real thing...!

title: Miracle Lingerie
description:
Teenager Murakami Chisato was sick of her granny panties and was hoping she would get lingerie that was more modern. Then out of nowhere, on her way to school, a pair of sexy lingerie falls from the sky. Confused at where it came from but excited by what she found, Chisato decides to keep the bra and panty. Little does she know that they were actually Miracle Lingerie from space that absorbs sun light and gives the user extreme amounts of power. She now has such powers as the strength to lift cars, the agility to leap from house to house and insane running speeds. The only drawback is that she has to take off her clothes and expose the lingerie she is wearing to the world for it to give her powers.

Her classmate, Umeko (aka Plum) Sainoji, also has Miracle Lingerie and is scheming to take Chisato’s pair from her. Chisato’s classmate, Kudou Daisuke is a pervert and tries hard to make her take off her clothes to reveal her underwear. How will Chisato juggle between being a normal school

title: Christmas Shimasho
description: Kyouko has always liked Takuto and eventually they start dating. Kyouko is looking forward to spending Christmas together with him - their first Christmas as a couple. But a few days before Christmas, Takuto starts avoiding Kyouko and then she sees him with another woman!

title: Triangle Blood
description: 'Won', the guardian angel, is sealed in the body of 'Hana' for the crime of saving 'Hana', an ordinary girl who was destined to die after breaking the will of heaven... The dark beings are aiming for the power of the guardian angel sealed by Hana and begin to stretch out their demonic beasts!

title: Fusuma Land 4.5
description: Udagawa Kachiko is a studious no-nonsense high school girl. One day, she found an entrance to a fantastic world called Fusuma Land.

title: Ouji to Hime to Watashi
description: A story about a handsome high school girl having a dilemma on becoming "everybody's prince".

title: Renai Kanjou no Marude nai Osananajimi Manga
description:
真田辰季と後鳥羽空良は、超がつくほど大事な幼馴染同士。手をつないだり、ハグをしたりと、びっくりするぐらいの仲良しぶり。でも恋愛感情なんて、絶対にないって話で――。

【ニヤニヤ/羨まし～い/殺しに来てる/ちょっw/もうお前ら結婚しろ/最高かよ/※恋愛漫画ではありません。/など話題沸騰！！！！！！！】

ここまで距離が近くて、付き合ってない…だと！！？

title: Taihen Waruku Dekimashita
description: On the first day of the second semester of middle school 2nd grade, Shiyumi came across a hidden cigarette scene of a classmate boy, Chizaki, in the backyard of the school. Honor student, popular person (and a childhood friend Mari's crush), but unexpectedly messing around with her, she can say that?? Chizaki, who can't see anything forever, she's starting to worry about him… Chizaki, who are you─?

title: Image Fight
description: Image Fight is a story based on two main characters, a geeky boy named Kayano and a pretty girl named Mayu. Kayano is an introvert who likes figurines and anime and often gets called a gross otaku by his classmates. Mayu, on the other hand, looks like Pure Mint, an anime character that Kayano loves.

title: Robotics;Notes - Pleiades Ambition
description: Part of [Robotic;Notes](https://mangadex.com/?page=search&title=Robotic%3BNotes) series.

title: Kyoukasho wa Oshiete Kurenai
description:
1. Kyoukasho wa Oshietekurenai  
  
2. Toumen na Jikan  
Normally, people who have died haunt their lovers or their enemies… So why is Yuuri, the ghost of a high school girl, following her boyfriend's little brother around?  
  
3. Kanojo no Tabako  
  
4. Okubyou na Kimi no Te - The Untouchable Venus  
Shino thought she could drive away the persistent Takeomi by telling him that she didn’t want to do anything physical–even hold hands–until she was married. But he agreed, and the two of them had a good relationship until Shino’s first boyfriend showed up and revealed the real reason why she was “waiting”.  
  
5. Kyoukasho ni wa Notte Inai  
  
"In high school, our responsibility is studying… But isn't it also important to learn about love?" Hinokawa wants to know the things that can't be found in a textbook–but the teacher she's chosen to focus her affections on isn't exactly responding the way she wants him to.

title: Flower
description:
Mayu is a book-worm who genuinely wants to do something different than the girls around her. One day, she accidentally walks into a body paint exhibition and finds…  
  
The mangaka's name can be written as Higuri You / Higuri Yuu.

title: Discommunication: Gakuenhen
description:
Two stories from the School Arc of Discommunication that were never included in the main series' volume release.

These chapters were originally serialized as chapters 53-58 of Discommunication, however they were published separately as this special volume. Though originally serialized 1996-7, the tankoubon did not appear until the end of 1998.

title: Ookami Otoko to Nurikabe-chan
description: In this world, where interspecies interaction between humans and youkai has progressed, there are "half-demons" who still retain the characteristics of youkai. Kogami Shiro, a descendant of a wolf who attends Yamamoto Half-Demon Academy, a high school where half-demons gather, has a problem. He transforms into a wolf when he gets nervous! "Today I'm not going to turn into a wolf!!" Shiro vows, but when he's in front of a girl, he turns into a wolf in an instant. His classmate, Kabe Nurumi, offers to help Shiro. For Kabe, a descendant of Nurikabe, Shiro's efforts to overcome his weaknesses seem to have stumbled over a "sexual 'wall'"...?

title: 99% Love
description: Irina is an ordinary high school girl, until the day she's brought to a fairyland by a handsome man. Terra Bitt just moved to a new school, where two attractive guys, Kai and Marcell, fall for her. An anthology of romantic short stories that showcase the various aspects of love

title: Ikenai Hokenshitsu
description:
1. Ikenai Hokenshitsu  
The new infirmary teacher is hot, but he's kind of perverted!? He reads porn, too. A very dangerous man indeed!! Just what's going to happen to Mimi, the health committee member!?  
  
2. Toilet no Hanao-kun  
  
3. Dan x Boi!  
  
4. Panic at the pool  
  
5. Count 10!

title: Soft Romantic
description: Shuka Nakagawa is a man in a woman's manga world. Cute, into feminine things, he and his new editor, Kenji Asama, have to compete with women artists for publication. With Kenji's support, just how far can Shuka go… and how far can he fall?

title: Koisuru Chihaya-Kun No Yuutsu
description:
Chiyoko, a kind-hearted high school girl with a little bit of a secret, is in love with Chihaya, a classmate who is active as an actor. In fact, Chihaya also likes her...?! 
Only the two of them are unaware of their love for each other!

title: Bodyguard
description: The story revolves around four young people. After the death of the president of Sung Han Group, a very prominent group in the world, the heir was to be decided. In the midst of all the commotion, his biological granddaughter was discovered, Jung Hween-Lin, and brought to live in the main house. Though kind and softhearted at first, the money changed her and she became very spoiled and obsessed with her bodyguard, Han Jae-Ha. Han Jae-Ha was initially raised by the president to become the successor of Sung Han Group, but instead now he's become nothing more than a Jung Hween-Lin personal bodyguard and head of the security in Sung Han Group. In order to fully protect her he hires a policeman, Baek Suk-Ho, who despite his old age looks very young and fits in immediately in the high school that they are attending.He joined the police force so he could legally beat up people and doesn't care much about rules or the consequences his actions produce. On one of his missions he meets up with Yo

title: Kimi to Apocalypse
description: Yamazaki-kun had his heart set on joining the Film Research Club even before starting high school, dreaming of a wonderful movie-filled life. But when he finally joins, he discovers the club only has two members: himself and the club president, Goto-san (♀), a die-hard fan of zombie maestro George A. Romero. Though many boys initially joined, drawn in by Goto-san’s sexy, busty allure, her overwhelming craziness drove them all away—except Yamazaki-kun. Now, as the sole remaining member, he finds himself completely at her mercy…!?

title: Romeo x Romeo
description: Watch the sparks fly between the two student body presidents of the so-called “Yuryo” brother schools, “Yusei School” and “Ryosei Academy”, as they fight for their rights for “Juliet”—!!?

title: Asaake no Kaede
description:
From 13 years old mangaka who win the 609th Bessatsu Margaret monthly Manga School competition in 2019  
(Bessatsu Margaret April 2020)

title: Ane ga Saikyousugite Josousezaru wo Enai Boku.
description: My sister’s a perfect superhuman *and* a total bro-con… but she’s got a hidden side, and thanks to that, *I’m* getting tangled up in increasingly messy relationships!?

title: Kokuin
description: Akatsuki Kouya is a genius medical student who doesn’t believe in people and tries to distance himself from them. However, he is tricked and imprisoned by Katase Eiichi, a professor who was attracted to his charm. One month after Kouya’s disappearance, Kisaragi Rei, the only one of Kouya’s team members who was worried about his disappearance, comes to his rescue. But the one who has become a tool in his professor’s human experiment is…!

title: Buriki no Kanzume
description: Oukawa Nabiki is an energetic and cheerful girl who dreams to become a stuffed toy maker. Ever since she joined Kousei High’s Crafting Club, with Fukamachi Itsuru, a boy who dreams to become a silverwork designer, both of them work hard together to become professionals! But due to the fact that Nabiki has to attend extra lessons, she’s not allowed to do any club activity for a week?!

title: Sukida!! Oka-kun!!
description: Bạn cùng lớp của Satsuki Oka, Hajime Tsunefusa, hẹn cậu trên sân thượng và tỏ tình với cậu. Mặc dù không kì thị đồng tính nhưng trước giờ cậu chưa từng hẹn hò với con trai. Cậu lập tức từ chối Hajime nhưng sau đó Hajime lại bắt đầu lẽo đẽo theo cậu… Đừng bỏ lỡ câu chuyện này của tác giả Sawaco, tác phẩm đầu tay đã bán hết sạch tại hội chợ truyện tranh dành cho người hâm mộ!!!!!

title: Blackberry
description: Ever since Fune Momohara was told that she was just like a "guy friend" by the boy she liked, she's been bent on becoming the ideal girl. But when she meets the perfect guy who turns out to be more than a little pretentious, she realizes that it can be difficult to keep up appearances!

title: Present
description:
1) Present  
This follows the main character through three periods of her life – ages 13, 18, and 21. Aki leads a normal life. She has friends, a family who cares about her, and a talent for writing. There's nothing seemingly wrong with her life, or herself for that matter. But when the the start of a new school year leads her to be in the same class as Yoshiko, a classmate a year older than her who still carries with her noticeable scars from the horrific burns she suffered from a fire, she begins to discover the best and worst in herself.  
  
2) The Whereabouts of the Prince  
For Haruka, Ami was a love at first sight. Everyone around him questions his tastes, calling her a plain Jane, but to him, it's as if she has a halo over her head. When he gets a friend to ask what her idea of the perfect guy is, she replies "someone prince-like." He takes this literally, and this sets him off on a journey to become the "Prince" of her dreams.  
  
3) There's Something I Want to Ask You  
Sae

title: Lovers or Friends
description:
1-4) Friends Like a Lover (Koi Tomo)  
Childhood friends Yukie and Kogawa are both in love with their other friend, Yamato.They relieve their unfulfilled sexual desire for Yamato by jerking each other off, but lately it seems they're progressing to something more serious… what will happen when Yamato finds out? Later on, a new guy enters the scene and he's also interested in one of the 3 friends. Will he be able to win his heart?  
  
5) Love Plot (Rabu Purotto)  
Kichii, Akira and Akira's older brother are models for Boyfriend Grand Prix magazine. Kichii made an unfortunate bet with Akira- if Kichii can outrank Akira's brother in the magazine boyfriend ranking, Akira will be his slave. Until then Kichii will be Akira's slave. Who will win? And why is Akira so determined to see his big brother beaten?  
  
6)Loving  
Tamura Chisato sleeps with just about anyone if they say they like him. Even though Masashi is straight, he finds himself irritated with the way Tamura acts and tries to c

title: Brat Hunt Chu
description: One day, Chiyu Usamoto, a sixth grader, suddenly begins to see strange creatures...? The true identities of the creatures are "brats", lost children whose emotions have been separated from their body in order to prevent them from thinking such things!

title: Ekiden Danshi Project
description: Hayata Hayata, a middle-distance runner whose last high school race ended in disappointment, was planning to find a job in his hometown of Iwate after graduation. However, he finds out that a private university, acquired by a major IT company, has established an ekiden team to compete in the "Hakone" relay race and is planning to hold a nationwide audition to recruit scholarship students. What's more, the team manager is a popular idol!

title: Hatachi no Koi
description: Oneshot set in stories you will see how each developed his love couple but this will not be easy but will have to fight for his love prevails.

title: 4-frame official anthology Nagi no Asukara
description:
A 4-koma anthology of Nagi no Asukara, chronicling the various situations that happen to Hikari, Manaka, Chisaki, Tsumugu, and Kaname.

(Source: MCAnime.net)

title: You're So Cool
description:
Everyone dreams about Seung-Ha, the perfect prince, the shining star of the school. Chasing after the perfect prince is definitely not easy. For Nan-Woo, Seung-Ha was just a dream far, far away. However, sometimes dreams exist to come true! But when Nan-Woo’s dream comes true, it comes at an expensive price. Who knew the perfect prince was actually a big jerk?! (From: Yen Press)  
  
Licensed in English by Yen Press as *You're So Cool*.

title: Ushirokara Dakishimete
description:
1. Ushirokara Dakishimete (Embraced from Behind)  
"If I could beat him, I would become his lover…". Koichiro believes that the only way he can ever woo his best friend Soji into a relationship is by challenging him with a judo match for love!!  
  
2. Sweet Smell  
A baseball freak fall in love with the alluring scent of his new tutor.  
  
3. Hankonkou (Resurrection Incense)  
A love triangle between an emperor, the emperor's faithful minister and the emperor's dead lover…  
  
4. Ai wa Konjou! (Love Must Persevere!)  
The ultra rich Kagura decides to go to an ordinary high school for a year. He will spend whatever it takes to be with his new friend Hayakawa.  
  
5. Sekai de Ichiban Ricchi na Honey (The richest sweetheart in the world)  
  
6. Sekai de Ichiban Happy Honey (The happiest sweetheart in the world)

title: Kira Kira Namida ~Koishiteta, Aishiteta
description: Yuuma is taciturn and no one knows what she’s thinking. But then, she’ll meet someone that will change that…

title: Hijikata-san wa Usodarake
description:
Towards the end of the Edo period, a 15-year-old girl named Ema is in love with Hijikata Toshizo, also known as 'Oni'.
Out of the blue, Hijikata's behaviour changes drastically. What reason lies behind this change?

title: Kore wa Kitto Koi Janai
description:
A drummer named Hibiki one day met a singer and a guitarist named Shou and Ritsu. Despite the fact that Hibiki and Shou at first didn't want to form a band, the two still managed to become friends through their music. The band was born, but on one condition: no love stories!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Ten Promises Between Me and Him
description: “¡Firmar este contrato debe mantenerse en secreto!” Han Shuo, quien siempre ha sido considerado como el portavoz de “Stupid Sweet”, nunca pensó en lo que significaba firmar el contrato de Lin Yijie. La vida sencilla y apasionada del campus nunca ha regresado. En cambio, rodeé a Lin Yijie, el gran problema número uno en el cielo, y lo bloqueé del acoso de los jefes de la escuela y las flores de la escuela hasta que …

title: Adult Teacher wa Osuki?
description: When frisky high school student Yuhi started dating his hot math teacher Watari, he thought there’d be more…dates. It seems the two can only connect in the bedroom, and Watari Sensei's open disdain for mushy romance baffles Yuhi. How can the smitten student convince his cool, collected teacher that "it's real"?

title: Momoiro Renka
description:
Sakura prays in front of cherry blossoms in the hope to meet her fated partner, where suddenly a guy really does show up!! Believing he is her fated person, she seeks him out but Sakura is met with more then just her fated partner…  
  
Also contains a one-shot, "Sketching the Color of Love"

title: Oya-san Chi no Hikaru-kun
description:
Subaru Takanashi, a first-year high school student, is struggling with her first experience living alone. But her neighbor, Hikari, is a caring young man with excellent life skills...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hajimari no Aizu
description: On graduation day, a former high-school student and her English teacher reminisce about their time together. How he helped her correct her mistakes, raise her grades and overcome her dislike for the language… But is that all there is to their relationship?

title: Totsuide kudasai, Naotaka-kun!
description: 春から都内の親戚の元で暮らし始めた高校生・円城寺 若葉（えんじょうじ わかば）には、ある大きな野望があった。それは……家業（農業）を継いでいくための『婿』を見つけること!! 都会の『イケメンな婿候補』をゲットするため奮闘する若葉だったが、周りに婿の話をしても引かれるばかり…。そんななか、合コンで知り合ったイケメン・望月 尚孝（もちづき なおたか）に一目惚れをした若葉は「（婿候補の）彼氏が欲しいです！」と猛アタック。すると…二つ返事で「いいよ」と言われお付き合いがスタートし、気が付けば尚孝のベッドの上で初めての○○○…!? チャラくてイケメンな婿候補にドキドキが止まりませんっ！ ……しかし尚孝には何か、裏の顔があるらしく――…？ 婿探し爆走JK×イケメンチャラ次男DKが送る、『婿』から始まるピュアラブコメディー！

title: Scarlet Lady
description: Для того, щоб помстити Марінет, Хлоя вирішує… викрасти її талісман?! Отакої… Що ж буде у світі, де талісман сонечка отримала Хлоя, а Леді баґ ніколи не існувало?

title: Samurai Darling
description:
Compilation of short stories:  
  
1-3) Samurai Darling  
Amiko saw a boy dressed like a samurai at a school festival. What will she do?  
  
4) Toumei Shoujo (Lucid Girl)  
Yuki rejects a present from his childhood friend Risa, but something happens and he sees things from a different point of view.  
  
5) Some Kind of Childhood  
Rika doesn't understand the point of kissing. Will she change her mind?

title: Yamazu ni Koishite, Koroshiya-san!
description:
A love comedy about a yandere assassin and a totally innocent girl who avoids danger! The main character, Sumika, has always been unable to read the mood of a situation, and people have always kept their distance from her. One day, when she handed a handkerchief to someone she was fighting with on the street, the next day that person transferred to her school...? "I quit being an assassin for you. Please fall in love with me." Her first confession was a terrifying signal that her life was being targeted by an assassin organization.

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title: Kimi o Omou Toki
description:
What does it mean to love? Most of the time, I don't know… Falling in love with someone always ends up with a farewell. Encounters in which you can meet a kind man are very rare. For someone to tell me, "Momo-chan, I love you very much~ ♪" and to caress me with a smile… I don't understand the meaning of those things. Still, that kind of behavior gives me a warm feeling and makes my head spin.  
  
Collection of short stories:  
  
- Kimi wo Omou Toki  
  
- Ryakudatsu Egotist  
  
- Sokubaku Darling

title: Happy Birthday Chitose-Kun
description:
"I'm going to celebrate Chitose's birthday so hard!"

Chitose, a college student, recalls the words of one of his high school classmates on the night of his birthday, which he spends in solitude.

Koutaka, a tall, handsome, and athletic boy who transferred to his school in his second year of high school, was a battery partner on the baseball team. When Chitose is assigned to be a battery partner with him on the baseball team, he learns of his unsociable nature and is attracted to him. The two gradually become aware of each other and begin dating.

Chitose is happy to be dating his first boyfriend, but he and Takataka cross paths when they start talking about their career paths.

Graduation comes and goes, and he no longer keeps in touch with Takataka. The message screen has remained static for two years. Chitose finally sends a new message to Takataka.

This is a painfully realistic adolescent love story of a blunt guy and a flawed college student! (Source MangaUpdates)

title: A Fabricated Love Affair
description: "Hey, over there, your girlfriend is passing by" "What? Do you want to die?" Lee Se-kyung is not good at anything besides studying. I am always bullied in that way by the kids at my school. When she goes out of school, she's a cheap girl herself?! Everyone doesn't recognize her because she's the complete opposite of school, and even adult men don't know that she's a high school student and begs Se-kyung to meet her. Tried to fool people and have some fun. What is that? Even if he is caught, his identity is found out by his classmate Ha Seon-woo?! The wandering, love, and youth of teenagers who are neither adults nor children. A sweet and spicy adolescent romance begins!

title: Ashita no Koto wa Wakaranai
description: Ten has the ability to see into people's futures for a limited time, even if he does not want to. Due to this ability, he is very popular with girls and often come to him for consultations, with an exception to Tsumugi. She seems to not be at all interested in fortune telling. This intrigues Ten, and before he knows it his eyes seems to always follow her. Can he predict a happy future with Tsumugi?

title: Koi Shika Dekinaiyo
description: High school teacher Umehara Akio drew Hataoka Kei, a problem child, out of his home and back to school. Years later, Umehara got transferred to a new high school and he met Kei again, who's now working as a delivery boy for a florist shop. Seeing his former student grown into a super good-looking college student, Umehara couldn't help feeling proud. What he didn't realize is Kei’s true colors… a pervert who molests his drunken, unsuspecting Umehara-sensei!

title: Bakusou!! Love Attack
description:
While Hoshigaoka High School undergoes remodeling, Minami Wakana and her classmates have to study at Sasara High School. On her first day going to Sasara, Wakana meets Keisho on the train and it’s love at first sight. But it turns out Sasara is a school full of gangsters and Keisho is the one who calls all the shots…!!  
  
Also included are:  
  
- Gokudou Renai Jingi (Black Road's Love)  
  
- Sakasemasu!! Koi no Hana (Let the Flower of Love Bloom)

title: Sparkle x Sparkle
description:
A college girl finds her ideal guy. There is just one problem though. The guy's younger than her. In fact, he's in high school!  
  
(Source: MU)

title: My Hero Academia - Feel Special (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Sixteen Syndrome
description:
This isn't your typical prince meets princess story. Ibuki is stronger and cooler than any guy. She is known as the prince and her beautiful best friend, Mei is known as the princess. They are always together and Ibuki has promised to protect Mei.   
  
The two meet in elementary school, Ibuki is the type to befriend everyone and she was told to protect Mei because of Mei’s beauty she was prone to kidnapping. One day Ibuki was sick of her and left her alone. Mei was kidnapped but couldn't run because the guy threatened to kill Ibuki. She was soon found and safe but she became afraid of men. Ibuki blames herself and vows that she can’t really be happy unless Mei is.  
  
In high school they are together and Ibuki protects Mei from the guys who all want to get close to her for the wrong reasons. A known playboy named Asada made a bet with his friends to see if he can pull apart the well known prince and princess couple. But he finds himself falling in love with the prince, not the prince

title: Lovely Lesson - Chuukyuuhen
description: The first story is about a girl who is always called fat and ugly by a cute guy. To make him say she is cute, she tries hard to look pretty.

title: Would You Give Your Heart to Me?
description:
Back in elementary school, Jin Sung-yu left things on a bad note with Ryu Wonha before transferring to a new school. She never really did get over it. Now she’s in high school with some key players from her elementary school years: her best friend, Oh Yeonji; the girl she hates, Lee Mi-ae; and her first crush ever, Ryu Wonha. Yup, that Wonha. And it’s starting to look like Wonha might not have gotten over what happened between them either.

---

- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=58585229)

---

- [Original Book <Yes24>](http://www.yes24.com/Product/Goods/34889498)

- [Original Book <Aladin>](https://www.aladin.co.kr/shop/wproduct.aspx?ItemId=99085484)

title: Mousou Shisugite Real ni Natta Mitai desu.
Tokyo Bancho
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Daiki Kusakami is a hard-nosed high school student who came to Tokyo from Yokkaichi. But in Tokyo, he is just an eccentric... 

This is a new wave fish-out-of-water story that is sure to make you laugh with excitement.

title: Matsuri Complex!
description: Suzunu Matsuri, a high school student with the appearance of an elementary school student, is invited by her senior Ayaka to join the handicraft club. However, the club's true form is a cosplay club!? What's more, the other members include a big-breasted manager whose hobby is cosplaying cute girls, an active female cosplayer who is an otaku, and a super masochistic boy. There are a lot of weirdos out there, including the vice manager and a male member who is forced by the manager to dress as a woman. Will Matsuri, who struggles with being bullied by the club members, be able to become a full-fledged cosplayer?

title: Romantic Scenery
description:
Let this Game begin in the name of Love. Two high school students, Ren and Sora are competing with each other to gain Yukas' affection. "The one who makes Yuka in love wins"  
Both of them are strategizing different ways to make her in love while stopping each other to succeed

title: Ichihime Ninja
description: With an unloving father who manages love hotels, an idiotic ninja "protector" named Jin who poses as her math teacher, and a history of getting into fist-fights, Ichihime's high school life isn't exactly easy. But when another girl at the exclusive high school sets her eyes on Jin, Ichihime might be the one in need of rescuing.

title: Cake×Bomb
description: In this world, there are "forks", a privileged class of people, "cakes", who are eaten by "forks", and "other ordinary people". Instead of losing their normal sense of taste, the "fork" people feel a special sweetness and deliciousness only for the "cake" people. Shirohana, a special student at the prestigious Satomei Academy, is bullied by the school's powerful "fork" Toga, but by chance she discovers a secret...?

title: Gokuaku Drop
description: Nami has been friends with Ryouku since they were children. But ever since they watched a kiss scene on TV, Ryoku became a "kissing monster." After entering middle school, Nami is getting confused, wondering what kind of relationship she has with him.

title: Koufuku no Ouji
description: When humans are at their happiest moments they emit an aura that is delicious for certain fairies. This story is about a guy who has a fairy follow him around because he will soon emit that aura and the fairy wants to eat it…but all this guy encounters is one-sided love or failed relationships, is he really ever going to emit that aura?

title: Utopia of Homosexuality
description: The story of two best friends – a girl who's convinced that she's a lesbian because of her "non-girly" tastes and a guy who believes he's gay because of his feminine personality, and their search for love.

title: Koisuru Youtuber
description: "What happens if you fall in love with a top Youtubers in the job ranking you are part of?" The story is about two young high schoolers who are content creators; a beauty YouTuber named Mina and a gamer YouTuber named Yuko.

title: Mojikoinenekoi
description:
Neneko Hanamura, 17 years old, she has no friends or boyfriend. She was cute and popular on SNS, and she was living a glittering JK life. However, because I was betrayed by my friend, I was completely in a state of rock bottom !? What changed my life was an email with a stranger and an encounter with a super beautiful bandman! A girl's real life that makes her heart tingle!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Kimi no Iru Sekai
description: "A girl lives in a small, quiet town by the sea, where life moves slowly and she is unable to move on."

title: Omae no Hitomi ni Ikasareru!
description:
"I won't stop until you're humiliated. I'll definitely make you come!"

I get aroused when I look in his eyes?! My body heats up all on its own. It's mortifying, but… it sure feels good…!

title: Kuchibiru kara Hatsunetsu
description: Nohara Kasumi is a plain 1st year high school student. One day, she gets hit by a handsome 3rd year by accident and hurts her leg. Taka then tells her to get on his bike… ? [oneshot from Kiss Shite mo Ii Koro]

title: Boku no Hero Academia - Shutter no Oto ga Kikoetara (Doujinshi)
description:
Bakugou Katsuki/Todoroki Shouto
A story about learning to keep things as memories, and take pictures to preserve those memories.

title: Himegal Paradise
description: Modest school girl Tachikawa Himeko's Road to Becoming a Gal and her not-so friendshipping with Gal Mikami Tochiotome-sama...who happens to be a guy ?!

title: Minty Summer
description: A teenage girl returns to her hometown and is reunited with a childhood sweetheart. The shadows of the past have turned them into strangers. As they adjust to life, they experience and feel everything: envy and longing, arrogance and prejudice, the light and bitter aroma of mint, just like their youth. The obscure love of boys and girls, the young heartbeat, and the confusion and expectations of the future…

title: 2-Ren wa Mob Ja Irarenai
description: The most visually stunning high school boy, Himekishima-kun, and the fierce girl, Onimaru-san. Their ideal is a life as unnoticed background characters, but they can't hide their radiance!? A school romance comedy about these two, whose overwhelming presence constantly draws attention!

title: Hajimete no Onii-chan
description:
Kokoro, a first year high school student, meets her mother's new husband. Then, her senior from middle school shows up... The story begins when Kokoro and her senior, who was the son of her mother's new husband, become step-siblings.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Momohone
description:
A collection of short stories:  A story about falling in love with a senior with outstanding motor skills, a story about an angel who watches over the succubus demon hidden within his childhood friend, and a story about a joint party with an alien!? Kimi no Seiten / Tohoyo / Gokon Lovers / Mob Onna!
  
* Tohohoyo  
The cool and competent Toho suddenly asks his childhood friend Hoyo to be his lover. At the same time he tells her, "Hoyo just being by my side is already fine."  
What will become of their relationship?  
  
(Source: MU)

title: Save Me, Hogu!
description:
세상에서 착한 게 제일 싫은 준영은 '자타공인 청정호구' 산호가 자꾸 거슬린다. 
취향이 없고 흐릿~한 것도, 맨날 손해보고 사는 것도 마음에 안 든다.
그런데... 산호의 목숨을 살리려면 이 순둥이를 나쁜 남자로 변화시켜야만 한다고?!
사람 속 긁는 건 타고난 준영이지만, 이렇게까지 해도 되는 거야?

title: Nidome no Yakusoku
description: Jun was Hayato's servant and childhood friend, but it came to an abrupt end when Jun decided to go to a different school. Now, in high school, they've been reunited. Jun must now figure out what he means to Hayato after all these years.

title: Kotodama
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A gem of a ballet manga following "The Dancing Princess Terpsichore"!　

As 16-year-old Sumi aspires to become a ballerina, she is lost as she tries to figure out how to overcome her "weak in the performance" mentality...

title: Frankenstein Syndrome Girl
description:
(from ebookjapan):
A high school girl, Enue Dei, auditions as a jazz dancer and is liked by the judge, Johnny Kawahara, because of her strong physical strength, which allows her to dance hard without breaking a sweat. Later, after passing the qualifying round, Enue and her boyfriend Dai are involved in a car accident during a road trip, but Enue quickly recovers completely with her amazing resilience. Enue then becomes curious about the term "genetic modification," which her father had mentioned on the phone ......!

title: My Little World
description:
Towards the boys who do not understand her inner self and only say they like her for her appearance, she absolutely hates them. Especially her homeroom teacher, who ticks her off even more. But how come…?  
  
In addition, there are four more love stories in this debut collection!

title: Kimi ga Tenshi ni Mieru Toki
description: If you try really hard playing tennis, you will be given angel wings," a boy told Yuuka when she was small. She still plays tennis, believing his words. She finally encounters the boy when she grows up.

title: WANTE-D
description: Tori Ichihashi, a 10th grade student, has a strong sense of justice, and hates bad guys. Every night, burglars hover around the school that Tori attends. Tori can't let it go unchallenged.

title: Mobius Doumei
description: Matsuri Takanose a first year high school student. Her mother is the board chairman of the school, and Matsuri is under a lot of pressure to be the perfect student. One day after a grueling meeting in her mother's office at school, Matsuri encounters two boys who treat her differently. One is Takemasa Andou-kun, a smart, quiet guy who is known for keeping to himself and not talking much. The other is Watanuki-kun. Kaguya Watanuki is a very cute, outgoing, athletic guy. He and Andou-kun are classmates, but they don't appear to be friends. Later Matsuri happens to find out about her favorite idol pop singer and those two's relationship… This sets up an interesting love triangle…

title: Neck and Neck
description: Dabin Choi is the daughter of Seoul's most powerful crime boss, and daddy's little girl has the hots for Eugene, the son of one of her father's 'friends'. There's just one problem: Eugene isn't into Dabin. In fact, he thinks of her more like a little sister. (The kiss of death!) To make matters worse, Dabin's new classmate is none other than the son of her father's long-time rival. Soon, everyone at school begins playing power games that would make their fathers proud!

title: Himitsu no Sono Ato
description: Ryouko is a borderline flunky who has to break into school because she forgot homework that will decide if she has to repeat or not. While breaking in, she is caught by the guard, but he happens to be the guy who shares the same last name as her but always gets top scores, Naruse!?

title: M.G. Darling
description:
Ouri is a girl who dreams of getting married to someone who will protect her, just like her dad protected her mom. When she refuses an arranged betrothal to someone she doesn't know, her mom insists she attends Clover Academy, where there are plenty of fiancee candidates. Rumors about her quickly spread around the school, causing many boys to swarm around her.  
  
Then, caught in a pinch, she's suddenly rescued by a "Meteorite Guardian" named Knight, who is now contracted to Ouri to protect her…

title: Toshiue Kareshi no Dekiai ga Amasugiru
description: 「俺さ、あの時からずっとヒナのこと好きなんだ―――」牧場育ちの女子高生・梶原陽菜（かじわらひな）は、幼馴染の外国人オリバーと再会する。陽菜に逢えたと喜ぶオリバーに押し倒され、そのまま同居することに！？ 困惑する陽菜にはお構いなしで、同じベッドで寝たり、いきなり愛を告げたり、さらにはキスまで…！？大胆すぎる外国人オリバーのアプローチに、田舎娘の陽菜はタジタジで…？ 溺愛が甘すぎる幼馴染との再会ラブコメディ！

title: At Sixes And Sevens
description: Ever since young, Rianna has been attracting weird people, now that she is older she wanted to make a new start. She transferred to a new town hoping that things are more normal there, hoping she'll find the right and normal person for her. But what she find in this house was beyond what she imagined.

title: Ｖ - For Your Smile
description: Come spring, Nishiwaki Haruka becomes a second year high school student. For a second time. Due to accidents and illnesses, she didn't have enough attendance, thus the repeat year. She transferred to Yamabuki High to run away from her old friends. One day, the baseball team from her old high school came for a friendly match, and Haruka bumped into some old friends. Her new classmate, Ono Kenta, found out her secret. She agreed to be the manager-cum-player to their weakling baseball team in order to keep him from telling her secret…

title: Tonari no Danshi
description:
From Aerandria Scans:  
Satoshi and Satomi are childhood friends who have been trying to outdo each other in everything since they were small. Christmas is coming, and they’ve started a new challenge to see who can get a date for Christmas first! It seems that Satoshi might win the bet, with Natsuki-chan, the Sexy Dynamite of the class making the move and asking him to be her date, but will things be that simple for our plain-looking boy?  
  
Extra oneshot from Otomentaru.

title: Suki Ja Nai
description:
A collection of 6 stories.  
  
[STORY 01]  
Suki Ja Nai (I Don't Love You)  
"If you always say 'I love you,' you'll find happiness." Thanks to grandmother's good luck charm, Rio is a very happy and bright high school girl, well-liked by everyone because she tells everyone that she loves them. …Except for a boy in her class named Kaito. For some reason, he's different from everyone else. He makes Rio nervous and gets her heart pounding, and she can't communicate an "I love you" to him. Just what's going on!?  
  
[STORY 02]  
Koi No Mukou (Beyond Love)  
Stories 2 and 6 are continuations of the first story.  
  
[STORY 03]  
Kiss No Jouken (The Terms of a Kiss)  
  
[STORY 04]  
Touched by Love  
  
[STORY 05]  
Surprise Attack  
  
[EXTRA]  
Happy

title: Futago no Omamori
description:
Mamori, a young girl whose parents have disappeared and whose only blood relative, her brother, is also missing, lives a lonely life. In one of her regular letters from her brother, she is offered a job as a bodyguard for a wealthy pair of twins, so she heads to the interview venue. Although the twins reject her, Mamori passes the interview, but ends up working at the boys' school the twins attend...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: My Hero Academia - Kon’ya 23-ji Yume no Naka de (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: My Brother, Boyfriend, and He
description: Brother always reject girls around him! Despite having an ideal boyfriend by her side, his charm is still not enough to attract her, because he is always by her side…

title: Tobiuo to Shinkaigyo
description: 進学校に入学したものの、勉強についていけなくなり不登校気味の男子高校生・千尋。彼の心の拠り所は、SNSで“女装DK”としてお菓子作りを投稿することだった。進学校に生息する浮上できない落ちこぼれ「深海魚」の青春ハイスクール白書！

title: Seito Kaichou-sama no Okiniiri
description: Iku Kureka, a commoner with zero immunity to boys, transfers from an ordinary girls' school to a co-ed celebrity high school for the very rich. On her first day at the new school, the president of the student council, the most handsome man in the school, somehow takes a liking to her and presses her to join the student council...! And the members of the student council are all good-looking guys!

title: Ou-sama no Bed
description: A suite of emotionally resonant, romantic stories told by a critically acclaimed manga creator. In “The Bed of My Dear King,” an electrician called to a remote job deep in the mountains discovers the startling reasons behind the behavior of the house’s lone occupant, an eccentric young sculptor. In “Cherry,” an overachieving high school student forms an unexpected bond with a laid-back classmate. And in “Flowers,” the secrets surrounding a tragic death lead to an unexpected, and poignant, resolution.

title: Kanojo no Mirai to Boku no Kaku Genjitsu
description: Caught between the present and the future, what decision will she make...? She and I reunited after six years, one afternoon after school, when preparations for the school festival were in full swing. She appeared to inspect the Game Technology Research Club, to which I belonged, and, in a complete change from her usual calm demeanor, placed an innocent trust in me...

title: Storm
description: As a young girl, AhSoo was involved in a plane accident. Years later, she has tried to move on from the incident. Everything seems to be going well, until she meets a person from her past. A transfer student has arrived at her school, and he is directly responsible for the plane accident AhSoo was involved in years ago.

title: Gerbera
description: Before entering High School, Ei and Yuuji had always been good friends, but it all started after Yuuji confessed to a girl and was rejected. The relationship between Ei and Yuuji has delicately changed. Boy’s worry when falling in love… particularly when the partner is also a "boy". What should they do…?

title: 21 Seiki no Kimi e
description:
Because her parents divorced, she stopped believing in love. While skipping class one day she knocked into Math teacher Takada sensei and accidentally fell from the 4th story.

At first she thought she was dead... but it turns out she had actually travelled back 18 years ago?

title: Memoirs of Romance
description: There are 5 famous pretty boys at school. Their odd natures disagree with their good looks. Now that Jun-Oh is their target, what will happen?

title: Chikyuu wa Kozumi no Mono na no de!
description:
The planet "Earth" is the No. 1 planet in the invasion recommendation ranking. The invasion has finally been lifted, and the new space princess, Kozumi, is the first to arrive on this planet! However, what awaits her is a beautiful unlucky boy, a natural inventor girl, and even a cosmic influencer.

A cosmic daily comedy depicting the interaction between characters whose personalities are causing a traffic jam!

title: King's Number One Star
description:
学校と友だちが大好きな15歳、七尾星来★
通っていた女子校が廃校になり、
超エリート男子校と合併することに！！
そこで星来が出会ったのは
“キング”と呼ばれる男の子で――！？

title: Persona 5: Royally Free
description: What do you do when you're up against evil, no-good, rotten adults? Steal their hearts, of course! Is that legal? How about, uh, shut up? Don't ask unnecessary questions... [This is a fan-based comic only intended for entertainment purposes. I am not associated with Atlus Co. or Sega in any way. All rights go to the original authors.]

title: Neko ni Wagamama
description: A rom-com about a caring but also annoying high school girl who loves cats despite her fur allergy. One day, she rescues a weak cat and takes it home, only for it to turn into a human boy overnight! And this mysterious cat boy is no less than the grumpy guy in school she can't seem to get along with!

title: Kimagure A La Mode
description: Eitaro, a high school senior on his way home from a mock exam, is forcibly brought to a retro coffee shop with a reluctant master and an easygoing part-time worker. Worried about his future career, Eitaro returns home without even touching the melon soda he was offered. However, when he meets the part-time worker again later, his heart is moved by the part-time worker's words.

title: Together on Sunday
description: This is the story of three girls who all realize at the same time, that the boys they've been chasing aren't available, and so decide to meet on a Sunday to invite the first boys they see to a party they're going to put together. Of course, it's not anywhere near that simple, and the three boys/men they pick up are all connected although none of them are aware of it, and some events in their own lives are going to complicate things…

title: Zettai Kareshi to wa Wakaremasen!
description: 純粋無垢な少女宮川美鈴に神の怒りが降る！？おもらし、触手、幼児退行、NTR、くすぐり…etc。

title: Jewelry Eyes
description:
Runa has a special hypnotherapy power that she inherited from her parents, and with it she can repel perverts/molesters. However, due to this power she can’t find her first love, and it can’t help her fall in love. How will this power affect her crush, Kitagawa-kun?  
  
Also includes the following side stories:  
  
The Patch of a Rebel  
Maika is the manager of the soccer team and dating her senpai. She suddenly gets a new transfer student, Seri, who demands that she pay him 36,000 yen. Supposedly, eight years ago when they knew each other, Maika was a bully!  
  
Lucky Flowers  
For fifteen years, Yuri and her younger sister Ayame have been friends with their neighbors, Chihaya and his older brother Shougo. Yuri secretly likes Chihaya, who is in the same class with her, while Ayame likes Shougo. However, will they ever confess their love?

title: A Super Villain Day Life
description: A webcomic about a Villain's day life... The Super Villains and Heroes have they Day lifes with each other and they will just crush anyone who tries to disturb their day life!

title: My Hero Academia - Kyoumi Nanka Nee wa! (Doujinshi)
description: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Ppoi!
description: Amano Taira is your average junior high student who has a problem with his height. Join him and his friends as they journey to many places and experience many hardships during their teenage years. This is a heartfelt school drama with a little bit of everything.

title: Koi wa Omoeba Omowaruru
description:
恋は、思い続ければきっと届く! 思われれば、やっぱ気になる!?
女子校と男子校が合併してできた新設校を舞台に繰り広げられる、 超高糖度、ハイテンション青春ラブコメ。

title: Haikyuu! - Sweet Bath Time (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Sawamura Daichi x Sugawara Koushi

title: Tonari kara Nagareboshi
description:
After the plain me moved in together with the popular Azuma-kun, my whole world changed. But even then, we’re still people of different Worlds. Being born on Earth as a ‘normal human being’ – that’s me.  
  
I’ve came to realise the difference in our social standing. To the handsome and popular Azuma-kun, my existance is but a far and tiny thing. I’m sure it can’t even be seen. That’s why… Before these feelings turn into Love, I wanted so much to pull myself away—

title: Sekar X Popular
description: Sekar is an ordinary high school student who has a crush on Ardhan, her upperclassman. To get her upperclassman’s attention, she has to be popular… Will she be popular and get her upperclassman to be hers?

title: Sukusuku Otokonoko
description:
Natsuyaki Hatsu is a first year student in high school. He's short, but he's in his growing period right now! As soon as he entered high school, he started to get curious about a boy who's even more adorable than a girl, Fuyuno Aki. It turns out that Aki likes him and wants to have a relationship with him. Hatsu vows that he will reply to Aki as soon as he has become taller than him.  
  
And then a tall and cool guy appears, Akimoto Kaname, who wants to make both Hatsu and Aki his. Aki doesn't like Kaname, but what about Hatsu…?!

title: Caramel Diary
description:
Hana loves the school, caramel and…drawing manga! Her speciality: Drawing romance stories! In real life, her heart beats for the cool Taro, but she's too shy to tell him…unfortunately, Marie, her rival, has decided to steal him!  
  
Included is extra chapter: Tottemo Suteki na Takaramono.

title: Datte Sukinandamon
description:
The new school Riria has just transferred to has a lot of people with suspicious abilities. There are vampires with fangs and the snow devil, son of the snow fairy.
And then it turns out that Riria is a demon who sucks the life out of the people by kissing them!?

title: Haikyu!! - Hinata-chan no Cinderella Keikaku!! (Doujinshi)
description: Khi Hinata cố gắng làm cho Kageyama nghĩ về mình như một người con gái. Kageyama Tobio x Fem! Hinata Shoyo

title: Suki Kamoshirenai
description:
First-year high school student, Haruki, joins the Astronomy Club to chase after the kind and always-smiling president, Hatayama. Once day, Haruki finds Hatayama napping and spontaneously tries to kiss him. But he’s seen by the club’s vice president, Mochida, who’s a blunt and terrifying senpai!! Even though Mochida is supposed to already have a lover in the Astronomy Club, why does he suddenly kiss Haruki?! Just who is in love with whom here?!  
  
This is the love story of seven boys!

title: Girls und Panzer - Shishunkina Oshida-kun to Andō-kun no manga (Doujinshi)
description: Una historia corta y divertida sobre Oshida y Andō.

title: The Demon Disks in the Blue Sky
description:
Excessive love and hatred running wild! Mystery and fear evoke the excessive delusions of teenage girls and adults. The gothic horror drawn with a strange story and heavy pen touch has been highly praised by Kenji Otsuki, a musician and novelist who loves the mysterious, and horror manga masters Hideshi Hino and Suehiro Maruo!

3rd story is a girl's love story.
Stories here are also in the horrors of Noroi Michiru.

note: 3-5, probably 6,8 are sfw. first 2 are suggestive and 7 is very much not safe

title: How Will You Grant Your Dreams?
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A veteran Mangaka who has made his dreams come true teaches middle and high school students who tend to give up on their dreams the grand voyage to make their dreams come true!　

Mangaka Leiji Matsumoto, who is still active after more than 60 years in the art world, speaks to junior high and high school students on the themes of "Creation," "Dreams," "Life," "Fighting and Friendship," "Time," and "Life". 

Includes his essay manga "Drifting in the Land of Insects" (Kombukoku Ryoryu Ki).　

**"The possibilities for young people are endless. Please draw, create, and pursue your dreams with a free spirit. In the limited time of your life, searching for friends, sometimes fighting, and carving many experiences into your life will surely be an asset."**

**"How Will You Grant Your Dreams?" ------.** 

**"I sincerely hope that the answer to this question has already begun to grow in the hearts of everyone who reads this book."** 

(From the Afterword)

title: Perfect Fit
description:
Mashimo is a senior in university, wondering whether he should apply to the school’s graduate program. Intending to collect papers to aid him in the decision, he goes to his professor’s office only to find a new face greeting him at the door.
Mashimo later finds out that the strange man he met in the office earlier is Yuuto Tanaka, a first-year star graduate student from another university. Mashimo quickly realizes that the personality he sees when he sees Tanaka is not the same personality that everybody else sees. But one night, as Mashimo stumbles home and wanders into an unknown street, he runs into – is that Tanaka?!

title: Harumei
description: The 10-years-older-than-me childhood friend who I met when I was very young, Haru-nii. The classmate childhood friend who was beside me before I realized it, Ren. This is a story of first loves between these 2 childhood friends and me, Tachibana Mei.

title: I Hate that I Love You
description:
- Can you handle the weirdness?  
- 4-panel romcom that breaks the 4th wall  
- Contains a lot of anime/meme references  
  
A girl finds the person she wants to get revenge on and somehow ends up taking him in.  
  
Official English URLs:  
[Webtoons Challenge Link](https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/i-hate-that-i-love-you/list?title_no=108576)  
[WebComics Link](http://m.webcomicsapp.com/comic/5c52feadd5626e72955e61bb)  
 [Tapas Link](https://tapas.io/series/I-hate-that-I-love-you/info)

title: Netsu Shisen
description:
Consists of four stories:  
  
1) Feverish Eyes (Netsu Shisen)  
Kaoru fell in love at first sight with the boy who rides the bus with her, but she's never gotten up the nerve to talk to him. When he starts dating one of her friends, is it the end of all hope?  
  
2) Love the Whole Body  
  
3) Forever Just the Two of Them  
  
4) Flower of Longing (Katsubau no Hana)  
There's a rumor going around that Iida is in love with Inaba, but she wouldn't like such a shallow, perverted guy, would she? Now he's her next door neighbor, and he seems determined to find out if the rumor's true.

title: Kirakira Hikare
description:
Mizuno Iruka is a high school girl who spends her every day perfectly peacefully and ordinarily. She has someone she likes, but she always looks at him from afar only. Then one day, Moriyama-kun, the one she's always admired, asked her out out of the blue, and they're suddenly getting closer!! But there's a deep reason behind it…?!  
  
(Source: Divine Sanctuary)

title: Kanashii Kotoba
description: After his mother passed away, Kyousuke decided to live alone and transfer to another school. There he met a rather peculiar classmate named Kaname who’s unable to talk. Although Kaname cannot speak, he was able to somehow convey his feelings clearly through writing and facial expressions that made Kyousuke more drawn to him. However, Kaname’s cousin, Satoshi noticed the intimacy developing between the two which he could not approve… A sweet ardent, story of pure love unfolds…

title: Turning the World into an Enemy
description: Since her dad's death when she was in elementary school, Kamura promised to always protect her mother. Since then she has taken the role of being the responsible one in the family, including cooking, cleaning, and even getting her mom up for work. But then her mom tells her that she is getting remarried, and Kamura finds out her future stepbrother is the homeless guy she saw on the streets just the day before! And now her friend Youhei, who always teases and makes her feel like a fool, is acting differently…and even tries to comfort her?! Will Kamura be to able accept her new family life with a father and brother, and be able to let go her feelings of being responsible for her mother?

title: Masako Watanabe Masterpiece Selection - Flowers, Western Mansions, and Fashion
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Masako Watanabe is still active as the oldest mangaka working today, and is the creator of many major works, including "Saint Rosalind," "The Glass Castle," and "Kinbeibai. 

This collection includes "Hall of Flowers" and three other gems from her early blockbuster years.

title: Wind ~A Breath of Heart~
description:
Adaptation of the visual novel of the same name. Story is based on the Hinata route.

---

Serialized in Dengeki G's magazine from July-December 2004. 1 Volume released on January 27, 2005.

title: Nakaseta Sekinin Totte Kure
description:
One of Japan's leading celebrity schools, Private Hoshijo Gakuen.

Hiyori Sakurano is a minority poor student
She is a celebrity compliant dog student.

One day, Hiyori was harassed by celebrities,
Where she seems to be in danger
Get help from a sadistic transfer student, Yamagishi Federation!

An alliance that disturbs the order of the school and opposes celebrities.
I'm more careful about the alliance than the worried Hiyori,
Suddenly she was kissed crazy-!?

title: Dokusen Yoku Tsuyome no Ookami-kun wa Doukyo Dake ja Sumasete Kurenai
description: Rinri is a serious girl who is devoted to her studies, and the new resident at her house is Zen Hiiragi, a famous and popular boy at school!　Rinri is not very good with boys, but she finds herself living together with Zen, who is always trying to play a trick on her...?

title: Yu Jian 20 Sui
description: Le jeune Nathan devient un garçon retiré et asocial à cause des circonstances de son enfance. C'est alors qu'il rencontre Sherwin, et peu à peu, sa vie commence à changer… Se pourrait-il que Sherwin soit ce que Nathan attendait tant ?

title: Girls Be Lovely!!
description:
From Divine Sanctuary:  
  
Having to move schools from the Countryside to Tokyo, Chinami realizes that 'being like a girl' is quite vastly different?!

title: Shitsuren Biyoushitsu
description:
A collection of 5 oneshots:  
  
1) Shitsuren Biyoushitsu  
She breaks the school's hair code because she wants to be noticed by the teacher. But, her teacher is transferring…  
  
2) Itsuka Suki to Ieru Made  
Tamao grows her hair in order to look like a decent girl, but…?!  
  
3) Kono Koi wo Mousukoshi Dake  
Nana and Nene are twin sisters. Nene's always copying Nana, and…?!  
  
4) Kimi Iro Destiny  
Having red hair was my complex. You told me that it was the red string of fate…  
  
5) Shitsuren Mobius  
Kirie goes to the Shitsuren Biyoushitsu. That is because of her hopeless love towards her sibling…

title: Lunacy
description:
Luna is a high school student living as the Fire God Child. She lives with her grandmother, “Obaba”, who was once the Fire God Child and runs an acupuncture clinic. At the clinic, they use moxa containing Luna's blood, selling self-realization—a so-called cult business. Luna is bullied in her class for being religious, but she has a good friendship with Subaru, her only confidant. One day, Kenshou, a popular kid in her class, comes to Luna's rescue when she is being bullied. This incident brings the two closer, and Luna falls in love with Kenshou. However, love is not allowed for Luna, the Fire God Child. Luna decides to incorporate Kenshou into her “business”.

**Award:** Won the Top Prize in the 2022 Weekly Bunshun Entertainment Manga Awards!.

title: 100-nen no Koi mo Samenakute
description: 「あの～～～告白まだスか？」幼稚園時代、決死の告白に「ダンゴムシと同じくらい好き！」と返されてからはや１０年。二瓶陽芽は１０年間、変わらず幼馴染のマキに片想い中。どうにかこうにかマキに告白してもらうよう努力する陽芽だけど、スーパー天然たらしのマキに逆にドキドキさせられる毎日。

title: YuruYuri - Ame Tokidoki Yurufaa (doujinshi)
description: Akari-chan and Chinatsu-chan have various ways of discerning rainy days. If one of them can bolster up the other?

title: Innocent Maze
description: Haruto and Ikuto have just transferred to a boarding school. Beautiful Ikuto is instantly a target for the boys all around! And as his brother Haruto desperately protects him, the School King, Ouga, has his own plans in mind!! All-boys school has never been this dangerous!!

title: Otome Game no Oshi ga Gyaku Trip Shite Kita Hanashi.
description:
Shiori Kitano, is a JK Student who works hard at her schoolwork, club activities, and part-time job. Her days are fast-paced, but her favorite pastime is playing the otome game "Real ni Tokimete" also known as "RiaToki." She gets her daily energy from her favorite character, Amane Yukihira. "I wish he was real."

One morning, while she was wishing that, Amane Yukihira appeared in my room at?!

title: Wakeari Danso Reijo, Rival Kara Kyukon Sareru
description: 選ばれし男性貴族のみが通う、アダマント魔法学校。 そこに訳あって男装して通う伯爵令嬢・リオニーは、公爵家の嫡男・アドルフに、何かとライバル視される毎日を送っていた…。 そんなある日、父親から告げられた婚約相手は、まさかのアドルフでーーー！？ 「さ、最悪だわ…！」 何とか婚約破棄させようとワガママ作戦に出るリオニーだったが、 彼の予想外の甘く優しい一面に、逆に翻弄されていてーーー？  美しき魔法がつなぐ、溺愛ラブロマンス開幕ーーー！

title: Goripuri!
description: Otome-chan is called the "gorilla woman", she's a very strong girl. A boy, one day, going to her school saw her beating up another boy… Kanoyoma is a weak boy who tries to protect her, she begins to like him, but she is only willing to go out with a strong boy who protects her. Kanoyoma confesses to her that when they were kids, he swore to protect her. Now that they are in trouble, in a fight, Kanoyoma's personality changes to take care of her. His other self is willing to make Kanoyoma's weak boy disappear.

title: Yasashii Akuma
description:
Tohko and Wataru were childhood friends. Wataru was rather wimpy so Tohko always had to protect him from bullies. Then he and his family moved away to Germany, and they lost touch with each other.  
  
Years later, Wataru returns to Japan alone for his first year of high school, when Tohko is in her second year of high school.  
  
However he's completely different from what he was like before, having grown extremely tall for his age and much more pushy and aggressive. Tohko is bossed around by him all the time, and even ends up having to make lunch for him everyday, but she doesn't know how to deal with the "new" Wataru. Although he seemed like an angel to her when they were kids, now she sees him as a demon.

title: Ochiteru futari
description: 青春伝奇の快作『魔法使いの事情』の西原梨花、最新作！　男子高校生アキヨシの隣人・明石さんは、自由奔放な大学生。ある日、夜道で何故かぐでんぐでんに酔い潰れた明石さんを介抱した彼は、彼女が隠したいある「事情」を知ってしまった！　なんてことない日常から目が離せなくなる「年の差」ラブコメ開幕！

title: My Hero Academia - Kiss Shitara Nakayoku Nareru ka to Omotte (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Megane Danshi na Kare.
description: A collection of short stories by various authors that feature guys with glasses.

title: Manga Academy
description:
In the not so distant future, manga and anime has grown and evolved with new innovations in technology. Many manga schools are abound, but among them sits the most prestigious of all - Manga Academy.

Many aspiring manga artist come here to make it big. And among, them a young man named Yuta is about to realize his destiny.

title: Sweet Bitter Love
description:
Things don't always work the way we want them to. This is a story of how one door closes and another opens. --- - [Original Webtoon ](https://chuchu-webtoon.postype.com/series/717380) --- - [Original Webtoon "Pre-Serialization"](https://webtoonleague.kakao.com/league/view/13905) --- - [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://toomics.com/tc/webtoon/episode/toon/4675) - [Official Spanish Translation](https://toomics.com/mx/webtoon/episode/toon/4675) - [Official Portuguese Translation](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/4675) - [Official Portuguese
Translation](https://toomics.com/br/webtoon/episode/toon/4675) - [Official Spanish Translation](https://toomics.com/es/webtoon/episode/toon/4675) - [Official Italian Translation](https://toomics.com/it/webtoon/episode/toon/4675)

title: Sensei no Iutoori.
description: Beautiful but unemotional Ishimoro-sensei has always been chased by women and has become an "expert at romance", despite never being involved in it. Students and teachers both always ask for his advice. The only one who doesn't is gym teacher Yamada who seems to hate him with a passion for some unknown reason.

title: Ice Ice Baby
description:
From Wataame Shoujo:  
Ice Ice Baby:  
Suh-Ah is a quiet and reserved high school girl who almost seems unapproachable. One fine Saturday after school, Suh-Ah is dragged into a "meeting" with boys from the neighboring highschool because one of the girls gets sick.  
Fate lands the well-known "king card" (Hwan) on her lap and she immediately says good bye and goes home. This incident hurts Hwan's pride and haunts him, to the point that he has to see Suh-Ah again…

title: Ampersand
description:
What would you do if one day, a time-traveling, hammer-wielding girl from the future suddenly appeared in your backyard searching for a mysterious object? Well, that's exactly what happens to Takayuki, who is a normal high school student. Join him on a crazy but sweet adventure that delves into the world of time travel and future beings as he discovers the true power the future beholds.

Digital Versions Delisted

title: Escape

description:
(from ebookjapan):

It was a war that lasted a mind-bogglingly long billions of years. A fierce battle with the destroyer of the universe, the Phantom Demon. The mighty Phantom Lord's power destroys most of the universe, and his evil hand finally reaches the earth. 

The supernatural powers of Jyo Azuma, a high school student, are awakened before the curtain rises on Armageddon! 

Teaming up with Hirai Kazumasa, the writer of "8 Man," this timeless bestseller depicts a supernatural war and the end of the world. 

Katsuhiro Otomo also participated in the animated feature film version, opening the golden age of SF manga!

title: Idol Clubs
description:
A Prince Charming suddenly appears in front of a country girl on a remote island.   
  
"I love you, I want to be happy with you like this forever."   
  
Setting a foot on a strange city to find her Prince Charming, she finds out that he is actually the Entertainment Industry's top star, Gang-Woo Choi.   
  
Even after seeing her, he pretends as if he doesn't know her…!!!   
  
"Gang-Woo Choi! You dare play around with me? I'll never forgive you!"

title: Classmate Gui, Please Be A Little Bit More Patient!
description: After failing to reincarnate countless times, Tao Zhi, a young girl, finally found a way she might enter reincarnation: to help a human teenager, Gui Zizhuo, who collaborates with the Ghost Realm, to raise the ratings of his ghost exorcisms. That being said, could Gui Zizhuo, whose exorcism methods were oversimplified and crude, get any good reviews?! Tao Zhi was once again deeply concerned about her chances at reincarnation…

title: Blooming
description: Beautiful like a flower, Kinar became the most popular student on campus. Eh… Instead of being praised, why is she being hated instead?

title: Tte Iuka Koi ja ne?
description:
