Ichino is a high school girl who absolutely hate guys due to the fact that her father betrayed them when she was young; stealing all the valuables that she & her mother possessed & disappearing without a trace. Since then she has vowed to become strong so she would not lose to any man. She has also longed for the day she could meet the lady from a fateful encounter in her childhood.  
  
One day, she accidentally beat up a guy who she mistook as a pervert pestering her friend, Miyabi. She tries to apologize but ends up beating him up even more…. She developed a distaste for the guy and two of his friends as they bump into each other once again resulting in more misunderstandings. Ichino personally believed that if she came across the same person thrice that would be considered 'fate'…  
  
Coincidentally, the start of her school begun with a surprise as she found out that all THREE of them turned out to be her new classmates !!

title: AniTomo - My Brother's Friend (Webtoon Version)
description: Nanase, a polite and old-fashioned girl, gets a boyfriend for the first time - her brother's friend. However, both of them have no idea what they should do next… Hand-holding would be too embarrassing, and 'dating' is something mature people would do.

title: Osananajimi to Kamisama to
description: 東京の高校に進学するために、幼なじみのしろねと共に故郷の島を出た千秋。ところが、しろねの体には島の土地神が憑依していた。森を破壊した人間どもへの復讐として神さまが千秋に求めてきたのは……子作り！？

title: Dousei Ai
description: The first person who hurt me was of my own sex. Tsubaki is in the same class as Kaoru and Koutarou is the gentle big brother. What embrace their souls are desires and tenacity... They are hurt, they throb, they are drowned, they cry... They love with their body and soul, these are the real ordinary lives of these boys.

title: HWA
description: A collection of short stories.

title: Hadaka no Ouji-sama
description: Chiemi is a young romantic girl. She dreams about her final love and imagines how the confession will be. One day, a boy named Kenzo-kun, who has a reputation as an ill-mannered and violent person, claims her to himself. What will happen between these two people and with the lecherous male students who are chasing after Chiemi?

title: Love Live! Superstar!! - Riera-chan to Pocky Game (Doujinshi)
Kuro Ouji no Dekiai ni wa Sakaraenai
description: 'If you insist, I might even make you my girl?' When ordinary high school student Ichika transfers to a new school, the invincible prince Rei boasts an extraordinary level of popularity. But when Ichika discovers Rei's other side - that he is a selfish, toxic scum - she unintentionally declares war on him with a slap! But their houses are unexpectedly next door to each other... He takes advantage of her weakness and decides to cooperate with her to overcome Rei's only flaw, but what does he mean when he says "let me touch you every day" ......? The perfect (?) tsundere gets sweeter and sweeter every day. The first volume of a romantic comedy with a prince who gets sweeter and sweeter every day!

title: Aquarium
description:
Consists of three stories:  
  
1. Aquarium  
2. The Flying Stewardess  
3. The Heart is Your Kingdom  
  
From CPM:  
Three tales of love, loss, and longing.  
A trio of girls tackle the trials of adolescence and try to find happiness.

title: HEART Anthology
description: Featuring stories from the 2020 Short Story Contest! From wholesome stories to tearjerkers, are you ready to catch these feelings? New stories released every Wednesday.

title: Brand Peace
description: 8th grader Mii is in a hurry to gain experience with guys. But poor her! The guys and girls in her class are at war with each other, so now she’s not allowed to fall in love. Despite this, she falls for the guys’ leader Yashiro anyway…It’s the perfect academy for love wars!

title: Otome no Omocha
description: An is a high school girl and a live-in superintendent at a share house. One day she receives a mysterious refrigerator through express delivery, and inside of it… was a very attractive guy! Turns out he is an android from the year 2222. And he came here to learn about love?!

title: Lover Puzzle
description:
Gyul, the outcast of the entire school, who used to be unable to get away from dangers without Ri Rang's help becomes strong with a sword obtained at an antique shop?!  
  
Hot-tempered, unruly fighter Woo Ri and my best friend Gyul suddenly seems different? My heart beats when I see Gyul! Without knowing my eyes turned to look at his lips, and I could feel myself blushing. This is not a disease, is it?

title: Megane Ouji
description:
From Nagareboshi Manga:  
  
The day Sachiko confesses her love to Masuda-senpai is the day she discovers that she'll be living with him from now on! After being rejected, how will Sachi deal with living with Masuda-senpai? Not to mention his double personality!

title: Starry☆Sky ~In Summer~
description: Tsukiko has joined the academy's archery club. As she practices for the summer competition, she also solves the problems between her teammates (Homare Kanakubo, Ryunosuke Miyaji, and Azusa Kinose) simultaneously.

title: Deep Flower
description: Sonoda Kaiya is an up and coming model. His classmate, Tateyama has been in love with Kaiya for a long time but Kaiya only sees Tateyama as a plaything. As for Tateyama, he is willing to do whatever the wicked Kaiya wants, thus starts an abusive and possessive relationship…

title: #Furikumanaide #Furimuite
description: Mo-Mio has a certain "fear of people! The person that Mo-Mio is most afraid of is her classmate "Yuuto Onomiya" who became her brother-in-law after her parents remarried. Can I like him? A love story of a communicative girl and an unsociable boy under one roof!

title: A Teacher's Paradigm
description:
Syasya is a regular high school teacher that doesn't take her job seriously at all!
One day, she discovers her ability to read minds but only while she's in the school grounds
A funny and heartwarming story filled with antics as Syasya gets to know more about her students!

title: Sayonara, High School
description: Asakura, a high school student at the bottom of the school pecking order, plans to disrupt the mood and order in his class when he is appointed as a member of the school festival committee, and makes a plan to date a beautiful girl from the top caste, Itou Mayumi. His plan to break up the caste system seems to be going smoothly, but an incident takes him in an unexpected direction?! A bizarre classroom chaos tragicomedy begins!

title: Namida Hyakuman Tsubu
description:
A collection of oneshots:  
  
1. Lovely You - July (Yuki Suetsugu)  
2. Last Class (Machiko Sakurai)  
3. Happy Tomorrow (Keiko Suenobu)  
4. To Be An Angel (Mizuho Aimoto)  
5. Indigo Blue (Tsugumi)

title: S+
description: A group called ICA shows up at Akane's school one day and takes Akane away. She is ordered to provide information about her brother Akihei, but she refuses. After a while, she changes her mind and agrees to help them, because…?

title: Nante Zurui Otoko
description:
A collection of one-shots.  
  
- **Nante Zurui Otoko (What a Sly Guy)**  
Yoshino Nene is a 16-year-old girl who fell in love at first sight with Fukazu-san, a man 9 years older than her. She sends him emails, trespasses (?), and intensely hits on him, but he won't respond to her. Finally, he told her: "I won't ever fall in love". But he looked very sad when he said that. Nene wants to know his real intentions…  
*- Intercross*  
  
- **Kimi ni Makasenasai!**  
After confessing to someone and being rejected, the infamous girly second year, Kaji-senpai who witnessed the whole thing offers to pick Tajima Rika up. And so begins Rika's transformation into a cute girl through Kaji-senpai's hands.  
  
- **Come to My Side**  
Uchino Tomaki, a 17 year old girl, becomes interested in her younger brother's friend, Shun.  
  
- **Kimi wo Itadaki!**  
About a girl who cannot stop feeling the need to compete with her childhood friend. Her uneasy feeling has made her never thought anything other t

title: Spy x Family: Anya x Damian (OTP cut scene)
description: SPY x FAMILY: Anya và Damian. Những cảnh cut của OTP AnDa trong manga.

title: Naerin
description: A disabled girl, Yuna, is going to school from home schooling. In addition to health problems, she has mental problems and lack of social skills. They start laughing at her at school. She decides to come up with a god who would help her, and suddenly... he responds

title: Blue Lock - Schrödinger's Genius (Doujinshi)
description:
Nagi ✕ Reo

The latest release from Circle [100h Suimin] is an IF story set in a world where Nagi’s "smartphone trap" never happened☆

When Nagi saw the person he had bumped into in the hallway, he realized it was the son of a wealthy family.

Seeing Nagi, the boy thought he had a good physique and told him to come watch if he was interested in soccer before walking away. However, Nagi had no interest in soccer, so he spent his days without any connection to it and eventually became an ordinary salaryman...

Even though he became a salaryman without playing soccer, Nagi couldn’t shake the feeling that he was missing something more important. Despite not having seen him for years, the face of his wealthy high school classmate (Reo) kept flashing in his mind, and he began to feel that something was off.

title: Danganronpa - Brand New Days (Doujinshi)
description: A Makoto Naegi x Mukuro Ikusaba doujin.

title: Kesalan Patharan
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Illustrator and essayist Yurako Hoshi suddenly decides to build a house near the nearest train station. Her niece Shion, who is Yurako's assistant and secretary while attending art school, fears her reckless decision, but... 

A new kind of manga about building a home!

title: When There's Light in Your Eyes
description:
Do-yoon Kang, who has always been misunderstood by people because of his scary appearance, meets Jeong-mi, a special friend who accepts him as he is, and her daughter, Hana Baek…

___
• Alternate Raws: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6327068), [Kakaopage](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=57342352), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/845026287), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=3eqr), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000048686)

title: How to Hate You
description: It is a college campus romance with freshmen’s love and friendships. It tells the story of Miri who's worrying between love and friendship as she started to like her best friend’s boyfriend.

title: Yami ni Koishita Hitsuji-chan
description:
Kusahara Hitsuji, the most beautiful girl in the school, falls in love with a transfer student named Kokuyou Haku, whose entire body is covered in bandages.
However, Kokuyou Haku is in fact a witch hunter who hunts 'black witches'!
When the love of a sheep embraces Kuroyoh, who curses witches and lives to hunt witches, the story begins to take a major turn -.

title: Omake no Kobayashi-kun
description:
This is the story of four high-school students whose family name happens to be Kobayashi that end up in the same class. No Kobayashi is similar to another Kobayashi and in fact, three of them are considered something similar to the Bermuda triangle. Anybody who gets near, ends up… well… that's better left unsaid.  
  
New student Kobayashi Yamato is not afraid however, and already considers them like brothers and sister! Will his naive youthfulness be crushed forever? Will the everlasting power of "always happy attitude" overpower the famous trio? Will anybody survive the year?

title: Juuni Hizoku no Palette
description: On the island of Opal live the world's most colorful birds. The birds have attracted a school for aspiring "Palettes" — wizards who have the ability to "borrow" color from one object and paint its qualities onto another. Young Cello has the potential to be a great Palette, but she just can't seem to control her power. As the end of freshman year approaches she's on the verge of failing, so she's going to need all the help her bird, Yoyo, can provide. (Baka-Updates)

title: Shibutani-kun Tomo no Kai
description:
Ageha is a high school student who has taken over the role of housewife ever since his mother passed away. He has two younger brothers whom he must care for, and a useless father who is always out dating women.   
  
There's a girl that Ageha likes–his classmate, Nina. She tells Ageha that she's in love with a handsome, popular singer. Ageha decides to sing on stage at an open mic session to prove to Shinna that he can be like that guy, too. But just after he starts to sing, someone interrupts and abducts him! The stranger is no other than Miyamoto Range, the singer whom Nina loves.   
  
Range wants Ageha to join the Shibutani Alliance Cub—his band—and is relentless in his pursuit. At first, Ageha thinks that Range is annoying. But little by little Ageha is won over by his charm. Will he be able to accept Range? Will Nina ever return his feelings?

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! - Himitsu no Omajinai (Doujinshi)
description:
ship: You x Riko  


---

 Links  
- [Author's Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/132763)  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/mizuno_yun)

title: Kuromaku Game
description: 異能をもつ者が観測され、その異能を使った犯罪が増加することになってしまった日本。しかし、犯罪に異能が使われる一方で、その力を正義のために振るう者は『捕獲者（ハンター）』と呼ばれた。そんな中、未来を見る力を得た積木来都は、破滅の未来を迎える世界を観測してしまい、それを救うために、ある決断をした。それは、無敵のお姫様怪盗、暗殺一家の箱入り娘、国民を騙した天才詐欺師、ギャルマッドサイエンティスト――とびきり優秀で頼もしくハチャメチャな仲間をスカウトし、“完全犯罪”を成立させて未来を改変していくこと――!?

title: Kimi, Kawaii ne.
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
1. Kimi, Kawaii ne.  
2. Watanabe no Kuse ni.  
  
3. Moteki Shuurai.  
In life, we have three times the chance to become popular, but once we get popularity what will happen…?!  
  
4. Sono Karada Kashite Kudasai.  
5. Shijou Saidai no Iyagarase.  
6. Kimi, Kawaii ne. Bangaihen

title: A Wolf Warning
description:
Han Summer (Yeuh-Reum) and Hyun Moo-Heum are very different from one another. While Moo-Heum is a brilliant, yet stunning son of a CEO of one of the most influential and extensive companies in the world, Summer, on the other hand, is a mediocre-looking girl - a plain Jane, who is just under an inescapable debt of 70 million! And to whom? It is none other than Hyun Moo-Heum! In the midst of this dilemma, a mysterious figure enters and intervenes with their lives. Could he be of any help to Summer or is he destined to make her life more complicated than it already is?  
  
- [Original (Naver)](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=4689906)

title: Dakara Anata ni Koi o Shita
description:
Ever since she was bullied by her classmate Chiba in elementary school, Kanon has been afraid of boys.
She was leading a peaceful junior high school life with her only boy friend, Tenhiro, but Chiba suddenly transferred to a new school...?
Who will win Tamane's heart? A storm of love is brewing in this coming-of-age triangle love story!

title: Exchange Male and Female
description:
절친이었던 세리와 하나.
그러던 어느 날, 세리가 하나의 전 남자친구인
구남훈과 사귀고 있다고 고백하는데..!

갑작스러운 두 사람의 배신에 힘들어하는 하나.
그런 하나에게 세리의 전 남자친구 차인호가 접근한다.

두 사람에게 복수하기 위해
자신과 가짜 연애를 해보지 않겠냐는 인호.

과연 둘은 무사히 복수할 수 있을까?

title: Dragon Girl
description:
From Yen Press:  
  
Fiesty, fierce Rinna Aizen is a girl with a dream — to follow in her father’s footsteps as the legendary captain of Shoryu Senior High’s cheering squad. Only problem? Shoryu High is an elite all-boys’ school! Or it was…until now! With the school going co-ed, Rinna might be one step closer to achieving her dream, but the road to a successful cheering squad is still full of hurdles…can Rinna clear them all?!

title: Yuri and Yuri and Yuri
description: The Metalworks & Jewelry Department’s freshman Lee Yuri bumps into Kwon Yuri, the Art teacher who turned down her confession. There’s also Cha Yuri, who is a seonbae in the same department known for being cold, who tends to help Lee Yuri a lot...

title: Love Home
description: Odagiri, who hates guys, is transferred into an all boys school. There, he meets Tomonaga, who is selling himself in the school for a bit of cash?! In order to monopolize Tomonaga, Odagiri pays him double price…?!

title: Suki Nan Desu
description: Koharu is dating the prince in school, Suwa. But things don't turn out as planned when Koharu tells him to keep their relationship a secret!

title: Koakuma no Kiss ni Ochiru
description: Since we became step siblings three years ago … I have considered Chisato as my cute little brother, but … Lately he tells me he's … to his limit? … Now … I have fallen in love with the kiss of this little demon …. What will I do?

title: Gekikawa♥Devil - Henshin★OshaLesson
description:
Mai is a first-year junior high school student who loves fashion. When she sees "gachioiwa" fashion and behavior, she gets mad at them.
Mai solves her friends' fashion problems one after another, but her love affair with Kai, the boy she loves, is not going so well...?

title: Sweetheart Devil
description: Kaori is a reserved girl who just got rejected by the boy she likes. Dejected, she goes to the library only to discover a book that allows her to summon a wish-granting demon. He will make her life better, but if she gets three wishes granted, she’ll lose something important to her…

title: Class Reunion
description: Time and time again, those flowers will always blossom, as long as they are there.

title: Maiden Armor Artemis
description:
Her "chest" has a secret.

The strongest and invincible in the game! But in real life, I, Ayumu Kameno, who is small, fat, and a creep, picks up a mysterious beautiful girl in the river one day...! ? Caught up in a big fate! ! A “slightly erotic” robot battle begins!

title: Punipuni to Sarasara - Arui wa Mokei Heya no Shounen to Shoujo ni okeru Hyoumen Chouryoku to Mousaikan Genshou
description: 大戦中の艦船模型作りが趣味の人気モデル・藤文夏は、中学生の同級生・更科匠海の祖母が経営する模型教室の生徒だったが、祖母が亡くなり模型店を相続した匠海が模型に全く興味ない事を知り！？

title: Powerful Gossip
description:
1-4) Two teachers having the same surname causes a lot of confusion on campus, but what one overhears could cause the other's demise.  
  
5) Kawahara is sponsoring Tooru, a poor artist. Do his feelings go beyond friendship?  
  
6) Asami's stern boss Oonoki is always scolding him. But after drinking one night Asami sees a new side to him, a very sexy one. But Oonoki doesn't remember anything when he drinks! Will Asami be able to resist the temptation?  
  
7) Extra for another story about Katsuragi and Sayama.

title: Danshiryou no Hitsuji-chan
description: Meiko is an ordinary JK who is thrilled to have been admitted to the high school of her dreams. She wanted to live a peaceful life, but the Ookami-kun has his eye on her!

title: Migiko's No. 1 in Japan!!
description:
Contains two stories:  
  
I. Migiko Nipponichi!! -  
As children Sakon confessed his love for Migiko and promised to protect her, but not long after suddenly cut all ties with her. Now, many years later, Migiko is determined to make Sakon take notice of her by becoming Japan's Number 1 idol. - From Solaris-SVU.  
  
II. Takuya of the 7 Wonders.-  
There's a rumor in the school that if a person steps into the school at night, they will disappear. Sanami, a middle school student who is oblivious about the rumours, decides to prove those rumors out. She gets her best friend missing and now must save her before she disappears.

title: Meojeori M-susaeng
description:
Cheon Jae‑beom seems like a comfortably above-average student: his parents spend 400 a month on private tutoring, he has a girlfriend, lots of friends, and grades that are better than most, so he confidently aims for a medical school spot in Seoul. 

When the college entrance exam goes badly, he ends up retaking the exam together with his girlfriend. Then, on the day before the second exam, his girlfriend suddenly breaks up with him. Crushed, Jae‑beom gives up on taking the test at all. 

The story follows what happens to his path afterward — how he deals with failure, lost love, and expectations, and what kind of future someone who fell off the elite track can still carve out for himself.

title: Sons of Eve
description: One day, the British youth trio of Heath, Justin, and Vergil are told by the angel Doziel that they are part of "Van Rose". The Van Roses are a male-only clan that Doziel created from Eve's ribs, many of whom are historical figures of all ages, east and west, and the chosen ones are temporarily transsexual and female. He had a child and was growing his blood. Therefore, they are homosexual.

title: Kimi Dake no Shirushi.
description: He noticed a bruise on the corner of his lips that won’t disappear. Why is that? Yurino can’t help but be curious about this mysterious boy, and the mysterious mark he’s got on him. Will she be able to uncover his secret?

title: Kankei Shoseki: Twitter Manga Tanpenshuu
description:
A collection of 14 Twitter romcom short stories, each with a new afterstory page.

**Note:** Only contains the first chapter of any multi-chapter work.

title: Magic Spectacles.
description:
This is the story of a stupid girl and a boy student of glasses, which have nothing in common, but they want to be together.  
Yuko is a girl from sophomore year to which confesses suddenly a guy who works part-time in first grade.  
Fukuda is in a prestigious high school, he is a very calm and quiet boy …

title: Buzu no Isshou
description: Miao was looking forward to high school life. However, when she entered the school, she found that all the students were beautiful except for her. When she tries to talk to them, they all just smile at her, and after checking her from top to bottom, they draw the line at her. Miao's fierce revenge life begins. ......

title: Dokidoki! PreCure - Love☆Kiss Rouge (Doujinshi)
description: A sweet shoujo-ai Doujinshi of Doki Doki PreCure - Regina is in kiss-mode ^^

title: Circuit Circus
description: After Haru had a falling off with his childhood best friend, Mai. He eventually decides to confront her so they can talk everything out—But unfortunately, his best friend's body was taken over by her alter-ego. How far will the story go?

title: Ooma ga Toki!
description: Miname Nanako is determined to see Ooma's "100 Faces Apparition". While following him around with her camera, she figures out what is causing his nickname. Determined to assist him with his troubles, she will not take no for an answer!

title: Take Care of My Cat
description: The renter living in our house is a horrible (but beautiful) cat prince!

title: Sukitte Itte Oka-kun!! 2
description: Bạn cùng lớp của Satsuki Oka, Hajime Tsunefusa, hẹn cậu trên sân thượng và tỏ tình với cậu. Mặc dù không kì thị đồng tính nhưng trước giờ cậu chưa từng hẹn hò với con trai. Cậu lập tức từ chối Hajime nhưng sau đó Hajime lại bắt đầu lẽo đẽo theo cậu… Đừng bỏ lỡ câu chuyện này của tác giả Sawaco, tác phẩm đầu tay đã bán hết sạch tại hội chợ truyện tranh dành cho người hâm mộ!!!!!

title: Happy Happy
description: Minami has a crush on Ryouta-kun, but all he does is tease her all the time…

title: Tokyo Shounen Shoujo
description:
Mimori Kosaka's dream comes true when she's accepted to the Meidai Attached High School and gets to wear their super-fashionable uniform! She's excited about having a fun freshman year of high school, but things don't turn out as effortlessly as she had hoped.  
  
Includes the following side stories:  
Volume 1: Basically Pure-Hearted  
Volume 2: Kiss the Mike!

title: Kingdom Hearts - After Battle (Doujinshi)
description: A short Kingdom Hearts doujinshi :)

title: Harenchi
description:
"Does the attractive force make me attracted to you ?"  
Sonoko is leading a life of high school girl idly, and one day at after school she "accidentally" kissed her friend's boyfriend in the science room. But Ito, a super A-student, saw the scene!! Although Sonoko hurriedly fled?  
  
Compilation of three oneshot stories: Harenchi, Denpa and Kuri Muso Da.

title: Celebrity Yuukoujouyaku
description: Dumped after her high society boyfriend uses her, Chidori swears off rich boyfriends. One day, she was robbed, but the guys turned out to be none other than Yuu and Kikuya practicing their acting skills. Chidori is attracted to Kikuya, but a classmate tells her that Kikuya is very rich! Afraid of being hurt again, Chidori keeps a 'safe' distance from him…

title: Makase Nasai!!
description:
Hiromi is a high school girl who has never had a boyfriend but has always enjoyed matchmaking. Riko (her younger sister) is experiencing her first love. To make it a success, Hiromi tries to find out who is the special someone in her sister's heart. To her surprise, it is Nan–best known to be the school's most flirtatious guy. It would appear that Hiromi has to face her toughest matchmaking challenge ever.  
  
Compilation volume of stories:  
- Hand Me Your Love!!  
- With a Blush and a Racing Heart  
- Perfect Feeling  
- Kiss Kiss x 2

title: Cactus and Radio
description: Listen to the world's various stories on Yoo Si Ae's radio show, Cactus and Radio.

title: Kuzu no Tadashii Tsukaikata
description: Rui Onoe is a first-year high school student who dreams of falling in love, but has zero experience with boys. One day, she meets Okita-senpai, a popular senior at school who is known for his romantic rumors. He teases her, saying, “Let me teach you about love,” but her impression of him is terrible...

title: Here Comes the Playboy!
description: John is a star player of the school baseball team, and the one and only darling of Linda Marbury, the prettiest girl at school. However, John doesn't see Linda as a girl, which frustrates her to no end. Everything changes when one day, a suave boy named Clint Walker transfers to their school, and sweeps Linda off her feet! Can John win Linda's heart back?

title: As You Wish My Lady
description:
Handsome and popular, but he has a secret hobby: dancing! Tian kept it a secret because he didn’t want to be judged. 

Unfortunately, Tina found out about his hobby and suddenly asked Tian to become her boyfriend in exchange for keeping his secret.

title: Skip Kiss
description: Hamura is a sheltered and very friendly high school student. He has always admired the reserved and troubled Miyake from afar. An incident in the locker room has finally opened up a chance for Hamura to be friends with Miyake. But does Miyake want a friend… or could they even be friends? Between Miyake's troubled past and Hamura's jealous close friend and perverted tutor, how will these two establish any type of relationship…

title: Sono Toki, Kimi ga Naita
description: Ritsu, a new high school teacher, finds that she can't get first year male high school student Shinobu off her mind. It seems that Shinobu can't get Ritsu out of his head either… A heartrending school love story that delicately depicts the feelings of men and women when they're in love.

title: Anata Watashi No Nanyakudesuka
description: 主人公の財閥令嬢・渚は、過保護な父の計らいにより、幼い頃から友達などの“役”を果たす人々に囲まれて生きてきた。高校こそは自由に過ごしたいと思い、自らが選択した学校に入学するも、そこにも12人の被雇用者がいることを知らされる。周囲を信じることができなくなった渚だが、彼女の前にひと目惚れをしたと言う少年・犬塚が現れて……。

title: Sayonara Pinky Ring
description: High school student Matsui has a crush on Shouko Shirakura.

title: Rebelde El Comic
description:
Rebelde was a Mexican comic book series, published by now defunct Ka-Boom! Estudio, based on the telenovela of the same title. The comic was first published April 2006 and lasted only two issues due to conflicts caused by Ka-Boom's writers. Despite initial demand being high, the amateur writing team from Ka-Boom delivered the scripts for the first three issues months later than agreed, causing the art team trouble and also creating conflicts with Televisa's editorial representatives, which led to the cancellation of the title.

The series was advertised as being based on the style of Japanese manga, but it was only partially based on it.

title: Unbeatable Youth
description: XIANG Wei-er, who has exceptional grades and a sense of justice, upon transferring to a new school and class, got named by the teacher as a little teacher dedicated to guiding the "special students" in the class… Gosh! Before she can even adjust to the unfamiliar new environment, she has to first deal with a bunch of difficult people… a serious girl meets a strange handsome guy, and together act out a surreal campus love comedy!

title: Bishounen Itadakimashita
description:
Yuka-sensei, is completely crazy about Reo Kajitani, one of her pupils that she finds all cute. But much to her surprise when she discover that under his appearance of a little lamb, hides a real wolf! Reo hides his game well and turns out to be a real playboy. But the surprises do not stop there, because after a blow of fate, Yuka finds herself sharing her roof with Reo. What will happen then?

source: mangaupdates

title: Junjou Karen
description: Tamiya, a student whose honesty tends to be so blunt that it gets him in trouble, has fallen in love with Shirasaka, a teacher from his school. He's an excellent teacher, very caring and popular among students, but because of his dark past, there seems no hope for Tamiya to win over his heart. In the past, Shirasaka had a relationship with Iogi, his senior on the track team, and they were both in an accident which was Shirasaka's fault. Iogi became seriously injured and was forced to give up his athletic dreams. Since then Iogi has used Shirasaka's guilt to keep him close. Is there any chance for Shirasaka and Tamiya to be together?

title: Sakura Zensen
description: At first, Sakura Nakahara, had a crush on Takehiko, her childhood friend who was cool, smart and excellent at sports. Lately, however, Sakura started to become really close with her 'supposed to be' enemy, Yuki. Yuki, on the other hand, knows that Sakura likes Take, and tries to help them get together.

title: Onkochisin na Kanojo
description: A traditional girl with a grandma's mindset, Kijima Rio wants to avoid getting involved with the "ill-mannered youngsters" at all cost. As fate would have it, she must work with a "youngster". And the fun begins…

title: Secret Diary
description:
After the final exams, everyone in the noticeably looser atmosphere of the school is planning and looking forward to summer vacation. Yujin, a sincere and good model student, is completely absorbed in an exchange diary.

The exchange diary is one that is passed back and forth daily through an empty locker, and the identity of the partner is kept secret. Yujin develops feelings for that partner and tries to arrange a meeting before summer vacation starts, while Sang-kyu grows increasingly worried about Yujin…

title: Umi o, Aruku Yagi
description: It all began the moment they were born. Yagi and Kaitaro are childhood friends and high school students. Yagi takes care of the naive Kaitaro. And today, as Kaitaro calls out to Yagi once again, there is a large scar on his beautiful face.

title: My Hero Academia - EYES MEET (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Wagamama na Kimi Dakara
description: Tachibana doesn't have it easy. His lover, Sawada, just doesn't care who sees them kissing! Tachibana doesn't want people judging them, while Sawada just wants to show his love when he feels it. Will everyone find out what kind of love they have?

title: Seito Kaichousama no Pet
description:
From Attractive Fascinante:  
  
Nizaki Eito was just about to sneak back into the dorm after finishing his part-time job when he ran into the student council president, Fujima. Because it was against the school rules, Nizaki agreed to become Fujima’s pet. When Nizaki started to get really popular, Fujima got jealous and decided to let go of him. However, Nizaki threatened Fujima instead and wanted Fujima to become his pet. Was it for love or for revenge?  
  
5. Tenohira no Ondo (Temperature of Palm)  
Daisuke's been acting troubled at work lately, and is always being called to the HR department. His childhood friend Motoki wants to find out why, but when he asks he receives an answer he wasn't expecting: Daisuke asks Motoki, "Can I kiss you?"

title: You’re So Cool
description: [PL] Pierwszego dnia w liceum Nan Woo spotkała chłopca. Od razu się w nim zakochała. Później jednak okazało się, iż jest on jak „książę” i otacza się gronem adoratorów. Nie tylko jest przystojny, ale również inteligentny i dobry w sporcie. Chciałoby się rzec: chłopak idealny. Czy jednak mimo wszystko uda jej się zdobyć jego serce?

title: Countdown, 60 days of love
description: Xia Xiaoai, orpheline, souffre depuis la naissance d'un problème cardiaque, ayant appris qu'il ne lui restait que 60 jours à vivre, elle refuse de participer à un programme expérimental et s'enfuit de l'hôpital, et est sauvé de justesse par un magnifique spécimen qui l'appelle "maîtresse"…?

title: Aozora, Kami Hikoki
description:
Sankaku is going to graduate from junior high soon, and she is a girl who treats many things with cold cynicism because of a disappointing romance during elementary school. She now does not have the courage to love and decides to bury her feelings for her long-time crush, Yokosuka, and graduate without telling him about how she feels. One day, she happens to run into Yokosuka and his friends, plotting to do something stupid on graduation day. Soon, Sankaku is caught in their crazy plan!  
  
Contains 5 oneshots.

title: Sukitte Itte Oka-kun!! 1
description: Bạn cùng lớp của Satsuki Oka, Hajime Tsunefusa, hẹn cậu trên sân thượng và tỏ tình với cậu. Mặc dù không kì thị đồng tính nhưng trước giờ cậu chưa từng hẹn hò với con trai. Cậu lập tức từ chối Hajime nhưng sau đó Hajime lại bắt đầu lẽo đẽo theo cậu… Đừng bỏ lỡ câu chuyện này của tác giả Sawaco, tác phẩm đầu tay đã bán hết sạch tại hội chợ truyện tranh dành cho người hâm mộ!!!!!

title: Imadoki no Shishunki
description:
1) Explosive Fairy Tale  
Childhood friends, Danzou and Shou, run into a dangerous bump in their relationship when Danzou reaches puberty ahead of his smaller friend and begins to see him in a whole new way.  
  
2) Undoubtedly Useless a Painful Season  
  
3) A philosopher in Love  
Shou-chan and Danzou's friendship is still damaged, but being assigned to give Danzou his homework gives them a chance to build back some sort of normal relationship. Will Shou-chan be able to forgive Danzou for all he's done to him?  
  
4) Follow-up  
  
5) Awakening Puberty  
  
6) An Eyeful and a Handful (Lots and Lots)  
  
7) Going into Overtime  
  
8) Afterword

title: Makunouchi
description:
"Maku no Uchi: Kubonouchi Eisaku Kessakushu" is a collection of short stories that seinen author Kubonouchi Eisaku, known for notable titles such as Chocolat, Cherry and Watanabe, has written in his early days. The contents of this book include: Laplace, Yocchore! Tosamaru-kun, Bell, Robot High School Girl Kaoruko's "Heartbreak", Bizzare – The Terror of the Salmon-Man, Robot High School Boy Kawarazaki Ayumu's "Seishun-I-N-G", Help!, Viva Eros Academy, Okappiki Eiji, Dream of Pumping Up, Present.  
  
"Maku no Uchi" is a kind of bentou, served during Kabuki in the olden days. It either got its name from the lunch the audience would eat during intermission, or perhaps from the lunch actors would eat during this time (seems plausible since the actors are also "behind the curtain", which is actually the literal translation of that phrase).

title: The Princess Is Mine
description: So the rumors are true: Himemiya does have sex with boys. After seeing it first hand, what will Takayuki do? Obviously, taking a shower is the correct answer – especially when you are not alone.

title: 16-Sai, Shinkon Baito Hajimemashita
description:
The employer is a perfect Ikemen husband!?  
  
I need the money no matter what…!! The bride position I reluctantly accepted comes with a bonus love miracle…?

title: Cynical Orange
description: The life of hottest girl in school is not easy. Sure, all the boys in school are in love with you, but that means that every girl in school is trying to destroy your life! Vicious rumors and gossip follow everywhere you go. But Hye-Min Hwang is not a delicate damsel in distress. She knows that there is nothing more satisfying than sweet revenge. That is, if it were not for her secret crush, Jung-Yun. He makes her want to hide her cynical dark side, put on an innocent, pretty face, and endure all the backstabbing lies. Then one day she finds out that he is the one guy in school who doesn’t like her anyway! It’s time for Hye-min’s sweet revenge, and her first victim will be Ma-Ha, a playboy who’s been begging for her attention for as long as she’s known him…

title: Secret Star Live
description: `Kotoka, a high school girl dreaming of idol stardom, has been failing every audition despite relying solely on her natural cuteness—while hiding that she's the daughter of a corporate tycoon. When her worried father arranges a marriage meeting to "save her from becoming a NEET," she pivots to VTubing as a last-ditch path to fame... but things don't go as planned

title: Kenzen na Kajitsu
description: Michi's mother always told her… "You must be obedient, healthy and above all stay away from the boys your age because they are dangerous." So she only watches from afar the boy she likes … Asahina-kun … who for her is A "carnivore" for the way he discovered kissing another girl as if devouring. But Asahina-kun is actually a "herbivore" who sees the innocent Michi as a perfect fruit … Can Michi now save herself from being devoured by Asahina-kun?

title: Bird Kiss
description: Remember the story of the Frog Prince? A little girl kisses a frog to get back her ball, and ends up with a frog for a husband! Only after she’s completely ignored and abused him does she realize the frog has changed into a handsome prince. Miyoul is a feisty high schooler whose only thoughts are of the hottest boy in school, Guelin. But her childhood friend, Heerack, who acts as her personal lackey, is deeply in love with her. Will Miyoul be able to see which is the frog and which is her true prince?

title: Shinai Virus
description: Mako and Haru have been friends forever. One day when Haru suddenly kisses Mako she starts thinking that this is a sign of a new beginning! However, soon after, Haru tells Mako that he has found a new girlfriend! How will Mako react to the news!?

title: Kimi no Mukougawa
description: Shou and Takashi were best friends in junior high, but abruptly, Shou moved away. Now, in their first year of high school, they meet up again. Takashi is thrilled! But Shou is giving him the cold shoulder.

title: Enslave Lover
description:
1-3) Enslave Lover  
Young newsman in love with his senpai. Will the senpai ever see him as anything but a subordinate?  
  
4-5) My High-Handed Lover  
Sports reporter Fujisaki is always being teased by famous baseball star Tsutsui. But the flirty star isn't serious, is he? Does Fujisaki want him to be? Oh well, a trip to a hot springs should sort everything out.  
  
6) The Sugar Cake that You Love  
On an exchange program, a young American falls in love with his host family's son. Will he reciprocate his feelings if he keeps teasing him about his name?  
  
7) The Flower of Understanding  
Painter Kairi has always been teased because of his mixed heritage. The only person he trusts is his adopted brother Kanade. But the love he feels for Kanade is slowly turning into something dark and obsessive that he can't control…

title: Carefree Matsutaro
description:
(from ANN): The story follows Matsutarō Sakaguchi, a giant roughneck man with strength far beyond ordinary people, and peerless in sumo wrestling. His greatest weakness is his own carefree personality. He grows into a full-fledged sumo westler.

---
 - **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for Seinen/General Manga in 1978**

title: Crossroad
description:
When her grandmother passes away, high school student Kajitsu Toda suddenly finds two hot stepbrothers and an adorable little stepsister dropped in her lap! Kajitsu and her step-siblings have only one thing in common: they were all abandoned by their parents. Against the odds, they've pulled together to form a family without grown-ups. They don't want charity, they don't want pity… they just want their dignity!  
  
Things are particularly tough for Kajitsu and her step-brother Natsu. As kids, they were as close as any true siblings. Now, reunited for the first time in seven years, they've grown as far apart as two people can be. Can they ever become friends again? And can two high school students living together, even as "siblings" ever escape scandal?

title: BooKeeper
description: Arrie decided to work at a second-hand book store and what will happen after that?

title: Seishun Shiteru Kai!
description: About a sixteen year old girl who graduated in Australia and returns to Japan to teach English in a high school. The students are of the same age and so she has a lot of difficulties getting accepted by them.

title: Ano Hi Bokura wa Koutei de
description:
1, 4) High-school student and tattoo artist Tohru is holding a secret love for his friend. So when he's confessed to by his junior he turns the boy down flat. But Katsumi isn't one to give up easily.  
  
2, 5) Former students and current sensei's Kikawa and Meguro had a relationship as children. But that was all over years ago, right? So why can't Kikawa stop thinking about Meguro?  
  
3, 6) Student Katahana can't help but wonder why his close friend Tohmune always wears an undershirt. What exactly is he trying to hide underneath his clothes?  
  
7-10) All the romances intertwine as we see a little of each couple in each story.

title: Saikou no Kiss o Ageru
description:
- HeartBeat Mail  
Uehara has always liked her classmate Kaji, who sits behind her, but cannot find the strength to talk to him. One day, Kaji left his phone on his desk so she decided to leave a note with her mail address on it. Soon, they started mailing each other; but what will come out of it?  
  
- 7Kiss  
Asano is transferring soon. However, 7 days before she does, she sees Andou-sensei shoveling and she went up to him and kissed him, using her cellphone to take a picture of the scene! Using the picture, she blackmailed Andou-sensei into agreeing to kiss her every morning for seven days till the last day before she transfers…  
  
- Love Lover (Part 2 is called Love Honey)  
Due to Shinji and Misaki’s parents remarrying, Shinji now becomes Misaki’s younger stepbrother. But that isn’t the only thing, Shinji and Misaki are also a couple, with their parents support! One day, when they come home from school, they find out that their parents have won a prize for a trip! What will hap

title: Love for Sale
description: Meet Kanade Nakamori. She always goes grocery shopping for her mom. But a younger guy from her school who works there keeps making snide remarks at her! What's his real intention?

title: A Time of Blooming
description:
Yumi always teased Eiji back when they were in elementary school. But now, the two move onto middle school. Their time in middle school present them with both physical and mental changes in their lives - and things seem to shift between the two.

An uncollected one-shot of Oka's that has not been present in any of her tankobon.

title: Oujisama wo Tsukamaero!
description:
1-4) Capture the Prince  
Keeping their promise, Koga met Iku-sempai up in high school after a short separation. Now, closer than before, Iku becomes aware of a hidden feeling of his, and struggles to keep it there, hidden. Koga, on the other hand, aims to prove that he adores Iku to the point of strong love. In the midst of love confusion, Iku, wanting to hide his feelings from Koga, treats Koga very meanly, yet at the same time is annoyed that Koga has yet to realize his feelings. Oh my, this is really a tough journey for Koga to Capture the Prince!  
  
5) Kuroki-kun's Situation  
  
6) Sister Complex (**Shotacon**)  
  
7) Princely Circumstances

title: Touken Ranbu - Megami ni Ibukuro wo Tsukamareta Hanashi (Doujinshi)
description:
Izuminokami Kanesada x Horikawa Kunihiro

A KaneHori high school AU with two-way unrequited love. No sword elements are present.

title: The Thousand-Year Fox's Operation-Human
description:
The prince of heaven is punished after defiling a thousand girls!  
  
Meanwhile, a nine-tailed fox has always wanted to be human. She's waited a thousand years to have a flowery romance on earth. However, when she gets there–surrounded by manic obsessive school-girls, she realizes earth isn't what she's always dreamed of. Especially when there's a boy named "Cha Ga-Un" who ultimately gives heartache to all the girls he meets!

title: Senzoku
description:
From Black Lilac Scans:  
  
What's it like to have a personal cook with great culinary skills and dashing looks? Sumika, an orphan, has one such personal cook, Miyoshi, who takes care of her needs. Miyoshi never complains but caries out his duties to the very end. But is it all just an act of duty? Does Sumika really understand how Miyoshi feels or does she take Miyoshi for granted? Follow Miyoshi and Sumika through trails and tribulations and witness a beautiful love story blossom~!

title: Nina Jalhae!
description:
Choi "Rotten Tooth" Choong Chi just wants to be left alone so that he can study like his mommy told him too. His life-long ambition is to be ranked first academically in school. Unfortunately for him, he's also a brilliant fighter, coveted (or targeted) by every gang that crosses his path.  
  
After transferring to the prestigious Yong Yong High School from the delinquent-ridden 88 Academy, Rotten Tooth also makes a new discovery: girls, and to top it all off, the prettiest and smartest girl in the school, Yeon Doo. Too bad his main rival Jang Bogo is also after the same girl.  
  
Can our hero get the girl? Can he even survive high school with his life and limbs intact?

title: I can see it!? Mr. Mikuriya's Fortune Telling
description: A slapstick exorcism comedy between a handsome fortune teller and a good-natured high school girl.

title: Aitte Yatsu wo Utatte Miyouka
description: Ari is a brand new first-year high school student. Shortly before school starts, she sees a band holding a mini outdoor concert. She is struck by how great the music is. That band, Sunnyside, is currently the hottest indie group. AND, the really cute lead singer, Youta-kun, is a student at Ari’s new school! Even better, he is in her grade, and they will be in the same class! However, Youta-kun is really popular with the girls, and he happily lets them hang all over him, like he’s dating them all! Youta-kun becomes really interested in Ari’s piano playing and makes an instant decision – Ari must be Sunnyside’s new keyboardist!

title: Tokuitaishitsu-kei Joshi no Hanashi
description: Kotoha is an average girl in love with a less-than-average condition: all of her thoughts come out of her body as physical letters! While the condition can be both a blessing (such as when thinking about food) and a curse, she has learned to keep her thoughts to herself until she can get home and "vent" in peace. But when a chance conversation with her crush, Kou, causes her weird letter-producing ability to go into overdrive, Kotoha kisses her high-school life goodbye. Will she finally get a chance with him, or will her idiosyncrasy​ send him running?

title: Kasumi Namori's Life with A Teacher!
description: "Remember, you'll be living with men." Kasumi is faced with a forced school transfer. Her homeroom teacher Mr. Sera tells her, "If you really want to stay, then come live with me." But doesn't that mean just Kasumi and him!? Her head spinning at the thought, she arrives at Mr. Sera's house... only to find it filled with wild teenage boys!!

title: Hidaka-kun wa Seito Kaichou no 〇〇
description: This is the story of Hidaka, who dyes his blond and picks up smoking because he wants the student council president to notice him, and Hashimoto, the student council president who is interested in the blond haired Hidaka.

title: Kazekou Engekibu!
description: Much to her embarrassement, the shy Mashio-chan wins a set of couple tickets for the amusement park. She feels at a loss for what to do since she has always been bad with men. So what will happen to her when the drama club president Katokura Aki suddenly declares that he would erase her awareness…?

title: Love Melodies
description: Three intertwining stories about family, friendship, and love. Life is like an ever-changing tune and sometimes this tune can suddenly stop, severing the bonds that it pulled along. But as Inoru und Zai entered Lawrence's life, those severed strings start to get rekindled, once again connecting him to people, he had long lost. Subgenres: Slowburn, LGBTQ+, Mental Health

title: Unintentional Error
description: Wu Xinghe, who finally mustered up the courage to confess her love, froze on the spot and was forced to retreat. Unfortunately, everyone found out about her feelings for Han Cheng from the class next door. To her surprise, Han Cheng's friend - Zhao Xinnan suddenly appeared and told her that he could help her achieve her wish...

title: Ougon Honey ♡
description: Hime is a natural blonde and with that comes basic expectations: for her to excel at everything and to speak English proficiently, and unfortunately to be a complete ditz and have many boyfriends. When Minami catches her studying English by listening to 'English for Dummies' the two become friends. But soon Minami falls prey to the rumors and distances himself from Hime. Will the two ever be able to regain their friendship?

title: 1000% For That Girl
description:
It has your average girl, with a childhood friend who's in love with her but won't admit it, and an older guy who likes her: a high school love story.  
  
Although the whole school knew what was happening between Azusa and Ikumi, there were rivals who came between them.

title: Kaiten Ginga
description: This manga focuses on a different pair of characters and their relationship/romance each chapter. All of the characters are interrelated (most go to the same high school), and the manga comes back to the same pair every once in a while.

title: Short Game: ~Mitsuru Adachi's High School Baseball Weaved in Short Stories~
description:
A short story collection by Mitsuru Adachi.

1. Relief
2. Yuugengaisha Adachi Pro
3. Dou-Kyou-Sei
4. Meitantei Go Page
5. Full Count
6. Tori no Ichi
7. Asaoka Koukou Yakyuubu Nisshi: Over Fence
8. Gag Touch
9. Yuku Toshi Kuru Toshi
10. Ame Ni Mo Make Zu
11. Yonpeji no Mirai

title: Barisuki
description: [Author's twitter](https://twitter.com/ichiruyasuhara)

title: Houkago, Nikoichi Kurashi
description:
Nico is living with her grandmother while her parents are transferred overseas. She finds rural life inconvenient, but thinks it'll be comfortable once she gets used to it. She's startled by the creaking of the house and laments, "Old houses are scary after all!" Just then, a gecko appears! Nico is suspicious of the "house guardian" who has been protecting the house for a long time.

A city-bred girl and her guardian deity begin their strange cohabitation!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Impossible Love
description: He Qinian and Sheng Xinghe were part of the high jump team at T College. Together, they advanced from the school team to the national team and found fame and success.

title: Koisuru Madan to Ikusa Hime no Akademia ~Another Story of the Lord Marksman and Vanadis~
description: 女神ティル＝ナ＝ファの加護によって数多の『魔弾の王』世界を渡り歩く力を手に入れたメイドのティッタ。想い人であるティグルの愛を独占するために、彼女は学園世界にやってきた。

title: Fool's Gold
description: Penny is a confident 15-year-old sophomore who designs clothes together with her aunt, Nicole. Sick of girls falling for jerks, she starts a club to identify bad boys and stop others from dating. She becomes the school's idol, but things take a turn when she develops feelings for a bad boy!

title: G-Senjou no Maria
description: Three students from an all-girls school are selling Bibles on the street... But, don't mistake them as servants of God. In actuality, they're making money for dating expenses. Even though their ways are not so good, their hearts are pure! Santa Maria, please listen to these girl's prayers!

title: Hoshi ni Memai wo
description: After the president of the Astronomy club graduated from high school, Shiose Kanako was appointed as the president. However, no one really takes her seriously, and most of the other female members are only interested in Azumi Seiya, a handsome and popular guy who’s also a member of the Astronomy club. Trying to gain more knowledge about Astronomy so that she could get more people interested in the club, Kanako goes to the rooftop one night, and she’s surprised to find…

title: Harry Potter - The World (Doujinshi)
description:
A collection of James x Severus doujinshi.  
  
Volume 1:  
1) Izonshou Ryouiki Shinpan  
2) Yesterday Saturday…  
3) Seichouutsuu  
4) Tsunagitakatta no wa Hidari te  
5) Goodbye our dearest seasons  
6) Love killed a Super Star (Super Star no Higeki)  
7) Bitter Candy  
8) Tunnel no Saki ni Yami  
9) The Loneliness of the Long Distance Walker  
10) Role Playing Bonus story only available in The World #1  
  
Volume 2:  
1) Mission in Pensieve  
2) No More Sentimental   
3) Knock'n Heaven's Door - 4/1  
4) Cute Honey 2  
5) Summer Special 2005  
6) Game Reset  
7) Replay Refrain  
8) Hide and Seek  
9) Taisetsu na Kimi no Taisetsu na Kinenbi  
  
Volume 3:  
?) Like a Stray Sheep

title: Scramble Game
description:
1-4) Suzuhara Jan is a new college student determined to devote himself to his studies. But a chance meeting with handsome professor Aoyama and discovery of the "Game to Win the Professor's Heart" become a distraction. Though he can't seem to stay away from Aoyama, the game may be impossible to win…  
  
5) Takashi Namasami is wandering lost in the woods when he's found by young master Wakamiya Hideto. But the pushy youngster has a requirement for rescue: Takashi has to be his pretend lover!

title: First Love Scandal
description:
(from Shogakukan):
The 31st Shogakukan Manga Award winner, Akira Oze's early masterpiece. 

High school student Tetsu Yazaki and his childhood friend Kumi Nagaoka, together with their friends, are crushed in love and hurt, but grow up!

---
- **As mentioned in the description, First Love Scandal won the 31st Shogakukan Manga Award**

title: Sunshine After
description:
Nami likes Jun, but Jun likes the girl with the umbrella.  
  
A sweet oneshot of romance and rain.

title: Hair-Up
description: 수염나는 여자와 대머리 남자가 만났다! 털이 많은, 많고 싶은 두 사람의 학원 코믹물!

title: Nekoka Danshi wa Kimagure ni Tsuki
description: One day, Aoi, who had been playing the role of the best student in her class, is told by Shirasaki, a boy in the same grade, that she is not a "good girl" at all! From that day on, she is pushed around by the whimsical and bullying Shirasaki...?

title: Ennui na Kanojo
description:
After being broken-hearted 3 times, in Kozue's mind, she no longer needed men anymore. But she unconsciously started to care about this mature and considerate Asano-sensei. After knowing Asano-sensei cherished and loved his girlfriend so much, she then discovered that she fell deeply in love with Asano-sensei…  
  
Even though being rejected by the teacher, But Kozue still couldn't forget her love and the romance for the teacher……!?  
  
Also includes the following stories:  
  
- You Are In My Heart  
  
- Small Adult

title: Ba-thump Ba-thump Diary
description: One day a young girl finds out that the boy she likes is going to transfer to a different school. The only one who knows how much she loves him is her diary.

title: An Everlasting Maiden
description:
The snowman maiden, whose soul has entered a human body, Seolha! However, her body melts when it becomes hot. Her first love has endured for no less than a hundred years.

There is only one way for Seolha to become human—she must succeed in love?!

However, unlike in her affectionate past life, Yiram doesn't understand Seolha's feelings. Even the god, Woojo, who used to argue every day, is showing an attitude quite different from before.

Will Seolha be able to safely find success in love?!

title: Deco Deco Kiss
description:
Mihara Hideko is a self-obsessed Deco-Deco accessory collector. She also hopes that Mutou-kun will also do Deco-Deco with her too. But when Mutou-kun tells her that he hates it, who or what will she choose between her love for Mutou-kun or Deco-Deco?  
(Source: Intercross)

title: Tobu, Kokoro
description:
1) Noda, a boy who has 3 secrets: First, he's in love with his classmate Fukushima. Second, he can draw his spirit out from his body. And finally, sometimes he secretly watches Fukushima at home, when his spirit has left his body. But one day he drops in at Fukushima's at a very unfavorable moment.   
  
2) A boy who is asked to take care of a huge white rabbit and how the animal makes him understand his own feelings.   
  
3) Yuzuru Sakaguchi, a boy who leads a lonely but peaceful life, cut off by the rumor that people can see ghosts around him. One day a new teacher comes to his school and his life is thrown completely out of joint.

title: Kare wa S-kei Seitokaichou
description:
Shizuku is not good with boys. Whenever she is touched, her reflexes end up nearly killing them.  
Many male students have been part of this blood fest. The villainous and sadistic student body president, who quietly watches Shizuku, forces her to join the student council! “I’ll fix your complex,” the president declares to Shizuku. And suddenly, he gives her a breath-taking kiss. Even Shizuku can’t raise her hand against him?

title: Messages From the Killer
description:
There's a serial killer in my WeChat moments!
There seems to be a mysterious large organization behind everything. The only one I can rely on is my buddy who sleeps on my lower bunk.

title: Manga College
description:
Manga College is a guide on how to do manga with three one-shots used as examples.

1) Story of Arizona Pic - A western featuring animal characters. Also meant to showcase slapstick.

2) Nose - A one-shot about a poor farmer who is offered three wishes by the Devil. Meant to illustrate composition and values.

3) Demogogy - In this one, shows the process with submitting manga to the editorial department.

---
**Volume 39 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Bungu Shoujo Nonono
description: Nono Wakai, a smart and beautiful first-year high school girl, finds herself one day facing a confession of love from a handsome upperclassman. Faced with the situation that many girls only dream of, she responds with "No!" But for what reason? [ANN]

title: The Crazy Running Song of the Elite
description: [Wild child Tetsuya takes on the challenge of a famous cram school!?] Tetsuya Katagiri is a mischievous sixth grade boy who moved from the countryside of Kansai to Tokyo. However, the area he is in is home to people who are incredibly enthusiastic about education! His mother has been influenced by his move, and he is forced to take the test for the Tokyo University cram school. Tetsuya is fully prepared to fail, but he is inspired by the words of the slightly cheeky and brilliant beauty Minami Yui, and comes up with a brilliant idea to win the test...!!

title: Rare Ji
description: Momoe is the type who accepts everyone’s opinions without contesting them regardless if they are right or not. That’s why people around her tend to call her dumb or stupid. Never showing a hurt face she’ll always smile back at them and she won’t even get angry. Takasugi, the school’s idol, gets to know her after some meetings in the infirmary and he’s amazed by her lack of self esteem combined with a warm smile ready to be given to anyone. She also starts to feel attracted to him, but is love what Takasugi feels or only curiosity?

title: Metallic Colors
description: The story of a stylish and gaudy girl who strives to win the heart of the boy she likes.

title: Refraction Love
description: A fantastic masterpiece dedicated to the 25 million (estimated) people nationwide who "love girls with glasses." The monumental work that broke new ground as a "fetish romantic comedy" is now revived!!

title: Crazy Run
description: After setting the fastest time in the nation for a middle school second year, Uzuki Jun is hailed as a genius runner. Expected to dominate the world of track and field, he suddenly disappears from the public eye. But once he enters high school, he's back in the competitive scene! But he no longer looks like he did -- now with bleached hair and a provocative demeanor, he's far from the image of an athlete! Everyone around him is shocked, but how did his skill hold up?

title: Bandelnya Judith
description:
Starting from the case of sitting close together in class, familiarity began to occur between Judith Olivia and Biyan Angga, initially Judith did not really know Biyan, what Judith knew was that Biyan was an annoying person. But the funny thing is that time actually brings Judith and Biyan closer, especially because Judith and Biyan have a lot in common, similarities in the movies they watch, the taste of music they listen to and much more. More and more, Judith secretly paid attention to Biyan, she thought that whatever Biyan did was cool, even bad things like skipping classes.

They also became good partners in tests, cheating on each other and helping each other when one of them had given up. Their relationship without realizing it was not just a friendly relationship anymore, Judith and Biyan were even in a temporary boyfriend/girlfriend relationship?

Initially Judith and Biyan agreed that their relationship was only based on wanting to make Biyan's ex, Angie, jealous. However, ov

title: Lovely
description:
High school girl Yoo Eun Bi becomes obsessed with ballroom dancing after watching a ballroom dancing competition. Her passion drives her to form a ballroom dancing club in school, but it isn’t as easy as it seems. Not only is the school refusing to fund the club, but model student Kang Woon is set on making Eun Bi’s life hell.  
  
While struggling to form the club, she finds out Kang Woon’s darkest secret. He leads a double life, balancing between being a top student in school and a devious dancer during the night. With the help of Kang Woon, will Eun Bi finally be able to accomplish her goal?

title: Twinkle Cherry
description: Sakura always believe she would meet the mysterious guy again, whom she fell in love with eight years ago. But she only knows two things about him, which are that his name starts with the letter "K" and he has already left this city. One day, two transfer students… Kurokawa Sei and Azuma, who used to live here eight years ago, suddenly appeared. Not only that but they are twins as well?!

title: Tonari no Seki no Fukami-kun ga Idol ni Naru Kamo Shirenai
description:
Akane Hayasaka loves a survival audition program where talented youngsters compete fiercely to become idols. One day, Akane learns that Fukami, who sits next to her at school, has passed the written examination for an extremely difficult audition. Akane hopes that the world will discover Fukami's brilliance, but Fukami himself doesn't seem keen on becoming an idol...

(Source: Natalie, translated and edited)

title: Comet-san☆
description:
This juvenile fantasy follows the adventures of Comet, a mysterious girl who comes to Earth from the planet Beta. Comet meets Takeshi Kawagoe and his younger brother, Kouji by chance, and ends up working as a live-in maid for the Kawagoe family. 

There, she is asked to sleep in the trashy storage room, and with a swing of her magic baton, she turns the room beautiful...?

title: Four Shojo Stories
description:
An anthology of oneshots:  
  
Story 1: Promise by NISHI Keiko  
Story 2: They Were Eleven by HAGIO Moto  
Story 3: The Changeling by SATO Shio  
Story 4: Since You've Been Gone by NISHI Keiko  
  
The two stories by NISHI Keiko were also published as a separate release in English called "Promise." Those stories were originally taken from "[Mizu ga Kooru ni Naru Toki](http://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=18906)."  
  
Read [this](http://www.mangablog.net/?p=939) to find out why this sampler was pulled off the shelves.

title: GO! NANA
description:
Nana Namiya is a 17 years old student who along with her mother runs a little old inn in Saitama, Japan. One day she meets a handsome guy named Andrew Anderson, an English boy interested in renting a room.  
This manga is meant to be read from left to right.

title: Haikyu!! - Utsuwa no Ookisa Shindansho (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Oikawa x Kageyama

An Oikage book (in which Miya-san is very involved, though not romantically)

title: Fuutarou's Final Regret
description:
A year has passed since graduation and Fuutarou has been invited to the same hot springs he went before. However, he can't help but feel something wrong with his feelings and begins to question them. What will he do about his feelings towards Yotsuba, and can he really call them true? This is an alternate ending to the series, it takes place after chapter 120. Written by XENOTIME.

To all international readers:

Hi I'm Angel, I'm the one in charge of the artistic part and in a certain way the one in charge of this project. I think I've mentioned it before but I'm a novice when it comes to general drawing.
Thank you very much for reading "Fuutarou's Final Regret"

We are an amateur team, for my part I will do everything possible to improve as an artist, I still have a long way to go but obviously I will not give up. Thank you very much again for your reading, I send you a hug and I hope to bring you a fanfic that is worth reading.

If you want to give me advice, opinions or any other in

title: Touma-kun wa Neratteru
description:
"Can you give me your heart?"

One morning, Arisu, an ordinary high school girl, is suddenly approached by a popular transfer student, Toma-kun. Arisu, an ordinary high school girl, feels in danger and quickly refuses the offer, but it seems that he has a serious reason for refusing...?

The extraterrestrial school love begins with a transfer student trying to kill her!

title: Our Beautiful Language
description: A Korean language teacher who cares about Korean too much, and a girl who loves such a teacher.

title: Kuro to Shiba Manga
description: Короткая зарисовка о девочке, похожей на черную кошку (黒猫), и мальчике, похожем на шиба ину (柴犬).

title: Uwasa no Kanojo
description: Tsukasa Endou, who has moved to a new school and rumors start to fly about her…she meets the prince of the school, only to find out he is not what he seems to be…One mishap on her part and she is now his slave..will they ever be friends or will they end up killing one another..read to find out!!

title: Angel Mate
description: Nowa is 10 years old. After she dies of an illness, she is sent to a school in heaven called "Enjiru Gakuen"! There, students are graded in pairs, but the boy she is paired with is a boy called "Devil"...?

title: Bye Bye, Ame.
description: When there are rainy days, there is no doubt, the highschooler Miyo will come at "Cafè Blanka" with her face filled with tears. The "job" of patissiere Keisuke is to clean that rain. Will he be able to do so?

title: Tameiki no Kuchizuke
description: The classic love triangle gets a new twist in this school age love story. Tanabe likes Akira. Akira likes Tatsuya. And really no one knows who Tatsuya is lusting after! But when Akira decides that unrequited love isn't all that noble and responds to Tanabe's advances, Tatsuya confesses?!? Akira isn't sure which way is up let alone which way lies love!

title: Koi no Yamai to Millefeuille
description:
"The more I get to know you, the more I fall in love with you."

Taiyo, a yankee who ran away to the infirmary looking for a place to be alone, met a mysterious girl, Shiori, who talks with books... An infirmary love comedy!

title: Hatsukoi Pierrot
description: Aina es una chica sensata que no está realmente interesada en el romance o en chicos. Un d� a, de repente se reúnen con Naru, un chico alegre de otro colegio con una personalidad de payaso. La primera impresión de Naru sobre Aina es que ella es un ángel, el le pide que le aconseje de como ser un ikemen. Con el tiempo, Aina cae… en una trampa de amor no correspondido.

title: How a Rebellious Girl Fell into Love
description: When a troubled teen girl returns to school, all she brings are imminent conflicts! A female gangster leader is forced to go back to school by her grandfather. Encountering reunion with her childhood sweetheart, conflicts with another gangster organization, school bullying and exploring the secret behind the death of a student... her school life is set to be chaotic.

title: Ni Mo Kakawarazu
description:
Story of Kiyo, a 20-year-old "yankee" tomboy, and what happens when she once again meets Tara-chan, her kind former step brother.  
  
(Source: MAL)

title: Kimi ga Iru Basho
description: A young man lives in a small town, where he owns a small grocery shop and struggles through life alone with his small son. His childhood friend who'd moved away after graduation suddenly shows up on his doorstep, unemployed and on his last penny, putting his life into utter chaos.

title: Blooming
description: Tomboy Mi-Ha is an extremely active and competitive girl who never likes to lose to anyone. She's such a tomboy that all boys are scared of her, and that's exactly what her brother wanted and trained her to be. It took him six long years to train her into a pseudo-military style girl to protect her from anyone else. Bishonen Sung-Suh is a new transfer student who's got the looks, the determination, and attitude to sweep her off the feet. Could this male beauty be able to tame the beast? Will Miha's brother let them be together and happily ever after? If you want it you've got to Bring It On!

title: Demon King's Princess
description: Xian Nian Nian, an ordinary second year high school student decided to buy male enticing charms online in fear of loosing face at High school heartthrob Han Che's girlfriend Gu Mo Li's birth day party. Xia Nian Nian used the four samples of blood sent by the mysterious trader. It's Gu Mo Li's birthday party today but the charms still did not work. Just when she was on the verge of being ridiculed by the crowd, Qian Yin descended like a prince and made her the center of attention.

title: Yagate Tako ni Naru Kimi to
description:
Majima-kun. He remembered my name. Majima Issei–kun. He's completely different from me, he has lots of friends, he's on the baseball team, he's a popular boy whose canines you can see when he smiles. I love him. I really love him. No matter what you turn into…

Kosaka-san, a girl with zero self-esteem. Majima-kun, a boy suffering from an “octopusification curse”. He has six months left.

A love×horror story that is endlessly pure and painfully sad.
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/wm_yagatetako)

title: Shingeki no Kyojin - Orange Cider Evergreen (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Levi x Eren  
  
The daily high school life of Levi and Eren.

title: Itaike na Bokura
description:
From Attractive Fascinante:  
  
1-3) Kyoushi and Kou have been lovers for 3 years, and their relationship has been discovered and accepted by Kyoushi's older sister. Now can their love withstand an overbearing, intrusive fan girl? How about an adorable 5-year old cousin who wants to marry Kyoushi?  
  
4) Don't Touch Me  
Bittersweet one-shot about the possibility of living life again and finding a new love after being raped.  
  
5-6) Sou and Keigo have been friends for years, but Keigo never realized Sou's secret - his parents are both men. Now that Keigo is beginning to be more concerned about Sou, is it time to meet the parents? Even if both parents are men, will they approve of their son's preferences?

title: Hina-chan no Koi
description: Even cynics fall in love…do they?

title: Sono Seishun
description:
Rakushin Elementary School, Class 5-X.
A record of the lively yet brutal days lived by thirty children.
That youth… will shake the world.

title: Niwa-kun wa Tada no Tomodachi desu!
Kiss Yumemiru Koi Hajimaru
description: 「憧れのあなたとの恋をいつも夢みてた…。」芸能人×一般人…3年間片想いを続けた相手は、同じクラスの人気モデル。仕事が忙しく学校での思い出のない彼のために、主人公がしてあげたことは…？　年上の大人男子×ＪＫ…バイト先の花屋の店長に恋してるけど、彼はいつも主人公のことを子ども扱いして…？　憧れの彼との恋が、キスから始まる奇跡を描いたときめきいっぱいのピュアラブ・オムニバス！

title: Rikutsu to Honno no Ren'ai(?) Housoku
description:
Rikutsugi Eita has plenty of logic but no friends. After school, Rikutsugi is approached by the school's most popular student with an instinctive brightness, Honnouji Akari. A short school romcom(?) about these two.
___
Alt Official Raws:
- [X](https://x.com/search?q=from%3A%40rierioto+%E7%90%86%E5%B1%88%E3%81%A8%E6%9C%AC%E8%83%BD%E3%81%AE%E6%81%8B%E6%84%9B%28%EF%BC%9F%29%E6%B3%95%E5%89%87&src=typed_query&f=live)
- [Jump Rookie!](https://rookie.shonenjump.com/series/FlR8CfEyHcw) (Note: Its numbering doesn't align with X & pixiv because it made Chapter 2.5 “Chapter 4”.)

title: Cream
description: Seo Kyoung is pitiful. Everyone thinks she is, especially after making the wrong "friends," she now has to prove that she does have a boyfriend. She accidentally chooses the most popular guy in school… And… he starts to like her. But his best friend likes her too. What will happen?

title: Honenuki ni Saretai
description:
1-3) I Want to be Emasculated  
Salaryman Hoshina has been sharing an apartment and bed with model Atsushi. Atsushi cooks, cleans, and remembers every anniversary, but Hoshina can't figure out why they are in this "type" of relationship. When Hoshina's younger brother moves in for a while, and the boys must endure until he's gone, will Hoshina even care? Will this time of separation be the turning point in their relationship? And which boy will be the one screaming, "Once is not enough"?  
  
4) Try to Say You Love Me  
Student Hasegawa has recently started noticing how cute his friend Hashimoto is, especially around homeroom sensei Sawa. Can Hasegawa cheer Hashimoto on, or will he take his adorable classmate for himself…  
  
5) Infection of Feeling  
Medical intern Ishiguro has been sleeping with his attending Sensei Sakuma for the past year. Their intensely physical relationship is all Ishiguro ever considered, but Sakuma thinks feelings should be involved as well.  
  
6-7) Refrain

title: Nokemono Koi Ga Tari ～ Mare Chi No Musume To Ayakashi Kitsune ～
description: 時は大正… 西洋人の母譲りの容姿を持つ春園アメリは、奇異の目にさらされながらも明るく、前向きに女子高等学校に通っている。 しかしある日を境に、アメリは妖怪に執拗に襲われるようになり―謎の軍人・暁（あかつき）に救われるも、暁もまたアメリの血によって暴走してしまう。妖狐の母を持つ半妖である暁に、自分を重ねたアメリは、暁にある“宣言”をし…！？ なぜアメリは妖怪に狙われるのか？暁が属する裏組織“覇軍”とは？ “のけもの”同士の出逢いが、人と妖の世を揺るがす！

title: Beautiful Liar
description:
사랑에 빠지면 내적 필터(?)가 없어지는 그녀, 이라희!

어릴 적 별똥별에 빌었던 소원 때문에, 좋아하는 사람 앞에서는 본심을 저절로 말해버리고 마는 라희. 그로 인해 여러 번 이별했던 라희는 더 이상 누군가를 좋아하지 않으려고 애쓰지만, 팀플에서 만난 귀여운 후배 현우에게 첫눈에 반하고 만다.
널 좋아하니까, 이런 내 모습 보여주고 싶지 않아! 아슬아슬한 사랑의 끝은?!

---

- [Original Webtoon <Lezhin>](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/beautiful_liar)

title: Ichi Kara Oshiete Ageru
description: Chiaki left his phone at school, so he goes back that evening to retrieve it. While he's there, he hears soft moaning coming from a nearby room and decides to take a look, only to find Mr. Chiba, the math teacher, taking it from another man… Despite being geeky, all the girls love Mr. Chiba, who in turn constantly nags Chiaki about getting more tutoring. Although hesitant, Chiaki takes this chance to blackmail Mr. Chiba and snaps a picture of the two men in action. The next day, Chiaki shows Mr. Chiba the photo during his tutoring sesssion after school. Instead of freaking out, Mr. Chiba simply smiles and kneels down, then takes Chiaki in his mouth to "bribe" him! This is the start of extra-curricular lessons between a cocky fool and a two-faced teacher!

title: "Risou no Hanayome o Sagashite Shiawase ni Shite Sashiagemasu" to Ittara, Sokkenakatta Kon'yakusha ga Nazeka Kakawatte Kimasuga, Hanayome Assen Ganbarimasu
description:
After ten long years of engagement to Gilbert Norman, heir to a ducal house, Seara Elliot, daughter of a humble viscount, finally makes up her mind—it’s time to call it off! Though her heart still belongs to Gilbert, his distant attitude toward her and the gentle smiles he offers to other women have convinced Seara that she’s not the one he wants. If setting him free means his happiness, then so be it. Rather than cling to a hopeless love, Seara decides to let him go with grace. But to her astonishment, Gilbert refuses! Completely bewildered, Seara begins to question everything: his intentions, his feelings, and the truth behind his cold facade. Determined to secure his happiness one way or another, she sets out on a mission: to find and recommend the perfect bride to take her place… even if her heart hasn’t quite caught up with the idea yet.

A spirited viscount’s daughter, a prideful duke’s heir, and a misguided engagement that simply refuses to end—a sweet, slow-burn romantic comedy

title: Izumi Matsumoto Short Story Collection: DIGITAL SHORT CONTENTS
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A collection of full-color masterpiece short stories by Izumi Matsumoto with all-digital drawings! A special edition of the romantic comedy masterpiece "Kimagure Orange Road" and other works not yet published in book form make a colorful appearance! 

Kyosuke Kasuga, who was playing tennis with Madoka Ayukawa, decides to go to a public bath in a neighboring town because of a community-wide water cutoff. Then, Kyosuke bumps into Hikaru Hiyama, who happens to be there, and their bodies switch...!

title: Graffiti (MATSUMOTO Izumi)
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A collection of Izumi Matsumoto's early works. Ryunosuke Tachibana  is on his way to the U.S. to become a Hollywood star, when he stops by Shanghai and is given a mysterious pendant by an old man on his deathbed. 

When Ryunosuke is about to be killed by a villain who wants the pendant, he is saved by a beautiful Chinese girl, Sara...?!

Also contains the pre-serialization one-shot to Kimagure Orange Road.

title: Yuuga na Kare to Chiisana Kanojo
description:
Collection of oneshots:

1. Yuuga na Kare to Chiisana Kanojo (優雅な彼と小さな彼女)
2. Karei na Kare to Chiisana Kanojo no Nayameru Renai (華麗な彼と小さな彼女の悩める恋愛)
3. Yuuga na Kare to Chiisana Kanojo e... (優雅な彼から小さな彼女へ…)
4. Soratobu Yume wo Miru (空飛ぶ夢を見る)

title: Risou no Otokonoko
description:
Akane Hibiya is a single, single, and in her twilight years, she is in her thirties. She is secretly longing for a romantic relationship, but she is taking a break from love due to various reasons, including the breakup of her engagement to her ex-boyfriend and living with Ritsu, her boss's son whom she has taken in as her guardian... Just then, Ritsu, who she thought was unsociable but kind, kisses her! 

This is the start of an idealistic but forbidden cohabitation love story.

title: Strawberry Canyon
description:
It all started because Miyo wanted to get to know Tetsu's new friend, Keita. Now, after five years together, Miyo, Keita, and Tetsu are Berry Canyon's Monkey Gang -that is, three talented climbers at the local bouldering gym "Berry Canyon." Suddenly, Keita announces he will be quitting bouldering, much to Miyo and Tetsu's surprise. Unable to contain her feelings, Miyo blurts out that she is aiming for the Olympics even though she rarely enters competitions, in the hopes that their gang can stay together. But now that she announced it, how will Miyo follow through? Will she be able to overcome her mental blocks and climb to the top? Or will the pressure get to her and make her lose her grip?

source: https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/ynkuew5/strawberry-canyon
