title: NG BOY x Paradise
description:
Miu is an average high school girl who lives in a fantasy world dreaming about the day she'll find her destined one, just like in the manga stories she reads. What she doesn't know is that her prince might be closer than she thinks.  
  
One day after getting punished by running around the school, she gets hit by a motorcycle at the school gate! When she sees it's a guy she thinks it's her so awaited prince. But later she'll find out a secret about this guy and his twin brother…

title: Love Crazy
description: When Wess decide to given up his feeling for Koane, and then he suddenly has to meet crazy man in mental hospital.

title: Megami-sama no Iutoori
description:
Koma, a high school girl, is a big fan of the idol group IBEE. She enthusiastically promotes their activities on social media, and is so famous that fellow fans call her a "goddess." Meanwhile, she becomes classmates with a boy who looks just like her favorite member of IBEE...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Love Simulation
description: Atsushi Yuzawa is a junior high school student, but he still has no interest in the opposite sex or sex, and has recently felt a gap with his friends. Ryomi Hayase, a transfer student who moved into Atsushi's house next door, is also the type who has no interest in romance. She is floating in class and club activities. The troubled two people came up with the idea of ​​``Let's try to imitate love in order to understand it.'' As the two people who don't like each other or anything at all simulate the form of "love" that they each think about... In addition to the main story serialized in Monthly Shonen Jump in 1987, it depicts the reunion of the two main characters who have grown up. with later talk

title: Not Young and Rich!
description:
Seo Min-joon, the son of the CEO of Perung Foods, where everything is perfect. It's an explosion of popularity with adults and friends, but she's a single mother who has never had a girlfriend.

Min-joon falls for Sae-young, a girl from the same school, and Sae-young's ideal type is a poor, but a hard worker, and she hates men who are better than her?

Min-joon's first love challenge, where he has to hide that he's Young & Rich in order to get love!

title: Milky Boy
description: CheSuBin is a sparkling high school girl with a height complex; this, however, has launched her into the modeling industry. There is just one problem… she has to pose as a male model! What kind of misfortune has fallen upon her? For a girl who's under a lot of stress, it just might prove to be fortunate. And her fellow student and CF Model, GanUnKyuk, just might trigger her love someday: "For you to see my true feelings~ would my pitiful self end up hurting?!"

title: Moment ~Cursed Umbrella~
description: Renjuro Kindaichi collaborates with her younger sister Imo Uto on her first original work! Introducing a collection of three short stories about falling in love with someone you never thought possible. "For example, a mystery like this'' where you solve a mysterious code and the contents are XXXX "Cursed Umbrella'' that allows you to use mutual umbrellas. I never thought I'd fall in love with you... This is a pure Kyun short story collection of love stories.

title: Megane to Kubiwa to Wanko-kun
description:
The good-looking younger childhood friend she reunites with her is  her former dog!

They used to play “dog and owner” when they were little. He tells her to keep quiet about their past, but it seems that the “cute” part of him hasn't changed. Do you want me to keep you again? A secret master-slave relationship between a girl with glasses and a handsome boy with a sharp temper!

title: Love Fantasy
description: When a fancy house is built, the rumors fly. But what is the truth behind the devil and the angel, or the mysterious boy?

title: Strange Frog Princess
description:
One day, Ochiko, a hopelessly bullied girl, is saved by a delinquent named Ikeno while being bullied by his classmates. "Ikeno-kun is Ochiko's prince!” Ochiko believed that someday a prince would appear and kill all the bullies. However, that hope is extinguished, and Ochiko... !! Kanda Mori's first published volume, which includes 6 stories including the title work "Strange Frog Princess”!

Cw: Extreme and bizarre violence! Chapter 4 features incest!

title: Haikyuu!! - Yakeru (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kuroo Tetsurou x Kozume Kenma

title: Hūn Hūn Yù Shuì
description: She thought she had met the one true love of her life; he thought he could have given her the perfect life with nothing left to be desired. But alas, fate loves to make fun of people. And after countless twists and turns in life, at the end, who was whose true love? And who would be the one to complete whose happiness? If she could, she would rather have met him a little earlier. If he could, he would rather have fallen in love with her a little sooner.

title: Replicant no Kiss
description: Tsutsumu Shisui is brought up by his grandfather, Dr. Yuujirou after his father, Dr. Hiromu died. But now Yuujirou also died with a lot of debt. At Yuujirou's funeral, Tsutsumu's cousin, Sou Takigawa suddenly appears and declares that he wants to take care of Tsutsumu.

title: Ano Koro, Boku-tachi wa Tenshi ga Mieta. ~Bed no Ue no Kanojo ni Koishita 365-nichi~
description:
Raised in a single-parent home, Daiki is a rebellious junior high school student who makes his teachers cry. However, in front of his homeroom teacher's daughter, Kagura, who is hospitalized due to physical weakness, he is strangely honest. One day, a boy who claims to be an angel appears, whom only the two of them can see. The boy says that he will grant Daiki's wish if she completes a task he gives her ......?

(google translated)

Makoto, a short guy of 165cm height, confesses to Sei, a popular guy of 185cm height, who is tall, handsome, and kind, “I like you” and “Please go out with me!" Makoto is ready to have his heart broken, but he is not. Makoto is prepared to have his heart broken, but the answer is “yes.” The story describes the happy days of a couple with a height difference who have graduated from high school and are now university students!

title: 4x4 ~Otonari-san wa 4B Danshi~
description: She loves her older sisters and hates men!! Momoko is the youngest of four sisters. Even though I was excited about my new life with my sisters... When she transfers to a new school, she is suddenly recognized as "someone of destiny" by a flirtatious and handsome guy, which is a big hassle for her. What's more, they discovered that... their houses are next door to each other!? A byword for playboy!? An omnibus quartet love story of 4 brothers and 4 sisters, complete with "4B" boys.

title: Dekiai Rule
description: Miyashita-sensei was always an overachiever, but his perfect life was disrupted when he met his desirous student, Jindou. Trying his best to get Jindou back on track, sensei had to guide him personally and fend off his ex-partners. They grew to love each other as time went by, but sensei kept a distance from Jindou by trying his best to maintain an innocent relationship between them. Will Jindou succeed in breaking down sensei's territory?

title: Sesame★Street
description:
*Unrelated to the children's series Sesame Street*

This is Goma Street. 

It's a small shopping center in the heart of downtown Tokyo. My name is Keiki Fujiya and I'm 18 years old. I go to a prep school to get ready for my college entrance exams, though I'm on-and-off with it. As a hobby, I play in a band, which is super dope. 

My family's been in the grocery trade since way back when during the Meiji era, and we're still carrying on the tradition. We have a warehouse, shrine, and temple, which is super rare to have in Tokyo nowadays. Our household maestro is my old man Konpei, who despite being a fogey is in great shape and very active. 
I'm pretty active myself, but not as much as my pops. 

Our family is a lively bunch of Tokyoites. We're also called "Edokko" which means "Children of Edo", "Edo" being an old name for Tokyo. 
Really, it just means we've lived here a few decades from my pops and my pops' pops. 

So who do we have in our humble abode? Well, like I said, there's my po

title: Takane no Hanamiya-kun to Bocchi na Kanojo
description: 笑顔を作るのが苦手な真白は、友達を作るべく奮闘しているけど固い笑顔が原因で失敗続き。そんなある日、バイト先に現れたのは、学校では眩しい笑顔を振りまく花宮くん。しかし、彼は「マジでだりぃ――」と言い放ち、不機嫌そのもので！？学校では裏の顔とは全く違う笑顔を作れる彼のことを尊敬した真白は、彼に笑顔の特訓をお願いすることに。笑顔を教わる中で2人の距離は少しずつ縮まっていって――？

title: Haikyuu!! - Connection (Doujinshi)
description: Kageyama and Hinata learn how to kiss, to the displeasure of everyone around them.

title: His Arrogance
description:
Ryo is helping out at his father's modeling agency. But, his classmate and rising rookie model at the agency, Ito, is openly antagonistic to Ryo's older brother, a very charismatic model. Ito finally corners Ryo and demands that he looks at him only! After a passionate kiss, he promises that crossing him will incur punishment! Ito may be an arrogant boy who does nothing but give orders, but Ryo is undone by his forceful and dominating approach!  
  
**First three chapters also published in Oresamateki**

title: Smash 1
description: Nagahara Miu is the former genius tennis player who mysteriously quit playing tennis four years ago. But now, Miu, forced to play a doubles tennis team match with her classmate Issei, once again stands on the court…?!

title: Try Me Boy!
description:
A collection of cute shoujo stories:

- Try Me Boy!
Kaoru was helping at the school festival staff, while working she remembered... there's a guy with the same last name as her?!

- Wish upon a star, from me to you
After going out for a month, Ayumi and Makoto finally have their first date. Five minutes into it, Ayumi unconsciously calls her current boyfriend Hiroto, who is her ex-boyfriend?!

- It's nonsense but important

- Sentimental honey
(from: MangaUpdates)

title: Majime ni Fumajime
description:
Youth Romance about a dilligent and serious middle school girl who's the class president. Her classmate who's somewhat of a troublemaker boy saved her one time and ever since, she has an interest in him. However she's struggling to properly talk to him until the day she's becoming his seat neighbor in class and the distance betwen them starts to close.

(Source: Manga Mogura)

title: Sorairo Kaigan
description: Sakurai Tomo is a highschool girl who lives in a town close to a beach. One day as she was getting molested on the bus, she gets rescued by a classmate(?!). However, the key holder dropped by her rescuer held the same Agate that she has gotten from a boy in her past?! Is he the same person?!

title: Daikirai!! Demo Honto wa ne...
description: Kohashi Juri, a guy with a beautiful face, always gets irritated if someone calls out his girly name. But he is infuriated when Kouta, who is famous with the girls, started calling his name "Juri Juri" passionately everyday. Juri once thought "He's the opposite type of mine" but when Kouta said to him "Let's touch each other, this thing'll be our secret", he did something he shouldn't have done with Kouta…!?

title: Bokura no Unsei
description:
Asahi might seem like your regular high school boy, but this kid's been down on his luck…his entire life! Thankfully, the sketchy but resourceful teacher, Rokujou, just so happens to have the right charm to cure Asahi of what ails him. Too bad it has to come in the form of a kiss! But when Asahi starts to want more than just a kiss, will Rokujou give in and break the delicate balance they've held so far?  
  
1) Our Luck (Bokura no Unsei) (3 chapters)  
  
2) The Mechanism of Love (Koi Suru Kikai)  
An Aphenphosmphobic living in the mountains receive the visit of his sister who brings him… a robot?… see what happens…  
  
3) The Uniform and You (Seifuku to Anata)  
  
4) Uwasa no Futari (The Rumour of Two)  
Oneshot prequel to the two volume manga of the same name.

title: March Bud
description:
Contains three stories.  
1) Chimi is impatiently awaiting spring and her 14th birthday. Not yet ready to give up her tomboy ways, Chimi has a lot of confusion to deal with when she feels the first stirrings of girlhood awakening inside her.

title: Monochrome Diary
description: Yoojoon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Jiho. When Jiho says "Jump," Yoojoon asks "How high?" And as the pair become more inseparable by the day, they solidify their master-dog dynamic. But little do they know, each boy is harboring his own dark secret. Jiho, who suffers from severe apathy resulting from childhood trauma, is using Yoojoon as an expendable toy, and Yoojoon is intensely and obsessively in love with Jiho. Despite that, can the two boys successfully remove each other's masks and break the cycle of abuse?

title: Aho to Watashi to Akai Ito
description: の主人公・天野真啓（あまのまひろ）は神に仕える一族の娘で、天野家の者には17歳で未来の出来事を知る“天啓”が訪れるとされていた。どんな“天啓”かは訪れるまでわからず、疫病や大災害など世界を揺るがす未来を見る者も多いことから、天野家の“天啓”には政府の情報機関も注視している。そんな中で真啓に訪れた“天啓”は、学校で隣の席に座っている変人・小川郁人（おがわいくと）と結婚するという未来だった。郁人と結ばれることを避けたい真啓は“天啓”の内容を隠し、彼から離れようと奮闘。しかし郁人との距離はどんどん縮まっていく。運命のいたずらに振り回される真啓だったが、一方の郁人も大きな秘密を抱えていた。

title: Daikirai!
description:
1-3) A Hateful Person  
Third-year student Bai is the beautiful prefect with an angelic smile - that allures the students into obeying his orders. However, his kouhai Chiaki always defies Bai and the latter has no idea why Chiaki hates him. Nor does Chiaki understand why Bai hates him so much that he never reprimands him for his sloppiness. Each secretly wishes to know what's on the other's mind… but how will they go about it?  
  
4) The Day That Prince Charming Will Come  
The pitiful freshman has been dumped for the 4th time even though it has only been 6 months since starting school. While he was thinking that things can't get worst, he gets a bucket load of cold water dumped on him while he was crying his eyes out.  
  
5) Love Rivals  
The beautiful bartender has women throwing themselves at him even though he is openly gay and very monogamous. His partner on the other hand, is bisexual and busy chasing skirts. How will he handle his betrayal time after time?  
  
6) Emergency

title: JUST!!
description: Sekine is the captain of the judo team. His friend and roommate Kosakai is a popular novelist. They both attend school and seem to be pretty close. Tamura Maiko is a member of the judo team and falls in love with the one of them. A love triangle ensues.

title: Like Violin
description:
A breathing tree, four strings. 
A soul's passion and that soft vibration.
To a world where the songs of violins emerge, I invite you.

title: PASSION 101
description:
People with psychic powers known as Passions have lived hidden from the rest of humanity in their own parallel society for centuries.

When Tomokazu, the son of two famous Passionate statespeople, joins the prestigious International Aldread Academy for the Passionate, he doesn't expect to last a day, much less to change the world.

title: Kimi to Blue ni Somaru Koro
description: An omnibus story depicting the blue, painful, and delicate days of youth!

title: Marimo no Hana - Saikyou Butouha Shougakusei Densetsu
description:
The story of the manga centers around Marimo Nogami, a usually quiet fourth-grade girl in elementary school. However, a certain incident leads to Marimo’s personal strength blossoming.

(from mangaupdates)

title: Kimi ga Orion
description: Entering my new school, the things are waiting for me are love and friendship with friends from the student council.

title: Otometeki Koi Kakumei Love Revo!!
description: Based on a dating simulation game of the same name; Sakuragawa Hitomi is your ordinary heroine…she might just be a bit overweight…100 KG to be exact. Although she was quite beautiful as a child and won many beauty contest, her love for sweets became her downfall and before she knew it, she was a giant blob of flesh. Now she's sent by her father to live with her older brother at a hi-tech apartment that's also home to some rather gorgeous boys…would she be able to loose weight and attract their attentions!?

title: Majimekei Kuzu no Nichijou
description: "Serious Kuzu," or Mashima Kuzumi, is a kuzu-ya with a serious skin! Mashima had many skills to deceive his teachers and his classmates, not being conspicuous, and easily living in school. But strange students, such as the real Kuzu Oden, who is interested in Majima, the grave of the class, Kiyokawa, and the mysterious female "Looking At Him," begin to gather around Majima! The New Generation of Kuzu Hero, Mashima Kucho's Youth, Daily Life and School Comedy!

title: My friend Mono
description: The story centers on Mono sanchez, a high school student from the north institute, where he will suffers many funny situations. In this web comic through history, the genres are changing.

title: Bataashi Kingyo
description:
Kaoru, a high school student, falls in love with Sonoko, the leader of his school's swimming club. Although he can not swim, he joins the swim club to seduce her.

It was adapted into a live action film directed by Joji Matsuoka in 1990.

title: Bokutachi no Shinjuu
description: A story about the life, death and sexuality of a boy and girl living in the bittersweet spring of their youth.

title: Shuugaku Ryokou no Susume
description: Yuuka is on a school trip to Kyoto but she's in the same group as her ex-boyfriend and his new girlfriend, so she ditches her group and goes off on her own–only to bump into a classmate doing the same thing.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen - Sensei!! (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Gojo Satoru x Itadori Yuuji

A story about Yuuji who confesses to Gojo-sensei.

title: Manabiya Sannin Kichisa
description: Perky Yaaya is a first year student at Koushinmaru High School and a new member of the school newspaper staff. In order to become a full member of the staff she must uncover the identities of the Sannin Kichisa, a mysterious trio of masked avengers haunting the school!

title: Not Boyfriends Yet
description: Minho would never go out with another guy! Or so he thought, as surprising rumors about him and bookish class president Hajun spread. How long will they last before they must admit to their school mates — and their feelings?

title: Brass Love!!
description:
Kotohara Sui was touched by the National Music Competition performances, and this prompted her to apply to study at the school which Sou Tsukasa attends. Though the school’s orchestra club rejected her application, after many recommendations from Tsukasa, she was admitted into the brass band… Will they be able to beat the Orchestra Club…?!  
  
Includes two other stories.

title: Mashiteya Sano-kun to Koi Nante
description: At her new high school, Koharu meets Sano-kun, who's juggling four girlfriends. Outraged, Koharu boldly declares to Sano, “I'll teach you what real love is!” Yet she finds herself at a loss, floundering day after day... Can Koharu truly teach Sano-kun about “real love”!?

title: Anata e no Tsuki
description:
Collection of 5 one shots:  
  
- Anata e no Tsuki (Moon for You)  
Mei's boyfriend, Hikaru, transferred schools 4 months ago. Now that summer break has started, they can meet again, but circumstances changed and Hikaru has to return earlier than they planned. Mei sends him with a smile, but deep down…  
  
- Kataomoi no Sono Saki (Beyond A One-Sided Love)  
It's almost Valentine's Day, and Yuka is determined to give her chocolates to the popular Hazuki-kun. Last year, Hazuki-kun didn't accept anyone's chocolates. Can Yuka figure out his secret?  
  
- 7-ho-me no Mirai  
  
- Kare ga Kanojo ni Nozomu Mono (What He Expects of Her)  
  
- Spring.

title: Shine
description:
This manga contains three stories.

Story 1: **Shine**
Maki is a shy girl secretly in love with his sempai at the photography club. Just when the mood is getting better between them, she meets Akihara, a very rude and straightforward guy she can't really deal with.

Story 2: **Slowly, my Lovely**
Fuuka has been really nervous since her classmate Kenji Tokuda confessed to her. Even though she hasn't given him an answer yet, he acts as if nothing has happened...?

Story 3: **Before the Promise**
During winter break, Yui met Hisashi in the mountains and liked him almost instantly. But then she had to leave without even telling him, so when they meet again months later, he's not very pleased to see her.

title: Kagi
description:
Consists of a volume with various oneshot.  
  
1- Key  
  
2- Alkaloid  
  
3- Breath  
  
4- Night, Midnight  
  
5- Dogs and Summer Clothes  
  
6- Key (epilogue)

title: Chika-chan wa Motto Shiritai
description: Chika, a second grader, can't help but be curious about Yuki, the boy who sits next to her. Wanting to know more about him, she one day encounters a mysterious creature named Pipsqueak...?!

title: Sayonara Sankaku
description:
A love triangle story of hurt, brokenness, and rebuilding. They thought that their peaceful days would continue as before…

Riku, Yuina, and Souma are childhood friends who have attended the same schools from elementary to high school. However, a certain confession causes their love triangle to change in a distorted way.

title: Meirei, Kimi wo Hanasanai
description: Rino is always with Ryo. They made a promise when they were younger. But will Rino continue to support this situation…?

title: Me2
description: Aki is a shy, introverted teen trying to cope with the death of her older brother. Coupled with the daily pressures of being the most bullied kid in school, she keeps having mysterious blackouts. Entire days begin to be unaccounted for as Aki finds strange items in her closet. Adding to her bewilderment, the cutest boy in school is suddenly taking an interest in her. Aki wonders if her grip on reality is slowly slipping away, but something even more shocking might be behind this haunting tale...

title: Kimi ni Sachi Are!
description: Naruse Sachi left his student ID at Happy Villa. His kouhai, Kunisaki picked it up and wants to return it. But does Kunisaki expect any favor in return? Sachi-chan kawai-ness is making Kunisaki all nervous and excited. Will Sachi accept being pursued by this first love of his life, his kouhai, and a guy on top of that?

title: I've Got a Question for Sensei!
description:
The daily life of Yumemi, a third year at Shirahadai Middle School. Surrounded by a colorful cast of students and teachers, there's never a dull moment to be found at school.
___
* Included in Volume 1:  **The Blue Sea**: A short poem manga centered a man longing for his wife, who left him all too soon.
* Included in Volume 2: **Spring in the Green Forest** (グリーンフォーレストの春, Green Forest no Haru):  An unpublished work.

title: Warito Yokuaru Danshikouteki Renaijijou
description: Welcome to Kinsei Private School: a respected, all-boys institution where it's rumored that ninety percent of the student body is gay (or bisexual). For the straight Nanase, this means constantly evading day-to-day advances from his love-struck classmates. Just what is a "normal" boy to do in this sea of abnormality? Enter Heiji, who proposes a unique solution to his senpai: namely, that he and Nanase pretend to be a couple, so as to deflect all of the unwanted attention. Sounds like a good plan, except that pretty soon Nanase finds himself performing all manner of embarrassing acts in order to keep up the "ruse." What's wrong with this picture?!

title: Maid Maiden
description:
When Alivia Wender was younger, she was saved by a boy and wants to thank him but cannot remember his face. Her only clues are a scar on his hand and a prestigious school badge. She promised herself that she would enter the school to meet her 'prince' again. Just when her application was accepted, her family went bankrupt and can't afford her education fees! Feeling dejected, she visited the school, snuck in through a tree and managed to get enrolled…?  
  
Will Alivia ever find her 'prince'?  
  
This comic is serialized in Gempak Starz comic magazine from Malaysia.

title: Yoru no Hanabira
description:
Collection of 7 oneshots:  
  
1) Yoru no Hanabira  
Host love.  
  
2) Kaika Zenya  
Back story about the host of the first chapter and how he met his guardian (no romance story)  
  
3) Junjou Escape  
Actors in love.  
  
4) Kimi ni Furu Yuki  
Art student in love with his sempai.  
  
5) Koi Suru Yajuu  
  
6) Kamu Otoko  
  
7) Haru wo Aisuru Hito

title: Hajimete Nandesu
description: After years of being childhood friends, Tatsuya suddenly confesses to his childhood friend, Yuuri. Yuuri is unsure of how to feel and act and slowly, she finds herself feeling things she'd never felt before…

title: Okaeri ga Koigokoro wo Komete
description: Suzune, a high school girl whose parents own the Japanese-style restaurant, "Fujikago," is in love with a college student, Arata, who works part-time at the restaurant. In place of her parents who are too  busy to do so, Arata is the one who gives her a "welcome home." Before he gets too busy to see each other as he preps to graduate college, Suzune tries to think up a plan that will allow them to meet, however...?! Living under one roof, an age gap romance!

title: Blue Petals
description:
This is the second kashihon manga (rental manga) published by the mangaka under the name "Akira Matsumoto" in 1958, and his second debut work. 

It contains three short stories that were published in the magazine "Shojo". A fantastic fantasy masterpiece full of suspense and fantasy that transcended the boundaries of shojo manga of the time. 

The e-book version does not include the "Blue Petal" reading book (special supplement).

title: Pochi
description: Cheerful middle-schooler Miku lives on a mountain farm with her grandpa, where they keep a large number of animals. When Aruga- a senpai at Miku's school- concocts a plan to help some local stray animals that are causing a nuisance, fellow animal lover Miku seems like a natural choice to help out. As the two of them become closer, Miku finds herself falling in love… but will dense Aruga ever figure it out?

title: Koisuru Toki mo, Yameru Toki mo
description:
After losing his career and girlfriend to heart disease, company employee Masahito Onigiku had decided that he would never create anything precious again. However, one day, he meets a high school girl, Rinko Shirato, who suddenly confesses to him, “Please go out with me!" 

Onigiku gradually finds hope for his life in Rinko, who is unfazed by the many times he has turned down her confession, and who is always so innocent and healthy. Then, during their annual tea party, Onigiku has a seizure. Onigiku tells Rinko, who is worried, that she is ill for the first time...?!

title: Koi kara wa Nigerarenai
description: 中学時代、短距離（男子100m）で、全国2位となった大塚ヒロ。しかし、彼は、1位になれなかった――。その理由は――おっぱい!!!!!!??そんなヒロの弱点を見抜き、スカウトした黒河高等学園の理事長!! しかし、ヒロの意思を尊重し、ヒロの為に作成された育成方法は、ヒロの陸上人生を大きく左右することに――!!? 行け。疾駆れ。

title: Seeing Double
description: Ohn can’t stand men, and he’s determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-woo is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he’s recruited his more confident twin brother, Jae-woo, to act as his double and approach Ohn. But as Jae-woo starts putting a little too much of his own heart into the act, the line between who’s courting Ohn gets blurred. Will the brothers break through Ohn’s hatred of men? And if so, which twin will be the one to win Ohn’s heart?

title: Lady M. o Sagase!
description:
Chaos and mayhem is afflicting Yoshida Akari's school. There is a ruthless bloomer thief on the loose-and no one is safe!  
But on a more serious note, Yoshida Akari's best friend, Hayakawa Maiko has been missing for 3 days now, and it seems as though no one is making any head in the investigation. So, Akari decides to take things in her own hands and questions the last person who was with her best friend, Student Council President Morishita Natsu. He quickly gives her the brush off stating that he is too busy with the bloomer incident.   
Who is this mystery thief and just what exactly has happened to Maiko?

title: Haikyuu!! - Sakura no Ato (Doujinshi)
description: Oikawa x Kageyama

title: Kawaii Beast
description:
1: Cute Beast  
There's a tall and mysterious (and scary!) guy named Onizuka in Kisaki's class. He looks horrifying at first glance, but if you take a good look, he's actually pretty handsome! And yet he acts like a big lumbering animal all the time. Now, Kisaki's starting to feel like he wants to keep Onizuka's hidden charms to himself… but why?!  
  
2: The Prince's Commitment  
Girls always confess to Miki, then dump him within weeks because he doesn't care enough. So when adorable classmate Sakura (male) confesses to Miki, he decides to try it out. Will Miki learn to care about another person, or will Sakura leave him like all the rest? And why does the entire class know Miki's business?  
  
3: Ramune, First Love, And Summer Break  
Years ago, Aki and his cousin Naomi (male) were very close with the much older Naomi taking care of Aki. Now a third year high school student, Aki must spend time with Naomi again and confront the feelings he's been hiding…  
  
4: Alice Reunite  
When

title: Spring Haze
description: It is said that there is a lake in Chunze City that allows people to make wishes come true. You can only wish once in your entire life. In the spring of her freshman year at high school, An Yuji, who was bullied, ran away from Dudong City to Chunze City to make a wish in the lake, hoping that she would no longer be bullied and leave Dudong City behind. Unexpectedly, her wish came true?! She successfully transferred to Chunze No. 1 Middle School and met Qin Fengshi, an unruly and lonely young man. But, the price of making a wish is...?

title: Tsurenai Yura-kun no Ai ga Dadamore desu
description: 高校２年生の結佳には、いつもつれない態度をとる幼なじみの由良くんがいる。幼なじみとして仲が良かったころに戻りたい結佳だけど、由良くんは結佳にだけ塩対応。なのに時々、わかりづらい優しさをみせてきたり、甘く迫ってきたり…由良くんはどうしても結佳をほっとけないみたいで――。

title: Takaramono
description:
Volume 1  
1) Takaramono  
Naoyuki, a sincere and honest country boy comes to Tokyo for high school and stays with his cousin's family. At first everybody takes advantage of him, thinking that he's too naive to catch on. His cousin Satoshi, who's in college, is no different. He demands that Naoyuki have sex with him in exchange for tutoring him… In no time, despite his less than honourable initiate intention, Satoshi starts falling in love with the pure-hearted boy.  
  
2) Kimochi no Yukue  
Oneshot also found in [Koibito no Namae](https://mangadex.org/title/55801/koibito-no-namae).  
  
3) Melody  
Futuristic Sci-fi story about a singer and an android that was abandoned. **Not scanlated**.  
  
4) Afterword  
  
Volume 2  
1-2) Takaramono  
  
3) Afterword  
  
Volume 3  
1) Takaramono  
  
2) Kimi to Konomama  
Tells of a tragic love story between a boxer with an incurable illness and his loyal fan. **Not scanlated**.  
  
3) Takaramono EX  
  
4) Afterword  
  
Volume 4  
1) Takara

title: Free! - Side by Side (Doujinshi)
description: Gou has been staring at Haru a lot lately…and he worries that she might have realized he and Rin are dating.

title: Tinker Bell
description:
One-shot compilation of Ryoko Yamagishi's. contains the following:

- **Tinker Bell** (ティンカー・ベル) - Daphne's only friend was Tinker Bell, who had been by her side since she was little. When Daphne was sad, Tinker Bell was always the only one to comfort her, but as she became closer to Ghee, whom she met one day, Tinker Bell became invisible to her. (description from [https://yamagishi-ryoko.hatenablog.com/](https://yamagishi-ryoko.hatenablog.com/entry/2020/01/24/233642))
- **Rapunzel Rapunzel** (ラプンツェル・ラプンツェル)
- **Pumpkin Carriage** (かぼちゃの馬車, Kabocha no Basha)
- **My Little Mermaid** (わたしの人魚姫, Watashi no Ningyohime)
- **Of The Slumbering Forest** (ねむれる森の, Nemureru Mori no)

title: Hired To Love
description:
Henley never thought she'd see so many zeros on one check$10,000 to be billionaire Bennett Calloway's fake girlfriend! And that's just the advance! She's barely scraping by, working two minimum wage jobs just to afford the worst apartment ever and the lawyer fees from her brother's wrongful conviction. Calloway is rude and entitled, but the opportunity seems too good to pass up. The only catch? Don't fall in love. In desperate need of cash, Henley finds herself caught up in a whirlwind business arrangement, pretending to date Calloway so his mother will ease up on the pressure for him to find a wife. But once Henley is enmeshed in Bennett's world, he falls for her, and she starts to develop feelings for him as well. 

Despite her romance with Bennett, it's clear something is wrongare the Calloways involved in the conviction that put her brother in jail? What secrets are their family hiding? Journeying deeper into a world of wealth and conspiracies, Henley is forced to rely on Bennett.

title: Jiyue Streamer
description: "A person's life is only a few decades, so what is there to be envious about?" "I have seen many flowers, but the one I will never forget is a flower that only bloomed for two hours." She always has a more gentle aura than the moonlight.

title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ - Maji Love 2000%
description: ST☆RISH, an idol group that made a sensational debut with "Maji LOVE 1000%", composed by Nanami Haruka, an aspiring composer, while they were students at the performing arts school Saotome Academy. They were working hard every day together, aiming to become top-class composers and idols. Then one day, their agency president, Shining Saotome, asks them to take the "Master Course" to further their growth. And there, the highly individualistic idol group QUARTET NIGHT appears as their instructors!

title: Lovers Only
description:
Collection of cute short stories focusing on formation of relationships.  
  
1-2) Welfare Storm  
A student has a crush on a new, beautiful, substitute school attendant. But the attendant is a jinker and brings unhappiness to the student…  
  
3) Attraction Liqueur  
A young ace worker from tech sector becomes the assistant of an ace salesman who cannot drink too much. The young worker shows how much he has yearned for the salesman and invites him to their private drinking session…  
  
4) Hibinoya Boarding House Chronicle  
The cloistered son of noble family suddenly lives to the hero's house in order to learn the life of ordinary people…  
  
5-6) Fickle Wings & Everyday Fickle  
Yoshimoto Oki is a quiet boy. With both his parents working overseas, he is often home alone, and so finds solace in his computer. But when he participates in and wins the "Infinite Colour Wing" game contest, the prize turns out to be something more than he bargained for…

title: Basic Ali
description:
Ali Family’s Strange Anecdote:
Basic Ali cartoon strip was first published in the sub-editorial page of “Prothom Alo” [one of the main newspaper publishers in Bangladesh] in November 2006.
The main focus of this cartoon strip is some funny moments occurring around family, friends and office colleagues.
Basic Ali is the eldest son of the prominent debt defaulter Talib Ali and his wife Moly Ali. Basic’s younger sister Nature Ali is a medical student and younger brother Magic Ali is a high school student, Basic’s best friend self-forgetful Hillol and Basic’s heart throb office colleague Riya Haque.

title: Hatsukoi wo Dakishimeru
description: Akane is in love with her private tutor Koizumi, but he wears a ring on his left finger... Is he engaged? What will happen with her feelings?

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai - Shortcake (Doujinshi)
description: A cute little ShiroKagu story involving shortcake.

title: To My Dear Summer
description: 가정학대 아동으로 자란 인하는 대학에 들어가자마자 집을 나온다. 혼자 힘으로 살아남기 위해 안간힘으로 발버둥치지만 세상은 그런 인하를 비웃듯이 고통만을 안겨준다. 끊어질래야 끊어질 것 같지 않는 이 구질구질한 굴레 속에서 가장 먼저 놓고자 했던 것은, 왜 하필 너였을까.

title: Koi ni Ochiru
description:
By Salva Nos Scans:  
  
Chika is a high school girl in her 3rd semester of 10th grade, who seems to have no luck on finding love. But before she knew it, she began to care about her classmate Kyohara. A book of serious love lessons.  
  
Includes "The Best Summer" and "The Ringing Bell"

title: Gochuumon wa Samenai Koi de
description: Since her parents' divorce, Nekomiya Tsunagi has lost faith in people's feelings. She tries to stay inconspicuous in her high school life and avoid being remembered by others, but during a visit to a coffee shop as a hobby, she meets Flame Aozumi!

title: Tonari no Danshi wo Tabeta Sugiru
description: Sakurako, a high school senior, is after the mature body of her childhood friend Hiiragi, who is two years younger than her. She does not have any romantic feelings for him, but she is fine as long as she can enjoy his beautiful body. As usual, she attacks him while he is sleeping, but Hiiragi fights back...!

title: Fuyu Monogatari
description:
Hikaru Morikawa failed his university entrance exam and even got into Yachiyo University of Commerce, which he thought would be a safe bet. On top of that, because he failed his girlfriend's entrance exam, he was even dumped by her. He reluctantly goes to the reception desk at the cram school, but there he meets Shiori Amemiya, a cute girl who
is aiming to get into the University of Tokyo, and is persuaded to enroll in the University
of Tokyo course. However, as she expected, Hikari can't keep up with her studies, but when she thinks about Shiori, she can't stop thinking about him. One day, Hikaru accidentally finds out that Shiori's girlfriend has a boyfriend, so he confides his feelings to Shiori and decides to change her course.

title: Shachi-kun to Love na Fukujuu
description:
Orcas are the rulers of the sea, hunting everything from penguins to whales several times their size with their intelligence and organizational skills! This is a youthful love story about the student council, featuring an orca-like student council president who tries to rule a closed-off, listless school, and Nae, a penguin-like girl who is excited about Shachi and struggles to change the school!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

---
Note: Previously a oneshot.

title: Kurara Shake
description: A slapstick drama revolving around the fate of the love of Kurara, a popular student at the school whose personality changes dramatically when her braids are untied☆ The cast of characters surrounding Kurara are funny, weird, and fun!

title: My Dead Girlfriend
description: Finney's family members are ghosts, and he's the only normal human at his school, Mephisto Prep. His life changes when he meets and instantly connects with the smart and beautiful Jenny. The only issue is that Jenny is a ghost, but Finney won't let even Death get in the way of true love

title: Ultra Cute
description: For all 15 years of their lives, Ami and Noa have competed against each other for love with the same results: both fall for the same guy, inevitably scaring him away and leaving them boyfriend-less. But the vicious cycle is broken when the girls go to a party and each fall for two different guys! With potential love on the horizon, the sky couldn't be bluer…until Ami discovers that these two dudes are actually duds with ulterior motives. Determined to get revenge on these players, Ami vows to make her guy fall for her while she trys to protect an unsuspecting Noa!

title: Shinyuu Henjou!
description:
Shino Satomi is jilted by a girl because she does not feel his "manliness". He is comforted by his best friend, Mamoru Hasegawa, but fails to enter the school of his first choice. Both enter the same all-boy high school, very unique school because most students are homosexual! They occupy the same room in the dormitory and Mamoru hides his love for Shino and keeps guard against the other students…  
  
This volume contains an unrelated story called, "Stripper."

title: The Chaotic Days of The Class President Lily from The Trouble Student Charlie
description: A girl named Lily White entered her first year of high school. One day, she worked so hard that she became sick. Upon returning to class, she locked eyes with Charlie, an attractive classmate who had also been absent and is always alone. Why is that ?

title: Moshi Ano Ko ga Tracen Gakuen ni Itte Nakattara. Teio no Baai
Un no Tsuki wa Koi no Hajimari
description: Iori Hazumi is a high school girl who is constantly pushed around by her father, who wants to make a profit, and is too unhappy to be moved by the slightest trouble. She moves back to the countryside where she used to live, but a mistake in the procedure puts her in a tight spot...! A girl she met by chance introduces her to a new friend and she ends up staying next door to a shrine, but the handsome Kagurazaka-kun who moves in with her is a strange guy...?!

title: Honey
description: Is it possible to be so transfixed by a stranger? Asano Miwa and Harmana Ichiro found themselves crossing paths as random strangers but what brings Ichiro to suddenly grab Miwa and what is Ichiro's secret? Is it a fairy tale ending or misfortune that awaits them?

title: Bikou Root
description:
Ichiko has idolized Arashi-sempai from a far, ever since she saw him play in his band a year ago.  
  
When she accidentally damages his right hand, she promises to become his right hand and do everything he needs until he recovers. Will this be the chance she's always wanted to get close to him, or will it prove to be more than she can handle?

title: Himegoto - Secret
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Miya was happily married and living a wealthy life in an apartment in Shirokanedai. 
She was loved by her husband and had everything she wanted. 
However, everything falls apart when she is reunited with Itoko, a classmate from junior high school...　

A completely new work by Masako Watanabe, a master mangaka with 68 years of experience!

title: Gokuama Ookami wa, Warui Koto wo Oshietai
description: If you don't know anything about men, I'll teach you." Even though she knows she shouldn't get close to him... A sweet, erotic love story begins, with a dangerous, top quality boy who plays around with you! High school junior Rina is one of Haruhi's face fans, who is rumoured to have a "superb face but terrible taste in women". One day, she goes to the infirmary and encounters Haruhi, who is hiding from the girls! She has never spoken to him before, but suddenly she is approached by a girl who says, "I want to tell you something bad". Rina is thrilled, but she thinks she has nothing more to do with Haruhi because she is just as scummy as the rumours say, but from then on, she gets teased about everything - and then some. Special treatment, kneecaps, sweet kisses... Suddenly, in this exciting everyday full of firsts, the heart of Rina, who has never been in love before, is on the verge of exploding...?

title: Imperial Academy
description: On Christmas eve, a girl dressed in a Santa Claus suit rides a motorcycle so fast that even the gangsters find it hard to keep up… What will happen if the police waiting in ambush catches hold of her mistaking her for a notorious gang leader called SKR?

title: Hime-sama ni Ijirare Asobare
description: 親の都合で転校となり、地元に戻ってきた男子高校生の迫田。転校先の高校で、可愛いくて成績優秀みんなの憧れの生徒会長通称"ヒメ様"が面倒を見てくれることに。それは放課後のヒミツの遊びの始まりだった――! ヒメ様とのヒミツの遊びは健全…じゃない！？

title: Tokio to Nanami
description: At South Sakura High, Nanami never had any friends. But when a transfer student arrives in her class, Nanami's subservient and timid school life starts to change little by little.

title: My Boy x My Love
description:
Title Story - After falling asleep in the snow Atsuki meets the fun and intelligent Kai who seems to be a bit sick.  
  
Darling Smoker - Asahi decides to give up on all guys that smoke because of her previous cheating boyfriend and meets respectable clean Itsuru the class president, but shock, he smokes!

title: Lovers Flowers
description:
From ShoujoMagic:  
  
1) Lovers Flowers  
It is believe that if a couple kisses during the fireworks festival, they will be together forever. In order to make the miraculous legend come true, Hayuri decides to confess. The one she likes is the basketball club’s captain, Hara-sempai. When she goes to see him, holding her letter, the guy who comes out is the basketball member, Konohana, Hayuri’s classmate. With Konohana’s idea, Hayuri becomes the club’s manager. But she gets introduced as Konohana’s girlfriend!?  
  
2) Go Burst ☆ Girl!  
Aki once beat her beloved friend Yousuke (whom she likes), in karate. Now he says he doesn't have anything to do with that, so he acts randomly. She feels regretful. Trouble appears, and the kendo's captain wants to go out with her…?!  
  
3) FAKE!!  
Saori is able to tell counterfeits, or fakes, from the real articles. She uses this talent to suit her goal of getting back her dead mother's necklace from two men that treated her cruelly after her fathe

title: Choco to Mint to
description:
Keiko is a junior 2nd year student, but has no experience in love. One day, while going to school, she helps an unconscious 'cute boy' who fainted from anemia. Being two-faced, he doesn’t thank Keiko but instead calls her an old lady. Surprising as it is, that boy goes to her school and is a first year.  
  
Also includes 2 oneshots: Never Let Go of Your Hand and Sweet Relationship.

title: Himitsu no Hanazono-sensei
description:
Sensei, please teach me how to fall in love!

The main character, Hikaru, is far from being popular. After being rescued from a pinch, he turns to a mysterious and serious teacher, Hanazono-sensei, as his love teacher and learns what love is all about!

title: Mikansei na Bokutachi
description:
1) Mikansei na Bokutachi  
Torikoshi had an unrequited crush on her school’s soccer star, who walked home with her. He promised to always support her artistic ambitions, but one day he didn’t come to the club room after school…  
  
2) Koe no Ato  
A boy who sings, and a girl intoxicated by the sound of his voice. What might develop between them?  
  
3) Koboreru Uso to Pierce Hole  
“Everything you say sounds like a lie.” After hearing that from a classmate, she vowed to change, but earrings and dyed hair might just get in the way of her new found honesty.  
  
4) Koiiro Tayori  
When Megumu found a misplaced love letter, she went to return it to the underclassman who had written it. Only, he didn’t look like the type to have written something so serious.  
  
5) Yonjyuukyuu no Eien  
“Uera-kun, you’re not running any more?” Those were the last words she thought she’d say to the boy she loved, who died that afternoon saving a girl from being hit by a car–until his ghost appeared. A st

title: Tennen Hachimitsu Ryou.
description: Nikaidou Nene has always carried a terrible burden--naturally curly hair. This unusual trait always brought only unhappy memories until one day a stranger comes to her aid. Meeting him again becomes her fondest wish. As she begins her life again and enters high school, she wonders what life on her own at the school's dorm will be like. Will she ever meet "her" golden haired stranger again?

title: My Beloved Devil
description:
It's about a girl named Ai Sugawa (16) who has a deep awaited love and fell for someone who deems to be unreachable, Naoya Senpai. He is a star in the Track and Field club and quite popular. When she was going to confess to him to help her a demon named aya the beast descends saying ''its been 11 year Ai'' Ai remains shocked perplexed about who he is with dark black wings !!!! What now ?   
  
keep reading! a sweet lovely one-shot .

title: Sono Hada, Tachiirikinshi
description:
- Sensei, Kiss no Kounou wa? (Sensei's Virtuous Kiss?)  
If you kiss an arrogant prince, will your wish come true?!

title: Hoosamguk High
description: Alice is the heiress to the famed Han Gan clan. She returns to Korea to search for a husband who can then lead the clan, and has her hands full with competitive suitors, each fighting for the coveted position more than for Alice herself. What they don't know, however, is Alice's true motive…

title: Kamisama to Gisou Couple Hajimemashita
description:
人気爆上がり中！チルな神さまとのニセ恋☆

縁結び神社の娘・詠（よみ）は、「縁切り神社」「心霊スポット」と悪評がたってしまった神社の人気を取り戻したいと考えている。そんな中神社で祀っている神さまが現れた！でもその神さまは、顔こそイケメンだけどやる気ゼロのゆる～いダメ神さまだった・・・。しかし詠はそんな神さまとSNSでカップルアカウントを作り、神社をPRすることを思いついて・・・！？

title: Usotsuki Chocolate Syrup
description: Let's do our best at making handmade chocolate! But how will this chocolate taste to the person I yearn for?

title: Love Live! - Hakka no Owari ni (Doujinshi)
Renai Plus α
description:
When the last night of the field trip comes around, teachers will throw a party and become less mindful of the students. Whilst students use the great opportunity to run off somewhere, the night becomes a time when everyone can kick off their shoes.  
  
Student Search Group Teacher, Natsukawa Hikaru, is in charge of finding delinquents truanting and is most commonly known to be dumb. However, on the hunt of such students, Natsukawa-sensei seems to have caught himself in trouble. Overseeing the innocent Natsukawa-sensei in trouble, illegal leave-taking student, Koga Takaya, comes to the rescue. Having finding an interest in the dumb-witted Natsukawa-sensei, Koga asks for a kiss in return. Not knowing Koga is actually one of the delinquents he is suppose to be looking for, due to his vacuity, Natsukawa-sensei is disturbed to the departed fact that Koga knows exactly who he is. Having become close throughout the story, will Natsukawa realize the fact that he is in love with Koga Takaya,

title: Prince Collection
description:
This is a collection of one-shots that all have the common theme of a secret host club at a high school called "Prince" that comes to the rescue of various girls who ask for help. Each chapter focuses on a separate pair of host and customer.
  
1) Call 1: Kyou  
2) Call 2: Shou  
3) Call 3: Kaoru  
4) Birthday Call  
5) Prince Call  
6) Last Call  
7) Hakuba no Ouji-sama

title: Hajimete...
description:
From Shoujo Crusade:  
Yui has always loved Koutarou to the point that she became the manager of the athletic team. One day Koutarou confessed to her and they become a couple. Will there be heaven or hell waiting for Yui?

title: Rumors
description: The guys in school say that Nikawa is like a Japanese doll: so fragile that no one dares to approach her. Meanwhile, Nikawa's friends talk about how scary Mashima's stare was when one bumped into him; all the girls in school are scared of Mashima due to his looks. One early morning, by coincidence, Mashima finds Nikawa by herself hungrily eating beef rice! Nikawa also finds that Mashima isn't such a cold person after all. The two discover that rumors are not always true and Mashima begins eating breakfast with Nikawa every morning. As they become closer, rumors suddenly start spreading after someone saw them eating together. Now what will become of them?

title: Viva Love You
description: The Girl's Teaching Classroom: Viva Love You, is a radio show about love, run by the normal schoolgirl Lee Si-Hyun. But who would have thought that the girl that give you the help you need for your love life have never been in love herself? But when she least expected love to come, a new male teacher appears in school. Will the girl who never experience love before, finally fall in love?

title: Cinderella Fella
description: Shin Gyu Yun is the heir of the Shin Oong Group and the self-proclaimed prince of Korea's economy. However, he has a secret. Since his father left them before Shin was born, he can't help but clean things due to his past of helping out his mother with the chores. It wasn't until that Shin's mother died in an accident that he came to know his scheming step-sisters by moving into his father's estate. The step-sisters conspire to make him lose his position… but could that have made him fall in love with a low-class girl?

title: Renai Gengogaku
description:
Because of the two senpais passionate affections towards each other, there isn’t any new recruit for the Archery Club. As a result, the club might be disbanded. However, there might be hope if the two freshmen, who have been studying archery for over ten years, join the club. Will the boys agree to join a club that has only three members and without a consultant? And will their relationship advance to the next stage? Includes a one-shot of a sweet love confession between a sensei and an intern.  
  
Included oneshot "Love internship".

title: Karasu Tengu Sama To Saiai No Chigiri Ochikobore No Watashi Ga, Saikyō No Ayakashi Ni Shūchakusareru Made
description:
「俺は生涯、お前を手放すつもりはない」
人間とあやかしが共存する世界。かつて闇堕ちしたあやかしに両親を殺されたすみれは、巫女になることを唯一の夢として生きてきた。しかし何故か霊力が減少し、今や落ちこぼれとして周囲から虐げられ、その夢も危うい立場。そんなある日、すみれは弱ったあやかしを介抱し、彼の回復のために自身の霊力を分け与える血の契約を結ぶ。
彼こそが最高の地位と美貌を持つ鴉天狗だった!

title: Kuroko no Basket - Kore Kara mo Yoroshiku (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Me vs Big Slacker Baby
description:
Arin is a teen girl who is always cleaning while Alvan is a teen boy who is smart but messy and lazy. Whenever they meet, they always clash in funny and riveting ways which would lead to something more. This is a love story of two teens who are opposed to one another, and yet they attract each other!

---
Official Release:
- Japanese release by Digital Catapult

title: Hinata to Hikari
description:
Hinata, who is an ordinary middle school girl from every angle, is the twin sister of the popular idol Hikari! In order not to disappoint Hikari's fans, Hinata has always kept her sister a secret and behaved in a low-key manner. One day, in order to save Hikari from a pinch, Hinata switches places with Hikari and jumps into a glittering world!!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title: Romanticist Egoist
description: One day, Riku finds a mysterious message on her table from a boy with the initials Y. N., stating that he likes her. Riku’s hoping Y. N. is the star of the school, Nakao Yoshiki-kun, but could he be interested in a girl like her? She wants to ask Nakao-kun if he was really the one who wrote the message, but there’s this guy who keeps trying to get in her way…

title: Bokuretsu Manken Love Gun
description: Fuyuki Souichirou is a first year freshman who arrives for his first day of high school only to find a great battle raging on in the school yard.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Yotsuba Keishou-hen 「Movie Promotion」
description:
Before the release of The Irregular at Magic High School - Yotsuba Succession Arc in theatres on Friday, May 8th, 2026, here is a manga compilation that lets you look back at the entire Mahouka anime series all at once!

As long as you read this, you’ll be able to enjoy the movie The Irregular at Magic High School: Yotsuba Succession Arc right away!

Let’s take a look back at the Mahouka anime together with the Shiba siblings!

title: Humor Me
description:
Les objectifs de Charlie dans la vie étaient assez simples : obtenir son diplôme d'études secondaires, devenir une adulte en bonne et due forme, prendre soin de son frère bien trop cultivé et s'assurer que les services sociaux ne comprennent pas que leur père s'était volatilisé.  
  
Ainsi, s'emparer de l'attention du célèbre James Hardford ne faisait certainement pas partie de ses plans, surtout quand il (comme tout le monde apparemment) pensait qu'elle était un garçon !  
  
(Nous avons décidé de ne plus poster ce webtoon sur cette plateforme pour des raisons pratiques, si ce projet vous intéresse, je vous invite à le retrouver sur notre site, qui vous mènera au liens vous permettant de le lire ^-^)

title: Megane na Kare to Fetish Kanojo
description: 僕の彼女は特殊だーー。心春と伊吹先輩はつき合い始めたばかりのカップル。超弩級のメガネフェチ・心春にとって、伊吹先輩は優しくてカッコよくて、さらにメガネが似合う最強彼氏！！クールな伊吹先輩は、心春の過剰なメガネ愛に振り回されつつも、そのまっすぐな愛情表現が嬉しくもあり…♡　お似合いな（バ）カップルのラブラブ青春コメディ

title: Vanilla
description: Morio is fascinated by his new high-school teacher Saeki-sensei. Despite Saeki-sensei's unsociable, cold and unfeeling attitude, Morio finds himself following his every move. But does Morio simply admire his new teacher, or does he desire something more…

title: Tabegoro 80's Tsushin
description: 1980s... Momoko, a cute little girl of the same age, moves next door to Toshifumi, the eldest son of the family who runs a lunchbox shop... Their bittersweet and tantalizing romance is enlivened by the popular culture and food habits of the 1980s, including Takenoko Zoku and Old Fashioned!

title: Oji Sama Wa Princess Ni Naritai
description: Rio Kuroe, is a high school girl who is treated like a prince by her classmates due to her good appearance. In reality, she loves cute things and dreams of a princess-like romance, but she hides her feelings, thinking they don't suit her. Then, Yuu Shirazawa, a boy she was close to when she was little, appears as a transfer student.

title: Pink de Ikou!
description: Ikumi is a schoolgirl who has a crush on Takase Hiroki, the most popular guy in school. However, Hiroki has refused the confessions of all the other girls, and it looks like he’s spurned Ikumi, too! But it looks like luck is on her side, because with her little brother Haruka, she is living in Hiroki’s house!

title: The Seven Mavericks
description: "Why don't you try and see if you can really change us?" I'm going to start a club with the bad guys of this school!? And if I fail, we'll all be kicked out...!

title: Nanako-san-teki na Nichijou SPIRITS
description: Set in a certain high school with nostalgic wooden school buildings in Hokkaidou in the Shouwa era, this is a story of healthy boy Kawara-kun and his classmate Nanako-san, a careless girl with a cute short haircut, weaving together laughter and lucky pervert moments!! This is the latest in the author's life's work, which has been published in different magazines for over 15 years.

title: Subarashiki Hibi - where happiness lives (Doujinshi)
description: Subarashiki Hibi doujinshi created by the original character designer Motoyon.

title: Rabu Yome
description: My husband is my homeroom teacher. Is there anything else to tell…

title: Everyday Every Night
description: Enohara Minato is an only child who was raised single-handedly by his father since young, after (believing) his mother passed away. When he skipped club activities one day, an exact replica of himself showed up, claiming to be his twin brother who was separated from him when their parents divorced. Just what is going on between their parents? And as more obstacles come his way, what will Minato and his twin’s relationship blossom into?

title: Gekkou no Sasayaki
description: A boy (Takuya) meets a girl (Satsuki), both 17 years of age, and they fall in love. When she discovers his fetishes, Satsuki brands Takuya a hentai (pervert) and leaves him, only to be drawn back by the power his fetishes give her over him.

title: Start Over
description: It's a love story between Hayami Akira, a high school first-year student who loves her hometown, and Tokinaga Rikichi, a boy who transferred from Tokyo with a cold attitude.

title: Hana Nusubito wa Shounen no Uchi
description:
Riko, a young lady who grew up in an adult world full of calculations, suddenly finds herself living at her cousin Masami's house after the death of her parents. 

Despite the drastic change in her environment, Riko finds a little happiness in living with Masami, whom she has admired for a long time, but there is another boy living in the house - Asagi, who is not related to her by blood. 

Riko is annoyed by Asagi, who is cheeky, impudent, and outspoken despite being younger than her, but on the other hand, she is moved by Asagi's honesty.

title: Ikemen Ni Tsugeraretanode OK Shitara Kain Nanba Datta Hanashi
description:
めちゃ顔が良い男子に告白された！
秒でOKしたら自分の他に3人も彼女がいた⁉︎
とんでもない4股野郎だけど、恋人を楽しませようという誠実さは抜群。
しかも彼女達と一緒にする推し活(交際)が楽しすぎる!!

title: Umi wa Aredomo, Kaze wa Kuku
description: Pink hair. Cup yakisoba for lunch. To other students, high school girl Lisa Kouda seems to be living without a care in the world. The fact that she knows they think of her like that... And the one she met behind the school building, who makes her heart feel restless... A striking one-shot that portrays a lively yet troubling youth!

title: Tough Love Baby
description: Three years ago, after realizing he had feelings not for his lover Keiko, but her little brother Sachi, Yoshino escaped the city. Once again, he has returned to his hometown and the last person he expects to meet appears before him.

title: Kimi o Wasurenai Tame no 101 no Koto
description: 「もしかして処女なんですか？」 傷ついた恋愛未経験のアラサー女子は年下イケメン男子大学生と出会い恋の練習をすることに…！？ ”絶対に忘れられない”、愛おしいほど甘い歳の差溺愛ラブストーリー

title: Futatsu no Tamashii
description: Jason Misawa is a typical high school boy until the night he gets attacked along with Yumi by an unusual creature. He is almost dead when a voice offers him power, and when he awakes he sees that he is a different person. He views the real demonic faces that are masked by the ordinary people, the mark on his hand can overpower the strongest, and he starts to be in peril constantly. Jason wants to know what took place that night, what this power signifies, and the reason why these monsters are manifesting in his life.

title: Nae-soong 9th Grade Project
description:
Who would have thought that Jung areum, the beauty queen of school had a sister with no other hobby than stealing people's food??  
  
Well this girl is no other than Jung Daum, whose number one fan of hers is the popular school idol Ju-Junk!! And WHO would have imagined that Jung Daum is head over heels in love with him??!! But of course, things don't go that easy… cause cute and two-faced big sister likes him too!!

title: Cicadas Do Not Cry When it Rains
description:
"차라리 내가 죽었어야 했던 거지?"
 
초등학교 시절. 우연히 일어난 교통사고로 친구를 잃은 도찬.
도찬은 사고 후. 죽은 친구의 모습이 되어 살아가기 시작하는데...
그 날 있었던 사고로 각기 다른 삶을 살아가게 된 다섯 명의 친구들이 조우하면서 벌어지는 성장 드라마.

title: Haikyu!! - Moshimo Hinata no Seibetsu ga Chigatte Itara to Iu (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kageyama x female! Hinata

title: Bokura no Pink
description: Momoko is a fan of Hero shows, like the Power Rangers. The boy she liked in Junior High says mean things about her obsession and breaks her heart. In High School, Momoko tries to reinvent herself, and throws away all her Hero souvenirs. But at school, she is asked to join a Hero Club with 3 tall, handsome members who dress up as Hero characters and patrol the school. They want her to be their Pink Ranger. Even though the other girls are jealous, Momoko is too scarred by her past to embrace her love of Hero stories, and she doesn't get along at all with the Red Ranger.

title: Uniform
description:
This is a collection of tied stories of classmates and their love lives revolving around their "cute school uniform".  
  
Everyone wears the same uniform, but underneath, everyone has a unique story. Three conjoined shorts give a glimpse of what makes each student different.

title: Kataomoi Fever
description: Risa, Tomohiro, and Utaya are childhood friends who have been best friends since elementary school and they're now attending the same high school. One day, Tomohiro falls in love with Maeda-senpai at first sight, and something terrible happens. Risa gets anxious and takes the plunge to confess to Tomohiro. However, Tomohiro, who is desperate for Maeda-senpai's affections, cannot accept her. Meanwhile, another childhood friend, Shinya, confesses his feelings to Risa... High school students in the heat of love throw their best effort! Is there a way out of this labyrinth of love where everyone has unrequited love...!?

title: Mr. FAYUDARA'S
description: 4-Koma Comic which tells the story of a man named Raffi who is the head of study program at a university. But his life doesn't go smoothly because his friends Fath, Yuan, Dandy and Shafa always act strangely which makes his life difficult. Will Raffi be able to survive?

title: Sukishiki Yuujoujutsu
description:
1) Unmei no Hito  
Sensei always looks out the window and sees a student running. There, he started falling in love with him. But the sensei has a fiance and drama starts when the student also falls in love.  
  
2-5) Sukishiki Yuuyoujyutsu  
Hiraiwa and Harui are best friends, and neighbors. Hiraiwa loves Harui very much, but Harui always says that its "None of his business" or, "I don't care". Suddenly, Hiraiwa has to take a tough decision between leaving Harui to work in Osaka, or stay in college with Harui.

title: Day by Bae
description: A story of a village girl named Sarmi Rahayu Ning Tyas (Hayu), who's very happy to change her ordinary life. She recklessly moved to the city to attend a university and help her mother's business who makes traditional herbal medicine. Unexpectedly, she met Rendaru Ganendra (Ndaru), her childhood friend that she hasn't seen for years. His face changed drastically, he's taller, has clearer skin, and is definitely Hayu's type. But sadly, he's surrounded by scary people and has a lot of bad rumors about him. Will Hayu stay by his side by accepting those rumors that will stick to her later?

title: Himitsu Note
description: A girl is in love with her teacher.

title: Anata ga Oshiete Kureta Koto
description:
1-3) It Is That You Taught  
Teacher trainee Nakatsumi Tetsuya is popular with his students except for one - Sano Tomo, who seems to hate him and keeps on ignoring him. When Testuya finally talks to him, giving Sano advice as a teacher, but Sano suddenly grabs Tetsuya and kisses him!  
  
4) Dream Bread  
Atsushi takes over the bakery when his father falls ill. He knows he's not as good as his father, but then a foreign looking boy named Mikoto declares that Atsushi will hand the bakery to him…  
  
5) Inside Work  
Manager Kubou is known for his stern approach and flawless beauty. When he's asked to have friendly Miyajima on his team, Kubou doesn't expect much from him. But Miyajima is full of surprises.  
  
6) The Thing You Seek  
Nakatsumi stops by the bakery to pick up some treats for Tomo from Atsushi and Mikoto. Miyajima stops in for a first time visit.

title: Asura: Destiny
description: A group of children train, love, and play at Asura, a school full of potential and stoutly independent amid a divided nation.

title: Mr. Doronko
description:
There was a kind middle school teacher nicknamed 'Mr. Doronko' by his students. Doronko is popular with his students because he gives them time to study freely, but not so popular with their parents. His students are seemingly good-for-nothings, but are planning for their lives after school. Doronko strives to be a great teacher to his students.


Also contains "Gutaro's 1000 Nights": A young man gets involved in odd situations. 

-Ticket to "Unhappy Station": 
Gutaro falls for a homely but kind girl.

-Delma the Woman Commander: Gutaro discovers a UFO on the roadside.

-Different Dimension: Gutaro gets hypnotized by a radio program.
