title: Houkago - Kindan no Lesson
description:
From momiji\_mii's livejournal:  
  
It's a story about retaliation and deals with the corruption of the Japanese police and how it puts people in danger. Mizuki, whose father is a policeman, falls for the new teacher and starts a relationship. But her teacher seems to be connected to her father in some way…

title: Rinko-chan no Blue Day
description: With the help of her friends, Rinko-chan managed to be the girlfriend of Hatomi-kun, the guy she likes who is very brusque and at the same time very kind, but … even if they are already engaged … She still has an unrequited love? Does not matter! Rinko-chan will do her best for Hatomi-kun to fall in love with her with the perfect date.

title: Tooi Nemuri
description:
1-3. Tooi Nemuri  
After the death of his best friend, Chizumi, the young president of a sweets-maker company, decided to adopt his late friendâ€™s son, Ibuki. As Chizumi watches Ibuki grow, Ibuki became more and more the spitting image of his father which made Chizumi unable to help but be reminded of the time when Natsume was still alive. Fortunately for him, Yatabe is always there to share his burden of the past among other things… And then one day, Ibuki confessed his love for Chizumi!?  
  
4. Unmei no Anata  
A high-school student who moves from partner to partner is in trouble when an ex-lover reappears looking for revenge.

title: World of Four Dimensions
description:
(from ebookjapan):

On a planet inhabited by those who have escaped from the Earth just before it was swallowed by the sun. Jack lives in a cave with his grandfather, where he paints on the walls. 

He is weak and cannot hunt like the other men. Maya, who had been the model for his paintings, grows weary of him and leaves on a journey with Mu, a stronger man. The world of survival of the fittest has begun. (Chapter 4).

title: Honnouji-san & Rikutsugi-kun Just Started Going Out
description:
Updated irregularly.
___
[Alt Official Raw (pixiv)](https://www.pixiv.net/user/39090740/series/57357)

title: Momoten Musume
description:
[From Impossibility]:  
Hikaru doesn't excel in school or is an 'ideal' student like her sister. In order to get her grades up, her mother hires one of her classmates, Momo, to help tutor her.

title: Oshi ga Tonari de Netemashite
description:
Hatsuka Shirai, who is on the run from a love affair with a childhood friend, finds solace in the mysterious and cool Yanaseori, who is very popular at school and her "crush." Then, Hatsuka's parents go abroad on a business trip, and she is sent to live with an acquaintance. She was told that her classmate's son was there, but when she woke up the next day, she found Yanaseori sleeping next to her...? When Hatsuka jumps out of bed, Ori gently touches her and says, "Good morning, Shirai." 

The roommate is a surprise! The sweet approach from the guy of your dreams will not stop your heart from pounding!

title: Akuma no Kao o Shiteiru
description: Pairing: Gojo Satoru x Itadori Yuuji

title: Ninja Boy Kabamaru
description:
The eponymous protagonist is a naive young ninja from the Iga province called Kagemaro (absolute shadow), nicknamed Kabamaru (hippo's mouth) for his insatiable appetite. After the death of his strict grandfather and ninja sensei, Kabamaru moves to Tokyo with one of his grandfather’s acquaintances. The plot deals mainly with Kabamaru adjusting to an urban lifestyle after spending a childhood in the mountains and how he finds himself caught up in the rivalry between two private schools.

Note: Was adapted into 24 episode TV series (1983) and a movie.

title: Kyoto Shimogamo Kamisama No Isoro
description: Harumiya Moeko, a first-year high school student living with relatives near the Shimogamo Shrine in Kyoto, is an ordinary teenager. Her "idol" is her childhood friend, Kamori Ryo a handsome young man who saved her when she was a child. Now that Ryo is a university student, Moeko worships him as a “living god” and enjoys peaceful days dedicated to her “idol activities.” However, occasionally a mysterious entity known as the “god’s servant” visits Moeko’s home—?

title: Fever
description:
This series is not about romance, exactly, but does contain the element for it. This series mainly focuses on overcoming the main characters' hardships. Each character has a different hardship. There is really nothing more to mention about the plot.  
  
It starts with a school girl who has trouble with her surroundings. It all started when her classmate was bullied and eventually commited suicide. Being a part of the group that bullied the girl, she feels extremely guilty. Her life becomes meaningless, and she wants to end it.

title: My Blossoming Summer
description: Relationships. Noun, "The way in which two or more concepts, objects, or people are connected, or the state of being connected."  A story about students in a school in modern japan & their evolving, or blossoming, if you can say, relationships. Be it best friends, enemies & potential lovers. Anything can go in this funny Rom-Com Manga. This is My Blossoming Summer!

title: Koyubi wa Amaku Sasayaku
description: Ever since he was very young, Tomonari Yui has been able to see something no one else can see - the red thread of fate which connects the little fingers of people who are fated to be together. But he's never been able to see the person on the other end of his red thread… until now.

title: Himitsu wa Koi no Hajimari
description:
This love comedy is about a girl who joins a party pretending to be an adult and falls in love with a teacher, who doesn't realize that he's dating a student.  
Included one-shots: Ikemen Hajimemashita, Kimi-iro Shashin

title: Casual Nightmares
description: For most people, having your crush confess their love to you, would be the greatest feeling in the world. But not for this loner. His life just got harder. Join him as he attempts to navigate love, responsibilities, school and protecting the girl of his dreams from lurking danger.

title: Warui Hito
description:
From Summer Rain:  
The moment my eyes met his, both my body and heart have gotten stolen.  
  
Includes the One-Shot: *Dare Dattakke? Suzuki-kun*

title: Hokori
description: Kumai Mai’s favorite things include bears, bears and… her senpai who frequently hangs out in the library. The thing is though, she isn’t exactly sure what she feels for her senpai. In order to find out, she exacts the help of her handmade teddy bear, Schubert! What fate awaits her?

title: Return
description:
This mildly innocent oneshot depicts the story of 2 different high-school girls, Yuzuki and Akane, as they crash into each other at the school's corridor and wake up in the infirmary with amnesia. As a result, both of their current love relationships take an unexpected turn…  
  
*Also includes three other stories:  
  
- Baribari Lovers!!! -  
A bittersweet high-school story depicting the follow-up between a cute but naive girl and a bad-boy delinquent who tramples with her innocent heart. You sway along with the main female–even when her heart breaks… You may have a undying urge to punch that gangster >.<  
  
- Koimitsu  
  
- 2U

title: Konna Panic
description: Mai Kisaragi was born as a shy, and cowardly person; always allowing people to take advantage of her. The object of her affection is the school's basketball star, Takumi Kai. This is where the story might have begun and ended… if something strange hadn't happened. Tired of being mocked one day, she suddenly gains a supernatural power during basketball practice. And soon, she is visited by a fox spirit named Ran who informs her that she is, in fact, a ​part fox spirit. At first, she doesn't believe him… until she transforms into a fox herself.

title: Yowamushi Pedal - Tokkouyaku wo, Hitotsu (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Teshima Junta x Aoyagi Hajime

title: Oyayubihime Infinity
description:
Long ago, couple suicides were common, but some left with unfinished business. Now some 'destined couples' have been reincarnated in the present day. Each has a reminder of the past: a butterfly-shaped birthmark on their thumbs. When the marks touch, they catch a glimpse of their shared past, though what they see doesn't always match.   
Tsubame insists that he and Kanoko are fated to be together. By the time Kanoko finds out it's not true, it's too late: she's already fallen for him. The "butterfly" friends must reconcile their ties to the past with their present desire for fun and romance!

title: Itoshi no Kiteretsu
description: High school girl Moeko lives for the girls' manga magazine Marin. Her childhood friend Renma once borrowed Marin from Moeko and became obsessed with girls' manga, and is now the number one popular young writer with a serialized manga in Marin. Though the two are always fighting, Moeko takes pride in supporting Koi as the number one fan of his manga. She had always believed she only loved “Koi's manga,” but she unexpectedly realizes she has developed feelings for Koi him..

title: Walking in the Rain
description: Yu Xiyu was a famous idol, but he was defamed due to a scandalous misunderstanding. He decides to go back to school, but is still being ostracized and shamed on by his peers. Despite having bad days in school, he won't let it get in the way with the help of his new friends

title: Orangenia na Hibi
description:
1-3) Love is in the air for another Kunisaki brother as the school carnival approaches. Rehearsals have begun, and Satsuki is hungry. Jumping out of the window may be one way to get away, but his ever-vigilant watchdog, Kunisaki Yamaji, is soon there to bring him back. As rehearsals for the school carnival continue, someone seems to be out to sabotage the play and Satsuki. Can Yamaji protect his precious Satsuki? Does Satsuki really need protecting?  
  
4) A one-shot that follows lovers Ginka and Kakei-senpai. Ginka and Kakei-senpai are both looking forward to their planned overnight trip during Golden Week, but Kakei-senpai doesn't show up. No phone call, no message… Kakei-senpai is gone. What happened? What is Ginka supposed to do? Has this little uke been abandoned?  
  
5-6) Mikami Yuusuke seems to be quite the gentleman, using his wealth and power to take care of many unfortunate men and women. Ichihashi Rui, a student in Mikami's school of design, is one of those unfortunates. N

title: My Fate Lies With You
description: A Loner With The Mysterious Power To Reverse Time Within 5 Minutes Tries To Stop A Girl From Jumping Off The Roof. Will This Be A Wholesome Love Story Or An Endless Nightmare?

title: Acurst
description: Akihiko Meiko returns for her second semester at a new school, in a world where all sees her as foe she finds the will to get through the day... one that will soon change everything...

title: Haikyu!! - Time Of The Beast (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Hinata is constantly hungry and craving and Kageyama decides to "feed" his boyfriend and to fill him to satisfaction.

title: Tonari no Seki no James-kun
description:
Mutsumi has always struggled to express herself—so much so that she eventually gave up on speaking altogether. But her quiet world is shaken when a foreign transfer student who can’t speak Japanese is seated next to her! Communications barriers won’t stop this heartwarming story about girl who can’t speak and a boy who can’t be understood.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: The Best Skilled Surgeon - The King of Neet
description:
This is a sequel to Saijou no Meii. Dr. Mogami currently has two major problems on his mind. The first is that the young, genius surgeon from the previous series, Saijou Mikoto, has fallen terribly ill. The second is his delinquent, shut-in son, Yoshiaki. He just knows that Yoshiaki has a lot of potential, but he's failed at raising him. Yoshiaki is nothing but a lazy, arrogant, spoiled brat.

After Dr. Mogami kicks him out of the house, in hopes that it will do him good, Yoshiaki crashes with his childhood friend Date Masamune. Date is also something of a punk, but, to Yoshiaki's surprise, he's decided to try to study to become a doctor. The combined efforts of Date and his father slowly nudge him back on track. After a near-tragic occurrence, Yoshiaki even begins to think that maybe he should become a doctor, too!

title: Hoppe ni Gohan
description: Ichitaro's father passed away before he was born and he was brought up single handedly by his mother. Because of that, he has a really strong mother complex. One day, Asai Moeko, a new transfer student arrived and grabbed everyone's attention as her famous lawyer brother comes along for the introduction. However, bigger surprise came along for Ichitaro as he found out that Moeko is a widow with a 4 year old child?!

title: Yamagata Girl Mary-san
description:
**Notes:**
- “henako” is a Yamagata dialectal way of saying “girl” (normally “onnanoko”).
- Published in the Shounen Magazine Edge February 2020 Issue.

title: Muteki no Banken ni Kamitsukaremashite
description:
It's awful when sometimes you're being watched...
An uncontrollable mad dog unbound by rules is the unrivaled watchdog that protects me...

I expected to live an ordinary life. As well as school life and spending time with friends, everything. But that possibility has been destroyed. I was brought to a an unknown world. By this man...By Ryouma's hand.

title: A Kiss to Save the World
description: "You're my soulmate! Marry me!" ...he said, on the first day we met. The day he kissed me, my whole world was thrown into disarray!

title: Netsujou Innocence
description:
1) LV Style  
Hijiri is a well known defense attorney, Takaki is a shrewd prosecutor, they are rivals in court but in their personal life there is nothing but love to each other…  
  
2) Nine Lives  
Story about Rio and his friends - Taki and the twins Kai and Sora - from their school days.  
  
3) Yubisaki no Kiseki (Side Story)  
Iori always stays after practice to spend time with his boyfriend Tsuguri in the art room. Tsuguri's obsessed with capturing a likeness of him, on paper or sculpture. But he can't seem to get it right.  
  
4) Rasen no Tou (The Spiral Tower)  
Up and coming designer, Rio Nanase, has lived with the guilt of letting a friend fall off a balcony when he was young. Then one day, he meets the young owner of a penthouse that he designed! Keiichiro Nagato is his name and he brings Rio to an observatory against his will. There the acrophobic Rio begins to tell the truth about what happened 17 years ago, a truth no else has heard before…  
  
5) Feather Ring (Rasen no

title: Kimi to Boku no Kuchi
description:
Year 20XX. A world where because of a new infectious disease, covering one's mouth with a mask has become part of the culture.

**Alt Official Raws:** [X](https://x.com/a_akito17/status/1296064480405725185), [X Extra 1](https://x.com/a_akito17/status/1297316691366445056), [X Extra 2](https://x.com/a_akito17/status/1300769759013691392), [X Extra 3](https://x.com/a_akito17/status/1317089054991687681)

title: Wagamama na Junai
description: Miyo has just gathered up all her courage and is about to confess her love to her long-time crush Honda-kun. However, things don't go quite like how Miyo planned. In a strange mishap, Miyo ends up confessing her love, but not to Honda (who has boarded the train and is now behind doors that are sliding shut)! Instead, when she opens her eyes to peek at her love interest to see what his reaction to her declaration is, she is shocked to see another guy standing in front of her. A very... large... guy. A very... intimidating and mean looking guy...

title: Revenge Love
description: "Let's...go back to being just friends." After dating for six months, Sakura was dumped by her childhood friend, Ren. She tries her best to move on, but when she sees her ex-boyfriend on her first day of high school, she realizes that her feelings for him still haven't faded…Maybe there is still a chance for them? After all, she still loves him.

title: Hoshi no Ko!
description: One night, Akihiko Hiroi was looking up at the sky from a window when he spotted a shooting star. Then, a girl named Kanae suddenly appeared, calling herself the "Fulfillment Star" and saying she had come to grant wishes. Akihiko long kept feelings for his classmate Komako Uehara, but had not been able to confess his feelings, so he decided to take the plunge and ask for Kanae's help...

title: Honey & Cigarettes
description: Jay Vaughn is your average teenager; he likes loud music, has a messy room, and is often late to class. His life is average at best on a good day, but how will his life change on the day Quintessa Beaumont is transferred to his school? Will the two be the perfect match, or will things with them go up in flames? This is a story of love and loss, separation and reunion, including many intertwining characters and storylines, LGBT romance, and polyamorous relationships.

title: Blue Sky Men
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A single deadly bullet marks the beginning of an endless struggle. Fight, Matsuri Tawaruta!　To crush the ambition of his father's avengers, the Kido clan, to rule Japan!

title: Renai Jikaku Shoujou
description:
1-5) Renai Jikaku Shoujou  
The beautiful, strong Agatsuma Tamaki has a weakness~ his kohai* (*junior in age or rank), Sawamura Kei, who simply just drives Tamaki up the wall by his mere existence. On one fateful night, Tamaki’s guilty secret was discovered by no other than…! Will romance blossom between this wild but emotionally inept couple?  
  
6) Kimi to Boku no Itsu Pobun  
Horiuchi has always been precognitive and his cousin always gave him a hard time for that. Now his bully of a cousin has to stay with his family temporarily and his ribbing doesn't stop. Oneshot also found in [Saikou no Kimi](https://mangadex.org/title/24834/saikou-no-kimi)  
  
7) Afterword

title: D'Princess
description:
Saint Laure Academy is an academy for people who aren't human but want to learn how to co-exist with humans. Ranko is a princess with the bloodline of a dragon. She falls in love with a normal human boy, Toranosuke. How will this unforgivable forbidden love unfold?

(from mangaupdates)

title: I Want to Escape the Earth
description:
I get embarrassed easily and really want to escape from this earth.

This new semester, I met a long-haired, beautiful girl who is the exact opposite of me.

Wait, no, it's a handsome guy, and social anxiety doesn't seem to be in his vocabulary! I end up witnessing him doing the most random things in the weirdest places...Ahhhh! I really really want to escape from the earth!

title: Kotaro Makaritoru! L
description: Kotaro's mother returns with mysterious ninja organization chasing after her.

title: Kiruto S
description: A year and a half has passed since the abominable murder. Kirito and Ryuji had forgotten everything and were enjoying their high school life. However, everything is about to begin. Revenge is not over yet...

title: Anata ni Oitsukenai
description: An ugly rumour breaks Rae and Suura apart, will they come back together? How? A completed project, compiled of nine acts, by mangaka Kawachi Yukari.

title: Kuroko no Basket - Vanilla Essence (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Persona 4 - Natsuiro Hokaugo Inspiration (Doujinshi)
description: A story set in summer following the Protagonist, Chie Satonaka and ice cream shenanigans!

title: Black Ink - Shortcuts
description:
A collection of short stories of different genres.  
(This comic is read from Left to Right)  
  
Note: I will post what I have finished translating so the order would be random. I'll update the tags as I post new chapters.

title: Aimai Blue Beast
description: This is a coming-of-age love story centered on Suzuka Hanamori, who moves to Tokyo to follow her favorite idol group. Suzuka had planned to devote her entire youth to supporting her favorite idol, but her favorite member, Fuji, suddenly leaves the group. Devastated, Suzuka enters high school and encounters Fuji at the entrance ceremony...?!

title: A Sweet-Talking Romance
description:
One day, Seok-woo, a third-year photography student, receives an offer from a famous magazine.

His heart races with excitement… but the person he’s recently been seeing around might just be a ghost?!
To decide whether to shoot Seok-woo — someone mysteriously tied to a strange photo — the editor decides to hold an open casting.

Then, an odd and unpredictable applicant shows up.

“You want to model for the ‘Nameless’ photo?”

A mysterious and charming freshman model slowly begins entering Seok-woo’s world…

❝Can Seok-woo capture that ‘nameless’ shot and make his debut through the magazine?❞

A heartwarming and romantic journey begins!

title: Kujirano-san's After School
description: Published in the Shounen Magazine Edge April 2020 Issue.

title: Hot Guys Have Something Special
description: Our young heroine - Choi Lee Na. She has a brother who's the leader of a gang of four members. All four of them are arrogant and one of them seems to be a playboy. On one stormy night, Lee Na somehow bumps into one of them and cant forget him ever since then. Is this the beginning of love?

title: Love Loser
description:
언제까지 썸만 탈꺼야? 이제 연애할 때도 됐잖아!
매번 사랑에 실패하는 러브 루저들에게 다섯커플이 사랑하는 방법을 적나라하게 보여준다!

title: Sour & Sweet
description:
Jung Dan Bi accidentally collides into top model Jung Ee Dun, plastering a piece of her toast onto his shirt. Not having enough time to even take the blame she ran off telling him to…  
  
- [Original (Naver)](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=41472)

title: Seiten Nari!
description: Growing up in a single parent family, she longed to have a father and brothers. Imagine her excitement after hearing that her mother's remarriage will fulfill her wishes! However, upon arriving at her new home, she accidentally swallowed their family treasure and gains some unknown powers, even becoming her new "brother's" slave! From then on, her life began to change.

title: Kanade no Lala
description:
金髪ギャルの女子高生、田中ララは毎日何か物足りなさを感じていた。そんなある日、ララは学校で絵の天才と言われる少年、奏と出会い人生を一変させる。
超絶ポジティブ金髪ギャル×不器用な天才画家、美術の世界を舞台に恋愛以上恋人未満な青春ドラマ始まります！

title: Saioshi Kouryaku Taishou ga Iru noni, Tutorial de Shinitaku Arimasen!
description:
推しキャラへの愛で、破滅回避してみせます！

ごく普通のOLが目を覚ますと、そこは大好きな乙女ゲームの世界だった。でも、彼女が転生したのはゲーム序盤で倒されるモブ令嬢のアンリエッタ！？しかも、最推しキャラのエルヴィスはゲームとまるで違う性格で――愛する本物のエルヴィス様を取り戻すため、彼女は死亡エンドの回避を決意する！前向きに頑張るうちに、なぜか他の攻略対象たちの好感度も急上昇して――！？

title: Osamu Tezuka Essay Collection
description:
The remaining 18 volumes of the 400 *Osamu Tezuka Manga Complete Works* were volumes containing Tezuka's Essays, Public Talks, Lectures, Scenarios, Novels, and even guides on how to draw manga. 

The volumes are as follows(order based on release):
- Osamu Tezuka Essay Collection Volume 1 - Includes the very famous *I am a Mangaka* (Boku wa Mangaka) essay from Tezuka.
- [Osamu Tezuka Novel Collection](https://mangadex.org/title/fc5cf3e1-33d9-45d5-8a48-6fa100616fc3/osamu-tezuka-novel-collection)
- [Osamu Tezuka’s Special Manga Course](https://mangadex.org/title/e8f66fd8-6bfe-4486-97a0-879ecb659b6c/osamu-tezuka-s-special-manga-course)
- Osamu Tezuka’s Scenario Collection
- Osamu Tezuka Essay Collection Volume 2
- Osamu Tezuka Talk Collection Volume 1
- Osamu Tezuka Essay Collection Volume 3
- Osamu Tezuka Talk Collection Volume 2
- [Secrets of Osamu Tezuka’s Manga](https://mangadex.org/title/cdc592bc-9b01-460d-b839-2e784966a4d5/secrets-of-osamu-tezuka-s-manga)
- Osamu Tezuka Essay Collect

title: My Hero Academia - CHAPTER### (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Dakara Kaneda wa Koi ga Dekinai
description:
From MangaHelpers:  
  
Ako is a student at an art university, though she's far from the top of the class. One day, the head of the school is removed due to illness and an extremely logical-minded young man named Kaneda Masumi takes his place. Masumi looks like a businessman, and he starts by making logical economic steps for the school–by dramatically increasing tuition for the following year. Ako doesn't want to ask her grandmother to support her with even more money, and after getting the bottom grade (E) on an assignment, she doesn't think she has a shot at a scholarship. When she breaks down in tears while talking over her options with Kaneda, he treats her with unexpected kindness, telling her to have more faith in herself. Now Ako is determined to work her way into a scholarship position, but she and her friends' ways of thinking still constantly clash with Kaneda's logical view of the world!

title: Sakura no Hana no Koucha Ouji
description: The manga centers on Yoshino, a girl who enacts a ritual to curse the arranged marriage partner that her father set her up with. However, something goes wrong, and instead she summons the "Black Tea Prince" Sakura. Sakura once served Yoshino's great-great-grandmother Yae.

title: Ordinary Fantasy Girl
description: “I’m a normal girl.” Everyone uses it casually, but what does normal mean? High school girl Sayuri suddenly became concerned about this. Even though she has a boyfriend of the same age, isn't it normal for her to indulge in a relationship with Youji, whom she met at a disco? Is Mr. Shirai, the office lady who follows Yoji, an ordinary person? Aren't high school girls just normal women? In the first place, what is normal love or dating? I thought I was getting sentimental, but wouldn't you also think about what "normal" means through Sayuri, who looks at us with cold eyes? (With a newly written afterword)

title: Ijiwaru na Aitsu
description: Cute, simple-minded Tomo Masaki has a brother complex, Tomo so adores his older brother Ei that he studied hard to get into Kouryou Academy, where Ei is a popular senior and Student Council President. Now the bane of Tomo's existence is Ei's best friend and Student Council Vice-president, Motoki Izumi. For some reason, Izumi always bullies and teases Tomo whenever he comes to the student council room to pay his brother a visit. Why can't Izumi just stop it and leave him alone? More importantly, why does Tomo's heart pound whenever Izumi does bully him?! Sometimes, Izumi's even nice to Tomo–which only makes his heart beat faster!

title: Plastics
description: Fujimoto Hajime is a third year high school student who has been dating his teacher Nakajima Keigo for the past six months, but he feels they're in an uneven relationship. Hajime's always the one to seduce Nakajima, and even though Nakajima's birthday is coming up he won't let Hajime buy him a present! Has Hajime been mistaken about their relationship this whole time?

title: Spring-Fallen Classroom And Two Fools
description: JinWook is happy that his childhood friend SeungMin returned after he moved away years ago. As the two grow closer, their friend YoungJae grows jealous of their intimacy. A love triangle forms between three boys in the cool spring season of their senior high school life

title: Attacker You!
description: Attacker You! is the story of ambitious and energetic thirteen year-old junior high schoolgirl You (pronounced Yoh) Hazuki, who moves to Tokyo from the Japanese countryside to live with her father Toshihiko, a cameraman recently returned from Peru, and attend school. You's mother is not in the picture, having left when You was very young. Also living with You and her father is her younger brother Sunny, who is very attached to his older sister and tends to follow her everywhere she goes, including to school and to her volleyball matches. However, You's father is not supportive of her volleyball playing, and You is puzzled as to why he gets so angry about it.

title: Bokura No PolyRhythm
description: It has been one year since the band was formed. The band thought it was getting on track, but all the members except Natsuo left the band. Natsuo was very disappointed, but he still wanted to continue his band activities...?

title: 9 Banme no Musashi - Ghost and Gray
description: After defeating the threat of the assassination group "Jet Black Frogs," Musashi is on a new mission, but he and several journalists are detained by an armed group in a certain village...?

title: Tokidoki, Sekai wa Utsukushii
description:
From Fantasyshrine:  
  
High School Senior, Yokozeki Haruhito has always been watching the teacher-in training, Arisawa Yuya. However, this doesn't go unnoticed by Yuya's cousin, Yuma. Yuma volunteered to be Yuya's substitute. Things started to escalate when one day Yuya walked in on them while they were kissing…

title: The Story Of A Gloomy Girl And A Delinquent Boy Who Sit Next To Each Other
description: One day, Saki, an aspiring manga artist and gloomy girl, ends up sitting next to Shuu, a delinquent in her class who she never wanted to be involved with, due to a seat change. This incident causes Saki's daily life to fall apart little by little.

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Shinario wo Shiranai ~Otome Game no Sekai de Shinjitsu no Koi wo Sagashimasu!~
description: Marie has had memories of her past life since she was five years old. Upon entering the academy, she finally realizes that the world she’s living in is the setting of an otome game her little sister loved! However, she barely remembers the characters or the story. Since she knows nothing, she decides to take it easy and aim for a wonderful romance. But soon, she finds herself attracting the affection of the very love interests who are supposed to be vying for the protagonist…!?

title: Osamu Tezuka Uncollected Manga Works
description:
*Works that were not collected in the Tezuka 400 released in 1978 due to Tezuka losing the originals, but collected in the Tezuka bunko. The first volume has the work Hurricane Z as a bonus.*

The first volume includes:
- Galaxy Boy (Ginga Shounen) - Serialized from April 1953-February 1954 in Funny Book (Omoshiro Book)
- Cyrano the Magnificent (Cyrano de Bergerac) - Serialized from April to November 1953 in Shonen Illustrated (Shounen Gaho)
- President Bean (Mame Daitoryo) - Serialized from October 1953 to December 1954 in Adventure King (Bouken-O)
- [Hurricane Z](https://mangadex.org/title/62df625c-2ce4-4e5e-861a-4cc5c284094c/hurricane-z)

The second volume includes:

- Treasure Island (Takarajima) - Published as kashihon on March 1st, 1947 by Fuji Shuppansha
- Prof. Bat and Jim (Bat-hakase to Jim) published as kashihon on July 15th, 1947 by Arifundo 
- The Mysterious Dr. Koronko (Kaijin Koronko-hakase) - Published as kashihon on October 5th, 1947 by Doumei Shuppansha
- The Memoirs o

title: Shirogane Shiro no Shitsukekata
description: こんな猛犬の飼い主になったつもりはありません！　ドキドキ刺激的な""しつけラブ""、開幕♡

title: Bye-Bye Love-Letters
description: Emi, a writer of short stories, is in love with Tsuzuki from the art club. She finds herself writing him love letter after love letter, but will she ever actually give him one of the letters?

title: Ichigo to Anzu
description: Identical twins–and they couldn't be more different. Friendly outgoing Anzu is in love with Makoto, but can't work up the nerve to confess. Shy withdrawn Ichigo (the one with the glasses) was a stalking victim and now hates men. But they're going to need each other to cope with a huge change in their lives. Their mother has remarried and the twins discover they've gained a brother as well; clever and carefree Kenta. And Kenta (with Makoto) has a plan to help Ichigo–just make the twins trade identities!

title: Drifting Train 000
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Dai Oyama, a struggling student attending junior high school while working part-time, mistakenly boards a train that is not on the timetable and should not exist. The name of the train is the "Drifting Main Line 000". 

Oyama, who has obtained a commuter pass for the infinite section of the 000 that travels through time, sets off on a journey through time and space, guided by the mysterious beauty, Mavis! Upon alighting at a station named Nishimujidani (西無時谷), Oyama sees a city where time has been suspended in the pursuit of eternal peace and happiness... 

A space-time romance epic by Leiji Matsumoto!

title: Minna, Kataomoi Bakari Shite Iru.
description: Chika falls in love with the senpai from athletic club. When finally they get along together, Chika finds herself in guilty as she knows Hiro has already had his beloved…

title: Girl (Jeon Young Hui)
description: The story is about Jung Won who lives with her mother, a florist. One day, when her mother is on an errand, a wounded boy, Ha Jun, who is her classmate suddenly enters the shop. Jung Won is a quiet and shy girl whereas Ha Jun is the popular boy. Will this night change things between them?

title: Shihai Ren'ai: Control Love
description: Hiyori has dreamt of competing on her high school swim team her entire life, but when a shoulder injury makes it difficult for her to swim, those dreams are crushed. To make matters worse, she'll also lose her scholarship. While all this is happening, student president Masahi decides to take an interest in Hiyori, but he seems hell-bent on controlling her. Is he doing this out of concern, love or something else...?

title: Princess
description: Kokona, daughter from the Eda family, and Hiro, the son of Kawai family, who has been serving as bodyguard her family for many generations, were engaged by their parents. She likes him. He seems to feel no feelings towards her.

title: Trouble in the Classroom
description: Sagigo, a high school girl, befriends a bunch of male delinquent friends who are making a bet when the teacher will quit his job. They will go to any means to do so. What side will Sagigo side take? The teacher's or her friends' side?

title: Tenshi-kun, Attack!
description: The head of the class, Asami Minami, is transferred to her class by Tenshi Higashimaru, aka Tenshi-kun, who has a nice face and a good head, but he is too natural! As she is pushed around by him, she gradually falls in love with him, but...?

title: Neo Girl
description: Lee Soon-Hee, a very athletic girl with extraordinary acrobatic skills, lives with her older brother who is a teenage genius. Her brother is already an instructor at a university, he tends to get annoyed by his younger sister's laziness and mischievous acts. A new neighbor moves in. He is a popular, self-centered, upperclassmen pretty boy. He seems to have taken interest in her due to her unique athletic features, which changes her normal lifestyle. How will Soon-Hee's new surroundings progress to?

title: Sharin no Kuni, Himawari no Shoujo
description:
In the near future. In a not so distant place. There exists a society where law is based upon deterrence and criminals are assigned "obligations" fitting for their crimes. Within this society, a man named Morita Kenichi aspires to the position of Special High Class Individual, one who holds authority over said criminals.

For the purpose of fulfilling his ambition, Kenichi returns to the town he once called home. There he will encounter three girls bearing "obligations" and the past he left behind. Won't you join him in this story about how people relate to their society?

title: Shining Nananana
description: After being bullied and living as a reclusive loner addicted to gaming, she gains the courage through Chan, whom she met in a brilliant game. Could a disguise help her go outside? And on the day she went out in disguise for the first time, she couldn't even recognize the girl who used to torment her...?!From wigs, contact lenses, makeup, posture, to voice tone, she transforms her appearance and decides to go back to school. With this new look, she's confident! But the guy she ends up living with in a share house is so cold towards her! But... could that guy possibly...? Can she manage to keep her double life as "Bright" a secret?

title: Kao Mishiranai Koibito
description: A poor-sighted 100-eyed demon and a scar-covered pulleyneck. They start dating while hiding their insecurities from each other…!? A youkai youth romantic comedy begins!

title: Nami Yori mo Odayaka de, Hoshi Yori mo Aoku
description: It's the spring of my second year of high school. I meet my childhood friend, a boy and a girl, and a transfer student. Our story, which is still colorless, begins to take on a gentle tone.

title: Short Circuit Love
description: Seol Jaeha and Lee Hyun have been best friends since childhood. They do nearly everything together, and despite Jaeha’s unprecedented popularity at school, he only has eyes for Hyun. Enter the new transfer student (and Jaeha’s personal nightmare), Kim Doyoung. Hyun and Doyoung spend more and more time together every day, leaving less time for Jaeha to make his move. What’s worse, Doyoung is icing him out for some unknown reason, all while growing ever closer to Hyun. The two seemingly butt heads at every turn, and Jaeha simply cannot figure out why. The answer is simple: Doyoung sees Jaeha’s coy, flirtatious teasing of Hyun as bullying, and wants to protect his new friend. Their wires crossed, an unending cycle of misunderstandings and misfortunes between the rivals ensues; however, a fateful game of basketball just might spark something electric between them…

title: TheLastPierrot
description: My name is AI, and I am the author of TheLastPierrot, Bleak and Amague! visit my facebook: <https://www.facebook.com/TheDreamCatcherz>

title: Hiruyasumi No Ryugi
description: Shota Takada loves his lunch break more than anything. He looks forward to his favorite lunch, but there is one person who makes him popular. It is Sera from the same class. Having never seen her eat anything, Takada happens to share his lunch break with her and...?!

title: Koiheki
description: Riho has an annoying habit in relationships that means they rarely last. Then she coincidentally meets up with her first love, Mamiya, who she went to middle school with. Riho is genuinely delighted at their reunion, but Mamiya seems to be acting a little strange... This is a (chaotic) romantic comedy about college students with some fairly difficult romantic habits! Can you sympathize with them or not?

title: The Ant and The Giant
description:
A string of events involving two victims of war, and the giant camphor tree that binds them and watches over them.

---
**Volume 72 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

title: Soredemo Tsuyoku, Daitekure.
description:
One day on the way to school, Akio feels sick due to bad food he had eaten. Unfortunately he pukes on honor student Yanagisawa's uniform and passes out after that.   
To make him pay for the ruined uniform and to keep him quiet about Yanagisawa's bad personality, Yanagisawa takes a picture of Akio in an explicit position. Still, this picture he took makes him feel hot whenever he looks at it.

title: Two-Faced Teacher's Night Class
description: Mini Mi who had run into huge amount of debt got a job in a bar, and found a great secret – the gentle teacher at school would become the cool poker-face boss in bar! Damn! Would Mini Mi be killed by the scheming teacher?

title: Private Aroma
description:
From Midnight Scans:  
  
Ootori Rara is searching for a fragrance which is sweet and kind, a fragrance she had once known a long time ago…

title: Muyu He Benxiaozhu
description: It's about a girl, Taobei, who has somebody writing on her book that she's a pig. This really angers her. Then, there's Muyu, the guy who's been friends with her since childhood… and he's angry with her. A really funny story of a silly and dense girl.

title: Kuroko no Basket - Sawatte, Kawatte (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Anezakari
description: A fleeting beauty, a solid person who cares deeply for her younger brother... an older sister with a reason! ? Her younger brother, Hinata, is struggling to get his girlfriend's older sister to do a "normal" job as she works in the middle of the night. A brother-brother manga where day and night are reversed, where your whole life is thrown around, but you can't hate it!

title: Saki - Kaju x Momo (Doujinshi)
description: This doujin has two parts. The first part is about the date we saw Yumi and Momo go on in a flashback during the anime, and is written from Yumi's perspective. The second part is about Yumi and Momo being alone in the club room and is written from Momo's perspective.

title: Kimi no Naka de Nemurasete
description: Moriuchi Sei, an exchange student, went to England to escape from his past. There he met Hue Wilfort, who was abandoned by his family. Despite his kind personality, Hue made himself being recognized as a delinquent drug dealer. Will he able to save Sei from his haunting memories? Will Sei not leave Hue after one year of exchange program?

title: Angel on Demand
description: Gladiol is an angel that was forbidden from returning to heaven. Revy, a normal high school student, now has to experience pure joy in order for him to get back. A thrilling tale about a handsome angel and an ordinary girl in their pursuit of happiness!

title: School x Fight
description: Mirai is willing to fight to defend others. One day she defeats some thugs attacking Ryo, the idol of her school and is moved up to class 1, the top class, from the normal class 3. After defending a girl from class 0, the lowest class, from the arrogant members of class 1, she says that she wants out of the two-faced class 1. She is not only kicked out of class 1, but down graded to class 0, with the girl she defended and a mysterious black-haired boy she met earlier. The real fight begins now!

title: Moon Drops
description: Selina steps up as the breadwinner of the family after she and her brother lost their parents. Devon is a selfish celestial being in the guise of an idol, and he may be Selina's last hope. After a bus accident, Selina enters a contract with Devon to save her brother's life - for a price!

title: Zurui Otoko
description:
1) A strange man hired a younger man to act as his new lover to get rid of his ex-boyfriend who's stalking him. It turns out the younger man is a student in the class of the older man… Sweet and a bit of angst.  
  
2) True Blue - Momo and Harumi are childhood friends, and Harumi has always relied on Momo. One day he sees Momo walk into a hotel with an older man.  
  
3-5) The Lover in the secret room - Kou and Natsume are good friends and also happens to the Captain and Assistant Captain on the schools soccer team. Natsume has always liked Kou, until he finds out that Kou is going to study abroad in France. Oda, who's also on the team has liked Natsume from afar. He confesses his feelings for him and then chains him up in his home. (slight bondage)  
  
6) Kaoru and Sei have been living together ever since Kaorus' dad was sent overseas for work. Kaoru catches Sei making out. Sei tells him that he likes someone else, but he can never be with him.

title: Wǒ de wáng hái wèi chéngnián
description: When the violent human girl encounters an alien emperor who is incarnate as an emperor, when the dark cooking industry encounters the murderous buns on the top of the food chain, how does the girl develop a powerful dragon who dominates the universe!

title: Haikyu!! - Himitsu no Amayadori (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama and Hinata get caught in the rain on their way home from school.

title: Tandem
description:
Shuma is out on his motorcycle one day, when to his surprise, he runs into his class's student council chairperson, Kaede, out riding her motorcycle as well! This chance encounter marks the beginning of their relationship, as they share their newly discovered common interest.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: A Certain Graduate School Of Science
description:
A comedy about a pair of graduate students in the chemistry lab of a certain graduate school of science.

Note: Starting with Chapter 16, the series switched from being a 4-paneller to being a 4-pager.

title: Kinou, Ie Nakatta Koto
description: Misaki's dream of becoming a nursery school teacher is not something she can tell her parents about, and she just goes about her daily life. But on the rooftop of her school, she meets her classmate, Takashima, who is a yankee and wears gold pants...?

title: Yureru Ruru
description: Now that the last senpai has also graduated, only 3 members remain in the choir club. Probably the club will have to be dismantled but the president does her best to find new members, at least until she finds out that the guy she likes is engaged …

title: Natsu ni, Yuki ga Furu You ni
Money Virus
description: Eun Band Wool, a girl who would do anything to earn money meets Choi Tae Won an arrogant, handsome school president. Why is Eun Band Wool desperate for earning money?

title: Niemiko
description: Born into a family of shrine maidens, high school girl Yagami Sumika can see “strange things” that ordinary people cannot. Constantly compared to her talented younger sister, she struggled to find her own sense of purpose. Then, during the family tradition of “praying under the full moon,” a sealed demon is unleashed, putting her in a desperate situation! Just then, a mysterious demon appears, calling the struggling Sumika a “sacrificial maiden.”

title: Summer Boy Blue
description:
性行為を初恋相手の親に見られて数年後、
ミチルはアルバイトに明け暮れる日々を過ごしていた。
けれどその平穏な生活を壊すように、かつての親友・潤がやってくる。
「嫌ならやめるよ」
初体験の時と同じ台詞を言われて断りきれず
潤がアルバイト先の喫茶店に通うのを許すミチル。
彼こそが初恋相手──ミチルが忘れたい男なのに。
ミチルは大人っぽくなった潤に翻弄される。
（だめだ、だめ、もうこれ以上）
そう抵抗するのも虚しく、自慰に駆り立てられてしまう。
持て余した思春期と、初恋の再燃と。
心の第二次性徴を描いた若葉色ボーイズラブ。

title: Jinzo Kyuketsuki Roa-Chan No Shakai Tekio Kiroku
description:
A "bloody school love comedy" about a former human artificial vampire named Roa and a twisted genius assistant to a doctor, Toru. After being turned into an artificial vampire who feeds on blood by a dark organization, Roa ends up attending high school as a normal girl, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Saikyou Seitokai Tsubakiyo
description: The student council is full of strange, quirky people with clashing personalities. One person in particular, Tsubaki Kiyoi (nicknamed Tsubakiyo), has a special talent that only one other person knows about– when she touches someone, she can access their thoughts and memories. But because of this talent, she is very introverted and damaged inside. Can she overcome her fear of coming in contact with other humans, and take control of her power?

title: Karma: What Goes Around Comes Around
description: Everyone in school knows that Se-Jin is gay. Then why is he chasing after Hyo Won? Isn't she a girl?

title: Soshite Koi ni Naru
description: The beautiful yet aloof Midori and the very outgoing Takahiro are college friends. One day, during a drinking party, the astute Soejima senpai finally got Midori to admit that he is gay, even though he was trying to ignore that fact. As he slowly comes to terms with his own homosexuality, he also discovers the truth behind his friendship with Takahiro.

title: Geboku Tenjite Hana to Nasu
description:
Shigure Rin, a high school girl who lost her family at a young age and is now completely alone. Due to certain circumstances, she was bullied at the orphanage and ostracized at school, enduring a painful daily life. Despite this, Rin lived with the hope of reuniting with her "older brother," who she had been separated from eight years ago. However, her daily life is completely transformed by her encounter with a single "demon."

*Source: Comic Days, translated*

title: Kimi wa Sekai no Chuushin desu
description:
An 18-year-old high school girl feels distant from her childhood friend, who’s now one of the most popular guys at school. But on her 18th birthday—the day they promised to get married when they were kids—he suddenly shows up?

(Source: Kiss Kodansha, translated)

title: Student Shima Kōsaku Job Hunting Arc
description: The fourth and final of the Young Shima Kōsaku prequel series released and the second chronologically.

title: Magical Girl Inkya
description: I can't even say “good morning” to the person I love. How can you be a magical girl if you can't even say “good morning” to the person you love?

title: Pitbull & Mew
description: Debby, Daren, Sansan are a trio of students in Indonesia who keep finding themselves in trouble. They also come in touch with Deo and Aryo, two mysterious friends who bring more fun to the circle. A story of romance and friendship about friends who face life's challenges and joys!

title: Today is Rain
description:
You, who came back on a rainy day, I think I like you.

Soyool, who is having a hard time getting to know people due to past trauma, seems to have fallen in love with Kim Hwon, whom she met as she entered high school. Can Soyool overcome her trauma and achieve love?

title: High School Musical
description:
A loose manga adaptation of High School Musical 3!

Troy and the gang of East High School are going through their senior year, facing graduating and going their separate ways. Coming to terms with the reality of it all, Troy wants to attend the nearby University of New Mexico next year on a basketball scholarship, but Gabriella wants to attend Julliard School of Arts in New York to set her sights on becoming an artist. Meanwhile, Sharpay, the school's shallow and spoiled rich girl, plots to go all out planning the school's final musical show with the idea to add music to her hopes and fears about the future. While Sharpay takes an up-and-coming British exchange student under her wing, her flamboyant fraternal twin brother, Ryan, has his sights set on something different after school. In addition, Troy's best friend and basketball teammate Chad, and Gabriella's best friend Taylor, all have their sights set on their plans after high school and come to terms with the reality of the real w

title: Ojou-sama wa Hatsukoi ni Goshuushin ni Tsuki
description: Momoha Kaguki, a young lady from one of the most prestigious schools in Japan, who is suddenly told by her childhood friend Sengen Amaya that he has a girlfriend and that he wants to keep his distance from her. Momoha is perplexed that Sengen, who is one year younger than Momoha and has always gotten along well with her despite being a plebeian, has a girlfriend, and she is determined to have a boyfriend of her own.

title: Splish-Splash
description: Hee Soo is a 20-year-old college student who falls in love at first sight with Lee Kyung. However, it seems like Hee Soo is receiving affection from an enthusiastic freshman. Even though it isn't that easy to win Lee Kyung's heart, Hee Soo does not want to give up!

title: Kabushikigaisha Love-Cotton
description: 15 year-old Naru Kinboshi usually travels around the world with her parents and her little brother. But when they go on a trip to Kenya, Naru doesn't want to accompany them, so she stays with her little brother in Japan. But renting a place is too expensive and she barely has any money to start with. By luck, Naru finds a job at a boutique that belonged to her grandmother, Venus. (MU)

title: Animal Eyes
description:
All the animals in the world look like humans to him. What will he do with his newly found ability?

---

- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/769)

title: Masami's Feelings
description: Arasawa Masami has no real interest in girls, thanks to the ministrations of two overbearing sisters. But he’s handsome and gets love letters all of the time, which he tears up. Then comes a day when he gets a letter by mistake written by Himekawa Masami, which was actually intended for Awasawa Masumi’s best friend. Awasawa apologizes for his mistake and agrees to help Himekawa win over his friend – thing is, they were seen together and the rumor has spread that the woman-hating Masami and the pretty girl Masami are dating…

title: Fantasy Sketch
description: An aspiring manwha author wannabe who was never really interested in girls finds a girl of his taste. However, the girl is taken. Even so, he still goes after the girl. Will he succeed?

title: Quartet Game
description:
Contains 3 stories:  
  
1) Quartet Game  
In order to welcome the visit of a famous violinist alumnus, Emi, Rui, Takasumi and Taeko were picked by the principal to form a string quartet ensemble for the welcoming concert. In the beginning, the four could hardly play together and often quarreled, for each of them was very talented and had different opinions over the music to be performed. However, during a practice session, they broke a bust statue accidentally and found an ancient sheet music hidden inside the statue, probably handwritten by the composer himself. Fearing to be punished, they didn't tell anyone about the manuscript and began investigation themselves. With a shared secret and a common goal, their relationships quickly improved. They didn't know, however, that the welcome concert was held with a secret purpose.  
  
2) Another Day  
A girl who can time travel finds herself stuck in the past with two boys who are willing to help.  
  
3) Heart Beat  
A boy is in love with

title: My Destiny  (Bi)
description: A little 6-chapter story about a boy and a girl… Let's just say they're meant to be together, due to a little something the boy did…

title: Kimi to Boku no Junjou Renai Jijou
description: Minami and Ritsu are next door neighbors and childhood friends. Minami's drama club is about to put on a play but their male lead is injured so Ritsu has to step in as the male lead.

title: Virgin Wars
description: Kanami's father has a debt of 300 million yen! He can either pay the money or sell his daughter, Kanami, to the sex industry. Kanami decides to go to the sex industry for the sake of her father. But before she does, she wants to have a normal life and lose her virginity normally. In the bathroom, she mistakenly stumbles across her classmate, Ryuuno, having sex with a girl. Later on at a gokun, she meets Ryuuno. She gets drunk and she wakes up to find herself in bed with Ryuuno. She doesn't fight back. When she wakes up later on, she sees Ryuuno (with his pants still on) injured very badly! Did Kanami do this? Does she have some hidden powers she doesn't know about?

title: Memory Eaters
description: Memory eaters live on people's memories. They are originally death messengers who remove a human's memories when they carry souls. But some of them are charmed by the beauty of the memories and become Exiles: Memory Eaters. Dio is one of them, but instead of stealing human memories like other Exiles, he earns them by helping people. One day, Dio finds a girl who is losing too many memories from Exiles. He tries to help her, but Ces, who was a model death messenger, is around her. What is he doing here ?

title: Ashita e Tsumugu Cobalt Blue
description: 控えめでおとなしく自分に自信のない小森まりえは、中学時代も周囲に馴染むことが出来ず人間関係でトラウマを抱えてしまい、進学した高校でもうまくいかなかったことからその高校に通うことをやめてしまった。そんな彼女は全日制の高校ではなく、新たに通信制高校に通うこととなる。ある日、課題の提出に難儀していた彼女のもとに、同じく通信課程に通う見た目が派手な男子・鴨川英一郎が助けに入り…。

title: Heavens Runner Akira
description: Approximately 2 meters tall, with eyes always white and emitting an eerie laugh, the man feared by those around him is Warrior Beard Akira. There's a certain reason he laughs that he can't tell anyone... Then, a fateful encounter with a certain girl awaits him!? Something happens whenever Akira runs!? A coming-of-age story of a young boy begins in Chigasaki!!

title: Anesan wa Iinchou
description:
Minoru is the class president of her school, and she has a problem – a new transfer student named Ryuuzaki, who is the son of a well-known (and very handsome) gangster and quite the handful himself.

(from mangaupdates)

[Note see amazon link there are 2 versions the second one is titled "shin" meaning new. Manga updates has both of them listed as one (3 and 5 volumes) but they should be separate. The covers here now match the Shin version.  After this is resolved remove this note]

title: Rival ni Ki wo Tsukero
description:
1-2)Rival ni Ki wo Tsukero (Beware of the Rival)  
Ren is in love with his younger cousin Sakae and has been for quite some time. On the day he plans on confessing he witnesses Kunimi, Sakae's classmate, confessing to Sakae. Upset that Kunimi stole Ren's perfect moment to confess he decides to find out who the guy is and hopefully what Sakae's answer was. When Sakae leaves the two together Kunimi tells Ren he knows Ren loves Sakae and that he will never hand Sakae over to Ren. The battle to win Sakae over is ON!  
  
3)Koishitatte ii janai (What's wrong with being in love?)  
Mei and Shouta are childhood friends. Mei is very clumsy and a little clueless so when he wants to move out of his parent's house and live alone, Shouta moves in with him. One day Mei comes home early and sees Shouta touching himself… while calling Mei's name! Everything changes after that…  
  
4)Suki Suki (Love Love)  
Toshikazu is very possessive over his lover, Hibiki. Hibiki starts to feel smothered but what

title: Tonari no Seki no Doukionin
description: A girl loses her home in a fire and starts to live together with the guy who sits next to her at school.

title: Pika Pika Days
description:
1-3. Shining Days  
The strong-willed Asahi and the easy-going Tetsuro have been close friends since kids. Now in high school, those two still “share” their bento. However, Asahi is asked to stop bullying Tetsuro, “because he’s too nice to tell you his true feelings!” But is that really how Tetsuro feels about Asahi’s bullying—?  
  
4. Fireworks  
Morio invite Saeki to the local fireworks festival but receives the usual cold response from Saeki. Follows Morio and Saeki-sensei from Vanilla.  
  
5. Anniversary  
Nakajima is unsure about his relationship status with Yajima, They have been going out for weeks but nothing physical has yet to happen between them. Follows Nakajima and Yajima from Vanilla.  
  
6) Lost Pain  
Nakajima is unsure of Yajima's love for him despite the constant declarations of love. The problem? Nakajima finds it hard to take Yajima seriously when all he can see is his poker face. Follows Nakajima and Yajima from Vanilla.  
  
7. The Prince's Secret  
The prince

title: The Pounding Tomb
description:
(from amazon.jp):

Mino Katase, a beautiful OL, recalls a strange scene as she waits for her lover, Naoto Otani. Whenever she shared a bed with him at a dizzying moment, she would see a white flash explode in her head and glasses and masks would break.

Was it a sign of things to come? An old fortune teller passing by also warns Mino that he is going to leave her.

When she dreams that Otani is sleeping with another woman and talking disparagingly about her, will Mino's fears come true? Is Mino's psychic power real?

A collection of occult romance manga that only Jiro Tsunoda could depict. Showing the drama between a man and a woman with a psychic theme.

title: Low Teen Blues
description:
Shingo falls in love with his new teacher, Ichijou Yuuko.

After a kiss happens on a class trip, and another classmate sees them, the plot of this forbidden love story thickens!

title: Lian Ai Makeup!
description:
Xiao Mei is a normal high school girl whose hobbies are reading and drawing manga. To encourage her because of her failed love confession, Xiao Zhu gave her a makeover. However, after the photography club's president took pictures of her and published them in the school magazine 'CLOVER', she becomes the 'MYSTERY BEAUTY' the whole school's looking for!  
  
Includes a 80 page extra.

title: Get Chu ♥
description: Chitose is eager to fall in love, and she thinks she's found the perfect candidate in Yamato. Yamato is good-looking, considerate… and a little bit of a delinquent! Chitose discovers that Yamato takes money for kisses and dates! Chitose wants Yamato's lips for herself, but she has absolutely no intention of paying for them. Look out, Yamato, because Chitose – a refreshingly spirited heroine – is out to Get Chu!

title: Oni Kari Jinja no Mori-hime
description:
High school student Touko has lost her grandmother, one of her few allies. Oppressed by her aunt and in despair, Touko is confronted by a relative of her missing mother. The Kamisaka family, who make a living by "hunting demons," welcome the "power" that Touko herself has always hated. Feeling accepted for who she is for the first time, Touko decides to live at the Kamisaka shrine. What awaits her is a life shared with Chihiro, a boy her own age, and Chiei, a talented sorcerer. Touko comes into contact with the anguish of Chihiro, who was born in Kamisaka but lacked powers, and the two polar opposites begin to bond.

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)

title: Color
description: Tsuda and Sakae are both artists who coincidentally painted nearly identical paintings. Now they are students at the same school. Are they destined to be together?

title: Boy_Friend
description: 엘리트 선도부장 유성, 구제불능 문제아 다빈을 만나고 순탄하게 흘러가던 학교생활이 꼬이기 시작하는데...

title: Renjaku-san to Asobo
description:
Junpei Sakai, who lacks self-confidence, meets a mysterious girl named Murasaki Renzaku at the high school he entered. She says she came to the high school to have fun, and Junpei is invited to play with her after school. But there seems to be a secret about her...?!

This is the secret after-school life of the free and mysterious girly and a boy, who lacks self-confidence!

title: Love Revenge
description: Can you get revenge on the person you loved the most?

title: Don't Leave Me Alone Daisy FOR EVER
description: Techno lived in a bomb shelter for most of his life. He and his grandfather are amazingly smart. One day Techno sees a girl named Hitomi on his yard. He instantly falls in love. He names her Daisy, even though she keeps telling him that's not her name. After 3 months of practice on a robot he decides to start a relationship with her.

title: Kimi Wo Mechakucha Ni Shitai Koi
description: This is the start of a thrilling and exciting romance series with a young boy who will fulfill your secret desires!

title: Hashitanakute Gomen
description:
Nishi Manao, 17 years. Her "boom" starts when she gets interested in the serious represent class student Yokura Yuki.
Always responsable in her activities, she uses some strange kind of way to calm herself only known by Yokura.

How the development will turn out when the two start to know each other?

title: Milk Chocolate
description: 女子高生・穂乃花は、親友の楓と共に穏やかで楽しい学校生活を送っていた。ある日、兄の春がいる２年生の教室を訪ねることになった穂乃花。そこで偶然、学校いちのモテ男・椋と出会い――？

title: My Lovable Fatty
description: Shin Dong Sun is the new girl in school and the problem seems to be that she’s fat, short, and ugly. She is picked on by her fellow classmates, her childhood friend, Jeh Suh, constantly abuses her, and her only love rejects her! Tired of her intolerable life she attempts to hang herself, but fails when the rope snaps due to her massive weight and there she finds a box full of medicine, and one bottle says that it’ll turn her into however she wants to be…

title: He's Such A Tease!
description: The school bully has a nemesis—a rival in love who likes to snitch. The worst thing is that his nemesis is bad at recognizing faces and is oblivious to everything he does. Move aside, love rival. You're in the way of me pursuing my dream girl!

title: Lemon Planet
description:
It’s summer vacation time, and no one is more excited about it than 2nd year high school student Karin-chan. Her childhood friend Sakumi-senpai is coming home from college to visit! Karin and Sakumi, along with his younger brother Tatsumi are childhood friends. Sakumi hasn’t been gone long, but now that he is back, Karin can really see a difference in him. Just seeing him makes Karin’s heart beats faster. Her crush on him hasn’t changed.  
  
Meanwhile, Tatsumi is the same age as Karin, and is in her class at school. He is aware of Karin’s obvious affection for Sakumi, however what are his feelings? He seems to care for Karin very much, could he be the one to comfort Karin when Sakumi rejects her? Over the summer, Sakumi begins to see how special Karin is. Will Karin gather the courage to confess? Will Tatsumi make his feelings known? Will Sakumi realize how special Karin has always been to him?

title: Piyo Piyo Angel
description: Yukito is an angel who is sent to study on Earth as punishment for his bad grades. His assignment is to give angel powers to a human. He accidentally gives these powers to his classmate Hiyoko, a girl who's super happy but not very smart. She also has a crush on Yukito, much to his disgust. (From: Chime)

title: Find Healing at the Arcade.
description: Gloomy, pessimist girl meets comforting, rhythm gamer boy.

title: New and Best!! Extremely Popular Committee Chairman
Cultural Festival Underground Executive Committee
description: The main character, Takuro Takano, has a desire to have his first kiss during his third year in middle school . Takuro and his admired classmate, Kirara Tanaka, experience haunted houses and flea markets in order to investigate the performances of the school festival. However, suspicious old men and aunts were waiting there to trap Takuro. Is the purpose of Takuro's first kiss with Kirara, the executive committee member of the back of the disaster-prone cultural festival, fulfilled

title: Suki desu Senpai, Nyuubu shimasu.
description:
"He's too much my type!"
'I want a boyfriend. But she can't even find someone she likes.' Hiyori, a troubled first-year high school student, finally falls in love at first sight with a "beautiful" boy on the baseball team, Mifu, a senpai! She decides to become the manager of the baseball team, and aims to become the senpai's girlfriend...?!

A club love story with a "beautiful" boy of the baseball club!

title: Ousama-tachi wa Ano Ko ni Muchuu
description:
Will she become the favorite of the strong-willed student council members?!

Mio Sakuraba has been shy since she was little. She is enthusiastic about changing herself in high school, but is forcibly recruited to join the student council by the student council president, Haru Oujou, who is also known as the "King"!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Don't Apologise
description: Yora Yutsu, the sweet and hard-working white dog, is the best Futora player in the school and is in love with a girl who never even looked at him. Kiya, she is a sweet and silenced cat girl who is deeply suffering from depression yet no one has any idea about it. Not even Yora. The life of them coming together... will it cure the pain of the kitty or is it going to make it even more miserable? Find it for yourself by reading this story of their love, fights, struggle and a life changing future ♡♡

title: 100-kai Mawatte Ai wo Nake
description: は元社長令嬢の女子高生・椛（いろは）と、問題ばかり起こす御曹司・京極の物語。亡き祖父の言いつけを守り、勉強にバイトにと多忙な毎日を過ごす椛は、寝不足で階段から落ちてしまう。下敷きになったのは何かと問題を起こしがちなクラスメイトの京極だった。学費免除のために特待生であり続けたい椛は、自分が押し倒したとは言わずに帰宅。すると翌日、骨折してしまった京極から「従順で賢い犬になれ」と命じられて……。

title: Harumachi no Mebuki
description: Mebuki, who has been living in a simple life like a cat on the porch, becomes aware of her childhood friend Raku for the first time when she reaches high school age. Once she realizes that she is in love, Mebuki's world begins to change color. However, one day, Mebuki sees an expression on Raku's face that she has never seen before. A bright  first love story!

title: Pukuko to Machio
description: Fukuko is called "Pukuko" by her classmates even though she his insecure about her body shape. She decides to go on a diet because she wants the boy she has a crush on to notice her! Machio-kun from her class is going to help her! To Fukoko, the meal she eats after muscle training together with Machio is the most delicious!

title: Nijiiro Joker
description: Asakura Kohime is a first year high school student who loves magic. She belongs to her school's magic club, and even performs magic in places like school or cafes. One day, she meets an oddball from the Chemistry Club, Kijimamoto Nari. He apparently hates magic! What will happen to the two?

title: Jun na Kimochi de Icchimae!
description: Tomo's eyes chase after fellow teammate Tanji. He knows he has fallen for Tanji already but what comes with first love, makes him both expectant and scared of getting hurt.

title: Kokuhaku Kurabu
description:
Story 1 - Confession Club  
Ueda Yuki sees the boy she likes, Mashimo Arata, kissing a book that she borrowed from her senpai. Seeing the situation as it is, Yuki knows immediately that Arata likes Misato-senpai. Thus, in order to be able to talk to him freely, Yuki volunteers to become Arata's practice partner by forming a so-called 'Confession Club' to help Arata confess to Misato-senpai. Will Yuki be able to help Arata confess, or will she fall for him?  
  
Story 2 - Please Tell Me If You Love Me  
Hinako is a quiet girl with a secret. She can't say the word ¨like¨. Because of that, Hinako has suffered when she confessed to a guy in middle school, everyone heard and laughed. And the problem is that now in high school, she likes the Principal's son, Kashiki. Wanting not to be laughed at, Hinako starts to practice how to say that word, but in the middle of the halfway someone hears her…?!  
  
Story 3 - Countdown  
Mioko is a average girl, who suddenly starts to have troubles with sc

title: Goshimei! Host Kyoushi J
description: J, a nightclub host in Kabukichou, Shinjuku Tokyo, has risen to the top in a mere 5 years, and is said to be legendary. J’s next challenge is to enter a prestigious school… as a teacher! With high hopes and ambitions, he begins his teaching life. However, his new class seems a bit… odd. Will J be able to teach these children how to love and dream?

title: Kasumi
description:
Kasumi's father moves around for work frequently, meaning she constantly has to change schools. On one such move, while the two of them have stopped to take a break, Kasumi spots an odd glowing light. She chases it up a tree, but after catching it the branch she's standing on breaks and she falls. When she wakes up the next day, strangely uninjured, she heads to her new school, which turns out to be super exclusive! Kasumi has trouble fitting in with the snobby rich kids in the school, even more so after she gains the ire of the most popular boy in school's fan club, and now she even seems to have gained special abilities!?! How will Kasumi fare in her new school and what are these strange powers that are developing?  
  
NOTE: This is an OEL. Not an English translation of a Japanese version.

[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasumi_(comics))

title: Dekiai Oresama Tailor
description:
Girls are greedy when it's about love and being smart-dressed! Kurisu Maiko wanted to become a designer but she failed at the entrance exam.(><。)  
  
But a high-school student, the genius Shigamiya Iou, recognize Maiko's abilities and bought her pattern. Then, he tried his best to let her become the next best designer of their generation, but there's also a second genius who met Maiko, Tachibanaou Hato.  
  
Will the three of them succeed in both love and dreams…?

title: Peppermint
description: For Haei, being able to go to school with her idol, Ijy, is a dream come true! Plus she gets to help him with rehearsing. But with the girls from his fan club, who make her life hell on earth. But then Eo, a kid in primary school, wants her to pretend to be his girlfriend, making it easier for him to get away from his groupies. Haei's life isn't done being complicated….

title: Sugao no Kimi to Koi ga Shitai
description: Nagomi has been mistaken for a flamboyant girl because of her appearance. When she was in high school, she secretly admired Mr. Ichihara, a kind and calm teacher. But when she meets him again as a university student...! Unexpected pure love💗!

title: My Hero Academia - L'incident Chocolaté (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Hitomi no Mukougawa
description:
From Fantasyshrine:  
  
In high school I, Hayami Ren, was reunited with my childhood friend, Hikawa Yukito. I've always been charmed by him. However, Yuki-chan has become too involved in his Kendo club and is even being labeled as the “Hope” of the club. Now, I feel more and more like I have been cast aside. But I love him, so I want to be with him and become his equal. Struggling between love and dreams, what would be our fate being that we’re such a clumsy couple…?  
  
This book includes the stories of Ren and Yukito’s sweet reunion and also Ren’s brother, Satoru’s story.

title: Saigo no Page
description:
Oneshot.  
  
Midori and Takeru are childhood friends, Midori wants to always stay childhood friends with Take. Midori thinks she knows everything about Take, but what she dosent know are his feelings for her…How will these childhood friends end up?

title: Yareba Dekirusa
description: What would a prep school teacher do to encourage a student to study for a college entrance exam? Well he woos him of course!

title: 38°C
description:
From ShoujoMagic:
1. 38°C
Taiji's normal body temperature is 38 degrees Celsius, or so he says, but Shiina thinks he's full of it. Taiji is a friend with whom Shiina can always--and does always--fight... Until Taiji unexpectedly confesses his love! Shiina begins to run a fever, but is that the only reason she's getting so hot...?

2. Solution Maze

3. Heaven in Jail

4. Winter's Aquarius

title: Automatic★Angel
description:
Story 1: Automatic Angel  
Serika, a high-school student, is known for being a well rounded girl with an attractive face and figure. She is clear-headed and has a talent for sports. But she's an… android!?   
  
Vol. 2, Story 2: Winter is almost over  
Tale of a high school professor and student.

title: Atashi Hitori de Daijoubu
description: Tired of the weak and childish guys in her class, Uematsu Akira is determined not to rely on any guys! The day before the school athletics meet, she decides that the only way her class can win is if she goes it alone. However, one guy might just be able to change her mind…

title: My Hero Academia - Prismic  (Doujinshi)
description: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Resistance Passion
description: Sei is an accountant that helped the Takashiro family keep their assets in place. He always has his way with the older twin of the Takashiro family, Mizuha. Mizuha has zero resistance against the flaming passion that emanates from Sei. Will they open their hearts to each other? The other twin, Yuuya, has been fending off perverts who are interested in Mizuha. But is his classmate, Tsuzuki, interested in Mizuha or in Yuuya? What will happen to Yuuya's unrequited love for Tsuzuki?

title: Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi
description: Kazuma Hoshino transfers from the city to the small mountain town of Yamahiko-cho so that his beloved, sickly younger brother, Ayumu, can recuperate. On his first day, Kazuma gets lost and is bewildered when a local girl, Hatsumi Nakatsugawa, appears before him. Hatsumi guides him to the school, but unexpected events await him, far from the peaceful country life he expected. What will become of his new encounters and turbulent school life?!

title: Forget Me Now
description: Elliott woke up with his memories gone. His life, friends even his boyfriend Nate, gone. Can he piece his life back together before it all resets?

title: Shotaro Manga - Poems of the Heart Series
description:
*Not collected in the Ishinomori Complete Works.*

(from ebookjapan):
Hero comic master Shotaro Ishinomori emotionally depicts the subtleties of various people's hearts in this human drama. Hiroshi sees a message on a postcard from his ex-girlfriend Hiromi, who married another man: "Are you still using a fountain pen? Hiroshi remembers the time he received a fountain pen from his ex-lover Hiromi, who married another man. Then, as his memory goes back, Hiroshi recalls a sweet and sour event with Hiromi in high school ......!

title: Kanojo no Yasei ga Te ni Oenai
description: 「究極のサバイバル」とは何か――。それは「個の生存」にあらず。「種の保存」すなわち「子作り」である!!

title: Mashiro-ke Complex!
description:
The Mayo family consists of four Kyodai: the eldest son, Jun; twins, the second and third sons, May and Kon; and the eldest daughter, Natsuki.
They attend the same high school. Their parents are wandering abroad, but the kyodai, led by older brother Jun, help each other out and live together day by day.
But...these Kyodai actually have a secret...

title: Is There Some Yokai!?
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Suddenly, a mysterious black-haired girl named Mil appears in front of Hideto. They both decide to embark on a journey together. Yokai are no more than a morning delight, and they encounter dragons and UFOs in a series of bizarre encounters. 

A mystery world full of laughter, tears, and fear. A romantic comedy adventure full of fun and excitement.

title: Love Record Book
description:
Jiyu has lived as a top student his entire life, but after entering high school he gets an unthinkable grade of being second in the whole school.


Jiyu, who was in shock, is trying to regain his top spot in the school. it's said that if you date, your grades will drop. so he made a confession attack on Dohyeon, the student who stole his first place tag.

Jiyu successfully seduces Dohyeon to date him. Can he get back the top spot in the school?

title: Anata wa Boku Dake no Hana
description:
1) You Are My Flower  
Yuuto has been living for years with Hisataka but he's wondering what are his true feelings for his lover since in the beginning, he accepted the relationship without being in love with Hisataka…  
  
2) Moving Forward Hand in Hand  
After changing shifting seats in the classroom, the shy boy finally got to sit next to the prince of campus. Will he be able to look beyond the facade and see him for his real self.   
  
3) It's Still Impossible to Turn Them into Memories  
He got the biggest shock of his life when he turned up for a rock concert only to discover his friend has invited his past lover without knowing that. Now they have to pretend to be nice to each other despite the bitter break up in the past.   
  
4) I Want You Only  
He doesn't quite get it why he is always getting dumped even though he is pretty popular. He jokingly tell his childhood friend that he might as well turn gay to avoid this terrible fate. Surprisingly, his friend volunteered for the

title: Shounen Nure Yasuku Koinarigatashi
description:
After he was sexually harassed and forcibly seduced by his female high school teacher, he reports her to school that quickly fires her. As he struggles to make sense of his feelings towards the teacher who doesn't seem want to let him go, he attempts to make sense of girls around him and life as well as its complications.

source: https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/vl64yz1/shounen-nure-yasuku-koinarigatashi

title: Gamushapa Heart B
description: Kurosu Riri is very bored with her school life. In an attempt to do something new she tries to form a band with Ayata and Jin. But something is still missing, a former member, Ruki Sugisaki is needed in order to have the complete band. The only problem is that he's in a fight with Ayata. Will Riri be able to make things work for her band and make Ruki join? Better yet, to have it formed before it falls apart…

title: Saki - PV21 (Doujinshi)
description: Momo tries to use her stealth mode to become a magical girl superhero. The doujin centers around Momoko, and therefore the YumiMomo pairing, but almost every pairing makes an appearance.

title: School Shampoo
description:
The main character, Soji Shirakawa, is 14 years old. He's a bright young boy, though a bit peculiar, and is nicknamed "Shampoo" by his peers.

Soji is a descendant of the ancient Mu people and is an esper, but his skills are still in his infancy. One day, he's teased by a bancho on the train, and Soji uses his psychic powers, but...?

title: Suki desu, Yume Ou Yume-kun
description:
