A second-year middle school student busy with her idol activities, ends up taking photos for the boys' volleyball team's album. As soon as he starts taking photos, he becomes obsessed with the adorable volleyball team member, Saki Yumeno! From that day on, she begins spending her days gazing at her "second oshi."

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title: Seven School Mysteries
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Horror manga master Jiro Tsunoda depicts the seven terrifying wonders associated with various schools in this school psychic manga. 

At a girls' high school, a rumor circulates that a handsome man's ghost appears in the art room. Shinobu, a high school girl who refuses to believe the rumor, goes to the art room after school just for the fun of it, and encounters a handsome male ghost as rumored. At that moment, the ghost asks her, "What is your name...?" 

Shinobu is then approached by...!

title: My Weird Roommate
description: He is a punk, and he is a nerd, can I make it any more obvious? When two complete opposites share a room.

title: Amaterasu (MIUCHI Suzue)
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Amaterasu, a woman indispensable for the restoration of the world, has descended to this world. However, it takes 16 years for her to awaken as Amaterasu, and during that time, a group of people arrives in Japan to protect her from the Daimajin Army. 

At the same time, a girl named Saya was born to a doctor named Chikura and a woman named Ayako. Is there any connection between Amaterasu and Saya?　

On the other hand, a mysterious group of people are also trying to accomplish their plan 666 by eliminating Amaterasu before her 16th birthday...?　

This is a new edition of "Amaterasu (1)" which was on sale until April 5, 2021. There are no changes in the content of the book.

title: Tonari no Jijou
description: That day, Miyata, who is still preparing for his university exam, got home and found not his brother, but an unknown man. That man, Shirai, has just moved into the neighbourhood. He looks at Miyata's messy test sheets and offers, "Shall I teach you?" With his airy smile and nearly perfect self, Shirai forcefully becomes Miyata's private tutor… and Miyata slowly becomes interested in Shirai…

title: One Astonishing Fine Day
description: Do you believe in destiny? He Xiaoqing, a freshman-to-be would rather believe in destiny than fate. on a fine day that stubborn guy who dragged her to do CPR to a fainted grandma which makes her miss the most important event in her life--the university entrance examination. Born in a broke family, Xiaoqing developed a hobby which is "making money". So when she met her "destined" guy again on another fine day, she decided to take revenge on him as well as making a lot of money from him...

title: Kirari Senpai Wa Jitai
description:
「君が欲しい！」…俺、なんで女の子に壁ドンされてんの!?
元・天才子役の演士はネットミームになってしまった自身の過去を清算すべく高校デビューを目指していた。
入学した矢先、突然不思議な先輩に目をつけられてしまう！
彼女の名前は花星きらり。演じている間はカリスマだけど、本当の彼女はぽんこつで…!?
熱意と熱意がポップにはじける、演劇コメディ★

title: Star Beat!
description: Elizabeth Lovewood has always been too much. She laughed too much, talked too much, sang too much, but most importantly, felt too much. And that has brought nothing but problems. Now, in her new school, she´s decided to drown her personality to fit in. But that changes when she´s forced to join a punk band, where she meets someone who awakens distant memories and pushes her to explore her spirituality and a love that transcends lifetimes.

title: Flowers and Storms
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Junya Shiratori is a high school student who devotes his youth to karate. One day, he learns that his father, a photographer and respected man, was killed by American soldiers' gunfire during the Vietnam War. 

As his anger toward the American soldiers grows, his karate club decides to hold a rivalry match against the American School!　

Junya is furious and beats up his opponents one after another...

title: AI (Inha Estudios)
description: AI es una historia psicológico-romántica sobre la vida cotidiana de unos adolescentes que están en secundaria y forman parte de vandas callejeras. Tendrán toda clase de problemas, peleas, batallas y romances.

title: Akarui Kazoku Keikaku
description: Shibutami lived the life of an everyday high school boy, but with one chronic problem: He could never stay interested in his girlfriends. However, when Yoshizumi transfers into his class, the teenager's arrival strangely piques his interest. Yet, for some reason Yoshizumi seems awkward, even hostile, when Shibutami tries to be his friend. Meanwhile, another high school student with a mask fetish falls deeply in lust with his dentist during an appointment. In another part of the city, a man grows jealous of his own lover's best friend. And elsewhere, a young couple nearly breaks up because they can never agree who should be on top in the bedroom.

title: My Lovely Class Leader
description:
Read about an outstanding freshman who is kind and a well-known chairman. Everything goes easily for her, except for one problem, and that's the class troubled-boy trio that can't seem to follow the rules. How will she handle this rebellious group who can't seem to stay out of trouble? Watch as things slowly change from her trying to keep them in line to her seeing the good in each one of them.

(from mangaupdates)

title: The Courage to Embrace Youth
description:
The girl was bullied in middle school and then stopped school for a time. But, encouraged by her online friends, she decided to go back to school. However, when she goes back, she experiences some problems on the first day.  
  
- [Traditional Chinese (Comico)](https://www.comico.com.tw/2725)  
- [Simplified Chinese (Kuaikan)](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/8525)

title: Tsubomi to Meteor
description:
Nagi is not good at talking to people and has yet to fit in at her new high school. However, gardening is the only thing she is good at, and as a member of the gardening club, she diligently takes care of the school's flower beds. Then one day, a junior boy named Nanase inadvertently destroys the flower beds, and as punishment, he is assigned to help the gardening club for a month... Nanase is Nagi's least favorite type of boy, but as she interacts with him, Nagi gradually changes.

(Source: Natalie.mu, machine translated)

title: Romcom Cancellation
description: The girl who suddenly confessed to the geek boy is in fact a ninja!? An unconfirmed romcom about said boy and a rejected ninja aiming for his life out of resentment!!

title: Kurenai MIX Special
description:
A collection of short stories about friends and romance.  
  
1. Kurenai Mix Special  
2. Okosama Ranchi (A Child's Ranch)  
3. Special Ranch  
4. HOT!  
5. COOL!  
6. Shangri-la  
7. Mr. Postman's Chronicle Mail, One Summer's Love

title: Summer of Lime
description: Moving from S city to coastal city Q, Dahlia Lime was enrolled in Mingtang Private Highschool. Taking the wrong road, on the first day of school, she accidentally witnessed the crying of Julian Summer, who is a delicate and good-looking top student in Mingtang High School, and their first meeting turned to be an unpleasant one. Then, fate brought her to Jared, the Prince Charming of all girls at school, and they even appointed to gamble through basketball. Being noticed by two top lady-killers in campus, even Dahlia herself was amazed. However…As they got familiar with each other, their relationship began to shift. A series of hilarious and warm stories thus happened among them.

title: Mondoumuyou!
description: Hitaka Touko catches a thief in her room. It turns out to be Hayashida Ichisaie, a classmate. Through a series of unexpected moments, she finds herself caught up in the act of burglarizing along with Ichisaie.

title: Rapuntsel ni Fuku Kaze
description: Grandma told Tsukamoto that if he didn't start paying attention, he'd get into trouble. Now he seems to have joined a mysterious club at school that is headed by Higashi Jyuji, otherwise known as Rapunzel. Will Tsukamoto be the prince to bring this princess down from the castle?

title: Kuroko no Basket - Kimi to Koi Suru Houteishiki (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kise Ryouta x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Error Detected
description: 'Oh Seung-pyo', who never missed out on first place in his entire school until middle school, lost his first place in his entire school to 'Ryu Jae-min' after entering high school. Ryu Jae-min won first place in the school, and Oh Seung-pyo won second place in the school. No matter how hard you study, you cannot reverse this order. Seungpyo continues to watch Jaemin without realizing it due to his first feeling of inferiority. Then one rainy day, Seung-pyo and Jaemin accidentally collide on the street and an accident occurs where their cell phones change. But something is strange. "what's this?" Ryu Jae-min's pause for first place in the entire school.

title: My Hero Academia - Katsuki-kun no Koibito (Doujinshi)
description: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Otome no Sainou
description:
Story One: Otome no Sainou  
  
Nakanishi Kiyoshin, nickname Onii-chan, is a 14-year-old, chivalrous heroine. She witnesses a guy, Kashiwaki Sachikana, being confessed to by another guy. The confessor gets aggressive, and Nakanishi steps in. After that, Nakanishi and Kashi-kun become friends, and then…  
  
Story Two: Tsuki Iro Secret  
  
Back in elementary school, Alice ("president" & "me" in the manga) met a boy who helped her out. Now president of her middle school, Alice meets a magical sorcerer named Lu ("mage" in the manga) who can't go back until the next full moon. All the students in her school dislike her and think that she is not good enough for the presidency. Where is the boy who helped her out?

title: My Polaris
description: The unlucky Tan Yue was cursed to cause harm to those she helped. When she made a wish to get rid of her curse so that she could confess to her crush, an “angel” appeared before her, but forced her to sign an unfair contract! He was a weirdo who stole her first kiss, levitated things when he threw tantrums, and loved tearing bed sheets… What’s wrong with this angel?

title: Can't Stop Love
description: The first stages of Love starts from attraction, realization, then finally, a crush. Yana, has suddenly entered this stage since a new transfer student walked in. After what she has witnessed, Yana then realizes that she might be the victim of love...

title: Bocchi, Nishihara-kun ni Dekiai sareru
description:
Kishimori-san, a shy and lonely girl who always eats lunch alone. One day, she starts having lunch with Nishihara-kun, the infamous delinquent boy in school! Though she initially finds him intimidating, their daily chats become something she looks forward to...!? And to her surprise, Nishihara-kun actually has feelings for her...!!?

A pure, heart-fluttering short romantic comedy about the overly innocent loner Kishimori and the tough-but-soft delinquent Nishihara!

title: Otome no Honki
description: A school yard is going to be reconstructed into a school library. Mikura strongly opposes the reconstruction, wanting to preserve the place where rumours say that if you kiss you will be together for life. But the student council president Hazuya will not listen to any of her arguments.

title: Date With Fox Spirit
description: When the youth Chen Fengjiao was born, there were anomalies in both heaven and earth. Each time he was attacked by evil spirits, he would saved by the leading female character Hu Qian, who was actually a fox spirit. To help Hu Qian thoroughly remould herself, Chen Fengjiao saved her at the risk of his own life, as a result, he finally won her heart. Jack shall have Jill, however, their marriage finally led them to destruction!

title: Starry☆Sky ~In Winter~
description: Collection of shorts stories featuring characters from the otome game Starry☆Sky ~in Winter~

title: Bocchama, Omoshiree Onna de Gozaimasu
description:
"I have found...I have found at last! A goddess (a funny woman) who will restore my boy's spirit!
I'm sorry I'm late. I am the bodyguard and butler of the little boy."
This is Mr. Kazuma, the selfish boy, and Shinobu. Now, this encounter...will it turn out to be a good thing or a bad thing for the two of you...or will you fall in love?

title: Beautiful Name
description:
From Here:  
First year high school student Karin holds tightly to the memory of her childhood love Yuuki-kun; so tightly that she still wears her hair in the same childhood style (two ponytails) to be sure that if they ever meet again, he'll recognize her. Delivering papers to the school infirmary, she meets up with a boy who seems to be coughing up blood (of course it's actually juice). He's an incorrigible prankster who can't resist teasing Karin constantly and pursues her even after she tells him she's still loyal to her first love, much to her consternation!

title: Hajimete no Koi no Sodatekata
description: Chiaki is going out with Kusakawa-kun even though she knows nothing about him. But when people begin to point out how they are unsuited, can Chiaki shake off the feeling that they come from two different worlds?

title: Kumokiri-san wa Love Comedy ga Shitai
description: Kanzaki-kun là một nam sinh trung học cực kỳ đam mê manga rom-com. Thế nhưng, vì một lý do nào đó, cậu lại là người hiểu rõ hơn ai hết rằng những chuyện tình rom-com như thế không hề tồn tại ngoài đời thực. Xuất hiện trước mặt cậu là Kumokiri-san - một cô gái mang bầu không khí đầy bí ẩn. Tình cờ, Kanzaki-kun lại đi "truyền giáo" bộ manga yêu thích của mình cho cô ấy. Để rồi ngay ngày hôm sau, Kanzaki-kun bị cuốn vào một diễn biến khó tin mà cậu không tài nào lường trước được!?

title: Tragedy of the 13th Month
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Marie's father, Larry Benson, hides the fact that he has a wife and child and is a rising bachelor star. Unable to speak publicly about her father, Marie is transferred to a boarding school, St. Rose Cross, after her mother dies. However, when Marie enters the classroom, she is surprised to see her classmates with uniformly unhealthy pale skin, large, glassy eyes, and gloomy expressions, and she is also informed that she is not allowed to leave the school until she graduates...

title: I can Hear the Rain
description:
A classmate becomes a mother! A delicate two-person life in progress!

Hiiragi ends up living with her stepmother and classmate, Anon. A love story depicting the delicate cohabitation of two innocent and clumsy people.

title: Between Two Question Marks
description: Cho Seyan wakes up to see people with signs on their heads saying their relationship to her. She's happy to see her crush's sign saying \"Boyfriend?\" but her childhood friend has the same sign. With two guys who will potentially become her lover, which one will Cho Seyan choose?

title: Summer Letter
description:
"You're my new boyfriend!"

With the lousy excuse that she made a bet with her friends, Boye storms into the life of quiet, model student Taebom, demanding that he act the part of her boyfriend. Little does he know however, that Boye has had her eye on him for quite some time...

---

title: What's Our Relationship?
description:
Se-hee e Yeon-woo são amigos de infância que se conhecem desde a infância, mas, na verdade, Se-hee tem uma queda por Yeon-woo.
No entanto, a atitude de Yeon-woo tornou-se estranhamente fria desde o ponto de começar sua paixão. Como resultado, Se-hee decide deixar de lado sua paixão sem esperança.
Seo-jin, um ex-aluno, aparece na frente de Se-hee, e os dois se aproximam cada vez mais...

title: Ami! Nonstop
description:
Ami is a normal school girl. One day with her friends, she got stopped for an interview by a camera crew who thought Ami was really cute.  
Shortly afterwards, Ami meets a blond boy who goes to her school named Nozomu. He seems to show some interest in her too. However, after she went to the 'Darwin', a group of two boy singers, concert, she met another Nozomu.  
Very soon after the encounter with Darwin, she then got roped into the entertainment world as there were many people already interested in her from her live interview, who she later also became interested in.

title: HaruHana
description: Yamada Hana's just moved to Tokyo, and her perfect debut falls disastrously flat. Not only do things at school start off badly, but her demon sister's sold her off to work for Haru, who seems to spend way too much time touching girls. If that wasn't enough, Haru's gorgeous, and Hana has a strange condition where she breaks out in hives whenever cute guys touch her!

title: Kimi wa Boku no Kagayakeru Hoshi
description:
3 oneshots :  
  
1. A Winter Star  
2. A Summer Love  
3. Strawberry Spring

title: Haikyuu!! - Good Luck Days (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

title: Sakanai Sakura (Yokoyama Mayumi)
description: Como es t� pico en los hombres, dejan todo para última hora, por lo que… sólo le queda hasta que las flores de cerezo florezcan para poder hacer que la chica que le gusta se enamore de él!

title: Kiss ja Tomaranai!
description: Wataru and Makoto are friends from early childhood. They are recognized as the gay couple in school, and while Makoto appears to be okay with it, Wataru is greatly troubled by it and by Makoto's attitude. Since Wataru will not permit anything more than a kiss, the anxious Makoto visits his prep school teacher and tries to consult him about this problem. However, he's not aware of the danger that awaits him!

title: Hayaku Shinaito Kaerenai
description:
Childhood friends Michiru and Taichi are suddenly surrounded by light while leaving high school and find themselves locked in a secret room! And they were told, “If you want to get out of here, you must kiss the neck!" What does that mean?! The two, looking for clues to escape, decide to complete the mission while suppressing their embarrassment...?!

The two, who are more than friends and less than lovers, step up their love in the world of forced flirting!

title: Juuji
description:
A young Catholic priest, named Amakusa Takara, uses his gift of holy powers to exorcise demons and on occasion the Devil himself. He is blessed and cursed with the ability to produce the "sign of the cross" on his forehead to banish demons back to Hell.

Yet, the process brings him close to the brink of insanity and physical pain. A woman called Shizuha is capable of producing the ancient writings of the "Scripture" on her body, therefore she is targeted by demons and cults alike. She asks Takara for assistance when her parents become part of a cult out to obtain her. Shizuha becomes attracted to the young priest and wishes to protect him in return

(from mangaupdates)

title: Kawaii Hito
description:
1-5, 6-11) It's all the little things that Ikeuchi does that makes Shinoda want him. Shinoda's been gay for as long as he can remember, but he's still a virgin. Then he falls in love with Ikeuchi, a younger man on the same basketball team. However, Ikeuchi has a girlfriend… is there any way Shinoda can make him want him?  
  
5.5) Hotta-san is secretly in love with his co-worker Yoshi, but Yoshi saw Hotta-san and their boss going at it in the Archives Room. Is there any hope for Hotta-san and Yoshi?  
  
5.6, 12) 2 short stories about Shin and Haruhiko.

title: 8 mm
description: When Sun-Hyuk Cho became an orphan at a young age he was taken in by his maternal grandfather, an extremly wealthy and notorius businessman. However his grandfather has just died leaving teenage Sun-Hyuk Cho his fortune under the condition he finish his education. In Sun-Hyuk Cho's video journal he reveals the difficulties he's having dealing with this death. He is not helped by the eccentric employees his grandfather has left behind or by his own eccentricities.

title: Go! Go! Kikaku
description: The wierdest, wildest, most-gratuitous orgy of teddy bears, super-heroes, pimp-outfits and vaguely underage sex we've ever seen. Includes sex through a pair of ripped pants, a teddy-bear hostage situation, and lots of scandalized kitty-cute uke boys who seem totally unaware of the kind of manga they've showed up to participate in.

title: Naruto - Rocket (Doujinshi)
description: There's a legend that says, if you kiss someone when the first firework lights up the sky on the last night of the Annual Culture Festival, you'll be with them forever. The students of Konoha Private School are preparing for their annual cultural festival. What they didn't expect was how the last night would turn out. SasuxNaru and KakaIru.

title: Eien no Omoi wo Kimi ni
description: Ever since she was small, Sakurako has always been treated nicely by all the boys she meets. That made her get too full of herself, and one day, she caused a boy to be hurt very badly. If only she can meet him again to apologize and tell him her true feelings…

title: Petal no Shintai
description: Shiroyama—class clown of the classroom, neighborhood charmer of the shopping district. One day, his quiet classmate Kotomi Aida approaches him: 'I want to repay you for helping me long ago...' Thus begins a tender boy-meets-girl story between two lonely souls carrying their own insecurities.

title: Mou Suki desho, Ore no Koto
description:
Her first love has returned as her younger brother. And what's more, he's become a bit of a playboy!  

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Cocktail Ponytail
description:
This is one of Hoshisato's first series, a romantic comedy about a youthful, energetic, and reluctant transforming high school girl hero named Saiko. A passing alien sees her courageously defending someone in a fight and is impressed with her sense of justice. He gives her a small handheld device which allows her to change into "Lady Tail", a futuristic superhero sporting a ponytail.

However, she had just recently cut her hair after her boyfriend berated her for fighting too much. When she transforms into Lady Tail, her ponytail comes back, which causes her to initially refuse the alien device. Eventually her sense of justice comes through and she begins using the device to transform into Lady Tail and assist those in need of protection.

title: Blind Heart 99%
description:
Twenty-year-old Jenna Shin has the ability to read how much others like her.
But the more she learns about people's true feelings, the deeper her distrust grows...

Until one day, a man appears who shows an unusually high level of affection toward her.

(Source: DAYcomics)

title: Osekkai Joshi (Pre-Serialization)
description: Web version of the manga Osekkai Joshi, Koi wo Suru.

title: Kocchi no Hoshi no Koi wo Mabushii
description:
A coming-of-age love story of love on a cosmic scale!

Asuka is an alien girl who came to Earth for “an important purpose” on her home planet. In order to learn about love, she chooses the cool and handsome Mr. Mitsuhara as her research subject. Asuka hopes to investigate how he, who has never been attracted to the opposite sex, falls in true love.

title: Never Cry
description: Joeun remembers everything that turned her life upside down. She remembers the man who helped her out at the darkest of times, who abandoned her while calling her cursed. She remembers her prince, who she had her first kiss with at the age of eight. He, too, abandoned her in one day. She remembers the strange black haired man who beat her mother up. Everyone said that she was cursed, and she wants to prove them wrong. Eight years later, Joeun finds a wallet. She is going to turn it in when her friend is caught by a gangster and lots of money is needed to save her. But the wallet owner sees everything, and decides that Joeun is his next target for revenge. But the wallet owner seems to be a cross-gender freak.

title: Papaya
description:
Summary From: Pinoymanga Scans  
The girl with psychic abilities Sae-in, the pretty foreign boy Harvey and the top model Jin-song that Sae-in really likes.  
  
An interesting story of the intertwined fate of these three teenagers. And who could be the guy that Sae-in is talking to through telekenesis?

title: The Belladonna's Ultimate Test
description: When an ordinary girl woke up, she found herself caught between three handsome men. Should she continue to be a player, pick one, or choose none of them?

title: Infinity Days
description:
Satomi Shinoda is an ordinary high school sophomore. Out of nowhere she receives a declaration of love from Takaya Kaito, an intelligent, tall and handsome student.
Having never spoken to each other, why her?

A pure, sweet and sad love story that will bring tears to your eyes.

title: Koi toka Ai toka
description: My class’s boys made some sort of group called O.P.D. (Mew Mew Group) and that stupid idiot “Shou”. Why do I always care about him? Why does he make my heart beat so fast? This sort of emotion is definitely not friendship… probably very special… Then that means I like–?!

title: Kigi no Yukue
description:
Juri has always been saying to herself that she has done everything that she wanted to do, and has lived to her own satisfaction. Plus, she's always been skipping class and coming in late in the mornings, only to be confronted by her class rep, Yoh. Aware of her own situation, she knows that she shouldn't leave any remaining desires and feelings behind…  
  
Also includes:  
  
- Santa ni Naritai (I Want to Become Santa)  
   
- Koe ni Naru  
Ever since something that frightened her as a child, Suzune hasn't spoken to anyone ever since. For a long time, she always thought to herself that she didn't need a voice, and that there were other ways of expressing her feelings. However, all of that changes when she meets the energetic and talkative Takuya.

title: Koisuru Ikimono
description:
A series of oneshots.  
  
1. Traces  
After his roommate left, Katsumi feels a presence in the room that tries to violate him.  
  
2-3. Midori no Himitsu & The Day After  
Mizuki and Fumiaki are cousins that haven't seen each other for nine years. Now that Fumiaki transfered to Mizuki's school and stays at his home they should get closer but Fumiaki doesn't talk about his home and distants himself from his classmates. Moreover, the plants around Fumiaki act strange.  
  
4. Traces 2  
Continuation of relationship from chapter one (timeline after second story).

title: D.C. III
description: An island named Hatsune-jima shaped similarly to a crescent moon is famous for its cheery blossom trees, one of which is rumored to make any wish come true. One day, the unofficial newspaper club decides to challenge the official newspaper club to see who can write a better article. Ricca Morizono, the president of the newspaper club, accepts the challenge along with Himeno Katsuragi, Charles Yoshino, Sara Rukawa, Aoi Hinomoto and the only male member of the club, Kiyotaka Yoshino, the protagonist. However the girls start to find Kiyotaka quite a distraction.

title: Love Gashapon
description:
It's 3 oneshots linked by the common theme of gashapon and some of the characters being friends with one another and/or attending the same school.  
  
- Love Gashapon  
On the first day that Yuhan moved into her new home, she discovered a window in her room that looks across directly at a neighbor's window. From that neighbor's window a mysterious shadow lurks…  
  
- Love Gashapon - First Love ♥ Welcome  
YanZhu is a very shy girl, who has always liked her senpai but didn't have the courage to confess. It isn't until Valentine's Day eve, after she bought a toy at Monmon's shop, that she finally got up the courage to confess, who knew…  
  
- Love Gashapon - The Prince Without Glass Slippers  
Zhou ZiYu is a playboy who has never refused anybody, so he has countless number of ex-girlfriends. He is this kind of guy, yet he meets his soulmate at a masque ball? This is the longest of the stories, has 3 parts.

title: Cursed One Piece
description:
***IT WILL GET OVER YOUR SKIN!***

"I want to be pretty. I want to be pretty. I want to be pretty... I want to wear nice clothes and be more beautiful than anyone else... If I do, he'll turn around and look at me! He'll turn around, because I'm pretty!"

3 horror stories about girls who face strange fates after wearing a mysterious beautiful dress. 4 more stories were published in Nemuki+ through 2021-2022. The sequel about adults has 6 chapters.

It was adapted into an OVA.

title: Datte Kore ga Hatsukoi
description: A history of being childhood friends for roughly 12 years. Through one thing or another, Amane and Azusa have always been together, but their romantic feelings were supposed to be at zero! And yet, upon learning that Azusa has a boyfriend, a first-time emotion begins to...!? The chronicle of a first love struggle for this incredibly naive boy begins now!

title: Futsuu to Fuhen no Hi
description:
This is a book about UiSaki going on a date in their school uniforms.
Will a flustered Ui-chan and a Saki-chan who keeps getting pulled along be able to have a normal date...?

title: Neon fish
description:
An omnibus story set in Kabukicho, Shinjuku. The first episode begins with Ami, a high school teacher, reuniting with her former student Yagi at a host club in Kabukicho. Ami is confused by the unexpected reunion with Yagi, who confessed his feelings to her in high school, but they continue their relationship as host and customer.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Dartmoor no Shounen
description:
A collection of famous early one-shots from Nanae Sasaya, chiefly from *Ribon* and with a focus on children.

- 1. **The Boy from Dartmoor** (ダートムーアの少年, Dartmoor no Shounen)
- 2. **Ahondara** (あほんだら)
- 3. **Hill of the Angels** (天使たちの丘, Tenshitachi no Oka)
- 4. **Letter** (手紙, Tegami): The story of a postman who falls for a young woman who's eagerly waiting for a certain letter.
- 5. **The Day Sandy Came** (サンディーがやってきた日, Sandy ga Yattekita Hi)

title: Rainbow
description: With the sweetness of mints, the two teenagers experienced a young and pure friendship in the summer, simple and beautiful, always remembering the summer that belonged only to them.

title: 2091 km To You
description: A bitterwsweet romance between Hong Kong and Seoul.

title: Gokujou Bitter Shounen
description: Tsubasa, boyfriend less, 18 and just failed her college entrance exams gets a job tutoring the son of her mother's superior. He's handsome, smart and perfect boyfriend material but he just so happens to be younger than her. So, she plans to make him into the perfect man! She then makes a list of qualities he should have but what happens when the one person who isn't supposed to see it sees it? Tricks her into something? And then uses it to blackmail her?

title: Kamikatari ni Sayonara wo
description:
Iroha is a girl who can see ayakashi and was born into a famous family that has worshipped ayakashi for generations. In order to protect the fortune brought by the ayakashi, she has lived her life according to her parents. Living with ayakashi who deceive her as “god,” and a fiancé who is far away from her age. Iroha runs out of her house, questioning her surroundings. There she meets a beautiful demon.

The story of an aloof demon and a girl who desires to be free!

title: Explosive Cinderella Warfront
description:
Hinazato Tsugumi, a normal girl, accidentally got picked as Miss Madonna for the Shiratori Girls School, a very select girls high school for the rich. So now Tsugumi, a girl from a middle class background, is attending Shiratori and trying to adjust to being the centre of attention amidst all of these high-class people. Of course, she's not ashamed of her background, and she's very high-spirited and cheerful. Takaomi, a slacker from the private boys' school next-door, is exactly the opposite - apathetic, and always napping outside. How will they deal with each other? (From: MU)  
  
Italian/Italiano:  
Hinazato Tsugumi, una ragazza normale, accidentalmente, viene scelta come Miss Madonna per la Shiratori Girls School.   
Miss Madonna è una delle ragazze che vengono selezionate per la scuola superiore dei ricchi. Ora Tsugumi cercherà di adattarsi ad essere al centro dell'attenzione, in mezzo a tutte queste persone di alta classe. Takaomi, un fannullone della scuola privata maschile che

title: Koisuru Suzume wa Ichizunari
description: "I'm cool, right? I'm popular? That's why he's so quick to..So he's going to fall in love with me right away..?!" A narcissistic boy falls in love at first sight with an older woman!

title: Shougakusei no Himitsu
description:
Elementary school students are full of "firsts". Because they are in elementary school, they have all kinds of problems. They may feel nervous for the first time when they meet a boy they have known since childhood, or they may be confused by the sudden changes in their bodies......even friendships are hard to manage.....you can't tell anyone, but the truth is, everyone is worried about it. This is such a secret story.

(google translated)

Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Rahasia Anak SD**

title: Blue Lock - 0812 & 0506
description:
Nagi ✕ Reo
Happy Birthday! Birthday booklets of Reo and Nagi.

title: The Champion Futo
description:
(from amazon.jp):

**"Please make me your disciple!"**

Tai Daito, a boy who has won all the national titles with his exceptional athletic talent, joins Rikidozan as his apprentice to prove that he can defeat even a big man with his techniques. With the encouragement of his younger brother Goro, a young girl named Ruriko who takes care of orphans, and Rikidozan, Tai makes a successful debut. 

However, in order to become a top-class wrestler, he develops a special move called "Knockout Q." 

In front of him, strong opponents such as Chief Shinigami, Mr. 50 Megaton, Smiley Akatsuki, a practical judo master, and other villainous wrestlers, challenge Tai, Rikidozan and the rest of the Japanese wrestling world.

 Will Tai be able to defeat his opponents in the world of Japanese wrestling with "Knockout Q"?

It is the debut work of manga writer Ikki Kajiwara, and was serialized in Kodansha's "Weekly Shonen Magazine" in 1962. With art by Tatsuo Yoshida, the duo would later team up once more

title: Ryokunohara Gakuen Series
description:
Other volumes in the series:
1. Rapyutasu Ryuuseigun
2. Psicron Syndrome
3. Hiroki - Harusaki Meiro
4. Anata - Mahoroba Festival
5. Lunatic Cinema
6. Human Nore no Koe
7. Winter Locket
8. Aoi Ginga no Yoake

Hiroki and Kanata are childhood friends spending their lives in Ryokunohara academy with their friends, surviving super natural hijinx along the way along with a hint of romance between the two boys growing.

title: Koibito no Namae
description:
V. Koibito no Namae  
  
1. Lover's Name  
One night, Ei Ariga the private detective was hit on by an obnoxious stranger whilst out working on a case handled by his father's agency. Then the timid and very polite Ryouichirou, who is a dead-ringer for the playboy stranger, turns up at the agency and tries to engage their services to find out why and how someone is breaking and entering his apartment. Ei-kun discovers that the nasty, violent and annoying carbon copy is called Naruaki and things get extremely complicated when he starts falling in love with both Ryouichirou and Naruaki… Lover's Name is also found in Double Lover - Koibito no Namae  
  
2. Saikou no Kimi  
The oneshot is also found in [Saikou no Kimi](https://mangadex.org/title/24834/saikou-no-kimi).  
  
—–  
  
V. Double Lover - Koibito no Namae (Reprint of V1)  
  
2. Kimochi no Yukue  
It's been three years since Kirima walked away from his relationship with Kou. Kou's obsessive love was what sent Kirima running in the

title: Boku no Kishi no Naito-san
description:
Kumagai, an otaku boy, is writing a romance novel set in another world, based on his beloved classmate, Naito. The heroine is, of course, himself. He absolutely cannot let Naito know about it---, but one day, Naito finds out that he is the author of the fantasy romance novel---!?

(Source: Comic Days)

title: From friendship comes love
description:
A história começa com Alex, nosso protagonista que retorna à sua cidade natal depois de 6 anos morando fora do país. Quando ele estava na Escola primária, havia um cara que costumava incomodá-lo, por causa de sua aparência delicada,  
Estar de volta para onde ele tem tantas lembranças ruins, não é algo que o alegre.  
  
From friendship comes love trata-se de uma webcomic postada originalmente no Tapastic e traduzida com a permissão da autora.

title: Ikinari☆Neko Kick
description: Masaru likes animals, especially cats. One day while out on a walk with his dog, he found a brown little kitten which looks like its lost. Masaru can't help but brought the kitten home. But next morning kitten some how turns to... little girl with cat ears!! Whats is a meaning of this and why Charo (so Masaru called kitten-girl) is looks so familiar? Light school romance begins. Ecchi-free (means no ecchi).

title: J-Boy
description:
Collection of one-shots
1) Indecent Encouter by Haruka Minami
2) We Will Love by Kana Mizuki
3) Go! Conflict Management Unit by Tsubaki Mikage
4) The Pale and Wavering Sketch by Waka Sagami
5) The Summer and the Nostalgia by Yukimura
6) The Proper Way to Raise a Pet by Ruiko
7) Pretend Lovers - Secret Slave by Aya Shouoto
8) Getting Along by Nanao Okuda
9) We Have a Hero in Our Hearts by Terako Tsukimoto
10) Spiteful Cooking by Naduki Koujima
11) Neko Samurai - Ocean Barrier by Danji Kyushu
12) The Troubles of Kurashina-sensei by Natsuho Shino
13) Thief x Thief by Homerun Ken
14) Our Relationship by Naduki Koujima
15) Loving Boys Boarding School by Danji Kyushu
16) Here in Magic Land by Hirono Suzuhara
17) Rabbit Ear Kindergarten by Yogorouta Kamei
18) Shadows of the Forest by the Quiet Lakeside by Sakyou Yozakura

title: Hina-chan wa Numa
description:
My brother's girlfriend is three years older than me, and she's so in love with me that she comes over to our house all the time, but for some reason, there's something strange about the distance between us...?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title: Star Catcher (pre-Originals)
description: The depressed-introvert Lucas meets and befriends the carefree-extrovert Thomas during their freshman year at Star Valley University. Now they are best friends! Totally just friends! Nothing... non-platonic here! Does contain themes of mental health struggles. (Normal world/College AU of Star Children)

title: That's why I KISS you!!
description: On the day of his 16th birthday, Shigeaki, a first-year traditional high school student, meets two cute transfer girls, Nikaido, who is a little unapproachable, and Aoyama, who has a friendly dog. Akira, who feels a premonition of a rosy school life, comes with the true power of her family for generations, the power to "stop time at will"! However, the power he inherited has a side effect, which causes Akira to be unable to move for a while...

title: Inran Baby
description: Jouganji Heisuke is considered pretty hot by the girls in his middle school, but the one he has a crush on, Eguchi Chihiro, has no interest in him at all. He's pretty new to puberty and liking girls, and he is constantly surprised by how much every little thing she does turns him on. It's too bad that his crush is completely one-sided!

title: Life Like a Flower
description:
Four women, all college seniors. Their four loves, four lives.

___
• [Alternate Raws (Kakaopage)](https://page.kakao.com/home/54046985)

title: Leave a Message
description: A ordinary girl finds a message written on her desk one day…

title: Hakushaku Reijou Sarah Cloria wa Kyou mo Akai Ito wo Kiru
description:
"My red thread has been cut!"

Suddenly, Alex Hubert, a knight candidate, sees a red thread and learns of the existence of a beautiful black-haired girl who is cutting that thread. She is Countess Sarah Cloria, who attends the same school. She carries a pair of scissors and easily cuts the threads because they are "in the way." She is rumored to be the "Witch of Catastrophe" and is isolated from the rest of the school. At first Alex resented Sarah's selfish behavior, but it seems that she is actually breaking up the relationship between the lovers for a reason...?!

title: Chairman Kuroiwa's Big Incident
description:
Won an Effort Award from the March 2022 New Generation Sunday Awards. ([X](https://x.com/syk0kys/status/1523792167839223808))
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [X](https://x.com/syk0kys/status/1525036240965226496)

title: X'mas wa Kirai
description: Fujikura Akira is aiming to be a photographer while Masaki Hiroyuki is a high school dropout. Akira takes an unknown picture of Hiroyuki last Christmas while Hiroyuki was crying… and all Akira wants to find out is why…

title: Romantic Fruity C-2
description: The first month of the first lunar brings back the popular previous work "Romantic Fruity C" sweetly, and restarts the second serialization again. The love of youth is as sweet and green as sour fruit. Four teenagers, two kinds of separation, two loves that change fate, beautiful but heart-wrenching.

title: Kooporasu e Youkoso
description:
Yamanobi Apartments have a story behind them: Anyone who lives there will gain something big, but lose something big as well. This is a collection of stories about the various tenants and their love lives.  
  
1) Muroi Kaname has just moved into Yamanobi. The naturally unsocial Kaname doesn't care about stories, and also quickly manages to alienate himself from everyone in the building. But when his upstairs neighbor, talkative Fujimura, sees a different side to him, he's determined to be Kaname's friend. Kaname slowly lets himself grow closer to Fujimura, but will their friendship withstand the jinx?  
  
2) Kamimura Mizuki has always chosen lovers for their looks, and gotten nothing but trouble. This time he wants a sincere guy, and he already has one picked out: Itokawa from his work. But getting his attention is proving to be somewhat difficult. At least slacker apartment caretaker Akabame always listens to his troubles…  
  
3) Nojima is known as the life of the party, always lig

title: Kimi wa Kanata yori
description:
The expressionless Kureboshi somehow ends up getting involved with Kanata, a type of guy she usually can't stand.

Note: Published in Margaret issue 17/2025.

title: Kuroko no Basket - Koi wa Daitan ni (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kagami Taiga x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Kyou mo Gokigen Morino-san
description:
Atsushi, a first-year high school student, cannot take his eyes off Morino, who is always smiling in a corner of the classroom. He wants to get closer to her, but...! 

This is a romantic comedy stories about a warm-hearted adolescent!

title: Ashihara-Kun No Amaikamiato
description: 真面目でお人好しな女子高生・ひろは、関わることのない人だと思っていた“高嶺の問題児”芦原くんになぜか目を付けられてしまい――!?　イケメン不良男子が一途に溺愛してくるドキドキラブ！

title: Soul Switch
description: Jonggu is gentle and kind, but he always gets in trouble because he looks like a scary delinquent. One day, he gets into an accident with the popular Sohee, and he wakes up trapped inside her body. Now, the two must quickly solve their body sharing problem while staying hidden from the Grim Reaper

title: Dokkiri Doctor
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Dr. Haruka Nishikikoji, the director of the Shirobara Clinic, is also the school doctor at Nanasei Junior High School, located right next door. So students come and go, just like in the infirmary. And one more. Miyuki, the nurse. She is firm, and in addition, cute and sexy. But for some reason, she is Haruka-sensei's fiancée. But the two are still in a platonic relationship. 

Now comes the first volume of the exploits of Haruka-sensei, a naughty and dirty...genius, eccentric, or rare inventor...who is not known at all!

title: Stars, Don't Fade!
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Published in 1960, this is the mangaka's first full-length work, and it is a major work that spans two books, the first part and the second part. 

Part 1 - The story revolves around a secret hidden in a doll owned by the main character, and is a dramatic story that keeps the reader's hands sweating.

Part 2 - The story takes place in Tokyo, Kyushu, and a hot spring resort deep in the mountains, all at a brisk tempo.

title: Pet wa Binyanshi
description:
Compilation of short stories:  
  
1) Pet wa Binyanshi.  
Shy girl Ruho has a secret. She keeps a cat named Kuro in the garden behind the school. One day while calling Kuro, a bishie answers. "Kuro here…!"  
What?!  
  
2) Tenori Life  
  
3) My Boyfriend is a Vampire  
  
4) Sono-saki wa Kindan Ryōiki  
  
5) Tsutsumu Tenohira Sasu Yubisaki  
  
6) Pet wa Binyanshi. Extra Chapter: Handsome Rival.

title: Lovely Lesson
description: Compared to other girls at your school, do you think you're ugly? No matter what you try, you never become as pretty as them? Or were you dumped because you weren't pretty enough? No matter what the reason, there is a way to heal you. Meet Yuhri, a "beauty healer" who really is just a high school goods storekeeper. But when Yuhri meets another "beauty healer" like her, Makoto, what will she do?

title: Tarintaran
description: Before Sugimoto Moe drew the idle daily lives of erythroblasts (immature red blood cells) who don't want to work in Hatarakanai Saibou the spin off to the popular Hataraku Saibou he drew a slice of life comedy about two people trying to fall in love

title: Shiawase no Tori wa Naniiro
description:
One day, Meguru, a high school girl, suddenly regains her memories of her previous life, when she was a little bird. Her owner in her previous life, “Ao-kun” (Ao), who is somewhere in this town, has a bad luck constitution. In the world between her previous life and this one, Meguru is told that Ao will never be happy as he is, so she decides to make him happy even if he is reborn.
After regaining her memory, Meguru immediately seeks out Ao and guides him to happiness while working part-time at the bookstore where he works!

title: Trap
description:
1-2+extra) Narushima, an elite detective of the Metropolitan Police Department who is guarding an important person at football stadium happens to meet his old friend, Fujisaki. When they were promising football players in same team, Fujisaki always dominated Narushima and deprived all of Narushima including of his pride and girlfriend. But Narushima realizes that Fujisaki becomes a sniper. He failed to catch Fujisaki and Fujisaki also failed to kill the VIP. They meet again and make love together…  
  
3) An ex-member of swimming club encourages a retired member by fatal injury to tell the ace swimmer his feeling. Ace swimmer accepts it because he loves injured butterflies…  
  
4) A teacher tries to find out the reason why his student acts rebelliously only against him…

title: Flavor of Love
description:
Ai has always believed that her cooking is really good, despite not being able to taste anything. She enjoys school life with her two friends. So what will happen when the famous VJ, Daiwen, asks her out? And what will happen when she finds out how bad her cooking truly is? So what has Lansi really been eating…?  
  
> Spin-off of Mushroom College

title: Toiki ni Furete
description:
- Fragments of Happiness  
  
President Midou has been interested in waiter, Sakura Kaname, since he flew into his Midou's arms escaping a molesting relative.  
  
- Part 2.  
  
Persued by Midou, Kaname feels he can't trust him now matter how attracted he is.  
  
- Story 2.  
  
"I won't ever open up my heart to anyone else again. I won't like anyone else again. That is the only way I can protect myself from harm." Minato Yuuya refuses to accept the feelings of his kouhai, Takami Naota, because of his own past.  
  
- Forbidden Lust  
  
Asahina has been in love with Manager Kizaki ever since they met a year ago, but it could never be mutual, could it?  
  
- Heart Throbbing Love  
  
A teacher's promiscuous private life is discovered by a student.

title: Wakeatte, Hensou shite Gakuen ni Sennyuu shiteimasu
description: Cecia is a lazy young lady's double. She is a servant of the Viscount's family, and if she graduates successfully, she will be rewarded with enough money to live on for the rest of her life. She is a lukewarm bully of the daughters at the academy and a hard worker in the mansion. But just before graduation, she falls into a trap where she gets paid nothing. Cecia is determined to get back at them. Suddenly, a second prince, whom she has never met before, appears and says, “If you want to get back at me, I'll help you!" A heroine who believes in fighting back, and the bad boy prince who puts his life on the line for his country, a love story that is not a simple one!

title: Sazanami Yurete Fureru
description:
Hiyama, who moved from Tokyo, was spending her days in a listless state, but by chance she became friends with a girl named Konkichi and got to know Konkichi's boyfriend. However, she gradually became interested in him...!?

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

title: New Tales of the 100 Tales
description:
(from ebookjapan):

The father of a high school girl, Hatsune Kozumi, is the abbot of Hoshuzan Kurinji Temple. At the temple's main hall, a "Hyakumonogatari no Kai" (Hundred Tales Club) is held every month. 

Hatsune's friends, as well as psychics and psychic researchers, attend the meeting to discuss real-life bizarre occurrences and horror stories, including psychic phenomena, yokai, curses, and black magic. 

This is an authentic horror manga that uses real-life examples and scientifically verifies bizarre phenomena!

title: Shibai Taroka
description:
There is a new student at Oobu High School. He is Yakuda Daigo. With his buff body, touch looking and a face that can give every one a run, soon rumor fly about about him. Some says he's the gang leader, some says he's get involve with Yakuza business, some says he rape, steal and like beating people up.

There is only a handful people know how Yakuda really is, including Minami-a girl Yakuda fell in love with. Yakuda loves to cook and he likes cute stuff. He is also enjoy gardening, crafting and he likes pet. He's an over all caring person. He always carry around a cute sewing kit and a cute firstaid kits around.

However, with many unfortunate events, he often get involve with gang fight and criminal, along with other coincidental things that happens around him. People always assume the worse for him.

Will everyone found out who he really is?

title: BlueMic
description:
Sihu Choi, a 2nd year high school student, is famous in his school for 2 things: reading the morning announcements and turning down confessions indifferently.  
  
Aeun Son, also a 2nd year, loves nothing more than to listen to Sihu's soothing voice every morning, often arriving to class late in order to hear the morning announcements in a quiet corridor.  
As the new school year begins and Aeun's obsession flares once more, she makes a promise to herself that she'll become Sihu's friend at the very least.  
  
With the help of her older sister, and the fact that they've been put into the same class, can Aeun succeed where every other girl before her has failed?

title: Ore-sama Kingdom
description:
Nonohara is a high-school girl who wants to become a mangaka. And her inspiration came from handsome boys in third year. But she can't just look at them, she also has to work hard! One day, when she was drawing at the library, the third years entered in the library. And then, they saw that Nonohara was drawing their face!!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Tameiki no Ondo
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- Tameiki no Ondo  
Jun is always being compared to his older brother Ryou, and falling short. But when his brother's friend Yuuya starts to tutor him, his patient nature begins to get through to Jun. When Jun realizes Yuuya's feelings for Ryou, he must confront his own feelings for Yuuya.  
  
- Blind  
  
- Distance  
  
- Border  
  
- Bokutachi no Sotsugyou (Our Graduation)  
Umebayashi has been in love with Matsubara from the day they first met, but cramped by his rival, Takeshiba, he never got around to express his feelings. Now that graduation is nearing, the boys feel the need to confess to the ones they like.

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Doujin Fujoshi
description:
A couple, Taku-kun and Miyabi-chan. The two met quite normally and started dating, but in reality, she was a fujoshi...

A 4koma manga.

title: Koharu To Futari No Naito
description:
心に傷を抱える女子高生、小春。
そんな彼女の夢、それは素敵な恋をすること──。
ある日学校の階段でつまづいた小春を助けてくれた同級生の伊織に、
小春はいつもと別人のような顔を覗かせる。
それは小春の中に生きるもう一人の人物、秋人だった……。
”恋人候補＝恋のライバル”!?新感覚(？)ラブコメ始動！

title: Hitsuji wo Kazoete Dokomademo
description:
From Impossibility:  
  
Miharu Tsuji is a 15 year old tom-boy who finds out that her best friend likes her. Now, she must deal with the different emotions and find out what she truly feels in this all-so-strange situation.

title: Oogami-san no Kojirase Ai ga Amasugiru
description:
Miu, a shy otaku girl who's not great with men, suddenly gets invited to the home of Oogami—a regular at her part-time job who looks intimidating but is actually super kind?!

A messy, all-consuming love between a pure-hearted guy and an otaku college girl, living under the same roof in this sweet and awkward romance ♡

title: Kuroko no Basket - Kunkou x Kunkou (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Sprinter
description: Adopted by a well to do family, Hikaru Yuuki had grown up knowing two things; hard work and a comfortable lifestyle. One day, when an old man notices Hikaru's natural talent for running, he pressures Hikaru to race. After his initial success, Hikaru falls in love with the sport and faces a huge decision. Will he continue his lavish lifestyle while working for the family business or pursue his newfound dream of becoming Japan's greatest sprinter?

title: Rhysmyth
description: Desperate for a group to fit in, clumsy Elena auditions for her school's Rhysmyth team by mistake. All of a sudden, Elena must compete in one-on-one dance-offs across a grid with disappearing blocks. Embracing style and precision, Elena discovers a new self and even love in the world of dance!

title: Sweet Mission
description: The storyline focuses on the student council solving mysteries while living their normal lives. They tackle different missions everyday regarding the school and solve any case given to them. But that's not all! Romance between the demonic president and council member, Akari continues to develop in the midst of chaos but is she honest enough to accept her own feelings for this sadist?

title: Taiyou to Tsuki no Aida de
description:
From Manga-Mania:  
On the day Sari transfers to her new school, she confesses her love for her cousin Kazuomi. After being subtly rejected, she find out that Kazuomi's best friend Mizuki is also interested in him. Because those two are like the sun and the moon, Sari's determination to be Kazuomi's girlfriend begins to waver. How will this interesting love triangle develop?

title: Kiss and Ride
description: On the day of the high school exam, it fell before Chiyo, a boy like Light, General (Tasuku). I assume that he is bad, Chiyo… But actually he was a motorcycle racer. It's Chiyo, but the general is showing me a new world that I didn't know about.

title: Vampire Dekiai Paradise
description:
Rikka Miku, a first year junior high school student, has a childhood friend named Shiraha Kou, who is kind and handsome, but has a bad mouth. After entering junior high school, Kou becomes a member of the school's idol group "Colors", which is made up of four good-looking boys, gets his ears pierced, and hangs out with a flashy senior. Miku becomes worried and asks Kou about Colors, but he warns her not to get close to the members. In fact, the members of Colors, including Kou, have a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Soko wa Nemuri no Mori
description:
Consists of three oneshots:  
1) Soko wa Nemuri no Mori -   
Yui has stopped growing because of something that happened when she was 12 years old. One day, 18-year-old Yuri found a young man with amnesia near the hidden cottage she lives in, and brought him home. Yui named the man "Pochi" because he cannot even remember his name, and she treats him as her pet…  
  
2) The Stars Knows Everything -   
Futari no Tame ni Sekai wa Aru no extra. Chiharu is dating the stundent rep Kyou but it's a secret - so she disguises their relationship with Fukaya Hisaki - it's too bad that Kyou's bestfriend feels she's 'corrupting' him and decides to intervene…  
  
3) Climb the Stairs of Cinderella. Kaya is a child prodigy, best in choir without any lessons, perfect piano playing, but she has a hard time dealing with other's jealousy, especially when Katsuma, the boy she likes is in love with Misaki, her bestfriend, but Misaki doesn't know….what should Kaya do?

title: Merry Go Round In Wonderland
description:
It was said that being in love is much like riding a roller coaster. This holds true for most except for junior high student, Haruka who finds that her love isn't at all like this and on the contrary compares it to a merry go round.  
  
When Haruka discovers that her favorite sempai in her camera club is going to move in just a month, she impulsively confesses her genuine feelings. Even so, her sempai does not take her seriously and brushes it aside lightly with jokes. But, though Haruka was nervous and embarrassed, she was not discouraged and thus her merry go round of love begins.

title: B-Virgin
description: Aki, a camera enthusiast who was completely ignored by girls, undergoes a dramatic transformation when he enrolls in the same university as his crush, Yui! Trained by his three sisters, he becomes a cool guy who's great at handling women. What's more, he becomes a "B virgin," fulfilling a girl's wish to only have sex with the woman he loves! However, Yui mistakes Aki, who's so good at handling women, for a "player" and doesn't take his feelings seriously...!? A must-read for both unpopular and popular guys! A surefire dating manual to transform you into a super-popular guy!

title: Ganbyeongdongmaeng
description:
[Sunshine Person] [Youngest Daughter of a Prestigious Family] [A Pampered Child]

Juwon enjoys a popular campus life, having earned nicknames like the ones above thanks to her gentle, cheerful personality and adorably attractive appearance that anyone would find likable.

But the reality is the complete opposite.

Every evening at sunset, the place she heads to is a nursing hospital on the outskirts of the city.

There, a mother waiting for death and an ill-tempered daughter caring for that mother spend their days.

Juwon is living an exhausting double life to fulfill her mother's final wish: to be surrounded by lots of people.

Meanwhile, unlike Juwon, Hangyeol is living the life of an outsider after returning to university.

Despite his handsome looks, his intimidating aura and taciturn personality make it difficult for anyone to approach him, leaving him to endure a lonely college life.

Then one day, the two meet in a hospital room.

And not just under ordinary circumstances.

Han-

title: Just a Girl
description:
From CPM:
On her own for the very first time, Erica finds herself dealing with the pressures of independence. Luckily, some old friends--and some exciting new ones--are there to help her make her way in this exciting new world. Will it be enough for her to grow and be a successful woman, or will she remain just a girl?

title: Meguru Kisetsu no Naka de
description: Spring can be hard season to deal with…

title: Con Con x Honey
description:
Sasami is the type of girl who gets easily pushed around at school. One day, a rambunctious young boy named Kou causes trouble in school and unknowingly drops a strange piece of candy. Sasami returns it to him, and he suddenly asks her to marry him! Will Sasami accept his proposal, or will she completely reject it?  
  
Volume contains the main story (chs.1-3) + 3 oneshots

title: Koigokoro Kyoumeichuu
description:
From Chibi Manga:  
Ritsuka and Kaze-kun are currently lovey dovey, but Aizawa-sensei who is extremely beautiful and has the perfect body just started working. Is Kaze-kun also excited over sensei's enormous breasts? With the appearance of a rival, Ritsuka is in a bind!  
I want to be my prettiest when I am in senpai's field of vision!  
Hayashi, Ritsuka's friend, is the main character in the extra story. This is an extremely happy compilation volume to the Koigokoro series!!

title: Itoshii Kimi
description:
A collection of 3 one-shots by Suetsugu Yuki all sharing the common theme of summer love between high school students.

July:
Sumitomo Ayumi has had a secret crush on Narazaki-kun for 2 years and has finally mustered up the courage to tell him, but just as she is about to confess her feelings, she finds out that he is suddenly going to move away...

August:
Mizuki Chihaya chose to concentrate in the sciences at her high school, which made her 1 of only 4 girls in her homeroom class. Teased and harassed by the boys, she is miserable. If it weren't for Kuonji-kun, her classmate from middle school, it would be unbearable...

September:
Fujio Chitose has been shamelessly going after her big time crush Takasuga-senpai of the soccer team, when suddenly, he assents to being her boyfriend. Her long-time dream has finally come true, right?

title: Romance no Hitomi
description: A series of three oneshots. Each with a romantic plot and twist of a love that shouldn't happen.

title: Quick Witted Boy
description:
In a deserted place, wish upon coins, then laugh loudly three times, your wish will come true…  
  
The carefree and outgoing Eu Hee secretly likes a girl; however the person she likes is another senpai. If this isn't ridiculous enough Eu Hee decided to help her confess to her crush!  
  
A sweet and light-hearted tale, this is Mi Sa-Lyn's first series after her Debut.

title: Yumemiru Alice Wa Koi Mo Shirazu Ni
description: 人里離れた森の中、壮麗で由緒正しい小中高一貫の寄宿学校、鏡凜学園。新学期から生徒たちの話題は、編入生、兎野アリスの話題で持ち切り。容姿端麗、成績優秀、物腰は柔らかで人当たりもよい。小動物に愛される様子は、さながら物語の主人公…しかしそれは見せかけで、アリスは努力で”主人公っぽく”自己演出していたのである。 しかし、ある日、その立場を危うくする人物が現れる…すべての面でアリスを上回る、天然主人公男子、有栖川律が入院から帰ってきた！美しく、賢く、ミステリアスで…キャラがかぶってるって！ そんな有栖川にアリスは絶対に知られてはいけない秘密を握られる…

title: Naturalist no Kare
description: Himeji's older brother, Miyaji, meets the new dorm manager, Hatoya Sensei. Is Miyaji a pervert just like his brother or does Hatoya Sensei have his own plans. Also, while Naruse and Kunisaki are happily in love, rejected waiter Aono still hasn't found his love. Is there a soul mate out there for Aono and why is that customer SO grumpy every morning? And why does Aono have to cater to him?

title: This Side of the Rape Blossom Field
description: About four young college girls living together. The work that made Kimura gain popularity.

title: Heart no Present
description: ILDA is one of the best basketball players. He even has his own cheering section. Tsubaki finds herself staring at him while she practices her shots. But her team is not any good, and if they don't find a way to win the next basketball game, their team might get canceled!

title: Miracle Illusion
description: Ever since his eighth birthday, Yeonwoo has been the target of cruel bullying by his classmates. It was a well-known fact that he was poor, smelly, and living with his grandma. But with the new transfer student Seongwoon’s dramatic appearance, he gains his first real friend. Just as Yeonwoo starts getting used to his new happy life, Seongwoon and his parents are in a tragic accident that leaves him orphaned with no memories. Now, it’s Yeonwoo’s turn to take care of the precious person who gifted him so many of his “firsts”—even if Seongwoon doesn’t remember a single one.

title: Torawareta Ojo Wa Ni Do, Shiawasena Yume  Omiru
description:
失ったのは、未来と、大切な人。
婚約破棄、冤罪、そして忠誠を尽くしてくれた護衛騎士・エドの最期――
彼の命と引き換えに、王女アナベルは過去へと時を巻き戻す。

「今度こそ、運命にあらがってみせる」

魔力を解放する鍵を求めて学園へ通い、やがてエドとも前世とは違う関係に…？
転生王女が運命に挑む、やり直しロマンスファンタジー！

title: Naimononedari no Kimi ni Hikari no Hanataba wo
description:
Kageko is a high school girl who has a complex about being "ordinary" in every way. However, during the second semester, she ends up sitting next to Mahiru, a popular student at school and a member of a hugely popular idol group. She thought she lived in a different world from him, a "special" boy who is the complete opposite of her... But by chance, they end up serving as library committee members together! What's more, it seems he has a side to him that those around him don't know about...?

*Source: Comic Walker, translated*

title: Tonari no Usotsuki - Be Side
description: What starts as a simple kiss between childhood friends, turns into something else?! Will their friendship crumble as they become adults or will it become something more?

title: Colors!
description:
Mafuyu's nature is that she is a delusional girl who loves idols.
And then, by chance, she ends up living in a share house called "COLORS". And there, the idols that Mafuyu loves so much are there! COLORS" is a share house exclusively for idols.

title: My Captive Princess
description:
Xia Niannian is an ordinary high school student.

Not wanting to be disgraced at Gu Jasmine's birthday party, she bought online a charming handsome boy online. Why? Because her Prince Charming is Han Che, Gu Jasmine boyfriend.

After received what she bought, she accidentally opened four blood contracts but didn't receive any charming handsome boy on the birthday party. When she was mocked by others, Qianyin appeared like a prince, and made her become the center of others' attentions.

title: Love Letter
description: Raka's normal high school life takes an exciting turn when he receives a strange letter from Meyssa. Though it turns out not to be a love letter, Raka's friends won't leave it at that. So begins an unlikely relationship between two teenagers from different classes

title: Dekiai Shitarinai.
description: 高1の真綾は目立つことが苦手なのに、校内でも有名な超イケメン不良の高良に突然ファーストキスを奪われてしまう。さらに彼に勉強を教えることになり――!?　超絶美形不良 × 真面目な地味子のドロ甘学園ラブ♡

title: Murder Dial 9999
description:
If you had the access to Murder Dial 9999, a strange service that causes the death of whoever you order it to kill, who would you murder?

"Rrrrr... this is Murder Dial 9999. If there's someone you want to kill, we'll take your order." A creepy message comes from a phone she picked up by chance... Akiko is skeptical, but when she places her order, her love rival Rina is found dead, covered in blood. But the price of fear is... This is a sleep-disturbing, mad horror collection of seven short stories, including "Murder Dial 9999," "The Secret Room Club," "The Human Bug Flower," "The Human Bug Flower - The Growth of Madness," "Jack the Ripper," "Nightmare," and "Murder Dial 9999 #2.

title: Lonely Ruka
description: Hokkaido, Sapporo. High school student Ruka is living her life in bliss in the house of lilac. Even though they didn't share their mother, Ruka had a beautiful older sister, as well as a lovely younger sister. They lived with their strict but loving mother and their gentle father, whom they all loved dearly. One day a young boy named Shion transfers to Ruka's school. For some unknown reason, he views Ruka as his sworn enemy. However, along with solving the riddle of his behavior, Ruka's life begins to turn for the worst...

title: Kenka, Tokidoki Kiss.
description: This is the last San Valentine with him in the middle school…

title: Gachikoi Mistake
description: Shigure Akutagawa is a first-year high school student. Shigure likes all things related to "Idols" and dislikes anything related to "Love". Suddenly one day, she is confessed to by Minoru Kakimoto, who is said to be the most handsome guy in the school! Moreover, it seems to be a huge misunderstanding...!? A love story that begins with a misunderstanding and a misconception between a handsome boy and a girl who dislikes love.

title: Suberu Tenshi
description: In the summer of his second year of high school, the ordinary boy with no dreams or goals, Shiroma, sees an unexpected figure of a beautiful girl in his class! A youthful comedy routine that he discovers through trial and error begins here.

title: Emiri ni Omakase♥
description: The story of an elementary girl in love with her school doctor....the only problem is the another female teacher is in love with him too. To meet the competition she takes some pills her brother gave her, and she turns into a grown up!!!!

title: KIsara Chan Wa Junjo Sakyubasu
description: の主人公・きさらは、母がサキュバス、父が人間の高校1年生。見た目はほぼ普通の女の子で、サキュバスとしての本能もないに等しく性的なことは大の苦手だった。しかし密かに思いを寄せていた3年生の柳瀬先輩が女子とふしだらな行為をしている現場を目撃してしまい、サキュバスの本能が暴走。思わず先輩にキスをしてしまい、自分がサキュバスだということもバレてしまう。そんなきさらに対して、柳瀬先輩がとんでもない提案をしてきたことから始まる2人の関係が描かれる。

title: Promise
description:
That was a long time ago. In the countryside where I went to escape from studying for exams, I met Nagisa, who was like a sunflower. The summer vacation I spent with her was an eternal time that gave me light and courage in my life. Nagisa, I will never forget the promise I made to you that summer. 
___
This is Yuki Suetsugu's masterpiece, depicting the sad memories hidden in her heart.

title: Azuki-chan
description:
Azusa Noyama is a 12-year-old girl student, taking 5th grade, but everyone knows her as Azuki-Chan, nickname that she dislikes. Yuunosuke Ogasawara, a new student, asks her about her nickname, saying that he likes it. Azuki falls in love with him, and they start going out together. They share a diary, and become boyfriend and girlfriend.  
  
(Source: ANN)

---

- Indonesian release by Elex Media

title: I Love You. I Hate You
description: Junior high school teacher Chihana Tagami's boyfriend, Mitsuru Ito, is the father of his homeroom student, Saou. He says he doesn't mind getting caught out, but he doesn't want to give up his teaching job just yet. And Hayabane, who noticed her relationship, seems to hate her these days. However, the real reason why things don't go well with Hayabane is that Chika's heart is affected by the thorns in her heart... Love, love, man, woman, and family. A collection of gem stories depicting human beings who live while being hurt in search of various bonds.

title: Kisu Made Oazuke
description: 男子免疫ゼロの葵紀は、共学に通い始めたその日に倒れたところを学校一モテるという噂の新堂先輩に助けてもらう。それをきっかけにやたらと新堂先輩にからまれ始めたけど、先輩にはとんでもない秘密があって――！？

title: D.C. III (HINATA Nonoka)
description: Serialized in Dengeki G's Magazine! The hit bishoujo game series "D.C." from the popular brand Circus is now being adapted into a comic. We will deliver the official story of the "Weathercock Arc," which is the main story of the original game.

title: No-ppakku Choe Ha-yeong
description: Yeonji, a high school girl who tries to help her classmate from abuse, ends up making herself the target of a bully. Her struggles only seem to get worse until the new girl Hayeong steps in for support, declaring war on the bullies. But the more Hayeong fights against mistreatment, the more hostility she attracts, and she must fight her way to keep the ones she cares for safe.

title: Sei Heroine ni Tensei Shimashita ga, Unmei no Haguruma wa Butsuri de Buchiko Washimasu
description:
Viscountess Sonia suddenly regains memories of her past life—she's been reincarnated as the heroine of the otome game "Saint Project." Now able to see the "gears" that control people according to the script, Sonia sets out to avoid a future where she ends up with the crown prince and other high-ranking nobles who are her love interests. The only way to break their "gears" is to hug them?!
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9499kh/)

title: Sweet Life
description: Kuramoto Yuushi, 17, is going out with aloof and arrogant, Kuzuhara Shuuichirou, a 28-year-old novelist. However, Yuushi’s tender age makes him doubt his place as a lover to this mature adult who never expresses his feelings… Fear, insecurity and jealousy will assail young and earnest Yuushi who chases after the years that separate him from the man he loves… But sometimes the most immature and desperately in love is not always the obvious one…

title: I Can't Look Into Your Eyes
description: A comedy about love being revealed Kuroda-kun, an elementary school student whose feelings are always on his face, has his feelings discovered by his classmate Akamine-san (?). Maybe she knows what I'm feeling right now? When I look into Akamine-san's honest eyes, I feel like she can see right into my heart... That's why I "can't look you in the eye and talk to you." A heartwarming and heart-pounding love comedy brought to you by CoroCoro Comic!

title: Fure Ai
description: Kabura Ogi, a gorgeous high school girl, and Momone Owada, a plain high school girl, they never talk at school, but become best friends who share everything at "Copal", a hideaway café away from the school. They are both in love with Nishiki-san, a college student who works at "Copal".

title: Outcast Cafe
description: Alex is a delinquent that hates injustice and constantly gets into fights to protect people who get mistreated. One day while walking home from school Alex barely saves a homeless girl from being molested by Mark who is the son of a infamous mafia boss. Mark swears revenge on Alex for interfering multiple times and The next day Alex comes home to his parents massacred by a mysterious assassin and their restaurant destroyed. After hearing his dad’s dying last words Alex promises to change his ways and to follow in his parent’s footsteps to become a successful chef like they wanted without seeking revenge. Will Alex keep his promise to give up fighting and make the new restaurant he was given by his parents successful? Or Will his old habits and upcoming threats lead him to a path of vengeance ? Or will he find an even better path to take?

title: Heart Hibikase-ron
description:
Izumi, a high school student, is invited by her friend to a live music club for the first time!　But when she hands over her ticket to enter the venue with nervousness, she is told that high school students are not allowed. Izumi is hit by a rude guy right away, and she can't get along with the music at all during the concert....Izumi is depressed, and the rude man says, "Let me apologize to you..."?!

Love is booming in the hall, and the heart rate of the live house manager and the tall JK is soaring!

title: Zense Karano Koijijo
description:
前世の恋を、キミと、もう一度。
昔々、「叶わぬ恋」ありけり。その男は家の“主”。その女は拾われの“従者”。そんな“立場”に縛られし時代――……なんてものは過ぎ去り、時は現代!フツ~の学生に生まれた二人には、前世の記憶が残っていた!!時代を越える、現代主従ラブコメ☆

title: Koisuru Melody Musume. - Love Song Trilogy
description:
A collection of short stories.  
  
1) DJ "COOL"  
Chiaki never expected to fall in love with the number one night club DJ!  
  
2) Pianist "Sou"  
Mizue is charmed by her enigmatic music professor.  
  
3) Guitarist "Demi"  
Hinano's boyfriend just dumped her because she's not his type! She's too cute, and he wants a sexy girl… but it would seem Hinano's mailman disagrees. By day, he hand delivers her mail, and by night he lets down his bleached blonde hair, and… (!!!)–but guys like that aren't Hinano's type!  
  
4) Princess Hungry  
Aoi, age 17, has a problem–an abnormal appetite! It's getting hard to keep it a secret from her classmates, but she can't let them know. She still remembers when she started dating her crush Kousaka… and then when he caught her pigging out after they'd parted one night, he never spoke to her again. But now Aoi is going on a trip with some classmates and their friends… and Kousaka is with them!? Is he mad at Aoi? Will he tell everyone her secret?

title: Trouble Dogs
description: Shiina Kanako, voted the most beautiful girl in her high school, is a member of the school's gymnastics team. Overhearing talk that the boy's soccer team was planning to harass her team during summer training, Shiina decides to ask a mysterious group on campus called "Trouble Dog" rumored to solve all sorts of clients' problems for money. Through this she encounters three mysterious guys named Ryuu, Pochi, and Sabu. Who are they really and what do they want her to do?

title: Hatsukare (Official Colored)
description: This is about Chihiro, a teenager who has only gone to an all-girls school and has no experience with boys whatsoever. One day, a boy that she sees at the train station every day asks her out and thus she begins her first relationship. This manga portrays the up and downs of first love with a good dose of humor.

title: Towa Remix
description: A selection of masterpieces with gags, lilies, and transvestites. It is an e-book of a book that collects short stories that I have drawn in various places and packs them tightly. Full volume of 200 pages, newly drawn when making a book, and color pages are also included.

title: Crossover
description:
Cặp anh em song sinh Hye – Sung được mệnh danh là ngọn gió mới của làng bóng rổ. Cặp đôi với tài năng thiên bẩm, chiều cao vượt trội cùng kỹ thuật đỉnh cao được mệnh danh là thiên tài thể thao. Tại ngôi trường trung học phổ thông nằm trong top 1 cả nước, cùng khát vọng chinh phục đại hội toàn quốc, cuộc phiêu lưu của hai người đang chuẩn bị bắt đầu…
