- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=51910134)

title: Kimi wo Sukuu Tatta Hitotsu no Houhou
description: On that day when my beloved idol was stabbed in front of my eyes, my life-long time leap began. Nodoka is working hard on her former classmate's idol, Akki. One day, she encounters a man and a woman in a back alley - but that man is Akki! Stabbed and covered in blood, Akki hands her something, and the next thing she knows,  she finds herself back in high school! If I change the past, can I change the future when Akki gets stabbed? If so...What is the future they will reach after the time leap?

title: Oshi Ga Fan No Fan Ni Nacchau Ohanashi
description: 主人公は歌い手・イットを推す会社員のたんぽぽ。過去の恋愛で「健気すぎて引く」と言われた彼女は、自分の気持ちで誰かを不快にさせないようにと、推しに“認知”されないように慎重に推し活をしていた。しかし当のイットもまた、たんぽぽをひっそりと認知し、彼女のファンとなっていて……。空木が描く、推しとファンのハートフルストーリーだ。

title: Persona 3 Reload: Beginnings
description: Hidden between one day and the next is a mysterious phenomenon called the Dark Hour: a time period where otherworldly creatures prey on human psyches, leaving behind victims with the debilitating Apathy Syndrome. In the midst of this darkness, the unknowing second-year transfer student Makoto Yuki arrives at Gekkoukan High School – and through a chance encounter, or perhaps fate itself, awakens a new power within…

title: Monster JK Mikuro-Chan
description: ごく普通の女子高生、最川未黒。まだら模様が特徴的な 化物の女の子。ある日突然片想い中の緒方くんから 告白されて、付き合うことになって…!?

title: Romance Endo Wa Kyohi Shimasu!
description:
愛犬のさくらと暮らす平凡なＯＬ・朋。巷のラブハラに負けず生活する彼女は、交通事故に見舞われてしまう……。望まぬ転生を強いられた朋はどうしても愛犬に会いたいと願い、神との約束を取り交わす。
それは――「恋愛ポイント（LP）を集めたら、生き返らせてあげる！」恋愛脳の神が創った『乙女ゲームの世界』で、エンディングを迎えることだった!?社会人のスルースキルで巧みにフラグを躱す彼女だが、「攻略対象」にご都合主義すぎる「イベント」と次々にロマンスが到来する。かくして、愛する以外に道はないのか!?DEAD OR LOVE!!　おしつけ異世界ラブコメディー開幕！

title: Kanzaki-san, Tsuno Detemasu!?
description: Mizuki Hinagiku is the 15 year old daughter of the family who runs the "Hekisui Shrine" in Miyamori City, a town where people worship gods. Hinagiku's crush is Kanzaki, an older, handsome man who lives in the "forbidden area" deep within the shrine. Every time she meets the kind but slightly naive Kanzaki, her heart races... But... is it really true that Kanzaki's true identity is...?!

title: Ryu no Nie Yome: Shiitagerareta Shou wa Unmei no Ban Toshite Aisareru
description: 主人公は巫女の養成機関・百花女学院に通う少女・鈴。名家に生まれながらも霊力を持たない彼女は、幼い頃に真名を奪われ、“名無し”として家族全員から蔑まれてきた。義母妹の日菜子からは毒見を強制させられ、体中をその呪いにむしばまれる日々。そんなある日、彼女は巫女選定の儀で、ある人物から声をかけられ……。いつか誰かに本当の名前を呼んでもらいたいと願う鈴の和風シンデレラストーリーが繰り広げられる。

title: Girls und Panzer - Hito Natsu no Ie (Doujinshi)
description: Andō estaba cometiendo allanamiento y Oshida se termina enterando eso a través del club de periodismo, esto terminará desencadenando una nueva relación de amistad y tal vez algo más.

title: RANDOM
description: One day, Lý, an eighth-grade student, unexpectedly scores a perfect mark on a multiple-choice test he answered entirely by guessing. But that stroke of luck soon draws one strange incident after another into his life. Later that same day, he crosses paths with Linh, a mysterious girl who seems to know something about what's happening to him.

title: Hanataba
description:
２カ月前突然クラスの一軍男子に告白された高校生、春花(ルビ：はる か)。
自分の好きな服装はやめ、彼の好みに合うように頑張っていたのだが――。

title: Tokimeki Tonight - Shu Makabe's Circumstances
description: Main story told from the point of view of Makabe; like the first meeting with Ranze, or marriage proposal

title: Translucent
description:
Shizuka is an introverted girl, dealing with schoolwork, boys, and a medical condition that begins to turn her invisible! She finds support with Mamoru, a boy who is falling for Shizuka despite her condition, and with Keiko, a woman who suffers from this illness and has finally turned completely invisible. The mysterious disease that the teens struggle with becomes a metaphor in the ordinary lives of the students in their classes, as they try to work their way through their friendships and romances.

(Source: [Dark Horse](https://www.darkhorse.com/Books/13-996/Translucent-Volume-1))

**Additional Notes:**

- The official English translation from Dark Horse was dropped after Volume 3

title: The Stalker
description: Parents of Shinka Yumiko, a student at seventeen, are rarely at home because most of the time traveling for work. One day at school meet Makoto Ikimura, a guy who begin to harass her. The reason? Who knows…

title: Grass Beside Nest
description: On the first day of school, a little hooligan transferred to Chen Hao's class. What happens when both the top student and hooligan don't want to create trouble? Trouble ensues. :)

title: Itoshi Otonari-san
description:
同じクラスの麓くん。
一見クールでスマートだけど、中身はとてもいとしい男の子でした。

title: M no Yoromeki
description: Narumi, the most popular teacher in a high school, teaches chemistry. All girl students are attracted to him, with an aura of prince. But there is a girl whom he has a lot of trouble in dealing with. This is a collection of youthful love stories.

title: Bunka-bu Domo no Tatakai-kata
description:
"They say Michelangelo took revenge on people he hated through art..." Kabeuchi Konta is the president of the Manga Research Club at a school where the cultural clubs are at the bottom of the social hierarchy. One day, his childhood best friend, Kamijo Kouji, returns from Tokyo after several years! When he meets him again after a long time, Kouji has become a handsome man at the top of the social hierarchy by any standards. Konta is happy to see him again and ends up telling Kouji about the webcomic he has been secretly drawing. However, the next day, when Konta arrives at school, he sees his classmates laughing at his webcomic, along with Kouji himself... Why has his best friend changed? Armed with art, the cultural club members begin their fight back against the unreasonable school.

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title: My Hero Academia - Bunseki Notebook (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Midoriya Izuku x Bakugou Katsuki

title: 5Toubun no Hanayome - Potemaru's Shorts
description: 5toubun no Hanayome short comics by author Potemaru.

title: Ouji ga Kuuki Yomana Sugiru
description:
僕の婚約者になってよ。

継母と義姉から虐げられている侯爵令嬢ナタリー・レノックス。ナタリーには、前世、日本で看護師をしていた記憶があり、それらの経験からなんとか耐えていた。そんな中、９歳の社交会プレデビューのパーティーで、ナタリーは“空気が読めない”と評判の王子ミハイル・リラドヴィアに助けられる。その日からナタリーの運命は１８０度変わってゆき――「僕の婚約者になってよ」「お、お断りします！」空気の読めない発言に、ナタリーが振り回されてしまう！？

title: Beast of Man ~Death Metal ma Hitozute Jigoku no Live Gomon Mokushiroku~
description: 広瀬郁斗（ひろせ あやと）はクールに澄ました顔で何でもこなし、イケメンでコミュ力も高い大学生。同級生からもモテて、充実した大学生活を謳歌していたように見えたが、ある日、思わぬ事件が起こる……!! ひょんなことから伊藤咲倉（いとう さくら）と出会い、【デスメタルバンド】に参加することになった広瀬――。大学生活は果たして、どうなる!?

title: Laras's Heart
description: In this prequel to Maya’s World, we catch up with the characters Radi, Laras, Maya, Tara and others while they are still in high school. The series focuses on Radi and his invitation into PEDAL, a mysterious chat group devoted to asking out Laras, the most popular girl in school.

title: Kyou Kara Futsuu no Maizono-kun
description: Two years ago, Tsukasa met Maizono, who was having doubts about whether to quit the entertainment industry, and told her, "If you're hesitating, why don't you just give up?" Inspired by Tsukasa, Maizono began to express her feelings for him directly and intensely. However, Tsukasa insisted on refusing, stating that his rough and unassuming personality "doesn't suit this kind of role."

title: This Cat Gave Me Friends!
description: Gen Maeda is a high school student who doesn't have the ability to socialize with people. One day when he was on his way home, he found a stray cat cornered by angry dogs. As he tried to save the cat, soon he will realize that his life will change from here on out!

title: Zettai Oshienai
description: Sugiyama Rika is the Chief of Public Moral in her school and dislikes the school's student body President Jinguuji Kasui. She thinks he's incompetent and an expert at lying. One day a rumor broke out about a myth about love in their old school building, suddenly Rika finds herself entangled in the love myth with none other than… Jinguuji Kasui?!

title: Aim for the Watery Horizon!
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Nanaumi Kataoka is a first-year high school student. Her mother, a pianist, encourages her to continue her vocal music studies, but in order to cure her chronic asthma, she is sent to her grandfather's house by the sea, where there is good air. When Nanami transfers to a new school, she meets a music-loving senpai, Kazumi Takase...

title: My Bodyguard
description:
A collection of oneshots:  
  
1. Plan: O.N.O.  
Misawa has fallen for the captain of the school's track team, but doesn't know if his captain feels the same way about him.  
  
2. Lip Service  
Katsuhiro is the bad boy type, irritated due to his father always telling him not to make him look bad, he gets into the habit of stealing books. The only one who truly understands him is his father's secretary and his chauffeur, Yoshizaki. On the way to a celebration for his grandfather's recovery, things get a little… intense between Katsuhiro and Yoshizaki.  
  
3. The Lucky Star of The Night  
Shy Aoyama has a crush on his chief, Matsuzawa. After a night of a little too much drinking, Aoyama ends up at Matsuzawa's home…  
  
4. Holiday  
Natsuki, company president’s son, was forced to cancel his weekend plans to go on a family retreat in the family villa for a party. Unfortunately, his father arranged the party in hopes for him to meet with potential brides. Just as Natsuki was about to exe

title: The Kabocha Wine - Extra Arc
description: Shunsuke is in a panic because his father is coming to visit. It would be a disaster if his father, who is hard-headed and values ​​being masculine above all else, finds out about Eru! What is the clever idea that Eru came up with while looking at the flustered Shunsuke?!?

title: Kimi no Obentou ni Naritai
description:
"I'm Yuki Kito. I'm a vampire. Nice to meet you."

When I entered high school, there was a vampire girl in my class. I wonder how vampires manage lunch.

"Well... I haven't eaten. The drinkable blood packs are in short supply..."

What!? Are you okay!? She can't eat a normal lunch box, and her only source of nutrition is hard to come by, so she always spends lunch break alone... I can't just leave her like that!!

"Kito-san... can you drink my blood...?"

title: The Favor
description: Hamza is a high school student who still has no idea what he wants to do in life, spending his days enjoying the little moments that life brings. However, things start to change when he offers a samosa to Marta, one of the best students of the school, and a war of favor breaks out.

title: 1 2 no Sanshirou
description: Houjou Shino is running very late for her first day at a new high school she’s transferred to, when she runs smack dab into Sanshirou, a big young man who is just as late if not even more so. It’s not his fault that they’ve crashed into one another, but Shino is a bit of a crybaby and it doesn’t get any better. Sanshirou is assigned to Shino to show her the ropes, something they both dread. Then things change as Shino sees the Rugby team in action and discovers that Sanshirou is being actively recruited by every “manly” sport in the school – all of which he excels at and none of which interest him.

title: Hanamaru GO! GO!
description:
New school, new teachers, a new class, new friends... and basketball.

All these things that Ishizuka Sakura are looking forward to are rudely interrupted by the fact that she's running late on her first day of high school! Everything is a mess with her being told the wrong directions to the auditorium, and after school when she looks to relax and play some basketball... she meets the legendary Miyamoto Hayato and Tadashi twins.

She wants to team up with them, but will they accept...?! Read and find out!

title: Ryu Karu Oji Ni Hatsukoi
description:
災いの化身「竜」が人々の生活を脅かす世界。
ショッピングモールで買い物をしていた高校生の山田愛茉（やまだえま）は、突如として現れた「竜」に襲われてしまった。
そこへ討伐隊の隊長・椚誠一郎（くぬぎせいいちろう）が現れて―――

「あなたのこと、好きになっちゃいました…！！」
「こんなおじさん、君に似合わないよ」

誠一郎にあしらわれる愛茉は、彼のことを振り向かせられるのか?!?!
竜狩イケおじ×超一途JKのドタバタラブコメディ！！

title: Shi to Kanojo to Boku Meguru
Spin Spin Kurumi-chan
description:
(from [well-corp.jp](https://www.well-corp.jp/katsudi/)):

Katsuji Matsumoto's representative work. Initially serialized in Shojo no Tomo from January 1938 until December 1940. In the early post-war period the manga resumed serialization in the manga magazine Shojo, now under the title "Kurumi-chan", from November 1949 to February 1954. 

Featuring the day-to-day of a little girl named Kurumi (クルミ, meaning "chestnut"), The chapters were episodic, each being around 4 pages. A gag work, with an emphasis on the everyday.

Kurumi-chan was later collected into two tankoban volumes in 1987, one year after Matsumoto's passing.

At the beginning of the Showa period (1926-1989), when the culture of Shojo magazines was flourishing and lyrical painters were competing with each other with their gorgeous brush strokes, Katsuji Matsumoto emerged as an artist of the new generation following Kayoi Takahata and Koji Fukiya, and his exotic and gorgeous style gained popularity with the likes of Junichi N

title: Miss Me?
description:
From CPM:

A fashionable high school girl has a crush on the lead singer of a heavy metal band, but he seems indifferent to her feelings. After attending a concert she meets the lead singer's handsome friend who falls in love with her. It's too bad she doesn't feel the spark for him… Whoever said that romance was easy?

title: The Saint Alice Empire
description:
(from ebookjapan):

On the day she transferred to St. Alice's Academy, Momoko Hanaki was told by a teacher, "Poor Momoko.... The school has a system of special honor students, and students who contribute to the school have priority in everything." 

The students are all full of individuality, including the queen, Hazumiko Yamato, who is higher than the principal, the thief, Zero, who is a friend of the weak, and the vandal, Jiro Kido, who is a member of the school's ministry.

title: Miraigata Renai Danshi 46
description: Onodera Nanami, elated from her third date with her new boyfriend, arrives at her apartment to find an strange, but extremely handsome boy with big ears welcoming her home as "Mistress!" Bewildered, Nanami soon finds out her genius older sister decided to test her new companion robot prototype called "D-46" on her…who happens to be this cute, puppy-like boy at her doorstep. Will Nanami stay true to her boyfriend, or will this android steal her heart away?

title: Sayonara Women
description:
(from ebookjapan):
A high school girl, Mari, aspires to be a mangaka. By chance, she becomes friends with a math teacher who used to be a model for her manga, and begins to fall in love with him... but what happens?　A collection of short stories with faint feelings!

Note: Digitized Hakusensha bunko release contains an afterword from Ooshima and 4 other one-shots, including the title one-shot of [Shinjirare Nation.](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/cz8nyhr/shinjirare-nation)

title: Sowachine
description: Machine Rokuro has been a freshman in college for 2 months now, after getting accepted to his desired college in Tokyo. He was filled with excitement for the college life but people laughed at his country accent and now he's afraid to talk to other students for fear of being mocked. One day, he meets Sowahara Chiko whom he instantly falls in love with. With her help, Rokuro joins the drama club Chiko is part of because the club members accept him for who he is and they think his accent is comedy gold. The college life that Rokuro dreamed about is just starting.

title: Watashi no Koto ga Sukisugite Shinjai sou na Uta-kun
description:
Yuka is a JK who is too firm to be popular with the ladies. One day, she passes a tattooed and pierced guy named Uta on the street. Yuka patches up his bleeding wrist. The next day, Usita shows up to thank her and asks her to go out with him! When Yuka, puzzled, refuses, Usita takes an unexpected step...?!

An unpredictable love affair between a serious JK who wants to be loved and a yandere handsome man begins...!

title: Graduation★Scramble
description:
Sotsugyou Scramble consists of five one-shots.  
  
Story 1 - Magical Scramble: Ninomiya Sora and her boyfriend, Hinase Hoshi, go to a fortune teller, and the fortune teller tells Sora that she will lose the one she loves. Soon after, a mysterious stranger snatches Sora away in a midst of playing cards!  
  
Story 3 - High School Scramble + Bonus: Sora and her friends are finally graduating, but the day before the graduation ceremony her grandfather and Hoshi's mother tell her she has to pass a special test. If she fails, she will repeat junior high school.  
  
Story 4 - Sassy Boy: China and her friends go to the beach for vacation. While there, they attempt to hook up with boys. Will they succeed?

title: Kuroko no Basket - Shinzou to Dai Ni Botan (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Surprise! Angel
description: "Gee! A naked girl is falling!" Kiichi Tobe, a boy whose parents are on a long overseas business trip, encounters a naked girl who faints when he passes by a river bank. Kiichi brings her to the apartment to take care of her. From there, they decided to live a life just like newlyweds. The first volume of a masterpiece romantic comedy manga full of dreams for girls in boyhood is now available as an e-book

title: Kids Joker
description:
Meet Hotaru Yanagawa: defender of justice, protector of the innocent and high-school student! She's looking to jumpstart her future career as a police officer between homework and home ec., but the sins of the city might be more than she can handle. From kidnappings to crime syndicates, Hotaru will skip the badge and hit the beat in the crime-fighting adventures of a girl detective!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Ojono Ai Wa Oreno Mono
description: 「お嬢は俺が守ります」私の番犬…なはずの幼なじみ・碧が、ある日突然甘く迫ってきて――!? 鷹樹組組長――いわゆる“ヤクザ”の長を祖父に持つ茉白は、縁が切れているとはいえ、その事情のせいでいつもひとりぼっち。だけど唯一、ボディガードとして常にそばにいてくれる碧に片想いをしている。 碧にはぐらかされてばかりの茉白だけど、碧とともに家から遠い高校に入学。念願だったフツーの高校生活を送れることに！しかし、世間知らずゆえに隙の多い茉白。見かねた碧が「あんまり隙があると、俺がお嬢を食いますよ」と突然迫ってきて――!?  独占欲を爆発させる碧の姿にドキドキが止まらない――!!お嬢×ボディガードの幼なじみラブ

title: Halfway
description:
Story 1 - Halfway:  
After graduation, a young couple must figure out what they'll do about their relationship now that they're going to different universities.  
   
Story 2 - Kyou Dake no Unreal:  
A college girl learns to cope with the death of a fellow student, someone whom she hated, and comes to terms with that hatred.  
  
Story 3 - Hoshi wa Hi ga Kureru Made Nemuru:  
A girl reunites with her childhood friend, only to find that he's quite different from the boy she once knew.

title: Elite Jack!!
description: The story is set at the elite Omega High School, where test results decide everything. The high-scorers in the student council, in particular the student council president, have a lot of authority. Yuria Aikawa comes to this school, and though she seems like an ordinary girl who loves fun things and her boyfriend Shuri, she's actually a super-genius who gets the top score on every test. She becomes student council president and tries to make school life more fun in various ways.

title: Doberman Kinshirei!
description: Shingo and Kippei are making out in a secret place at school. Not secret enough, however, because the people who run the student council find them there. Homosexual behaviour is strictly frowned upon, and leads to physical punishment. (No, not the kind you're thinking, unfortunately.) The leader Sawatou, nicknamed "Doberman", tall, dark, handsome, and with a cape, impresses Kippei so much that he instantly falls in love. But with Sawatou despising homosexuals, surely that love is doomed to failure?

title: Crowded Yeonaesa
description: Chyoo Lee Ning, jerk Eun Jeh, pretty boy Yun Jun woo, if it’s liking or just bullying the one year younger guy who confuses people… Hyun bin. Heh young, who believes that the strongest person can achieve love… This is a love story about different teens.

title: Watashi no Sensei wa Kaodake Kowai
The Failed Heiress
description: Na Seulgi, a girl who can see the life force of others, has a kind grandmother who passed away. Her grandmother secretly gave her an apartment address that has Seulgi's inheritance hidden inside. However, the apartment is occupied by a cold but handsome guy whose life force is fading away

title: Dokonimo Ikenai Bokutachi wa,
description: Umi was abandoned by her mother when she was eight years old and lives with her younger brother at the age of 18. She lives a life of shuttling back and forth between the driving school where she works and her home, but when she meets Kaname, who offers her a handkerchief, little by little Umizu's world begins to change... A love story in which she finds hope in the midst of cruel reality.

title: Unmei no Noroware Ouji to, Mahou Gakkou de Futatabi Koi ni Ochiru
description: When Sophia was young, she made a lifelong vow with her childhood friend—a prince. By the time she realized his identity, he had already become a distant figure. Determined to meet him one last time and confront her feelings, she resolves to become the top student at the magic school, the only path to gain an audience with him... Meanwhile, the prince himself is...!?

title: Just Listen to the Song (Fan Colored)
description: A boy makes a love song for his crush. The song gets attention from the global population and its meaning becomes construed.

title: Ace of Diamond - Misawa Short Short Story ● Top of the First Inning (Doujinshi)
description:
Ace of Diamond dj - School Teacher AU
Pairing: Miyuki Kazuya x Sawamura Eijun

title: A, Akuma-chan
description: Small-town girl Hinagi learns one day that her crush, Ishidori, is leaving the countryside for Tokyo. Hinagi hatches a plan to liven up their town to make Ishidori reconsider moving! To do so, she'll undergo the transformation of a lifetime...!! Can love turn a girl into a devil?! Here comes a high-speed romantic comedy!

title: Saseum, I'm a Deer
description: In Korea, the deer is considered to be symbolic of innocence and purity. Maria wishes she were a deer… Torn between her love for her protective brother Rin and her desire to fend for herself, Maria will need to make her own choices, and so will Rin.

title: Cheat Noryoku wo Motta Koukousei no Ikinokori wo Kaketa Nagaku Mijikai Nanokakan
description: Rin, a lackluster high school boy, is unexpectedly reincarnated into another world with 20 of his classmates following a fateful bus accident. A self-proclaimed god named Adora announces that “the person who becomes the most famous in this world gets to decide who dies.” As the gods’ ulterior motives gradually come to light and the heartbreaking reality is revealed, they find themselves caught in a struggle for redemption—banding together as allies and clashing as foes. What was meant to be their desperate fight over seven days (Earth time) in another world takes an unforeseen twist when Rin, the god declared capable of even greater feats than Himself, entrusts a profound sentiment to his childhood friend Hitomi.

title: Ranpou
description:
(from ebookjapan):

This absurd gag comedy depicts the crazy antics of the mysterious boy Ranpou and his unique friends. Ranpou is scolded by teacher Kakumaru for chatting with Chutaro the rat during class.

 In fact, Ranpou, who was an honor student a month ago, has been taken inside a mysterious UFO and turned into a new Ranpou, different from the one before. Mutsumi, a female student who is interested in Ranpou, who may possibly be an alien, follows him to...!

Adapted into an anime in 1984. title: Satou, Watashi wo Sukitte Barechau yo
description: Usagi and Ageha are in love. It's a secret from the world. An idol's forbidden love starts!

title: Introduction to the Study of Adultery
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Adultery is a man's adventure, a woman's fashion...? Shotaro Ishinomori dramatically spins an omnibus of real-life love stories of "ten different couples," including a Marunouchi office worker and her section chief, a tutor and her mother, a PTA member and her teacher, and a mother's friend and her husband, all of whom are consumed by an illicit love affair, even though they know it is unforgivable! The book contains a total of 10 stories depicting the pleasures and perils of adultery, as well as a legal column for each drama. A true introduction to the study of adultery!

title: Mienai Kimi e no Okurimono
description:
Collection of 5 short stories:  
  
1) Mienai Kimi e no Okurimono  
Tsuchiya Haruka comes from a family where the members are able to see ghosts meets a ghost her age at her school. The ghost quickly discovers she has a crush on someone, and decides to help her out. At the same time, she wants him to get over his attachments on earth, so he can pass on.  
  
2) Like… Like… Like  
Asami Niijima found out her boyfriend was two timing, and when she confronted him, he dumped her. She is determined to not trust boys again, until she meets Takumi. She quickly recovers from her break up, and falls in love with Takumi. When going out however, it seems he is becoming distant. What is this uneasy feeling?  
  
3) Kiss Me… Kiss Me…  
Ai is considered a real beauty by her peers at school, and they idolize her. Her boyfriend Yoi, with whom she has been dating for 3 months, doesn't seem to mind at all. In fact, he doesn't seem to care at all. This frustrates Ai, who begins to wonder if he really lov

title: We Are Still...!
description: Doe-won is about to enter high school. She's ready to face her new school and her new classmates, but then she meets the class representative, Baek Joon, who chooses the seat next to her rather than a seat somewhere else. Why does Baek Joon seem so interested in her? And why is Doe-won so nervous to see Eun Eegi, who demands something of her that she thought he had forgotten…!?

title: Kisu Made Toho 2 Byo
description: A good looking new teacher, Shiki, arrives at the girls' high school where Mahiro works as a school nurse! The two are living together in secret...? If they get caught, they will be fired! Love under one roof with a younger co-worker!

title: Virgo and the Sparklings
description: Riani, who is keen towards sounds and has a mysterious power, was invited by Monica and Ussy to form a band together. However, the challenges they will face in the future doesn't look that easy…

title: Houou Gakuen Shikkoubu
description:
From Toothpaste Scanlations:  
  
Only the rich, upper-class students get to attend the private school, Ootari Gakuen. The ordinary girl who transferred to this campus was Oogisaki Minori. Minori originally dreamed of having a happy school life, but she never thought that there would possibly be a reputative Student Enforcement Council full of cute guys, who through their strict rules, control the whole school! Not only that, but on Minori's first day of school, she was picked on by them!  
  
Also includes:  
Happy Tea Time  
Instead of going overseas with her parents, Nao decides to live with some relatives who own a cake shop called Peach Garden. The owners had to go to Tokyo so that left Nao with their three sons. Will Nao be okay living in a house only with guys?

title: Kuroko no Basket - Love Letter From You (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Ren-ai no Saki ni Kekkon Keikaku
description: Tsukina's father stole money from her as a child to use on gambling, and as well as her older brother for being cold to her. She developed a huge annoyance for men,begging her mother to let her go into an all girls school.Now her father had sold their house which forces Tsukina and family to end up living with her mom's rich friend,and her FOUR SONS. The two mothers have some plans in store for Tsukina and the four sons!Let the Marriage Operation before romance commence!

title: It's Pathetic, but I Want to do Romance

Maryokuryou Rekidai Saikyou na Tensei Seijo-sama no Gakuen Seikatsu wa Haran ni Michiafureteiru you desu: Ouji-sama ni Akuyaku Reijou to Heroine-poi Kotachi ga Iru keredo, Koko wa Otomege Sekai desu ka?
description: Nai, a young girl who, after being reincarnated, found herself an orphan and had to survive in dire circumstances. One day, she is chosen to become a saint, and her second life is turned completely upside down. Thanks to the intervention of the duke who supports her, Nai takes the entrance exam for the Royal Academy, attended by many children of the nobility and passes with flying colors. But for some unknown reason, she is admitted not to the general section, but to the honors section! This class consists solely of children of the high nobility: a prince, a duke’s daughter, the son of the head of the royal guard…! “Am I in a romance game?” Nai wonders, perplexed. But another girl from the common people, also admitted to the elite class, begins to “conquer” the princes…! A forbidden love story with a nobleman who is already engaged will gradually turn the class into a veritable battlefield, which is a real headache for Nai, who simply wants to live in peace with her dear childhood frie

title: #Kietai Boku wa Kimi ni 150-ji no Ai o Ageru
description: 周囲の顔色を伺い、本当の気持ちを言葉にすることができない雫は、誰にも伝えられない思いを150字のSNS・Letterにこっそりと投稿する日々を送っていた。そんなある日、クラスメイトの駆からLetterのコンテストに応募するために「一緒に物語を作ってほしい」と頼まれ……。

title: Japanese na Kanojo
description: Rizu Honda has a ``foreigner allergy'' that causes her entire body to itch when touched by foreigners. One day, her mother suddenly decides to marry a Norwegian man, and Rizu has to transfer to a boarding high school. However, it is an international school full of foreigners...!? A universal love comedy!!

title: Monigasanai Kara Kukugoshite
description: 遠くの高校を受験し、ひとり暮らしを始めた三葉。だけど、苦い失恋をきっかけに距離をおいた幼なじみの玲央が、隣の部屋に引っ越してきてしまった！　しかも三葉の高校で〝プリンス〟と呼ばれていたのは玲央だったらしい。玲央を避けようとするけれど、彼はどんどん近づいてきて――!?

title: Like Stars Army War
description:
Around 1691-92: The land is ruled by the Satomi clan. Inue Shimbē Masashi and his twin younger sister, Fuse, had lost their parents, so they become the new clan heads. Inue also becomes leader of the Hakkenshi, 8 elite warriors loyal to the Satomi clan.

Present time, 1991-92.
The Hakkenshi are reincarnated into normal people, each of them connected to a bead containing a kanji character that reflects one of the eight fundamental virtues of Confucianism. Each Hakkenshi is now studying/working at CLAMP Gakuen.

Kazae Tōma, Inue Shimbē Masashi's reincarnation, is a 1st year high school student in CLAMP Gakuen. In his dreams he keeps on seeing glimpses of his past life he can't remember.

title: Megane Danshi Kurabu
description:
In the Megane Danshi Kurabu series:  
  
Volume 1) Maruhi Megane Danshi Kurabu  
  
Shirokane Academy photography club exists not only because of their love for taking pictures, but it is also a secret club for adoring glasses-wearing boys. Their usual work includes finding boys who look good with glasses and taking a picture of them for their club. The club is frowned upon the school's student council, but the girls persevere through various obstacles and continue to share their love and joy for glasses-wearing boys. [Finger Scans]  
  
Volume 2) Moe Megane Danshi Kurabu  
  
Volume 3) Mitsu Megane Danshi Kurabu

title: Nemureru Kemono Ha Ai Wo Sakebu
description:
学校の人気者・榛名朔に突然気に入られてしまった澪。 それは１か月前のとある日、榛名くんのキケンな裏の顔を見てしまったことがきっかけでー…⁉
キケンな男子にドキドキが止まらない 期待の新連載・開幕です！

title: Haikyu! - In The Middle of Your World (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

title: Twilight Snap
description:
空気を読みすぎる双葉と空気を読まなすぎる真柴。
正反対の2人がふとしたきっかけで文化祭実行委員に…⁉︎

title: Recuerda Recuerda
description: DJ KageHina, Cuando Kageyama confiesa sus sentimientos hacia hinata, un accidente hace que olvide todo, pero algo ocurre que hace a hinata…

title: Wind! Clouds! Swords!
description:
(from ebookjapan):

In the late Tokugawa period... 

...A young swordsman, Habinoshin Fubuki, sets out on a journey of training to make a living with the sword, and as he comes into contact with many people, he grows strong and dreams of becoming the greatest swordsman in the world....

title: Koisuru Kyuukyuubako
description: Momo never cared about guys. She was always a jock with a spectacular throwing/catching arm. One day, however, at the start of a new term, she meets a guy who throws her off her feet. He's part of the baseball team and to get close to him, she joins the cheerleading team in hopes of cheering him on at his baseball games. After a series of event she wants to join the female baseball team but she's stuck with the cheerleading team. Who knew the cheerleading team was full of surprises…..

title: Gyu Gyutto Mamotte!
description: Umiha Hiyoko is just transferring into her new school. Unlike most ordinary girls, Hiyoko beholds a special power. She can understand feelings of things that most humans cannot (such as flowers, trees, birds, etc.). Although Hiyoko doesn't know it at first, she is a princess of this place called the Bloom Kingdom! Just what in the world is going on?

title: Hibi Kore Heitan
description:
A comic that lets you enjoy high school life, featuring the title series that depicts the ordinary everyday lives of high school boys and girls, plus the entire series of the hugely popular "Pure Relationships" that was published in the web supplement.

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

Includes 35 chapters of the "Junsui Danjo Koudai" web supplement series, and 14 extra chapters.

title: SISTER, DON'T CRY
description:
Senoo Arata is unsociable at work. However, in front of her sister, she completely changes!?

The bond between the two is more than that of family!? A story of sisterly love!

Published in Young King BULL 2025 Issue 8 (April 22 Issue).

title: The Girl Who Sees Time
description: The Girl Who Sees Time: Time stops for the introverted Xia Shi whenever she gets nervous. Only the super popular Jing Guangyang, can unfreeze her time. In order to treat her time illness, she decides to take the first step—that is, to try and be friends with Jing Guangyang!

title: The Mermaid on the Side
description: 인어공주 전설의 현실 재림! 다만 인어 공주가 아닌 왕자일 뿐! 스토리, 로맨스12세 이용가

title: Suihelibe!
description:
A boy-meets-alien-girl story with an academic twist, the series follows a bookish biology student whose encounter with an extraterrestrial turns him into an alien hunter.

[Wikipedia](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%81%99%E3%81%84%E3%81%B8%E3%83%BC%E3%82%8A%E3%83%BC%E3%81%B9!)

title: La Esperança
description:
In a European school dorm, Georges Saphir is admired and loved by everyone. However, afraid of others doing him harm, he has never allowed anyone to get close. Why is it then that misfit Robert can effortlessly step over this line Georges has drawn, and see right through him? And will getting too close to Robert result in a tragedy that justifies his worst fears?

(from mangaupdates)

title: Chako-chan's Diary
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Masterpiece shojo manga reprinted in e-book format. The mangaka is Yoko Imamura, a pioneer in Shojo Manga. 

This work, which depicts the daily life of a child with a heartwarming and lively touch, was first published in the shojo manga magazine "Ribon" in 1963 and gained immense popularity. 

The daily life of children centering on "Chako-chan," a bright and lively fifth grader, and her naughty and carefree younger brother "Boku-chan" is funny and sure to bring a smile to your face.

title: Ikenai Day Dream
description: Miyake Yuuri is in her 2nd year of high school. She has a well-developed body, but no experience with men. But she's still a normal teenage girl, and she gets interested in boys from time to time. Although, maybe normal isn't the best word...because when she gets worked up, she has precognitive visions! These visions always involve her in provocative situations, and they always come true.

title: Hirotta Inui-kun to Koi wo suru
description:
拾ったのは、黒くて大きくて優しい男のコでした。

高2目前の春休み、両親が海外転勤になり1人暮らしを始めた兎々子。大好きなワンちゃんを飼うために自立した子になれるよう頑張っているけれど…1週間連続で3食コンビニ飯を買う姿を店員さんにディスられるほど、生活力は皆無。
ある日兎々子は偶然店員さんに火事のピンチを助けてもらう一方で、店員さんの住むアパートがまさかの全焼!?
家を失った店員さんは、兎々子の家に住むかわりにお世話をしてくれることに！
彼の名は…「戌」井くん！

title: Boys' Kingdom II
description:
A collection of stories including a 2 chapter prequel to Boys' Kingdom, an extra, and two other oneshots.  
  
1-2) A 2 chapter prequel to Boys' Kingdom  
3) Renai Ohkoku: An extra chapter related to Boys' Kingdom  
4) Bakuretsubishyoujo Takamine Mime  
5) Baraironoijiwaru

title: Prism Heart
description:
1. Prism Heart  
2. Teen's Road  
3. Hot White Kiss  
4. 17 Year Old

title: Ashita, Kimi to Koi o Shiru
description: Rio, whose motto is to let sleeping dogs lie, is kinda scared of her classmate, Shioya. However, after a certain something caused them to start talking to each other, that's how she came to learn of his honest side.

title: Boku no Apple Iro Alien
description: 主人公・にこは、これまで全然モテてこなかったが、高校こそは素敵な彼氏を作りたいと意気込んでいる。そんな彼女の隣の家に引っ越してきたのは、超絶イケメンの蒼井。偶然にも同じクラスになった2人だが、蒼井はモテるがゆえに女子に冷たく……。正反対なにこと蒼井は、わかり合えないところから関係をスタートさせる。

title: The Best of Sone Masako
description:
A collection of disastrous girl horror stories called by pure hearts!
The mysterious world of boys and girls. A lottery ticket that extends life, a procession of the dead and a test of courage, and a woman's grudge in her long black hair...
A masterpiece collection of occult horror stories by Masako Sone!

The 3 volumes linked together on kindle link are not actually related to the 5-volume Kessakushuu.

---

Volumes:
1 ◆ The House in Death's Shadow
2 ◆ Your Final Ride
3 ◆ The Mark of Red Death
4 ◆ Someday, Someone will Murder
5 ◆ The Sea Without Mermaids

title: Wana ni Kakatta Villain-kun
description: の主人公は、友人の柚の初恋を成就させようとしている女子高生・千紘。彼女はある日ダブルデートをきっかけに柚たちをくっつけようと、柚の思い人とも仲がいい男子・赤峰に協力を要請する。しかし彼に「ほっとけばよくない？」「あんたおせっかいだな」と断られてしまい……。性格も考え方もまったく合わない2人の恋が描かれる。

title: Saikyou Mahou Kyoushi Emilia Crane wa Hohoemu
description: 生まれつき膨大な魔力を持つ男爵家令嬢のエミリア。魔法の勉強をしたいにもかかわらず、貴族の娘として厳しい花嫁教育ばかり受けさせられてきた彼女だが、19歳で婚約者から婚約破棄されてしまう。彼女の思いを知る兄の薦めで、魔法学校のルーウェン男子校の先生を務めることなったエミリア。しかし担当のクラスには、大きな魔力を持つ問題児ばかりで

title: Kaho-chan Can't Recognise Faces
description:
Kaho, having entered her dream high school, is filled with anticipation for a fun-filled high school life. But she has a unique condition—she cannot distinguish people's faces or expressions—prosopagnosia (face blindness). A new class, club activities, friendships, and romance. She can't recognize the faces or expressions of her classmates, but Kaho faces forward with all her might to enjoy her sparkling youth! "People are more than just their faces, after all."

*Source: Comic Days, translated*

title: The Fifteenth Year
description: Chisato and Reiko have been childhood friends for 15 years. They have different hobbies and personalities, but they have fallen in love with one man - Sugimoto Keisuke, a member of the same light music club as Chisato. Keisuke confesses his feelings for Chisato, but Chisato is concerned about Reiko...

title: Dreams of the Days
description:
"To be honest, my dream is erotic, but it is horror as well…"  
  
Howon is a high school student who lives with his sister and his mom. As his dad passed away, his sister is supporting the family. He starts having very vivid erotic dreams, involving his current best friend, Jihyung, and his former one, Changwoo. Now, he must try to figure out if he is gay and the way this might affect his already frail family. Howon remembers the time Changwoo helped him in a fight, years before, making them become close friends and maybe more than that. As his friend Jihyung also has some important news to share, Howon's life becomes an emotional and sexual rollercoaster.

title: Very! Very! Daisuki
description: A spoiled brat from a wealthy Japanese family, Tsuyoshi is unceremoniously shipped off to Korea by his strict grandfather who tells him the family secret — they’re Korean! Sparks fly when the resentful high schooler arrives at the airport and shares an impromptu cab ride with Kang Be-Ri, a plucky girl who happens to be his new neighbor. Will the two ever get past their differences? And will Tsuyoshi learn to accept his new destiny?

title: Seven Days of Soccer
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Jun Hanabusa is a soccer crazed fool who spends seven days a week thinking about soccer. His negative attitude toward work has led to his being left behind in a miserable place deep in the mountains of Kagoshima, where he travels by horseback and the company is located in a farmer's yard. 

He is despondent, but by chance, he takes on the job of coaching the local high school soccer team. The chance to get close to the only beautiful woman in the village motivates him...

Note: 
The fifth tankoban went unpublished for years until 2018 when it was released on ebookjapan.

title: Le Gardenie
description:
Orange is a 15 year old boy who shares a wisecracking friendship with a perky young girl named Kiwi. When the new school term starts in spring, Orange finds himself instantly falling for the smart and attractive Apple. But when the bewitchingly beautiful Lemon shows up, Orange’s heart starts to pull him in both directions at the same time. And as Kiwi worries about what’s becoming of Orange, cracks begin to show in their friendship…  
  
Note: In Full Colour  
  
On June 22, 2006, Le Gardenie received third place in Japan's first International Manga Award.

title: Kiss+πr²
description: Includes "I'm Terribly Sorry to Keep You Waiting" in volume 2.

title: Yuki-Yuki
description: Miyuki and Yukiko are twins, whose lives are turned upside-down when a man named Joe enters their lives. How the three of them deal with the challenges of life and love, the pain and joy of simply living... well, that's the story to be told here.

title: Surechi Koi
description:
The only things I know about love I learned from shoujo manga—

Miran Koudouzono, a very sheltered high school girl, is going to meet the man of her dreams when she walks around that corner. The man she meets is, to her surprise, 〇○○…!? This is the latest work by the gag manga prodigy, Hatohana Tsurun, and it is a totally unique kind of shoujo manga!

title: Retsu!!! Date Senpai
description: Katakura is a high-schooler who loves Mego, a girl that unexpectedly loves him also. Lovely couple, huh? The problem is "Date-senpai", Mego's brother that is a Sengoku era maniac. He talk in a very polite way and even brands a sword and rides a horse (at school!). What will this love and gag story turn into?

title: Taiyou ga Ippai
description: A first love, a broken heart, and true love are all serious affairs to a person involved. Mei Sakisaka fell out of love with her teacher Takaoka. She made the first kiss with Masami, and…

title: Shikiji-san Switch
description:
Just before the summer vacation, Ootsuki was planning to invite Shikiji-san, the girl he had a crush on, to the fireworks festival. However, Shikiji-san invited Ootsuki's best friend, Taiyou, to the fireworks festival first. Ootsuki, who was at a loss for what to do after his broken heart, ends up bumping into Shikiji-san and switching bodies with her! How will this tangled love triangle turn out!?

Won a Semi-outstanding Newcomer Award in the 83rd Chiba Tetsuya Awards (second half of 2020). 
___
**Alt Official Raws:** [YanMaga Web](https://yanmaga.jp/viewer/comics/%E3%81%A1%E3%81%B0%E3%81%A6%E3%81%A4%E3%82%84%E8%B3%9E%E5%8F%97%E8%B3%9E%E4%BD%9C%E5%93%81%E7%AC%AC79%E5%9B%9E%E7%AC%AC87%E5%9B%9E/1b32228bbef2273473060266104e2b57?cid=06Z0000000000199FREE), [X](https://x.com/yanmaga_new/status/1646695079892127745)

title: Wild Run
description: Jaguar (Lum-chan) is a beast from the Amazon that became a human girl through animal experiments conducted by a genius doctor. She becomes friends with the doctor's only son and gradually learns about the morals of human society, but eventually the two fall in love and end up getting married! ? Here is a form of love that transcends biological barriers!

title: Hijiyama-san: Hoshi no Oto Mori no Uta - Kouno Fumiyo Tanpenshuu
description:
1. Chiisana Koi no Uta (小さな恋のうた)
2. Hoshi no Furu Sato (星のふる里)
3. Odense Daikanon! (おでんせ大歓音!)
4. Lise to Genshi no Mori (リーゼと原始の森)
5-12. Hijiyama-san Series (ヒジヤマさんシリーズ)
13. Kaku Hito e (描く人へ)

title: Bukita-kun
description:
Fumio Kida (Bukita) is an ugly boy obsessed with love, his goal in life is to find his "Eternal Sweetheart", his obsessive behavior always leading his crushes to unfortunate demises...

Volume 1: Love’s Specimen Box
Volume 2: Alice Through the Looking Glass
Volume 3: Legend of the Red String

title: Shiganai Mob Reijou na no de, Ouji no Kyuukon wa Mi ni Amarimasu!
description:
“You want me to be your fiancée?!"

No way, I’d much rather stay a background extra off to the side, so I’ll have to decline…!!

Misaki, the daughter of a baron studying at the Royal Yuris Academy in the Kingdom of Welfe, is actually a reincarnated person. During the entrance ceremony, her memories of her previous life suddenly return, and she realizes she’s been reborn inside the world of an otome game she used to play.

She may only be a minor background character, but she’s perfectly happy just being able to watch her favorite trio up close: the mischievous marquis’s son, the sharp and calculating duke’s son with glasses, and the cool yet slightly airheaded second prince (her absolute favorite!). She’s thrilled to even encounter the villainess and the heroine, but before she knows it, the prince himself starts taking an interest in her…?!

But For some reason, after being reincarnated the prince came to like her, but all she really wants is to live a peaceful, quiet life――!!

title: Lily's Supernatural Theater
description: A young artist girl finds herself in a very boring life routine, with a rough school and a desire for something new, till one day her life changes with the entrance of the supernatural world in her tiny theater.

title: We Just Guess Each Other
description:
High school alumni met after 5 years, Kim Hyun-oh and Kim Chan-i. However, the circumstances of the two are completely reversed! Hyeon-oh, who went from being a popular fighter to a lethargic rake. Chan-yi, who was bullied at school, has been transformed into a pretty boy. A sweet reunion in which the two heal each other's wounds. 

In high school, Kim Chan-yi was unusually white and fat. Everyone called him Piglet. Now, his body was reduced to almost half. The only thing he hadn't changed since then was his white skin like glutinous rice cakes. He Was he that tall and broad-shouldered? His eyes were large and round, and his nose was pointed. It was a kind and friendly impression. Just like the male lead in a romance manga, a glowing effect seems to float nearby. If you compare it to an animal, what should I say? dog? squirrel? Rabbit? if it's a rabbit it looked like a rabbit A thin white rabbit. Chan-yi Kim's change was amazing. I couldn't even recognize it at first glance. Kim Chan-y

title: Meimu Short Story Collection: My Favorite Person was XXed by ○○.
description: Short stories with a variety of horror, science fiction, and comedy, featuring MEIMU.

title: Romance no Tamago
description: Includes two other works: "Super Girl" and "Watashi wa Flamingo ni Naritai".

title: Sky Blue Mina
description: Mina Katsuragi, commonly known as Mina. She inherited her blue eyes and red hair from her foreign mother. On top of that, she is 171cm tall, and she is currently active as the hope of Aoi Gakuen's middle school track and field club. Mina currently lives with her older brother, Shinobu, who is a Japanese language teacher at the same school. However, this brother is the seed of her headache. She's lazy at school, but lazy at home. She's a man who can't do anything without everyone.

title: Promise
description: Yurim Han has just been accepted to the exclusive Yusung High School, known for its high standards. Expecting that, she is still shocked by the level of excellence. Every student around her is a freakishly gifted genius! It's high school life on cognitive enhancement drugs. Can Yurim survive in such an environment?

title: Shiawase no Hitokuchi
description:
A clumsy girl who wants to make sweets for her younger brother asks a slightly gloomy, lonely boy for guidance! They're not family, but this is the beginning of a sweet and gentle relationship.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title: Me o Sorasazu ni Ite
description:
Toeda Hana, who has been truant from school due to bullying, happens to see a TAIDO tournament.
The sight of a boy fighting even though he was injured there shook Hana's heart!
Then, she meets Nanto again at her new school, and something begins to change and move within Hana...

title: Warui Koto, Zenbu.
description: Hinako, the student council president, secretly pines for the council's advisor Yano-san. When Chibana, an underclassman on the council, finds out about Hinako's secret, he forces her into a "mutual agreement." The straight-laced council president and the scheming kouhai, all alone in the student council office after school with their shared secrets.

title: Senior x Junior
description: Witnessing the sleeping Tenten being kissed by Ketsu, Tonjou realized his feelings for Tenten too. This sudden moment of the kiss instantly caused an uproar between the relationships of the three of themâ€¦

title: Kiss Shite Killer Tune
description:
Kanon ends up forming a band with Dan-senpai, a third-year student she admires, and while she finds herself increasingly drawn to him, she has some issues with the instrument!

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

title: Watashi no Jusha wa Nejiraseteiru
description: かつては大企業の令嬢だった姫川原朱里は、突然の倒産により一転して没落。両親を亡くし莫大な借金を抱え、淡々と返済に追われる日々を送っていた。そんな朱里の前に１０年ぶりに現れたのは、元執事の犬居十吉。再会した彼はなぜか超金持ちになっており、朱里の借金を即完済してみせる。その代償として突きつけられたのは――主従契約！？

title: Smile
description: Smile tells the story of 2 childhood friends - Wayne Huntington Jr (a half-japanese, half-american) and Itou Ren (Japanese) - who fall in love.

title: Onnanoko o Tengoku ni Tsureteiku ni wa
description:
Yuichi, a boy so kind, jumping off a railway bridge? It was unbelievable.
But Chisuzu, one of his high school classmates, revealed that she somehow “knew” Yuichi would die to his best friend.
Determined to uncover the mystery of his friends death, Mitsufumi teams up with the mysterious girl. As they investigates, they come to meet another grim reality: Chisuzu would die in a year’s time.

title: Datte mou Suki ni natchattashi
description:
A no-holds-barred, full-on attack against the most vicious, useless guy!

Ririka falls in love at first sight with the handsome Itsuki, a man with 30,000 Instagram followers and a cute, airy face whose seduction techniques for wooing girls are beyond destructive. After she finally manages to say "I love you," he kisses her and says "See you later"... What!? This could be the start of a powerful, yet incredibly formidable, love affair!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Let's Akumateku Kyoushitsu
description:
From Aka Roze Tenshi  
  
Story 1 - Let’s Akuma Tech Kyoushitsu :  
Minami has been rejected by her crush for the tenth time after confessing her feeling ten times. While being depressed in the library, she caught the attention of the school idol Ichinose Kouki. Smart and with good looks, Ichinose’s popularity is known all over the school and girls flocks around him. Minami end up learning ‘love tech’ from him to get to her crush and the ‘akuma love tech classroom’ begin…  
  
Story 2 - Kimi no Soba ni Wasuremono  
  
Story 3 - Sensei data hazu na no ni  
  
Story 4 - Nise Love  
  
Story 5 - Satou-san Renai Kakumei

title: Boku no Koto Oshiete yo
description:
Nagisa is a third-year middle school student whose life revolves around supporting the super popular idol Wataya Reina. When she unexpectedly gets a short haircut during spring break, she is mistaken for a member of the boy idol group Dai-Ly... What's more, even though she's a girl, she ends up acting as a substitute for a missing member...?!

The one who supports becomes the one who is supported! An eventful youth story of a substitute idol!!

title: Peach and her Papas
description: Neil and Dustin are college roommates who couldn't be more different. Neil is a serious student and Dustin is a slacker from a rich family. Neil wants a clean dorm, and Dustin keeps bringing home random strays— a lizard, a cat, and now a BABY?! When Dustin's childhood friend begs him to care for her baby while she's away, the boys suddenly become surrogate dads. Can this chaotic, bickering pair overcome the odds to raise baby Peach? Will they become more than roommates... and more than friends?

title: Toki Nazumi, Futari Nazumu
description:
From Amaranth Scans:

Haruhi, Shinogu and Moe are sixth graders from the same elementary school. Moe and Haruhi are said to be polar opposites as Moe is Shinogu's gentle and caring childhood friend, while Haruhi is Shinogu's lively classmate.

Shinogu suddenly decides to attend a private junior high school that Moe is going to attend, and Haruhi finds out the reason why. Fast-forward by three years, what will happen when Haruhi enters the same school?


Includes an extra story (chapter 5):
Ribbon of Love

title: Kiryuu-kun Dake wa Suki ni Naranai
description:
Nina, a high school student longing for love, has a nemesis in her class, Akiju Kiryu. Nina has completely ignored him since an incident in elementary school, but one day, by chance, she accepts his proposal....
She tries her best to find a boyfriend, but she keeps failing because she has never been in a relationship before. But Akiju is always there to help her out with his casual kindness... Is he just trying to tease her by worrying about her and protecting her in a pinch? 
A love story about two childhood friends who are torn between love and hate!

title: Magic Star Academy Triple☆☆☆
description:
What is the commotion that unfolds among the members of the "Animal Master Department" of the Magic Star Academy, a wizard training college? What will happen to the love between Mori and Nao? And what is "Morishin"?

(google translated)

title: Lintegrame
description: Depuis toute petite, Chéolsa ne rêve que d'une chose : entrer dans la seule et unique école qui forme les futurs marionnettistes. Aujourd'hui jeune étudiante dans cet établissement, elle espère y retrouver Endje, son ami d'enfance. Malheureusement pour elle, tout ne va pas se passer comme prévu.

title: If You've Ever Got Worries, All Right?
description:
A compilation of short stories.  
  
Nayamigoto, attara ne?  
Tenryuu's life is turned upside down when he has to take care of his giddy 10-year-old daughter, Mari. Mari is excited about the arrival of a new baby half-brother, but is worried about her father being on his own. Tenryuu is exasperated by Mari's picky eating habits, fickle moods and incessant questions about making a baby. Can father and daughter ever see eye to eye?   
  
This is a Sakende Yaruze! side story featuring guest appearances by Shino, Nakaya, and the rest of the cast.

title: Kimi ga Mabushii Sei de
description:
Extremely shy, Koharu Uzuki spent her middle school days alone, unable to make friends. Dreaming of youth, she was determined to make it to high school, but she made a huge mistake when she introduced herself. However, when Aoi Yuuki, the most outgoing boy in her class, spoke to her, things started to change for Koharu's high school life, which had started off with such a blunder.

Koharu Uzuki, a shy girl; Aoi Yuuki, the most outgoing person in her class; Ukino Sora, a childhood friend who goes at his own pace; and Shiratori Miu, a beautiful, solitary girl. A story of love and friendship between four people with different personalities and social classes!

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)

title: Kashinoki-sensei wa Watashi wo Oshiteiru!?
description: 「私たち　見つめ合ったことあるんですよ」配信限定アイドル『あにまる未満。』のメンバー『なーの』（本名：南雲日菜乃）は、実は人の視線が超苦手！日菜乃の時は学校でも下を向いて人を避ける日々。ある日、超こわ～い美術の樫木先生が「なーの」のガチオタだと判明！見た目はこんなに怖いのに、中身は超優しくて私の超オタクで…？オタクの愛が背中を押す☆アイドル成長物語！

title: I Will Return My New Brother
description:
Marian, who longs to live a normal, quiet life, suddenly finds herself in a state of change. Her mother's remarriage has brought her a new brother, but the problem is... it's a burden!!

"Until the day I die, not a drop of water will touch your hands." 
"Why do you promise that?" 
"If you have any wishes, just tell me." 
"Please don't stay home and meet your friends outside and get to know them better." 

Even more, he's considerate of me, who hates to stand out, and he's even willing to spend money to change my fancy carriage into a more modest one. 

Is this person crazy? Or are all nobles this crazy? 

I thought my mother's remarriage was just her having a new husband, and it had nothing to do with me. But... can I accept my new family?

title: Osananajimi De Oshideite ！
description: 「俺、アイドルオーディション受けるわ！」　咲良と透は幼なじみ。ハマるものもずっと一緒で、高校生になった今は韓国のアイドルに夢中‼︎ …なんだけど、実は咲良は透がずっと好き。意を決して告白しようと思ったら…透が公開型アイドルオーディション番組に参加⁉︎　あれよあれよと有名になっていく透。自分もオタクだから応援はしたいけど、自分だけの好きな人でもいてほしくて…‼︎

title: Serim ui Cheolchik
description: Everyone is terrified of Han Serim thanks to rumors that she’s a gangster. Golden boy Kang Seung-Woo ends up paired with her for a mentor-mentee program. Ever the perfectionist, he tries to get close to Serim to ensure everything goes off without a hitch. But… what is her deal? A high-stakes romance between Han Serim, who lives like there’s no tomorrow, and Kang Seung-Woo, who has his entire life perfectly mapped out.

title: Jajjimento to fuuki midashi
description: A story about the discipline committee member Machida-san and the laid-back Isurugi-kun.

title: Maou no Musume to Narushisuto
description:
ナルシストな完璧少年・橘くん。
自分に見向きもしない転校生の愛塚は
実は魔王の娘だった！

彼女を自分に惚れさせて、
地球滅亡を阻止しようとする橘くんだけど…？

title: Kanojo ga Cafe ni Iru
description:
A 16-year-old high school girl, Michiru Isshiki, has cool childhood friends--- her next door neighbors, Ryouhei and Shuusuke Kuwa. Shuusuke, the same age as Michiru, is a pure-hearted, passionate rugby player. On the other hand, Ryouhei, three years their senior, works as a model, and is the campus crush. Because Michiru is a pure-hearted person, Michiru opposes the playboy Ryouhei, but she realized her true feelings when she saw a kissing scene between Ryouhei and his girlfriend, Youko!

(from mangaupdates)

title: Shin Star of the Giants
description:
*Description contains spoilers for Star of the Giants*

(from ebookjapan):

Five years have passed since Hoshi Hyuma, who destroyed his left arm in exchange for a perfect game, left without telling anyone where he was going. His passion for baseball is rekindled!

It was the summer of the year when the Giants, under Nagashima's leadership, suffered the humiliation of finishing in last place for the first time in the team's history.

In the suburbs of Tokyo, a new player emerged who could bat for 30,000 yen with a 100 percent success rate and became the talk of the town. The man who died as a pitcher, Hyuma, appeared as a batter!

title: KADO: The Right Answer: Blue Spring & Railgun
description:
The lives of 2 high schoolers drastically change after the arrival of the Kado cube and the unlimited energy source Wam.

Largely takes place after Episode 5 of the anime or Chapter 4 of the manga.

title: Girl, You'd Better Give In
description: Tess, a common high school girl, ran into a genius boy at a nightclub and kissed him accidentally! That kiss reminds him of his disappeared lover… what’s the relationship between the nightclub girl and his sweet lover? During the search for the truth, a big conspiracy finally uncovered…

title: Love Letter
description: Hoshino Hitomi is a junior high school student who has feelings for her math teacher, Mr. Takeda. Hitomi is studying hard to get into her teacher's school, Higashi High, but her classmate, Kazuya, makes a pass at her... In the end, a secret note describing her feelings for him is discovered by the school...

title: Autumn's Sanctuary
description: To give thanks is a gift that we all receive but very few we put into practice. In the case of Emily, there is in this world a puppy that would do everything possible to show his gratitude to her for saving him from an accident on the street

title: Watashitachi Ni Koi Wa Nai
description: 彼女をとっかえひっかえする幼なじみの彼と私には、ある秘密の関係があった。

title: Triple Honey
description:
Compilation of short stories:  
  
- Triple Honey  
  
- Kirai, Kirai, demo Suki  
  
- Hatsukoi Spiral  
  
- Yume Nanka ja Nakute  
One day, Ai had a dream of kissing her classmate, Mitani. But isn’t Mitani a guy who’s famous for being anti-social and scary?!   
  
- Dangan Lover

title: Kiss no Jijou
description: Five stories about kissing set in the same high school.

title: Sera-kun wa Tomodachi ni wa Naranai
description:
She has had no friends since she was born. She was determined to make it to high school, but as soon as she entered school, she stopped attending due to the flu. Hotaru is a clumsy communicator who has trouble communicating her feelings. She admires Sera-kun, the most popular boy in her class, and wants to be like him. She was supposed to be observing him in order to be like him, but on the contrary, he takes an interest in her!

Will the simple girl who is a communicator but tries her best make friends for the first time?

title: Kyoto Kurena Wiso Kitan
description: Mio, a high school girl raised in a family of exorcists who purge evil spirits. Despite being forbidden to leave her hometown of Nagano, she secretly heads to Kyoto without telling her family...! There, when she's about to be attacked by an evil spirit, she's saved by a high school boy named Takara—but for some reason, he knows about Mio...

title: Chatting by the Stairs
description:
(from ebookjapan):

What will happen to the love triangle surrounding them? Kanan Morimoto, an eighth grader, has a complex about her naturally permed curly hair. Kanan's schoolwork, friends, and love life are not going well, but she is helped by the kindness of her fight buddy, Sen Nakayamate, and before she knows it, she has fallen in love with him. 

Like a pair of ladybugs, Kanan thinks they are well-balanced, but there is a girl by Line's side who goes to a different high school and seems to be friendly with him!

Contains bonus one-shot "Cocoon-Bound Piccadilly" in volume 2.

title: Osananajimi Wa Gaman Oyameta. ~ Mezameta Kemono Wa Dekiaichu ~
description: 〝藤宮学園のナイト〟と呼ばれるクール系女子・司は、〝姫〟と呼ばれるほどの美少年・波留と幼なじみ。ずっと波留の世話を焼いてきた司だけど、波留が「ナイト役はもう交代」と言ってきて――!?　かわいすぎる男子×イケメン女子の焦れ甘ラブストーリー！

title: Dangeki!
description:
I'm a girl, and I'm in the boys' theater club (dangeki)!

Akira Segawa, a handsome girl aiming to become an actress, fails her high school entrance exam. Just when she's worried about her future, she gets a helping hand! She is scouted by the "boys" drama club of Shirou High School, a regular participant in national competitions! As a condition of admission and joining the club, Akira has to enter as a "man"...! The members of the drama club are all boys with strong personalities, and the risk of being exposed is always at its maximum...! If he's found out, he'll be expelled immediately!

title: Ice Kiss
description: Xu Min takes care of the family because her parents go to work early every morning. On the first day of high school, on a crowded train, she accidentally kisses the annoying and humourous Buay Fan. From then on, her normally peaceful life is disrupted…

title: Witch Angel
description:
(from ebookjapan):
This SF fantasy depicts the mysterious events involving Kejime Monono, a boy with a twisted face and a dim head, and a beautiful witch angel who haunts him. Kejime Monono is a junior high school student whose school life is ridiculed by the students. A beautiful woman, Rei Tokinowa, suddenly appears in front of him and confesses to Kejime that she loves him, and begins to show her ardent affection for him......?

title: August Blind Spot
description: Yoko, a member of the art club, has a crush on Morisue, a member of the soccer club. One day, she hears a shrill scream coming from the classroom and rushes to find Yamada, a member of the same club, murdered. From then on, a series of strange incidents occur around Yoko, and the identity of the culprit gradually becomes clear.

title: Inuma-kun wa Mate ga Dekinai
description:
Inuma, a freshman in the student council is very attached to Aoi, the student council president.

He always gives his best at supporting the slightly clumsy Aoi but not only has he shown stalker-like tendencies, he tends to go over the top in his actions.

Unfortunately for Inuma, Aoi can only see him as a younger boy who is cute and puppy-like!

title: I Love Persia!
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A Lion Girl's Life in Japan Begins! 

A young girl who was raised by lions on the African prairie was taken into the custody of zoologist Dr. Yagami after the death of her parent lion. Named "Persia," she is sent to live with Dr. Yagami, and She then began living with the doctor's twin sons at the doctor's family home in Japan... 

Persia is not used to this new life. 

This is the first volume of the hilarious wild girl slapstick manga!

-Addendum on the Anime Adaptation:

Persia's anime adaptation was the second in Pierrot's Magical Girl series after Creamy Mami, and the only one to be an adaptation. The title was altered from *"I Love Persia!"* to  *"Persia, the Magic Fairy"* (Maho no Yousei Persia, 魔法の妖精 ペルシャ)

Barring Persia's design, which was adapted very closely, and elements of the content from the early chapters being adapted, there is little resemblance to the manga in terms of story, characterization, themes and so forth. 

Persia herself in the original

title: Say Goodbye With a Smile
description:
At the end of the college entrance examination, Mai Xin thought she would start a new life full of girl's life, but never did she thought that she would study funeral service major in college! This “closest to death” major is terrifying to think about. What should she do if she is timid in her four years of college?

However, the somewhat strange and gentle classmate, the real movements brought during the internship, all made her gradually change her mind...
Overcome the fear, and the story of alternative laughter and tears will begin!

title: Tsukareru Hodo ni Dekiaisaretete Sasuga ni Shi ni sou Nan da ga??
description: Mao is an art club member who is a gloomy person. She posts her illustrations on social media and is depressed when she gets zero "likes". One day, she is possessed by a cheerful ghost boy, and for some reason, he loves her very much...?! A midsummer girl-meets-boy story that reminds you of the feeling of "like".

title: Zankoku Yuugi
description:
Story 1: Suou Hatasu is a nice guy with a pretty normal life. Like most college students, he's living alone in a little shoebox apartment and commutes on-foot. In spite of his financial limitations, he's fairly satified with his life: he's got a good friend, a cute girlfriend and is just starting his first student-teaching job at an area high school.  
  
Things only seem to be getting better for him when one of his students, handsome and fabulously wealthy Harashima Daichi, seems to take a shine to him. Immediately feeling welcomed to his new school, Suou couldn't really ask for more. Until his new "buddy" Harashima suddenly turns on him in a deserted hallway and vows to make Suou "his property".  
  
Can money really buy love? Harashima certainly seems to think so…  
  
Story 2: Three childhood friends, Yoshito, Sei and Daisuke, come to a crossroads in their relationship when Yoshito announces he's getting married. Sei's composure crumbles and he admits to having loved Yoshito since

title: Prism Baby
description: Because of a past heartbreaking experience, Yuki closed off her heart. Not until her classmates dragged her and forced her to attend a group date with the guys from another school. There she met crybaby, Tsuyoshi. The next day, the next thing she knows is that she is being chased by Tsuyoshi saying that he wants her to listen to his depressing love story! But surrounded by the younger crybaby Tsuyoshi and hot classmate Keito, she can’t remain uninvolved with love!

title: Kanojo wa NO no Tsubasa o Motte Iru
description:
Is drinking after work really necessary? If people around me suddenly start wearing make-up… do I have to, too? It bothers me when my boyfriend makes dirty jokes…

"I don't want people to dislike me."
"I don't want to ruin the mood."

Tsubasa, a high school girl who is willing to say “no,” gradually changes the thoughts and actions of those who have a hard time because of such feelings…

A story about the power of saying NO, a power that is within all of us.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Shinitagari No Eteruno
description:
'Please kill me.' — With this sudden confession, the girl's fate begins to move drastically. A rondo of love, hatred, and loyalty, woven across the vast eternity of time.

---

title: Yeoreumbanghak Jeonnal
description: That time has passed or is yet to come for you. What kind of memories do you remember from your teenage years?

title: Sensei, Imakara Oto Shini Iku ne
description:
Chizuru, a teacher, has for some reason been getting hit on by Mioka, a newly hired rookie teacher who joined the school in April.

Mioka handles his classes with ease and is constantly surrounded by swooning female students, so why would someone like him be interested in Chizuru...?

Chizuru assumes Mioka is just teasing him, but it turns out Mioka was once his student back when Chizuru was a student teacher!?

"...I've been serious about you this whole time. You still haven't figured it out? I want to be your boyfriend."

Chizuru's disciplinary guidance can't keep up with this younger man's obsessive devotion!

title: Time Tora-vel
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Atarashii Furuhito is an aspiring archaeologist. He is conducting field research for his graduation thesis entitled "Proof of Himiko's Existence." There, Furuhito unearths a mysterious object, but a woman appears from inside. She is Tora Bell. She is a female thief who travels through time and space with a time machine. She forces him to offer her room at his lodgings as a temporary hiding place for the various treasures she intends to steal and collect from all the "times" in the world. She also asks him to be her assistant. ......?

title: The Whale's Back
description:
Kujira and Takeshi are childhood friends in their second year of middle school. When they were little, there was no difference between boys and girls, and they all played together, but lately, both the people around them and they themselves have been acting strange. This is the story of the stormy adolescence that clashes as their self-consciousness screams and their bodies grow!

**Award:** Won the Autumn 2019 Afternoon Four Seasons Awards Four Seasons Grand Prize, earning its publication in Afternoon's December 2019 Issue.

title: Anata To Gyuutto
description: Masashi was enjoying the high school girl life in Tokyo. However, when her parents moved, she decided to transfer to an agricultural high school in a very rural area. She's on duty to take care of the cows and sell vegetables... She thought her youth was over... but then there was an unexpectedly handsome boy sitting next to her!?

title: Rambling Rose, Rambling Rose
description:
(from ebookjapan):
A stranger calls out to Tsuguo, "Come here," in a dream he has had repeatedly since childhood. Tsuguo decides to search for the house he sees in the dream, which becomes more and more real with each passing month... Includes the title story and four others.

title: Marriage Games
description:
Daisuke Tsukasa is a first year high school student who leaves his parents and lives alone in an apartment. Then he receives an order from his father to get married. Moreover,
the other person was Yumeko, the beautiful homeroom teacher. Thus begins a secret newlywed life between students and teachers at school and husband and wife at home.

It is a romantic comedy that depicts the dilemma of being in love with each other but unable to act as a ``real husband and wife'' because they are high school students, and the frustration of not being able to openly express jealousy towards the person who is courting each other because their relationship is a secret.

title: Osumon
description: Mizuki Amano, a beautiful model who becomes captivated by the charm of sumo after an unexpected encounter, faces various challenges. From family issues to societal pressures and the differences between men and women, she pushes forward. However, once she steps into the sumo ring, it's all about two people facing each other and clashing with their full strength! Alongside her unique friends, she strives to assert her own will and aim for the top!

title: Lyrical Karen-chan
description: A lyrical love story about Karen Domotojima, a tall girl show worries about her height, depicting her sweet and sad adolescence.

title: Kick Off!
description:
Krille, a teenage boy always dogged by misfortune, one day finds himself being haunted by an unusually confident and vain ghost who seems to be around the same age as himself. Join us as Krille's supernatural adventure in daily life, filled with love, action and soccer, starts to unfold!   
  
Kick Off won the best comic award at Bookjuryn 2008.

title: Vitamin (YEO Ho-Kyoung)
description: Hana's a high school girl with a life that's only composed of one catastrophe after another. Her bad luck is only matched by her even worse temper and oversized ego. Tagging along are her best friend Sua and the poor victim Jiyong for some of the funniest misunderstandings and catastrophes.

title: Koi to Synchronicity
description:
Kokorosaki Nora, who will soon be in her second year of high school, is saved from a difficult situation by a male classmate, Sasaki Haru, and falls in love with him. Competition is fierce, and Nora hears rumors that there is a person nearby who is so beautiful that it makes people lose the will to fight, but she still refuses to give up. However, one day, the person in question appears before Nora...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yuē dìng yú xīng yè de hǎi
description:
Uika x Saki doujinshi
*The story takes place after Episode 12

title: Scrambled: Journeylism
description: Visi is a shy student at high school. After deciding she decided to join the extracurricular journalism at school, she instead got the task of creating articles about the 5 most popular boys in school! Very Shit (or profit?)… the guy who Visi has a crush on is included in the list!

title: The Samurai
description: Sixteen-year-old high school student Takeshi Chimatsuri has devoted his life to being a master samurai like his father was. Then one day, the Toki twins, two ninja sisters he's known since childhood, transfer to his school and issue him a challenge to take back their family dagger from him. Unfortunately for him, they have discovered his one weakness: the fear of the naked female body. Now, Takeshi must undergo special training from his classmates Atsuko and Torai, and his teacher Miss Ayatsugi to resist the combined brute strength of Akari and the temptation of her sex-crazed twin Kagiri. Class will never be in order with these three constantly fighting each other.

title: The Thief Cinderella
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Nozomi Sugimura, who had stolen a doll as a child, was transformed by this experience into a college student with a strong desire for what she does not have. Her desire for other people's beauty, a beautiful voice, a lucid brain, and money, which is endless, only grows deeper. 

Then one day, she is involved in a car accident, which gives her a mysterious ability. One day, after a car accident, she is given a mysterious ability that allows her to fulfill her desires. 

What awaits her is happiness and unhappiness!　

In addition to " Thief Cinderella," which depicts a mysterious Cinderella story, " The Green Mask," "Napoleon and I," and "Elizabeth's Sunshine" are also included in this collection.

title: Kimi no Kawaii-sa wa Hitoriji me Shitai (Fan Colored)
Kore wa Koi desu
description:
High school teacher, Ayai Tsurugi feels uncomfortable around one of his students, Endou Kanaga. One day, after school, the two of them end up getting trapped in the teacher's lounge, and Ayai realizes that his feelings for her is "love"...!?

(from mangaupdates)

title: Mi No Ke
description: Mi No Ke (pronounced Mee-No-Kay) is derived from the Japanese word “Me no ke” which means ‘eye hair’ in Japanese. ‘Mi No Ke’ is a psychological thriller, comedy, mystery, with a bit of romance sprinkled in.

title: Koisuru Himawari Wa Wakimaenai
description:
"Do you laugh at children's love?" A 26-year-old lawyer and a 16-year-old high school girl begin their sweet and sad life together.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title: Gazing Into Your Eyes.
description:
A heartrending and painful story of “favoritism” that takes place in the art club of a rural high school in Kyuushuu.

Originally published in [Champion BUZZ Vol. 11](https://www.akitashoten.co.jp/w-championbuzz/2024/11), a supplement included with the digital version of [Weekly Shounen Champion 2024 No. 35](https://www.akitashoten.co.jp/w-champion/2024/35).

title: Naisho No Otonari San
description: 上京してきたばかりの料理好き女子高生・春日理乃。引っ越してきたアパートのお隣さん・藤堂馨はなんだか危ない雰囲気で…？

title: The Wildcat Constellation
description: Wakana is in love with a boy one year younger, who she's never confessed to….and she'll be graduating soon. Will she be able to see him again?

title: Aomugi to Hototogisu
description: なんでもほどほどできてしまう高校生男子、麦。実は挫折の記憶を抱え、前に踏み出せなくなっていた。美人で寡黙な同級生、飛鳥が落とした一枚の短冊が、麦の世界を色付けて――俳句が紡ぐ眩しい青春がはじまる！

title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu SPINOUT!
Become the Wind!
description: Yuki is a freshman and a member of the tennis club where all she does is fetch balls. One day, by chance, Yuki runs to make up for the lack of members on her best friend Mayumi's track team, but her hidden talent is discovered by the track coach Hideki...

title: Aozora Floppy
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Twelve years ago, Tokio Sorano was picked up in a coin locker at Shinjuku Station and raised by a group of vagrants. Undeterred by adversity, Tokio grew up to become a popular boy in the city.

 His homeroom teacher, Masao Marui, who has a burning sense of duty as a teacher, tries to understand him, but Tokio is out of the norm in every way. As soon as he entered the school, Tokio happened to show off his brilliant soccer skills. His feet caught the attention of his classmate Takano Miyako, a forward on the boys' soccer team!　

(Desc. of Volume 1!)

title: The Lady is a Cavewoman
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Neely, a college girl, went to her grandfather's cottage with her friend Killy during their summer vacation, but the cottage that used to be there was gone, and her grandfather appeared in the form of a caveman. 

Neely sympathizes with Grandpa, who has built an atomic hometown where people live in the wilderness without the use of man-made structures, but Killy leaves him out of love. 

Then Ryan, a male friend who joins them later, comes to live with Neeley and Grandpa...! 

In addition to "The Lady is a Cavewoman", the collection also includes "I'm Learning To Tell Fortunes", "Black Cat Tango", "My Sister Marin", and "There's Room for Rent".

title: Sky Colored Melody
description:
Melody's parent died a few months ago and now she's moving in with her uncle whom she never met in her life in a new town. One day, she accidentally breaks into the attic and finds a portrait of herself in luxurious costume, wearing the same locket her parents gave her.
