What is Melody's relation with the girl in the picture?

(from mangaupdates)

title: Koi no Nettaiteikiatsu
description:
Short collection of love stories by author Umino Tsunami.

Content:
- Chapter 1. **Koi no Nettaiteikiatsu** (恋の熱帯低気圧)
- Chapter 2. **Poyoyon Ghostbusters** (ぽよよん ゴーストバスターズ )
- Chapter 3. **Merry Merry Christmas Kiss** (メリー・メリー・クリスマスキッス)
- Chapter 4. **Otsuki-sama ni Onegai** (お月様にお願い)

title: Watashi No Oshi Danshi Shokai Shimasu
description:
What do you find attractive in boys?
The caring big-sister type, the model student with a surprising side, the office worker next door, the seemingly flashy guy who's actually serious, the cute boyish type...
An omnibus love story depicting the everyday lives of boys full of unexpected contrasts!
By the time you finish this story, you're sure to find your favorite.

title: Futari no Hanabi ga Chiru Mae ni
description: 【平成女子高生×タイムスリップ×ヒューマンドラマ】 瑞生（みずき）と綾音（あやちゃん）は学生時代からの大親友。周りがどんどん結婚していく中、お互いに独身のOLを続けていた。ずっと変わらず仲良く過ごしてきたふたりの相性は、”男女だったら、絶対付き合っていた！”と思えるほど。しかし、”変わらない”と思っていたふたりの関係が、花火大会をきっかけにぐらつきはじめる。それは、初めて一緒に花火を見た高校生の時にも覚えた感覚——。悩む瑞生が次に目を覚ますと、そこはあやちゃんと出会った高校時代。あやちゃんとの新しい未来を描きなおそうと息まく瑞生。なぜなら、自分がイケメン男子高校生になっていたから…！

title: Shigure-senpai no Unmei no Hito
description:
甘いのに、ほろ苦い…青春ラブ第1巻！！

才色兼備な姉に比べて、見た目も中身も普通な自分に複雑な気持ちを抱く苗。
高校に入学し、1人でなんでもできるようになりたいと意気込む苗は、
落とし物を拾ってもらったことをきっかけに、3年生の時雨先輩と知り合いに。
意地悪だけど優しい時雨先輩が気になり出す苗だけど、先輩は苗の姉・芹を知っているようで…？

title: Rinjin wo Aisou
description: Kazuhito is a model student and he has a troublesome neighbour who always sleeps during classes. One day, he sees him in the streets and without knowing why, he decides to stalk him…

title: Gu-Gu Ganmo
description:
(from ebookjapan):

He is a chicken, but not a chicken, and although he understands human language, he is not a human. Ganmo is a chicken-like housemate who has fallen in love with an ordinary family. 

He is currently struggling to become a good pet for his owners, Hanpeita-kun, a mischievous third grader in elementary school, and Tsukune-chan, a carefree junior high school student! How will Ganmo do?

title: Mother-kon
description: Mana Mamiya, an inconspicuous high school girl in her class, has a faint crush on Shinichi Sakurada, a mysterious new art teacher. One day during an art class, Shinichi recommends that Mana wear contact lenses, and Mana takes his advice and removes her thick glasses. Mana continues to change as Shinichi leads her, but Shinichi has a terrible plan in store for her...

title: Balsam Bread
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Maja and Midori are as close as real sisters. Midori is strangely convinced of this when Akio, whom she secretly has feelings for, falls in love with Maja. But suddenly Maja changes...!　Includes the title story and five other stories.

title: Spiral Memory
description: Nerd high school student Jing, in order to get rid of the control of his mother who prevents him from over-studying, pretends to date his classmates in April and takes the opportunity to study secretly. Unexpectedly, April is actually a famous killer, approaching him in order to kill his mother. Seeing April's plan is implemented step by step, at this moment, a shocking secret emerges. She is actually…

title: Saionji-san to Yamada-kun
description: Includes two other works: "Lorelei wa Tsuki no Yoru ni" and "Sweets".

title: Chiisana Koi no Monogatari
description:
Tiny schoolgirl Chiiko develops a crush on older boy Saly and believes herself to be his girlfriend, 
although Saly is already involved with a girl called Tonko.

title: Sakurae-san wa Guigui Kisugiru.
description: Top of her class, morally upright, and admired by everyone at school- high schooler Sakurae Mishima has it all. She wants to take things to the next level with her fiancé Haruto, but her romantic skills? They're seriously disappointing...!?

title: Feel So Good
description: A story about the progression in the lives of Shimun and Shi Un Lee, brother and sister; and their trials of sadness, love, and friendships.

title: There May Be Something There That Wasn’t There Before - Haikyuu dj
Kiyasuku Fureru na Kuroshoubi ni
description: Tamaya Kuroha is a "lonely daughter" who is so distrustful of people that she keeps everyone at a distance and is feared as the "Black Rose Princess." However, her life changes drastically when her childhood friend Rio appears as her bodyguard! As Rio loves Tamaya too much, she is pushed around both physically and emotionally, and her gray youth begins to change color...?

title: My Youth
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Studying for exams, boxing, and sex - Kensaku spends his days in a fog. One day, a cute girl named Sumire moves into his house, and a "dream bridge" is built between Kensaku's room and Sumire's room! The dreamy days have just begun, but the fantasies of sex scenes are not coming true. George Akiyama's masterpiece depicts the psychology of a young man's mixed feelings of pleasure and anguish in a flexible manner!

title: Bratty Cop
description:
(from amazon.jp):

Volume 1: As part of the "50th Anniversary of Tatsuhiko Yamagami's Manga Career" we will be selling his masterpiece "Gaki Deka" as an e-book.

"Gaki Deka" is a brilliant milestone in Japanese manga, and it is no exaggeration to say that gag manga that have continued to the present day began here.

It became a social phenomenon, and the popular phrase "Death Penalty!" by Komawari-kun became a buzzword. The total number of tankobon published (26 volumes) exceeded 30 million, and the magazine in which it appeared, "Weekly Shonen Champion" became the first in the Japanese manga world to sell 2 million copies, which is a testament to the popularity of the manga.

For this e-book version, we have decided to use the Akita Shoten version (first edition) and "Gaki Deka THE BEST" (3 volumes, Shogakukan Creative) as the base.

"Gaki Deka THE BEST" is basically scanned directly from the original manuscripts, proofread by the magazines in which they were published (Weekly Shonen

title: Burning Ｖ
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Bui Hazama, 15 years old, also known as Victory Hazama, or V Hazama, is a man who, as his name suggests, has never lost a fight in his life! After the death of his foster parent, Gen-san, V is traveling alone in search of his parents, who separated when he was a child.

During his journey, V by chance tries tennis for the first time in his life, and beats a tennis player ranked 5th in Japan by playing tennis beyond the norm. The challenge of a man who was born and raised to win, while carrying a secret past!

title: Blue Planter
description: 「宇宙農業」。 それは、SFではなく、もう目の前にある未来の話。 ある夢を胸に秘める、宙野園芸高校 宇宙農業科１年生の広田千留。 ある夢を諦めた過去を持つ、宇宙農業科 実習助手の相楽青星。 空高く、そして碧く輝く宇宙に向かって、二人の夢が今、動き出す！

title: Teppen no Himawari
description: Ryuhei Ohno has just entered a high school where 90% of the student population is rumored to be gay. However, a couple of the students in Ryuhei's class haven't heard the rumors surrounding the school. Kunihisa Imaizumi is cute, adorable and homophobic. Unable to deal with the increasingly bold advances of his classmates, he appoints Ryuhei as his "knight in shining armor", to keep his suitors at bay. Ryuhei is more than happy to protect Kunihisa's innocence at first, but eventually, even Ryuhei finds himself falling for Kunihisa. Who is going to protect our "poor maiden" from his knight?!

title: Love You Only
description: Morishita is in love with his sempai Yushioka. But Yushioka just wants to be left alone. Or does he?

title: Kono Koi Ha Amakunai Hazu Desita
description: 高１の葉純は、「完全無欠の王子様」と名高いクラスメイト・柳沢くんが告白されているのを目撃する。優しく断る柳沢くんは、相手の女子がいなくなった瞬間毒づきだして――!?　猫かぶりな彼との偽物の恋は甘くない、はずなのに…？

title: Netabare Kinshi No Amamiya-Kun
description:
Mei dreams of spending her after-school time with her boyfriend. However, she lacks the communication skills and courage to interact with boys, so she can't find a boyfriend, let alone someone she likes. Meanwhile, at a family restaurant, she meets a kind boy who lends her some pencil lead...

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title: Fuwa Fuwa Shita Joshi ni Kokuhaku Sareta (Fan Colored)
description: A girl with the ability to float in mid-air when her mood becomes buoyant confesses to the boy she likes.

title: Love Knot
description:
1-2) Love Knot & Re:Start  
Tomoya rejected the confession from his classmate, Kazuki, stating height as the main reason. Two years later, Kazuki became taller and came back once more. However, the Kazuki that used to protect Tomoya in fights became gentle and kind. Will Tomoya be able to face his own feelings now and accept Kazuki? Includes the individual stories of the twins, Yuu and Kaede, with their lovers, Shougo and Jin and two one-shots.  
  
3) Loveliness  
Twins Yuu and Kaede have similar taste and men, the question is does Yuu need to steal Shougo's heart or was it his in the first place?  
  
4) Use That Arm Again to Hold Me  
Jin want's to know why Keade broke up with him a year ago via e-mail with no explanation, he's determined to get Keade back.  
  
5) Just Love the Way You Are  
When Jin see's how depressed Yuu is he decides to take matter's into his own hands and confront Shougo.  
  
6) Captive  
Will the playboy infirmary sensei Kajimoto ever change?  
  
7) Blindly

title: Yagami-senpai wa Se ga Hikui!
description:
A story about a short boy and a tall girl in the volleyball club.
___
[3-Chapter Preserialization (LINE Manga Indies)](https://manga.line.me/indies/product/detail?id=10747) (Chapters are the same.)

title: Hoho ni Shizumu
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
1. Hoo ni Shizumu  
  
2. Kimi wa Chiisana Kesshou (You're My Small Crystal)  
Kaho puts on a facade in front of everyone, hiding who she truly is, in other words lying to those she cares about in order to make them feel at ease. One day she meets a boy at a social gathering who sees right through her and helps her change…  
- Fate  
  
3. Wagamama ni Dakishimete  
  
4. Yakusoku ga Kimi wo Yaburu  
Aina and Tooru are childhood friends who made a promise to always be siblings. As the years pass, Aina?s feeling for Tooru turned to love but Tooru became cold and distant. Will either of them be able to keep their promise?

title: Sunday Scandal
description: Mizo gets elected as class rep and becomes involved in the lives of the class idol, Mario, and his girlfriend.

title: Koi ni Arazu
description: "I'll be your fake boyfriend." High school student Kashiwagi Sousuke was in love with his childhood friend, Sakurai Akari. However, Akari has a boyfriend—her homeroom teacher, Abekawa Midori. Sousuke makes a proposal to Akari, who is troubled by a forbidden love that must be kept secret from everyone. A relationship based entirely on lies gradually throws the gears out of alignment. Everything proceeds exactly as Sousuke intended. The sin swells up secretly, and eventually, the girl...

title: Fujunsura Junjou
description: 高校2年生の薄井仁子は、新学期が始まって1か月が経つのに未だ ぼっち。友達を作りたいと思っているけど、うまくいかない。ある日、クラスメイトの仕事を代わると、ペアの相手は湊だった。仁子が苦手な陽キャの彼との時間はとても気まずい。いっそ1人で作業したいと思った仁子は思わず「私、ドMなので大丈夫です！　お任せください！」と言ってしまう。すると湊が「俺から命令。どMなら聞けるよね？」と言ってきて!?

title: Namaiki Sugiru yo, Chigaya-kun
description:
Ever since the day they met, no matter how many times she tries to brush him off, Natsune always finds herself at the center of Chigaya's playful aim-his words, his smiles, his relentless teasing, all reserved just for her. Flustered by his knowing grin and mischievous jabs, she can't help but wonder... could there be something more behind his teasing than just a joke?

A charming, heart-fluttering high school romance between two archers - a composed senior and her mischievous junior who just might be shooting straight for her heart!

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

title: Dol Wota Never Die
description: ドルヲタとして生きてきた10年を捧げたアイドルが引退。絶望して死んだ俺だが、気がつくと高校２年生に…。初恋の人にもう一度出会うために、青春を生き直す！

title: Sekai de Ichiban Ani Shiteru
description:
Yori, a 2nd year high school student suddenly finds herself living with her mother's new husband's son, Seki, a 2nd year university student. When she visits Seki's apartment, a half-naked, scary-looking man comes out... but for some reason, he immediately starts doting on her!? He's frivolous and overly affectionate... but she just can't hate him.

(Source: Palcy, translated)

title: Seishun Wa Wagamama Kurai Ga Chodoi
description:
Shiho is the ace and captain of a strong volleyball team, and with her fervent desire to win the Spring High Tournament, which decides which team is best in Japan, she is constantly relied on by those around her. She puts her own needs on the back burner and is feeling crushed by the pressure. In the midst of all this, Shiho reunites with her childhood friend Ryou, who is one year younger than her. When she meets him again after a long time, he has grown into a large, selfish, cheeky young man, with all the traces of the cute boy she used to protect once having vanished.

"Be more selfish. I'll grant your selfish wishes."

Her selfish youth begins now!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title: ELEMENTS: Users Of The Universe
description: After a group of aliens, known as IDOs, are assisted by Brian McGrath and friends in defeating an enemy; the two species form an alliance to eradicate darkness from the Universe and bring justice down upon those opposing them.

title: Sweet Sky
description: Jin Haneul is a lower angel whose job is to erase bad memories and feelings from people. As Jin goes through this process or erasing burdens, Min Deule, his first love, appears. A forgotten first love, a bond that transcends space and time, and their intertwined feelings

title: Bijuu to Runway
description: Nui Kodaka is an energetic girl who wants to become a fashion designer. When she asks the super-beautiful Ariga Rose, whom she met at the entrance ceremony, to model for her, she is told, "Okay, but you have to be my caretaker in return..."! A thrilling coming-of-age story begins!

title: Himeko According to the Gossip
description:
A masterpiece, published for over more than 10 years with a total of 31 volumes.

A school comedy manga about the youth of Umemiya Himeko, a girl in the upper grades of elementary school, and her friends.

title: Attention All Students! - Teacher Arc
description: Included one-shot: Volume 25: Maria Theresia (two parts)

title: Oshi ni Osewa ni Nattemasu
description: Yusai, a JK who is working hard on her love life. She lives with an acquaintance of her stepfather's for family reasons. To her surprise, she meets mystery guesser! Yusai wants to avoid being exposed as an otaku due to her embarrassment and her reluctance to know his real face, but the very natural Shuri comes on to her without realizing it?!

title: If The Two Could Meet
description:
A one-shot compilation with the theme of marriage and couples.

(from ebookjapan):
Ritsuko Mizusawa attended her friend's engagement party with a group of four good friends. After the second and third parties, they got drunk and found themselves in a hotel room with Hashimoto, the man on the groom's side. Neither of them remembers anything, but Hashimoto says he will take the responsibility and marry her. Hashimoto comes to Ritsuko's house to ask her to marry him...?

In addition to the title story (*Big Comic Original*, March 20th, 1979), also includes:
- **My Alien** (わたしの宇宙人, Watashi no Uchuujin) - *Big Comic Original Zoukan*, May 1st, 1977
- **The Woman Who Wants to Wed** (結婚したい女, Kekkonshitai Onna) - *Big Comic Original Zoukan*, October 15th, 1978
- **There Goes Naomi-san** (直美さんが行く, Naomi-san ga Yuku) - *Big Comic Original*, December 5th, 1979
- **To Be Frank, Roommates** (前略同居人サマ, Zenryaku Dokyonin-sama) - *Big Comic Original*, June 20th, 1977
- **Story of Cream Soda** (クリーム・ソーダ

title: Boku no Ato
description: One day, he finds a red mark on the neck of the class president, who is always calm and composed, and from that day, he follows her with his eyes. A coming-of-age story about a ‘hickey’ between a diligent member of the class president's  and a light-hearted boy.

title: Goodbye Triangle
description:
Taku Kamijo and Asuka Hoshino are third year junior high school students whose houses are next door to each other. With the high school entrance exam coming up, we're in the middle of the rush! However, while Asuka has excellent grades, Taku is very bad at studying. Taku, who hopes to apply to Misaki High School, is in danger, so his parents arrange for a private tutor. It was a beautiful female college student...!? A refreshing
school love comedy!!

title: Kaedama Youjo wa Jiyuu ni Narimasu!
description: Nina Lindra is a gifted student and skilled magic user, but she has a secret that no one can find out. She often disguises herself as her adoptive sister, Lilia Lust, even taking her exams in her place, at the request of the Lust family. When the kingdom’s queen requests Lilia to heal her ailing son, Nina once again steps into her role, using her powers to ease Prince Erland’s pain. As Nina tends to him, she discovers the warmth hidden beneath Erland’s icy facade. But as feelings grow and a charming foreign prince enters her life, Nina must face the hardest choice. Will she continue living a lie, or risk everything to be herself?

title: Haru no Susume
description:
“He does seem like he's interested in stuff like romance.” —But Ichijou, the super serious guy who’s the subject of such rumors, actually has a girlfriend!

(Source: Harta, translated)

title: SWEET HACKER
description: 学校内のトラブルを解決するという噂の謎の集団“SNOW”。そんなSNOWの正体をひょんなことから知ってしまった栞は、その手伝いをすることになり…！？

title: Saredo, Futari wa Kusare Koi
description: この春高校生になった夢来（むく）には苦手な人がいる。それは、小学校以来の幼なじみ・八雲。ルックスがよく秀才な八雲は学校中で人気があるものの、夢来にはいつも上から目線で偉そうな態度を取ってくるのだった。そんな八雲が彼女と別れたことを耳にした夢来は、彼とまた小さな喧嘩を繰り広げるのだが……。

title: Free! - Sunege Mo Aishite (Doujinshi)
description: Haru, después de recapitular un suceso importante, llega a la conclusión de que en realidad no está soñando…

title: My Sky 2001
description:
(from ebookjapan):

The Yasuda Group, a conglomerate said to be capable of founding a small independent country with just one family, had a custom. The heir to the family must find a wife who is approved by all members of the family and bring her home. 

The prospective heir, Ippei Yasuda, embarks on a journey that may never end in order to meet a wonderful woman. 

As Ippei continues to grow and develop through repeated encounters and partings, he learns of the disappearance of his mother, who left him when he was very young. ......

title: Suki to Iuniwa Mada Osanai
description:
【この年下男子、メロすぎ注意。】
クールなのに、ときどき天然。ゲーム友達とのオフ会で 恋、はじまっちゃいました。ーーオンラインゲーム「Sparkle Animals（スパークル アニマルズ）」にどハマりしている高校生の光理（ひかり）。ある日、仲良しのゲーム友達4人でオフ会をすることに！
初対面で意外な印象だったのは、一つ年下でちょっぴり天然な市岡（いちおか）くん。
光理の想像とは裏腹に、彼の見た目はクールなヤンキーだった…！思わず怯んでしまう光理だが、市岡くんの飾らない人柄と優しさに惹かれていくーー。趣味に熱中する女子と、低温男子の初な青春ラブストーリー。

title: Oshite Mofute
description: "ぬい"を吸うヤンキーと目が合って…!?　もしかして…同担ですか!?

title: Shisaku Shinwa
description: 気になるあの子は創造主!?青春の世界創作コメディ!!

title: Evil Girl/Justice Boy
description:
「私、怪人デザイナーになりたいんです！！」
愛する人の秘密を知った少年は足を踏み入れた――この厳しい恋の戦いに。

ヒーローに憧れる日路(ひのみち)は、想いを寄せていたクラスメイト・心亜(ここあ)に告白をする。晴れて恋を成就させた日路だったが、招かれた彼女の自宅で見たものは世界を恐怖に陥れる悪の組織《EVIL（イーブル）》の怪人たちだった…！

「大切な人は”怪人＝悪”を生み出している…？」

苦悩する日路の前にEVILと闘うヒーロー《ジャスティサイダー》も姿を現して…。愛する彼女のため、そして自身が信じる道のため、日路少年は過酷な闘いに身を投じてゆく――

title: Yǔ Zhǐ Xīng Jiàng Shí
description: Uika Misumi x Sakiko Togawa

title: Yukarikun Na Gap Ga Zurui
description:
Cute, sexy, puppy-like, and mature! Today, I'm being swept away by a mysterious guy with too many contradictions.

Meiko has started working part-time as a lecturer at a vocational school once a week. The only reason she can manage the unfamiliar lessons is because of Yukari-kun, the diligent student. Yukari-kun is a source of comfort! A mental oasis, a cute student! But outside of school, Yukari-kun has an unexpected side to him…!?

title: Nazuna! Nazuna!
description:
(from wikipedia.jp):
Momo, a sophomore at Sakuraen High School, is molested on her way to school on the bus and loses her student handbook at the same time. Momo's best friend, Yomogi, also loses a book on child-rearing and childbirth that she was supposed to show Momo on the same bus. On the same day, a beautiful boy named Serina Nazuna is transferred to her class. Momo thinks he is the culprit and tries to rehabilitate him, but when she visits Nazuna's house, she finds out that Nazuna is raising a younger sister and four younger brothers. He tells her that he stole Momo's notebook in order to verify her name and face, and because he wanted to try freeing himself from his cold-blooded father in the house where he now lives.

Contains *Rodian Romanovich Raskolnikov* and  *Respond, People of Planet Kirara!* (Kirara-Seijin Outou seyo). *Rodian Romanovich Raskolnikov* is Yumiko Ooshima's own adaptation of *Crime and Punishment*.

Note: The only edition of *Nazuna! Nazuna!* is the Hakusens

title: Haikyu!! - Hanbun Kono Sekai (Doujinshi)
description: Haikyu!! Dj-Hanbun Kono Sekai doujinshisi nin türkçe çevirisidir

title: Ghost House Waltz
description:
今日こそは、告白をしようと決めたのに。
嫌われたくない一心で、思いを寄せていた幼馴染のルークから逃げてしまった少女・リグレッタ。

でもやっぱり好きって言えばよかった。
だって大好きなルークお兄ちゃんは、もうすぐ海の向こうに行ってしまうから。

そんな想いにゴーストハウスが呼応し、彼女を屋敷へ招き入れる。
そこで待っていたのは、変わり者の幽霊でした。

その幽霊・リラックは、リグレッタを誰かと勘違いしているみたい。
自分は負け犬だと言いだした彼の過去を知って、リグレッタは居てもたってもいられなくなり…。

人間と幽霊、立場が異なる二人の切なく、温かい物語が開幕。

title: Until The Day All Becomes Green
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Lesdeg is the daughter of an oil company president. In order to restore her father's company, which is on the verge of bankruptcy, she is asked to enter into a political marriage...?　A collection of 5 sensitive short stories including the title story!

title: Kawarime-san no Genba kara wa Ijou Desu
description:
A girl who supports her best friend's love, Kawarime-san. She watches over her best friend from the shadows, hoping that his confession goes well, but due to an unexpected turn of events, she ends up being the one to confess…

She watches a turning point in her life. A slapstick cross-purposes romcom.

**Note:** Also includes the short romcom *Cunning Kosaka-san*!
___
**Buy:**
- [Melonbooks](https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=2089781)
- [Suruga-ya](https://www.suruga-ya.jp/product/detail/ZHORO80926)

title: Yami ni Oboreta Tenshi ni Kiss wo.
description:
"This is a secret."
Mio Shirano, an ordinary high school girl who enjoys reading, gets closer to her classmate Takuya Kanda when he asks her to tell him about a book she recommends. Kanda has a handsome face that makes him look like a picture when he reads, and his school uniform is well-dressed and neat. Mio is happy to be able to talk with Kanda, whom she admires, but she discovers his secret in the infirmary. And that was the beginning of an inescapable love affair with Kanda.

title: Assault Wolf
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Due to a major earthquake that hit the Tokai region, Mt. Fuji was surrounded by a large fault line and turned into an isolated island on land. Unfortunately, Mr. and Mrs. Ida, who were visiting an animal park at the foot of Mt. Fuji, lost their beloved child... 

Ten years have passed since then. Kyosuke Ida, who was raised by wolves and grew up to be a kind-hearted boy who can speak human language, sets out on a journey in search of his parents!

title: Elize's Smile
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Irene, a girl who lost her sight after falling from a horse, is advised by her doctor to train with a guide dog. Irene, who does not trust dogs, refuses, but is told that a guide dog will take her safely where she wants to go, so she agrees. 

She begins training with Buddy, a guide dog for the blind, and gradually feels a connection with him. However, her mean friends make impossible demands on Irene and Buddy... 

"Go! Buddy," "Silver Duet," "Barefoot Jenna," and "Elise's Smile" are also included.

title: Stand By Me
description:
A collection of 4 one-shots by author Shiina Karuho.

Stand By Me:
Asuka just got dumped by her boyfriend. As she nurses her broken heart, rowdy, but popular classmate Kobe tells her sadly that he just got dumped, too...

Boku ni Yasashiku:
Suzu meets Futoshi on the street and is sketched out, but it turns out that he was just trying to find the apt. building that her parents' are renting out. Even more surprisingly, he is moving to take the post of temporary art teacher at her high school...

Switch ON!:
Inukai likes Nekotsuki even though everyone tells her that Nekotsuki is a dangerous guy. But is there something to all of these rumors?

Orion Teikuu:
Yuusuke is in love with a girl that walks by where he works everyday. Struck by his determination, Maria decides to offer her help...

title: Blazing Kotodama
description:
(from ebookjapan):

From "Blazing Transfer Student" to "Guts Squadron Gutsman" - a selection of inspiring quotes from the works of Kazuhiko Shimamoto, the "Master of Flames"! 

At the end of the book, there is an INDEX to answer all the problems that arise in life!

The bible of the soul that the times demanded is finally here!

title: Tadashii Furyo No Hajimekata
description: 柊冴月は学年1位の優等生。勉強はできるが人間関係は苦手… 校庭で教師に追われているのは不良で通る、正宗先輩。 ある日、柊は廃部した映研の部室管理を任される。 その部室を占拠していたのは、正宗先輩の問題児グループ！！ 麻雀で勝たなければ帰さないと挑発され、勝負することに 自分勝手な正宗先輩に強引に部員にされてしまい… 天才少女が部活を守るため…「不良」はじめます！

title: SEVEN
description:
A cute girl Xia Li got involved in endless supernatural incidents but she was rescued by a popular young man Li Youjun.
Was it for love or just because Xia Li was his destiny?
It was a love story starting from Big Band till today.
It was a curse triggered during Tang Dynasty.
It was a love between an immortal and a mortal…

title: Super Sabu
description:
(from ebookjapan):

A small sub from Kyushu with excellent soccer sense. The middle sub is a bluff soccer kid from Tokyo. A thread of fate pulls the three subs together! The middle sub has longed to join the prestigious Toukyou Gakuen High School soccer club, and while the small sub has been passed over for a regular spot, the older players are giving him a hard time... 

The first part of a coming-of-age soccer manga by the manga world's soccer fanatic, Mikiya Mochizuki!!

title: Boku dake ga Shitte Iru
description: Reichi Natsume, a boy who has been special since childhood, is placed in a class full of unique individuals. Reichi is troubled and perplexed by his lively new class. The spring of his fourth year has begun, changing him!

title: Shiina Karuho Renai Joshi Tanpenshuu
description: This collection vividly depicts the lives of adolescent girls and boys who are troubled, confused, and perplexed, but continue moving forward.

title: Oshi to no Riakoi Jirai desu
description:
Tenma, who is recognized by everyone as a perfectly handsome man, proposes to Amane, a member of his fan club, on a date, but is rejected.
The reason is "because he's my oshi." Huh? Doesn't "oshi" mean "to like" something?
Unable to accept this, Tenma devises a plan (a charade) to get Amane to notice him.

title: Dragon's Flag
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Blue skies, white waves, uninhabited islands. Ryoma Mori is a boy who dreams of leading the world's largest fleet of boats on an endless adventure across the seven seas. 

When Ryoma is welcomed by all the teachers and students at his new school, he is immediately confronted by a group of bancho. What is the meaning of the Dragon Flag that Ryoma, a sergeant of the Mori family, a large Brazilian conglomerate, holds dear?

title: Hatsukoi Akira Metainoni Maho No Yubiwa Ga Hazuremasen!
description:
初恋の呪いはエッチな魔法で解除!?
「責任取って、ミカが私と初夜を過ごすのはどう…かな…」エリート魔法学生・イリスはかつて、年上の幼馴染・ミカと高難度魔法で「永遠の愛」を誓った仲。幼い頃から、優しくて頼りになるミカに片思いし続けるイリスの指には“リスモワールの指輪”という婚約の証が残っているけど、学園の教師になったミカの手に指輪は見つからない…。そんな時、「一ヶ月以内に誰かと初夜を過ごさないと、一生誰のことも好きにならなくなり、恋心すら失う」という、エッチすぎる“メナージュの魔法”に掛かってしまったイリスは!?初恋魔と初恋と呪いのファンタジック魔法学園ラブ！

title: Ore No Koto Do Omottenno
description: 生活力皆無の女子高生・せわの秘密は、学校一モテる高杉理人と幼なじみで――しかも彼に毎日お世話してもらっていること！　見た目はコワいけど、実は家事万能な理人を「お母さんみたいな人」だと思っているせわに対して理人のほうは…？

title: Kokurekishi Club
description: A young girl's secret desires are the refinement of a lady. Erena Arisawa, a dreamy second-year middle school student, was once again lost in her fantasies today. With her translucent blonde hair, long eyelashes, and blue eyes, she was deeply infatuated with her imaginary prince, Vincent. One day, she meets a classmate named Tomoe Saku, who is called “Prince.” When the dreamy, trend-following girl meets prince, a chaotic school life filled with fantasies and imagination begins!

title: Love and Gewalt
description:
April 1968. Student movements continued to spread around the world, and
even in Japan, a storm was raging, centering on universities. Hiroshi Togi, a naive young man who came to Tokyo from Sendai
as a trump card for the right-wing student activity unit, fulfills a fateful encounter on a chaotic campus where left-wing and right-wing students are jumbled together . Michiko Hojo, a lovely woman who grows plants on a run-down university campus. Hiroshi begins to become attracted to her, but she is also secretly acting as a left-wing secret weapon. In a turbulent era, the drama of love and revolution begins!

title: Oshikatsu ~Hatsukoi wa Saioshi to~
description:
BL-loving first-year high school student Nono Haisaki is in love with her classmate Saku Ikurumi, a guy with handsome face and a strong sense of humor. At first, Saku is a little annoyed with Nono for stalking him, but...?!

This is a love story set in an high school about a good looking guy and a fujoshi girl who are in love with each other!

title: Banana School
description:
Since birth, bananas are always with Nana because her family is running a banana business. Even her name has "banana" in it.  
Nana is forced to transfer schools…and it happens that her her new school is named "Banana". There, Nana meets a tall and beautiful "girl" who always treats her nicely. To Nana's suprise, this "girl" is actually a guy….?!!!

title: Soda Sodaa!
description: A big incident occurs in "Paradise Class" Class 1! The class idol "En-chan" is in love! When Mirai and the other students find out that she is in love with an otaku named "Ane-kun," they get very nosy. But, the class is about to be in turmoil!

title: Silhouette of the Stars' Pupil
description: One of Kasumi’s close friends, Mariko, has fallen in love with Satoshi – an old friend of Kasumi’s that she’s not really all that close to anymore. Kasumi wants to support her friend and is helping her, but she’s beginning to realize that she likes Satoshi too, and even worse that Satoshi might also like her…

title: 19XX Kageki Ha
description: Yae Iyoda is left by a man whom she did everything for, and he asks Tsuchiya and Nakajo, members of the ``19XX Radicals'', a social reform group, to take revenge on her. However, because she happened to know Tsuchiya's real job, she became a member of the "19XX extremists"...?

title: Munou Ryoku no Watashi ga Jiki Toushu no Tsugai ni Narimashita
description: Momose Riko was born into a branch family of individuals with special abilities. However, during the judgment ceremony, she was deemed powerless and endured mistreatment from her parents and her talented younger sister. Later, she awakens her abilities but chooses to hide them, wishing to live a quiet life. At 17, during her spring semester, her homeroom teacher, Ren Ichijo, the next heir of a clan that governs ability users discovers her secret. Intrigued, Ren begins to approach her abruptly, but...

title: Moeko to Hatake to Otera Gohan
description:
Wakairo Moeko, was awakened to the importance of "effort" when she was in junior high school by the words of her admired senior, Amano. Having become a "person of hard work," Moeko continues to work hard even now, five years into her career, until one day she learns that Amano has quit his job. This triggers Moeko's sudden loss of energy and ill health. While taking a day off from work to help her grandfather in the fields, she meets her classmate, Hodaka, the son of a temple priest, for the first time in a long time... The breath of vegetables soothes Moeko's body and mind.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Kao to Koe no Ii Senpai ni Kawaretemasu.
description:
「――残念だなあ みちか。お前の弱みはもうわかってんの」

声フェチのみちかは、イケボなドS生徒会長の声にやられっぱなし。みちかがその声に逆らえないことを知っていて、会長は「彼女役をしろ」と言ってきて…！？ものすごく自分勝手なのに、DNAレベルで逆らえない！！

title: Aoharu Infight
description: This puppy-dog-like younger boxer is so, so, so naughty!!! After a heartbreak, a love story begins where she's left with no escape and is relentlessly pursued!

title: Rinne No Miko Toki Okoe, Ogami Sama Karachoaisareru
description:
月影瑞穂はその地で、苦難の日々を送っていた。
8歳の時に父親を亡くし、翌年には母親が失踪。
引き取り先の叔母からは虐げられ、従兄弟からは虐待を受け…
すべてに絶望した瑞穂は、ついに家を飛び出す。
そんな彼女の前に現れたのは謎の青年、蒼介。

「これからは俺がアンタを護る　アンタは輪廻の巫女だから」

蒼介は瑞穂に、彼女が守護神・煌狼アカツキの巫女の霊力を継ぐ、特別な存在であることを明かす。
そして自分は瑞穂と「ツガイ」になる存在だと告げ──？

title: Space Operation 1
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Published under the name Akira Matsumoto, this masterpiece full of dreams, adventure, and romance ushered in the SF boom of the 1950s.

 It is the prototype for the heroes and heroines who later appeared in works such as "Galaxy Express 999" and "Space Battleship Yamato".

title: Amarini Amakute Aragaenai
description:
「バラされたくなかったら――俺の彼女になれ」

巻き髪に目立つメイク、短いスカート――その見た目から「遊んでる」と噂される小夏は、実は恋に不器用な純粋すぎる女の子。失恋した幼なじみへの恋心も、誰にも知られず胸の奥にしまっておこう…そう思っていた。しかしある日突然、校内イチのイケメンで不良と噂される爽にその気持ちがバレてしまう。秘密を隠す代わりに爽が突き付けた交換条件は――「彼女になること」で…？

title: Dun-dun Rascal
description:
(from ebookjapan):

"My name is Tagosaku Saotome. I transferred to Class B of the first year at Jonan Junior High School. So, as soon as I transferred, I was noticed by the head watchdog. I'm going to do what I'm good at!" 

"Let's play!"

title: 30 Halaman Mencari Cinta
description:
Saga and his friends are back in 30 Pages in Search of Love!
When Saga falls in love, but the story that starts out sweet, ends up heartbroken...?! How will Saga fight for her love? Move on or move off?

(Source: M&C Comics, translated)

title: Heart-Pounding Jin
description: Jin Tomari, a first-year high school student on the track and field team, and Seiko Moriyama, who is also on the same track and field team, thought they were just friends. When she learns that Jin's best friend, Seko, has confessed her feelings to Seiko, she feels for the first time that she is not just her friend, but a woman. Although Seiko is worried about her relationship with Jin, she decides to go out with Seko...!!

title: Daisukina Konyakusha-Sama Mo Owakare Shima Sho
description: 【素直になれないヒロイン×魅了魔法にかかって溺愛が止まらないヒーローのすれ違いラブロマンス】公爵令嬢のエルヴィアナはある事件をきっかけに"魅了魔法の呪い"にかかり、意図せず男性を虜にする体質になってしまう。大好きな婚約者であるクラウスにその事実を言えず、ふたりの関係は悪化。"もう一度あなたに「大好き」って言ってほしい―…" そんな複雑な思いを抱えるエルヴィアナに、クラウスと仲の良い王女様が「クラウス様 あなたのことお嫌いですって」と告げてきたことで、これ以上迷惑をかけるならばと彼との別れを決意する。しかし、婚約解消寸前で魅了魔法が発動。クラウスが盲目的に迫ってくるようになってしまい―…！？

title: Makotoni Katte Nagara Osasete Itadakimasu
description:
周りが"推し活"を楽しむ中、いまいち"推し"という言葉にピンとこず、引け目を感じている高校生のちひろ。自分は推すことに向いていないのかも、と過ごしていたところ、隣のまりさんに息子さんの家政婦を頼まれる。仕事に向かうとそこにいたのは・・・友人たちが推していた大人気ゲーム実況者・千両 3 号である那須彰人！！
オラオラ系で人気を博していたはずだが、実際に目の前にいた彼は、今にも泣き出しそうで・・・！？
しかも、なぜかちひろの心がきゅんきゅんし出して・・・！？
実は××な大人気ゲーム実況者×超お世話好き女子高校生のだめきゅんラブ！！

title: Akarui Kazoku Keikaku
description: A cute story about Honoka and the guys she has to live with (a pair of twins in kindergarten, a junior high student, a high school student, a college student) as well as the other guys she meets in school. Honoka is generally a sweet, naive girl which draws an assortment of guys who instinctively want to protect her and maybe become her boyfriend…

title: Passion Girls
description:
High-school models Sakurai Erika and Tsukioka Hazumi are true princesses brimming with confidence who know no fear. As such, they're rivals who fight everyday... One day, after her return from Paris, Erika witnesses Hazumi hugging the current top male model Kai...! Could she have finally found Hazumi's greatest weak spot!?

(from mangaupdates)

title: Moongazer
description:
Kaguya, the protagonist of "Moongazer," is a striking beauty, but behind her back she is referred to as a "doll" due to her lack of emotional stability. She has a twin brother, Kosumi, who is a successful ballet dancer, and has decided to go overseas to meet him after graduating from high school. When her parents remarried, Gyoji became Kaguya's stepbrother, but he doesn't believe that she wants to go abroad and is worried about her. This is the story of a girl who has suppressed her feelings in despair about her future, and the 10 men who surround her.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Replay
description: Karam's new teacher, Mr. Lee, is also her mother's new boarder. Why does he seem so interested in Karam, and why does she feel some strange connection to him? This is a story of past and present lives, love, jealousy, sacrifice, and salvation.

title: Nakadori Diary
description:
"A new family, a new community, and that guy I wanted to forget..."

21-year-old Chie Monono lives at home and works at her family's orchard. Today, Haru, a third-grader left behind by the Monono's eldest daughter (Chie's older sister), arrives at the Monono household! Having lost both her father and her mother, Haru's only selfish wish is to continue playing baseball. Unable to find a reason to refuse, Chie "promises" without hesitation, but this opportunity will change her life forever!

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)

title: Kuroko no Basket - Mae no Seki no Kimi (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Yoi Wo Matsu Tsuki No Monogatari
description:
The town where high school student Yohana Sakaki lives is dominated by the Yashiro family, a family of Shinto priests who exterminate evil spirits. Having lost her parents and living with her grandmother, Yohana is summoned to a banquet held at the Yashiro family's estate at her grandmother's request, which leads her to meet a mysteriously beautiful boy, Chitose...!?

With the awakening of a new power and an encounter with a boy, the lonely girl enters a world of the supernatural.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hoshikuzu Paradise
description: After his mother passes away, high school student Hiroshi Houshou's long lost father suddenly reappears, with two new family members: a new mother who is also a famous actress, and her daughter, the popular and beautiful idol singer Rina Yuuki.

title: Two Brothers, One Sister
description: It’s tough to make friends when you’re the sheltered youngest child of a business mogul, but Kay isn’t about to let that stop her! After her strict upbringing with her brothers Jarod and Sebastian, the three find themselves on the bridge between childhood and adulthood. New experiences and people begin to enter their lives, and the bond that they’ve shared with each other–and only each other–will be tested to its limit.

title: Datte Sensei Dakara
description: 好きだからチューするんだよ？ 「素直になれない女教師」×「愛にまっすぐな生徒」×「考えが読めない男教師」＝波乱続きの大恋愛!?   小学校の教師をしている桜子は、同僚で同期の体育教師・田中に恋心を寄せていた。女性らしさを出すのが苦手で田中へのアプローチは上手くいかずにいたが、一方で担当しているクラスの生徒・明智からは好意を寄せられている様子。そんな明智から「田中先生の好きな人知ってる」と言われた後いきなりキスされて…!?

title: Supreme Pride
description: The beautiful girl who used the software ps for ordinary teenagers to come true, not only became his girlfriend, but also learned that he has the magical ability of "lie" to "real". Huang Yan's chaotic life has officially begun!

title: Omoi Karamari, Itsuka Kimi to.
description:
Musubu Shiomi is a 2nd year junior high student with an ordinary life. At the seniors' graduation ceremony, she is approached by "Shizu-chan," her senpai and former childhood friend, who asks her to take a picture for him. "I'm going to Kitakou School...” ”I'll go to Kitakou too!" 

Musubu is able to fulfill her promise made a year ago and successfully enrolls in the same high school as Shizu-chan, however....

title: It's Tough! Boku-chan
description: A lively youth comedy.

title: Gohoubi wa, Baito no Ato de ~Amemiya-kun Chi de Kajidaikou Hajimemashita~
description: BL漫画が大好きな女子高生、結乃。漫画を買うために家事が得意なことを活かして、仲良しなお隣さんちで家事代行バイトをすることに！早速バイト先の家に向かうと、出てきたのはクールな国宝級イケメンクラスメイトの雨宮仁で……！？お隣さんの弟が雨宮くんだと知り、動揺しつつも一生懸命仕事をする結乃。でも手が触れてしまったり、ひょんなことからお泊まりになってしまったりとふたりきりの密室バイトは、ドキドキの連続で……？

title: Harris's Wind
description:
(from ebookjapan):
He hates school. He spends his days fighting and gluttonously eating, and all the neighborhood kids are his henchmen! His name is Ishida Kunimatsu! One day, an old man claiming to be the headmaster of the prestigious Harris School suddenly appears to Kunimatsu, who has been misbehaving constantly, and asks him to enroll in the school. Kunimatsu reluctantly agreed to attend the school without knowing the reason why. Kunimatsu reluctantly enrolls in the school, but is met with a crowd of strong men. Kunimatsu is invited by several sports clubs and joins them all in exchange for a good lunch box....

title: September Poppy
description:
A collection of three love stories: Haru wa Yayoi, Ame no Nioi no suru Machi, 9Gatsu no Poppy.

Poppy, who has her childhood first love in her heart, begins to be attracted to the playboy of a new teacher, Rainie. Beginning with the title work depicting the first love of an innocent girl, a high school girl's admiration for a senpai, and a smart boy's first love, it is a romantic drama filled with the eternal admiration of girls around the world.

title: When We Were Fifteen
description: The first year of high school! Nana, who has had trouble making friends in the past, meets new friends at school. Instantly, Nana's lonely days are filled with stories of friendship that are both sweet and complicated.

title: Pure Koi Begins
description:
Aki broke up with his first girlfriend, Yume, just before they had their first sexual experience. After that, they both started dating different people, but it seems that Yume's current boyfriend is married...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: It's Love
description: When the orphaned Sera was taken in by the Lady of the Choi household, her dreams of having a family were fulfilled. However, Sera found herself rejected by the Lady's three handsome sons, and it was made very clear to her that she was nothing more than an orphan who would would never become part of their family. At 16, Sera still finds herself bullied by the three brothers, and soon it becomes evident that there is more than just her background that makes the boys reluctant to officially adopt her into the family.

title: Terepari Kiss
description: My name is Akari Mochizuki. I am a ninth grader, and in love with Wataru-kun, a member of the soccer club. He is very popular among girls, though he is quiet and even blunt. One day the ball he kicked hit me, and I've got a special power to be able to understand how a boy who kisses me feels.

title: Kimi e Okuru Uta.
description:
A young man searches for his wife's reincarnation in the present day, relying on his memories of his past life. A slightly mysterious love story.

**Award:** Won the March 2023 Bronze Rookie Award, earning publication on Jump+.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Jump Rookie!](https://rookie.shonenjump.com/series/pGBIkZltfSI)

title: Yan Onna Wa Ryu No Yume Omiru
description: 超バズ人気の「たまごキャラ漫画」を投稿する女子高生ユメコの夢は、ステゴロ最強にして暴ヤン魂バリバリの超絶ヤンキー漫画を描く事…。だけど送れど送れど新人賞じゃ落選ばかり…。そんな折、ダブリのパイセン・宮元竜次と関わった事から、クソ熱きヤンキー漫画街道をキュートにホットに驀進するのでありました…。

title: Kiss no Ato made Oshiete Ageru
description: ある日クラスメイトである八千代くんの首筋にキスマークを発見した蓮。大人っぽくて物静かな八千代くんの意外な一面が気になって仕方ない蓮は、2人きりになったタイミングで思わず真相を聞いてしまう。すると八千代くんの様子が豹変！？初めて見る八千代くんは不用意に近づいてはいけないようなどこかキケンな雰囲気を醸していて――…。

title: Haru Koi Reset
description:
Sakuto Somei is a third-year middle school student. She likes her classmate, Yoh, but she can only watch him from afar... But she plans to confess her feelings after the graduation ceremony! ...But then she gets into an accident and is transported back to the world of one year ago!? A time-traveling love story that happens on the last day of middle school!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Gertrude no Recipe
description:
Sahara is a normal high-school girl whose life is turned upside down when she meets "Gertrude," a 100-year-old demon who looks like a teenaged boy. Gertrude is a man-made demon, constructed from the parts of various other demons and brought to life through a "recipe" from an ancient spellbook.

(from mangaupdates)

title: Peppermint Age
description: An Segawa is in her third year of junior high school. Since their first encounter in the second year of junior high school, An has been in a bad relationship with Sho Hayami, who is always there for her, even though she is a clumsy and good-natured girl. However, Sho suddenly transfers schools without telling An. An enrolls in the high school where he lives with the sole intention of meeting him, and they have a dramatic reunion...

title: Atama ga xxx de Ippai desu!!
description:
Ikkyuu-chan, the daughter of a temple priest, has a problem. Lately, her mind has been filled with sexual curiosity! She even has lewd fantasies about her innocent boyfriend, Satori-kun, and it's confusing to her...? A comedy about a middle school couple and sex education, where you can learn about the mysteries of the male body, sexual consent, and more in a fun way!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Notes:
- Includes 15 extra chapters.
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

title: The Friendly and Vague Harmony
description: Our high school is co-ed, but forget about any interaction. The two gender camps aren't talking to each other. This is what Battle of the Sexes looks like in Hwa Mok High School!

title: Katatsumuri Zensen
description:
High-school student Wakamori Asako has always been watching Sakura from the athletic department after she comes home from school. One day, however, Asako comes across a snail... who can talk! The snail is actually her schoolmate Kajiwara Atsushi, an omnipotent athlete with excellent grades whom the girls treat like a celebrity. However, stress causes Atsushi to turn into a snail. Asako becomes a "snail helper" to aid Atsushi while he is in this form, but she might cause Sakura to misunderstand...

(from mangaupdates)

title: Kakugoshite Yo Ne, Senpai?
description: Chiharu Ayase, the manager of the basketball club, was looking forward to a new student joining the club. The one who joins the childhood friend she hasn't seen in a long time has become a somewhat more flirting boy.

title: 100-banme no Hitsuji
description: A heart-throbbing youth story about Naomi, a high school girl who lives in a convent and grows up little by little while worrying about love, family, and the future.

title: Shoko's Etude
description:
(from ebookjapan):
One day, Shoko suddenly lost her parents in a car accident... Left all alone, Shoko was taken in by the Kirishima family, but for some reason, Kaoru, the eldest son of the Kirishima family, was especially harsh with her...

title: Natural Beauty.
description: Futami is an average girl in her school who isn't too special in any way. Even though this is so, she attracts very dynamic and popular people to her side. Friends with the two most popular girls at school, Futami thinks it's weird that they enjoy hanging around her so much. She thinks it's even weirder when the class prince starts to take notice of her too.

title: Come Back Home
description:
1. Talent  
"Do what you do best!"  
They met by coincidence, a school girl and a delinquent. While she works hard to obtain her dream, will he find a way to use his talent?  
  
2. Bride  
"His name is Bride, a gifted musician. They say he became music's bride because of his immense love toward it. He has never loved anything else other than music. And every concert is a wedding. At the end he throws his guitar toward the audience. Whoever catches the guitar becomes a guitarist as well. The guitar Bride throws, they call it the bouquet."  
So when I catch his guitar, will I become a guitarist?  
  
3. Trick  
  
4. Sky  
  
5. Idem  
A delinquent with a fiery temper and a beautiful girl have known each other for years. While entering high school will their love withstand the problems ahead?

title: Chihiro-Kun To Shitai Koto.
description:
「俺　彼女以外に興味ないんで」
高１のあるみには悩みがある。それは完璧すぎる彼氏の千尋が好きすぎること。イケメンでモテモテな彼がなぜ平凡な自分と付き合ってくれているのか不安でしょうがないあるみだけど、千尋はあるみにだけ優しく甘々で…？
クールだけどあるみのことが好きすぎる千尋の、甘い独占欲が止まらない!!　”したいコト”がいっぱいな２人のじれ甘ラブ!!

title: Yumeiro Cooking
description:
Serika Goto is a sweet girl whose expertise is cooking. She often uses her delicious cooking to help her friends. An offer of good cooking can seal the love between a couple. Serika helps her friend so much that her own love life suffers as a result. But no matter! In each chapter Serika cooks up a new dish for us to admire. At the end of each book, there are recipes for the dishes covered in the story. It's presented by Semansa, a cute looking cat that is the mascot of this manga.

source: mangaupdates

title: Unbalanced Relationship
description: "Please, keep it a secret." Yuri, the main character who is not good at dealing with people, unexpectedly has a relationship with Chikuma, the most popular boy in school. What is the secret exchanged between the two that cannot be told to others? A very popular heart-pounding school story

title: A Destined Meeting
description: Everyone will meet the one who he/she's fascinated about in his/her best years. And I believe that I'm bound to meet you. In school, the person I like is a legendary genius painter. I had been deeply fascinated by him in a small exhibition. Since then, I have been trying to follow his footsteps, and want to be the only one around him.

title: Futari Wa Kari Tomo
description:
Chie Suzuki, who gave up on making friends back in elementary school, has spent her school life as a solitary "cool beauty," content in her own little world. 

However, her current concern is the "character overlap" between herself and Satou, the "Prince of Ice"—a handsome, top-performing student who remains expressionless and distant. Frankly, she finds him a nuisance. But one day, Satou unexpectedly asks her, "Will you be my friend?"

As it turns out, behind his icy exterior, Satou is just a pure-hearted boy who struggles to connect with others and make friends. At first, Chie refuses his request, believing that you need a particular type skill to be able to make “friends," something she believes she lacks the aptitude for.  But then Satou proposes, "How about we try being (temporary) friends, since neither of us really gets it?"

And so begins their tentative experiment in friendship!

(Source: MangaMee, edited)

title: Oh! Our Poor Student Council
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Mayumi Aida, who made her debut with "Happy End Story," continued to draw works under the title of "Love Catch Story" and created a comical happy story of youth with "Oh! This is the first collection of four works, including the first part of the "Lesser Student Council" series!

title: B.B. Paradise
description: Tsubasa Nonomiya transfered to a new school because she wanted to be the manager of the boy's basketball team. When asked, she claims to hate basketball. So why did she transfer schools? The answer: Takaya Misaki. Who happens to be on the school's soccer team, not on the basketball team. What's going on!?

title: Study
description:
Contains one main story, and a few oneshots.  
Story 1 - A girl who has always put studying as her main focus in life, now finds she wants a boyfriend. But will her high scores make the guy she likes feel inferior…? And this guy seems to be the ex-boyfriend of the most popular girl at school! Is he really a player…?!

title: ASB
description:
Makoto Minami, a first-year student at Chuo High School who works as a scullery maid for the student council, is entrusted with a sacred sword that has been handed down at the school for generations, and Minami learns the truth behind the town...the threads of fate are intricately entwined, and the battle over the targeted seals is fierce!

(google translated)

title: Do Your Best, Transfer Student!
description: The transfer student Kosaku falls in love with Sanae, who is an expert at piano.

title: I'll Be the Wife!
description:
"(from ebookjapan):

Ayuko is surprised when the handsome, smart, and kind Reiji presses her for a kiss. One day, Yuri, a male high school senior who claims to be a relative of Ayuko's, suddenly visits her. He is from a family with nine elder siblings, eight of whom are all sisters. 

Reiji is jealous and angry at Yuri for living with him. The gossipy members of the newspaper club notice the reason for his living together with Yuri, who behaves in a feminine manner due to the influence of his sisters.... 

In addition to "I'll Be Your Bride! Wedding Dress", "Confess! Monkey Rock", and "Laughing Lover" are also included.

title: Unubore Danshi to no Koi wa Wazawai no Gen
description:
Haruki enrolls in a university in Tokyo as a special student in order to help her poor family. She has no interest in anything other than her studies, and love is a complete no-no for her! But then Eiomi, a handsome, rich, self-satisfied boy, catches her eye...!

A campus love story that will not stop!

title: Magic Star Academy
description: The animal that Mori received at Magic Star Academy, a vocational school for wizard training, was... a caterpillar! ? A magical gag comedy filled with love, magic, and animals

title: Hatsukoi To Cider
description:
先輩の「頑張れ」に救われたあの日から、
私の初恋は走り出したんだ。

陸上一筋の主人公・桃は、中学３年 最後の陸上大会前に背中を押してくれた“瀬戸先輩”に初恋する。高校に進学して、先輩が同じ学校に通う２年生だったという運命にときめくものの、たった「１学年の差」が遠くて、ひっそりと憧れるしかない日々を送っていた。
そんなとき、風に誘われるように向かった学校の屋上で、瀬戸先輩と２人っきりの再会を果たす。
ただ遠くから眺めているだけで満足だったはずなのに、
走り出した初恋はもう止められない――追い駆けるのは私の「得意種目」だ。

ピュアでまっすぐ、努力上等！な主人公の、
一生忘れられない初恋が今、はじまる…!!

title: #Bug tte Kyuru Kyuru
description:
Lala is a popular influencer searching for her very own prince charming. She accepts everyone who comes along and dates them, but they never last more than two weeks, and after her 32nd heartbreak, she finally hits rock bottom. She begs her apartment neighbor and only friend, Wataru, for help, but he abandons her. Panicked, Lala decides to join a certain club after receiving a direct message on social media, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Long and Short Summer
description:
Secret, free, peaceful, and then...

After the death of his grandparents, middle school teacher Yukino got rid of all the things in his room.
However, one by one, new items begin to appear in the empty room without him realizing it.
Who is there and for what purpose? When Yukino, who is suspicious, appears before him...?

"Would you let me stay here?"
After meeting this mysterious woman, Yukino realizes something he had forgotten...

A delicate and gentle summer human drama that vividly depicts the human heart begins!!

title: The Day I Met The Wind ~ Short Story Collection With Debut Work and Other Stories ~
description:
(from ebookjapan):
A collection of Nami Saso's early works. The title story is "The Day I Met the Wind," a story about a younger sister who loses her brother at an early age, as the author says that the theme of "death of a child" was always present in the works she drew in her teens. In addition, "The Forest of Wild Roses" depicts a heart-to-heart between a high school boy who is straight in love for the first time and a girl who cannot believe in love, as well as various other stories from her debut and early years. Also included are newly drawn essay manga  related to the works! 

- **The Day I Met the Wind**
- **About *The Day I Met the Wind***
- **What Hiromi Heard**
- **I Was 17 Years Old.**
- **My Manga History**
- **The Forest of Wild Roses**
- **Greetings from Midsummer**
- **About *Greetings from  Midsummer***
- **Dangerous Strawberry Jam**
- **Pencil Drawing Afternoon**

title: Watashi wo Korosu Gitei wo Rourakushiyou to Omoi Masu
description:
After clashing with her stepbrother Filio over the throne, Lea is executed by Filio's hand - and when she wakes up, she finds herself reverted to being 15 years old! In order to avoid any conflict this time, Lea intends to win over her stepbrother and make him her ally, but instead she finds herself becoming obsessed with Filio, wanting to have her stepbrother all to herself.

He's supposed to be her cute stepbrother, but it seems there's more to him than just his sister complex that Lea doesn't know about...

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title: Hajimete no Otoko Tomodachi, Hajimete no XX
description:
Even if she didn't have any friends in her class, she thought music was enough. Until she became "friends" with him... Ryou, a second-year high school student, was born with a mean look in her eyes, has trouble talking to people, and tends to be unsociable. Because of this, people around her often fear her, earning her the nickname "Iron Mask" in middle school. Even after class changes this year, she hasn't been able to make any friends, and she feels depressed every day. Then one day, when Umemori, the most outgoing student in her class, approaches her, her lonely daily life begins to change into a bittersweet school life...!?

Her first male friend, her first feelings, her first love... A pure love story filled with many firsts between a girl in a band and a outgoing boy with a secret!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Hamarase Danshi ni Zubuzubu desu
description:
The person I fell in love with is a very mysterious guy! Segawa, the charming and popular senior at my part-time job. I used to think he was a dangerous person I should stay away from, but our shared love for "Anmitsu" revealed an unexpected and unknown side of him...? Now, I can't pull away from him! It’s a pure and sweet love story, so sweet it makes me dizzy.

A touching romantic series!

title: Oshietekudasai! Shirasu-kun
description:
Kohinata Nobara, a wealthy young lady, transfers to a high school near her home to become independent and live a new life! Everything outside is new and exciting! Her new school is full of the delinquents she's heard about...?!?!? On her first day at school, she's harassed by delinquents, but an even more flashy boy comes to her rescue...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: I Accept You
description:
Yee Su-yoon is a high school student who has everything going for him – top of his class, top fighter and a Barbie-like girlfriend named Kang Ha-eun.  
But why does he mistreat his girlfriend and seem to always protect a girl named Chae Shin-hee?

title: The Sound of Snow
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Polly Brown, who has no self-confidence in her own appearance, has spent her life as an even more timid college girl because of a broken heart when she was 16 years old. 

Then Kilmenyi approached Polly for some advice. She asked Polly to substitute for her fiancé, Bert, during her own trip because she and Polly have a very similar speaking voice. 

Bert has lost his sight in an accident, so he doesn't even recognize the understudy.... Soon Polly and Bert's strange days begin... 

In addition to "The Sound of Snow," in which an unexpected turn of events unfolds, "A Snowy Day" is also included.

title: Hottokenai yo Kujou-kun
description: Class committee member Kujo-kun looks like an honor student, but in fact he is a super clumsy person! I'm the only one in the whole school who realizes this fact...?　I have to support Kujo-kun from the shadows so that he doesn't find out how clumsy he is!

title: Mary ♥ Lou
description:
(from ebookjapan):
"Who is your true partner?What is the love turmoil between two beautiful sisters....?!" Fifteen-year-old Mary Lou is worried that her older sister, Laura, is too popular, and their house is a ruckus. One day, however, she sees George, a man standing in front of their house, and discovers the troubles of being in love... A must-read masterpiece of American romance manga that keeps on shining!

Also contains "The Road of Apple Trees".

title: Otogi no En no Snow White
description:
王子様は自分でつかみ取れ！ 狂った学園で戦う女の子のおとぎ話

猪突猛進な白雪は、幼いころに引き離された初恋相手 一心との約束のため「強く」「正しく」「美しく」をモットーとする御伽学園に入学することに。 だけど再会した一心は手の届かない人になっていて――！？

title: 2x8 Song!
description: School will bring a fresh start and a way to break free from her seemingly cursed fate. Disaster strikes before she even arrives for her first day at school and a most embarrassing secret is discovered by Chun Hyuk, an aspiring band vocalist who loves only money and music. Can Yu Goon Goon and her best friend, Da-Jung, find a way to shut the mouths of Chun Hyuk and his fellow band members before her high school life is ruined? Da Jung wants to make a deal with the guys but how high a price are the girls willing to pay?

title: My Crazy Buddy
description:
Hitomi, who lost her beloved mother, is suddenly kidnapped on her way to school one day.  
There, she meets Kurosaki, one of the kidnappers, who reveals a part of the truth behind her mother's death...Why did her mother kill herself? Why was Hitomi kidnapped? Are the two incidents connected? And who is the culprit?!

A high school girl and an underworld gangster...A love suspense story between two people who should never have crossed paths begins!

title: Toaru Neko Kaburi Shounen no Himitsu
description: Suzuno is the president of the Student Council and as an obligation of her position she has set herself the goal of discovering the face of Natsume, a lonely boy who always wears a mask, as this is against the school rules. What face is hidden under that mask? If he were a handsome boy, he wouldn't hide his face, would he?

title: Rumi-chan's Classroom
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Rumi lives with her brother in a shabby apartment. Although she is not rich, she lives a very happy and joyful life. 

Even though she has not yet started school, she follows her older sister to the fourth grade classroom every day. This is a heartwarming story about the adorable Rumi and the people around her. 

This is a legendary rare work that is said to be the pinnacle of children's manga.

title: GIRL TASTE
description:
Introducing Girl's Taste! 
Starring Sakura, Hanako, Chloe, Kaori and Emiko!
And they are not just ordinary girls, but they are extraordinary, and talented girls!

title: Eoreuni
description:
Five childhood friends - Dabin, Jaeha, Taehyeon, Sehui, and Hanbin - make a promise to always stay friends, even after they become adults. Fast forward to the present, where they are now 24-year-olds facing pivotal moments in their journey into adulthood. 

As they face different challenges, the five friends try to carve out their own paths and figure out what they want for the future, lending each other a helping hand or offering a shoulder to cry on along the way. 

And amidst it all, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom where there was once only friendship…

title: Hana to Kurage to Rifurein
description: 幼少期、神隠しに遭った高校一年・科戸花風。神隠しを調査している謎の同級生・温森透悟。関わりがなかった二人は思いもしない出会いによってお互いの秘密を知ることに——。

title: Hoshikuzu Serenade: Hoshi no Hitomi no Silhouette Another Story
description: Yuzuki Setogawa, a new student at Northeastern University, meets a wonderful man on the day of her entrance ceremony: an astronomy professor, Satoshi Kusumi...this is a story of a new crush between the grown-up Kusumi and his students.

title: Go Sashuu Kudasai
description:
The assistant teacher that she hates turns out to be a fellow writer with whom she continued to create in a genre of her favorite game that has since been discontinued --!? Just as tensions begin to build between high school girl artist Kumai and high school teacher Shirokawa, a certain project is announced by the official website for the discontinued content...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Socho Sama, Dekiai Chunitsuki ～Saikyo Ikemen To Aisare Ryo Seikatsu !?～
description: 史上最悪の暴走族を一夜にして壊滅させた伝説の少女“サラ”こと高校2年生の白咲由姫（しらさきゆき）は、地味子に変装し全寮制の高校・西園寺学園に編入することに。そこにはお金持ちで超イケメンな不良男子がたくさん！遠距離恋愛中の彼氏・春季（はるき）に会えるのを楽しみにしていた由姫だったけど、ある手違いから校内一イケメンの総長・蓮（れん）と隣の部屋になったり、危険なクラスメイトと仲良くなったり……。校内のイケメンたちによる由姫をめぐる恋のバトル勃発！？イケメンだらけの胸キュン学園生活、スタート♥ （※野いちごジュニア文庫版『総長さま、溺愛中につき。』の設定を一部変更しております。）

title: Grand Tour - British Style Big Educational Journey
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Based on the Suntory Prize-award-winning book, this is the first manga serialized in JAL's in-flight magazine!　In the 18th century, the "Grand Tour" was popular among British aristocrats, who sent their children to the European continent for international education. With experienced tutors as chaperones and ample financial resources, the grand tours lasted from a year at the shortest to five or six years at times. From the start of the trip, they traveled through France and Italy until they returned home. The young man was greeted not only by high culture and traditions, but also by bad roads, cheap accommodations, swindlers, and prostitutes. A vivid portrayal of the customs of the time!

title: Rising!
description:
From the Ultimate Manga Guide:

Yuki Nishina has joined the prestigious Kyuen Music College only because she wants to learn ballroom dancing. Bewildered, she sets out on the path to the world of dramatic arts.

title: A Queen's Love
description: Marissa is admired by all of the men at Dawa University, including the popular Shin Shim-hae . However, her eyes are set on Lee Dae-sung, the only man who doesn't seem to care for her. Follow a tale of unrequited love as Risa tries to finally win Dae-seong's attention!

title: Kimi wa Shiranai I Love You
description:
Amane, a high school girl in the photography club. One day, she hears that her boyfriend, who goes to a different school, is hanging out with another girl. Curious and suspicious, she asks her junior club member to come along as a photographer so they can follow him.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Kono Koi, Neko Note Okarishimasu
description:
He is capricious, sometimes saying sweet things and other times being cold. With the help of her cat, she is finally going to conquer the boy who always teases her...

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

title: Unfriend
description: A "best friend" I only know online changes my boring, gray days!

title: Doukyo Ijou Doosei Miman
description: Rin happened to meet her favorite guy again. But it's a "family"...!? A must-read for girls who can't be honest!

title: Kindan Wa Ni Jusai Ni Natte Kara
description:
Hinako has lived a smooth sailing life. She became a teacher, which was her dream, but contrary to the expectations of those around her, her days were not going well. Feeling that her students were scary, she was feeling down alone in the park with no one to talk to, when a mysterious handsome 20-year-old man called out to her. For the first time, she was able to share her wounds and feel healed, but in fact, his true identity is...!?

A legal but forbidden love begins with this 20-year-old boyfriend...!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title: Persona 4 - Kimi nashi ja i rarenai (Doujinshi)
Shonen Ha Watashi Wo Hitorizime Shitagaru
description: 彼氏に振られ、仕事も伸び悩んでいる美遥（28）は、家の前で倒れていた17歳の少年・泉をしばらく家に置くことに。彼はかつて美遥が家庭教師をしていた時の教え子だった。かっこよく育った泉が「ぼくのお嫁さんになって」といきなり告白を！ 年下少年・泉に、美遥は翻弄されっぱなしで!?

title: Funky Cosmos
description: Akari Toshiba, a bright and energetic girl. One morning, when I was running trying to catch the train to school, I bumped into a scary student wearing a mask and sunglasses. After school that day, Akari, was called out by a group of delinquent students called "Tora no Ane Gang", went to the back of the gym while standing. However, what was waiting was not a sanction, but a confession of love from the "Major Bancho of the Shadow." It is said that Kageru Tsukiyomi, a gloomy boy who acts as the boss of the organization, fell in love at first glance at with the "cosmos-like" Akari. The two will go out as they are. However, the personalities of each other are so strong that it is difficult for ordinary male and female dating. In the end, to make a rare case because of the love...? Volume 1 (4 volumes in total), a humorous school comedy featuring positive Akari and negative Kageru!

title: Kare wa Charisma
description: 第1巻の内容紹介: 「お前は俺の〈運命の相手〉だ！」。その男・一晴生（にのまえ・はるを）の宣言によって、入学早々、珠実（たまみ）の波乱の日々が始まった！　たぐいまれな美声と圧倒的な存在感、加えて予知能力を持つ〈カリスマ〉ニノマエに、振り回され、殴られ、蹴られ……これは果たして愛のムチ!?　平穏を望む珠実の、明日はどっちだ!?　描きおろし新作『2 weeks coordinate』も同時収録。

title: 5 Go Ryu
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Ryu Komagata is a junior high school student who has a father who runs an outlandish betting Shogi parlor called "Serious Master" for a living. One day, Keisuke Torafura, a betting Shogi player who had turned his father's fate upside down, appears on the scene. 

In order to stop his father from challenging him to a fight that would plunge the family to the bottom again if he loses, Ryu challenges his father to a serious game of Shogi, a game he has always hated... 

This is a legendary Shogi manga that many professional players, including Zenji Hanyu, aspired to become professionals after reading this work!

title: Netemo Sametemo Dokusenshitai
description: 人の役に立つことが大好きなお節介女子高生・梓。ある日、母が海外に行くことになった関係で、知人の家に同居することに。しかしその家に住んでいたのは、学校で『王子様』と呼ばれる同級生の完璧イケメン・織原真琴だった！？学校で女子に騒がれることに疲れていた真琴は、梓に対して超不愛想な態度。でも下心ゼロで世話を焼こうとしてくる梓に、だんだん心を許していく。放課後ふたりきりですごす部屋の中、真琴は梓だけに甘い表情を見せてきて―？

title: Choumaru
description:
Volume1  
1) Choumaru  
Choumaru is a beautiful, smart, and arrogant playboy who dumps every girl he has unsatisfactory sex with. Currently he's living with Shina with whom he also has casual sex, but what he doesn't know is that his roommate wants more from him.  
  
2) Angel  
  
3) Rocker Motion  
  
4) May Be Blue  
  
5) The Cherry Blossoms Bloom  
  
Volume 2  
1-4) Scene 1, 2, 3, Last  
Continuation of Choumaru. Shina brings home a kid to look after while his photographer friend is away. However, there seems to be many after this child…  
  
5) Born

title: Naisho no Half Moon
description:
Yuu is a high school student and award-winning actress who has been cast in a movie called “Half Moon”, based on a best-selling novel about of a brother/sister duo who actually aren’t related by blood and have a romantic relationship. But she hates her counterpart in the film and is dreading the famous kiss scene…

(from mangaupdates)

title: Hime-sama, Jikyuu 800 Yen
description:
「土日は日給1.5万？名前貸すだけでもＯＫ？」（不良一味の「姫」なんて、今時、時代錯誤が過ぎるでしょ……頭下げられたってやりたくないけど）
「えっ、実績に応じて昇給……？」
ごく普通の女子高生、鳴海麗が紹介されたのはちょっと（かなり）怪しいアルバイト。不良グループの「姫」を演じて座っているだけでいい、という触れ込みだったのに、嘘吐きのイケメン不良たちは、今日も無茶苦茶言ってきます――!!

title: Kougyou Aika Volley Boys
description: The story follows the risque misadventures of three students named Akagi, Miyamoto, and Taniguchi — known by others as the Numa-Kō 3 Baka Trio ("The Asanuma Technical High School Idiot Trio"). The trio start a second volleyball team at their school in a misguided attempt to be popular.

title: Ponytail Hakusho
description:
This is a cute growing-up story about a girl named Yui who loves kendo and comes to terms with the realization that she is adopted.

(from mangaupdates)

title: It's Midnight, and I Can't Sleep
description:
Ever since she was little, Mizuru has had dreams in which a strange boy appears. One day, she is seized by panic when the same boy suddenly appears before her!

Volume 2 of Iisuka Yukako Masterpiece Collection

title: Renai Rookie
description:
From Rebellious Love:  
  
About a school who has an elite section and a regular section. These sections are always at war; however, for the next school festival, the leaders (matsuriya) from both sides want to work together to make it a good school festival.

title: In The Case of Cecil...!?
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Cecile, whose grandmother is the president of the prestigious St. Lily Academy and whose mother is the head of the school, hates men. The school has a strict no-men policy, and many of the students protested against the school culture. However, the boarding school, surrounded by high walls, is a safe and secure place for Cecile, who gets rashes at the mere sight of a man's picture. The wall separating the school from the neighboring boys' school, Barnard High School, is particularly high, sturdy, and reliable. However, for some reason, part of that wall has a hidden door...?  "Leave Love to the Wind!" and "Viva! Shinigami-san" are also included.

title: Konishi-San Wa Ikemen Ga Nigatenanoni
description: あかりはイケメンが苦手な高校1年生。入学早々イケメン・北川くんと隣の席になってしまう！でも北川くんは、目が合った瞬間急に変顔を始めて！？お笑い好きでふざけてばかりの北川くんは、今まで知っていた男の子とちょっと違うみたいで―…。

title: Love Energy Hyper Mimi!
description: Mimi Kurumi falls in love with Senpai Hayashida and when she tries to give him the letter she wrote over three days, Senpai Hayashida is kidnapped by a group of homosexuals...

title: First Love Story
description:
A collection of one-shots.

- **First Love Story** (初恋物語, Hatsukoi Monogatari)
- **Under This Sky** (この空の下に, Kono Sora no Shita ni) 
- **6:30 in the Morning** (朝は6時30分, Asa wa 6 Ji 30 Bun)
- **The Harmony of Friendship** (友情のハーモニー, Yuujou no Harmony)

title: Adult Practice
description:
"Would my friends have felt regret or envy as they watched me suddenly transfer to Seoul?"

Shinbi, a neighborhood resident who's lived in the same place for 17 years, is forced to leave her beloved neighborhood and move to Seoul when her older brother, Shinhye, transfers to a preparatory school. Leaving her familiar surroundings and encountering new people... 

Shinbi, who has never met anyone before, yearns for her old neighborhood. Will she be able to navigate this sudden shift in her mindset? 

A tumultuous coming-of-age story of high school students on the brink of adulthood!

title: Ochita Tsuki to Taiyou
description:
転校先で恋をしたのは、絶対好きになりたくない人で――
ほろ苦青春ドラマ、スタート――。

title: Shounen Bodyguard to Koisuru Ojou-sama
description:
少年ボディーガード×夢見る少女漫画大好きお嬢さまの同居ラブコメ!?

春子は少女漫画のような恋にあこがれる女の子。しかし、女子校育ちの彼女が共学へ通うには、父親から出された条件がひとつ「ボディーガードの少年をつけること」。

ところが春子を守るクールな美少年・美冬は春子の恋を応援するどころか邪魔してきて、さらには二人で一緒に住むことになって…？

title: Akuyaku Reijo To Yobareteiru Watakushi No Koto, Anata Honto wa Daisuki nano desho?
description:
わたくし、ブーシャルドン侯爵家の嫡子ノエルと申します。皆さまはわたくしのことを「悪役令嬢」とか呼んでいるようよ。それはさておき、幼馴染のアレクったらとっても優秀で、わたくしのことが大好きで仕方がないみたいなの。なのに最近なんだかそっけないのよ。やっぱりわたくしが美しすぎるから、照れているのかしら。ねえ？
コッテコテの最強悪役令嬢と腹黒幼馴染の異世界ハイテンションラブコメディ☆

title: Haruhara-kun wa Tachitakunai no ni
description: Haruhara, appears before Ichigo, who hates men due to the trauma of being cheated on by her ex-boyfriend! Haruhara confesses his love to Ichigo...?!

title: Legendary Kang Do-Young
description: There was a Legend about a guy named Kang Do-Young. He was perfect, great at sports, rich and good at fighting. Na Mirae was a girl who was in a leader of a club called ‘Pink Lady’ and who also wants to be Jiang of her whole school. For Do-Young, it was love at first site while for Mirae, it wasn’t.

title: Season in the Pocket
description:
An anthology of one-shots from Kimura. Includes:
Vol 1:
- **Gift** (贈り物, Okurimono) - *Bessatsu Shojo Comic* (BetsuComi), October 1974
- **Invisible Autumn** (見えない秋, Mienai Aki) - *BetsuComi*, November 1974
- **The Rape Blossom** (菜の花, Nanohana) - *BetsuComi*, January 1975
- **Sick Day** (病気の日, Byouki no Hi) - *Ribon Comic*, August 1970
- **To the Sea** (海へ, Umi e, alt: 海へ..., Umi e..., To the Sea...) - *Ribon Comic*, September 1970
- **Carnival** (カルナバル) - *Ribon Comic*, October 1970
- **Winter Fireworks** (冬の花火, Fuyu no Hanabi) - *Ribon Comic*, February 1971
- **The Flying Box That Couldn't Fly** (跳べないとび箱, Tobenai Tobi Hako) - *Ribon*, May 1971

Vol 2:
- **This Side of the Rape Blossom Field** (菜の花畑のこちらがわ, Nanohana Hatake no Kochiragawa) - *BetsuComi*, November 1975-January 1976
- **Little Brother** (おとうと, Otouto) - *COM*, September 1969
- **A Letter from Uraguay** (ウルグアイからの手紙, Uraguay kara no Tegami) - *Funny*, May 1973
- **My Big Sis's Marriage** (おねえさんの結婚, Oneesan no Kekkon) - *CO

title: Tanabata Iin: Hoshi ni Negai wo Hen
description: Norie, from an all-girls school, and Yoshio, from an all-boys, wind up on the Star Festival Committees for their respective schools.

title: Tenko-sama no Dekiai Konintan
description:
Machida Rei lost her parents at a young age and was bullied by her aunt and uncle and her twin sister. She often dreams of herself in a hakama, sewing while thinking of someone, but she never understood what these dreams meant... One day, after being hurt by her sister's fiance and having her mother's keepsake broken, Rei runs away from home and heads to Kitsunozaka Shrine. There, she hums a tune she heard in her dream, and Aoi, the head of the Kitsunozaka family, appears as if guided! He saved people during the great earthquake 100 years ago and is worshipped as "Tenko-sama," and even now he continues to wait for the reincarnation of his one and only "soulmate."

This is the Cinderella story of a girl guided by fate, with a dramatic reversal of events!

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title: Three-Point Line of Love
description:
I let you see how willful and badtempered I am when we first met each other... Did you hate me? Everyone has a person that they want to protect. Xia Zhi, who's that person for you?

[Official English: Season 2](https://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/Three-Point-Line-Of-Love-S2/655464918c252b0e2249ab04)

title: Come on First Love!
description:
(from ebookjapan) 

Katsura Kamimura has met her two first loves, Jo Igarashi and Hiroshi Tsuda. Katsura once decided to get engaged to Tsuda, but she is drawn by Jo's strong love and decides to live with him. However, as she chooses one love and nurtures it, she cannot help but hurt those around her. This eternal coming-of-age manga vividly depicts 15-year-old Katsura as she grows up and experiences love as an young lady.

title: Kimi no Iru Basho - Real x Fake
description:
From Osuwari Team:  
  
Mitsuha is sick of her stupid friends and boring school life. All she wants is to be left in peace. One day by mistake she becomes penpals with Haru, whom she doesn't know at all. Only with him can she be honest. There's one guy in Mitsuha's school who's just the way Mitsuha would like to be - cool, a little scary and above all - alone. One day she meets him in a bus… What will happen next?  
  
*NOTE: The mangaka, YAMAMOTO Keiko, decided not to draw for this manga series anymore after it went on a hiatus since the seventh issue of the Margaret magazine. Another mangaka, NAGI Michiko, will continue this manga.

title: Hatsukoi Wa Kimi Gai!
description: One rainy day, high school girl Yuzu was riding a train shrouded in damp air. When she reached out to help a boy looking unwell on the station platform, he fell in love with her scent!? What's more, he was Taisei-kun from her own class, and from that moment on, he aggressively pursued her every day, declaring, “You're my destined one!”...!? An omnibus love story packed with “the moment your first love comes true” begins!

title: Sanada Mei Wa Aidoru No Uso o Shinjiteru
description: Mei Sanada, a university student blessed with overwhelming beauty. Because of her looks, she draws unwanted attention and inevitably lingers in people’s memories; she’s lost count of how many times she’s been scouted. Though Mei harbors a strong dislike for the entertainment world, there is one thing she has always held onto—her faith in “the lie of a certain idol.”

title: Shunrai to Noise
description:
Suzu tried to lay low to avoid being linked to her flashy and popular older brother. However, once her identity as his little sister was revealed, her peaceful high school life came crashing down — she was thrust into the popular crowd, who fawned over her and tried to use her to get to her brother. To make matters worse, she was attacked by a delinquent who harbored a grudge against her brother. The one who saved Suzu from the attack was Hata, her brother's friend — exactly the kind of person she wanted to avoid. Even though she’s “just my friend’s little sister,” Hata somehow takes an interest in Suzu. Thanks to his forceful kindness, Suzu’s world gradually begins to take on a life of her own—

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

title: Hatsutomo
