description: 大井あさひは転校続きの高校1年生。今度こそ親友を作ろうと思っていたのに、いきなり期末テストのクラス競争で足を引っ張る大ピンチ！　風邪を引いた病み上がりの大井は、保健室でテストを受けることになったけれど、そこには片瀬という男子生徒もいて……？　親友ができない“よそ者女子”の青春ラブストーリー！

title: Bara no Seikon
description: Everything changes for Hiiro when a "special guy" appears out of the blue!

title: JK o Hirotta To, Omottadesho?
description: 寒空の下、路頭に迷う女子高生を放っておけず自宅に保護した黒瀬。大人として彼女に一目ぼれしたことは何としても隠し通してみせる！ 一方、女子高生のほうにも秘密があるようで…⁉ 騙し騙され☆駆け引きラブコメ！

title: 5 Yarder
description:
(from ebookjapan):

Here at Yamato High School, the four sports clubs of the Sumo, Rugby, Baseball, and Track & Field clubs are engaged in a daily battle to take the field. In the midst of all this, the main character Tsubasa Washizume shows up to start up the American Football club. Tsubasa, who has just transferred to his new school, challenges the captains of the four athletic teams to a football game and defeats them one by one. 

The four defeated players are forced to join the football team, and training with the five members begins that day. The missing members were reinforced from other sports clubs, and finally 11 members joined the team. The Yamato High School football team's battle of sweat and tears now begins!　

This work is the same as the one distributed by other publishers in the past. Please be careful not to purchase more than one copy!

title: Yoake Madeha Kokoniite
description:
It takes two hours to get to high school. She has only two classmates. Hana lives deep in the countryside, and her first neighbor is a handsome guy from Tokyo, but actually.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title: Countryside General
description:
(from mangapedia):

Kaze Ozaemon, who lives in Aomori, is the strongest boy in his village, able to throw even a rampaging bear with his bare hands. Surrounded by animals, Ozaemon lives a peaceful life until one day he is suddenly visited by Yagoro Ohkaki, a close friend of his late father, Jinzaemon. He tells Ozaemon to come to Tokyo to fulfill a promise he made to Jinzaemon, but Ozaemon, who loves the village, refuses to go to Tokyo.

He challenges Ozaemon, who says he is the strongest man in the village and has never been beaten by anyone, to a match. Yagoro easily throws Ozaemon to the ground with judo techniques, and tells Ozaemon that he is a frog in a well, and encourages him to go out into the world and experience more things. Impressed by Yagoro's words, Ozaemon vows to become a superstar and decides to go to Tokyo.

---
- **Won the 14th Shogakukan Manga Award in 1968, which it shared with Kawasaki's other serial Animal 1**

title: Love Pop
description:
From Sensation Scans:  
  
Soda and Sukhee have known each other since they were little. Soda was the "hero" of the local kids, famous for her flying-chicken attack. While Sukhee was the new kid in town who tried to take over the playground and ended up getting a good beating from Soda. What really is the fate between these two as Sukhee challenge Soda to a fight each and everyday?

title: Tea Time ni Mahou Wokakete
description:
Nina Shinkai is a shy high school freshman. She has been frequenting the cafe Torigo ever since she was cheered up by the lovely smiling staff member Kurosu-san. One day, she is invited to work there part-time, and discovers the true face of her much-admired Kurosu-san...?

The bittersweet cafe story is about to begin!

Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

title: Caustics ni Todoku Koi
description: This is a fictional BL story about a kind high school boy whose best asset is his energy, and another high school boy who has a lung disease that makes life difficult.

title: Happy Chokuzen
description:
Mizuki has been hired to be the private tutor of Naomae kun, one of the worst student of his class.... Naomae kun is not only lazy, but is pretty much incredibly negative when facing academic studies, fact which prompts the serious Mizuki to be very diligent when dealing with Naomae's classes.

Naomae is not only a bad student, but also is a little bit of a prankster, so he really isn't easy to tame when it comes right down to it.... And before she notices it, the relationship between the two has this very strange chemistry that can't be easily explained.

Naomae, for his part; is quick to fall for Mizuki, and suddenly his goal changes from "getting into the best high-school" to "going to the same high-school that Mizuki", while the high-school is actually the same for those two objectives, Naomae seems to take the second phrasing of his goal much more seriously.... Yet not seriously enough.

title: Goei Kareshi no Ura Omote
description:
Nagi Shiratori is the only daughter of a large company, the Shiratori Group, she is feared because of her family background and is looked away from by her classmates. One day, however, she is suddenly asked by a stranger, a male student, to become “engaged” to him, and Nagi is perplexed. She is rescued by a beautiful young man named Rei Kuroshima, who for some reason claims to be “Nagi's boyfriend” even though they have never met before. In fact, Kuroshima says that he was sent as a guard to protect Nagi from those who are after her fiancé. In order to avoid being targeted by others, the two pretend to be friendly “lovers” at school! On the outside, Kuroshima plays the role of a sweet boyfriend, and on the inside, he teases the confused Nagi. However, behind the scenes, Kuroshima is hiding his growing feelings for Nagi!

A high tension reversible love comedy where love starts from a lie!

title: General Acorn
description:
(from ebookjapan):

On the border of Nagano and Niigata prefectures, there is a village nestled between mountains. This village, known as Dongurimura, is a small, tiny village with only one bus service per day. 

Ichiban Todoroki is a fifth grader at an elementary school with a total of only 28 students, and he sprawls out in the great outdoors every day. 

Noboru Kawasaki's heartwarming gag manga unfolds in this peaceful village.

title: Bitter na Kokuin
description: A high school girl has a secret relationship with the school's infirmary sensei, whom she has history with.

title: Okubyou na Yubisaki
description: Hashibami recently lost his older brother, Isao, to a tragic traffic accident. Though he pretends he doesn't care, deep down he is greatly hurt by it. He meets Ashino, a charming student who goes to the same school as he does. He later finds out that Ashino is connected to his brother Isao. What is his connection to Isao? Why is it bothering Hashibami so much?

title: VSCANDAL
description: Karina, who has a double life as an honor student and a famous VTuber, receives a threat that can ruin her reputation. And she intends to protect them at all costs!

title: Natural Kids
description:
From Boku-Tachi:  
  
Kaoru thought that high school was boring. And then he met Kaname and Yuta. Kaname and Yuta are trying to start "The Creator's Club", a club with creation of all sorts of unusual inventions as its aim. The club's formation is opposed by Kaoru's reticence to make up numbers, and the school council president's obstinate nature. With the aid of hard work, cheeriness, and sheep, Kaname, Yuta, and a somewhat bemused Kaoru set about changing her mind.

title: 9 Banme no Musashi - Silent Black
description:
Behold the activities of the coolest woman in the world, Musashi! What is the mysterious organization UB, which runs the world's history from the shadows and is also known as the "United Nations of Darkness"? 
Musashi is an elite member of UB with overwhelming beauty and strength. The latest in the "9th Musashi" series about her exploits! She travels around the world, but this time she takes a vacation for her boyfriend, Shingo Tachibana, where she meets Keita, the boy who tried to attack the embassy...?

title: Not You, Not Today
description: A high school confession to a very popular girl goes in an unexpected way

title: For the Elite
description: Baek Yu-jin, once a piano prodigy, suddenly finds herself living in a shelter as a runaway teen. As if the pressure of preparing for music college entrance exams isn’t enough, guys she wants nothing to do with keep getting involved…

title: Ayakashi Koikoi Crisis
description:
"Make me a boyfriend or anything right away, and set me free!" Izumi Kanzaki (Isumi Kanzaki) is a high school girl who is looking for a highly acclaimed boyfriend! I confessed to a boy with a pulse, but for some reason he was rejected and is breaking the record for heartbreak...(crying). 

In the midst of such youth, Izumi's life changes completely after his birthday. A terrifying monster was able to be seen, and what appeared in front of Izumi Sumi, who was about to be eaten... Red-haired demon!? The demon Koji, who was sealed in Izumisumi's prayer beads, had no choice but to protect Izumisumi in order to gain freedom. The key to breaking the seal is to make a boyfriend to Sumi < Izumi>?

A JK who wants to get freedom and wants to make a boyfriend. Now that their interests have coincided, the story of the two begins - an innocent romantic comedy × gag!

title: Shining!
description:
A success love story that makes dreams come true

Nene Daikon, 10 years old
An elementary school student who just enjoys every day to the fullest.
I love my friends and school.
However, “How do I find my dreams?”
I have doubts about the future. One day, Nene has a fateful encounter with Takito Taki,
a very popular actor. This encounter leads Nene to the door to the entertainment world,
a world she never imagined. A successful love story of a girl who believes in herself and pursues her dreams and love. A popular work with heart-touching words that will fill you with energy when you read it!

title: Kizoku Gakuen no Fubunritsu: Aru Koushaku Reijou-sama ga Dance Party de Konyaku o Haki Sareta Riyuu
description:
"In the Western Kingdom's aristocratic academy, there are countless unwritten rules."

During a dance party, the Marquis's daughter is told her engagement is broken off. Everyone acknowledged the closeness of the two, so there must be a reason for such a cruel rejection... However, Carol de la Cassata, the person at the center of the turmoil, has no idea why the engagement is being broken off. So, she decides to seek the wisdom of the student council secretary, who is rumored to be skilled at giving advice.

This is a buddy mystery in which a serious commoner secretary and the frivolous prince student council president unravel various incidents that occur at the aristocratic academy.
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/s9769j/)

title: Red Rose for a Blue Boyfriend
description: Ryutaro Otaka, a handsome high school student with a bright mind, good at sports, and a cheerful personality, has a hobby that no one should know about. That's...a girls' manga! A heart-pounding (?) comedy about Ryutaro, who truly loves girls' manga such as Kuramochi◯Sako, Iwadate◯Riko, and Tabuchi Yu◯ko. Also included is Yoko Gendai's professional debut work "191/2 (Nineteen Half)'', and the heartbreak comedy "Harubaru Hakodate♡'' about the ugly main character Ecchan, who is the first girl's manga (!?), and many other energetic early works!

title: Shoki Renai Tan Henshu Jokan - Senpai To Koisuru Aka Oni-Kun -
description: 初期の恋愛短編を４本収録。「先輩と恋する赤鬼くん」園芸部の友野は調理部の部長に憧れる恋する男の子。叶わぬ恋と知りながら今日も先輩のために野菜を育てているが、ある日調理部に招待されてー…。「１５歳のユウウツ」父親の小さな本屋を手伝うゆかりは、ある日サラリーマン風の男の接客をするが、高校の入学式で再会してー…。「Re:青春プレイ」勉強も将来も諦め気味なまどかは、二十歳の転校生に出会い人生が小さく変わっていくー…。「金曜姫と本とくず」金曜日の図書室はいつも静か。図書委員の姫咲の元にチャラい後輩が突然現れてー…。

title: Yanagi-Kun No Himitsu
description: 存在感が薄い女子高生・一宮和花は、学年が進むにつれてますます影が薄くなっていることが目下の悩み。自分とは正反対にいつも周りに囲まれているクールな男子・柳愁一のことが密かに憧れだったけど、遠くから見つめるばかり…。そんなある日、下校中に柳くんの弟・遥をそうとは知らずに助けてから思わぬ事態に巻き込まれ！？癒されほっこり＆キュンな内緒の関係、スタートです！

title: Our Timid First Kiss
description:
I'll never let you go. My first kiss with him was a sweet sensation but also left a bitter aftertaste...

Note: Volumes combine several chapters into one and change it to page form, there are 4 volumes and 7 chapters total.

title: Shirikodama
description:
"Special news on marriage hunting! There is bound to be hot single kappa near you, and you too can open the door to a dazzling interspecies marriage!"

Kawataro is a handsome young Kappa who is looking for a beautiful wife, and for his search, he leaves the water and starts looking for a potential mate in the local High School Yōkai Club!

A love square romantic horror comedy!

title: Boku ga Kimi o Kaeru
description: Nako is a shy and introverted high school girl, but her boyfriend is a fresh and handsome guy who is popular among the students in her grade. Nako is humiliated by the negative comments she hears around her, but for some reason, Shinobu Midou, one of the "Midou Brothers" known for their beauty, decides to give her a makeover.

title: School Treasure Island
description: Author's Umino Tsunami first serialized work. Includes two other stories: "Shounen Shoujo Boyoyon Mukokuseki Katsugeki - 21 Seiki Touzoku-dan" and "Birthday Girl".

title: My Childhood Friend Wags His Tail
Koyamasou no Kiraware Mono
description:
When his father is transferred to America for business Shougo decides to stay behind. His father arranges for him to stay in an apartment managed by a friend. But it’s not really an apartment but actually a room in an over-sized house, and there are others staying there as well…

(from mangaupdates)

title: Virgo and the Sparklings: Official Movie Companion
description:
Riani, a high school girl who has the ability to see the color of voice and sound and emits sparks from her body. Riani is considered freak by her friends and is ostracized, so she is forced to move from school to school. Riani’s dream for a normal life at her newest school ed when her new friend invites her to join a band… what will happen to Riani?

(Source: BumiLangit)

title: I Will Steal Her, My First Love!
description:
My first love from six years ago, Im Nareem, and my best friend of 13 years, Lee Riun, are getting married. 

Everything was perfect for the groom, Lee Riun, but he suddenly leaves Nareem behind, and Taeshin and Nareem find themselves thrown back six years into the past!

title: Oshiete, Natsu.
description: Akino is depressed, why can't she talk to Nacchan like before? And now, he wants to teach her how to dance. What to do?

title: High School Bold Legend - Performance Iwajiro
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Iwajiro is an out-of-control high school student. He rides around on his moped and ponders the meaning of youth, but when he sees a woman, he repeatedly asks her, "Let me do you." He is unable to lose his virginity and struggles with his power. What kind of *performance* does Iwajiro give?

title: Hana wo Kotori wo Suki Sugiru
description: は、明るい普通の女子高生・山田ことりと、彼女を取り巻く美しい友人たちを描いた学園ラブロマンス。赤いバラのように可憐な幼なじみ・椿姫（つばき）や学年の王子様・煌臣（あきおみ）と仲の良いことりは、2人の輝きに挟まれいつも影が薄くなってしまう。ある日、煌臣が告白されている場面に遭遇したことり。彼に思い人がいることを知り、きっとその相手は椿姫のことだろうと思い込むが、実は煌臣はことりに好意を持っていて……。

title: Scrap School
description: Mia Nekoyama is a beautiful girl, but has little interest in her surroundings and is very troublesome. Scrap Gakuen depicts the bizarre and incoherent school life she leads with strange and peculiar characters.

title: Piyo Piyo Clinic
description: Mao has a crush on Yamashita-kun, who goes to the same cram school. Yamashita-kun was in love with his best friend Miyuki, even though she was so determined to confess to him. However, one week later, something strange happens!? A large number of chicks that other people can't see appear around Masakura!!

title: No Programmer Can Be So Cute!
description: Forced to disguise herself as a man, she was on a road to becoming a elite programmer. A comedy about her daily life with her programmer colleagues and a cold blooded CEO.

title: Akane Snow Song
description:
(from ebookjapan):

This is a story of a sweet Ainu girl, Machi, who lives in Hidaka, Hokkaido, and her pony, full of the spirit of travel.

title: Kaibou
description:
During a biology class at school, a live frog was dissected. Manami, a high school girl who is not good at dissections, accidentally stabbed the frog's heart and killed it...! After that, Manami began to be attacked by strange phenomena. As Manami shuts herself in her room in fear, a teacher with a creepy smile appears before her...!? A collection of six short tales of bloody terror by splatter master Kaburagi Saiko. (Kaburagi Baku & Natsuki Hiura)

◆Contains◆

1: The Dissection [解剖• Horror House, 12/1987] 
2: A Burial [喰葬 • Pandora, 07/1988]
3: Husbandry [飼育 • Pandora, 08/1988]
4: The Living Rot [生き腐れ • Horror House, 03/1988]
5: The Confession [告白 • Pandora, 07/1987]
6: The Portrait of Dionne Colbert [ディオンヌ・コルベールの肖像 • Solitaire, 12/1986]

*6 is Kaburagi Saiko's debut work

title: Sisyphus at Peace
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Naruse sees a woman he met by chance on the subway and witnesses her pushing a man in front of her! Together with his best friends, Fujihiko Hayami and Junko Nara, he begins to investigate her background... This is the first of Riyoko Ikeda's suspense drama masterpiece!

title: Aoharu Ale
description: 人と距離を置きたいギャルの聖奈にやたら構ってくる藤城先輩。チャラそうなのに意外と真面目な先輩の言動に、だんだん心がほぐれていく聖奈だけど･･･？

title: Ochikobore Shokanshi to Yami no Seirei
description: 「あなたが運命を選び取るの――」幼い頃に魔力を高く評価され、召喚士の学園に迎えられた少女・ルノエ。しかし何年経っても成果を出せず生徒だけではなく教師からも「落ちこぼれ」と揶揄されるようになっていった。胸に秘めた想いを隠しながらも卒業という名の学園追放を免れる為ルノエは最後の召喚の儀に挑む。そこでルノエと契約を結んだのは名を持たぬ精霊で……？契約と魔法。呪いに謀略。想いが交錯する王道ファンタジー

title: Wastepaper Terminal
description: This is a room that paper airplanes filled with various wishes fly to. The boy always watches the destination of people's wishes in this room. Then, a certain girl appears in front of him…

title: Love Stories From Some Time Ago - Nami Saso Short Stories and Essay Manga
description:
(from ebookjapan):
A collection of short stories by Nami Sasou of "Roses are Born on the Battlefield" including her previous original works on the theme of "love" and newly done essay manga about her own love (!). They're stories of various kinds of "love" that can be depicted only in "shoujo manga"...  Enjoy the "Showa-era youth" with sweet and sour crushes scattered throughout!　The feeling of being in love is a treasure, now and in the past!

title: Boys United
description:
(from ebookjapan):
Wickedness infests the world. War, murder, racism, corruption ....... It is created by adults. Therefore, only boys can fight against wickedness. The boy warriors chosen to bring peace back to the world, they are the comrades of "Boys United"! Comrade Kazeta was chosen as a representative of ---- Japan and passed the test. With his partner, Comrade Eliza, he spends his time training. One day, during training on an isolated island, a mysterious group of people appear and ......? The "Asahi Shogakusei Shinbun" edition begins!

title: Hey, Rob the Cradle!
description: She had gone from being a Princess to Cinderella in a single night. She had no choice but to step on the arduous journey to seek help from her "fiance". How could she have imagined that not only would she be rejected for help, she didn't even meet him. What’s more, she accidentally met her fiance's uncle and fell into a forbidden love all of a sudden?!

title: Love Virus
description:
From Konnichiwa:  
Suh Yeon Oong, a laid back guy. Has a broken family and now living with his father. Is a spunky chick-boy type of guy that easily wins hearts of girls..until he saw another fine looking gal named Daji. Meanwhile, another person appeared into Suh Yeon's life which was his childhood enemy/friend. Who is that girl? And why can't he remember her?

title: Jinchouge
description:
A collection of one-shots. In addition to the title story, includes:
- **Jinchouge** (沈丁花)
- **Cold Spring** (寒い春, Samui Haru)
- **That Person is Now...** (あの人はいま…, Ano Hito wa Ima...)
- **A Stardust Fairy Tale** (星くずのメルヘン, Hoshikuzu no Marchen)
- **Portrait of Francesca** (フランチェスカの肖像, Francesca no Shouzou)
- **Othello** (オセロー) - Adaptation of Shakespeare's play.

Note: Digital condition just contains title one-shot. Digitally, the title one-shot can also be found in the digital edition for *Early Spring Trembling*.

title: Kuroko no Basket - Sairoku Hon (Doujinshi)
description: Reprinting of several Akashi x Kuroko (and some Kise x Kuroko) doujinshis by Praly/Tsuzuki Saaya.

title: Koukan Uso Nikki
description:
Nozomi Kuroda is in her 2nd year of high school. One day, she finds a letter in a classroom desk. The letter has only the word "like" written on it. The person who wrote the letter is Jun Setoyama. He happens to be the most popular boy at the high school. Nozomi Kuroda feels embarrassed, but she eventually leaves a reply in a shoe closet at school.This is how their secret exchange diary begins. Nozomi Kuroda soon learns that the intended recipient for the first letter was her best friend. Nevertheless, Nozomi Kuroda is attracted to Jun Setoyama, who expresses his thoughts and feelings unlike her. She's unable to tell him the truth that the person exchanging messages is her and not her best friend.


Note: This Manga was adapted for a movie in 2023 with the name 'Our Secret Diary'.

title: Miki Falls
description:
It's spring—a time for new beginnings. This is Miki Yoshida's final year of high school, and she's determined to make this the best year yet. Miki is in control . . . . . . until Hiro Sakurai shows up. The tall, handsome new student is hiding something, and Miki wants to know what. As she breaks down Hiro's defenses, she is unnerved by how much she cares about him. Too bad he is the one guy who can't care for her back. But Miki is falling for Hiro, and nothing's going to stop her from getting close to him—not even his dangerous secret.

(Source: back of book)

title: Oshi No Fansa Ni Koi Wa Shinai
description: 藤本ひまりはLimit.柴田蒼空の大ファン チケットが当選し初ライブ参戦!!ーーーが、推しの引退宣言により大ショック。 放心状態で保健室に向かうと、そこにいたのはー… オタク共感値1000％! 元大人気アイドルと夢キュンなスクールライフが始まる!

title: Kuroko no Basket - Yahari Seishun Suru Nara Nijigen ni Kagiru (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Mayuzumi Chihiro x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: The Unearthly Traveler
description: Following a near-fatal bus accident, high school student Scout Evans finds herself in a strange predicament when she wakes up sharing her body with an alien named Seven. Now bound together for life, the two must learn to coexist, making some otherworldly friends and foes along the way (as well as earthly ones). *Updates every 7th of the month*

title: Gazing at the Sky, from the Bottom of the Earth
description: A mysterious transfer student, Honjo Sei. She has angel wings and devil horns, and is neither male nor female. She is a fallen angel who has incurred the wrath of God and is not allowed to return to heaven...! Will the wandering Sei be able to find the "door to heaven"...?

title: Haru to 100-nin no Darling
description: Spring is the time of year when you find a cool boy and make a fuss over him, but when he confesses his feelings for you he turns out to be “creepy”. You are sure to be in love with good-looking boys around you, but when you get to know them, they become a disappointment. Will there be a great turnaround in spring love?

title: Black Jack (Official Colored)
description: 全ページを新たにカラー化した特別編集版！　闇の天才外科医・ブラック・ジャックの活躍をカラーでお楽しみください。

title: Yan Lu Guang Tao Pao
description:
A-chun and Xiaobo have always been friends. But…why are they just friends?  
  
Not rated for older shoujo readers.

title: Ohi-sama no Shita no Luna
description: In Hanamori Town, there are "magicians" who have a great magical power by nature, and "guides" who support half-beasts as wizards. Luna, the heroine, is a human being who has no magical powers even though she is born as a guide child. Still, I was attending a magic school with the dream of becoming a guide for Yokai, a childhood friend who is a wizard.

title: Sakura-sensei no Scenario Doori
description:
Konoka is a serious girl who is shy when it comes to love. But one day, she is shocked to find out that the author of the popular, slightly erotic shoujo manga "Ijiwaru Cherry" is the refreshingly handsome Kikuta from her class! What's more, when Kikuta gets injured while trying to save her, she is forced to help him with his secret job.

A surprisingly pure first love story between a serious girl and a handsome manga artist!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ai No Bekutoru Ga Bagutteru!
description: 春。高校の入学式。早々にイケメンで学校の話題をかっさらった1年生がいるらしい…。 という話を友達から聞いてもいまいちピンとこない3年の森部ほのかだったが、とある偶然から何故か噂のイケメン1年生・宮古瞬に好かれ、出会ってすぐ抱きしめられてしまう！ 実は幼い頃に二人は仲良しだった過去が判明するが、たかがそれだけで…と思っていたところ、宮古君のラブアピールはどんどん過剰になっていき…⁉︎ え、これって普通…⁉︎ 宮古君のピュアすぎて癖強な愛情に、振り回されちゃうラブコメディ♡

title: Sarutobi Ecchan
description:
(from ebookjapan):
A funny transfer student, Etsuko Sarutobi, has arrived at Miko and Momo's elementary school! Etsuko is very nimble and strong, and she is able to fend off pranks from a group of rambunctious kids with her mysterious powers, and before you know it, she is popular throughout the school! Miko, Momo, and Ecchan are three good friends in this slapstick everyday comedy! This is a collection of the serialized story "The Odd, Odd, Odd, Odd Girl" (Okashina Okashina Okashina Anoko) from "Weekly Margaret" with a new title.

title: Yuu & You
description: An energetic girl, Yu, is in her first year of junior high school. Yuu, a childhood friend I met for the first time in a long time, seems to have grown taller, and his atmosphere is very different from when he was in elementary school. He became a very concerned person... And if you think! I was a child inside! Playing around and being insensitive, Yu keeps being swayed by Isamu. Even so, Isamu is brave enough to think about Yu, and Yu is Yu, and says things that annoy Yuu... Ah, huh? Which "Yu" said the line "date with YOU"? Anyway, I'm sure you'll enjoy reading it from either side, girl or boy!

title: Rosairo Eleven
description: This is a rose garden girls' school where the motto is clean, tidy, and pure. For some reason, only 11 male students have entered this high school of beautiful maidens! ! Actually, this was collected by the principal's wish to become the best soccer player in Japan and to realize coeducation. That's why Masaru Saka and other boys who love soccer entered the school. Eleven of the soccer club started practicing with the aim of conquering the whole country while causing ripples in the maiden's garden. But Captain Saka and Miss Rose Garden...!?

title: Pechako-chan
description:
(from ebookjapan):

This is an ebook reprint of the fantastic masterpiece manga "Pechako-chan," which was serialized in " First Grader's Magazine" (Shogakukan) from 1968 to 1977. The main character's name is Takako Hana-no-Takako, but her name is Hana-Pecha, so "Pechako-chan" is a bright, active, girl who's a bit chubby in the first grade of elementary school. 

This is a heartwarming and relaxing work depicting the happy days of Pechako-chan, her cute little sister "Mamitan," the people in Hana's family, her boyfriend "Itchan" who's slightly precocious, and their friends. 

The mangaka is Yoko Imamura, a pioneer in shojo manga. Her works, which depicts children's daily life with a heartwarming and lively touch, have been serialized in "Weekly Margaret" (Shueisha) from 1964 to 1967, and gained immense popularity, winning the 6th Kodansha Children's Manga Award in 1965.

title: Choremates
description:
Four wild roommates struggle to live together in college life without losing their minds. Markus, a perfectionist clean freak, constantly seeks war with Jess, a lazy romance drama binge watcher who avoids chores like her life depends on it. Their friends, Leo the video game geek and Tina the playful, wild, insane friend, try (or fail) to keep peace as chaos erupts.

Behind those arguments, four of those roommates hide personal issues they’d somewhat ignore until living together forces them to grow and mature as they enter adult life.

title: 1-Byou Saki wa, Koi
description:
Usawa had a dull middle school life, but one day she falls in love with a tough, hard-nosed guy.

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title: Junjou Crazy Fruits Zoku Hen
description:
Miyoko just can't get enough of Odajima-sensei, but he's gone off to America. One day, however, she finds out he's coming back! Tenacity is key! 

Won the 12th Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo in 1988.

title: Koisuru Kaicho wa Mendokusai
description:
Suou is the perfect student council president, handsome, academically gifted, and athletically talented—everyone admires him. However, he has a hidden side: his approach to the secretary, Nagi, is heavy and annoying! Despite Nagi's cold and dismissive responses, the president relentlessly pursues her.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
